optionsEn: Vortex-induced vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds.
Choosing the best paint is enough for steel to last 120 years at sea.
Under full restraint the shrinkage tensile stress is σ = E_eff·ε_sh.
quiz.explanation: 完全受約束時收縮拉應力 σ = E_eff·ε_sh，取 E_c = 34 GPa、潛變係數 φ = 2，E_eff = 34/(1+2) ≈ 11.3 GPa，收縮應變 300×10⁻⁶：σ ≈ 11,333×300×10⁻⁶ ≈ 3.4 MPa，已高於約 3 MPa 的混凝土抗拉強度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Under full restraint the shrinkage tensile stress is σ = E_eff·ε_sh; with E_c = 34 GPa and creep coefficient φ = 2, E_eff = 34/(1+2) ≈ 11.3 GPa, and with a shrinkage strain of 300×10⁻⁶, σ ≈ 11,333×300×10⁻⁶ ≈ 3.4 MPa, above a concrete tensile strength of about 3 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 淺水區組合梁與橋面板收縮：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Composite girders and deck shrinkage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼—混凝土組合梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel–concrete composite girders” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段與長期分析計算收縮、潛變與負彎矩區的橋面板應力，並以預力或配筋控制裂縫寬度；現場量測橋面板齡期、剪力釘焊接品質（彎曲試驗抽驗）與裂縫寬度，與設計限值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute deck stresses from shrinkage, creep and hogging moments in staged and long-term analyses, controlling crack width by prestress or reinforcement; on site record panel age at connection, check stud welds by bend tests on a sample, and measure crack widths against design limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工規範應規定橋面板最短存放齡期、負彎矩區的澆置或結合順序與裂縫寬度允收值；剪力釘焊接設程序評定與每日開工試焊，結果列入檢驗紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should set a minimum storage age for deck panels, the casting or connection sequence in hogging zones and crack-width acceptance limits; stud welding needs procedure qualification and daily trial welds, recorded in the inspection file.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若橋面板在新澆後立即與鋼梁結合，收縮受約束而在負彎矩區形成橫向貫穿裂縫，海風鹽分沿裂縫進入，鋼筋與剪力釘腐蝕；剪力釘焊接不良則使組合作用下降、撓度增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Making the deck composite immediately after casting restrains shrinkage and forms full-depth transverse cracks in hogging zones, through which salt-laden sea air reaches reinforcement and studs; poor stud welds reduce composite action and increase deflection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段與長期分析計算收縮、潛變與負彎矩區的橋面板應力，並以預力或配筋控制裂縫寬度；現場量測橋面板齡期、剪力釘焊接品質（彎曲試驗抽驗）與裂縫寬度，與設計限值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Compute deck stresses from shrinkage, creep and hogging moments in staged and long-term analyses, controlling crack width by prestress or reinforcement; on site record panel age at connection, check stud welds by bend tests on a sample, and measure crack widths against design limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工規範應規定橋面板最短存放齡期、負彎矩區的澆置或結合順序與裂縫寬度允收值；剪力釘焊接設程序評定與每日開工試焊，結果列入檢驗紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should set a minimum storage age for deck panels, the casting or connection sequence in hogging zones and crack-width acceptance limits; stud welding needs procedure qualification and daily trial welds, recorded in the inspection file.

quiz.question: 要驗證「淺水區組合梁與橋面板收縮」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Composite girders and deck shrinkage"?
options: 以施工階段與長期分析計算收縮、潛變與負彎矩區的橋面板應力，並以預力或配筋控制裂縫寬度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
設計壽命從 100 年改為 120 年，只是把數字改大，不影響設計參數。
optionsEn: Compute deck stresses from shrinkage, creep and hogging moments in staged and long-term analyses, controlling crack width by prestress or reinforcement.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Moving the design life from 100 to 120 years only changes a number and leaves design parameters unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段與長期分析計算收縮、潛變與負彎矩區的橋面板應力，並以預力或配筋控制裂縫寬度；現場量測橋面板齡期、剪力釘焊接品質（彎曲試驗抽驗）與裂縫寬度，與設計限值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute deck stresses from shrinkage, creep and hogging moments in staged and long-term analyses, controlling crack width by prestress or reinforcement; on site record panel age at connection, check stud welds by bend tests on a sample, and measure crack widths against design limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 淺水區組合梁與橋面板收縮：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Composite girders and deck shrinkage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼—混凝土組合梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steel–concrete composite girders” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若橋面板在新澆後立即與鋼梁結合，收縮受約束而在負彎矩區形成橫向貫穿裂縫，海風鹽分沿裂縫進入，鋼筋與剪力釘腐蝕；剪力釘焊接不良則使組合作用下降、撓度增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Making the deck composite immediately after casting restrains shrinkage and forms full-depth transverse cracks in hogging zones, through which salt-laden sea air reaches reinforcement and studs; poor stud welds reduce composite action and increase deflection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：組合梁的關鍵在於混凝土收縮與潛變：混凝土板想縮短，卻被剪力釘與鋼梁約束，於是板中產生拉應力、鋼梁產生壓應力；連續梁中間支點的負彎矩又讓橋面板受拉，若不控制就會開裂並讓鹽分滲入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The key is concrete shrinkage and creep: the slab wants to shorten but is restrained by studs and steel, so the slab goes into tension and the steel into compression; hogging moments over interior supports of a continuous girder also put the deck in tension, and uncontrolled cracking lets chlorides in.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「組合梁中的混凝土橋面板只受壓，不需要擔心裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The concrete deck of a composite girder is always in compression, so cracking is no concern." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若橋面板在新澆後立即與鋼梁結合，收縮受約束而在負彎矩區形成橫向貫穿裂縫，海風鹽分沿裂縫進入，鋼筋與剪力釘腐蝕；剪力釘焊接不良則使組合作用下降、撓度增加。
knowledge.textEn: Making the deck composite immediately after casting restrains shrinkage and forms full-depth transverse cracks in hogging zones, through which salt-laden sea air reaches reinforcement and studs; poor stud welds reduce composite action and increase deflection.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「淺水區組合梁與橋面板收縮」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Composite girders and deck shrinkage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若橋面板在新澆後立即與鋼梁結合，收縮受約束而在負彎矩區形成橫向貫穿裂縫，海風鹽分沿裂縫進入，鋼筋與剪力釘腐蝕；剪力釘焊接不良則使組合作用下降、撓度增加。
構件做得越大越重，施工風險就越低。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Making the deck composite immediately after casting restrains shrinkage and forms full-depth transverse cracks in hogging zones, through which salt-laden sea air reaches reinforcement and studs.
The bigger and heavier the prefabricated pieces, the lower the construction risk.
quiz.explanation: 若橋面板在新澆後立即與鋼梁結合，收縮受約束而在負彎矩區形成橫向貫穿裂縫，海風鹽分沿裂縫進入，鋼筋與剪力釘腐蝕；剪力釘焊接不良則使組合作用下降、撓度增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Making the deck composite immediately after casting restrains shrinkage and forms full-depth transverse cracks in hogging zones, through which salt-laden sea air reaches reinforcement and studs; poor stud welds reduce composite action and increase deflection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「大型構件的整體吊裝」與「颱風季施工風險與工法變更」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Single-piece lifts of large components" and "Typhoon-season risk and a method change": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 大型構件的整體吊裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Single-piece lifts of large components: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「整體吊裝鋼塔」如何影響港珠澳大橋橋梁段的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Single-lift steel tower” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: bridge works”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 港珠澳大橋大量把構件做大、做重，在工廠或預製場完成後一次吊裝，以減少海上作業時間與颱風暴露。公開報導記載江海直達船航道橋的海豚形鋼塔高約 105 公尺，第一座塔吊裝總重約 3,100 公噸，由大型浮吊整體吊起再旋轉就位；鋼箱梁與組合梁也以整孔或大節段吊裝。整體吊裝把風險集中在少數幾次關鍵作業：構件重量與重心、吊點與吊具、浮吊的穩定與海象，任何一項誤差都會直接影響安全。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「整體吊裝鋼塔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The project made components larger and heavier, completing them in factories or yards and lifting them in one piece to cut time at sea and typhoon exposure. Reports record the Jianghai Channel Bridge's dolphin-shaped steel towers at about 105 m tall, with the first tower lifted at about 3,100 t by large floating cranes and rotated into position; steel box and composite girders were likewise lifted as full spans or large segments. Single-piece lifting concentrates risk in a few critical operations: weight and centre of gravity, lifting points and rigging, crane stability and sea state, and an error in any one bears directly on safety. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Single-lift steel tower” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 3,100 t lift with a dynamic factor of 1.10 plus 150 t of rigging, the design load is 3,100×1.10 + 150 = 3,560 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「構件做得越大越重，施工風險就越低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The bigger and heavier the prefabricated pieces, the lower the construction risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「整體吊裝鋼塔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Single-lift steel tower”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 大型構件的整體吊裝
knowledge.text: 港珠澳大橋大量把構件做大、做重，在工廠或預製場完成後一次吊裝，以減少海上作業時間與颱風暴露。公開報導記載江海直達船航道橋的海豚形鋼塔高約 105 公尺，第一座塔吊裝總重約 3,100 公噸，由大型浮吊整體吊起再旋轉就位；鋼箱梁與組合梁也以整孔或大節段吊裝。
knowledge.textEn: The project made components larger and heavier, completing them in factories or yards and lifting them in one piece to cut time at sea and typhoon exposure. Reports record the Jianghai Channel Bridge's dolphin-shaped steel towers at about 105 m tall, with the first tower lifted at about 3,100 t by large floating cranes and rotated into position; steel box and composite girders were likewise lifted as full spans or large segments.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：構件做得越大越重，施工風險就越低。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The bigger and heavier the prefabricated pieces, the lower the construction risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「大型構件的整體吊裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Single-piece lifts of large components" is correct?
options: 構件做得越大越重，施工風險就越低。
施工期很短，颱風風險可以用完工後的設計風速涵蓋。
港珠澳大橋大量把構件做大、做重，在工廠或預製場完成後一次吊裝，以減少海上作業時間與颱風暴露。
optionsEn: The bigger and heavier the prefabricated pieces, the lower the construction risk.
Construction is short, so typhoon risk is covered by the design wind for the finished bridge.
The project made components larger and heavier, completing them in factories or yards and lifting them in one piece to cut time at sea and typhoon exposure.
quiz.explanation: 港珠澳大橋大量把構件做大、做重，在工廠或預製場完成後一次吊裝，以減少海上作業時間與颱風暴露。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The project made components larger and heavier, completing them in factories or yards and lifting them in one piece to cut time at sea and typhoon exposure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 大型構件的整體吊裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Single-piece lifts of large components: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「整體吊裝鋼塔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Single-lift steel tower” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：吊重 3,100 t，動態放大係數 1.10，再加吊具 150 t：設計吊重 = 3,100×1.10 + 150 = 3,560 t。若採用額定 4,000 t 的浮吊組合，利用率 = 3,560/4,000 = 89%；若動態放大升到 1.20，設計吊重 3,870 t，利用率約 97%，幾乎沒有餘裕。吊具重與浮吊能力為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 3,100 t lift with a dynamic factor of 1.10 plus 150 t of rigging, the design load is 3,100×1.10 + 150 = 3,560 t. With floating cranes rated 4,000 t in total, utilisation is 3,560/4,000 = 89%; if the dynamic factor rises to 1.20 the design load becomes 3,870 t and utilisation about 97%, leaving almost no margin. Rigging weight and crane capacity are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：構件出廠前秤重並以三維量測確定重心，吊點焊縫做 100% 無損檢測與荷重試驗；吊裝前依海象預報確認浪高、風速與流速窗口，吊裝中監測各吊鉤荷重與構件姿態，落位後量測塔軸線與底座螺栓位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Weigh components and determine the centre of gravity by 3D survey before leaving the yard, test lifting-lug welds fully by non-destructive methods and proof-load them; before lifting confirm wave, wind and current windows from forecasts, monitor hook loads and attitude during the lift, and survey tower axis and base bolt positions after landing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 吊重 3,100 t，動態放大係數 1.10，再加吊具 150 t：設計吊重 = 3,100×1.10 + 150 = 3,560 t。若採用額定 4,000 t 的浮吊組合，利用率 = 3,560/4,000 = 89%；若動態放大升到 1.20，設計吊重 3,870 t，利用率約 97%，幾乎沒有餘裕。吊具重與浮吊能力為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 3,100 t lift with a dynamic factor of 1.10 plus 150 t of rigging, the design load is 3,100×1.10 + 150 = 3,560 t. With floating cranes rated 4,000 t in total, utilisation is 3,560/4,000 = 89%; if the dynamic factor rises to 1.20 the design load becomes 3,870 t and utilisation about 97%, leaving almost no margin. Rigging weight and crane capacity are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「大型構件的整體吊裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Single-piece lifts of large components", which statement holds?
options: 每個節段都通過自己的允差檢查，組起來就一定沒問題。
感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全，資料自然會告訴我們問題在哪裡。
optionsEn: For a 3,100 t lift with a dynamic factor of 1.10 plus 150 t of rigging, the design load is 3,100×1.10 + 150 = 3,560 t.
If every segment passes its own tolerance check, the assembled unit is bound to fit.
The more sensors installed the safer the bridge, and the data will reveal problems by itself.
quiz.explanation: 吊重 3,100 t，動態放大係數 1.10，再加吊具 150 t：設計吊重 = 3,100×1.10 + 150 = 3,560 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 3,100 t lift with a dynamic factor of 1.10 plus 150 t of rigging, the design load is 3,100×1.10 + 150 = 3,560 t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 大型構件的整體吊裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Single-piece lifts of large components: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「整體吊裝鋼塔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Single-lift steel tower” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 構件出廠前秤重並以三維量測確定重心，吊點焊縫做 100% 無損檢測與荷重試驗；吊裝前依海象預報確認浪高、風速與流速窗口，吊裝中監測各吊鉤荷重與構件姿態，落位後量測塔軸線與底座螺栓位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Weigh components and determine the centre of gravity by 3D survey before leaving the yard, test lifting-lug welds fully by non-destructive methods and proof-load them; before lifting confirm wave, wind and current windows from forecasts, monitor hook loads and attitude during the lift, and survey tower axis and base bolt positions after landing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每次重件吊裝都需專項方案：秤重與重心報告、吊點設計與試驗、浮吊穩定計算、海象門檻與中止準則，並由獨立審查與海事主管機關核准；吊裝當日召開開工會議逐項確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every heavy lift needs a dedicated method statement covering weight and centre-of-gravity reports, lifting-point design and tests, crane stability calculations, metocean limits and abort criteria, approved by an independent checker and the maritime authority, with a pre-lift meeting confirming each item on the day.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重心估計錯誤時，多台浮吊或多吊點受力不均，構件傾斜甚至碰撞；在浪高超限時強行吊裝，動態荷載可能使吊點撕裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wrong centre of gravity loads cranes or lifting points unequally, tilting or even colliding the piece; lifting in excessive waves can tear lifting lugs under dynamic load. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 構件出廠前秤重並以三維量測確定重心，吊點焊縫做 100% 無損檢測與荷重試驗；吊裝前依海象預報確認浪高、風速與流速窗口，吊裝中監測各吊鉤荷重與構件姿態，落位後量測塔軸線與底座螺栓位置。
knowledge.textEn: Weigh components and determine the centre of gravity by 3D survey before leaving the yard, test lifting-lug welds fully by non-destructive methods and proof-load them; before lifting confirm wave, wind and current windows from forecasts, monitor hook loads and attitude during the lift, and survey tower axis and base bolt positions after landing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每次重件吊裝都需專項方案：秤重與重心報告、吊點設計與試驗、浮吊穩定計算、海象門檻與中止準則，並由獨立審查與海事主管機關核准；吊裝當日召開開工會議逐項確認。
knowledge.textEn: Every heavy lift needs a dedicated method statement covering weight and centre-of-gravity reports, lifting-point design and tests, crane stability calculations, metocean limits and abort criteria, approved by an independent checker and the maritime authority, with a pre-lift meeting confirming each item on the day.

quiz.question: 要驗證「大型構件的整體吊裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Single-piece lifts of large components"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
構件出廠前秤重並以三維量測確定重心，吊點焊縫做 100% 無損檢測與荷重試驗。
三塔斜張橋只是把兩座雙塔斜張橋並排，設計方法相同。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Weigh components and determine the centre of gravity by 3D survey before leaving the yard, test lifting-lug welds fully by non-destructive methods and proof-load them.
A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges side by side and is designed the same way.
quiz.explanation: 構件出廠前秤重並以三維量測確定重心，吊點焊縫做 100% 無損檢測與荷重試驗；吊裝前依海象預報確認浪高、風速與流速窗口，吊裝中監測各吊鉤荷重與構件姿態，落位後量測塔軸線與底座螺栓位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Weigh components and determine the centre of gravity by 3D survey before leaving the yard, test lifting-lug welds fully by non-destructive methods and proof-load them; before lifting confirm wave, wind and current windows from forecasts, monitor hook loads and attitude during the lift, and survey tower axis and base bolt positions after landing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 大型構件的整體吊裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Single-piece lifts of large components: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「整體吊裝鋼塔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Single-lift steel tower” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重心估計錯誤時，多台浮吊或多吊點受力不均，構件傾斜甚至碰撞；在浪高超限時強行吊裝，動態荷載可能使吊點撕裂。旋轉就位時若底座螺栓孔偏位，被迫強力對位會在塔底留下鎖入應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A wrong centre of gravity loads cranes or lifting points unequally, tilting or even colliding the piece; lifting in excessive waves can tear lifting lugs under dynamic load. If base bolt holes are misaligned during rotation, forcing the fit leaves locked-in stresses at the tower base. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整體吊裝把風險集中在少數幾次關鍵作業：構件重量與重心、吊點與吊具、浮吊的穩定與海象，任何一項誤差都會直接影響安全。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Single-piece lifting concentrates risk in a few critical operations: weight and centre of gravity, lifting points and rigging, crane stability and sea state, and an error in any one bears directly on safety.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「構件做得越大越重，施工風險就越低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The bigger and heavier the prefabricated pieces, the lower the construction risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重心估計錯誤時，多台浮吊或多吊點受力不均，構件傾斜甚至碰撞；在浪高超限時強行吊裝，動態荷載可能使吊點撕裂。旋轉就位時若底座螺栓孔偏位，被迫強力對位會在塔底留下鎖入應力。
knowledge.textEn: A wrong centre of gravity loads cranes or lifting points unequally, tilting or even colliding the piece; lifting in excessive waves can tear lifting lugs under dynamic load. If base bolt holes are misaligned during rotation, forcing the fit leaves locked-in stresses at the tower base.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「大型構件的整體吊裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Single-piece lifts of large components" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
施工期很短，颱風風險可以用完工後的設計風速涵蓋。
重心估計錯誤時，多台浮吊或多吊點受力不均，構件傾斜甚至碰撞；在浪高超限時強行吊裝，動態荷載可能使吊點撕裂。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Construction is short, so typhoon risk is covered by the design wind for the finished bridge.
A wrong centre of gravity loads cranes or lifting points unequally, tilting or even colliding the piece.
quiz.explanation: 重心估計錯誤時，多台浮吊或多吊點受力不均，構件傾斜甚至碰撞；在浪高超限時強行吊裝，動態荷載可能使吊點撕裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A wrong centre of gravity loads cranes or lifting points unequally, tilting or even colliding the piece; lifting in excessive waves can tear lifting lugs under dynamic load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 颱風季施工風險與工法變更：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Typhoon-season risk and a method change: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「颱風季最大懸臂」如何影響港珠澳大橋橋梁段的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Maximum cantilever in typhoon season” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: bridge works”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斜張橋與連續梁在懸臂拼裝期間最脆弱：懸臂越長，風致扭轉與抖振越大，而且結構尚未形成最終體系。廣東省交通運輸廳 2017 年核准的一項設計變更顯示，江海直達船航道橋 138 號塔附近的鋼箱梁原設計以 12 片小節段平衡拼裝，為避免最大懸臂狀態落在颱風季並縮短安裝時間，改為 2 個大節段整體吊裝。這是一個以施工期風險決定工法的實例：多花在大型吊裝與節段製造上的費用，換來颱風暴露時間大幅縮短。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「颱風季最大懸臂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cable-stayed and continuous girders are most vulnerable during cantilever erection, when longer cantilevers mean larger wind-induced torsion and buffeting and the final structural system is not yet formed. A design change approved in 2017 by the Guangdong Provincial Department of Transport shows that steel box girders near tower 138 of the Jianghai Channel Bridge, originally designed as 12 small segments in balanced assembly, were changed to two large segments lifted whole, to keep the maximum-cantilever state out of the typhoon season and shorten installation. It is an example of construction-stage risk choosing the method: the extra cost of big lifts and segment fabrication buys a large cut in typhoon exposure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Maximum cantilever in typhoon season” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以泊松過程估計：颱風季中影響工地的颱風平均率 λ = 0.02 次/日，最大懸臂暴露 60 天時至少遇到一次的機率 P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70%；若改為大節段把暴露縮到 10 天，P = 1 − e^(−0.2) ≈ 18%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a Poisson model and an average rate of λ = 0.02 typhoons per day affecting the site in season, 60 days at maximum cantilever give P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70% of meeting at least one; cutting exposure to 10 days with large segments gives P = 1 − e^(−0.2) ≈ 18%. λ and durations are teaching assumptions.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工期很短，颱風風險可以用完工後的設計風速涵蓋。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Construction is short, so typhoon risk is covered by the design wind for the finished bridge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「颱風季最大懸臂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Maximum cantilever in typhoon season”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 颱風季施工風險與工法變更
knowledge.titleEn: Typhoon-season risk and a method change
knowledge.text: 斜張橋與連續梁在懸臂拼裝期間最脆弱：懸臂越長，風致扭轉與抖振越大，而且結構尚未形成最終體系。廣東省交通運輸廳 2017 年核准的一項設計變更顯示，江海直達船航道橋 138 號塔附近的鋼箱梁原設計以 12 片小節段平衡拼裝，為避免最大懸臂狀態落在颱風季並縮短安裝時間，改為 2 個大節段整體吊裝。
knowledge.textEn: Cable-stayed and continuous girders are most vulnerable during cantilever erection, when longer cantilevers mean larger wind-induced torsion and buffeting and the final structural system is not yet formed. A design change approved in 2017 by the Guangdong Provincial Department of Transport shows that steel box girders near tower 138 of the Jianghai Channel Bridge, originally designed as 12 small segments in balanced assembly, were changed to two large segments lifted whole, to keep the maximum-cantilever state out of the typhoon season and shorten installation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工期很短，颱風風險可以用完工後的設計風速涵蓋。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Construction is short, so typhoon risk is covered by the design wind for the finished bridge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「颱風季施工風險與工法變更」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Typhoon-season risk and a method change" is correct?
options: 斜張橋與連續梁在懸臂拼裝期間最脆弱：懸臂越長，風致扭轉與抖振越大，而且結構尚未形成最終體系。
施工期很短，颱風風險可以用完工後的設計風速涵蓋。
渦激振動只發生在颱風等極強風速下。
optionsEn: Cable-stayed and continuous girders are most vulnerable during cantilever erection, when longer cantilevers mean larger wind-induced torsion and buffeting and the final structural system is not yet formed.
Construction is short, so typhoon risk is covered by the design wind for the finished bridge.
Vortex-induced vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds.
quiz.explanation: 斜張橋與連續梁在懸臂拼裝期間最脆弱：懸臂越長，風致扭轉與抖振越大，而且結構尚未形成最終體系。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cable-stayed and continuous girders are most vulnerable during cantilever erection, when longer cantilevers mean larger wind-induced torsion and buffeting and the final structural system is not yet formed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 颱風季施工風險與工法變更：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Typhoon-season risk and a method change: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「颱風季最大懸臂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Maximum cantilever in typhoon season” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以泊松過程估計：颱風季中影響工地的颱風平均率 λ = 0.02 次/日，最大懸臂暴露 60 天時至少遇到一次的機率 P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70%；若改為大節段把暴露縮到 10 天，P = 1 − e^(−0.2) ≈ 18%。λ 與天數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a Poisson model and an average rate of λ = 0.02 typhoons per day affecting the site in season, 60 days at maximum cantilever give P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70% of meeting at least one; cutting exposure to 10 days with large segments gives P = 1 − e^(−0.2) ≈ 18%. λ and durations are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工階段分析須計算每個懸臂狀態在設計施工風速下的應力與變形，並以風洞或抖振分析檢查最大懸臂的穩定；工期計畫以颱風季為約束排定關鍵作業，颱風警報時依應急方案加設臨時抗風索或錨定，並記錄事後檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Staged analysis computes stresses and deformations for each cantilever state at the design construction wind speed, and wind-tunnel or buffeting analysis checks stability at maximum cantilever; the programme schedules critical activities around the typhoon season, and on a typhoon warning the contingency plan adds temporary wind ties or anchors, with post-event inspection recorded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以泊松過程估計：颱風季中影響工地的颱風平均率 λ = 0.02 次/日，最大懸臂暴露 60 天時至少遇到一次的機率 P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70%；若改為大節段把暴露縮到 10 天，P = 1 − e^(−0.2) ≈ 18%。λ 與天數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a Poisson model and an average rate of λ = 0.02 typhoons per day affecting the site in season, 60 days at maximum cantilever give P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70% of meeting at least one; cutting exposure to 10 days with large segments gives P = 1 − e^(−0.2) ≈ 18%. λ and durations are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「颱風季施工風險與工法變更」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Typhoon-season risk and a method change", which statement holds?
options: 只要選用最好的塗料，鋼結構就能在海上撐過 120 年。
以泊松過程估計：颱風季中影響工地的颱風平均率 λ = 0.02 次/日，最大懸臂暴露 60 天時至少遇到一次的機率 P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70%。
設計壽命從 100 年改為 120 年，只是把數字改大，不影響設計參數。
optionsEn: Choosing the best paint is enough for steel to last 120 years at sea.
With a Poisson model and an average rate of λ = 0.02 typhoons per day affecting the site in season, 60 days at maximum cantilever give P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70% of meeting at least one.
Moving the design life from 100 to 120 years only changes a number and leaves design parameters unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 以泊松過程估計：颱風季中影響工地的颱風平均率 λ = 0.02 次/日，最大懸臂暴露 60 天時至少遇到一次的機率 P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70%；若改為大節段把暴露縮到 10 天，P = 1 − e^(−0.2) ≈ 18%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a Poisson model and an average rate of λ = 0.02 typhoons per day affecting the site in season, 60 days at maximum cantilever give P = 1 − e^(−λt) = 1 − e^(−1.2) ≈ 70% of meeting at least one; cutting exposure to 10 days with large segments gives P = 1 − e^(−0.2) ≈ 18%. λ and durations are teaching assumptions. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 颱風季施工風險與工法變更：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Typhoon-season risk and a method change: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「颱風季最大懸臂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Maximum cantilever in typhoon season” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工階段分析須計算每個懸臂狀態在設計施工風速下的應力與變形，並以風洞或抖振分析檢查最大懸臂的穩定；工期計畫以颱風季為約束排定關鍵作業，颱風警報時依應急方案加設臨時抗風索或錨定，並記錄事後檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Staged analysis computes stresses and deformations for each cantilever state at the design construction wind speed, and wind-tunnel or buffeting analysis checks stability at maximum cantilever; the programme schedules critical activities around the typhoon season, and on a typhoon warning the contingency plan adds temporary wind ties or anchors, with post-event inspection recorded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工風險登錄表應列出每個關鍵狀態的颱風暴露天數與應變措施，工期延誤時重新評估是否進入颱風季；任何為縮短暴露而改變工法的變更，須經設計單位檢核並報主管機關核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction risk register should list typhoon exposure days and responses for each critical state, re-evaluated whenever delays approach the season; any method change to shorten exposure must be checked by the designer and approved by the authority.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以完工狀態設計而不檢查懸臂期，颱風來襲時懸臂端大幅扭轉擺動，臨時固結與吊機可能損壞，甚至造成梁段墜落；工期延誤使原本避開颱風季的作業被推入颱風季，是常見的連鎖風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing for the completed state without checking the cantilever stage lets a typhoon twist and swing the tip violently, damaging temporary fixings and cranes or even dropping segments; delays that push work planned to avoid the season into it are a common chain of risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「颱風季施工風險與工法變更」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Typhoon-season risk and a method change"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
鋼箱梁整體應力很低，所以橋面板不會有疲勞問題。
施工階段分析須計算每個懸臂狀態在設計施工風速下的應力與變形，並以風洞或抖振分析檢查最大懸臂的穩定。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A steel box girder with low global stresses cannot have deck fatigue problems.
Staged analysis computes stresses and deformations for each cantilever state at the design construction wind speed, and wind-tunnel or buffeting analysis checks stability at maximum cantilever.

quiz.explanationEn: Staged analysis computes stresses and deformations for each cantilever state at the design construction wind speed, and wind-tunnel or buffeting analysis checks stability at maximum cantilever; the programme schedules critical activities around the typhoon season, and on a typhoon warning the contingency plan adds temporary wind ties or anchors, with post-event inspection recorded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 颱風季施工風險與工法變更：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Typhoon-season risk and a method change: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「颱風季最大懸臂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Maximum cantilever in typhoon season” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以完工狀態設計而不檢查懸臂期，颱風來襲時懸臂端大幅扭轉擺動，臨時固結與吊機可能損壞，甚至造成梁段墜落；工期延誤使原本避開颱風季的作業被推入颱風季，是常見的連鎖風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing for the completed state without checking the cantilever stage lets a typhoon twist and swing the tip violently, damaging temporary fixings and cranes or even dropping segments; delays that push work planned to avoid the season into it are a common chain of risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是一個以施工期風險決定工法的實例：多花在大型吊裝與節段製造上的費用，換來颱風暴露時間大幅縮短。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is an example of construction-stage risk choosing the method: the extra cost of big lifts and segment fabrication buys a large cut in typhoon exposure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工期很短，颱風風險可以用完工後的設計風速涵蓋。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Construction is short, so typhoon risk is covered by the design wind for the finished bridge." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以完工狀態設計而不檢查懸臂期，颱風來襲時懸臂端大幅扭轉擺動，臨時固結與吊機可能損壞，甚至造成梁段墜落；工期延誤使原本避開颱風季的作業被推入颱風季，是常見的連鎖風險。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「颱風季施工風險與工法變更」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Typhoon-season risk and a method change" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只以完工狀態設計而不檢查懸臂期，颱風來襲時懸臂端大幅扭轉擺動，臨時固結與吊機可能損壞，甚至造成梁段墜落。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
渦激振動只發生在颱風等極強風速下。
optionsEn: Designing for the completed state without checking the cantilever stage lets a typhoon twist and swing the tip violently, damaging temporary fixings and cranes or even dropping segments.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Vortex-induced vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds.
quiz.explanation: 若只以完工狀態設計而不檢查懸臂期，颱風來襲時懸臂端大幅扭轉擺動，臨時固結與吊機可能損壞，甚至造成梁段墜落；工期延誤使原本避開颱風季的作業被推入颱風季，是常見的連鎖風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「風洞試驗與渦激振動」與「鋼結構製造檢驗與預拼裝」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration" and "Fabrication inspection and trial assembly": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與渦激振動：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼箱梁斷面風洞模型」如何影響港珠澳大橋橋梁段的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Box-girder sectional model” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: bridge works”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 流線形鋼箱梁在中低風速下可能發生渦激振動：氣流在梁尾交替脫落渦流，當脫落頻率接近梁的豎彎或扭轉頻率時，梁體出現限幅但明顯的振動。這種振動很少直接威脅強度，卻會讓用路人不適、增加疲勞循環。設計時以斷面模型風洞試驗量測不同風攻角下的振幅，必要時調整欄杆、檢修車軌道或加導流板。附近的虎門大橋在 2020 年 5 月曾發生明顯渦振，調查指出沿橋面臨時放置的水馬改變了斷面氣動外形，說明營運期改變橋面附屬物也會影響氣動性能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼箱梁斷面風洞模型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Streamlined steel box girders can suffer vortex-induced vibration at low to moderate wind speeds: vortices shed alternately from the trailing edge, and when the shedding frequency approaches a vertical or torsional frequency the deck oscillates with limited but noticeable amplitude. Such motion rarely threatens strength but discomforts users and adds fatigue cycles. Designers measure amplitudes at several angles of attack in sectional wind-tunnel tests and adjust railings, inspection-gantry rails or add guide vanes if needed. The nearby Humen Bridge showed marked vortex-induced vibration in May 2020, and investigators linked it to water-filled barriers temporarily placed along the deck that changed the section's aerodynamic shape, showing that altering deck furniture in service can change aerodynamic behaviour. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Box-girder sectional model” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：渦流脫落臨界風速 U_cr = f·D/St。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Critical speed for vortex shedding U_cr = f·D/St. With a vertical frequency f = 0.4 Hz, girder depth D = 4.5 m and Strouhal number St = 0.11, U_cr = 0.4×4.5/0.11 ≈ 16.4 m/s, within common wind speeds; if railing changes shift St to 0.09, U_cr rises to about 20 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「渦激振動只發生在颱風等極強風速下。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Vortex-induced vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼箱梁斷面風洞模型」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Box-girder sectional model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 風洞試驗與渦激振動
knowledge.text: 流線形鋼箱梁在中低風速下可能發生渦激振動：氣流在梁尾交替脫落渦流，當脫落頻率接近梁的豎彎或扭轉頻率時，梁體出現限幅但明顯的振動。這種振動很少直接威脅強度，卻會讓用路人不適、增加疲勞循環。
knowledge.textEn: Streamlined steel box girders can suffer vortex-induced vibration at low to moderate wind speeds: vortices shed alternately from the trailing edge, and when the shedding frequency approaches a vertical or torsional frequency the deck oscillates with limited but noticeable amplitude. Such motion rarely threatens strength but discomforts users and adds fatigue cycles.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：渦激振動只發生在颱風等極強風速下。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Vortex-induced vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「風洞試驗與渦激振動」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration" is correct?
options: 渦激振動只發生在颱風等極強風速下。
流線形鋼箱梁在中低風速下可能發生渦激振動：氣流在梁尾交替脫落渦流，當脫落頻率接近梁的豎彎或扭轉頻率時，梁體出現限幅但明顯的振動。
每個節段都通過自己的允差檢查，組起來就一定沒問題。
optionsEn: Vortex-induced vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds.

Streamlined steel box girders can suffer vortex-induced vibration at low to moderate wind speeds: vortices shed alternately from the trailing edge, and when the shedding frequency approaches a vertical or torsional frequency the deck oscillates with limited but noticeable amplitude.
If every segment passes its own tolerance check, the assembled unit is bound to fit.
quiz.explanation: 流線形鋼箱梁在中低風速下可能發生渦激振動：氣流在梁尾交替脫落渦流，當脫落頻率接近梁的豎彎或扭轉頻率時，梁體出現限幅但明顯的振動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Streamlined steel box girders can suffer vortex-induced vibration at low to moderate wind speeds: vortices shed alternately from the trailing edge, and when the shedding frequency approaches a vertical or torsional frequency the deck oscillates with limited but noticeable amplitude. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與渦激振動：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼箱梁斷面風洞模型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Box-girder sectional model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：渦流脫落臨界風速 U_cr = f·D/St。取豎彎頻率 f = 0.4 Hz、梁高 D = 4.5 m、Strouhal 數 St = 0.11：U_cr = 0.4×4.5/0.11 ≈ 16.4 m/s，屬於常見風速範圍；若欄杆改變使 St 變為 0.09，U_cr 升到約 20 m/s。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Critical speed for vortex shedding U_cr = f·D/St. With a vertical frequency f = 0.4 Hz, girder depth D = 4.5 m and Strouhal number St = 0.11, U_cr = 0.4×4.5/0.11 ≈ 16.4 m/s, within common wind speeds; if railing changes shift St to 0.09, U_cr rises to about 20 m/s. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 1:50 至 1:80 等比例的斷面模型在不同攻角與阻尼比下做風洞試驗，量測渦振鎖定風速區間與最大振幅，並與舒適度與疲勞限值比較；完工後以環境振動量測確認實際頻率與阻尼，修正換算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test sectional models at scales such as 1:50 to 1:80 for several angles of attack and damping ratios, measuring lock-in wind ranges and peak amplitudes against comfort and fatigue limits; after completion measure actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to correct the scaling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 風洞試驗與渦激振動：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼箱梁斷面風洞模型」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Box-girder sectional model” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 1:50 至 1:80 等比例的斷面模型在不同攻角與阻尼比下做風洞試驗，量測渦振鎖定風速區間與最大振幅，並與舒適度與疲勞限值比較；完工後以環境振動量測確認實際頻率與阻尼，修正換算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test sectional models at scales such as 1:50 to 1:80 for several angles of attack and damping ratios, measuring lock-in wind ranges and peak amplitudes against comfort and fatigue limits; after completion measure actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to correct the scaling. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工文件應記錄風洞試驗所採用的橋面附屬物外形，營運規定明訂任何改變欄杆、護欄或在橋面放置大型物件前須經氣動評估；長期監測設定渦振振幅預警值並與風速資料連動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: As-built records should state the deck-furniture geometry used in wind-tunnel tests, and operating rules should require aerodynamic review before any change to railings or barriers or placing large objects on the deck; long-term monitoring sets vortex-amplitude alerts linked to wind data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：營運單位在橋面加裝隔音牆、廣告或臨時護欄而未評估氣動影響，可能把原本穩定的斷面變成容易渦振；渦振長期持續則使欄杆、伸縮縫與吊點產生疲勞損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Operators adding noise barriers, signs or temporary barriers without aerodynamic review can turn a stable section into one prone to vortex shedding; persistent vortex vibration fatigues railings, joints and attachment points. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 風洞試驗與渦激振動：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼箱梁斷面風洞模型」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Box-girder sectional model” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 營運單位在橋面加裝隔音牆、廣告或臨時護欄而未評估氣動影響，可能把原本穩定的斷面變成容易渦振；渦振長期持續則使欄杆、伸縮縫與吊點產生疲勞損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Operators adding noise barriers, signs or temporary barriers without aerodynamic review can turn a stable section into one prone to vortex shedding; persistent vortex vibration fatigues railings, joints and attachment points. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：附近的虎門大橋在 2020 年 5 月曾發生明顯渦振，調查指出沿橋面臨時放置的水馬改變了斷面氣動外形，說明營運期改變橋面附屬物也會影響氣動性能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The nearby Humen Bridge showed marked vortex-induced vibration in May 2020, and investigators linked it to water-filled barriers temporarily placed along the deck that changed the section's aerodynamic shape, showing that altering deck furniture in service can change aerodynamic behaviour.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「渦激振動只發生在颱風等極強風速下。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Vortex-induced vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「風洞試驗與渦激振動」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind-tunnel testing and vortex-induced vibration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

每個節段都通過自己的允差檢查，組起來就一定沒問題。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

steps.title: 鋼結構製造檢驗與預拼裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fabrication inspection and trial assembly: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「工廠預拼裝與焊縫檢測」如何影響港珠澳大橋橋梁段的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shop trial assembly and weld testing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: bridge works”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大節段與整孔吊裝的前提是工廠製造的精度：節段之間的對接焊口、螺栓孔、支承位置與預拱都必須在工廠就符合允差，因為海上沒有餘裕修正。常用做法是在工廠做連續預拼裝，把相鄰節段依序組立量測，確認累積長度、線形與接口；焊縫則以超音波、相位陣列或射線檢測驗收。工廠化讓焊接在穩定的溫濕度與自動化條件下進行，但驗收紀錄必須完整，才能在 120 年使用期內追溯每一道關鍵焊縫。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「工廠預拼裝與焊縫檢測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large-segment and full-span lifting depend on shop accuracy: butt-weld preparations, bolt holes, bearing positions and camber between segments must meet tolerances in the factory, because there is no margin to correct at sea. Common practice is progressive trial assembly in the shop, erecting adjacent segments in sequence to confirm cumulative length, profile and interfaces, while welds are accepted by ultrasonic, phased-array or radiographic testing. Factory production allows welding in stable temperature and humidity with automation, but acceptance records must be complete so that every critical weld can be traced through a 120-year life. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shop trial assembly and weld testing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：10 個接口、每個長度誤差 ±2 mm 且彼此獨立隨機時，累積誤差約 √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm；若誤差都偏同一方向（系統誤差），最壞情況是 10×2 = 20 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 10 interfaces each carrying an independent random length error of ±2 mm, the cumulative error is about √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm; if all errors lean the same way (systematic), the worst case is 10×2 = 20 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個節段都通過自己的允差檢查，組起來就一定沒問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every segment passes its own tolerance check, the assembled unit is bound to fit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「工廠預拼裝與焊縫檢測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shop trial assembly and weld testing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
