Large-segment and full-span lifting depend on shop accuracy: butt-weld preparations, bolt holes, bearing positions and camber between segments must meet tolerances in the factory, because there is no margin to correct at sea.
quiz.explanation: 大節段與整孔吊裝的前提是工廠製造的精度：節段之間的對接焊口、螺栓孔、支承位置與預拱都必須在工廠就符合允差，因為海上沒有餘裕修正。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Large-segment and full-span lifting depend on shop accuracy: butt-weld preparations, bolt holes, bearing positions and camber between segments must meet tolerances in the factory, because there is no margin to correct at sea. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼結構製造檢驗與預拼裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fabrication inspection and trial assembly: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「工廠預拼裝與焊縫檢測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shop trial assembly and weld testing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：10 個接口、每個長度誤差 ±2 mm 且彼此獨立隨機時，累積誤差約 √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm；若誤差都偏同一方向（系統誤差），最壞情況是 10×2 = 20 mm。預拼裝的目的就是在工廠發現系統誤差並修正。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 10 interfaces each carrying an independent random length error of ±2 mm, the cumulative error is about √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm; if all errors lean the same way (systematic), the worst case is 10×2 = 20 mm. Trial assembly exists to catch and correct systematic error in the shop. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：預拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個節段的長度、對角線、預拱與接口位置，與設計三維模型比較；焊縫依等級做 100% 或抽樣無損檢測，不合格率超過門檻時擴大抽樣並追查焊工與程序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During trial assembly measure each segment's length, diagonals, camber and interface positions by total station or laser scanning against the 3D model; test welds fully or by sampling according to class, widening the sample and tracing welders and procedures when reject rates exceed a threshold.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 10 個接口、每個長度誤差 ±2 mm 且彼此獨立隨機時，累積誤差約 √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm；若誤差都偏同一方向（系統誤差），最壞情況是 10×2 = 20 mm。預拼裝的目的就是在工廠發現系統誤差並修正。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 10 interfaces each carrying an independent random length error of ±2 mm, the cumulative error is about √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm; if all errors lean the same way (systematic), the worst case is 10×2 = 20 mm. Trial assembly exists to catch and correct systematic error in the shop. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼結構製造檢驗與預拼裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fabrication inspection and trial assembly", which statement holds?
options: 10 個接口、每個長度誤差 ±2 mm 且彼此獨立隨機時，累積誤差約 √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm。
設計壽命從 100 年改為 120 年，只是把數字改大，不影響設計參數。
鋼箱梁整體應力很低，所以橋面板不會有疲勞問題。
optionsEn: With 10 interfaces each carrying an independent random length error of ±2 mm, the cumulative error is about √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm.
Moving the design life from 100 to 120 years only changes a number and leaves design parameters unchanged.
A steel box girder with low global stresses cannot have deck fatigue problems.
quiz.explanation: 10 個接口、每個長度誤差 ±2 mm 且彼此獨立隨機時，累積誤差約 √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm；若誤差都偏同一方向（系統誤差），最壞情況是 10×2 = 20 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 10 interfaces each carrying an independent random length error of ±2 mm, the cumulative error is about √10×2 ≈ 6.3 mm; if all errors lean the same way (systematic), the worst case is 10×2 = 20 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼結構製造檢驗與預拼裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fabrication inspection and trial assembly: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「工廠預拼裝與焊縫檢測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shop trial assembly and weld testing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 預拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個節段的長度、對角線、預拱與接口位置，與設計三維模型比較；焊縫依等級做 100% 或抽樣無損檢測，不合格率超過門檻時擴大抽樣並追查焊工與程序。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During trial assembly measure each segment's length, diagonals, camber and interface positions by total station or laser scanning against the 3D model; test welds fully or by sampling according to class, widening the sample and tracing welders and procedures when reject rates exceed a threshold. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製造規範應要求連續預拼裝並以累積誤差而非單件誤差作為驗收依據；每道關鍵焊縫建立編號，記錄焊工、程序、檢測結果與修補，作為交接資料的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The fabrication specification should require progressive trial assembly and accept on cumulative rather than single-piece error; every critical weld gets an identifier recording welder, procedure, test results and repairs, forming part of the handover data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若每個節段都在個別允差內但偏向同一方向，整孔或整聯拼裝後的累積誤差可能超出支承或伸縮縫可容許的範圍；焊縫檢測紀錄不完整時，日後發現裂紋也無法判斷是製造缺陷還是使用造成。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Segments individually within tolerance but all biased one way can sum to an error that bearings or joints cannot accept once a full span or unit is assembled; incomplete weld records mean a crack found later cannot be attributed to fabrication or service. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 預拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個節段的長度、對角線、預拱與接口位置，與設計三維模型比較；焊縫依等級做 100% 或抽樣無損檢測，不合格率超過門檻時擴大抽樣並追查焊工與程序。
knowledge.textEn: During trial assembly measure each segment's length, diagonals, camber and interface positions by total station or laser scanning against the 3D model; test welds fully or by sampling according to class, widening the sample and tracing welders and procedures when reject rates exceed a threshold.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 製造規範應要求連續預拼裝並以累積誤差而非單件誤差作為驗收依據；每道關鍵焊縫建立編號，記錄焊工、程序、檢測結果與修補，作為交接資料的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: The fabrication specification should require progressive trial assembly and accept on cumulative rather than single-piece error; every critical weld gets an identifier recording welder, procedure, test results and repairs, forming part of the handover data.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼結構製造檢驗與預拼裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fabrication inspection and trial assembly"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
預拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個節段的長度、對角線、預拱與接口位置，與設計三維模型比較。
構件做得越大越重，施工風險就越低。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
During trial assembly measure each segment's length, diagonals, camber and interface positions by total station or laser scanning against the 3D model.
The bigger and heavier the prefabricated pieces, the lower the construction risk.
quiz.explanation: 預拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個節段的長度、對角線、預拱與接口位置，與設計三維模型比較；焊縫依等級做 100% 或抽樣無損檢測，不合格率超過門檻時擴大抽樣並追查焊工與程序。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During trial assembly measure each segment's length, diagonals, camber and interface positions by total station or laser scanning against the 3D model; test welds fully or by sampling according to class, widening the sample and tracing welders and procedures when reject rates exceed a threshold. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼結構製造檢驗與預拼裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fabrication inspection and trial assembly: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「工廠預拼裝與焊縫檢測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shop trial assembly and weld testing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若每個節段都在個別允差內但偏向同一方向，整孔或整聯拼裝後的累積誤差可能超出支承或伸縮縫可容許的範圍；焊縫檢測紀錄不完整時，日後發現裂紋也無法判斷是製造缺陷還是使用造成。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Segments individually within tolerance but all biased one way can sum to an error that bearings or joints cannot accept once a full span or unit is assembled; incomplete weld records mean a crack found later cannot be attributed to fabrication or service. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：工廠化讓焊接在穩定的溫濕度與自動化條件下進行，但驗收紀錄必須完整，才能在 120 年使用期內追溯每一道關鍵焊縫。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Factory production allows welding in stable temperature and humidity with automation, but acceptance records must be complete so that every critical weld can be traced through a 120-year life.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個節段都通過自己的允差檢查，組起來就一定沒問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every segment passes its own tolerance check, the assembled unit is bound to fit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若每個節段都在個別允差內但偏向同一方向，整孔或整聯拼裝後的累積誤差可能超出支承或伸縮縫可容許的範圍；焊縫檢測紀錄不完整時，日後發現裂紋也無法判斷是製造缺陷還是使用造成。
knowledge.textEn: Segments individually within tolerance but all biased one way can sum to an error that bearings or joints cannot accept once a full span or unit is assembled; incomplete weld records mean a crack found later cannot be attributed to fabrication or service.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼結構製造檢驗與預拼裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fabrication inspection and trial assembly" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要選用最好的塗料，鋼結構就能在海上撐過 120 年。
若每個節段都在個別允差內但偏向同一方向，整孔或整聯拼裝後的累積誤差可能超出支承或伸縮縫可容許的範圍。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Choosing the best paint is enough for steel to last 120 years at sea.
Segments individually within tolerance but all biased one way can sum to an error that bearings or joints cannot accept once a full span or unit is assembled.
quiz.explanation: 若每個節段都在個別允差內但偏向同一方向，整孔或整聯拼裝後的累積誤差可能超出支承或伸縮縫可容許的範圍；焊縫檢測紀錄不完整時，日後發現裂紋也無法判斷是製造缺陷還是使用造成。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Segments individually within tolerance but all biased one way can sum to an error that bearings or joints cannot accept once a full span or unit is assembled; incomplete weld records mean a crack found later cannot be attributed to fabrication or service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「120 年的防腐策略」與「健康監測、維護與三地交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "A corrosion strategy for 120 years" and "Monitoring, maintenance and tri-party handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 120 年的防腐策略：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: A corrosion strategy for 120 years: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「浪濺區鋼構件防腐」如何影響港珠澳大橋橋梁段的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Splash-zone corrosion protection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: bridge works”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 海上橋梁最嚴重的腐蝕發生在浪濺區與潮汐區：鋼材反覆乾濕、氧氣充足，又有鹽分沉積，腐蝕速率可比完全浸水的部位高數倍。120 年的設計壽命遠超過任何塗裝系統的壽命，因此防腐必須是多層次的：鋼構件的長效塗裝與預定的重塗週期、浸水鋼材的陰極保護、鋼護筒或鋼管的腐蝕裕度，以及混凝土構件的保護層與低滲透配比。鋼箱梁內部則可用除濕或密封降低濕度，讓內部不需頻繁塗裝。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「浪濺區鋼構件防腐」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The worst corrosion on marine bridges occurs in the splash and tidal zones, where steel wets and dries repeatedly with plenty of oxygen and salt deposits, corroding several times faster than fully submerged parts. A 120-year design life far exceeds any coating system's life, so protection must be layered: long-life coatings with planned recoating cycles on steelwork, cathodic protection for submerged steel, corrosion allowance on steel casings or pipes, and cover and low-permeability mixes for concrete. Inside steel boxes, dehumidification or sealing lowers humidity so the interior needs little repainting. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Splash-zone corrosion protection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：浪濺區鋼材若無保護、腐蝕率取 0.1 mm/年，120 年損失 0.1×120 = 12 mm；一支壁厚 20 mm 的鋼管將剩 8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Unprotected splash-zone steel corroding at 0.1 mm a year loses 0.1×120 = 12 mm in 120 years, leaving 8 mm of a 20 mm pipe wall.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要選用最好的塗料，鋼結構就能在海上撐過 120 年。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Choosing the best paint is enough for steel to last 120 years at sea." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「浪濺區鋼構件防腐」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Splash-zone corrosion protection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 120 年的防腐策略
knowledge.text: 海上橋梁最嚴重的腐蝕發生在浪濺區與潮汐區：鋼材反覆乾濕、氧氣充足，又有鹽分沉積，腐蝕速率可比完全浸水的部位高數倍。120 年的設計壽命遠超過任何塗裝系統的壽命，因此防腐必須是多層次的：鋼構件的長效塗裝與預定的重塗週期、浸水鋼材的陰極保護、鋼護筒或鋼管的腐蝕裕度，以及混凝土構件的保護層與低滲透配比。
knowledge.textEn: The worst corrosion on marine bridges occurs in the splash and tidal zones, where steel wets and dries repeatedly with plenty of oxygen and salt deposits, corroding several times faster than fully submerged parts. A 120-year design life far exceeds any coating system's life, so protection must be layered: long-life coatings with planned recoating cycles on steelwork, cathodic protection for submerged steel, corrosion allowance on steel casings or pipes, and cover and low-permeability mixes for concrete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要選用最好的塗料，鋼結構就能在海上撐過 120 年。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Choosing the best paint is enough for steel to last 120 years at sea. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「120 年的防腐策略」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "A corrosion strategy for 120 years" is correct?
options: 海上橋梁最嚴重的腐蝕發生在浪濺區與潮汐區：鋼材反覆乾濕、氧氣充足，又有鹽分沉積，腐蝕速率可比完全浸水的部位高數倍。
只要選用最好的塗料，鋼結構就能在海上撐過 120 年。
感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全，資料自然會告訴我們問題在哪裡。
optionsEn: The worst corrosion on marine bridges occurs in the splash and tidal zones, where steel wets and dries repeatedly with plenty of oxygen and salt deposits, corroding several times faster than fully submerged parts.
Choosing the best paint is enough for steel to last 120 years at sea.
The more sensors installed the safer the bridge, and the data will reveal problems by itself.
quiz.explanation: 海上橋梁最嚴重的腐蝕發生在浪濺區與潮汐區：鋼材反覆乾濕、氧氣充足，又有鹽分沉積，腐蝕速率可比完全浸水的部位高數倍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The worst corrosion on marine bridges occurs in the splash and tidal zones, where steel wets and dries repeatedly with plenty of oxygen and salt deposits, corroding several times faster than fully submerged parts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 120 年的防腐策略：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A corrosion strategy for 120 years: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「浪濺區鋼構件防腐」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Splash-zone corrosion protection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：浪濺區鋼材若無保護、腐蝕率取 0.1 mm/年，120 年損失 0.1×120 = 12 mm；一支壁厚 20 mm 的鋼管將剩 8 mm。若塗裝有效 25 年、之後由陰極保護把速率降到 0.02 mm/年，損失為 0.02×95 ≈ 1.9 mm。腐蝕率與有效年限為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Unprotected splash-zone steel corroding at 0.1 mm a year loses 0.1×120 = 12 mm in 120 years, leaving 8 mm of a 20 mm pipe wall. If coating lasts 25 years and cathodic protection then cuts the rate to 0.02 mm a year, the loss is 0.02×95 ≈ 1.9 mm. Corrosion rates and coating life are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：塗裝驗收量測乾膜厚度、附著力與針孔，並保存塗裝批號；陰極保護系統定期量測保護電位與陽極消耗；在代表性位置設置腐蝕試片或超音波測厚點，建立壁厚隨時間的趨勢並與設計腐蝕裕度比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Accept coatings by dry-film thickness, adhesion and holiday testing and keep batch records; measure cathodic-protection potentials and anode consumption periodically; set corrosion coupons or ultrasonic thickness points at representative locations to trend wall loss against the design allowance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 浪濺區鋼材若無保護、腐蝕率取 0.1 mm/年，120 年損失 0.1×120 = 12 mm；一支壁厚 20 mm 的鋼管將剩 8 mm。若塗裝有效 25 年、之後由陰極保護把速率降到 0.02 mm/年，損失為 0.02×95 ≈ 1.9 mm。腐蝕率與有效年限為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Unprotected splash-zone steel corroding at 0.1 mm a year loses 0.1×120 = 12 mm in 120 years, leaving 8 mm of a 20 mm pipe wall. If coating lasts 25 years and cathodic protection then cuts the rate to 0.02 mm a year, the loss is 0.02×95 ≈ 1.9 mm. Corrosion rates and coating life are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「120 年的防腐策略」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "A corrosion strategy for 120 years", which statement holds?
options: 三塔斜張橋只是把兩座雙塔斜張橋並排，設計方法相同。
浪濺區鋼材若無保護、腐蝕率取 0.1 mm/年，120 年損失 0.1×120 = 12 mm；一支壁厚 20 mm 的鋼管將剩 8 mm。
組合梁中的混凝土橋面板只受壓，不需要擔心裂縫。
optionsEn: A three-tower cable-stayed bridge is just two two-tower bridges side by side and is designed the same way.
Unprotected splash-zone steel corroding at 0.1 mm a year loses 0.1×120 = 12 mm in 120 years, leaving 8 mm of a 20 mm pipe wall.
The concrete deck of a composite girder is always in compression, so cracking is no concern.
quiz.explanation: 浪濺區鋼材若無保護、腐蝕率取 0.1 mm/年，120 年損失 0.1×120 = 12 mm；一支壁厚 20 mm 的鋼管將剩 8 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Unprotected splash-zone steel corroding at 0.1 mm a year loses 0.1×120 = 12 mm in 120 years, leaving 8 mm of a 20 mm pipe wall. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 120 年的防腐策略：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: A corrosion strategy for 120 years: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「浪濺區鋼構件防腐」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Splash-zone corrosion protection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 塗裝驗收量測乾膜厚度、附著力與針孔，並保存塗裝批號；陰極保護系統定期量測保護電位與陽極消耗；在代表性位置設置腐蝕試片或超音波測厚點，建立壁厚隨時間的趨勢並與設計腐蝕裕度比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Accept coatings by dry-film thickness, adhesion and holiday testing and keep batch records; measure cathodic-protection potentials and anode consumption periodically; set corrosion coupons or ultrasonic thickness points at representative locations to trend wall loss against the design allowance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：耐久設計文件應以表格列出每類構件的防腐手段、預估有效年限與維護時程，並在交接時連同腐蝕監測點位置一併移交；每次大修後更新剩餘壽命評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The durability document should tabulate protection measures, expected service life and maintenance timing for each component type, handed over with the locations of corrosion monitoring points; remaining-life estimates are updated after each major repair.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依賴初始塗裝而沒有重塗與陰極保護計畫，浪濺區鋼材在數十年內大幅減薄，承載力與挫屈強度降低；鋼箱梁內部若排水或除濕失效，凝結水在底板積聚造成隱蔽腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Relying on the initial coating without recoating or cathodic-protection plans thins splash-zone steel substantially within decades, reducing capacity and buckling strength; failed drainage or dehumidification inside a box lets condensation pool on the bottom plate and corrode it out of sight. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 塗裝驗收量測乾膜厚度、附著力與針孔，並保存塗裝批號；陰極保護系統定期量測保護電位與陽極消耗；在代表性位置設置腐蝕試片或超音波測厚點，建立壁厚隨時間的趨勢並與設計腐蝕裕度比較。
knowledge.textEn: Accept coatings by dry-film thickness, adhesion and holiday testing and keep batch records; measure cathodic-protection potentials and anode consumption periodically; set corrosion coupons or ultrasonic thickness points at representative locations to trend wall loss against the design allowance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 耐久設計文件應以表格列出每類構件的防腐手段、預估有效年限與維護時程，並在交接時連同腐蝕監測點位置一併移交；每次大修後更新剩餘壽命評估。
knowledge.textEn: The durability document should tabulate protection measures, expected service life and maintenance timing for each component type, handed over with the locations of corrosion monitoring points; remaining-life estimates are updated after each major repair.

quiz.question: 要驗證「120 年的防腐策略」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "A corrosion strategy for 120 years"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
施工期很短，颱風風險可以用完工後的設計風速涵蓋。
塗裝驗收量測乾膜厚度、附著力與針孔，並保存塗裝批號。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Construction is short, so typhoon risk is covered by the design wind for the finished bridge.
Accept coatings by dry-film thickness, adhesion and holiday testing and keep batch records.
quiz.explanation: 塗裝驗收量測乾膜厚度、附著力與針孔，並保存塗裝批號；陰極保護系統定期量測保護電位與陽極消耗；在代表性位置設置腐蝕試片或超音波測厚點，建立壁厚隨時間的趨勢並與設計腐蝕裕度比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Accept coatings by dry-film thickness, adhesion and holiday testing and keep batch records; measure cathodic-protection potentials and anode consumption periodically; set corrosion coupons or ultrasonic thickness points at representative locations to trend wall loss against the design allowance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 120 年的防腐策略：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A corrosion strategy for 120 years: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「浪濺區鋼構件防腐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Splash-zone corrosion protection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依賴初始塗裝而沒有重塗與陰極保護計畫，浪濺區鋼材在數十年內大幅減薄，承載力與挫屈強度降低；鋼箱梁內部若排水或除濕失效，凝結水在底板積聚造成隱蔽腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Relying on the initial coating without recoating or cathodic-protection plans thins splash-zone steel substantially within decades, reducing capacity and buckling strength; failed drainage or dehumidification inside a box lets condensation pool on the bottom plate and corrode it out of sight. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼箱梁內部則可用除濕或密封降低濕度，讓內部不需頻繁塗裝。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inside steel boxes, dehumidification or sealing lowers humidity so the interior needs little repainting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要選用最好的塗料，鋼結構就能在海上撐過 120 年。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Choosing the best paint is enough for steel to last 120 years at sea." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只依賴初始塗裝而沒有重塗與陰極保護計畫，浪濺區鋼材在數十年內大幅減薄，承載力與挫屈強度降低；鋼箱梁內部若排水或除濕失效，凝結水在底板積聚造成隱蔽腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Relying on the initial coating without recoating or cathodic-protection plans thins splash-zone steel substantially within decades, reducing capacity and buckling strength; failed drainage or dehumidification inside a box lets condensation pool on the bottom plate and corrode it out of sight.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「120 年的防腐策略」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "A corrosion strategy for 120 years" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只依賴初始塗裝而沒有重塗與陰極保護計畫，浪濺區鋼材在數十年內大幅減薄，承載力與挫屈強度降低；鋼箱梁內部若排水或除濕失效，凝結水在底板積聚造成隱蔽腐蝕。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全，資料自然會告訴我們問題在哪裡。
optionsEn: Relying on the initial coating without recoating or cathodic-protection plans thins splash-zone steel substantially within decades, reducing capacity and buckling strength.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The more sensors installed the safer the bridge, and the data will reveal problems by itself.
quiz.explanation: 若只依賴初始塗裝而沒有重塗與陰極保護計畫，浪濺區鋼材在數十年內大幅減薄，承載力與挫屈強度降低；鋼箱梁內部若排水或除濕失效，凝結水在底板積聚造成隱蔽腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Relying on the initial coating without recoating or cathodic-protection plans thins splash-zone steel substantially within decades, reducing capacity and buckling strength; failed drainage or dehumidification inside a box lets condensation pool on the bottom plate and corrode it out of sight. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 健康監測、維護與三地交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Monitoring, maintenance and tri-party handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「監測資料與三地共管」如何影響港珠澳大橋橋梁段的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Monitoring data and tri-party management” governs force, deformation or durability in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge: bridge works”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 港珠澳大橋由廣東、香港、澳門三地共同建設，主體工程由三地政府設立的管理機構負責營運維護，連接線則由各自政府管理。長大橋梁的監測系統通常包含風速、溫度、加速度、應變、位移、GNSS 與斜索索力等感測器，產生大量連續資料；真正的困難在於資料管理與判讀：誰負責設定預警值、誰在颱風後判斷是否需要封橋檢查、資料格式能否在數十年內被讀取。交接因此不只是移交設備，而是移交基準值、判讀規則與責任分工。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「監測資料與三地共管」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bridge was built jointly by Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao; the main works are operated and maintained by an authority set up by the three governments, while each link road is managed by its own government. Monitoring systems on long bridges usually include anemometers, thermometers, accelerometers, strain gauges, displacement sensors, GNSS and stay-force sensors producing large continuous data streams; the real difficulty is data management and interpretation: who sets alert values, who decides after a typhoon whether to close the bridge for inspection, and whether data formats stay readable for decades. Handover therefore transfers not just equipment but baselines, interpretation rules and responsibilities. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Monitoring data and tri-party management” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若 500 個通道以 100 Hz 取樣、每點 4 bytes：每日資料量 = 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB；一年約 6.3 TB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 500 channels sampled at 100 Hz and 4 bytes per sample, daily volume is 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB, about 6.3 TB a year.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全，資料自然會告訴我們問題在哪裡。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more sensors installed the safer the bridge, and the data will reveal problems by itself." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「監測資料與三地共管」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Monitoring data and tri-party management”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 健康監測、維護與三地交接
knowledge.text: 港珠澳大橋由廣東、香港、澳門三地共同建設，主體工程由三地政府設立的管理機構負責營運維護，連接線則由各自政府管理。長大橋梁的監測系統通常包含風速、溫度、加速度、應變、位移、GNSS 與斜索索力等感測器，產生大量連續資料；真正的困難在於資料管理與判讀：誰負責設定預警值、誰在颱風後判斷是否需要封橋檢查、資料格式能否在數十年內被讀取。
knowledge.textEn: The bridge was built jointly by Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao; the main works are operated and maintained by an authority set up by the three governments, while each link road is managed by its own government. Monitoring systems on long bridges usually include anemometers, thermometers, accelerometers, strain gauges, displacement sensors, GNSS and stay-force sensors producing large continuous data streams; the real difficulty is data management and interpretation: who sets alert values, who decides after a typhoon whether to close the bridge for inspection, and whether data formats stay readable for decades.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全，資料自然會告訴我們問題在哪裡。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more sensors installed the safer the bridge, and the data will reveal problems by itself. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「健康監測、維護與三地交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Monitoring, maintenance and tri-party handover" is correct?
options: 感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全，資料自然會告訴我們問題在哪裡。
港珠澳大橋由廣東、香港、澳門三地共同建設，主體工程由三地政府設立的管理機構負責營運維護，連接線則由各自政府管理。
設計壽命從 100 年改為 120 年，只是把數字改大，不影響設計參數。
optionsEn: The more sensors installed the safer the bridge, and the data will reveal problems by itself.
The bridge was built jointly by Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao.
Moving the design life from 100 to 120 years only changes a number and leaves design parameters unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 港珠澳大橋由廣東、香港、澳門三地共同建設，主體工程由三地政府設立的管理機構負責營運維護，連接線則由各自政府管理。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The bridge was built jointly by Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao; the main works are operated and maintained by an authority set up by the three governments, while each link road is managed by its own government. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 健康監測、維護與三地交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring, maintenance and tri-party handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「監測資料與三地共管」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Monitoring data and tri-party management” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若 500 個通道以 100 Hz 取樣、每點 4 bytes：每日資料量 = 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB；一年約 6.3 TB。若只保存事件期間的原始資料、其餘存 10 分鐘統計值，可降到原來的幾十分之一。通道數與取樣率為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 500 channels sampled at 100 Hz and 4 bytes per sample, daily volume is 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB, about 6.3 TB a year. Keeping raw data only for events and 10-minute statistics otherwise cuts this by a factor of several tens. Channel count and sampling rate are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：竣工時以載重試驗與環境振動量測建立頻率、撓度、應變與索力基準；每年檢查感測器漂移與失效率，以冗餘感測器交叉比對；颱風或地震後依預先訂定的判讀流程比較事件前後的頻率與永久變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish baselines for frequency, deflection, strain and stay force by load testing and ambient vibration at completion; check sensor drift and failure rates annually, cross-checking with redundant sensors; after typhoons or earthquakes compare pre- and post-event frequencies and permanent deformation under a predefined interpretation procedure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若 500 個通道以 100 Hz 取樣、每點 4 bytes：每日資料量 = 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB；一年約 6.3 TB。若只保存事件期間的原始資料、其餘存 10 分鐘統計值，可降到原來的幾十分之一。通道數與取樣率為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 500 channels sampled at 100 Hz and 4 bytes per sample, daily volume is 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB, about 6.3 TB a year. Keeping raw data only for events and 10-minute statistics otherwise cuts this by a factor of several tens. Channel count and sampling rate are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「健康監測、維護與三地交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Monitoring, maintenance and tri-party handover", which statement holds?
options: 鋼箱梁整體應力很低，所以橋面板不會有疲勞問題。
構件做得越大越重，施工風險就越低。
若 500 個通道以 100 Hz 取樣、每點 4 bytes：每日資料量 = 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB。
optionsEn: A steel box girder with low global stresses cannot have deck fatigue problems.
The bigger and heavier the prefabricated pieces, the lower the construction risk.
With 500 channels sampled at 100 Hz and 4 bytes per sample, daily volume is 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB, about 6.3 TB a year.
quiz.explanation: 若 500 個通道以 100 Hz 取樣、每點 4 bytes：每日資料量 = 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB；一年約 6.3 TB。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 500 channels sampled at 100 Hz and 4 bytes per sample, daily volume is 500×100×86,400×4 ≈ 1.73×10¹⁰ bytes ≈ 17.3 GB, about 6.3 TB a year. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 健康監測、維護與三地交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring, maintenance and tri-party handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「監測資料與三地共管」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Monitoring data and tri-party management” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 竣工時以載重試驗與環境振動量測建立頻率、撓度、應變與索力基準；每年檢查感測器漂移與失效率，以冗餘感測器交叉比對；颱風或地震後依預先訂定的判讀流程比較事件前後的頻率與永久變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish baselines for frequency, deflection, strain and stay force by load testing and ambient vibration at completion; check sensor drift and failure rates annually, cross-checking with redundant sensors; after typhoons or earthquakes compare pre- and post-event frequencies and permanent deformation under a predefined interpretation procedure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含感測器清單與校正紀錄、基準值、預警與行動門檻、事件後檢查流程、資料格式與保存政策，以及三地管理單位之間的通報與決策權責；每年發布監測年報供獨立審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the sensor list and calibrations, baselines, alert and action thresholds, post-event inspection procedures, data formats and retention policy, and notification and decision responsibilities among the three parties; an annual monitoring report supports independent review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：監測系統只收資料而無人判讀，或預警值設定不當，異常趨勢被淹沒在海量資料中；感測器失效未更換、資料格式隨軟體更新而無法讀取，使數十年的監測失去比較基準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A system that collects data nobody interprets, or with poorly set alerts, buries abnormal trends in sheer volume; failed sensors left unreplaced and formats unreadable after software changes destroy the comparison baseline built over decades. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 竣工時以載重試驗與環境振動量測建立頻率、撓度、應變與索力基準；每年檢查感測器漂移與失效率，以冗餘感測器交叉比對；颱風或地震後依預先訂定的判讀流程比較事件前後的頻率與永久變形。
knowledge.textEn: Establish baselines for frequency, deflection, strain and stay force by load testing and ambient vibration at completion; check sensor drift and failure rates annually, cross-checking with redundant sensors; after typhoons or earthquakes compare pre- and post-event frequencies and permanent deformation under a predefined interpretation procedure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含感測器清單與校正紀錄、基準值、預警與行動門檻、事件後檢查流程、資料格式與保存政策，以及三地管理單位之間的通報與決策權責；每年發布監測年報供獨立審查。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include the sensor list and calibrations, baselines, alert and action thresholds, post-event inspection procedures, data formats and retention policy, and notification and decision responsibilities among the three parties; an annual monitoring report supports independent review.

quiz.question: 要驗證「健康監測、維護與三地交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring, maintenance and tri-party handover"?
options: 竣工時以載重試驗與環境振動量測建立頻率、撓度、應變與索力基準。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
渦激振動只發生在颱風等極強風速下。
optionsEn: Establish baselines for frequency, deflection, strain and stay force by load testing and ambient vibration at completion.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Vortex-induced vibration only happens in typhoon-strength winds.
quiz.explanation: 竣工時以載重試驗與環境振動量測建立頻率、撓度、應變與索力基準；每年檢查感測器漂移與失效率，以冗餘感測器交叉比對；颱風或地震後依預先訂定的判讀流程比較事件前後的頻率與永久變形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Establish baselines for frequency, deflection, strain and stay force by load testing and ambient vibration at completion; check sensor drift and failure rates annually, cross-checking with redundant sensors; after typhoons or earthquakes compare pre- and post-event frequencies and permanent deformation under a predefined interpretation procedure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 健康監測、維護與三地交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring, maintenance and tri-party handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監測資料與三地共管」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Monitoring data and tri-party management” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 監測系統只收資料而無人判讀，或預警值設定不當，異常趨勢被淹沒在海量資料中；感測器失效未更換、資料格式隨軟體更新而無法讀取，使數十年的監測失去比較基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A system that collects data nobody interprets, or with poorly set alerts, buries abnormal trends in sheer volume; failed sensors left unreplaced and formats unreadable after software changes destroy the comparison baseline built over decades. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接因此不只是移交設備，而是移交基準值、判讀規則與責任分工。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover therefore transfers not just equipment but baselines, interpretation rules and responsibilities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全，資料自然會告訴我們問題在哪裡。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more sensors installed the safer the bridge, and the data will reveal problems by itself." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 監測系統只收資料而無人判讀，或預警值設定不當，異常趨勢被淹沒在海量資料中；感測器失效未更換、資料格式隨軟體更新而無法讀取，使數十年的監測失去比較基準。
knowledge.textEn: A system that collects data nobody interprets, or with poorly set alerts, buries abnormal trends in sheer volume; failed sensors left unreplaced and formats unreadable after software changes destroy the comparison baseline built over decades.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「健康監測、維護與三地交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring, maintenance and tri-party handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
監測系統只收資料而無人判讀，或預警值設定不當，異常趨勢被淹沒在海量資料中；感測器失效未更換、資料格式隨軟體更新而無法讀取，使數十年的監測失去比較基準。
設計壽命從 100 年改為 120 年，只是把數字改大，不影響設計參數。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A system that collects data nobody interprets, or with poorly set alerts, buries abnormal trends in sheer volume.
Moving the design life from 100 to 120 years only changes a number and leaves design parameters unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 監測系統只收資料而無人判讀，或預警值設定不當，異常趨勢被淹沒在海量資料中；感測器失效未更換、資料格式隨軟體更新而無法讀取，使數十年的監測失去比較基準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A system that collects data nobody interprets, or with poorly set alerts, buries abnormal trends in sheer volume; failed sensors left unreplaced and formats unreadable after software changes destroy the comparison baseline built over decades. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 聯邦大橋（加拿大）
summary: 聯邦大橋連接愛德華王子島與新布倫瑞克省，全長約 12.9 公里，是跨越冬季結冰海域最長的橋梁，主橋段以約 250 公尺的跨徑排列，設計壽命 100 年。本課從浮冰荷載與冰盾錐體出發，拆解主梁懸臂與掛梁組成的預製體系、高性能混凝土與墩身接合，再看陸上預製場、浮吊 Svanen 與高峰期每週一跨的安裝節奏，最後談冰力監測、強風管制、除冰鹽與凍融，以及 2032 年特許營運結束時的交接。
summaryEn: Confederation Bridge links Prince Edward Island and New Brunswick over about 12.9 km, the longest bridge over ice-covered water, with main spans of about 250 m and a 100-year design life. Starting from pack-ice loads and the ice-shield cones, the course unpacks the precast system of cantilevered main girders and drop-in spans, high-performance concrete and pier joints, then the land casting yard, the floating crane Svanen and a peak rate of one span a week, ending with ice-force monitoring, wind restrictions, de-icing salt and freeze–thaw, and the handover when the concession ends in 2032.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

Ice and wind monitoring and inspection records

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 冰盾設計練習：某主墩水線寬 D = 14 m，設計冰厚 h = 0.6 m。垂直面壓碎力 F_c = σ_c·h·D = 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN；錐面彎曲破壞力 F_b = k·σ_f·h² = 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN。冰力作用點到墩座接合面的力臂取 25 m，彎矩分別為 16.8×25 = 420 MN·m 與 2.52×25 = 63 MN·m。接合面面積 A = 40 m²、斷面模數 S = 60 m³，彎曲應力分別為 420/60 = 7.0 MPa 與 63/60 = 1.05 MPa。若上方主梁重 7,500 t（約 73.6 MN），平均壓應力 73.6/40 ≈ 1.84 MPa：錐面情況下 1.84 > 1.05，接合面不會張開；垂直面情況下需再增加約 (7.0 − 1.84)×40 ≈ 206 MN 的預力才能保持全斷面受壓。結論是冰盾錐體大幅減少了墩身與接合面所需的預力。數值為教學假設，不代表聯邦大橋的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Ice-shield exercise: a main pier is D = 14 m wide at the waterline with design ice thickness h = 0.6 m. Crushing on a vertical face gives F_c = σ_c·h·D = 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN; bending failure on a cone gives F_b = k·σ_f·h² = 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN. With a 25 m lever arm to the base joint, the moments are 16.8×25 = 420 MN·m and 2.52×25 = 63 MN·m. For a joint area A = 40 m² and section modulus S = 60 m³, the bending stresses are 420/60 = 7.0 MPa and 63/60 = 1.05 MPa. A 7,500 t girder above (about 73.6 MN) gives an average compression of 73.6/40 ≈ 1.84 MPa: with the cone, 1.84 > 1.05 and the joint stays closed; with a vertical face about (7.0 − 1.84)×40 ≈ 206 MN of extra prestress would be needed to keep the section in compression. The cone therefore greatly reduces the prestress demand on shaft and joint. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Confederation Bridge design.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「海峽浮冰與冰盾錐體」與「250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pack ice and the ice-shield cones" and "Precast system for the 250 m spans": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 海峽浮冰與冰盾錐體：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pack ice and the ice-shield cones: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「冰盾錐體」如何影響聯邦大橋（加拿大）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ice-shield cone” governs force, deformation or durability in “Confederation Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 諾森伯蘭海峽每年冬季被浮冰覆蓋，冰板隨潮流與風移動，撞到橋墩時會產生很大的水平力。若墩身在水線處是垂直面，冰板只能被壓碎，力量由冰的抗壓強度決定；聯邦大橋在每座墩的水線處設置錐形冰盾，讓冰板沿斜面爬升而以彎曲方式斷裂，冰的抗彎強度遠低於抗壓強度，因此傳到墩身的力大幅降低。錐體也讓碎冰順利從墩旁流走，避免冰塊在墩前堆積造成更大的推力或阻塞海流。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「冰盾錐體」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Northumberland Strait is covered in pack ice every winter, and ice sheets driven by tide and wind exert large horizontal forces on piers. With a vertical face at the waterline the ice can only crush, with force set by its compressive strength; Confederation Bridge has a conical ice shield at the waterline of each pier so that the sheet rides up the slope and fails in bending, and because ice is far weaker in bending than in compression, the force on the pier drops sharply. The cone also lets broken ice clear past the pier instead of piling up in front of it, where rubble would push harder and obstruct the flow. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ice-shield cone” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：垂直面壓碎力 F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D：σ_c = 2.0 MPa、冰厚 h = 0.6 m、水線寬 D = 14 m，F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Crushing on a vertical face F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D: with σ_c = 2.0 MPa, ice thickness h = 0.6 m and waterline width D = 14 m, F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「冰比混凝土軟得多，所以浮冰對橋墩的力量可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ice is much softer than concrete, so pack-ice forces on piers are negligible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「冰盾錐體」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ice-shield cone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「海峽浮冰與冰盾錐體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pack ice and the ice-shield cones" is correct?
options: 冰比混凝土軟得多，所以浮冰對橋墩的力量可以忽略。
諾森伯蘭海峽每年冬季被浮冰覆蓋，冰板隨潮流與風移動，撞到橋墩時會產生很大的水平力。

steps.title: 海峽浮冰與冰盾錐體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pack ice and the ice-shield cones: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「冰盾錐體」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ice-shield cone” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：垂直面壓碎力 F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D：σ_c = 2.0 MPa、冰厚 h = 0.6 m、水線寬 D = 14 m，F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN。錐面彎曲破壞力以簡化式 F_b ≈ k·σ_f·h²：k = 10、σ_f = 0.7 MPa，F_b ≈ 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN，約為壓碎力的 1/6.7。所有參數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Crushing on a vertical face F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D: with σ_c = 2.0 MPa, ice thickness h = 0.6 m and waterline width D = 14 m, F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN. Bending failure on a cone, by a simplified F_b ≈ k·σ_f·h² with k = 10 and σ_f = 0.7 MPa, gives F_b ≈ 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN, about 1/6.7 of the crushing force. All parameters are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時以海冰觀測資料統計冰厚、冰速與冰強度，並以冰槽模型試驗或數值模擬比較錐體與垂直面的冰力；營運期在代表性墩位量測墩身傾斜、加速度或應變，配合冰況觀測反算實際冰力，與設計值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage derive ice thickness, speed and strength statistics from observations and compare cone and vertical-face ice forces in ice-tank model tests or simulations; in service measure tilt, acceleration or strain on representative piers and back-calculate actual ice forces from observed ice conditions for comparison with design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 垂直面壓碎力 F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D：σ_c = 2.0 MPa、冰厚 h = 0.6 m、水線寬 D = 14 m，F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN。錐面彎曲破壞力以簡化式 F_b ≈ k·σ_f·h²：k = 10、σ_f = 0.7 MPa，F_b ≈ 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN，約為壓碎力的 1/6.7。所有參數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Crushing on a vertical face F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D: with σ_c = 2.0 MPa, ice thickness h = 0.6 m and waterline width D = 14 m, F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN. Bending failure on a cone, by a simplified F_b ≈ k·σ_f·h² with k = 10 and σ_f = 0.7 MPa, gives F_b ≈ 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN, about 1/6.7 of the crushing force. All parameters are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「海峽浮冰與冰盾錐體」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pack ice and the ice-shield cones", which statement holds?
options: 預製構件夠重，疊上去後不需要灌漿或預力就能穩定傳力。
預製構件尺寸精準，放上去後的高程就不會再改變。
垂直面壓碎力 F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D：σ_c = 2.0 MPa、冰厚 h = 0.6 m、水線寬 D = 14 m，F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN。
optionsEn: Precast pieces are heavy enough to transmit load reliably when stacked, without grout or prestress.
Precast pieces are accurate, so their levels stay fixed after placement.
Crushing on a vertical face F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D: with σ_c = 2.0 MPa, ice thickness h = 0.6 m and waterline width D = 14 m, F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN.
quiz.explanation: 垂直面壓碎力 F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D：σ_c = 2.0 MPa、冰厚 h = 0.6 m、水線寬 D = 14 m，F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Crushing on a vertical face F_c ≈ σ_c·h·D: with σ_c = 2.0 MPa, ice thickness h = 0.6 m and waterline width D = 14 m, F_c ≈ 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 海峽浮冰與冰盾錐體：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pack ice and the ice-shield cones: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「冰盾錐體」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ice-shield cone” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時以海冰觀測資料統計冰厚、冰速與冰強度，並以冰槽模型試驗或數值模擬比較錐體與垂直面的冰力；營運期在代表性墩位量測墩身傾斜、加速度或應變，配合冰況觀測反算實際冰力，與設計值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage derive ice thickness, speed and strength statistics from observations and compare cone and vertical-face ice forces in ice-tank model tests or simulations; in service measure tilt, acceleration or strain on representative piers and back-calculate actual ice forces from observed ice conditions for comparison with design. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：冰區橋梁的設計基準應明列冰厚、冰強度、冰速與水位組合，冰盾的有效高程範圍要涵蓋設計潮差與風暴潮；營運手冊規定冰季巡查項目，例如墩前冰堆積、錐面磨損與異常振動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis for an ice-exposed bridge should list combinations of ice thickness, strength, speed and water level, and the cone's effective elevation range must cover design tides and storm surge; the operating manual sets ice-season patrol items such as rubble build-up, cone wear and unusual vibration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若冰盾角度或位置與實際水位、潮差不配合，冰板在高潮或低潮時打到錐體以外的垂直墩身，力量回到壓碎模式；冰塊在墩前堆積成冰脊時，作用力與作用高度都超出單層冰板的假設，墩身承受額外彎矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the cone angle or elevation does not match actual water levels and tides, ice strikes the vertical shaft above or below the cone at high or low water and the force returns to crushing; rubble ridges piling in front of a pier exceed the single-sheet assumption in both force and height, adding bending to the shaft. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計時以海冰觀測資料統計冰厚、冰速與冰強度，並以冰槽模型試驗或數值模擬比較錐體與垂直面的冰力；營運期在代表性墩位量測墩身傾斜、加速度或應變，配合冰況觀測反算實際冰力，與設計值比較。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage derive ice thickness, speed and strength statistics from observations and compare cone and vertical-face ice forces in ice-tank model tests or simulations; in service measure tilt, acceleration or strain on representative piers and back-calculate actual ice forces from observed ice conditions for comparison with design.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 冰區橋梁的設計基準應明列冰厚、冰強度、冰速與水位組合，冰盾的有效高程範圍要涵蓋設計潮差與風暴潮；營運手冊規定冰季巡查項目，例如墩前冰堆積、錐面磨損與異常振動。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis for an ice-exposed bridge should list combinations of ice thickness, strength, speed and water level, and the cone's effective elevation range must cover design tides and storm surge; the operating manual sets ice-season patrol items such as rubble build-up, cone wear and unusual vibration.

quiz.question: 要驗證「海峽浮冰與冰盾錐體」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pack ice and the ice-shield cones"?

Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the structure can withstand storm winds, vehicles on it are automatically safe.
quiz.explanation: 設計時以海冰觀測資料統計冰厚、冰速與冰強度，並以冰槽模型試驗或數值模擬比較錐體與垂直面的冰力；營運期在代表性墩位量測墩身傾斜、加速度或應變，配合冰況觀測反算實際冰力，與設計值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage derive ice thickness, speed and strength statistics from observations and compare cone and vertical-face ice forces in ice-tank model tests or simulations; in service measure tilt, acceleration or strain on representative piers and back-calculate actual ice forces from observed ice conditions for comparison with design. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 海峽浮冰與冰盾錐體：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pack ice and the ice-shield cones: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「冰盾錐體」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ice-shield cone” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若冰盾角度或位置與實際水位、潮差不配合，冰板在高潮或低潮時打到錐體以外的垂直墩身，力量回到壓碎模式；冰塊在墩前堆積成冰脊時，作用力與作用高度都超出單層冰板的假設，墩身承受額外彎矩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the cone angle or elevation does not match actual water levels and tides, ice strikes the vertical shaft above or below the cone at high or low water and the force returns to crushing; rubble ridges piling in front of a pier exceed the single-sheet assumption in both force and height, adding bending to the shaft. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：錐體也讓碎冰順利從墩旁流走，避免冰塊在墩前堆積造成更大的推力或阻塞海流。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The cone also lets broken ice clear past the pier instead of piling up in front of it, where rubble would push harder and obstruct the flow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「冰比混凝土軟得多，所以浮冰對橋墩的力量可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ice is much softer than concrete, so pack-ice forces on piers are negligible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若冰盾角度或位置與實際水位、潮差不配合，冰板在高潮或低潮時打到錐體以外的垂直墩身，力量回到壓碎模式；冰塊在墩前堆積成冰脊時，作用力與作用高度都超出單層冰板的假設，墩身承受額外彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: If the cone angle or elevation does not match actual water levels and tides, ice strikes the vertical shaft above or below the cone at high or low water and the force returns to crushing; rubble ridges piling in front of a pier exceed the single-sheet assumption in both force and height, adding bending to the shaft.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「海峽浮冰與冰盾錐體」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pack ice and the ice-shield cones" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若冰盾角度或位置與實際水位、潮差不配合，冰板在高潮或低潮時打到錐體以外的垂直墩身，力量回到壓碎模式。
預製構件只要在陸上做好，放到墩上就完成了結構體系。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If the cone angle or elevation does not match actual water levels and tides, ice strikes the vertical shaft above or below the cone at high or low water and the force returns to crushing.
Once precast pieces are made on land and set on the piers, the structural system is complete.
quiz.explanation: 若冰盾角度或位置與實際水位、潮差不配合，冰板在高潮或低潮時打到錐體以外的垂直墩身，力量回到壓碎模式；冰塊在墩前堆積成冰脊時，作用力與作用高度都超出單層冰板的假設，墩身承受額外彎矩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the cone angle or elevation does not match actual water levels and tides, ice strikes the vertical shaft above or below the cone at high or low water and the force returns to crushing; rubble ridges piling in front of a pier exceed the single-sheet assumption in both force and height, adding bending to the shaft. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Precast system for the 250 m spans: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「主梁懸臂與中央掛梁」如何影響聯邦大橋（加拿大）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Main girder cantilevers and drop-ins” governs force, deformation or durability in “Confederation Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主橋段以約 250 公尺的跨徑重複排列，上部結構是後拉預力混凝土箱梁。公開資料指出，主墩、主梁與掛梁都在陸上預製：主梁跨坐在墩頂、向兩側懸臂伸出，相鄰兩支主梁的懸臂端之間再放入一段較短的掛梁，組成完整跨徑。這種體系讓最重的構件在陸上完成，海上只需要放置、對位與連接；但懸臂根部承受極大的負彎矩，必須靠深梁高與大量預力承擔，而掛梁兩端的連接決定了行車平順與伸縮行為。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「主梁懸臂與中央掛梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main bridge repeats spans of about 250 m, with post-tensioned concrete box girders. Public sources state that the main piers, main girders and drop-in spans were all precast on land: a main girder sits astride a pier and cantilevers both ways, and a shorter drop-in span fills the gap between the cantilever tips of adjacent main girders to complete each span. The system keeps the heaviest work on land, leaving placement, alignment and connection at sea; but the cantilever roots carry very large hogging moments that require great depth and heavy prestress, and the drop-in connections govern ride quality and movement behaviour. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Main girder cantilevers and drop-ins” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：主梁每側懸臂 a = 95 m、自重 w = 300 kN/m，懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m；60 m 掛梁以 w = 200 kN/m 簡支計，跨中彎矩 M = w·L²/8 = 200×60²/8 = 90,000 kN·m，只約為前者的 1/15。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 95 m cantilevers each side and self-weight w = 300 kN/m, the root moment is M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m; a 60 m drop-in span at w = 200 kN/m, simply supported, has M = w·L²/8 = 200×60²/8 = 90,000 kN·m, only about 1/15 of the former.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預製構件只要在陸上做好，放到墩上就完成了結構體系。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once precast pieces are made on land and set on the piers, the structural system is complete." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「主梁懸臂與中央掛梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Main girder cantilevers and drop-ins”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系

knowledge.textEn: The main bridge repeats spans of about 250 m, with post-tensioned concrete box girders. Public sources state that the main piers, main girders and drop-in spans were all precast on land: a main girder sits astride a pier and cantilevers both ways, and a shorter drop-in span fills the gap between the cantilever tips of adjacent main girders to complete each span.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預製構件只要在陸上做好，放到墩上就完成了結構體系。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once precast pieces are made on land and set on the piers, the structural system is complete. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Precast system for the 250 m spans" is correct?
options: 預製構件只要在陸上做好，放到墩上就完成了結構體系。
混凝土強度夠高，就能同時抵抗凍融、氯離子與冰磨蝕。
主橋段以約 250 公尺的跨徑重複排列，上部結構是後拉預力混凝土箱梁。
optionsEn: Once precast pieces are made on land and set on the piers, the structural system is complete.
High concrete strength alone resists freeze–thaw, chlorides and ice abrasion together.
The main bridge repeats spans of about 250 m, with post-tensioned concrete box girders.
