quiz.explanationEn: The main bridge repeats spans of about 250 m, with post-tensioned concrete box girders. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Precast system for the 250 m spans: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主梁懸臂與中央掛梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Main girder cantilevers and drop-ins” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主梁每側懸臂 a = 95 m、自重 w = 300 kN/m，懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m；60 m 掛梁以 w = 200 kN/m 簡支計，跨中彎矩 M = w·L²/8 = 200×60²/8 = 90,000 kN·m，只約為前者的 1/15。尺寸與荷載為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 95 m cantilevers each side and self-weight w = 300 kN/m, the root moment is M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m; a 60 m drop-in span at w = 200 kN/m, simply supported, has M = w·L²/8 = 200×60²/8 = 90,000 kN·m, only about 1/15 of the former. Dimensions and loads are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段模型檢查主梁在吊裝、存放與就位時的應力（支點位置不同時彎矩會反轉），並以長期分析預測懸臂端撓度；就位後量測懸臂端高程與掛梁支座位置，確認與預測一致才進行連接。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check main-girder stresses in lifting, storage and placement with a staged model, since moments reverse as support positions change, and predict long-term tip deflections; after placement survey tip levels and drop-in seat positions and connect only when they match predictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 主梁每側懸臂 a = 95 m、自重 w = 300 kN/m，懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m；60 m 掛梁以 w = 200 kN/m 簡支計，跨中彎矩 M = w·L²/8 = 200×60²/8 = 90,000 kN·m，只約為前者的 1/15。尺寸與荷載為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 95 m cantilevers each side and self-weight w = 300 kN/m, the root moment is M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m; a 60 m drop-in span at w = 200 kN/m, simply supported, has M = w·L²/8 = 200×60²/8 = 90,000 kN·m, only about 1/15 of the former. Dimensions and loads are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Precast system for the 250 m spans", which statement holds?
options: 主梁每側懸臂 a = 95 m、自重 w = 300 kN/m，懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m。
只要浮吊能力夠大，工程進度就只取決於吊裝速度。
冰力很難量測，所以只能完全依賴設計規範的數值。
optionsEn: With 95 m cantilevers each side and self-weight w = 300 kN/m, the root moment is M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m.
With a big enough crane, progress depends only on lifting speed.
Ice forces cannot be measured, so engineers must rely entirely on code values.
quiz.explanation: 主梁每側懸臂 a = 95 m、自重 w = 300 kN/m，懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m；60 m 掛梁以 w = 200 kN/m 簡支計，跨中彎矩 M = w·L²/8 = 200×60²/8 = 90,000 kN·m，只約為前者的 1/15。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 95 m cantilevers each side and self-weight w = 300 kN/m, the root moment is M = w·a²/2 = 300×95²/2 ≈ 1.35×10⁶ kN·m; a 60 m drop-in span at w = 200 kN/m, simply supported, has M = w·L²/8 = 200×60²/8 = 90,000 kN·m, only about 1/15 of the former. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Precast system for the 250 m spans: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主梁懸臂與中央掛梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Main girder cantilevers and drop-ins” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段模型檢查主梁在吊裝、存放與就位時的應力（支點位置不同時彎矩會反轉），並以長期分析預測懸臂端撓度；就位後量測懸臂端高程與掛梁支座位置，確認與預測一致才進行連接。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check main-girder stresses in lifting, storage and placement with a staged model, since moments reverse as support positions change, and predict long-term tip deflections; after placement survey tip levels and drop-in seat positions and connect only when they match predictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計文件應同時提供每個構件在吊裝、運輸、存放與就位各階段的支承條件與允許應力，並以懸臂端長期撓度預測訂定掛梁座的預留高程；就位與連接順序列為停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design documents should give support conditions and allowable stresses for every component during lifting, transport, storage and placement, and set the drop-in seat levels from long-term tip-deflection predictions; placement and connection sequences are hold points.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：主梁預力或梁高不足時，懸臂根部頂板在長期潛變與活載下開裂；相鄰懸臂端撓度不同時，掛梁兩端產生高差，造成行車跳動與伸縮裝置損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient prestress or depth cracks the top slab at the cantilever root under long-term creep and live load; unequal tip deflections of adjacent cantilevers leave a step at the drop-in ends, causing ride bumps and expansion-device damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段模型檢查主梁在吊裝、存放與就位時的應力（支點位置不同時彎矩會反轉），並以長期分析預測懸臂端撓度；就位後量測懸臂端高程與掛梁支座位置，確認與預測一致才進行連接。
knowledge.textEn: Check main-girder stresses in lifting, storage and placement with a staged model, since moments reverse as support positions change, and predict long-term tip deflections; after placement survey tip levels and drop-in seat positions and connect only when they match predictions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計文件應同時提供每個構件在吊裝、運輸、存放與就位各階段的支承條件與允許應力，並以懸臂端長期撓度預測訂定掛梁座的預留高程；就位與連接順序列為停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Design documents should give support conditions and allowable stresses for every component during lifting, transport, storage and placement, and set the drop-in seat levels from long-term tip-deflection predictions; placement and connection sequences are hold points.

quiz.question: 要驗證「250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Precast system for the 250 m spans"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以施工階段模型檢查主梁在吊裝、存放與就位時的應力（支點位置不同時彎矩會反轉），並以長期分析預測懸臂端撓度。
鋪面只影響行車舒適，與結構壽命無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Check main-girder stresses in lifting, storage and placement with a staged model, since moments reverse as support positions change, and predict long-term tip deflections.
Surfacing only affects ride comfort and has nothing to do with structural life.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段模型檢查主梁在吊裝、存放與就位時的應力（支點位置不同時彎矩會反轉），並以長期分析預測懸臂端撓度；就位後量測懸臂端高程與掛梁支座位置，確認與預測一致才進行連接。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check main-girder stresses in lifting, storage and placement with a staged model, since moments reverse as support positions change, and predict long-term tip deflections; after placement survey tip levels and drop-in seat positions and connect only when they match predictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Precast system for the 250 m spans: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主梁懸臂與中央掛梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Main girder cantilevers and drop-ins” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 主梁預力或梁高不足時，懸臂根部頂板在長期潛變與活載下開裂；相鄰懸臂端撓度不同時，掛梁兩端產生高差，造成行車跳動與伸縮裝置損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient prestress or depth cracks the top slab at the cantilever root under long-term creep and live load; unequal tip deflections of adjacent cantilevers leave a step at the drop-in ends, causing ride bumps and expansion-device damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種體系讓最重的構件在陸上完成，海上只需要放置、對位與連接；但懸臂根部承受極大的負彎矩，必須靠深梁高與大量預力承擔，而掛梁兩端的連接決定了行車平順與伸縮行為。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The system keeps the heaviest work on land, leaving placement, alignment and connection at sea; but the cantilever roots carry very large hogging moments that require great depth and heavy prestress, and the drop-in connections govern ride quality and movement behaviour.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預製構件只要在陸上做好，放到墩上就完成了結構體系。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once precast pieces are made on land and set on the piers, the structural system is complete." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 主梁預力或梁高不足時，懸臂根部頂板在長期潛變與活載下開裂；相鄰懸臂端撓度不同時，掛梁兩端產生高差，造成行車跳動與伸縮裝置損壞。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient prestress or depth cracks the top slab at the cantilever root under long-term creep and live load; unequal tip deflections of adjacent cantilevers leave a step at the drop-in ends, causing ride bumps and expansion-device damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「250 公尺主跨的預製構件體系」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Precast system for the 250 m spans" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混凝土強度夠高，就能同時抵抗凍融、氯離子與冰磨蝕。
主梁預力或梁高不足時，懸臂根部頂板在長期潛變與活載下開裂；相鄰懸臂端撓度不同時，掛梁兩端產生高差，造成行車跳動與伸縮裝置損壞。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High concrete strength alone resists freeze–thaw, chlorides and ice abrasion together.
Insufficient prestress or depth cracks the top slab at the cantilever root under long-term creep and live load.
quiz.explanation: 主梁預力或梁高不足時，懸臂根部頂板在長期潛變與活載下開裂；相鄰懸臂端撓度不同時，掛梁兩端產生高差，造成行車跳動與伸縮裝置損壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient prestress or depth cracks the top slab at the cantilever root under long-term creep and live load; unequal tip deflections of adjacent cantilevers leave a step at the drop-in ends, causing ride bumps and expansion-device damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「百年設計壽命的材料選擇」與「預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Materials for a 100-year design life" and "Joining bases, shafts and ice shields": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 百年設計壽命的材料選擇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Materials for a 100-year design life: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「高性能混凝土」如何影響聯邦大橋（加拿大）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-performance concrete” governs force, deformation or durability in “Confederation Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 聯邦大橋的合約要求 100 年設計壽命，約為一般橋梁的兩倍，公開資料指出預製構件使用高等級混凝土與鋼筋來達成。海峽環境同時有三種劣化：海水氯離子讓鋼筋腐蝕、冬季凍融循環讓混凝土表層剝落、浮冰在水線處反覆磨蝕冰盾表面。高性能混凝土以低水膠比與卜作嵐材料降低滲透性，並以適當的氣泡系統抵抗凍融；在冰磨蝕最嚴重的水線帶，常再加大保護層或提高表面耐磨性，把部分厚度當作可犧牲層。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「高性能混凝土」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The contract required a 100-year design life, about twice that of ordinary bridges, and public sources say high-grade concrete and reinforcement in the precast components were used to achieve it. The strait combines three deterioration modes: seawater chlorides corrode reinforcement, winter freeze–thaw cycles scale the concrete surface, and pack ice repeatedly abrades the ice shields at the waterline. High-performance concrete lowers permeability with a low water–binder ratio and pozzolans and resists freeze–thaw with a suitable air-void system; in the waterline band where ice abrasion is worst, cover is often increased or surface abrasion resistance raised, treating part of the thickness as sacrificial. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “High-performance concrete” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若水線帶冰磨蝕率取 0.5 mm/年，100 年損失 0.5×100 = 50 mm；設計保護層 75 mm 時，只剩約 25 mm 保護鋼筋，因此需要加大保護層或耐磨面層。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If ice abrades the waterline band at 0.5 mm a year, 100 years remove 0.5×100 = 50 mm; with 75 mm cover only about 25 mm would remain over the steel, so larger cover or an abrasion-resistant layer is needed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度夠高，就能同時抵抗凍融、氯離子與冰磨蝕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High concrete strength alone resists freeze–thaw, chlorides and ice abrasion together." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「高性能混凝土」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “High-performance concrete”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 百年設計壽命的材料選擇
knowledge.text: 聯邦大橋的合約要求 100 年設計壽命，約為一般橋梁的兩倍，公開資料指出預製構件使用高等級混凝土與鋼筋來達成。海峽環境同時有三種劣化：海水氯離子讓鋼筋腐蝕、冬季凍融循環讓混凝土表層剝落、浮冰在水線處反覆磨蝕冰盾表面。
knowledge.textEn: The contract required a 100-year design life, about twice that of ordinary bridges, and public sources say high-grade concrete and reinforcement in the precast components were used to achieve it. The strait combines three deterioration modes: seawater chlorides corrode reinforcement, winter freeze–thaw cycles scale the concrete surface, and pack ice repeatedly abrades the ice shields at the waterline.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度夠高，就能同時抵抗凍融、氯離子與冰磨蝕。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High concrete strength alone resists freeze–thaw, chlorides and ice abrasion together. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「百年設計壽命的材料選擇」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Materials for a 100-year design life" is correct?
options: 聯邦大橋的合約要求 100 年設計壽命，約為一般橋梁的兩倍，公開資料指出預製構件使用高等級混凝土與鋼筋來達成。
混凝土強度夠高，就能同時抵抗凍融、氯離子與冰磨蝕。
預製構件夠重，疊上去後不需要灌漿或預力就能穩定傳力。
optionsEn: The contract required a 100-year design life, about twice that of ordinary bridges, and public sources say high-grade concrete and reinforcement in the precast components were used to achieve it.
High concrete strength alone resists freeze–thaw, chlorides and ice abrasion together.
Precast pieces are heavy enough to transmit load reliably when stacked, without grout or prestress.
quiz.explanation: 聯邦大橋的合約要求 100 年設計壽命，約為一般橋梁的兩倍，公開資料指出預製構件使用高等級混凝土與鋼筋來達成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The contract required a 100-year design life, about twice that of ordinary bridges, and public sources say high-grade concrete and reinforcement in the precast components were used to achieve it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 百年設計壽命的材料選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Materials for a 100-year design life: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高性能混凝土」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-performance concrete” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若水線帶冰磨蝕率取 0.5 mm/年，100 年損失 0.5×100 = 50 mm；設計保護層 75 mm 時，只剩約 25 mm 保護鋼筋，因此需要加大保護層或耐磨面層。若磨蝕率降為 0.2 mm/年，損失只有 20 mm。磨蝕率與保護層為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If ice abrades the waterline band at 0.5 mm a year, 100 years remove 0.5×100 = 50 mm; with 75 mm cover only about 25 mm would remain over the steel, so larger cover or an abrasion-resistant layer is needed. At 0.2 mm a year the loss is only 20 mm. Abrasion rates and cover are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：配比驗證包含抗壓強度、氯離子滲透、凍融耐久（例如 ASTM C666）與氣泡間距係數；預製場逐批抽驗並保存試驗紀錄；營運期在水線帶定期量測磨蝕深度與保護層剩餘厚度，建立劣化速率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mix qualification includes compressive strength, chloride penetration, freeze–thaw durability (for example ASTM C666) and air-void spacing factor; the casting yard tests every batch and keeps records; in service the waterline band is measured periodically for abrasion depth and remaining cover to establish deterioration rates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若水線帶冰磨蝕率取 0.5 mm/年，100 年損失 0.5×100 = 50 mm；設計保護層 75 mm 時，只剩約 25 mm 保護鋼筋，因此需要加大保護層或耐磨面層。若磨蝕率降為 0.2 mm/年，損失只有 20 mm。磨蝕率與保護層為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If ice abrades the waterline band at 0.5 mm a year, 100 years remove 0.5×100 = 50 mm; with 75 mm cover only about 25 mm would remain over the steel, so larger cover or an abrasion-resistant layer is needed. At 0.2 mm a year the loss is only 20 mm. Abrasion rates and cover are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「百年設計壽命的材料選擇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Materials for a 100-year design life", which statement holds?
options: 預製構件尺寸精準，放上去後的高程就不會再改變。
若水線帶冰磨蝕率取 0.5 mm/年，100 年損失 0.5×100 = 50 mm。
只要橋梁結構能承受颱風等級的風，車輛在橋上就一定安全。
optionsEn: Precast pieces are accurate, so their levels stay fixed after placement.
If ice abrades the waterline band at 0.5 mm a year, 100 years remove 0.5×100 = 50 mm.
If the structure can withstand storm winds, vehicles on it are automatically safe.
quiz.explanation: 若水線帶冰磨蝕率取 0.5 mm/年，100 年損失 0.5×100 = 50 mm；設計保護層 75 mm 時，只剩約 25 mm 保護鋼筋，因此需要加大保護層或耐磨面層。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If ice abrades the waterline band at 0.5 mm a year, 100 years remove 0.5×100 = 50 mm; with 75 mm cover only about 25 mm would remain over the steel, so larger cover or an abrasion-resistant layer is needed. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 百年設計壽命的材料選擇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Materials for a 100-year design life: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高性能混凝土」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High-performance concrete” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配比驗證包含抗壓強度、氯離子滲透、凍融耐久（例如 ASTM C666）與氣泡間距係數；預製場逐批抽驗並保存試驗紀錄；營運期在水線帶定期量測磨蝕深度與保護層剩餘厚度，建立劣化速率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mix qualification includes compressive strength, chloride penetration, freeze–thaw durability (for example ASTM C666) and air-void spacing factor; the casting yard tests every batch and keeps records; in service the waterline band is measured periodically for abrasion depth and remaining cover to establish deterioration rates. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：耐久規範應依暴露區（水下、潮汐、浪濺、水線冰磨、橋面）分別訂定保護層、配比與試驗要求，預製場的品質紀錄須逐構件追溯；在水線帶預設量測點，作為日後磨蝕評估的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The durability specification should set cover, mix and test requirements by exposure zone (submerged, tidal, splash, waterline ice abrasion, deck), with yard quality records traceable to each component; reference points in the waterline band provide a baseline for future abrasion surveys.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若混凝土氣泡系統不足，凍融循環使表層逐年剝落，保護層變薄、氯離子更快到達鋼筋；水線帶磨蝕若未監測，數十年後鋼筋外露，修補必須在冰季以外的短窗口進行，代價很高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A deficient air-void system lets freeze–thaw scale the surface year by year, thinning cover so chlorides reach the steel sooner; unmonitored waterline abrasion can expose reinforcement after decades, and repairs must fit short windows outside the ice season at great cost. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 配比驗證包含抗壓強度、氯離子滲透、凍融耐久（例如 ASTM C666）與氣泡間距係數；預製場逐批抽驗並保存試驗紀錄；營運期在水線帶定期量測磨蝕深度與保護層剩餘厚度，建立劣化速率。
knowledge.textEn: Mix qualification includes compressive strength, chloride penetration, freeze–thaw durability (for example ASTM C666) and air-void spacing factor; the casting yard tests every batch and keeps records; in service the waterline band is measured periodically for abrasion depth and remaining cover to establish deterioration rates.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 耐久規範應依暴露區（水下、潮汐、浪濺、水線冰磨、橋面）分別訂定保護層、配比與試驗要求，預製場的品質紀錄須逐構件追溯；在水線帶預設量測點，作為日後磨蝕評估的基準。
knowledge.textEn: The durability specification should set cover, mix and test requirements by exposure zone (submerged, tidal, splash, waterline ice abrasion, deck), with yard quality records traceable to each component; reference points in the waterline band provide a baseline for future abrasion surveys.

quiz.question: 要驗證「百年設計壽命的材料選擇」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Materials for a 100-year design life"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
特許期結束時橋還能通車，就代表結構狀態良好。
配比驗證包含抗壓強度、氯離子滲透、凍融耐久（例如 ASTM C666）與氣泡間距係數。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If the bridge is still open at the end of the concession, its condition must be good.
Mix qualification includes compressive strength, chloride penetration, freeze–thaw durability (for example ASTM C666) and air-void spacing factor.
quiz.explanation: 配比驗證包含抗壓強度、氯離子滲透、凍融耐久（例如 ASTM C666）與氣泡間距係數；預製場逐批抽驗並保存試驗紀錄；營運期在水線帶定期量測磨蝕深度與保護層剩餘厚度，建立劣化速率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mix qualification includes compressive strength, chloride penetration, freeze–thaw durability (for example ASTM C666) and air-void spacing factor; the casting yard tests every batch and keeps records; in service the waterline band is measured periodically for abrasion depth and remaining cover to establish deterioration rates. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 百年設計壽命的材料選擇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Materials for a 100-year design life: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高性能混凝土」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High-performance concrete” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若混凝土氣泡系統不足，凍融循環使表層逐年剝落，保護層變薄、氯離子更快到達鋼筋；水線帶磨蝕若未監測，數十年後鋼筋外露，修補必須在冰季以外的短窗口進行，代價很高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A deficient air-void system lets freeze–thaw scale the surface year by year, thinning cover so chlorides reach the steel sooner; unmonitored waterline abrasion can expose reinforcement after decades, and repairs must fit short windows outside the ice season at great cost. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高性能混凝土以低水膠比與卜作嵐材料降低滲透性，並以適當的氣泡系統抵抗凍融；在冰磨蝕最嚴重的水線帶，常再加大保護層或提高表面耐磨性，把部分厚度當作可犧牲層。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High-performance concrete lowers permeability with a low water–binder ratio and pozzolans and resists freeze–thaw with a suitable air-void system; in the waterline band where ice abrasion is worst, cover is often increased or surface abrasion resistance raised, treating part of the thickness as sacrificial.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度夠高，就能同時抵抗凍融、氯離子與冰磨蝕。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High concrete strength alone resists freeze–thaw, chlorides and ice abrasion together." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若混凝土氣泡系統不足，凍融循環使表層逐年剝落，保護層變薄、氯離子更快到達鋼筋；水線帶磨蝕若未監測，數十年後鋼筋外露，修補必須在冰季以外的短窗口進行，代價很高。
knowledge.textEn: A deficient air-void system lets freeze–thaw scale the surface year by year, thinning cover so chlorides reach the steel sooner; unmonitored waterline abrasion can expose reinforcement after decades, and repairs must fit short windows outside the ice season at great cost.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「百年設計壽命的材料選擇」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Materials for a 100-year design life" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若混凝土氣泡系統不足，凍融循環使表層逐年剝落，保護層變薄、氯離子更快到達鋼筋；水線帶磨蝕若未監測，數十年後鋼筋外露，修補必須在冰季以外的短窗口進行，代價很高。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
預製構件夠重，疊上去後不需要灌漿或預力就能穩定傳力。
optionsEn: A deficient air-void system lets freeze–thaw scale the surface year by year, thinning cover so chlorides reach the steel sooner.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Precast pieces are heavy enough to transmit load reliably when stacked, without grout or prestress.
quiz.explanation: 若混凝土氣泡系統不足，凍融循環使表層逐年剝落，保護層變薄、氯離子更快到達鋼筋；水線帶磨蝕若未監測，數十年後鋼筋外露，修補必須在冰季以外的短窗口進行，代價很高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A deficient air-void system lets freeze–thaw scale the surface year by year, thinning cover so chlorides reach the steel sooner; unmonitored waterline abrasion can expose reinforcement after decades, and repairs must fit short windows outside the ice season at great cost. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joining bases, shafts and ice shields: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墩座與墩身接合面」如何影響聯邦大橋（加拿大）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pier base-to-shaft joint” governs force, deformation or durability in “Confederation Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每座主墩由多個大型預製件組成：坐在海床上的墩座、帶有冰盾的墩身，以及上方的主梁。構件之間的接合面必須同時傳遞巨大的垂直力、冰與風造成的水平力和彎矩，通常以灌漿填平接觸面，再以後拉預力把構件壓成一體。灌漿層讓不完全平整的接觸面均勻受力，預力則讓接合面在設計荷載下維持受壓、不張開，否則海水會進入接縫腐蝕預力鋼材。接合面的摩擦抗剪也是抵抗浮冰水平推力的主要機制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墩座與墩身接合面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each main pier is assembled from large precast pieces: a base seated on the seabed, a shaft carrying the ice shield, and the main girder above. Joints between them must transmit huge vertical loads together with horizontal forces and moments from ice and wind, typically by grouting the contact faces and post-tensioning the pieces together. The grout layer spreads load over imperfect contact surfaces, and prestress keeps the joint in compression under design loads so it does not open, otherwise seawater would enter and corrode the tendons. Friction across the joint is also the main mechanism resisting horizontal ice thrust. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pier base-to-shaft joint” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：剪力摩擦 V_cap = μ·N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Shear friction V_cap = μ·N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預製構件夠重，疊上去後不需要灌漿或預力就能穩定傳力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Precast pieces are heavy enough to transmit load reliably when stacked, without grout or prestress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「墩座與墩身接合面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pier base-to-shaft joint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合
knowledge.titleEn: Joining bases, shafts and ice shields
knowledge.text: 每座主墩由多個大型預製件組成：坐在海床上的墩座、帶有冰盾的墩身，以及上方的主梁。構件之間的接合面必須同時傳遞巨大的垂直力、冰與風造成的水平力和彎矩，通常以灌漿填平接觸面，再以後拉預力把構件壓成一體。
knowledge.textEn: Each main pier is assembled from large precast pieces: a base seated on the seabed, a shaft carrying the ice shield, and the main girder above. Joints between them must transmit huge vertical loads together with horizontal forces and moments from ice and wind, typically by grouting the contact faces and post-tensioning the pieces together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預製構件夠重，疊上去後不需要灌漿或預力就能穩定傳力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Precast pieces are heavy enough to transmit load reliably when stacked, without grout or prestress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joining bases, shafts and ice shields" is correct?
options: 預製構件夠重，疊上去後不需要灌漿或預力就能穩定傳力。
每座主墩由多個大型預製件組成：坐在海床上的墩座、帶有冰盾的墩身，以及上方的主梁。
只要浮吊能力夠大，工程進度就只取決於吊裝速度。
optionsEn: Precast pieces are heavy enough to transmit load reliably when stacked, without grout or prestress.
Each main pier is assembled from large precast pieces: a base seated on the seabed, a shaft carrying the ice shield, and the main girder above.
With a big enough crane, progress depends only on lifting speed.
quiz.explanation: 每座主墩由多個大型預製件組成：坐在海床上的墩座、帶有冰盾的墩身，以及上方的主梁。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each main pier is assembled from large precast pieces: a base seated on the seabed, a shaft carrying the ice shield, and the main girder above. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joining bases, shafts and ice shields: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墩座與墩身接合面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pier base-to-shaft joint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：剪力摩擦 V_cap = μ·N。若接合面上方承受主梁重 7,500 t（N = 7,500×9.81 ≈ 73,600 kN）、摩擦係數 μ = 0.6，V_cap ≈ 0.6×73,600 ≈ 44,100 kN，遠大於錐面冰力 2.52 MN，也大於垂直面壓碎力 16.8 MN。重量與 μ 為教學假設；實際設計還需加上預力與抗剪鍵。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Shear friction V_cap = μ·N. With a 7,500 t main girder above the joint (N = 7,500×9.81 ≈ 73,600 kN) and μ = 0.6, V_cap ≈ 0.6×73,600 ≈ 44,100 kN, far above the 2.52 MN cone ice force and also above the 16.8 MN crushing force. Weight and μ are teaching assumptions; real design also adds prestress and shear keys. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：構件就位後以 GNSS 與全站儀量測平面位置、高程與垂直度，公開資料指出定位精度可達約 2 cm；灌漿時記錄灌入量與壓力並確認溢漿，預力張拉逐束記錄伸長量與油壓，與計算比較；接縫以目視與潛水檢查確認無漏漿與張開。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After placement survey plan position, level and plumb by GNSS and total station, with public sources citing placement to about 2 cm; during grouting record volume and pressure and confirm vent overflow; record elongation and jack pressure for each tendon against calculation; inspect joints visually and by divers for grout leaks or opening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 剪力摩擦 V_cap = μ·N。若接合面上方承受主梁重 7,500 t（N = 7,500×9.81 ≈ 73,600 kN）、摩擦係數 μ = 0.6，V_cap ≈ 0.6×73,600 ≈ 44,100 kN，遠大於錐面冰力 2.52 MN，也大於垂直面壓碎力 16.8 MN。重量與 μ 為教學假設；實際設計還需加上預力與抗剪鍵。
knowledge.textEn: Shear friction V_cap = μ·N. With a 7,500 t main girder above the joint (N = 7,500×9.81 ≈ 73,600 kN) and μ = 0.6, V_cap ≈ 0.6×73,600 ≈ 44,100 kN, far above the 2.52 MN cone ice force and also above the 16.8 MN crushing force. Weight and μ are teaching assumptions; real design also adds prestress and shear keys.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joining bases, shafts and ice shields", which statement holds?
options: 冰力很難量測，所以只能完全依賴設計規範的數值。
鋪面只影響行車舒適，與結構壽命無關。
剪力摩擦 V_cap = μ·N。
optionsEn: Ice forces cannot be measured, so engineers must rely entirely on code values.
Surfacing only affects ride comfort and has nothing to do with structural life.
Shear friction V_cap = μ·N.
quiz.explanation: 剪力摩擦 V_cap = μ·N。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Shear friction V_cap = μ·N. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joining bases, shafts and ice shields: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墩座與墩身接合面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pier base-to-shaft joint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 構件就位後以 GNSS 與全站儀量測平面位置、高程與垂直度，公開資料指出定位精度可達約 2 cm；灌漿時記錄灌入量與壓力並確認溢漿，預力張拉逐束記錄伸長量與油壓，與計算比較；接縫以目視與潛水檢查確認無漏漿與張開。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After placement survey plan position, level and plumb by GNSS and total station, with public sources citing placement to about 2 cm; during grouting record volume and pressure and confirm vent overflow; record elongation and jack pressure for each tendon against calculation; inspect joints visually and by divers for grout leaks or opening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接合程序應依序設停留點：接觸面清潔與量測、灌漿與溢漿確認、預力張拉與紀錄、孔道灌漿與封錨；每個接縫建立紀錄卡，交接時納入營運資料，作為日後檢查預力狀態的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The joining procedure should have sequential hold points: surface cleaning and survey, grouting with vent confirmation, tendon stressing with records, duct grouting and anchor sealing; every joint gets a record card that enters the operating file as the basis for later checks of tendon condition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸面灌漿不完整時，荷載集中在少數接觸點，局部壓碎並在預力作用下產生裂縫；預力損失或接縫張開讓海水進入孔道，預力鋼材腐蝕而無法目視發現，是預製海事結構最危險的隱蔽劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incomplete joint grouting concentrates load on a few contact points, crushing them locally and cracking under prestress; prestress loss or joint opening lets seawater into ducts and corrodes tendons invisibly, the most dangerous hidden deterioration in precast marine structures. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 構件就位後以 GNSS 與全站儀量測平面位置、高程與垂直度，公開資料指出定位精度可達約 2 cm；灌漿時記錄灌入量與壓力並確認溢漿，預力張拉逐束記錄伸長量與油壓，與計算比較；接縫以目視與潛水檢查確認無漏漿與張開。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接合程序應依序設停留點：接觸面清潔與量測、灌漿與溢漿確認、預力張拉與紀錄、孔道灌漿與封錨；每個接縫建立紀錄卡，交接時納入營運資料，作為日後檢查預力狀態的依據。

quiz.question: 要驗證「預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joining bases, shafts and ice shields"?
options: 構件就位後以 GNSS 與全站儀量測平面位置、高程與垂直度，公開資料指出定位精度可達約 2 cm。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

quiz.explanationEn: After placement survey plan position, level and plumb by GNSS and total station, with public sources citing placement to about 2 cm; during grouting record volume and pressure and confirm vent overflow; record elongation and jack pressure for each tendon against calculation; inspect joints visually and by divers for grout leaks or opening. steps.title: 預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joining bases, shafts and ice shields: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墩座與墩身接合面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pier base-to-shaft joint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接觸面灌漿不完整時，荷載集中在少數接觸點，局部壓碎並在預力作用下產生裂縫；預力損失或接縫張開讓海水進入孔道，預力鋼材腐蝕而無法目視發現，是預製海事結構最危險的隱蔽劣化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incomplete joint grouting concentrates load on a few contact points, crushing them locally and cracking under prestress; prestress loss or joint opening lets seawater into ducts and corrodes tendons invisibly, the most dangerous hidden deterioration in precast marine structures. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接合面的摩擦抗剪也是抵抗浮冰水平推力的主要機制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Friction across the joint is also the main mechanism resisting horizontal ice thrust.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預製構件夠重，疊上去後不需要灌漿或預力就能穩定傳力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Precast pieces are heavy enough to transmit load reliably when stacked, without grout or prestress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接觸面灌漿不完整時，荷載集中在少數接觸點，局部壓碎並在預力作用下產生裂縫；預力損失或接縫張開讓海水進入孔道，預力鋼材腐蝕而無法目視發現，是預製海事結構最危險的隱蔽劣化。
knowledge.textEn: Incomplete joint grouting concentrates load on a few contact points, crushing them locally and cracking under prestress; prestress loss or joint opening lets seawater into ducts and corrodes tendons invisibly, the most dangerous hidden deterioration in precast marine structures.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預製墩座、墩身與冰盾的接合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joining bases, shafts and ice shields" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
接觸面灌漿不完整時，荷載集中在少數接觸點，局部壓碎並在預力作用下產生裂縫。
只要浮吊能力夠大，工程進度就只取決於吊裝速度。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Incomplete joint grouting concentrates load on a few contact points, crushing them locally and cracking under prestress.
With a big enough crane, progress depends only on lifting speed.
quiz.explanation: 接觸面灌漿不完整時，荷載集中在少數接觸點，局部壓碎並在預力作用下產生裂縫；預力損失或接縫張開讓海水進入孔道，預力鋼材腐蝕而無法目視發現，是預製海事結構最危險的隱蔽劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Incomplete joint grouting concentrates load on a few contact points, crushing them locally and cracking under prestress; prestress loss or joint opening lets seawater into ducts and corrodes tendons invisibly, the most dangerous hidden deterioration in precast marine structures. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨」與「主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week" and "Girder placement, drop-ins and alignment": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「陸上預製場與重件運輸」如何影響聯邦大橋（加拿大）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Land casting yard and heavy transport” governs force, deformation or durability in “Confederation Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主墩、主梁與掛梁都在愛德華王子島博登—卡爾頓附近的預製場製作，構件在場內以履帶式運輸車沿軌道移動到存放區與碼頭，再由浮吊 Svanen 運到海上吊放。公開資料提到全橋約有 175 件主要構件，最重約 7,500 公噸，高峰期每週可完成一跨。把海上工作化為陸上工廠作業，品質與進度較能掌控，但整個工程的節奏取決於預製場產能、存放空間、浮吊與海況，以及每年冰季前必須完成的安裝窗口。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「陸上預製場與重件運輸」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The main piers, main girders and drop-in spans were made at a casting yard near Borden-Carleton, Prince Edward Island, moved within the yard by crawler transporters on rails to storage and the wharf, and then carried out and placed by the floating crane Svanen. Public sources mention about 175 major structural pieces, the heaviest about 7,500 t, with one span completed each week at the peak. Turning marine work into a land factory improves control of quality and schedule, but the pace of the whole job depends on yard output, storage space, the crane, sea conditions and the installation window that must close before each ice season. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Land casting yard and heavy transport” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：主橋 44 跨、每跨約 4 件主要構件（墩座、墩身、主梁、掛梁），共約 44×4 = 176 件，與公開的約 175 件相符。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 44 main spans and about 4 major pieces each (base, shaft, main girder, drop-in), there are about 44×4 = 176 pieces, consistent with the published figure of about 175.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要浮吊能力夠大，工程進度就只取決於吊裝速度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a big enough crane, progress depends only on lifting speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「陸上預製場與重件運輸」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Land casting yard and heavy transport”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨
knowledge.titleEn: The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week
knowledge.text: 主墩、主梁與掛梁都在愛德華王子島博登—卡爾頓附近的預製場製作，構件在場內以履帶式運輸車沿軌道移動到存放區與碼頭，再由浮吊 Svanen 運到海上吊放。公開資料提到全橋約有 175 件主要構件，最重約 7,500 公噸，高峰期每週可完成一跨。
knowledge.textEn: The main piers, main girders and drop-in spans were made at a casting yard near Borden-Carleton, Prince Edward Island, moved within the yard by crawler transporters on rails to storage and the wharf, and then carried out and placed by the floating crane Svanen. Public sources mention about 175 major structural pieces, the heaviest about 7,500 t, with one span completed each week at the peak.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要浮吊能力夠大，工程進度就只取決於吊裝速度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With a big enough crane, progress depends only on lifting speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week" is correct?
options: 只要浮吊能力夠大，工程進度就只取決於吊裝速度。
預製構件尺寸精準，放上去後的高程就不會再改變。
主墩、主梁與掛梁都在愛德華王子島博登—卡爾頓附近的預製場製作，構件在場內以履帶式運輸車沿軌道移動到存放區與碼頭，再由浮吊 Svanen 運到海上吊放。
optionsEn: With a big enough crane, progress depends only on lifting speed.
Precast pieces are accurate, so their levels stay fixed after placement.

The main piers, main girders and drop-in spans were made at a casting yard near Borden-Carleton, Prince Edward Island, moved within the yard by crawler transporters on rails to storage and the wharf, and then carried out and placed by the floating crane Svanen.
quiz.explanation: 主墩、主梁與掛梁都在愛德華王子島博登—卡爾頓附近的預製場製作，構件在場內以履帶式運輸車沿軌道移動到存放區與碼頭，再由浮吊 Svanen 運到海上吊放。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The main piers, main girders and drop-in spans were made at a casting yard near Borden-Carleton, Prince Edward Island, moved within the yard by crawler transporters on rails to storage and the wharf, and then carried out and placed by the floating crane Svanen. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「陸上預製場與重件運輸」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Land casting yard and heavy transport” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主橋 44 跨、每跨約 4 件主要構件（墩座、墩身、主梁、掛梁），共約 44×4 = 176 件，與公開的約 175 件相符。若兩個無冰施工季各 30 週、共 60 週，平均每週需完成 44/60 ≈ 0.73 跨；高峰期每週一跨表示每週約 4 次重件吊放。每跨構件數與施工週數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 44 main spans and about 4 major pieces each (base, shaft, main girder, drop-in), there are about 44×4 = 176 pieces, consistent with the published figure of about 175. If two ice-free seasons of 30 weeks each give 60 weeks, the average rate must be 44/60 ≈ 0.73 spans a week; a peak of one span a week means about 4 heavy lifts a week. Pieces per span and season length are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以預製、存放、運輸與吊放的排程模擬檢查產能瓶頸；每件構件出場前檢查強度、尺寸、預埋件與吊點，並秤重確認；每次吊放前依海象預報確認浪高、風速與冰況，吊放後量測位置並記錄，作為下一件構件的修正依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Simulate the schedule of casting, storage, transport and lifting to find bottlenecks; before each piece leaves the yard check strength, dimensions, embedded items and lifting points and weigh it; before each lift confirm wave, wind and ice forecasts, then survey and record the placed position as the correction basis for the next piece.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 主橋 44 跨、每跨約 4 件主要構件（墩座、墩身、主梁、掛梁），共約 44×4 = 176 件，與公開的約 175 件相符。若兩個無冰施工季各 30 週、共 60 週，平均每週需完成 44/60 ≈ 0.73 跨；高峰期每週一跨表示每週約 4 次重件吊放。每跨構件數與施工週數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 44 main spans and about 4 major pieces each (base, shaft, main girder, drop-in), there are about 44×4 = 176 pieces, consistent with the published figure of about 175. If two ice-free seasons of 30 weeks each give 60 weeks, the average rate must be 44/60 ≈ 0.73 spans a week; a peak of one span a week means about 4 heavy lifts a week. Pieces per span and season length are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week", which statement holds?
options: 主橋 44 跨、每跨約 4 件主要構件（墩座、墩身、主梁、掛梁），共約 44×4 = 176 件，與公開的約 175 件相符。
只要橋梁結構能承受颱風等級的風，車輛在橋上就一定安全。
特許期結束時橋還能通車，就代表結構狀態良好。
optionsEn: With 44 main spans and about 4 major pieces each (base, shaft, main girder, drop-in), there are about 44×4 = 176 pieces, consistent with the published figure of about 175.
If the structure can withstand storm winds, vehicles on it are automatically safe.
If the bridge is still open at the end of the concession, its condition must be good.
quiz.explanation: 主橋 44 跨、每跨約 4 件主要構件（墩座、墩身、主梁、掛梁），共約 44×4 = 176 件，與公開的約 175 件相符。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 44 main spans and about 4 major pieces each (base, shaft, main girder, drop-in), there are about 44×4 = 176 pieces, consistent with the published figure of about 175. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「陸上預製場與重件運輸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Land casting yard and heavy transport” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以預製、存放、運輸與吊放的排程模擬檢查產能瓶頸；每件構件出場前檢查強度、尺寸、預埋件與吊點，並秤重確認；每次吊放前依海象預報確認浪高、風速與冰況，吊放後量測位置並記錄，作為下一件構件的修正依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Simulate the schedule of casting, storage, transport and lifting to find bottlenecks; before each piece leaves the yard check strength, dimensions, embedded items and lifting points and weigh it; before each lift confirm wave, wind and ice forecasts, then survey and record the placed position as the correction basis for the next piece. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：整體施工計畫應以冰季為硬性約束，訂定每季必須完成的墩位與越冬安全狀態；預製場與海上作業共用一套構件追蹤系統，記錄每件的製造、檢驗、存放與安裝資料，交接時完整移交。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The overall programme should treat the ice season as a hard constraint, fixing which piers must be complete each season and the safe overwintering state; yard and marine operations share one component-tracking system recording fabrication, inspection, storage and installation of every piece, handed over in full.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預製場進度落後時，安裝被推遲到秋末，冰季提前來臨使部分墩位暴露在未完成狀態下過冬；重件在存放區支承不當時，構件可能在吊裝前就出現裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the yard falls behind, installation slips into late autumn and an early ice season leaves some piers to winter in an unfinished state; heavy pieces stored on poorly placed supports can crack before they are ever lifted. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以預製、存放、運輸與吊放的排程模擬檢查產能瓶頸；每件構件出場前檢查強度、尺寸、預埋件與吊點，並秤重確認；每次吊放前依海象預報確認浪高、風速與冰況，吊放後量測位置並記錄，作為下一件構件的修正依據。
knowledge.textEn: Simulate the schedule of casting, storage, transport and lifting to find bottlenecks; before each piece leaves the yard check strength, dimensions, embedded items and lifting points and weigh it; before each lift confirm wave, wind and ice forecasts, then survey and record the placed position as the correction basis for the next piece.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 整體施工計畫應以冰季為硬性約束，訂定每季必須完成的墩位與越冬安全狀態；預製場與海上作業共用一套構件追蹤系統，記錄每件的製造、檢驗、存放與安裝資料，交接時完整移交。
knowledge.textEn: The overall programme should treat the ice season as a hard constraint, fixing which piers must be complete each season and the safe overwintering state; yard and marine operations share one component-tracking system recording fabrication, inspection, storage and installation of every piece, handed over in full.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以預製、存放、運輸與吊放的排程模擬檢查產能瓶頸。
預製構件只要在陸上做好，放到墩上就完成了結構體系。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Simulate the schedule of casting, storage, transport and lifting to find bottlenecks.
Once precast pieces are made on land and set on the piers, the structural system is complete.
quiz.explanation: 以預製、存放、運輸與吊放的排程模擬檢查產能瓶頸；每件構件出場前檢查強度、尺寸、預埋件與吊點，並秤重確認；每次吊放前依海象預報確認浪高、風速與冰況，吊放後量測位置並記錄，作為下一件構件的修正依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Simulate the schedule of casting, storage, transport and lifting to find bottlenecks; before each piece leaves the yard check strength, dimensions, embedded items and lifting points and weigh it; before each lift confirm wave, wind and ice forecasts, then survey and record the placed position as the correction basis for the next piece. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「陸上預製場與重件運輸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Land casting yard and heavy transport” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預製場進度落後時，安裝被推遲到秋末，冰季提前來臨使部分墩位暴露在未完成狀態下過冬；重件在存放區支承不當時，構件可能在吊裝前就出現裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the yard falls behind, installation slips into late autumn and an early ice season leaves some piers to winter in an unfinished state; heavy pieces stored on poorly placed supports can crack before they are ever lifted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把海上工作化為陸上工廠作業，品質與進度較能掌控，但整個工程的節奏取決於預製場產能、存放空間、浮吊與海況，以及每年冰季前必須完成的安裝窗口。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Turning marine work into a land factory improves control of quality and schedule, but the pace of the whole job depends on yard output, storage space, the crane, sea conditions and the installation window that must close before each ice season.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要浮吊能力夠大，工程進度就只取決於吊裝速度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With a big enough crane, progress depends only on lifting speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 預製場進度落後時，安裝被推遲到秋末，冰季提前來臨使部分墩位暴露在未完成狀態下過冬；重件在存放區支承不當時，構件可能在吊裝前就出現裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: If the yard falls behind, installation slips into late autumn and an early ice season leaves some piers to winter in an unfinished state; heavy pieces stored on poorly placed supports can crack before they are ever lifted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預製場、Svanen 與每週一跨」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The casting yard, Svanen and a span a week" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
預製構件尺寸精準，放上去後的高程就不會再改變。
預製場進度落後時，安裝被推遲到秋末，冰季提前來臨使部分墩位暴露在未完成狀態下過冬；重件在存放區支承不當時，構件可能在吊裝前就出現裂縫。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Precast pieces are accurate, so their levels stay fixed after placement.
If the yard falls behind, installation slips into late autumn and an early ice season leaves some piers to winter in an unfinished state.
quiz.explanation: 預製場進度落後時，安裝被推遲到秋末，冰季提前來臨使部分墩位暴露在未完成狀態下過冬；重件在存放區支承不當時，構件可能在吊裝前就出現裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the yard falls behind, installation slips into late autumn and an early ice season leaves some piers to winter in an unfinished state; heavy pieces stored on poorly placed supports can crack before they are ever lifted. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Girder placement, drop-ins and alignment: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「掛梁就位與懸臂端高差」如何影響聯邦大橋（加拿大）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drop-in seating and tip level difference” governs force, deformation or durability in “Confederation Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主梁放上墩頂後，兩側懸臂端會在自重與預力作用下產生撓度，並隨混凝土潛變與收縮持續變化；掛梁放入時，兩端支座的高程取決於相鄰兩支主梁的懸臂端撓度。如果相鄰主梁的製造齡期、預力或放置時間不同，兩者的潛變速率不同，掛梁兩端就會出現高差。線形控制因此必須以時間為變數：預測每支主梁在放置掛梁時與長期的撓度，調整掛梁座高程或墊片，讓完工後的橋面縱斷面平順。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「掛梁就位與懸臂端高差」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once a main girder is set on its pier, both cantilever tips deflect under self-weight and prestress and keep moving with creep and shrinkage; when a drop-in is placed, its seat levels depend on the tip deflections of the two neighbouring main girders. If those girders differ in casting age, prestress or placement date, their creep rates differ and the drop-in ends end up at different levels. Alignment control must therefore treat time as a variable: predict each girder's deflection at drop-in placement and in the long term, and adjust seat levels or shims so the finished profile is smooth. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Drop-in seating and tip level difference” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸臂端彈性撓度 40 mm，長期撓度 ≈ δ_el·(1+φ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Elastic tip deflection is 40 mm and long-term deflection ≈ δ_el·(1+φ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預製構件尺寸精準，放上去後的高程就不會再改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Precast pieces are accurate, so their levels stay fixed after placement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「掛梁就位與懸臂端高差」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Drop-in seating and tip level difference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制
knowledge.text: 主梁放上墩頂後，兩側懸臂端會在自重與預力作用下產生撓度，並隨混凝土潛變與收縮持續變化；掛梁放入時，兩端支座的高程取決於相鄰兩支主梁的懸臂端撓度。如果相鄰主梁的製造齡期、預力或放置時間不同，兩者的潛變速率不同，掛梁兩端就會出現高差。
knowledge.textEn: Once a main girder is set on its pier, both cantilever tips deflect under self-weight and prestress and keep moving with creep and shrinkage; when a drop-in is placed, its seat levels depend on the tip deflections of the two neighbouring main girders. If those girders differ in casting age, prestress or placement date, their creep rates differ and the drop-in ends end up at different levels.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預製構件尺寸精準，放上去後的高程就不會再改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Precast pieces are accurate, so their levels stay fixed after placement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Girder placement, drop-ins and alignment" is correct?
options: 主梁放上墩頂後，兩側懸臂端會在自重與預力作用下產生撓度，並隨混凝土潛變與收縮持續變化；掛梁放入時，兩端支座的高程取決於相鄰兩支主梁的懸臂端撓度。
預製構件尺寸精準，放上去後的高程就不會再改變。
冰力很難量測，所以只能完全依賴設計規範的數值。
optionsEn: Once a main girder is set on its pier, both cantilever tips deflect under self-weight and prestress and keep moving with creep and shrinkage.
Precast pieces are accurate, so their levels stay fixed after placement.
Ice forces cannot be measured, so engineers must rely entirely on code values.
quiz.explanation: 主梁放上墩頂後，兩側懸臂端會在自重與預力作用下產生撓度，並隨混凝土潛變與收縮持續變化；掛梁放入時，兩端支座的高程取決於相鄰兩支主梁的懸臂端撓度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once a main girder is set on its pier, both cantilever tips deflect under self-weight and prestress and keep moving with creep and shrinkage; when a drop-in is placed, its seat levels depend on the tip deflections of the two neighbouring main girders. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Girder placement, drop-ins and alignment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「掛梁就位與懸臂端高差」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drop-in seating and tip level difference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸臂端彈性撓度 40 mm，長期撓度 ≈ δ_el·(1+φ)。若甲主梁放置時齡期較長、φ = 1.5，長期撓度 40×2.5 = 100 mm；乙主梁較年輕、φ = 2.0，長期撓度 40×3.0 = 120 mm；兩端高差約 20 mm，需在掛梁座預留調整。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Elastic tip deflection is 40 mm and long-term deflection ≈ δ_el·(1+φ). An older girder with φ = 1.5 reaches 40×2.5 = 100 mm, while a younger one with φ = 2.0 reaches 40×3.0 = 120 mm; the 20 mm difference must be allowed for at the drop-in seats. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每支主梁從預製到放置定期量測懸臂端高程，以實測撓度修正潛變模型；掛梁就位前量測兩端座高差並依預測決定墊片厚度，完工後與一年後各量測一次全線縱斷面，確認長期變形符合預測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure tip levels of every main girder periodically from casting to placement and update the creep model with measured deflections; before seating a drop-in survey the seat level difference and choose shim thickness from predictions; survey the full profile at completion and again after a year to confirm long-term behaviour.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸臂端彈性撓度 40 mm，長期撓度 ≈ δ_el·(1+φ)。若甲主梁放置時齡期較長、φ = 1.5，長期撓度 40×2.5 = 100 mm；乙主梁較年輕、φ = 2.0，長期撓度 40×3.0 = 120 mm；兩端高差約 20 mm，需在掛梁座預留調整。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Elastic tip deflection is 40 mm and long-term deflection ≈ δ_el·(1+φ). An older girder with φ = 1.5 reaches 40×2.5 = 100 mm, while a younger one with φ = 2.0 reaches 40×3.0 = 120 mm; the 20 mm difference must be allowed for at the drop-in seats. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Girder placement, drop-ins and alignment", which statement holds?
options: 鋪面只影響行車舒適，與結構壽命無關。
懸臂端彈性撓度 40 mm，長期撓度 ≈ δ_el·(1+φ)。
冰比混凝土軟得多，所以浮冰對橋墩的力量可以忽略。
optionsEn: Surfacing only affects ride comfort and has nothing to do with structural life.
Elastic tip deflection is 40 mm and long-term deflection ≈ δ_el·(1+φ).
Ice is much softer than concrete, so pack-ice forces on piers are negligible.
quiz.explanation: 懸臂端彈性撓度 40 mm，長期撓度 ≈ δ_el·(1+φ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Elastic tip deflection is 40 mm and long-term deflection ≈ δ_el·(1+φ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Girder placement, drop-ins and alignment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「掛梁就位與懸臂端高差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drop-in seating and tip level difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每支主梁從預製到放置定期量測懸臂端高程，以實測撓度修正潛變模型；掛梁就位前量測兩端座高差並依預測決定墊片厚度，完工後與一年後各量測一次全線縱斷面，確認長期變形符合預測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure tip levels of every main girder periodically from casting to placement and update the creep model with measured deflections; before seating a drop-in survey the seat level difference and choose shim thickness from predictions; survey the full profile at completion and again after a year to confirm long-term behaviour. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：線形控制應有專責小組，建立每支主梁的齡期、預力與撓度紀錄，施工順序變更時重新預測並調整掛梁座；墊片或調整量的決定與實測值一併歸檔，交接後供維護單位判讀變形。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A dedicated alignment team should keep age, prestress and deflection records for every main girder, re-predict and adjust seats whenever the sequence changes, and file each shim decision with its measurements for maintenance staff to interpret deformation after handover.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依設計理想齡期調整掛梁座，而實際施工順序改變，部分掛梁兩端高差逐年擴大，造成行車跳動、伸縮裝置受衝擊與防水層破壞；長期撓度大於預測時，橋面縱斷面出現連續起伏。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Setting drop-in seats for ideal design ages when the actual sequence changed lets level differences grow year by year, causing ride bumps, impact on expansion devices and torn waterproofing; long-term deflections larger than predicted leave a repeating wave in the profile. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每支主梁從預製到放置定期量測懸臂端高程，以實測撓度修正潛變模型；掛梁就位前量測兩端座高差並依預測決定墊片厚度，完工後與一年後各量測一次全線縱斷面，確認長期變形符合預測。
knowledge.textEn: Measure tip levels of every main girder periodically from casting to placement and update the creep model with measured deflections; before seating a drop-in survey the seat level difference and choose shim thickness from predictions; survey the full profile at completion and again after a year to confirm long-term behaviour.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 線形控制應有專責小組，建立每支主梁的齡期、預力與撓度紀錄，施工順序變更時重新預測並調整掛梁座；墊片或調整量的決定與實測值一併歸檔，交接後供維護單位判讀變形。
knowledge.textEn: A dedicated alignment team should keep age, prestress and deflection records for every main girder, re-predict and adjust seats whenever the sequence changes, and file each shim decision with its measurements for maintenance staff to interpret deformation after handover.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Girder placement, drop-ins and alignment"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
混凝土強度夠高，就能同時抵抗凍融、氯離子與冰磨蝕。
每支主梁從預製到放置定期量測懸臂端高程，以實測撓度修正潛變模型。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
High concrete strength alone resists freeze–thaw, chlorides and ice abrasion together.
Measure tip levels of every main girder periodically from casting to placement and update the creep model with measured deflections.
quiz.explanation: 每支主梁從預製到放置定期量測懸臂端高程，以實測撓度修正潛變模型；掛梁就位前量測兩端座高差並依預測決定墊片厚度，完工後與一年後各量測一次全線縱斷面，確認長期變形符合預測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure tip levels of every main girder periodically from casting to placement and update the creep model with measured deflections; before seating a drop-in survey the seat level difference and choose shim thickness from predictions; survey the full profile at completion and again after a year to confirm long-term behaviour. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Girder placement, drop-ins and alignment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「掛梁就位與懸臂端高差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drop-in seating and tip level difference” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依設計理想齡期調整掛梁座，而實際施工順序改變，部分掛梁兩端高差逐年擴大，造成行車跳動、伸縮裝置受衝擊與防水層破壞；長期撓度大於預測時，橋面縱斷面出現連續起伏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Setting drop-in seats for ideal design ages when the actual sequence changed lets level differences grow year by year, causing ride bumps, impact on expansion devices and torn waterproofing; long-term deflections larger than predicted leave a repeating wave in the profile. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：線形控制因此必須以時間為變數：預測每支主梁在放置掛梁時與長期的撓度，調整掛梁座高程或墊片，讓完工後的橋面縱斷面平順。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Alignment control must therefore treat time as a variable: predict each girder's deflection at drop-in placement and in the long term, and adjust seat levels or shims so the finished profile is smooth.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預製構件尺寸精準，放上去後的高程就不會再改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Precast pieces are accurate, so their levels stay fixed after placement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只依設計理想齡期調整掛梁座，而實際施工順序改變，部分掛梁兩端高差逐年擴大，造成行車跳動、伸縮裝置受衝擊與防水層破壞；長期撓度大於預測時，橋面縱斷面出現連續起伏。
knowledge.textEn: Setting drop-in seats for ideal design ages when the actual sequence changed lets level differences grow year by year, causing ride bumps, impact on expansion devices and torn waterproofing; long-term deflections larger than predicted leave a repeating wave in the profile.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主梁就位、掛梁與線形控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Girder placement, drop-ins and alignment" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只依設計理想齡期調整掛梁座，而實際施工順序改變，部分掛梁兩端高差逐年擴大，造成行車跳動、伸縮裝置受衝擊與防水層破壞。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
冰力很難量測，所以只能完全依賴設計規範的數值。
optionsEn: Setting drop-in seats for ideal design ages when the actual sequence changed lets level differences grow year by year, causing ride bumps, impact on expansion devices and torn waterproofing.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Ice forces cannot be measured, so engineers must rely entirely on code values.
quiz.explanation: 若只依設計理想齡期調整掛梁座，而實際施工順序改變，部分掛梁兩端高差逐年擴大，造成行車跳動、伸縮裝置受衝擊與防水層破壞；長期撓度大於預測時，橋面縱斷面出現連續起伏。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Setting drop-in seats for ideal design ages when the actual sequence changed lets level differences grow year by year, causing ride bumps, impact on expansion devices and torn waterproofing; long-term deflections larger than predicted leave a repeating wave in the profile. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「冰力與結構反應監測」與「強風管制與高側車輛」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Monitoring ice forces and response" and "Wind restrictions and high-sided vehicles": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 冰力與結構反應監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Monitoring ice forces and response: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墩身傾斜計」如何影響聯邦大橋（加拿大）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pier tiltmeters” governs force, deformation or durability in “Confederation Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 冰力的設計值帶有很大的不確定性：冰的強度隨溫度、鹽度與加載速率變化，冰板厚度與漂移速度年年不同。在代表性墩位裝設傾斜計、加速度計或應變計，再配合冰況觀測（冰厚、冰速、破壞模式），可以從結構反應反算實際冰力，檢驗設計假設，並為其他冰區橋梁累積資料。監測也能發現冰盾磨損或墩前堆冰改變受力模式的情況，作為冰季巡查與維修的依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墩身傾斜計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Design ice forces carry large uncertainty: ice strength varies with temperature, salinity and loading rate, and sheet thickness and drift speed change from year to year. Tiltmeters, accelerometers or strain gauges on representative piers, combined with ice observations of thickness, speed and failure mode, let engineers back-calculate actual ice forces from structural response, test design assumptions and build data for other ice-exposed bridges. Monitoring also reveals when shield wear or rubble build-up changes the loading mode, guiding ice-season patrols and repairs. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pier tiltmeters” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以墩身轉動勁度 k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad 反算：量到冰作用時墩頂附加傾角 θ = 20 μrad，彎矩 M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m；若作用點到轉動中心的力臂 30 m，冰力 F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Back-calculate with a pier rotational stiffness k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad: an extra tilt θ = 20 μrad during an ice event gives M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m, and with a 30 m lever arm to the rotation centre the ice force is F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「冰力很難量測，所以只能完全依賴設計規範的數值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ice forces cannot be measured, so engineers must rely entirely on code values." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「墩身傾斜計」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pier tiltmeters”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 冰力與結構反應監測
