knowledge.text: 冰力的設計值帶有很大的不確定性：冰的強度隨溫度、鹽度與加載速率變化，冰板厚度與漂移速度年年不同。在代表性墩位裝設傾斜計、加速度計或應變計，再配合冰況觀測（冰厚、冰速、破壞模式），可以從結構反應反算實際冰力，檢驗設計假設，並為其他冰區橋梁累積資料。
knowledge.textEn: Design ice forces carry large uncertainty: ice strength varies with temperature, salinity and loading rate, and sheet thickness and drift speed change from year to year. Tiltmeters, accelerometers or strain gauges on representative piers, combined with ice observations of thickness, speed and failure mode, let engineers back-calculate actual ice forces from structural response, test design assumptions and build data for other ice-exposed bridges.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：冰力很難量測，所以只能完全依賴設計規範的數值。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ice forces cannot be measured, so engineers must rely entirely on code values. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「冰力與結構反應監測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Monitoring ice forces and response" is correct?
options: 冰力很難量測，所以只能完全依賴設計規範的數值。
冰力的設計值帶有很大的不確定性：冰的強度隨溫度、鹽度與加載速率變化，冰板厚度與漂移速度年年不同。
只要橋梁結構能承受颱風等級的風，車輛在橋上就一定安全。
optionsEn: Ice forces cannot be measured, so engineers must rely entirely on code values.
Design ice forces carry large uncertainty: ice strength varies with temperature, salinity and loading rate, and sheet thickness and drift speed change from year to year.
If the structure can withstand storm winds, vehicles on it are automatically safe.
quiz.explanation: 冰力的設計值帶有很大的不確定性：冰的強度隨溫度、鹽度與加載速率變化，冰板厚度與漂移速度年年不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Design ice forces carry large uncertainty: ice strength varies with temperature, salinity and loading rate, and sheet thickness and drift speed change from year to year. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 冰力與結構反應監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring ice forces and response: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墩身傾斜計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pier tiltmeters” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以墩身轉動勁度 k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad 反算：量到冰作用時墩頂附加傾角 θ = 20 μrad，彎矩 M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m；若作用點到轉動中心的力臂 30 m，冰力 F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN。勁度與力臂為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Back-calculate with a pier rotational stiffness k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad: an extra tilt θ = 20 μrad during an ice event gives M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m, and with a 30 m lever arm to the rotation centre the ice force is F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN. Stiffness and lever arm are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先以已知荷載（例如載重車或拉索施力）標定墩身的轉動勁度，再於冰季連續記錄傾角、溫度與冰況影像；以溫度修正排除日照造成的傾斜，比較反算冰力的統計分布與設計冰力，並檢查最大事件發生時的冰厚與破壞模式。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: First calibrate the pier's rotational stiffness with a known load such as test trucks or a cable pull, then log tilt, temperature and ice imagery continuously through the ice season; remove sun-induced tilt by temperature correction, compare the statistical distribution of back-calculated forces with design ice loads, and check ice thickness and failure mode during the largest events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以墩身轉動勁度 k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad 反算：量到冰作用時墩頂附加傾角 θ = 20 μrad，彎矩 M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m；若作用點到轉動中心的力臂 30 m，冰力 F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN。勁度與力臂為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Back-calculate with a pier rotational stiffness k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad: an extra tilt θ = 20 μrad during an ice event gives M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m, and with a 30 m lever arm to the rotation centre the ice force is F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN. Stiffness and lever arm are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「冰力與結構反應監測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Monitoring ice forces and response", which statement holds?
options: 特許期結束時橋還能通車，就代表結構狀態良好。
預製構件只要在陸上做好，放到墩上就完成了結構體系。
以墩身轉動勁度 k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad 反算：量到冰作用時墩頂附加傾角 θ = 20 μrad，彎矩 M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m。
optionsEn: If the bridge is still open at the end of the concession, its condition must be good.
Once precast pieces are made on land and set on the piers, the structural system is complete.

Back-calculate with a pier rotational stiffness k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad: an extra tilt θ = 20 μrad during an ice event gives M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m, and with a 30 m lever arm to the rotation centre the ice force is F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN.
quiz.explanation: 以墩身轉動勁度 k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad 反算：量到冰作用時墩頂附加傾角 θ = 20 μrad，彎矩 M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m；若作用點到轉動中心的力臂 30 m，冰力 F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Back-calculate with a pier rotational stiffness k_θ = 5×10⁸ kN·m/rad: an extra tilt θ = 20 μrad during an ice event gives M = k_θ·θ = 5×10⁸×20×10⁻⁶ = 10,000 kN·m, and with a 30 m lever arm to the rotation centre the ice force is F = 10,000/30 ≈ 333 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 冰力與結構反應監測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring ice forces and response: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墩身傾斜計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pier tiltmeters” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先以已知荷載（例如載重車或拉索施力）標定墩身的轉動勁度，再於冰季連續記錄傾角、溫度與冰況影像；以溫度修正排除日照造成的傾斜，比較反算冰力的統計分布與設計冰力，並檢查最大事件發生時的冰厚與破壞模式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: First calibrate the pier's rotational stiffness with a known load such as test trucks or a cable pull, then log tilt, temperature and ice imagery continuously through the ice season; remove sun-induced tilt by temperature correction, compare the statistical distribution of back-calculated forces with design ice loads, and check ice thickness and failure mode during the largest events. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測計畫應明訂標定方法、溫度修正、資料品質檢查與冰況同步觀測的方式，並指定判讀人員與年度報告格式；異常冰力事件後須進行墩身與冰盾的特別檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The monitoring plan should define calibration, temperature correction, data-quality checks and synchronised ice observation, name the analysts and the annual report format, and require special inspection of pier and shield after any abnormal ice-force event.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若未做溫度修正，日照造成的墩身傾斜會被誤判為冰力，得出偏高或偏低的結論；感測器在冰季失效而未及時更換，正好錯過最需要的資料。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without temperature correction, sun-induced tilt is mistaken for ice load and leads to wrong conclusions; sensors that fail during the ice season and are not replaced miss exactly the data that matter most. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先以已知荷載（例如載重車或拉索施力）標定墩身的轉動勁度，再於冰季連續記錄傾角、溫度與冰況影像；以溫度修正排除日照造成的傾斜，比較反算冰力的統計分布與設計冰力，並檢查最大事件發生時的冰厚與破壞模式。
knowledge.textEn: First calibrate the pier's rotational stiffness with a known load such as test trucks or a cable pull, then log tilt, temperature and ice imagery continuously through the ice season; remove sun-induced tilt by temperature correction, compare the statistical distribution of back-calculated forces with design ice loads, and check ice thickness and failure mode during the largest events.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測計畫應明訂標定方法、溫度修正、資料品質檢查與冰況同步觀測的方式，並指定判讀人員與年度報告格式；異常冰力事件後須進行墩身與冰盾的特別檢查。
knowledge.textEn: The monitoring plan should define calibration, temperature correction, data-quality checks and synchronised ice observation, name the analysts and the annual report format, and require special inspection of pier and shield after any abnormal ice-force event.

quiz.question: 要驗證「冰力與結構反應監測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring ice forces and response"?
options: 先以已知荷載（例如載重車或拉索施力）標定墩身的轉動勁度，再於冰季連續記錄傾角、溫度與冰況影像。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
預製構件夠重，疊上去後不需要灌漿或預力就能穩定傳力。
optionsEn: First calibrate the pier's rotational stiffness with a known load such as test trucks or a cable pull, then log tilt, temperature and ice imagery continuously through the ice season.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Precast pieces are heavy enough to transmit load reliably when stacked, without grout or prestress.
quiz.explanation: 先以已知荷載（例如載重車或拉索施力）標定墩身的轉動勁度，再於冰季連續記錄傾角、溫度與冰況影像；以溫度修正排除日照造成的傾斜，比較反算冰力的統計分布與設計冰力，並檢查最大事件發生時的冰厚與破壞模式。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: First calibrate the pier's rotational stiffness with a known load such as test trucks or a cable pull, then log tilt, temperature and ice imagery continuously through the ice season; remove sun-induced tilt by temperature correction, compare the statistical distribution of back-calculated forces with design ice loads, and check ice thickness and failure mode during the largest events. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 冰力與結構反應監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring ice forces and response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墩身傾斜計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pier tiltmeters” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若未做溫度修正，日照造成的墩身傾斜會被誤判為冰力，得出偏高或偏低的結論；感測器在冰季失效而未及時更換，正好錯過最需要的資料。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without temperature correction, sun-induced tilt is mistaken for ice load and leads to wrong conclusions; sensors that fail during the ice season and are not replaced miss exactly the data that matter most. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測也能發現冰盾磨損或墩前堆冰改變受力模式的情況，作為冰季巡查與維修的依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Monitoring also reveals when shield wear or rubble build-up changes the loading mode, guiding ice-season patrols and repairs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「冰力很難量測，所以只能完全依賴設計規範的數值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ice forces cannot be measured, so engineers must rely entirely on code values." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若未做溫度修正，日照造成的墩身傾斜會被誤判為冰力，得出偏高或偏低的結論；感測器在冰季失效而未及時更換，正好錯過最需要的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Without temperature correction, sun-induced tilt is mistaken for ice load and leads to wrong conclusions; sensors that fail during the ice season and are not replaced miss exactly the data that matter most.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「冰力與結構反應監測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring ice forces and response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若未做溫度修正，日照造成的墩身傾斜會被誤判為冰力，得出偏高或偏低的結論；感測器在冰季失效而未及時更換，正好錯過最需要的資料。
只要橋梁結構能承受颱風等級的風，車輛在橋上就一定安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Without temperature correction, sun-induced tilt is mistaken for ice load and leads to wrong conclusions.
If the structure can withstand storm winds, vehicles on it are automatically safe.
quiz.explanation: 若未做溫度修正，日照造成的墩身傾斜會被誤判為冰力，得出偏高或偏低的結論；感測器在冰季失效而未及時更換，正好錯過最需要的資料。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without temperature correction, sun-induced tilt is mistaken for ice load and leads to wrong conclusions; sensors that fail during the ice season and are not replaced miss exactly the data that matter most. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 強風管制與高側車輛：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wind restrictions and high-sided vehicles: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋面風速計」如何影響聯邦大橋（加拿大）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck anemometers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Confederation Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋面大部分高出海面約 40 公尺，航道段最高約 60 公尺，海峽上的強風對結構通常不是控制因素，卻直接威脅高側車輛、空車拖車與機車的行車安全。營運單位在橋上設置風速計，官方網站每 6 分鐘更新持續風速與陣風，超過門檻時實施分級限制，例如禁止特定車種或降低速限。這是一種以量測支撐營運決策的措施：門檻值由車輛傾覆與側滑的力學計算決定，並以實際事故與風速紀錄修正。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面風速計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Most of the deck is about 40 m above the sea and up to about 60 m at the navigation span; strong winds over the strait rarely govern the structure but directly threaten high-sided vehicles, empty trailers and motorcycles. The operator runs deck anemometers, and its website updates sustained winds and gusts every six minutes, triggering staged restrictions such as banning certain vehicle types or lowering speed limits when thresholds are exceeded. It is a measurement-based operating decision: thresholds come from the mechanics of vehicle overturning and sliding, refined with incident and wind records. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck anemometers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 107 km/h gust is 29.7 m/s, so q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×29.7² ≈ 541 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要橋梁結構能承受颱風等級的風，車輛在橋上就一定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the structure can withstand storm winds, vehicles on it are automatically safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋面風速計」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck anemometers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 強風管制與高側車輛
knowledge.text: 橋面大部分高出海面約 40 公尺，航道段最高約 60 公尺，海峽上的強風對結構通常不是控制因素，卻直接威脅高側車輛、空車拖車與機車的行車安全。營運單位在橋上設置風速計，官方網站每 6 分鐘更新持續風速與陣風，超過門檻時實施分級限制，例如禁止特定車種或降低速限。
knowledge.textEn: Most of the deck is about 40 m above the sea and up to about 60 m at the navigation span; strong winds over the strait rarely govern the structure but directly threaten high-sided vehicles, empty trailers and motorcycles. The operator runs deck anemometers, and its website updates sustained winds and gusts every six minutes, triggering staged restrictions such as banning certain vehicle types or lowering speed limits when thresholds are exceeded.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要橋梁結構能承受颱風等級的風，車輛在橋上就一定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the structure can withstand storm winds, vehicles on it are automatically safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「強風管制與高側車輛」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wind restrictions and high-sided vehicles" is correct?
options: 只要橋梁結構能承受颱風等級的風，車輛在橋上就一定安全。
鋪面只影響行車舒適，與結構壽命無關。
橋面大部分高出海面約 40 公尺，航道段最高約 60 公尺，海峽上的強風對結構通常不是控制因素，卻直接威脅高側車輛、空車拖車與機車的行車安全。
optionsEn: If the structure can withstand storm winds, vehicles on it are automatically safe.
Surfacing only affects ride comfort and has nothing to do with structural life.
Most of the deck is about 40 m above the sea and up to about 60 m at the navigation span.
quiz.explanation: 橋面大部分高出海面約 40 公尺，航道段最高約 60 公尺，海峽上的強風對結構通常不是控制因素，卻直接威脅高側車輛、空車拖車與機車的行車安全。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Most of the deck is about 40 m above the sea and up to about 60 m at the navigation span; strong winds over the strait rarely govern the structure but directly threaten high-sided vehicles, empty trailers and motorcycles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 強風管制與高側車輛：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wind restrictions and high-sided vehicles: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面風速計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck anemometers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：陣風 107 km/h = 29.7 m/s，q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×29.7² ≈ 541 Pa。空拖車側面積 39 m²、側力係數 1.2：F = 541×1.2×39 ≈ 25.3 kN，作用高度 2.0 m，傾覆彎矩約 50.6 kN·m。空車重 80 kN、輪距半寬 1.0 m，抗傾覆彎矩 80 kN·m，安全係數約 1.58；滿載 300 kN 時約 5.9。車輛參數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 107 km/h gust is 29.7 m/s, so q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×29.7² ≈ 541 Pa. An empty trailer with 39 m² side area and side-force coefficient 1.2 sees F = 541×1.2×39 ≈ 25.3 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of about 50.6 kN·m. Weighing 80 kN with a half-track of 1.0 m, it resists 80 kN·m, a factor of about 1.58; loaded to 300 kN the factor is about 5.9. Vehicle parameters are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：風速計的位置、高度與遮蔽需與設計風場一致，並定期校正；以多年風速紀錄統計超過各門檻的時數，評估交通中斷的頻率；事故或車輛偏移事件發生時，回查當時風速與限制狀態，檢討門檻是否適當。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Anemometer position, height and shelter must match the design wind field, with regular calibration; multi-year wind records give the hours above each threshold and thus closure frequency; after incidents or vehicle drift events, review the wind speed and restriction status at the time to judge whether thresholds are right.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 陣風 107 km/h = 29.7 m/s，q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×29.7² ≈ 541 Pa。空拖車側面積 39 m²、側力係數 1.2：F = 541×1.2×39 ≈ 25.3 kN，作用高度 2.0 m，傾覆彎矩約 50.6 kN·m。空車重 80 kN、輪距半寬 1.0 m，抗傾覆彎矩 80 kN·m，安全係數約 1.58；滿載 300 kN 時約 5.9。車輛參數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 107 km/h gust is 29.7 m/s, so q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×29.7² ≈ 541 Pa. An empty trailer with 39 m² side area and side-force coefficient 1.2 sees F = 541×1.2×39 ≈ 25.3 kN at 2.0 m height, an overturning moment of about 50.6 kN·m. Weighing 80 kN with a half-track of 1.0 m, it resists 80 kN·m, a factor of about 1.58; loaded to 300 kN the factor is about 5.9. Vehicle parameters are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「強風管制與高側車輛」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wind restrictions and high-sided vehicles", which statement holds?
options: 冰比混凝土軟得多，所以浮冰對橋墩的力量可以忽略。
混凝土強度夠高，就能同時抵抗凍融、氯離子與冰磨蝕。
optionsEn: A 107 km/h gust is 29.7 m/s, so q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×29.7² ≈ 541 Pa.
Ice is much softer than concrete, so pack-ice forces on piers are negligible.
High concrete strength alone resists freeze–thaw, chlorides and ice abrasion together.
quiz.explanation: 陣風 107 km/h = 29.7 m/s，q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×29.7² ≈ 541 Pa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 107 km/h gust is 29.7 m/s, so q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×29.7² ≈ 541 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 強風管制與高側車輛：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind restrictions and high-sided vehicles: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面風速計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck anemometers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 風速計的位置、高度與遮蔽需與設計風場一致，並定期校正；以多年風速紀錄統計超過各門檻的時數，評估交通中斷的頻率；事故或車輛偏移事件發生時，回查當時風速與限制狀態，檢討門檻是否適當。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Anemometer position, height and shelter must match the design wind field, with regular calibration; multi-year wind records give the hours above each threshold and thus closure frequency; after incidents or vehicle drift events, review the wind speed and restriction status at the time to judge whether thresholds are right. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：營運手冊應列出各車種的風速門檻、量測來源、發布與解除程序及通報管道，並每年以事故與風速資料檢討；更換護欄或在橋面加裝設施時，須確認不影響風速計的代表性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The operating manual should list wind thresholds by vehicle type, measurement sources, procedures for issuing and lifting restrictions and communication channels, reviewed annually with incident and wind data; replacing barriers or adding deck equipment must not compromise anemometer representativeness.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：風速計被結構或護欄遮蔽、量測偏低時，限制發布太晚，空車或高側車輛可能在陣風中偏移撞擊護欄甚至傾覆；門檻過於保守則頻繁封閉，影響島上物流與民生。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An anemometer sheltered by the structure or barriers reads low and restrictions come too late, so empty or high-sided vehicles can drift into barriers or overturn in gusts; overly conservative thresholds close the bridge often and disrupt island logistics and daily life. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 風速計的位置、高度與遮蔽需與設計風場一致，並定期校正；以多年風速紀錄統計超過各門檻的時數，評估交通中斷的頻率；事故或車輛偏移事件發生時，回查當時風速與限制狀態，檢討門檻是否適當。
knowledge.textEn: Anemometer position, height and shelter must match the design wind field, with regular calibration; multi-year wind records give the hours above each threshold and thus closure frequency; after incidents or vehicle drift events, review the wind speed and restriction status at the time to judge whether thresholds are right.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 營運手冊應列出各車種的風速門檻、量測來源、發布與解除程序及通報管道，並每年以事故與風速資料檢討；更換護欄或在橋面加裝設施時，須確認不影響風速計的代表性。
knowledge.textEn: The operating manual should list wind thresholds by vehicle type, measurement sources, procedures for issuing and lifting restrictions and communication channels, reviewed annually with incident and wind data; replacing barriers or adding deck equipment must not compromise anemometer representativeness.

quiz.question: 要驗證「強風管制與高側車輛」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wind restrictions and high-sided vehicles"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
風速計的位置、高度與遮蔽需與設計風場一致，並定期校正。
只要浮吊能力夠大，工程進度就只取決於吊裝速度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Anemometer position, height and shelter must match the design wind field, with regular calibration.
With a big enough crane, progress depends only on lifting speed.
quiz.explanation: 風速計的位置、高度與遮蔽需與設計風場一致，並定期校正；以多年風速紀錄統計超過各門檻的時數，評估交通中斷的頻率；事故或車輛偏移事件發生時，回查當時風速與限制狀態，檢討門檻是否適當。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Anemometer position, height and shelter must match the design wind field, with regular calibration; multi-year wind records give the hours above each threshold and thus closure frequency; after incidents or vehicle drift events, review the wind speed and restriction status at the time to judge whether thresholds are right. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 強風管制與高側車輛：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wind restrictions and high-sided vehicles: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋面風速計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck anemometers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 風速計被結構或護欄遮蔽、量測偏低時，限制發布太晚，空車或高側車輛可能在陣風中偏移撞擊護欄甚至傾覆；門檻過於保守則頻繁封閉，影響島上物流與民生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An anemometer sheltered by the structure or barriers reads low and restrictions come too late, so empty or high-sided vehicles can drift into barriers or overturn in gusts; overly conservative thresholds close the bridge often and disrupt island logistics and daily life. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是一種以量測支撐營運決策的措施：門檻值由車輛傾覆與側滑的力學計算決定，並以實際事故與風速紀錄修正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is a measurement-based operating decision: thresholds come from the mechanics of vehicle overturning and sliding, refined with incident and wind records.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要橋梁結構能承受颱風等級的風，車輛在橋上就一定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the structure can withstand storm winds, vehicles on it are automatically safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 風速計被結構或護欄遮蔽、量測偏低時，限制發布太晚，空車或高側車輛可能在陣風中偏移撞擊護欄甚至傾覆；門檻過於保守則頻繁封閉，影響島上物流與民生。
knowledge.textEn: An anemometer sheltered by the structure or barriers reads low and restrictions come too late, so empty or high-sided vehicles can drift into barriers or overturn in gusts; overly conservative thresholds close the bridge often and disrupt island logistics and daily life.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「強風管制與高側車輛」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wind restrictions and high-sided vehicles" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋪面只影響行車舒適，與結構壽命無關。
風速計被結構或護欄遮蔽、量測偏低時，限制發布太晚，空車或高側車輛可能在陣風中偏移撞擊護欄甚至傾覆；門檻過於保守則頻繁封閉，影響島上物流與民生。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Surfacing only affects ride comfort and has nothing to do with structural life.
An anemometer sheltered by the structure or barriers reads low and restrictions come too late, so empty or high-sided vehicles can drift into barriers or overturn in gusts.
quiz.explanation: 風速計被結構或護欄遮蔽、量測偏低時，限制發布太晚，空車或高側車輛可能在陣風中偏移撞擊護欄甚至傾覆；門檻過於保守則頻繁封閉，影響島上物流與民生。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An anemometer sheltered by the structure or barriers reads low and restrictions come too late, so empty or high-sided vehicles can drift into barriers or overturn in gusts; overly conservative thresholds close the bridge often and disrupt island logistics and daily life. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修」與「特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "De-icing salt, freeze–thaw and resurfacing" and "Concession, inspections and the 2032 transfer": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: De-icing salt, freeze–thaw and resurfacing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋面防水與鋪面」如何影響聯邦大橋（加拿大）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck waterproofing and surfacing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Confederation Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 冬季除冰鹽讓橋面混凝土承受高濃度氯離子，加上反覆凍融，是橋面板最主要的劣化來源。橋面防水層與瀝青鋪面的任務就是把水和鹽擋在結構混凝土之外；營運單位說明 2015 年做過微表處理，近期又進行自通車以來最大規模的鋪面更新，目的之一正是防止水與除冰鹽進入結構橋面板，以確保 100 年壽命。鋪面是犧牲層，必須定期更換；施工時刨除舊鋪面若傷及防水層或橋面板，反而會縮短結構壽命。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面防水與鋪面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Winter de-icing salt loads the deck concrete with high chloride concentrations, which together with repeated freeze–thaw is the main deterioration source for the deck slab. The waterproofing membrane and asphalt surfacing exist to keep water and salt out of the structural concrete; the operator explains that micro-surfacing was done in 2015 and that a recent resurfacing, the largest since opening, aimed partly at keeping water and de-icing salt out of the structural deck to secure the 100-year life. Surfacing is a sacrificial layer that must be renewed periodically, and milling that damages the membrane or the slab shortens the structure's life instead. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck waterproofing and surfacing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ASTM C666 耐久因數 DF = P·N/M：300 次凍融循環後相對動彈性模數 P = 90%，DF = 90×300/300 = 90。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ASTM C666 durability factor DF = P·N/M: with relative dynamic modulus P = 90% after 300 cycles, DF = 90×300/300 = 90.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋪面只影響行車舒適，與結構壽命無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Surfacing only affects ride comfort and has nothing to do with structural life." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋面防水與鋪面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck waterproofing and surfacing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修
knowledge.text: 冬季除冰鹽讓橋面混凝土承受高濃度氯離子，加上反覆凍融，是橋面板最主要的劣化來源。橋面防水層與瀝青鋪面的任務就是把水和鹽擋在結構混凝土之外；營運單位說明 2015 年做過微表處理，近期又進行自通車以來最大規模的鋪面更新，目的之一正是防止水與除冰鹽進入結構橋面板，以確保 100 年壽命。
knowledge.textEn: Winter de-icing salt loads the deck concrete with high chloride concentrations, which together with repeated freeze–thaw is the main deterioration source for the deck slab. The waterproofing membrane and asphalt surfacing exist to keep water and salt out of the structural concrete; the operator explains that micro-surfacing was done in 2015 and that a recent resurfacing, the largest since opening, aimed partly at keeping water and de-icing salt out of the structural deck to secure the 100-year life.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋪面只影響行車舒適，與結構壽命無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Surfacing only affects ride comfort and has nothing to do with structural life. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "De-icing salt, freeze–thaw and resurfacing" is correct?
options: 冬季除冰鹽讓橋面混凝土承受高濃度氯離子，加上反覆凍融，是橋面板最主要的劣化來源。
鋪面只影響行車舒適，與結構壽命無關。
特許期結束時橋還能通車，就代表結構狀態良好。
optionsEn: Winter de-icing salt loads the deck concrete with high chloride concentrations, which together with repeated freeze–thaw is the main deterioration source for the deck slab.
Surfacing only affects ride comfort and has nothing to do with structural life.
If the bridge is still open at the end of the concession, its condition must be good.
quiz.explanation: 冬季除冰鹽讓橋面混凝土承受高濃度氯離子，加上反覆凍融，是橋面板最主要的劣化來源。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Winter de-icing salt loads the deck concrete with high chloride concentrations, which together with repeated freeze–thaw is the main deterioration source for the deck slab. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修：定量估算
steps.titleEn: De-icing salt, freeze–thaw and resurfacing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面防水與鋪面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck waterproofing and surfacing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ASTM C666 耐久因數 DF = P·N/M：300 次凍融循環後相對動彈性模數 P = 90%，DF = 90×300/300 = 90。若每年約 60 次凍融、100 年約 6,000 次，遠多於試驗的 300 次，所以試驗結果只能作為配比比較，必須配合防水層把橋面混凝土保持在低含水狀態。凍融次數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ASTM C666 durability factor DF = P·N/M: with relative dynamic modulus P = 90% after 300 cycles, DF = 90×300/300 = 90. At about 60 freeze–thaw cycles a year, 100 years bring about 6,000 cycles, far beyond the 300 tested, so the test only ranks mixes and the membrane must keep the deck concrete dry. The cycle count is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋪面翻修前以透地雷達或鑽心檢查防水層與橋面板狀況，刨除時控制刨深並檢查有無傷及防水層；新鋪面驗收壓實度、厚度與平整度；定期在代表性位置量測橋面板氯離子含量與半電池電位，追蹤腐蝕風險。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before resurfacing check the membrane and slab by ground-penetrating radar or cores, control milling depth and look for membrane damage; accept the new surfacing on compaction, thickness and smoothness; periodically measure chloride content and half-cell potential at representative deck locations to track corrosion risk.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ASTM C666 耐久因數 DF = P·N/M：300 次凍融循環後相對動彈性模數 P = 90%，DF = 90×300/300 = 90。若每年約 60 次凍融、100 年約 6,000 次，遠多於試驗的 300 次，所以試驗結果只能作為配比比較，必須配合防水層把橋面混凝土保持在低含水狀態。凍融次數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ASTM C666 durability factor DF = P·N/M: with relative dynamic modulus P = 90% after 300 cycles, DF = 90×300/300 = 90. At about 60 freeze–thaw cycles a year, 100 years bring about 6,000 cycles, far beyond the 300 tested, so the test only ranks mixes and the membrane must keep the deck concrete dry. The cycle count is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "De-icing salt, freeze–thaw and resurfacing", which statement holds?
options: 預製構件只要在陸上做好，放到墩上就完成了結構體系。
ASTM C666 耐久因數 DF = P·N/M：300 次凍融循環後相對動彈性模數 P = 90%，DF = 90×300/300 = 90。
預製構件夠重，疊上去後不需要灌漿或預力就能穩定傳力。
optionsEn: Once precast pieces are made on land and set on the piers, the structural system is complete.
ASTM C666 durability factor DF = P·N/M: with relative dynamic modulus P = 90% after 300 cycles, DF = 90×300/300 = 90.
Precast pieces are heavy enough to transmit load reliably when stacked, without grout or prestress.
quiz.explanation: ASTM C666 耐久因數 DF = P·N/M：300 次凍融循環後相對動彈性模數 P = 90%，DF = 90×300/300 = 90。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ASTM C666 durability factor DF = P·N/M: with relative dynamic modulus P = 90% after 300 cycles, DF = 90×300/300 = 90. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: De-icing salt, freeze–thaw and resurfacing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面防水與鋪面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck waterproofing and surfacing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋪面翻修前以透地雷達或鑽心檢查防水層與橋面板狀況，刨除時控制刨深並檢查有無傷及防水層；新鋪面驗收壓實度、厚度與平整度；定期在代表性位置量測橋面板氯離子含量與半電池電位，追蹤腐蝕風險。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before resurfacing check the membrane and slab by ground-penetrating radar or cores, control milling depth and look for membrane damage; accept the new surfacing on compaction, thickness and smoothness; periodically measure chloride content and half-cell potential at representative deck locations to track corrosion risk. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋪面翻修規範應包含刨深控制、防水層檢查與修補、交通維持與冬季前完工的期限；每次翻修後更新橋面板狀況紀錄，並在交接文件中記錄防水層系統與歷次翻修資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Resurfacing specifications should cover milling-depth control, membrane inspection and repair, traffic management and a completion deadline before winter; update the deck condition record after each campaign and include the membrane system and resurfacing history in handover documents.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋪面裂縫與坑洞若長期不修，鹽水直接滲入橋面板，鋼筋腐蝕膨脹使橋面板底部剝落；刨除過深傷到防水層後重鋪，表面看似全新，內部卻失去防水保護。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Long-unrepaired cracks and potholes let brine soak into the slab, and corroding bars spall its soffit; milling too deep and damaging the membrane before repaving leaves a surface that looks new while the deck has lost its waterproofing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鋪面翻修前以透地雷達或鑽心檢查防水層與橋面板狀況，刨除時控制刨深並檢查有無傷及防水層；新鋪面驗收壓實度、厚度與平整度；定期在代表性位置量測橋面板氯離子含量與半電池電位，追蹤腐蝕風險。
knowledge.textEn: Before resurfacing check the membrane and slab by ground-penetrating radar or cores, control milling depth and look for membrane damage; accept the new surfacing on compaction, thickness and smoothness; periodically measure chloride content and half-cell potential at representative deck locations to track corrosion risk.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鋪面翻修規範應包含刨深控制、防水層檢查與修補、交通維持與冬季前完工的期限；每次翻修後更新橋面板狀況紀錄，並在交接文件中記錄防水層系統與歷次翻修資料。
knowledge.textEn: Resurfacing specifications should cover milling-depth control, membrane inspection and repair, traffic management and a completion deadline before winter; update the deck condition record after each campaign and include the membrane system and resurfacing history in handover documents.

quiz.question: 要驗證「除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

鋪面翻修前以透地雷達或鑽心檢查防水層與橋面板狀況，刨除時控制刨深並檢查有無傷及防水層。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Precast pieces are accurate, so their levels stay fixed after placement.
Before resurfacing check the membrane and slab by ground-penetrating radar or cores, control milling depth and look for membrane damage.
quiz.explanation: 鋪面翻修前以透地雷達或鑽心檢查防水層與橋面板狀況，刨除時控制刨深並檢查有無傷及防水層；新鋪面驗收壓實度、厚度與平整度；定期在代表性位置量測橋面板氯離子含量與半電池電位，追蹤腐蝕風險。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before resurfacing check the membrane and slab by ground-penetrating radar or cores, control milling depth and look for membrane damage; accept the new surfacing on compaction, thickness and smoothness; periodically measure chloride content and half-cell potential at representative deck locations to track corrosion risk. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: De-icing salt, freeze–thaw and resurfacing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋面防水與鋪面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck waterproofing and surfacing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋪面裂縫與坑洞若長期不修，鹽水直接滲入橋面板，鋼筋腐蝕膨脹使橋面板底部剝落；刨除過深傷到防水層後重鋪，表面看似全新，內部卻失去防水保護。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Long-unrepaired cracks and potholes let brine soak into the slab, and corroding bars spall its soffit; milling too deep and damaging the membrane before repaving leaves a surface that looks new while the deck has lost its waterproofing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋪面是犧牲層，必須定期更換；施工時刨除舊鋪面若傷及防水層或橋面板，反而會縮短結構壽命。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surfacing is a sacrificial layer that must be renewed periodically, and milling that damages the membrane or the slab shortens the structure's life instead.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋪面只影響行車舒適，與結構壽命無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Surfacing only affects ride comfort and has nothing to do with structural life." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋪面裂縫與坑洞若長期不修，鹽水直接滲入橋面板，鋼筋腐蝕膨脹使橋面板底部剝落；刨除過深傷到防水層後重鋪，表面看似全新，內部卻失去防水保護。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「除冰鹽、凍融與橋面翻修」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "De-icing salt, freeze–thaw and resurfacing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
特許期結束時橋還能通車，就代表結構狀態良好。
optionsEn: Long-unrepaired cracks and potholes let brine soak into the slab, and corroding bars spall its soffit.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If the bridge is still open at the end of the concession, its condition must be good.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Concession, inspections and the 2032 transfer: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「2032 年交接文件」如何影響聯邦大橋（加拿大）的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “2032 transfer records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Confederation Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 聯邦大橋屬於加拿大聯邦資產，由 Strait Crossing 公司依 1993 年協議設計、興建、融資、營運與維護，營運期至 2032 年，之後移交加拿大政府；公共服務及採購部表示仍進行年度檢查與預防性維護。這種長期特許模式把維護責任與收費收入綁在一起，但移交時點的狀態定義至關重要：新管理者需要知道結構已用掉多少壽命、哪些構件接近劣化門檻、哪些監測資料可用。交接文件因此要回答「現況是否符合百年設計壽命的軌跡」。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「2032 年交接文件」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Confederation Bridge is a federal asset designed, built, financed, operated and maintained by Strait Crossing under 1993 agreements, operating until 2032 when it passes to the Government of Canada; Public Services and Procurement Canada states that it continues annual inspections and preventive maintenance. Such a long concession ties maintenance to toll revenue, but defining condition at the transfer date is critical: the new manager must know how much life has been used, which components are near deterioration thresholds and what monitoring data exist. Handover documents must therefore answer whether the bridge is on track for its 100-year life. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “2032 transfer records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：1997 年通車到 2032 年移交共 35 年，佔 100 年設計壽命的 35/100 = 35%，剩餘約 65 年（2016 年預算官報告估計壽命至 2097 年）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: From opening in 1997 to transfer in 2032 is 35 years, 35/100 = 35% of the design life, leaving about 65 years (a 2016 budget-officer report put the end of life at 2097).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「特許期結束時橋還能通車，就代表結構狀態良好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the bridge is still open at the end of the concession, its condition must be good." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「2032 年交接文件」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “2032 transfer records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接
knowledge.text: 聯邦大橋屬於加拿大聯邦資產，由 Strait Crossing 公司依 1993 年協議設計、興建、融資、營運與維護，營運期至 2032 年，之後移交加拿大政府；公共服務及採購部表示仍進行年度檢查與預防性維護。這種長期特許模式把維護責任與收費收入綁在一起，但移交時點的狀態定義至關重要：新管理者需要知道結構已用掉多少壽命、哪些構件接近劣化門檻、哪些監測資料可用。
knowledge.textEn: Confederation Bridge is a federal asset designed, built, financed, operated and maintained by Strait Crossing under 1993 agreements, operating until 2032 when it passes to the Government of Canada; Public Services and Procurement Canada states that it continues annual inspections and preventive maintenance. Such a long concession ties maintenance to toll revenue, but defining condition at the transfer date is critical: the new manager must know how much life has been used, which components are near deterioration thresholds and what monitoring data exist.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：特許期結束時橋還能通車，就代表結構狀態良好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the bridge is still open at the end of the concession, its condition must be good. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Concession, inspections and the 2032 transfer" is correct?
options: 特許期結束時橋還能通車，就代表結構狀態良好。
聯邦大橋屬於加拿大聯邦資產，由 Strait Crossing 公司依 1993 年協議設計、興建、融資、營運與維護，營運期至 2032 年，之後移交加拿大政府。

Ice is much softer than concrete, so pack-ice forces on piers are negligible.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Concession, inspections and the 2032 transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「2032 年交接文件」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “2032 transfer records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：1997 年通車到 2032 年移交共 35 年，佔 100 年設計壽命的 35/100 = 35%，剩餘約 65 年（2016 年預算官報告估計壽命至 2097 年）。若某暴露區預測在第 60 年開始腐蝕，即約 2057 年，移交後只有 25 年可規劃修繕。腐蝕起始年份為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: From opening in 1997 to transfer in 2032 is 35 years, 35/100 = 35% of the design life, leaving about 65 years (a 2016 budget-officer report put the end of life at 2097). If one exposure zone is predicted to start corroding at year 60, about 2057, only 25 years remain after transfer to plan repairs. The initiation year is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：移交前由雙方共同委託獨立檢查，依構件逐項評定狀況等級，並以氯離子剖面、保護層、預力孔道與冰盾磨蝕的量測資料推估剩餘壽命；比較歷年年度檢查紀錄的趨勢，確認劣化速率與百年設計的假設一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before transfer both parties commission an independent inspection that rates every component, and estimate remaining life from chloride profiles, cover, tendon-duct and ice-shield abrasion data; compare trends in years of annual inspection records to confirm deterioration rates consistent with the 100-year assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 1997 年通車到 2032 年移交共 35 年，佔 100 年設計壽命的 35/100 = 35%，剩餘約 65 年（2016 年預算官報告估計壽命至 2097 年）。若某暴露區預測在第 60 年開始腐蝕，即約 2057 年，移交後只有 25 年可規劃修繕。腐蝕起始年份為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: From opening in 1997 to transfer in 2032 is 35 years, 35/100 = 35% of the design life, leaving about 65 years (a 2016 budget-officer report put the end of life at 2097). If one exposure zone is predicted to start corroding at year 60, about 2057, only 25 years remain after transfer to plan repairs. The initiation year is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Concession, inspections and the 2032 transfer", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土強度夠高，就能同時抵抗凍融、氯離子與冰磨蝕。
只要浮吊能力夠大，工程進度就只取決於吊裝速度。
1997 年通車到 2032 年移交共 35 年，佔 100 年設計壽命的 35/100 = 35%，剩餘約 65 年（2016 年預算官報告估計壽命至 2097 年）。
optionsEn: High concrete strength alone resists freeze–thaw, chlorides and ice abrasion together.
With a big enough crane, progress depends only on lifting speed.
From opening in 1997 to transfer in 2032 is 35 years, 35/100 = 35% of the design life, leaving about 65 years (a 2016 budget-officer report put the end of life at 2097).

steps.title: 特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concession, inspections and the 2032 transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「2032 年交接文件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “2032 transfer records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 移交前由雙方共同委託獨立檢查，依構件逐項評定狀況等級，並以氯離子剖面、保護層、預力孔道與冰盾磨蝕的量測資料推估剩餘壽命；比較歷年年度檢查紀錄的趨勢，確認劣化速率與百年設計的假設一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before transfer both parties commission an independent inspection that rates every component, and estimate remaining life from chloride profiles, cover, tendon-duct and ice-shield abrasion data; compare trends in years of annual inspection records to confirm deterioration rates consistent with the 100-year assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：特許合約應事先訂定移交時的狀態標準、必須提交的檢查與量測資料、剩餘壽命評估方法與缺失處理方式；移交文件包含竣工圖、構件履歷、年度檢查、監測資料與維修紀錄，並由獨立工程師簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The concession agreement should define in advance the condition standard at transfer, required inspection and measurement data, the remaining-life method and how defects are handled; transfer documents include as-built drawings, component histories, annual inspections, monitoring data and repair records, signed off by an independent engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若移交只看外觀而未量測隱蔽劣化，新管理者可能在接手數年後才發現預力孔道或橋面板的嚴重問題，修繕責任與費用產生爭議；監測資料格式不明或基準遺失，則多年資料無法比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A transfer based on appearance without measuring hidden deterioration may leave the new manager discovering serious tendon or deck problems a few years later, with disputes over responsibility and cost; unclear data formats or lost baselines make years of monitoring incomparable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 移交前由雙方共同委託獨立檢查，依構件逐項評定狀況等級，並以氯離子剖面、保護層、預力孔道與冰盾磨蝕的量測資料推估剩餘壽命；比較歷年年度檢查紀錄的趨勢，確認劣化速率與百年設計的假設一致。
knowledge.textEn: Before transfer both parties commission an independent inspection that rates every component, and estimate remaining life from chloride profiles, cover, tendon-duct and ice-shield abrasion data; compare trends in years of annual inspection records to confirm deterioration rates consistent with the 100-year assumptions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 特許合約應事先訂定移交時的狀態標準、必須提交的檢查與量測資料、剩餘壽命評估方法與缺失處理方式；移交文件包含竣工圖、構件履歷、年度檢查、監測資料與維修紀錄，並由獨立工程師簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The concession agreement should define in advance the condition standard at transfer, required inspection and measurement data, the remaining-life method and how defects are handled; transfer documents include as-built drawings, component histories, annual inspections, monitoring data and repair records, signed off by an independent engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Concession, inspections and the 2032 transfer"?
options: 移交前由雙方共同委託獨立檢查，依構件逐項評定狀況等級，並以氯離子剖面、保護層、預力孔道與冰盾磨蝕的量測資料推估剩餘壽命。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
冰力很難量測，所以只能完全依賴設計規範的數值。
optionsEn: Before transfer both parties commission an independent inspection that rates every component, and estimate remaining life from chloride profiles, cover, tendon-duct and ice-shield abrasion data.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Ice forces cannot be measured, so engineers must rely entirely on code values.
quiz.explanation: 移交前由雙方共同委託獨立檢查，依構件逐項評定狀況等級，並以氯離子剖面、保護層、預力孔道與冰盾磨蝕的量測資料推估剩餘壽命；比較歷年年度檢查紀錄的趨勢，確認劣化速率與百年設計的假設一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before transfer both parties commission an independent inspection that rates every component, and estimate remaining life from chloride profiles, cover, tendon-duct and ice-shield abrasion data; compare trends in years of annual inspection records to confirm deterioration rates consistent with the 100-year assumptions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concession, inspections and the 2032 transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「2032 年交接文件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “2032 transfer records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若移交只看外觀而未量測隱蔽劣化，新管理者可能在接手數年後才發現預力孔道或橋面板的嚴重問題，修繕責任與費用產生爭議；監測資料格式不明或基準遺失，則多年資料無法比較。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A transfer based on appearance without measuring hidden deterioration may leave the new manager discovering serious tendon or deck problems a few years later, with disputes over responsibility and cost; unclear data formats or lost baselines make years of monitoring incomparable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件因此要回答「現況是否符合百年設計壽命的軌跡」。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents must therefore answer whether the bridge is on track for its 100-year life.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「特許期結束時橋還能通車，就代表結構狀態良好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the bridge is still open at the end of the concession, its condition must be good." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若移交只看外觀而未量測隱蔽劣化，新管理者可能在接手數年後才發現預力孔道或橋面板的嚴重問題，修繕責任與費用產生爭議；監測資料格式不明或基準遺失，則多年資料無法比較。
knowledge.textEn: A transfer based on appearance without measuring hidden deterioration may leave the new manager discovering serious tendon or deck problems a few years later, with disputes over responsibility and cost; unclear data formats or lost baselines make years of monitoring incomparable.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「特許營運、年度檢查與 2032 交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concession, inspections and the 2032 transfer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若移交只看外觀而未量測隱蔽劣化，新管理者可能在接手數年後才發現預力孔道或橋面板的嚴重問題，修繕責任與費用產生爭議。
冰比混凝土軟得多，所以浮冰對橋墩的力量可以忽略。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

A transfer based on appearance without measuring hidden deterioration may leave the new manager discovering serious tendon or deck problems a few years later, with disputes over responsibility and cost.
Ice is much softer than concrete, so pack-ice forces on piers are negligible.

quiz.explanationEn: A transfer based on appearance without measuring hidden deterioration may leave the new manager discovering serious tendon or deck problems a few years later, with disputes over responsibility and cost; unclear data formats or lost baselines make years of monitoring incomparable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 雪梨港灣大橋
summary: 雪梨港灣大橋是跨度 503 公尺的雙鉸鋼拱橋，拱頂高出水面 134 公尺，橋面同時承載公路、鐵路、自行車道與人行道，1932 年通車。本課從雙鉸拱的推力與荷載路徑出發，分析桁架深度變化、鉚接與支承銷，再拆解兩岸以 128 條隧道錨碇鋼索支撐半拱懸臂架設、1930 年拱頂合龍與 1932 年 96 輛機車的載重試驗，最後談鉚接細節的疲勞評估、大面積塗裝維護，以及作為工程遺產的修繕與交接。
summaryEn: Sydney Harbour Bridge is a two-hinged steel arch spanning 503 m, its crown 134 m above the water, carrying road, rail, cycleway and footway since 1932. Starting from the thrust and load path of a two-hinged arch, the course examines varying truss depth, riveting and bearing pins, then the cantilever erection of each half-arch held back by 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels, the 1930 crown closure and the 1932 load test with 96 locomotives, ending with fatigue assessment of riveted details, painting of a vast steel surface and repair and handover of an engineering heritage structure.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 拱橋推力與溫度練習：取跨度 L = 503 m、拱矢 f = 120 m、總荷載 w = 700 kN/m。拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN，每側垂直反力 V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN；每側兩片桁架分擔，單一支承合力 ≈ √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN。若拱矢減為 110 m，H 升到約 201,300 kN，增加約 9%，說明矢跨比對推力很敏感。溫度方面，拋物線拱弧長 s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 503 + 8×120²/(3×503) ≈ 579.3 m；升溫 30 °C 時弧長增加 Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×579.3×30 ≈ 0.209 m，跨度固定時拱矢增加 Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×503×0.209/(16×120) ≈ 0.164 m，與公開資料所說熱天拱頂升高約 18 公分同量級。數值為教學假設，不代表雪梨港灣大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Arch thrust and temperature exercise: take span L = 503 m, rise f = 120 m and total load w = 700 kN/m. A parabolic arch has thrust H = w·L²/(8f) = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN and vertical reaction per side V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN; with two trusses per side, one bearing's resultant is about √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN. Reducing the rise to 110 m raises H to about 201,300 kN, about 9% more, showing how sensitive thrust is to the rise-to-span ratio. For temperature, the parabolic arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 503 + 8×120²/(3×503) ≈ 579.3 m; a 30 °C rise lengthens it by Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×579.3×30 ≈ 0.209 m, and with the span fixed the rise grows by Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×503×0.209/(16×120) ≈ 0.164 m, the same order as the roughly 18 cm crown rise on hot days cited publicly. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of the bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」與「桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch" and "Truss depth and unbalanced loading": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙鉸拱支承」如何影響雪梨港灣大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two-hinged arch bearings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雪梨港灣大橋由兩片平行的拱桁架組成，每片桁架只在兩端以鉸接支承在橋台上，屬於雙鉸拱：支點可以轉動但不能水平移動，因此拱的重量與橋面荷載主要以軸壓沿拱肋傳到支點，並在支點產生很大的水平推力，由兩岸的砂岩與混凝土橋台承受。橋面以吊桿懸掛在拱下，同時承載公路、兩條鐵路、自行車道與人行道；四座以花崗岩飾面的橋塔位於拱端，主要是建築與視覺作用，並不承擔拱的推力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙鉸拱支承」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bridge consists of two parallel arch trusses, each supported only by hinges at its two ends on the abutments, making it a two-hinged arch: the supports can rotate but not move horizontally, so the weight of the arch and deck travels mainly as axial compression along the ribs to the supports, producing a large horizontal thrust resisted by sandstone and concrete abutments on each shore. The deck hangs from the arch on vertical hangers and carries road lanes, two railway tracks, a cycleway and a footway; the four granite-faced pylons at the arch ends are mainly architectural and visual and do not resist the arch thrust. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Two-hinged arch bearings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The massive stone pylons at each end of the bridge carry the arch thrust." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙鉸拱支承」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Two-hinged arch bearings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑
knowledge.titleEn: Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch
knowledge.text: 雪梨港灣大橋由兩片平行的拱桁架組成，每片桁架只在兩端以鉸接支承在橋台上，屬於雙鉸拱：支點可以轉動但不能水平移動，因此拱的重量與橋面荷載主要以軸壓沿拱肋傳到支點，並在支點產生很大的水平推力，由兩岸的砂岩與混凝土橋台承受。橋面以吊桿懸掛在拱下，同時承載公路、兩條鐵路、自行車道與人行道；四座以花崗岩飾面的橋塔位於拱端，主要是建築與視覺作用，並不承擔拱的推力。

The deck hangs from the arch on vertical hangers and carries road lanes, two railway tracks, a cycleway and a footway; the four granite-faced pylons at the arch ends are mainly architectural and visual and do not resist the arch thrust.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch" is correct?
options: 雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。
雪梨港灣大橋由兩片平行的拱桁架組成，每片桁架只在兩端以鉸接支承在橋台上，屬於雙鉸拱：支點可以轉動但不能水平移動，因此拱的重量與橋面荷載主要以軸壓沿拱肋傳到支點，並在支點產生很大的水平推力，由兩岸的砂岩與混凝土橋台承受。
拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。
optionsEn: The massive stone pylons at each end of the bridge carry the arch thrust.

quiz.explanation: 雪梨港灣大橋由兩片平行的拱桁架組成，每片桁架只在兩端以鉸接支承在橋台上，屬於雙鉸拱：支點可以轉動但不能水平移動，因此拱的重量與橋面荷載主要以軸壓沿拱肋傳到支點，並在支點產生很大的水平推力，由兩岸的砂岩與混凝土橋台承受。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙鉸拱支承」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two-hinged arch bearings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。取 w = 700 kN/m（恆載加活載）、L = 503 m、拱矢 f = 120 m：H = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN；每側垂直反力 V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN。每側兩個支承各分擔一半，單一支承合力 ≈ √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN。w 與 f 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f). With w = 700 kN/m (dead plus live), L = 503 m and rise f = 120 m, H = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN, and the vertical reaction per side is V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN. Each side has two bearings sharing half, so one bearing's resultant is about √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN. w and f are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以桁架模型分析各種荷載排列下的弦桿與腹桿力，比較雙鉸拱的推力與支承反力；橋台的抗推力以岩盤承載與滑動檢核驗證；營運期以測量監測橋台與支承的位移，任何水平位移都會改變拱的內力分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyse chord and web forces under all load arrangements with a truss model, comparing two-hinged thrust and bearing reactions; verify abutment thrust resistance by rock bearing and sliding checks; in service monitor abutment and bearing movements by survey, since any horizontal movement changes the arch's internal forces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。取 w = 700 kN/m（恆載加活載）、L = 503 m、拱矢 f = 120 m：H = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN；每側垂直反力 V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN。每側兩個支承各分擔一半，單一支承合力 ≈ √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN。w 與 f 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f). With w = 700 kN/m (dead plus live), L = 503 m and rise f = 120 m, H = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN, and the vertical reaction per side is V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN. Each side has two bearings sharing half, so one bearing's resultant is about √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN. w and f are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch", which statement holds?
options: 鉸接支承一旦安裝完成，就會永遠自由轉動，不需要維護。
兩個半拱只要對準就能直接接上，溫度影響可以忽略。
拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。
optionsEn: Once installed, a hinged bearing will always rotate freely without maintenance.
The two half-arches can simply be joined once aligned, and temperature can be ignored.
For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f).
quiz.explanation: 拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a parabolic arch the thrust is H = w·L²/(8f). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙鉸拱支承」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two-hinged arch bearings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以桁架模型分析各種荷載排列下的弦桿與腹桿力，比較雙鉸拱的推力與支承反力；橋台的抗推力以岩盤承載與滑動檢核驗證；營運期以測量監測橋台與支承的位移，任何水平位移都會改變拱的內力分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse chord and web forces under all load arrangements with a truss model, comparing two-hinged thrust and bearing reactions; verify abutment thrust resistance by rock bearing and sliding checks; in service monitor abutment and bearing movements by survey, since any horizontal movement changes the arch's internal forces. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：評估或改建前應先依原設計與竣工資料畫出明確的荷載路徑圖，標示受力構件與非結構構件；任何鄰近橋台的開挖或隧道工程都要先檢核對橋台水平位移的影響並設監測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before assessment or alteration, draw an explicit load-path diagram from original design and as-built records that separates structural from non-structural elements; any excavation or tunnelling near the abutments must first be checked for its effect on horizontal movement and monitored.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply; mistaking the pylons for load-bearing members during alterations can confuse the actual load path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以桁架模型分析各種荷載排列下的弦桿與腹桿力，比較雙鉸拱的推力與支承反力；橋台的抗推力以岩盤承載與滑動檢核驗證；營運期以測量監測橋台與支承的位移，任何水平位移都會改變拱的內力分布。
knowledge.textEn: Analyse chord and web forces under all load arrangements with a truss model, comparing two-hinged thrust and bearing reactions; verify abutment thrust resistance by rock bearing and sliding checks; in service monitor abutment and bearing movements by survey, since any horizontal movement changes the arch's internal forces.
