steps.title: 503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙鉸拱支承」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two-hinged arch bearings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply; mistaking the pylons for load-bearing members during alterations can confuse the actual load path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：橋面以吊桿懸掛在拱下，同時承載公路、兩條鐵路、自行車道與人行道；四座以花崗岩飾面的橋塔位於拱端，主要是建築與視覺作用，並不承擔拱的推力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The deck hangs from the arch on vertical hangers and carries road lanes, two railway tracks, a cycleway and a footway; the four granite-faced pylons at the arch ends are mainly architectural and visual and do not resist the arch thrust.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The massive stone pylons at each end of the bridge carry the arch thrust." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。
knowledge.textEn: If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply; mistaking the pylons for load-bearing members during alterations can confuse the actual load path.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「503 公尺雙鉸拱的荷載路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path of the 503 m two-hinged arch" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。
拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply.
An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 若橋台在推力下發生水平位移，拱跨增加、拱頂下沉，拱肋彎矩大幅增加；把橋塔誤當成受力構件而在改建時移除或加載，會干擾原有的荷載路徑判斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If an abutment moves horizontally under thrust, the span lengthens, the crown drops and rib bending rises sharply; mistaking the pylons for load-bearing members during alterations can confuse the actual load path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Truss depth and unbalanced loading: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「拱肋桁架深度」如何影響雪梨港灣大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arch truss depth” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 拱桁架在拱頂深約 18 公尺、在兩端靠近橋塔處深約 57 公尺。如果荷載完全均勻並與拱軸吻合，拱只受軸壓；但列車、車流只佔半跨時，拱會產生彎矩，由上下弦桿的拉壓差承擔。桁架越深，同樣彎矩造成的弦桿力越小，所以在彎矩較大的區域加深桁架是有效率的做法。溫度變化也會讓雙鉸拱產生內力與變形：公開資料指出，炎熱天氣時拱頂可升高約 18 公分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「拱肋桁架深度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The arch trusses are about 18 m deep at the crown and about 57 m deep at the ends near the pylons. If loading were perfectly uniform and matched the arch axis, the arch would be in pure compression; but trains and traffic on half the span cause bending, carried as a push–pull difference between top and bottom chords. The deeper the truss, the smaller the chord forces for the same moment, so deepening the truss where moments are larger is efficient. Temperature also causes forces and movement in a two-hinged arch: public sources note that the crown can rise by about 18 cm on hot days. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Arch truss depth” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「拱肋桁架深度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Arch truss depth”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載
knowledge.text: 拱桁架在拱頂深約 18 公尺、在兩端靠近橋塔處深約 57 公尺。如果荷載完全均勻並與拱軸吻合，拱只受軸壓；但列車、車流只佔半跨時，拱會產生彎矩，由上下弦桿的拉壓差承擔。
knowledge.textEn: The arch trusses are about 18 m deep at the crown and about 57 m deep at the ends near the pylons. If loading were perfectly uniform and matched the arch axis, the arch would be in pure compression; but trains and traffic on half the span cause bending, carried as a push–pull difference between top and bottom chords.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Truss depth and unbalanced loading" is correct?
options: 拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。
鉚接接頭就像高強度螺栓摩擦接頭一樣，靠板件之間的摩擦傳力。
拱桁架在拱頂深約 18 公尺、在兩端靠近橋塔處深約 57 公尺。
optionsEn: An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered.
Riveted joints work like high-strength bolted friction joints, carrying load by friction between plies.
The arch trusses are about 18 m deep at the crown and about 57 m deep at the ends near the pylons.
quiz.explanation: 拱桁架在拱頂深約 18 公尺、在兩端靠近橋塔處深約 57 公尺。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The arch trusses are about 18 m deep at the crown and about 57 m deep at the ends near the pylons. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Truss depth and unbalanced loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱肋桁架深度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arch truss depth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。若半跨活載在某斷面產生 M = 400,000 kN·m：在桁架深 h = 30 m 處 ΔN ≈ 400,000/30 ≈ 13,300 kN；若同樣彎矩出現在拱頂 h = 18 m 處，ΔN ≈ 22,200 kN，增加約 67%。彎矩值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h. If half-span live load produces M = 400,000 kN·m at a section where h = 30 m, ΔN ≈ 400,000/30 ≈ 13,300 kN; the same moment at the crown with h = 18 m gives ΔN ≈ 22,200 kN, about 67% more. The moment is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以影響線求各桿件在鐵路與公路荷載不同排列下的最大拉、壓力，並把溫度作用納入組合；評估時在代表性弦桿與腹桿量測應變，比較實測與模型在列車通過時的反應比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations; in assessment strain-gauge representative chords and web members and compare measured and modelled response ratios under passing trains.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。若半跨活載在某斷面產生 M = 400,000 kN·m：在桁架深 h = 30 m 處 ΔN ≈ 400,000/30 ≈ 13,300 kN；若同樣彎矩出現在拱頂 h = 18 m 處，ΔN ≈ 22,200 kN，增加約 67%。彎矩值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h. If half-span live load produces M = 400,000 kN·m at a section where h = 30 m, ΔN ≈ 400,000/30 ≈ 13,300 kN; the same moment at the crown with h = 18 m gives ΔN ≈ 22,200 kN, about 67% more. The moment is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Truss depth and unbalanced loading", which statement holds?
options: 弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。
鋼拱在架設時就已經是拱，自己會撐住，不需要任何臨時支撐。
載重試驗的目的是把橋加載到接近破壞，以證明它夠強。
optionsEn: Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h.
A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support.
A load test aims to load the bridge close to failure to prove it is strong enough.
quiz.explanation: 弦桿附加力 ΔN ≈ M/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Additional chord force ΔN ≈ M/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Truss depth and unbalanced loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱肋桁架深度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arch truss depth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以影響線求各桿件在鐵路與公路荷載不同排列下的最大拉、壓力，並把溫度作用納入組合；評估時在代表性弦桿與腹桿量測應變，比較實測與模型在列車通過時的反應比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations; in assessment strain-gauge representative chords and web members and compare measured and modelled response ratios under passing trains. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：拱橋評估必須包含半跨與偏心荷載排列及溫度組合，並列出每類桿件的最不利工況；量測資料應附溫度紀錄，避免把溫度內力誤判為荷載效應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Arch assessment must include half-span and eccentric load patterns with temperature combinations and list the governing case for each member type; measurement data should carry temperature records so thermal forces are not mistaken for load effects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以均布荷載檢核，半跨受載時的弦桿反向力或腹桿受力可能被低估；受壓腹桿在反覆受力下若接頭鬆動，有效長度增加，挫屈強度降低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only uniform load can underestimate chord force reversals and web forces under half-span loading; if joints of compression web members loosen under repeated loading, their effective length grows and buckling strength falls. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations; in assessment strain-gauge representative chords and web members and compare measured and modelled response ratios under passing trains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Truss depth and unbalanced loading"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以影響線求各桿件在鐵路與公路荷載不同排列下的最大拉、壓力，並把溫度作用納入組合；評估時在代表性弦桿與腹桿量測應變，比較實測與模型在列車通過時的反應比例。
鋼橋只要定期刷一層新漆，就不會發生腐蝕損傷。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations.
As long as a steel bridge gets a fresh coat of paint regularly, corrosion damage cannot occur.

quiz.explanationEn: Use influence lines to find maximum tension and compression in each member for rail and road load arrangements, including temperature in the combinations; in assessment strain-gauge representative chords and web members and compare measured and modelled response ratios under passing trains. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Truss depth and unbalanced loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱肋桁架深度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arch truss depth” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以均布荷載檢核，半跨受載時的弦桿反向力或腹桿受力可能被低估；受壓腹桿在反覆受力下若接頭鬆動，有效長度增加，挫屈強度降低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only uniform load can underestimate chord force reversals and web forces under half-span loading; if joints of compression web members loosen under repeated loading, their effective length grows and buckling strength falls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：溫度變化也會讓雙鉸拱產生內力與變形：公開資料指出，炎熱天氣時拱頂可升高約 18 公分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temperature also causes forces and movement in a two-hinged arch: public sources note that the crown can rise by about 18 cm on hot days.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拱只受壓，所以不需要考慮彎矩與受拉桿件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An arch is only in compression, so bending and tension members need not be considered." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以均布荷載檢核，半跨受載時的弦桿反向力或腹桿受力可能被低估；受壓腹桿在反覆受力下若接頭鬆動，有效長度增加，挫屈強度降低。
knowledge.textEn: Checking only uniform load can underestimate chord force reversals and web forces under half-span loading; if joints of compression web members loosen under repeated loading, their effective length grows and buckling strength falls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「桁架深度變化與非對稱荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Truss depth and unbalanced loading" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鉚接接頭就像高強度螺栓摩擦接頭一樣，靠板件之間的摩擦傳力。
若只以均布荷載檢核，半跨受載時的弦桿反向力或腹桿受力可能被低估；受壓腹桿在反覆受力下若接頭鬆動，有效長度增加，挫屈強度降低。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Riveted joints work like high-strength bolted friction joints, carrying load by friction between plies.
Checking only uniform load can underestimate chord force reversals and web forces under half-span loading.
quiz.explanation: 若只以均布荷載檢核，半跨受載時的弦桿反向力或腹桿受力可能被低估；受壓腹桿在反覆受力下若接頭鬆動，有效長度增加，挫屈強度降低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only uniform load can underestimate chord force reversals and web forces under half-span loading; if joints of compression web members loosen under repeated loading, their effective length grows and buckling strength falls. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘」與「支承銷、橋台與非結構橋塔」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Steel, workshops and six million rivets" and "Bearing pins, abutments and pylons": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel, workshops and six million rivets: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鉚接接頭」如何影響雪梨港灣大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Riveted joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大橋鋼構總重約 52,800 公噸，其中拱約 39,000 公噸。承包商 Dorman Long 在北岸米爾森斯角設置兩座加工廠，把鋼板與型鋼加工成桁架構件，公開資料指出約八成的拱段鋼材由英國預先成形後運來。構件之間以鉚接連接，全橋約有六百萬顆手工打製的鉚釘：鉚釘加熱到紅熱後插入孔中打成頭，冷卻收縮把板件夾緊，主要以釘身受剪與孔壁承壓傳力。鉚接沒有現代高強度螺栓那樣可靠的預拉力，因此接頭的行為更依賴孔的精度與鉚釘填孔程度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鉚接接頭」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The steelwork weighs about 52,800 t, about 39,000 t of it in the arch. The contractor Dorman Long set up two workshops at Milsons Point on the north shore to fabricate plates and sections into truss members, and public sources say about four-fifths of the arch steel arrived pre-formed from England. Members were joined by about six million hand-driven rivets: each was heated red-hot, inserted and headed, shrinking as it cooled to clamp the plies, transferring force mainly by shank shear and bearing on the hole walls. Riveting lacks the reliable preload of modern high-strength bolts, so joint behaviour depends more on hole accuracy and how well rivets fill their holes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Riveted joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鉚釘直徑 d = 25 mm，面積 A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²；容許剪應力取 100 MPa，單剪容量約 49.1 kN，雙剪約 98.2 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A rivet of d = 25 mm has A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²; at an allowable shear stress of 100 MPa it carries about 49.1 kN in single shear and 98.2 kN in double shear.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鉚接接頭就像高強度螺栓摩擦接頭一樣，靠板件之間的摩擦傳力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Riveted joints work like high-strength bolted friction joints, carrying load by friction between plies." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鉚接接頭」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Riveted joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘
knowledge.titleEn: Steel, workshops and six million rivets
knowledge.text: 大橋鋼構總重約 52,800 公噸，其中拱約 39,000 公噸。承包商 Dorman Long 在北岸米爾森斯角設置兩座加工廠，把鋼板與型鋼加工成桁架構件，公開資料指出約八成的拱段鋼材由英國預先成形後運來。
knowledge.textEn: The steelwork weighs about 52,800 t, about 39,000 t of it in the arch. The contractor Dorman Long set up two workshops at Milsons Point on the north shore to fabricate plates and sections into truss members, and public sources say about four-fifths of the arch steel arrived pre-formed from England.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鉚接接頭就像高強度螺栓摩擦接頭一樣，靠板件之間的摩擦傳力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Riveted joints work like high-strength bolted friction joints, carrying load by friction between plies. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Steel, workshops and six million rivets" is correct?
options: 大橋鋼構總重約 52,800 公噸，其中拱約 39,000 公噸。
鉚接接頭就像高強度螺栓摩擦接頭一樣，靠板件之間的摩擦傳力。
鉸接支承一旦安裝完成，就會永遠自由轉動，不需要維護。
optionsEn: The steelwork weighs about 52,800 t, about 39,000 t of it in the arch.
Riveted joints work like high-strength bolted friction joints, carrying load by friction between plies.
Once installed, a hinged bearing will always rotate freely without maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 大橋鋼構總重約 52,800 公噸，其中拱約 39,000 公噸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The steelwork weighs about 52,800 t, about 39,000 t of it in the arch. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel, workshops and six million rivets: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鉚接接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Riveted joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鉚釘直徑 d = 25 mm，面積 A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²；容許剪應力取 100 MPa，單剪容量約 49.1 kN，雙剪約 98.2 kN。傳遞 10,000 kN 構件力需 10,000/98.2 ≈ 102 顆鉚釘。直徑與容許應力為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A rivet of d = 25 mm has A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²; at an allowable shear stress of 100 MPa it carries about 49.1 kN in single shear and 98.2 kN in double shear. Transferring a 10,000 kN member force needs 10,000/98.2 ≈ 102 rivets. Diameter and allowable stress are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：評估時以原始圖說核對接頭鉚釘數量與排列，並以敲擊、目視或超音波檢查鬆動鉚釘與鉚釘頭腐蝕；鋼材取樣做拉伸與衝擊試驗，確認當年鋼材的強度與韌性，作為容量計算的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In assessment, check rivet numbers and layouts against original drawings, look for loose rivets and corroded heads by tapping, visual or ultrasonic checks, and test steel samples in tension and impact to establish the strength and toughness of the original steel as the basis for capacity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 鉚釘直徑 d = 25 mm，面積 A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²；容許剪應力取 100 MPa，單剪容量約 49.1 kN，雙剪約 98.2 kN。傳遞 10,000 kN 構件力需 10,000/98.2 ≈ 102 顆鉚釘。直徑與容許應力為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A rivet of d = 25 mm has A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²; at an allowable shear stress of 100 MPa it carries about 49.1 kN in single shear and 98.2 kN in double shear. Transferring a 10,000 kN member force needs 10,000/98.2 ≈ 102 rivets. Diameter and allowable stress are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steel, workshops and six million rivets", which statement holds?
options: 兩個半拱只要對準就能直接接上，溫度影響可以忽略。
鉚釘直徑 d = 25 mm，面積 A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²。
百年老橋沒有倒，代表它不會有疲勞問題。
optionsEn: The two half-arches can simply be joined once aligned, and temperature can be ignored.
A rivet of d = 25 mm has A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²; at an allowable shear stress of 100 MPa it carries about 49.1 kN in single shear and 98.2 kN in double shear.
A century-old bridge that is still standing cannot have fatigue problems.
quiz.explanation: 鉚釘直徑 d = 25 mm，面積 A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²；容許剪應力取 100 MPa，單剪容量約 49.1 kN，雙剪約 98.2 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A rivet of d = 25 mm has A = π×25²/4 ≈ 491 mm²; at an allowable shear stress of 100 MPa it carries about 49.1 kN in single shear and 98.2 kN in double shear. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel, workshops and six million rivets: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鉚接接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Riveted joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 評估時以原始圖說核對接頭鉚釘數量與排列，並以敲擊、目視或超音波檢查鬆動鉚釘與鉚釘頭腐蝕；鋼材取樣做拉伸與衝擊試驗，確認當年鋼材的強度與韌性，作為容量計算的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In assessment, check rivet numbers and layouts against original drawings, look for loose rivets and corroded heads by tapping, visual or ultrasonic checks, and test steel samples in tension and impact to establish the strength and toughness of the original steel as the basis for capacity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：歷史鋼橋評估應先做材料試驗與接頭盤點，再決定容量計算的假設；發現鬆動鉚釘時以一對一的方式記錄位置與處置，替換方式需依保存原則與結構需求由工程與遺產雙方共同核定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assessment of historic steel bridges should start with material testing and a joint inventory before fixing capacity assumptions; loose rivets are logged one by one with location and action, and replacement methods agreed jointly by engineering and heritage authorities according to conservation principles and structural needs.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鉚釘頭腐蝕或鬆動後，接頭夾緊力喪失，板件之間產生相對滑動與磨損，孔壁承壓集中而出現裂紋；若以現代鋼材性質假設評估百年前的鋼材，可能高估韌性，低溫下的脆性破壞風險被忽略。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Corroded or loose rivet heads lose clamping, letting plies slip and wear and concentrating bearing at hole edges until cracks form; assessing century-old steel with modern material properties can overestimate toughness and overlook brittle-fracture risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 評估時以原始圖說核對接頭鉚釘數量與排列，並以敲擊、目視或超音波檢查鬆動鉚釘與鉚釘頭腐蝕；鋼材取樣做拉伸與衝擊試驗，確認當年鋼材的強度與韌性，作為容量計算的依據。
knowledge.textEn: In assessment, check rivet numbers and layouts against original drawings, look for loose rivets and corroded heads by tapping, visual or ultrasonic checks, and test steel samples in tension and impact to establish the strength and toughness of the original steel as the basis for capacity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 歷史鋼橋評估應先做材料試驗與接頭盤點，再決定容量計算的假設；發現鬆動鉚釘時以一對一的方式記錄位置與處置，替換方式需依保存原則與結構需求由工程與遺產雙方共同核定。
knowledge.textEn: Assessment of historic steel bridges should start with material testing and a joint inventory before fixing capacity assumptions; loose rivets are logged one by one with location and action, and replacement methods agreed jointly by engineering and heritage authorities according to conservation principles and structural needs.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Steel, workshops and six million rivets"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
遺產橋梁只能原樣保存，任何修繕都會破壞其價值。
評估時以原始圖說核對接頭鉚釘數量與排列，並以敲擊、目視或超音波檢查鬆動鉚釘與鉚釘頭腐蝕；鋼材取樣做拉伸與衝擊試驗，確認當年鋼材的強度與韌性，作為容量計算的依據。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A heritage bridge must be kept exactly as built, and any repair destroys its value.

In assessment, check rivet numbers and layouts against original drawings, look for loose rivets and corroded heads by tapping, visual or ultrasonic checks, and test steel samples in tension and impact to establish the strength and toughness of the original steel as the basis for capacity.
quiz.explanation: 評估時以原始圖說核對接頭鉚釘數量與排列，並以敲擊、目視或超音波檢查鬆動鉚釘與鉚釘頭腐蝕；鋼材取樣做拉伸與衝擊試驗，確認當年鋼材的強度與韌性，作為容量計算的依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In assessment, check rivet numbers and layouts against original drawings, look for loose rivets and corroded heads by tapping, visual or ultrasonic checks, and test steel samples in tension and impact to establish the strength and toughness of the original steel as the basis for capacity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steel, workshops and six million rivets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鉚接接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Riveted joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鉚釘頭腐蝕或鬆動後，接頭夾緊力喪失，板件之間產生相對滑動與磨損，孔壁承壓集中而出現裂紋；若以現代鋼材性質假設評估百年前的鋼材，可能高估韌性，低溫下的脆性破壞風險被忽略。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Corroded or loose rivet heads lose clamping, letting plies slip and wear and concentrating bearing at hole edges until cracks form; assessing century-old steel with modern material properties can overestimate toughness and overlook brittle-fracture risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鉚接沒有現代高強度螺栓那樣可靠的預拉力，因此接頭的行為更依賴孔的精度與鉚釘填孔程度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Riveting lacks the reliable preload of modern high-strength bolts, so joint behaviour depends more on hole accuracy and how well rivets fill their holes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鉚接接頭就像高強度螺栓摩擦接頭一樣，靠板件之間的摩擦傳力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Riveted joints work like high-strength bolted friction joints, carrying load by friction between plies." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鉚釘頭腐蝕或鬆動後，接頭夾緊力喪失，板件之間產生相對滑動與磨損，孔壁承壓集中而出現裂紋；若以現代鋼材性質假設評估百年前的鋼材，可能高估韌性，低溫下的脆性破壞風險被忽略。
knowledge.textEn: Corroded or loose rivet heads lose clamping, letting plies slip and wear and concentrating bearing at hole edges until cracks form; assessing century-old steel with modern material properties can overestimate toughness and overlook brittle-fracture risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼材、工廠與六百萬顆鉚釘」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel, workshops and six million rivets" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 鉚釘頭腐蝕或鬆動後，接頭夾緊力喪失，板件之間產生相對滑動與磨損，孔壁承壓集中而出現裂紋。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鉸接支承一旦安裝完成，就會永遠自由轉動，不需要維護。
optionsEn: Corroded or loose rivet heads lose clamping, letting plies slip and wear and concentrating bearing at hole edges until cracks form.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once installed, a hinged bearing will always rotate freely without maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 鉚釘頭腐蝕或鬆動後，接頭夾緊力喪失，板件之間產生相對滑動與磨損，孔壁承壓集中而出現裂紋；若以現代鋼材性質假設評估百年前的鋼材，可能高估韌性，低溫下的脆性破壞風險被忽略。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Corroded or loose rivet heads lose clamping, letting plies slip and wear and concentrating bearing at hole edges until cracks form; assessing century-old steel with modern material properties can overestimate toughness and overlook brittle-fracture risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支承銷、橋台與非結構橋塔：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bearing pins, abutments and pylons: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「支承銷與橋台」如何影響雪梨港灣大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bearing pins and abutments” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙鉸拱的鉸接點必須讓拱端自由轉動、同時傳遞巨大的推力與垂直力。雪梨港灣大橋每片桁架在每端以大型支承銷座在橋台的支承上，銷與銷座之間的接觸應力、轉動摩擦與潤滑決定鉸接是否真的像鉸。橋台把推力傳到砂岩岩盤，花崗岩飾面的橋塔則矗立在橋台上方，公開資料明確指出它們是建築性的、不承擔主結構荷載。鉸接若因腐蝕或磨耗而卡住，拱的實際行為會偏離雙鉸假設，溫度變化在支點處產生額外彎矩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「支承銷與橋台」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The hinges of a two-hinged arch must let the arch ends rotate freely while transmitting huge thrust and vertical forces. Each truss end sits on a large bearing pin seated in abutment bearings, and contact stress, rotational friction and lubrication between pin and seat decide whether the hinge truly acts as a hinge. Abutments pass the thrust into sandstone rock, and the granite-faced pylons stand above them; public sources state clearly that they are architectural rather than structural. If corrosion or wear seizes a hinge, the arch departs from two-hinged behaviour and temperature changes induce extra moments at the supports. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bearing pins and abutments” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單一支承合力 R ≈ 127,500 kN（承前單元假設），若支承銷直徑 d = 0.37 m、承壓長度 l = 4.2 m，平均投影承壓應力 σ = R/(d·l) = 127.5/(0.37×4.2) ≈ 82 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taking a bearing resultant R ≈ 127,500 kN from the previous unit's assumptions, a pin of diameter d = 0.37 m and bearing length l = 4.2 m has an average projected bearing stress σ = R/(d·l) = 127.5/(0.37×4.2) ≈ 82 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鉸接支承一旦安裝完成，就會永遠自由轉動，不需要維護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once installed, a hinged bearing will always rotate freely without maintenance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「支承銷與橋台」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bearing pins and abutments”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支承銷、橋台與非結構橋塔
knowledge.text: 雙鉸拱的鉸接點必須讓拱端自由轉動、同時傳遞巨大的推力與垂直力。雪梨港灣大橋每片桁架在每端以大型支承銷座在橋台的支承上，銷與銷座之間的接觸應力、轉動摩擦與潤滑決定鉸接是否真的像鉸。
knowledge.textEn: The hinges of a two-hinged arch must let the arch ends rotate freely while transmitting huge thrust and vertical forces. Each truss end sits on a large bearing pin seated in abutment bearings, and contact stress, rotational friction and lubrication between pin and seat decide whether the hinge truly acts as a hinge.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鉸接支承一旦安裝完成，就會永遠自由轉動，不需要維護。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once installed, a hinged bearing will always rotate freely without maintenance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支承銷、橋台與非結構橋塔」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bearing pins, abutments and pylons" is correct?
options: 鉸接支承一旦安裝完成，就會永遠自由轉動，不需要維護。
雙鉸拱的鉸接點必須讓拱端自由轉動、同時傳遞巨大的推力與垂直力。
鋼拱在架設時就已經是拱，自己會撐住，不需要任何臨時支撐。
optionsEn: Once installed, a hinged bearing will always rotate freely without maintenance.
The hinges of a two-hinged arch must let the arch ends rotate freely while transmitting huge thrust and vertical forces.
A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support.
quiz.explanation: 雙鉸拱的鉸接點必須讓拱端自由轉動、同時傳遞巨大的推力與垂直力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The hinges of a two-hinged arch must let the arch ends rotate freely while transmitting huge thrust and vertical forces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支承銷、橋台與非結構橋塔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bearing pins, abutments and pylons: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支承銷與橋台」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bearing pins and abutments” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單一支承合力 R ≈ 127,500 kN（承前單元假設），若支承銷直徑 d = 0.37 m、承壓長度 l = 4.2 m，平均投影承壓應力 σ = R/(d·l) = 127.5/(0.37×4.2) ≈ 82 MPa。銷徑與長度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taking a bearing resultant R ≈ 127,500 kN from the previous unit's assumptions, a pin of diameter d = 0.37 m and bearing length l = 4.2 m has an average projected bearing stress σ = R/(d·l) = 127.5/(0.37×4.2) ≈ 82 MPa. Pin diameter and length are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期檢查支承銷周圍有無腐蝕產物、磨耗痕跡與潤滑狀況，並量測拱端在不同溫度下的轉角，確認鉸接仍能轉動；橋台以精密測量監測水平與垂直位移，與歷史紀錄比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect around the bearing pins for corrosion products, wear marks and lubrication, and measure arch-end rotation at different temperatures to confirm the hinges still turn; monitor abutment horizontal and vertical movement by precise survey against historical records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單一支承合力 R ≈ 127,500 kN（承前單元假設），若支承銷直徑 d = 0.37 m、承壓長度 l = 4.2 m，平均投影承壓應力 σ = R/(d·l) = 127.5/(0.37×4.2) ≈ 82 MPa。銷徑與長度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Taking a bearing resultant R ≈ 127,500 kN from the previous unit's assumptions, a pin of diameter d = 0.37 m and bearing length l = 4.2 m has an average projected bearing stress σ = R/(d·l) = 127.5/(0.37×4.2) ≈ 82 MPa. Pin diameter and length are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.title: 支承銷、橋台與非結構橋塔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bearing pins, abutments and pylons: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支承銷與橋台」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bearing pins and abutments” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期檢查支承銷周圍有無腐蝕產物、磨耗痕跡與潤滑狀況，並量測拱端在不同溫度下的轉角，確認鉸接仍能轉動；橋台以精密測量監測水平與垂直位移，與歷史紀錄比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect around the bearing pins for corrosion products, wear marks and lubrication, and measure arch-end rotation at different temperatures to confirm the hinges still turn; monitor abutment horizontal and vertical movement by precise survey against historical records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支承鉸接應列為關鍵構件，訂定檢查週期、潤滑與防蝕程序，並以轉角與溫度的量測紀錄判斷是否仍有效；任何支承維修都要先評估施工期間的臨時荷載路徑並設停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hinged bearings should be classed as critical components with set inspection intervals and lubrication and corrosion-protection procedures, judged effective by rotation-versus-temperature records; any bearing repair needs a prior assessment of the temporary load path and hold points.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承銷卡滯時，雙鉸拱局部變成固定拱，溫度與活載在拱端產生原設計沒有考慮的彎矩，可能使端部桿件或接頭過應力；銷座腐蝕產生的膨脹也會改變接觸條件，造成應力集中。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A seized pin turns the two-hinged arch locally into a fixed arch, so temperature and live load create end moments the original design never considered, possibly overstressing end members or joints; expanding corrosion in the seat alters contact and concentrates stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支承銷、橋台與非結構橋塔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bearing pins, abutments and pylons"?
options: 定期檢查支承銷周圍有無腐蝕產物、磨耗痕跡與潤滑狀況，並量測拱端在不同溫度下的轉角，確認鉸接仍能轉動；橋台以精密測量監測水平與垂直位移，與歷史紀錄比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
雪梨港灣大橋兩端的巨大石砌橋塔承擔了拱的推力。
optionsEn: Inspect around the bearing pins for corrosion products, wear marks and lubrication, and measure arch-end rotation at different temperatures to confirm the hinges still turn.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The massive stone pylons at each end of the bridge carry the arch thrust.
quiz.explanation: 定期檢查支承銷周圍有無腐蝕產物、磨耗痕跡與潤滑狀況，並量測拱端在不同溫度下的轉角，確認鉸接仍能轉動；橋台以精密測量監測水平與垂直位移，與歷史紀錄比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect around the bearing pins for corrosion products, wear marks and lubrication, and measure arch-end rotation at different temperatures to confirm the hinges still turn; monitor abutment horizontal and vertical movement by precise survey against historical records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支承銷、橋台與非結構橋塔：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bearing pins, abutments and pylons: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支承銷與橋台」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bearing pins and abutments” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支承銷卡滯時，雙鉸拱局部變成固定拱，溫度與活載在拱端產生原設計沒有考慮的彎矩，可能使端部桿件或接頭過應力；銷座腐蝕產生的膨脹也會改變接觸條件，造成應力集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A seized pin turns the two-hinged arch locally into a fixed arch, so temperature and live load create end moments the original design never considered, possibly overstressing end members or joints; expanding corrosion in the seat alters contact and concentrates stress. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鉸接若因腐蝕或磨耗而卡住，拱的實際行為會偏離雙鉸假設，溫度變化在支點處產生額外彎矩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If corrosion or wear seizes a hinge, the arch departs from two-hinged behaviour and temperature changes induce extra moments at the supports.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鉸接支承一旦安裝完成，就會永遠自由轉動，不需要維護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once installed, a hinged bearing will always rotate freely without maintenance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支承銷卡滯時，雙鉸拱局部變成固定拱，溫度與活載在拱端產生原設計沒有考慮的彎矩，可能使端部桿件或接頭過應力；銷座腐蝕產生的膨脹也會改變接觸條件，造成應力集中。
knowledge.textEn: A seized pin turns the two-hinged arch locally into a fixed arch, so temperature and live load create end moments the original design never considered, possibly overstressing end members or joints; expanding corrosion in the seat alters contact and concentrates stress.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支承銷、橋台與非結構橋塔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bearing pins, abutments and pylons" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
支承銷卡滯時，雙鉸拱局部變成固定拱，溫度與活載在拱端產生原設計沒有考慮的彎矩，可能使端部桿件或接頭過應力；銷座腐蝕產生的膨脹也會改變接觸條件，造成應力集中。
鋼拱在架設時就已經是拱，自己會撐住，不需要任何臨時支撐。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A seized pin turns the two-hinged arch locally into a fixed arch, so temperature and live load create end moments the original design never considered, possibly overstressing end members or joints.
A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support.
quiz.explanation: 支承銷卡滯時，雙鉸拱局部變成固定拱，溫度與活載在拱端產生原設計沒有考慮的彎矩，可能使端部桿件或接頭過應力；銷座腐蝕產生的膨脹也會改變接觸條件，造成應力集中。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A seized pin turns the two-hinged arch locally into a fixed arch, so temperature and live load create end moments the original design never considered, possibly overstressing end members or joints; expanding corrosion in the seat alters contact and concentrates stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「懸臂架設與錨碇鋼索」與「1930 年拱頂合龍」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cantilever erection with anchor cables" and "The 1930 crown closure": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 懸臂架設與錨碇鋼索：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cantilever erection with anchor cables: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「隧道錨碇鋼索」如何影響雪梨港灣大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel-anchored cables” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雪梨港在架設時不能設置中間支架，兩個半拱只能從兩岸同時向港中央懸臂伸出。每個半拱在完成前都像一支從支承銷伸出的長懸臂，自重會讓它繞支承銷向港內傾倒；因此在兩岸岩盤中開挖 U 形隧道，以 128 條鋼索穿過隧道並連接到半拱上弦，把傾覆力矩拉回岸上。拱上各有一台爬升吊機沿著已完成的上弦向前移動，逐段吊裝新構件；隨著懸臂變長，鋼索拉力持續增加，必須依計算逐步調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「隧道錨碇鋼索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: No intermediate falsework was possible in the harbour, so the two half-arches were cantilevered simultaneously from each shore toward the centre. Until completed, each half-arch acts like a long cantilever from its bearing pin, its weight trying to rotate it into the harbour; so U-shaped tunnels were cut into the rock on each shore and 128 steel cables passed through them and connected to the top chord of the half-arch, pulling the overturning moment back to shore. A creeper crane on each half moved forward along the completed top chord, lifting each new piece; as the cantilever grew, the cable pull increased and was adjusted step by step to calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tunnel-anchored cables” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以半拱接近完成時估算：半拱鋼重約 39,000/2 = 19,500 t，即約 191 MN；若重心距支承銷水平 110 m、錨索對支承銷的力臂 55 m，所需拉力 T = W·x/h = 191×110/55 ≈ 383 MN，平均每條鋼索約 383/128 ≈ 3.0 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Near completion, each half-arch weighs about 39,000/2 = 19,500 t, about 191 MN; with its centroid 110 m from the pin horizontally and a cable lever arm of 55 m about the pin, the required pull is T = W·x/h = 191×110/55 ≈ 383 MN, about 383/128 ≈ 3.0 MN per cable on average.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼拱在架設時就已經是拱，自己會撐住，不需要任何臨時支撐。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「隧道錨碇鋼索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tunnel-anchored cables”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 懸臂架設與錨碇鋼索
knowledge.text: 雪梨港在架設時不能設置中間支架，兩個半拱只能從兩岸同時向港中央懸臂伸出。每個半拱在完成前都像一支從支承銷伸出的長懸臂，自重會讓它繞支承銷向港內傾倒；因此在兩岸岩盤中開挖 U 形隧道，以 128 條鋼索穿過隧道並連接到半拱上弦，把傾覆力矩拉回岸上。
knowledge.textEn: No intermediate falsework was possible in the harbour, so the two half-arches were cantilevered simultaneously from each shore toward the centre. Until completed, each half-arch acts like a long cantilever from its bearing pin, its weight trying to rotate it into the harbour; so U-shaped tunnels were cut into the rock on each shore and 128 steel cables passed through them and connected to the top chord of the half-arch, pulling the overturning moment back to shore.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼拱在架設時就已經是拱，自己會撐住，不需要任何臨時支撐。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「懸臂架設與錨碇鋼索」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cantilever erection with anchor cables" is correct?
options: 鋼拱在架設時就已經是拱，自己會撐住，不需要任何臨時支撐。
兩個半拱只要對準就能直接接上，溫度影響可以忽略。
雪梨港在架設時不能設置中間支架，兩個半拱只能從兩岸同時向港中央懸臂伸出。
optionsEn: A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support.
The two half-arches can simply be joined once aligned, and temperature can be ignored.
No intermediate falsework was possible in the harbour, so the two half-arches were cantilevered simultaneously from each shore toward the centre.
quiz.explanation: 雪梨港在架設時不能設置中間支架，兩個半拱只能從兩岸同時向港中央懸臂伸出。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: No intermediate falsework was possible in the harbour, so the two half-arches were cantilevered simultaneously from each shore toward the centre. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 懸臂架設與錨碇鋼索：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cantilever erection with anchor cables: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隧道錨碇鋼索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunnel-anchored cables” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以半拱接近完成時估算：半拱鋼重約 39,000/2 = 19,500 t，即約 191 MN；若重心距支承銷水平 110 m、錨索對支承銷的力臂 55 m，所需拉力 T = W·x/h = 191×110/55 ≈ 383 MN，平均每條鋼索約 383/128 ≈ 3.0 MN。重心與力臂為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Near completion, each half-arch weighs about 39,000/2 = 19,500 t, about 191 MN; with its centroid 110 m from the pin horizontally and a cable lever arm of 55 m about the pin, the required pull is T = W·x/h = 191×110/55 ≈ 383 MN, about 383/128 ≈ 3.0 MN per cable on average. Centroid and lever arm are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每吊裝一段後量測半拱端點高程與平面位置，並量測代表性錨索的拉力，與施工階段計算比較；錨碇隧道的岩體與錨座在架設前做驗證試驗，確認能承受設計拉力並有餘裕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After each segment, survey the half-arch tip level and position and measure selected cable forces against staged calculations; before erection, proof-test the anchorage tunnels' rock and seats to confirm the design pull with margin.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: Near completion, each half-arch weighs about 39,000/2 = 19,500 t, about 191 MN; with its centroid 110 m from the pin horizontally and a cable lever arm of 55 m about the pin, the required pull is T = W·x/h = 191×110/55 ≈ 383 MN, about 383/128 ≈ 3.0 MN per cable on average. steps.title: 懸臂架設與錨碇鋼索：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cantilever erection with anchor cables: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隧道錨碇鋼索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tunnel-anchored cables” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每吊裝一段後量測半拱端點高程與平面位置，並量測代表性錨索的拉力，與施工階段計算比較；錨碇隧道的岩體與錨座在架設前做驗證試驗，確認能承受設計拉力並有餘裕。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After each segment, survey the half-arch tip level and position and measure selected cable forces against staged calculations; before erection, proof-test the anchorage tunnels' rock and seats to confirm the design pull with margin. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：懸臂架設計畫應列出每個階段的錨索拉力、端點高程與允差，以及錨碇驗證試驗結果；每階段完成後由設計者與施工者共同確認量測值在允差內，才可進入下一段吊裝。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The cantilever erection plan should list cable forces, tip levels and tolerances for each stage together with anchorage proof-test results; after each stage the designer and builder jointly confirm measurements within tolerance before the next lift.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若錨索拉力分配不均，某些鋼索超載而斷裂，半拱的傾覆平衡被打破；錨碇岩體若有未發現的弱面，隧道錨座在巨大拉力下滑動，懸臂端下沉並可能造成倒塌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven cable force distribution can overload and break some cables, upsetting the half-arch's balance against overturning; an undetected weak plane in the anchorage rock can let the tunnel seat slide under the huge pull, dropping the cantilever tip and risking collapse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 懸臂架設與錨碇鋼索：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cantilever erection with anchor cables: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隧道錨碇鋼索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tunnel-anchored cables” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若錨索拉力分配不均，某些鋼索超載而斷裂，半拱的傾覆平衡被打破；錨碇岩體若有未發現的弱面，隧道錨座在巨大拉力下滑動，懸臂端下沉並可能造成倒塌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven cable force distribution can overload and break some cables, upsetting the half-arch's balance against overturning; an undetected weak plane in the anchorage rock can let the tunnel seat slide under the huge pull, dropping the cantilever tip and risking collapse. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：拱上各有一台爬升吊機沿著已完成的上弦向前移動，逐段吊裝新構件；隨著懸臂變長，鋼索拉力持續增加，必須依計算逐步調整。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A creeper crane on each half moved forward along the completed top chord, lifting each new piece; as the cantilever grew, the cable pull increased and was adjusted step by step to calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼拱在架設時就已經是拱，自己會撐住，不需要任何臨時支撐。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steel arch already acts as an arch during erection and supports itself without temporary support." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 1930 年拱頂合龍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: The 1930 crown closure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「拱頂合龍」如何影響雪梨港灣大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crown closure” governs force, deformation or durability in “Sydney Harbour Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩個半拱伸到港中央時，端點之間預留一段間隙，接著以逐步放鬆錨索的方式讓兩個半拱繞支承銷向內、向下轉動，直到在拱頂相接；公開資料指出兩個半拱在 1930 年 8 月 19 日首次接合，鉚接完成後拱即可自我支撐，錨索隨後拆除。合龍時間對溫度非常敏感：白天日照使鋼材膨脹、間隙縮小，夜間冷卻又使間隙擴大，因此放索與接合必須配合溫度變化，確保接合時兩端的位置、角度與內力都符合設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「拱頂合龍」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the half-arches reached mid-harbour, a gap was left between their tips, and the cables were then slackened step by step so each half rotated inward and downward about its pin until they met at the crown; public sources record that the halves first met on 19 August 1930, after which riveting made the arch self-supporting and the cables were removed. Closure is highly temperature-sensitive: sun expands the steel and narrows the gap by day, and cooling widens it at night, so cable release and connection had to follow temperature to ensure position, angle and internal forces at the joint matched design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Crown closure” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：放鬆錨索 Δc = 0.10 m、力臂 h = 57 m，半拱繞支承銷轉角 θ = Δc/h ≈ 1.75 mrad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Letting out the cables by Δc = 0.10 m on a lever arm of h = 57 m rotates the half-arch about its pin by θ = Δc/h ≈ 1.75 mrad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個半拱只要對準就能直接接上，溫度影響可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The two half-arches can simply be joined once aligned, and temperature can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「拱頂合龍」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 1930 年拱頂合龍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The 1930 crown closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱頂合龍」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
