steps.title: 檢查通道與載重評等：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inspection access and load rating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「檢查步道」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inspection catwalk” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查以目視、敲擊與超音波測厚記錄斷面損失、裂紋與鬆動螺栓，斷裂關鍵構件依規定做近距離檢查；載重評等以實測斷面與材料資料更新模型，結果與前次評等比較，評等低於門檻時啟動限重或補強決策。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspections record section loss, cracks and loose bolts by visual, tapping and ultrasonic thickness methods, with hands-on examination of fracture-critical members as required; the load rating updates the model with measured sections and material data, compares with the previous rating, and triggers posting or strengthening decisions when it falls below thresholds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢查計畫應列出每類構件的檢查方法與可達性（步道、繩索、無人機），並把無法近距離檢查的構件標示為風險項目；載重評等報告須由專業工程師簽認，評等因數低於 1.0 的構件立即通報業主。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection plan should list method and access (catwalk, rope, drone) for each member type and flag members that cannot be reached closely as risk items; load-rating reports must be sealed by a professional engineer, and members rating below 1.0 reported to the owner immediately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若檢查通道無法到達某些構件而長期只做遠距目視，斷面損失或裂紋可能在評等中被忽略，評等因數高估；高處檢查作業若缺乏墜落防護與救援計畫，檢查人員本身面臨重大風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If access cannot reach some members and they only get distant visual checks for years, section loss or cracks may be missed and the rating overestimated; high-level inspection without fall protection and rescue planning puts inspectors at serious risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若檢查通道無法到達某些構件而長期只做遠距目視，斷面損失或裂紋可能在評等中被忽略，評等因數高估；高處檢查作業若缺乏墜落防護與救援計畫，檢查人員本身面臨重大風險。
knowledge.textEn: If access cannot reach some members and they only get distant visual checks for years, section loss or cracks may be missed and the rating overestimated; high-level inspection without fall protection and rescue planning puts inspectors at serious risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「檢查通道與載重評等」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inspection access and load rating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
耐候鋼橋完全免維護，不需要任何防蝕管理。
若檢查通道無法到達某些構件而長期只做遠距目視，斷面損失或裂紋可能在評等中被忽略，評等因數高估；高處檢查作業若缺乏墜落防護與救援計畫，檢查人員本身面臨重大風險。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Weathering-steel bridges are completely maintenance-free and need no corrosion management.
If access cannot reach some members and they only get distant visual checks for years, section loss or cracks may be missed and the rating overestimated.
quiz.explanation: 若檢查通道無法到達某些構件而長期只做遠距目視，斷面損失或裂紋可能在評等中被忽略，評等因數高估；高處檢查作業若缺乏墜落防護與救援計畫，檢查人員本身面臨重大風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If access cannot reach some members and they only get distant visual checks for years, section loss or cracks may be missed and the rating overestimated; high-level inspection without fall protection and rescue planning puts inspectors at serious risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「耐候鋼的長期維護」與「橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-term care of weathering steel" and "Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 耐候鋼的長期維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term care of weathering steel: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「伸縮縫漏水與耐候鋼」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint leakage on weathering steel” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 耐候鋼的保護鏽層只有在乾濕交替、表面能乾燥的條件下才會形成。橋面伸縮縫漏水、排水管斷裂或除冰鹽水長期滴落在同一位置，會讓鋼材持續潮濕並含氯離子，鏽層變得鬆散剝落，腐蝕速率大幅增加；鳥糞與碎屑堆積在節點板與下弦桿上也有類似效果。因此耐候鋼橋的維護重點不是油漆，而是讓水離開鋼材：修好伸縮縫與排水、清除堆積物，並在局部劣化處考慮塗裝。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「伸縮縫漏水與耐候鋼」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The protective patina of weathering steel forms only where the surface can wet and then dry. Leaking deck joints, broken drains or de-icing brine dripping on one spot keep the steel wet and chloride-laden, so the rust layer turns loose and flaky and corrosion speeds up greatly; bird droppings and debris collecting on gusset plates and bottom chords have a similar effect. Maintenance of a weathering-steel bridge is therefore not about paint but about getting water off the steel: repairing joints and drainage, removing deposits and considering local coating where deterioration has started. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joint leakage on weathering steel” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：大氣腐蝕常以冪次律 C = A·tⁿ 估計。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Atmospheric corrosion is often estimated by the power law C = A·tⁿ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「耐候鋼橋完全免維護，不需要任何防蝕管理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Weathering-steel bridges are completely maintenance-free and need no corrosion management." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「伸縮縫漏水與耐候鋼」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Joint leakage on weathering steel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 耐候鋼的長期維護
knowledge.text: 耐候鋼的保護鏽層只有在乾濕交替、表面能乾燥的條件下才會形成。橋面伸縮縫漏水、排水管斷裂或除冰鹽水長期滴落在同一位置，會讓鋼材持續潮濕並含氯離子，鏽層變得鬆散剝落，腐蝕速率大幅增加；鳥糞與碎屑堆積在節點板與下弦桿上也有類似效果。
knowledge.textEn: The protective patina of weathering steel forms only where the surface can wet and then dry. Leaking deck joints, broken drains or de-icing brine dripping on one spot keep the steel wet and chloride-laden, so the rust layer turns loose and flaky and corrosion speeds up greatly; bird droppings and debris collecting on gusset plates and bottom chords have a similar effect.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：耐候鋼橋完全免維護，不需要任何防蝕管理。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Weathering-steel bridges are completely maintenance-free and need no corrosion management. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「耐候鋼的長期維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term care of weathering steel" is correct?
options: 耐候鋼的保護鏽層只有在乾濕交替、表面能乾燥的條件下才會形成。
耐候鋼橋完全免維護，不需要任何防蝕管理。
行人比車輛輕得多，所以人群上橋對結構沒有影響。
optionsEn: The protective patina of weathering steel forms only where the surface can wet and then dry.
Weathering-steel bridges are completely maintenance-free and need no corrosion management.
Pedestrians weigh far less than vehicles, so crowds on a bridge have no structural effect.
quiz.explanation: 耐候鋼的保護鏽層只有在乾濕交替、表面能乾燥的條件下才會形成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The protective patina of weathering steel forms only where the surface can wet and then dry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 耐候鋼的長期維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term care of weathering steel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伸縮縫漏水與耐候鋼」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint leakage on weathering steel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：大氣腐蝕常以冪次律 C = A·tⁿ 估計。取第一年損失 A = 10 μm：正常乾濕條件 n = 0.5，50 年損失 10×50^0.5 ≈ 71 μm；長期潮濕含鹽 n = 0.8，50 年損失 10×50^0.8 ≈ 229 μm，約為 3.2 倍。A 與 n 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Atmospheric corrosion is often estimated by the power law C = A·tⁿ. With a first-year loss A = 10 μm, normal wet–dry exposure with n = 0.5 gives 10×50^0.5 ≈ 71 μm after 50 years; persistently wet, salty exposure with n = 0.8 gives 10×50^0.8 ≈ 229 μm, about 3.2 times as much. A and n are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查時記錄鏽層的顏色、質地與附著性（緻密或片狀剝落），並在可疑處以超音波測厚量測剩餘厚度；以伸縮縫與排水口的位置為檢查重點，比較各區的腐蝕程度，追蹤歷年趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record patina colour, texture and adherence (tight or flaking) during inspection, measuring remaining thickness ultrasonically at suspect spots; focus on locations below joints and drains, comparing corrosion between zones and tracking trends over the years.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 大氣腐蝕常以冪次律 C = A·tⁿ 估計。取第一年損失 A = 10 μm：正常乾濕條件 n = 0.5，50 年損失 10×50^0.5 ≈ 71 μm；長期潮濕含鹽 n = 0.8，50 年損失 10×50^0.8 ≈ 229 μm，約為 3.2 倍。A 與 n 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Atmospheric corrosion is often estimated by the power law C = A·tⁿ. With a first-year loss A = 10 μm, normal wet–dry exposure with n = 0.5 gives 10×50^0.5 ≈ 71 μm after 50 years; persistently wet, salty exposure with n = 0.8 gives 10×50^0.8 ≈ 229 μm, about 3.2 times as much. A and n are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「耐候鋼的長期維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term care of weathering steel", which statement holds?
options: 立柱只承受垂直壓力，斜撐只是為了外觀或施工方便。
大氣腐蝕常以冪次律 C = A·tⁿ 估計。
箱形斷面是封閉的，所以內部不會腐蝕，也不需要檢查。
optionsEn: Columns only take vertical compression, and the bracing is just for appearance or construction convenience.
Atmospheric corrosion is often estimated by the power law C = A·tⁿ.
A box section is closed, so its interior cannot corrode and needs no inspection.
quiz.explanation: 大氣腐蝕常以冪次律 C = A·tⁿ 估計。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Atmospheric corrosion is often estimated by the power law C = A·tⁿ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 耐候鋼的長期維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term care of weathering steel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「伸縮縫漏水與耐候鋼」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint leakage on weathering steel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查時記錄鏽層的顏色、質地與附著性（緻密或片狀剝落），並在可疑處以超音波測厚量測剩餘厚度；以伸縮縫與排水口的位置為檢查重點，比較各區的腐蝕程度，追蹤歷年趨勢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record patina colour, texture and adherence (tight or flaking) during inspection, measuring remaining thickness ultrasonically at suspect spots; focus on locations below joints and drains, comparing corrosion between zones and tracking trends over the years. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護計畫應把伸縮縫、排水與碎屑清除列為定期工作，檢查表中加入鏽層狀態分類；對長期潮濕或含鹽的局部區域，由工程師決定是否改善排水或局部塗裝，並記錄處置位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance plan should schedule joint, drainage and debris work regularly and add patina condition classes to the checklist; where zones stay wet or salty, an engineer decides on drainage improvements or local coating, and the locations treated are recorded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：伸縮縫長年漏水使下方支承與排架頂部腐蝕成片狀剝落，斷面損失持續累積，最後需要大規模切除更換；若以為耐候鋼完全免維護而延誤排水修繕，局部腐蝕可能演變成結構性損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Years of joint leakage flake away the steel at bearings and bent tops below, accumulating section loss until large replacements are needed; treating weathering steel as maintenance-free and delaying drainage repairs can turn local corrosion into structural damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查時記錄鏽層的顏色、質地與附著性（緻密或片狀剝落），並在可疑處以超音波測厚量測剩餘厚度；以伸縮縫與排水口的位置為檢查重點，比較各區的腐蝕程度，追蹤歷年趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Record patina colour, texture and adherence (tight or flaking) during inspection, measuring remaining thickness ultrasonically at suspect spots; focus on locations below joints and drains, comparing corrosion between zones and tracking trends over the years.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護計畫應把伸縮縫、排水與碎屑清除列為定期工作，檢查表中加入鏽層狀態分類；對長期潮濕或含鹽的局部區域，由工程師決定是否改善排水或局部塗裝，並記錄處置位置。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance plan should schedule joint, drainage and debris work regularly and add patina condition classes to the checklist; where zones stay wet or salty, an engineer decides on drainage improvements or local coating, and the locations treated are recorded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「耐候鋼的長期維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term care of weathering steel"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
合龍只是把最後一根構件吊上去接起來，千斤頂只是輔助。
檢查時記錄鏽層的顏色、質地與附著性（緻密或片狀剝落），並在可疑處以超音波測厚量測剩餘厚度；以伸縮縫與排水口的位置為檢查重點，比較各區的腐蝕程度，追蹤歷年趨勢。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Closure is just lifting the last member into place, with jacks as a minor aid.
Record patina colour, texture and adherence (tight or flaking) during inspection, measuring remaining thickness ultrasonically at suspect spots.
quiz.explanation: 檢查時記錄鏽層的顏色、質地與附著性（緻密或片狀剝落），並在可疑處以超音波測厚量測剩餘厚度；以伸縮縫與排水口的位置為檢查重點，比較各區的腐蝕程度，追蹤歷年趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record patina colour, texture and adherence (tight or flaking) during inspection, measuring remaining thickness ultrasonically at suspect spots; focus on locations below joints and drains, comparing corrosion between zones and tracking trends over the years. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 耐候鋼的長期維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term care of weathering steel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伸縮縫漏水與耐候鋼」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint leakage on weathering steel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫長年漏水使下方支承與排架頂部腐蝕成片狀剝落，斷面損失持續累積，最後需要大規模切除更換；若以為耐候鋼完全免維護而延誤排水修繕，局部腐蝕可能演變成結構性損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Years of joint leakage flake away the steel at bearings and bent tops below, accumulating section loss until large replacements are needed; treating weathering steel as maintenance-free and delaying drainage repairs can turn local corrosion into structural damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此耐候鋼橋的維護重點不是油漆，而是讓水離開鋼材：修好伸縮縫與排水、清除堆積物，並在局部劣化處考慮塗裝。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance of a weathering-steel bridge is therefore not about paint but about getting water off the steel: repairing joints and drainage, removing deposits and considering local coating where deterioration has started.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「耐候鋼橋完全免維護，不需要任何防蝕管理。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Weathering-steel bridges are completely maintenance-free and need no corrosion management." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫長年漏水使下方支承與排架頂部腐蝕成片狀剝落，斷面損失持續累積，最後需要大規模切除更換；若以為耐候鋼完全免維護而延誤排水修繕，局部腐蝕可能演變成結構性損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Years of joint leakage flake away the steel at bearings and bent tops below, accumulating section loss until large replacements are needed; treating weathering steel as maintenance-free and delaying drainage repairs can turn local corrosion into structural damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「耐候鋼的長期維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term care of weathering steel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 伸縮縫長年漏水使下方支承與排架頂部腐蝕成片狀剝落，斷面損失持續累積，最後需要大規模切除更換；若以為耐候鋼完全免維護而延誤排水修繕，局部腐蝕可能演變成結構性損傷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
行人比車輛輕得多，所以人群上橋對結構沒有影響。
optionsEn: Years of joint leakage flake away the steel at bearings and bent tops below, accumulating section loss until large replacements are needed.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Pedestrians weigh far less than vehicles, so crowds on a bridge have no structural effect.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫長年漏水使下方支承與排架頂部腐蝕成片狀剝落，斷面損失持續累積，最後需要大規模切除更換；若以為耐候鋼完全免維護而延誤排水修繕，局部腐蝕可能演變成結構性損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Years of joint leakage flake away the steel at bearings and bent tops below, accumulating section loss until large replacements are needed; treating weathering steel as maintenance-free and delaying drainage repairs can turn local corrosion into structural damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋梁日人群荷載」如何影響新河峽大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bridge Day crowd load” governs force, deformation or durability in “New River Gorge Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大橋由西維吉尼亞州交通部門管理，位於新河峽國家公園範圍內；每年十月第三個星期六的橋梁日會封閉車道，開放行人上橋並舉辦跳傘活動，自 1980 年起舉辦。2013 年大橋列入美國國家史蹟名錄，代表它的工程價值被正式認定，日後修繕需兼顧保存。對結構而言，大量人群集中在橋面是一種特殊荷載情境：人群密度可能高於一般設計的行人荷載假設，而且分布不均，必須事先評估並以活動管理控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋梁日人群荷載」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bridge is managed by West Virginia's transportation department and lies within New River Gorge National Park; on Bridge Day, the third Saturday of October since 1980, traffic lanes close and pedestrians and parachutists take over the deck. In 2013 the bridge was listed on the National Register of Historic Places, formally recognising its engineering value so future repairs must respect conservation. Structurally, a large crowd on the deck is a special load case: crowd density can exceed ordinary pedestrian design assumptions and be unevenly distributed, so it must be assessed in advance and controlled by event management. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bridge Day crowd load” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 AASHTO 行人荷載 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa 作為密集人群強度，乘以橋面寬約 21.1 m，線荷載 ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m；四車道設計車道荷載各約 9.3 kN/m，合計約 37.2 kN/m，人群線荷載約為其兩倍（尚未計設計卡車與多車道折減）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using the AASHTO pedestrian load of 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa as a dense-crowd intensity over a deck about 21.1 m wide gives ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m; four design lane loads of about 9.3 kN/m each total about 37.2 kN/m, so the crowd line load is roughly double, before design trucks and multiple-presence factors.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「行人比車輛輕得多，所以人群上橋對結構沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pedestrians weigh far less than vehicles, so crowds on a bridge have no structural effect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋梁日人群荷載」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bridge Day crowd load”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接
knowledge.titleEn: Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover
knowledge.text: 大橋由西維吉尼亞州交通部門管理，位於新河峽國家公園範圍內；每年十月第三個星期六的橋梁日會封閉車道，開放行人上橋並舉辦跳傘活動，自 1980 年起舉辦。2013 年大橋列入美國國家史蹟名錄，代表它的工程價值被正式認定，日後修繕需兼顧保存。
knowledge.textEn: The bridge is managed by West Virginia's transportation department and lies within New River Gorge National Park; on Bridge Day, the third Saturday of October since 1980, traffic lanes close and pedestrians and parachutists take over the deck. In 2013 the bridge was listed on the National Register of Historic Places, formally recognising its engineering value so future repairs must respect conservation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：行人比車輛輕得多，所以人群上橋對結構沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pedestrians weigh far less than vehicles, so crowds on a bridge have no structural effect. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover" is correct?
options: 行人比車輛輕得多，所以人群上橋對結構沒有影響。
大橋由西維吉尼亞州交通部門管理，位於新河峽國家公園範圍內；每年十月第三個星期六的橋梁日會封閉車道，開放行人上橋並舉辦跳傘活動，自 1980 年起舉辦。
峽谷越深，拱就必須越高，所以矢跨比對推力沒有影響。
optionsEn: Pedestrians weigh far less than vehicles, so crowds on a bridge have no structural effect.
The bridge is managed by West Virginia's transportation department and lies within New River Gorge National Park.
A deeper gorge simply needs a taller arch, so the rise-to-span ratio does not affect thrust.
quiz.explanation: 大橋由西維吉尼亞州交通部門管理，位於新河峽國家公園範圍內；每年十月第三個星期六的橋梁日會封閉車道，開放行人上橋並舉辦跳傘活動，自 1980 年起舉辦。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The bridge is managed by West Virginia's transportation department and lies within New River Gorge National Park; on Bridge Day, the third Saturday of October since 1980, traffic lanes close and pedestrians and parachutists take over the deck. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋梁日人群荷載」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bridge Day crowd load” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 AASHTO 行人荷載 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa 作為密集人群強度，乘以橋面寬約 21.1 m，線荷載 ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m；四車道設計車道荷載各約 9.3 kN/m，合計約 37.2 kN/m，人群線荷載約為其兩倍（尚未計設計卡車與多車道折減）。比較方式為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using the AASHTO pedestrian load of 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa as a dense-crowd intensity over a deck about 21.1 m wide gives ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m; four design lane loads of about 9.3 kN/m each total about 37.2 kN/m, so the crowd line load is roughly double, before design trucks and multiple-presence factors. The comparison is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：活動前以結構模型比較人群荷載與設計荷載的效應，決定可容許的人數、分區與動線；活動期間以入口計數與分區管控維持密度，必要時在代表性構件裝設臨時應變或位移量測；活動後檢查欄杆、伸縮縫與步道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the event compare crowd and design load effects in the structural model to set allowable numbers, zones and routes; during the event keep density in check with gate counts and zone control, adding temporary strain or displacement monitoring on representative members if needed; inspect railings, joints and walkways afterwards.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 AASHTO 行人荷載 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa 作為密集人群強度，乘以橋面寬約 21.1 m，線荷載 ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m；四車道設計車道荷載各約 9.3 kN/m，合計約 37.2 kN/m，人群線荷載約為其兩倍（尚未計設計卡車與多車道折減）。比較方式為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Using the AASHTO pedestrian load of 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa as a dense-crowd intensity over a deck about 21.1 m wide gives ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m; four design lane loads of about 9.3 kN/m each total about 37.2 kN/m, so the crowd line load is roughly double, before design trucks and multiple-presence factors. The comparison is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover", which statement holds?
options: 耐候鋼會自己形成保護鏽層，所以任何環境、任何細節都不需要考慮腐蝕與韌性。
臨時纜索吊運系統只是施工機具，不需要像永久結構一樣設計與驗證。
以 AASHTO 行人荷載 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa 作為密集人群強度，乘以橋面寬約 21.1 m，線荷載 ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m。
optionsEn: Weathering steel forms its own protective rust, so corrosion and toughness need no attention in any environment or detail.
A temporary cableway is just construction equipment and needs no design or verification like a permanent structure.
Using the AASHTO pedestrian load of 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa as a dense-crowd intensity over a deck about 21.1 m wide gives ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m.
quiz.explanation: 以 AASHTO 行人荷載 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa 作為密集人群強度，乘以橋面寬約 21.1 m，線荷載 ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m；四車道設計車道荷載各約 9.3 kN/m，合計約 37.2 kN/m，人群線荷載約為其兩倍（尚未計設計卡車與多車道折減）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the AASHTO pedestrian load of 0.075 ksf ≈ 3.59 kPa as a dense-crowd intensity over a deck about 21.1 m wide gives ≈ 3.59×21.1 ≈ 75.7 kN/m; four design lane loads of about 9.3 kN/m each total about 37.2 kN/m, so the crowd line load is roughly double, before design trucks and multiple-presence factors. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋梁日人群荷載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bridge Day crowd load” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 活動前以結構模型比較人群荷載與設計荷載的效應，決定可容許的人數、分區與動線；活動期間以入口計數與分區管控維持密度，必要時在代表性構件裝設臨時應變或位移量測；活動後檢查欄杆、伸縮縫與步道。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the event compare crowd and design load effects in the structural model to set allowable numbers, zones and routes; during the event keep density in check with gate counts and zone control, adding temporary strain or displacement monitoring on representative members if needed; inspect railings, joints and walkways afterwards. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：大型活動應有書面結構評估、人數上限、分區與緊急疏散計畫，並由橋梁管理機關核准；交接文件包含檢查紀錄、載重評等、史蹟登錄的保存要求、活動評估與歷年維修資料，由州交通部門與國家公園管理單位共享。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Large events need a written structural assessment, crowd caps, zoning and an emergency evacuation plan approved by the bridge owner; handover files include inspections, load ratings, historic-listing conservation requirements, event assessments and repair history, shared between the state transportation department and the park service.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若人群集中在少數觀景點，局部欄杆與橋面板承受遠高於平均的荷載；活動附屬設施（舞台、跳傘設備、臨時固定）若未經結構檢核就固定在橋上，可能損傷構件或耐候鋼表面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Crowds concentrated at a few viewpoints load local railings and deck panels far above the average; event fixtures such as stages, parachuting equipment or temporary anchors attached without structural review can damage members or the weathering-steel surface. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 活動前以結構模型比較人群荷載與設計荷載的效應，決定可容許的人數、分區與動線；活動期間以入口計數與分區管控維持密度，必要時在代表性構件裝設臨時應變或位移量測；活動後檢查欄杆、伸縮縫與步道。
knowledge.textEn: Before the event compare crowd and design load effects in the structural model to set allowable numbers, zones and routes; during the event keep density in check with gate counts and zone control, adding temporary strain or displacement monitoring on representative members if needed; inspect railings, joints and walkways afterwards.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 大型活動應有書面結構評估、人數上限、分區與緊急疏散計畫，並由橋梁管理機關核准；交接文件包含檢查紀錄、載重評等、史蹟登錄的保存要求、活動評估與歷年維修資料，由州交通部門與國家公園管理單位共享。
knowledge.textEn: Large events need a written structural assessment, crowd caps, zoning and an emergency evacuation plan approved by the bridge owner; handover files include inspections, load ratings, historic-listing conservation requirements, event assessments and repair history, shared between the state transportation department and the park service.

quiz.question: 要驗證「橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover"?
options: 活動前以結構模型比較人群荷載與設計荷載的效應，決定可容許的人數、分區與動線。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
鋼構件很剛硬，溫度對拱的高程影響只有幾公釐，可以忽略。
optionsEn: Before the event compare crowd and design load effects in the structural model to set allowable numbers, zones and routes.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Steel is stiff, so temperature changes the arch level by only a few millimetres and can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 活動前以結構模型比較人群荷載與設計荷載的效應，決定可容許的人數、分區與動線；活動期間以入口計數與分區管控維持密度，必要時在代表性構件裝設臨時應變或位移量測；活動後檢查欄杆、伸縮縫與步道。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the event compare crowd and design load effects in the structural model to set allowable numbers, zones and routes; during the event keep density in check with gate counts and zone control, adding temporary strain or displacement monitoring on representative members if needed; inspect railings, joints and walkways afterwards. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋梁日人群荷載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bridge Day crowd load” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若人群集中在少數觀景點，局部欄杆與橋面板承受遠高於平均的荷載；活動附屬設施（舞台、跳傘設備、臨時固定）若未經結構檢核就固定在橋上，可能損傷構件或耐候鋼表面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Crowds concentrated at a few viewpoints load local railings and deck panels far above the average; event fixtures such as stages, parachuting equipment or temporary anchors attached without structural review can damage members or the weathering-steel surface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對結構而言，大量人群集中在橋面是一種特殊荷載情境：人群密度可能高於一般設計的行人荷載假設，而且分布不均，必須事先評估並以活動管理控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Structurally, a large crowd on the deck is a special load case: crowd density can exceed ordinary pedestrian design assumptions and be unevenly distributed, so it must be assessed in advance and controlled by event management.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「行人比車輛輕得多，所以人群上橋對結構沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pedestrians weigh far less than vehicles, so crowds on a bridge have no structural effect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若人群集中在少數觀景點，局部欄杆與橋面板承受遠高於平均的荷載；活動附屬設施（舞台、跳傘設備、臨時固定）若未經結構檢核就固定在橋上，可能損傷構件或耐候鋼表面。
knowledge.textEn: Crowds concentrated at a few viewpoints load local railings and deck panels far above the average; event fixtures such as stages, parachuting equipment or temporary anchors attached without structural review can damage members or the weathering-steel surface.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「橋梁日、遺產登錄與管理交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bridge Day, heritage listing and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若人群集中在少數觀景點，局部欄杆與橋面板承受遠高於平均的荷載；活動附屬設施（舞台、跳傘設備、臨時固定）若未經結構檢核就固定在橋上，可能損傷構件或耐候鋼表面。
峽谷越深，拱就必須越高，所以矢跨比對推力沒有影響。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Crowds concentrated at a few viewpoints load local railings and deck panels far above the average.
A deeper gorge simply needs a taller arch, so the rise-to-span ratio does not affect thrust.
quiz.explanation: 若人群集中在少數觀景點，局部欄杆與橋面板承受遠高於平均的荷載；活動附屬設施（舞台、跳傘設備、臨時固定）若未經結構檢核就固定在橋上，可能損傷構件或耐候鋼表面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Crowds concentrated at a few viewpoints load local railings and deck panels far above the average; event fixtures such as stages, parachuting equipment or temporary anchors attached without structural review can damage members or the weathering-steel surface. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鋼拱橋拱肋合龍
summary: 大跨度鋼拱多半以兩側半拱懸臂伸出、在拱頂合龍的方式架設，合龍是整個施工中結構體系改變最劇烈、對幾何與溫度最敏感的時刻。本課以雪梨港灣大橋 1930 年放索合龍、新河峽大橋 1976 年以 16 具千斤頂下放合龍，以及上海盧浦大橋以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設為例，說明合龍前後的力學、架設方法選擇、合龍段構造、溫度場、線形調整、鎖定時機、扣索卸載與驗收，最後談強迫對位的風險與合龍紀錄的交接。
summaryEn: Most long-span steel arches are built by cantilevering half-arches from both sides and closing them at the crown, and closure is the moment of the most drastic system change in the whole erection, the most sensitive to geometry and temperature. Using the 1930 cable-release closure of Sydney Harbour Bridge, the 1976 jack-down closure of New River Gorge Bridge with 16 jacks and the temporary cable-stayed cantilevering of Shanghai's Lupu Bridge, the course explains the mechanics before and after closure, choice of erection method, closure-segment detailing, temperature fields, geometry adjustment, locking time, tieback release and acceptance, ending with the risks of forced fit and the handover of closure records.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 合龍規劃練習：某鋼拱 L = 400 m、拱矢 f = 80 m、施工階段自重 w = 180 kN/m。成拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 180×400²/(8×80) = 45,000 kN。合龍前每個半拱懸臂 200 m，拱腳彎矩 M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 180×200²/2 = 3.6×10⁶ kN·m；扣索力臂 50 m 時扣索力 T = 3.6×10⁶/50 = 72,000 kN。扣索長 250 m、斷面 0.08 m²、E = 195 GPa，彈性伸長 δ = 72×10⁶×250/(195×10⁹×0.08) ≈ 1.15 m，必須納入預拱與扣索長度設定。拱軸弧長 s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 400 + 8×80²/1,200 ≈ 442.7 m，溫度變化 10 °C 時合龍間隙改變 1.2×10⁻⁵×442.7×10 ≈ 53 mm，遠大於螺栓孔容許的數公釐，因此必須以實測溫度與間隙決定合龍段尺寸與鎖定時段。若拱矢提高到 100 m，推力降為 36,000 kN（減少 20%），但拱肋更長、溫度間隙變化與扣索高度都增加。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Closure-planning exercise: a steel arch has L = 400 m, rise f = 80 m and erection-stage self-weight w = 180 kN/m. The completed thrust is H = w·L²/(8f) = 180×400²/(8×80) = 45,000 kN. Before closure each half-arch cantilevers 200 m with a foot moment M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 180×200²/2 = 3.6×10⁶ kN·m; with a 50 m tieback lever arm the tieback force is T = 3.6×10⁶/50 = 72,000 kN. A 250 m tieback of 0.08 m² with E = 195 GPa stretches δ = 72×10⁶×250/(195×10⁹×0.08) ≈ 1.15 m, which must be built into camber and tieback length settings. The arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 400 + 8×80²/1,200 ≈ 442.7 m, so a 10 °C change alters the closure gap by 1.2×10⁻⁵×442.7×10 ≈ 53 mm, far more than the few millimetres bolt holes allow, which is why measured temperature and gap must set the closure-piece size and locking window. Raising the rise to 100 m cuts thrust to 36,000 kN (20% less) but lengthens the ribs, increasing thermal gap change and tieback height. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「合龍的力學意義」與「架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "What closure means structurally" and "Choosing the erection method and temporary support": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 合龍的力學意義：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: What closure means structurally: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「合龍前後的體系轉換」如何影響鋼拱橋拱肋合龍的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System change at closure” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel arch rib closure”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 合龍前，每個半拱都是從拱腳伸出的懸臂，自重在拱腳產生很大的傾覆彎矩，必須由扣索、背拉索或臨時支架承擔；合龍後，兩個半拱在拱頂互相頂住，荷載改以軸壓沿拱軸傳到拱腳，並在拱腳產生水平推力。同一批鋼構件在合龍前後的受力方式完全不同：懸臂狀態下上弦受拉、下弦受壓且彎矩很大，成拱後以軸壓為主。合龍與之後的扣索卸載，就是把荷載從臨時系統轉移到永久拱體系的過程，順序與量值都必須受控。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「合龍前後的體系轉換」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before closure each half-arch is a cantilever from its springing, and its self-weight creates a large overturning moment at the foot that tiebacks, backstays or temporary falsework must resist; after closure the two halves bear against each other at the crown, loads travel as axial compression along the arch axis to the springings, and horizontal thrust appears there. The same steel members carry load entirely differently before and after: as a cantilever the top chord is in tension, the bottom chord in compression and bending is large, while the completed arch works mainly in axial compression. Closure and the subsequent tieback release transfer load from the temporary system to the permanent arch, so both sequence and magnitudes must be controlled. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “System change at closure” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 L = 300 m、f = 60 m、w = 150 kN/m 的拱為例：成拱後推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For an arch with L = 300 m, f = 60 m and w = 150 kN/m, the completed thrust is H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼拱在架設過程中一直都是拱，構件受力和完工後一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steel arch behaves as an arch throughout erection, so members carry the same forces as in service." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「合龍前後的體系轉換」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “System change at closure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 合龍的力學意義
knowledge.text: 合龍前，每個半拱都是從拱腳伸出的懸臂，自重在拱腳產生很大的傾覆彎矩，必須由扣索、背拉索或臨時支架承擔；合龍後，兩個半拱在拱頂互相頂住，荷載改以軸壓沿拱軸傳到拱腳，並在拱腳產生水平推力。同一批鋼構件在合龍前後的受力方式完全不同：懸臂狀態下上弦受拉、下弦受壓且彎矩很大，成拱後以軸壓為主。
knowledge.textEn: Before closure each half-arch is a cantilever from its springing, and its self-weight creates a large overturning moment at the foot that tiebacks, backstays or temporary falsework must resist; after closure the two halves bear against each other at the crown, loads travel as axial compression along the arch axis to the springings, and horizontal thrust appears there. The same steel members carry load entirely differently before and after: as a cantilever the top chord is in tension, the bottom chord in compression and bending is large, while the completed arch works mainly in axial compression.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼拱在架設過程中一直都是拱，構件受力和完工後一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steel arch behaves as an arch throughout erection, so members carry the same forces as in service. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「合龍的力學意義」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "What closure means structurally" is correct?
options: 鋼拱在架設過程中一直都是拱，構件受力和完工後一樣。
合龍前，每個半拱都是從拱腳伸出的懸臂，自重在拱腳產生很大的傾覆彎矩，必須由扣索、背拉索或臨時支架承擔。
扣索只要強度夠就好，它的伸長量不會影響拱的線形。
optionsEn: A steel arch behaves as an arch throughout erection, so members carry the same forces as in service.
Before closure each half-arch is a cantilever from its springing, and its self-weight creates a large overturning moment at the foot that tiebacks, backstays or temporary falsework must resist.
Tiebacks only need enough strength; their stretch does not affect the arch geometry.
quiz.explanation: 合龍前，每個半拱都是從拱腳伸出的懸臂，自重在拱腳產生很大的傾覆彎矩，必須由扣索、背拉索或臨時支架承擔；合龍後，兩個半拱在拱頂互相頂住，荷載改以軸壓沿拱軸傳到拱腳，並在拱腳產生水平推力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before closure each half-arch is a cantilever from its springing, and its self-weight creates a large overturning moment at the foot that tiebacks, backstays or temporary falsework must resist; after closure the two halves bear against each other at the crown, loads travel as axial compression along the arch axis to the springings, and horizontal thrust appears there. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 合龍的力學意義：定量估算
steps.titleEn: What closure means structurally: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「合龍前後的體系轉換」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System change at closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 L = 300 m、f = 60 m、w = 150 kN/m 的拱為例：成拱後推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN。合龍前半拱懸臂長 150 m，拱腳彎矩 M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 150×150²/2 ≈ 1.69×10⁶ kN·m；若扣索對拱腳的力臂 40 m，扣索力 T ≈ 1.69×10⁶/40 ≈ 42,200 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an arch with L = 300 m, f = 60 m and w = 150 kN/m, the completed thrust is H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN. Before closure each half is a 150 m cantilever with a foot moment M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 150×150²/2 ≈ 1.69×10⁶ kN·m; with a 40 m tieback lever arm about the foot, the tieback force is T ≈ 1.69×10⁶/40 ≈ 42,200 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析逐步計算每一安裝階段、合龍與卸載各步驟的桿件力、扣索力與線形，並確認每個構件在最不利的臨時狀態下仍有足夠容量；分析模型須經獨立審查，作為施工監控的預測基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use staged analysis to compute member forces, tieback forces and geometry for every erection stage, the closure and each release step, confirming every member has capacity in its worst temporary state; the model is independently checked and becomes the prediction baseline for construction monitoring.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 L = 300 m、f = 60 m、w = 150 kN/m 的拱為例：成拱後推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN。合龍前半拱懸臂長 150 m，拱腳彎矩 M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 150×150²/2 ≈ 1.69×10⁶ kN·m；若扣索對拱腳的力臂 40 m，扣索力 T ≈ 1.69×10⁶/40 ≈ 42,200 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For an arch with L = 300 m, f = 60 m and w = 150 kN/m, the completed thrust is H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN. Before closure each half is a 150 m cantilever with a foot moment M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 150×150²/2 ≈ 1.69×10⁶ kN·m; with a 40 m tieback lever arm about the foot, the tieback force is T ≈ 1.69×10⁶/40 ≈ 42,200 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「合龍的力學意義」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "What closure means structurally", which statement holds?
options: 只要量氣溫就能代表拱肋的溫度狀態。
合龍可以在任何時間進行，只要工人準備好就能鎖定。
optionsEn: Air temperature alone represents the thermal state of the arch ribs.
Closure can happen at any time as long as the crew is ready to lock it.
For an arch with L = 300 m, f = 60 m and w = 150 kN/m, the completed thrust is H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN.
quiz.explanation: 以 L = 300 m、f = 60 m、w = 150 kN/m 的拱為例：成拱後推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For an arch with L = 300 m, f = 60 m and w = 150 kN/m, the completed thrust is H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 合龍的力學意義：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: What closure means structurally: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「合龍前後的體系轉換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System change at closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析逐步計算每一安裝階段、合龍與卸載各步驟的桿件力、扣索力與線形，並確認每個構件在最不利的臨時狀態下仍有足夠容量；分析模型須經獨立審查，作為施工監控的預測基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use staged analysis to compute member forces, tieback forces and geometry for every erection stage, the closure and each release step, confirming every member has capacity in its worst temporary state; the model is independently checked and becomes the prediction baseline for construction monitoring. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計單位應提供完整的施工階段分析與每階段的允許值，施工者不得自行改變架設或卸載順序；任何順序變更須重新分析並經設計者書面核准，合龍與卸載列為主要停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The designer should supply a full staged analysis with permissible values for each stage, and the contractor may not change erection or release sequences on its own; any change needs re-analysis and written approval by the designer, with closure and release as principal hold points.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只依完工狀態設計構件而未檢查懸臂狀態，上弦在懸臂期受拉、下弦受到遠大於完工時的壓力，可能在架設中挫屈或連接破壞；卸載順序錯誤時，荷載可能瞬間集中到少數構件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing members only for the completed state without checking the cantilever stage can leave top chords in tension and bottom chords under far more compression than in service, risking buckling or connection failure during erection; a wrong release sequence can suddenly concentrate load on a few members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段分析逐步計算每一安裝階段、合龍與卸載各步驟的桿件力、扣索力與線形，並確認每個構件在最不利的臨時狀態下仍有足夠容量；分析模型須經獨立審查，作為施工監控的預測基準。
knowledge.textEn: Use staged analysis to compute member forces, tieback forces and geometry for every erection stage, the closure and each release step, confirming every member has capacity in its worst temporary state; the model is independently checked and becomes the prediction baseline for construction monitoring.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計單位應提供完整的施工階段分析與每階段的允許值，施工者不得自行改變架設或卸載順序；任何順序變更須重新分析並經設計者書面核准，合龍與卸載列為主要停留點。
knowledge.textEn: The designer should supply a full staged analysis with permissible values for each stage, and the contractor may not change erection or release sequences on its own; any change needs re-analysis and written approval by the designer, with closure and release as principal hold points.

quiz.question: 要驗證「合龍的力學意義」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "What closure means structurally"?
options: 以施工階段分析逐步計算每一安裝階段、合龍與卸載各步驟的桿件力、扣索力與線形，並確認每個構件在最不利的臨時狀態下仍有足夠容量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
拱只要外觀看起來對稱平順，就代表合龍成功。
optionsEn: Use staged analysis to compute member forces, tieback forces and geometry for every erection stage, the closure and each release step, confirming every member has capacity in its worst temporary state.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the arch looks symmetrical and smooth, closure was successful.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段分析逐步計算每一安裝階段、合龍與卸載各步驟的桿件力、扣索力與線形，並確認每個構件在最不利的臨時狀態下仍有足夠容量；分析模型須經獨立審查，作為施工監控的預測基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use staged analysis to compute member forces, tieback forces and geometry for every erection stage, the closure and each release step, confirming every member has capacity in its worst temporary state; the model is independently checked and becomes the prediction baseline for construction monitoring. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合龍的力學意義：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: What closure means structurally: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「合龍前後的體系轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System change at closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只依完工狀態設計構件而未檢查懸臂狀態，上弦在懸臂期受拉、下弦受到遠大於完工時的壓力，可能在架設中挫屈或連接破壞；卸載順序錯誤時，荷載可能瞬間集中到少數構件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing members only for the completed state without checking the cantilever stage can leave top chords in tension and bottom chords under far more compression than in service, risking buckling or connection failure during erection; a wrong release sequence can suddenly concentrate load on a few members. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：合龍與之後的扣索卸載，就是把荷載從臨時系統轉移到永久拱體系的過程，順序與量值都必須受控。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Closure and the subsequent tieback release transfer load from the temporary system to the permanent arch, so both sequence and magnitudes must be controlled.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼拱在架設過程中一直都是拱，構件受力和完工後一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steel arch behaves as an arch throughout erection, so members carry the same forces as in service." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只依完工狀態設計構件而未檢查懸臂狀態，上弦在懸臂期受拉、下弦受到遠大於完工時的壓力，可能在架設中挫屈或連接破壞；卸載順序錯誤時，荷載可能瞬間集中到少數構件。
knowledge.textEn: Designing members only for the completed state without checking the cantilever stage can leave top chords in tension and bottom chords under far more compression than in service, risking buckling or connection failure during erection; a wrong release sequence can suddenly concentrate load on a few members.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合龍的力學意義」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "What closure means structurally" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只依完工狀態設計構件而未檢查懸臂狀態，上弦在懸臂期受拉、下弦受到遠大於完工時的壓力，可能在架設中挫屈或連接破壞；卸載順序錯誤時，荷載可能瞬間集中到少數構件。
扣索只要強度夠就好，它的伸長量不會影響拱的線形。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Designing members only for the completed state without checking the cantilever stage can leave top chords in tension and bottom chords under far more compression than in service, risking buckling or connection failure during erection.
Tiebacks only need enough strength; their stretch does not affect the arch geometry.
quiz.explanation: 若只依完工狀態設計構件而未檢查懸臂狀態，上弦在懸臂期受拉、下弦受到遠大於完工時的壓力，可能在架設中挫屈或連接破壞；卸載順序錯誤時，荷載可能瞬間集中到少數構件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing members only for the completed state without checking the cantilever stage can leave top chords in tension and bottom chords under far more compression than in service, risking buckling or connection failure during erection; a wrong release sequence can suddenly concentrate load on a few members. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Choosing the erection method and temporary support: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「扣索與背拉系統」如何影響鋼拱橋拱肋合龍的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tieback and stay systems” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel arch rib closure”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼拱的架設方法取決於地形、水域與跨度。雪梨港灣大橋在港灣上無法設支架，於兩岸岩盤開挖隧道錨碇 128 條鋼索拉住半拱；新河峽大橋在 267 公尺深的峽谷中以纜索吊運送構件，並以油井套管背拉索錨碇在拱腳後方約 200 英尺的地錨；上海盧浦大橋則以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設 550 公尺的拱。這些方法的共同點是：臨時系統必須提供與半拱自重相當的抗傾覆能力，而且其彈性伸長會直接影響半拱端點的位置，所以扣索既是承力構件，也是調整線形的工具。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「扣索與背拉系統」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Erection method depends on terrain, water and span. Sydney Harbour Bridge could have no falsework over the harbour, so 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels held back the half-arches; New River Gorge Bridge, over a gorge 267 m deep, used a cableway to deliver steel and oil-well-casing tiebacks anchored in deadmen about 200 ft behind the springings; Shanghai's Lupu Bridge cantilevered its 550 m arch on temporary cable stays. In every case the temporary system must provide overturning resistance comparable to the half-arch's weight, and its elastic stretch directly moves the half-arch tip, so tiebacks are both load-carrying members and tools for adjusting geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tieback and stay systems” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：扣索彈性伸長 δ = T·L/(E·A)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tieback stretch δ = T·L/(E·A).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「扣索只要強度夠就好，它的伸長量不會影響拱的線形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tiebacks only need enough strength; their stretch does not affect the arch geometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「扣索與背拉系統」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tieback and stay systems”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇
knowledge.titleEn: Choosing the erection method and temporary support
knowledge.text: 鋼拱的架設方法取決於地形、水域與跨度。雪梨港灣大橋在港灣上無法設支架，於兩岸岩盤開挖隧道錨碇 128 條鋼索拉住半拱；新河峽大橋在 267 公尺深的峽谷中以纜索吊運送構件，並以油井套管背拉索錨碇在拱腳後方約 200 英尺的地錨；上海盧浦大橋則以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設 550 公尺的拱。
knowledge.textEn: Erection method depends on terrain, water and span. Sydney Harbour Bridge could have no falsework over the harbour, so 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels held back the half-arches; New River Gorge Bridge, over a gorge 267 m deep, used a cableway to deliver steel and oil-well-casing tiebacks anchored in deadmen about 200 ft behind the springings; Shanghai's Lupu Bridge cantilevered its 550 m arch on temporary cable stays.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：扣索只要強度夠就好，它的伸長量不會影響拱的線形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tiebacks only need enough strength; their stretch does not affect the arch geometry. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Choosing the erection method and temporary support" is correct?
options: 扣索只要強度夠就好，它的伸長量不會影響拱的線形。
合龍段只要尺寸大致吻合，用螺栓強行鎖緊就能達到設計狀態。
鋼拱的架設方法取決於地形、水域與跨度。
optionsEn: Tiebacks only need enough strength; their stretch does not affect the arch geometry.
If the closure piece roughly fits, forcing the bolts tight achieves the design state.
Erection method depends on terrain, water and span.
quiz.explanation: 鋼拱的架設方法取決於地形、水域與跨度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Erection method depends on terrain, water and span. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Choosing the erection method and temporary support: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「扣索與背拉系統」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tieback and stay systems” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：扣索彈性伸長 δ = T·L/(E·A)。T = 42.2 MN、扣索長 L = 200 m、E = 195 GPa、斷面 A = 0.03 m²：δ = 42.2×10⁶×200/(195×10⁹×0.03) ≈ 1.44 m；若 A 加倍為 0.06 m²，δ ≈ 0.72 m。扣索伸長會使半拱繞拱腳轉動，端點下沉，必須在預拱或扣索長度中補償。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tieback stretch δ = T·L/(E·A). With T = 42.2 MN, length L = 200 m, E = 195 GPa and A = 0.03 m², δ = 42.2×10⁶×200/(195×10⁹×0.03) ≈ 1.44 m; doubling A to 0.06 m² gives δ ≈ 0.72 m. The stretch rotates the half-arch about its foot and drops the tip, so it must be compensated in camber or tieback length. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：扣索系統的錨碇（岩盤隧道、地錨或塔架）在使用前做驗證拉拔試驗，扣索張拉時記錄油壓、伸長量與溫度；每階段量測半拱端點位置，與包含扣索伸長的施工分析比較，差異超過允差時先查明原因再繼續。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Proof-test tieback anchorages (rock tunnels, deadmen or towers) before use and record jack pressure, elongation and temperature during stressing; survey the half-arch tip at every stage against a staged analysis that includes tieback stretch, and investigate before continuing whenever the difference exceeds tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 扣索彈性伸長 δ = T·L/(E·A)。T = 42.2 MN、扣索長 L = 200 m、E = 195 GPa、斷面 A = 0.03 m²：δ = 42.2×10⁶×200/(195×10⁹×0.03) ≈ 1.44 m；若 A 加倍為 0.06 m²，δ ≈ 0.72 m。扣索伸長會使半拱繞拱腳轉動，端點下沉，必須在預拱或扣索長度中補償。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Tieback stretch δ = T·L/(E·A). With T = 42.2 MN, length L = 200 m, E = 195 GPa and A = 0.03 m², δ = 42.2×10⁶×200/(195×10⁹×0.03) ≈ 1.44 m; doubling A to 0.06 m² gives δ ≈ 0.72 m. The stretch rotates the half-arch about its foot and drops the tip, so it must be compensated in camber or tieback length. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Choosing the erection method and temporary support", which statement holds?
options: 扣索彈性伸長 δ = T·L/(E·A)。
端點高程對齊就代表可以合龍，轉角與平面位置不重要。
合龍接上之後，扣索可以一次全部拆除，拱會自動承受全部荷載。
optionsEn: Tieback stretch δ = T·L/(E·A).
Once tip levels match, closure can proceed; rotation and plan position do not matter.
Once the crown is joined, all tiebacks can be removed at once and the arch will simply take the full load.
quiz.explanation: 扣索彈性伸長 δ = T·L/(E·A)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Tieback stretch δ = T·L/(E·A). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Choosing the erection method and temporary support: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「扣索與背拉系統」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tieback and stay systems” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 扣索系統的錨碇（岩盤隧道、地錨或塔架）在使用前做驗證拉拔試驗，扣索張拉時記錄油壓、伸長量與溫度；每階段量測半拱端點位置，與包含扣索伸長的施工分析比較，差異超過允差時先查明原因再繼續。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Proof-test tieback anchorages (rock tunnels, deadmen or towers) before use and record jack pressure, elongation and temperature during stressing; survey the half-arch tip at every stage against a staged analysis that includes tieback stretch, and investigate before continuing whenever the difference exceeds tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：架設方案應比較支架、扣索懸臂、纜索吊運、轉體與大段提升等方法的風險與成本，選定後由獨立工程師審查臨時系統；扣索錨碇的驗證試驗與每階段量測列為停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The erection scheme should compare falsework, tieback cantilevering, cableway, rotation and large-segment lifting for risk and cost, with the chosen temporary system independently checked; anchorage proof tests and stage-by-stage surveys are hold points.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若低估扣索伸長或錨碇位移，半拱端點逐段下沉，合龍時兩端高程差遠超可調整範圍；錨碇失效則可能使半拱失去平衡而倒塌，是拱橋架設中最嚴重的風險之一。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underestimating tieback stretch or anchorage movement lets the half-arch tip sink stage by stage until the closure level difference far exceeds the adjustable range; an anchorage failure can unbalance and collapse the half-arch, one of the gravest risks in arch erection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Proof-test tieback anchorages (rock tunnels, deadmen or towers) before use and record jack pressure, elongation and temperature during stressing; survey the half-arch tip at every stage against a staged analysis that includes tieback stretch, and investigate before continuing whenever the difference exceeds tolerance.

knowledge.text: 架設方案應比較支架、扣索懸臂、纜索吊運、轉體與大段提升等方法的風險與成本，選定後由獨立工程師審查臨時系統；扣索錨碇的驗證試驗與每階段量測列為停留點。

quiz.question: 要驗證「架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Choosing the erection method and temporary support"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
扣索系統的錨碇（岩盤隧道、地錨或塔架）在使用前做驗證拉拔試驗，扣索張拉時記錄油壓、伸長量與溫度。
螺栓孔對不上時，用千斤頂強行對位是正常的施工手段，不需要通報設計者。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Proof-test tieback anchorages (rock tunnels, deadmen or towers) before use and record jack pressure, elongation and temperature during stressing.
Jacking ends into position when bolt holes do not align is routine and need not be reported to the designer.
quiz.explanation: 扣索系統的錨碇（岩盤隧道、地錨或塔架）在使用前做驗證拉拔試驗，扣索張拉時記錄油壓、伸長量與溫度；每階段量測半拱端點位置，與包含扣索伸長的施工分析比較，差異超過允差時先查明原因再繼續。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Proof-test tieback anchorages (rock tunnels, deadmen or towers) before use and record jack pressure, elongation and temperature during stressing; survey the half-arch tip at every stage against a staged analysis that includes tieback stretch, and investigate before continuing whenever the difference exceeds tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Choosing the erection method and temporary support: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「扣索與背拉系統」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tieback and stay systems” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若低估扣索伸長或錨碇位移，半拱端點逐段下沉，合龍時兩端高程差遠超可調整範圍；錨碇失效則可能使半拱失去平衡而倒塌，是拱橋架設中最嚴重的風險之一。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Underestimating tieback stretch or anchorage movement lets the half-arch tip sink stage by stage until the closure level difference far exceeds the adjustable range; an anchorage failure can unbalance and collapse the half-arch, one of the gravest risks in arch erection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些方法的共同點是：臨時系統必須提供與半拱自重相當的抗傾覆能力，而且其彈性伸長會直接影響半拱端點的位置，所以扣索既是承力構件，也是調整線形的工具。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In every case the temporary system must provide overturning resistance comparable to the half-arch's weight, and its elastic stretch directly moves the half-arch tip, so tiebacks are both load-carrying members and tools for adjusting geometry.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「扣索只要強度夠就好，它的伸長量不會影響拱的線形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tiebacks only need enough strength; their stretch does not affect the arch geometry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Choosing the erection method and temporary support" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
合龍段只要尺寸大致吻合，用螺栓強行鎖緊就能達到設計狀態。
若低估扣索伸長或錨碇位移，半拱端點逐段下沉，合龍時兩端高程差遠超可調整範圍；錨碇失效則可能使半拱失去平衡而倒塌，是拱橋架設中最嚴重的風險之一。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If the closure piece roughly fits, forcing the bolts tight achieves the design state.
Underestimating tieback stretch or anchorage movement lets the half-arch tip sink stage by stage until the closure level difference far exceeds the adjustable range.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合」與「溫度場與日照溫差」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Closure-segment detailing and HS bolting" and "Temperature fields and solar gradients": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure-segment detailing and HS bolting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「合龍段與拼接板」如何影響鋼拱橋拱肋合龍的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure segment and splice plates” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel arch rib closure”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 合龍段是填補兩個半拱端點之間間隙的構件，構造上常見的做法有三種：先量測實際間隙再現場切割或配製的配合段；預留長孔或可調墊板的螺栓拼接；以及先以臨時銷或鎖定裝置接合、再焊接或鎖緊的分步作法。歷史上雪梨港灣大橋以鉚接完成拱頂接合，現代鋼拱多採高強度螺栓摩擦接合或全滲透焊接。合龍段必須在很短的時間內完成連接，並在接合後立刻能承受成拱後的軸壓與溫度變化造成的附加力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「合龍段與拼接板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A closure segment fills the gap between the two half-arch tips, typically in one of three ways: a fitting piece cut or made to the measured gap; a bolted splice with slotted holes or adjustable shims; or a staged connection locked first by temporary pins or locking devices and then welded or fully bolted. Historically Sydney Harbour Bridge completed its crown joint by riveting, while modern steel arches mostly use slip-critical high-strength bolting or full-penetration welds. The closure must be connected in a short time and, once joined, immediately carry the completed arch's axial compression and the extra forces from temperature change. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Closure segment and splice plates” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：摩擦型接合的抗滑力 R = n_s·μ·F_p。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Slip resistance of a friction joint R = n_s·μ·F_p.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「合龍段只要尺寸大致吻合，用螺栓強行鎖緊就能達到設計狀態。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the closure piece roughly fits, forcing the bolts tight achieves the design state." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「合龍段與拼接板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Closure segment and splice plates”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合

knowledge.textEn: A closure segment fills the gap between the two half-arch tips, typically in one of three ways: a fitting piece cut or made to the measured gap; a bolted splice with slotted holes or adjustable shims; or a staged connection locked first by temporary pins or locking devices and then welded or fully bolted. Historically Sydney Harbour Bridge completed its crown joint by riveting, while modern steel arches mostly use slip-critical high-strength bolting or full-penetration welds.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：合龍段只要尺寸大致吻合，用螺栓強行鎖緊就能達到設計狀態。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the closure piece roughly fits, forcing the bolts tight achieves the design state. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closure-segment detailing and HS bolting" is correct?
options: 合龍段是填補兩個半拱端點之間間隙的構件，構造上常見的做法有三種：先量測實際間隙再現場切割或配製的配合段。
合龍段只要尺寸大致吻合，用螺栓強行鎖緊就能達到設計狀態。
只要量氣溫就能代表拱肋的溫度狀態。
optionsEn: A closure segment fills the gap between the two half-arch tips, typically in one of three ways: a fitting piece cut or made to the measured gap.
If the closure piece roughly fits, forcing the bolts tight achieves the design state.
Air temperature alone represents the thermal state of the arch ribs.
