quiz.explanationEn: A closure segment fills the gap between the two half-arch tips, typically in one of three ways: a fitting piece cut or made to the measured gap; a bolted splice with slotted holes or adjustable shims; or a staged connection locked first by temporary pins or locking devices and then welded or fully bolted. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closure-segment detailing and HS bolting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「合龍段與拼接板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure segment and splice plates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：摩擦型接合的抗滑力 R = n_s·μ·F_p。M24、10.9 級螺栓預拉力 F_p = 0.7×1,040×353 ≈ 257 kN，兩個摩擦面 n_s = 2、μ = 0.5：每顆約 2×0.5×257 ≈ 257 kN。若合龍接頭需傳遞 20,000 kN 而不滑動，需要 20,000/257 ≈ 78 顆螺栓。等級與 μ 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Slip resistance of a friction joint R = n_s·μ·F_p. An M24 grade 10.9 bolt has preload F_p = 0.7×1,040×353 ≈ 257 kN; with two slip planes n_s = 2 and μ = 0.5, each bolt resists about 2×0.5×257 ≈ 257 kN. A closure joint that must carry 20,000 kN without slip needs 20,000/257 ≈ 78 bolts. Grade and μ are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：合龍段製作前以多次量測（不同溫度）決定配合尺寸，接觸面依規定處理並量測摩擦係數試片；螺栓以轉角法或扭矩法鎖緊並抽驗預拉力，焊接合龍則以超音波檢測全滲透焊道，記錄焊接時的溫度與拱的狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before making the closure piece, measure the gap several times at different temperatures to set its dimensions; prepare faying surfaces as specified and test slip-coefficient coupons; tighten bolts by turn-of-nut or torque with preload spot-checks, and for welded closures test full-penetration welds ultrasonically, recording temperature and arch state during welding.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 摩擦型接合的抗滑力 R = n_s·μ·F_p。M24、10.9 級螺栓預拉力 F_p = 0.7×1,040×353 ≈ 257 kN，兩個摩擦面 n_s = 2、μ = 0.5：每顆約 2×0.5×257 ≈ 257 kN。若合龍接頭需傳遞 20,000 kN 而不滑動，需要 20,000/257 ≈ 78 顆螺栓。等級與 μ 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Slip resistance of a friction joint R = n_s·μ·F_p. An M24 grade 10.9 bolt has preload F_p = 0.7×1,040×353 ≈ 257 kN; with two slip planes n_s = 2 and μ = 0.5, each bolt resists about 2×0.5×257 ≈ 257 kN. A closure joint that must carry 20,000 kN without slip needs 20,000/257 ≈ 78 bolts. Grade and μ are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Closure-segment detailing and HS bolting", which statement holds?
options: 合龍可以在任何時間進行，只要工人準備好就能鎖定。
摩擦型接合的抗滑力 R = n_s·μ·F_p。
拱只要外觀看起來對稱平順，就代表合龍成功。
optionsEn: Closure can happen at any time as long as the crew is ready to lock it.
Slip resistance of a friction joint R = n_s·μ·F_p.
If the arch looks symmetrical and smooth, closure was successful.
quiz.explanation: 摩擦型接合的抗滑力 R = n_s·μ·F_p。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Slip resistance of a friction joint R = n_s·μ·F_p. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closure-segment detailing and HS bolting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「合龍段與拼接板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closure segment and splice plates” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 合龍段製作前以多次量測（不同溫度）決定配合尺寸，接觸面依規定處理並量測摩擦係數試片；螺栓以轉角法或扭矩法鎖緊並抽驗預拉力，焊接合龍則以超音波檢測全滲透焊道，記錄焊接時的溫度與拱的狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before making the closure piece, measure the gap several times at different temperatures to set its dimensions; prepare faying surfaces as specified and test slip-coefficient coupons; tighten bolts by turn-of-nut or torque with preload spot-checks, and for welded closures test full-penetration welds ultrasonically, recording temperature and arch state during welding. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合龍段的設計應預留調整量（長孔、墊板或可切割餘量），並在施工計畫中明訂量測次數、溫度修正與最終尺寸核定流程；螺栓或焊接的檢驗結果與合龍時溫度一併記錄，由設計代表簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Closure-segment design should include adjustment (slotted holes, shims or trimming allowance), and the plan should state how many measurements, what temperature correction and who approves final dimensions; bolting or weld inspection results are recorded with the closure temperature and signed by the designer's representative.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若依單次量測製作合龍段，溫度不同時尺寸不符，只能以千斤頂強迫對位；摩擦面受油污或塗料污染時抗滑力不足，接頭在成拱後滑動，使拱頂產生非預期的變形與應力重分配。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A closure piece made from a single measurement does not fit at another temperature, forcing alignment by jacks; faying surfaces contaminated by oil or paint lack slip resistance, so the joint slips once the arch carries load and the crown deforms and redistributes stress unexpectedly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 合龍段的設計應預留調整量（長孔、墊板或可切割餘量），並在施工計畫中明訂量測次數、溫度修正與最終尺寸核定流程；螺栓或焊接的檢驗結果與合龍時溫度一併記錄，由設計代表簽認。

quiz.question: 要驗證「合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closure-segment detailing and HS bolting"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
合龍完成、橋梁通車後，施工階段的量測資料就沒有保存價值。
合龍段製作前以多次量測（不同溫度）決定配合尺寸，接觸面依規定處理並量測摩擦係數試片。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once closure is complete and the bridge opens, construction-stage measurements are no longer worth keeping.
Before making the closure piece, measure the gap several times at different temperatures to set its dimensions.
quiz.explanation: 合龍段製作前以多次量測（不同溫度）決定配合尺寸，接觸面依規定處理並量測摩擦係數試片；螺栓以轉角法或扭矩法鎖緊並抽驗預拉力，焊接合龍則以超音波檢測全滲透焊道，記錄焊接時的溫度與拱的狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before making the closure piece, measure the gap several times at different temperatures to set its dimensions; prepare faying surfaces as specified and test slip-coefficient coupons; tighten bolts by turn-of-nut or torque with preload spot-checks, and for welded closures test full-penetration welds ultrasonically, recording temperature and arch state during welding. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closure-segment detailing and HS bolting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「合龍段與拼接板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closure segment and splice plates” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若依單次量測製作合龍段，溫度不同時尺寸不符，只能以千斤頂強迫對位；摩擦面受油污或塗料污染時抗滑力不足，接頭在成拱後滑動，使拱頂產生非預期的變形與應力重分配。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A closure piece made from a single measurement does not fit at another temperature, forcing alignment by jacks; faying surfaces contaminated by oil or paint lack slip resistance, so the joint slips once the arch carries load and the crown deforms and redistributes stress unexpectedly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：合龍段必須在很短的時間內完成連接，並在接合後立刻能承受成拱後的軸壓與溫度變化造成的附加力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The closure must be connected in a short time and, once joined, immediately carry the completed arch's axial compression and the extra forces from temperature change.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「合龍段只要尺寸大致吻合，用螺栓強行鎖緊就能達到設計狀態。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the closure piece roughly fits, forcing the bolts tight achieves the design state." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若依單次量測製作合龍段，溫度不同時尺寸不符，只能以千斤頂強迫對位；摩擦面受油污或塗料污染時抗滑力不足，接頭在成拱後滑動，使拱頂產生非預期的變形與應力重分配。
knowledge.textEn: A closure piece made from a single measurement does not fit at another temperature, forcing alignment by jacks; faying surfaces contaminated by oil or paint lack slip resistance, so the joint slips once the arch carries load and the crown deforms and redistributes stress unexpectedly.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closure-segment detailing and HS bolting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若依單次量測製作合龍段，溫度不同時尺寸不符，只能以千斤頂強迫對位；摩擦面受油污或塗料污染時抗滑力不足，接頭在成拱後滑動，使拱頂產生非預期的變形與應力重分配。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要量氣溫就能代表拱肋的溫度狀態。
optionsEn: A closure piece made from a single measurement does not fit at another temperature, forcing alignment by jacks.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Air temperature alone represents the thermal state of the arch ribs.
quiz.explanation: 若依單次量測製作合龍段，溫度不同時尺寸不符，只能以千斤頂強迫對位；摩擦面受油污或塗料污染時抗滑力不足，接頭在成拱後滑動，使拱頂產生非預期的變形與應力重分配。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A closure piece made from a single measurement does not fit at another temperature, forcing alignment by jacks; faying surfaces contaminated by oil or paint lack slip resistance, so the joint slips once the arch carries load and the crown deforms and redistributes stress unexpectedly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 溫度場與日照溫差：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature fields and solar gradients: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「拱肋溫度場」如何影響鋼拱橋拱肋合龍的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rib temperature field” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel arch rib closure”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼材導熱快、熱容量小，日照下拱肋溫度在數小時內就能變化十幾度。均勻溫度變化使兩個半拱伸長或縮短，直接改變拱頂間隙；上下或左右的溫差則使拱肋彎曲，端點產生上下或側向偏移。箱形拱肋向陽的頂板可能比陰影中的底板熱好幾度，即使平均溫度不變，端點高程也會明顯改變。因此合龍前的量測必須同時記錄拱肋多個位置的鋼溫，而不是只看氣溫；量到的間隙與高差要換算回同一溫度狀態才有意義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「拱肋溫度場」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel conducts heat quickly and stores little, so arch ribs can change temperature by more than ten degrees within hours of sunshine. A uniform change lengthens or shortens the half-arches and directly alters the crown gap; a gradient top to bottom or side to side bends the rib and moves the tip up, down or sideways. In a box rib the sunlit top plate may be several degrees warmer than the shaded bottom plate, so the tip level changes markedly even when the average temperature does not. Pre-closure surveys must therefore record steel temperature at several points on the ribs rather than air temperature, and measured gaps and level differences are meaningful only when corrected to one thermal state. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rib temperature field” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩半拱合計弧長 320 m，均勻溫度變化 12 °C，間隙改變 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 320 m of arc in the two halves and a uniform 12 °C change, the gap changes by ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要量氣溫就能代表拱肋的溫度狀態。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Air temperature alone represents the thermal state of the arch ribs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「拱肋溫度場」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rib temperature field”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度場與日照溫差
knowledge.text: 鋼材導熱快、熱容量小，日照下拱肋溫度在數小時內就能變化十幾度。均勻溫度變化使兩個半拱伸長或縮短，直接改變拱頂間隙；上下或左右的溫差則使拱肋彎曲，端點產生上下或側向偏移。
knowledge.textEn: Steel conducts heat quickly and stores little, so arch ribs can change temperature by more than ten degrees within hours of sunshine. A uniform change lengthens or shortens the half-arches and directly alters the crown gap; a gradient top to bottom or side to side bends the rib and moves the tip up, down or sideways.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要量氣溫就能代表拱肋的溫度狀態。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Air temperature alone represents the thermal state of the arch ribs. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度場與日照溫差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temperature fields and solar gradients" is correct?
options: 只要量氣溫就能代表拱肋的溫度狀態。
鋼材導熱快、熱容量小，日照下拱肋溫度在數小時內就能變化十幾度。
端點高程對齊就代表可以合龍，轉角與平面位置不重要。
optionsEn: Air temperature alone represents the thermal state of the arch ribs.
Steel conducts heat quickly and stores little, so arch ribs can change temperature by more than ten degrees within hours of sunshine.
Once tip levels match, closure can proceed; rotation and plan position do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 鋼材導熱快、熱容量小，日照下拱肋溫度在數小時內就能變化十幾度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Steel conducts heat quickly and stores little, so arch ribs can change temperature by more than ten degrees within hours of sunshine. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度場與日照溫差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature fields and solar gradients: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱肋溫度場」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rib temperature field” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩半拱合計弧長 320 m，均勻溫度變化 12 °C，間隙改變 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm。若拱肋深 3 m、上下溫差 5 °C，曲率 κ = α·ΔT/h = 1.2×10⁻⁵×5/3 = 2×10⁻⁵ /m；160 m 懸臂端轉角 κ·L ≈ 3.2 mrad、端點撓度 κ·L²/2 ≈ 0.256 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 320 m of arc in the two halves and a uniform 12 °C change, the gap changes by ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm. For a 3 m deep rib with a 5 °C top-to-bottom difference, the curvature is κ = α·ΔT/h = 1.2×10⁻⁵×5/3 = 2×10⁻⁵ /m; a 160 m cantilever tip rotates κ·L ≈ 3.2 mrad and deflects κ·L²/2 ≈ 0.256 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在拱肋頂板、底板與腹板布設溫度感測器，合龍前至少連續記錄一至兩個晝夜，同步量測端點三維位置；以溫度資料回歸出端點位置與平均溫度、溫差的關係，並與熱分析結果比較，用以預測合龍時段的狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install temperature sensors on rib top plates, bottom plates and webs and log at least one or two full days before closure while surveying tip positions in 3D; regress tip position against mean temperature and gradient, compare with thermal analysis and use the relation to predict conditions in the closure window.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩半拱合計弧長 320 m，均勻溫度變化 12 °C，間隙改變 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm。若拱肋深 3 m、上下溫差 5 °C，曲率 κ = α·ΔT/h = 1.2×10⁻⁵×5/3 = 2×10⁻⁵ /m；160 m 懸臂端轉角 κ·L ≈ 3.2 mrad、端點撓度 κ·L²/2 ≈ 0.256 m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 320 m of arc in the two halves and a uniform 12 °C change, the gap changes by ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm. For a 3 m deep rib with a 5 °C top-to-bottom difference, the curvature is κ = α·ΔT/h = 1.2×10⁻⁵×5/3 = 2×10⁻⁵ /m; a 160 m cantilever tip rotates κ·L ≈ 3.2 mrad and deflects κ·L²/2 ≈ 0.256 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度場與日照溫差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temperature fields and solar gradients", which statement holds?
options: 合龍接上之後，扣索可以一次全部拆除，拱會自動承受全部荷載。
螺栓孔對不上時，用千斤頂強行對位是正常的施工手段，不需要通報設計者。
兩半拱合計弧長 320 m，均勻溫度變化 12 °C，間隙改變 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm。
optionsEn: Once the crown is joined, all tiebacks can be removed at once and the arch will simply take the full load.
Jacking ends into position when bolt holes do not align is routine and need not be reported to the designer.
With 320 m of arc in the two halves and a uniform 12 °C change, the gap changes by ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm.
quiz.explanation: 兩半拱合計弧長 320 m，均勻溫度變化 12 °C，間隙改變 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 320 m of arc in the two halves and a uniform 12 °C change, the gap changes by ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溫度場與日照溫差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temperature fields and solar gradients: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱肋溫度場」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib temperature field” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在拱肋頂板、底板與腹板布設溫度感測器，合龍前至少連續記錄一至兩個晝夜，同步量測端點三維位置；以溫度資料回歸出端點位置與平均溫度、溫差的關係，並與熱分析結果比較，用以預測合龍時段的狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install temperature sensors on rib top plates, bottom plates and webs and log at least one or two full days before closure while surveying tip positions in 3D; regress tip position against mean temperature and gradient, compare with thermal analysis and use the relation to predict conditions in the closure window. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合龍監測計畫應規定溫度感測器的位置與數量、量測頻率、資料同步方式與溫度修正方法；量測成果由監控小組每日整理，提供合龍時段預測，並經設計代表確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The closure monitoring plan should specify sensor locations and numbers, sampling rate, synchronisation and correction method; the monitoring team compiles results daily into a closure-window forecast confirmed by the designer's representative.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以氣溫推估鋼溫，日照時段拱肋實際溫差被忽略，端點高程被誤判，依此調整扣索後，到夜間溫度均勻時兩端高差反而擴大；合龍若在溫差最大時鎖定，接頭會在夜間承受很大的附加彎矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inferring steel temperature from air temperature ignores the real gradients in sunshine, misjudging tip levels; tiebacks adjusted on that basis leave a larger level difference once temperatures even out at night, and a closure locked at peak gradient puts large extra moments into the joint overnight. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在拱肋頂板、底板與腹板布設溫度感測器，合龍前至少連續記錄一至兩個晝夜，同步量測端點三維位置；以溫度資料回歸出端點位置與平均溫度、溫差的關係，並與熱分析結果比較，用以預測合龍時段的狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Install temperature sensors on rib top plates, bottom plates and webs and log at least one or two full days before closure while surveying tip positions in 3D; regress tip position against mean temperature and gradient, compare with thermal analysis and use the relation to predict conditions in the closure window.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合龍監測計畫應規定溫度感測器的位置與數量、量測頻率、資料同步方式與溫度修正方法；量測成果由監控小組每日整理，提供合龍時段預測，並經設計代表確認。
knowledge.textEn: The closure monitoring plan should specify sensor locations and numbers, sampling rate, synchronisation and correction method; the monitoring team compiles results daily into a closure-window forecast confirmed by the designer's representative.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度場與日照溫差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temperature fields and solar gradients"?
options: 在拱肋頂板、底板與腹板布設溫度感測器，合龍前至少連續記錄一至兩個晝夜，同步量測端點三維位置。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
鋼拱在架設過程中一直都是拱，構件受力和完工後一樣。
optionsEn: Install temperature sensors on rib top plates, bottom plates and webs and log at least one or two full days before closure while surveying tip positions in 3D.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A steel arch behaves as an arch throughout erection, so members carry the same forces as in service.
quiz.explanation: 在拱肋頂板、底板與腹板布設溫度感測器，合龍前至少連續記錄一至兩個晝夜，同步量測端點三維位置；以溫度資料回歸出端點位置與平均溫度、溫差的關係，並與熱分析結果比較，用以預測合龍時段的狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Install temperature sensors on rib top plates, bottom plates and webs and log at least one or two full days before closure while surveying tip positions in 3D; regress tip position against mean temperature and gradient, compare with thermal analysis and use the relation to predict conditions in the closure window. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度場與日照溫差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature fields and solar gradients: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱肋溫度場」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rib temperature field” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以氣溫推估鋼溫，日照時段拱肋實際溫差被忽略，端點高程被誤判，依此調整扣索後，到夜間溫度均勻時兩端高差反而擴大；合龍若在溫差最大時鎖定，接頭會在夜間承受很大的附加彎矩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring steel temperature from air temperature ignores the real gradients in sunshine, misjudging tip levels; tiebacks adjusted on that basis leave a larger level difference once temperatures even out at night, and a closure locked at peak gradient puts large extra moments into the joint overnight. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此合龍前的量測必須同時記錄拱肋多個位置的鋼溫，而不是只看氣溫；量到的間隙與高差要換算回同一溫度狀態才有意義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pre-closure surveys must therefore record steel temperature at several points on the ribs rather than air temperature, and measured gaps and level differences are meaningful only when corrected to one thermal state.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要量氣溫就能代表拱肋的溫度狀態。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Air temperature alone represents the thermal state of the arch ribs." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以氣溫推估鋼溫，日照時段拱肋實際溫差被忽略，端點高程被誤判，依此調整扣索後，到夜間溫度均勻時兩端高差反而擴大；合龍若在溫差最大時鎖定，接頭會在夜間承受很大的附加彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Inferring steel temperature from air temperature ignores the real gradients in sunshine, misjudging tip levels; tiebacks adjusted on that basis leave a larger level difference once temperatures even out at night, and a closure locked at peak gradient puts large extra moments into the joint overnight.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度場與日照溫差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temperature fields and solar gradients" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若只以氣溫推估鋼溫，日照時段拱肋實際溫差被忽略，端點高程被誤判，依此調整扣索後，到夜間溫度均勻時兩端高差反而擴大。
端點高程對齊就代表可以合龍，轉角與平面位置不重要。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Inferring steel temperature from air temperature ignores the real gradients in sunshine, misjudging tip levels.
Once tip levels match, closure can proceed; rotation and plan position do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 若只以氣溫推估鋼溫，日照時段拱肋實際溫差被忽略，端點高程被誤判，依此調整扣索後，到夜間溫度均勻時兩端高差反而擴大；合龍若在溫差最大時鎖定，接頭會在夜間承受很大的附加彎矩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inferring steel temperature from air temperature ignores the real gradients in sunshine, misjudging tip levels; tiebacks adjusted on that basis leave a larger level difference once temperatures even out at night, and a closure locked at peak gradient puts large extra moments into the joint overnight. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「合龍前的線形調整」與「合龍時機與臨時鎖定」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Geometry adjustment before closure" and "Closure timing and temporary locking": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 合龍前的線形調整：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Geometry adjustment before closure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「扣索調整千斤頂」如何影響鋼拱橋拱肋合龍的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tieback adjusting jacks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel arch rib closure”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 合龍前兩個半拱端點的高程、平面位置與轉角必須同時接近設計值，否則合龍段無法在無應力狀態下接上。調整的手段主要是改變扣索或背拉索的長度與拉力：放鬆扣索使半拱繞拱腳轉動，端點下降並向中央移動；收緊則相反。新河峽大橋以背拉系統與 16 具千斤頂把兩側拱臂下放合龍，雪梨港灣大橋則以逐步放鬆錨索讓兩個半拱相接。實務上常建立影響係數矩陣，描述每根扣索變化對各端點座標的影響，再解出所需的調整量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「扣索調整千斤頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before closure the two tips must approach design values in level, plan position and rotation simultaneously, or the closure segment cannot be fitted stress-free. Adjustment works mainly by changing tieback or backstay length and force: slackening a tieback rotates the half-arch about its foot, lowering the tip and moving it toward mid-span, and tightening does the reverse. New River Gorge Bridge lowered both arms to closure with its tieback system and 16 jacks, while Sydney Harbour Bridge brought its halves together by gradually releasing the anchor cables. In practice an influence-coefficient matrix describes how each tieback change moves each tip coordinate, and the required adjustments are solved from it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tieback adjusting jacks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設某扣索每改變 1 MN，端點高程改變 s = 12 mm/MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Suppose one tieback moves the tip level by s = 12 mm per MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「端點高程對齊就代表可以合龍，轉角與平面位置不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once tip levels match, closure can proceed; rotation and plan position do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「扣索調整千斤頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tieback adjusting jacks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 合龍前的線形調整
knowledge.text: 合龍前兩個半拱端點的高程、平面位置與轉角必須同時接近設計值，否則合龍段無法在無應力狀態下接上。調整的手段主要是改變扣索或背拉索的長度與拉力：放鬆扣索使半拱繞拱腳轉動，端點下降並向中央移動；收緊則相反。
knowledge.textEn: Before closure the two tips must approach design values in level, plan position and rotation simultaneously, or the closure segment cannot be fitted stress-free. Adjustment works mainly by changing tieback or backstay length and force: slackening a tieback rotates the half-arch about its foot, lowering the tip and moving it toward mid-span, and tightening does the reverse.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：端點高程對齊就代表可以合龍，轉角與平面位置不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once tip levels match, closure can proceed; rotation and plan position do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「合龍前的線形調整」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Geometry adjustment before closure" is correct?
options: 端點高程對齊就代表可以合龍，轉角與平面位置不重要。
合龍可以在任何時間進行，只要工人準備好就能鎖定。
合龍前兩個半拱端點的高程、平面位置與轉角必須同時接近設計值，否則合龍段無法在無應力狀態下接上。
optionsEn: Once tip levels match, closure can proceed; rotation and plan position do not matter.
Closure can happen at any time as long as the crew is ready to lock it.
Before closure the two tips must approach design values in level, plan position and rotation simultaneously, or the closure segment cannot be fitted stress-free.
quiz.explanation: 合龍前兩個半拱端點的高程、平面位置與轉角必須同時接近設計值，否則合龍段無法在無應力狀態下接上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before closure the two tips must approach design values in level, plan position and rotation simultaneously, or the closure segment cannot be fitted stress-free. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 合龍前的線形調整：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Geometry adjustment before closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「扣索調整千斤頂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tieback adjusting jacks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設某扣索每改變 1 MN，端點高程改變 s = 12 mm/MN。若端點需抬高 60 mm，所需扣索力增量 ΔT = 60/12 = 5 MN；若同時需要平面修正，以 2×2 影響係數矩陣聯立兩根扣索的調整量。影響係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Suppose one tieback moves the tip level by s = 12 mm per MN. Raising the tip 60 mm needs ΔT = 60/12 = 5 MN; if plan correction is also needed, a 2×2 influence-coefficient matrix solves the adjustments of two tiebacks together. The influence coefficient is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以小幅試調整量測實際影響係數，與分析值比較並修正矩陣；每次調整後在相同溫度條件下量測端點座標與扣索力，確認收斂；最終位置需同時符合高程、平面與轉角的允差，才進入合龍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure actual influence coefficients with small trial adjustments, compare with analysis and update the matrix; after each adjustment survey tip coordinates and tieback forces at the same thermal condition to confirm convergence; proceed to closure only when level, plan and rotation are all within tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 設某扣索每改變 1 MN，端點高程改變 s = 12 mm/MN。若端點需抬高 60 mm，所需扣索力增量 ΔT = 60/12 = 5 MN；若同時需要平面修正，以 2×2 影響係數矩陣聯立兩根扣索的調整量。影響係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Suppose one tieback moves the tip level by s = 12 mm per MN. Raising the tip 60 mm needs ΔT = 60/12 = 5 MN; if plan correction is also needed, a 2×2 influence-coefficient matrix solves the adjustments of two tiebacks together. The influence coefficient is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「合龍前的線形調整」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Geometry adjustment before closure", which statement holds?
options: 設某扣索每改變 1 MN，端點高程改變 s = 12 mm/MN。
拱只要外觀看起來對稱平順，就代表合龍成功。
合龍完成、橋梁通車後，施工階段的量測資料就沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: Suppose one tieback moves the tip level by s = 12 mm per MN.
If the arch looks symmetrical and smooth, closure was successful.
Once closure is complete and the bridge opens, construction-stage measurements are no longer worth keeping.
quiz.explanation: 設某扣索每改變 1 MN，端點高程改變 s = 12 mm/MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Suppose one tieback moves the tip level by s = 12 mm per MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 合龍前的線形調整：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Geometry adjustment before closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「扣索調整千斤頂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tieback adjusting jacks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以小幅試調整量測實際影響係數，與分析值比較並修正矩陣；每次調整後在相同溫度條件下量測端點座標與扣索力，確認收斂；最終位置需同時符合高程、平面與轉角的允差，才進入合龍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure actual influence coefficients with small trial adjustments, compare with analysis and update the matrix; after each adjustment survey tip coordinates and tieback forces at the same thermal condition to confirm convergence; proceed to closure only when level, plan and rotation are all within tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調整程序應以影響係數矩陣為依據，規定每次調整的最大增量、同步要求與量測時機；千斤頂操作由專人指揮並有雙向通訊，任一扣索力或端點位移超出預警即停止，由監控小組與設計代表共同決定下一步。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The adjustment procedure should be based on the influence matrix and set maximum increments, synchronisation and survey timing; jack operation needs a single commander with two-way communication, and any tieback force or tip movement beyond alert values stops work until the monitoring team and designer decide the next step.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只調整高程而忽略轉角，兩端看似對齊，接上後合龍段內卻產生很大的彎矩；千斤頂不同步或單側過量放索，使拱肋扭轉、側向失穩，甚至造成扣索過載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adjusting level alone while ignoring rotation can make the tips look aligned yet lock large moments into the closure segment; unsynchronised jacks or over-release on one side twist the rib, threaten lateral stability or overload tiebacks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Geometry adjustment before closure"?

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合龍前的線形調整：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Geometry adjustment before closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「扣索調整千斤頂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tieback adjusting jacks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只調整高程而忽略轉角，兩端看似對齊，接上後合龍段內卻產生很大的彎矩；千斤頂不同步或單側過量放索，使拱肋扭轉、側向失穩，甚至造成扣索過載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adjusting level alone while ignoring rotation can make the tips look aligned yet lock large moments into the closure segment; unsynchronised jacks or over-release on one side twist the rib, threaten lateral stability or overload tiebacks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實務上常建立影響係數矩陣，描述每根扣索變化對各端點座標的影響，再解出所需的調整量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In practice an influence-coefficient matrix describes how each tieback change moves each tip coordinate, and the required adjustments are solved from it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「端點高程對齊就代表可以合龍，轉角與平面位置不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once tip levels match, closure can proceed; rotation and plan position do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只調整高程而忽略轉角，兩端看似對齊，接上後合龍段內卻產生很大的彎矩；千斤頂不同步或單側過量放索，使拱肋扭轉、側向失穩，甚至造成扣索過載。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合龍前的線形調整」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Geometry adjustment before closure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
合龍可以在任何時間進行，只要工人準備好就能鎖定。
若只調整高程而忽略轉角，兩端看似對齊，接上後合龍段內卻產生很大的彎矩；千斤頂不同步或單側過量放索，使拱肋扭轉、側向失穩，甚至造成扣索過載。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Closure can happen at any time as long as the crew is ready to lock it.
Adjusting level alone while ignoring rotation can make the tips look aligned yet lock large moments into the closure segment.
quiz.explanation: 若只調整高程而忽略轉角，兩端看似對齊，接上後合龍段內卻產生很大的彎矩；千斤頂不同步或單側過量放索，使拱肋扭轉、側向失穩，甚至造成扣索過載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adjusting level alone while ignoring rotation can make the tips look aligned yet lock large moments into the closure segment; unsynchronised jacks or over-release on one side twist the rib, threaten lateral stability or overload tiebacks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 合龍時機與臨時鎖定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure timing and temporary locking: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「合龍時段與臨時鎖定」如何影響鋼拱橋拱肋合龍的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure window and temporary locking” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel arch rib closure”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 因為間隙隨溫度持續變化，合龍通常選在溫度最穩定的時段，例如日出前後或陰天夜間，並先以臨時鎖定裝置（剛性連接件、臨時銷或楔塊）把兩端固定在一起，再進行正式的螺栓或焊接。鎖定的那一刻定義了拱的合龍溫度：之後的溫度變化都會以這個狀態為零點，在雙鉸或無鉸拱中產生溫度內力。若鎖定得太晚，溫度已經開始上升，鎖定裝置在固定過程中就承受力量，焊接中的接頭甚至可能被拉裂。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「合龍時段與臨時鎖定」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Because the gap keeps changing with temperature, closure is usually timed for the most stable period, such as around dawn or on overcast nights, and the two ends are first fixed by temporary locking devices (rigid links, temporary pins or wedges) before final bolting or welding. The moment of locking defines the arch's closure temperature: every later temperature change counts from this zero state and produces thermal forces in two-hinged or fixed arches. Locking too late, as temperatures begin to climb, loads the devices while they are being fixed and can even crack a joint mid-weld. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Closure window and temporary locking” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：日溫差振幅 8 °C 的正弦變化，最大變化率 dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a sinusoidal daily swing of amplitude 8 °C, the peak rate is dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「合龍可以在任何時間進行，只要工人準備好就能鎖定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Closure can happen at any time as long as the crew is ready to lock it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「合龍時段與臨時鎖定」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Closure window and temporary locking”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Because the gap keeps changing with temperature, closure is usually timed for the most stable period, such as around dawn or on overcast nights, and the two ends are first fixed by temporary locking devices (rigid links, temporary pins or wedges) before final bolting or welding. The moment of locking defines the arch's closure temperature: every later temperature change counts from this zero state and produces thermal forces in two-hinged or fixed arches.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：合龍可以在任何時間進行，只要工人準備好就能鎖定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Closure can happen at any time as long as the crew is ready to lock it. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「合龍時機與臨時鎖定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closure timing and temporary locking" is correct?
options: 因為間隙隨溫度持續變化，合龍通常選在溫度最穩定的時段，例如日出前後或陰天夜間，並先以臨時鎖定裝置（剛性連接件、臨時銷或楔塊）把兩端固定在一起，再進行正式的螺栓或焊接。
合龍可以在任何時間進行，只要工人準備好就能鎖定。
合龍接上之後，扣索可以一次全部拆除，拱會自動承受全部荷載。
optionsEn: Because the gap keeps changing with temperature, closure is usually timed for the most stable period, such as around dawn or on overcast nights, and the two ends are first fixed by temporary locking devices (rigid links, temporary pins or wedges) before final bolting or welding.
Closure can happen at any time as long as the crew is ready to lock it.
Once the crown is joined, all tiebacks can be removed at once and the arch will simply take the full load.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 合龍時機與臨時鎖定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closure timing and temporary locking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「合龍時段與臨時鎖定」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure window and temporary locking” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：日溫差振幅 8 °C 的正弦變化，最大變化率 dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h。兩半拱合計 320 m，間隙變化率 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×2.09 ≈ 8.0 mm/h；若鎖定允許間隙變化 3 mm，在變化最快時只有約 22 分鐘，而在溫度轉折點附近時間窗口長得多。溫度振幅為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a sinusoidal daily swing of amplitude 8 °C, the peak rate is dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h. With 320 m of arc in the two halves, the gap changes at 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×2.09 ≈ 8.0 mm/h; if locking tolerates 3 mm of change, only about 22 minutes are available at the fastest rate, while near the temperature turning point the window is much longer. The amplitude is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：合龍當天以即時監測確認鋼溫、間隙與端點位置都在預定範圍，鎖定裝置就位後量測其受力或變形；鎖定完成時記錄的平均鋼溫即為合龍溫度，正式接合過程中持續監控，確認鎖定裝置受力不超過設計值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On closure day confirm steel temperature, gap and tip positions are within planned ranges by real-time monitoring, then measure force or deformation in the locking devices once placed; the average steel temperature at locking becomes the closure temperature, and monitoring continues during final connection to confirm device forces stay within design values.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 日溫差振幅 8 °C 的正弦變化，最大變化率 dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h。兩半拱合計 320 m，間隙變化率 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×2.09 ≈ 8.0 mm/h；若鎖定允許間隙變化 3 mm，在變化最快時只有約 22 分鐘，而在溫度轉折點附近時間窗口長得多。溫度振幅為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a sinusoidal daily swing of amplitude 8 °C, the peak rate is dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h. With 320 m of arc in the two halves, the gap changes at 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×2.09 ≈ 8.0 mm/h; if locking tolerates 3 mm of change, only about 22 minutes are available at the fastest rate, while near the temperature turning point the window is much longer. The amplitude is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「合龍時機與臨時鎖定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Closure timing and temporary locking", which statement holds?
options: 螺栓孔對不上時，用千斤頂強行對位是正常的施工手段，不需要通報設計者。
日溫差振幅 8 °C 的正弦變化，最大變化率 dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h。
鋼拱在架設過程中一直都是拱，構件受力和完工後一樣。
optionsEn: Jacking ends into position when bolt holes do not align is routine and need not be reported to the designer.
For a sinusoidal daily swing of amplitude 8 °C, the peak rate is dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h.
A steel arch behaves as an arch throughout erection, so members carry the same forces as in service.
quiz.explanation: 日溫差振幅 8 °C 的正弦變化，最大變化率 dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a sinusoidal daily swing of amplitude 8 °C, the peak rate is dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 合龍時機與臨時鎖定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closure timing and temporary locking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「合龍時段與臨時鎖定」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closure window and temporary locking” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 合龍當天以即時監測確認鋼溫、間隙與端點位置都在預定範圍，鎖定裝置就位後量測其受力或變形；鎖定完成時記錄的平均鋼溫即為合龍溫度，正式接合過程中持續監控，確認鎖定裝置受力不超過設計值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On closure day confirm steel temperature, gap and tip positions are within planned ranges by real-time monitoring, then measure force or deformation in the locking devices once placed; the average steel temperature at locking becomes the closure temperature, and monitoring continues during final connection to confirm device forces stay within design values. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合龍程序應明訂可接受的合龍溫度範圍、鎖定的開始與完成條件、鎖定裝置的設計力與監測方法，以及溫度超出範圍時的延後決策權；合龍溫度與時間寫入正式紀錄並由設計代表簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The closure procedure should define the acceptable closure-temperature range, start and completion conditions for locking, locking-device design forces and monitoring, and who decides to postpone if temperatures leave the range; closure temperature and time go into the formal record signed by the designer's representative.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若因工期壓力在溫度快速上升時鎖定，鎖定裝置承受的力超過設計值而變形或破壞，兩端回彈；合龍溫度未記錄或與設計假設差異很大時，日後的溫度內力計算失去基準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Locking under schedule pressure while temperatures rise fast can overload, deform or break the devices and let the ends spring apart; an unrecorded closure temperature, or one far from the design assumption, leaves later thermal-force calculations without a baseline. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 合龍當天以即時監測確認鋼溫、間隙與端點位置都在預定範圍，鎖定裝置就位後量測其受力或變形；鎖定完成時記錄的平均鋼溫即為合龍溫度，正式接合過程中持續監控，確認鎖定裝置受力不超過設計值。
knowledge.textEn: On closure day confirm steel temperature, gap and tip positions are within planned ranges by real-time monitoring, then measure force or deformation in the locking devices once placed; the average steel temperature at locking becomes the closure temperature, and monitoring continues during final connection to confirm device forces stay within design values.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合龍程序應明訂可接受的合龍溫度範圍、鎖定的開始與完成條件、鎖定裝置的設計力與監測方法，以及溫度超出範圍時的延後決策權；合龍溫度與時間寫入正式紀錄並由設計代表簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The closure procedure should define the acceptable closure-temperature range, start and completion conditions for locking, locking-device design forces and monitoring, and who decides to postpone if temperatures leave the range; closure temperature and time go into the formal record signed by the designer's representative.

quiz.question: 要驗證「合龍時機與臨時鎖定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closure timing and temporary locking"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
合龍段只要尺寸大致吻合，用螺栓強行鎖緊就能達到設計狀態。
合龍當天以即時監測確認鋼溫、間隙與端點位置都在預定範圍，鎖定裝置就位後量測其受力或變形。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
If the closure piece roughly fits, forcing the bolts tight achieves the design state.
On closure day confirm steel temperature, gap and tip positions are within planned ranges by real-time monitoring, then measure force or deformation in the locking devices once placed.
quiz.explanation: 合龍當天以即時監測確認鋼溫、間隙與端點位置都在預定範圍，鎖定裝置就位後量測其受力或變形；鎖定完成時記錄的平均鋼溫即為合龍溫度，正式接合過程中持續監控，確認鎖定裝置受力不超過設計值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On closure day confirm steel temperature, gap and tip positions are within planned ranges by real-time monitoring, then measure force or deformation in the locking devices once placed; the average steel temperature at locking becomes the closure temperature, and monitoring continues during final connection to confirm device forces stay within design values. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合龍時機與臨時鎖定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closure timing and temporary locking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「合龍時段與臨時鎖定」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closure window and temporary locking” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若因工期壓力在溫度快速上升時鎖定，鎖定裝置承受的力超過設計值而變形或破壞，兩端回彈；合龍溫度未記錄或與設計假設差異很大時，日後的溫度內力計算失去基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Locking under schedule pressure while temperatures rise fast can overload, deform or break the devices and let the ends spring apart; an unrecorded closure temperature, or one far from the design assumption, leaves later thermal-force calculations without a baseline. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若鎖定得太晚，溫度已經開始上升，鎖定裝置在固定過程中就承受力量，焊接中的接頭甚至可能被拉裂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Locking too late, as temperatures begin to climb, loads the devices while they are being fixed and can even crack a joint mid-weld.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「合龍可以在任何時間進行，只要工人準備好就能鎖定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Closure can happen at any time as long as the crew is ready to lock it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若因工期壓力在溫度快速上升時鎖定，鎖定裝置承受的力超過設計值而變形或破壞，兩端回彈；合龍溫度未記錄或與設計假設差異很大時，日後的溫度內力計算失去基準。
knowledge.textEn: Locking under schedule pressure while temperatures rise fast can overload, deform or break the devices and let the ends spring apart; an unrecorded closure temperature, or one far from the design assumption, leaves later thermal-force calculations without a baseline.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合龍時機與臨時鎖定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closure timing and temporary locking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若因工期壓力在溫度快速上升時鎖定，鎖定裝置承受的力超過設計值而變形或破壞，兩端回彈；合龍溫度未記錄或與設計假設差異很大時，日後的溫度內力計算失去基準。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
合龍接上之後，扣索可以一次全部拆除，拱會自動承受全部荷載。
optionsEn: Locking under schedule pressure while temperatures rise fast can overload, deform or break the devices and let the ends spring apart.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Once the crown is joined, all tiebacks can be removed at once and the arch will simply take the full load.
quiz.explanation: 若因工期壓力在溫度快速上升時鎖定，鎖定裝置承受的力超過設計值而變形或破壞，兩端回彈；合龍溫度未記錄或與設計假設差異很大時，日後的溫度內力計算失去基準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Locking under schedule pressure while temperatures rise fast can overload, deform or break the devices and let the ends spring apart; an unrecorded closure temperature, or one far from the design assumption, leaves later thermal-force calculations without a baseline. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「體系轉換與扣索卸載監測」與「合龍後驗收：線形與應力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "System transfer and tieback release monitoring" and "Post-closure acceptance: geometry and stress": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 體系轉換與扣索卸載監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: System transfer and tieback release monitoring: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「扣索卸載監測」如何影響鋼拱橋拱肋合龍的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tieback release monitoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel arch rib closure”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 合龍完成後，拱已經能互相頂住，但扣索仍然拉著半拱；接著要分階段放鬆扣索，讓荷載逐步轉移到拱體系，拱腳推力由零增加到設計值。雪梨港灣大橋在拱頂鉚接完成後才拆除錨索，新河峽大橋則以千斤頂控制下放過程。卸載的關鍵是對稱、分級與量測：兩側扣索要同步放鬆，避免拱受到不對稱的力；每一級都要量測拱頂高程、拱腳推力或應變與扣索殘餘力，確認結構反應與分析一致，才能進入下一級。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「扣索卸載監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After closure the two halves bear on each other, but the tiebacks still hold the half-arches; they are then released in stages so load transfers progressively to the arch and springing thrust rises from zero to its design value. Sydney Harbour Bridge removed its anchor cables only after the crown was riveted, and New River Gorge Bridge controlled the lowering with jacks. Release depends on symmetry, staging and measurement: tiebacks on both sides slacken together to avoid unbalanced forces, and at each stage crown level, springing thrust or strain and residual tieback force are measured to confirm agreement with analysis before the next stage. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tieback release monitoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若推力 H ≈ 28 MN 分 4 級轉移，每級增加約 7 MN；某弦桿面積 A = 0.25 m²，每級應力增量 Δσ = 7×10⁶/0.25 = 28 MPa，對應應變 Δε = 28/200,000 = 140 με，可由應變計清楚量到。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If a thrust of about 28 MN is transferred in 4 stages, each adds about 7 MN; for a chord with A = 0.25 m² the stress rises by Δσ = 7×10⁶/0.25 = 28 MPa per stage, a strain of Δε = 28/200,000 = 140 με that strain gauges can clearly detect.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「合龍接上之後，扣索可以一次全部拆除，拱會自動承受全部荷載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the crown is joined, all tiebacks can be removed at once and the arch will simply take the full load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「扣索卸載監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tieback release monitoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 體系轉換與扣索卸載監測
knowledge.titleEn: System transfer and tieback release monitoring
knowledge.text: 合龍完成後，拱已經能互相頂住，但扣索仍然拉著半拱；接著要分階段放鬆扣索，讓荷載逐步轉移到拱體系，拱腳推力由零增加到設計值。雪梨港灣大橋在拱頂鉚接完成後才拆除錨索，新河峽大橋則以千斤頂控制下放過程。
knowledge.textEn: After closure the two halves bear on each other, but the tiebacks still hold the half-arches; they are then released in stages so load transfers progressively to the arch and springing thrust rises from zero to its design value. Sydney Harbour Bridge removed its anchor cables only after the crown was riveted, and New River Gorge Bridge controlled the lowering with jacks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：合龍接上之後，扣索可以一次全部拆除，拱會自動承受全部荷載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the crown is joined, all tiebacks can be removed at once and the arch will simply take the full load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「體系轉換與扣索卸載監測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System transfer and tieback release monitoring" is correct?
options: 合龍接上之後，扣索可以一次全部拆除，拱會自動承受全部荷載。
合龍完成後，拱已經能互相頂住，但扣索仍然拉著半拱；接著要分階段放鬆扣索，讓荷載逐步轉移到拱體系，拱腳推力由零增加到設計值。
拱只要外觀看起來對稱平順，就代表合龍成功。
optionsEn: Once the crown is joined, all tiebacks can be removed at once and the arch will simply take the full load.
After closure the two halves bear on each other, but the tiebacks still hold the half-arches.
If the arch looks symmetrical and smooth, closure was successful.
quiz.explanation: 合龍完成後，拱已經能互相頂住，但扣索仍然拉著半拱；接著要分階段放鬆扣索，讓荷載逐步轉移到拱體系，拱腳推力由零增加到設計值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After closure the two halves bear on each other, but the tiebacks still hold the half-arches; they are then released in stages so load transfers progressively to the arch and springing thrust rises from zero to its design value. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 體系轉換與扣索卸載監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System transfer and tieback release monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「扣索卸載監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tieback release monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若推力 H ≈ 28 MN 分 4 級轉移，每級增加約 7 MN；某弦桿面積 A = 0.25 m²，每級應力增量 Δσ = 7×10⁶/0.25 = 28 MPa，對應應變 Δε = 28/200,000 = 140 με，可由應變計清楚量到。分級數與面積為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If a thrust of about 28 MN is transferred in 4 stages, each adds about 7 MN; for a chord with A = 0.25 m² the stress rises by Δσ = 7×10⁶/0.25 = 28 MPa per stage, a strain of Δε = 28/200,000 = 140 με that strain gauges can clearly detect. Stage count and area are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在拱腳、四分點與拱頂的弦桿裝設應變計，扣索端以測力計或油壓量測殘餘力，拱頂以全站儀量測高程；每級卸載後比較實測與預測的應變、高程與扣索力，差異在允差內才繼續，所有資料同步記錄溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit strain gauges to chords at the springings, quarter points and crown, measure residual tieback force by load cells or jack pressure, and survey crown level by total station; after each stage compare measured strains, levels and forces with predictions and proceed only within tolerance, logging temperature with all data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若推力 H ≈ 28 MN 分 4 級轉移，每級增加約 7 MN；某弦桿面積 A = 0.25 m²，每級應力增量 Δσ = 7×10⁶/0.25 = 28 MPa，對應應變 Δε = 28/200,000 = 140 με，可由應變計清楚量到。分級數與面積為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If a thrust of about 28 MN is transferred in 4 stages, each adds about 7 MN; for a chord with A = 0.25 m² the stress rises by Δσ = 7×10⁶/0.25 = 28 MPa per stage, a strain of Δε = 28/200,000 = 140 με that strain gauges can clearly detect. Stage count and area are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「體系轉換與扣索卸載監測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System transfer and tieback release monitoring", which statement holds?
options: 合龍完成、橋梁通車後，施工階段的量測資料就沒有保存價值。
扣索只要強度夠就好，它的伸長量不會影響拱的線形。
若推力 H ≈ 28 MN 分 4 級轉移，每級增加約 7 MN。
optionsEn: Once closure is complete and the bridge opens, construction-stage measurements are no longer worth keeping.
Tiebacks only need enough strength; their stretch does not affect the arch geometry.
If a thrust of about 28 MN is transferred in 4 stages, each adds about 7 MN.
quiz.explanation: 若推力 H ≈ 28 MN 分 4 級轉移，每級增加約 7 MN；某弦桿面積 A = 0.25 m²，每級應力增量 Δσ = 7×10⁶/0.25 = 28 MPa，對應應變 Δε = 28/200,000 = 140 με，可由應變計清楚量到。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If a thrust of about 28 MN is transferred in 4 stages, each adds about 7 MN; for a chord with A = 0.25 m² the stress rises by Δσ = 7×10⁶/0.25 = 28 MPa per stage, a strain of Δε = 28/200,000 = 140 με that strain gauges can clearly detect. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 體系轉換與扣索卸載監測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: System transfer and tieback release monitoring: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「扣索卸載監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tieback release monitoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在拱腳、四分點與拱頂的弦桿裝設應變計，扣索端以測力計或油壓量測殘餘力，拱頂以全站儀量測高程；每級卸載後比較實測與預測的應變、高程與扣索力，差異在允差內才繼續，所有資料同步記錄溫度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit strain gauges to chords at the springings, quarter points and crown, measure residual tieback force by load cells or jack pressure, and survey crown level by total station; after each stage compare measured strains, levels and forces with predictions and proceed only within tolerance, logging temperature with all data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：卸載程序應以表格列出每級的扣索放鬆量、預期的應變、高程與扣索力及允差，指定量測人員與判讀責任；任一指標超出預警值即停止並回到上一級穩定狀態，由設計者決定處置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The release procedure should tabulate tieback slackening, expected strains, levels and forces with tolerances for each stage, naming who measures and who interprets; any indicator beyond its alert value stops work and returns to the previous stable stage while the designer decides.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若一次大量放鬆或兩側不同步，拱體系瞬間承受不對稱荷載，可能造成拱腳支承或某些弦桿過載；量測資料未即時判讀時，異常反應在多級卸載後才被發現，已難以回復。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Releasing a large amount at once or unevenly between sides suddenly loads the arch unsymmetrically and can overload springing bearings or some chords; if data are not interpreted in real time, abnormal response is noticed only several stages later, when it is hard to reverse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在拱腳、四分點與拱頂的弦桿裝設應變計，扣索端以測力計或油壓量測殘餘力，拱頂以全站儀量測高程；每級卸載後比較實測與預測的應變、高程與扣索力，差異在允差內才繼續，所有資料同步記錄溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Fit strain gauges to chords at the springings, quarter points and crown, measure residual tieback force by load cells or jack pressure, and survey crown level by total station; after each stage compare measured strains, levels and forces with predictions and proceed only within tolerance, logging temperature with all data.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 卸載程序應以表格列出每級的扣索放鬆量、預期的應變、高程與扣索力及允差，指定量測人員與判讀責任；任一指標超出預警值即停止並回到上一級穩定狀態，由設計者決定處置。
knowledge.textEn: The release procedure should tabulate tieback slackening, expected strains, levels and forces with tolerances for each stage, naming who measures and who interprets; any indicator beyond its alert value stops work and returns to the previous stable stage while the designer decides.

quiz.question: 要驗證「體系轉換與扣索卸載監測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System transfer and tieback release monitoring"?
options: 在拱腳、四分點與拱頂的弦桿裝設應變計，扣索端以測力計或油壓量測殘餘力，拱頂以全站儀量測高程。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要量氣溫就能代表拱肋的溫度狀態。
optionsEn: Fit strain gauges to chords at the springings, quarter points and crown, measure residual tieback force by load cells or jack pressure, and survey crown level by total station.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Air temperature alone represents the thermal state of the arch ribs.
quiz.explanation: 在拱腳、四分點與拱頂的弦桿裝設應變計，扣索端以測力計或油壓量測殘餘力，拱頂以全站儀量測高程；每級卸載後比較實測與預測的應變、高程與扣索力，差異在允差內才繼續，所有資料同步記錄溫度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit strain gauges to chords at the springings, quarter points and crown, measure residual tieback force by load cells or jack pressure, and survey crown level by total station; after each stage compare measured strains, levels and forces with predictions and proceed only within tolerance, logging temperature with all data. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 體系轉換與扣索卸載監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System transfer and tieback release monitoring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「扣索卸載監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tieback release monitoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若一次大量放鬆或兩側不同步，拱體系瞬間承受不對稱荷載，可能造成拱腳支承或某些弦桿過載；量測資料未即時判讀時，異常反應在多級卸載後才被發現，已難以回復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Releasing a large amount at once or unevenly between sides suddenly loads the arch unsymmetrically and can overload springing bearings or some chords; if data are not interpreted in real time, abnormal response is noticed only several stages later, when it is hard to reverse. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：卸載的關鍵是對稱、分級與量測：兩側扣索要同步放鬆，避免拱受到不對稱的力；每一級都要量測拱頂高程、拱腳推力或應變與扣索殘餘力，確認結構反應與分析一致，才能進入下一級。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Release depends on symmetry, staging and measurement: tiebacks on both sides slacken together to avoid unbalanced forces, and at each stage crown level, springing thrust or strain and residual tieback force are measured to confirm agreement with analysis before the next stage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「合龍接上之後，扣索可以一次全部拆除，拱會自動承受全部荷載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the crown is joined, all tiebacks can be removed at once and the arch will simply take the full load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若一次大量放鬆或兩側不同步，拱體系瞬間承受不對稱荷載，可能造成拱腳支承或某些弦桿過載；量測資料未即時判讀時，異常反應在多級卸載後才被發現，已難以回復。
knowledge.textEn: Releasing a large amount at once or unevenly between sides suddenly loads the arch unsymmetrically and can overload springing bearings or some chords; if data are not interpreted in real time, abnormal response is noticed only several stages later, when it is hard to reverse.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「體系轉換與扣索卸載監測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System transfer and tieback release monitoring" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若一次大量放鬆或兩側不同步，拱體系瞬間承受不對稱荷載，可能造成拱腳支承或某些弦桿過載；量測資料未即時判讀時，異常反應在多級卸載後才被發現，已難以回復。
拱只要外觀看起來對稱平順，就代表合龍成功。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Releasing a large amount at once or unevenly between sides suddenly loads the arch unsymmetrically and can overload springing bearings or some chords.
If the arch looks symmetrical and smooth, closure was successful.
quiz.explanation: 若一次大量放鬆或兩側不同步，拱體系瞬間承受不對稱荷載，可能造成拱腳支承或某些弦桿過載；量測資料未即時判讀時，異常反應在多級卸載後才被發現，已難以回復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Releasing a large amount at once or unevenly between sides suddenly loads the arch unsymmetrically and can overload springing bearings or some chords; if data are not interpreted in real time, abnormal response is noticed only several stages later, when it is hard to reverse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 合龍後驗收：線形與應力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-closure acceptance: geometry and stress: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「拱軸線形驗收」如何影響鋼拱橋拱肋合龍的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arch axis acceptance” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel arch rib closure”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 合龍與卸載完成後，要以量測證明拱達到設計的成橋狀態：拱軸線形（高程與平面）在允差內，各主要桿件應力與分析預測一致，拱腳推力與支承反力合理，扣索已完全卸載。拱軸偏差會在成拱後轉為附加彎矩，因為軸壓作用在偏心的位置；應力偏差則可能代表合龍時鎖入了非預期的內力。驗收結果同時是日後監測的零點，所有量測都要換算到參考溫度並記錄當時狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「拱軸線形驗收」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After closure and release, measurements must prove the arch has reached its design completed state: arch axis (level and plan) within tolerance, main member stresses consistent with analysis, reasonable springing thrust and bearing reactions, and tiebacks fully released. Axis deviation turns into extra bending once the arch carries load, because axial compression acts eccentrically; stress deviations may indicate unexpected forces locked in at closure. The acceptance results are also the zero point for later monitoring, so every measurement is corrected to a reference temperature and the state at the time recorded. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Arch axis acceptance” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學允差取拱軸高程偏差 ≤ L/5,000：L = 300 m 時為 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take a teaching tolerance of L/5,000 on arch-axis level: for L = 300 m that is 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拱只要外觀看起來對稱平順，就代表合龍成功。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the arch looks symmetrical and smooth, closure was successful." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「拱軸線形驗收」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Arch axis acceptance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 合龍後驗收：線形與應力
knowledge.text: 合龍與卸載完成後，要以量測證明拱達到設計的成橋狀態：拱軸線形（高程與平面）在允差內，各主要桿件應力與分析預測一致，拱腳推力與支承反力合理，扣索已完全卸載。拱軸偏差會在成拱後轉為附加彎矩，因為軸壓作用在偏心的位置；應力偏差則可能代表合龍時鎖入了非預期的內力。
knowledge.textEn: After closure and release, measurements must prove the arch has reached its design completed state: arch axis (level and plan) within tolerance, main member stresses consistent with analysis, reasonable springing thrust and bearing reactions, and tiebacks fully released. Axis deviation turns into extra bending once the arch carries load, because axial compression acts eccentrically; stress deviations may indicate unexpected forces locked in at closure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拱只要外觀看起來對稱平順，就代表合龍成功。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the arch looks symmetrical and smooth, closure was successful. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「合龍後驗收：線形與應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-closure acceptance: geometry and stress" is correct?
options: 拱只要外觀看起來對稱平順，就代表合龍成功。
螺栓孔對不上時，用千斤頂強行對位是正常的施工手段，不需要通報設計者。
合龍與卸載完成後，要以量測證明拱達到設計的成橋狀態：拱軸線形（高程與平面）在允差內，各主要桿件應力與分析預測一致，拱腳推力與支承反力合理，扣索已完全卸載。
optionsEn: If the arch looks symmetrical and smooth, closure was successful.
Jacking ends into position when bolt holes do not align is routine and need not be reported to the designer.

After closure and release, measurements must prove the arch has reached its design completed state: arch axis (level and plan) within tolerance, main member stresses consistent with analysis, reasonable springing thrust and bearing reactions, and tiebacks fully released.
quiz.explanation: 合龍與卸載完成後，要以量測證明拱達到設計的成橋狀態：拱軸線形（高程與平面）在允差內，各主要桿件應力與分析預測一致，拱腳推力與支承反力合理，扣索已完全卸載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After closure and release, measurements must prove the arch has reached its design completed state: arch axis (level and plan) within tolerance, main member stresses consistent with analysis, reasonable springing thrust and bearing reactions, and tiebacks fully released. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 合龍後驗收：線形與應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-closure acceptance: geometry and stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱軸線形驗收」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
