steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arch axis acceptance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學允差取拱軸高程偏差 ≤ L/5,000：L = 300 m 時為 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm。若實測最大偏差 42 mm，在允差內；以推力 28,125 kN 乘偏心 0.042 m，附加彎矩約 1,180 kN·m，需確認在桿件餘裕內。允差與偏差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take a teaching tolerance of L/5,000 on arch-axis level: for L = 300 m that is 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm. A measured maximum deviation of 42 mm is within it; multiplying the 28,125 kN thrust by a 0.042 m eccentricity gives about 1,180 kN·m of extra moment, to be checked against member reserves. Tolerance and deviation are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全站儀或 GNSS 在清晨量測拱軸各控制點並做溫度修正，與設計成橋線形比較；以應變計資料計算主要桿件的累積應力，與施工階段分析的最終狀態比較；必要時以載重試驗確認勁度，結果寫入竣工報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey arch-axis control points at dawn by total station or GNSS with temperature correction and compare with the design completed profile; compute accumulated stresses in main members from strain-gauge data against the final staged-analysis state; if required confirm stiffness by load testing, and record results in the as-built report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學允差取拱軸高程偏差 ≤ L/5,000：L = 300 m 時為 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm。若實測最大偏差 42 mm，在允差內；以推力 28,125 kN 乘偏心 0.042 m，附加彎矩約 1,180 kN·m，需確認在桿件餘裕內。允差與偏差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Take a teaching tolerance of L/5,000 on arch-axis level: for L = 300 m that is 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm. A measured maximum deviation of 42 mm is within it; multiplying the 28,125 kN thrust by a 0.042 m eccentricity gives about 1,180 kN·m of extra moment, to be checked against member reserves. Tolerance and deviation are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「合龍後驗收：線形與應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-closure acceptance: geometry and stress", which statement holds?
options: 鋼拱在架設過程中一直都是拱，構件受力和完工後一樣。
合龍段只要尺寸大致吻合，用螺栓強行鎖緊就能達到設計狀態。
optionsEn: Take a teaching tolerance of L/5,000 on arch-axis level: for L = 300 m that is 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm.
A steel arch behaves as an arch throughout erection, so members carry the same forces as in service.
If the closure piece roughly fits, forcing the bolts tight achieves the design state.
quiz.explanation: 教學允差取拱軸高程偏差 ≤ L/5,000：L = 300 m 時為 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take a teaching tolerance of L/5,000 on arch-axis level: for L = 300 m that is 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 合龍後驗收：線形與應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-closure acceptance: geometry and stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱軸線形驗收」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arch axis acceptance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以全站儀或 GNSS 在清晨量測拱軸各控制點並做溫度修正，與設計成橋線形比較；以應變計資料計算主要桿件的累積應力，與施工階段分析的最終狀態比較；必要時以載重試驗確認勁度，結果寫入竣工報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey arch-axis control points at dawn by total station or GNSS with temperature correction and compare with the design completed profile; compute accumulated stresses in main members from strain-gauge data against the final staged-analysis state; if required confirm stiffness by load testing, and record results in the as-built report. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收準則（線形允差、應力差異上限、扣索殘餘力、支承狀態）應在施工前就寫入規範，由業主、設計與施工三方共同見證量測；驗收報告包含原始資料、溫度修正與判定結論，作為交接文件的核心。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance criteria for geometry tolerance, stress difference limits, residual tieback force and bearing condition should be in the specification before construction, with measurements witnessed jointly by owner, designer and contractor; the acceptance report with raw data, temperature correction and conclusions is the core of the handover file.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若驗收時未做溫度修正，可能把溫度造成的偏差誤判為施工誤差而進行不必要的調整，或反過來把真正的偏差掩蓋；應力資料缺失時，無法知道合龍是否鎖入了額外內力，日後評估只能以假設代替。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without temperature correction, acceptance may mistake thermal deviation for construction error and trigger needless adjustment, or hide a real deviation; missing stress data leave no way of knowing whether closure locked in extra forces, so later assessments must rely on assumptions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全站儀或 GNSS 在清晨量測拱軸各控制點並做溫度修正，與設計成橋線形比較；以應變計資料計算主要桿件的累積應力，與施工階段分析的最終狀態比較；必要時以載重試驗確認勁度，結果寫入竣工報告。
knowledge.textEn: Survey arch-axis control points at dawn by total station or GNSS with temperature correction and compare with the design completed profile; compute accumulated stresses in main members from strain-gauge data against the final staged-analysis state; if required confirm stiffness by load testing, and record results in the as-built report.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 驗收準則（線形允差、應力差異上限、扣索殘餘力、支承狀態）應在施工前就寫入規範，由業主、設計與施工三方共同見證量測；驗收報告包含原始資料、溫度修正與判定結論，作為交接文件的核心。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria for geometry tolerance, stress difference limits, residual tieback force and bearing condition should be in the specification before construction, with measurements witnessed jointly by owner, designer and contractor; the acceptance report with raw data, temperature correction and conclusions is the core of the handover file.

quiz.question: 要驗證「合龍後驗收：線形與應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-closure acceptance: geometry and stress"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以全站儀或 GNSS 在清晨量測拱軸各控制點並做溫度修正，與設計成橋線形比較。
端點高程對齊就代表可以合龍，轉角與平面位置不重要。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Survey arch-axis control points at dawn by total station or GNSS with temperature correction and compare with the design completed profile.
Once tip levels match, closure can proceed; rotation and plan position do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以全站儀或 GNSS 在清晨量測拱軸各控制點並做溫度修正，與設計成橋線形比較；以應變計資料計算主要桿件的累積應力，與施工階段分析的最終狀態比較；必要時以載重試驗確認勁度，結果寫入竣工報告。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey arch-axis control points at dawn by total station or GNSS with temperature correction and compare with the design completed profile; compute accumulated stresses in main members from strain-gauge data against the final staged-analysis state; if required confirm stiffness by load testing, and record results in the as-built report. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合龍後驗收：線形與應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-closure acceptance: geometry and stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱軸線形驗收」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arch axis acceptance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若驗收時未做溫度修正，可能把溫度造成的偏差誤判為施工誤差而進行不必要的調整，或反過來把真正的偏差掩蓋；應力資料缺失時，無法知道合龍是否鎖入了額外內力，日後評估只能以假設代替。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without temperature correction, acceptance may mistake thermal deviation for construction error and trigger needless adjustment, or hide a real deviation; missing stress data leave no way of knowing whether closure locked in extra forces, so later assessments must rely on assumptions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：驗收結果同時是日後監測的零點，所有量測都要換算到參考溫度並記錄當時狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The acceptance results are also the zero point for later monitoring, so every measurement is corrected to a reference temperature and the state at the time recorded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拱只要外觀看起來對稱平順，就代表合龍成功。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the arch looks symmetrical and smooth, closure was successful." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若驗收時未做溫度修正，可能把溫度造成的偏差誤判為施工誤差而進行不必要的調整，或反過來把真正的偏差掩蓋；應力資料缺失時，無法知道合龍是否鎖入了額外內力，日後評估只能以假設代替。
knowledge.textEn: Without temperature correction, acceptance may mistake thermal deviation for construction error and trigger needless adjustment, or hide a real deviation; missing stress data leave no way of knowing whether closure locked in extra forces, so later assessments must rely on assumptions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合龍後驗收：線形與應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-closure acceptance: geometry and stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
螺栓孔對不上時，用千斤頂強行對位是正常的施工手段，不需要通報設計者。
若驗收時未做溫度修正，可能把溫度造成的偏差誤判為施工誤差而進行不必要的調整，或反過來把真正的偏差掩蓋。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Jacking ends into position when bolt holes do not align is routine and need not be reported to the designer.
Without temperature correction, acceptance may mistake thermal deviation for construction error and trigger needless adjustment, or hide a real deviation.
quiz.explanation: 若驗收時未做溫度修正，可能把溫度造成的偏差誤判為施工誤差而進行不必要的調整，或反過來把真正的偏差掩蓋；應力資料缺失時，無法知道合龍是否鎖入了額外內力，日後評估只能以假設代替。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without temperature correction, acceptance may mistake thermal deviation for construction error and trigger needless adjustment, or hide a real deviation; missing stress data leave no way of knowing whether closure locked in extra forces, so later assessments must rely on assumptions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「強迫對位與鎖入應力」與「合龍紀錄、基準與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Forced fit and locked-in stress" and "Closure records, baselines and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 強迫對位與鎖入應力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Forced fit and locked-in stress: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「強迫合龍鎖入力」如何影響鋼拱橋拱肋合龍的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Locked-in force from forced fit” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel arch rib closure”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 當兩端的間隙或高差超出合龍段可調整的範圍，現場常有以千斤頂強行頂開或拉近、讓螺栓孔對上的誘惑。強迫對位等於在拱中施加一個非設計的變形，合龍後這個變形被鎖住，轉為永久的附加推力與彎矩；它不會在外觀上顯現，卻會消耗桿件的承載餘裕，並在溫度與活載疊加時提早使某些桿件達到極限。正確的做法是回到量測與分析：查明偏差來源，以扣索調整、合龍段重新配製或在設計者核准下控制強迫量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「強迫合龍鎖入力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the gap or level difference exceeds what the closure segment can absorb, the temptation on site is to jack the ends apart or together until bolt holes line up. Forcing the fit imposes an undesigned deformation on the arch that is locked in at closure and becomes permanent additional thrust and moment; it cannot be seen, yet it consumes member reserves and brings some members to their limits earlier when temperature and live load add on. The correct course is to return to measurement and analysis: identify the source of the deviation and use tieback adjustment, a remade closure piece or a forcing amount controlled with the designer's approval. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Locked-in force from forced fit” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若拱對拱頂相對水平位移的勁度 k_H = 500 MN/m，強迫拉近 Δ = 20 mm 會鎖入 ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN 的附加推力，約為設計推力 28 MN 的 36%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If the arch's stiffness against relative horizontal movement at the crown is k_H = 500 MN/m, forcing the ends together by Δ = 20 mm locks in ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN of extra thrust, about 36% of a 28 MN design thrust.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「螺栓孔對不上時，用千斤頂強行對位是正常的施工手段，不需要通報設計者。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Jacking ends into position when bolt holes do not align is routine and need not be reported to the designer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「強迫合龍鎖入力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Locked-in force from forced fit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 強迫對位與鎖入應力
knowledge.text: 當兩端的間隙或高差超出合龍段可調整的範圍，現場常有以千斤頂強行頂開或拉近、讓螺栓孔對上的誘惑。強迫對位等於在拱中施加一個非設計的變形，合龍後這個變形被鎖住，轉為永久的附加推力與彎矩；它不會在外觀上顯現，卻會消耗桿件的承載餘裕，並在溫度與活載疊加時提早使某些桿件達到極限。
knowledge.textEn: When the gap or level difference exceeds what the closure segment can absorb, the temptation on site is to jack the ends apart or together until bolt holes line up. Forcing the fit imposes an undesigned deformation on the arch that is locked in at closure and becomes permanent additional thrust and moment; it cannot be seen, yet it consumes member reserves and brings some members to their limits earlier when temperature and live load add on.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：螺栓孔對不上時，用千斤頂強行對位是正常的施工手段，不需要通報設計者。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Jacking ends into position when bolt holes do not align is routine and need not be reported to the designer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「強迫對位與鎖入應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Forced fit and locked-in stress" is correct?
options: 當兩端的間隙或高差超出合龍段可調整的範圍，現場常有以千斤頂強行頂開或拉近、讓螺栓孔對上的誘惑。
螺栓孔對不上時，用千斤頂強行對位是正常的施工手段，不需要通報設計者。
合龍完成、橋梁通車後，施工階段的量測資料就沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: When the gap or level difference exceeds what the closure segment can absorb, the temptation on site is to jack the ends apart or together until bolt holes line up.
Jacking ends into position when bolt holes do not align is routine and need not be reported to the designer.
Once closure is complete and the bridge opens, construction-stage measurements are no longer worth keeping.
quiz.explanation: 當兩端的間隙或高差超出合龍段可調整的範圍，現場常有以千斤頂強行頂開或拉近、讓螺栓孔對上的誘惑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When the gap or level difference exceeds what the closure segment can absorb, the temptation on site is to jack the ends apart or together until bolt holes line up. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 強迫對位與鎖入應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Forced fit and locked-in stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「強迫合龍鎖入力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Locked-in force from forced fit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若拱對拱頂相對水平位移的勁度 k_H = 500 MN/m，強迫拉近 Δ = 20 mm 會鎖入 ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN 的附加推力，約為設計推力 28 MN 的 36%。勁度為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If the arch's stiffness against relative horizontal movement at the crown is k_H = 500 MN/m, forcing the ends together by Δ = 20 mm locks in ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN of extra thrust, about 36% of a 28 MN design thrust. The stiffness is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：合龍前後比較應變計讀數與分析預測，若主要桿件出現與溫度及荷載無法解釋的應力差，即可能有鎖入力；千斤頂強迫對位時須記錄千斤頂力與位移，換算鎖入量並交由設計者檢核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare strain readings before and after closure with predictions; stress differences in main members that temperature and load cannot explain suggest locked-in forces; if jacks force alignment, record jack forces and displacements, convert them to locked-in effects and submit them to the designer for checking.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若拱對拱頂相對水平位移的勁度 k_H = 500 MN/m，強迫拉近 Δ = 20 mm 會鎖入 ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN 的附加推力，約為設計推力 28 MN 的 36%。勁度為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If the arch's stiffness against relative horizontal movement at the crown is k_H = 500 MN/m, forcing the ends together by Δ = 20 mm locks in ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN of extra thrust, about 36% of a 28 MN design thrust. The stiffness is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「強迫對位與鎖入應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Forced fit and locked-in stress", which statement holds?
options: 扣索只要強度夠就好，它的伸長量不會影響拱的線形。
若拱對拱頂相對水平位移的勁度 k_H = 500 MN/m，強迫拉近 Δ = 20 mm 會鎖入 ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN 的附加推力，約為設計推力 28 MN 的 36%。
只要量氣溫就能代表拱肋的溫度狀態。
optionsEn: Tiebacks only need enough strength; their stretch does not affect the arch geometry.

If the arch's stiffness against relative horizontal movement at the crown is k_H = 500 MN/m, forcing the ends together by Δ = 20 mm locks in ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN of extra thrust, about 36% of a 28 MN design thrust.
Air temperature alone represents the thermal state of the arch ribs.
quiz.explanation: 若拱對拱頂相對水平位移的勁度 k_H = 500 MN/m，強迫拉近 Δ = 20 mm 會鎖入 ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN 的附加推力，約為設計推力 28 MN 的 36%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If the arch's stiffness against relative horizontal movement at the crown is k_H = 500 MN/m, forcing the ends together by Δ = 20 mm locks in ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN of extra thrust, about 36% of a 28 MN design thrust. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 強迫對位與鎖入應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Forced fit and locked-in stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「強迫合龍鎖入力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Locked-in force from forced fit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 合龍前後比較應變計讀數與分析預測，若主要桿件出現與溫度及荷載無法解釋的應力差，即可能有鎖入力；千斤頂強迫對位時須記錄千斤頂力與位移，換算鎖入量並交由設計者檢核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare strain readings before and after closure with predictions; stress differences in main members that temperature and load cannot explain suggest locked-in forces; if jacks force alignment, record jack forces and displacements, convert them to locked-in effects and submit them to the designer for checking. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工規範應明訂強迫對位的最大允許量與必須通報的門檻，超過門檻須停止並由設計者評估；所有強迫對位的位置、千斤頂力與位移都記錄在合龍紀錄中，納入竣工資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should set a maximum permitted forcing amount and a reporting threshold, beyond which work stops for the designer's assessment; every forced alignment's location, jack force and displacement is entered in the closure record and the as-built file.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未經檢核的強迫對位使某些弦桿長期處於較高應力，在極端低溫或重載時接近挫屈或連接滑動；若鎖入力未記錄，日後評估與補強都以錯誤的初始狀態計算。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unchecked forced fit leaves some chords permanently at higher stress, close to buckling or joint slip in extreme cold or heavy load; unrecorded locked-in forces mean later assessments and strengthening start from a wrong initial state. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 合龍前後比較應變計讀數與分析預測，若主要桿件出現與溫度及荷載無法解釋的應力差，即可能有鎖入力；千斤頂強迫對位時須記錄千斤頂力與位移，換算鎖入量並交由設計者檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Compare strain readings before and after closure with predictions; stress differences in main members that temperature and load cannot explain suggest locked-in forces; if jacks force alignment, record jack forces and displacements, convert them to locked-in effects and submit them to the designer for checking.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工規範應明訂強迫對位的最大允許量與必須通報的門檻，超過門檻須停止並由設計者評估；所有強迫對位的位置、千斤頂力與位移都記錄在合龍紀錄中，納入竣工資料。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should set a maximum permitted forcing amount and a reporting threshold, beyond which work stops for the designer's assessment; every forced alignment's location, jack force and displacement is entered in the closure record and the as-built file.

quiz.question: 要驗證「強迫對位與鎖入應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Forced fit and locked-in stress"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
合龍可以在任何時間進行，只要工人準備好就能鎖定。
合龍前後比較應變計讀數與分析預測，若主要桿件出現與溫度及荷載無法解釋的應力差，即可能有鎖入力；千斤頂強迫對位時須記錄千斤頂力與位移，換算鎖入量並交由設計者檢核。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Closure can happen at any time as long as the crew is ready to lock it.
Compare strain readings before and after closure with predictions.
quiz.explanation: 合龍前後比較應變計讀數與分析預測，若主要桿件出現與溫度及荷載無法解釋的應力差，即可能有鎖入力；千斤頂強迫對位時須記錄千斤頂力與位移，換算鎖入量並交由設計者檢核。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare strain readings before and after closure with predictions; stress differences in main members that temperature and load cannot explain suggest locked-in forces; if jacks force alignment, record jack forces and displacements, convert them to locked-in effects and submit them to the designer for checking. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 強迫對位與鎖入應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Forced fit and locked-in stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「強迫合龍鎖入力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Locked-in force from forced fit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未經檢核的強迫對位使某些弦桿長期處於較高應力，在極端低溫或重載時接近挫屈或連接滑動；若鎖入力未記錄，日後評估與補強都以錯誤的初始狀態計算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unchecked forced fit leaves some chords permanently at higher stress, close to buckling or joint slip in extreme cold or heavy load; unrecorded locked-in forces mean later assessments and strengthening start from a wrong initial state. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：正確的做法是回到量測與分析：查明偏差來源，以扣索調整、合龍段重新配製或在設計者核准下控制強迫量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The correct course is to return to measurement and analysis: identify the source of the deviation and use tieback adjustment, a remade closure piece or a forcing amount controlled with the designer's approval.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「螺栓孔對不上時，用千斤頂強行對位是正常的施工手段，不需要通報設計者。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Jacking ends into position when bolt holes do not align is routine and need not be reported to the designer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未經檢核的強迫對位使某些弦桿長期處於較高應力，在極端低溫或重載時接近挫屈或連接滑動；若鎖入力未記錄，日後評估與補強都以錯誤的初始狀態計算。
knowledge.textEn: Unchecked forced fit leaves some chords permanently at higher stress, close to buckling or joint slip in extreme cold or heavy load; unrecorded locked-in forces mean later assessments and strengthening start from a wrong initial state.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「強迫對位與鎖入應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Forced fit and locked-in stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未經檢核的強迫對位使某些弦桿長期處於較高應力，在極端低溫或重載時接近挫屈或連接滑動；若鎖入力未記錄，日後評估與補強都以錯誤的初始狀態計算。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
合龍完成、橋梁通車後，施工階段的量測資料就沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: Unchecked forced fit leaves some chords permanently at higher stress, close to buckling or joint slip in extreme cold or heavy load.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once closure is complete and the bridge opens, construction-stage measurements are no longer worth keeping.
quiz.explanation: 未經檢核的強迫對位使某些弦桿長期處於較高應力，在極端低溫或重載時接近挫屈或連接滑動；若鎖入力未記錄，日後評估與補強都以錯誤的初始狀態計算。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unchecked forced fit leaves some chords permanently at higher stress, close to buckling or joint slip in extreme cold or heavy load; unrecorded locked-in forces mean later assessments and strengthening start from a wrong initial state. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 合龍紀錄、基準與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Closure records, baselines and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「合龍紀錄與監測基準」如何影響鋼拱橋拱肋合龍的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure records and monitoring baseline” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel arch rib closure”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 合龍的成果最終要轉成可交接的工程資料：合龍溫度與時間、合龍段的實際尺寸與接合方式、扣索卸載過程的量測、驗收時的線形與應力，以及任何強迫對位或偏差處置。這些資料定義了拱的「零應力狀態」與初始內力，是日後評估溫度內力、補強或更換構件時不可或缺的起點。像新河峽大橋這樣在數十年後仍被詳細記錄於國家史蹟文件中的架設資料，正說明了合龍紀錄對長期管理的價值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「合龍紀錄與監測基準」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The results of closure must finally become handover data: closure temperature and time, actual closure-segment dimensions and connection method, measurements during tieback release, geometry and stresses at acceptance, and any forced alignment or deviation treatment. These records define the arch's stress-free state and initial internal forces, the indispensable starting point for later assessments of thermal forces, strengthening or member replacement. The detailed erection record of New River Gorge Bridge preserved decades later in its National Register documentation shows the long-term management value of closure records. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Closure records and monitoring baseline” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以竣工基準建立拱頂高程—溫度回歸：斜率 4 mm/°C、參考溫度 20 °C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Build a crown level–temperature baseline at completion with a slope of 4 mm/°C and a reference of 20 °C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「合龍完成、橋梁通車後，施工階段的量測資料就沒有保存價值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once closure is complete and the bridge opens, construction-stage measurements are no longer worth keeping." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「合龍紀錄與監測基準」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Closure records and monitoring baseline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 合龍紀錄、基準與交接
knowledge.text: 合龍的成果最終要轉成可交接的工程資料：合龍溫度與時間、合龍段的實際尺寸與接合方式、扣索卸載過程的量測、驗收時的線形與應力，以及任何強迫對位或偏差處置。這些資料定義了拱的「零應力狀態」與初始內力，是日後評估溫度內力、補強或更換構件時不可或缺的起點。
knowledge.textEn: The results of closure must finally become handover data: closure temperature and time, actual closure-segment dimensions and connection method, measurements during tieback release, geometry and stresses at acceptance, and any forced alignment or deviation treatment. These records define the arch's stress-free state and initial internal forces, the indispensable starting point for later assessments of thermal forces, strengthening or member replacement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：合龍完成、橋梁通車後，施工階段的量測資料就沒有保存價值。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once closure is complete and the bridge opens, construction-stage measurements are no longer worth keeping. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「合龍紀錄、基準與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closure records, baselines and handover" is correct?
options: 合龍完成、橋梁通車後，施工階段的量測資料就沒有保存價值。
合龍的成果最終要轉成可交接的工程資料：合龍溫度與時間、合龍段的實際尺寸與接合方式、扣索卸載過程的量測、驗收時的線形與應力，以及任何強迫對位或偏差處置。
鋼拱在架設過程中一直都是拱，構件受力和完工後一樣。
optionsEn: Once closure is complete and the bridge opens, construction-stage measurements are no longer worth keeping.

The results of closure must finally become handover data: closure temperature and time, actual closure-segment dimensions and connection method, measurements during tieback release, geometry and stresses at acceptance, and any forced alignment or deviation treatment.
A steel arch behaves as an arch throughout erection, so members carry the same forces as in service.
quiz.explanation: 合龍的成果最終要轉成可交接的工程資料：合龍溫度與時間、合龍段的實際尺寸與接合方式、扣索卸載過程的量測、驗收時的線形與應力，以及任何強迫對位或偏差處置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The results of closure must finally become handover data: closure temperature and time, actual closure-segment dimensions and connection method, measurements during tieback release, geometry and stresses at acceptance, and any forced alignment or deviation treatment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 合龍紀錄、基準與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closure records, baselines and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「合龍紀錄與監測基準」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure records and monitoring baseline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以竣工基準建立拱頂高程—溫度回歸：斜率 4 mm/°C、參考溫度 20 °C。某年在 25 °C 量測，預期應比基準高 5×4 = 20 mm，實測卻低 10 mm，殘差 −30 mm，超出量測不確定度（約 ±5 mm）甚多，代表可能有拱腳位移或構件變化，需啟動特別檢查。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Build a crown level–temperature baseline at completion with a slope of 4 mm/°C and a reference of 20 °C. A survey at 25 °C should read 5×4 = 20 mm above baseline but reads 10 mm below, a residual of −30 mm, well beyond the measurement uncertainty of about ±5 mm, suggesting springing movement or member change and triggering a special inspection. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前核對紀錄的完整性：每個施工階段的量測、合龍與卸載的原始資料、驗收報告與所有不符合事項的處置；營運單位依基準曲線定期量測並計算殘差，殘差超出門檻時依程序通報與檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover check the records for completeness: measurements at every stage, raw closure and release data, the acceptance report and the disposition of every nonconformance; the operator surveys periodically against the baseline curve, computes residuals and follows the notification and inspection procedure when they exceed thresholds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以竣工基準建立拱頂高程—溫度回歸：斜率 4 mm/°C、參考溫度 20 °C。某年在 25 °C 量測，預期應比基準高 5×4 = 20 mm，實測卻低 10 mm，殘差 −30 mm，超出量測不確定度（約 ±5 mm）甚多，代表可能有拱腳位移或構件變化，需啟動特別檢查。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Build a crown level–temperature baseline at completion with a slope of 4 mm/°C and a reference of 20 °C. A survey at 25 °C should read 5×4 = 20 mm above baseline but reads 10 mm below, a residual of −30 mm, well beyond the measurement uncertainty of about ±5 mm, suggesting springing movement or member change and triggering a special inspection. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「合龍紀錄、基準與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Closure records, baselines and handover", which statement holds?
options: 合龍段只要尺寸大致吻合，用螺栓強行鎖緊就能達到設計狀態。
端點高程對齊就代表可以合龍，轉角與平面位置不重要。
以竣工基準建立拱頂高程—溫度回歸：斜率 4 mm/°C、參考溫度 20 °C。
optionsEn: If the closure piece roughly fits, forcing the bolts tight achieves the design state.
Once tip levels match, closure can proceed; rotation and plan position do not matter.
Build a crown level–temperature baseline at completion with a slope of 4 mm/°C and a reference of 20 °C.
quiz.explanation: 以竣工基準建立拱頂高程—溫度回歸：斜率 4 mm/°C、參考溫度 20 °C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a crown level–temperature baseline at completion with a slope of 4 mm/°C and a reference of 20 °C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 合龍紀錄、基準與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closure records, baselines and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「合龍紀錄與監測基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closure records and monitoring baseline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前核對紀錄的完整性：每個施工階段的量測、合龍與卸載的原始資料、驗收報告與所有不符合事項的處置；營運單位依基準曲線定期量測並計算殘差，殘差超出門檻時依程序通報與檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover check the records for completeness: measurements at every stage, raw closure and release data, the acceptance report and the disposition of every nonconformance; the operator surveys periodically against the baseline curve, computes residuals and follows the notification and inspection procedure when they exceed thresholds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含合龍溫度與時間、合龍段尺寸、扣索卸載紀錄、驗收線形與應力、強迫對位紀錄與基準回歸曲線，並以可長期讀取的格式保存；營運手冊明訂殘差門檻與通報對象，由業主指定專責工程師管理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include closure temperature and time, closure-segment dimensions, release records, acceptance geometry and stresses, forced-fit records and baseline regression curves in a long-term readable format; the operating manual sets residual thresholds and whom to notify, managed by an engineer the owner designates.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若合龍資料散失或只留下摘要，數十年後需要更換構件或補強時，工程師無法得知原始的鎖入力與合龍溫度，只能保守假設而增加成本，或錯誤假設而留下風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If closure data are lost or reduced to summaries, engineers replacing members or strengthening decades later cannot know the original locked-in forces and closure temperature, and must either assume conservatively at extra cost or assume wrongly and leave risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前核對紀錄的完整性：每個施工階段的量測、合龍與卸載的原始資料、驗收報告與所有不符合事項的處置；營運單位依基準曲線定期量測並計算殘差，殘差超出門檻時依程序通報與檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover check the records for completeness: measurements at every stage, raw closure and release data, the acceptance report and the disposition of every nonconformance; the operator surveys periodically against the baseline curve, computes residuals and follows the notification and inspection procedure when they exceed thresholds.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含合龍溫度與時間、合龍段尺寸、扣索卸載紀錄、驗收線形與應力、強迫對位紀錄與基準回歸曲線，並以可長期讀取的格式保存；營運手冊明訂殘差門檻與通報對象，由業主指定專責工程師管理。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include closure temperature and time, closure-segment dimensions, release records, acceptance geometry and stresses, forced-fit records and baseline regression curves in a long-term readable format; the operating manual sets residual thresholds and whom to notify, managed by an engineer the owner designates.

quiz.question: 要驗證「合龍紀錄、基準與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closure records, baselines and handover"?
options: 交接前核對紀錄的完整性：每個施工階段的量測、合龍與卸載的原始資料、驗收報告與所有不符合事項的處置。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
合龍接上之後，扣索可以一次全部拆除，拱會自動承受全部荷載。
optionsEn: Before handover check the records for completeness: measurements at every stage, raw closure and release data, the acceptance report and the disposition of every nonconformance.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Once the crown is joined, all tiebacks can be removed at once and the arch will simply take the full load.
quiz.explanation: 交接前核對紀錄的完整性：每個施工階段的量測、合龍與卸載的原始資料、驗收報告與所有不符合事項的處置；營運單位依基準曲線定期量測並計算殘差，殘差超出門檻時依程序通報與檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover check the records for completeness: measurements at every stage, raw closure and release data, the acceptance report and the disposition of every nonconformance; the operator surveys periodically against the baseline curve, computes residuals and follows the notification and inspection procedure when they exceed thresholds. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合龍紀錄、基準與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closure records, baselines and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「合龍紀錄與監測基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closure records and monitoring baseline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若合龍資料散失或只留下摘要，數十年後需要更換構件或補強時，工程師無法得知原始的鎖入力與合龍溫度，只能保守假設而增加成本，或錯誤假設而留下風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If closure data are lost or reduced to summaries, engineers replacing members or strengthening decades later cannot know the original locked-in forces and closure temperature, and must either assume conservatively at extra cost or assume wrongly and leave risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：像新河峽大橋這樣在數十年後仍被詳細記錄於國家史蹟文件中的架設資料，正說明了合龍紀錄對長期管理的價值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The detailed erection record of New River Gorge Bridge preserved decades later in its National Register documentation shows the long-term management value of closure records.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「合龍完成、橋梁通車後，施工階段的量測資料就沒有保存價值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once closure is complete and the bridge opens, construction-stage measurements are no longer worth keeping." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若合龍資料散失或只留下摘要，數十年後需要更換構件或補強時，工程師無法得知原始的鎖入力與合龍溫度，只能保守假設而增加成本，或錯誤假設而留下風險。
knowledge.textEn: If closure data are lost or reduced to summaries, engineers replacing members or strengthening decades later cannot know the original locked-in forces and closure temperature, and must either assume conservatively at extra cost or assume wrongly and leave risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合龍紀錄、基準與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closure records, baselines and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若合龍資料散失或只留下摘要，數十年後需要更換構件或補強時，工程師無法得知原始的鎖入力與合龍溫度，只能保守假設而增加成本，或錯誤假設而留下風險。
鋼拱在架設過程中一直都是拱，構件受力和完工後一樣。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

If closure data are lost or reduced to summaries, engineers replacing members or strengthening decades later cannot know the original locked-in forces and closure temperature, and must either assume conservatively at extra cost or assume wrongly and leave risk.
A steel arch behaves as an arch throughout erection, so members carry the same forces as in service.
quiz.explanation: 若合龍資料散失或只留下摘要，數十年後需要更換構件或補強時，工程師無法得知原始的鎖入力與合龍溫度，只能保守假設而增加成本，或錯誤假設而留下風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If closure data are lost or reduced to summaries, engineers replacing members or strengthening decades later cannot know the original locked-in forces and closure temperature, and must either assume conservatively at extra cost or assume wrongly and leave risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工
summary: 從懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁出發，計算施工期不平衡荷載與墩頂臨時固結，再處理懸臂鋼腱、節塊接縫、懸臂工作車循環、溫度與潛變造成的線形偏差與跨中閉合，最後以伸長量、測量回饋與長期撓度監測驗證，並以 Bendorf 橋、Stolma 橋與 Koror–Babeldaob 橋的成敗對照。
summaryEn: Starting from cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder, compute construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary pier fixity, then handle cantilever tendons, segment joints, the form-traveler cycle, thermal and creep effects on geometry and the midspan closure, and finally verify with elongations, survey feedback and long-term deflection monitoring, contrasting Bendorf, Stolma and the Koror–Babeldaob bridge.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一座 150 m 主跨的場鑄平衡懸臂箱梁，計算第 10 號節塊端點的澆置預拱。預測各項撓度（向下為負）：本節塊與後續節塊自重 −45 mm、懸臂鋼腱上拱 +20 mm、長期潛變與乾縮 −30 mm、閉合與連續鋼腱 +6 mm、鋪面與護欄 −12 mm，合計 −45 + 20 − 30 + 6 − 12 = −61 mm，所以節塊須澆在完工高程之上 61 mm。工作車在濕混凝土下另下撓 8 mm，因此模板應設在完工高程之上 61 + 8 = 69 mm。若實際潛變係數比假設大 25%，潛變項變為 −30×1.25 = −37.5 mm，總預拱變為 68.5 mm，模板須設在 76.5 mm；若仍以 69 mm 澆置，該點長期約低 7.5 mm。這說明潛變參數的不確定性為何要在設計時做敏感度分析並在施工中回饋修正。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: for a 150 m cast-in-place balanced-cantilever box girder, compute the casting camber at the tip of segment 10. Predicted deflections (downward negative): self-weight of this and later segments −45 mm, cantilever prestress uplift +20 mm, long-term creep and shrinkage −30 mm, closure and continuity tendons +6 mm, surfacing and barriers −12 mm, totalling −45 + 20 − 30 + 6 − 12 = −61 mm, so the segment must be cast 61 mm above the final profile. The traveler deflects another 8 mm under wet concrete, so the forms are set 61 + 8 = 69 mm above the final profile. If the real creep coefficient is 25% higher than assumed, the creep term becomes −30×1.25 = −37.5 mm, the total camber 68.5 mm and the form setting 76.5 mm; casting at 69 mm would leave that point about 7.5 mm low in the long term. This shows why creep uncertainty needs a design sensitivity study and feedback correction during construction. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁」與「施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder" and "Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墩頂變高度箱梁」如何影響橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Haunched box girder at the pier” governs force, deformation or durability in “Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 平衡懸臂工法讓每一座橋墩成為一個 T 形構架：節塊由柱頭段向兩側對稱延伸，施工期間整個懸臂只靠墩頂承受負彎矩，彎矩隨懸臂長度的平方增長。因此箱梁在墩頂最深、跨中最淺，底板在墩頂加厚以承受壓力，頂板則容納大量懸臂鋼腱。跨中閉合並張拉連續鋼腱後，結構才轉為連續梁，跨中正彎矩出現；施工期與營運期的內力分布截然不同，設計必須逐階段追蹤。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墩頂變高度箱梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Balanced-cantilever construction turns each pier into a T-frame: segments grow symmetrically from the pier table, and during construction the whole cantilever is carried by hogging moment at the pier, which grows with the square of the cantilever length. The box girder is therefore deepest at the pier and shallowest at midspan; the bottom slab thickens near the pier to carry compression while the top slab houses many cantilever tendons. Only after midspan closure and continuity tendons does the structure become a continuous girder with sagging moment at midspan, so construction-stage and service-stage force distributions differ completely and the design must track every stage. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Haunched box girder at the pier” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·L²/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Root moment of the cantilever M = w·L²/2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平衡懸臂橋完工後的內力與施工期間一樣，只需用完工模型設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A balanced-cantilever bridge carries the same internal forces during construction as when finished, so the finished model is enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「墩頂變高度箱梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Haunched box girder at the pier”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁
knowledge.titleEn: Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder
knowledge.text: 平衡懸臂工法讓每一座橋墩成為一個 T 形構架：節塊由柱頭段向兩側對稱延伸，施工期間整個懸臂只靠墩頂承受負彎矩，彎矩隨懸臂長度的平方增長。因此箱梁在墩頂最深、跨中最淺，底板在墩頂加厚以承受壓力，頂板則容納大量懸臂鋼腱。
knowledge.textEn: Balanced-cantilever construction turns each pier into a T-frame: segments grow symmetrically from the pier table, and during construction the whole cantilever is carried by hogging moment at the pier, which grows with the square of the cantilever length. The box girder is therefore deepest at the pier and shallowest at midspan; the bottom slab thickens near the pier to carry compression while the top slab houses many cantilever tendons.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平衡懸臂橋完工後的內力與施工期間一樣，只需用完工模型設計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A balanced-cantilever bridge carries the same internal forces during construction as when finished, so the finished model is enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder" is correct?
options: 平衡懸臂橋完工後的內力與施工期間一樣，只需用完工模型設計。
平衡懸臂工法讓每一座橋墩成為一個 T 形構架：節塊由柱頭段向兩側對稱延伸，施工期間整個懸臂只靠墩頂承受負彎矩，彎矩隨懸臂長度的平方增長。
只要兩側節塊數量相同，墩頂就不會有不平衡彎矩。
optionsEn: A balanced-cantilever bridge carries the same internal forces during construction as when finished, so the finished model is enough.

Balanced-cantilever construction turns each pier into a T-frame: segments grow symmetrically from the pier table, and during construction the whole cantilever is carried by hogging moment at the pier, which grows with the square of the cantilever length.
If both sides have the same number of segments, there is no unbalanced moment at the pier.
quiz.explanation: 平衡懸臂工法讓每一座橋墩成為一個 T 形構架：節塊由柱頭段向兩側對稱延伸，施工期間整個懸臂只靠墩頂承受負彎矩，彎矩隨懸臂長度的平方增長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Balanced-cantilever construction turns each pier into a T-frame: segments grow symmetrically from the pier table, and during construction the whole cantilever is carried by hogging moment at the pier, which grows with the square of the cantilever length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墩頂變高度箱梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Haunched box girder at the pier” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·L²/2。取主跨 150 m、懸臂 L = 75 m、平均自重 w = 300 kN/m，M = 300×75²/2 ≈ 843,750 kN·m。若墩頂梁深取跨度 1/17 ≈ 8.8 m、跨中取 1/45 ≈ 3.3 m，所需懸臂預力約 P ≈ M/(0.75h) = 843,750/(0.75×8.8) ≈ 127,500 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Root moment of the cantilever M = w·L²/2. For a 150 m main span, cantilever L = 75 m and average self-weight w = 300 kN/m, M = 300×75²/2 ≈ 843,750 kN·m. With a pier depth of span/17 ≈ 8.8 m and a midspan depth of span/45 ≈ 3.3 m, the required cantilever prestress is roughly P ≈ M/(0.75h) = 843,750/(0.75×8.8) ≈ 127,500 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析軟體逐一加入節塊、工作車、鋼腱與閉合，輸出每一階段墩頂與各接縫的上下緣應力，與手算 M = wL²/2 及容許應力（施工期頂緣不得出現超過規範的拉應力）比較；同時核對變高度曲線（拋物線或多項式）在每個節塊端點的梁深與圖說一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a construction-stage analysis that adds each segment, traveler, tendon and the closure in sequence, output top- and bottom-fibre stresses at the pier and at every joint for every stage, and compare them with the hand estimate M = wL²/2 and the allowable stresses, with no top-fibre tension beyond the code limit during construction; also check that the haunch curve, parabolic or polynomial, gives the drawing depth at every segment end.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·L²/2。取主跨 150 m、懸臂 L = 75 m、平均自重 w = 300 kN/m，M = 300×75²/2 ≈ 843,750 kN·m。若墩頂梁深取跨度 1/17 ≈ 8.8 m、跨中取 1/45 ≈ 3.3 m，所需懸臂預力約 P ≈ M/(0.75h) = 843,750/(0.75×8.8) ≈ 127,500 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Root moment of the cantilever M = w·L²/2. For a 150 m main span, cantilever L = 75 m and average self-weight w = 300 kN/m, M = 300×75²/2 ≈ 843,750 kN·m. With a pier depth of span/17 ≈ 8.8 m and a midspan depth of span/45 ≈ 3.3 m, the required cantilever prestress is roughly P ≈ M/(0.75h) = 843,750/(0.75×8.8) ≈ 127,500 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder", which statement holds?
options: 預鑄節塊的環氧接縫就像膠水，主要靠黏著力承受剪力。
只要兩懸臂端在閉合當天高程相同，橋梁線形就已經完成。
懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·L²/2。
optionsEn: The epoxy in precast segment joints acts like glue and carries shear mainly by adhesion.
Once the two tips are at the same level on closure day, the bridge geometry is finished.
Root moment of the cantilever M = w·L²/2.
quiz.explanation: 懸臂根部彎矩 M = w·L²/2。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墩頂變高度箱梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Haunched box girder at the pier” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析軟體逐一加入節塊、工作車、鋼腱與閉合，輸出每一階段墩頂與各接縫的上下緣應力，與手算 M = wL²/2 及容許應力（施工期頂緣不得出現超過規範的拉應力）比較；同時核對變高度曲線（拋物線或多項式）在每個節塊端點的梁深與圖說一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a construction-stage analysis that adds each segment, traveler, tendon and the closure in sequence, output top- and bottom-fibre stresses at the pier and at every joint for every stage, and compare them with the hand estimate M = wL²/2 and the allowable stresses, with no top-fibre tension beyond the code limit during construction; also check that the haunch curve, parabolic or polynomial, gives the drawing depth at every segment end. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計說明書必須列出施工順序假設（節塊長度、工作車重量、張拉時程與閉合順序），並註明承包商若變更順序須重新提送施工階段分析，經設計單位審查同意後方可執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design report must state the assumed construction sequence (segment lengths, traveler weight, stressing times and closure order) and require the contractor to resubmit a construction-stage analysis, reviewed and accepted by the designer, before any change to that sequence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以完工後的連續梁模型設計，忽略懸臂階段的負彎矩峰值與施工期鋼腱尚未全部張拉的狀態，墩頂附近頂板可能在懸臂末段出現橫向裂縫，底板則因壓應力過高而壓碎或剝落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing only with the finished continuous-girder model, ignoring the hogging peak of the cantilever stage and the state before all tendons are stressed, can crack the top slab transversely near the pier during the last cantilever segments and overstress the bottom slab in compression until it spalls. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段分析軟體逐一加入節塊、工作車、鋼腱與閉合，輸出每一階段墩頂與各接縫的上下緣應力，與手算 M = wL²/2 及容許應力（施工期頂緣不得出現超過規範的拉應力）比較；同時核對變高度曲線（拋物線或多項式）在每個節塊端點的梁深與圖說一致。
knowledge.textEn: Run a construction-stage analysis that adds each segment, traveler, tendon and the closure in sequence, output top- and bottom-fibre stresses at the pier and at every joint for every stage, and compare them with the hand estimate M = wL²/2 and the allowable stresses, with no top-fibre tension beyond the code limit during construction; also check that the haunch curve, parabolic or polynomial, gives the drawing depth at every segment end.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計說明書必須列出施工順序假設（節塊長度、工作車重量、張拉時程與閉合順序），並註明承包商若變更順序須重新提送施工階段分析，經設計單位審查同意後方可執行。
knowledge.textEn: The design report must state the assumed construction sequence (segment lengths, traveler weight, stressing times and closure order) and require the contractor to resubmit a construction-stage analysis, reviewed and accepted by the designer, before any change to that sequence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Run a construction-stage analysis that adds each segment, traveler, tendon and the closure in sequence, output top- and bottom-fibre stresses at the pier and at every joint for every stage, and compare them with the hand estimate M = wL²/2 and the allowable stresses, with no top-fibre tension beyond the code limit during construction.

quiz.explanationEn: Run a construction-stage analysis that adds each segment, traveler, tendon and the closure in sequence, output top- and bottom-fibre stresses at the pier and at every joint for every stage, and compare them with the hand estimate M = wL²/2 and the allowable stresses, with no top-fibre tension beyond the code limit during construction; also check that the haunch curve, parabolic or polynomial, gives the drawing depth at every segment end. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cantilever hogging moment and the haunched box girder: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墩頂變高度箱梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Haunched box girder at the pier” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以完工後的連續梁模型設計，忽略懸臂階段的負彎矩峰值與施工期鋼腱尚未全部張拉的狀態，墩頂附近頂板可能在懸臂末段出現橫向裂縫，底板則因壓應力過高而壓碎或剝落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing only with the finished continuous-girder model, ignoring the hogging peak of the cantilever stage and the state before all tendons are stressed, can crack the top slab transversely near the pier during the last cantilever segments and overstress the bottom slab in compression until it spalls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：跨中閉合並張拉連續鋼腱後，結構才轉為連續梁，跨中正彎矩出現；施工期與營運期的內力分布截然不同，設計必須逐階段追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Only after midspan closure and continuity tendons does the structure become a continuous girder with sagging moment at midspan, so construction-stage and service-stage force distributions differ completely and the design must track every stage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平衡懸臂橋完工後的內力與施工期間一樣，只需用完工模型設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A balanced-cantilever bridge carries the same internal forces during construction as when finished, so the finished model is enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以完工後的連續梁模型設計，忽略懸臂階段的負彎矩峰值與施工期鋼腱尚未全部張拉的狀態，墩頂附近頂板可能在懸臂末段出現橫向裂縫，底板則因壓應力過高而壓碎或剝落。
knowledge.textEn: Designing only with the finished continuous-girder model, ignoring the hogging peak of the cantilever stage and the state before all tendons are stressed, can crack the top slab transversely near the pier during the last cantilever segments and overstress the bottom slab in compression until it spalls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
