quiz.explanationEn: Designing only with the finished continuous-girder model, ignoring the hogging peak of the cantilever stage and the state before all tendons are stressed, can crack the top slab transversely near the pier during the last cantilever segments and overstress the bottom slab in compression until it spalls. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墩頂臨時固結」如何影響橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary pier fixity” governs force, deformation or durability in “Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 兩側懸臂永遠不會完全平衡：一側節塊先澆、工作車前移時間不同、施工材料堆放不對稱、甚至一個預鑄節塊意外掉落，都會在墩頂產生不平衡彎矩。若永久支承是可滑動或可轉動的，懸臂期間必須用臨時固結把箱梁與墩身鎖成剛接，常見作法是墩頂臨時混凝土墊塊加預力鋼棒錨拉，或在墩旁設臨時支撐塔。分段橋設計規範要求檢核差異自重、施工活載、施工機具與節塊意外釋放等施工荷載組合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墩頂臨時固結」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The two cantilevers are never perfectly balanced: one segment is cast first, travelers advance at different times, materials are stacked unevenly, and a precast segment could even be dropped, each creating an unbalanced moment at the pier. If the permanent bearings slide or rotate, the girder must be locked to the pier during cantilevering, usually with temporary concrete blocks plus post-tensioned tie-down bars, or with temporary towers beside the pier. Segmental design provisions require construction load combinations covering differential dead load, construction live load, equipment and accidental release of a segment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temporary pier fixity” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一側先澆 4 m 節塊 W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN，力臂 72 m，彎矩 86,400 kN·m；加上一側自重多 2% 的差異荷載 0.02×300×75×37.5 ≈ 16,875 kN·m，合計 M_u ≈ 103,275 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One 4 m segment cast ahead weighs W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN at a 72 m arm, giving 86,400 kN·m; a 2% differential dead load on one side adds 0.02×300×75×37.5 ≈ 16,875 kN·m, for M_u ≈ 103,275 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要兩側節塊數量相同，墩頂就不會有不平衡彎矩。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If both sides have the same number of segments, there is no unbalanced moment at the pier." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「墩頂臨時固結」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Temporary pier fixity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結
knowledge.titleEn: Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity
knowledge.text: 兩側懸臂永遠不會完全平衡：一側節塊先澆、工作車前移時間不同、施工材料堆放不對稱、甚至一個預鑄節塊意外掉落，都會在墩頂產生不平衡彎矩。若永久支承是可滑動或可轉動的，懸臂期間必須用臨時固結把箱梁與墩身鎖成剛接，常見作法是墩頂臨時混凝土墊塊加預力鋼棒錨拉，或在墩旁設臨時支撐塔。
knowledge.textEn: The two cantilevers are never perfectly balanced: one segment is cast first, travelers advance at different times, materials are stacked unevenly, and a precast segment could even be dropped, each creating an unbalanced moment at the pier. If the permanent bearings slide or rotate, the girder must be locked to the pier during cantilevering, usually with temporary concrete blocks plus post-tensioned tie-down bars, or with temporary towers beside the pier.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要兩側節塊數量相同，墩頂就不會有不平衡彎矩。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If both sides have the same number of segments, there is no unbalanced moment at the pier. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity" is correct?
options: 只要兩側節塊數量相同，墩頂就不會有不平衡彎矩。
懸臂鋼腱只在施工期有用，閉合後就可以不計。
兩側懸臂永遠不會完全平衡：一側節塊先澆、工作車前移時間不同、施工材料堆放不對稱、甚至一個預鑄節塊意外掉落，都會在墩頂產生不平衡彎矩。
optionsEn: If both sides have the same number of segments, there is no unbalanced moment at the pier.
Cantilever tendons only matter during construction and can be ignored after closure.

The two cantilevers are never perfectly balanced: one segment is cast first, travelers advance at different times, materials are stacked unevenly, and a precast segment could even be dropped, each creating an unbalanced moment at the pier.
quiz.explanation: 兩側懸臂永遠不會完全平衡：一側節塊先澆、工作車前移時間不同、施工材料堆放不對稱、甚至一個預鑄節塊意外掉落，都會在墩頂產生不平衡彎矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The two cantilevers are never perfectly balanced: one segment is cast first, travelers advance at different times, materials are stacked unevenly, and a precast segment could even be dropped, each creating an unbalanced moment at the pier. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墩頂臨時固結」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temporary pier fixity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一側先澆 4 m 節塊 W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN，力臂 72 m，彎矩 86,400 kN·m；加上一側自重多 2% 的差異荷載 0.02×300×75×37.5 ≈ 16,875 kN·m，合計 M_u ≈ 103,275 kN·m。墩頂兩排臨時墊塊相距 4.0 m、總垂直力 N = 300×150 = 45,000 kN，單排反力 R = 22,500 ± 103,275/4.0 = 22,500 ± 25,819 kN，最小值約 −3,319 kN，表示需錨拉鋼棒。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One 4 m segment cast ahead weighs W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN at a 72 m arm, giving 86,400 kN·m; a 2% differential dead load on one side adds 0.02×300×75×37.5 ≈ 16,875 kN·m, for M_u ≈ 103,275 kN·m. With two rows of temporary blocks 4.0 m apart and N = 300×150 = 45,000 kN, each row carries R = 22,500 ± 103,275/4.0 = 22,500 ± 25,819 kN; the minimum, about −3,319 kN, means tie-down bars are required. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：臨時固結設計須列出每一種施工荷載組合下的墊塊壓力與錨拉鋼棒拉力，鋼棒以千斤頂壓力錶與伸長量雙重確認張拉值；懸臂施工期間定期量測兩側懸臂端高程差與墩頂傾斜，若傾斜趨勢與不平衡荷載預測不符，立即停止下一節塊作業。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The temporary-fixity design must list block pressures and tie-down bar forces for every construction load combination; bars are verified by both jack gauge pressure and elongation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 一側先澆 4 m 節塊 W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN，力臂 72 m，彎矩 86,400 kN·m；加上一側自重多 2% 的差異荷載 0.02×300×75×37.5 ≈ 16,875 kN·m，合計 M_u ≈ 103,275 kN·m。墩頂兩排臨時墊塊相距 4.0 m、總垂直力 N = 300×150 = 45,000 kN，單排反力 R = 22,500 ± 103,275/4.0 = 22,500 ± 25,819 kN，最小值約 −3,319 kN，表示需錨拉鋼棒。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: One 4 m segment cast ahead weighs W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN at a 72 m arm, giving 86,400 kN·m; a 2% differential dead load on one side adds 0.02×300×75×37.5 ≈ 16,875 kN·m, for M_u ≈ 103,275 kN·m. With two rows of temporary blocks 4.0 m apart and N = 300×150 = 45,000 kN, each row carries R = 22,500 ± 103,275/4.0 = 22,500 ± 25,819 kN; the minimum, about −3,319 kN, means tie-down bars are required. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity", which statement holds?
options: 一側先澆 4 m 節塊 W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN，力臂 72 m，彎矩 86,400 kN·m。
掛籃只是模板，重量與變形不會影響橋梁線形。
線形誤差可以等到閉合時再一次修正。
optionsEn: One 4 m segment cast ahead weighs W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN at a 72 m arm, giving 86,400 kN·m.
A form traveler is just formwork, so its weight and deflection do not affect the bridge geometry.
Geometry errors can all be corrected at once at closure.
quiz.explanation: 一側先澆 4 m 節塊 W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN，力臂 72 m，彎矩 86,400 kN·m；加上一側自重多 2% 的差異荷載 0.02×300×75×37.5 ≈ 16,875 kN·m，合計 M_u ≈ 103,275 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: One 4 m segment cast ahead weighs W = 300×4 = 1,200 kN at a 72 m arm, giving 86,400 kN·m; a 2% differential dead load on one side adds 0.02×300×75×37.5 ≈ 16,875 kN·m, for M_u ≈ 103,275 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墩頂臨時固結」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temporary pier fixity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 臨時固結設計須列出每一種施工荷載組合下的墊塊壓力與錨拉鋼棒拉力，鋼棒以千斤頂壓力錶與伸長量雙重確認張拉值；懸臂施工期間定期量測兩側懸臂端高程差與墩頂傾斜，若傾斜趨勢與不平衡荷載預測不符，立即停止下一節塊作業。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The temporary-fixity design must list block pressures and tie-down bar forces for every construction load combination; bars are verified by both jack gauge pressure and elongation. During cantilevering, survey the level difference between the two tips and the pier-top tilt regularly, and stop work on the next segment if the tilt trend does not match the unbalanced-load prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在施工計畫中明訂「最多領先一個節塊」與工地材料堆放區位置，臨時固結的拆除時機（通常在閉合並張拉連續鋼腱之後）列為設計單位簽認的停留點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan should state a rule of at most one segment ahead on either side and fix the locations of material stockpiles; the release of temporary fixity, normally after closure and continuity stressing, is a hold point signed off by the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：臨時錨拉鋼棒張拉不足、墊塊壓碎或提早拆除時，懸臂會繞墩頂轉動，一側下沉、另一側上翹，輕則閉合段高程無法對齊，重則整個 T 構傾覆；墩身在施工期承受的彎矩若未檢核，也可能在墩底出現水平裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If tie-down bars are under-stressed, blocks crush or fixity is released early, the cantilever rotates about the pier top, one tip dropping and the other rising; at best the closure cannot be aligned, at worst the whole T-frame overturns. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 臨時固結設計須列出每一種施工荷載組合下的墊塊壓力與錨拉鋼棒拉力，鋼棒以千斤頂壓力錶與伸長量雙重確認張拉值；懸臂施工期間定期量測兩側懸臂端高程差與墩頂傾斜，若傾斜趨勢與不平衡荷載預測不符，立即停止下一節塊作業。
knowledge.textEn: The temporary-fixity design must list block pressures and tie-down bar forces for every construction load combination; bars are verified by both jack gauge pressure and elongation. During cantilevering, survey the level difference between the two tips and the pier-top tilt regularly, and stop work on the next segment if the tilt trend does not match the unbalanced-load prediction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在施工計畫中明訂「最多領先一個節塊」與工地材料堆放區位置，臨時固結的拆除時機（通常在閉合並張拉連續鋼腱之後）列為設計單位簽認的停留點。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan should state a rule of at most one segment ahead on either side and fix the locations of material stockpiles; the release of temporary fixity, normally after closure and continuity stressing, is a hold point signed off by the designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
臨時固結設計須列出每一種施工荷載組合下的墊塊壓力與錨拉鋼棒拉力，鋼棒以千斤頂壓力錶與伸長量雙重確認張拉值。
混凝土潛變幾年內就結束，之後撓度不再增加。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
The temporary-fixity design must list block pressures and tie-down bar forces for every construction load combination.
Concrete creep ends within a few years, after which deflection stops increasing.
quiz.explanation: 臨時固結設計須列出每一種施工荷載組合下的墊塊壓力與錨拉鋼棒拉力，鋼棒以千斤頂壓力錶與伸長量雙重確認張拉值；懸臂施工期間定期量測兩側懸臂端高程差與墩頂傾斜，若傾斜趨勢與不平衡荷載預測不符，立即停止下一節塊作業。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The temporary-fixity design must list block pressures and tie-down bar forces for every construction load combination; bars are verified by both jack gauge pressure and elongation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墩頂臨時固結」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temporary pier fixity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 臨時錨拉鋼棒張拉不足、墊塊壓碎或提早拆除時，懸臂會繞墩頂轉動，一側下沉、另一側上翹，輕則閉合段高程無法對齊，重則整個 T 構傾覆；墩身在施工期承受的彎矩若未檢核，也可能在墩底出現水平裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If tie-down bars are under-stressed, blocks crush or fixity is released early, the cantilever rotates about the pier top, one tip dropping and the other rising; at best the closure cannot be aligned, at worst the whole T-frame overturns. Pier bending during construction, if not checked, can also crack the pier base horizontally. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分段橋設計規範要求檢核差異自重、施工活載、施工機具與節塊意外釋放等施工荷載組合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Segmental design provisions require construction load combinations covering differential dead load, construction live load, equipment and accidental release of a segment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要兩側節塊數量相同，墩頂就不會有不平衡彎矩。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If both sides have the same number of segments, there is no unbalanced moment at the pier." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 臨時錨拉鋼棒張拉不足、墊塊壓碎或提早拆除時，懸臂會繞墩頂轉動，一側下沉、另一側上翹，輕則閉合段高程無法對齊，重則整個 T 構傾覆；墩身在施工期承受的彎矩若未檢核，也可能在墩底出現水平裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: If tie-down bars are under-stressed, blocks crush or fixity is released early, the cantilever rotates about the pier top, one tip dropping and the other rising; at best the closure cannot be aligned, at worst the whole T-frame overturns. Pier bending during construction, if not checked, can also crack the pier base horizontally.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工期不平衡荷載與臨時固結」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction-stage unbalanced loads and temporary fixity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
懸臂鋼腱只在施工期有用，閉合後就可以不計。
臨時錨拉鋼棒張拉不足、墊塊壓碎或提早拆除時，懸臂會繞墩頂轉動，一側下沉、另一側上翹，輕則閉合段高程無法對齊，重則整個 T 構傾覆。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Cantilever tendons only matter during construction and can be ignored after closure.
If tie-down bars are under-stressed, blocks crush or fixity is released early, the cantilever rotates about the pier top, one tip dropping and the other rising.
quiz.explanation: 臨時錨拉鋼棒張拉不足、墊塊壓碎或提早拆除時，懸臂會繞墩頂轉動，一側下沉、另一側上翹，輕則閉合段高程無法對齊，重則整個 T 構傾覆；墩身在施工期承受的彎矩若未檢核，也可能在墩底出現水平裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If tie-down bars are under-stressed, blocks crush or fixity is released early, the cantilever rotates about the pier top, one tip dropping and the other rising; at best the closure cannot be aligned, at worst the whole T-frame overturns. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「懸臂鋼腱、錨碇與連續鋼腱」與「現澆施工縫與匹配澆注接縫」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cantilever tendons, anchorages and continuity tendons" and "Cast-in-place joints and match-cast joints": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 懸臂鋼腱、錨碇與連續鋼腱：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cantilever tendons, anchorages and continuity tendons: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「頂板懸臂鋼腱」如何影響橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Top-slab cantilever tendons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每加一對節塊，就在頂板張拉一對懸臂鋼腱，錨定在該節塊端面，使鋼腱數量由懸臂末端往墩頂逐漸累積，正好呼應彎矩向墩頂遞增。閉合後在底板張拉連續鋼腱，錨定在箱內齒塊上，以承受跨中正彎矩；現代設計常再加體外鋼腱，經轉向塊彎折，便於日後檢查與更換。錨碇區承受極大的集中力，需配置抵抗劈裂與爆裂的螺旋筋與格狀鋼筋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「頂板懸臂鋼腱」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each new segment pair receives a pair of top-slab cantilever tendons anchored at its end face, so the tendon count accumulates from the tip towards the pier, matching the moment growth. After closure, continuity tendons in the bottom slab, anchored on blisters inside the box, resist midspan sagging moment; modern designs often add external tendons deviated at deviator blocks so they can be inspected and replaced later. Anchorage zones carry huge concentrated forces and need spiral and orthogonal reinforcement against bursting and spalling. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Top-slab cantilever tendons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take a 19-strand 15.2 mm tendon: A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm², f_pu = 1,860 MPa, jacking force P_j = 0.75×1,860×2,660 ≈ 3,711 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸臂鋼腱只在施工期有用，閉合後就可以不計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cantilever tendons only matter during construction and can be ignored after closure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「頂板懸臂鋼腱」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Top-slab cantilever tendons”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 懸臂鋼腱、錨碇與連續鋼腱
knowledge.titleEn: Cantilever tendons, anchorages and continuity tendons
knowledge.text: 每加一對節塊，就在頂板張拉一對懸臂鋼腱，錨定在該節塊端面，使鋼腱數量由懸臂末端往墩頂逐漸累積，正好呼應彎矩向墩頂遞增。閉合後在底板張拉連續鋼腱，錨定在箱內齒塊上，以承受跨中正彎矩；現代設計常再加體外鋼腱，經轉向塊彎折，便於日後檢查與更換。
knowledge.textEn: Each new segment pair receives a pair of top-slab cantilever tendons anchored at its end face, so the tendon count accumulates from the tip towards the pier, matching the moment growth. After closure, continuity tendons in the bottom slab, anchored on blisters inside the box, resist midspan sagging moment; modern designs often add external tendons deviated at deviator blocks so they can be inspected and replaced later.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：懸臂鋼腱只在施工期有用，閉合後就可以不計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cantilever tendons only matter during construction and can be ignored after closure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「懸臂鋼腱、錨碇與連續鋼腱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cantilever tendons, anchorages and continuity tendons" is correct?
options: 每加一對節塊，就在頂板張拉一對懸臂鋼腱，錨定在該節塊端面，使鋼腱數量由懸臂末端往墩頂逐漸累積，正好呼應彎矩向墩頂遞增。
懸臂鋼腱只在施工期有用，閉合後就可以不計。
預鑄節塊的環氧接縫就像膠水，主要靠黏著力承受剪力。
optionsEn: Each new segment pair receives a pair of top-slab cantilever tendons anchored at its end face, so the tendon count accumulates from the tip towards the pier, matching the moment growth.
Cantilever tendons only matter during construction and can be ignored after closure.
The epoxy in precast segment joints acts like glue and carries shear mainly by adhesion.
quiz.explanation: 每加一對節塊，就在頂板張拉一對懸臂鋼腱，錨定在該節塊端面，使鋼腱數量由懸臂末端往墩頂逐漸累積，正好呼應彎矩向墩頂遞增。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each new segment pair receives a pair of top-slab cantilever tendons anchored at its end face, so the tendon count accumulates from the tip towards the pier, matching the moment growth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 懸臂鋼腱、錨碇與連續鋼腱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cantilever tendons, anchorages and continuity tendons: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂板懸臂鋼腱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Top-slab cantilever tendons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線為一束：A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm²，f_pu = 1,860 MPa，千斤頂力 P_j = 0.75×1,860×2,660 ≈ 3,711 kN。扣除損失後每束取 3,200 kN，墩頂需要 127,500/3,200 ≈ 40 束，約每對節塊增加 2 至 3 束。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take a 19-strand 15.2 mm tendon: A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm², f_pu = 1,860 MPa, jacking force P_j = 0.75×1,860×2,660 ≈ 3,711 kN. Allowing for losses at 3,200 kN per tendon, the pier section needs 127,500/3,200 ≈ 40 tendons, roughly 2 to 3 more for each segment pair. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對每一節塊端面的鋼腱數量與錨碇位置是否與鋼腱配置圖一致，錨碇區鋼筋於澆置前由監造逐項檢查；錨具與夾片須有系統認證與批次試驗報告，錨碇區混凝土在張拉時必須達到設計規定的最低強度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check that the tendon count and anchor positions at each segment face match the tendon layout drawings, and have the supervising engineer inspect anchorage-zone reinforcement item by item before casting; anchors and wedges need system approval and lot test reports, and the anchorage concrete must reach the specified minimum strength before stressing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線為一束：A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm²，f_pu = 1,860 MPa，千斤頂力 P_j = 0.75×1,860×2,660 ≈ 3,711 kN。扣除損失後每束取 3,200 kN，墩頂需要 127,500/3,200 ≈ 40 束，約每對節塊增加 2 至 3 束。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Take a 19-strand 15.2 mm tendon: A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm², f_pu = 1,860 MPa, jacking force P_j = 0.75×1,860×2,660 ≈ 3,711 kN. Allowing for losses at 3,200 kN per tendon, the pier section needs 127,500/3,200 ≈ 40 tendons, roughly 2 to 3 more for each segment pair. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「懸臂鋼腱、錨碇與連續鋼腱」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cantilever tendons, anchorages and continuity tendons", which statement holds?
options: 只要兩懸臂端在閉合當天高程相同，橋梁線形就已經完成。
千斤頂壓力達到設計值，就代表鋼腱整段都有設計預力。
optionsEn: Once the two tips are at the same level on closure day, the bridge geometry is finished.
Take a 19-strand 15.2 mm tendon: A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm², f_pu = 1,860 MPa, jacking force P_j = 0.75×1,860×2,660 ≈ 3,711 kN.
If the jack reaches the design pressure, the whole tendon carries the design prestress.
quiz.explanation: 以 19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線為一束：A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm²，f_pu = 1,860 MPa，千斤頂力 P_j = 0.75×1,860×2,660 ≈ 3,711 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take a 19-strand 15.2 mm tendon: A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm², f_pu = 1,860 MPa, jacking force P_j = 0.75×1,860×2,660 ≈ 3,711 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 懸臂鋼腱、錨碇與連續鋼腱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cantilever tendons, anchorages and continuity tendons: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂板懸臂鋼腱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Top-slab cantilever tendons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對每一節塊端面的鋼腱數量與錨碇位置是否與鋼腱配置圖一致，錨碇區鋼筋於澆置前由監造逐項檢查；錨具與夾片須有系統認證與批次試驗報告，錨碇區混凝土在張拉時必須達到設計規定的最低強度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check that the tendon count and anchor positions at each segment face match the tendon layout drawings, and have the supervising engineer inspect anchorage-zone reinforcement item by item before casting; anchors and wedges need system approval and lot test reports, and the anchorage concrete must reach the specified minimum strength before stressing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋼腱配置圖要同時標示孔道座標、錨碇編號與張拉順序，並要求承包商在澆置前以孔道通球或通索確認暢通；預留空孔道與錨碇作為未來補強之用，並在竣工圖上清楚標示。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tendon drawings should show duct coordinates, anchor numbers and stressing order, and the contractor should prove each duct clear with a pig or trial strand before casting; spare ducts and anchorages for future strengthening are provided and clearly marked on the as-built drawings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨碇區鋼筋不足或混凝土強度未達就張拉，會在錨墊板後方產生縱向劈裂裂縫，甚至錨具陷入；鋼腱孔道灌漿不實則讓水氣與氯離子沿孔道進入，長期造成鋼絞線腐蝕斷絲，這是體內鋼腱難以檢查的主要隱患。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient anchorage-zone reinforcement or stressing before the concrete reaches strength causes longitudinal splitting behind the bearing plate or even anchor punch-through; voids in duct grout let moisture and chlorides travel along the duct and corrode strands over the years, the main hidden risk of internal tendons that cannot be inspected easily. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對每一節塊端面的鋼腱數量與錨碇位置是否與鋼腱配置圖一致，錨碇區鋼筋於澆置前由監造逐項檢查；錨具與夾片須有系統認證與批次試驗報告，錨碇區混凝土在張拉時必須達到設計規定的最低強度。
knowledge.textEn: Check that the tendon count and anchor positions at each segment face match the tendon layout drawings, and have the supervising engineer inspect anchorage-zone reinforcement item by item before casting; anchors and wedges need system approval and lot test reports, and the anchorage concrete must reach the specified minimum strength before stressing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鋼腱配置圖要同時標示孔道座標、錨碇編號與張拉順序，並要求承包商在澆置前以孔道通球或通索確認暢通；預留空孔道與錨碇作為未來補強之用，並在竣工圖上清楚標示。
knowledge.textEn: Tendon drawings should show duct coordinates, anchor numbers and stressing order, and the contractor should prove each duct clear with a pig or trial strand before casting; spare ducts and anchorages for future strengthening are provided and clearly marked on the as-built drawings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「懸臂鋼腱、錨碇與連續鋼腱」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cantilever tendons, anchorages and continuity tendons"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
預力混凝土箱梁內部沒有車輛荷載，所以不需要定期進入檢查。
核對每一節塊端面的鋼腱數量與錨碇位置是否與鋼腱配置圖一致，錨碇區鋼筋於澆置前由監造逐項檢查。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The inside of a prestressed box girder carries no traffic, so it needs no routine inspection.

Check that the tendon count and anchor positions at each segment face match the tendon layout drawings, and have the supervising engineer inspect anchorage-zone reinforcement item by item before casting.
quiz.explanation: 核對每一節塊端面的鋼腱數量與錨碇位置是否與鋼腱配置圖一致，錨碇區鋼筋於澆置前由監造逐項檢查；錨具與夾片須有系統認證與批次試驗報告，錨碇區混凝土在張拉時必須達到設計規定的最低強度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check that the tendon count and anchor positions at each segment face match the tendon layout drawings, and have the supervising engineer inspect anchorage-zone reinforcement item by item before casting; anchors and wedges need system approval and lot test reports, and the anchorage concrete must reach the specified minimum strength before stressing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 懸臂鋼腱、錨碇與連續鋼腱：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cantilever tendons, anchorages and continuity tendons: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂板懸臂鋼腱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Top-slab cantilever tendons” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨碇區鋼筋不足或混凝土強度未達就張拉，會在錨墊板後方產生縱向劈裂裂縫，甚至錨具陷入；鋼腱孔道灌漿不實則讓水氣與氯離子沿孔道進入，長期造成鋼絞線腐蝕斷絲，這是體內鋼腱難以檢查的主要隱患。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient anchorage-zone reinforcement or stressing before the concrete reaches strength causes longitudinal splitting behind the bearing plate or even anchor punch-through; voids in duct grout let moisture and chlorides travel along the duct and corrode strands over the years, the main hidden risk of internal tendons that cannot be inspected easily. steps.title: 現澆施工縫與匹配澆注接縫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cast-in-place joints and match-cast joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「剪力鍵與節塊接縫」如何影響橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shear keys and segment joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 場鑄平衡懸臂的節塊接縫是施工縫：前一節塊端面打毛、普通鋼筋連續穿過，新混凝土直接澆在舊混凝土上。預鑄平衡懸臂則採匹配澆注：新節塊緊貼前一節塊澆製，使兩者端面完全吻合，安裝時以環氧樹脂接縫與多重剪力鍵傳遞剪力，接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，完全靠預力壓緊。因此預鑄接縫在任何施工與營運階段都不容許拉應力，剪力鍵的幾何與環氧樹脂的擠壓品質直接決定接縫剪力強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「剪力鍵與節塊接縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In cast-in-place balanced cantilevers the segment joint is a construction joint: the previous end face is roughened, ordinary reinforcement runs through, and new concrete is cast against old. Precast balanced cantilevers use match casting: each new segment is cast against the previous one so the faces fit exactly, and at erection epoxy joints and multiple shear keys transfer shear with no continuous reinforcement, held closed only by prestress. Precast joints therefore allow no tension at any construction or service stage, and shear-key geometry and the quality of epoxy squeeze-out govern joint shear strength. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shear keys and segment joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：環氧接縫固化期間以臨時預力棒維持平均壓應力 0.28 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: While the epoxy cures, temporary bars maintain an average joint compression of 0.28 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預鑄節塊的環氧接縫就像膠水，主要靠黏著力承受剪力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The epoxy in precast segment joints acts like glue and carries shear mainly by adhesion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「剪力鍵與節塊接縫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shear keys and segment joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 現澆施工縫與匹配澆注接縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cast-in-place joints and match-cast joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剪力鍵與節塊接縫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shear keys and segment joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：環氧接縫固化期間以臨時預力棒維持平均壓應力 0.28 MPa。端面淨面積 8 m² 時，所需壓力 F = 0.28×8×10⁶ N = 2,240 kN；每支 36 mm 鋼棒施加 600 kN，需 2,240/600 ≈ 3.7，取 4 支並對稱配置。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: While the epoxy cures, temporary bars maintain an average joint compression of 0.28 MPa. For a net face area of 8 m², the required force is F = 0.28×8×10⁶ N = 2,240 kN; at 600 kN per 36 mm bar, 2,240/600 ≈ 3.7, so use 4 bars placed symmetrically. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：場鑄接縫在澆置前檢查打毛深度、清潔與濕潤狀態；預鑄接縫在安裝前做乾接合試拼，確認剪力鍵密合，塗佈環氧後檢查擠出是否沿全周連續，並保存環氧批號、適用時間與環境溫度紀錄，固化試體強度與規格比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For cast joints, inspect roughening depth, cleanliness and moisture before casting; for precast joints, do a dry fit before erection to confirm shear-key seating, check that epoxy squeeze-out is continuous around the perimeter, and record epoxy lot, pot life and ambient temperature, comparing cured specimen strength with the specification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 環氧接縫固化期間以臨時預力棒維持平均壓應力 0.28 MPa。端面淨面積 8 m² 時，所需壓力 F = 0.28×8×10⁶ N = 2,240 kN；每支 36 mm 鋼棒施加 600 kN，需 2,240/600 ≈ 3.7，取 4 支並對稱配置。數值為教學假設。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 現澆施工縫與匹配澆注接縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cast-in-place joints and match-cast joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剪力鍵與節塊接縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shear keys and segment joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 場鑄接縫在澆置前檢查打毛深度、清潔與濕潤狀態；預鑄接縫在安裝前做乾接合試拼，確認剪力鍵密合，塗佈環氧後檢查擠出是否沿全周連續，並保存環氧批號、適用時間與環境溫度紀錄，固化試體強度與規格比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For cast joints, inspect roughening depth, cleanliness and moisture before casting; for precast joints, do a dry fit before erection to confirm shear-key seating, check that epoxy squeeze-out is continuous around the perimeter, and record epoxy lot, pot life and ambient temperature, comparing cured specimen strength with the specification. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格中寫明環氧材料的適用溫度範圍、最長開放時間與最低臨時壓應力；低溫或下雨時停止接縫作業，並由監造在每一接縫完成後簽署檢查紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should state the epoxy's temperature range, maximum open time and minimum temporary compression; stop jointing in cold or rain, and have the supervising engineer sign an inspection record for every completed joint.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：環氧塗佈後超過適用時間才合攏，或臨時預力不足，接縫會留下未擠實的空隙，日後成為水分進入孔道的通道；匹配澆注時若剪力鍵破損仍強行安裝，接縫局部承壓不均，可能在預力張拉時崩角。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Closing the joint after the epoxy's pot life has expired, or with too little temporary prestress, leaves unfilled voids that later let water reach the ducts; forcing a segment with damaged shear keys into place causes uneven bearing that can spall corners during stressing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 場鑄接縫在澆置前檢查打毛深度、清潔與濕潤狀態；預鑄接縫在安裝前做乾接合試拼，確認剪力鍵密合，塗佈環氧後檢查擠出是否沿全周連續，並保存環氧批號、適用時間與環境溫度紀錄，固化試體強度與規格比對。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格中寫明環氧材料的適用溫度範圍、最長開放時間與最低臨時壓應力；低溫或下雨時停止接縫作業，並由監造在每一接縫完成後簽署檢查紀錄。

steps.title: 現澆施工縫與匹配澆注接縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cast-in-place joints and match-cast joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剪力鍵與節塊接縫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shear keys and segment joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 環氧塗佈後超過適用時間才合攏，或臨時預力不足，接縫會留下未擠實的空隙，日後成為水分進入孔道的通道；匹配澆注時若剪力鍵破損仍強行安裝，接縫局部承壓不均，可能在預力張拉時崩角。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Closing the joint after the epoxy's pot life has expired, or with too little temporary prestress, leaves unfilled voids that later let water reach the ducts; forcing a segment with damaged shear keys into place causes uneven bearing that can spall corners during stressing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此預鑄接縫在任何施工與營運階段都不容許拉應力，剪力鍵的幾何與環氧樹脂的擠壓品質直接決定接縫剪力強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Precast joints therefore allow no tension at any construction or service stage, and shear-key geometry and the quality of epoxy squeeze-out govern joint shear strength.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預鑄節塊的環氧接縫就像膠水，主要靠黏著力承受剪力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The epoxy in precast segment joints acts like glue and carries shear mainly by adhesion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 環氧塗佈後超過適用時間才合攏，或臨時預力不足，接縫會留下未擠實的空隙，日後成為水分進入孔道的通道；匹配澆注時若剪力鍵破損仍強行安裝，接縫局部承壓不均，可能在預力張拉時崩角。
knowledge.textEn: Closing the joint after the epoxy's pot life has expired, or with too little temporary prestress, leaves unfilled voids that later let water reach the ducts; forcing a segment with damaged shear keys into place causes uneven bearing that can spall corners during stressing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現澆施工縫與匹配澆注接縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cast-in-place joints and match-cast joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
環氧塗佈後超過適用時間才合攏，或臨時預力不足，接縫會留下未擠實的空隙，日後成為水分進入孔道的通道。
掛籃只是模板，重量與變形不會影響橋梁線形。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Closing the joint after the epoxy's pot life has expired, or with too little temporary prestress, leaves unfilled voids that later let water reach the ducts.
A form traveler is just formwork, so its weight and deflection do not affect the bridge geometry.
quiz.explanation: 環氧塗佈後超過適用時間才合攏，或臨時預力不足，接縫會留下未擠實的空隙，日後成為水分進入孔道的通道；匹配澆注時若剪力鍵破損仍強行安裝，接縫局部承壓不均，可能在預力張拉時崩角。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Closing the joint after the epoxy's pot life has expired, or with too little temporary prestress, leaves unfilled voids that later let water reach the ducts; forcing a segment with damaged shear keys into place causes uneven bearing that can spall corners during stressing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環」與「預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Form travelers and the segment cycle" and "Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Form travelers and the segment cycle: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「懸臂工作車循環」如何影響橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Form-traveler cycle” governs force, deformation or durability in “Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 場鑄懸臂由懸臂工作車（掛籃）在已完成節塊的端部承托模板與新混凝土，循環為：工作車前移與錨定、調整模板高程、綁紮鋼筋與佈設孔道、澆置、養護、達到張拉強度後張拉懸臂鋼腱、拆模再前移。工作車重量通常約為節塊重量的一半，它本身也是懸臂結構，濕混凝土澆入時會下撓，必須預先抬高模板。整個工期的節奏由混凝土達到張拉強度所需的時間決定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「懸臂工作車循環」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In cast-in-place cantilevering, a form traveler anchored to the end of the completed segment carries the formwork and fresh concrete. The cycle is: advance and anchor the traveler, set form levels, place reinforcement and ducts, cast, cure, stress the cantilever tendons once the concrete reaches stressing strength, strip and advance again. A traveler often weighs about half a segment and is itself a cantilever that deflects as wet concrete is placed, so forms must be pre-raised. The pace of the whole job is set by how fast the concrete reaches stressing strength. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Form-traveler cycle” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：依 ACI 209 強度發展 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ACI 209 strength gain f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「掛籃只是模板，重量與變形不會影響橋梁線形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A form traveler is just formwork, so its weight and deflection do not affect the bridge geometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「懸臂工作車循環」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Form-traveler cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環
knowledge.titleEn: Form travelers and the segment cycle
knowledge.text: 場鑄懸臂由懸臂工作車（掛籃）在已完成節塊的端部承托模板與新混凝土，循環為：工作車前移與錨定、調整模板高程、綁紮鋼筋與佈設孔道、澆置、養護、達到張拉強度後張拉懸臂鋼腱、拆模再前移。工作車重量通常約為節塊重量的一半，它本身也是懸臂結構，濕混凝土澆入時會下撓，必須預先抬高模板。
knowledge.textEn: In cast-in-place cantilevering, a form traveler anchored to the end of the completed segment carries the formwork and fresh concrete. The cycle is: advance and anchor the traveler, set form levels, place reinforcement and ducts, cast, cure, stress the cantilever tendons once the concrete reaches stressing strength, strip and advance again.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：掛籃只是模板，重量與變形不會影響橋梁線形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A form traveler is just formwork, so its weight and deflection do not affect the bridge geometry. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Form travelers and the segment cycle" is correct?
options: 掛籃只是模板，重量與變形不會影響橋梁線形。
只要兩懸臂端在閉合當天高程相同，橋梁線形就已經完成。
場鑄懸臂由懸臂工作車（掛籃）在已完成節塊的端部承托模板與新混凝土，循環為：工作車前移與錨定、調整模板高程、綁紮鋼筋與佈設孔道、澆置、養護、達到張拉強度後張拉懸臂鋼腱、拆模再前移。
optionsEn: A form traveler is just formwork, so its weight and deflection do not affect the bridge geometry.
Once the two tips are at the same level on closure day, the bridge geometry is finished.
In cast-in-place cantilevering, a form traveler anchored to the end of the completed segment carries the formwork and fresh concrete.
quiz.explanation: 場鑄懸臂由懸臂工作車（掛籃）在已完成節塊的端部承托模板與新混凝土，循環為：工作車前移與錨定、調整模板高程、綁紮鋼筋與佈設孔道、澆置、養護、達到張拉強度後張拉懸臂鋼腱、拆模再前移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In cast-in-place cantilevering, a form traveler anchored to the end of the completed segment carries the formwork and fresh concrete. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Form travelers and the segment cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「懸臂工作車循環」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Form-traveler cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：依 ACI 209 強度發展 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t)。f₂₈ = 50 MPa、張拉需 30 MPa（比值 0.6）：第 I 型水泥 a = 4、b = 0.85，t = 0.6×4/(1 − 0.6×0.85) ≈ 4.9 天；早強水泥 a = 2.3、b = 0.92，t ≈ 3.1 天。懸臂 69 m 分為 18 節塊時，每節塊省 1.8 天可縮短約 32 天。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ACI 209 strength gain f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t). With f₂₈ = 50 MPa and 30 MPa needed for stressing (ratio 0.6), Type I cement (a = 4, b = 0.85) gives t = 0.6×4/(1 − 0.6×0.85) ≈ 4.9 days; high-early cement (a = 2.3, b = 0.92) gives t ≈ 3.1 days. With a 69 m cantilever in 18 segments, saving 1.8 days per segment shortens the work by about 32 days. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：張拉前以與節塊同條件養護的圓柱試體確認強度，並以成熟度感測器輔助判斷；工作車首次使用前做載重試驗（例如以水袋或配重加載至設計荷重），量測撓度與錨定桿受力，建立濕混凝土撓度的修正值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before stressing, confirm strength with cylinders cured alongside the segment, supported by maturity sensors; before first use, load-test the traveler with water bags or ballast to its design load, measuring deflection and anchor-rod forces to establish the wet-concrete deflection correction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 依 ACI 209 強度發展 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t)。f₂₈ = 50 MPa、張拉需 30 MPa（比值 0.6）：第 I 型水泥 a = 4、b = 0.85，t = 0.6×4/(1 − 0.6×0.85) ≈ 4.9 天；早強水泥 a = 2.3、b = 0.92，t ≈ 3.1 天。懸臂 69 m 分為 18 節塊時，每節塊省 1.8 天可縮短約 32 天。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: ACI 209 strength gain f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t). With f₂₈ = 50 MPa and 30 MPa needed for stressing (ratio 0.6), Type I cement (a = 4, b = 0.85) gives t = 0.6×4/(1 − 0.6×0.85) ≈ 4.9 days; high-early cement (a = 2.3, b = 0.92) gives t ≈ 3.1 days. With a 69 m cantilever in 18 segments, saving 1.8 days per segment shortens the work by about 32 days. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Form travelers and the segment cycle", which statement holds?
options: 依 ACI 209 強度發展 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t)。
千斤頂壓力達到設計值，就代表鋼腱整段都有設計預力。
預力混凝土箱梁內部沒有車輛荷載，所以不需要定期進入檢查。
optionsEn: ACI 209 strength gain f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t).
If the jack reaches the design pressure, the whole tendon carries the design prestress.
The inside of a prestressed box girder carries no traffic, so it needs no routine inspection.
quiz.explanation: 依 ACI 209 強度發展 f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ACI 209 strength gain f(t) = f₂₈·t/(a + b·t). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Form travelers and the segment cycle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「懸臂工作車循環」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Form-traveler cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 張拉前以與節塊同條件養護的圓柱試體確認強度，並以成熟度感測器輔助判斷；工作車首次使用前做載重試驗（例如以水袋或配重加載至設計荷重），量測撓度與錨定桿受力，建立濕混凝土撓度的修正值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before stressing, confirm strength with cylinders cured alongside the segment, supported by maturity sensors; before first use, load-test the traveler with water bags or ballast to its design load, measuring deflection and anchor-rod forces to establish the wet-concrete deflection correction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：工作車的設計、組立、載重試驗與每次前移後的錨定檢查應由專業技師簽認，前移作業列為停留點；每一循環的張拉放行條件（試體強度與錨定檢查）以表單管理，不得口頭放行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Traveler design, assembly, load test and anchorage check after each advance must be signed by a qualified engineer, with every advance a hold point; release for stressing in each cycle (cylinder strength and anchorage check) is managed by a signed form, never verbally.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：工作車後錨桿鬆脫或錨定於強度不足的混凝土時，工作車可能整體前傾墜落；若為趕工在強度未達時張拉，錨碇區崩裂與過大潛變撓度都會出現，事後只能鑿除修補並重新評估線形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a traveler's rear anchor rods loosen or are anchored in under-strength concrete, the traveler can tip forward and fall; stressing early to save time causes anchorage cracking and excessive creep deflection, leaving only demolition, repair and a re-evaluated geometry. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 張拉前以與節塊同條件養護的圓柱試體確認強度，並以成熟度感測器輔助判斷；工作車首次使用前做載重試驗（例如以水袋或配重加載至設計荷重），量測撓度與錨定桿受力，建立濕混凝土撓度的修正值。
knowledge.textEn: Before stressing, confirm strength with cylinders cured alongside the segment, supported by maturity sensors; before first use, load-test the traveler with water bags or ballast to its design load, measuring deflection and anchor-rod forces to establish the wet-concrete deflection correction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 工作車的設計、組立、載重試驗與每次前移後的錨定檢查應由專業技師簽認，前移作業列為停留點；每一循環的張拉放行條件（試體強度與錨定檢查）以表單管理，不得口頭放行。
knowledge.textEn: Traveler design, assembly, load test and anchorage check after each advance must be signed by a qualified engineer, with every advance a hold point; release for stressing in each cycle (cylinder strength and anchorage check) is managed by a signed form, never verbally.

quiz.question: 要驗證「懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Form travelers and the segment cycle"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
張拉前以與節塊同條件養護的圓柱試體確認強度，並以成熟度感測器輔助判斷。
只要兩側節塊數量相同，墩頂就不會有不平衡彎矩。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before stressing, confirm strength with cylinders cured alongside the segment, supported by maturity sensors.
If both sides have the same number of segments, there is no unbalanced moment at the pier.
quiz.explanation: 張拉前以與節塊同條件養護的圓柱試體確認強度，並以成熟度感測器輔助判斷；工作車首次使用前做載重試驗（例如以水袋或配重加載至設計荷重），量測撓度與錨定桿受力，建立濕混凝土撓度的修正值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before stressing, confirm strength with cylinders cured alongside the segment, supported by maturity sensors; before first use, load-test the traveler with water bags or ballast to its design load, measuring deflection and anchor-rod forces to establish the wet-concrete deflection correction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Form travelers and the segment cycle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「懸臂工作車循環」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Form-traveler cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 工作車後錨桿鬆脫或錨定於強度不足的混凝土時，工作車可能整體前傾墜落；若為趕工在強度未達時張拉，錨碇區崩裂與過大潛變撓度都會出現，事後只能鑿除修補並重新評估線形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a traveler's rear anchor rods loosen or are anchored in under-strength concrete, the traveler can tip forward and fall; stressing early to save time causes anchorage cracking and excessive creep deflection, leaving only demolition, repair and a re-evaluated geometry. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整個工期的節奏由混凝土達到張拉強度所需的時間決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The pace of the whole job is set by how fast the concrete reaches stressing strength.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「掛籃只是模板，重量與變形不會影響橋梁線形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A form traveler is just formwork, so its weight and deflection do not affect the bridge geometry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 工作車後錨桿鬆脫或錨定於強度不足的混凝土時，工作車可能整體前傾墜落；若為趕工在強度未達時張拉，錨碇區崩裂與過大潛變撓度都會出現，事後只能鑿除修補並重新評估線形。
knowledge.textEn: If a traveler's rear anchor rods loosen or are anchored in under-strength concrete, the traveler can tip forward and fall; stressing early to save time causes anchorage cracking and excessive creep deflection, leaving only demolition, repair and a re-evaluated geometry.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「懸臂工作車與節塊施工循環」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Form travelers and the segment cycle" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要兩懸臂端在閉合當天高程相同，橋梁線形就已經完成。
工作車後錨桿鬆脫或錨定於強度不足的混凝土時，工作車可能整體前傾墜落；若為趕工在強度未達時張拉，錨碇區崩裂與過大潛變撓度都會出現，事後只能鑿除修補並重新評估線形。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once the two tips are at the same level on closure day, the bridge geometry is finished.
If a traveler's rear anchor rods loosen or are anchored in under-strength concrete, the traveler can tip forward and fall.
quiz.explanation: 工作車後錨桿鬆脫或錨定於強度不足的混凝土時，工作車可能整體前傾墜落；若為趕工在強度未達時張拉，錨碇區崩裂與過大潛變撓度都會出現，事後只能鑿除修補並重新評估線形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a traveler's rear anchor rods loosen or are anchored in under-strength concrete, the traveler can tip forward and fall; stressing early to save time causes anchorage cracking and excessive creep deflection, leaving only demolition, repair and a re-evaluated geometry. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「閉合段與預拱線形」如何影響橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure segment and camber” governs force, deformation or durability in “Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 每一節塊的澆置高程等於完工縱斷面再加上預拱值，預拱抵銷之後所有會發生的變形：後續節塊自重、預力上拱、工作車移除、閉合與連續鋼腱、鋪面荷重，以及多年的潛變與乾縮。日照使頂板比底板熱，懸臂端會在白天上翹、夜間回落，所以測量與閉合都安排在溫度穩定的清晨。閉合時先以鋼支撐或型鋼骨架把兩懸臂端鎖住，再於一天最低溫時澆置閉合段，使混凝土硬化時兩端不再相對移動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「閉合段與預拱線形」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each segment's casting elevation is the final profile plus a camber that offsets every later deformation: the weight of later segments, prestress uplift, traveler removal, closure and continuity tendons, surfacing loads, and years of creep and shrinkage. Sun heats the top slab more than the bottom, so cantilever tips rise by day and drop at night; survey and closure are therefore scheduled in the stable early morning. At closure, steel struts or a stiff skeleton first lock the two tips together, and the closure segment is cast at the day's lowest temperature so the tips no longer move relative to each other while the concrete hardens. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Closure segment and camber” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：線性溫差造成曲率 κ = α·ΔT/h，懸臂端撓度 δ = κ·L²/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A linear temperature difference gives curvature κ = α·ΔT/h and tip deflection δ = κ·L²/2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要兩懸臂端在閉合當天高程相同，橋梁線形就已經完成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once the two tips are at the same level on closure day, the bridge geometry is finished." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「閉合段與預拱線形」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Closure segment and camber”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合
knowledge.titleEn: Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure
knowledge.text: 每一節塊的澆置高程等於完工縱斷面再加上預拱值，預拱抵銷之後所有會發生的變形：後續節塊自重、預力上拱、工作車移除、閉合與連續鋼腱、鋪面荷重，以及多年的潛變與乾縮。日照使頂板比底板熱，懸臂端會在白天上翹、夜間回落，所以測量與閉合都安排在溫度穩定的清晨。
knowledge.textEn: Each segment's casting elevation is the final profile plus a camber that offsets every later deformation: the weight of later segments, prestress uplift, traveler removal, closure and continuity tendons, surfacing loads, and years of creep and shrinkage. Sun heats the top slab more than the bottom, so cantilever tips rise by day and drop at night; survey and closure are therefore scheduled in the stable early morning.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要兩懸臂端在閉合當天高程相同，橋梁線形就已經完成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the two tips are at the same level on closure day, the bridge geometry is finished. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure" is correct?
options: 每一節塊的澆置高程等於完工縱斷面再加上預拱值，預拱抵銷之後所有會發生的變形：後續節塊自重、預力上拱、工作車移除、閉合與連續鋼腱、鋪面荷重，以及多年的潛變與乾縮。
只要兩懸臂端在閉合當天高程相同，橋梁線形就已經完成。
線形誤差可以等到閉合時再一次修正。
optionsEn: Each segment's casting elevation is the final profile plus a camber that offsets every later deformation: the weight of later segments, prestress uplift, traveler removal, closure and continuity tendons, surfacing loads, and years of creep and shrinkage.
Once the two tips are at the same level on closure day, the bridge geometry is finished.
Geometry errors can all be corrected at once at closure.
quiz.explanation: 每一節塊的澆置高程等於完工縱斷面再加上預拱值，預拱抵銷之後所有會發生的變形：後續節塊自重、預力上拱、工作車移除、閉合與連續鋼腱、鋪面荷重，以及多年的潛變與乾縮。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each segment's casting elevation is the final profile plus a camber that offsets every later deformation: the weight of later segments, prestress uplift, traveler removal, closure and continuity tendons, surfacing loads, and years of creep and shrinkage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閉合段與預拱線形」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure segment and camber” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：線性溫差造成曲率 κ = α·ΔT/h，懸臂端撓度 δ = κ·L²/2。α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C、頂底溫差 ΔT = 10°C、平均梁深 h = 5 m、L = 75 m：κ = 2×10⁻⁵ 1/m，δ = 2×10⁻⁵×75²/2 ≈ 56 mm。中午測量若不修正，閉合高程可差數公分。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A linear temperature difference gives curvature κ = α·ΔT/h and tip deflection δ = κ·L²/2. With α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C, a top-to-bottom difference ΔT = 10°C, average depth h = 5 m and L = 75 m, κ = 2×10⁻⁵ 1/m and δ = 2×10⁻⁵×75²/2 ≈ 56 mm. An uncorrected noon survey can therefore miss the closure level by several centimetres. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：閉合前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端的高程、相對水平位移與梁內溫度，選定溫差最小、兩端相對移動最少的時段；鎖定支撐安裝後確認兩端高差在允差內（例如 ±10 mm），閉合段澆置後追蹤試體強度，達標才張拉連續鋼腱並拆除臨時固結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before closure, monitor tip levels, relative horizontal movement and internal girder temperature for 24 hours to choose the window with the smallest gradient and least relative movement; after installing the locking struts confirm the level difference is within tolerance, for example ±10 mm; after casting, track cylinder strength and only then stress continuity tendons and release temporary fixity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 線性溫差造成曲率 κ = α·ΔT/h，懸臂端撓度 δ = κ·L²/2。α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C、頂底溫差 ΔT = 10°C、平均梁深 h = 5 m、L = 75 m：κ = 2×10⁻⁵ 1/m，δ = 2×10⁻⁵×75²/2 ≈ 56 mm。中午測量若不修正，閉合高程可差數公分。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A linear temperature difference gives curvature κ = α·ΔT/h and tip deflection δ = κ·L²/2. With α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C, a top-to-bottom difference ΔT = 10°C, average depth h = 5 m and L = 75 m, κ = 2×10⁻⁵ 1/m and δ = 2×10⁻⁵×75²/2 ≈ 56 mm. An uncorrected noon survey can therefore miss the closure level by several centimetres. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土潛變幾年內就結束，之後撓度不再增加。
線性溫差造成曲率 κ = α·ΔT/h，懸臂端撓度 δ = κ·L²/2。
平衡懸臂橋完工後的內力與施工期間一樣，只需用完工模型設計。
optionsEn: Concrete creep ends within a few years, after which deflection stops increasing.
A linear temperature difference gives curvature κ = α·ΔT/h and tip deflection δ = κ·L²/2.
A balanced-cantilever bridge carries the same internal forces during construction as when finished, so the finished model is enough.
quiz.explanation: 線性溫差造成曲率 κ = α·ΔT/h，懸臂端撓度 δ = κ·L²/2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A linear temperature difference gives curvature κ = α·ΔT/h and tip deflection δ = κ·L²/2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閉合段與預拱線形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closure segment and camber” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 閉合前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端的高程、相對水平位移與梁內溫度，選定溫差最小、兩端相對移動最少的時段；鎖定支撐安裝後確認兩端高差在允差內（例如 ±10 mm），閉合段澆置後追蹤試體強度，達標才張拉連續鋼腱並拆除臨時固結。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before closure, monitor tip levels, relative horizontal movement and internal girder temperature for 24 hours to choose the window with the smallest gradient and least relative movement; after installing the locking struts confirm the level difference is within tolerance, for example ±10 mm; after casting, track cylinder strength and only then stress continuity tendons and release temporary fixity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：閉合程序書須包含鎖定支撐設計、溫度與時段條件、澆置與養護計畫、連續鋼腱張拉順序及臨時固結拆除順序，由設計與監造雙方簽認後才可執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The closure procedure must include the locking-strut design, temperature and time-window conditions, casting and curing plan, continuity-stressing order and the sequence for releasing temporary fixity, and be signed by both designer and supervising engineer before execution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在白天高溫時鎖定兩懸臂端，夜間降溫收縮時閉合段新混凝土會被拉裂；預拱值低估潛變則讓跨中逐年下垂，形成明顯的「中跨凹陷」，影響行車舒適與排水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Locking the tips during a hot afternoon lets night cooling pull the fresh closure concrete apart and crack it; underestimating creep in the camber makes the midspan sag year after year into a visible dip that harms ride quality and drainage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 閉合前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端的高程、相對水平位移與梁內溫度，選定溫差最小、兩端相對移動最少的時段；鎖定支撐安裝後確認兩端高差在允差內（例如 ±10 mm），閉合段澆置後追蹤試體強度，達標才張拉連續鋼腱並拆除臨時固結。
knowledge.textEn: Before closure, monitor tip levels, relative horizontal movement and internal girder temperature for 24 hours to choose the window with the smallest gradient and least relative movement; after installing the locking struts confirm the level difference is within tolerance, for example ±10 mm; after casting, track cylinder strength and only then stress continuity tendons and release temporary fixity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 閉合程序書須包含鎖定支撐設計、溫度與時段條件、澆置與養護計畫、連續鋼腱張拉順序及臨時固結拆除順序，由設計與監造雙方簽認後才可執行。
knowledge.textEn: The closure procedure must include the locking-strut design, temperature and time-window conditions, casting and curing plan, continuity-stressing order and the sequence for releasing temporary fixity, and be signed by both designer and supervising engineer before execution.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
懸臂鋼腱只在施工期有用，閉合後就可以不計。
閉合前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端的高程、相對水平位移與梁內溫度，選定溫差最小、兩端相對移動最少的時段。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Cantilever tendons only matter during construction and can be ignored after closure.
Before closure, monitor tip levels, relative horizontal movement and internal girder temperature for 24 hours to choose the window with the smallest gradient and least relative movement.
quiz.explanation: 閉合前連續 24 小時量測兩懸臂端的高程、相對水平位移與梁內溫度，選定溫差最小、兩端相對移動最少的時段；鎖定支撐安裝後確認兩端高差在允差內（例如 ±10 mm），閉合段澆置後追蹤試體強度，達標才張拉連續鋼腱並拆除臨時固結。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before closure, monitor tip levels, relative horizontal movement and internal girder temperature for 24 hours to choose the window with the smallest gradient and least relative movement; after installing the locking struts confirm the level difference is within tolerance, for example ±10 mm; after casting, track cylinder strength and only then stress continuity tendons and release temporary fixity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「閉合段與預拱線形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closure segment and camber” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在白天高溫時鎖定兩懸臂端，夜間降溫收縮時閉合段新混凝土會被拉裂；預拱值低估潛變則讓跨中逐年下垂，形成明顯的「中跨凹陷」，影響行車舒適與排水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Locking the tips during a hot afternoon lets night cooling pull the fresh closure concrete apart and crack it; underestimating creep in the camber makes the midspan sag year after year into a visible dip that harms ride quality and drainage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合時先以鋼支撐或型鋼骨架把兩懸臂端鎖住，再於一天最低溫時澆置閉合段，使混凝土硬化時兩端不再相對移動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At closure, steel struts or a stiff skeleton first lock the two tips together, and the closure segment is cast at the day's lowest temperature so the tips no longer move relative to each other while the concrete hardens.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要兩懸臂端在閉合當天高程相同，橋梁線形就已經完成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the two tips are at the same level on closure day, the bridge geometry is finished." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在白天高溫時鎖定兩懸臂端，夜間降溫收縮時閉合段新混凝土會被拉裂；預拱值低估潛變則讓跨中逐年下垂，形成明顯的「中跨凹陷」，影響行車舒適與排水。
knowledge.textEn: Locking the tips during a hot afternoon lets night cooling pull the fresh closure concrete apart and crack it; underestimating creep in the camber makes the midspan sag year after year into a visible dip that harms ride quality and drainage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預拱、溫度效應與跨中閉合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Camber, thermal effects and midspan closure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若在白天高溫時鎖定兩懸臂端，夜間降溫收縮時閉合段新混凝土會被拉裂；預拱值低估潛變則讓跨中逐年下垂，形成明顯的「中跨凹陷」，影響行車舒適與排水。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
線形誤差可以等到閉合時再一次修正。
optionsEn: Locking the tips during a hot afternoon lets night cooling pull the fresh closure concrete apart and crack it.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Geometry errors can all be corrected at once at closure.
quiz.explanation: 若在白天高溫時鎖定兩懸臂端，夜間降溫收縮時閉合段新混凝土會被拉裂；預拱值低估潛變則讓跨中逐年下垂，形成明顯的「中跨凹陷」，影響行車舒適與排水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Locking the tips during a hot afternoon lets night cooling pull the fresh closure concrete apart and crack it; underestimating creep in the camber makes the midspan sag year after year into a visible dip that harms ride quality and drainage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「線形測量與預拱回饋控制」與「摩擦損失與伸長量驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Geometry survey and camber feedback" and "Friction losses and elongation checks": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 線形測量與預拱回饋控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Geometry survey and camber feedback: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「懸臂端測量控制點」如何影響橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Survey points at cantilever tips” governs force, deformation or durability in “Balanced-cantilever segmental bridge construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 線形控制是一個回饋迴路：每一節塊在澆置前、澆置後、張拉後與工作車前移後都要量測端點高程，與預測撓度曲線比較，若偏差超出門檻，就修正後續節塊的澆置高程與模型參數（例如彈性模數、潛變係數、工作車勁度）。預鑄節塊的回饋則發生在預製場：每一節塊的匹配澆注幾何都要量測，因為一個微小的轉角誤差會沿懸臂放大。測量點需固定於節塊頂板並在全程保留。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「懸臂端測量控制點」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Geometry control is a feedback loop: each segment tip is surveyed before casting, after casting, after stressing and after the traveler moves, and compared with the predicted deflection curve; if the deviation exceeds a threshold, later casting elevations and model parameters such as elastic modulus, creep coefficient and traveler stiffness are revised. For precast segments the feedback happens in the casting yard: the match-cast geometry of every segment is surveyed, because a tiny angular error is amplified along the cantilever. Survey points are fixed in the top slab and kept for the whole job. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Survey points at cantilever tips” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：角度誤差沿懸臂放大：δ_tip = θ·L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Angular error grows along the cantilever: δ_tip = θ·L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「線形誤差可以等到閉合時再一次修正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Geometry errors can all be corrected at once at closure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「懸臂端測量控制點」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Survey points at cantilever tips”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 線形測量與預拱回饋控制
knowledge.text: 線形控制是一個回饋迴路：每一節塊在澆置前、澆置後、張拉後與工作車前移後都要量測端點高程，與預測撓度曲線比較，若偏差超出門檻，就修正後續節塊的澆置高程與模型參數（例如彈性模數、潛變係數、工作車勁度）。預鑄節塊的回饋則發生在預製場：每一節塊的匹配澆注幾何都要量測，因為一個微小的轉角誤差會沿懸臂放大。
knowledge.textEn: Geometry control is a feedback loop: each segment tip is surveyed before casting, after casting, after stressing and after the traveler moves, and compared with the predicted deflection curve; if the deviation exceeds a threshold, later casting elevations and model parameters such as elastic modulus, creep coefficient and traveler stiffness are revised. For precast segments the feedback happens in the casting yard: the match-cast geometry of every segment is surveyed, because a tiny angular error is amplified along the cantilever.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：線形誤差可以等到閉合時再一次修正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
