Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫」與「體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Match-cast joints: dry and epoxy" and "Deviators and anchorages for external tendons": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Match-cast joints: dry and epoxy: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「剪力鍵與乾接縫」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shear keys and dry joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 逐跨工法的節塊在預製場以匹配澆注製作，相鄰節塊端面完全吻合，並設多重剪力鍵。佛州 Long Key 橋與曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路採用乾接縫，完全依靠體外預力壓緊接縫與剪力鍵傳遞剪力；許多新近規範則要求環氧接縫，用以密封接縫、填補微小不平並在架設時潤滑定位。乾接縫施工快、不受天候影響，但接縫沒有任何抗拉能力，也不能防水，因此需要較高的殘餘壓應力與更好的箱內防水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「剪力鍵與乾接縫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Span-by-span segments are match-cast in the yard, so the faces of adjacent segments fit exactly and carry multiple shear keys. Florida's Long Key Bridge and Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway used dry joints, relying entirely on external prestress to clamp the joints so shear keys transfer shear; many recent specifications require epoxy joints instead, to seal the joint, fill small irregularities and lubricate alignment during erection. Dry joints are fast and weather-independent, but they have no tensile capacity and no water-tightness, so they need higher residual compression and better waterproofing of the box. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shear keys and dry joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Support shear V = 180×42/2 + 50×42/2 + 1,500 = 6,330 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「乾接縫只是少塗一層環氧，結構行為與環氧接縫完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dry joint is just an epoxy joint without the epoxy and behaves identically." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「剪力鍵與乾接縫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shear keys and dry joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫
knowledge.text: 逐跨工法的節塊在預製場以匹配澆注製作，相鄰節塊端面完全吻合，並設多重剪力鍵。佛州 Long Key 橋與曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路採用乾接縫，完全依靠體外預力壓緊接縫與剪力鍵傳遞剪力；許多新近規範則要求環氧接縫，用以密封接縫、填補微小不平並在架設時潤滑定位。
knowledge.textEn: Span-by-span segments are match-cast in the yard, so the faces of adjacent segments fit exactly and carry multiple shear keys. Florida's Long Key Bridge and Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway used dry joints, relying entirely on external prestress to clamp the joints so shear keys transfer shear; many recent specifications require epoxy joints instead, to seal the joint, fill small irregularities and lubricate alignment during erection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：乾接縫只是少塗一層環氧，結構行為與環氧接縫完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dry joint is just an epoxy joint without the epoxy and behaves identically. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Match-cast joints: dry and epoxy" is correct?
options: 逐跨工法的節塊在預製場以匹配澆注製作，相鄰節塊端面完全吻合，並設多重剪力鍵。
乾接縫只是少塗一層環氧，結構行為與環氧接縫完全相同。
體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。
optionsEn: Span-by-span segments are match-cast in the yard, so the faces of adjacent segments fit exactly and carry multiple shear keys.
A dry joint is just an epoxy joint without the epoxy and behaves identically.
Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement.
quiz.explanation: 逐跨工法的節塊在預製場以匹配澆注製作，相鄰節塊端面完全吻合，並設多重剪力鍵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Span-by-span segments are match-cast in the yard, so the faces of adjacent segments fit exactly and carry multiple shear keys. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Match-cast joints: dry and epoxy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剪力鍵與乾接縫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shear keys and dry joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：支點剪力 V = 180×42/2 + 50×42/2 + 1,500 = 6,330 kN。若腹板範圍分擔 30% 預力，摩擦係數 μ = 0.6，接縫摩擦抗剪 V_f = 0.6×0.3×43,200 ≈ 7,776 kN，比值 7,776/6,330 ≈ 1.23（未計剪力鍵貢獻）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Support shear V = 180×42/2 + 50×42/2 + 1,500 = 6,330 kN. If the webs carry 30% of the prestress and μ = 0.6, joint friction resistance is V_f = 0.6×0.3×43,200 ≈ 7,776 kN, a ratio of 7,776/6,330 ≈ 1.23 before counting shear keys. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：預製場每一節塊拆模後檢查剪力鍵完整性與端面清潔，架設前做乾接合試拼；環氧接縫則記錄批號、溫度與適用時間，並檢查擠出是否沿全周連續。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In the yard, inspect shear-key integrity and face cleanliness after each segment is stripped, and dry-fit before erection; for epoxy joints, record lot, temperature and pot life and check that squeeze-out is continuous round the perimeter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Support shear V = 180×42/2 + 50×42/2 + 1,500 = 6,330 kN. If the webs carry 30% of the prestress and μ = 0.6, joint friction resistance is V_f = 0.6×0.3×43,200 ≈ 7,776 kN, a ratio of 7,776/6,330 ≈ 1.23 before counting shear keys. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Match-cast joints: dry and epoxy", which statement holds?
options: 張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。
體外鋼腱張拉完成後力量不會改變，所以不需要再量測。
optionsEn: After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings.
Once stressed, an external tendon's force never changes, so it need not be measured again.
quiz.explanationEn: Support shear V = 180×42/2 + 50×42/2 + 1,500 = 6,330 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Match-cast joints: dry and epoxy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剪力鍵與乾接縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shear keys and dry joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 預製場每一節塊拆模後檢查剪力鍵完整性與端面清潔，架設前做乾接合試拼；環氧接縫則記錄批號、溫度與適用時間，並檢查擠出是否沿全周連續。張拉後以塞尺抽查接縫是否完全閉合，任何開口都要記錄位置與深度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In the yard, inspect shear-key integrity and face cleanliness after each segment is stripped, and dry-fit before erection; for epoxy joints, record lot, temperature and pot life and check that squeeze-out is continuous round the perimeter. After stressing, spot-check joint closure with feeler gauges and record the location and depth of any opening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接縫型式（乾或環氧）、最低殘餘壓應力、剪力鍵修補程序與箱內排水設計應在招標文件中一次訂定，施工中不得以趕工為由由環氧改為乾接縫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify joint type (dry or epoxy), minimum residual compression, shear-key repair procedure and box drainage in the tender documents, and forbid switching from epoxy to dry joints during construction to save time.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：剪力鍵在運輸或吊裝時崩角而未修補，接縫局部承壓集中，張拉時可能進一步崩裂；乾接縫若殘餘壓應力不足，重車通過時接縫反覆微開，箱內積水沿底板流向錨碇區，成為腐蝕源頭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shear keys chipped in transport or lifting and left unrepaired concentrate bearing and can spall further during stressing; dry joints with too little residual compression breathe open under heavy trucks, letting water collect inside the box and run along the bottom slab to the anchorages, starting corrosion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 預製場每一節塊拆模後檢查剪力鍵完整性與端面清潔，架設前做乾接合試拼；環氧接縫則記錄批號、溫度與適用時間，並檢查擠出是否沿全周連續。張拉後以塞尺抽查接縫是否完全閉合，任何開口都要記錄位置與深度。
knowledge.textEn: In the yard, inspect shear-key integrity and face cleanliness after each segment is stripped, and dry-fit before erection; for epoxy joints, record lot, temperature and pot life and check that squeeze-out is continuous round the perimeter. After stressing, spot-check joint closure with feeler gauges and record the location and depth of any opening.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接縫型式（乾或環氧）、最低殘餘壓應力、剪力鍵修補程序與箱內排水設計應在招標文件中一次訂定，施工中不得以趕工為由由環氧改為乾接縫。
knowledge.textEn: Specify joint type (dry or epoxy), minimum residual compression, shear-key repair procedure and box drainage in the tender documents, and forbid switching from epoxy to dry joints during construction to save time.

quiz.question: 要驗證「匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Match-cast joints: dry and epoxy"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
接縫出現滲水只是防水問題，與結構無關。
預製場每一節塊拆模後檢查剪力鍵完整性與端面清潔，架設前做乾接合試拼；環氧接縫則記錄批號、溫度與適用時間，並檢查擠出是否沿全周連續。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Water seeping at a segment joint is only a waterproofing issue with no structural meaning.
In the yard, inspect shear-key integrity and face cleanliness after each segment is stripped, and dry-fit before erection.
quiz.explanation: 預製場每一節塊拆模後檢查剪力鍵完整性與端面清潔，架設前做乾接合試拼；環氧接縫則記錄批號、溫度與適用時間，並檢查擠出是否沿全周連續。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In the yard, inspect shear-key integrity and face cleanliness after each segment is stripped, and dry-fit before erection; for epoxy joints, record lot, temperature and pot life and check that squeeze-out is continuous round the perimeter. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Match-cast joints: dry and epoxy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剪力鍵與乾接縫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shear keys and dry joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 剪力鍵在運輸或吊裝時崩角而未修補，接縫局部承壓集中，張拉時可能進一步崩裂；乾接縫若殘餘壓應力不足，重車通過時接縫反覆微開，箱內積水沿底板流向錨碇區，成為腐蝕源頭。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shear keys chipped in transport or lifting and left unrepaired concentrate bearing and can spall further during stressing; dry joints with too little residual compression breathe open under heavy trucks, letting water collect inside the box and run along the bottom slab to the anchorages, starting corrosion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：乾接縫施工快、不受天候影響，但接縫沒有任何抗拉能力，也不能防水，因此需要較高的殘餘壓應力與更好的箱內防水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dry joints are fast and weather-independent, but they have no tensile capacity and no water-tightness, so they need higher residual compression and better waterproofing of the box.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「乾接縫只是少塗一層環氧，結構行為與環氧接縫完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dry joint is just an epoxy joint without the epoxy and behaves identically." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 剪力鍵在運輸或吊裝時崩角而未修補，接縫局部承壓集中，張拉時可能進一步崩裂；乾接縫若殘餘壓應力不足，重車通過時接縫反覆微開，箱內積水沿底板流向錨碇區，成為腐蝕源頭。
knowledge.textEn: Shear keys chipped in transport or lifting and left unrepaired concentrate bearing and can spall further during stressing; dry joints with too little residual compression breathe open under heavy trucks, letting water collect inside the box and run along the bottom slab to the anchorages, starting corrosion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Match-cast joints: dry and epoxy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 剪力鍵在運輸或吊裝時崩角而未修補，接縫局部承壓集中，張拉時可能進一步崩裂。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。
optionsEn: Shear keys chipped in transport or lifting and left unrepaired concentrate bearing and can spall further during stressing.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement.
quiz.explanation: 剪力鍵在運輸或吊裝時崩角而未修補，接縫局部承壓集中，張拉時可能進一步崩裂；乾接縫若殘餘壓應力不足，重車通過時接縫反覆微開，箱內積水沿底板流向錨碇區，成為腐蝕源頭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shear keys chipped in transport or lifting and left unrepaired concentrate bearing and can spall further during stressing; dry joints with too little residual compression breathe open under heavy trucks, letting water collect inside the box and run along the bottom slab to the anchorages, starting corrosion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Deviators and anchorages for external tendons: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「轉向塊與錨碇橫隔」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 體外鋼腱位於箱梁內部但不埋在混凝土中，只在端部錨碇橫隔與跨內轉向塊與結構接觸。鋼腱在轉向塊轉折時，會對轉向塊施加向上與向內的集中力，轉向塊必須以鋼筋把這股力吊掛回腹板與頂板；錨碇橫隔則要把整束鋼腱的集中力擴散到整個箱梁斷面。轉向處預埋彎曲鋼管，彎曲半徑與出口喇叭口要能避免鋼絞線在邊緣受到尖角磨損。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「轉向塊與錨碇橫隔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External tendons run inside the box but are not embedded in concrete; they touch the structure only at end anchorage diaphragms and intermediate deviators. Where a tendon changes direction at a deviator it pushes upward and inward with a concentrated force that the deviator reinforcement must hang back into the webs and top slab, while the anchorage diaphragm must spread the full tendon force into the whole box section. Deviators contain preformed curved steel pipes whose radius and flared exits prevent strands from being nicked on sharp edges. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：轉向力 F = 2P·sin(θ/2)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Deviation force F = 2P·sin(θ/2).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「轉向塊與錨碇橫隔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇
knowledge.titleEn: Deviators and anchorages for external tendons
knowledge.text: 體外鋼腱位於箱梁內部但不埋在混凝土中，只在端部錨碇橫隔與跨內轉向塊與結構接觸。鋼腱在轉向塊轉折時，會對轉向塊施加向上與向內的集中力，轉向塊必須以鋼筋把這股力吊掛回腹板與頂板；錨碇橫隔則要把整束鋼腱的集中力擴散到整個箱梁斷面。
knowledge.textEn: External tendons run inside the box but are not embedded in concrete; they touch the structure only at end anchorage diaphragms and intermediate deviators. Where a tendon changes direction at a deviator it pushes upward and inward with a concentrated force that the deviator reinforcement must hang back into the webs and top slab, while the anchorage diaphragm must spread the full tendon force into the whole box section.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deviators and anchorages for external tendons" is correct?
options: 體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。
體外鋼腱位於箱梁內部但不埋在混凝土中，只在端部錨碇橫隔與跨內轉向塊與結構接觸。
架橋機本身很重，所以推進時不可能傾覆。
optionsEn: Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement.
External tendons run inside the box but are not embedded in concrete; they touch the structure only at end anchorage diaphragms and intermediate deviators.
A gantry is so heavy that it cannot overturn while launching.
quiz.explanation: 體外鋼腱位於箱梁內部但不埋在混凝土中，只在端部錨碇橫隔與跨內轉向塊與結構接觸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: External tendons run inside the box but are not embedded in concrete; they touch the structure only at end anchorage diaphragms and intermediate deviators. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deviators and anchorages for external tendons: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉向塊與錨碇橫隔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：轉向力 F = 2P·sin(θ/2)。每束張拉時 P = 3,711 kN、轉角 θ = 0.10 rad：F = 2×3,711×sin(0.05) ≈ 371 kN；一側腹板 6 束合計約 2,226 kN，轉向塊吊筋須以此力加上設計放大係數配置。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Deviation force F = 2P·sin(θ/2). With P = 3,711 kN per tendon at jacking and θ = 0.10 rad, F = 2×3,711×sin(0.05) ≈ 371 kN; six tendons on one web give about 2,226 kN, which the deviator hanger reinforcement must carry with the design load factor. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：預製轉向塊節塊時，以三維量測確認預埋彎管的進出口座標與角度，與鋼腱線形圖比對；張拉後檢查轉向塊周邊混凝土是否出現放射狀或沿腹板的裂縫，並記錄寬度作為基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: When casting deviator segments, survey the entry and exit coordinates and angles of the curved pipes in 3D and compare them with the tendon profile drawings; after stressing, inspect concrete around deviators for radial cracks or cracks along the webs and record widths as a baseline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 轉向力 F = 2P·sin(θ/2)。每束張拉時 P = 3,711 kN、轉角 θ = 0.10 rad：F = 2×3,711×sin(0.05) ≈ 371 kN；一側腹板 6 束合計約 2,226 kN，轉向塊吊筋須以此力加上設計放大係數配置。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Deviation force F = 2P·sin(θ/2). With P = 3,711 kN per tendon at jacking and θ = 0.10 rad, F = 2×3,711×sin(0.05) ≈ 371 kN; six tendons on one web give about 2,226 kN, which the deviator hanger reinforcement must carry with the design load factor. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deviators and anchorages for external tendons", which statement holds?
options: 預製場的模板精度夠高，就不需要逐塊量測幾何。
體外鋼腱有 HDPE 套管保護，所以不會腐蝕。
轉向力 F = 2P·sin(θ/2)。
optionsEn: If the yard forms are accurate enough, segment geometry need not be surveyed one by one.
External tendons in HDPE sheaths cannot corrode.
Deviation force F = 2P·sin(θ/2).
quiz.explanation: 轉向力 F = 2P·sin(θ/2)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Deviation force F = 2P·sin(θ/2). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deviators and anchorages for external tendons: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉向塊與錨碇橫隔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 預製轉向塊節塊時，以三維量測確認預埋彎管的進出口座標與角度，與鋼腱線形圖比對；張拉後檢查轉向塊周邊混凝土是否出現放射狀或沿腹板的裂縫，並記錄寬度作為基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: When casting deviator segments, survey the entry and exit coordinates and angles of the curved pipes in 3D and compare them with the tendon profile drawings; after stressing, inspect concrete around deviators for radial cracks or cracks along the webs and record widths as a baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：轉向塊與錨碇節塊屬於關鍵節塊，預製時應有專屬檢查表（彎管座標、鋼筋、混凝土強度），並保留量測紀錄隨節塊編號歸檔；彎管出口須有圓滑過渡並經監造逐一確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Deviator and anchorage segments are critical segments that need dedicated checklists in the yard (pipe coordinates, reinforcement, concrete strength), with survey records filed under each segment number; pipe exits must have smooth transitions confirmed one by one by the supervising engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：彎管角度或位置錯誤使鋼腱在出口處形成尖角折線，鋼絞線外層 HDPE 套管被磨破，長期振動下套管破損處成為腐蝕點；轉向塊吊筋不足則在張拉時把轉向塊從腹板拉出裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A pipe set at the wrong angle or position kinks the tendon at the exit, wearing through the HDPE sheath, and under long-term vibration the damaged sheath becomes a corrosion point; insufficient hanger reinforcement lets the stressing force crack the deviator away from the web. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 預製轉向塊節塊時，以三維量測確認預埋彎管的進出口座標與角度，與鋼腱線形圖比對；張拉後檢查轉向塊周邊混凝土是否出現放射狀或沿腹板的裂縫，並記錄寬度作為基準。
knowledge.textEn: When casting deviator segments, survey the entry and exit coordinates and angles of the curved pipes in 3D and compare them with the tendon profile drawings; after stressing, inspect concrete around deviators for radial cracks or cracks along the webs and record widths as a baseline.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 轉向塊與錨碇節塊屬於關鍵節塊，預製時應有專屬檢查表（彎管座標、鋼筋、混凝土強度），並保留量測紀錄隨節塊編號歸檔；彎管出口須有圓滑過渡並經監造逐一確認。
knowledge.textEn: Deviator and anchorage segments are critical segments that need dedicated checklists in the yard (pipe coordinates, reinforcement, concrete strength), with survey records filed under each segment number; pipe exits must have smooth transitions confirmed one by one by the supervising engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deviators and anchorages for external tendons"?
options: 預製轉向塊節塊時，以三維量測確認預埋彎管的進出口座標與角度，與鋼腱線形圖比對；張拉後檢查轉向塊周邊混凝土是否出現放射狀或沿腹板的裂縫，並記錄寬度作為基準。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。
optionsEn: When casting deviator segments, survey the entry and exit coordinates and angles of the curved pipes in 3D and compare them with the tendon profile drawings.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete.
quiz.explanation: 預製轉向塊節塊時，以三維量測確認預埋彎管的進出口座標與角度，與鋼腱線形圖比對；張拉後檢查轉向塊周邊混凝土是否出現放射狀或沿腹板的裂縫，並記錄寬度作為基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: When casting deviator segments, survey the entry and exit coordinates and angles of the curved pipes in 3D and compare them with the tendon profile drawings; after stressing, inspect concrete around deviators for radial cracks or cracks along the webs and record widths as a baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deviators and anchorages for external tendons: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉向塊與錨碇橫隔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 彎管角度或位置錯誤使鋼腱在出口處形成尖角折線，鋼絞線外層 HDPE 套管被磨破，長期振動下套管破損處成為腐蝕點；轉向塊吊筋不足則在張拉時把轉向塊從腹板拉出裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A pipe set at the wrong angle or position kinks the tendon at the exit, wearing through the HDPE sheath, and under long-term vibration the damaged sheath becomes a corrosion point; insufficient hanger reinforcement lets the stressing force crack the deviator away from the web. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：轉向處預埋彎曲鋼管，彎曲半徑與出口喇叭口要能避免鋼絞線在邊緣受到尖角磨損。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Deviators contain preformed curved steel pipes whose radius and flared exits prevent strands from being nicked on sharp edges.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 彎管角度或位置錯誤使鋼腱在出口處形成尖角折線，鋼絞線外層 HDPE 套管被磨破，長期振動下套管破損處成為腐蝕點；轉向塊吊筋不足則在張拉時把轉向塊從腹板拉出裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: A pipe set at the wrong angle or position kinks the tendon at the exit, wearing through the HDPE sheath, and under long-term vibration the damaged sheath becomes a corrosion point; insufficient hanger reinforcement lets the stressing force crack the deviator away from the web.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deviators and anchorages for external tendons" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
彎管角度或位置錯誤使鋼腱在出口處形成尖角折線，鋼絞線外層 HDPE 套管被磨破，長期振動下套管破損處成為腐蝕點；轉向塊吊筋不足則在張拉時把轉向塊從腹板拉出裂縫。
架橋機本身很重，所以推進時不可能傾覆。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A pipe set at the wrong angle or position kinks the tendon at the exit, wearing through the HDPE sheath, and under long-term vibration the damaged sheath becomes a corrosion point.
A gantry is so heavy that it cannot overturn while launching.
quiz.explanation: 彎管角度或位置錯誤使鋼腱在出口處形成尖角折線，鋼絞線外層 HDPE 套管被磨破，長期振動下套管破損處成為腐蝕點；轉向塊吊筋不足則在張拉時把轉向塊從腹板拉出裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A pipe set at the wrong angle or position kinks the tendon at the exit, wearing through the HDPE sheath, and under long-term vibration the damaged sheath becomes a corrosion point; insufficient hanger reinforcement lets the stressing force crack the deviator away from the web. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆」與「整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gantry launching, cantilevering and overturning" and "Span assembly, stressing and load transfer": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Gantry launching, cantilevering and overturning: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「架橋機推進穩定」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gantry launching stability” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 架橋機完成一跨後，要把主桁推向下一座橋墩：推進過程中主桁前端有一段很長的懸臂，重心必須始終位於後支點之內，否則整機前傾。推進時通常先把前支腿收起，主桁以後支點與中支點滑移，到達下一墩後放下前支腿，再移動後支腿。推進作業的風速限制、縱坡與彎道造成的側向分力、以及支腿與墩頂的錨定，都是決定能否安全推進的條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「架橋機推進穩定」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After completing a span, the gantry girder must be pushed to the next pier; during launching its front end becomes a long cantilever, and the centre of gravity must always stay inside the rear support or the machine tips forward. The front leg is usually lifted, the girder slides on rear and middle supports, the front leg is lowered on reaching the next pier, and then the rear leg is moved. Wind-speed limits, longitudinal gradient, lateral components on curves and the anchorage of legs to the pier top all decide whether launching is safe. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gantry launching stability” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a girder weight q = 60 kN/m, 50 m behind the pivot and a 42 m front cantilever: overturning moment M_o = 60×42²/2 = 52,920 kN·m, restoring moment M_r = 60×50²/2 = 75,000 kN·m, factor 75,000/52,920 ≈ 1.42.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「架橋機本身很重，所以推進時不可能傾覆。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A gantry is so heavy that it cannot overturn while launching." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「架橋機推進穩定」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gantry launching stability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆
knowledge.text: 架橋機完成一跨後，要把主桁推向下一座橋墩：推進過程中主桁前端有一段很長的懸臂，重心必須始終位於後支點之內，否則整機前傾。推進時通常先把前支腿收起，主桁以後支點與中支點滑移，到達下一墩後放下前支腿，再移動後支腿。
knowledge.textEn: After completing a span, the gantry girder must be pushed to the next pier; during launching its front end becomes a long cantilever, and the centre of gravity must always stay inside the rear support or the machine tips forward. The front leg is usually lifted, the girder slides on rear and middle supports, the front leg is lowered on reaching the next pier, and then the rear leg is moved.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：架橋機本身很重，所以推進時不可能傾覆。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A gantry is so heavy that it cannot overturn while launching. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gantry launching, cantilevering and overturning" is correct?
options: 架橋機本身很重，所以推進時不可能傾覆。
張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。
架橋機完成一跨後，要把主桁推向下一座橋墩：推進過程中主桁前端有一段很長的懸臂，重心必須始終位於後支點之內，否則整機前傾。
optionsEn: A gantry is so heavy that it cannot overturn while launching.
After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings.
After completing a span, the gantry girder must be pushed to the next pier.
quiz.explanation: 架橋機完成一跨後，要把主桁推向下一座橋墩：推進過程中主桁前端有一段很長的懸臂，重心必須始終位於後支點之內，否則整機前傾。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After completing a span, the gantry girder must be pushed to the next pier; during launching its front end becomes a long cantilever, and the centre of gravity must always stay inside the rear support or the machine tips forward. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gantry launching, cantilevering and overturning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「架橋機推進穩定」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gantry launching stability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主桁均布重 q = 60 kN/m，後段 50 m、前懸臂 42 m：傾覆彎矩 M_o = 60×42²/2 = 52,920 kN·m，抵抗彎矩 M_r = 60×50²/2 = 75,000 kN·m，安全係數 75,000/52,920 ≈ 1.42。若要求 1.5，需增加 1.5×52,920 − 75,000 = 4,380 kN·m，於後端 50 m 處加配重 4,380/50 ≈ 88 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a girder weight q = 60 kN/m, 50 m behind the pivot and a 42 m front cantilever: overturning moment M_o = 60×42²/2 = 52,920 kN·m, restoring moment M_r = 60×50²/2 = 75,000 kN·m, factor 75,000/52,920 ≈ 1.42. To reach 1.5, add 1.5×52,920 − 75,000 = 4,380 kN·m, i.e. a counterweight of 4,380/50 ≈ 88 kN at the rear end. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：推進前依檢查表確認：風速低於上限、支腿與軌道錨定、配重位置、液壓與制動系統、前支腿與下一墩的對位標記；推進中由專人監看前端下撓與後支點反力讀值，若反力接近零（將失去抵抗）立即停止。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before launching, a checklist confirms wind below the limit, leg and rail anchorage, counterweight position, hydraulic and braking systems, and alignment marks between the front leg and the next pier; during launching an assigned person watches front-end deflection and rear-support reaction readings, and stops immediately if the rear reaction approaches zero.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With a girder weight q = 60 kN/m, 50 m behind the pivot and a 42 m front cantilever: overturning moment M_o = 60×42²/2 = 52,920 kN·m, restoring moment M_r = 60×50²/2 = 75,000 kN·m, factor 75,000/52,920 ≈ 1.42. To reach 1.5, add 1.5×52,920 − 75,000 = 4,380 kN·m, i.e. a counterweight of 4,380/50 ≈ 88 kN at the rear end. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gantry launching, cantilevering and overturning", which statement holds?
options: 體外鋼腱張拉完成後力量不會改變，所以不需要再量測。
接縫出現滲水只是防水問題，與結構無關。
optionsEn: With a girder weight q = 60 kN/m, 50 m behind the pivot and a 42 m front cantilever: overturning moment M_o = 60×42²/2 = 52,920 kN·m, restoring moment M_r = 60×50²/2 = 75,000 kN·m, factor 75,000/52,920 ≈ 1.42.
Once stressed, an external tendon's force never changes, so it need not be measured again.
Water seeping at a segment joint is only a waterproofing issue with no structural meaning.
quiz.explanation: 主桁均布重 q = 60 kN/m，後段 50 m、前懸臂 42 m：傾覆彎矩 M_o = 60×42²/2 = 52,920 kN·m，抵抗彎矩 M_r = 60×50²/2 = 75,000 kN·m，安全係數 75,000/52,920 ≈ 1.42。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a girder weight q = 60 kN/m, 50 m behind the pivot and a 42 m front cantilever: overturning moment M_o = 60×42²/2 = 52,920 kN·m, restoring moment M_r = 60×50²/2 = 75,000 kN·m, factor 75,000/52,920 ≈ 1.42. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gantry launching, cantilevering and overturning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「架橋機推進穩定」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gantry launching stability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 推進前依檢查表確認：風速低於上限、支腿與軌道錨定、配重位置、液壓與制動系統、前支腿與下一墩的對位標記；推進中由專人監看前端下撓與後支點反力讀值，若反力接近零（將失去抵抗）立即停止。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before launching, a checklist confirms wind below the limit, leg and rail anchorage, counterweight position, hydraulic and braking systems, and alignment marks between the front leg and the next pier; during launching an assigned person watches front-end deflection and rear-support reaction readings, and stops immediately if the rear reaction approaches zero. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：架橋機的組立、首次推進與每次推進列為停留點，須由架橋機設計者提供推進程序與安全係數計算，並由專業技師與監造簽認；颱風季應訂定停機錨定程序與撤離條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Gantry assembly, first launch and every launch are hold points; the gantry designer must provide the launching procedure and stability calculation, signed off by a qualified engineer and the supervising engineer, and a parking, anchoring and evacuation procedure is set for the typhoon season.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：推進時忘記把上一跨的配重或吊具移回後端，或在超過風速限制時強行推進，主桁前傾觸及下一墩或墜落；在彎道或縱坡上推進而未設側向與下滑止擋，也曾導致架橋機滑移出軌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Forgetting to move counterweights or lifting gear back after the previous span, or pushing beyond the wind limit, can tip the girder onto the next pier or drop it; launching on curves or gradients without lateral and downhill stops has also let gantries slide off their rails. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 推進前依檢查表確認：風速低於上限、支腿與軌道錨定、配重位置、液壓與制動系統、前支腿與下一墩的對位標記；推進中由專人監看前端下撓與後支點反力讀值，若反力接近零（將失去抵抗）立即停止。
knowledge.textEn: Before launching, a checklist confirms wind below the limit, leg and rail anchorage, counterweight position, hydraulic and braking systems, and alignment marks between the front leg and the next pier; during launching an assigned person watches front-end deflection and rear-support reaction readings, and stops immediately if the rear reaction approaches zero.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 架橋機的組立、首次推進與每次推進列為停留點，須由架橋機設計者提供推進程序與安全係數計算，並由專業技師與監造簽認；颱風季應訂定停機錨定程序與撤離條件。
knowledge.textEn: Gantry assembly, first launch and every launch are hold points; the gantry designer must provide the launching procedure and stability calculation, signed off by a qualified engineer and the supervising engineer, and a parking, anchoring and evacuation procedure is set for the typhoon season.

quiz.question: 要驗證「架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gantry launching, cantilevering and overturning"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
推進前依檢查表確認：風速低於上限、支腿與軌道錨定、配重位置、液壓與制動系統、前支腿與下一墩的對位標記。
架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

Before launching, a checklist confirms wind below the limit, leg and rail anchorage, counterweight position, hydraulic and braking systems, and alignment marks between the front leg and the next pier.
Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient.
quiz.explanation: 推進前依檢查表確認：風速低於上限、支腿與軌道錨定、配重位置、液壓與制動系統、前支腿與下一墩的對位標記；推進中由專人監看前端下撓與後支點反力讀值，若反力接近零（將失去抵抗）立即停止。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before launching, a checklist confirms wind below the limit, leg and rail anchorage, counterweight position, hydraulic and braking systems, and alignment marks between the front leg and the next pier; during launching an assigned person watches front-end deflection and rear-support reaction readings, and stops immediately if the rear reaction approaches zero. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gantry launching, cantilevering and overturning: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「架橋機推進穩定」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gantry launching stability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 推進時忘記把上一跨的配重或吊具移回後端，或在超過風速限制時強行推進，主桁前傾觸及下一墩或墜落；在彎道或縱坡上推進而未設側向與下滑止擋，也曾導致架橋機滑移出軌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Forgetting to move counterweights or lifting gear back after the previous span, or pushing beyond the wind limit, can tip the girder onto the next pier or drop it; launching on curves or gradients without lateral and downhill stops has also let gantries slide off their rails. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：推進作業的風速限制、縱坡與彎道造成的側向分力、以及支腿與墩頂的錨定，都是決定能否安全推進的條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wind-speed limits, longitudinal gradient, lateral components on curves and the anchorage of legs to the pier top all decide whether launching is safe.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「架橋機本身很重，所以推進時不可能傾覆。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A gantry is so heavy that it cannot overturn while launching." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 推進時忘記把上一跨的配重或吊具移回後端，或在超過風速限制時強行推進，主桁前傾觸及下一墩或墜落；在彎道或縱坡上推進而未設側向與下滑止擋，也曾導致架橋機滑移出軌。
knowledge.textEn: Forgetting to move counterweights or lifting gear back after the previous span, or pushing beyond the wind limit, can tip the girder onto the next pier or drop it; launching on curves or gradients without lateral and downhill stops has also let gantries slide off their rails.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gantry launching, cantilevering and overturning" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。
推進時忘記把上一跨的配重或吊具移回後端，或在超過風速限制時強行推進，主桁前傾觸及下一墩或墜落；在彎道或縱坡上推進而未設側向與下滑止擋，也曾導致架橋機滑移出軌。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings.
Forgetting to move counterweights or lifting gear back after the previous span, or pushing beyond the wind limit, can tip the girder onto the next pier or drop it.
quiz.explanation: 推進時忘記把上一跨的配重或吊具移回後端，或在超過風速限制時強行推進，主桁前傾觸及下一墩或墜落；在彎道或縱坡上推進而未設側向與下滑止擋，也曾導致架橋機滑移出軌。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Forgetting to move counterweights or lifting gear back after the previous span, or pushing beyond the wind limit, can tip the girder onto the next pier or drop it; launching on curves or gradients without lateral and downhill stops has also let gantries slide off their rails. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Span assembly, stressing and load transfer: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「整跨荷重轉換」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Whole-span load transfer” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 節塊依序吊掛到架橋機後，先以吊桿或千斤頂調整每一塊的高程、橫坡與接縫間隙，使整跨符合預定的預拱線形；墩頂常留一道現澆濕接縫吸收累積誤差。張拉完成時，梁體因預力上拱而逐漸離開吊桿，荷重從架橋機轉移到永久支承。若轉換過程不同步，部分吊桿突然卸載或過載，梁端支承也可能一端先受力，造成扭轉與支承偏壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「整跨荷重轉換」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Segments are hung on the gantry in sequence, and hangers or jacks adjust each one's level, cross-fall and joint gap so the span follows the intended camber; a cast-in-place wet joint at the pier often absorbs accumulated error. As stressing completes, the girder cambers up off the hangers and its weight transfers from the gantry to the permanent bearings. If the transfer is not synchronised, some hangers unload or overload suddenly and one end bearing may pick up load first, causing twist and uneven bearing pressure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Whole-span load transfer” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以等偏心近似，預力上拱 δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI)，自重下撓 δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a constant-eccentricity approximation, prestress camber δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI) and self-weight deflection δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「整跨荷重轉換」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Whole-span load transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換
knowledge.titleEn: Span assembly, stressing and load transfer
knowledge.text: 節塊依序吊掛到架橋機後，先以吊桿或千斤頂調整每一塊的高程、橫坡與接縫間隙，使整跨符合預定的預拱線形；墩頂常留一道現澆濕接縫吸收累積誤差。張拉完成時，梁體因預力上拱而逐漸離開吊桿，荷重從架橋機轉移到永久支承。
knowledge.textEn: Segments are hung on the gantry in sequence, and hangers or jacks adjust each one's level, cross-fall and joint gap so the span follows the intended camber; a cast-in-place wet joint at the pier often absorbs accumulated error. As stressing completes, the girder cambers up off the hangers and its weight transfers from the gantry to the permanent bearings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Span assembly, stressing and load transfer" is correct?
options: 節塊依序吊掛到架橋機後，先以吊桿或千斤頂調整每一塊的高程、橫坡與接縫間隙，使整跨符合預定的預拱線形；墩頂常留一道現澆濕接縫吸收累積誤差。
張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。
預製場的模板精度夠高，就不需要逐塊量測幾何。
optionsEn: Segments are hung on the gantry in sequence, and hangers or jacks adjust each one's level, cross-fall and joint gap so the span follows the intended camber.
After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings.
If the yard forms are accurate enough, segment geometry need not be surveyed one by one.
quiz.explanation: 節塊依序吊掛到架橋機後，先以吊桿或千斤頂調整每一塊的高程、橫坡與接縫間隙，使整跨符合預定的預拱線形；墩頂常留一道現澆濕接縫吸收累積誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Segments are hung on the gantry in sequence, and hangers or jacks adjust each one's level, cross-fall and joint gap so the span follows the intended camber; a cast-in-place wet joint at the pier often absorbs accumulated error. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Span assembly, stressing and load transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「整跨荷重轉換」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Whole-span load transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以等偏心近似，預力上拱 δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI)，自重下撓 δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI)。EI = 35,000 MPa × 3.0 m⁴ = 1.05×10⁸ kN·m²：δ_P = 43,200×1.0×42²/(8×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 90.7 mm，δ_g = 5×180×42⁴/(384×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 69.5 mm，淨上拱約 21 mm，表示梁體會自行離開吊桿。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a constant-eccentricity approximation, prestress camber δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI) and self-weight deflection δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI). For EI = 35,000 MPa × 3.0 m⁴ = 1.05×10⁸ kN·m², δ_P = 43,200×1.0×42²/(8×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 90.7 mm and δ_g = 5×180×42⁴/(384×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 69.5 mm, a net upward camber of about 21 mm, so the girder lifts itself off the hangers. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：張拉依設計順序左右對稱分級進行，每一級記錄吊桿荷重、梁端高程與跨中高程；最終淨上拱與計算值比較（例如偏差超過 ±20% 即暫停查明），並確認四個支承都已受力、無懸空。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Stress symmetrically in design order and in stages, recording hanger loads, end levels and midspan level at each stage; compare the final net camber with calculation, pausing to investigate if it deviates by more than, for example, ±20%, and confirm all four bearings carry load with none hanging free.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以等偏心近似，預力上拱 δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI)，自重下撓 δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI)。EI = 35,000 MPa × 3.0 m⁴ = 1.05×10⁸ kN·m²：δ_P = 43,200×1.0×42²/(8×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 90.7 mm，δ_g = 5×180×42⁴/(384×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 69.5 mm，淨上拱約 21 mm，表示梁體會自行離開吊桿。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a constant-eccentricity approximation, prestress camber δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI) and self-weight deflection δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI). For EI = 35,000 MPa × 3.0 m⁴ = 1.05×10⁸ kN·m², δ_P = 43,200×1.0×42²/(8×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 90.7 mm and δ_g = 5×180×42⁴/(384×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 69.5 mm, a net upward camber of about 21 mm, so the girder lifts itself off the hangers. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Span assembly, stressing and load transfer", which statement holds?
options: 體外鋼腱有 HDPE 套管保護，所以不會腐蝕。
以等偏心近似，預力上拱 δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI)，自重下撓 δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI)。
逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。
optionsEn: External tendons in HDPE sheaths cannot corrode.
With a constant-eccentricity approximation, prestress camber δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI) and self-weight deflection δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI).
Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete.
quiz.explanation: 以等偏心近似，預力上拱 δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI)，自重下撓 δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a constant-eccentricity approximation, prestress camber δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI) and self-weight deflection δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Span assembly, stressing and load transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「整跨荷重轉換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Whole-span load transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 張拉依設計順序左右對稱分級進行，每一級記錄吊桿荷重、梁端高程與跨中高程；最終淨上拱與計算值比較（例如偏差超過 ±20% 即暫停查明），並確認四個支承都已受力、無懸空。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Stress symmetrically in design order and in stages, recording hanger loads, end levels and midspan level at each stage; compare the final net camber with calculation, pausing to investigate if it deviates by more than, for example, ±20%, and confirm all four bearings carry load with none hanging free. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：架設程序書要包含節塊吊掛順序、線形調整允差、濕接縫澆置條件、張拉順序與吊桿卸載步驟，荷重轉換列為停留點；支承墊石高程在架設前複測並留下紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The erection procedure should include segment hanging order, alignment tolerances, wet-joint casting conditions, stressing order and hanger release steps, with load transfer as a hold point; bearing plinth levels are re-surveyed and recorded before erection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若單側鋼腱先全部張拉，箱梁產生側彎與扭轉，接縫一側張開；支承墊石高程不一時，張拉後一個支承懸空，梁體成為三點支承，在活載下搖動並使支承與墊石受衝擊損壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stressing all tendons on one side first bends and twists the box sideways and opens joints on one side; uneven plinth levels leave one bearing unloaded after stressing, so the span rocks on three supports under traffic, hammering and damaging bearings and plinths. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 張拉依設計順序左右對稱分級進行，每一級記錄吊桿荷重、梁端高程與跨中高程；最終淨上拱與計算值比較（例如偏差超過 ±20% 即暫停查明），並確認四個支承都已受力、無懸空。
knowledge.textEn: Stress symmetrically in design order and in stages, recording hanger loads, end levels and midspan level at each stage; compare the final net camber with calculation, pausing to investigate if it deviates by more than, for example, ±20%, and confirm all four bearings carry load with none hanging free.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 架設程序書要包含節塊吊掛順序、線形調整允差、濕接縫澆置條件、張拉順序與吊桿卸載步驟，荷重轉換列為停留點；支承墊石高程在架設前複測並留下紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: The erection procedure should include segment hanging order, alignment tolerances, wet-joint casting conditions, stressing order and hanger release steps, with load transfer as a hold point; bearing plinth levels are re-surveyed and recorded before erection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Span assembly, stressing and load transfer"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
乾接縫只是少塗一層環氧，結構行為與環氧接縫完全相同。
張拉依設計順序左右對稱分級進行，每一級記錄吊桿荷重、梁端高程與跨中高程。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A dry joint is just an epoxy joint without the epoxy and behaves identically.
Stress symmetrically in design order and in stages, recording hanger loads, end levels and midspan level at each stage.
quiz.explanation: 張拉依設計順序左右對稱分級進行，每一級記錄吊桿荷重、梁端高程與跨中高程；最終淨上拱與計算值比較（例如偏差超過 ±20% 即暫停查明），並確認四個支承都已受力、無懸空。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Stress symmetrically in design order and in stages, recording hanger loads, end levels and midspan level at each stage; compare the final net camber with calculation, pausing to investigate if it deviates by more than, for example, ±20%, and confirm all four bearings carry load with none hanging free. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Span assembly, stressing and load transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「整跨荷重轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Whole-span load transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若單側鋼腱先全部張拉，箱梁產生側彎與扭轉，接縫一側張開；支承墊石高程不一時，張拉後一個支承懸空，梁體成為三點支承，在活載下搖動並使支承與墊石受衝擊損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stressing all tendons on one side first bends and twists the box sideways and opens joints on one side; uneven plinth levels leave one bearing unloaded after stressing, so the span rocks on three supports under traffic, hammering and damaging bearings and plinths. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若轉換過程不同步，部分吊桿突然卸載或過載，梁端支承也可能一端先受力，造成扭轉與支承偏壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If the transfer is not synchronised, some hangers unload or overload suddenly and one end bearing may pick up load first, causing twist and uneven bearing pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若單側鋼腱先全部張拉，箱梁產生側彎與扭轉，接縫一側張開；支承墊石高程不一時，張拉後一個支承懸空，梁體成為三點支承，在活載下搖動並使支承與墊石受衝擊損壞。
knowledge.textEn: Stressing all tendons on one side first bends and twists the box sideways and opens joints on one side; uneven plinth levels leave one bearing unloaded after stressing, so the span rocks on three supports under traffic, hammering and damaging bearings and plinths.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Span assembly, stressing and load transfer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若單側鋼腱先全部張拉，箱梁產生側彎與扭轉，接縫一側張開；支承墊石高程不一時，張拉後一個支承懸空，梁體成為三點支承，在活載下搖動並使支承與墊石受衝擊損壞。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
預製場的模板精度夠高，就不需要逐塊量測幾何。
optionsEn: Stressing all tendons on one side first bends and twists the box sideways and opens joints on one side.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the yard forms are accurate enough, segment geometry need not be surveyed one by one.
quiz.explanation: 若單側鋼腱先全部張拉，箱梁產生側彎與扭轉，接縫一側張開；支承墊石高程不一時，張拉後一個支承懸空，梁體成為三點支承，在活載下搖動並使支承與墊石受衝擊損壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Stressing all tendons on one side first bends and twists the box sideways and opens joints on one side; uneven plinth levels leave one bearing unloaded after stressing, so the span rocks on three supports under traffic, hammering and damaging bearings and plinths. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制」與「體外鋼腱力量的驗收量測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Short-line match casting and curve control" and "Acceptance measurement of external tendon force": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Short-line match casting and curve control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預製場匹配幾何」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Casting-yard match geometry” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大量逐跨節塊多在短線法預製台座生產：固定端模不動，前一節塊作為匹配節塊移到相對位置，再澆製新節塊。平面曲線、縱坡與超高都靠每次調整匹配節塊的位置與角度來達成，所以預製場幾何控制其實是在把橋梁的三維線形分解成每一個接縫的微小轉角。Bang Na 高架道路的預製場設有約 100 個澆注台座，月產能約 1,800 個節塊，量測與資料管理的規模與一般工程截然不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預製場匹配幾何」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High-volume span-by-span segments are usually produced on short-line casting cells: the bulkhead stays fixed while the previously cast segment is moved into a relative position as the match-cast unit and the new segment is cast against it. Horizontal curves, gradients and superelevation are created by adjusting the position and angle of the match-cast unit each time, so yard geometry control decomposes the bridge's 3D alignment into small rotations at every joint. The Bang Na Expressway yard had about 100 casting cells with a capacity of about 1,800 segments per month, a scale of surveying and data management very different from ordinary jobs. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Casting-yard match geometry” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：平曲線半徑 R = 600 m、節塊長 s = 3.0 m：每接縫轉角 θ = s/R = 0.005 rad，節塊遠端相對切線的偏移 s²/(2R) = 9/1,200 = 7.5 mm；42 m 整跨的弦長與弧線中點差 L²/(8R) = 42²/4,800 ≈ 368 mm，決定箱內體外鋼腱與支承的平面位置。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a horizontal radius R = 600 m and segment length s = 3.0 m, each joint turns θ = s/R = 0.005 rad and the far end of a segment is offset s²/(2R) = 9/1,200 = 7.5 mm from the tangent; over a 42 m span the arc departs from the chord by L²/(8R) = 42²/4,800 ≈ 368 mm at midspan, which fixes the plan positions of external tendons and bearings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預製場的模板精度夠高，就不需要逐塊量測幾何。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the yard forms are accurate enough, segment geometry need not be surveyed one by one." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預製場匹配幾何」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Casting-yard match geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Short-line match casting and curve control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預製場匹配幾何」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Casting-yard match geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平曲線半徑 R = 600 m、節塊長 s = 3.0 m：每接縫轉角 θ = s/R = 0.005 rad，節塊遠端相對切線的偏移 s²/(2R) = 9/1,200 = 7.5 mm；42 m 整跨的弦長與弧線中點差 L²/(8R) = 42²/4,800 ≈ 368 mm，決定箱內體外鋼腱與支承的平面位置。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a horizontal radius R = 600 m and segment length s = 3.0 m, each joint turns θ = s/R = 0.005 rad and the far end of a segment is offset s²/(2R) = 9/1,200 = 7.5 mm from the tangent; over a 42 m span the arc departs from the chord by L²/(8R) = 42²/4,800 ≈ 368 mm at midspan, which fixes the plan positions of external tendons and bearings. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一節塊澆置前後由測量塔與固定控制點量測頂板控制點，計算實際轉角並與理論值比較，將誤差回饋到下一節塊的匹配位置（誤差不可累積）；每跨完成後計算整跨實際幾何，與設計線形比對並調整濕接縫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before and after each cast, survey top-slab control points from the survey tower and fixed benchmarks, compute the actual rotation and compare it with theory, feeding the error back into the next match position so errors do not accumulate; after each span, compute the as-cast span geometry, compare it with the design alignment and adjust the wet joint.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 平曲線半徑 R = 600 m、節塊長 s = 3.0 m：每接縫轉角 θ = s/R = 0.005 rad，節塊遠端相對切線的偏移 s²/(2R) = 9/1,200 = 7.5 mm；42 m 整跨的弦長與弧線中點差 L²/(8R) = 42²/4,800 ≈ 368 mm，決定箱內體外鋼腱與支承的平面位置。數值為教學假設。

Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Short-line match casting and curve control", which statement holds?
options: 接縫出現滲水只是防水問題，與結構無關。
架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。
平曲線半徑 R = 600 m、節塊長 s = 3.0 m：每接縫轉角 θ = s/R = 0.005 rad，節塊遠端相對切線的偏移 s²/(2R) = 9/1,200 = 7.5 mm。
optionsEn: Water seeping at a segment joint is only a waterproofing issue with no structural meaning.
Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient.
For a horizontal radius R = 600 m and segment length s = 3.0 m, each joint turns θ = s/R = 0.005 rad and the far end of a segment is offset s²/(2R) = 9/1,200 = 7.5 mm from the tangent.
quiz.explanation: 平曲線半徑 R = 600 m、節塊長 s = 3.0 m：每接縫轉角 θ = s/R = 0.005 rad，節塊遠端相對切線的偏移 s²/(2R) = 9/1,200 = 7.5 mm；42 m 整跨的弦長與弧線中點差 L²/(8R) = 42²/4,800 ≈ 368 mm，決定箱內體外鋼腱與支承的平面位置。 重算時請保留單位。

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Short-line match casting and curve control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預製場匹配幾何」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Casting-yard match geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一節塊澆置前後由測量塔與固定控制點量測頂板控制點，計算實際轉角並與理論值比較，將誤差回饋到下一節塊的匹配位置（誤差不可累積）；每跨完成後計算整跨實際幾何，與設計線形比對並調整濕接縫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before and after each cast, survey top-slab control points from the survey tower and fixed benchmarks, compute the actual rotation and compare it with theory, feeding the error back into the next match position so errors do not accumulate; after each span, compute the as-cast span geometry, compare it with the design alignment and adjust the wet joint. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預製場應有獨立的幾何控制工程師與專用軟體，每節塊產出一份經簽認的幾何紀錄並以節塊編號追蹤到架設位置；測量塔與控制點每月複核穩定性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The yard needs an independent geometry-control engineer and dedicated software, with a signed geometry record for every segment traced by segment number to its erected position; survey towers and benchmarks are checked for stability monthly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若預製場只照理論座標擺放匹配節塊而不回饋實測誤差，誤差逐塊累積，到現場整跨無法對準支承或下一跨，只能加大濕接縫或修鑿節塊，甚至報廢重做。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Placing match units by theoretical coordinates without feeding back measured errors lets errors accumulate segment by segment, so on site the span misses its bearings or the next span and needs a wider wet joint, grinding, or even a scrapped segment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每一節塊澆置前後由測量塔與固定控制點量測頂板控制點，計算實際轉角並與理論值比較，將誤差回饋到下一節塊的匹配位置（誤差不可累積）；每跨完成後計算整跨實際幾何，與設計線形比對並調整濕接縫。
knowledge.textEn: Before and after each cast, survey top-slab control points from the survey tower and fixed benchmarks, compute the actual rotation and compare it with theory, feeding the error back into the next match position so errors do not accumulate; after each span, compute the as-cast span geometry, compare it with the design alignment and adjust the wet joint.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預製場應有獨立的幾何控制工程師與專用軟體，每節塊產出一份經簽認的幾何紀錄並以節塊編號追蹤到架設位置；測量塔與控制點每月複核穩定性。
knowledge.textEn: The yard needs an independent geometry-control engineer and dedicated software, with a signed geometry record for every segment traced by segment number to its erected position; survey towers and benchmarks are checked for stability monthly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Short-line match casting and curve control"?
options: 每一節塊澆置前後由測量塔與固定控制點量測頂板控制點，計算實際轉角並與理論值比較，將誤差回饋到下一節塊的匹配位置（誤差不可累積）。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。
optionsEn: Before and after each cast, survey top-slab control points from the survey tower and fixed benchmarks, compute the actual rotation and compare it with theory, feeding the error back into the next match position so errors do not accumulate.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement.
quiz.explanation: 每一節塊澆置前後由測量塔與固定控制點量測頂板控制點，計算實際轉角並與理論值比較，將誤差回饋到下一節塊的匹配位置（誤差不可累積）；每跨完成後計算整跨實際幾何，與設計線形比對並調整濕接縫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Short-line match casting and curve control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預製場匹配幾何」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Casting-yard match geometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若預製場只照理論座標擺放匹配節塊而不回饋實測誤差，誤差逐塊累積，到現場整跨無法對準支承或下一跨，只能加大濕接縫或修鑿節塊，甚至報廢重做。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Placing match units by theoretical coordinates without feeding back measured errors lets errors accumulate segment by segment, so on site the span misses its bearings or the next span and needs a wider wet joint, grinding, or even a scrapped segment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Bang Na 高架道路的預製場設有約 100 個澆注台座，月產能約 1,800 個節塊，量測與資料管理的規模與一般工程截然不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Bang Na Expressway yard had about 100 casting cells with a capacity of about 1,800 segments per month, a scale of surveying and data management very different from ordinary jobs.

steps.objective: 說明「體外鋼腱振動頻率」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “External tendon vibration frequency” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 體外鋼腱在轉向塊之間是一段自由的張緊索，它的橫向自然頻率與張力直接相關，因此可以在張拉後以加速度計輕敲量測頻率，反算每一束的有效力，作為千斤頂讀值與伸長量之外的第三種獨立驗證。這個方法也能在營運期重複使用，追蹤預力損失或發現斷絲。量測需考慮套管與灌漿質量、端部約束與鋼腱抗彎勁度的影響，最好先以舉離試驗校正。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「體外鋼腱振動頻率」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Between deviators an external tendon is a free taut cable whose lateral natural frequency relates directly to its tension, so after stressing a light tap and an accelerometer give the frequency and hence the effective force of every tendon, a third independent check beyond jack readings and elongation. The measurement must account for the mass of sheath and grout, end restraint and tendon bending stiffness, ideally calibrated first by a lift-off test. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “External tendon vibration frequency” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：張緊弦 T = 4·m·L²·f²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Taut string T = 4·m·L²·f².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「體外鋼腱張拉完成後力量不會改變，所以不需要再量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
