steps.title: 體外鋼腱力量的驗收量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acceptance measurement of external tendon force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「體外鋼腱振動頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “External tendon vibration frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：張緊弦 T = 4·m·L²·f²。鋼腱含套管與灌漿 m = 31 kg/m、自由長 L = 10 m，實測基頻 f = 17.0 Hz：T = 4×31×10²×17.0² ≈ 3,584 kN，與設計有效力 3,600 kN 相差約 −0.4%。若頻率降為 16.0 Hz，T ≈ 3,174 kN，即損失約 12%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Taut string T = 4·m·L²·f². For a tendon with sheath and grout m = 31 kg/m, free length L = 10 m and measured fundamental f = 17.0 Hz, T = 4×31×10²×17.0² ≈ 3,584 kN, about −0.4% from the 3,600 kN design effective force. A frequency of 16.0 Hz would give T ≈ 3,174 kN, a loss of about 12%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每一跨所有體外鋼腱量測頻率並換算張力，與張拉紀錄比較；同一跨內各束差異超過設定門檻（例如 ±5%）時，以舉離試驗或補充量測確認，並把頻率基準值寫入竣工資料，供日後定期檢查比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure frequencies of all external tendons in each span and convert them to forces, compare with the stressing records, and if tendons in a span differ by more than a set threshold, for example ±5%, confirm by lift-off or further measurement; record baseline frequencies in the as-built file for later periodic comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 對每一跨所有體外鋼腱量測頻率並換算張力，與張拉紀錄比較；同一跨內各束差異超過設定門檻（例如 ±5%）時，以舉離試驗或補充量測確認，並把頻率基準值寫入竣工資料，供日後定期檢查比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure frequencies of all external tendons in each span and convert them to forces, compare with the stressing records, and if tendons in a span differ by more than a set threshold, for example ±5%, confirm by lift-off or further measurement; record baseline frequencies in the as-built file for later periodic comparison. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工資料要以表格列出每一束鋼腱的編號、張拉力、伸長量、量測頻率與換算張力，並說明量測時的溫度與校正方法，讓維護單位能用同一方法重測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: As-built records should tabulate every tendon's number, jacking force, elongation, measured frequency and derived force, with the temperature and calibration method, so the maintenance team can repeat the same measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用千斤頂讀值驗收而不量測個別鋼腱，某一束錨具滑絲或夾片未咬合的問題可能被掩蓋，日後該束力量明顯偏低，接縫殘餘壓應力不足而開始張開。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accepting only on jack readings, without measuring individual tendons, can hide a tendon whose strands slipped or whose wedges did not bite, leaving it well below force so that joint residual compression falls short and joints begin to open. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 若只用千斤頂讀值驗收而不量測個別鋼腱，某一束錨具滑絲或夾片未咬合的問題可能被掩蓋，日後該束力量明顯偏低，接縫殘餘壓應力不足而開始張開。
knowledge.textEn: Accepting only on jack readings, without measuring individual tendons, can hide a tendon whose strands slipped or whose wedges did not bite, leaving it well below force so that joint residual compression falls short and joints begin to open.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「體外鋼腱力量的驗收量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Acceptance measurement of external tendon force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「體外鋼腱防蝕與可更換設計」與「接縫行為監測與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrosion protection and replaceability of external tendons" and "Joint behaviour monitoring and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 體外鋼腱防蝕與可更換設計：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosion protection and replaceability of external tendons: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint compression after tendon loss” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 體外鋼腱的優點是看得到、可更換，但它的防蝕完全依賴 HDPE 套管、灌漿或填充材與錨頭保護蓋；套管破裂或灌漿有空洞時，水分與氯離子會在低點積聚，鋼絞線可在多年內腐蝕斷裂。1990 年代末至 2000 年前後，佛州數座分段橋的體外鋼腱曾因灌漿空洞與滲水而發現斷束，促成灌漿材料與施工規範的全面修訂。設計時必須假設某一束可能失效或需要更換，檢查其餘鋼腱是否仍能維持接縫受壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External tendons are visible and replaceable, but their corrosion protection depends entirely on the HDPE sheath, the grout or filler and the anchor caps; with a cracked sheath or grout voids, water and chlorides collect at low points and strands can corrode and break within years. Around the late 1990s and 2000, failed external tendons were found in several Florida segmental bridges with grout voids and water ingress, prompting broad revisions of grout materials and construction specifications. Design must assume that any one tendon may fail or need replacing and check that the rest still keep the joints in compression. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joint compression after tendon loss” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 12 tendons the bottom-fibre stresses are P/A = 43,200/7.2 = 6,000 kPa, Pe/S_b = 10,800 kPa and −12,679 kPa from self-weight and surfacing, leaving 4,121 kPa, so the live-load decompression moment is 4,121×4.0 ≈ 16,485 kN·m > 12,000.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「體外鋼腱有 HDPE 套管保護，所以不會腐蝕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "External tendons in HDPE sheaths cannot corrode." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Joint compression after tendon loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Corrosion protection and replaceability of external tendons

quiz.question: 關於「體外鋼腱防蝕與可更換設計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrosion protection and replaceability of external tendons" is correct?
options: 體外鋼腱的優點是看得到、可更換，但它的防蝕完全依賴 HDPE 套管、灌漿或填充材與錨頭保護蓋。
體外鋼腱有 HDPE 套管保護，所以不會腐蝕。
接縫出現滲水只是防水問題，與結構無關。
optionsEn: External tendons are visible and replaceable, but their corrosion protection depends entirely on the HDPE sheath, the grout or filler and the anchor caps.
External tendons in HDPE sheaths cannot corrode.
Water seeping at a segment joint is only a waterproofing issue with no structural meaning.
quiz.explanation: 體外鋼腱的優點是看得到、可更換，但它的防蝕完全依賴 HDPE 套管、灌漿或填充材與錨頭保護蓋；套管破裂或灌漿有空洞時，水分與氯離子會在低點積聚，鋼絞線可在多年內腐蝕斷裂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: External tendons are visible and replaceable, but their corrosion protection depends entirely on the HDPE sheath, the grout or filler and the anchor caps; with a cracked sheath or grout voids, water and chlorides collect at low points and strands can corrode and break within years. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 體外鋼腱防蝕與可更換設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrosion protection and replaceability of external tendons: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint compression after tendon loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：12 束時底緣應力：P/A = 43,200/7.2 = 6,000 kPa、Pe/S_b = 10,800 kPa、自重與鋪面 −12,679 kPa，殘餘 4,121 kPa，消壓活載彎矩 4,121×4.0 ≈ 16,485 kN·m > 12,000。若少 1 束（39,600 kN），殘餘降為 2,721 kPa，消壓彎矩約 10,885 kN·m < 12,000，滿載時接縫會張開。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 12 tendons the bottom-fibre stresses are P/A = 43,200/7.2 = 6,000 kPa, Pe/S_b = 10,800 kPa and −12,679 kPa from self-weight and surfacing, leaving 4,121 kPa, so the live-load decompression moment is 4,121×4.0 ≈ 16,485 kN·m > 12,000. With one tendon lost (39,600 kN) the residual falls to 2,721 kPa and the decompression moment to about 10,885 kN·m < 12,000, so joints open under full live load. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：竣工前以內視鏡或敲擊抽查錨頭後方與低點的灌漿飽滿度，檢查套管接頭、熱熔焊口與錨頭保護蓋；更換程序的可行性（千斤頂空間、錨碇拆除與鋼腱抽出路徑）在交接前以實際尺寸確認一次。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before completion, spot-check grout fullness behind anchors and at low points by borescope or sounding, and inspect sheath couplers, fusion welds and anchor caps; confirm the feasibility of the replacement procedure, including jack clearance, anchor removal and tendon withdrawal path, with real dimensions once before handover.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 12 束時底緣應力：P/A = 43,200/7.2 = 6,000 kPa、Pe/S_b = 10,800 kPa、自重與鋪面 −12,679 kPa，殘餘 4,121 kPa，消壓活載彎矩 4,121×4.0 ≈ 16,485 kN·m > 12,000。若少 1 束（39,600 kN），殘餘降為 2,721 kPa，消壓彎矩約 10,885 kN·m < 12,000，滿載時接縫會張開。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 12 tendons the bottom-fibre stresses are P/A = 43,200/7.2 = 6,000 kPa, Pe/S_b = 10,800 kPa and −12,679 kPa from self-weight and surfacing, leaving 4,121 kPa, so the live-load decompression moment is 4,121×4.0 ≈ 16,485 kN·m > 12,000. With one tendon lost (39,600 kN) the residual falls to 2,721 kPa and the decompression moment to about 10,885 kN·m < 12,000, so joints open under full live load. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「體外鋼腱防蝕與可更換設計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corrosion protection and replaceability of external tendons", which statement holds?
options: 架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。
體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。
optionsEn: Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient.

With 12 tendons the bottom-fibre stresses are P/A = 43,200/7.2 = 6,000 kPa, Pe/S_b = 10,800 kPa and −12,679 kPa from self-weight and surfacing, leaving 4,121 kPa, so the live-load decompression moment is 4,121×4.0 ≈ 16,485 kN·m > 12,000.
Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement.
quiz.explanation: 12 束時底緣應力：P/A = 43,200/7.2 = 6,000 kPa、Pe/S_b = 10,800 kPa、自重與鋪面 −12,679 kPa，殘餘 4,121 kPa，消壓活載彎矩 4,121×4.0 ≈ 16,485 kN·m > 12,000。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 12 tendons the bottom-fibre stresses are P/A = 43,200/7.2 = 6,000 kPa, Pe/S_b = 10,800 kPa and −12,679 kPa from self-weight and surfacing, leaving 4,121 kPa, so the live-load decompression moment is 4,121×4.0 ≈ 16,485 kN·m > 12,000. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 體外鋼腱防蝕與可更換設計：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Corrosion protection and replaceability of external tendons: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint compression after tendon loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 竣工前以內視鏡或敲擊抽查錨頭後方與低點的灌漿飽滿度，檢查套管接頭、熱熔焊口與錨頭保護蓋；更換程序的可行性（千斤頂空間、錨碇拆除與鋼腱抽出路徑）在交接前以實際尺寸確認一次。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before completion, spot-check grout fullness behind anchors and at low points by borescope or sounding, and inspect sheath couplers, fusion welds and anchor caps; confirm the feasibility of the replacement procedure, including jack clearance, anchor removal and tendon withdrawal path, with real dimensions once before handover. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計須檢核任一束鋼腱失效或更換時的接縫狀態並規定更換期間的交通限制；採購規格要求經認證的預力系統與灌漿材料，灌漿作業由合格人員執行並保留逐束紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design must check joint behaviour with any one tendon lost or under replacement and state the traffic restrictions during replacement; procurement requires certified post-tensioning systems and grout, with grouting by qualified personnel and records kept tendon by tendon.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：箱內排水不良使雨水在錨碇橫隔前積存，錨頭保護蓋與套管接頭長期泡水，鋼絞線在錨具後方腐蝕斷裂；若設計沒有考慮單束失效，斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力不足，整跨必須限載直到更換完成。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor box drainage lets rainwater pond in front of anchorage diaphragms so anchor caps and sheath joints sit in water for years and strands corrode and break behind the anchors; if design did not consider single-tendon loss, the remaining joint compression is insufficient and the whole span must be load-restricted until replacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 竣工前以內視鏡或敲擊抽查錨頭後方與低點的灌漿飽滿度，檢查套管接頭、熱熔焊口與錨頭保護蓋；更換程序的可行性（千斤頂空間、錨碇拆除與鋼腱抽出路徑）在交接前以實際尺寸確認一次。
knowledge.textEn: Before completion, spot-check grout fullness behind anchors and at low points by borescope or sounding, and inspect sheath couplers, fusion welds and anchor caps; confirm the feasibility of the replacement procedure, including jack clearance, anchor removal and tendon withdrawal path, with real dimensions once before handover.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計須檢核任一束鋼腱失效或更換時的接縫狀態並規定更換期間的交通限制；採購規格要求經認證的預力系統與灌漿材料，灌漿作業由合格人員執行並保留逐束紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Design must check joint behaviour with any one tendon lost or under replacement and state the traffic restrictions during replacement; procurement requires certified post-tensioning systems and grout, with grouting by qualified personnel and records kept tendon by tendon.

quiz.question: 要驗證「體外鋼腱防蝕與可更換設計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corrosion protection and replaceability of external tendons"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。
竣工前以內視鏡或敲擊抽查錨頭後方與低點的灌漿飽滿度，檢查套管接頭、熱熔焊口與錨頭保護蓋。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings.
Before completion, spot-check grout fullness behind anchors and at low points by borescope or sounding, and inspect sheath couplers, fusion welds and anchor caps.
quiz.explanation: 竣工前以內視鏡或敲擊抽查錨頭後方與低點的灌漿飽滿度，檢查套管接頭、熱熔焊口與錨頭保護蓋；更換程序的可行性（千斤頂空間、錨碇拆除與鋼腱抽出路徑）在交接前以實際尺寸確認一次。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before completion, spot-check grout fullness behind anchors and at low points by borescope or sounding, and inspect sheath couplers, fusion welds and anchor caps; confirm the feasibility of the replacement procedure, including jack clearance, anchor removal and tendon withdrawal path, with real dimensions once before handover. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 體外鋼腱防蝕與可更換設計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corrosion protection and replaceability of external tendons: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint compression after tendon loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 箱內排水不良使雨水在錨碇橫隔前積存，錨頭保護蓋與套管接頭長期泡水，鋼絞線在錨具後方腐蝕斷裂；若設計沒有考慮單束失效，斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力不足，整跨必須限載直到更換完成。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor box drainage lets rainwater pond in front of anchorage diaphragms so anchor caps and sheath joints sit in water for years and strands corrode and break behind the anchors; if design did not consider single-tendon loss, the remaining joint compression is insufficient and the whole span must be load-restricted until replacement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計時必須假設某一束可能失效或需要更換，檢查其餘鋼腱是否仍能維持接縫受壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design must assume that any one tendon may fail or need replacing and check that the rest still keep the joints in compression.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「體外鋼腱有 HDPE 套管保護，所以不會腐蝕。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "External tendons in HDPE sheaths cannot corrode." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 接縫行為監測與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint behaviour monitoring and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「接縫監測基準」如何影響橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint monitoring baseline” governs force, deformation or durability in “Span-by-span precast bridge erection”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 逐跨預鑄橋的健康狀態主要反映在接縫：只要接縫保持受壓，梁體就近似一根完整的預力梁；接縫一旦在活載下張開，底緣應變會出現非線性跳增，接縫處的位移計會讀到開口。因此交接時應在代表性跨的跨中接縫裝設應變計與位移計，以已知重量的車輛做一次基準量測，日後定期重測比較，就能判斷預力是否流失或接縫是否開始呼吸。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「接縫監測基準」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The health of a span-by-span precast bridge shows mainly at its joints: as long as they stay in compression the girder behaves like a monolithic prestressed beam, but once a joint opens under live load the bottom-fibre strain jumps non-linearly and a displacement gauge across the joint reads an opening. Handover should therefore install strain and displacement gauges at midspan joints of representative spans, take a baseline with vehicles of known weight, and repeat periodically to tell whether prestress has been lost or joints have started to breathe. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joint monitoring baseline” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：接縫受壓時，活載彎矩 12,000 kN·m 造成底緣應變 ε = M/(S_b·E) = 12,000/(4.0×35×10⁶) ≈ 86 με；若同一載重下量到約 120 με 並伴隨跨接縫位移計讀值，代表接縫已局部張開。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: While the joint stays compressed, a live-load moment of 12,000 kN·m produces a bottom-fibre strain ε = M/(S_b·E) = 12,000/(4.0×35×10⁶) ≈ 86 με; measuring about 120 με under the same load, together with a reading on the gauge across the joint, indicates the joint has partly opened.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫出現滲水只是防水問題，與結構無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Water seeping at a segment joint is only a waterproofing issue with no structural meaning." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「接縫監測基準」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Joint monitoring baseline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接縫行為監測與工程交接
knowledge.text: 逐跨預鑄橋的健康狀態主要反映在接縫：只要接縫保持受壓，梁體就近似一根完整的預力梁；接縫一旦在活載下張開，底緣應變會出現非線性跳增，接縫處的位移計會讀到開口。因此交接時應在代表性跨的跨中接縫裝設應變計與位移計，以已知重量的車輛做一次基準量測，日後定期重測比較，就能判斷預力是否流失或接縫是否開始呼吸。

Handover should therefore install strain and displacement gauges at midspan joints of representative spans, take a baseline with vehicles of known weight, and repeat periodically to tell whether prestress has been lost or joints have started to breathe.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫出現滲水只是防水問題，與結構無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Water seeping at a segment joint is only a waterproofing issue with no structural meaning. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接縫行為監測與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint behaviour monitoring and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫監測基準」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint monitoring baseline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：接縫受壓時，活載彎矩 12,000 kN·m 造成底緣應變 ε = M/(S_b·E) = 12,000/(4.0×35×10⁶) ≈ 86 με；若同一載重下量到約 120 με 並伴隨跨接縫位移計讀值，代表接縫已局部張開。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: While the joint stays compressed, a live-load moment of 12,000 kN·m produces a bottom-fibre strain ε = M/(S_b·E) = 12,000/(4.0×35×10⁶) ≈ 86 με; measuring about 120 με under the same load, together with a reading on the gauge across the joint, indicates the joint has partly opened. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：基準量測使用已知軸重的試驗車，以慢速與正常速度各通過數次，記錄應變、位移與溫度；量測結果與計算值的比值（量測／計算）應在可解釋範圍內，並將感測器位置、車重與原始資料一併納入交接文件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The baseline uses test trucks of known axle loads crossing several times at crawl and normal speed, recording strain, displacement and temperature; the measured-to-calculated ratio must be explainable, and sensor locations, truck weights and raw data go into the handover documents.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 接縫受壓時，活載彎矩 12,000 kN·m 造成底緣應變 ε = M/(S_b·E) = 12,000/(4.0×35×10⁶) ≈ 86 με；若同一載重下量到約 120 με 並伴隨跨接縫位移計讀值，代表接縫已局部張開。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: While the joint stays compressed, a live-load moment of 12,000 kN·m produces a bottom-fibre strain ε = M/(S_b·E) = 12,000/(4.0×35×10⁶) ≈ 86 με; measuring about 120 με under the same load, together with a reading on the gauge across the joint, indicates the joint has partly opened. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

架橋機本身很重，所以推進時不可能傾覆。

optionsEn: A dry joint is just an epoxy joint without the epoxy and behaves identically.
A gantry is so heavy that it cannot overturn while launching.

steps.title: 接縫行為監測與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint behaviour monitoring and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接縫監測基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint monitoring baseline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 基準量測使用已知軸重的試驗車，以慢速與正常速度各通過數次，記錄應變、位移與溫度；量測結果與計算值的比值（量測／計算）應在可解釋範圍內，並將感測器位置、車重與原始資料一併納入交接文件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The baseline uses test trucks of known axle loads crossing several times at crawl and normal speed, recording strain, displacement and temperature; the measured-to-calculated ratio must be explainable, and sensor locations, truck weights and raw data go into the handover documents. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含節塊與鋼腱編號對照、預製幾何紀錄、張拉與頻率量測表、接縫監測基準、箱內通行與排水維護計畫，以及鋼腱更換程序；首次定期檢查應在通車約一年內完成。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should include segment and tendon cross-references, casting geometry records, stressing and frequency tables, the joint monitoring baseline, box access and drainage maintenance plans and the tendon replacement procedure; the first routine inspection should be done within about a year of opening.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有基準資料時，多年後在接縫看到白華或滲水痕跡，也無法判斷是排水問題還是預力流失；等到底板出現沿接縫的明顯開口，往往已有鋼腱斷束，修復代價遠高於早期介入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a baseline, efflorescence or seepage at a joint years later cannot be attributed to drainage or to prestress loss; by the time an obvious opening appears along the bottom slab, tendons have often already failed and repair costs far exceed early intervention. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 基準量測使用已知軸重的試驗車，以慢速與正常速度各通過數次，記錄應變、位移與溫度；量測結果與計算值的比值（量測／計算）應在可解釋範圍內，並將感測器位置、車重與原始資料一併納入交接文件。
knowledge.textEn: The baseline uses test trucks of known axle loads crossing several times at crawl and normal speed, recording strain, displacement and temperature; the measured-to-calculated ratio must be explainable, and sensor locations, truck weights and raw data go into the handover documents.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含節塊與鋼腱編號對照、預製幾何紀錄、張拉與頻率量測表、接縫監測基準、箱內通行與排水維護計畫，以及鋼腱更換程序；首次定期檢查應在通車約一年內完成。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents should include segment and tendon cross-references, casting geometry records, stressing and frequency tables, the joint monitoring baseline, box access and drainage maintenance plans and the tendon replacement procedure; the first routine inspection should be done within about a year of opening.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接縫行為監測與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint behaviour monitoring and handover"?
options: 基準量測使用已知軸重的試驗車，以慢速與正常速度各通過數次，記錄應變、位移與溫度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the yard forms are accurate enough, segment geometry need not be surveyed one by one.
quiz.explanation: 基準量測使用已知軸重的試驗車，以慢速與正常速度各通過數次，記錄應變、位移與溫度；量測結果與計算值的比值（量測／計算）應在可解釋範圍內，並將感測器位置、車重與原始資料一併納入交接文件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The baseline uses test trucks of known axle loads crossing several times at crawl and normal speed, recording strain, displacement and temperature; the measured-to-calculated ratio must be explainable, and sensor locations, truck weights and raw data go into the handover documents. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接縫行為監測與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint behaviour monitoring and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接縫監測基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint monitoring baseline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沒有基準資料時，多年後在接縫看到白華或滲水痕跡，也無法判斷是排水問題還是預力流失；等到底板出現沿接縫的明顯開口，往往已有鋼腱斷束，修復代價遠高於早期介入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a baseline, efflorescence or seepage at a joint years later cannot be attributed to drainage or to prestress loss; by the time an obvious opening appears along the bottom slab, tendons have often already failed and repair costs far exceed early intervention. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此交接時應在代表性跨的跨中接縫裝設應變計與位移計，以已知重量的車輛做一次基準量測，日後定期重測比較，就能判斷預力是否流失或接縫是否開始呼吸。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover should therefore install strain and displacement gauges at midspan joints of representative spans, take a baseline with vehicles of known weight, and repeat periodically to tell whether prestress has been lost or joints have started to breathe.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫出現滲水只是防水問題，與結構無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Water seeping at a segment joint is only a waterproofing issue with no structural meaning." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沒有基準資料時，多年後在接縫看到白華或滲水痕跡，也無法判斷是排水問題還是預力流失；等到底板出現沿接縫的明顯開口，往往已有鋼腱斷束，修復代價遠高於早期介入。
knowledge.textEn: Without a baseline, efflorescence or seepage at a joint years later cannot be attributed to drainage or to prestress loss; by the time an obvious opening appears along the bottom slab, tendons have often already failed and repair costs far exceed early intervention.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接縫行為監測與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint behaviour monitoring and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
沒有基準資料時，多年後在接縫看到白華或滲水痕跡，也無法判斷是排水問題還是預力流失；等到底板出現沿接縫的明顯開口，往往已有鋼腱斷束，修復代價遠高於早期介入。
逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without a baseline, efflorescence or seepage at a joint years later cannot be attributed to drainage or to prestress loss.
Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete.
quiz.explanation: 沒有基準資料時，多年後在接縫看到白華或滲水痕跡，也無法判斷是排水問題還是預力流失；等到底板出現沿接縫的明顯開口，往往已有鋼腱斷束，修復代價遠高於早期介入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without a baseline, efflorescence or seepage at a joint years later cannot be attributed to drainage or to prestress loss; by the time an obvious opening appears along the bottom slab, tendons have often already failed and repair costs far exceed early intervention. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 橋梁頂推施工
summary: 從頂推過程中每一斷面輪流經過墩頂與跨中所產生的交變彎矩出發，計算導梁長度與中心預力需求，再處理導梁上墩、滑移支承與側向導向、橋台後預製台座的每週循環、臨時墩與鋼橋面頂推，最後以支承反力、頂推力與摩擦監測驗證並完成永久支承安裝與交接，案例涵蓋 Caroní 橋、Kufstein 茵河橋、Ravensbosch 高架橋與 Millau 高架橋。
summaryEn: Starting from the alternating moments that arise as every section passes alternately over piers and midspans, compute launching-nose length and centric prestress, then handle nose landing, sliding bearings and lateral guides, the weekly cycle of the casting bed behind the abutment, temporary piers and steel-deck launching, and finally verify with support reactions, launch force and friction monitoring before installing permanent bearings and handing over, with the Caroní, Kufstein Inn, Ravensbosch and Millau bridges as cases.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計比較練習：跨度 L = 50 m、梁重 w = 200 kN/m、導梁 15 kN/m，比較三種導梁長度。導梁 0.5L = 25 m 時，混凝土懸臂 25 m，M = 200×25²/2 + 15×25×(25 + 12.5) ≈ 76,563 kN·m；導梁 0.62L = 31 m 時 M ≈ 52,143 kN·m；導梁 0.7L = 35 m 時懸臂彎矩降為 200×15²/2 + 15×35×(15 + 17.5) ≈ 39,563 kN·m，但此時控制值改為連續梁墩頂彎矩 wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m。取 S = 10.0 m³、A = 7.0 m²、容許拉應力 1.5 MPa、每束有效力 1,875 kN，所需中心預力分別為：0.5L 時 (76,563/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 43,094 kN（約 23 束）；0.62L 時約 26,000 kN（14 束）；0.7L 時 (41,667/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 18,667 kN（10 束）。導梁由 0.5L 加長到 0.62L 可省約 9 束，但再加長到 0.7L 只再省 4 束，且導梁更長更重、上墩撓度更大。這說明導梁長度約取跨度 60% 至 65% 的工程理由。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design comparison: span L = 50 m, girder w = 200 kN/m, nose 15 kN/m, three nose lengths. With a 0.5L = 25 m nose the concrete cantilever is 25 m and M = 200×25²/2 + 15×25×(25 + 12.5) ≈ 76,563 kN·m; with 0.62L = 31 m, M ≈ 52,143 kN·m; with 0.7L = 35 m the cantilever moment drops to 200×15²/2 + 15×35×(15 + 17.5) ≈ 39,563 kN·m, but the continuous-beam support moment wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m then governs. With S = 10.0 m³, A = 7.0 m², 1.5 MPa allowable tension and 1,875 kN effective per tendon, the centric prestress needed is (76,563/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 43,094 kN (about 23 tendons) for 0.5L, about 26,000 kN (14 tendons) for 0.62L and (41,667/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 18,667 kN (10 tendons) for 0.7L. Lengthening the nose from 0.5L to 0.62L saves about 9 tendons, but going on to 0.7L saves only 4 more while the nose gets longer, heavier and sags more at landing. This is the engineering reason for noses of about 60% to 65% of the span. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「交變彎矩與導梁的作用」與「中心預力與頂推階段的應力控制」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Alternating moments and the role of the nose" and "Centric prestress and stress control during launching": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 交變彎矩與導梁的作用：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Alternating moments and the role of the nose: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」如何影響橋梁頂推施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Front cantilever moment with nose” governs force, deformation or durability in “Incremental bridge launching”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 頂推時整條梁在橋墩上滑動，每一個斷面都會輪流經過墩頂（負彎矩）與跨中（正彎矩），所以斷面必須同時承受兩種符號的彎矩，這與一般連續梁每個斷面只承受固定符號的彎矩完全不同。最嚴重的狀態出現在梁前端剛要到達下一座墩之前：前端成為長懸臂，根部負彎矩隨懸臂長度平方增長。輕質鋼導梁接在梁前端，先一步搭上下一座墩，用很輕的重量取代一大段混凝土懸臂，大幅降低這個峰值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During launching the whole girder slides over the piers, so every section passes alternately over a pier (hogging) and through midspan (sagging) and must resist both signs of moment, unlike an ordinary continuous girder whose sections see one sign. The worst state occurs just before the front reaches the next pier: the front becomes a long cantilever whose root hogging moment grows with the square of its length. A light steel launching nose attached to the front reaches the next pier first, replacing a long concrete cantilever with a light structure and sharply reducing this peak. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Front cantilever moment with nose” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：跨度 L = 50 m、梁重 w = 200 kN/m、導梁 15 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Span L = 50 m, girder w = 200 kN/m, nose 15 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂推梁完工後是連續梁，所以只要依連續梁的彎矩分布配置預力即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A launched girder ends up continuous, so prestress can simply follow the continuous-beam moment diagram." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Front cantilever moment with nose”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 交變彎矩與導梁的作用
knowledge.titleEn: Alternating moments and the role of the nose
knowledge.text: 頂推時整條梁在橋墩上滑動，每一個斷面都會輪流經過墩頂（負彎矩）與跨中（正彎矩），所以斷面必須同時承受兩種符號的彎矩，這與一般連續梁每個斷面只承受固定符號的彎矩完全不同。最嚴重的狀態出現在梁前端剛要到達下一座墩之前：前端成為長懸臂，根部負彎矩隨懸臂長度平方增長。
knowledge.textEn: During launching the whole girder slides over the piers, so every section passes alternately over a pier (hogging) and through midspan (sagging) and must resist both signs of moment, unlike an ordinary continuous girder whose sections see one sign. The worst state occurs just before the front reaches the next pier: the front becomes a long cantilever whose root hogging moment grows with the square of its length.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頂推梁完工後是連續梁，所以只要依連續梁的彎矩分布配置預力即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A launched girder ends up continuous, so prestress can simply follow the continuous-beam moment diagram. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「交變彎矩與導梁的作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Alternating moments and the role of the nose" is correct?
options: 頂推梁完工後是連續梁，所以只要依連續梁的彎矩分布配置預力即可。
頂推時整條梁在橋墩上滑動，每一個斷面都會輪流經過墩頂（負彎矩）與跨中（正彎矩），所以斷面必須同時承受兩種符號的彎矩，這與一般連續梁每個斷面只承受固定符號的彎矩完全不同。
頂推時的預力只要依完工後跨中正彎矩配置在底板即可。
optionsEn: A launched girder ends up continuous, so prestress can simply follow the continuous-beam moment diagram.

During launching the whole girder slides over the piers, so every section passes alternately over a pier (hogging) and through midspan (sagging) and must resist both signs of moment, unlike an ordinary continuous girder whose sections see one sign.
Launching prestress need only be placed in the bottom slab for the final midspan sagging moment.
quiz.explanation: 頂推時整條梁在橋墩上滑動，每一個斷面都會輪流經過墩頂（負彎矩）與跨中（正彎矩），所以斷面必須同時承受兩種符號的彎矩，這與一般連續梁每個斷面只承受固定符號的彎矩完全不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During launching the whole girder slides over the piers, so every section passes alternately over a pier (hogging) and through midspan (sagging) and must resist both signs of moment, unlike an ordinary continuous girder whose sections see one sign. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 交變彎矩與導梁的作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Alternating moments and the role of the nose: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Front cantilever moment with nose” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：跨度 L = 50 m、梁重 w = 200 kN/m、導梁 15 kN/m。無導梁時懸臂彎矩 wL²/2 = 250,000 kN·m；導梁長 0.62L = 31 m 時，混凝土懸臂 19 m：M = 200×19²/2 + 15×31×(19 + 15.5) ≈ 52,143 kN·m，約為無導梁時的 21%，與連續梁墩頂彎矩 wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m 同一量級。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Span L = 50 m, girder w = 200 kN/m, nose 15 kN/m. Without a nose the cantilever moment is wL²/2 = 250,000 kN·m; with a nose 0.62L = 31 m long the concrete cantilever is 19 m: M = 200×19²/2 + 15×31×(19 + 15.5) ≈ 52,143 kN·m, about 21% of the no-nose value and of the same order as the continuous-beam support moment wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以頂推階段分析逐步移動梁位（例如每 1 至 2 m 一個位置），輸出每一斷面在全部位置下的最大正負彎矩包絡線，與手算的懸臂峰值和 wL²/12 比較；包絡線須涵蓋導梁搭墩前後、梁尾離開預製台座等關鍵位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a launching analysis that moves the girder in steps of, say, 1 to 2 m, output the envelope of maximum positive and negative moments at every section over all positions, and compare it with the hand-calculated cantilever peak and wL²/12; the envelope must include key positions such as just before and after the nose lands and the tail leaving the casting bed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 跨度 L = 50 m、梁重 w = 200 kN/m、導梁 15 kN/m。無導梁時懸臂彎矩 wL²/2 = 250,000 kN·m；導梁長 0.62L = 31 m 時，混凝土懸臂 19 m：M = 200×19²/2 + 15×31×(19 + 15.5) ≈ 52,143 kN·m，約為無導梁時的 21%，與連續梁墩頂彎矩 wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m 同一量級。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Span L = 50 m, girder w = 200 kN/m, nose 15 kN/m. Without a nose the cantilever moment is wL²/2 = 250,000 kN·m; with a nose 0.62L = 31 m long the concrete cantilever is 19 m: M = 200×19²/2 + 15×31×(19 + 15.5) ≈ 52,143 kN·m, about 21% of the no-nose value and of the same order as the continuous-beam support moment wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 交變彎矩與導梁的作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alternating moments and the role of the nose: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Front cantilever moment with nose” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以頂推階段分析逐步移動梁位（例如每 1 至 2 m 一個位置），輸出每一斷面在全部位置下的最大正負彎矩包絡線，與手算的懸臂峰值和 wL²/12 比較；包絡線須涵蓋導梁搭墩前後、梁尾離開預製台座等關鍵位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a launching analysis that moves the girder in steps of, say, 1 to 2 m, output the envelope of maximum positive and negative moments at every section over all positions, and compare it with the hand-calculated cantilever peak and wL²/12; the envelope must include key positions such as just before and after the nose lands and the tail leaving the casting bed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計文件應附頂推階段彎矩與剪力包絡線、導梁長度與重量假設、每座墩的最大反力，並規定承包商改變導梁或跨配置時必須重新分析並經設計單位同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design documents should attach the launching moment and shear envelopes, the assumed nose length and weight and the maximum reaction at every pier, and require re-analysis and designer approval if the contractor changes the nose or span arrangement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只檢核完工連續梁的彎矩分布，忽略頂推時每個斷面都會經過墩頂，跨中斷面可能在頂推中承受設計從未考慮的負彎矩，頂板出現橫向裂縫，甚至在導梁搭墩前因懸臂過長而開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only the finished continuous-girder moments, and forgetting that every section passes over a pier during launching, can impose hogging moments on midspan sections that the design never considered, cracking the top slab transversely, or crack the girder when the cantilever grows too long before the nose lands. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 交變彎矩與導梁的作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alternating moments and the role of the nose: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Front cantilever moment with nose” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只檢核完工連續梁的彎矩分布，忽略頂推時每個斷面都會經過墩頂，跨中斷面可能在頂推中承受設計從未考慮的負彎矩，頂板出現橫向裂縫，甚至在導梁搭墩前因懸臂過長而開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only the finished continuous-girder moments, and forgetting that every section passes over a pier during launching, can impose hogging moments on midspan sections that the design never considered, cracking the top slab transversely, or crack the girder when the cantilever grows too long before the nose lands. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：輕質鋼導梁接在梁前端，先一步搭上下一座墩，用很輕的重量取代一大段混凝土懸臂，大幅降低這個峰值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A light steel launching nose attached to the front reaches the next pier first, replacing a long concrete cantilever with a light structure and sharply reducing this peak.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂推梁完工後是連續梁，所以只要依連續梁的彎矩分布配置預力即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A launched girder ends up continuous, so prestress can simply follow the continuous-beam moment diagram." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 中心預力與頂推階段的應力控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Centric prestress and stress control during launching: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「中心預力」如何影響橋梁頂推施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Centric launching prestress” governs force, deformation or durability in “Incremental bridge launching”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 既然每一個斷面都要承受正負兩種彎矩，頂推階段的預力必須放在斷面形心附近，使頂板與底板同時獲得均勻壓應力，稱為中心預力或頂推預力，通常以頂板與底板的直線鋼腱達成。頂推完成、結構成為連續梁後，再張拉沿彎矩分布配置的連續鋼腱（常為體外鋼腱），補足營運需求。因為中心預力在營運時效率較低，設計者會用較小的跨深比、導梁與臨時墩來降低頂推彎矩，從而減少中心預力用量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「中心預力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Since every section must resist both positive and negative moment, launching prestress is placed near the centroid so the top and bottom slabs both receive uniform compression, called centric or launching prestress and usually provided by straight tendons in the top and bottom slabs. After launching, once the structure is continuous, continuity tendons following the moment diagram, often external, are stressed to meet service demands. Because centric prestress is less efficient in service, designers reduce launching moments with modest span-to-depth ratios, a nose and temporary piers, minimising the centric prestress needed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Centric launching prestress” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a launching hogging peak of 52,143 kN·m, section modulus S = 10.0 m³, area A = 7.0 m² and 1.5 MPa allowable tension, the required uniform compression is σ = 52,143/10.0 − 1,500 ≈ 3,714 kPa, so P = 3,714×7.0 ≈ 26,000 kN; at about 1,875 kN effective per 12-strand 15.2 mm tendon, 26,000/1,875 ≈ 13.9, so use 14 tendons.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂推時的預力只要依完工後跨中正彎矩配置在底板即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Launching prestress need only be placed in the bottom slab for the final midspan sagging moment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「中心預力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Centric launching prestress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 中心預力與頂推階段的應力控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Centric prestress and stress control during launching: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中心預力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Centric launching prestress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：頂推負彎矩峰值 52,143 kN·m，斷面模數 S = 10.0 m³、面積 A = 7.0 m²、容許拉應力 1.5 MPa：所需均勻壓應力 σ = 52,143/10.0 − 1,500 ≈ 3,714 kPa，P = 3,714×7.0 ≈ 26,000 kN；以每束 12 股 15.2 mm 有效力約 1,875 kN 計，需 26,000/1,875 ≈ 13.9，取 14 束。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a launching hogging peak of 52,143 kN·m, section modulus S = 10.0 m³, area A = 7.0 m² and 1.5 MPa allowable tension, the required uniform compression is σ = 52,143/10.0 − 1,500 ≈ 3,714 kPa, so P = 3,714×7.0 ≈ 26,000 kN; at about 1,875 kN effective per 12-strand 15.2 mm tendon, 26,000/1,875 ≈ 13.9, so use 14 tendons. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對每一段張拉後的中心預力與頂推包絡線所需值，並以施工階段模型確認在所有梁位下頂底板拉應力都在容許範圍；頂推鋼腱多以聯結器逐段接續，須檢查聯結器所在斷面不集中在同一位置，並確認聯結器處的應力與裂縫控制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the centric prestress after each segment is stressed against the envelope demand, and confirm in the staged model that top and bottom tensile stresses stay within limits at every girder position; launching tendons are usually extended segment by segment with couplers, so check that coupler sections are staggered and verify stress and crack control there.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 頂推負彎矩峰值 52,143 kN·m，斷面模數 S = 10.0 m³、面積 A = 7.0 m²、容許拉應力 1.5 MPa：所需均勻壓應力 σ = 52,143/10.0 − 1,500 ≈ 3,714 kPa，P = 3,714×7.0 ≈ 26,000 kN；以每束 12 股 15.2 mm 有效力約 1,875 kN 計，需 26,000/1,875 ≈ 13.9，取 14 束。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a launching hogging peak of 52,143 kN·m, section modulus S = 10.0 m³, area A = 7.0 m² and 1.5 MPa allowable tension, the required uniform compression is σ = 52,143/10.0 − 1,500 ≈ 3,714 kPa, so P = 3,714×7.0 ≈ 26,000 kN; at about 1,875 kN effective per 12-strand 15.2 mm tendon, 26,000/1,875 ≈ 13.9, so use 14 tendons. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「中心預力與頂推階段的應力控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

頂推梁在台座上製作，幾何誤差可以在頂推後再一次修正。
墩頂高程差幾公釐對頂推中的長梁沒有影響。

Because the girder is cast on a bed, geometric errors can be corrected after launching.
A few millimetres of pier-level difference has no effect on a long girder being launched.

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 中心預力與頂推階段的應力控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Centric prestress and stress control during launching: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「中心預力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Centric launching prestress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對每一段張拉後的中心預力與頂推包絡線所需值，並以施工階段模型確認在所有梁位下頂底板拉應力都在容許範圍；頂推鋼腱多以聯結器逐段接續，須檢查聯結器所在斷面不集中在同一位置，並確認聯結器處的應力與裂縫控制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the centric prestress after each segment is stressed against the envelope demand, and confirm in the staged model that top and bottom tensile stresses stay within limits at every girder position; launching tendons are usually extended segment by segment with couplers, so check that coupler sections are staggered and verify stress and crack control there. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫應以表格列出每一段的頂推鋼腱、聯結器位置與張拉時機，並規定在張拉完成並確認伸長量之前不得頂推；頂推後的連續鋼腱張拉順序也須經設計單位核定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan should tabulate launching tendons, coupler locations and stressing times for every segment and forbid launching until stressing is complete and elongations are accepted; the post-launch continuity stressing order must also be approved by the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：聯結器集中在同一個施工縫斷面時，該處有效預力與鋼筋都較弱，頂推中經過墩頂與跨中反覆受彎，常在施工縫出現貫穿裂縫；中心預力不足則讓底板在跨中位置開裂，日後滲水造成鋼腱腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Couplers concentrated at one construction-joint section leave it weaker in effective prestress and reinforcement, and repeated bending over piers and midspans during launching often cracks it through; insufficient centric prestress cracks the bottom slab at midspan positions, later admitting water that corrodes tendons. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Check the centric prestress after each segment is stressed against the envelope demand, and confirm in the staged model that top and bottom tensile stresses stay within limits at every girder position; launching tendons are usually extended segment by segment with couplers, so check that coupler sections are staggered and verify stress and crack control there.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫應以表格列出每一段的頂推鋼腱、聯結器位置與張拉時機，並規定在張拉完成並確認伸長量之前不得頂推；頂推後的連續鋼腱張拉順序也須經設計單位核定。

quiz.question: 要驗證「中心預力與頂推階段的應力控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Centric prestress and stress control during launching"?

頂推完成就等於施工完成，支承轉換只是簡單的換件作業。

Check the centric prestress after each segment is stressed against the envelope demand, and confirm in the staged model that top and bottom tensile stresses stay within limits at every girder position.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 中心預力與頂推階段的應力控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Centric prestress and stress control during launching: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中心預力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Centric launching prestress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 聯結器集中在同一個施工縫斷面時，該處有效預力與鋼筋都較弱，頂推中經過墩頂與跨中反覆受彎，常在施工縫出現貫穿裂縫；中心預力不足則讓底板在跨中位置開裂，日後滲水造成鋼腱腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Couplers concentrated at one construction-joint section leave it weaker in effective prestress and reinforcement, and repeated bending over piers and midspans during launching often cracks it through; insufficient centric prestress cracks the bottom slab at midspan positions, later admitting water that corrodes tendons. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為中心預力在營運時效率較低，設計者會用較小的跨深比、導梁與臨時墩來降低頂推彎矩，從而減少中心預力用量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because centric prestress is less efficient in service, designers reduce launching moments with modest span-to-depth ratios, a nose and temporary piers, minimising the centric prestress needed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂推時的預力只要依完工後跨中正彎矩配置在底板即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Launching prestress need only be placed in the bottom slab for the final midspan sagging moment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 聯結器集中在同一個施工縫斷面時，該處有效預力與鋼筋都較弱，頂推中經過墩頂與跨中反覆受彎，常在施工縫出現貫穿裂縫；中心預力不足則讓底板在跨中位置開裂，日後滲水造成鋼腱腐蝕。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「中心預力與頂推階段的應力控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Centric prestress and stress control during launching" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
導梁越長越好，長度可以等於整個跨度。
聯結器集中在同一個施工縫斷面時，該處有效預力與鋼筋都較弱，頂推中經過墩頂與跨中反覆受彎，常在施工縫出現貫穿裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The longer the nose the better; it can be as long as the whole span.

Couplers concentrated at one construction-joint section leave it weaker in effective prestress and reinforcement, and repeated bending over piers and midspans during launching often cracks it through.

quiz.explanationEn: Couplers concentrated at one construction-joint section leave it weaker in effective prestress and reinforcement, and repeated bending over piers and midspans during launching often cracks it through; insufficient centric prestress cracks the bottom slab at midspan positions, later admitting water that corrodes tendons. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼導梁設計與上墩」與「滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Steel nose design and landing on the pier" and "Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼導梁設計與上墩：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel nose design and landing on the pier: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「導梁前端撓度」如何影響橋梁頂推施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nose tip deflection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Incremental bridge launching”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 導梁通常是兩片鋼板梁或桁架，長度約為跨度的 60% 至 65%，每公尺重量只有混凝土梁的一小部分。導梁本身要夠輕才能降低懸臂彎矩，又要夠勁才能限制前端下垂；到達下一墩時，前端已因混凝土懸臂轉角與導梁自身撓度而低於墩頂，必須靠前端的上墩千斤頂或斜坡把導梁抬上滑板。導梁與混凝土梁的連接處承受很大的彎矩與剪力，是需要特別細部設計與疲勞檢查的節點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「導梁前端撓度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A launching nose is usually two steel plate girders or a truss, about 60% to 65% of the span long and weighing a small fraction of the concrete girder per metre. It must be light enough to reduce the cantilever moment yet stiff enough to limit tip sag; on arrival at the next pier its tip lies below the pier top because of the concrete cantilever's rotation and the nose's own deflection, so a tip jack or ramp must lift it onto the sliding pad. The nose-to-girder connection carries large moment and shear and needs special detailing and fatigue checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Nose tip deflection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：混凝土懸臂 19 m（EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴）承受自重與導梁 465 kN：端點下撓約 20 mm、轉角約 0.0016 rad，乘導梁長 31 m 得 50 mm；導梁自重 15 kN/m、EI = 210,000 MPa × 0.08 m⁴，自身下撓 15×31⁴/(8EI) ≈ 103 mm，前端合計約 173 mm，上墩千斤頂行程須大於此值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The 19 m concrete cantilever (EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴) under its own weight and the 465 kN nose deflects about 20 mm at its end with a rotation of about 0.0016 rad, which over the 31 m nose gives 50 mm; the nose itself (15 kN/m, EI = 210,000 MPa × 0.08 m⁴) sags 15×31⁴/(8EI) ≈ 103 mm, so the tip is about 173 mm low and the landing jack stroke must exceed this.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「導梁越長越好，長度可以等於整個跨度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The longer the nose the better; it can be as long as the whole span." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「導梁前端撓度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Nose tip deflection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 導梁通常是兩片鋼板梁或桁架，長度約為跨度的 60% 至 65%，每公尺重量只有混凝土梁的一小部分。導梁本身要夠輕才能降低懸臂彎矩，又要夠勁才能限制前端下垂；到達下一墩時，前端已因混凝土懸臂轉角與導梁自身撓度而低於墩頂，必須靠前端的上墩千斤頂或斜坡把導梁抬上滑板。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

quiz.question: 關於「鋼導梁設計與上墩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Steel nose design and landing on the pier" is correct?

steps.title: 鋼導梁設計與上墩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel nose design and landing on the pier: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導梁前端撓度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nose tip deflection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：混凝土懸臂 19 m（EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴）承受自重與導梁 465 kN：端點下撓約 20 mm、轉角約 0.0016 rad，乘導梁長 31 m 得 50 mm；導梁自重 15 kN/m、EI = 210,000 MPa × 0.08 m⁴，自身下撓 15×31⁴/(8EI) ≈ 103 mm，前端合計約 173 mm，上墩千斤頂行程須大於此值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The 19 m concrete cantilever (EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴) under its own weight and the 465 kN nose deflects about 20 mm at its end with a rotation of about 0.0016 rad, which over the 31 m nose gives 50 mm; the nose itself (15 kN/m, EI = 210,000 MPa × 0.08 m⁴) sags 15×31⁴/(8EI) ≈ 103 mm, so the tip is about 173 mm low and the landing jack stroke must exceed this. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：導梁製作後檢查焊道（非破壞檢測）與栓接預拉力，組裝時量測導梁與混凝土梁的接合角度；首次上墩前預測前端下垂量，現場量測實際值並比較，偏差過大時檢查導梁連接是否鬆動或梁體勁度與假設不同。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After fabrication, inspect nose welds by non-destructive testing and check bolt pretension, and measure the joint angle between nose and concrete girder at assembly; before the first landing, predict the tip sag, measure the actual value and compare, investigating connection slack or girder stiffness differing from assumptions if the deviation is large.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
