knowledge.text: 混凝土懸臂 19 m（EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴）承受自重與導梁 465 kN：端點下撓約 20 mm、轉角約 0.0016 rad，乘導梁長 31 m 得 50 mm；導梁自重 15 kN/m、EI = 210,000 MPa × 0.08 m⁴，自身下撓 15×31⁴/(8EI) ≈ 103 mm，前端合計約 173 mm，上墩千斤頂行程須大於此值。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The 19 m concrete cantilever (EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴) under its own weight and the 465 kN nose deflects about 20 mm at its end with a rotation of about 0.0016 rad, which over the 31 m nose gives 50 mm; the nose itself (15 kN/m, EI = 210,000 MPa × 0.08 m⁴) sags 15×31⁴/(8EI) ≈ 103 mm, so the tip is about 173 mm low and the landing jack stroke must exceed this. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼導梁設計與上墩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steel nose design and landing on the pier", which statement holds?
options: 臨時墩只承受垂直力，不需要考慮水平力。
混凝土懸臂 19 m（EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴）承受自重與導梁 465 kN：端點下撓約 20 mm、轉角約 0.0016 rad，乘導梁長 31 m 得 50 mm。
頂推力只與梁重有關，與溫度和滑板狀態無關。
optionsEn: Temporary piers carry only vertical force, so horizontal force can be ignored.

The 19 m concrete cantilever (EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴) under its own weight and the 465 kN nose deflects about 20 mm at its end with a rotation of about 0.0016 rad, which over the 31 m nose gives 50 mm.
Launch force depends only on girder weight, not on temperature or pad condition.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土懸臂 19 m（EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴）承受自重與導梁 465 kN：端點下撓約 20 mm、轉角約 0.0016 rad，乘導梁長 31 m 得 50 mm；導梁自重 15 kN/m、EI = 210,000 MPa × 0.08 m⁴，自身下撓 15×31⁴/(8EI) ≈ 103 mm，前端合計約 173 mm，上墩千斤頂行程須大於此值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The 19 m concrete cantilever (EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴) under its own weight and the 465 kN nose deflects about 20 mm at its end with a rotation of about 0.0016 rad, which over the 31 m nose gives 50 mm; the nose itself (15 kN/m, EI = 210,000 MPa × 0.08 m⁴) sags 15×31⁴/(8EI) ≈ 103 mm, so the tip is about 173 mm low and the landing jack stroke must exceed this. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼導梁設計與上墩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel nose design and landing on the pier: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導梁前端撓度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nose tip deflection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 導梁製作後檢查焊道（非破壞檢測）與栓接預拉力，組裝時量測導梁與混凝土梁的接合角度；首次上墩前預測前端下垂量，現場量測實際值並比較，偏差過大時檢查導梁連接是否鬆動或梁體勁度與假設不同。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After fabrication, inspect nose welds by non-destructive testing and check bolt pretension, and measure the joint angle between nose and concrete girder at assembly; before the first landing, predict the tip sag, measure the actual value and compare, investigating connection slack or girder stiffness differing from assumptions if the deviation is large. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：導梁在每次頂推前檢查連接栓、焊道與前端千斤頂，每完成若干跨做一次詳細檢查並記錄前端下垂量趨勢；導梁拆除與再利用須經原設計者確認其疲勞紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Inspect nose bolts, welds and the tip jack before every launch, carry out a detailed inspection every few spans and log the tip-sag trend; dismantling and reuse of a nose requires the original designer to review its fatigue record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：導梁與梁體的連接栓在反覆頂推中鬆動或疲勞開裂，前端下垂逐次加大，最終導梁撞上墩頂或滑板邊緣；若上墩千斤頂行程不足而強行頂推，導梁下翼板可能被墩頂撞擊而局部挫屈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bolts joining the nose to the girder can loosen or crack by fatigue under repeated launches so the tip sags more each time until it strikes the pier top or pad edge; launching on with an insufficient landing-jack stroke can let the pier top hit and locally buckle the nose bottom flange. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 導梁製作後檢查焊道（非破壞檢測）與栓接預拉力，組裝時量測導梁與混凝土梁的接合角度；首次上墩前預測前端下垂量，現場量測實際值並比較，偏差過大時檢查導梁連接是否鬆動或梁體勁度與假設不同。
knowledge.textEn: After fabrication, inspect nose welds by non-destructive testing and check bolt pretension, and measure the joint angle between nose and concrete girder at assembly; before the first landing, predict the tip sag, measure the actual value and compare, investigating connection slack or girder stiffness differing from assumptions if the deviation is large.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 導梁在每次頂推前檢查連接栓、焊道與前端千斤頂，每完成若干跨做一次詳細檢查並記錄前端下垂量趨勢；導梁拆除與再利用須經原設計者確認其疲勞紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect nose bolts, welds and the tip jack before every launch, carry out a detailed inspection every few spans and log the tip-sag trend; dismantling and reuse of a nose requires the original designer to review its fatigue record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼導梁設計與上墩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Steel nose design and landing on the pier"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
頂推梁沒有中間伸縮縫，所以溫度變化的影響比較小。
導梁製作後檢查焊道（非破壞檢測）與栓接預拉力，組裝時量測導梁與混凝土梁的接合角度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A launched girder has no intermediate joints, so temperature effects are smaller.
After fabrication, inspect nose welds by non-destructive testing and check bolt pretension, and measure the joint angle between nose and concrete girder at assembly.
quiz.explanation: 導梁製作後檢查焊道（非破壞檢測）與栓接預拉力，組裝時量測導梁與混凝土梁的接合角度；首次上墩前預測前端下垂量，現場量測實際值並比較，偏差過大時檢查導梁連接是否鬆動或梁體勁度與假設不同。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After fabrication, inspect nose welds by non-destructive testing and check bolt pretension, and measure the joint angle between nose and concrete girder at assembly; before the first landing, predict the tip sag, measure the actual value and compare, investigating connection slack or girder stiffness differing from assumptions if the deviation is large. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼導梁設計與上墩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steel nose design and landing on the pier: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導梁前端撓度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nose tip deflection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 導梁與梁體的連接栓在反覆頂推中鬆動或疲勞開裂，前端下垂逐次加大，最終導梁撞上墩頂或滑板邊緣；若上墩千斤頂行程不足而強行頂推，導梁下翼板可能被墩頂撞擊而局部挫屈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Bolts joining the nose to the girder can loosen or crack by fatigue under repeated launches so the tip sags more each time until it strikes the pier top or pad edge; launching on with an insufficient landing-jack stroke can let the pier top hit and locally buckle the nose bottom flange. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：導梁與混凝土梁的連接處承受很大的彎矩與剪力，是需要特別細部設計與疲勞檢查的節點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The nose-to-girder connection carries large moment and shear and needs special detailing and fatigue checks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「導梁越長越好，長度可以等於整個跨度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The longer the nose the better; it can be as long as the whole span." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 導梁與梁體的連接栓在反覆頂推中鬆動或疲勞開裂，前端下垂逐次加大，最終導梁撞上墩頂或滑板邊緣；若上墩千斤頂行程不足而強行頂推，導梁下翼板可能被墩頂撞擊而局部挫屈。
knowledge.textEn: Bolts joining the nose to the girder can loosen or crack by fatigue under repeated launches so the tip sags more each time until it strikes the pier top or pad edge; launching on with an insufficient landing-jack stroke can let the pier top hit and locally buckle the nose bottom flange.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼導梁設計與上墩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel nose design and landing on the pier" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 導梁與梁體的連接栓在反覆頂推中鬆動或疲勞開裂，前端下垂逐次加大，最終導梁撞上墩頂或滑板邊緣；若上墩千斤頂行程不足而強行頂推，導梁下翼板可能被墩頂撞擊而局部挫屈。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
PTFE 滑板摩擦極低，所以頂推時不必考慮梁體自行滑動。
optionsEn: Bolts joining the nose to the girder can loosen or crack by fatigue under repeated launches so the tip sags more each time until it strikes the pier top or pad edge.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
PTFE pads have such low friction that runaway of the girder need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 導梁與梁體的連接栓在反覆頂推中鬆動或疲勞開裂，前端下垂逐次加大，最終導梁撞上墩頂或滑板邊緣；若上墩千斤頂行程不足而強行頂推，導梁下翼板可能被墩頂撞擊而局部挫屈。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Bolts joining the nose to the girder can loosen or crack by fatigue under repeated launches so the tip sags more each time until it strikes the pier top or pad edge; launching on with an insufficient landing-jack stroke can let the pier top hit and locally buckle the nose bottom flange. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「滑板與側向導向」如何影響橋梁頂推施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sliding pads and lateral guides” governs force, deformation or durability in “Incremental bridge launching”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 頂推時梁體底板在每座墩頂的臨時滑移支承上滑動：常見作法是不鏽鋼面的混凝土塊或鋼座，上面不斷插入以橡膠加勁的聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑板，滑板隨梁前進，從另一端取出再回送。摩擦力隨溫度、接觸壓力與初始靜摩擦變化，啟動時最大。墩頂兩側還要設側向導向裝置，控制梁體平面位置，曲線橋上導向力更大。梁在縱坡下坡方向頂推時，若摩擦低於坡度分力，梁會自行滑動，必須設制動或拉回裝置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「滑板與側向導向」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During launching the girder soffit slides over temporary sliding bearings on each pier: commonly concrete blocks or steel seats faced with stainless steel, onto which elastomer-backed PTFE pads are continuously fed so that they travel with the girder and are retrieved at the far end and returned. Friction varies with temperature, contact pressure and initial static breakaway, peaking at start-up. Lateral guides on both sides of each pier control plan position, with larger guide forces on curved bridges. When launching downhill on a gradient, if friction falls below the slope component the girder can run away by itself, so braking or hold-back devices are required. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sliding pads and lateral guides” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：梁重 W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Girder weight W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「PTFE 滑板摩擦極低，所以頂推時不必考慮梁體自行滑動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "PTFE pads have such low friction that runaway of the girder need not be considered." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「滑板與側向導向」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sliding pads and lateral guides”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向
knowledge.titleEn: Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance
knowledge.text: 頂推時梁體底板在每座墩頂的臨時滑移支承上滑動：常見作法是不鏽鋼面的混凝土塊或鋼座，上面不斷插入以橡膠加勁的聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑板，滑板隨梁前進，從另一端取出再回送。摩擦力隨溫度、接觸壓力與初始靜摩擦變化，啟動時最大。
knowledge.textEn: During launching the girder soffit slides over temporary sliding bearings on each pier: commonly concrete blocks or steel seats faced with stainless steel, onto which elastomer-backed PTFE pads are continuously fed so that they travel with the girder and are retrieved at the far end and returned. Friction varies with temperature, contact pressure and initial static breakaway, peaking at start-up.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：PTFE 滑板摩擦極低，所以頂推時不必考慮梁體自行滑動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: PTFE pads have such low friction that runaway of the girder need not be considered. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance" is correct?
options: PTFE 滑板摩擦極低，所以頂推時不必考慮梁體自行滑動。
頂推時梁體底板在每座墩頂的臨時滑移支承上滑動：常見作法是不鏽鋼面的混凝土塊或鋼座，上面不斷插入以橡膠加勁的聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑板，滑板隨梁前進，從另一端取出再回送。
頂推梁在台座上製作，幾何誤差可以在頂推後再一次修正。
optionsEn: PTFE pads have such low friction that runaway of the girder need not be considered.

During launching the girder soffit slides over temporary sliding bearings on each pier: commonly concrete blocks or steel seats faced with stainless steel, onto which elastomer-backed PTFE pads are continuously fed so that they travel with the girder and are retrieved at the far end and returned.
Because the girder is cast on a bed, geometric errors can be corrected after launching.
quiz.explanation: 頂推時梁體底板在每座墩頂的臨時滑移支承上滑動：常見作法是不鏽鋼面的混凝土塊或鋼座，上面不斷插入以橡膠加勁的聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑板，滑板隨梁前進，從另一端取出再回送。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During launching the girder soffit slides over temporary sliding bearings on each pier: commonly concrete blocks or steel seats faced with stainless steel, onto which elastomer-backed PTFE pads are continuously fed so that they travel with the girder and are retrieved at the far end and returned. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滑板與側向導向」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sliding pads and lateral guides” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：梁重 W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN。上坡 2%、摩擦 μ = 0.04：頂推力 F = W(μ + i) = 80,000×0.06 = 4,800 kN。下坡 2% 且摩擦最低只有 0.01 時，下滑淨力 W(i − μ) = 80,000×0.01 = 800 kN，必須由制動裝置抵抗。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Girder weight W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN. Uphill at 2% with μ = 0.04, launch force F = W(μ + i) = 80,000×0.06 = 4,800 kN. Downhill at 2% with a minimum friction of only 0.01, the net runaway force W(i − μ) = 80,000×0.01 = 800 kN must be held by braking devices. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：滑移支承與 PTFE 滑板依規格檢驗材料與表面粗糙度，安裝時量測各墩滑移面高程與橫坡；頂推中記錄每次啟動與等速段的頂推力，反算摩擦係數，並確認側向導向的間隙與受力在設計範圍內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sliding-bearing materials and surface finish against the specification and survey the level and cross-fall of each sliding surface at installation; during launching record the force at breakaway and in steady motion to back-calculate friction, and confirm lateral-guide clearances and forces stay within design limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 梁重 W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN。上坡 2%、摩擦 μ = 0.04：頂推力 F = W(μ + i) = 80,000×0.06 = 4,800 kN。下坡 2% 且摩擦最低只有 0.01 時，下滑淨力 W(i − μ) = 80,000×0.01 = 800 kN，必須由制動裝置抵抗。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Girder weight W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN. Uphill at 2% with μ = 0.04, launch force F = W(μ + i) = 80,000×0.06 = 4,800 kN. Downhill at 2% with a minimum friction of only 0.01, the net runaway force W(i − μ) = 80,000×0.01 = 800 kN must be held by braking devices. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance", which statement holds?
options: 墩頂高程差幾公釐對頂推中的長梁沒有影響。
頂推完成就等於施工完成，支承轉換只是簡單的換件作業。
optionsEn: A few millimetres of pier-level difference has no effect on a long girder being launched.
Once launching ends construction is finished; changing to permanent bearings is a simple swap.
Girder weight W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN.
quiz.explanation: 梁重 W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Girder weight W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「滑板與側向導向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sliding pads and lateral guides” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 滑移支承與 PTFE 滑板依規格檢驗材料與表面粗糙度，安裝時量測各墩滑移面高程與橫坡；頂推中記錄每次啟動與等速段的頂推力，反算摩擦係數，並確認側向導向的間隙與受力在設計範圍內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check sliding-bearing materials and surface finish against the specification and survey the level and cross-fall of each sliding surface at installation; during launching record the force at breakaway and in steady motion to back-calculate friction, and confirm lateral-guide clearances and forces stay within design limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每座墩頂指派專人負責滑板插放與觀察，並以對講系統與頂推控制室連線，任何異常可立即停機；下坡頂推的制動與拉回系統須經設計並在首次頂推前試運轉。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assign a person at every pier to feed pads and observe, linked by intercom to the launch control room so any anomaly stops the push immediately; braking and hold-back systems for downhill launching must be designed and test-run before the first launch.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：滑板漏放或錯位時，混凝土直接在不鏽鋼面上摩擦，頂推力突增並刮傷底板；側向導向間隙過大，曲線梁逐漸偏離設計位置，最後在支承安裝時找不到正確位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A missed or displaced pad lets concrete rub on stainless steel, so launch force jumps and the soffit is scored; excessive lateral-guide clearance lets a curved girder drift from its design position until bearings cannot be set correctly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 滑移支承與 PTFE 滑板依規格檢驗材料與表面粗糙度，安裝時量測各墩滑移面高程與橫坡；頂推中記錄每次啟動與等速段的頂推力，反算摩擦係數，並確認側向導向的間隙與受力在設計範圍內。
knowledge.textEn: Check sliding-bearing materials and surface finish against the specification and survey the level and cross-fall of each sliding surface at installation; during launching record the force at breakaway and in steady motion to back-calculate friction, and confirm lateral-guide clearances and forces stay within design limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每座墩頂指派專人負責滑板插放與觀察，並以對講系統與頂推控制室連線，任何異常可立即停機；下坡頂推的制動與拉回系統須經設計並在首次頂推前試運轉。
knowledge.textEn: Assign a person at every pier to feed pads and observe, linked by intercom to the launch control room so any anomaly stops the push immediately; braking and hold-back systems for downhill launching must be designed and test-run before the first launch.

quiz.question: 要驗證「滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance"?
options: 滑移支承與 PTFE 滑板依規格檢驗材料與表面粗糙度，安裝時量測各墩滑移面高程與橫坡。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
頂推梁完工後是連續梁，所以只要依連續梁的彎矩分布配置預力即可。
optionsEn: Check sliding-bearing materials and surface finish against the specification and survey the level and cross-fall of each sliding surface at installation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A launched girder ends up continuous, so prestress can simply follow the continuous-beam moment diagram.
quiz.explanation: 滑移支承與 PTFE 滑板依規格檢驗材料與表面粗糙度，安裝時量測各墩滑移面高程與橫坡；頂推中記錄每次啟動與等速段的頂推力，反算摩擦係數，並確認側向導向的間隙與受力在設計範圍內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check sliding-bearing materials and surface finish against the specification and survey the level and cross-fall of each sliding surface at installation; during launching record the force at breakaway and in steady motion to back-calculate friction, and confirm lateral-guide clearances and forces stay within design limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滑板與側向導向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sliding pads and lateral guides” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 滑板漏放或錯位時，混凝土直接在不鏽鋼面上摩擦，頂推力突增並刮傷底板；側向導向間隙過大，曲線梁逐漸偏離設計位置，最後在支承安裝時找不到正確位置。下坡頂推若未設制動，梁體在千斤頂釋放瞬間可能自行滑移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A missed or displaced pad lets concrete rub on stainless steel, so launch force jumps and the soffit is scored; excessive lateral-guide clearance lets a curved girder drift from its design position until bearings cannot be set correctly. Downhill launching without braking can let the girder slide on its own when the jacks release. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：梁在縱坡下坡方向頂推時，若摩擦低於坡度分力，梁會自行滑動，必須設制動或拉回裝置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: When launching downhill on a gradient, if friction falls below the slope component the girder can run away by itself, so braking or hold-back devices are required.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「PTFE 滑板摩擦極低，所以頂推時不必考慮梁體自行滑動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "PTFE pads have such low friction that runaway of the girder need not be considered." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 滑板漏放或錯位時，混凝土直接在不鏽鋼面上摩擦，頂推力突增並刮傷底板；側向導向間隙過大，曲線梁逐漸偏離設計位置，最後在支承安裝時找不到正確位置。下坡頂推若未設制動，梁體在千斤頂釋放瞬間可能自行滑移。
knowledge.textEn: A missed or displaced pad lets concrete rub on stainless steel, so launch force jumps and the soffit is scored; excessive lateral-guide clearance lets a curved girder drift from its design position until bearings cannot be set correctly. Downhill launching without braking can let the girder slide on its own when the jacks release.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
滑板漏放或錯位時，混凝土直接在不鏽鋼面上摩擦，頂推力突增並刮傷底板；側向導向間隙過大，曲線梁逐漸偏離設計位置，最後在支承安裝時找不到正確位置。
頂推梁在台座上製作，幾何誤差可以在頂推後再一次修正。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A missed or displaced pad lets concrete rub on stainless steel, so launch force jumps and the soffit is scored.
Because the girder is cast on a bed, geometric errors can be corrected after launching.
quiz.explanation: 滑板漏放或錯位時，混凝土直接在不鏽鋼面上摩擦，頂推力突增並刮傷底板；側向導向間隙過大，曲線梁逐漸偏離設計位置，最後在支承安裝時找不到正確位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A missed or displaced pad lets concrete rub on stainless steel, so launch force jumps and the soffit is scored; excessive lateral-guide clearance lets a curved girder drift from its design position until bearings cannot be set correctly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預製台座與每週頂推循環」與「臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle" and "Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預製台座與每週頂推循環：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋台後預製台座」如何影響橋梁頂推施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Casting bed behind the abutment” governs force, deformation or durability in “Incremental bridge launching”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 頂推工法把整座橋的製造集中在橋台後方的固定預製台座：每一段約 15 至 25 m，在同一副模板中澆製並緊貼前一段匹配，張拉中心預力後整條梁向前推一段距離，空出台座再做下一段。這讓施工像工廠一樣重複，常見節奏是每週一段。台座本身的基礎與模板精度極重要：每一段都由同一副模板決定幾何，微小的角度誤差會隨每一段傳到整座橋；VSL 的報告指出，若 19 m 的一段誤差 1 mm，累積到全橋可達約 100 mm。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋台後預製台座」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Incremental launching concentrates the manufacture of the whole bridge on a fixed casting bed behind the abutment: each segment, about 15 to 25 m long, is cast in the same formwork against the previous one, centric prestress is stressed, the whole girder is pushed forward by one segment length, and the bed is freed for the next. Work repeats like a factory, typically at one segment per week. The bed's foundation and form accuracy are critical because one formwork sets the geometry of every segment and small angular errors propagate through the bridge; a VSL report notes that a 1 mm error over one 19 m segment could accumulate to about 100 mm over the bridge length. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Casting bed behind the abutment” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 420 m bridge in 19 m segments, 420/19 ≈ 22.1, so 23 segments; at one per week that is about 23 × 7 = 161 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂推梁在台座上製作，幾何誤差可以在頂推後再一次修正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because the girder is cast on a bed, geometric errors can be corrected after launching." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋台後預製台座」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Casting bed behind the abutment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預製台座與每週頂推循環
knowledge.titleEn: Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle
knowledge.text: 頂推工法把整座橋的製造集中在橋台後方的固定預製台座：每一段約 15 至 25 m，在同一副模板中澆製並緊貼前一段匹配，張拉中心預力後整條梁向前推一段距離，空出台座再做下一段。這讓施工像工廠一樣重複，常見節奏是每週一段。
knowledge.textEn: Incremental launching concentrates the manufacture of the whole bridge on a fixed casting bed behind the abutment: each segment, about 15 to 25 m long, is cast in the same formwork against the previous one, centric prestress is stressed, the whole girder is pushed forward by one segment length, and the bed is freed for the next. Work repeats like a factory, typically at one segment per week.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頂推梁在台座上製作，幾何誤差可以在頂推後再一次修正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because the girder is cast on a bed, geometric errors can be corrected after launching. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預製台座與每週頂推循環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle" is correct?
options: 頂推梁在台座上製作，幾何誤差可以在頂推後再一次修正。
臨時墩只承受垂直力，不需要考慮水平力。
頂推工法把整座橋的製造集中在橋台後方的固定預製台座：每一段約 15 至 25 m，在同一副模板中澆製並緊貼前一段匹配，張拉中心預力後整條梁向前推一段距離，空出台座再做下一段。
optionsEn: Because the girder is cast on a bed, geometric errors can be corrected after launching.
Temporary piers carry only vertical force, so horizontal force can be ignored.

Incremental launching concentrates the manufacture of the whole bridge on a fixed casting bed behind the abutment: each segment, about 15 to 25 m long, is cast in the same formwork against the previous one, centric prestress is stressed, the whole girder is pushed forward by one segment length, and the bed is freed for the next.
quiz.explanation: 頂推工法把整座橋的製造集中在橋台後方的固定預製台座：每一段約 15 至 25 m，在同一副模板中澆製並緊貼前一段匹配，張拉中心預力後整條梁向前推一段距離，空出台座再做下一段。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Incremental launching concentrates the manufacture of the whole bridge on a fixed casting bed behind the abutment: each segment, about 15 to 25 m long, is cast in the same formwork against the previous one, centric prestress is stressed, the whole girder is pushed forward by one segment length, and the bed is freed for the next. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預製台座與每週頂推循環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋台後預製台座」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Casting bed behind the abutment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橋長 420 m、每段 19 m：420/19 ≈ 22.1，取 23 段，每週一段約 23 × 7 = 161 天。頂推速度 3 至 6 m/h 時，一段 19 m 純移動時間約 19/6 ≈ 3.2 h 至 19/3 ≈ 6.3 h，頂推本身只占循環很小部分，關鍵是鋼筋、澆置、養護與張拉。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 420 m bridge in 19 m segments, 420/19 ≈ 22.1, so 23 segments; at one per week that is about 23 × 7 = 161 days. At launching speeds of 3 to 6 m/h, moving one 19 m segment takes about 19/6 ≈ 3.2 h to 19/3 ≈ 6.3 h, a small part of the cycle; reinforcement, casting, curing and stressing are critical. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：預製台座基礎在使用前做沉陷觀測並定期複測，底模與側模在每一段澆置前以精密水準量測高程與線形（目標精度為十分之一公釐級）；每段完成後量測端面位置與梁底高程，與理論縱斷面比較並回饋下一段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Monitor settlement of the casting-bed foundation before use and re-survey periodically; before every cast, level the soffit and side forms precisely, aiming at tenth-of-a-millimetre accuracy; after each segment, survey the end face position and soffit level, compare with the theoretical profile and feed back to the next segment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 橋長 420 m、每段 19 m：420/19 ≈ 22.1，取 23 段，每週一段約 23 × 7 = 161 天。頂推速度 3 至 6 m/h 時，一段 19 m 純移動時間約 19/6 ≈ 3.2 h 至 19/3 ≈ 6.3 h，頂推本身只占循環很小部分，關鍵是鋼筋、澆置、養護與張拉。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 420 m bridge in 19 m segments, 420/19 ≈ 22.1, so 23 segments; at one per week that is about 23 × 7 = 161 days. At launching speeds of 3 to 6 m/h, moving one 19 m segment takes about 19/6 ≈ 3.2 h to 19/3 ≈ 6.3 h, a small part of the cycle; reinforcement, casting, curing and stressing are critical. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預製台座與每週頂推循環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle", which statement holds?
options: 頂推力只與梁重有關，與溫度和滑板狀態無關。
頂推梁沒有中間伸縮縫，所以溫度變化的影響比較小。
optionsEn: For a 420 m bridge in 19 m segments, 420/19 ≈ 22.1, so 23 segments; at one per week that is about 23 × 7 = 161 days.
Launch force depends only on girder weight, not on temperature or pad condition.
A launched girder has no intermediate joints, so temperature effects are smaller.
quiz.explanation: 橋長 420 m、每段 19 m：420/19 ≈ 22.1，取 23 段，每週一段約 23 × 7 = 161 天。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 420 m bridge in 19 m segments, 420/19 ≈ 22.1, so 23 segments; at one per week that is about 23 × 7 = 161 days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預製台座與每週頂推循環：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋台後預製台座」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Casting bed behind the abutment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 預製台座基礎在使用前做沉陷觀測並定期複測，底模與側模在每一段澆置前以精密水準量測高程與線形（目標精度為十分之一公釐級）；每段完成後量測端面位置與梁底高程，與理論縱斷面比較並回饋下一段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor settlement of the casting-bed foundation before use and re-survey periodically; before every cast, level the soffit and side forms precisely, aiming at tenth-of-a-millimetre accuracy; after each segment, survey the end face position and soffit level, compare with the theoretical profile and feed back to the next segment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預製台座的基礎、底模支撐與量測控制點應有專屬設計與檢查表，每段澆置前的模板高程單由測量工程師簽認；台座附近禁止堆放重物或開挖，避免改變基礎狀態。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The casting bed's foundation, soffit supports and survey control need their own design and checklist, with a form-level sheet signed by the survey engineer before every cast; heavy stockpiles and excavation near the bed are forbidden to avoid disturbing its foundation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：台座基礎不均勻沉陷而未察覺，每一段的底模都帶著相同的微小傾角，梁底成為鋸齒或折線，到了遠端墩頂高差可達數公分，頂推中支承反力重新分配，梁體出現非預期裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unnoticed differential settlement of the casting bed gives every segment the same small tilt, so the soffit becomes a saw-tooth or kinked line; at distant piers level errors reach several centimetres, reactions redistribute during launching and unexpected cracks appear. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 預製台座基礎在使用前做沉陷觀測並定期複測，底模與側模在每一段澆置前以精密水準量測高程與線形（目標精度為十分之一公釐級）；每段完成後量測端面位置與梁底高程，與理論縱斷面比較並回饋下一段。
knowledge.textEn: Monitor settlement of the casting-bed foundation before use and re-survey periodically; before every cast, level the soffit and side forms precisely, aiming at tenth-of-a-millimetre accuracy; after each segment, survey the end face position and soffit level, compare with the theoretical profile and feed back to the next segment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 預製台座的基礎、底模支撐與量測控制點應有專屬設計與檢查表，每段澆置前的模板高程單由測量工程師簽認；台座附近禁止堆放重物或開挖，避免改變基礎狀態。
knowledge.textEn: The casting bed's foundation, soffit supports and survey control need their own design and checklist, with a form-level sheet signed by the survey engineer before every cast; heavy stockpiles and excavation near the bed are forbidden to avoid disturbing its foundation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預製台座與每週頂推循環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
預製台座基礎在使用前做沉陷觀測並定期複測，底模與側模在每一段澆置前以精密水準量測高程與線形（目標精度為十分之一公釐級）。
頂推時的預力只要依完工後跨中正彎矩配置在底板即可。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Monitor settlement of the casting-bed foundation before use and re-survey periodically.
Launching prestress need only be placed in the bottom slab for the final midspan sagging moment.
quiz.explanation: 預製台座基礎在使用前做沉陷觀測並定期複測，底模與側模在每一段澆置前以精密水準量測高程與線形（目標精度為十分之一公釐級）；每段完成後量測端面位置與梁底高程，與理論縱斷面比較並回饋下一段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitor settlement of the casting-bed foundation before use and re-survey periodically; before every cast, level the soffit and side forms precisely, aiming at tenth-of-a-millimetre accuracy; after each segment, survey the end face position and soffit level, compare with the theoretical profile and feed back to the next segment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預製台座與每週頂推循環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋台後預製台座」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Casting bed behind the abutment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 台座基礎不均勻沉陷而未察覺，每一段的底模都帶著相同的微小傾角，梁底成為鋸齒或折線，到了遠端墩頂高差可達數公分，頂推中支承反力重新分配，梁體出現非預期裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unnoticed differential settlement of the casting bed gives every segment the same small tilt, so the soffit becomes a saw-tooth or kinked line; at distant piers level errors reach several centimetres, reactions redistribute during launching and unexpected cracks appear. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：台座本身的基礎與模板精度極重要：每一段都由同一副模板決定幾何，微小的角度誤差會隨每一段傳到整座橋；VSL 的報告指出，若 19 m 的一段誤差 1 mm，累積到全橋可達約 100 mm。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The bed's foundation and form accuracy are critical because one formwork sets the geometry of every segment and small angular errors propagate through the bridge; a VSL report notes that a 1 mm error over one 19 m segment could accumulate to about 100 mm over the bridge length.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂推梁在台座上製作，幾何誤差可以在頂推後再一次修正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because the girder is cast on a bed, geometric errors can be corrected after launching." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 台座基礎不均勻沉陷而未察覺，每一段的底模都帶著相同的微小傾角，梁底成為鋸齒或折線，到了遠端墩頂高差可達數公分，頂推中支承反力重新分配，梁體出現非預期裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Unnoticed differential settlement of the casting bed gives every segment the same small tilt, so the soffit becomes a saw-tooth or kinked line; at distant piers level errors reach several centimetres, reactions redistribute during launching and unexpected cracks appear.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預製台座與每週頂推循環」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
臨時墩只承受垂直力，不需要考慮水平力。
台座基礎不均勻沉陷而未察覺，每一段的底模都帶著相同的微小傾角，梁底成為鋸齒或折線，到了遠端墩頂高差可達數公分，頂推中支承反力重新分配，梁體出現非預期裂縫。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Temporary piers carry only vertical force, so horizontal force can be ignored.
Unnoticed differential settlement of the casting bed gives every segment the same small tilt, so the soffit becomes a saw-tooth or kinked line.
quiz.explanation: 台座基礎不均勻沉陷而未察覺，每一段的底模都帶著相同的微小傾角，梁底成為鋸齒或折線，到了遠端墩頂高差可達數公分，頂推中支承反力重新分配，梁體出現非預期裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unnoticed differential settlement of the casting bed gives every segment the same small tilt, so the soffit becomes a saw-tooth or kinked line; at distant piers level errors reach several centimetres, reactions redistribute during launching and unexpected cracks appear. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「臨時墩與多點頂推」如何影響橋梁頂推施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary piers and multi-point launching” governs force, deformation or durability in “Incremental bridge launching”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 當永久跨度超過頂推經濟範圍時，可在跨中設臨時墩，把頂推跨度減半。Millau 高架橋的鋼橋面由谷地兩側分別頂推，以臨時支撐把 342 m 主跨分成約 171 m 的頂推跨，最高臨時支撐約 175 m。頂推長而重的梁時，若只在橋台集中施力，各墩頂的摩擦力都會以水平力推動高墩；改在每座墩與臨時墩頂設同步控制的頂推裝置，各點只克服本身摩擦，墩頂水平力大幅降低。鋼橋面頂推還要檢查腹板在滑移點的局部承壓與挫屈。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「臨時墩與多點頂推」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When permanent spans exceed the economic launching range, temporary piers at midspan halve the launch span. Millau's steel deck was launched from both sides of the valley with temporary supports dividing the 342 m spans into launch spans of about 171 m, the tallest temporary support being about 175 m high. Pushing a long heavy girder from the abutment alone makes the friction at every pier push the tall piers horizontally; synchronised launching devices on each pier and temporary support let each point overcome only its own friction, sharply reducing horizontal pier forces. Steel decks also need checks of web patch loading and buckling at the sliding points. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temporary piers and multi-point launching” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某臨時墩反力 R = 25,000 kN、摩擦 μ = 0.05：若由橋台集中頂推，該墩頂水平力 H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN，在 175 m 高處造成墩底彎矩 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m；若墩頂自設頂推裝置，H 接近零。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a temporary pier reaction R = 25,000 kN and μ = 0.05, launching from the abutment alone puts H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN on the pier top, a base moment of 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m at 175 m height; with its own launching device on the pier top, H is close to zero.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臨時墩只承受垂直力，不需要考慮水平力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Temporary piers carry only vertical force, so horizontal force can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「臨時墩與多點頂推」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Temporary piers and multi-point launching”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推
knowledge.titleEn: Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching
knowledge.text: 當永久跨度超過頂推經濟範圍時，可在跨中設臨時墩，把頂推跨度減半。Millau 高架橋的鋼橋面由谷地兩側分別頂推，以臨時支撐把 342 m 主跨分成約 171 m 的頂推跨，最高臨時支撐約 175 m。
knowledge.textEn: When permanent spans exceed the economic launching range, temporary piers at midspan halve the launch span. Millau's steel deck was launched from both sides of the valley with temporary supports dividing the 342 m spans into launch spans of about 171 m, the tallest temporary support being about 175 m high.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：臨時墩只承受垂直力，不需要考慮水平力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Temporary piers carry only vertical force, so horizontal force can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching" is correct?
options: 當永久跨度超過頂推經濟範圍時，可在跨中設臨時墩，把頂推跨度減半。
臨時墩只承受垂直力，不需要考慮水平力。
墩頂高程差幾公釐對頂推中的長梁沒有影響。
optionsEn: When permanent spans exceed the economic launching range, temporary piers at midspan halve the launch span.
Temporary piers carry only vertical force, so horizontal force can be ignored.
A few millimetres of pier-level difference has no effect on a long girder being launched.
quiz.explanation: 當永久跨度超過頂推經濟範圍時，可在跨中設臨時墩，把頂推跨度減半。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When permanent spans exceed the economic launching range, temporary piers at midspan halve the launch span. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臨時墩與多點頂推」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temporary piers and multi-point launching” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某臨時墩反力 R = 25,000 kN、摩擦 μ = 0.05：若由橋台集中頂推，該墩頂水平力 H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN，在 175 m 高處造成墩底彎矩 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m；若墩頂自設頂推裝置，H 接近零。半橋頂推 1,000 m、每循環 0.6 m 約需 1,667 循環，每循環 4 分鐘則純移動約 111 h。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a temporary pier reaction R = 25,000 kN and μ = 0.05, launching from the abutment alone puts H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN on the pier top, a base moment of 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m at 175 m height; with its own launching device on the pier top, H is close to zero. Launching half a deck 1,000 m at 0.6 m per cycle needs about 1,667 cycles, about 111 h of movement at 4 minutes per cycle. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：臨時墩設計須檢核頂推中最不利的垂直反力、水平力與風載組合，並量測臨時墩頂的位移與傾斜；分散式頂推以中央電腦同步控制，記錄每一點的推力與行程，任何一點推力偏離設定範圍即自動停機。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Temporary-pier design must cover the worst launching combination of vertical reaction, horizontal force and wind, with displacement and tilt monitored at the pier top; distributed launching is synchronised by a central computer that logs each point's force and stroke and stops automatically if any point leaves its set range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 某臨時墩反力 R = 25,000 kN、摩擦 μ = 0.05：若由橋台集中頂推，該墩頂水平力 H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN，在 175 m 高處造成墩底彎矩 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m；若墩頂自設頂推裝置，H 接近零。半橋頂推 1,000 m、每循環 0.6 m 約需 1,667 循環，每循環 4 分鐘則純移動約 111 h。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a temporary pier reaction R = 25,000 kN and μ = 0.05, launching from the abutment alone puts H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN on the pier top, a base moment of 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m at 175 m height; with its own launching device on the pier top, H is close to zero. Launching half a deck 1,000 m at 0.6 m per cycle needs about 1,667 cycles, about 111 h of movement at 4 minutes per cycle. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching", which statement holds?
options: 頂推完成就等於施工完成，支承轉換只是簡單的換件作業。
某臨時墩反力 R = 25,000 kN、摩擦 μ = 0.05：若由橋台集中頂推，該墩頂水平力 H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN，在 175 m 高處造成墩底彎矩 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m。
頂推梁完工後是連續梁，所以只要依連續梁的彎矩分布配置預力即可。
optionsEn: Once launching ends construction is finished; changing to permanent bearings is a simple swap.
For a temporary pier reaction R = 25,000 kN and μ = 0.05, launching from the abutment alone puts H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN on the pier top, a base moment of 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m at 175 m height.
A launched girder ends up continuous, so prestress can simply follow the continuous-beam moment diagram.
quiz.explanation: 某臨時墩反力 R = 25,000 kN、摩擦 μ = 0.05：若由橋台集中頂推，該墩頂水平力 H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN，在 175 m 高處造成墩底彎矩 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m；若墩頂自設頂推裝置，H 接近零。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a temporary pier reaction R = 25,000 kN and μ = 0.05, launching from the abutment alone puts H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN on the pier top, a base moment of 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m at 175 m height; with its own launching device on the pier top, H is close to zero. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「臨時墩與多點頂推」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temporary piers and multi-point launching” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 臨時墩設計須檢核頂推中最不利的垂直反力、水平力與風載組合，並量測臨時墩頂的位移與傾斜；分散式頂推以中央電腦同步控制，記錄每一點的推力與行程，任何一點推力偏離設定範圍即自動停機。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Temporary-pier design must cover the worst launching combination of vertical reaction, horizontal force and wind, with displacement and tilt monitored at the pier top; distributed launching is synchronised by a central computer that logs each point's force and stroke and stops automatically if any point leaves its set range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：頂推作業前召開停留點會議，確認臨時墩與高墩的位移監測、風速限制、同步系統測試與緊急停機程序；每次頂推由頂推總指揮統一下令，各墩回報就緒後才能啟動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold a hold-point meeting before launching to confirm displacement monitoring of temporary and tall piers, wind limits, synchronisation tests and emergency stops; every push is ordered by a single launch director and starts only after every pier reports ready.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：分散式頂推不同步時，某一墩的裝置推得比其他快，該墩頂承受反向水平力，高墩或臨時墩可能過度變形；鋼橋面腹板在滑移點若未加勁，局部承壓可使腹板挫屈，頂推被迫中斷補強。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If distributed devices lose synchronisation, one pushes faster than the rest and its pier takes a reverse horizontal force that can over-deflect a tall or temporary pier; an unstiffened steel web at a sliding point can buckle under patch loading, halting the launch for strengthening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 臨時墩設計須檢核頂推中最不利的垂直反力、水平力與風載組合，並量測臨時墩頂的位移與傾斜；分散式頂推以中央電腦同步控制，記錄每一點的推力與行程，任何一點推力偏離設定範圍即自動停機。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary-pier design must cover the worst launching combination of vertical reaction, horizontal force and wind, with displacement and tilt monitored at the pier top; distributed launching is synchronised by a central computer that logs each point's force and stroke and stops automatically if any point leaves its set range.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 頂推作業前召開停留點會議，確認臨時墩與高墩的位移監測、風速限制、同步系統測試與緊急停機程序；每次頂推由頂推總指揮統一下令，各墩回報就緒後才能啟動。
knowledge.textEn: Hold a hold-point meeting before launching to confirm displacement monitoring of temporary and tall piers, wind limits, synchronisation tests and emergency stops; every push is ordered by a single launch director and starts only after every pier reports ready.

quiz.question: 要驗證「臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
導梁越長越好，長度可以等於整個跨度。
臨時墩設計須檢核頂推中最不利的垂直反力、水平力與風載組合，並量測臨時墩頂的位移與傾斜。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The longer the nose the better; it can be as long as the whole span.
Temporary-pier design must cover the worst launching combination of vertical reaction, horizontal force and wind, with displacement and tilt monitored at the pier top.
quiz.explanation: 臨時墩設計須檢核頂推中最不利的垂直反力、水平力與風載組合，並量測臨時墩頂的位移與傾斜；分散式頂推以中央電腦同步控制，記錄每一點的推力與行程，任何一點推力偏離設定範圍即自動停機。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Temporary-pier design must cover the worst launching combination of vertical reaction, horizontal force and wind, with displacement and tilt monitored at the pier top; distributed launching is synchronised by a central computer that logs each point's force and stroke and stops automatically if any point leaves its set range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臨時墩與多點頂推」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temporary piers and multi-point launching” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 分散式頂推不同步時，某一墩的裝置推得比其他快，該墩頂承受反向水平力，高墩或臨時墩可能過度變形；鋼橋面腹板在滑移點若未加勁，局部承壓可使腹板挫屈，頂推被迫中斷補強。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If distributed devices lose synchronisation, one pushes faster than the rest and its pier takes a reverse horizontal force that can over-deflect a tall or temporary pier; an unstiffened steel web at a sliding point can buckle under patch loading, halting the launch for strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼橋面頂推還要檢查腹板在滑移點的局部承壓與挫屈。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Steel decks also need checks of web patch loading and buckling at the sliding points.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「臨時墩只承受垂直力，不需要考慮水平力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Temporary piers carry only vertical force, so horizontal force can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 分散式頂推不同步時，某一墩的裝置推得比其他快，該墩頂承受反向水平力，高墩或臨時墩可能過度變形；鋼橋面腹板在滑移點若未加勁，局部承壓可使腹板挫屈，頂推被迫中斷補強。
knowledge.textEn: If distributed devices lose synchronisation, one pushes faster than the rest and its pier takes a reverse horizontal force that can over-deflect a tall or temporary pier; an unstiffened steel web at a sliding point can buckle under patch loading, halting the launch for strengthening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 分散式頂推不同步時，某一墩的裝置推得比其他快，該墩頂承受反向水平力，高墩或臨時墩可能過度變形。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
墩頂高程差幾公釐對頂推中的長梁沒有影響。
optionsEn: If distributed devices lose synchronisation, one pushes faster than the rest and its pier takes a reverse horizontal force that can over-deflect a tall or temporary pier.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A few millimetres of pier-level difference has no effect on a long girder being launched.
quiz.explanation: 分散式頂推不同步時，某一墩的裝置推得比其他快，該墩頂承受反向水平力，高墩或臨時墩可能過度變形；鋼橋面腹板在滑移點若未加勁，局部承壓可使腹板挫屈，頂推被迫中斷補強。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If distributed devices lose synchronisation, one pushes faster than the rest and its pier takes a reverse horizontal force that can over-deflect a tall or temporary pier; an unstiffened steel web at a sliding point can buckle under patch loading, halting the launch for strengthening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支承高程偏差與反力量測」與「頂推力、摩擦反算與變形監測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support level deviations and reaction measurement" and "Launch force, back-calculated friction and deformation monitoring": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支承高程偏差與反力量測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Support level deviations and reaction measurement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墩頂高程偏差與反力」如何影響橋梁頂推施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pier level deviation and reactions” governs force, deformation or durability in “Incremental bridge launching”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 頂推中的梁是一根很長的連續梁，墩頂滑移面高程只要偏差幾公釐，就會改變各墩反力與梁內彎矩，這也是歐洲規範要求頂推分析必須考慮支承高程偏差的原因。因此在每座墩頂滑移支承下設置油壓千斤頂或荷重計，頂推過程中直接量測反力，比較預測值；若某一墩反力明顯偏高，可能是滑移面過高、梁底局部凸起或台座幾何誤差，須在下一次頂推前調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墩頂高程偏差與反力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A girder being launched is a long continuous beam, and a deviation of a few millimetres in a pier's sliding-surface level changes every reaction and the internal moments, which is why European rules require launching analyses to include support level deviations. Hydraulic jacks or load cells under each pier's sliding bearing therefore measure reactions directly during launching for comparison with predictions; a reaction well above prediction may mean a sliding surface set too high, a local bulge on the soffit or casting-bed geometry error, to be adjusted before the next push. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pier level deviation and reactions” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩等跨連續梁中間支承下陷 δ 時，反力變化 ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a two-equal-span continuous beam whose middle support drops δ, the reaction changes by ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「墩頂高程差幾公釐對頂推中的長梁沒有影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 支承高程偏差與反力量測
knowledge.titleEn: Support level deviations and reaction measurement
knowledge.text: 頂推中的梁是一根很長的連續梁，墩頂滑移面高程只要偏差幾公釐，就會改變各墩反力與梁內彎矩，這也是歐洲規範要求頂推分析必須考慮支承高程偏差的原因。因此在每座墩頂滑移支承下設置油壓千斤頂或荷重計，頂推過程中直接量測反力，比較預測值；若某一墩反力明顯偏高，可能是滑移面過高、梁底局部凸起或台座幾何誤差，須在下一次頂推前調整。
knowledge.textEn: A girder being launched is a long continuous beam, and a deviation of a few millimetres in a pier's sliding-surface level changes every reaction and the internal moments, which is why European rules require launching analyses to include support level deviations. Hydraulic jacks or load cells under each pier's sliding bearing therefore measure reactions directly during launching for comparison with predictions; a reaction well above prediction may mean a sliding surface set too high, a local bulge on the soffit or casting-bed geometry error, to be adjusted before the next push.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：墩頂高程差幾公釐對頂推中的長梁沒有影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A few millimetres of pier-level difference has no effect on a long girder being launched. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支承高程偏差與反力量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

頂推力只與梁重有關，與溫度和滑板狀態無關。
optionsEn: A few millimetres of pier-level difference has no effect on a long girder being launched.

A girder being launched is a long continuous beam, and a deviation of a few millimetres in a pier's sliding-surface level changes every reaction and the internal moments, which is why European rules require launching analyses to include support level deviations.
Launch force depends only on girder weight, not on temperature or pad condition.

quiz.explanationEn: A girder being launched is a long continuous beam, and a deviation of a few millimetres in a pier's sliding-surface level changes every reaction and the internal moments, which is why European rules require launching analyses to include support level deviations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支承高程偏差與反力量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support level deviations and reaction measurement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墩頂高程偏差與反力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pier level deviation and reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩等跨連續梁中間支承下陷 δ 時，反力變化 ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³。EI = 2.8×10⁸ kN·m²、L = 50 m、δ = 10 mm：ΔR = 6×2.8×10⁸×0.01/50³ ≈ 134 kN，墩頂附加彎矩 ΔM = ΔR·L/2 ≈ 3,360 kN·m，約為 wL²/12 的 8%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a two-equal-span continuous beam whose middle support drops δ, the reaction changes by ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³. With EI = 2.8×10⁸ kN·m², L = 50 m and δ = 10 mm, ΔR = 6×2.8×10⁸×0.01/50³ ≈ 134 kN and the added support moment ΔM = ΔR·L/2 ≈ 3,360 kN·m, about 8% of wL²/12. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每座墩的滑移面在安裝後與每次頂推前以精密水準複測，偏差超過設計容許值即以墊片調整；反力量測系統須先校正，頂推中以固定梁位（例如每段頂推完成時）記錄全部反力，總和應等於已頂出梁重，並與預測分布比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Re-level each sliding surface precisely after installation and before every push, shimming if the deviation exceeds the design allowance; calibrate the reaction-measurement system first, record all reactions at fixed girder positions such as the end of each push, check that their sum equals the launched weight, and compare the distribution with prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩等跨連續梁中間支承下陷 δ 時，反力變化 ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³。EI = 2.8×10⁸ kN·m²、L = 50 m、δ = 10 mm：ΔR = 6×2.8×10⁸×0.01/50³ ≈ 134 kN，墩頂附加彎矩 ΔM = ΔR·L/2 ≈ 3,360 kN·m，約為 wL²/12 的 8%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a two-equal-span continuous beam whose middle support drops δ, the reaction changes by ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³. With EI = 2.8×10⁸ kN·m², L = 50 m and δ = 10 mm, ΔR = 6×2.8×10⁸×0.01/50³ ≈ 134 kN and the added support moment ΔM = ΔR·L/2 ≈ 3,360 kN·m, about 8% of wL²/12. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支承高程偏差與反力量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support level deviations and reaction measurement", which statement holds?
options: 頂推梁沒有中間伸縮縫，所以溫度變化的影響比較小。
頂推時的預力只要依完工後跨中正彎矩配置在底板即可。
兩等跨連續梁中間支承下陷 δ 時，反力變化 ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³。
optionsEn: A launched girder has no intermediate joints, so temperature effects are smaller.
Launching prestress need only be placed in the bottom slab for the final midspan sagging moment.
For a two-equal-span continuous beam whose middle support drops δ, the reaction changes by ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³.
quiz.explanation: 兩等跨連續梁中間支承下陷 δ 時，反力變化 ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a two-equal-span continuous beam whose middle support drops δ, the reaction changes by ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支承高程偏差與反力量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support level deviations and reaction measurement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墩頂高程偏差與反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pier level deviation and reactions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每座墩的滑移面在安裝後與每次頂推前以精密水準複測，偏差超過設計容許值即以墊片調整；反力量測系統須先校正，頂推中以固定梁位（例如每段頂推完成時）記錄全部反力，總和應等於已頂出梁重，並與預測分布比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Re-level each sliding surface precisely after installation and before every push, shimming if the deviation exceeds the design allowance; calibrate the reaction-measurement system first, record all reactions at fixed girder positions such as the end of each push, check that their sum equals the launched weight, and compare the distribution with prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：頂推紀錄表應包含每座墩的滑移面高程、反力讀值、溫度與梁位，與預測值的偏差由設計單位設定警戒與停止門檻；所有原始量測資料保存至竣工。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The launching log should include each pier's sliding-surface level, reaction readings, temperature and girder position, with alert and stop thresholds for deviations set by the designer; all raw measurements are kept until completion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若某座墩滑移面偏高而未調整，該墩反力持續偏大，梁經過時底板局部承壓過高、腹板出現斜裂縫；相鄰墩反力不足則讓滑板滑出或側向導向失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A sliding surface left too high keeps that pier's reaction above prediction, overstressing the soffit locally and cracking webs diagonally as the girder passes; neighbouring piers with too little reaction may let pads slide out or lateral guides lose effect. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每座墩的滑移面在安裝後與每次頂推前以精密水準複測，偏差超過設計容許值即以墊片調整；反力量測系統須先校正，頂推中以固定梁位（例如每段頂推完成時）記錄全部反力，總和應等於已頂出梁重，並與預測分布比較。
knowledge.textEn: Re-level each sliding surface precisely after installation and before every push, shimming if the deviation exceeds the design allowance; calibrate the reaction-measurement system first, record all reactions at fixed girder positions such as the end of each push, check that their sum equals the launched weight, and compare the distribution with prediction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 頂推紀錄表應包含每座墩的滑移面高程、反力讀值、溫度與梁位，與預測值的偏差由設計單位設定警戒與停止門檻；所有原始量測資料保存至竣工。
knowledge.textEn: The launching log should include each pier's sliding-surface level, reaction readings, temperature and girder position, with alert and stop thresholds for deviations set by the designer; all raw measurements are kept until completion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支承高程偏差與反力量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support level deviations and reaction measurement"?
options: 每座墩的滑移面在安裝後與每次頂推前以精密水準複測，偏差超過設計容許值即以墊片調整。

quiz.explanationEn: Re-level each sliding surface precisely after installation and before every push, shimming if the deviation exceeds the design allowance; calibrate the reaction-measurement system first, record all reactions at fixed girder positions such as the end of each push, check that their sum equals the launched weight, and compare the distribution with prediction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支承高程偏差與反力量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support level deviations and reaction measurement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墩頂高程偏差與反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pier level deviation and reactions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若某座墩滑移面偏高而未調整，該墩反力持續偏大，梁經過時底板局部承壓過高、腹板出現斜裂縫；相鄰墩反力不足則讓滑板滑出或側向導向失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sliding surface left too high keeps that pier's reaction above prediction, overstressing the soffit locally and cracking webs diagonally as the girder passes; neighbouring piers with too little reaction may let pads slide out or lateral guides lose effect. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此在每座墩頂滑移支承下設置油壓千斤頂或荷重計，頂推過程中直接量測反力，比較預測值；若某一墩反力明顯偏高，可能是滑移面過高、梁底局部凸起或台座幾何誤差，須在下一次頂推前調整。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic jacks or load cells under each pier's sliding bearing therefore measure reactions directly during launching for comparison with predictions; a reaction well above prediction may mean a sliding surface set too high, a local bulge on the soffit or casting-bed geometry error, to be adjusted before the next push.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「墩頂高程差幾公釐對頂推中的長梁沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A few millimetres of pier-level difference has no effect on a long girder being launched." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若某座墩滑移面偏高而未調整，該墩反力持續偏大，梁經過時底板局部承壓過高、腹板出現斜裂縫；相鄰墩反力不足則讓滑板滑出或側向導向失效。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支承高程偏差與反力量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support level deviations and reaction measurement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若某座墩滑移面偏高而未調整，該墩反力持續偏大，梁經過時底板局部承壓過高、腹板出現斜裂縫；相鄰墩反力不足則讓滑板滑出或側向導向失效。
頂推力只與梁重有關，與溫度和滑板狀態無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A sliding surface left too high keeps that pier's reaction above prediction, overstressing the soffit locally and cracking webs diagonally as the girder passes.

steps.title: 頂推力、摩擦反算與變形監測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Launch force, back-calculated friction and deformation monitoring: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「頂推力紀錄」如何影響橋梁頂推施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Launch-force log” governs force, deformation or durability in “Incremental bridge launching”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 頂推力是頂推過程中最直接的健康指標：它等於所有墩頂摩擦力與坡度分力的總和，若突然增加，代表某處滑板漏放、側向導向卡住或梁底有障礙；若緩慢下降，可能是溫度升高使摩擦降低。把每一次頂推的啟動力與等速力記錄下來，就能反算實際摩擦係數，與設計假設比較。同時以全站儀追蹤導梁前端與梁體平面位置，以應變計觀察關鍵斷面，確認結構行為與分析一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「頂推力紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Launch force is the most direct health indicator during launching: it equals the sum of all pier friction forces and the gradient component, so a sudden rise signals a missing pad, a jammed lateral guide or an obstruction under the soffit, while a slow fall may reflect warmer weather lowering friction. Logging breakaway and steady-motion forces for every push lets engineers back-calculate the real friction coefficient and compare it with design. Meanwhile a total station tracks the nose tip and the girder's plan position, and strain gauges at key sections confirm the structure behaves as analysed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Launch-force log” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：摩擦反算 μ = F/W − i。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Back-calculated friction μ = F/W − i.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂推力只與梁重有關，與溫度和滑板狀態無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Launch force depends only on girder weight, not on temperature or pad condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「頂推力紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Launch-force log”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.explanationEn: Launch force is the most direct health indicator during launching: it equals the sum of all pier friction forces and the gradient component, so a sudden rise signals a missing pad, a jammed lateral guide or an obstruction under the soffit, while a slow fall may reflect warmer weather lowering friction.
