steps.title: 頂推力、摩擦反算與變形監測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Launch force, back-calculated friction and deformation monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂推力紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Launch-force log” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：摩擦反算 μ = F/W − i。某次等速頂推力 F = 3,600 kN、已頂出梁重 W = 60,000 kN、上坡 i = 1%：μ = 3,600/60,000 − 0.01 = 0.05（5%）。若設計假設 μ_max = 4%，表示需要檢查滑板或導向，並重新評估千斤頂容量餘裕。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Back-calculated friction μ = F/W − i. A steady launch force F = 3,600 kN for a launched weight W = 60,000 kN uphill at i = 1% gives μ = 3,600/60,000 − 0.01 = 0.05 (5%). If the design assumed μ_max = 4%, pads or guides must be checked and the jack capacity margin re-evaluated. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：頂推千斤頂與壓力感測器須校正，控制系統自動記錄推力—行程曲線；每次頂推後繪製摩擦係數隨梁長與溫度的趨勢，與設計上下限比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate launching jacks and pressure sensors and have the control system log force–stroke curves automatically; after every push plot the friction coefficient against launched length and temperature and compare it with the design bounds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 摩擦反算 μ = F/W − i。某次等速頂推力 F = 3,600 kN、已頂出梁重 W = 60,000 kN、上坡 i = 1%：μ = 3,600/60,000 − 0.01 = 0.05（5%）。若設計假設 μ_max = 4%，表示需要檢查滑板或導向，並重新評估千斤頂容量餘裕。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Back-calculated friction μ = F/W − i. A steady launch force F = 3,600 kN for a launched weight W = 60,000 kN uphill at i = 1% gives μ = 3,600/60,000 − 0.01 = 0.05 (5%). If the design assumed μ_max = 4%, pads or guides must be checked and the jack capacity margin re-evaluated. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頂推力、摩擦反算與變形監測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Launch force, back-calculated friction and deformation monitoring", which statement holds?
options: 摩擦反算 μ = F/W − i。
頂推梁完工後是連續梁，所以只要依連續梁的彎矩分布配置預力即可。
導梁越長越好，長度可以等於整個跨度。
optionsEn: Back-calculated friction μ = F/W − i.
A launched girder ends up continuous, so prestress can simply follow the continuous-beam moment diagram.
The longer the nose the better; it can be as long as the whole span.
quiz.explanation: 摩擦反算 μ = F/W − i。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Back-calculated friction μ = F/W − i. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頂推力、摩擦反算與變形監測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Launch force, back-calculated friction and deformation monitoring: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂推力紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Launch-force log” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 頂推千斤頂與壓力感測器須校正，控制系統自動記錄推力—行程曲線；每次頂推後繪製摩擦係數隨梁長與溫度的趨勢，與設計上下限比較。VSL 報告記載 Ravensbosch 高架橋初期摩擦偏高，之後穩定在約 5%，與設計假設相符，這正是此類比對的例子。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate launching jacks and pressure sensors and have the control system log force–stroke curves automatically; after every push plot the friction coefficient against launched length and temperature and compare it with the design bounds. A VSL report records that friction at the Ravensbosch Viaduct was high at first and then settled at about 5%, matching the design assumption, an example of exactly this comparison. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：頂推前由設計單位提供每段頂推的預測推力範圍與停止門檻；中途停止時，必須確認當下梁位是可以長時間停留的安全狀態，否則先完成到下一個安全位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before launching, the designer provides the predicted force range and stop threshold for every push; if a push must stop, confirm that the girder position is safe for a long stay, otherwise first complete it to the next safe position.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只看推力是否在千斤頂容量內而不分析趨勢，滑板逐漸損耗或某墩導向逐漸卡緊的徵兆會被忽略，直到推力突然超限而被迫停在半途，此時梁可能停在對結構最不利的位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Watching only whether the force stays within jack capacity, without analysing trends, misses gradual pad wear or a guide slowly jamming until the force suddenly exceeds the limit and the push stops halfway, possibly leaving the girder in its most unfavourable position. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 頂推千斤頂與壓力感測器須校正，控制系統自動記錄推力—行程曲線；每次頂推後繪製摩擦係數隨梁長與溫度的趨勢，與設計上下限比較。VSL 報告記載 Ravensbosch 高架橋初期摩擦偏高，之後穩定在約 5%，與設計假設相符，這正是此類比對的例子。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate launching jacks and pressure sensors and have the control system log force–stroke curves automatically; after every push plot the friction coefficient against launched length and temperature and compare it with the design bounds. A VSL report records that friction at the Ravensbosch Viaduct was high at first and then settled at about 5%, matching the design assumption, an example of exactly this comparison.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 頂推前由設計單位提供每段頂推的預測推力範圍與停止門檻；中途停止時，必須確認當下梁位是可以長時間停留的安全狀態，否則先完成到下一個安全位置。

quiz.question: 要驗證「頂推力、摩擦反算與變形監測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Launch force, back-calculated friction and deformation monitoring"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

頂推梁在台座上製作，幾何誤差可以在頂推後再一次修正。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Calibrate launching jacks and pressure sensors and have the control system log force–stroke curves automatically.
Because the girder is cast on a bed, geometric errors can be corrected after launching.

quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate launching jacks and pressure sensors and have the control system log force–stroke curves automatically; after every push plot the friction coefficient against launched length and temperature and compare it with the design bounds. steps.title: 頂推力、摩擦反算與變形監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Launch force, back-calculated friction and deformation monitoring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂推力紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Launch-force log” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只看推力是否在千斤頂容量內而不分析趨勢，滑板逐漸損耗或某墩導向逐漸卡緊的徵兆會被忽略，直到推力突然超限而被迫停在半途，此時梁可能停在對結構最不利的位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Watching only whether the force stays within jack capacity, without analysing trends, misses gradual pad wear or a guide slowly jamming until the force suddenly exceeds the limit and the push stops halfway, possibly leaving the girder in its most unfavourable position. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：同時以全站儀追蹤導梁前端與梁體平面位置，以應變計觀察關鍵斷面，確認結構行為與分析一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Meanwhile a total station tracks the nose tip and the girder's plan position, and strain gauges at key sections confirm the structure behaves as analysed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂推力只與梁重有關，與溫度和滑板狀態無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Launch force depends only on girder weight, not on temperature or pad condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只看推力是否在千斤頂容量內而不分析趨勢，滑板逐漸損耗或某墩導向逐漸卡緊的徵兆會被忽略，直到推力突然超限而被迫停在半途，此時梁可能停在對結構最不利的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Watching only whether the force stays within jack capacity, without analysing trends, misses gradual pad wear or a guide slowly jamming until the force suddenly exceeds the limit and the push stops halfway, possibly leaving the girder in its most unfavourable position.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頂推力、摩擦反算與變形監測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Launch force, back-calculated friction and deformation monitoring" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
頂推完成就等於施工完成，支承轉換只是簡單的換件作業。
若只看推力是否在千斤頂容量內而不分析趨勢，滑板逐漸損耗或某墩導向逐漸卡緊的徵兆會被忽略，直到推力突然超限而被迫停在半途，此時梁可能停在對結構最不利的位置。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once launching ends construction is finished; changing to permanent bearings is a simple swap.

Watching only whether the force stays within jack capacity, without analysing trends, misses gradual pad wear or a guide slowly jamming until the force suddenly exceeds the limit and the push stops halfway, possibly leaving the girder in its most unfavourable position.

quiz.explanationEn: Watching only whether the force stays within jack capacity, without analysing trends, misses gradual pad wear or a guide slowly jamming until the force suddenly exceeds the limit and the push stops halfway, possibly leaving the girder in its most unfavourable position. stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換」與「長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching" and "Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「永久支承置換頂升」如何影響橋梁頂推施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jacking onto permanent bearings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Incremental bridge launching”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 梁推到最終位置後，要從臨時滑移支承轉換到永久支承：在每座墩以油壓千斤頂把梁頂起數公釐（VSL 報告記載約 5 至 10 mm），拆除滑移支承，安裝永久支承後再落梁。同時張拉沿彎矩分布的連續鋼腱，必要時拆除或放鬆部分中心預力，使結構轉為營運狀態。頂升過程等同於人為製造支承高程差，所以必須同步、分級並限制相鄰墩的高差，否則會在梁內引起不必要的彎矩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「永久支承置換頂升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once the girder reaches its final position, it must be transferred from temporary sliding bearings to permanent bearings: hydraulic jacks lift it a few millimetres at each pier, about 5 to 10 mm according to a VSL report, the sliding bearings are removed, permanent bearings installed and the girder lowered. Continuity tendons following the moment diagram are stressed and, where needed, part of the centric prestress is removed or released, bringing the structure to its service state. Jacking is effectively an imposed support-level difference, so it must be synchronised, staged and limited in level difference between adjacent piers, or it induces unwanted moments. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Jacking onto permanent bearings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：內墩反力約 R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN，頂升 10 mm 另增 ΔR ≈ 134 kN，共約 12,634 kN；以 4 支千斤頂且每支只用到 60% 容量，單支需 12,634/4/0.6 ≈ 5,264 kN，宜選 6,000 kN 級。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An interior pier reaction of about R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN plus ΔR ≈ 134 kN for a 10 mm lift gives about 12,634 kN; with 4 jacks each used to only 60% of capacity, each needs 12,634/4/0.6 ≈ 5,264 kN, so a 6,000 kN class jack is suitable.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂推完成就等於施工完成，支承轉換只是簡單的換件作業。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once launching ends construction is finished; changing to permanent bearings is a simple swap." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「永久支承置換頂升」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Jacking onto permanent bearings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換
knowledge.titleEn: Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching
knowledge.text: 梁推到最終位置後，要從臨時滑移支承轉換到永久支承：在每座墩以油壓千斤頂把梁頂起數公釐（VSL 報告記載約 5 至 10 mm），拆除滑移支承，安裝永久支承後再落梁。同時張拉沿彎矩分布的連續鋼腱，必要時拆除或放鬆部分中心預力，使結構轉為營運狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Once the girder reaches its final position, it must be transferred from temporary sliding bearings to permanent bearings: hydraulic jacks lift it a few millimetres at each pier, about 5 to 10 mm according to a VSL report, the sliding bearings are removed, permanent bearings installed and the girder lowered. Continuity tendons following the moment diagram are stressed and, where needed, part of the centric prestress is removed or released, bringing the structure to its service state.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頂推完成就等於施工完成，支承轉換只是簡單的換件作業。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once launching ends construction is finished; changing to permanent bearings is a simple swap. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching" is correct?
options: 梁推到最終位置後，要從臨時滑移支承轉換到永久支承：在每座墩以油壓千斤頂把梁頂起數公釐（VSL 報告記載約 5 至 10 mm），拆除滑移支承，安裝永久支承後再落梁。
頂推完成就等於施工完成，支承轉換只是簡單的換件作業。
頂推梁沒有中間伸縮縫，所以溫度變化的影響比較小。
optionsEn: Once the girder reaches its final position, it must be transferred from temporary sliding bearings to permanent bearings: hydraulic jacks lift it a few millimetres at each pier, about 5 to 10 mm according to a VSL report, the sliding bearings are removed, permanent bearings installed and the girder lowered.
Once launching ends construction is finished; changing to permanent bearings is a simple swap.
A launched girder has no intermediate joints, so temperature effects are smaller.
quiz.explanation: 梁推到最終位置後，要從臨時滑移支承轉換到永久支承：在每座墩以油壓千斤頂把梁頂起數公釐（VSL 報告記載約 5 至 10 mm），拆除滑移支承，安裝永久支承後再落梁。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once the girder reaches its final position, it must be transferred from temporary sliding bearings to permanent bearings: hydraulic jacks lift it a few millimetres at each pier, about 5 to 10 mm according to a VSL report, the sliding bearings are removed, permanent bearings installed and the girder lowered. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「永久支承置換頂升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Jacking onto permanent bearings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：內墩反力約 R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN，頂升 10 mm 另增 ΔR ≈ 134 kN，共約 12,634 kN；以 4 支千斤頂且每支只用到 60% 容量，單支需 12,634/4/0.6 ≈ 5,264 kN，宜選 6,000 kN 級。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An interior pier reaction of about R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN plus ΔR ≈ 134 kN for a 10 mm lift gives about 12,634 kN; with 4 jacks each used to only 60% of capacity, each needs 12,634/4/0.6 ≈ 5,264 kN, so a 6,000 kN class jack is suitable. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：頂升計畫列出每一墩的頂升量、順序、相鄰墩最大高差與千斤頂壓力預測值；頂升時同步量測位移與壓力，任一值超出預測範圍即停止。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The jacking plan lists lift, order, maximum level difference between adjacent piers and predicted jack pressure for each pier; during jacking, displacement and pressure are measured together and work stops if any value leaves the predicted range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 內墩反力約 R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN，頂升 10 mm 另增 ΔR ≈ 134 kN，共約 12,634 kN；以 4 支千斤頂且每支只用到 60% 容量，單支需 12,634/4/0.6 ≈ 5,264 kN，宜選 6,000 kN 級。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: An interior pier reaction of about R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN plus ΔR ≈ 134 kN for a 10 mm lift gives about 12,634 kN; with 4 jacks each used to only 60% of capacity, each needs 12,634/4/0.6 ≈ 5,264 kN, so a 6,000 kN class jack is suitable. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching", which statement holds?
options: 頂推時的預力只要依完工後跨中正彎矩配置在底板即可。
PTFE 滑板摩擦極低，所以頂推時不必考慮梁體自行滑動。
optionsEn: Launching prestress need only be placed in the bottom slab for the final midspan sagging moment.
An interior pier reaction of about R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN plus ΔR ≈ 134 kN for a 10 mm lift gives about 12,634 kN.
PTFE pads have such low friction that runaway of the girder need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 內墩反力約 R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN，頂升 10 mm 另增 ΔR ≈ 134 kN，共約 12,634 kN；以 4 支千斤頂且每支只用到 60% 容量，單支需 12,634/4/0.6 ≈ 5,264 kN，宜選 6,000 kN 級。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An interior pier reaction of about R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN plus ΔR ≈ 134 kN for a 10 mm lift gives about 12,634 kN; with 4 jacks each used to only 60% of capacity, each needs 12,634/4/0.6 ≈ 5,264 kN, so a 6,000 kN class jack is suitable. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「永久支承置換頂升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Jacking onto permanent bearings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 頂升計畫列出每一墩的頂升量、順序、相鄰墩最大高差與千斤頂壓力預測值；頂升時同步量測位移與壓力，任一值超出預測範圍即停止。永久支承安裝後確認方向、預設偏位（考慮溫度與潛變）與墊石砂漿強度，再落梁並記錄最終反力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The jacking plan lists lift, order, maximum level difference between adjacent piers and predicted jack pressure for each pier; during jacking, displacement and pressure are measured together and work stops if any value leaves the predicted range. After installing permanent bearings, confirm orientation, preset offset for temperature and creep, and grout strength before lowering, then record final reactions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支承轉換與連續鋼腱張拉列為設計單位簽認的停留點，頂升紀錄與最終反力隨支承編號存檔；永久支承的預設偏位以安裝當日實測溫度計算並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bearing transfer and continuity stressing are hold points signed off by the designer, with jacking records and final reactions filed by bearing number; permanent-bearing preset offsets are calculated and recorded from the measured temperature on the day of installation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：各墩頂升不同步，造成某墩瞬間承擔過大反力或梁頂板開裂；永久支承預設偏位忘記考慮安裝時溫度，活動支承在夏季或冬季頂到行程末端，對墩柱產生非預期水平力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronised jacking makes one pier momentarily carry an excessive reaction or cracks the top slab; forgetting the installation temperature when presetting bearing offsets drives sliding bearings to the end of travel in summer or winter, imposing unexpected horizontal force on the piers. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 頂升計畫列出每一墩的頂升量、順序、相鄰墩最大高差與千斤頂壓力預測值；頂升時同步量測位移與壓力，任一值超出預測範圍即停止。永久支承安裝後確認方向、預設偏位（考慮溫度與潛變）與墊石砂漿強度，再落梁並記錄最終反力。
knowledge.textEn: The jacking plan lists lift, order, maximum level difference between adjacent piers and predicted jack pressure for each pier; during jacking, displacement and pressure are measured together and work stops if any value leaves the predicted range. After installing permanent bearings, confirm orientation, preset offset for temperature and creep, and grout strength before lowering, then record final reactions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 支承轉換與連續鋼腱張拉列為設計單位簽認的停留點，頂升紀錄與最終反力隨支承編號存檔；永久支承的預設偏位以安裝當日實測溫度計算並記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Bearing transfer and continuity stressing are hold points signed off by the designer, with jacking records and final reactions filed by bearing number; permanent-bearing preset offsets are calculated and recorded from the measured temperature on the day of installation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
臨時墩只承受垂直力，不需要考慮水平力。
頂升計畫列出每一墩的頂升量、順序、相鄰墩最大高差與千斤頂壓力預測值；頂升時同步量測位移與壓力，任一值超出預測範圍即停止。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Temporary piers carry only vertical force, so horizontal force can be ignored.
The jacking plan lists lift, order, maximum level difference between adjacent piers and predicted jack pressure for each pier.
quiz.explanation: 頂升計畫列出每一墩的頂升量、順序、相鄰墩最大高差與千斤頂壓力預測值；頂升時同步量測位移與壓力，任一值超出預測範圍即停止。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The jacking plan lists lift, order, maximum level difference between adjacent piers and predicted jack pressure for each pier; during jacking, displacement and pressure are measured together and work stops if any value leaves the predicted range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「永久支承置換頂升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Jacking onto permanent bearings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 各墩頂升不同步，造成某墩瞬間承擔過大反力或梁頂板開裂；永久支承預設偏位忘記考慮安裝時溫度，活動支承在夏季或冬季頂到行程末端，對墩柱產生非預期水平力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronised jacking makes one pier momentarily carry an excessive reaction or cracks the top slab; forgetting the installation temperature when presetting bearing offsets drives sliding bearings to the end of travel in summer or winter, imposing unexpected horizontal force on the piers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：頂升過程等同於人為製造支承高程差，所以必須同步、分級並限制相鄰墩的高差，否則會在梁內引起不必要的彎矩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Jacking is effectively an imposed support-level difference, so it must be synchronised, staged and limited in level difference between adjacent piers, or it induces unwanted moments.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂推完成就等於施工完成，支承轉換只是簡單的換件作業。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once launching ends construction is finished; changing to permanent bearings is a simple swap." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 各墩頂升不同步，造成某墩瞬間承擔過大反力或梁頂板開裂；永久支承預設偏位忘記考慮安裝時溫度，活動支承在夏季或冬季頂到行程末端，對墩柱產生非預期水平力。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronised jacking makes one pier momentarily carry an excessive reaction or cracks the top slab; forgetting the installation temperature when presetting bearing offsets drives sliding bearings to the end of travel in summer or winter, imposing unexpected horizontal force on the piers.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 各墩頂升不同步，造成某墩瞬間承擔過大反力或梁頂板開裂；永久支承預設偏位忘記考慮安裝時溫度，活動支承在夏季或冬季頂到行程末端，對墩柱產生非預期水平力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
頂推梁沒有中間伸縮縫，所以溫度變化的影響比較小。
optionsEn: Unsynchronised jacking makes one pier momentarily carry an excessive reaction or cracks the top slab.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A launched girder has no intermediate joints, so temperature effects are smaller.
quiz.explanation: 各墩頂升不同步，造成某墩瞬間承擔過大反力或梁頂板開裂；永久支承預設偏位忘記考慮安裝時溫度，活動支承在夏季或冬季頂到行程末端，對墩柱產生非預期水平力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronised jacking makes one pier momentarily carry an excessive reaction or cracks the top slab; forgetting the installation temperature when presetting bearing offsets drives sliding bearings to the end of travel in summer or winter, imposing unexpected horizontal force on the piers. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「長連續梁伸縮量」如何影響橋梁頂推施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Movement of a long continuous deck” governs force, deformation or durability in “Incremental bridge launching”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 頂推工法造就的是很長、沒有中間伸縮縫的連續梁，溫度、乾縮與潛變造成的長度變化全部集中在梁端，因此梁端伸縮縫與活動支承的行程必須足夠，固定點（常在一側橋台或中間墩）也要能承受制動力與摩擦力。頂推過程中底板曾在每一座墩頂滑過，滑移區可能留下刮痕、局部修補或滑板殘留物，都要在交接前檢查並處理。交接文件則應保存頂推期間的反力、推力、高程與裂縫紀錄，作為日後評估的基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「長連續梁伸縮量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Launching produces long continuous girders without intermediate joints, so length changes from temperature, shrinkage and creep all accumulate at the girder ends; end expansion joints and sliding bearings need sufficient travel, and the fixed point, often one abutment or a central pier, must resist braking and bearing friction. During launching the soffit slid over every pier, possibly leaving scoring, local repairs or pad debris that must be inspected and dealt with before handover. Handover documents should keep the reaction, force, level and crack records from launching as the baseline for later assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Movement of a long continuous deck” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：固定於一端的 420 m 連續梁，溫度變化範圍 ΔT = 45°C、α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C：ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm，另加乾縮與潛變的縮短量，梁端伸縮縫與支承行程須以此為基礎再加安裝餘裕。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 420 m continuous girder fixed at one end with a temperature range ΔT = 45°C and α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C, ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm, plus shrinkage and creep shortening; the end joint and bearing travel are based on this plus an installation margin.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂推梁沒有中間伸縮縫，所以溫度變化的影響比較小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A launched girder has no intermediate joints, so temperature effects are smaller." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「長連續梁伸縮量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Movement of a long continuous deck”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks
knowledge.text: 頂推工法造就的是很長、沒有中間伸縮縫的連續梁，溫度、乾縮與潛變造成的長度變化全部集中在梁端，因此梁端伸縮縫與活動支承的行程必須足夠，固定點（常在一側橋台或中間墩）也要能承受制動力與摩擦力。頂推過程中底板曾在每一座墩頂滑過，滑移區可能留下刮痕、局部修補或滑板殘留物，都要在交接前檢查並處理。
knowledge.textEn: Launching produces long continuous girders without intermediate joints, so length changes from temperature, shrinkage and creep all accumulate at the girder ends; end expansion joints and sliding bearings need sufficient travel, and the fixed point, often one abutment or a central pier, must resist braking and bearing friction. During launching the soffit slid over every pier, possibly leaving scoring, local repairs or pad debris that must be inspected and dealt with before handover.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頂推梁沒有中間伸縮縫，所以溫度變化的影響比較小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A launched girder has no intermediate joints, so temperature effects are smaller. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks" is correct?
options: 頂推梁沒有中間伸縮縫，所以溫度變化的影響比較小。
頂推工法造就的是很長、沒有中間伸縮縫的連續梁，溫度、乾縮與潛變造成的長度變化全部集中在梁端，因此梁端伸縮縫與活動支承的行程必須足夠，固定點（常在一側橋台或中間墩）也要能承受制動力與摩擦力。
頂推梁完工後是連續梁，所以只要依連續梁的彎矩分布配置預力即可。
optionsEn: A launched girder has no intermediate joints, so temperature effects are smaller.
Launching produces long continuous girders without intermediate joints, so length changes from temperature, shrinkage and creep all accumulate at the girder ends.
A launched girder ends up continuous, so prestress can simply follow the continuous-beam moment diagram.
quiz.explanation: 頂推工法造就的是很長、沒有中間伸縮縫的連續梁，溫度、乾縮與潛變造成的長度變化全部集中在梁端，因此梁端伸縮縫與活動支承的行程必須足夠，固定點（常在一側橋台或中間墩）也要能承受制動力與摩擦力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Launching produces long continuous girders without intermediate joints, so length changes from temperature, shrinkage and creep all accumulate at the girder ends; end expansion joints and sliding bearings need sufficient travel, and the fixed point, often one abutment or a central pier, must resist braking and bearing friction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長連續梁伸縮量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Movement of a long continuous deck” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：固定於一端的 420 m 連續梁，溫度變化範圍 ΔT = 45°C、α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C：ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm，另加乾縮與潛變的縮短量，梁端伸縮縫與支承行程須以此為基礎再加安裝餘裕。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 420 m continuous girder fixed at one end with a temperature range ΔT = 45°C and α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C, ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm, plus shrinkage and creep shortening; the end joint and bearing travel are based on this plus an installation margin. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前檢查底板滑移區、施工縫與聯結器斷面的裂縫並建立裂縫圖，量測各支承的偏位與伸縮縫間隙，並以當日溫度換算回設計參考溫度確認預設值正確；建立梁端位移的長期量測點，追蹤乾縮與潛變造成的縮短趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, inspect the soffit sliding zones, construction joints and coupler sections and draw crack maps, measure bearing offsets and joint gaps, and convert them to the design reference temperature using the day's temperature to confirm presets; set long-term measuring points at the girder ends to track shortening from shrinkage and creep.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 固定於一端的 420 m 連續梁，溫度變化範圍 ΔT = 45°C、α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C：ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm，另加乾縮與潛變的縮短量，梁端伸縮縫與支承行程須以此為基礎再加安裝餘裕。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 420 m continuous girder fixed at one end with a temperature range ΔT = 45°C and α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C, ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm, plus shrinkage and creep shortening; the end joint and bearing travel are based on this plus an installation margin. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks", which statement holds?
options: 導梁越長越好，長度可以等於整個跨度。
頂推梁在台座上製作，幾何誤差可以在頂推後再一次修正。
固定於一端的 420 m 連續梁，溫度變化範圍 ΔT = 45°C、α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C：ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm，另加乾縮與潛變的縮短量，梁端伸縮縫與支承行程須以此為基礎再加安裝餘裕。
optionsEn: The longer the nose the better; it can be as long as the whole span.
Because the girder is cast on a bed, geometric errors can be corrected after launching.
For a 420 m continuous girder fixed at one end with a temperature range ΔT = 45°C and α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C, ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm, plus shrinkage and creep shortening.
quiz.explanation: 固定於一端的 420 m 連續梁，溫度變化範圍 ΔT = 45°C、α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C：ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm，另加乾縮與潛變的縮短量，梁端伸縮縫與支承行程須以此為基礎再加安裝餘裕。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 420 m continuous girder fixed at one end with a temperature range ΔT = 45°C and α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C, ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm, plus shrinkage and creep shortening; the end joint and bearing travel are based on this plus an installation margin. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長連續梁伸縮量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Movement of a long continuous deck” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前檢查底板滑移區、施工縫與聯結器斷面的裂縫並建立裂縫圖，量測各支承的偏位與伸縮縫間隙，並以當日溫度換算回設計參考溫度確認預設值正確；建立梁端位移的長期量測點，追蹤乾縮與潛變造成的縮短趨勢。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, inspect the soffit sliding zones, construction joints and coupler sections and draw crack maps, measure bearing offsets and joint gaps, and convert them to the design reference temperature using the day's temperature to confirm presets; set long-term measuring points at the girder ends to track shortening from shrinkage and creep. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接資料應包含頂推分析與實測紀錄、預製台座幾何紀錄、支承與伸縮縫的預設與安裝溫度、滑移區修補紀錄，以及梁端位移監測基準；首次定期檢查應確認伸縮縫行程與支承偏位是否符合預測趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover data should include launching analyses and measured records, casting-bed geometry records, bearing and joint presets with installation temperatures, sliding-zone repair records and the girder-end movement baseline; the first routine inspection should confirm that joint travel and bearing offsets follow the predicted trend.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：梁端伸縮縫行程只依溫度計算而忽略多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，數年後伸縮縫在冬季拉開超過設計值，止水帶撕裂、雨水流到支承與墩帽；固定墩若未考慮支承摩擦累積，墩柱可能出現水平裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing the end joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep shortening, lets it open beyond its design gap in winter after a few years, tearing the seal and draining water onto bearings and pier caps; a fixed pier designed without accumulated bearing friction may crack horizontally. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前檢查底板滑移區、施工縫與聯結器斷面的裂縫並建立裂縫圖，量測各支承的偏位與伸縮縫間隙，並以當日溫度換算回設計參考溫度確認預設值正確；建立梁端位移的長期量測點，追蹤乾縮與潛變造成的縮短趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, inspect the soffit sliding zones, construction joints and coupler sections and draw crack maps, measure bearing offsets and joint gaps, and convert them to the design reference temperature using the day's temperature to confirm presets; set long-term measuring points at the girder ends to track shortening from shrinkage and creep.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接資料應包含頂推分析與實測紀錄、預製台座幾何紀錄、支承與伸縮縫的預設與安裝溫度、滑移區修補紀錄，以及梁端位移監測基準；首次定期檢查應確認伸縮縫行程與支承偏位是否符合預測趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Handover data should include launching analyses and measured records, casting-bed geometry records, bearing and joint presets with installation temperatures, sliding-zone repair records and the girder-end movement baseline; the first routine inspection should confirm that joint travel and bearing offsets follow the predicted trend.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks"?
options: 交接前檢查底板滑移區、施工縫與聯結器斷面的裂縫並建立裂縫圖，量測各支承的偏位與伸縮縫間隙，並以當日溫度換算回設計參考溫度確認預設值正確。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
墩頂高程差幾公釐對頂推中的長梁沒有影響。
optionsEn: Before handover, inspect the soffit sliding zones, construction joints and coupler sections and draw crack maps, measure bearing offsets and joint gaps, and convert them to the design reference temperature using the day's temperature to confirm presets.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A few millimetres of pier-level difference has no effect on a long girder being launched.
quiz.explanation: 交接前檢查底板滑移區、施工縫與聯結器斷面的裂縫並建立裂縫圖，量測各支承的偏位與伸縮縫間隙，並以當日溫度換算回設計參考溫度確認預設值正確；建立梁端位移的長期量測點，追蹤乾縮與潛變造成的縮短趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, inspect the soffit sliding zones, construction joints and coupler sections and draw crack maps, measure bearing offsets and joint gaps, and convert them to the design reference temperature using the day's temperature to confirm presets; set long-term measuring points at the girder ends to track shortening from shrinkage and creep. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長連續梁伸縮量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Movement of a long continuous deck” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 梁端伸縮縫行程只依溫度計算而忽略多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，數年後伸縮縫在冬季拉開超過設計值，止水帶撕裂、雨水流到支承與墩帽；固定墩若未考慮支承摩擦累積，墩柱可能出現水平裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing the end joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep shortening, lets it open beyond its design gap in winter after a few years, tearing the seal and draining water onto bearings and pier caps; a fixed pier designed without accumulated bearing friction may crack horizontally. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件則應保存頂推期間的反力、推力、高程與裂縫紀錄，作為日後評估的基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents should keep the reaction, force, level and crack records from launching as the baseline for later assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頂推梁沒有中間伸縮縫，所以溫度變化的影響比較小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A launched girder has no intermediate joints, so temperature effects are smaller." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 梁端伸縮縫行程只依溫度計算而忽略多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，數年後伸縮縫在冬季拉開超過設計值，止水帶撕裂、雨水流到支承與墩帽；固定墩若未考慮支承摩擦累積，墩柱可能出現水平裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing the end joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep shortening, lets it open beyond its design gap in winter after a few years, tearing the seal and draining water onto bearings and pier caps; a fixed pier designed without accumulated bearing friction may crack horizontally.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
梁端伸縮縫行程只依溫度計算而忽略多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，數年後伸縮縫在冬季拉開超過設計值，止水帶撕裂、雨水流到支承與墩帽。
頂推梁完工後是連續梁，所以只要依連續梁的彎矩分布配置預力即可。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Sizing the end joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep shortening, lets it open beyond its design gap in winter after a few years, tearing the seal and draining water onto bearings and pier caps.
A launched girder ends up continuous, so prestress can simply follow the continuous-beam moment diagram.
quiz.explanation: 梁端伸縮縫行程只依溫度計算而忽略多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，數年後伸縮縫在冬季拉開超過設計值，止水帶撕裂、雨水流到支承與墩帽；固定墩若未考慮支承摩擦累積，墩柱可能出現水平裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing the end joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep shortening, lets it open beyond its design gap in winter after a few years, tearing the seal and draining water onto bearings and pier caps; a fixed pier designed without accumulated bearing friction may crack horizontally. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 橋梁轉體施工
summary: 從平行於鐵路、道路或河道建造、再轉到跨越位置的工法邏輯出發，計算轉體重量、重心偏心與撐腳間隙，再處理球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩、下轉盤局部承壓、牽引系統、到位精調與封鉸，最後以稱重試驗、轉動監測與封固後的沉陷與淨空檢核驗收，並以比利時 Ben-Ahin 斜張橋、塞維亞 Barqueta 拱橋的浮力旋轉與石板坡鋼箱梁的轉向對照。
summaryEn: Starting from the logic of building parallel to a railway, road or river and then swinging into the crossing position, compute rotating weight, centre-of-gravity eccentricity and support-leg gaps, then handle spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque, local bearing in the lower turntable, the traction system, final positioning and hinge encasement, and finally accept with a weighing test, rotation monitoring and post-encasement settlement and clearance checks, contrasting Belgium's Ben-Ahin cable-stayed bridge, the floating swing of Seville's Barqueta arch and the turning of the Shibanpo steel box.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計比較練習：轉體重 W = 150,000 kN，牽引半徑 4.5 m 由兩台千斤頂形成力偶，啟動靜摩擦 μ_s = 0.08、運行動摩擦 μ_d = 0.04，比較球鉸半徑 R = 2.0 m 與 2.5 m。R = 2.0 m：接觸應力 150,000/(π×2.0²) ≈ 11.9 MPa；啟動力矩 (2/3)×0.08×150,000×2.0 = 16,000 kN·m，每台千斤頂 16,000/(2×4.5) ≈ 1,778 kN；運行力矩 8,000 kN·m，每台約 889 kN。R = 2.5 m：接觸應力降為 150,000/(π×2.5²) ≈ 7.6 MPa（降低約 36%），但啟動力矩升為 20,000 kN·m，每台約 2,222 kN；運行力矩 10,000 kN·m，每台約 1,111 kN（增加 25%）。若 60 m 懸臂端轉動 70°（弧長約 73.3 m）且端點速度限 1.2 m/min，純轉動約 73.3/1.2 ≈ 61 min。結論：加大球鉸換來較低的接觸應力與較大的承壓餘裕，代價是牽引力與千斤頂規格提高，兩者需與封鎖時段及設備可用性一起權衡。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design comparison: rotating weight W = 150,000 kN, a 4.5 m traction radius with two jacks in a couple, static breakaway μ_s = 0.08 and running μ_d = 0.04, comparing hinge radii R = 2.0 m and 2.5 m. For R = 2.0 m the contact stress is 150,000/(π×2.0²) ≈ 11.9 MPa; the breakaway torque is (2/3)×0.08×150,000×2.0 = 16,000 kN·m, so each jack needs 16,000/(2×4.5) ≈ 1,778 kN; the running torque is 8,000 kN·m, about 889 kN per jack. For R = 2.5 m the contact stress falls to 150,000/(π×2.5²) ≈ 7.6 MPa, about 36% lower, but the breakaway torque rises to 20,000 kN·m, about 2,222 kN per jack, and the running torque to 10,000 kN·m, about 1,111 kN per jack, 25% more. Turning a 60 m tip through 70°, an arc of about 73.3 m, at a 1.2 m/min tip limit takes about 73.3/1.2 ≈ 61 min. Conclusion: a larger hinge buys lower contact stress and more bearing margin at the cost of higher traction and larger jacks, to be weighed together with the possession window and equipment availability. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉體工法的系統與適用情境」與「轉體重量、重心與撐腳平衡」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "System logic and where rotation fits" and "Rotating weight, centre of gravity and leg balance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉體工法的系統與適用情境：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: System logic and where rotation fits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「轉動 T 構與跨越線」如何影響橋梁轉體施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotating T-frame and the crossing line” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge rotation construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉體施工把橋梁上部結構先在不影響交通或河道的位置（通常平行於鐵路或河岸）以支架、懸臂或預製方式建好，再以橋墩頂或承台中的轉動中心旋轉到設計軸線。水平轉體最常見：一座平衡懸臂 T 構或斜張橋半跨坐在球鉸上，繞豎軸旋轉數十度；豎向轉體則把拱肋半跨先豎直或平躺建造，再繞拱腳的水平軸轉下或轉起；另有以浮箱支撐一端、繞另一端旋轉的浮運轉體。其核心價值是把跨越營運中鐵路或航道的高風險時段，壓縮成一次可控的數小時作業。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「轉動 T 構與跨越線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rotation construction builds the superstructure where it does not obstruct traffic or navigation, usually parallel to a railway or riverbank, by falsework, cantilevering or prefabrication, then swings it onto the design axis about a pivot in the pier top or pile cap. Horizontal rotation is most common: a balanced-cantilever T-frame or half of a cable-stayed bridge sits on a spherical hinge and turns tens of degrees about a vertical axis. Vertical rotation builds arch-rib halves upright or lying down and turns them about a horizontal axis at the springing; floating rotation supports one end on pontoons and pivots about the other. Its core value is compressing the high-risk period over a live railway or waterway into one controlled operation of a few hours. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rotating T-frame and the crossing line” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸臂端半徑 r = 60 m、轉角 70° = 1.222 rad：端點弧長 s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a cantilever tip radius r = 60 m and a rotation of 70° = 1.222 rad, the tip travels s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉體只是把橋轉個方向，結構受力與一般懸臂施工完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rotation just turns the bridge, so its forces are identical to ordinary cantilever construction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「轉動 T 構與跨越線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rotating T-frame and the crossing line”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉體工法的系統與適用情境
knowledge.titleEn: System logic and where rotation fits
knowledge.text: 轉體施工把橋梁上部結構先在不影響交通或河道的位置（通常平行於鐵路或河岸）以支架、懸臂或預製方式建好，再以橋墩頂或承台中的轉動中心旋轉到設計軸線。水平轉體最常見：一座平衡懸臂 T 構或斜張橋半跨坐在球鉸上，繞豎軸旋轉數十度；豎向轉體則把拱肋半跨先豎直或平躺建造，再繞拱腳的水平軸轉下或轉起；另有以浮箱支撐一端、繞另一端旋轉的浮運轉體。
knowledge.textEn: Rotation construction builds the superstructure where it does not obstruct traffic or navigation, usually parallel to a railway or riverbank, by falsework, cantilevering or prefabrication, then swings it onto the design axis about a pivot in the pier top or pile cap. Horizontal rotation is most common: a balanced-cantilever T-frame or half of a cable-stayed bridge sits on a spherical hinge and turns tens of degrees about a vertical axis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：轉體只是把橋轉個方向，結構受力與一般懸臂施工完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rotation just turns the bridge, so its forces are identical to ordinary cantilever construction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉體工法的系統與適用情境」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System logic and where rotation fits" is correct?
options: 轉體只是把橋轉個方向，結構受力與一般懸臂施工完全相同。
轉體施工把橋梁上部結構先在不影響交通或河道的位置（通常平行於鐵路或河岸）以支架、懸臂或預製方式建好，再以橋墩頂或承台中的轉動中心旋轉到設計軸線。
對稱設計的 T 構兩側重量必定相等，不需要配重。
optionsEn: Rotation just turns the bridge, so its forces are identical to ordinary cantilever construction.

Rotation construction builds the superstructure where it does not obstruct traffic or navigation, usually parallel to a railway or riverbank, by falsework, cantilevering or prefabrication, then swings it onto the design axis about a pivot in the pier top or pile cap.
A symmetrically designed T-frame is always balanced and never needs ballast.
quiz.explanation: 轉體施工把橋梁上部結構先在不影響交通或河道的位置（通常平行於鐵路或河岸）以支架、懸臂或預製方式建好，再以橋墩頂或承台中的轉動中心旋轉到設計軸線。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rotation construction builds the superstructure where it does not obstruct traffic or navigation, usually parallel to a railway or riverbank, by falsework, cantilevering or prefabrication, then swings it onto the design axis about a pivot in the pier top or pile cap. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉體工法的系統與適用情境：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System logic and where rotation fits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉動 T 構與跨越線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotating T-frame and the crossing line” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸臂端半徑 r = 60 m、轉角 70° = 1.222 rad：端點弧長 s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m。若端點速度上限 1.5 m/min，純轉動時間約 73.3/1.5 ≈ 49 min，角速度 1.5/60 = 0.025 rad/min。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a cantilever tip radius r = 60 m and a rotation of 70° = 1.222 rad, the tip travels s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m. At a tip speed limit of 1.5 m/min, pure rotation takes about 73.3/1.5 ≈ 49 min, an angular speed of 1.5/60 = 0.025 rad/min. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：方案比選時以平面圖檢查轉動掃過的範圍：懸臂端與斜張索在整個轉動弧內不得碰觸電車線、號誌、既有建物或航道設施，並保留安全間距；同時以時程表確認轉動作業（含準備、試轉、轉動與精調）能放進業主核准的鐵路封鎖或交通管制時段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During option selection, check the swept area on plan: the cantilever tips and stays must clear catenary, signals, existing buildings and waterway facilities throughout the rotation arc with a safety margin, and a time schedule must show that preparation, trial turning, rotation and fine adjustment fit inside the railway possession or traffic closure approved by the owner.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸臂端半徑 r = 60 m、轉角 70° = 1.222 rad：端點弧長 s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m。若端點速度上限 1.5 m/min，純轉動時間約 73.3/1.5 ≈ 49 min，角速度 1.5/60 = 0.025 rad/min。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a cantilever tip radius r = 60 m and a rotation of 70° = 1.222 rad, the tip travels s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m. At a tip speed limit of 1.5 m/min, pure rotation takes about 73.3/1.5 ≈ 49 min, an angular speed of 1.5/60 = 0.025 rad/min. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉體工法的系統與適用情境」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System logic and where rotation fits", which statement holds?
options: 承台本來就很大，承受球鉸集中力不需要特別配筋。
萬噸級結構轉動時慣性很大，到位時一定需要很大的制動力。
optionsEn: A pile cap is so massive that it needs no special reinforcement for the hinge load.
A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes has huge rotational inertia and needs a huge braking force at arrival.
With a cantilever tip radius r = 60 m and a rotation of 70° = 1.222 rad, the tip travels s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m.
quiz.explanation: 懸臂端半徑 r = 60 m、轉角 70° = 1.222 rad：端點弧長 s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a cantilever tip radius r = 60 m and a rotation of 70° = 1.222 rad, the tip travels s = r·θ = 60×1.222 ≈ 73.3 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉體工法的系統與適用情境：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: System logic and where rotation fits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉動 T 構與跨越線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rotating T-frame and the crossing line” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 方案比選時以平面圖檢查轉動掃過的範圍：懸臂端與斜張索在整個轉動弧內不得碰觸電車線、號誌、既有建物或航道設施，並保留安全間距；同時以時程表確認轉動作業（含準備、試轉、轉動與精調）能放進業主核准的鐵路封鎖或交通管制時段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 轉體工法的系統與適用情境：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System logic and where rotation fits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉動 T 構與跨越線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rotating T-frame and the crossing line” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若規劃時只看起點與終點位置，忽略轉動弧線中段的淨空，懸臂端可能在轉動途中逼近電車線或鄰近結構，只能中途停止，讓結構停在既非施工位置也非設計位置的不利狀態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Planning only the start and end positions and ignoring clearance along the middle of the arc can bring a tip close to catenary or a neighbouring structure mid-turn, forcing a stop that leaves the structure in neither its construction nor its design position. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：其核心價值是把跨越營運中鐵路或航道的高風險時段，壓縮成一次可控的數小時作業。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its core value is compressing the high-risk period over a live railway or waterway into one controlled operation of a few hours.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉體只是把橋轉個方向，結構受力與一般懸臂施工完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rotation just turns the bridge, so its forces are identical to ordinary cantilever construction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 轉體重量、重心與撐腳平衡：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rotating weight, centre of gravity and leg balance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「轉體重心偏心」如何影響橋梁轉體施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Centre-of-gravity eccentricity” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge rotation construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 水平轉體時，整個上部結構與上轉盤只靠中心球鉸承重，周圍一圈撐腳與環形滑道保持數公釐到數十公釐的間隙，只在結構傾斜時接觸，作為防傾的保險。理論上兩側懸臂重量相等，但混凝土實際密度、斷面尺寸、預力與施工殘留物都會造成重心偏離球鉸中心，形成不平衡力矩。若不平衡力矩過大，撐腳會壓在滑道上摩擦，使牽引力暴增；因此設計常要求先量出偏心，再以配重調整，或刻意保留很小的縱向偏心，使結構穩定地以球鉸加一側撐腳轉動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「轉體重心偏心」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In horizontal rotation the whole superstructure and upper turntable rest only on the central spherical hinge, while a ring of support legs keeps a gap of a few to tens of millimetres above an annular slideway and touches it only if the structure tilts, as an anti-overturning safeguard. In theory the two cantilevers weigh the same, but actual concrete density, section sizes, prestress and construction leftovers shift the centre of gravity off the hinge, creating an unbalanced moment. If it is large, legs bear on the slideway and friction greatly increases the traction needed, so designs usually require the eccentricity to be measured and corrected with ballast, or a very small longitudinal eccentricity kept on purpose so the structure turns steadily on the hinge plus one leg pair. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Centre-of-gravity eccentricity” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：轉體重 W = 150,000 kN、重心偏心 e = 0.05 m：不平衡力矩 M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m；若由半徑 4.0 m 的撐腳承擔，撐腳力 7,500/4.0 = 1,875 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a rotating weight W = 150,000 kN and centre-of-gravity eccentricity e = 0.05 m, the unbalanced moment M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m; carried by legs at 4.0 m radius, the leg force is 7,500/4.0 = 1,875 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「對稱設計的 T 構兩側重量必定相等，不需要配重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A symmetrically designed T-frame is always balanced and never needs ballast." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「轉體重心偏心」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Centre-of-gravity eccentricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

球鉸做得越大越安全，轉動也會越省力。

steps.title: 轉體重量、重心與撐腳平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rotating weight, centre of gravity and leg balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉體重心偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Centre-of-gravity eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：轉體重 W = 150,000 kN、重心偏心 e = 0.05 m：不平衡力矩 M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m；若由半徑 4.0 m 的撐腳承擔，撐腳力 7,500/4.0 = 1,875 kN。撐腳間隙 10 mm、撐腳半徑 4.5 m 時，傾角上限 0.010/4.5 ≈ 0.0022 rad，對應 60 m 懸臂端豎向位移約 133 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a rotating weight W = 150,000 kN and centre-of-gravity eccentricity e = 0.05 m, the unbalanced moment M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m; carried by legs at 4.0 m radius, the leg force is 7,500/4.0 = 1,875 kN. With a 10 mm leg gap at 4.5 m radius, tilt is limited to 0.010/4.5 ≈ 0.0022 rad, about 133 mm vertical movement at a 60 m tip. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工紀錄（實測混凝土單位重、斷面尺寸、預力與附屬物）重新計算重心，並與稱重試驗結果比較；撐腳與滑道的間隙在轉動前逐點量測並記錄，任何一點間隙為零或過大都要查明原因。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate the centre of gravity from construction records (measured concrete unit weight, section dimensions, prestress and attachments) and compare with the weighing test; measure and record the gap at every leg before rotation, investigating any leg with zero or excessive gap.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 轉體重 W = 150,000 kN、重心偏心 e = 0.05 m：不平衡力矩 M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m；若由半徑 4.0 m 的撐腳承擔，撐腳力 7,500/4.0 = 1,875 kN。撐腳間隙 10 mm、撐腳半徑 4.5 m 時，傾角上限 0.010/4.5 ≈ 0.0022 rad，對應 60 m 懸臂端豎向位移約 133 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a rotating weight W = 150,000 kN and centre-of-gravity eccentricity e = 0.05 m, the unbalanced moment M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m; carried by legs at 4.0 m radius, the leg force is 7,500/4.0 = 1,875 kN. With a 10 mm leg gap at 4.5 m radius, tilt is limited to 0.010/4.5 ≈ 0.0022 rad, about 133 mm vertical movement at a 60 m tip. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉體重量、重心與撐腳平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rotating weight, centre of gravity and leg balance", which statement holds?
options: 轉體重 W = 150,000 kN、重心偏心 e = 0.05 m：不平衡力矩 M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m。

Traction only needs to exceed resistance, and bigger jacks are always easier to control.
The hinge friction coefficient can be taken from the catalogue without site testing.
quiz.explanation: 轉體重 W = 150,000 kN、重心偏心 e = 0.05 m：不平衡力矩 M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m；若由半徑 4.0 m 的撐腳承擔，撐腳力 7,500/4.0 = 1,875 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a rotating weight W = 150,000 kN and centre-of-gravity eccentricity e = 0.05 m, the unbalanced moment M = W·e = 7,500 kN·m; carried by legs at 4.0 m radius, the leg force is 7,500/4.0 = 1,875 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉體重量、重心與撐腳平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotating weight, centre of gravity and leg balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉體重心偏心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Centre-of-gravity eccentricity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工紀錄（實測混凝土單位重、斷面尺寸、預力與附屬物）重新計算重心，並與稱重試驗結果比較；撐腳與滑道的間隙在轉動前逐點量測並記錄，任何一點間隙為零或過大都要查明原因。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate the centre of gravity from construction records (measured concrete unit weight, section dimensions, prestress and attachments) and compare with the weighing test; measure and record the gap at every leg before rotation, investigating any leg with zero or excessive gap. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工中持續累計兩側懸臂的實際重量（含預力、護欄預埋件與殘留模板），並在設計文件中訂明容許偏心與配重調整程序；配重的重量與位置由設計單位核定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep a running tally of the actual weight of each cantilever during construction, including prestress, barrier embedments and leftover formwork, and state the allowable eccentricity and ballast procedure in the design documents; ballast weight and position are approved by the designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未量測偏心就轉動，撐腳在滑道上一路摩擦，牽引力超過千斤頂容量而卡在半途；偏心更大時結構傾斜到撐腳承壓，滑道局部壓碎，懸臂端下沉侵入下方鐵路淨空。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rotating without measuring eccentricity lets legs scrape along the slideway so traction exceeds jack capacity and the turn stalls halfway; larger eccentricity tilts the structure onto its legs, crushing the slideway locally and dropping a tip into the railway clearance below. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工紀錄（實測混凝土單位重、斷面尺寸、預力與附屬物）重新計算重心，並與稱重試驗結果比較；撐腳與滑道的間隙在轉動前逐點量測並記錄，任何一點間隙為零或過大都要查明原因。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the centre of gravity from construction records (measured concrete unit weight, section dimensions, prestress and attachments) and compare with the weighing test; measure and record the gap at every leg before rotation, investigating any leg with zero or excessive gap.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工中持續累計兩側懸臂的實際重量（含預力、護欄預埋件與殘留模板），並在設計文件中訂明容許偏心與配重調整程序；配重的重量與位置由設計單位核定。
knowledge.textEn: Keep a running tally of the actual weight of each cantilever during construction, including prestress, barrier embedments and leftover formwork, and state the allowable eccentricity and ballast procedure in the design documents; ballast weight and position are approved by the designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉體重量、重心與撐腳平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rotating weight, centre of gravity and leg balance"?

以施工紀錄（實測混凝土單位重、斷面尺寸、預力與附屬物）重新計算重心，並與稱重試驗結果比較。
封鉸後球鉸就失去作用，之後的沉陷與耐久與轉體無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Recalculate the centre of gravity from construction records (measured concrete unit weight, section dimensions, prestress and attachments) and compare with the weighing test.
Once encased, the hinge plays no further role, so later settlement and durability have nothing to do with the rotation.
