quiz.explanationEn: Recalculate the centre of gravity from construction records (measured concrete unit weight, section dimensions, prestress and attachments) and compare with the weighing test; measure and record the gap at every leg before rotation, investigating any leg with zero or excessive gap. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉體重量、重心與撐腳平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rotating weight, centre of gravity and leg balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉體重心偏心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Centre-of-gravity eccentricity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未量測偏心就轉動，撐腳在滑道上一路摩擦，牽引力超過千斤頂容量而卡在半途；偏心更大時結構傾斜到撐腳承壓，滑道局部壓碎，懸臂端下沉侵入下方鐵路淨空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rotating without measuring eccentricity lets legs scrape along the slideway so traction exceeds jack capacity and the turn stalls halfway; larger eccentricity tilts the structure onto its legs, crushing the slideway locally and dropping a tip into the railway clearance below. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若不平衡力矩過大，撐腳會壓在滑道上摩擦，使牽引力暴增；因此設計常要求先量出偏心，再以配重調整，或刻意保留很小的縱向偏心，使結構穩定地以球鉸加一側撐腳轉動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If it is large, legs bear on the slideway and friction greatly increases the traction needed, so designs usually require the eccentricity to be measured and corrected with ballast, or a very small longitudinal eccentricity kept on purpose so the structure turns steadily on the hinge plus one leg pair.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「對稱設計的 T 構兩側重量必定相等，不需要配重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A symmetrically designed T-frame is always balanced and never needs ballast." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未量測偏心就轉動，撐腳在滑道上一路摩擦，牽引力超過千斤頂容量而卡在半途；偏心更大時結構傾斜到撐腳承壓，滑道局部壓碎，懸臂端下沉侵入下方鐵路淨空。
knowledge.textEn: Rotating without measuring eccentricity lets legs scrape along the slideway so traction exceeds jack capacity and the turn stalls halfway; larger eccentricity tilts the structure onto its legs, crushing the slideway locally and dropping a tip into the railway clearance below.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉體重量、重心與撐腳平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rotating weight, centre of gravity and leg balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
球鉸做得越大越安全，轉動也會越省力。
未量測偏心就轉動，撐腳在滑道上一路摩擦，牽引力超過千斤頂容量而卡在半途；偏心更大時結構傾斜到撐腳承壓，滑道局部壓碎，懸臂端下沉侵入下方鐵路淨空。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A bigger spherical hinge is always safer and also easier to turn.
Rotating without measuring eccentricity lets legs scrape along the slideway so traction exceeds jack capacity and the turn stalls halfway.
quiz.explanation: 未量測偏心就轉動，撐腳在滑道上一路摩擦，牽引力超過千斤頂容量而卡在半途；偏心更大時結構傾斜到撐腳承壓，滑道局部壓碎，懸臂端下沉侵入下方鐵路淨空。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rotating without measuring eccentricity lets legs scrape along the slideway so traction exceeds jack capacity and the turn stalls halfway; larger eccentricity tilts the structure onto its legs, crushing the slideway locally and dropping a tip into the railway clearance below. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩」與「上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque" and "Turntables, support legs and slideway details": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「球鉸與聚四氟乙烯滑片」如何影響橋梁轉體施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spherical hinge and PTFE pads” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge rotation construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 球鉸由上下兩片球面鋼板組成：下球面板固定在下轉盤，上球面板固定在上轉盤，兩者之間嵌入聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑片並塗抹潤滑脂。球面讓結構在豎直力作用下自動對中，也允許少量傾斜；滑片把接觸應力限制在材料容許範圍，並提供低而穩定的摩擦。轉動時的阻力主要是球鉸摩擦力矩，它與總重、摩擦係數與球鉸半徑成正比，所以球鉸做得越大，接觸應力越低，但摩擦力矩反而越大，這是球鉸尺寸設計的核心取捨。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「球鉸與聚四氟乙烯滑片」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A spherical hinge consists of two spherical steel plates: the lower one fixed in the lower turntable and the upper one in the upper turntable, with greased PTFE pads inset between them. The spherical shape self-centres the structure under vertical load and permits a little tilt, while the pads keep contact stress within material limits and give low, stable friction. Rotation resistance is mainly the hinge friction torque, proportional to total weight, friction coefficient and hinge radius; a larger hinge lowers contact stress but raises friction torque, the central trade-off in sizing the hinge. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spherical hinge and PTFE pads” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：球鉸投影半徑 R = 2.0 m：面積 π×2.0² ≈ 12.57 m²，W = 150,000 kN 時平均接觸應力 σ ≈ 150,000/12.57 ≈ 11.9 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a projected hinge radius R = 2.0 m, the area is π×2.0² ≈ 12.57 m² and the average contact stress for W = 150,000 kN is σ ≈ 150,000/12.57 ≈ 11.9 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「球鉸做得越大越安全，轉動也會越省力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bigger spherical hinge is always safer and also easier to turn." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「球鉸與聚四氟乙烯滑片」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Spherical hinge and PTFE pads”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩
knowledge.titleEn: Spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque
knowledge.text: 球鉸由上下兩片球面鋼板組成：下球面板固定在下轉盤，上球面板固定在上轉盤，兩者之間嵌入聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑片並塗抹潤滑脂。球面讓結構在豎直力作用下自動對中，也允許少量傾斜；滑片把接觸應力限制在材料容許範圍，並提供低而穩定的摩擦。
knowledge.textEn: A spherical hinge consists of two spherical steel plates: the lower one fixed in the lower turntable and the upper one in the upper turntable, with greased PTFE pads inset between them. The spherical shape self-centres the structure under vertical load and permits a little tilt, while the pads keep contact stress within material limits and give low, stable friction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：球鉸做得越大越安全，轉動也會越省力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A bigger spherical hinge is always safer and also easier to turn. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque" is correct?
options: 球鉸由上下兩片球面鋼板組成：下球面板固定在下轉盤，上球面板固定在上轉盤，兩者之間嵌入聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑片並塗抹潤滑脂。
球鉸做得越大越安全，轉動也會越省力。
承台本來就很大，承受球鉸集中力不需要特別配筋。
optionsEn: A spherical hinge consists of two spherical steel plates: the lower one fixed in the lower turntable and the upper one in the upper turntable, with greased PTFE pads inset between them.
A bigger spherical hinge is always safer and also easier to turn.
A pile cap is so massive that it needs no special reinforcement for the hinge load.
quiz.explanation: 球鉸由上下兩片球面鋼板組成：下球面板固定在下轉盤，上球面板固定在上轉盤，兩者之間嵌入聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑片並塗抹潤滑脂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A spherical hinge consists of two spherical steel plates: the lower one fixed in the lower turntable and the upper one in the upper turntable, with greased PTFE pads inset between them. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「球鉸與聚四氟乙烯滑片」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spherical hinge and PTFE pads” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：球鉸投影半徑 R = 2.0 m：面積 π×2.0² ≈ 12.57 m²，W = 150,000 kN 時平均接觸應力 σ ≈ 150,000/12.57 ≈ 11.9 MPa。以均布壓力近似，摩擦力矩 M_f = (2/3)·μ·W·R；設計摩擦 μ = 0.06 時 M_f = (2/3)×0.06×150,000×2.0 = 12,000 kN·m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a projected hinge radius R = 2.0 m, the area is π×2.0² ≈ 12.57 m² and the average contact stress for W = 150,000 kN is σ ≈ 150,000/12.57 ≈ 11.9 MPa. Approximating uniform pressure, the friction torque is M_f = (2/3)·μ·W·R; with a design friction μ = 0.06, M_f = (2/3)×0.06×150,000×2.0 = 12,000 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：球鉸在工廠完成後量測球面曲率半徑、表面粗糙度與滑片嵌入深度，並做組合試驗；現場安裝時以精密水準確認下球面板水平度與中心位置，澆置下轉盤混凝土時防止球面板浮動或變形，完成後再複測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After shop fabrication, measure the sphere radius, surface roughness and pad recess depth and carry out an assembly check; on site, verify the levelness and centre of the lower plate by precise levelling, prevent it floating or distorting while the lower turntable is cast, and re-survey afterwards.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With a projected hinge radius R = 2.0 m, the area is π×2.0² ≈ 12.57 m² and the average contact stress for W = 150,000 kN is σ ≈ 150,000/12.57 ≈ 11.9 MPa. Approximating uniform pressure, the friction torque is M_f = (2/3)·μ·W·R; with a design friction μ = 0.06, M_f = (2/3)×0.06×150,000×2.0 = 12,000 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque", which statement holds?
options: 萬噸級結構轉動時慣性很大，到位時一定需要很大的制動力。
轉動只需要量轉角，到位後再量高程即可。
optionsEn: A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes has huge rotational inertia and needs a huge braking force at arrival.
With a projected hinge radius R = 2.0 m, the area is π×2.0² ≈ 12.57 m² and the average contact stress for W = 150,000 kN is σ ≈ 150,000/12.57 ≈ 11.9 MPa.
Only the rotation angle needs measuring during the turn; levels can be checked on arrival.
quiz.explanation: 球鉸投影半徑 R = 2.0 m：面積 π×2.0² ≈ 12.57 m²，W = 150,000 kN 時平均接觸應力 σ ≈ 150,000/12.57 ≈ 11.9 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a projected hinge radius R = 2.0 m, the area is π×2.0² ≈ 12.57 m² and the average contact stress for W = 150,000 kN is σ ≈ 150,000/12.57 ≈ 11.9 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「球鉸與聚四氟乙烯滑片」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spherical hinge and PTFE pads” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 球鉸在工廠完成後量測球面曲率半徑、表面粗糙度與滑片嵌入深度，並做組合試驗；現場安裝時以精密水準確認下球面板水平度與中心位置，澆置下轉盤混凝土時防止球面板浮動或變形，完成後再複測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After shop fabrication, measure the sphere radius, surface roughness and pad recess depth and carry out an assembly check; on site, verify the levelness and centre of the lower plate by precise levelling, prevent it floating or distorting while the lower turntable is cast, and re-survey afterwards. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：球鉸的製造、運輸、安裝與保護（防塵、防雨、防焊渣）應有專屬程序，安裝完成至轉動前以保護罩覆蓋；滑片材料與潤滑脂須有出廠檢驗與摩擦試驗報告。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hinge fabrication, transport, installation and protection from dust, rain and weld spatter need a dedicated procedure, with a protective cover from installation until rotation; pad material and grease require mill certificates and friction test reports.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：下球面板在澆置時偏移或傾斜，上下球面無法密貼，接觸集中在局部，滑片被擠出或磨損，摩擦力矩遠大於設計值；潤滑脂混入砂土同樣會使摩擦暴增，轉動時出現停頓跳動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the lower plate shifts or tilts during casting, the spheres do not seat, contact concentrates locally, pads extrude or wear and friction torque far exceeds design; grease contaminated with sand also sharply raises friction, causing stick-slip jumps during rotation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

跨鐵路的梁底淨空只要在完工驗收時合格即可。

steps.title: 球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「球鉸與聚四氟乙烯滑片」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spherical hinge and PTFE pads” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 下球面板在澆置時偏移或傾斜，上下球面無法密貼，接觸集中在局部，滑片被擠出或磨損，摩擦力矩遠大於設計值；潤滑脂混入砂土同樣會使摩擦暴增，轉動時出現停頓跳動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the lower plate shifts or tilts during casting, the spheres do not seat, contact concentrates locally, pads extrude or wear and friction torque far exceeds design; grease contaminated with sand also sharply raises friction, causing stick-slip jumps during rotation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：轉動時的阻力主要是球鉸摩擦力矩，它與總重、摩擦係數與球鉸半徑成正比，所以球鉸做得越大，接觸應力越低，但摩擦力矩反而越大，這是球鉸尺寸設計的核心取捨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Rotation resistance is mainly the hinge friction torque, proportional to total weight, friction coefficient and hinge radius; a larger hinge lowers contact stress but raises friction torque, the central trade-off in sizing the hinge.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「球鉸做得越大越安全，轉動也會越省力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bigger spherical hinge is always safer and also easier to turn." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spherical-hinge contact stress and friction torque" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 下球面板在澆置時偏移或傾斜，上下球面無法密貼，接觸集中在局部，滑片被擠出或磨損，摩擦力矩遠大於設計值；潤滑脂混入砂土同樣會使摩擦暴增，轉動時出現停頓跳動。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
承台本來就很大，承受球鉸集中力不需要特別配筋。
optionsEn: If the lower plate shifts or tilts during casting, the spheres do not seat, contact concentrates locally, pads extrude or wear and friction torque far exceeds design.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A pile cap is so massive that it needs no special reinforcement for the hinge load.

quiz.explanationEn: If the lower plate shifts or tilts during casting, the spheres do not seat, contact concentrates locally, pads extrude or wear and friction torque far exceeds design; grease contaminated with sand also sharply raises friction, causing stick-slip jumps during rotation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Turntables, support legs and slideway details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「下轉盤局部承壓」如何影響橋梁轉體施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local bearing in the lower turntable” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge rotation construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 球鉸把數萬噸的力量集中在直徑數公尺的範圍內，下轉盤（承台頂部）必須把這股集中力擴散到下方的樁基，同時抵抗局部壓碎與劈裂；上轉盤則把橋墩傳下的力量收攏到球鉸上，承受很大的徑向拉力。兩者都需密集配置環向與徑向鋼筋及多層鋼筋網。撐腳常為鋼管混凝土，底部有滑靴，環形滑道則是嵌入下轉盤的不鏽鋼板，平整度直接影響撐腳一旦接觸時的摩擦與衝擊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「下轉盤局部承壓」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The hinge concentrates tens of thousands of tonnes onto an area a few metres across, so the lower turntable on top of the pile cap must spread this force into the piles while resisting local crushing and splitting; the upper turntable gathers pier forces onto the hinge and carries large radial tension. Both need dense hoop and radial reinforcement and several layers of mesh. Support legs are often concrete-filled steel tubes with sliding shoes, and the annular slideway is a stainless steel plate set into the lower turntable whose flatness governs friction and impact if a leg touches. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Local bearing in the lower turntable” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：局部承壓強度 F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Local bearing resistance F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「承台本來就很大，承受球鉸集中力不需要特別配筋。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A pile cap is so massive that it needs no special reinforcement for the hinge load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「下轉盤局部承壓」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Local bearing in the lower turntable”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部
knowledge.titleEn: Turntables, support legs and slideway details
knowledge.text: 球鉸把數萬噸的力量集中在直徑數公尺的範圍內，下轉盤（承台頂部）必須把這股集中力擴散到下方的樁基，同時抵抗局部壓碎與劈裂；上轉盤則把橋墩傳下的力量收攏到球鉸上，承受很大的徑向拉力。兩者都需密集配置環向與徑向鋼筋及多層鋼筋網。
knowledge.textEn: The hinge concentrates tens of thousands of tonnes onto an area a few metres across, so the lower turntable on top of the pile cap must spread this force into the piles while resisting local crushing and splitting; the upper turntable gathers pier forces onto the hinge and carries large radial tension. Both need dense hoop and radial reinforcement and several layers of mesh.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：承台本來就很大，承受球鉸集中力不需要特別配筋。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A pile cap is so massive that it needs no special reinforcement for the hinge load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Turntables, support legs and slideway details" is correct?
options: 承台本來就很大，承受球鉸集中力不需要特別配筋。
球鉸把數萬噸的力量集中在直徑數公尺的範圍內，下轉盤（承台頂部）必須把這股集中力擴散到下方的樁基，同時抵抗局部壓碎與劈裂。
牽引力只要大於轉動阻力即可，千斤頂越大越好控制。
optionsEn: A pile cap is so massive that it needs no special reinforcement for the hinge load.

The hinge concentrates tens of thousands of tonnes onto an area a few metres across, so the lower turntable on top of the pile cap must spread this force into the piles while resisting local crushing and splitting.
Traction only needs to exceed resistance, and bigger jacks are always easier to control.
quiz.explanation: 球鉸把數萬噸的力量集中在直徑數公尺的範圍內，下轉盤（承台頂部）必須把這股集中力擴散到下方的樁基，同時抵抗局部壓碎與劈裂；上轉盤則把橋墩傳下的力量收攏到球鉸上，承受很大的徑向拉力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The hinge concentrates tens of thousands of tonnes onto an area a few metres across, so the lower turntable on top of the pile cap must spread this force into the piles while resisting local crushing and splitting; the upper turntable gathers pier forces onto the hinge and carries large radial tension. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Turntables, support legs and slideway details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「下轉盤局部承壓」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local bearing in the lower turntable” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：局部承壓強度 F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0)。C40 混凝土 f_cd = 40/1.5 ≈ 26.7 MPa；球鉸承壓直徑 4 m、擴散直徑 6 m，面積比 (6/4)² = 2.25，√2.25 = 1.5，局部承壓強度 26.7×1.5 ≈ 40 MPa，大於平均接觸應力 11.9 MPa 但仍需配置抗劈裂鋼筋。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Local bearing resistance F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0). For C40 concrete f_cd = 40/1.5 ≈ 26.7 MPa; with a 4 m loaded diameter spreading to 6 m, the area ratio is (6/4)² = 2.25 and √2.25 = 1.5, giving a local bearing strength of 26.7×1.5 ≈ 40 MPa, above the 11.9 MPa average contact stress but still requiring splitting reinforcement. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：下轉盤混凝土澆置前逐項檢查鋼筋網層數、間距與球鉸錨筋，澆置時以分層振動並監測球面板高程；環形滑道安裝後以水準儀量測全周平整度（例如任意 1 m 內高差小於 2 mm），撐腳與滑道間隙逐一記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before casting the lower turntable, check mesh layers, spacing and hinge anchor bars item by item, vibrate in layers while monitoring the plate level; after installing the slideway, level its full circumference, for example within 2 mm over any 1 m, and record the gap at every leg.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Local bearing resistance F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0). For C40 concrete f_cd = 40/1.5 ≈ 26.7 MPa; with a 4 m loaded diameter spreading to 6 m, the area ratio is (6/4)² = 2.25 and √2.25 = 1.5, giving a local bearing strength of 26.7×1.5 ≈ 40 MPa, above the 11.9 MPa average contact stress but still requiring splitting reinforcement. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Turntables, support legs and slideway details", which statement holds?
options: 球鉸摩擦係數可以直接採用材料型錄值，不必現場試驗。
封鉸後球鉸就失去作用，之後的沉陷與耐久與轉體無關。
局部承壓強度 F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0)。
optionsEn: The hinge friction coefficient can be taken from the catalogue without site testing.
Once encased, the hinge plays no further role, so later settlement and durability have nothing to do with the rotation.
Local bearing resistance F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0).
quiz.explanation: 局部承壓強度 F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Local bearing resistance F_Rdu = A_c0·f_cd·√(A_c1/A_c0). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Turntables, support legs and slideway details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「下轉盤局部承壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local bearing in the lower turntable” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 下轉盤混凝土澆置前逐項檢查鋼筋網層數、間距與球鉸錨筋，澆置時以分層振動並監測球面板高程；環形滑道安裝後以水準儀量測全周平整度（例如任意 1 m 內高差小於 2 mm），撐腳與滑道間隙逐一記錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before casting the lower turntable, check mesh layers, spacing and hinge anchor bars item by item, vibrate in layers while monitoring the plate level; after installing the slideway, level its full circumference, for example within 2 mm over any 1 m, and record the gap at every leg. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：下轉盤與球鉸區應以實體模型或三維鋼筋圖預先檢查可施工性，必要時改用自充填混凝土；撐腳、滑道與球鉸的安裝精度列為停留點，由監造與設計單位共同驗收。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check constructability of the lower turntable and hinge zone with a mock-up or 3D reinforcement model, using self-compacting concrete if needed; installation accuracy of legs, slideway and hinge is a hold point accepted jointly by the supervising engineer and designer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：下轉盤鋼筋過密而混凝土未振實，球鉸下方出現蜂窩，轉動時局部壓碎使球鉸下沉傾斜；滑道接縫錯台使撐腳一旦接觸就卡住，轉動中出現衝擊與停頓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Congested reinforcement with poorly compacted concrete leaves honeycombing under the hinge that crushes during rotation so the hinge sinks and tilts; a step at a slideway joint snags any leg that touches, causing impacts and stalls during rotation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 下轉盤混凝土澆置前逐項檢查鋼筋網層數、間距與球鉸錨筋，澆置時以分層振動並監測球面板高程；環形滑道安裝後以水準儀量測全周平整度（例如任意 1 m 內高差小於 2 mm），撐腳與滑道間隙逐一記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Before casting the lower turntable, check mesh layers, spacing and hinge anchor bars item by item, vibrate in layers while monitoring the plate level; after installing the slideway, level its full circumference, for example within 2 mm over any 1 m, and record the gap at every leg.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 下轉盤與球鉸區應以實體模型或三維鋼筋圖預先檢查可施工性，必要時改用自充填混凝土；撐腳、滑道與球鉸的安裝精度列為停留點，由監造與設計單位共同驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Check constructability of the lower turntable and hinge zone with a mock-up or 3D reinforcement model, using self-compacting concrete if needed; installation accuracy of legs, slideway and hinge is a hold point accepted jointly by the supervising engineer and designer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Turntables, support legs and slideway details"?
options: 下轉盤混凝土澆置前逐項檢查鋼筋網層數、間距與球鉸錨筋，澆置時以分層振動並監測球面板高程。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
轉體只是把橋轉個方向，結構受力與一般懸臂施工完全相同。
optionsEn: Before casting the lower turntable, check mesh layers, spacing and hinge anchor bars item by item, vibrate in layers while monitoring the plate level.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Rotation just turns the bridge, so its forces are identical to ordinary cantilever construction.
quiz.explanation: 下轉盤混凝土澆置前逐項檢查鋼筋網層數、間距與球鉸錨筋，澆置時以分層振動並監測球面板高程；環形滑道安裝後以水準儀量測全周平整度（例如任意 1 m 內高差小於 2 mm），撐腳與滑道間隙逐一記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before casting the lower turntable, check mesh layers, spacing and hinge anchor bars item by item, vibrate in layers while monitoring the plate level; after installing the slideway, level its full circumference, for example within 2 mm over any 1 m, and record the gap at every leg. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Turntables, support legs and slideway details: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「下轉盤局部承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local bearing in the lower turntable” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 下轉盤鋼筋過密而混凝土未振實，球鉸下方出現蜂窩，轉動時局部壓碎使球鉸下沉傾斜；滑道接縫錯台使撐腳一旦接觸就卡住，轉動中出現衝擊與停頓。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Congested reinforcement with poorly compacted concrete leaves honeycombing under the hinge that crushes during rotation so the hinge sinks and tilts; a step at a slideway joint snags any leg that touches, causing impacts and stalls during rotation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：撐腳常為鋼管混凝土，底部有滑靴，環形滑道則是嵌入下轉盤的不鏽鋼板，平整度直接影響撐腳一旦接觸時的摩擦與衝擊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Support legs are often concrete-filled steel tubes with sliding shoes, and the annular slideway is a stainless steel plate set into the lower turntable whose flatness governs friction and impact if a leg touches.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「承台本來就很大，承受球鉸集中力不需要特別配筋。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A pile cap is so massive that it needs no special reinforcement for the hinge load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 下轉盤鋼筋過密而混凝土未振實，球鉸下方出現蜂窩，轉動時局部壓碎使球鉸下沉傾斜；滑道接縫錯台使撐腳一旦接觸就卡住，轉動中出現衝擊與停頓。
knowledge.textEn: Congested reinforcement with poorly compacted concrete leaves honeycombing under the hinge that crushes during rotation so the hinge sinks and tilts; a step at a slideway joint snags any leg that touches, causing impacts and stalls during rotation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「上下轉盤、撐腳與滑道細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Turntables, support legs and slideway details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
下轉盤鋼筋過密而混凝土未振實，球鉸下方出現蜂窩，轉動時局部壓碎使球鉸下沉傾斜；滑道接縫錯台使撐腳一旦接觸就卡住，轉動中出現衝擊與停頓。
牽引力只要大於轉動阻力即可，千斤頂越大越好控制。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Congested reinforcement with poorly compacted concrete leaves honeycombing under the hinge that crushes during rotation so the hinge sinks and tilts.
Traction only needs to exceed resistance, and bigger jacks are always easier to control.
quiz.explanation: 下轉盤鋼筋過密而混凝土未振實，球鉸下方出現蜂窩，轉動時局部壓碎使球鉸下沉傾斜；滑道接縫錯台使撐腳一旦接觸就卡住，轉動中出現衝擊與停頓。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Congested reinforcement with poorly compacted concrete leaves honeycombing under the hinge that crushes during rotation so the hinge sinks and tilts; a step at a slideway joint snags any leg that touches, causing impacts and stalls during rotation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「牽引系統與轉動力的配置」與「轉動到位、精調與封鉸」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Traction system and turning force" and "Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 牽引系統與轉動力的配置：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Traction system and turning force: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「牽引索與連續千斤頂」如何影響橋梁轉體施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Traction strands and continuous jacks” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge rotation construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 水平轉體通常在上轉盤外圍纏繞鋼絞線牽引索，兩端分別接到對稱布置的兩台連續千斤頂，形成一對力偶推動結構旋轉，力偶不會對球鉸產生側向力。連續千斤頂以前後兩組夾持器交替工作，使牽引索連續前進而不需反覆換索。啟動瞬間要克服較大的靜摩擦，常另設助推千斤頂頂在撐腳或上轉盤上幫助啟動；轉動中則以較低的動摩擦力矩運行，並由電腦同步兩台千斤頂的行程與力量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「牽引索與連續千斤頂」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal rotation usually wraps strand traction cables around the upper turntable, each end connected to one of two symmetrically placed continuous jacks, forming a force couple that turns the structure without pushing the hinge sideways. Continuous jacks alternate front and rear grippers so the strands advance continuously without re-anchoring. At start-up the larger static friction must be overcome, often with auxiliary push jacks bearing on a leg or the upper turntable; during the turn the lower running friction torque applies, and a computer synchronises the strokes and forces of both jacks. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Traction strands and continuous jacks” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：牽引半徑 4.5 m、兩台千斤頂形成力偶：每台力 F = M_f/(2×4.5)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 4.5 m traction radius and two jacks forming a couple, each jack force is F = M_f/(2×4.5).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「牽引力只要大於轉動阻力即可，千斤頂越大越好控制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Traction only needs to exceed resistance, and bigger jacks are always easier to control." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「牽引索與連續千斤頂」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Traction strands and continuous jacks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 牽引系統與轉動力的配置
knowledge.text: 水平轉體通常在上轉盤外圍纏繞鋼絞線牽引索，兩端分別接到對稱布置的兩台連續千斤頂，形成一對力偶推動結構旋轉，力偶不會對球鉸產生側向力。連續千斤頂以前後兩組夾持器交替工作，使牽引索連續前進而不需反覆換索。
knowledge.textEn: Horizontal rotation usually wraps strand traction cables around the upper turntable, each end connected to one of two symmetrically placed continuous jacks, forming a force couple that turns the structure without pushing the hinge sideways. Continuous jacks alternate front and rear grippers so the strands advance continuously without re-anchoring.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：牽引力只要大於轉動阻力即可，千斤頂越大越好控制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Traction only needs to exceed resistance, and bigger jacks are always easier to control. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「牽引系統與轉動力的配置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Traction system and turning force" is correct?
options: 牽引力只要大於轉動阻力即可，千斤頂越大越好控制。
萬噸級結構轉動時慣性很大，到位時一定需要很大的制動力。
水平轉體通常在上轉盤外圍纏繞鋼絞線牽引索，兩端分別接到對稱布置的兩台連續千斤頂，形成一對力偶推動結構旋轉，力偶不會對球鉸產生側向力。
optionsEn: Traction only needs to exceed resistance, and bigger jacks are always easier to control.
A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes has huge rotational inertia and needs a huge braking force at arrival.

Horizontal rotation usually wraps strand traction cables around the upper turntable, each end connected to one of two symmetrically placed continuous jacks, forming a force couple that turns the structure without pushing the hinge sideways.
quiz.explanation: 水平轉體通常在上轉盤外圍纏繞鋼絞線牽引索，兩端分別接到對稱布置的兩台連續千斤頂，形成一對力偶推動結構旋轉，力偶不會對球鉸產生側向力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Horizontal rotation usually wraps strand traction cables around the upper turntable, each end connected to one of two symmetrically placed continuous jacks, forming a force couple that turns the structure without pushing the hinge sideways. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 牽引系統與轉動力的配置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Traction system and turning force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牽引索與連續千斤頂」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Traction strands and continuous jacks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：牽引半徑 4.5 m、兩台千斤頂形成力偶：每台力 F = M_f/(2×4.5)。動摩擦 μ = 0.06 時 M_f = 12,000 kN·m，F ≈ 1,333 kN；啟動靜摩擦取 μ = 0.10，M_f = 20,000 kN·m，F ≈ 2,222 kN。千斤頂額定容量宜至少為啟動力的 1.5 至 2 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 4.5 m traction radius and two jacks forming a couple, each jack force is F = M_f/(2×4.5). For running friction μ = 0.06, M_f = 12,000 kN·m and F ≈ 1,333 kN; for static breakaway μ = 0.10, M_f = 20,000 kN·m and F ≈ 2,222 kN. Rated jack capacity should be at least 1.5 to 2 times the breakaway force. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：牽引系統安裝後先做空載試運轉，確認兩台千斤頂同步、夾持器動作與油壓管路；正式轉動前做小角度試轉（例如轉動數度後停止），記錄啟動力與運行力，反算摩擦係數並與稱重試驗結果比較，再決定是否進入正式轉動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After installation, run the traction system unloaded to confirm synchronisation, gripper action and hydraulic lines; before the main rotation, make a small trial turn of a few degrees, record breakaway and running forces, back-calculate friction and compare with the weighing test before deciding to proceed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 牽引半徑 4.5 m、兩台千斤頂形成力偶：每台力 F = M_f/(2×4.5)。動摩擦 μ = 0.06 時 M_f = 12,000 kN·m，F ≈ 1,333 kN；啟動靜摩擦取 μ = 0.10，M_f = 20,000 kN·m，F ≈ 2,222 kN。千斤頂額定容量宜至少為啟動力的 1.5 至 2 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a 4.5 m traction radius and two jacks forming a couple, each jack force is F = M_f/(2×4.5). For running friction μ = 0.06, M_f = 12,000 kN·m and F ≈ 1,333 kN; for static breakaway μ = 0.10, M_f = 20,000 kN·m and F ≈ 2,222 kN. Rated jack capacity should be at least 1.5 to 2 times the breakaway force. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「牽引系統與轉動力的配置」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Traction system and turning force", which statement holds?
options: 牽引半徑 4.5 m、兩台千斤頂形成力偶：每台力 F = M_f/(2×4.5)。
轉動只需要量轉角，到位後再量高程即可。
跨鐵路的梁底淨空只要在完工驗收時合格即可。
optionsEn: With a 4.5 m traction radius and two jacks forming a couple, each jack force is F = M_f/(2×4.5).
Only the rotation angle needs measuring during the turn; levels can be checked on arrival.
Soffit clearance over a railway only has to pass at completion.
quiz.explanation: 牽引半徑 4.5 m、兩台千斤頂形成力偶：每台力 F = M_f/(2×4.5)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 4.5 m traction radius and two jacks forming a couple, each jack force is F = M_f/(2×4.5). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 牽引系統與轉動力的配置：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Traction system and turning force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「牽引索與連續千斤頂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Traction strands and continuous jacks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 牽引系統安裝後先做空載試運轉，確認兩台千斤頂同步、夾持器動作與油壓管路；正式轉動前做小角度試轉（例如轉動數度後停止），記錄啟動力與運行力，反算摩擦係數並與稱重試驗結果比較，再決定是否進入正式轉動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After installation, run the traction system unloaded to confirm synchronisation, gripper action and hydraulic lines; before the main rotation, make a small trial turn of a few degrees, record breakaway and running forces, back-calculate friction and compare with the weighing test before deciding to proceed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：牽引系統設計、試運轉與試轉都列為停留點，由專業技師與設計單位簽認；轉動指揮由單一總指揮下令，每一個監測點都能直接下達停止指令。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Traction design, unloaded trial and trial turn are hold points signed by a qualified engineer and the designer; the rotation is commanded by a single director, and every monitoring post can order an immediate stop.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩台千斤頂不同步時，力偶變成合力，對球鉸施加水平推力，結構偏離中心或撐腳單側受壓；牽引索在轉盤槽內交疊或跳槽，會使牽引力突然下降，結構在慣性與風力下產生非預期擺動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronised jacks turn the couple into a net force that pushes the hinge sideways, shifting the structure off-centre or loading legs on one side; strands overlapping or jumping out of the turntable groove cause a sudden loss of traction and unplanned swinging under wind. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 牽引系統安裝後先做空載試運轉，確認兩台千斤頂同步、夾持器動作與油壓管路；正式轉動前做小角度試轉（例如轉動數度後停止），記錄啟動力與運行力，反算摩擦係數並與稱重試驗結果比較，再決定是否進入正式轉動。
knowledge.textEn: After installation, run the traction system unloaded to confirm synchronisation, gripper action and hydraulic lines; before the main rotation, make a small trial turn of a few degrees, record breakaway and running forces, back-calculate friction and compare with the weighing test before deciding to proceed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 牽引系統設計、試運轉與試轉都列為停留點，由專業技師與設計單位簽認；轉動指揮由單一總指揮下令，每一個監測點都能直接下達停止指令。
knowledge.textEn: Traction design, unloaded trial and trial turn are hold points signed by a qualified engineer and the designer; the rotation is commanded by a single director, and every monitoring post can order an immediate stop.

quiz.question: 要驗證「牽引系統與轉動力的配置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Traction system and turning force"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
牽引系統安裝後先做空載試運轉，確認兩台千斤頂同步、夾持器動作與油壓管路。
對稱設計的 T 構兩側重量必定相等，不需要配重。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
After installation, run the traction system unloaded to confirm synchronisation, gripper action and hydraulic lines.
A symmetrically designed T-frame is always balanced and never needs ballast.
quiz.explanation: 牽引系統安裝後先做空載試運轉，確認兩台千斤頂同步、夾持器動作與油壓管路；正式轉動前做小角度試轉（例如轉動數度後停止），記錄啟動力與運行力，反算摩擦係數並與稱重試驗結果比較，再決定是否進入正式轉動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After installation, run the traction system unloaded to confirm synchronisation, gripper action and hydraulic lines; before the main rotation, make a small trial turn of a few degrees, record breakaway and running forces, back-calculate friction and compare with the weighing test before deciding to proceed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 牽引系統與轉動力的配置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Traction system and turning force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「牽引索與連續千斤頂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Traction strands and continuous jacks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩台千斤頂不同步時，力偶變成合力，對球鉸施加水平推力，結構偏離中心或撐腳單側受壓；牽引索在轉盤槽內交疊或跳槽，會使牽引力突然下降，結構在慣性與風力下產生非預期擺動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronised jacks turn the couple into a net force that pushes the hinge sideways, shifting the structure off-centre or loading legs on one side; strands overlapping or jumping out of the turntable groove cause a sudden loss of traction and unplanned swinging under wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：啟動瞬間要克服較大的靜摩擦，常另設助推千斤頂頂在撐腳或上轉盤上幫助啟動；轉動中則以較低的動摩擦力矩運行，並由電腦同步兩台千斤頂的行程與力量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At start-up the larger static friction must be overcome, often with auxiliary push jacks bearing on a leg or the upper turntable; during the turn the lower running friction torque applies, and a computer synchronises the strokes and forces of both jacks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「牽引力只要大於轉動阻力即可，千斤頂越大越好控制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Traction only needs to exceed resistance, and bigger jacks are always easier to control." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩台千斤頂不同步時，力偶變成合力，對球鉸施加水平推力，結構偏離中心或撐腳單側受壓；牽引索在轉盤槽內交疊或跳槽，會使牽引力突然下降，結構在慣性與風力下產生非預期擺動。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronised jacks turn the couple into a net force that pushes the hinge sideways, shifting the structure off-centre or loading legs on one side; strands overlapping or jumping out of the turntable groove cause a sudden loss of traction and unplanned swinging under wind.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「牽引系統與轉動力的配置」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Traction system and turning force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
萬噸級結構轉動時慣性很大，到位時一定需要很大的制動力。
兩台千斤頂不同步時，力偶變成合力，對球鉸施加水平推力，結構偏離中心或撐腳單側受壓。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes has huge rotational inertia and needs a huge braking force at arrival.
Unsynchronised jacks turn the couple into a net force that pushes the hinge sideways, shifting the structure off-centre or loading legs on one side.
quiz.explanation: 兩台千斤頂不同步時，力偶變成合力，對球鉸施加水平推力，結構偏離中心或撐腳單側受壓；牽引索在轉盤槽內交疊或跳槽，會使牽引力突然下降，結構在慣性與風力下產生非預期擺動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronised jacks turn the couple into a net force that pushes the hinge sideways, shifting the structure off-centre or loading legs on one side; strands overlapping or jumping out of the turntable groove cause a sudden loss of traction and unplanned swinging under wind. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉動到位、精調與封鉸：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「到位限位與封鉸混凝土」如何影響橋梁轉體施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stop blocks and hinge encasement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge rotation construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 萬噸級結構以每分鐘幾公分的角速度轉動，動能其實很小，真正難的是精度：接近設計軸線時改為點動，每次只移動很小的距離，並在轉盤設置限位塊防止超轉。到位後以千斤頂微調軸線、高程與橫坡，接著以鋼楔或鋼支撐把上轉盤與下轉盤臨時鎖死，再在球鉸與撐腳周圍澆置封鉸混凝土，使轉動機構變成固結的墩底，最後與相鄰跨進行合龍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「到位限位與封鉸混凝土」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes turning at a few centimetres per minute has very little kinetic energy; the difficulty is precision. Near the design axis the jacks switch to inching, moving a tiny distance each time, and stop blocks on the turntable prevent over-rotation. On arrival, jacks fine-tune axis, level and cross-fall, steel wedges or struts temporarily lock the upper turntable to the lower, and encasement concrete is cast around the hinge and legs so the mechanism becomes a fixed pier base before closure with the adjacent spans. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stop blocks and hinge encasement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以兩側 60 m 懸臂近似，迴轉半徑 r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m，質量 m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg，I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²；ω = 0.025 rad/min ≈ 4.17×10⁻⁴ rad/s，動能 ½Iω² ≈ 1.6 kJ，極小。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Treating two 60 m arms, the radius of gyration r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m, mass m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg and I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²; at ω = 0.025 rad/min ≈ 4.17×10⁻⁴ rad/s the kinetic energy ½Iω² is only about 1.6 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「萬噸級結構轉動時慣性很大，到位時一定需要很大的制動力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes has huge rotational inertia and needs a huge braking force at arrival." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「到位限位與封鉸混凝土」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stop blocks and hinge encasement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉動到位、精調與封鉸
knowledge.titleEn: Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement
knowledge.text: 萬噸級結構以每分鐘幾公分的角速度轉動，動能其實很小，真正難的是精度：接近設計軸線時改為點動，每次只移動很小的距離，並在轉盤設置限位塊防止超轉。到位後以千斤頂微調軸線、高程與橫坡，接著以鋼楔或鋼支撐把上轉盤與下轉盤臨時鎖死，再在球鉸與撐腳周圍澆置封鉸混凝土，使轉動機構變成固結的墩底，最後與相鄰跨進行合龍。
