Near the design axis the jacks switch to inching, moving a tiny distance each time, and stop blocks on the turntable prevent over-rotation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：萬噸級結構轉動時慣性很大，到位時一定需要很大的制動力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes has huge rotational inertia and needs a huge braking force at arrival. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉動到位、精調與封鉸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement" is correct?
options: 萬噸級結構以每分鐘幾公分的角速度轉動，動能其實很小，真正難的是精度：接近設計軸線時改為點動，每次只移動很小的距離，並在轉盤設置限位塊防止超轉。
萬噸級結構轉動時慣性很大，到位時一定需要很大的制動力。
球鉸摩擦係數可以直接採用材料型錄值，不必現場試驗。
optionsEn: A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes turning at a few centimetres per minute has very little kinetic energy; the difficulty is precision.
A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes has huge rotational inertia and needs a huge braking force at arrival.
The hinge friction coefficient can be taken from the catalogue without site testing.
quiz.explanation: 萬噸級結構以每分鐘幾公分的角速度轉動，動能其實很小，真正難的是精度：接近設計軸線時改為點動，每次只移動很小的距離，並在轉盤設置限位塊防止超轉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes turning at a few centimetres per minute has very little kinetic energy; the difficulty is precision. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉動到位、精調與封鉸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「到位限位與封鉸混凝土」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stop blocks and hinge encasement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以兩側 60 m 懸臂近似，迴轉半徑 r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m，質量 m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg，I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²；ω = 0.025 rad/min ≈ 4.17×10⁻⁴ rad/s，動能 ½Iω² ≈ 1.6 kJ，極小。端點定位 ±10 mm 等於轉角 0.010/60 ≈ 1.67×10⁻⁴ rad，對應 4.5 m 牽引半徑上僅約 0.75 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Treating two 60 m arms, the radius of gyration r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m, mass m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg and I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²; at ω = 0.025 rad/min ≈ 4.17×10⁻⁴ rad/s the kinetic energy ½Iω² is only about 1.6 kJ. Positioning a tip to ±10 mm means 0.010/60 ≈ 1.67×10⁻⁴ rad, only about 0.75 mm at the 4.5 m traction radius. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：接近終點時以全站儀連續量測兩懸臂端座標，換算剩餘轉角並逐次點動；到位後確認軸線、高程與相鄰跨端點的對位在允差內（例如軸線 ±10 mm），鎖定後再複測一次，封鉸混凝土澆置前檢查鋼筋與清潔，並追蹤試體強度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Near the end, track both tip coordinates continuously with total stations, convert to the remaining angle and inch accordingly; on arrival confirm axis, level and alignment with adjacent span ends within tolerance, for example ±10 mm on axis, re-survey after locking, check reinforcement and cleanliness before casting the encasement and track cylinder strength.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以兩側 60 m 懸臂近似，迴轉半徑 r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m，質量 m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg，I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²；ω = 0.025 rad/min ≈ 4.17×10⁻⁴ rad/s，動能 ½Iω² ≈ 1.6 kJ，極小。端點定位 ±10 mm 等於轉角 0.010/60 ≈ 1.67×10⁻⁴ rad，對應 4.5 m 牽引半徑上僅約 0.75 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Treating two 60 m arms, the radius of gyration r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m, mass m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg and I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²; at ω = 0.025 rad/min ≈ 4.17×10⁻⁴ rad/s the kinetic energy ½Iω² is only about 1.6 kJ. Positioning a tip to ±10 mm means 0.010/60 ≈ 1.67×10⁻⁴ rad, only about 0.75 mm at the 4.5 m traction radius. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉動到位、精調與封鉸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement", which statement holds?
options: 封鉸後球鉸就失去作用，之後的沉陷與耐久與轉體無關。
以兩側 60 m 懸臂近似，迴轉半徑 r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m，質量 m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg，I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²。
轉體只是把橋轉個方向，結構受力與一般懸臂施工完全相同。
optionsEn: Once encased, the hinge plays no further role, so later settlement and durability have nothing to do with the rotation.
Treating two 60 m arms, the radius of gyration r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m, mass m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg and I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m².
Rotation just turns the bridge, so its forces are identical to ordinary cantilever construction.
quiz.explanation: 以兩側 60 m 懸臂近似，迴轉半徑 r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m，質量 m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg，I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²；ω = 0.025 rad/min ≈ 4.17×10⁻⁴ rad/s，動能 ½Iω² ≈ 1.6 kJ，極小。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating two 60 m arms, the radius of gyration r_g = 60/√3 ≈ 34.6 m, mass m = 150,000 kN/9.81 ≈ 15.3×10⁶ kg and I = m·r_g² ≈ 1.83×10¹⁰ kg·m²; at ω = 0.025 rad/min ≈ 4.17×10⁻⁴ rad/s the kinetic energy ½Iω² is only about 1.6 kJ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉動到位、精調與封鉸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「到位限位與封鉸混凝土」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stop blocks and hinge encasement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 接近終點時以全站儀連續量測兩懸臂端座標，換算剩餘轉角並逐次點動；到位後確認軸線、高程與相鄰跨端點的對位在允差內（例如軸線 ±10 mm），鎖定後再複測一次，封鉸混凝土澆置前檢查鋼筋與清潔，並追蹤試體強度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Near the end, track both tip coordinates continuously with total stations, convert to the remaining angle and inch accordingly; on arrival confirm axis, level and alignment with adjacent span ends within tolerance, for example ±10 mm on axis, re-survey after locking, check reinforcement and cleanliness before casting the encasement and track cylinder strength. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：轉動程序書須明訂點動開始的剩餘角度、限位塊位置、鎖定方式與封鉸澆置條件；鎖定與封鉸完成前，任何人不得移除牽引或限位裝置，並由設計單位確認封固後的體系轉換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The rotation procedure must specify the remaining angle at which inching begins, stop-block positions, the locking method and encasement conditions; no one may remove traction or stop devices before locking and encasement are complete, and the designer confirms the system change after fixing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：千斤頂控制解析度不足或靜摩擦黏滑，結構在終點前一下停滯、一下跳動，容易超轉；未先鎖定就開始封鉸，溫度變化或風力使結構在混凝土初凝期間微轉，封鉸混凝土開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Coarse jack control or stick-slip friction makes the structure stall and jump near the end, easily overshooting; starting encasement before locking lets temperature or wind turn the structure slightly while the concrete sets, cracking the encasement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 接近終點時以全站儀連續量測兩懸臂端座標，換算剩餘轉角並逐次點動；到位後確認軸線、高程與相鄰跨端點的對位在允差內（例如軸線 ±10 mm），鎖定後再複測一次，封鉸混凝土澆置前檢查鋼筋與清潔，並追蹤試體強度。
knowledge.textEn: Near the end, track both tip coordinates continuously with total stations, convert to the remaining angle and inch accordingly; on arrival confirm axis, level and alignment with adjacent span ends within tolerance, for example ±10 mm on axis, re-survey after locking, check reinforcement and cleanliness before casting the encasement and track cylinder strength.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 轉動程序書須明訂點動開始的剩餘角度、限位塊位置、鎖定方式與封鉸澆置條件；鎖定與封鉸完成前，任何人不得移除牽引或限位裝置，並由設計單位確認封固後的體系轉換。
knowledge.textEn: The rotation procedure must specify the remaining angle at which inching begins, stop-block positions, the locking method and encasement conditions; no one may remove traction or stop devices before locking and encasement are complete, and the designer confirms the system change after fixing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉動到位、精調與封鉸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
球鉸做得越大越安全，轉動也會越省力。
接近終點時以全站儀連續量測兩懸臂端座標，換算剩餘轉角並逐次點動。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A bigger spherical hinge is always safer and also easier to turn.
Near the end, track both tip coordinates continuously with total stations, convert to the remaining angle and inch accordingly.
quiz.explanation: 接近終點時以全站儀連續量測兩懸臂端座標，換算剩餘轉角並逐次點動；到位後確認軸線、高程與相鄰跨端點的對位在允差內（例如軸線 ±10 mm），鎖定後再複測一次，封鉸混凝土澆置前檢查鋼筋與清潔，並追蹤試體強度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Near the end, track both tip coordinates continuously with total stations, convert to the remaining angle and inch accordingly; on arrival confirm axis, level and alignment with adjacent span ends within tolerance, for example ±10 mm on axis, re-survey after locking, check reinforcement and cleanliness before casting the encasement and track cylinder strength. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉動到位、精調與封鉸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「到位限位與封鉸混凝土」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stop blocks and hinge encasement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 千斤頂控制解析度不足或靜摩擦黏滑，結構在終點前一下停滯、一下跳動，容易超轉；未先鎖定就開始封鉸，溫度變化或風力使結構在混凝土初凝期間微轉，封鉸混凝土開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Coarse jack control or stick-slip friction makes the structure stall and jump near the end, easily overshooting; starting encasement before locking lets temperature or wind turn the structure slightly while the concrete sets, cracking the encasement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：到位後以千斤頂微調軸線、高程與橫坡，接著以鋼楔或鋼支撐把上轉盤與下轉盤臨時鎖死，再在球鉸與撐腳周圍澆置封鉸混凝土，使轉動機構變成固結的墩底，最後與相鄰跨進行合龍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: On arrival, jacks fine-tune axis, level and cross-fall, steel wedges or struts temporarily lock the upper turntable to the lower, and encasement concrete is cast around the hinge and legs so the mechanism becomes a fixed pier base before closure with the adjacent spans.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「萬噸級結構轉動時慣性很大，到位時一定需要很大的制動力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes has huge rotational inertia and needs a huge braking force at arrival." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 千斤頂控制解析度不足或靜摩擦黏滑，結構在終點前一下停滯、一下跳動，容易超轉；未先鎖定就開始封鉸，溫度變化或風力使結構在混凝土初凝期間微轉，封鉸混凝土開裂。
knowledge.textEn: Coarse jack control or stick-slip friction makes the structure stall and jump near the end, easily overshooting; starting encasement before locking lets temperature or wind turn the structure slightly while the concrete sets, cracking the encasement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉動到位、精調與封鉸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Arrival, fine adjustment and hinge encasement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 千斤頂控制解析度不足或靜摩擦黏滑，結構在終點前一下停滯、一下跳動，容易超轉；未先鎖定就開始封鉸，溫度變化或風力使結構在混凝土初凝期間微轉，封鉸混凝土開裂。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
球鉸摩擦係數可以直接採用材料型錄值，不必現場試驗。
optionsEn: Coarse jack control or stick-slip friction makes the structure stall and jump near the end, easily overshooting.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The hinge friction coefficient can be taken from the catalogue without site testing.
quiz.explanation: 千斤頂控制解析度不足或靜摩擦黏滑，結構在終點前一下停滯、一下跳動，容易超轉；未先鎖定就開始封鉸，溫度變化或風力使結構在混凝土初凝期間微轉，封鉸混凝土開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Coarse jack control or stick-slip friction makes the structure stall and jump near the end, easily overshooting; starting encasement before locking lets temperature or wind turn the structure slightly while the concrete sets, cracking the encasement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉動前稱重試驗」與「轉動過程監測與停機條件」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pre-rotation weighing test" and "Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉動前稱重試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pre-rotation weighing test: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「稱重試驗與不平衡力矩」如何影響橋梁轉體施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weighing test and unbalanced moment” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge rotation construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 拆除臨時支撐、讓結構完全落在球鉸上之後，要做稱重試驗：在撐腳附近兩側以千斤頂分別向上頂，量測千斤頂力與位移，找出位移突然增加的轉折點，代表結構開始繞球鉸轉動。由兩側的轉折點力量，可以同時解出重心偏心造成的不平衡力矩與球鉸的摩擦力矩，進而決定配重量與牽引力。這是轉體前唯一能直接量到真實狀態的機會，數據品質決定了後續所有判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「稱重試驗與不平衡力矩」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After temporary supports are removed and the structure rests fully on the hinge, a weighing test is carried out: jacks near the legs on each side push upward in turn while force and displacement are measured, and the point where displacement suddenly increases marks the start of rotation about the hinge. The turning-point forces from both sides solve simultaneously for the unbalanced moment due to eccentricity and the hinge friction moment, which then set the ballast and traction force. It is the only chance before rotation to measure the real state directly, and its data quality governs every later decision. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Weighing test and unbalanced moment” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩側千斤頂距中心 a = 4.0 m，轉折力 P₁ = 2,600 kN、P₂ = 1,100 kN：不平衡力矩 M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m，摩擦力矩 M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With jacks at a = 4.0 m from the centre and turning-point forces P₁ = 2,600 kN and P₂ = 1,100 kN, the unbalanced moment is M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m and the friction moment M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「球鉸摩擦係數可以直接採用材料型錄值，不必現場試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The hinge friction coefficient can be taken from the catalogue without site testing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「稱重試驗與不平衡力矩」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Weighing test and unbalanced moment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉動前稱重試驗
knowledge.text: 拆除臨時支撐、讓結構完全落在球鉸上之後，要做稱重試驗：在撐腳附近兩側以千斤頂分別向上頂，量測千斤頂力與位移，找出位移突然增加的轉折點，代表結構開始繞球鉸轉動。由兩側的轉折點力量，可以同時解出重心偏心造成的不平衡力矩與球鉸的摩擦力矩，進而決定配重量與牽引力。
knowledge.textEn: After temporary supports are removed and the structure rests fully on the hinge, a weighing test is carried out: jacks near the legs on each side push upward in turn while force and displacement are measured, and the point where displacement suddenly increases marks the start of rotation about the hinge. The turning-point forces from both sides solve simultaneously for the unbalanced moment due to eccentricity and the hinge friction moment, which then set the ballast and traction force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：球鉸摩擦係數可以直接採用材料型錄值，不必現場試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The hinge friction coefficient can be taken from the catalogue without site testing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉動前稱重試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pre-rotation weighing test" is correct?
options: 球鉸摩擦係數可以直接採用材料型錄值，不必現場試驗。
拆除臨時支撐、讓結構完全落在球鉸上之後，要做稱重試驗：在撐腳附近兩側以千斤頂分別向上頂，量測千斤頂力與位移，找出位移突然增加的轉折點，代表結構開始繞球鉸轉動。
轉動只需要量轉角，到位後再量高程即可。
optionsEn: The hinge friction coefficient can be taken from the catalogue without site testing.

After temporary supports are removed and the structure rests fully on the hinge, a weighing test is carried out: jacks near the legs on each side push upward in turn while force and displacement are measured, and the point where displacement suddenly increases marks the start of rotation about the hinge.
Only the rotation angle needs measuring during the turn; levels can be checked on arrival.
quiz.explanation: 拆除臨時支撐、讓結構完全落在球鉸上之後，要做稱重試驗：在撐腳附近兩側以千斤頂分別向上頂，量測千斤頂力與位移，找出位移突然增加的轉折點，代表結構開始繞球鉸轉動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After temporary supports are removed and the structure rests fully on the hinge, a weighing test is carried out: jacks near the legs on each side push upward in turn while force and displacement are measured, and the point where displacement suddenly increases marks the start of rotation about the hinge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉動前稱重試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pre-rotation weighing test: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「稱重試驗與不平衡力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weighing test and unbalanced moment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩側千斤頂距中心 a = 4.0 m，轉折力 P₁ = 2,600 kN、P₂ = 1,100 kN：不平衡力矩 M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m，摩擦力矩 M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m。偏心 e = 3,000/150,000 = 0.02 m，摩擦係數 μ = 3M_F/(2WR) = 3×7,400/(2×150,000×2.0) ≈ 0.037。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With jacks at a = 4.0 m from the centre and turning-point forces P₁ = 2,600 kN and P₂ = 1,100 kN, the unbalanced moment is M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m and the friction moment M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m. The eccentricity is e = 3,000/150,000 = 0.02 m and the friction coefficient μ = 3M_F/(2WR) = 3×7,400/(2×150,000×2.0) ≈ 0.037. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：千斤頂與位移計須事先校正，加載以小級距進行並繪製力—位移曲線，以兩種方法（曲線轉折點與切線交點）判讀並取一致結果；試驗至少重複一次，偏心與摩擦結果與施工重量計算比較，差異過大須查明原因並由設計單位決定配重。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate jacks and displacement gauges beforehand, load in small steps and plot force–displacement curves, read the turning point by two methods (curve break and tangent intersection) and require agreement; repeat at least once, compare eccentricity and friction with the construction weight calculation, and have the designer decide on ballast if they differ significantly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: With jacks at a = 4.0 m from the centre and turning-point forces P₁ = 2,600 kN and P₂ = 1,100 kN, the unbalanced moment is M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m and the friction moment M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m. The eccentricity is e = 3,000/150,000 = 0.02 m and the friction coefficient μ = 3M_F/(2WR) = 3×7,400/(2×150,000×2.0) ≈ 0.037. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉動前稱重試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pre-rotation weighing test", which statement holds?
options: 跨鐵路的梁底淨空只要在完工驗收時合格即可。
對稱設計的 T 構兩側重量必定相等，不需要配重。
兩側千斤頂距中心 a = 4.0 m，轉折力 P₁ = 2,600 kN、P₂ = 1,100 kN：不平衡力矩 M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m，摩擦力矩 M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m。
optionsEn: Soffit clearance over a railway only has to pass at completion.
A symmetrically designed T-frame is always balanced and never needs ballast.

With jacks at a = 4.0 m from the centre and turning-point forces P₁ = 2,600 kN and P₂ = 1,100 kN, the unbalanced moment is M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m and the friction moment M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m.
quiz.explanation: 兩側千斤頂距中心 a = 4.0 m，轉折力 P₁ = 2,600 kN、P₂ = 1,100 kN：不平衡力矩 M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m，摩擦力矩 M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With jacks at a = 4.0 m from the centre and turning-point forces P₁ = 2,600 kN and P₂ = 1,100 kN, the unbalanced moment is M_G = (P₁ − P₂)·a/2 = 3,000 kN·m and the friction moment M_F = (P₁ + P₂)·a/2 = 7,400 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉動前稱重試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pre-rotation weighing test: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「稱重試驗與不平衡力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weighing test and unbalanced moment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 千斤頂與位移計須事先校正，加載以小級距進行並繪製力—位移曲線，以兩種方法（曲線轉折點與切線交點）判讀並取一致結果；試驗至少重複一次，偏心與摩擦結果與施工重量計算比較，差異過大須查明原因並由設計單位決定配重。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate jacks and displacement gauges beforehand, load in small steps and plot force–displacement curves, read the turning point by two methods (curve break and tangent intersection) and require agreement; repeat at least once, compare eccentricity and friction with the construction weight calculation, and have the designer decide on ballast if they differ significantly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：稱重試驗前由監造確認所有臨時支撐、砂箱與鎖定裝置已解除並拍照記錄；試驗報告須含原始資料、判讀方法、計算結果與配重建議，經設計單位簽認後才能進入試轉。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before the weighing test the supervising engineer confirms and photographs the release of all temporary supports, sand boxes and locks; the report must contain raw data, interpretation method, results and ballast recommendation, signed by the designer before any trial turn.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若稱重時臨時支撐或砂箱未完全拆除，部分重量仍由支撐承擔，量到的摩擦力矩偏低、偏心判斷錯誤，正式轉動時牽引力不足或結構突然傾向一側。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If temporary supports or sand boxes are not fully removed, part of the weight bypasses the hinge, so measured friction is too low and eccentricity is misjudged; during the actual rotation traction proves insufficient or the structure suddenly leans to one side. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 千斤頂與位移計須事先校正，加載以小級距進行並繪製力—位移曲線，以兩種方法（曲線轉折點與切線交點）判讀並取一致結果；試驗至少重複一次，偏心與摩擦結果與施工重量計算比較，差異過大須查明原因並由設計單位決定配重。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate jacks and displacement gauges beforehand, load in small steps and plot force–displacement curves, read the turning point by two methods (curve break and tangent intersection) and require agreement; repeat at least once, compare eccentricity and friction with the construction weight calculation, and have the designer decide on ballast if they differ significantly.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 稱重試驗前由監造確認所有臨時支撐、砂箱與鎖定裝置已解除並拍照記錄；試驗報告須含原始資料、判讀方法、計算結果與配重建議，經設計單位簽認後才能進入試轉。
knowledge.textEn: Before the weighing test the supervising engineer confirms and photographs the release of all temporary supports, sand boxes and locks; the report must contain raw data, interpretation method, results and ballast recommendation, signed by the designer before any trial turn.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉動前稱重試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pre-rotation weighing test"?
options: 千斤頂與位移計須事先校正，加載以小級距進行並繪製力—位移曲線，以兩種方法（曲線轉折點與切線交點）判讀並取一致結果。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
承台本來就很大，承受球鉸集中力不需要特別配筋。
optionsEn: Calibrate jacks and displacement gauges beforehand, load in small steps and plot force–displacement curves, read the turning point by two methods (curve break and tangent intersection) and require agreement.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A pile cap is so massive that it needs no special reinforcement for the hinge load.
quiz.explanation: 千斤頂與位移計須事先校正，加載以小級距進行並繪製力—位移曲線，以兩種方法（曲線轉折點與切線交點）判讀並取一致結果；試驗至少重複一次，偏心與摩擦結果與施工重量計算比較，差異過大須查明原因並由設計單位決定配重。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate jacks and displacement gauges beforehand, load in small steps and plot force–displacement curves, read the turning point by two methods (curve break and tangent intersection) and require agreement; repeat at least once, compare eccentricity and friction with the construction weight calculation, and have the designer decide on ballast if they differ significantly. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉動前稱重試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pre-rotation weighing test: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「稱重試驗與不平衡力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weighing test and unbalanced moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若稱重時臨時支撐或砂箱未完全拆除，部分重量仍由支撐承擔，量到的摩擦力矩偏低、偏心判斷錯誤，正式轉動時牽引力不足或結構突然傾向一側。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If temporary supports or sand boxes are not fully removed, part of the weight bypasses the hinge, so measured friction is too low and eccentricity is misjudged; during the actual rotation traction proves insufficient or the structure suddenly leans to one side. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是轉體前唯一能直接量到真實狀態的機會，數據品質決定了後續所有判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is the only chance before rotation to measure the real state directly, and its data quality governs every later decision.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「球鉸摩擦係數可以直接採用材料型錄值，不必現場試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The hinge friction coefficient can be taken from the catalogue without site testing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若稱重時臨時支撐或砂箱未完全拆除，部分重量仍由支撐承擔，量到的摩擦力矩偏低、偏心判斷錯誤，正式轉動時牽引力不足或結構突然傾向一側。
knowledge.textEn: If temporary supports or sand boxes are not fully removed, part of the weight bypasses the hinge, so measured friction is too low and eccentricity is misjudged; during the actual rotation traction proves insufficient or the structure suddenly leans to one side.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉動前稱重試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pre-rotation weighing test" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若稱重時臨時支撐或砂箱未完全拆除，部分重量仍由支撐承擔，量到的摩擦力矩偏低、偏心判斷錯誤，正式轉動時牽引力不足或結構突然傾向一側。
轉動只需要量轉角，到位後再量高程即可。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If temporary supports or sand boxes are not fully removed, part of the weight bypasses the hinge, so measured friction is too low and eccentricity is misjudged.
Only the rotation angle needs measuring during the turn; levels can be checked on arrival.
quiz.explanation: 若稱重時臨時支撐或砂箱未完全拆除，部分重量仍由支撐承擔，量到的摩擦力矩偏低、偏心判斷錯誤，正式轉動時牽引力不足或結構突然傾向一側。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If temporary supports or sand boxes are not fully removed, part of the weight bypasses the hinge, so measured friction is too low and eccentricity is misjudged; during the actual rotation traction proves insufficient or the structure suddenly leans to one side. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉動過程監測與停機條件：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「轉動中監測與風速限制」如何影響橋梁轉體施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Monitoring and wind limits during rotation” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge rotation construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉動期間結構處於一個與完工或施工階段都不同的臨時狀態：只有中心一點支承、兩側長懸臂、撐腳懸空。監測重點包括轉角與端點座標、兩懸臂端高程差、撐腳與滑道間隙、牽引力、墩身或轉盤應變，以及現場風速。風對長懸臂的影響主要不是水平扭轉，而是兩側不對稱的上揚或下壓力造成傾斜，可能使撐腳接觸滑道。每一項都必須事先設定警戒值與停止值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「轉動中監測與風速限制」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During rotation the structure is in a temporary state unlike both construction and service: supported at a single central point with two long cantilevers and legs in the air. Monitoring covers rotation angle and tip coordinates, level difference between the tips, leg-to-slideway gaps, traction forces, pier or turntable strains and site wind speed. Wind acts on long cantilevers less through horizontal twisting than through unequal uplift or downward pressure on the two sides, which tilts the structure and can bring legs onto the slideway. Every quantity needs alert and stop values set in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Monitoring and wind limits during rotation” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風速 15 m/s 時動壓 q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa；一側懸臂寬 16 m、長 60 m，上揚係數 0.5 時 F = 0.5×141×960 ≈ 67.5 kN，作用於 30 m 處的傾覆力矩約 2,025 kN·m；與稱重殘餘不平衡 3,000 kN·m 疊加為 5,025 kN·m，若撐腳半徑 4.0 m 接觸，撐腳力約 1,256 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 15 m/s the dynamic pressure is q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa; for one arm 16 m wide and 60 m long with an uplift coefficient of 0.5, F = 0.5×141×960 ≈ 67.5 kN acting at 30 m gives about 2,025 kN·m of tilting moment; added to the 3,000 kN·m residual imbalance from weighing, the total is 5,025 kN·m, so a leg touching at 4.0 m radius carries about 1,256 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉動只需要量轉角，到位後再量高程即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Only the rotation angle needs measuring during the turn; levels can be checked on arrival." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「轉動中監測與風速限制」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Monitoring and wind limits during rotation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉動過程監測與停機條件
knowledge.titleEn: Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation
knowledge.text: 轉動期間結構處於一個與完工或施工階段都不同的臨時狀態：只有中心一點支承、兩側長懸臂、撐腳懸空。監測重點包括轉角與端點座標、兩懸臂端高程差、撐腳與滑道間隙、牽引力、墩身或轉盤應變，以及現場風速。
knowledge.textEn: During rotation the structure is in a temporary state unlike both construction and service: supported at a single central point with two long cantilevers and legs in the air. Monitoring covers rotation angle and tip coordinates, level difference between the tips, leg-to-slideway gaps, traction forces, pier or turntable strains and site wind speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：轉動只需要量轉角，到位後再量高程即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Only the rotation angle needs measuring during the turn; levels can be checked on arrival. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉動過程監測與停機條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation" is correct?
options: 轉動只需要量轉角，到位後再量高程即可。
封鉸後球鉸就失去作用，之後的沉陷與耐久與轉體無關。
轉動期間結構處於一個與完工或施工階段都不同的臨時狀態：只有中心一點支承、兩側長懸臂、撐腳懸空。
optionsEn: Only the rotation angle needs measuring during the turn; levels can be checked on arrival.
Once encased, the hinge plays no further role, so later settlement and durability have nothing to do with the rotation.
During rotation the structure is in a temporary state unlike both construction and service: supported at a single central point with two long cantilevers and legs in the air.
quiz.explanation: 轉動期間結構處於一個與完工或施工階段都不同的臨時狀態：只有中心一點支承、兩側長懸臂、撐腳懸空。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During rotation the structure is in a temporary state unlike both construction and service: supported at a single central point with two long cantilevers and legs in the air. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉動過程監測與停機條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉動中監測與風速限制」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Monitoring and wind limits during rotation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風速 15 m/s 時動壓 q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa；一側懸臂寬 16 m、長 60 m，上揚係數 0.5 時 F = 0.5×141×960 ≈ 67.5 kN，作用於 30 m 處的傾覆力矩約 2,025 kN·m；與稱重殘餘不平衡 3,000 kN·m 疊加為 5,025 kN·m，若撐腳半徑 4.0 m 接觸，撐腳力約 1,256 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 15 m/s the dynamic pressure is q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa; for one arm 16 m wide and 60 m long with an uplift coefficient of 0.5, F = 0.5×141×960 ≈ 67.5 kN acting at 30 m gives about 2,025 kN·m of tilting moment; added to the 3,000 kN·m residual imbalance from weighing, the total is 5,025 kN·m, so a leg touching at 4.0 m radius carries about 1,256 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：轉動前確認氣象預報與現場風速計運作，訂定轉動上限風速；轉動中由監測中心整合全站儀、間隙感測器、千斤頂壓力與應變資料即時顯示，任一項達警戒值即減速，達停止值即停機鎖定，所有資料以同一時間基準保存。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before rotation confirm the forecast and that site anemometers work, and set a maximum wind speed; during rotation a monitoring centre combines total-station, gap-sensor, jack-pressure and strain data in real time, slowing at any alert value and stopping and locking at any stop value, with all data stored on a common time base.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 風速 15 m/s 時動壓 q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa；一側懸臂寬 16 m、長 60 m，上揚係數 0.5 時 F = 0.5×141×960 ≈ 67.5 kN，作用於 30 m 處的傾覆力矩約 2,025 kN·m；與稱重殘餘不平衡 3,000 kN·m 疊加為 5,025 kN·m，若撐腳半徑 4.0 m 接觸，撐腳力約 1,256 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: At 15 m/s the dynamic pressure is q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa; for one arm 16 m wide and 60 m long with an uplift coefficient of 0.5, F = 0.5×141×960 ≈ 67.5 kN acting at 30 m gives about 2,025 kN·m of tilting moment; added to the 3,000 kN·m residual imbalance from weighing, the total is 5,025 kN·m, so a leg touching at 4.0 m radius carries about 1,256 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉動過程監測與停機條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation", which statement holds?
options: 轉體只是把橋轉個方向，結構受力與一般懸臂施工完全相同。
球鉸做得越大越安全，轉動也會越省力。
optionsEn: At 15 m/s the dynamic pressure is q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa.
Rotation just turns the bridge, so its forces are identical to ordinary cantilever construction.
A bigger spherical hinge is always safer and also easier to turn.
quiz.explanation: 風速 15 m/s 時動壓 q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa；一側懸臂寬 16 m、長 60 m，上揚係數 0.5 時 F = 0.5×141×960 ≈ 67.5 kN，作用於 30 m 處的傾覆力矩約 2,025 kN·m；與稱重殘餘不平衡 3,000 kN·m 疊加為 5,025 kN·m，若撐腳半徑 4.0 m 接觸，撐腳力約 1,256 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At 15 m/s the dynamic pressure is q = 0.5×1.25×15² ≈ 141 Pa; for one arm 16 m wide and 60 m long with an uplift coefficient of 0.5, F = 0.5×141×960 ≈ 67.5 kN acting at 30 m gives about 2,025 kN·m of tilting moment; added to the 3,000 kN·m residual imbalance from weighing, the total is 5,025 kN·m, so a leg touching at 4.0 m radius carries about 1,256 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉動過程監測與停機條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉動中監測與風速限制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Monitoring and wind limits during rotation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 轉動前確認氣象預報與現場風速計運作，訂定轉動上限風速；轉動中由監測中心整合全站儀、間隙感測器、千斤頂壓力與應變資料即時顯示，任一項達警戒值即減速，達停止值即停機鎖定，所有資料以同一時間基準保存。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before rotation confirm the forecast and that site anemometers work, and set a maximum wind speed; during rotation a monitoring centre combines total-station, gap-sensor, jack-pressure and strain data in real time, slowing at any alert value and stopping and locking at any stop value, with all data stored on a common time base. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：轉動作業前召開停留點會議，確認監測項目、警戒與停止值、通訊方式、風速限制與緊急鎖定程序；總指揮、設計代表、監造與鐵路或航道主管機關代表均需在場。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold a hold-point meeting before rotation to confirm monitored items, alert and stop values, communications, wind limit and emergency locking; the rotation director, design representative, supervising engineer and the railway or waterway authority representative must all be present.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：監測資料分散在不同單位、不同時間基準，轉動中無法即時判斷撐腳是否接觸；陣風突然加大時繼續轉動，結構傾斜、撐腳衝擊滑道，造成滑道損壞或懸臂端劇烈晃動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Monitoring scattered across teams on different time bases cannot tell in real time whether a leg is touching; continuing to turn as gusts rise lets the structure tilt and legs strike the slideway, damaging it or making the tips sway violently. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 轉動前確認氣象預報與現場風速計運作，訂定轉動上限風速；轉動中由監測中心整合全站儀、間隙感測器、千斤頂壓力與應變資料即時顯示，任一項達警戒值即減速，達停止值即停機鎖定，所有資料以同一時間基準保存。
knowledge.textEn: Before rotation confirm the forecast and that site anemometers work, and set a maximum wind speed; during rotation a monitoring centre combines total-station, gap-sensor, jack-pressure and strain data in real time, slowing at any alert value and stopping and locking at any stop value, with all data stored on a common time base.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 轉動作業前召開停留點會議，確認監測項目、警戒與停止值、通訊方式、風速限制與緊急鎖定程序；總指揮、設計代表、監造與鐵路或航道主管機關代表均需在場。
knowledge.textEn: Hold a hold-point meeting before rotation to confirm monitored items, alert and stop values, communications, wind limit and emergency locking; the rotation director, design representative, supervising engineer and the railway or waterway authority representative must all be present.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉動過程監測與停機條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
轉動前確認氣象預報與現場風速計運作，訂定轉動上限風速。
牽引力只要大於轉動阻力即可，千斤頂越大越好控制。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Before rotation confirm the forecast and that site anemometers work, and set a maximum wind speed.
Traction only needs to exceed resistance, and bigger jacks are always easier to control.
quiz.explanation: 轉動前確認氣象預報與現場風速計運作，訂定轉動上限風速；轉動中由監測中心整合全站儀、間隙感測器、千斤頂壓力與應變資料即時顯示，任一項達警戒值即減速，達停止值即停機鎖定，所有資料以同一時間基準保存。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before rotation confirm the forecast and that site anemometers work, and set a maximum wind speed; during rotation a monitoring centre combines total-station, gap-sensor, jack-pressure and strain data in real time, slowing at any alert value and stopping and locking at any stop value, with all data stored on a common time base. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉動過程監測與停機條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉動中監測與風速限制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Monitoring and wind limits during rotation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 監測資料分散在不同單位、不同時間基準，轉動中無法即時判斷撐腳是否接觸；陣風突然加大時繼續轉動，結構傾斜、撐腳衝擊滑道，造成滑道損壞或懸臂端劇烈晃動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring scattered across teams on different time bases cannot tell in real time whether a leg is touching; continuing to turn as gusts rise lets the structure tilt and legs strike the slideway, damaging it or making the tips sway violently. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每一項都必須事先設定警戒值與停止值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every quantity needs alert and stop values set in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉動只需要量轉角，到位後再量高程即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Only the rotation angle needs measuring during the turn; levels can be checked on arrival." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 監測資料分散在不同單位、不同時間基準，轉動中無法即時判斷撐腳是否接觸；陣風突然加大時繼續轉動，結構傾斜、撐腳衝擊滑道，造成滑道損壞或懸臂端劇烈晃動。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring scattered across teams on different time bases cannot tell in real time whether a leg is touching; continuing to turn as gusts rise lets the structure tilt and legs strike the slideway, damaging it or making the tips sway violently.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉動過程監測與停機條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring and stop criteria during rotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
封鉸後球鉸就失去作用，之後的沉陷與耐久與轉體無關。
監測資料分散在不同單位、不同時間基準，轉動中無法即時判斷撐腳是否接觸；陣風突然加大時繼續轉動，結構傾斜、撐腳衝擊滑道，造成滑道損壞或懸臂端劇烈晃動。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once encased, the hinge plays no further role, so later settlement and durability have nothing to do with the rotation.
Monitoring scattered across teams on different time bases cannot tell in real time whether a leg is touching.
quiz.explanation: 監測資料分散在不同單位、不同時間基準，轉動中無法即時判斷撐腳是否接觸；陣風突然加大時繼續轉動，結構傾斜、撐腳衝擊滑道，造成滑道損壞或懸臂端劇烈晃動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring scattered across teams on different time bases cannot tell in real time whether a leg is touching; continuing to turn as gusts rise lets the structure tilt and legs strike the slideway, damaging it or making the tips sway violently. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷」與「跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "System change after fixing and long-term settlement" and "Clearance budget over a live line and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: System change after fixing and long-term settlement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「封固後承台沉陷」如何影響橋梁轉體施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pile-cap settlement after fixing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge rotation construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉體期間全部重量集中在球鉸，再由下轉盤擴散到承台與樁基；封鉸後球鉸、撐腳與封固混凝土共同成為墩底，結構體系由單點支承轉為固結。接著與相鄰跨合龍，懸臂成為連續梁的一部分，潛變使內力逐漸重分配。因為整座 T 構只坐在一個承台上，承台的不均勻沉陷會直接轉為懸臂端的高程變化；跨越鐵路時，這個變化還關係到下方淨空與相鄰跨的接縫。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「封固後承台沉陷」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During rotation all the weight passes through the hinge and spreads through the lower turntable into the pile cap and piles; after encasement the hinge, legs and encasement concrete together form the pier base and the system changes from a single-point support to a fixed base. Closure with adjacent spans then makes the cantilevers part of a continuous girder, and creep gradually redistributes forces. Because the whole T-frame stands on one pile cap, differential settlement of that cap translates directly into tip-level changes, which over a railway also affect the clearance below and the joints with adjacent spans. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pile-cap settlement after fixing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：承台寬 10 m，兩側樁群差異沉陷 Δs = 5 mm：承台傾角 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad，傳到 60 m 懸臂端的高程變化約 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm，足以影響閉合段高程與相鄰伸縮縫。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 10 m wide pile cap with Δs = 5 mm differential settlement between pile groups, the cap tilts 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad, changing the 60 m tip level by about 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm, enough to affect the closure level and the adjacent expansion joint.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「封鉸後球鉸就失去作用，之後的沉陷與耐久與轉體無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once encased, the hinge plays no further role, so later settlement and durability have nothing to do with the rotation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「封固後承台沉陷」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pile-cap settlement after fixing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷
knowledge.titleEn: System change after fixing and long-term settlement
knowledge.text: 轉體期間全部重量集中在球鉸，再由下轉盤擴散到承台與樁基；封鉸後球鉸、撐腳與封固混凝土共同成為墩底，結構體系由單點支承轉為固結。接著與相鄰跨合龍，懸臂成為連續梁的一部分，潛變使內力逐漸重分配。
knowledge.textEn: During rotation all the weight passes through the hinge and spreads through the lower turntable into the pile cap and piles; after encasement the hinge, legs and encasement concrete together form the pier base and the system changes from a single-point support to a fixed base. Closure with adjacent spans then makes the cantilevers part of a continuous girder, and creep gradually redistributes forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：封鉸後球鉸就失去作用，之後的沉陷與耐久與轉體無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once encased, the hinge plays no further role, so later settlement and durability have nothing to do with the rotation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System change after fixing and long-term settlement" is correct?
options: 轉體期間全部重量集中在球鉸，再由下轉盤擴散到承台與樁基；封鉸後球鉸、撐腳與封固混凝土共同成為墩底，結構體系由單點支承轉為固結。
封鉸後球鉸就失去作用，之後的沉陷與耐久與轉體無關。
跨鐵路的梁底淨空只要在完工驗收時合格即可。
optionsEn: During rotation all the weight passes through the hinge and spreads through the lower turntable into the pile cap and piles.
Once encased, the hinge plays no further role, so later settlement and durability have nothing to do with the rotation.
Soffit clearance over a railway only has to pass at completion.
quiz.explanation: 轉體期間全部重量集中在球鉸，再由下轉盤擴散到承台與樁基；封鉸後球鉸、撐腳與封固混凝土共同成為墩底，結構體系由單點支承轉為固結。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During rotation all the weight passes through the hinge and spreads through the lower turntable into the pile cap and piles; after encasement the hinge, legs and encasement concrete together form the pier base and the system changes from a single-point support to a fixed base. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System change after fixing and long-term settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「封固後承台沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pile-cap settlement after fixing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：承台寬 10 m，兩側樁群差異沉陷 Δs = 5 mm：承台傾角 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad，傳到 60 m 懸臂端的高程變化約 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm，足以影響閉合段高程與相鄰伸縮縫。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 10 m wide pile cap with Δs = 5 mm differential settlement between pile groups, the cap tilts 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad, changing the 60 m tip level by about 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm, enough to affect the closure level and the adjacent expansion joint. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在承台四角與兩懸臂端設永久沉陷與高程觀測點，於轉動前、轉動後、封鉸後、合龍後及通車後定期量測，與預測沉陷曲線比較；封鉸混凝土定期檢查裂縫，並確認排水孔暢通，避免積水進入球鉸區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Set permanent settlement and level points at the four cap corners and both tips, survey them before and after rotation, after encasement, after closure and periodically after opening, and compare with the predicted settlement curve; inspect the encasement concrete for cracks and keep drains clear so water does not reach the hinge zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 承台寬 10 m，兩側樁群差異沉陷 Δs = 5 mm：承台傾角 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad，傳到 60 m 懸臂端的高程變化約 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm，足以影響閉合段高程與相鄰伸縮縫。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 10 m wide pile cap with Δs = 5 mm differential settlement between pile groups, the cap tilts 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad, changing the 60 m tip level by about 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm, enough to affect the closure level and the adjacent expansion joint. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System change after fixing and long-term settlement", which statement holds?
options: 對稱設計的 T 構兩側重量必定相等，不需要配重。
承台寬 10 m，兩側樁群差異沉陷 Δs = 5 mm：承台傾角 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad，傳到 60 m 懸臂端的高程變化約 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm，足以影響閉合段高程與相鄰伸縮縫。
承台本來就很大，承受球鉸集中力不需要特別配筋。
optionsEn: A symmetrically designed T-frame is always balanced and never needs ballast.

For a 10 m wide pile cap with Δs = 5 mm differential settlement between pile groups, the cap tilts 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad, changing the 60 m tip level by about 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm, enough to affect the closure level and the adjacent expansion joint.
A pile cap is so massive that it needs no special reinforcement for the hinge load.
quiz.explanation: 承台寬 10 m，兩側樁群差異沉陷 Δs = 5 mm：承台傾角 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad，傳到 60 m 懸臂端的高程變化約 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm，足以影響閉合段高程與相鄰伸縮縫。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 10 m wide pile cap with Δs = 5 mm differential settlement between pile groups, the cap tilts 0.005/10 = 0.0005 rad, changing the 60 m tip level by about 0.0005×60 = 0.030 m = 30 mm, enough to affect the closure level and the adjacent expansion joint. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: System change after fixing and long-term settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「封固後承台沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pile-cap settlement after fixing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在承台四角與兩懸臂端設永久沉陷與高程觀測點，於轉動前、轉動後、封鉸後、合龍後及通車後定期量測，與預測沉陷曲線比較；封鉸混凝土定期檢查裂縫，並確認排水孔暢通，避免積水進入球鉸區。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Set permanent settlement and level points at the four cap corners and both tips, survey them before and after rotation, after encasement, after closure and periodically after opening, and compare with the predicted settlement curve; inspect the encasement concrete for cracks and keep drains clear so water does not reach the hinge zone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：承台與樁基設計須以轉體期間的單點集中荷載與封固後的長期荷載兩種狀態檢核，並在交接文件中保留沉陷觀測歷程與預測曲線；任何鄰近開挖或降水工程須通知橋梁管理單位評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Pile cap and pile design must be checked for both the single-point load during rotation and the long-term load after fixing, with the settlement history and predicted curve kept in the handover file; any nearby excavation or dewatering must be notified to the bridge owner for assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只在轉動前後量測，忽略封鉸與合龍後的長期沉陷，數年後懸臂端下沉、伸縮縫錯台，跨鐵路段淨空逐漸減少；封鉸混凝土與既有轉盤之間若形成冷縫且未處理，雨水滲入使球鉸鋼板與錨筋腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surveying only around the rotation and ignoring long-term settlement after encasement and closure lets the tips drop and joints step over the years while clearance over the railway shrinks; an untreated cold joint between encasement and turntable lets rainwater reach the hinge plates and anchors, corroding them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在承台四角與兩懸臂端設永久沉陷與高程觀測點，於轉動前、轉動後、封鉸後、合龍後及通車後定期量測，與預測沉陷曲線比較；封鉸混凝土定期檢查裂縫，並確認排水孔暢通，避免積水進入球鉸區。
knowledge.textEn: Set permanent settlement and level points at the four cap corners and both tips, survey them before and after rotation, after encasement, after closure and periodically after opening, and compare with the predicted settlement curve; inspect the encasement concrete for cracks and keep drains clear so water does not reach the hinge zone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 承台與樁基設計須以轉體期間的單點集中荷載與封固後的長期荷載兩種狀態檢核，並在交接文件中保留沉陷觀測歷程與預測曲線；任何鄰近開挖或降水工程須通知橋梁管理單位評估。
knowledge.textEn: Pile cap and pile design must be checked for both the single-point load during rotation and the long-term load after fixing, with the settlement history and predicted curve kept in the handover file; any nearby excavation or dewatering must be notified to the bridge owner for assessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System change after fixing and long-term settlement"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
萬噸級結構轉動時慣性很大，到位時一定需要很大的制動力。
在承台四角與兩懸臂端設永久沉陷與高程觀測點，於轉動前、轉動後、封鉸後、合龍後及通車後定期量測，與預測沉陷曲線比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A structure of tens of thousands of tonnes has huge rotational inertia and needs a huge braking force at arrival.

Set permanent settlement and level points at the four cap corners and both tips, survey them before and after rotation, after encasement, after closure and periodically after opening, and compare with the predicted settlement curve.
quiz.explanation: 在承台四角與兩懸臂端設永久沉陷與高程觀測點，於轉動前、轉動後、封鉸後、合龍後及通車後定期量測，與預測沉陷曲線比較；封鉸混凝土定期檢查裂縫，並確認排水孔暢通，避免積水進入球鉸區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Set permanent settlement and level points at the four cap corners and both tips, survey them before and after rotation, after encasement, after closure and periodically after opening, and compare with the predicted settlement curve; inspect the encasement concrete for cracks and keep drains clear so water does not reach the hinge zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System change after fixing and long-term settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「封固後承台沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pile-cap settlement after fixing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只在轉動前後量測，忽略封鉸與合龍後的長期沉陷，數年後懸臂端下沉、伸縮縫錯台，跨鐵路段淨空逐漸減少；封鉸混凝土與既有轉盤之間若形成冷縫且未處理，雨水滲入使球鉸鋼板與錨筋腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surveying only around the rotation and ignoring long-term settlement after encasement and closure lets the tips drop and joints step over the years while clearance over the railway shrinks; an untreated cold joint between encasement and turntable lets rainwater reach the hinge plates and anchors, corroding them. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為整座 T 構只坐在一個承台上，承台的不均勻沉陷會直接轉為懸臂端的高程變化；跨越鐵路時，這個變化還關係到下方淨空與相鄰跨的接縫。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the whole T-frame stands on one pile cap, differential settlement of that cap translates directly into tip-level changes, which over a railway also affect the clearance below and the joints with adjacent spans.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「封鉸後球鉸就失去作用，之後的沉陷與耐久與轉體無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once encased, the hinge plays no further role, so later settlement and durability have nothing to do with the rotation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只在轉動前後量測，忽略封鉸與合龍後的長期沉陷，數年後懸臂端下沉、伸縮縫錯台，跨鐵路段淨空逐漸減少；封鉸混凝土與既有轉盤之間若形成冷縫且未處理，雨水滲入使球鉸鋼板與錨筋腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Surveying only around the rotation and ignoring long-term settlement after encasement and closure lets the tips drop and joints step over the years while clearance over the railway shrinks; an untreated cold joint between encasement and turntable lets rainwater reach the hinge plates and anchors, corroding them.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「封固後的體系轉換與長期沉陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System change after fixing and long-term settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只在轉動前後量測，忽略封鉸與合龍後的長期沉陷，數年後懸臂端下沉、伸縮縫錯台，跨鐵路段淨空逐漸減少。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
跨鐵路的梁底淨空只要在完工驗收時合格即可。
optionsEn: Surveying only around the rotation and ignoring long-term settlement after encasement and closure lets the tips drop and joints step over the years while clearance over the railway shrinks.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Soffit clearance over a railway only has to pass at completion.
quiz.explanation: 若只在轉動前後量測，忽略封鉸與合龍後的長期沉陷，數年後懸臂端下沉、伸縮縫錯台，跨鐵路段淨空逐漸減少；封鉸混凝土與既有轉盤之間若形成冷縫且未處理，雨水滲入使球鉸鋼板與錨筋腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surveying only around the rotation and ignoring long-term settlement after encasement and closure lets the tips drop and joints step over the years while clearance over the railway shrinks; an untreated cold joint between encasement and turntable lets rainwater reach the hinge plates and anchors, corroding them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Clearance budget over a live line and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「跨鐵路淨空預算」如何影響橋梁轉體施工的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Clearance budget over the railway” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge rotation construction”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 轉體橋多半跨越營運中的鐵路或道路，完工後下方仍有列車與電車線，所以梁底淨空不能只在完工當天符合，而要在整個使用年限內符合：潛變下垂、承台沉陷、未來鋪面加鋪與鐵路軌道抬升都會吃掉淨空。交接時必須把這些因素做成淨空預算，並說明實測基準；同時把轉體期間的全部紀錄（稱重、試轉、轉動監測、封鉸）整理為工程檔案，因為日後的任何評估都需要知道這座橋曾經承受過的特殊臨時狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「跨鐵路淨空預算」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rotated bridges usually cross live railways or roads, so trains and catenary remain below after completion, and soffit clearance must hold not just on opening day but throughout the service life: creep sag, pile-cap settlement, future resurfacing and track lifting all consume clearance. Handover must therefore present a clearance budget with measured baselines, and compile every rotation record, from weighing, trial turn and rotation monitoring to encasement, into the engineering file, because any later assessment needs to know the unusual temporary states the bridge has experienced. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Clearance budget over the railway” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸臂端彈性撓度 25 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時潛變下垂 25×2.0 = 50 mm；完工實測淨空 7.25 m，扣除 0.05 m 後為 7.20 m，若鐵路要求最小 7.00 m，尚餘 0.20 m 供沉陷與軌道抬升使用。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 25 mm elastic tip deflection and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, creep sag is 25×2.0 = 50 mm; an as-built clearance of 7.25 m becomes 7.20 m, and against a railway minimum of 7.00 m, 0.20 m remains for settlement and future track lifting.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「跨鐵路的梁底淨空只要在完工驗收時合格即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Soffit clearance over a railway only has to pass at completion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Clearance budget over a live line and handover
knowledge.text: 轉體橋多半跨越營運中的鐵路或道路，完工後下方仍有列車與電車線，所以梁底淨空不能只在完工當天符合，而要在整個使用年限內符合：潛變下垂、承台沉陷、未來鋪面加鋪與鐵路軌道抬升都會吃掉淨空。交接時必須把這些因素做成淨空預算，並說明實測基準；同時把轉體期間的全部紀錄（稱重、試轉、轉動監測、封鉸）整理為工程檔案，因為日後的任何評估都需要知道這座橋曾經承受過的特殊臨時狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Rotated bridges usually cross live railways or roads, so trains and catenary remain below after completion, and soffit clearance must hold not just on opening day but throughout the service life: creep sag, pile-cap settlement, future resurfacing and track lifting all consume clearance. Handover must therefore present a clearance budget with measured baselines, and compile every rotation record, from weighing, trial turn and rotation monitoring to encasement, into the engineering file, because any later assessment needs to know the unusual temporary states the bridge has experienced.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：跨鐵路的梁底淨空只要在完工驗收時合格即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Soffit clearance over a railway only has to pass at completion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Clearance budget over a live line and handover" is correct?
options: 跨鐵路的梁底淨空只要在完工驗收時合格即可。
轉體橋多半跨越營運中的鐵路或道路，完工後下方仍有列車與電車線，所以梁底淨空不能只在完工當天符合，而要在整個使用年限內符合：潛變下垂、承台沉陷、未來鋪面加鋪與鐵路軌道抬升都會吃掉淨空。
轉體只是把橋轉個方向，結構受力與一般懸臂施工完全相同。
optionsEn: Soffit clearance over a railway only has to pass at completion.

Rotated bridges usually cross live railways or roads, so trains and catenary remain below after completion, and soffit clearance must hold not just on opening day but throughout the service life: creep sag, pile-cap settlement, future resurfacing and track lifting all consume clearance.
Rotation just turns the bridge, so its forces are identical to ordinary cantilever construction.
quiz.explanation: 轉體橋多半跨越營運中的鐵路或道路，完工後下方仍有列車與電車線，所以梁底淨空不能只在完工當天符合，而要在整個使用年限內符合：潛變下垂、承台沉陷、未來鋪面加鋪與鐵路軌道抬升都會吃掉淨空。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rotated bridges usually cross live railways or roads, so trains and catenary remain below after completion, and soffit clearance must hold not just on opening day but throughout the service life: creep sag, pile-cap settlement, future resurfacing and track lifting all consume clearance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Clearance budget over a live line and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨鐵路淨空預算」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Clearance budget over the railway” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸臂端彈性撓度 25 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時潛變下垂 25×2.0 = 50 mm；完工實測淨空 7.25 m，扣除 0.05 m 後為 7.20 m，若鐵路要求最小 7.00 m，尚餘 0.20 m 供沉陷與軌道抬升使用。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 25 mm elastic tip deflection and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, creep sag is 25×2.0 = 50 mm; an as-built clearance of 7.25 m becomes 7.20 m, and against a railway minimum of 7.00 m, 0.20 m remains for settlement and future track lifting. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：通車前與鐵路主管機關共同量測梁底至軌面的淨空並簽認，作為基準；之後在定期檢查中以相同測點與方法重測，扣除溫度影響後比較趨勢，接近預算下限時提早規劃處置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before opening, measure soffit-to-rail clearance jointly with the railway authority and sign it as the baseline; at routine inspections re-measure at the same points by the same method, correct for temperature, compare the trend and plan remedies early if the budget's lower limit approaches.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸臂端彈性撓度 25 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時潛變下垂 25×2.0 = 50 mm；完工實測淨空 7.25 m，扣除 0.05 m 後為 7.20 m，若鐵路要求最小 7.00 m，尚餘 0.20 m 供沉陷與軌道抬升使用。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a 25 mm elastic tip deflection and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, creep sag is 25×2.0 = 50 mm; an as-built clearance of 7.25 m becomes 7.20 m, and against a railway minimum of 7.00 m, 0.20 m remains for settlement and future track lifting. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Clearance budget over a live line and handover", which statement holds?
options: 球鉸做得越大越安全，轉動也會越省力。
牽引力只要大於轉動阻力即可，千斤頂越大越好控制。
懸臂端彈性撓度 25 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時潛變下垂 25×2.0 = 50 mm。
optionsEn: A bigger spherical hinge is always safer and also easier to turn.
Traction only needs to exceed resistance, and bigger jacks are always easier to control.
With a 25 mm elastic tip deflection and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, creep sag is 25×2.0 = 50 mm.
quiz.explanation: 懸臂端彈性撓度 25 mm、潛變係數 φ = 2.0 時潛變下垂 25×2.0 = 50 mm；完工實測淨空 7.25 m，扣除 0.05 m 後為 7.20 m，若鐵路要求最小 7.00 m，尚餘 0.20 m 供沉陷與軌道抬升使用。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 25 mm elastic tip deflection and creep coefficient φ = 2.0, creep sag is 25×2.0 = 50 mm; an as-built clearance of 7.25 m becomes 7.20 m, and against a railway minimum of 7.00 m, 0.20 m remains for settlement and future track lifting. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Clearance budget over a live line and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨鐵路淨空預算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Clearance budget over the railway” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 通車前與鐵路主管機關共同量測梁底至軌面的淨空並簽認，作為基準；之後在定期檢查中以相同測點與方法重測，扣除溫度影響後比較趨勢，接近預算下限時提早規劃處置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before opening, measure soffit-to-rail clearance jointly with the railway authority and sign it as the baseline; at routine inspections re-measure at the same points by the same method, correct for temperature, compare the trend and plan remedies early if the budget's lower limit approaches. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含轉體全過程紀錄、球鉸與封鉸細部竣工圖、淨空預算與基準、沉陷觀測計畫，以及與鐵路或道路主管機關的介面聯絡窗口；檢查時進入鐵路範圍須依其安全規定申請封鎖時段。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should contain the full rotation record, as-built hinge and encasement details, the clearance budget and baseline, the settlement monitoring plan and interface contacts with the railway or road authority; inspections inside the railway corridor must apply for possessions under its safety rules.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交接時沒有淨空預算與基準，多年後鐵路抬升軌道或加裝設備時才發現淨空不足，只能限制列車或緊急改善；轉體紀錄遺失則讓日後評估者無法判斷某些裂縫是否源自轉動期間的臨時受力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a clearance budget and baseline at handover, insufficient clearance is discovered only years later when the railway lifts its track or adds equipment, forcing restrictions or urgent works; lost rotation records leave later assessors unable to tell whether certain cracks date from temporary forces during rotation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 通車前與鐵路主管機關共同量測梁底至軌面的淨空並簽認，作為基準；之後在定期檢查中以相同測點與方法重測，扣除溫度影響後比較趨勢，接近預算下限時提早規劃處置。
knowledge.textEn: Before opening, measure soffit-to-rail clearance jointly with the railway authority and sign it as the baseline; at routine inspections re-measure at the same points by the same method, correct for temperature, compare the trend and plan remedies early if the budget's lower limit approaches.

knowledge.textEn: Handover documents should contain the full rotation record, as-built hinge and encasement details, the clearance budget and baseline, the settlement monitoring plan and interface contacts with the railway or road authority; inspections inside the railway corridor must apply for possessions under its safety rules.

quiz.question: 要驗證「跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Clearance budget over a live line and handover"?
options: 通車前與鐵路主管機關共同量測梁底至軌面的淨空並簽認，作為基準；之後在定期檢查中以相同測點與方法重測，扣除溫度影響後比較趨勢，接近預算下限時提早規劃處置。
