quiz.explanationEn: Before opening, measure soffit-to-rail clearance jointly with the railway authority and sign it as the baseline; at routine inspections re-measure at the same points by the same method, correct for temperature, compare the trend and plan remedies early if the budget's lower limit approaches. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Clearance budget over a live line and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨鐵路淨空預算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Clearance budget over the railway” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交接時沒有淨空預算與基準，多年後鐵路抬升軌道或加裝設備時才發現淨空不足，只能限制列車或緊急改善；轉體紀錄遺失則讓日後評估者無法判斷某些裂縫是否源自轉動期間的臨時受力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without a clearance budget and baseline at handover, insufficient clearance is discovered only years later when the railway lifts its track or adds equipment, forcing restrictions or urgent works; lost rotation records leave later assessors unable to tell whether certain cracks date from temporary forces during rotation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時必須把這些因素做成淨空預算，並說明實測基準；同時把轉體期間的全部紀錄（稱重、試轉、轉動監測、封鉸）整理為工程檔案，因為日後的任何評估都需要知道這座橋曾經承受過的特殊臨時狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover must therefore present a clearance budget with measured baselines, and compile every rotation record, from weighing, trial turn and rotation monitoring to encasement, into the engineering file, because any later assessment needs to know the unusual temporary states the bridge has experienced.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跨鐵路的梁底淨空只要在完工驗收時合格即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Soffit clearance over a railway only has to pass at completion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「跨越營運線的淨空預算與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Clearance budget over a live line and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
交接時沒有淨空預算與基準，多年後鐵路抬升軌道或加裝設備時才發現淨空不足，只能限制列車或緊急改善。
轉體只是把橋轉個方向，結構受力與一般懸臂施工完全相同。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without a clearance budget and baseline at handover, insufficient clearance is discovered only years later when the railway lifts its track or adds equipment, forcing restrictions or urgent works.
Rotation just turns the bridge, so its forces are identical to ordinary cantilever construction.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作
summary: 從輪載經面板、縱肋、橫梁到主梁的局部與整體傳力出發，以疲勞為主控計算面板厚度，再處理 U 形肋冷彎、肋—面板部分滲透焊、面板單元焊接變形、工地拼接收縮、非破壞檢測與試拼裝，最後以鋪面協同、疲勞熱點檢查與裂縫成長評估交接，並以金門大橋 1982 至 1986 年換裝鋼橋面、Lions Gate 橋與 Millau 高架橋為案例。
summaryEn: Starting from the local and global load path from wheel to deck plate, ribs, floorbeams and main girders, size the deck plate with fatigue governing, then handle cold-formed U-ribs, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, panel welding distortion, site-splice shrinkage, non-destructive testing and trial assembly, and finally hand over with surfacing interaction, fatigue hot-spot inspection and crack-growth assessment, using the Golden Gate Bridge's 1982–1986 redecking, Lions Gate and Millau as cases.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁施工工法與大型架設
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge construction methods and heavy erection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計取捨練習：一座寬 30 m、長 1,000 m 的鋼橋面（面積 30,000 m²），比較面板厚度 12、16、18 mm。局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比：由 12 mm 改為 16 mm，應力幅降為 (12/16)² ≈ 0.56 倍，以 m = 3 的 S–N 曲線計，疲勞壽命約增為 (16/12)⁶ ≈ 5.6 倍；增加的鋼重為 0.004 m × 7,850 kg/m³ = 31.4 kg/m²，全橋約 31.4×30,000/1,000 ≈ 942 t。再由 16 mm 加到 18 mm，應力幅降為 (16/18)² ≈ 0.79 倍，壽命約增為 (18/16)⁶ ≈ 2.0 倍，增重 15.7 kg/m²，全橋約 471 t。若再考慮常溫鋪面合成可使板條勁度增為約 5.3 倍、夏季高溫只剩約 1.9 倍，設計應以高溫狀態檢核重車道細部。結論：在重車道使用較厚面板、在輕載區維持標準厚度，是兼顧重量與疲勞的常見作法。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Trade-off exercise: a steel deck 30 m wide and 1,000 m long (30,000 m²) compares deck plates of 12, 16 and 18 mm. Local bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness: going from 12 mm to 16 mm cuts the stress range to (12/16)² ≈ 0.56 times, so with an m = 3 S–N curve the fatigue life rises about (16/12)⁶ ≈ 5.6 times; the added steel is 0.004 m × 7,850 kg/m³ = 31.4 kg/m², about 31.4×30,000/1,000 ≈ 942 t for the bridge. Going on from 16 mm to 18 mm cuts the stress range to (16/18)² ≈ 0.79 times and raises life about (18/16)⁶ ≈ 2.0 times for 15.7 kg/m², about 471 t. Allowing for surfacing composite action, which raises strip stiffness about 5.3 times at moderate temperature but only about 1.9 times in summer heat, heavy-lane details should be checked for the hot condition. Conclusion: thicker plates in heavy lanes and standard thickness elsewhere is a common balance of weight and fatigue. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」與「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" and "Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。輪載先使面板在相鄰肋腹板之間局部受彎，再由縱肋把荷重以連續梁方式傳到橫梁，橫梁再傳到主梁或箱梁腹板；同時整片面板與縱肋又是主梁的上翼板，承受整體彎曲的縱向應力。這種一板多用的設計使橋面重量遠低於混凝土橋面，因此長跨懸索橋、斜張橋與活動橋普遍採用，但也意味著每一處焊接細部都承受局部與整體應力的疊加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name. A wheel load first bends the deck plate locally between adjacent rib webs; the ribs then carry the load as continuous beams to the floorbeams, which pass it to the main girders or box webs. At the same time the deck plate and ribs act as the top flange of the main girder, carrying longitudinal stress from global bending. This multiple use makes the deck far lighter than concrete, so long suspension, cable-stayed and movable bridges widely adopt it, but it also means every welded detail sees local and global stresses superimposed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輪載 P = 75 kN、輪印長 0.4 m，面板在肋腹板間跨距 s = 0.3 m 以兩端固定板條計：w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m，M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m；面板 16 mm 時 S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³，σ ≈ 82 MPa；12 mm 時 σ ≈ 146 MPa，增加約 78%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a wheel load P = 75 kN on a 0.4 m long patch and a deck plate spanning s = 0.3 m between rib webs as a fixed-ended strip, w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m and M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m; with a 16 mm plate S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³ and σ ≈ 82 MPa; with 12 mm, σ ≈ 146 MPa, about 78% more.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力
knowledge.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck
knowledge.text: 正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。輪載先使面板在相鄰肋腹板之間局部受彎，再由縱肋把荷重以連續梁方式傳到橫梁，橫梁再傳到主梁或箱梁腹板；同時整片面板與縱肋又是主梁的上翼板，承受整體彎曲的縱向應力。
knowledge.textEn: An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name. A wheel load first bends the deck plate locally between adjacent rib webs; the ribs then carry the load as continuous beams to the floorbeams, which pass it to the main girders or box webs.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" is correct?
options: 鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。
正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。
鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。
optionsEn: A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough.

An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name.
If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.
quiz.explanation: 正交異性鋼橋面由一片薄鋼面板、與其焊接的密排縱肋，以及間隔數公尺的橫梁組成，兩個方向勁度不同，故名正交異性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An orthotropic steel deck consists of a thin steel deck plate, closely spaced longitudinal ribs welded to it and floorbeams a few metres apart, with different stiffness in the two directions, hence the name. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輪載 P = 75 kN、輪印長 0.4 m，面板在肋腹板間跨距 s = 0.3 m 以兩端固定板條計：w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m，M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m；面板 16 mm 時 S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³，σ ≈ 82 MPa；12 mm 時 σ ≈ 146 MPa，增加約 78%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a wheel load P = 75 kN on a 0.4 m long patch and a deck plate spanning s = 0.3 m between rib webs as a fixed-ended strip, w = 75×(0.3/0.4)/0.3 = 187.5 kN/m and M = w·s²/12 ≈ 1.41 kN·m; with a 16 mm plate S = 0.4×0.016²/6 ≈ 1.71×10⁻⁵ m³ and σ ≈ 82 MPa; with 12 mm, σ ≈ 146 MPa, about 78% more. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計報告須同時提供整體與局部模型的關鍵細部應力表，並標示重車道與輪跡位置；製造廠的焊接程序與檢驗計畫必須依這些關鍵細部分級，而不是對所有焊縫一視同仁。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design report must give tables of key detail stresses from both global and local models and mark heavy lanes and wheel paths; the fabricator's welding procedures and inspection plan must be graded by these key details rather than treating every weld alike.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計報告須同時提供整體與局部模型的關鍵細部應力表，並標示重車道與輪跡位置；製造廠的焊接程序與檢驗計畫必須依這些關鍵細部分級，而不是對所有焊縫一視同仁。
knowledge.textEn: The design report must give tables of key detail stresses from both global and local models and mark heavy lanes and wheel paths; the fabricator's welding procedures and inspection plan must be graded by these key details rather than treating every weld alike.

quiz.question: 要驗證「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck"?
options: 設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。
optionsEn: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site.
quiz.explanation: 設計時以局部有限元素模型（殼元素，含輪印與鋪面）計算面板、肋—面板焊縫與肋—橫梁連接的應力，與手算板條模型比較量級；並在整體模型中取出同一位置的整體縱向應力，檢查兩者疊加後的設計值與疲勞應力幅。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage, compute stresses in the deck plate, rib-to-deck welds and rib-to-floorbeam connections with a local shell finite-element model including the wheel patch and surfacing, compare the order of magnitude with the hand strip model, and take the global longitudinal stress at the same location from the global model to check the superimposed design value and fatigue stress range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面板—縱肋—橫梁傳力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck plate–rib–floorbeam load path” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種一板多用的設計使橋面重量遠低於混凝土橋面，因此長跨懸索橋、斜張橋與活動橋普遍採用，但也意味著每一處焊接細部都承受局部與整體應力的疊加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This multiple use makes the deck far lighter than concrete, so long suspension, cable-stayed and movable bridges widely adopt it, but it also means every welded detail sees local and global stresses superimposed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。
knowledge.textEn: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「正交異性橋面的雙重功能與傳力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dual role and load path of the orthotropic deck" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲。
鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels.
If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.
quiz.explanation: 只用整體模型設計主梁、把橋面板視為均勻翼板，會漏掉輪載下面板的局部彎曲；早期採用較薄面板的橋梁，常在重車道輪跡下方出現沿肋—面板焊縫的縱向疲勞裂縫，並使上方鋪面開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing the main girders with a global model alone, treating the deck as a uniform flange, misses local plate bending under wheels; early decks with thinner plates often developed longitudinal fatigue cracks along rib-to-deck welds beneath heavy-lane wheel paths, cracking the surfacing above. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。焊接細部的疲勞壽命依 S–N 曲線與應力幅的三次方成反比，而面板局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比，所以面板稍微加厚，壽命就大幅增加。FHWA 2012 年手冊把面板最小厚度提高到 14 至 16 mm 列為近年改進之一，正是早期薄面板疲勞經驗的反映。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century. Welded-detail fatigue life is inversely proportional to the cube of stress range on the S–N curve, while local plate bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness, so a slightly thicker plate greatly extends life. FHWA's 2012 manual lists raising the minimum deck-plate thickness to 14 to 16 mm among recent improvements, reflecting the fatigue experience of early thin plates. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rib-to-deck weld stress range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇
knowledge.text: 正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。焊接細部的疲勞壽命依 S–N 曲線與應力幅的三次方成反比，而面板局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比，所以面板稍微加厚，壽命就大幅增加。
knowledge.textEn: Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century. Welded-detail fatigue life is inversely proportional to the cube of stress range on the S–N curve, while local plate bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness, so a slightly thicker plate greatly extends life.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness" is correct?
options: 鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。
縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。
正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。
optionsEn: If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.
Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate.
Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century.
quiz.explanation: 正交異性橋面的設計通常不是由強度控制，而是由疲勞控制：每一個重車輪通過都在面板與焊縫產生一次應力循環，百年內次數可達數億。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Orthotropic deck design is usually governed not by strength but by fatigue: every heavy wheel causes one stress cycle in the plate and welds, adding up to hundreds of millions over a century. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。16 mm 面板應力幅 45 MPa：N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶；改用 12 mm，應力幅乘 (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 成為 80 MPa，N ≈ 1.4×10⁶，壽命只剩約 1/5.6。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa. A 16 mm plate with a 45 MPa stress range gives N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶; a 12 mm plate multiplies the stress range by (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 to 80 MPa, giving N ≈ 1.4×10⁶, about 1/5.6 of the life. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依規範疲勞荷載模型（重車軸重、橫向分布與車流量）計算關鍵細部的應力幅頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷檢核設計年限；新型細部或沒有規範類別的細部，須以足尺疲勞試驗驗證，試體的焊接程序必須與量產一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute stress-range spectra at key details from the code fatigue load model (axle loads, transverse distribution and traffic volume) and check the design life by Miner's cumulative damage; new details without a code category need full-scale fatigue tests whose specimens are welded with the same procedure as production.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。16 mm 面板應力幅 45 MPa：N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶；改用 12 mm，應力幅乘 (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 成為 80 MPa，N ≈ 1.4×10⁶，壽命只剩約 1/5.6。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa. A 16 mm plate with a 45 MPa stress range gives N ≈ 2×10⁶×(71/45)³ ≈ 7.9×10⁶; a 12 mm plate multiplies the stress range by (16/12)² ≈ 1.78 to 80 MPa, giving N ≈ 1.4×10⁶, about 1/5.6 of the life. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness", which statement holds?
options: S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。
焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。
焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。
optionsEn: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa.
Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly.
A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside.
quiz.explanation: S–N：N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³，取細部類別 Δσ_C = 71 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: S–N: N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³ with a detail category Δσ_C = 71 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依規範疲勞荷載模型（重車軸重、橫向分布與車流量）計算關鍵細部的應力幅頻譜，以 Miner 累積損傷檢核設計年限；新型細部或沒有規範類別的細部，須以足尺疲勞試驗驗證，試體的焊接程序必須與量產一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute stress-range spectra at key details from the code fatigue load model (axle loads, transverse distribution and traffic volume) and check the design life by Miner's cumulative damage; new details without a code category need full-scale fatigue tests whose specimens are welded with the same procedure as production. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主規範應明訂面板最小厚度、縱肋最小厚度與關鍵細部的疲勞類別，並要求新細部須有試驗依據；設計審查時把疲勞計算列為必審項目，而不是附錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Owner specifications should set minimum deck-plate and rib thicknesses and fatigue categories for key details, require test evidence for new details, and treat fatigue calculations as a mandatory review item rather than an appendix.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以強度為主決定面板厚度、再事後補做疲勞檢核，常發現重車道細部壽命不足，只能局部加厚或更換細部，造成設計與製造反覆；若完全忽略疲勞，裂縫可能在通車十多年內就出現在輪跡下方。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

knowledge.text: 業主規範應明訂面板最小厚度、縱肋最小厚度與關鍵細部的疲勞類別，並要求新細部須有試驗依據；設計審查時把疲勞計算列為必審項目，而不是附錄。

steps.title: 疲勞主控的面板厚度選擇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fatigue-governed choice of deck-plate thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「肋—面板焊縫應力幅」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rib-to-deck weld stress range” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以強度為主決定面板厚度、再事後補做疲勞檢核，常發現重車道細部壽命不足，只能局部加厚或更換細部，造成設計與製造反覆；若完全忽略疲勞，裂縫可能在通車十多年內就出現在輪跡下方。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing the plate for strength and checking fatigue afterwards often reveals insufficient life at heavy-lane details, forcing local thickening or detail changes and design–fabrication rework; ignoring fatigue entirely can let cracks appear beneath wheel paths within a decade or two of opening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：FHWA 2012 年手冊把面板最小厚度提高到 14 至 16 mm 列為近年改進之一，正是早期薄面板疲勞經驗的反映。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: FHWA's 2012 manual lists raising the minimum deck-plate thickness to 14 to 16 mm among recent improvements, reflecting the fatigue experience of early thin plates.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇」與「肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Closed U-ribs and steel selection" and "Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Closed U-ribs and steel selection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「U 形縱肋冷彎成型」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cold-formed U-ribs” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 現代正交異性橋面多採閉口梯形或 U 形縱肋，由 6 至 10 mm 鋼板冷彎成型，抗扭勁度高，能把輪載分散到相鄰肋，且每延公尺需要的焊縫比開口肋少。冷彎時外緣纖維產生很大的塑性應變，會降低鋼材韌性並可能出現微裂，因此彎曲內半徑、鋼材的韌性等級與彎後檢查都要事先規定。閉口肋內部無法進入，所以肋的兩端要封閉或做好防蝕，肋本身的直線度與開口寬度也直接決定日後與面板的組裝間隙。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「U 形縱肋冷彎成型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Modern orthotropic decks mostly use closed trapezoidal or U-shaped ribs cold-bent from 6 to 10 mm plate, with high torsional stiffness that spreads wheel loads to neighbouring ribs and fewer welds per metre than open ribs. Cold bending puts large plastic strain in the outer fibres, which reduces toughness and can cause micro-cracks, so the inner bend radius, the steel's toughness grade and post-bending inspection must be specified in advance. The inside of a closed rib is inaccessible, so its ends must be sealed or protected against corrosion, and the rib's straightness and opening width directly govern the later fit-up gap to the deck plate. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cold-formed U-ribs” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：冷彎外緣應變 ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Outer-fibre bending strain ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「U 形縱肋冷彎成型」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cold-formed U-ribs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇
knowledge.text: 現代正交異性橋面多採閉口梯形或 U 形縱肋，由 6 至 10 mm 鋼板冷彎成型，抗扭勁度高，能把輪載分散到相鄰肋，且每延公尺需要的焊縫比開口肋少。冷彎時外緣纖維產生很大的塑性應變，會降低鋼材韌性並可能出現微裂，因此彎曲內半徑、鋼材的韌性等級與彎後檢查都要事先規定。
knowledge.textEn: Modern orthotropic decks mostly use closed trapezoidal or U-shaped ribs cold-bent from 6 to 10 mm plate, with high torsional stiffness that spreads wheel loads to neighbouring ribs and fewer welds per metre than open ribs. Cold bending puts large plastic strain in the outer fibres, which reduces toughness and can cause micro-cracks, so the inner bend radius, the steel's toughness grade and post-bending inspection must be specified in advance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closed U-ribs and steel selection" is correct?
options: 現代正交異性橋面多採閉口梯形或 U 形縱肋，由 6 至 10 mm 鋼板冷彎成型，抗扭勁度高，能把輪載分散到相鄰肋，且每延公尺需要的焊縫比開口肋少。
縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。
肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。
optionsEn: Modern orthotropic decks mostly use closed trapezoidal or U-shaped ribs cold-bent from 6 to 10 mm plate, with high torsional stiffness that spreads wheel loads to neighbouring ribs and fewer welds per metre than open ribs.
Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate.
The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best.
quiz.explanation: 現代正交異性橋面多採閉口梯形或 U 形縱肋，由 6 至 10 mm 鋼板冷彎成型，抗扭勁度高，能把輪載分散到相鄰肋，且每延公尺需要的焊縫比開口肋少。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Modern orthotropic decks mostly use closed trapezoidal or U-shaped ribs cold-bent from 6 to 10 mm plate, with high torsional stiffness that spreads wheel loads to neighbouring ribs and fewer welds per metre than open ribs. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closed U-ribs and steel selection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「U 形縱肋冷彎成型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cold-formed U-ribs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：冷彎外緣應變 ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t)。肋厚 t = 8 mm、內半徑 r_i = 4t = 32 mm：ε = 8/(64 + 8) ≈ 11%。U 肋頂寬 300 mm、底寬 180 mm、高 300 mm 時，斜腹板長 √(300² + 60²) ≈ 306 mm，展開寬約 180 + 2×306 ≈ 792 mm，每公尺重 0.792×0.008×7,850 ≈ 49.7 kg。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Outer-fibre bending strain ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t). For t = 8 mm and r_i = 4t = 32 mm, ε = 8/(64 + 8) ≈ 11%. A U-rib 300 mm wide at the top, 180 mm at the bottom and 300 mm deep has sloping webs √(300² + 60²) ≈ 306 mm long, a developed width of about 180 + 2×306 ≈ 792 mm and a weight of 0.792×0.008×7,850 ≈ 49.7 kg per metre. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋼板進廠核對出廠證明的化學成分、強度與衝擊韌性；冷彎後抽查彎角處的磁粉或滲透檢測、開口寬度、腹板角度與全長直線度，並與允差比較；首批產品以切片確認彎角內外表面沒有裂紋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On receipt, check mill certificates for chemistry, strength and impact toughness; after bending, spot-check bends by magnetic-particle or dye-penetrant testing and measure opening width, web angle and full-length straightness against tolerances; for the first batch, section samples to confirm no cracking on the inside or outside of the bends.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 冷彎外緣應變 ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t)。肋厚 t = 8 mm、內半徑 r_i = 4t = 32 mm：ε = 8/(64 + 8) ≈ 11%。U 肋頂寬 300 mm、底寬 180 mm、高 300 mm 時，斜腹板長 √(300² + 60²) ≈ 306 mm，展開寬約 180 + 2×306 ≈ 792 mm，每公尺重 0.792×0.008×7,850 ≈ 49.7 kg。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Outer-fibre bending strain ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t). For t = 8 mm and r_i = 4t = 32 mm, ε = 8/(64 + 8) ≈ 11%. A U-rib 300 mm wide at the top, 180 mm at the bottom and 300 mm deep has sloping webs √(300² + 60²) ≈ 306 mm long, a developed width of about 180 + 2×306 ≈ 792 mm and a weight of 0.792×0.008×7,850 ≈ 49.7 kg per metre. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Closed U-ribs and steel selection", which statement holds?
options: 工地對接焊只會影響局部，不會改變整跨長度。
冷彎外緣應變 ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t)。
只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。
optionsEn: Site butt welds are local and do not change the length of a whole span.
Outer-fibre bending strain ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t).
If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site.
quiz.explanation: 冷彎外緣應變 ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Outer-fibre bending strain ε ≈ t/(2r_i + t). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closed U-ribs and steel selection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「U 形縱肋冷彎成型」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cold-formed U-ribs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋼板進廠核對出廠證明的化學成分、強度與衝擊韌性；冷彎後抽查彎角處的磁粉或滲透檢測、開口寬度、腹板角度與全長直線度，並與允差比較；首批產品以切片確認彎角內外表面沒有裂紋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On receipt, check mill certificates for chemistry, strength and impact toughness; after bending, spot-check bends by magnetic-particle or dye-penetrant testing and measure opening width, web angle and full-length straightness against tolerances; for the first batch, section samples to confirm no cracking on the inside or outside of the bends. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購規格須訂明肋用鋼材的韌性等級、最小彎曲內半徑與彎後檢查頻率；每批肋件以批號追蹤到面板單元，確保發現問題時能回溯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Procurement must specify the rib steel's toughness grade, minimum inner bend radius and post-bending inspection frequency; each batch of ribs is traced by lot number to its panels so any problem can be traced back.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：內半徑過小或鋼材韌性不足，彎角外側出現微裂紋，日後在交通載重下成為疲勞起始點；肋開口寬度超差，與面板組裝時間隙不均，部分滲透焊的熔深隨之忽深忽淺。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Too small a bend radius or insufficient toughness creates micro-cracks on the outside of bends that later initiate fatigue under traffic; ribs with out-of-tolerance opening widths give uneven gaps at fit-up, so the penetration of the partial-penetration weld varies along the rib. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closed U-ribs and steel selection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「U 形縱肋冷彎成型」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cold-formed U-ribs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 內半徑過小或鋼材韌性不足，彎角外側出現微裂紋，日後在交通載重下成為疲勞起始點；肋開口寬度超差，與面板組裝時間隙不均，部分滲透焊的熔深隨之忽深忽淺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Too small a bend radius or insufficient toughness creates micro-cracks on the outside of bends that later initiate fatigue under traffic; ribs with out-of-tolerance opening widths give uneven gaps at fit-up, so the penetration of the partial-penetration weld varies along the rib. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉口肋內部無法進入，所以肋的兩端要封閉或做好防蝕，肋本身的直線度與開口寬度也直接決定日後與面板的組裝間隙。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The inside of a closed rib is inaccessible, so its ends must be sealed or protected against corrosion, and the rib's straightness and opening width directly govern the later fit-up gap to the deck plate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「閉口 U 形肋與鋼材選擇」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closed U-ribs and steel selection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 內半徑過小或鋼材韌性不足，彎角外側出現微裂紋，日後在交通載重下成為疲勞起始點；肋開口寬度超差，與面板組裝時間隙不均，部分滲透焊的熔深隨之忽深忽淺。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。
optionsEn: Too small a bend radius or insufficient toughness creates micro-cracks on the outside of bends that later initiate fatigue under traffic.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「肋—面板部分滲透焊」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 閉口肋只能從外側焊接，所以肋—面板焊縫是單面部分滲透焊：熔深太淺，未熔合的根部像一道預存裂縫，在輪載反覆下由根部向面板或焊趾成長；熔深太深則燒穿，在肋內形成焊瘤與缺口。FHWA 手冊強調此焊縫須控制熔深且不得燒穿。肋穿過橫梁時，橫梁腹板常在肋底部留下開孔，讓肋在輪載下能有限度地轉動，降低肋—橫梁焊縫的拘束應力；開孔形狀、焊縫包角與切割面品質都是疲勞敏感處。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「肋—面板部分滲透焊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A closed rib can only be welded from outside, so the rib-to-deck weld is a one-sided partial-penetration weld: too shallow and the unfused root acts as a built-in crack that grows under repeated wheel loads into the deck plate or toe; too deep and it melts through, leaving drop-through and notches inside the rib. FHWA's manual stresses controlled penetration with no melt-through. Where ribs pass through floorbeams, the floorbeam web usually has a cut-out below the rib so the rib can rotate a little under wheel loads, reducing restraint stresses in the rib-to-floorbeam weld; cut-out shape, weld wrap-around and cut-edge quality are all fatigue-sensitive. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：肋壁 8 mm，若目標熔深 80% 為 6.4 mm、下限 70% 為 5.6 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With an 8 mm rib wall, an 80% penetration target is 6.4 mm and a 70% minimum is 5.6 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「肋—面板部分滲透焊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部

steps.title: 肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「肋—面板部分滲透焊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：肋壁 8 mm，若目標熔深 80% 為 6.4 mm、下限 70% 為 5.6 mm。潛弧焊熱輸入 Q = V·I·60/(1,000·v)：30 V、600 A、行進速度 500 mm/min，Q = 30×600×60/(1,000×500) = 2.16 kJ/mm；速度降到 400 mm/min 時 Q 升為 2.7 kJ/mm，熔深加大、燒穿風險上升。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an 8 mm rib wall, an 80% penetration target is 6.4 mm and a 70% minimum is 5.6 mm. Submerged-arc heat input Q = V·I·60/(1,000·v): at 30 V, 600 A and 500 mm/min, Q = 30×600×60/(1,000×500) = 2.16 kJ/mm; slowing to 400 mm/min raises Q to 2.7 kJ/mm, deepening penetration and increasing the risk of melt-through. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：焊接程序評定須以實際肋與面板組合做試焊，切取多個斷面做巨觀蝕刻量測熔深與根部形狀；量產時依規定頻率（例如每一面板單元的端部延伸段）切取試片，並以相位陣列超音波沿線檢查熔深，與程序評定結果比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Welding procedure qualification must use real rib and plate assemblies, sectioning several locations for macro-etch measurement of penetration and root shape; in production, cut test pieces at the specified frequency, for example from run-off extensions on each panel, and scan penetration along the weld with phased-array ultrasonics for comparison with the qualification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 肋壁 8 mm，若目標熔深 80% 為 6.4 mm、下限 70% 為 5.6 mm。潛弧焊熱輸入 Q = V·I·60/(1,000·v)：30 V、600 A、行進速度 500 mm/min，Q = 30×600×60/(1,000×500) = 2.16 kJ/mm；速度降到 400 mm/min 時 Q 升為 2.7 kJ/mm，熔深加大、燒穿風險上升。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With an 8 mm rib wall, an 80% penetration target is 6.4 mm and a 70% minimum is 5.6 mm. Submerged-arc heat input Q = V·I·60/(1,000·v): at 30 V, 600 A and 500 mm/min, Q = 30×600×60/(1,000×500) = 2.16 kJ/mm; slowing to 400 mm/min raises Q to 2.7 kJ/mm, deepening penetration and increasing the risk of melt-through. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details", which statement holds?
options: 焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。
鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。
肋壁 8 mm，若目標熔深 80% 為 6.4 mm、下限 70% 為 5.6 mm。
optionsEn: A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside.
Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn.
With an 8 mm rib wall, an 80% penetration target is 6.4 mm and a 70% minimum is 5.6 mm.
quiz.explanation: 肋壁 8 mm，若目標熔深 80% 為 6.4 mm、下限 70% 為 5.6 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With an 8 mm rib wall, an 80% penetration target is 6.4 mm and a 70% minimum is 5.6 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「肋—面板部分滲透焊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 焊接程序評定須以實際肋與面板組合做試焊，切取多個斷面做巨觀蝕刻量測熔深與根部形狀；量產時依規定頻率（例如每一面板單元的端部延伸段）切取試片，並以相位陣列超音波沿線檢查熔深，與程序評定結果比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Welding procedure qualification must use real rib and plate assemblies, sectioning several locations for macro-etch measurement of penetration and root shape; in production, cut test pieces at the specified frequency, for example from run-off extensions on each panel, and scan penetration along the weld with phased-array ultrasonics for comparison with the qualification. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：肋—面板焊接應以自動化設備、固定姿勢與經評定的參數施焊，組裝間隙在焊前逐段檢查並記錄；開孔以數控切割並規定表面粗糙度與研磨要求，關鍵焊縫的焊工資格與參數紀錄須可追溯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Rib-to-deck welds should be made with automated equipment in a fixed position with qualified parameters, with fit-up gaps checked and recorded section by section before welding; cut-outs are CNC cut with specified roughness and grinding, and welder qualifications and parameter records for key welds must be traceable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：組裝間隙忽大忽小，固定焊接參數下熔深隨之變化，間隙大處燒穿、間隙小處熔深不足；開孔切割面粗糙或焊縫包角不完整，橫梁腹板在開孔端部出現疲勞裂縫並向腹板內擴展。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With a gap that varies along the rib and fixed welding parameters, penetration varies with it: melt-through where the gap is large and too little penetration where it is tight; rough cut-out edges or incomplete weld wrap-around let fatigue cracks start at cut-out ends and grow into the floorbeam web. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 焊接程序評定須以實際肋與面板組合做試焊，切取多個斷面做巨觀蝕刻量測熔深與根部形狀；量產時依規定頻率（例如每一面板單元的端部延伸段）切取試片，並以相位陣列超音波沿線檢查熔深，與程序評定結果比較。
knowledge.textEn: Welding procedure qualification must use real rib and plate assemblies, sectioning several locations for macro-etch measurement of penetration and root shape; in production, cut test pieces at the specified frequency, for example from run-off extensions on each panel, and scan penetration along the weld with phased-array ultrasonics for comparison with the qualification.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 肋—面板焊接應以自動化設備、固定姿勢與經評定的參數施焊，組裝間隙在焊前逐段檢查並記錄；開孔以數控切割並規定表面粗糙度與研磨要求，關鍵焊縫的焊工資格與參數紀錄須可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Rib-to-deck welds should be made with automated equipment in a fixed position with qualified parameters, with fit-up gaps checked and recorded section by section before welding; cut-outs are CNC cut with specified roughness and grinding, and welder qualifications and parameter records for key welds must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details"?
options: 焊接程序評定須以實際肋與面板組合做試焊，切取多個斷面做巨觀蝕刻量測熔深與根部形狀。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。
optionsEn: Welding procedure qualification must use real rib and plate assemblies, sectioning several locations for macro-etch measurement of penetration and root shape.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough.
quiz.explanation: 焊接程序評定須以實際肋與面板組合做試焊，切取多個斷面做巨觀蝕刻量測熔深與根部形狀；量產時依規定頻率（例如每一面板單元的端部延伸段）切取試片，並以相位陣列超音波沿線檢查熔深，與程序評定結果比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Welding procedure qualification must use real rib and plate assemblies, sectioning several locations for macro-etch measurement of penetration and root shape; in production, cut test pieces at the specified frequency, for example from run-off extensions on each panel, and scan penetration along the weld with phased-array ultrasonics for comparison with the qualification. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「肋—面板部分滲透焊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rib-to-deck partial-penetration weld” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 組裝間隙忽大忽小，固定焊接參數下熔深隨之變化，間隙大處燒穿、間隙小處熔深不足；開孔切割面粗糙或焊縫包角不完整，橫梁腹板在開孔端部出現疲勞裂縫並向腹板內擴展。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With a gap that varies along the rib and fixed welding parameters, penetration varies with it: melt-through where the gap is large and too little penetration where it is tight; rough cut-out edges or incomplete weld wrap-around let fatigue cracks start at cut-out ends and grow into the floorbeam web. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：肋穿過橫梁時，橫梁腹板常在肋底部留下開孔，讓肋在輪載下能有限度地轉動，降低肋—橫梁焊縫的拘束應力；開孔形狀、焊縫包角與切割面品質都是疲勞敏感處。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Where ribs pass through floorbeams, the floorbeam web usually has a cut-out below the rib so the rib can rotate a little under wheel loads, reducing restraint stresses in the rib-to-floorbeam weld; cut-out shape, weld wrap-around and cut-edge quality are all fatigue-sensitive.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 組裝間隙忽大忽小，固定焊接參數下熔深隨之變化，間隙大處燒穿、間隙小處熔深不足；開孔切割面粗糙或焊縫包角不完整，橫梁腹板在開孔端部出現疲勞裂縫並向腹板內擴展。
knowledge.textEn: With a gap that varies along the rib and fixed welding parameters, penetration varies with it: melt-through where the gap is large and too little penetration where it is tight; rough cut-out edges or incomplete weld wrap-around let fatigue cracks start at cut-out ends and grow into the floorbeam web.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「肋—面板焊縫與橫梁開孔細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rib-to-deck welds and floorbeam cut-out details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
組裝間隙忽大忽小，固定焊接參數下熔深隨之變化，間隙大處燒穿、間隙小處熔深不足；開孔切割面粗糙或焊縫包角不完整，橫梁腹板在開孔端部出現疲勞裂縫並向腹板內擴展。
焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
With a gap that varies along the rib and fixed welding parameters, penetration varies with it: melt-through where the gap is large and too little penetration where it is tight.
Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly.
quiz.explanation: 組裝間隙忽大忽小，固定焊接參數下熔深隨之變化，間隙大處燒穿、間隙小處熔深不足；開孔切割面粗糙或焊縫包角不完整，橫梁腹板在開孔端部出現疲勞裂縫並向腹板內擴展。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With a gap that varies along the rib and fixed welding parameters, penetration varies with it: melt-through where the gap is large and too little penetration where it is tight; rough cut-out edges or incomplete weld wrap-around let fatigue cracks start at cut-out ends and grow into the floorbeam web. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面板單元製作與焊接變形控制」與「工地拼接與焊接收縮預留」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Panel fabrication and welding distortion control" and "Site splices and shrinkage allowance": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面板單元製作與焊接變形控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel fabrication and welding distortion control: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「反變形胎架」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pre-cambered welding jig” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 面板單元通常是數公尺寬、十餘公尺長的面板配上數根 U 肋，大量長焊縫集中在面板一側，焊後冷卻收縮會使面板縱向彎曲並在肋間產生橫向角變形。若不控制，面板單元在組成箱梁時無法密合，工地拼接間隙不均，鋪面也難以平整。工廠常用反變形胎架把面板預先彎成與焊接收縮方向相反的形狀，配合對稱焊接順序與夾具，使焊後回彈到設計形狀；必要時再以火焰矯正，但火焰矯正溫度須受控，以免改變鋼材性質。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「反變形胎架」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A panel unit is usually a deck plate a few metres wide and over ten metres long with several U-ribs, concentrating many long welds on one side; cooling shrinkage bows the panel longitudinally and causes angular distortion between ribs. Uncontrolled, panels will not fit when assembled into box girders, site-splice gaps become uneven and the surfacing is hard to finish flat. Shops use pre-cambered jigs that bend the panel opposite to the weld shrinkage, together with symmetrical welding sequences and clamps, so it springs back to the design shape; flame straightening may follow if needed, but its temperature must be controlled so the steel's properties are not altered. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pre-cambered welding jig” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：寬 3.6 m、16 mm 面板配 6 根 8 mm U 肋，中性軸在面板下約 0.073 m，I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 3.6 m wide, 16 mm plate with six 8 mm U-ribs, the neutral axis lies about 0.073 m below the plate and I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「反變形胎架」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pre-cambered welding jig”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 面板單元製作與焊接變形控制
knowledge.titleEn: Panel fabrication and welding distortion control
knowledge.text: 面板單元通常是數公尺寬、十餘公尺長的面板配上數根 U 肋，大量長焊縫集中在面板一側，焊後冷卻收縮會使面板縱向彎曲並在肋間產生橫向角變形。若不控制，面板單元在組成箱梁時無法密合，工地拼接間隙不均，鋪面也難以平整。
knowledge.textEn: A panel unit is usually a deck plate a few metres wide and over ten metres long with several U-ribs, concentrating many long welds on one side; cooling shrinkage bows the panel longitudinally and causes angular distortion between ribs. Uncontrolled, panels will not fit when assembled into box girders, site-splice gaps become uneven and the surfacing is hard to finish flat.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「面板單元製作與焊接變形控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Panel fabrication and welding distortion control" is correct?
options: 焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。
工地對接焊只會影響局部，不會改變整跨長度。
面板單元通常是數公尺寬、十餘公尺長的面板配上數根 U 肋，大量長焊縫集中在面板一側，焊後冷卻收縮會使面板縱向彎曲並在肋間產生橫向角變形。
optionsEn: Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly.
Site butt welds are local and do not change the length of a whole span.
A panel unit is usually a deck plate a few metres wide and over ten metres long with several U-ribs, concentrating many long welds on one side.
quiz.explanation: 面板單元通常是數公尺寬、十餘公尺長的面板配上數根 U 肋，大量長焊縫集中在面板一側，焊後冷卻收縮會使面板縱向彎曲並在肋間產生橫向角變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A panel unit is usually a deck plate a few metres wide and over ten metres long with several U-ribs, concentrating many long welds on one side; cooling shrinkage bows the panel longitudinally and causes angular distortion between ribs. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 面板單元製作與焊接變形控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Panel fabrication and welding distortion control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反變形胎架」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pre-cambered welding jig” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：寬 3.6 m、16 mm 面板配 6 根 8 mm U 肋，中性軸在面板下約 0.073 m，I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴。12 道焊縫各產生 120 kN 收縮力，合計 1,440 kN，作用在面板高度，彎矩 M ≈ 1,440×0.073 ≈ 105 kN·m；12 m 長單元的拱度 δ = M·L²/(8EI) = 105×12²/(8×2.1×10⁸×1.15×10⁻³) ≈ 7.9 mm，胎架預彎量以此為初值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 3.6 m wide, 16 mm plate with six 8 mm U-ribs, the neutral axis lies about 0.073 m below the plate and I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴. Twelve weld lines each shrinking with 120 kN give 1,440 kN at plate level, M ≈ 1,440×0.073 ≈ 105 kN·m; over a 12 m unit the bow is δ = M·L²/(8EI) = 105×12²/(8×2.1×10⁸×1.15×10⁻³) ≈ 7.9 mm, the starting value for the jig pre-camber. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：首批面板單元焊前、焊後與冷卻後以三維量測記錄縱向拱度、肋間角變形與面板平整度，與預測比較並修正胎架預彎量與焊接順序；量產後每一單元出廠前量測並與允差比較，火焰矯正區域記錄位置與溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: For the first panels, survey longitudinal bow, angular distortion between ribs and plate flatness in 3D before welding, after welding and after cooling, compare with prediction and adjust the jig pre-camber and welding sequence; in production, measure every unit before dispatch against tolerances and record the location and temperature of any flame straightening.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 寬 3.6 m、16 mm 面板配 6 根 8 mm U 肋，中性軸在面板下約 0.073 m，I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴。12 道焊縫各產生 120 kN 收縮力，合計 1,440 kN，作用在面板高度，彎矩 M ≈ 1,440×0.073 ≈ 105 kN·m；12 m 長單元的拱度 δ = M·L²/(8EI) = 105×12²/(8×2.1×10⁸×1.15×10⁻³) ≈ 7.9 mm，胎架預彎量以此為初值。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 3.6 m wide, 16 mm plate with six 8 mm U-ribs, the neutral axis lies about 0.073 m below the plate and I ≈ 1.15×10⁻³ m⁴. Twelve weld lines each shrinking with 120 kN give 1,440 kN at plate level, M ≈ 1,440×0.073 ≈ 105 kN·m; over a 12 m unit the bow is δ = M·L²/(8EI) = 105×12²/(8×2.1×10⁸×1.15×10⁻³) ≈ 7.9 mm, the starting value for the jig pre-camber. Values are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 面板單元製作與焊接變形控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Panel fabrication and welding distortion control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反變形胎架」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pre-cambered welding jig” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 首批面板單元焊前、焊後與冷卻後以三維量測記錄縱向拱度、肋間角變形與面板平整度，與預測比較並修正胎架預彎量與焊接順序；量產後每一單元出廠前量測並與允差比較，火焰矯正區域記錄位置與溫度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For the first panels, survey longitudinal bow, angular distortion between ribs and plate flatness in 3D before welding, after welding and after cooling, compare with prediction and adjust the jig pre-camber and welding sequence; in production, measure every unit before dispatch against tolerances and record the location and temperature of any flame straightening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製造計畫須包含胎架設計、焊接順序圖、變形量測點與允差、火焰矯正溫度上限與方法，並經業主審查；變形量測結果應建檔，作為後續批次修正的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The fabrication plan must include jig design, welding-sequence drawings, distortion measuring points and tolerances, and flame-straightening temperature limits and methods, reviewed by the owner; distortion records are filed as the basis for correcting later batches.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未使用反變形或焊接順序不對稱，面板單元扭曲成馬鞍形，組裝箱梁時以強力拉合，留下很大的殘餘應力；過度火焰矯正則使局部鋼材過熱，韌性下降，日後成為脆性破壞或疲勞的起點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without pre-camber or with unsymmetrical welding, panels twist into a saddle shape and are forced together during box assembly, locking in large residual stresses; excessive flame straightening overheats the steel locally, lowering toughness and creating a starting point for brittle fracture or fatigue. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 面板單元製作與焊接變形控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Panel fabrication and welding distortion control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反變形胎架」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pre-cambered welding jig” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未使用反變形或焊接順序不對稱，面板單元扭曲成馬鞍形，組裝箱梁時以強力拉合，留下很大的殘餘應力；過度火焰矯正則使局部鋼材過熱，韌性下降，日後成為脆性破壞或疲勞的起點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without pre-camber or with unsymmetrical welding, panels twist into a saddle shape and are forced together during box assembly, locking in large residual stresses; excessive flame straightening overheats the steel locally, lowering toughness and creating a starting point for brittle fracture or fatigue. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：工廠常用反變形胎架把面板預先彎成與焊接收縮方向相反的形狀，配合對稱焊接順序與夾具，使焊後回彈到設計形狀；必要時再以火焰矯正，但火焰矯正溫度須受控，以免改變鋼材性質。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Shops use pre-cambered jigs that bend the panel opposite to the weld shrinkage, together with symmetrical welding sequences and clamps, so it springs back to the design shape; flame straightening may follow if needed, but its temperature must be controlled so the steel's properties are not altered.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Without pre-camber or with unsymmetrical welding, panels twist into a saddle shape and are forced together during box assembly, locking in large residual stresses; excessive flame straightening overheats the steel locally, lowering toughness and creating a starting point for brittle fracture or fatigue.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「面板單元製作與焊接變形控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Panel fabrication and welding distortion control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。

未使用反變形或焊接順序不對稱，面板單元扭曲成馬鞍形，組裝箱梁時以強力拉合，留下很大的殘餘應力。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Site butt welds are local and do not change the length of a whole span.
Without pre-camber or with unsymmetrical welding, panels twist into a saddle shape and are forced together during box assembly, locking in large residual stresses.

steps.title: 工地拼接與焊接收縮預留：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site splices and shrinkage allowance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「肋拼接嵌補段」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rib splice insert” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 面板單元在工廠組成箱梁節段後，於工地或預拼場對接：面板以單面焊加陶瓷襯墊做全滲透對接焊，縱肋則因無法從內部焊接，常以一段短的嵌補肋在兩端與既有肋對接，或改用高強度螺栓拼接板。每一道橫向對接焊冷卻時都會縮短一點，數十道累積起來就可能讓整跨鋼梁長度不足，因此節段製作長度必須預留收縮量。拼接順序也很關鍵：先焊面板再焊縱肋，或反之，會產生不同的拘束應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「肋拼接嵌補段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Panels are assembled into box segments in the shop and joined on site or in a pre-assembly yard: the deck plate gets one-sided full-penetration butt welds on ceramic backing, while ribs, which cannot be welded from inside, are usually joined with a short insert rib welded at both ends to the existing ribs, or with high-strength bolted splice plates. Each transverse butt weld shortens a little as it cools, and dozens of them can leave a whole span short, so segment fabrication lengths must include a shrinkage allowance. Splice sequence also matters: welding the deck plate first or the ribs first produces different restraint stresses. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Rib splice insert” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：主跨 360 m 由 30 道橫向工地對接組成，每道對接焊收縮約 1.5 mm，累積 30×1.5 = 45 mm；節段放樣須平均每段加長 1.5 mm，否則跨中閉合缺口約 45 mm，需另行加長嵌補段。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 360 m main span with 30 transverse site butt joints, each shrinking about 1.5 mm, shortens by 30×1.5 = 45 mm; each segment must be laid out 1.5 mm longer on average, otherwise the midspan closure gap is about 45 mm short and needs a longer insert.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「工地對接焊只會影響局部，不會改變整跨長度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Site butt welds are local and do not change the length of a whole span." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「肋拼接嵌補段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Rib splice insert”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 工地拼接與焊接收縮預留：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：主跨 360 m 由 30 道橫向工地對接組成，每道對接焊收縮約 1.5 mm，累積 30×1.5 = 45 mm；節段放樣須平均每段加長 1.5 mm，否則跨中閉合缺口約 45 mm，需另行加長嵌補段。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
