Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以工廠試焊量測實際橫向收縮量，作為放樣加長的依據；工地拼接前量測兩節段端面的間隙、錯邊與肋的對位，焊後量測收縮並更新累積值；面板對接焊以超音波或射線檢測，嵌補肋焊縫以磁粉檢測加超音波檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure actual transverse shrinkage on shop trial welds as the basis for the layout allowance; before each site splice, measure gap, misalignment and rib registration at the two segment faces, measure shrinkage after welding and update the running total; test deck butt welds by ultrasonics or radiography and insert-rib welds by magnetic particle plus ultrasonics.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 主跨 360 m 由 30 道橫向工地對接組成，每道對接焊收縮約 1.5 mm，累積 30×1.5 = 45 mm；節段放樣須平均每段加長 1.5 mm，否則跨中閉合缺口約 45 mm，需另行加長嵌補段。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 360 m main span with 30 transverse site butt joints, each shrinking about 1.5 mm, shortens by 30×1.5 = 45 mm; each segment must be laid out 1.5 mm longer on average, otherwise the midspan closure gap is about 45 mm short and needs a longer insert. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「工地拼接與焊接收縮預留」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site splices and shrinkage allowance", which statement holds?
options: 鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。
主跨 360 m 由 30 道橫向工地對接組成，每道對接焊收縮約 1.5 mm，累積 30×1.5 = 45 mm。
鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。
optionsEn: Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn.
A 360 m main span with 30 transverse site butt joints, each shrinking about 1.5 mm, shortens by 30×1.5 = 45 mm.
A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough.
quiz.explanation: 主跨 360 m 由 30 道橫向工地對接組成，每道對接焊收縮約 1.5 mm，累積 30×1.5 = 45 mm；節段放樣須平均每段加長 1.5 mm，否則跨中閉合缺口約 45 mm，需另行加長嵌補段。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 360 m main span with 30 transverse site butt joints, each shrinking about 1.5 mm, shortens by 30×1.5 = 45 mm; each segment must be laid out 1.5 mm longer on average, otherwise the midspan closure gap is about 45 mm short and needs a longer insert. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 工地拼接與焊接收縮預留：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site splices and shrinkage allowance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「肋拼接嵌補段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib splice insert” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以工廠試焊量測實際橫向收縮量，作為放樣加長的依據；工地拼接前量測兩節段端面的間隙、錯邊與肋的對位，焊後量測收縮並更新累積值；面板對接焊以超音波或射線檢測，嵌補肋焊縫以磁粉檢測加超音波檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure actual transverse shrinkage on shop trial welds as the basis for the layout allowance; before each site splice, measure gap, misalignment and rib registration at the two segment faces, measure shrinkage after welding and update the running total; test deck butt welds by ultrasonics or radiography and insert-rib welds by magnetic particle plus ultrasonics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：工地焊接須有防風、防雨與預熱措施，焊接程序與焊工須在工地條件下評定；收縮累積表由製造廠與架設單位共同維護，閉合段長度在最後量測後才放樣切割。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Site welding needs wind, rain and preheat protection, with procedures and welders qualified under site conditions; the shrinkage tally is kept jointly by fabricator and erector, and the closure piece is laid out and cut only after the final measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate; insert-rib welds made overhead or vertical in poor site conditions have many root defects and are among the first places to crack by fatigue after opening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以工廠試焊量測實際橫向收縮量，作為放樣加長的依據；工地拼接前量測兩節段端面的間隙、錯邊與肋的對位，焊後量測收縮並更新累積值；面板對接焊以超音波或射線檢測，嵌補肋焊縫以磁粉檢測加超音波檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Measure actual transverse shrinkage on shop trial welds as the basis for the layout allowance; before each site splice, measure gap, misalignment and rib registration at the two segment faces, measure shrinkage after welding and update the running total; test deck butt welds by ultrasonics or radiography and insert-rib welds by magnetic particle plus ultrasonics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 工地焊接須有防風、防雨與預熱措施，焊接程序與焊工須在工地條件下評定；收縮累積表由製造廠與架設單位共同維護，閉合段長度在最後量測後才放樣切割。
knowledge.textEn: Site welding needs wind, rain and preheat protection, with procedures and welders qualified under site conditions; the shrinkage tally is kept jointly by fabricator and erector, and the closure piece is laid out and cut only after the final measurement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「工地拼接與焊接收縮預留」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Site splices and shrinkage allowance"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。
以工廠試焊量測實際橫向收縮量，作為放樣加長的依據。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate.
Measure actual transverse shrinkage on shop trial welds as the basis for the layout allowance.
quiz.explanation: 以工廠試焊量測實際橫向收縮量，作為放樣加長的依據；工地拼接前量測兩節段端面的間隙、錯邊與肋的對位，焊後量測收縮並更新累積值；面板對接焊以超音波或射線檢測，嵌補肋焊縫以磁粉檢測加超音波檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure actual transverse shrinkage on shop trial welds as the basis for the layout allowance; before each site splice, measure gap, misalignment and rib registration at the two segment faces, measure shrinkage after welding and update the running total; test deck butt welds by ultrasonics or radiography and insert-rib welds by magnetic particle plus ultrasonics. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 工地拼接與焊接收縮預留：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site splices and shrinkage allowance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「肋拼接嵌補段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rib splice insert” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate; insert-rib welds made overhead or vertical in poor site conditions have many root defects and are among the first places to crack by fatigue after opening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：拼接順序也很關鍵：先焊面板再焊縱肋，或反之，會產生不同的拘束應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Splice sequence also matters: welding the deck plate first or the ribs first produces different restraint stresses.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「工地對接焊只會影響局部，不會改變整跨長度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Site butt welds are local and do not change the length of a whole span." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。
knowledge.textEn: Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate; insert-rib welds made overhead or vertical in poor site conditions have many root defects and are among the first places to crack by fatigue after opening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「工地拼接與焊接收縮預留」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site splices and shrinkage allowance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。
optionsEn: Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside.
quiz.explanation: 沒有預留收縮或只依理論值預留，最後的閉合段長度不符，只能現場切割或加長鋼板；嵌補肋焊縫在工地仰焊或立焊條件差，根部缺陷多，成為通車後最早出現疲勞裂縫的位置之一。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Making no shrinkage allowance, or relying on theory alone, leaves the final closure the wrong length, forcing site cutting or added plate; insert-rib welds made overhead or vertical in poor site conditions have many root defects and are among the first places to crack by fatigue after opening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」與「試拼裝與幾何量測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification" and "Trial assembly and geometric survey": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Non-destructive testing and penetration verification: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「相位陣列超音波」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Phased-array ultrasonic testing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性橋面的焊縫數量以公里計，檢測策略必須分級：面板與主要對接焊做全長超音波或射線檢測；肋—面板部分滲透焊因為根部本來就不熔合，傳統超音波難以區分刻意的未熔合與缺陷，所以需要相位陣列超音波量測熔深，並以巨觀蝕刻試片校正；角焊縫與開孔端部則以目視與磁粉檢測表面裂紋。檢測結果必須與焊接參數紀錄連結，才能找出系統性問題，例如某一台焊機或某一班次的熔深偏低。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「相位陣列超音波」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Welds on an orthotropic deck run to kilometres, so inspection must be graded: deck-plate and main butt welds get full-length ultrasonic or radiographic testing; rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds have an intentionally unfused root that conventional ultrasonics struggle to distinguish from defects, so phased-array ultrasonics measure penetration, calibrated against macro-etch specimens; fillet welds and cut-out ends are checked visually and by magnetic particle for surface cracks. Results must be linked to welding-parameter records to reveal systematic problems such as low penetration from a particular machine or shift. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Phased-array ultrasonic testing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：肋壁 t = 8 mm，相位陣列超音波量得未熔合根部高度 1.8 mm，熔深比例 (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%，高於 70% 下限；若量得 2.6 mm，熔深 (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%，低於下限須評估補焊。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a rib wall t = 8 mm, a phased-array measurement of a 1.8 mm unfused root gives a penetration ratio of (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%, above the 70% minimum; a 2.6 mm reading gives (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%, below the minimum, requiring a repair assessment.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「相位陣列超音波」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Phased-array ultrasonic testing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證
knowledge.text: 正交異性橋面的焊縫數量以公里計，檢測策略必須分級：面板與主要對接焊做全長超音波或射線檢測；肋—面板部分滲透焊因為根部本來就不熔合，傳統超音波難以區分刻意的未熔合與缺陷，所以需要相位陣列超音波量測熔深，並以巨觀蝕刻試片校正；角焊縫與開孔端部則以目視與磁粉檢測表面裂紋。檢測結果必須與焊接參數紀錄連結，才能找出系統性問題，例如某一台焊機或某一班次的熔深偏低。
knowledge.textEn: Welds on an orthotropic deck run to kilometres, so inspection must be graded: deck-plate and main butt welds get full-length ultrasonic or radiographic testing; rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds have an intentionally unfused root that conventional ultrasonics struggle to distinguish from defects, so phased-array ultrasonics measure penetration, calibrated against macro-etch specimens; fillet welds and cut-out ends are checked visually and by magnetic particle for surface cracks. Results must be linked to welding-parameter records to reveal systematic problems such as low penetration from a particular machine or shift.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification" is correct?
options: 焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。
正交異性橋面的焊縫數量以公里計，檢測策略必須分級：面板與主要對接焊做全長超音波或射線檢測。
只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。
optionsEn: A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside.
Welds on an orthotropic deck run to kilometres, so inspection must be graded: deck-plate and main butt welds get full-length ultrasonic or radiographic testing.
If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site.
quiz.explanation: 正交異性橋面的焊縫數量以公里計，檢測策略必須分級：面板與主要對接焊做全長超音波或射線檢測；肋—面板部分滲透焊因為根部本來就不熔合，傳統超音波難以區分刻意的未熔合與缺陷，所以需要相位陣列超音波量測熔深，並以巨觀蝕刻試片校正；角焊縫與開孔端部則以目視與磁粉檢測表面裂紋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Welds on an orthotropic deck run to kilometres, so inspection must be graded: deck-plate and main butt welds get full-length ultrasonic or radiographic testing; rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds have an intentionally unfused root that conventional ultrasonics struggle to distinguish from defects, so phased-array ultrasonics measure penetration, calibrated against macro-etch specimens; fillet welds and cut-out ends are checked visually and by magnetic particle for surface cracks. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Non-destructive testing and penetration verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相位陣列超音波」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Phased-array ultrasonic testing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：肋壁 t = 8 mm，相位陣列超音波量得未熔合根部高度 1.8 mm，熔深比例 (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%，高於 70% 下限；若量得 2.6 mm，熔深 (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%，低於下限須評估補焊。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a rib wall t = 8 mm, a phased-array measurement of a 1.8 mm unfused root gives a penetration ratio of (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%, above the 70% minimum; a 2.6 mm reading gives (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%, below the minimum, requiring a repair assessment. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：相位陣列超音波系統以含已知熔深的參考試塊校正，並與同批巨觀蝕刻試片交叉比對；檢測人員須具相應資格，掃描資料連同位置與焊接參數存檔；不合格位置的補焊程序須另行評定並重新檢測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the phased-array system on reference blocks of known penetration and cross-check against macro-etch specimens from the same batch; inspectors must hold the relevant qualification, and scan data are archived with position and welding parameters; repairs at rejected locations need their own qualified procedure and re-inspection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 肋壁 t = 8 mm，相位陣列超音波量得未熔合根部高度 1.8 mm，熔深比例 (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%，高於 70% 下限；若量得 2.6 mm，熔深 (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%，低於下限須評估補焊。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a rib wall t = 8 mm, a phased-array measurement of a 1.8 mm unfused root gives a penetration ratio of (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%, above the 70% minimum; a 2.6 mm reading gives (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%, below the minimum, requiring a repair assessment. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification", which statement holds?
options: 鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。
鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。
肋壁 t = 8 mm，相位陣列超音波量得未熔合根部高度 1.8 mm，熔深比例 (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%，高於 70% 下限。
optionsEn: Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately.
If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.
For a rib wall t = 8 mm, a phased-array measurement of a 1.8 mm unfused root gives a penetration ratio of (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%, above the 70% minimum.
quiz.explanation: 肋壁 t = 8 mm，相位陣列超音波量得未熔合根部高度 1.8 mm，熔深比例 (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%，高於 70% 下限；若量得 2.6 mm，熔深 (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%，低於下限須評估補焊。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a rib wall t = 8 mm, a phased-array measurement of a 1.8 mm unfused root gives a penetration ratio of (8 − 1.8)/8 = 77.5%, above the 70% minimum; a 2.6 mm reading gives (8 − 2.6)/8 = 67.5%, below the minimum, requiring a repair assessment. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Non-destructive testing and penetration verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相位陣列超音波」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Phased-array ultrasonic testing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 相位陣列超音波系統以含已知熔深的參考試塊校正，並與同批巨觀蝕刻試片交叉比對；檢測人員須具相應資格，掃描資料連同位置與焊接參數存檔；不合格位置的補焊程序須另行評定並重新檢測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the phased-array system on reference blocks of known penetration and cross-check against macro-etch specimens from the same batch; inspectors must hold the relevant qualification, and scan data are archived with position and welding parameters; repairs at rejected locations need their own qualified procedure and re-inspection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢驗計畫應列出每一類焊縫的檢測方法、比例與允收標準，第三方檢驗須獨立於製造廠；檢測發現系統性問題時，啟動停工、追溯與擴大抽檢的程序，並經業主同意後恢復生產。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection plan should list method, extent and acceptance criteria for each weld type, with third-party inspection independent of the fabricator; a systematic problem triggers a stop, traceback and extended sampling, and production resumes only with owner approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以目視檢查外觀良好的肋—面板焊縫，無法發現熔深不足，問題要到通車多年後鋪面沿肋線開裂才浮現；檢測資料與焊接紀錄分開保存，則無法判斷缺陷是個別偶發還是整批參數錯誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Visual checks of a neat-looking rib-to-deck weld cannot reveal shallow penetration, which surfaces only years after opening as surfacing cracks along the rib lines; keeping inspection data apart from welding records makes it impossible to tell an isolated defect from a whole batch welded with wrong parameters. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 相位陣列超音波系統以含已知熔深的參考試塊校正，並與同批巨觀蝕刻試片交叉比對；檢測人員須具相應資格，掃描資料連同位置與焊接參數存檔；不合格位置的補焊程序須另行評定並重新檢測。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the phased-array system on reference blocks of known penetration and cross-check against macro-etch specimens from the same batch; inspectors must hold the relevant qualification, and scan data are archived with position and welding parameters; repairs at rejected locations need their own qualified procedure and re-inspection.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 檢驗計畫應列出每一類焊縫的檢測方法、比例與允收標準，第三方檢驗須獨立於製造廠；檢測發現系統性問題時，啟動停工、追溯與擴大抽檢的程序，並經業主同意後恢復生產。
knowledge.textEn: The inspection plan should list method, extent and acceptance criteria for each weld type, with third-party inspection independent of the fabricator; a systematic problem triggers a stop, traceback and extended sampling, and production resumes only with owner approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification"?
options: 相位陣列超音波系統以含已知熔深的參考試塊校正，並與同批巨觀蝕刻試片交叉比對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。
optionsEn: Calibrate the phased-array system on reference blocks of known penetration and cross-check against macro-etch specimens from the same batch.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best.
quiz.explanation: 相位陣列超音波系統以含已知熔深的參考試塊校正，並與同批巨觀蝕刻試片交叉比對；檢測人員須具相應資格，掃描資料連同位置與焊接參數存檔；不合格位置的補焊程序須另行評定並重新檢測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate the phased-array system on reference blocks of known penetration and cross-check against macro-etch specimens from the same batch; inspectors must hold the relevant qualification, and scan data are archived with position and welding parameters; repairs at rejected locations need their own qualified procedure and re-inspection. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Non-destructive testing and penetration verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相位陣列超音波」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Phased-array ultrasonic testing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以目視檢查外觀良好的肋—面板焊縫，無法發現熔深不足，問題要到通車多年後鋪面沿肋線開裂才浮現；檢測資料與焊接紀錄分開保存，則無法判斷缺陷是個別偶發還是整批參數錯誤。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Visual checks of a neat-looking rib-to-deck weld cannot reveal shallow penetration, which surfaces only years after opening as surfacing cracks along the rib lines; keeping inspection data apart from welding records makes it impossible to tell an isolated defect from a whole batch welded with wrong parameters. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢測結果必須與焊接參數紀錄連結，才能找出系統性問題，例如某一台焊機或某一班次的熔深偏低。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Results must be linked to welding-parameter records to reveal systematic problems such as low penetration from a particular machine or shift.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smooth weld of the right size must have adequate penetration inside." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以目視檢查外觀良好的肋—面板焊縫，無法發現熔深不足，問題要到通車多年後鋪面沿肋線開裂才浮現；檢測資料與焊接紀錄分開保存，則無法判斷缺陷是個別偶發還是整批參數錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Visual checks of a neat-looking rib-to-deck weld cannot reveal shallow penetration, which surfaces only years after opening as surfacing cracks along the rib lines; keeping inspection data apart from welding records makes it impossible to tell an isolated defect from a whole batch welded with wrong parameters.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「焊縫非破壞檢測與熔深驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Non-destructive testing and penetration verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只以目視檢查外觀良好的肋—面板焊縫，無法發現熔深不足，問題要到通車多年後鋪面沿肋線開裂才浮現。
只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Visual checks of a neat-looking rib-to-deck weld cannot reveal shallow penetration, which surfaces only years after opening as surfacing cracks along the rib lines.
If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site.
quiz.explanation: 只以目視檢查外觀良好的肋—面板焊縫，無法發現熔深不足，問題要到通車多年後鋪面沿肋線開裂才浮現；檢測資料與焊接紀錄分開保存，則無法判斷缺陷是個別偶發還是整批參數錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Visual checks of a neat-looking rib-to-deck weld cannot reveal shallow penetration, which surfaces only years after opening as surfacing cracks along the rib lines; keeping inspection data apart from welding records makes it impossible to tell an isolated defect from a whole batch welded with wrong parameters. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 試拼裝與幾何量測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Trial assembly and geometric survey: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「工廠試拼裝」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shop trial assembly” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼箱梁節段離開工廠前，常把相鄰兩至三個節段在預拼場依設計線形擺放，確認端面間隙、面板錯邊、縱肋對位、拼接板孔位與整體預拱，必要時在工廠內修正，避免到了海上或高空才發現對不上。正交異性橋面的關鍵是縱肋與面板在拼接處的錯邊：對接處的偏心會使局部應力集中，直接縮短疲勞壽命。三維雷射掃描或全站儀量測把每一節段的實際幾何建成數位模型，供架設時模擬閉合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「工廠試拼裝」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before leaving the shop, two or three adjacent box segments are often laid out in the pre-assembly yard on the design alignment to check end gaps, deck-plate misalignment, rib registration, splice-plate hole positions and overall camber, correcting problems in the shop rather than discovering them at sea or at height. For orthotropic decks the key item is misalignment of ribs and plates at splices: eccentricity at a butt joint concentrates local stress and directly shortens fatigue life. 3D laser scanning or total-station surveys build a digital model of each segment's real geometry for simulating closure during erection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shop trial assembly” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：板件對接錯邊 e 造成的彎曲應力集中係數 SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Misalignment e at a plate butt joint gives a bending stress concentration factor SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「工廠試拼裝」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shop trial assembly”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試拼裝與幾何量測
knowledge.text: 鋼箱梁節段離開工廠前，常把相鄰兩至三個節段在預拼場依設計線形擺放，確認端面間隙、面板錯邊、縱肋對位、拼接板孔位與整體預拱，必要時在工廠內修正，避免到了海上或高空才發現對不上。正交異性橋面的關鍵是縱肋與面板在拼接處的錯邊：對接處的偏心會使局部應力集中，直接縮短疲勞壽命。
knowledge.textEn: Before leaving the shop, two or three adjacent box segments are often laid out in the pre-assembly yard on the design alignment to check end gaps, deck-plate misalignment, rib registration, splice-plate hole positions and overall camber, correcting problems in the shop rather than discovering them at sea or at height. For orthotropic decks the key item is misalignment of ribs and plates at splices: eccentricity at a butt joint concentrates local stress and directly shortens fatigue life.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試拼裝與幾何量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trial assembly and geometric survey" is correct?
options: 只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。
鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。
鋼箱梁節段離開工廠前，常把相鄰兩至三個節段在預拼場依設計線形擺放，確認端面間隙、面板錯邊、縱肋對位、拼接板孔位與整體預拱，必要時在工廠內修正，避免到了海上或高空才發現對不上。
optionsEn: If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site.
Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn.

Before leaving the shop, two or three adjacent box segments are often laid out in the pre-assembly yard on the design alignment to check end gaps, deck-plate misalignment, rib registration, splice-plate hole positions and overall camber, correcting problems in the shop rather than discovering them at sea or at height.
quiz.explanation: 鋼箱梁節段離開工廠前，常把相鄰兩至三個節段在預拼場依設計線形擺放，確認端面間隙、面板錯邊、縱肋對位、拼接板孔位與整體預拱，必要時在工廠內修正，避免到了海上或高空才發現對不上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before leaving the shop, two or three adjacent box segments are often laid out in the pre-assembly yard on the design alignment to check end gaps, deck-plate misalignment, rib registration, splice-plate hole positions and overall camber, correcting problems in the shop rather than discovering them at sea or at height. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試拼裝與幾何量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trial assembly and geometric survey: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「工廠試拼裝」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shop trial assembly” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：板件對接錯邊 e 造成的彎曲應力集中係數 SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t。肋壁 t = 8 mm：錯邊 1 mm 時 SCF ≈ 1 + 3×1/8 = 1.375；錯邊 2 mm 時 SCF ≈ 1.75。以 m = 3 的 S–N 曲線，壽命比約 (1.375/1.75)³ ≈ 0.48，錯邊加倍壽命約減半。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Misalignment e at a plate butt joint gives a bending stress concentration factor SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t. For an 8 mm rib wall, 1 mm misalignment gives SCF ≈ 1 + 3×1/8 = 1.375 and 2 mm gives SCF ≈ 1.75. With an m = 3 S–N curve the life ratio is about (1.375/1.75)³ ≈ 0.48, so doubling the misalignment roughly halves the life. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個端面的面板高程、肋位置與間隙，逐肋記錄錯邊並與允差比較；整體預拱與平面線形以設計座標比對，結果製成節段幾何報告，隨節段出廠交給架設單位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During trial assembly survey each face's deck-plate levels, rib positions and gaps by total station or laser scanning, record misalignment rib by rib against tolerance, compare overall camber and plan alignment with design coordinates, and issue a segment geometry report that travels with the segment to the erector.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 板件對接錯邊 e 造成的彎曲應力集中係數 SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t。肋壁 t = 8 mm：錯邊 1 mm 時 SCF ≈ 1 + 3×1/8 = 1.375；錯邊 2 mm 時 SCF ≈ 1.75。以 m = 3 的 S–N 曲線，壽命比約 (1.375/1.75)³ ≈ 0.48，錯邊加倍壽命約減半。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Misalignment e at a plate butt joint gives a bending stress concentration factor SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t. For an 8 mm rib wall, 1 mm misalignment gives SCF ≈ 1 + 3×1/8 = 1.375 and 2 mm gives SCF ≈ 1.75. With an m = 3 S–N curve the life ratio is about (1.375/1.75)³ ≈ 0.48, so doubling the misalignment roughly halves the life. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試拼裝與幾何量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trial assembly and geometric survey", which statement holds?
options: 板件對接錯邊 e 造成的彎曲應力集中係數 SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t。
鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。
縱肋只是加勁板，用一般鋼板隨意冷彎即可。
optionsEn: Misalignment e at a plate butt joint gives a bending stress concentration factor SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t.
A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough.
Ribs are mere stiffeners and can be cold-bent from any ordinary plate.
quiz.explanation: 板件對接錯邊 e 造成的彎曲應力集中係數 SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Misalignment e at a plate butt joint gives a bending stress concentration factor SCF ≈ 1 + 3e/t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試拼裝與幾何量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trial assembly and geometric survey: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「工廠試拼裝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shop trial assembly” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個端面的面板高程、肋位置與間隙，逐肋記錄錯邊並與允差比較；整體預拱與平面線形以設計座標比對，結果製成節段幾何報告，隨節段出廠交給架設單位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During trial assembly survey each face's deck-plate levels, rib positions and gaps by total station or laser scanning, record misalignment rib by rib against tolerance, compare overall camber and plan alignment with design coordinates, and issue a segment geometry report that travels with the segment to the erector. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約應規定試拼裝的範圍與頻率、錯邊與間隙允差，以及不符合時的修正程序；節段幾何報告與數位模型屬於竣工資料的一部分，供日後檢查與維修使用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The contract should define trial-assembly extent and frequency, misalignment and gap tolerances and the correction procedure for non-conformance; segment geometry reports and digital models form part of the as-built records for later inspection and repair.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略試拼裝，到了架設現場才發現縱肋錯位數公釐，只能以強制對位或加墊板處理，在拼接處留下錯邊與附加應力；拼接板孔位不符時現場擴孔，削弱摩擦型螺栓接合的性能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping trial assembly lets ribs arrive several millimetres out of register, forcing them together or shimming and leaving misalignment and added stress at splices; mismatched splice holes are reamed on site, weakening slip-critical bolted joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個端面的面板高程、肋位置與間隙，逐肋記錄錯邊並與允差比較；整體預拱與平面線形以設計座標比對，結果製成節段幾何報告，隨節段出廠交給架設單位。
knowledge.textEn: During trial assembly survey each face's deck-plate levels, rib positions and gaps by total station or laser scanning, record misalignment rib by rib against tolerance, compare overall camber and plan alignment with design coordinates, and issue a segment geometry report that travels with the segment to the erector.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 合約應規定試拼裝的範圍與頻率、錯邊與間隙允差，以及不符合時的修正程序；節段幾何報告與數位模型屬於竣工資料的一部分，供日後檢查與維修使用。
knowledge.textEn: The contract should define trial-assembly extent and frequency, misalignment and gap tolerances and the correction procedure for non-conformance; segment geometry reports and digital models form part of the as-built records for later inspection and repair.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試拼裝與幾何量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Trial assembly and geometric survey"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
試拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個端面的面板高程、肋位置與間隙，逐肋記錄錯邊並與允差比較。
焊接變形可以等組裝時再用千斤頂硬拉回來。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

During trial assembly survey each face's deck-plate levels, rib positions and gaps by total station or laser scanning, record misalignment rib by rib against tolerance, compare overall camber and plan alignment with design coordinates, and issue a segment geometry report that travels with the segment to the erector.
Welding distortion can simply be pulled out with jacks during assembly.
quiz.explanation: 試拼裝時以全站儀或雷射掃描量測每個端面的面板高程、肋位置與間隙，逐肋記錄錯邊並與允差比較；整體預拱與平面線形以設計座標比對，結果製成節段幾何報告，隨節段出廠交給架設單位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During trial assembly survey each face's deck-plate levels, rib positions and gaps by total station or laser scanning, record misalignment rib by rib against tolerance, compare overall camber and plan alignment with design coordinates, and issue a segment geometry report that travels with the segment to the erector. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 試拼裝與幾何量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trial assembly and geometric survey: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「工廠試拼裝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shop trial assembly” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略試拼裝，到了架設現場才發現縱肋錯位數公釐，只能以強制對位或加墊板處理，在拼接處留下錯邊與附加應力；拼接板孔位不符時現場擴孔，削弱摩擦型螺栓接合的性能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping trial assembly lets ribs arrive several millimetres out of register, forcing them together or shimming and leaving misalignment and added stress at splices; mismatched splice holes are reamed on site, weakening slip-critical bolted joints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：三維雷射掃描或全站儀量測把每一節段的實際幾何建成數位模型，供架設時模擬閉合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: 3D laser scanning or total-station surveys build a digital model of each segment's real geometry for simulating closure during erection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每個節段尺寸各自合格，到現場一定能順利對接。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every segment is individually within tolerance, they will always fit on site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略試拼裝，到了架設現場才發現縱肋錯位數公釐，只能以強制對位或加墊板處理，在拼接處留下錯邊與附加應力；拼接板孔位不符時現場擴孔，削弱摩擦型螺栓接合的性能。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping trial assembly lets ribs arrive several millimetres out of register, forcing them together or shimming and leaving misalignment and added stress at splices; mismatched splice holes are reamed on site, weakening slip-critical bolted joints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試拼裝與幾何量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Trial assembly and geometric survey" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。
省略試拼裝，到了架設現場才發現縱肋錯位數公釐，只能以強制對位或加墊板處理，在拼接處留下錯邊與附加應力；拼接板孔位不符時現場擴孔，削弱摩擦型螺栓接合的性能。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn.
Skipping trial assembly lets ribs arrive several millimetres out of register, forcing them together or shimming and leaving misalignment and added stress at splices.
quiz.explanation: 省略試拼裝，到了架設現場才發現縱肋錯位數公釐，只能以強制對位或加墊板處理，在拼接處留下錯邊與附加應力；拼接板孔位不符時現場擴孔，削弱摩擦型螺栓接合的性能。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping trial assembly lets ribs arrive several millimetres out of register, forcing them together or shimming and leaving misalignment and added stress at splices; mismatched splice holes are reamed on site, weakening slip-critical bolted joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋪面系統與面板協同作用」與「疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Surfacing system and composite action with the plate" and "Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「環氧瀝青鋪面」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性橋面的鋪面不只是行車表面：它把輪載分散到較大面積，並在低溫時與鋼面板部分合成，顯著降低面板與焊縫的應力幅；同時保護鋼面板免受水與鹽侵蝕。金門大橋 1980 年代換裝的鋼橋面採用約 2 吋（約 50 mm）的環氧瀝青鋪面。鋪面的勁度隨溫度大幅改變，夏季高溫時合成效果降低，面板應力上升；鋪面開裂或與鋼板脫層，則同時失去分散荷載與防水兩種功能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「環氧瀝青鋪面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The surfacing on an orthotropic deck is more than a running surface: it spreads wheel loads over a larger area and, when cold, acts partly compositely with the steel plate, markedly reducing stress ranges in the plate and welds, while protecting the plate from water and salt. The Golden Gate Bridge's 1980s steel deck received about 2 inches (about 50 mm) of epoxy asphalt. Surfacing stiffness changes greatly with temperature, so composite action drops in hot summers and plate stresses rise; cracking or debonding of the surfacing loses both load spreading and waterproofing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：16 mm 鋼面板加 50 mm 鋪面，假設完全合成：鋪面模數 5,000 MPa（約常溫）時板條抗彎勁度約為鋼板單獨的 5.3 倍；高溫降到 1,000 MPa 時只剩約 1.9 倍；低溫 10,000 MPa 時約 9.1 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 16 mm steel plate with 50 mm of surfacing assumed fully composite, a surfacing modulus of 5,000 MPa at moderate temperature gives a strip bending stiffness about 5.3 times that of the plate alone; at 1,000 MPa in hot weather only about 1.9 times; at 10,000 MPa in cold weather about 9.1 times.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「環氧瀝青鋪面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用
knowledge.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate
knowledge.text: 正交異性橋面的鋪面不只是行車表面：它把輪載分散到較大面積，並在低溫時與鋼面板部分合成，顯著降低面板與焊縫的應力幅；同時保護鋼面板免受水與鹽侵蝕。金門大橋 1980 年代換裝的鋼橋面採用約 2 吋（約 50 mm）的環氧瀝青鋪面。
knowledge.textEn: The surfacing on an orthotropic deck is more than a running surface: it spreads wheel loads over a larger area and, when cold, acts partly compositely with the steel plate, markedly reducing stress ranges in the plate and welds, while protecting the plate from water and salt. The Golden Gate Bridge's 1980s steel deck received about 2 inches (about 50 mm) of epoxy asphalt.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋪面系統與面板協同作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Surfacing system and composite action with the plate" is correct?
options: 正交異性橋面的鋪面不只是行車表面：它把輪載分散到較大面積，並在低溫時與鋼面板部分合成，顯著降低面板與焊縫的應力幅；同時保護鋼面板免受水與鹽侵蝕。
鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。
鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。
optionsEn: The surfacing on an orthotropic deck is more than a running surface: it spreads wheel loads over a larger area and, when cold, acts partly compositely with the steel plate, markedly reducing stress ranges in the plate and welds, while protecting the plate from water and salt.
Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn.
Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately.
quiz.explanation: 正交異性橋面的鋪面不只是行車表面：它把輪載分散到較大面積，並在低溫時與鋼面板部分合成，顯著降低面板與焊縫的應力幅；同時保護鋼面板免受水與鹽侵蝕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The surfacing on an orthotropic deck is more than a running surface: it spreads wheel loads over a larger area and, when cold, acts partly compositely with the steel plate, markedly reducing stress ranges in the plate and welds, while protecting the plate from water and salt. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環氧瀝青鋪面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：16 mm 鋼面板加 50 mm 鋪面，假設完全合成：鋪面模數 5,000 MPa（約常溫）時板條抗彎勁度約為鋼板單獨的 5.3 倍；高溫降到 1,000 MPa 時只剩約 1.9 倍；低溫 10,000 MPa 時約 9.1 倍。勁度比的變化說明夏季重車造成的應力幅最大。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 16 mm steel plate with 50 mm of surfacing assumed fully composite, a surfacing modulus of 5,000 MPa at moderate temperature gives a strip bending stiffness about 5.3 times that of the plate alone; at 1,000 MPa in hot weather only about 1.9 times; at 10,000 MPa in cold weather about 9.1 times. The variation shows why heavy trucks in summer cause the largest stress ranges. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鋪設前檢查鋼面板噴砂等級、粗糙度與防蝕底漆，鋪面材料做配比與黏結強度試驗；鋪設後以拉拔試驗抽查與鋼板的黏結，並以敲擊或熱像檢查脫層；通車初期在面板下方貼應變計量測不同季節的應力幅，驗證設計假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before paving, check blast grade, roughness and primer on the steel plate and test the surfacing mix and bond strength; after paving, spot-check bond by pull-off tests and look for debonding by sounding or thermography; in the first years, gauge the plate underside to measure stress ranges in different seasons and verify design assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 16 mm 鋼面板加 50 mm 鋪面，假設完全合成：鋪面模數 5,000 MPa（約常溫）時板條抗彎勁度約為鋼板單獨的 5.3 倍；高溫降到 1,000 MPa 時只剩約 1.9 倍；低溫 10,000 MPa 時約 9.1 倍。勁度比的變化說明夏季重車造成的應力幅最大。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 16 mm steel plate with 50 mm of surfacing assumed fully composite, a surfacing modulus of 5,000 MPa at moderate temperature gives a strip bending stiffness about 5.3 times that of the plate alone; at 1,000 MPa in hot weather only about 1.9 times; at 10,000 MPa in cold weather about 9.1 times. The variation shows why heavy trucks in summer cause the largest stress ranges. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋪面系統與面板協同作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Surfacing system and composite action with the plate", which statement holds?
options: 鋼橋面板只要強度足夠，疲勞可以等出現裂縫再處理。
16 mm 鋼面板加 50 mm 鋪面，假設完全合成：鋪面模數 5,000 MPa（約常溫）時板條抗彎勁度約為鋼板單獨的 5.3 倍。
肋—面板焊縫焊得越深越好，最好完全燒穿。
optionsEn: If the steel deck is strong enough, fatigue can be dealt with once cracks appear.

For a 16 mm steel plate with 50 mm of surfacing assumed fully composite, a surfacing modulus of 5,000 MPa at moderate temperature gives a strip bending stiffness about 5.3 times that of the plate alone.
The deeper the rib-to-deck weld the better; full melt-through is best.
quiz.explanation: 16 mm 鋼面板加 50 mm 鋪面，假設完全合成：鋪面模數 5,000 MPa（約常溫）時板條抗彎勁度約為鋼板單獨的 5.3 倍；高溫降到 1,000 MPa 時只剩約 1.9 倍；低溫 10,000 MPa 時約 9.1 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 16 mm steel plate with 50 mm of surfacing assumed fully composite, a surfacing modulus of 5,000 MPa at moderate temperature gives a strip bending stiffness about 5.3 times that of the plate alone; at 1,000 MPa in hot weather only about 1.9 times; at 10,000 MPa in cold weather about 9.1 times. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環氧瀝青鋪面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鋪設前檢查鋼面板噴砂等級、粗糙度與防蝕底漆，鋪面材料做配比與黏結強度試驗；鋪設後以拉拔試驗抽查與鋼板的黏結，並以敲擊或熱像檢查脫層；通車初期在面板下方貼應變計量測不同季節的應力幅，驗證設計假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before paving, check blast grade, roughness and primer on the steel plate and test the surfacing mix and bond strength; after paving, spot-check bond by pull-off tests and look for debonding by sounding or thermography; in the first years, gauge the plate underside to measure stress ranges in different seasons and verify design assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鋪面系統（防蝕層、黏結層、鋪面）應與鋼橋面一起設計與驗收，規格中明訂適用溫度範圍與黏結強度；維護計畫須包括鋪面裂縫的即時封填，避免水分進入鋼板界面。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design and accept the surfacing system (corrosion layer, bond coat, surfacing) together with the steel deck, specifying the temperature range and bond strength; the maintenance plan must include prompt sealing of surfacing cracks so water cannot reach the steel interface.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鋪設前檢查鋼面板噴砂等級、粗糙度與防蝕底漆，鋪面材料做配比與黏結強度試驗；鋪設後以拉拔試驗抽查與鋼板的黏結，並以敲擊或熱像檢查脫層；通車初期在面板下方貼應變計量測不同季節的應力幅，驗證設計假設。
knowledge.textEn: Before paving, check blast grade, roughness and primer on the steel plate and test the surfacing mix and bond strength; after paving, spot-check bond by pull-off tests and look for debonding by sounding or thermography; in the first years, gauge the plate underside to measure stress ranges in different seasons and verify design assumptions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 鋪面系統（防蝕層、黏結層、鋪面）應與鋼橋面一起設計與驗收，規格中明訂適用溫度範圍與黏結強度；維護計畫須包括鋪面裂縫的即時封填，避免水分進入鋼板界面。
knowledge.textEn: Design and accept the surfacing system (corrosion layer, bond coat, surfacing) together with the steel deck, specifying the temperature range and bond strength; the maintenance plan must include prompt sealing of surfacing cracks so water cannot reach the steel interface.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋪面系統與面板協同作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surfacing system and composite action with the plate"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
工地對接焊只會影響局部，不會改變整跨長度。
鋪設前檢查鋼面板噴砂等級、粗糙度與防蝕底漆，鋪面材料做配比與黏結強度試驗。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Site butt welds are local and do not change the length of a whole span.
Before paving, check blast grade, roughness and primer on the steel plate and test the surfacing mix and bond strength.
quiz.explanation: 鋪設前檢查鋼面板噴砂等級、粗糙度與防蝕底漆，鋪面材料做配比與黏結強度試驗；鋪設後以拉拔試驗抽查與鋼板的黏結，並以敲擊或熱像檢查脫層；通車初期在面板下方貼應變計量測不同季節的應力幅，驗證設計假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before paving, check blast grade, roughness and primer on the steel plate and test the surfacing mix and bond strength; after paving, spot-check bond by pull-off tests and look for debonding by sounding or thermography; in the first years, gauge the plate underside to measure stress ranges in different seasons and verify design assumptions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋪面系統與面板協同作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surfacing system and composite action with the plate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環氧瀝青鋪面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Epoxy-asphalt surfacing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋪面的勁度隨溫度大幅改變，夏季高溫時合成效果降低，面板應力上升；鋪面開裂或與鋼板脫層，則同時失去分散荷載與防水兩種功能。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surfacing stiffness changes greatly with temperature, so composite action drops in hot summers and plate stresses rise; cracking or debonding of the surfacing loses both load spreading and waterproofing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋪面只是行車面，壞了換新就好，與鋼橋面疲勞無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Surfacing is just a wearing course, unrelated to deck fatigue, and can simply be replaced when worn." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。
knowledge.textEn: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋪面系統與面板協同作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surfacing system and composite action with the plate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。
optionsEn: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately.
quiz.explanation: 鋼板表面處理不良，鋪面在數年內大面積脫層，水分積在鋪面與鋼板之間，造成鋼板腐蝕與鋪面推擠；若設計時以低溫勁度計入合成作用，夏季實際應力幅高於預期，疲勞裂縫提早出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor surface preparation lets the surfacing debond over large areas within a few years, trapping water between surfacing and plate, corroding the steel and shoving the surfacing; counting cold-weather composite stiffness in design underestimates summer stress ranges and brings fatigue cracking forward. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「疲勞熱點檢查清單」如何影響正交異性鋼橋面板製作的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” governs force, deformation or durability in “Orthotropic steel deck fabrication”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 正交異性橋面的疲勞裂縫集中在少數已知位置：肋—面板焊縫根部向面板內成長、肋—橫梁連接與開孔端部、嵌補肋拼接焊縫、面板對接焊。根部向面板成長的裂縫從上方被鋪面遮住、從箱內看不到焊縫內部，往往要到鋪面沿肋線開裂才被發現。因此交接時必須提供以熱點為主的檢查清單、箱內通行路線、可用的超音波檢測方法，以及依裂縫成長速度訂定的檢查週期；修復可用止裂孔、螺栓補強板或橋面加鋪高性能混凝土層。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「疲勞熱點檢查清單」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds. Root cracks growing into the plate are hidden by surfacing from above and invisible inside the weld from within the box, so they are often found only when the surfacing cracks along rib lines. Handover must therefore supply a hot-spot inspection checklist, access routes inside the box, suitable ultrasonic methods and inspection intervals based on crack-growth rates; repairs include stop holes, bolted doubler plates or an overlay of high-performance concrete on the deck. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Paris 定律 da/dN = C·(ΔK)³，ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa)，C = 3×10⁻¹³（mm 與 MPa√mm）、Y = 1.12、Δσ = 40 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Paris law da/dN = C·(ΔK)³ with ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa), C = 3×10⁻¹³ (mm and MPa√mm), Y = 1.12 and Δσ = 40 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover
knowledge.text: 正交異性橋面的疲勞裂縫集中在少數已知位置：肋—面板焊縫根部向面板內成長、肋—橫梁連接與開孔端部、嵌補肋拼接焊縫、面板對接焊。根部向面板成長的裂縫從上方被鋪面遮住、從箱內看不到焊縫內部，往往要到鋪面沿肋線開裂才被發現。
knowledge.textEn: Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds. Root cracks growing into the plate are hidden by surfacing from above and invisible inside the weld from within the box, so they are often found only when the surfacing cracks along rib lines.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover" is correct?
options: 鋼橋面疲勞裂縫一出現就表示整座橋面必須立即更換。
正交異性橋面的疲勞裂縫集中在少數已知位置：肋—面板焊縫根部向面板內成長、肋—橫梁連接與開孔端部、嵌補肋拼接焊縫、面板對接焊。
鋼橋面板只是主梁的上翼板，只要整體彎曲應力合格即可。
optionsEn: Once a fatigue crack appears, the whole steel deck must be replaced immediately.

Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds.
A steel deck plate is just the top flange of the girder, so passing the global bending check is enough.

quiz.explanationEn: Fatigue cracks in orthotropic decks concentrate at a few known locations: rib-to-deck weld roots growing into the deck plate, rib-to-floorbeam connections and cut-out ends, insert-rib splice welds and deck-plate butt welds. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「疲勞熱點檢查清單」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Paris 定律 da/dN = C·(ΔK)³，ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa)，C = 3×10⁻¹³（mm 與 MPa√mm）、Y = 1.12、Δσ = 40 MPa。裂縫由 2 mm 長到 12 mm：N = 2(a₀^−0.5 − a₁^−0.5)/[C·(YΔσ)³·π^1.5] ≈ 5.6×10⁶ 次；若重車輪每日 3,000 次，約 5.1 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Paris law da/dN = C·(ΔK)³ with ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa), C = 3×10⁻¹³ (mm and MPa√mm), Y = 1.12 and Δσ = 40 MPa. Growing a crack from 2 mm to 12 mm takes N = 2(a₀^−0.5 − a₁^−0.5)/[C·(YΔσ)³·π^1.5] ≈ 5.6×10⁶ cycles, about 5.1 years at 3,000 heavy wheel passes a day. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前完成一次基準檢查：箱內熱點逐一目視與磁粉檢測、重車道肋—面板焊縫以超音波抽查、鋪面裂縫圖與照片；之後的檢查週期依裂縫成長計算與實際交通量設定，每次結果與基準比較，新裂縫須記錄位置、長度與方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover complete a baseline inspection: every hot spot inside the box checked visually and by magnetic particle, heavy-lane rib-to-deck welds sampled by ultrasonics, and the surfacing crack map photographed; set later intervals from crack-growth calculations and actual traffic, compare every result with the baseline, and record the position, length and direction of any new crack.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Paris 定律 da/dN = C·(ΔK)³，ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa)，C = 3×10⁻¹³（mm 與 MPa√mm）、Y = 1.12、Δσ = 40 MPa。裂縫由 2 mm 長到 12 mm：N = 2(a₀^−0.5 − a₁^−0.5)/[C·(YΔσ)³·π^1.5] ≈ 5.6×10⁶ 次；若重車輪每日 3,000 次，約 5.1 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Paris law da/dN = C·(ΔK)³ with ΔK = Y·Δσ·√(πa), C = 3×10⁻¹³ (mm and MPa√mm), Y = 1.12 and Δσ = 40 MPa. Growing a crack from 2 mm to 12 mm takes N = 2(a₀^−0.5 − a₁^−0.5)/[C·(YΔσ)³·π^1.5] ≈ 5.6×10⁶ cycles, about 5.1 years at 3,000 heavy wheel passes a day. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「疲勞熱點檢查清單」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fatigue hot-spot checklist” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前完成一次基準檢查：箱內熱點逐一目視與磁粉檢測、重車道肋—面板焊縫以超音波抽查、鋪面裂縫圖與照片；之後的檢查週期依裂縫成長計算與實際交通量設定，每次結果與基準比較，新裂縫須記錄位置、長度與方向。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover complete a baseline inspection: every hot spot inside the box checked visually and by magnetic particle, heavy-lane rib-to-deck welds sampled by ultrasonics, and the surfacing crack map photographed; set later intervals from crack-growth calculations and actual traffic, compare every result with the baseline, and record the position, length and direction of any new crack. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含關鍵細部清單與疲勞計算、焊接與檢測紀錄、節段幾何報告、鋪面系統資料、箱內通行與照明配置及檢查週期；重車道交通量顯著增加時，管理單位應通知結構顧問重新評估檢查週期。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should contain the key-detail list and fatigue calculations, welding and inspection records, segment geometry reports, surfacing data, box access and lighting layout and inspection intervals; if heavy-lane traffic rises markedly, the owner should ask the structural consultant to re-evaluate the intervals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有熱點清單與基準資料，檢查人員在箱內只看塗裝與鏽蝕，面板根部裂縫持續成長，直到穿透面板使鋪面局部塌陷；修補時若只封填鋪面裂縫而不處理鋼板裂縫，問題會在下一個夏季重現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without a hot-spot list and baseline, inspectors inside the box look only at coating and rust while root cracks keep growing until they penetrate the plate and the surfacing locally collapses; sealing the surfacing crack without repairing the steel crack brings the problem back the next summer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Before handover complete a baseline inspection: every hot spot inside the box checked visually and by magnetic particle, heavy-lane rib-to-deck welds sampled by ultrasonics, and the surfacing crack map photographed; set later intervals from crack-growth calculations and actual traffic, compare every result with the baseline, and record the position, length and direction of any new crack.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含關鍵細部清單與疲勞計算、焊接與檢測紀錄、節段幾何報告、鋪面系統資料、箱內通行與照明配置及檢查週期；重車道交通量顯著增加時，管理單位應通知結構顧問重新評估檢查週期。

quiz.question: 要驗證「疲勞檢查、裂縫成長與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fatigue inspection, crack growth and handover"?
options: 交接前完成一次基準檢查：箱內熱點逐一目視與磁粉檢測、重車道肋—面板焊縫以超音波抽查、鋪面裂縫圖與照片。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
焊縫外觀平滑、尺寸合格，就代表內部熔深足夠。
optionsEn: Before handover complete a baseline inspection: every hot spot inside the box checked visually and by magnetic particle, heavy-lane rib-to-deck welds sampled by ultrasonics, and the surfacing crack map photographed.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
