quiz.explanationEn: The designer models the transport state with the actual support positions, prestress and self-weight, checks girder-end top-fibre and midspan bottom-fibre stresses including the dynamic allowance against construction-stage limits, and confirms that the transporter's layout drawing shows the coordinates of every support point. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support-point change and moment reversal during the move: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「運輸車支承點與懸臂端」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “SPMT support points and overhangs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 運輸商為了配合車輛長度把支點往內移，梁端外伸變長，預力梁端部頂緣在運輸中開裂；若支點落在沒有橫隔梁的位置，梁底局部承壓過大，造成翼板破損或鋼梁腹板局部挫屈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A transport contractor moving support points inward to suit vehicle length lengthens the overhangs and cracks prestressed girder ends at the top during transport; supports placed away from diaphragms overload the soffit locally, breaking flanges or buckling steel webs. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：預力梁端部頂緣在營運時本來就受預力拉應力，再加上外伸負彎矩，可能開裂，因此支承點位置必須由設計者決定，而不是由運輸商依車輛配置自行選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At prestressed girder ends the top fibre already carries tension from prestress, and the overhang moment can crack it, so support positions must be set by the designer, not chosen by the transport contractor to suit the vehicle layout.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「運輸車在梁下任何位置頂起都可以，只要總重不超過車輛容量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Transporters may lift a span anywhere along its length as long as total weight is within capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 運輸商為了配合車輛長度把支點往內移，梁端外伸變長，預力梁端部頂緣在運輸中開裂；若支點落在沒有橫隔梁的位置，梁底局部承壓過大，造成翼板破損或鋼梁腹板局部挫屈。
knowledge.textEn: A transport contractor moving support points inward to suit vehicle length lengthens the overhangs and cracks prestressed girder ends at the top during transport; supports placed away from diaphragms overload the soffit locally, breaking flanges or buckling steel webs.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「換橋時的支承點改變與彎矩反轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support-point change and moment reversal during the move" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
運輸商為了配合車輛長度把支點往內移，梁端外伸變長，預力梁端部頂緣在運輸中開裂；若支點落在沒有橫隔梁的位置，梁底局部承壓過大，造成翼板破損或鋼梁腹板局部挫屈。
SPMT 軸線越多越安全，群組怎麼分都沒有差別。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A transport contractor moving support points inward to suit vehicle length lengthens the overhangs and cracks prestressed girder ends at the top during transport.
More axle lines always make the move safer, and how they are grouped makes no difference.
quiz.explanation: 運輸商為了配合車輛長度把支點往內移，梁端外伸變長，預力梁端部頂緣在運輸中開裂；若支點落在沒有橫隔梁的位置，梁底局部承壓過大，造成翼板破損或鋼梁腹板局部挫屈。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A transport contractor moving support points inward to suit vehicle length lengthens the overhangs and cracks prestressed girder ends at the top during transport; supports placed away from diaphragms overload the soffit locally, breaking flanges or buckling steel webs. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「軸線容量與液壓分組」如何影響自行式模組運輸車換橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Axle-line capacity and hydraulic grouping” governs force, deformation or durability in “SPMT bridge replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: SPMT 由多個六軸或四軸模組拼接，每一軸線有額定承載，懸吊為液壓式：同一液壓群組內各軸壓力相等，因此可以把整組車輛分成三個液壓群組，形成靜定的三點支承。這樣地面起伏或坡度變化只讓橋體整體傾斜，不會強迫橋體扭曲；若誤設成四點以上的獨立群組，地面一處下陷就會讓某一角卸載、對角加載，在橋面產生扭轉。FHWA 手冊建議運輸時至少加上 15% 的自重動態放大，並且不允許暫時超應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「軸線容量與液壓分組」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SPMTs are assembled from six- or four-axle modules, each axle line with a rated capacity, and their suspension is hydraulic: pressures are equal within a hydraulic group, so the fleet can be divided into three groups to form a statically determinate three-point support. Ground undulations or grade changes then merely tilt the span as a whole without forcing it to twist; set up wrongly as four or more independent groups, a dip under one corner unloads it and overloads the diagonal, twisting the deck. The FHWA manual recommends a dynamic allowance of at least 15% on dead load during the move and allows no temporary overstress. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Axle-line capacity and hydraulic grouping” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：橋體 10,000 kN 加臨時支撐 1,000 kN，乘 1.15 動態放大為 12,650 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 10,000 kN span plus 1,000 kN of temporary supports, times 1.15 dynamic allowance, gives 12,650 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「SPMT 軸線越多越安全，群組怎麼分都沒有差別。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More axle lines always make the move safer, and how they are grouped makes no difference." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「軸線容量與液壓分組」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Axle-line capacity and hydraulic grouping”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承
knowledge.titleEn: Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support
knowledge.text: SPMT 由多個六軸或四軸模組拼接，每一軸線有額定承載，懸吊為液壓式：同一液壓群組內各軸壓力相等，因此可以把整組車輛分成三個液壓群組，形成靜定的三點支承。這樣地面起伏或坡度變化只讓橋體整體傾斜，不會強迫橋體扭曲；若誤設成四點以上的獨立群組，地面一處下陷就會讓某一角卸載、對角加載，在橋面產生扭轉。
knowledge.textEn: SPMTs are assembled from six- or four-axle modules, each axle line with a rated capacity, and their suspension is hydraulic: pressures are equal within a hydraulic group, so the fleet can be divided into three groups to form a statically determinate three-point support. Ground undulations or grade changes then merely tilt the span as a whole without forcing it to twist; set up wrongly as four or more independent groups, a dip under one corner unloads it and overloads the diagonal, twisting the deck.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：SPMT 軸線越多越安全，群組怎麼分都沒有差別。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More axle lines always make the move safer, and how they are grouped makes no difference. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support" is correct?
options: SPMT 軸線越多越安全，群組怎麼分都沒有差別。
臨時支撐塔只承受垂直力，行駛時的水平力很小可以忽略。
SPMT 由多個六軸或四軸模組拼接，每一軸線有額定承載，懸吊為液壓式：同一液壓群組內各軸壓力相等，因此可以把整組車輛分成三個液壓群組，形成靜定的三點支承。
optionsEn: More axle lines always make the move safer, and how they are grouped makes no difference.
Temporary towers carry only vertical load; horizontal forces during travel are negligible.

SPMTs are assembled from six- or four-axle modules, each axle line with a rated capacity, and their suspension is hydraulic: pressures are equal within a hydraulic group, so the fleet can be divided into three groups to form a statically determinate three-point support.
quiz.explanation: SPMT 由多個六軸或四軸模組拼接，每一軸線有額定承載，懸吊為液壓式：同一液壓群組內各軸壓力相等，因此可以把整組車輛分成三個液壓群組，形成靜定的三點支承。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: SPMTs are assembled from six- or four-axle modules, each axle line with a rated capacity, and their suspension is hydraulic: pressures are equal within a hydraulic group, so the fleet can be divided into three groups to form a statically determinate three-point support. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軸線容量與液壓分組」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Axle-line capacity and hydraulic grouping” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橋體 10,000 kN 加臨時支撐 1,000 kN，乘 1.15 動態放大為 12,650 kN。FHWA 手冊所列每軸線約 24 至 30 t，取保守 24 t ≈ 235 kN：需 12,650/235 ≈ 54 軸線；若利用率限 80%，需 54/0.8 ≈ 68 軸線，可用 12 組六軸模組共 72 軸線。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 10,000 kN span plus 1,000 kN of temporary supports, times 1.15 dynamic allowance, gives 12,650 kN. Taking the conservative end of the FHWA range of about 24 to 30 t per axle line, 24 t ≈ 235 kN, needs 12,650/235 ≈ 54 axle lines; limiting utilisation to 80% needs 54/0.8 ≈ 68, provided by 12 six-axle modules with 72 axle lines. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：運輸商的配置計算須列出每一群組的軸線數、群組合力位置與橋體重心的關係、每軸線荷載與利用率；頂升時以各群組液壓讀值反算實際重量與重心，與計算值比較（例如差異超過 5% 即停止查明）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The transporter's layout calculation must list axle lines per group, the relation between group resultants and the span's centre of gravity, and load and utilisation per axle line; at lift-off, back-calculate actual weight and centre of gravity from group pressures and compare with calculation, stopping to investigate if they differ by more than, for example, 5%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 橋體 10,000 kN 加臨時支撐 1,000 kN，乘 1.15 動態放大為 12,650 kN。FHWA 手冊所列每軸線約 24 至 30 t，取保守 24 t ≈ 235 kN：需 12,650/235 ≈ 54 軸線；若利用率限 80%，需 54/0.8 ≈ 68 軸線，可用 12 組六軸模組共 72 軸線。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 10,000 kN span plus 1,000 kN of temporary supports, times 1.15 dynamic allowance, gives 12,650 kN. Taking the conservative end of the FHWA range of about 24 to 30 t per axle line, 24 t ≈ 235 kN, needs 12,650/235 ≈ 54 axle lines; limiting utilisation to 80% needs 54/0.8 ≈ 68, provided by 12 six-axle modules with 72 axle lines. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support", which statement holds?
options: 橋體 10,000 kN 加臨時支撐 1,000 kN，乘 1.15 動態放大為 12,650 kN。
只要 SPMT 能在幾十分鐘內移動橋梁，整個換橋工程就一定能在幾小時內完成。
運輸車有自動調平系統，所以橋體在運輸中不會受到額外應力。
optionsEn: A 10,000 kN span plus 1,000 kN of temporary supports, times 1.15 dynamic allowance, gives 12,650 kN.
If SPMTs can move a span in tens of minutes, the whole replacement must finish within hours.
Because transporters self-level, the span sees no extra stress during the move.
quiz.explanation: 橋體 10,000 kN 加臨時支撐 1,000 kN，乘 1.15 動態放大為 12,650 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 10,000 kN span plus 1,000 kN of temporary supports, times 1.15 dynamic allowance, gives 12,650 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軸線容量與液壓分組」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Axle-line capacity and hydraulic grouping” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 運輸商的配置計算須列出每一群組的軸線數、群組合力位置與橋體重心的關係、每軸線荷載與利用率；頂升時以各群組液壓讀值反算實際重量與重心，與計算值比較（例如差異超過 5% 即停止查明）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The transporter's layout calculation must list axle lines per group, the relation between group resultants and the span's centre of gravity, and load and utilisation per axle line; at lift-off, back-calculate actual weight and centre of gravity from group pressures and compare with calculation, stopping to investigate if they differ by more than, for example, 5%. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：運輸前以實際稱重或液壓讀值確認橋體重量與重心，群組設定與利用率上限由運輸工程師簽認並經設計單位確認；任何臨時增加的材料都必須登記並重算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before the move, confirm span weight and centre of gravity by weighing or hydraulic readings; the group configuration and utilisation limit are signed by the transport engineer and confirmed by the designer, and any added material is logged and recalculated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：橋體實際重量因額外鋪面、護欄或臨時材料超出估算，軸線利用率超過額定值，輪胎或懸吊在行駛中失效；液壓群組設定錯誤造成四點支承，經過路面坡度轉折時橋面扭轉開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extra surfacing, barriers or temporary materials push the real weight above the estimate, exceeding axle-line ratings so tyres or suspension fail en route; wrongly configured hydraulic groups create four-point support that twists and cracks the deck at a grade break. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 運輸商的配置計算須列出每一群組的軸線數、群組合力位置與橋體重心的關係、每軸線荷載與利用率；頂升時以各群組液壓讀值反算實際重量與重心，與計算值比較（例如差異超過 5% 即停止查明）。
knowledge.textEn: The transporter's layout calculation must list axle lines per group, the relation between group resultants and the span's centre of gravity, and load and utilisation per axle line; at lift-off, back-calculate actual weight and centre of gravity from group pressures and compare with calculation, stopping to investigate if they differ by more than, for example, 5%.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 運輸前以實際稱重或液壓讀值確認橋體重量與重心，群組設定與利用率上限由運輸工程師簽認並經設計單位確認；任何臨時增加的材料都必須登記並重算。
knowledge.textEn: Before the move, confirm span weight and centre of gravity by weighing or hydraulic readings; the group configuration and utilisation limit are signed by the transport engineer and confirmed by the designer, and any added material is logged and recalculated.

quiz.question: 要驗證「軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
運輸商的配置計算須列出每一群組的軸線數、群組合力位置與橋體重心的關係、每軸線荷載與利用率。
SPMT 換橋只是換上部結構，下部結構可以照舊不必評估。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
The transporter's layout calculation must list axle lines per group, the relation between group resultants and the span's centre of gravity, and load and utilisation per axle line.
An SPMT replacement only swaps the superstructure, so the substructure needs no assessment.
quiz.explanation: 運輸商的配置計算須列出每一群組的軸線數、群組合力位置與橋體重心的關係、每軸線荷載與利用率；頂升時以各群組液壓讀值反算實際重量與重心，與計算值比較（例如差異超過 5% 即停止查明）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The transporter's layout calculation must list axle lines per group, the relation between group resultants and the span's centre of gravity, and load and utilisation per axle line; at lift-off, back-calculate actual weight and centre of gravity from group pressures and compare with calculation, stopping to investigate if they differ by more than, for example, 5%. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「軸線容量與液壓分組」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Axle-line capacity and hydraulic grouping” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 橋體實際重量因額外鋪面、護欄或臨時材料超出估算，軸線利用率超過額定值，輪胎或懸吊在行駛中失效；液壓群組設定錯誤造成四點支承，經過路面坡度轉折時橋面扭轉開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extra surfacing, barriers or temporary materials push the real weight above the estimate, exceeding axle-line ratings so tyres or suspension fail en route; wrongly configured hydraulic groups create four-point support that twists and cracks the deck at a grade break. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：FHWA 手冊建議運輸時至少加上 15% 的自重動態放大，並且不允許暫時超應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The FHWA manual recommends a dynamic allowance of at least 15% on dead load during the move and allows no temporary overstress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「SPMT 軸線越多越安全，群組怎麼分都沒有差別。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More axle lines always make the move safer, and how they are grouped makes no difference." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 橋體實際重量因額外鋪面、護欄或臨時材料超出估算，軸線利用率超過額定值，輪胎或懸吊在行駛中失效；液壓群組設定錯誤造成四點支承，經過路面坡度轉折時橋面扭轉開裂。
knowledge.textEn: Extra surfacing, barriers or temporary materials push the real weight above the estimate, exceeding axle-line ratings so tyres or suspension fail en route; wrongly configured hydraulic groups create four-point support that twists and cracks the deck at a grade break.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「軸線數量、動態放大與三點支承」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Axle lines, dynamic allowance and three-point support" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
臨時支撐塔只承受垂直力，行駛時的水平力很小可以忽略。
橋體實際重量因額外鋪面、護欄或臨時材料超出估算，軸線利用率超過額定值，輪胎或懸吊在行駛中失效；液壓群組設定錯誤造成四點支承，經過路面坡度轉折時橋面扭轉開裂。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Temporary towers carry only vertical load; horizontal forces during travel are negligible.
Extra surfacing, barriers or temporary materials push the real weight above the estimate, exceeding axle-line ratings so tyres or suspension fail en route.
quiz.explanation: 橋體實際重量因額外鋪面、護欄或臨時材料超出估算，軸線利用率超過額定值，輪胎或懸吊在行駛中失效；液壓群組設定錯誤造成四點支承，經過路面坡度轉折時橋面扭轉開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extra surfacing, barriers or temporary materials push the real weight above the estimate, exceeding axle-line ratings so tyres or suspension fail en route; wrongly configured hydraulic groups create four-point support that twists and cracks the deck at a grade break. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓」與「行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing" and "Travel path, ground bearing and buried services": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「運輸車上的臨時支撐塔」如何影響自行式模組運輸車換橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary towers on the transporters” governs force, deformation or durability in “SPMT bridge replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋梁支承面通常比運輸車平台高出數公尺，所以運輸車上要架設臨時支撐塔或疊木，把橋體頂到所需高度。這些支撐塔在行駛中承受加速、煞車、坡度與轉向造成的水平力，又坐在會微小起伏的液壓平台上，橫向穩定與塔頂和梁底的接觸都必須設計：接觸點應對準橫隔梁或腹板，並以墊板分散壓力；塔身需交叉斜撐，塔頂與梁體要有防滑與限位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「運輸車上的臨時支撐塔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bridge seats are usually several metres above the transporter decks, so temporary towers or cribbing on the transporters raise the span to the required height. During travel these towers take horizontal forces from acceleration, braking, grade and steering while standing on hydraulic platforms that move slightly, so their lateral stability and the contact between tower head and girder must be designed: contact points should align with diaphragms or webs with spreader plates, towers need cross-bracing, and the head needs anti-slip and restraint devices against the span. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temporary towers on the transporters” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a tower load P = 2,750 kN, height 6 m and a horizontal coefficient of 0.07 from a 2% grade plus 0.05g braking, H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN and the overturning moment at the base is 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m; a 3 m base gives a restoring moment of 2,750×1.5 = 4,125 kN·m, a factor of 4,125/1,155 ≈ 3.6.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臨時支撐塔只承受垂直力，行駛時的水平力很小可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Temporary towers carry only vertical load; horizontal forces during travel are negligible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「運輸車上的臨時支撐塔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Temporary towers on the transporters”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓
knowledge.titleEn: Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing
knowledge.text: 橋梁支承面通常比運輸車平台高出數公尺，所以運輸車上要架設臨時支撐塔或疊木，把橋體頂到所需高度。這些支撐塔在行駛中承受加速、煞車、坡度與轉向造成的水平力，又坐在會微小起伏的液壓平台上，橫向穩定與塔頂和梁底的接觸都必須設計：接觸點應對準橫隔梁或腹板，並以墊板分散壓力；塔身需交叉斜撐，塔頂與梁體要有防滑與限位。
knowledge.textEn: Bridge seats are usually several metres above the transporter decks, so temporary towers or cribbing on the transporters raise the span to the required height. During travel these towers take horizontal forces from acceleration, braking, grade and steering while standing on hydraulic platforms that move slightly, so their lateral stability and the contact between tower head and girder must be designed: contact points should align with diaphragms or webs with spreader plates, towers need cross-bracing, and the head needs anti-slip and restraint devices against the span.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：臨時支撐塔只承受垂直力，行駛時的水平力很小可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Temporary towers carry only vertical load; horizontal forces during travel are negligible. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing" is correct?
options: 橋梁支承面通常比運輸車平台高出數公尺，所以運輸車上要架設臨時支撐塔或疊木，把橋體頂到所需高度。
臨時支撐塔只承受垂直力，行駛時的水平力很小可以忽略。
SPMT 輪胎很多、接地壓力低，所以不需要檢查行駛路徑的地盤。
optionsEn: Bridge seats are usually several metres above the transporter decks, so temporary towers or cribbing on the transporters raise the span to the required height.
Temporary towers carry only vertical load; horizontal forces during travel are negligible.
With so many tyres and low contact pressure, an SPMT route needs no ground checks.
quiz.explanation: 橋梁支承面通常比運輸車平台高出數公尺，所以運輸車上要架設臨時支撐塔或疊木，把橋體頂到所需高度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bridge seats are usually several metres above the transporter decks, so temporary towers or cribbing on the transporters raise the span to the required height. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「運輸車上的臨時支撐塔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temporary towers on the transporters” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單塔垂直力 P = 2,750 kN、高 6 m，坡度 2% 加煞車 0.05g 的水平係數 0.07：H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN，塔底傾覆彎矩 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m；塔底寬 3 m 的抵抗彎矩 2,750×1.5 = 4,125 kN·m，安全係數 4,125/1,155 ≈ 3.6。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a tower load P = 2,750 kN, height 6 m and a horizontal coefficient of 0.07 from a 2% grade plus 0.05g braking, H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN and the overturning moment at the base is 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m; a 3 m base gives a restoring moment of 2,750×1.5 = 4,125 kN·m, a factor of 4,125/1,155 ≈ 3.6. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：臨時支撐塔須有設計計算與製作圖，組立後檢查斜撐、螺栓與焊縫，並量測塔頂高程與垂直度；橋體頂升初期以小量頂起暫停，檢查接觸點是否均勻受壓、墊板有無偏移，再繼續頂升。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Temporary towers need design calculations and shop drawings; after erection check bracing, bolts and welds and survey head levels and plumbness; at the start of lifting, raise a little and pause to confirm contact points bear evenly and spreader plates have not shifted before continuing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單塔垂直力 P = 2,750 kN、高 6 m，坡度 2% 加煞車 0.05g 的水平係數 0.07：H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN，塔底傾覆彎矩 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m；塔底寬 3 m 的抵抗彎矩 2,750×1.5 = 4,125 kN·m，安全係數 4,125/1,155 ≈ 3.6。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a tower load P = 2,750 kN, height 6 m and a horizontal coefficient of 0.07 from a 2% grade plus 0.05g braking, H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN and the overturning moment at the base is 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m; a 3 m base gives a restoring moment of 2,750×1.5 = 4,125 kN·m, a factor of 4,125/1,155 ≈ 3.6. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing", which statement holds?
options: SPMT 的升降行程很大，落梁時不需要預先計算行程與撓度。
單塔垂直力 P = 2,750 kN、高 6 m，坡度 2% 加煞車 0.05g 的水平係數 0.07：H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN，塔底傾覆彎矩 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m。
地質報告合格就代表行駛路徑一定能承受運輸荷載。
optionsEn: SPMT lift range is so large that set-down needs no stroke or deflection calculation.

With a tower load P = 2,750 kN, height 6 m and a horizontal coefficient of 0.07 from a 2% grade plus 0.05g braking, H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN and the overturning moment at the base is 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m.
A satisfactory geotechnical report guarantees the route can take the transport load.
quiz.explanation: 單塔垂直力 P = 2,750 kN、高 6 m，坡度 2% 加煞車 0.05g 的水平係數 0.07：H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN，塔底傾覆彎矩 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m；塔底寬 3 m 的抵抗彎矩 2,750×1.5 = 4,125 kN·m，安全係數 4,125/1,155 ≈ 3.6。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a tower load P = 2,750 kN, height 6 m and a horizontal coefficient of 0.07 from a 2% grade plus 0.05g braking, H = 0.07×2,750 ≈ 193 kN and the overturning moment at the base is 193×6 ≈ 1,155 kN·m; a 3 m base gives a restoring moment of 2,750×1.5 = 4,125 kN·m, a factor of 4,125/1,155 ≈ 3.6. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「運輸車上的臨時支撐塔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temporary towers on the transporters” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 臨時支撐塔須有設計計算與製作圖，組立後檢查斜撐、螺栓與焊縫，並量測塔頂高程與垂直度；橋體頂升初期以小量頂起暫停，檢查接觸點是否均勻受壓、墊板有無偏移，再繼續頂升。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Temporary towers need design calculations and shop drawings; after erection check bracing, bolts and welds and survey head levels and plumbness; at the start of lifting, raise a little and pause to confirm contact points bear evenly and spreader plates have not shifted before continuing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：臨時支撐塔與梁體連接細部屬於停留點，須由專業技師設計簽認並在頂升前檢查；行駛速度、轉向半徑與緊急煞車程序寫入運輸計畫，並與支撐塔設計採用的水平係數一致。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Temporary towers and their connection to the span are a hold point, designed and signed by a qualified engineer and inspected before lifting; travel speed, turning radius and emergency braking procedures go into the transport plan consistent with the horizontal coefficient used for the towers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支撐塔沒有足夠斜撐，在轉彎或緊急煞車時側傾，橋體滑落；接觸點偏離橫隔梁，梁底翼板或鋼梁下翼板在集中力下局部破壞，被迫中止運輸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Under-braced towers lean over during a turn or emergency stop and the span slides off; contact points away from diaphragms crush the soffit flange or buckle a steel bottom flange locally, forcing the move to stop. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 臨時支撐塔須有設計計算與製作圖，組立後檢查斜撐、螺栓與焊縫，並量測塔頂高程與垂直度；橋體頂升初期以小量頂起暫停，檢查接觸點是否均勻受壓、墊板有無偏移，再繼續頂升。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary towers need design calculations and shop drawings; after erection check bracing, bolts and welds and survey head levels and plumbness; at the start of lifting, raise a little and pause to confirm contact points bear evenly and spreader plates have not shifted before continuing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 臨時支撐塔與梁體連接細部屬於停留點，須由專業技師設計簽認並在頂升前檢查；行駛速度、轉向半徑與緊急煞車程序寫入運輸計畫，並與支撐塔設計採用的水平係數一致。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary towers and their connection to the span are a hold point, designed and signed by a qualified engineer and inspected before lifting; travel speed, turning radius and emergency braking procedures go into the transport plan consistent with the horizontal coefficient used for the towers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
新橋就位、恢復通車之後，運輸階段的資料就沒有保存價值。
臨時支撐塔須有設計計算與製作圖，組立後檢查斜撐、螺栓與焊縫，並量測塔頂高程與垂直度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once the new span is set and traffic resumes, transport-stage data are no longer worth keeping.
Temporary towers need design calculations and shop drawings.
quiz.explanation: 臨時支撐塔須有設計計算與製作圖，組立後檢查斜撐、螺栓與焊縫，並量測塔頂高程與垂直度；橋體頂升初期以小量頂起暫停，檢查接觸點是否均勻受壓、墊板有無偏移，再繼續頂升。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Temporary towers need design calculations and shop drawings; after erection check bracing, bolts and welds and survey head levels and plumbness; at the start of lifting, raise a little and pause to confirm contact points bear evenly and spreader plates have not shifted before continuing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「運輸車上的臨時支撐塔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temporary towers on the transporters” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支撐塔沒有足夠斜撐，在轉彎或緊急煞車時側傾，橋體滑落；接觸點偏離橫隔梁，梁底翼板或鋼梁下翼板在集中力下局部破壞，被迫中止運輸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Under-braced towers lean over during a turn or emergency stop and the span slides off; contact points away from diaphragms crush the soffit flange or buckle a steel bottom flange locally, forcing the move to stop. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這些支撐塔在行駛中承受加速、煞車、坡度與轉向造成的水平力，又坐在會微小起伏的液壓平台上，橫向穩定與塔頂和梁底的接觸都必須設計：接觸點應對準橫隔梁或腹板，並以墊板分散壓力；塔身需交叉斜撐，塔頂與梁體要有防滑與限位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: During travel these towers take horizontal forces from acceleration, braking, grade and steering while standing on hydraulic platforms that move slightly, so their lateral stability and the contact between tower head and girder must be designed: contact points should align with diaphragms or webs with spreader plates, towers need cross-bracing, and the head needs anti-slip and restraint devices against the span.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「臨時支撐塔只承受垂直力，行駛時的水平力很小可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Temporary towers carry only vertical load; horizontal forces during travel are negligible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支撐塔沒有足夠斜撐，在轉彎或緊急煞車時側傾，橋體滑落；接觸點偏離橫隔梁，梁底翼板或鋼梁下翼板在集中力下局部破壞，被迫中止運輸。
knowledge.textEn: Under-braced towers lean over during a turn or emergency stop and the span slides off; contact points away from diaphragms crush the soffit flange or buckle a steel bottom flange locally, forcing the move to stop.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「臨時支撐塔、橫向穩定與局部承壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temporary towers, lateral stability and local bearing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 支撐塔沒有足夠斜撐，在轉彎或緊急煞車時側傾，橋體滑落；接觸點偏離橫隔梁，梁底翼板或鋼梁下翼板在集中力下局部破壞，被迫中止運輸。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
SPMT 輪胎很多、接地壓力低，所以不需要檢查行駛路徑的地盤。
optionsEn: Under-braced towers lean over during a turn or emergency stop and the span slides off.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
With so many tyres and low contact pressure, an SPMT route needs no ground checks.
quiz.explanation: 支撐塔沒有足夠斜撐，在轉彎或緊急煞車時側傾，橋體滑落；接觸點偏離橫隔梁，梁底翼板或鋼梁下翼板在集中力下局部破壞，被迫中止運輸。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Under-braced towers lean over during a turn or emergency stop and the span slides off; contact points away from diaphragms crush the soffit flange or buckle a steel bottom flange locally, forcing the move to stop. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Travel path, ground bearing and buried services: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「行駛路徑地盤承載」如何影響自行式模組運輸車換橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Travel-path ground bearing” governs force, deformation or durability in “SPMT bridge replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: SPMT 把數千噸的力量分散在大量輪胎上，每一軸線的接地壓力不高，但整個車隊下方的地盤承受大面積、長時間的荷載，地面的沉陷差會讓橋體傾斜，局部軟弱點甚至讓單一軸線陷落。FHWA 手冊指出每一軸線最大接地壓力約為每平方英尺 1,500 至 2,000 磅，車輛可吸收約 18 吋的地面起伏、爬升約 8% 的坡度。行駛路徑下方的箱涵、管線與擋土牆必須逐一檢核，路面還要有足夠平整度與排水，避免雨水使路基軟化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「行駛路徑地盤承載」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SPMTs spread thousands of tonnes over many tyres, so pressure under each axle line is modest, but the ground beneath the whole fleet carries a large area for a long time; differential settlement tilts the span and a local soft spot can sink a single axle line. The FHWA manual gives a maximum ground pressure per axle line of about 1,500 to 2,000 pounds per square foot, with surface variations of about 18 inches and grades of about 8% manageable by the vehicles. Culverts, utilities and retaining walls under the travel path must each be checked, and the surface needs enough flatness and drainage so rain does not soften the subgrade. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Travel-path ground bearing” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每軸線 235 kN、輪組占地 2.43 m × 1.5 m = 3.65 m²：接地壓力 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa（約 1,350 psf），在 FHWA 所列範圍下限附近。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For 235 kN per axle line on a 2.43 m × 1.5 m footprint of 3.65 m², ground pressure is 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa (about 1,350 psf), near the lower end of the FHWA range.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「SPMT 輪胎很多、接地壓力低，所以不需要檢查行駛路徑的地盤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With so many tyres and low contact pressure, an SPMT route needs no ground checks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「行駛路徑地盤承載」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Travel-path ground bearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線
knowledge.titleEn: Travel path, ground bearing and buried services
knowledge.text: SPMT 把數千噸的力量分散在大量輪胎上，每一軸線的接地壓力不高，但整個車隊下方的地盤承受大面積、長時間的荷載，地面的沉陷差會讓橋體傾斜，局部軟弱點甚至讓單一軸線陷落。FHWA 手冊指出每一軸線最大接地壓力約為每平方英尺 1,500 至 2,000 磅，車輛可吸收約 18 吋的地面起伏、爬升約 8% 的坡度。
knowledge.textEn: SPMTs spread thousands of tonnes over many tyres, so pressure under each axle line is modest, but the ground beneath the whole fleet carries a large area for a long time; differential settlement tilts the span and a local soft spot can sink a single axle line. The FHWA manual gives a maximum ground pressure per axle line of about 1,500 to 2,000 pounds per square foot, with surface variations of about 18 inches and grades of about 8% manageable by the vehicles.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：SPMT 輪胎很多、接地壓力低，所以不需要檢查行駛路徑的地盤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With so many tyres and low contact pressure, an SPMT route needs no ground checks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Travel path, ground bearing and buried services" is correct?
options: SPMT 輪胎很多、接地壓力低，所以不需要檢查行駛路徑的地盤。
SPMT 把數千噸的力量分散在大量輪胎上，每一軸線的接地壓力不高，但整個車隊下方的地盤承受大面積、長時間的荷載，地面的沉陷差會讓橋體傾斜，局部軟弱點甚至讓單一軸線陷落。
只要 SPMT 能在幾十分鐘內移動橋梁，整個換橋工程就一定能在幾小時內完成。
optionsEn: With so many tyres and low contact pressure, an SPMT route needs no ground checks.
SPMTs spread thousands of tonnes over many tyres, so pressure under each axle line is modest, but the ground beneath the whole fleet carries a large area for a long time.
If SPMTs can move a span in tens of minutes, the whole replacement must finish within hours.
quiz.explanation: SPMT 把數千噸的力量分散在大量輪胎上，每一軸線的接地壓力不高，但整個車隊下方的地盤承受大面積、長時間的荷載，地面的沉陷差會讓橋體傾斜，局部軟弱點甚至讓單一軸線陷落。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: SPMTs spread thousands of tonnes over many tyres, so pressure under each axle line is modest, but the ground beneath the whole fleet carries a large area for a long time; differential settlement tilts the span and a local soft spot can sink a single axle line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Travel path, ground bearing and buried services: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「行駛路徑地盤承載」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Travel-path ground bearing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每軸線 235 kN、輪組占地 2.43 m × 1.5 m = 3.65 m²：接地壓力 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa（約 1,350 psf），在 FHWA 所列範圍下限附近。以 2:1 擴散至 1.5 m 深，單軸線下方應力約 235/[(2.43 + 1.5)×(1.5 + 1.5)] ≈ 20 kPa，但相鄰軸線重疊時應以整個車隊面積檢核。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For 235 kN per axle line on a 2.43 m × 1.5 m footprint of 3.65 m², ground pressure is 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa (about 1,350 psf), near the lower end of the FHWA range. Spreading 2:1 to 1.5 m depth gives about 235/[(2.43 + 1.5)×(1.5 + 1.5)] ≈ 20 kPa under a single line, but overlapping adjacent lines mean the check must use the whole fleet footprint. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以鑽探、平鈑載重試驗或動態圓錐貫入試驗確認行駛路徑承載，調查並標示所有地下管線與結構物；必要時以鋼板、級配層或臨時路面加強，並在路徑上設測點，預壓後量測沉陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm bearing along the path by borings, plate-load tests or dynamic cone penetration, survey and mark all buried services and structures, strengthen with steel plates, granular layers or temporary paving where needed, and set survey points on the path to measure settlement after proof loading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每軸線 235 kN、輪組占地 2.43 m × 1.5 m = 3.65 m²：接地壓力 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa（約 1,350 psf），在 FHWA 所列範圍下限附近。以 2:1 擴散至 1.5 m 深，單軸線下方應力約 235/[(2.43 + 1.5)×(1.5 + 1.5)] ≈ 20 kPa，但相鄰軸線重疊時應以整個車隊面積檢核。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For 235 kN per axle line on a 2.43 m × 1.5 m footprint of 3.65 m², ground pressure is 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa (about 1,350 psf), near the lower end of the FHWA range. Spreading 2:1 to 1.5 m depth gives about 235/[(2.43 + 1.5)×(1.5 + 1.5)] ≈ 20 kPa under a single line, but overlapping adjacent lines mean the check must use the whole fleet footprint. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Travel path, ground bearing and buried services", which statement holds?
options: 運輸車有自動調平系統，所以橋體在運輸中不會受到額外應力。
SPMT 換橋只是換上部結構，下部結構可以照舊不必評估。
每軸線 235 kN、輪組占地 2.43 m × 1.5 m = 3.65 m²：接地壓力 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa（約 1,350 psf），在 FHWA 所列範圍下限附近。
optionsEn: Because transporters self-level, the span sees no extra stress during the move.
An SPMT replacement only swaps the superstructure, so the substructure needs no assessment.
For 235 kN per axle line on a 2.43 m × 1.5 m footprint of 3.65 m², ground pressure is 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa (about 1,350 psf), near the lower end of the FHWA range.
quiz.explanation: 每軸線 235 kN、輪組占地 2.43 m × 1.5 m = 3.65 m²：接地壓力 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa（約 1,350 psf），在 FHWA 所列範圍下限附近。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For 235 kN per axle line on a 2.43 m × 1.5 m footprint of 3.65 m², ground pressure is 235/3.65 ≈ 64.6 kPa (about 1,350 psf), near the lower end of the FHWA range. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Travel path, ground bearing and buried services: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「行駛路徑地盤承載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Travel-path ground bearing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以鑽探、平鈑載重試驗或動態圓錐貫入試驗確認行駛路徑承載，調查並標示所有地下管線與結構物；必要時以鋼板、級配層或臨時路面加強，並在路徑上設測點，預壓後量測沉陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm bearing along the path by borings, plate-load tests or dynamic cone penetration, survey and mark all buried services and structures, strengthen with steel plates, granular layers or temporary paving where needed, and set survey points on the path to measure settlement after proof loading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：行駛路徑設計須包括地盤調查、地下設施清單與保護措施、平整度與排水要求，並在運輸前一天做最後巡查；天候不佳時依事先訂定的條件延期，而不是冒險移動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The travel-path design must include ground investigation, a buried-services register with protection measures, and flatness and drainage requirements, with a final walk-down the day before; in bad weather postpone by pre-agreed criteria instead of risking the move.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未調查的地下排水箱涵在車隊通過時壓垮，單側軸線下陷，橋體大幅傾斜；雨後路基軟化使車輛液壓行程用盡，橋體被迫停在路中央，延長封閉時間並造成橋體受扭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An unrecorded drainage culvert collapses under the fleet and one side drops, tilting the span sharply; a subgrade softened by rain exhausts the hydraulic stroke and leaves the span stranded mid-route, extending the closure and twisting the span. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以鑽探、平鈑載重試驗或動態圓錐貫入試驗確認行駛路徑承載，調查並標示所有地下管線與結構物；必要時以鋼板、級配層或臨時路面加強，並在路徑上設測點，預壓後量測沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm bearing along the path by borings, plate-load tests or dynamic cone penetration, survey and mark all buried services and structures, strengthen with steel plates, granular layers or temporary paving where needed, and set survey points on the path to measure settlement after proof loading.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 行駛路徑設計須包括地盤調查、地下設施清單與保護措施、平整度與排水要求，並在運輸前一天做最後巡查；天候不佳時依事先訂定的條件延期，而不是冒險移動。
knowledge.textEn: The travel-path design must include ground investigation, a buried-services register with protection measures, and flatness and drainage requirements, with a final walk-down the day before; in bad weather postpone by pre-agreed criteria instead of risking the move.

quiz.question: 要驗證「行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Travel path, ground bearing and buried services"?
options: 以鑽探、平鈑載重試驗或動態圓錐貫入試驗確認行駛路徑承載，調查並標示所有地下管線與結構物；必要時以鋼板、級配層或臨時路面加強，並在路徑上設測點，預壓後量測沉陷。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
運輸車在梁下任何位置頂起都可以，只要總重不超過車輛容量。
optionsEn: Confirm bearing along the path by borings, plate-load tests or dynamic cone penetration, survey and mark all buried services and structures, strengthen with steel plates, granular layers or temporary paving where needed, and set survey points on the path to measure settlement after proof loading.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Transporters may lift a span anywhere along its length as long as total weight is within capacity.
quiz.explanation: 以鑽探、平鈑載重試驗或動態圓錐貫入試驗確認行駛路徑承載，調查並標示所有地下管線與結構物；必要時以鋼板、級配層或臨時路面加強，並在路徑上設測點，預壓後量測沉陷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm bearing along the path by borings, plate-load tests or dynamic cone penetration, survey and mark all buried services and structures, strengthen with steel plates, granular layers or temporary paving where needed, and set survey points on the path to measure settlement after proof loading. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Travel path, ground bearing and buried services: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「行駛路徑地盤承載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Travel-path ground bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未調查的地下排水箱涵在車隊通過時壓垮，單側軸線下陷，橋體大幅傾斜；雨後路基軟化使車輛液壓行程用盡，橋體被迫停在路中央，延長封閉時間並造成橋體受扭。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An unrecorded drainage culvert collapses under the fleet and one side drops, tilting the span sharply; a subgrade softened by rain exhausts the hydraulic stroke and leaves the span stranded mid-route, extending the closure and twisting the span. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：行駛路徑下方的箱涵、管線與擋土牆必須逐一檢核，路面還要有足夠平整度與排水，避免雨水使路基軟化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Culverts, utilities and retaining walls under the travel path must each be checked, and the surface needs enough flatness and drainage so rain does not soften the subgrade.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「SPMT 輪胎很多、接地壓力低，所以不需要檢查行駛路徑的地盤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With so many tyres and low contact pressure, an SPMT route needs no ground checks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未調查的地下排水箱涵在車隊通過時壓垮，單側軸線下陷，橋體大幅傾斜；雨後路基軟化使車輛液壓行程用盡，橋體被迫停在路中央，延長封閉時間並造成橋體受扭。
knowledge.textEn: An unrecorded drainage culvert collapses under the fleet and one side drops, tilting the span sharply; a subgrade softened by rain exhausts the hydraulic stroke and leaves the span stranded mid-route, extending the closure and twisting the span.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「行駛路徑、地盤承載與地下管線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Travel path, ground bearing and buried services" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
未調查的地下排水箱涵在車隊通過時壓垮，單側軸線下陷，橋體大幅傾斜；雨後路基軟化使車輛液壓行程用盡，橋體被迫停在路中央，延長封閉時間並造成橋體受扭。
只要 SPMT 能在幾十分鐘內移動橋梁，整個換橋工程就一定能在幾小時內完成。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An unrecorded drainage culvert collapses under the fleet and one side drops, tilting the span sharply.
If SPMTs can move a span in tens of minutes, the whole replacement must finish within hours.
quiz.explanation: 未調查的地下排水箱涵在車隊通過時壓垮，單側軸線下陷，橋體大幅傾斜；雨後路基軟化使車輛液壓行程用盡，橋體被迫停在路中央，延長封閉時間並造成橋體受扭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An unrecorded drainage culvert collapses under the fleet and one side drops, tilting the span sharply; a subgrade softened by rain exhausts the hydraulic stroke and leaves the span stranded mid-route, extending the closure and twisting the span. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制」與「液壓行程、落梁與支承對位」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting" and "Hydraulic stroke, set-down and bearing alignment": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「封閉時段時程」如何影響自行式模組運輸車換橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closure-window timeline” governs force, deformation or durability in “SPMT bridge replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: SPMT 換橋的價值在於把現場對交通的影響從數月縮短到數小時或一個週末：新橋在預製區與交通隔離的條件下施工，舊橋在封閉開始後被整跨移走，支承座與台帽在短時間內整修，新橋開到位、落梁，接著完成引道與接縫，最後恢復通車。FHWA 手冊的佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue 案例中，每跨新橋從預製區運到橋位約 30 分鐘，但手冊也提醒，道路與引道工程必須跟上橋梁的速度，否則封閉時間會被非橋梁工項拖長。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「封閉時段時程」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The value of an SPMT replacement lies in shrinking the traffic impact from months to hours or a weekend: the new span is built in a staging area away from traffic, the old span is carried off whole once the closure starts, bearing seats and caps are refurbished quickly, the new span is driven in and set, approaches and joints are completed and traffic resumes. In the FHWA manual's Florida I-4/Graves Avenue case each new span took about 30 minutes to travel from the staging area to the bridge, but the manual also warns that roadwork must keep pace with the bridge or non-bridge items will stretch the closure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Closure-window timeline” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：週末封閉 55 h 的時程預算：舊橋移除 2 h、支承座整修 8 h、新橋運入 1 h、落梁與對位 3 h、引道版與鋪面 20 h，合計 34 h，餘裕 55 − 34 = 21 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 55 h weekend closure budget: old span removal 2 h, bearing-seat repair 8 h, moving in the new span 1 h, set-down and alignment 3 h, approach slabs and paving 20 h, totalling 34 h with 55 − 34 = 21 h of float.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要 SPMT 能在幾十分鐘內移動橋梁，整個換橋工程就一定能在幾小時內完成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If SPMTs can move a span in tens of minutes, the whole replacement must finish within hours." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「封閉時段時程」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Closure-window timeline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制
knowledge.titleEn: Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting

In the FHWA manual's Florida I-4/Graves Avenue case each new span took about 30 minutes to travel from the staging area to the bridge, but the manual also warns that roadwork must keep pace with the bridge or non-bridge items will stretch the closure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要 SPMT 能在幾十分鐘內移動橋梁，整個換橋工程就一定能在幾小時內完成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If SPMTs can move a span in tens of minutes, the whole replacement must finish within hours. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting" is correct?
options: 只要 SPMT 能在幾十分鐘內移動橋梁，整個換橋工程就一定能在幾小時內完成。

steps.title: 預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「封閉時段時程」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closure-window timeline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：週末封閉 55 h 的時程預算：舊橋移除 2 h、支承座整修 8 h、新橋運入 1 h、落梁與對位 3 h、引道版與鋪面 20 h，合計 34 h，餘裕 55 − 34 = 21 h。若引道版改為現場澆置需 36 h，合計 50 h，餘裕只剩 5 h。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 55 h weekend closure budget: old span removal 2 h, bearing-seat repair 8 h, moving in the new span 1 h, set-down and alignment 3 h, approach slabs and paving 20 h, totalling 34 h with 55 − 34 = 21 h of float. If approach slabs are cast in place taking 36 h, the total is 50 h and only 5 h of float remains. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分鐘級時程表演練整個封閉時段，列出每一工項的前置條件、負責人與替代方案；封閉前一週召開準備會議確認設備、人員、材料與天候，封閉期間每小時比對實際進度與計畫，落後超過預設門檻即啟動應變方案。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Rehearse the whole closure with a minute-level schedule listing each activity's prerequisites, owner and fallback; hold a readiness meeting a week before to confirm equipment, crews, materials and weather, and during the closure compare progress with the plan hourly, triggering contingency plans if slippage exceeds a preset threshold.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 週末封閉 55 h 的時程預算：舊橋移除 2 h、支承座整修 8 h、新橋運入 1 h、落梁與對位 3 h、引道版與鋪面 20 h，合計 34 h，餘裕 55 − 34 = 21 h。若引道版改為現場澆置需 36 h，合計 50 h，餘裕只剩 5 h。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 55 h weekend closure budget: old span removal 2 h, bearing-seat repair 8 h, moving in the new span 1 h, set-down and alignment 3 h, approach slabs and paving 20 h, totalling 34 h with 55 − 34 = 21 h of float. If approach slabs are cast in place taking 36 h, the total is 50 h and only 5 h of float remains. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting", which statement holds?

地質報告合格就代表行駛路徑一定能承受運輸荷載。
新橋就位、恢復通車之後，運輸階段的資料就沒有保存價值。
optionsEn: A 55 h weekend closure budget: old span removal 2 h, bearing-seat repair 8 h, moving in the new span 1 h, set-down and alignment 3 h, approach slabs and paving 20 h, totalling 34 h with 55 − 34 = 21 h of float.
A satisfactory geotechnical report guarantees the route can take the transport load.
Once the new span is set and traffic resumes, transport-stage data are no longer worth keeping.
quiz.explanation: 週末封閉 55 h 的時程預算：舊橋移除 2 h、支承座整修 8 h、新橋運入 1 h、落梁與對位 3 h、引道版與鋪面 20 h，合計 34 h，餘裕 55 − 34 = 21 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 55 h weekend closure budget: old span removal 2 h, bearing-seat repair 8 h, moving in the new span 1 h, set-down and alignment 3 h, approach slabs and paving 20 h, totalling 34 h with 55 − 34 = 21 h of float. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「封閉時段時程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closure-window timeline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分鐘級時程表演練整個封閉時段，列出每一工項的前置條件、負責人與替代方案；封閉前一週召開準備會議確認設備、人員、材料與天候，封閉期間每小時比對實際進度與計畫，落後超過預設門檻即啟動應變方案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Rehearse the whole closure with a minute-level schedule listing each activity's prerequisites, owner and fallback; hold a readiness meeting a week before to confirm equipment, crews, materials and weather, and during the closure compare progress with the plan hourly, triggering contingency plans if slippage exceeds a preset threshold. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：合約以封閉時段為核心訂定獎懲，要求承包商事先調查並預修支承座、預製引道版或採用早強材料，並準備備用設備；封閉開始的放行條件（設備、天候、人員）由業主與承包商共同簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Contracts build incentives and penalties around the closure window, require the contractor to investigate and pre-repair bearing seats, prefabricate approach slabs or use rapid-strength materials and keep standby equipment; release to start the closure (equipment, weather, crews) is signed jointly by owner and contractor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：橋梁本身準時就位，但引道版混凝土強度未達或鋪面機具故障，封閉被迫延長，抵銷了 SPMT 換橋的效益；舊橋移除後才發現支承座嚴重劣化，需要的修復時間遠超過預算。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The span itself is set on time, but approach-slab concrete is not strong enough or paving plant breaks down, so the closure overruns and cancels the benefit of the SPMT move; finding severely deteriorated bearing seats only after removing the old span needs repair time far beyond the budget. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以分鐘級時程表演練整個封閉時段，列出每一工項的前置條件、負責人與替代方案。
SPMT 軸線越多越安全，群組怎麼分都沒有差別。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Rehearse the whole closure with a minute-level schedule listing each activity's prerequisites, owner and fallback.
More axle lines always make the move safer, and how they are grouped makes no difference.
quiz.explanation: 以分鐘級時程表演練整個封閉時段，列出每一工項的前置條件、負責人與替代方案；封閉前一週召開準備會議確認設備、人員、材料與天候，封閉期間每小時比對實際進度與計畫，落後超過預設門檻即啟動應變方案。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Rehearse the whole closure with a minute-level schedule listing each activity's prerequisites, owner and fallback; hold a readiness meeting a week before to confirm equipment, crews, materials and weather, and during the closure compare progress with the plan hourly, triggering contingency plans if slippage exceeds a preset threshold. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「封閉時段時程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closure-window timeline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 橋梁本身準時就位，但引道版混凝土強度未達或鋪面機具故障，封閉被迫延長，抵銷了 SPMT 換橋的效益；舊橋移除後才發現支承座嚴重劣化，需要的修復時間遠超過預算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The span itself is set on time, but approach-slab concrete is not strong enough or paving plant breaks down, so the closure overruns and cancels the benefit of the SPMT move; finding severely deteriorated bearing seats only after removing the old span needs repair time far beyond the budget. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：FHWA 手冊的佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue 案例中，每跨新橋從預製區運到橋位約 30 分鐘，但手冊也提醒，道路與引道工程必須跟上橋梁的速度，否則封閉時間會被非橋梁工項拖長。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In the FHWA manual's Florida I-4/Graves Avenue case each new span took about 30 minutes to travel from the staging area to the bridge, but the manual also warns that roadwork must keep pace with the bridge or non-bridge items will stretch the closure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要 SPMT 能在幾十分鐘內移動橋梁，整個換橋工程就一定能在幾小時內完成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If SPMTs can move a span in tens of minutes, the whole replacement must finish within hours." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 橋梁本身準時就位，但引道版混凝土強度未達或鋪面機具故障，封閉被迫延長，抵銷了 SPMT 換橋的效益；舊橋移除後才發現支承座嚴重劣化，需要的修復時間遠超過預算。
knowledge.textEn: The span itself is set on time, but approach-slab concrete is not strong enough or paving plant breaks down, so the closure overruns and cancels the benefit of the SPMT move; finding severely deteriorated bearing seats only after removing the old span needs repair time far beyond the budget.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預製、舊橋移除與新橋就位的時程控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Timeline from prefabrication to removal and setting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
SPMT 的升降行程很大，落梁時不需要預先計算行程與撓度。
橋梁本身準時就位，但引道版混凝土強度未達或鋪面機具故障，封閉被迫延長，抵銷了 SPMT 換橋的效益；舊橋移除後才發現支承座嚴重劣化，需要的修復時間遠超過預算。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
SPMT lift range is so large that set-down needs no stroke or deflection calculation.
The span itself is set on time, but approach-slab concrete is not strong enough or paving plant breaks down, so the closure overruns and cancels the benefit of the SPMT move.
quiz.explanation: 橋梁本身準時就位，但引道版混凝土強度未達或鋪面機具故障，封閉被迫延長，抵銷了 SPMT 換橋的效益；舊橋移除後才發現支承座嚴重劣化，需要的修復時間遠超過預算。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The span itself is set on time, but approach-slab concrete is not strong enough or paving plant breaks down, so the closure overruns and cancels the benefit of the SPMT move; finding severely deteriorated bearing seats only after removing the old span needs repair time far beyond the budget. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 液壓行程、落梁與支承對位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic stroke, set-down and bearing alignment: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「落梁對位與支承墊」如何影響自行式模組運輸車換橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Set-down alignment and bearing pads” governs force, deformation or durability in “SPMT bridge replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: SPMT 以液壓懸吊升降，行程有限：FHWA 手冊指出可用垂直行程至少約 24 吋，作業時宜只假設 16 至 20 吋。這段行程要同時應付頂起時越過支承座的淨空、行駛中的地面起伏，以及落梁時支點由運輸點移到永久支承所造成的撓度改變。落梁時先粗對位，再以液壓微調平面與高程，最後慢慢下降使梁平均坐上支承；任何一個支承懸空或偏壓，都會讓梁體以三點支承並在活載下搖動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「落梁對位與支承墊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SPMTs raise and lower through hydraulic suspension with limited stroke: the FHWA manual gives a minimum available vertical stroke of about 24 inches and advises assuming only 16 to 20 inches in operations. This stroke must cover the clearance over the bearing seats at lift-off, ground undulations on the route, and the change in deflection when support moves from the transport points to the permanent bearings at set-down. Set-down starts with rough alignment, then hydraulic fine adjustment in plan and level, and finally a slow descent so the girders seat evenly; any bearing left unloaded or overloaded leaves the span rocking on three supports under traffic. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Set-down alignment and bearing pads” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：EI = 1.2×10⁸ kN·m²、w = 250 kN/m：支點內縮 3 m 時跨中自重撓度 5wL'⁴/(384EI) − wa²L'²/(16EI) ≈ 34.9 mm，移到 40 m 支承後為 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 69.4 mm，增加約 34.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With EI = 1.2×10⁸ kN·m² and w = 250 kN/m, self-weight midspan deflection with supports 3 m inside the ends is 5wL'⁴/(384EI) − wa²L'²/(16EI) ≈ 34.9 mm, rising to 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 69.4 mm on the 40 m bearings, an increase of about 34.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「SPMT 的升降行程很大，落梁時不需要預先計算行程與撓度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "SPMT lift range is so large that set-down needs no stroke or deflection calculation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「落梁對位與支承墊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Set-down alignment and bearing pads”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 液壓行程、落梁與支承對位
knowledge.titleEn: Hydraulic stroke, set-down and bearing alignment
knowledge.text: SPMT 以液壓懸吊升降，行程有限：FHWA 手冊指出可用垂直行程至少約 24 吋，作業時宜只假設 16 至 20 吋。這段行程要同時應付頂起時越過支承座的淨空、行駛中的地面起伏，以及落梁時支點由運輸點移到永久支承所造成的撓度改變。
knowledge.textEn: SPMTs raise and lower through hydraulic suspension with limited stroke: the FHWA manual gives a minimum available vertical stroke of about 24 inches and advises assuming only 16 to 20 inches in operations. This stroke must cover the clearance over the bearing seats at lift-off, ground undulations on the route, and the change in deflection when support moves from the transport points to the permanent bearings at set-down.
