steps.title: 長構件的吊點位置與吊裝狀態受力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lift-point positions and lifted-state forces in long members: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊裝狀態彎矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bending in the lifted state” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 構件設計者以吊裝計畫的實際吊點與動態放大檢核應力與穩定，必要時規定臨時加勁或側撐；吊裝前在關鍵斷面貼應變計，頂離支架數公分後暫停，比較量測與計算，確認無誤再繼續。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The member designer checks stresses and stability for the actual lift points and dynamic factor in the lift plan, specifying temporary stiffening or bracing if needed; before lifting, gauge critical sections, pause after raising the member a few centimetres off its supports, compare measured and calculated values and proceed only if they agree. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構件施工圖應標示允許吊點範圍、吊裝狀態所需的臨時加勁與最小混凝土強度，吊裝計畫不得超出這些範圍；變更須經構件設計者書面同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Member shop drawings should mark allowed lift-point zones, temporary stiffening required for the lifted state and the minimum concrete strength, and the lift plan must stay within them; changes need the member designer's written consent.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊點被移到構件端部附近以配合吊具，跨中彎矩倍增，預力混凝土主梁底緣開裂或鋼梁下翼板屈服；細長鋼梁未加側撐，吊起後側向扭轉，吊具失衡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Moving lift points near the ends to suit the rigging multiplies midspan moment, cracking a prestressed girder soffit or yielding a steel bottom flange; a slender steel girder without bracing twists laterally once lifted and unbalances the rigging. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 構件設計者以吊裝計畫的實際吊點與動態放大檢核應力與穩定，必要時規定臨時加勁或側撐；吊裝前在關鍵斷面貼應變計，頂離支架數公分後暫停，比較量測與計算，確認無誤再繼續。
knowledge.textEn: The member designer checks stresses and stability for the actual lift points and dynamic factor in the lift plan, specifying temporary stiffening or bracing if needed; before lifting, gauge critical sections, pause after raising the member a few centimetres off its supports, compare measured and calculated values and proceed only if they agree.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 構件施工圖應標示允許吊點範圍、吊裝狀態所需的臨時加勁與最小混凝土強度，吊裝計畫不得超出這些範圍；變更須經構件設計者書面同意。
knowledge.textEn: Member shop drawings should mark allowed lift-point zones, temporary stiffening required for the lifted state and the minimum concrete strength, and the lift plan must stay within them; changes need the member designer's written consent.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長構件的吊點位置與吊裝狀態受力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lift-point positions and lifted-state forces in long members"?
options: 構件設計者以吊裝計畫的實際吊點與動態放大檢核應力與穩定，必要時規定臨時加勁或側撐。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要吊索總容量大於構件重量，吊索角度與長度就無關緊要。
optionsEn: The member designer checks stresses and stability for the actual lift points and dynamic factor in the lift plan, specifying temporary stiffening or bracing if needed.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
As long as total sling capacity exceeds member weight, sling angles and lengths do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 構件設計者以吊裝計畫的實際吊點與動態放大檢核應力與穩定，必要時規定臨時加勁或側撐；吊裝前在關鍵斷面貼應變計，頂離支架數公分後暫停，比較量測與計算，確認無誤再繼續。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The member designer checks stresses and stability for the actual lift points and dynamic factor in the lift plan, specifying temporary stiffening or bracing if needed; before lifting, gauge critical sections, pause after raising the member a few centimetres off its supports, compare measured and calculated values and proceed only if they agree. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長構件的吊點位置與吊裝狀態受力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lift-point positions and lifted-state forces in long members: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊裝狀態彎矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bending in the lifted state” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吊點被移到構件端部附近以配合吊具，跨中彎矩倍增，預力混凝土主梁底緣開裂或鋼梁下翼板屈服；細長鋼梁未加側撐，吊起後側向扭轉，吊具失衡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Moving lift points near the ends to suit the rigging multiplies midspan moment, cracking a prestressed girder soffit or yielding a steel bottom flange; a slender steel girder without bracing twists laterally once lifted and unbalances the rigging. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：細長鋼梁在吊裝時還可能側向扭轉挫屈，必須加臨時側向支撐或採用吊梁使吊點力保持垂直；預力混凝土構件則要檢查吊點處頂緣的拉應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Slender steel girders can also buckle laterally and torsionally while hanging, needing temporary lateral bracing or a spreader beam to keep lift forces vertical, and prestressed concrete members need checks of top-fibre tension at the lift points.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「構件能承受營運荷載，就一定能承受自己的吊裝狀態。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A member that can carry service loads can always carry its own lifting state." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 吊點被移到構件端部附近以配合吊具，跨中彎矩倍增，預力混凝土主梁底緣開裂或鋼梁下翼板屈服；細長鋼梁未加側撐，吊起後側向扭轉，吊具失衡。
knowledge.textEn: Moving lift points near the ends to suit the rigging multiplies midspan moment, cracking a prestressed girder soffit or yielding a steel bottom flange; a slender steel girder without bracing twists laterally once lifted and unbalances the rigging.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長構件的吊點位置與吊裝狀態受力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lift-point positions and lifted-state forces in long members" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
吊點被移到構件端部附近以配合吊具，跨中彎矩倍增，預力混凝土主梁底緣開裂或鋼梁下翼板屈服；細長鋼梁未加側撐，吊起後側向扭轉，吊具失衡。
浮吊很重，水流不可能推動它，所以不必特別錨泊。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Moving lift points near the ends to suit the rigging multiplies midspan moment, cracking a prestressed girder soffit or yielding a steel bottom flange.
A floating crane is so heavy that current cannot move it, so special mooring is unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 吊點被移到構件端部附近以配合吊具，跨中彎矩倍增，預力混凝土主梁底緣開裂或鋼梁下翼板屈服；細長鋼梁未加側撐，吊起後側向扭轉，吊具失衡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Moving lift points near the ends to suit the rigging multiplies midspan moment, cracking a prestressed girder soffit or yielding a steel bottom flange; a slender steel girder without bracing twists laterally once lifted and unbalances the rigging. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「浮吊錨泊、流力與定位」與「落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mooring, current forces and positioning" and "Set-down alignment, tide and draft change": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 浮吊錨泊、流力與定位：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mooring, current forces and positioning: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「浮吊錨泊與定位」如何影響浮吊大型橋段吊裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crane-barge mooring and positioning” governs force, deformation or durability in “Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 浮吊靠近橋墩作業時，需以錨纜、定位樁或動力定位系統保持位置，抵抗潮流、風與波浪的漂移力。船體側向迎流時受力遠大於船首迎流，所以定位方向要配合潮流，並把作業安排在潮流轉向的平潮時段。吊重時船體吃水與傾斜改變，錨纜張力隨之變化；靠近橋墩還要考慮淺水與海底管線，錨的位置與拋錨路徑須事先申請與標示。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「浮吊錨泊與定位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When working beside a pier, a crane barge must hold position with mooring lines, spuds or dynamic positioning against drift forces from current, wind and waves. Beam-on current loads are much larger than bow-on loads, so the vessel is oriented to the current and operations are scheduled around slack water when the tide turns. Lifting changes draft and heel, and mooring tensions change with them; near piers, shallow water and seabed pipelines must be considered, and anchor positions and anchoring paths must be permitted and marked in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Crane-barge mooring and positioning” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：流力 F = ½ρC_dAV²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Current force F = ½ρC_dAV².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮吊很重，水流不可能推動它，所以不必特別錨泊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A floating crane is so heavy that current cannot move it, so special mooring is unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「浮吊錨泊與定位」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Crane-barge mooring and positioning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 浮吊錨泊、流力與定位
knowledge.text: 浮吊靠近橋墩作業時，需以錨纜、定位樁或動力定位系統保持位置，抵抗潮流、風與波浪的漂移力。船體側向迎流時受力遠大於船首迎流，所以定位方向要配合潮流，並把作業安排在潮流轉向的平潮時段。
knowledge.textEn: When working beside a pier, a crane barge must hold position with mooring lines, spuds or dynamic positioning against drift forces from current, wind and waves. Beam-on current loads are much larger than bow-on loads, so the vessel is oriented to the current and operations are scheduled around slack water when the tide turns.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：浮吊很重，水流不可能推動它，所以不必特別錨泊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A floating crane is so heavy that current cannot move it, so special mooring is unnecessary. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「浮吊錨泊、流力與定位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mooring, current forces and positioning" is correct?
options: 浮吊很重，水流不可能推動它，所以不必特別錨泊。
浮吊落位與陸上起重機一樣，只要把吊鉤慢慢放下即可。
浮吊靠近橋墩作業時，需以錨纜、定位樁或動力定位系統保持位置，抵抗潮流、風與波浪的漂移力。
optionsEn: A floating crane is so heavy that current cannot move it, so special mooring is unnecessary.
Setting down with a floating crane is just like a land crane: lower the hook slowly.
When working beside a pier, a crane barge must hold position with mooring lines, spuds or dynamic positioning against drift forces from current, wind and waves.
quiz.explanation: 浮吊靠近橋墩作業時，需以錨纜、定位樁或動力定位系統保持位置，抵抗潮流、風與波浪的漂移力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When working beside a pier, a crane barge must hold position with mooring lines, spuds or dynamic positioning against drift forces from current, wind and waves. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 浮吊錨泊、流力與定位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mooring, current forces and positioning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「浮吊錨泊與定位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crane-barge mooring and positioning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：流力 F = ½ρC_dAV²。ρ = 1,025 kg/m³、C_d = 1.0、流速 1.5 m/s：船首迎流投影面積 30 m × 7 m = 210 m² 時 F ≈ 0.5×1,025×1.0×210×1.5² ≈ 242 kN；側向迎流 117 m × 7 m = 819 m² 時 F ≈ 944 kN，約為船首迎流的 3.9 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Current force F = ½ρC_dAV². With ρ = 1,025 kg/m³, C_d = 1.0 and 1.5 m/s current, a bow-on projected area of 30 m × 7 m = 210 m² gives F ≈ 0.5×1,025×1.0×210×1.5² ≈ 242 kN; beam-on, 117 m × 7 m = 819 m² gives F ≈ 944 kN, about 3.9 times as much. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：錨泊分析須列出各錨纜在設計流速、風速與吊重狀態下的張力，與錨的抓力和纜繩破斷力比較並保留安全係數；作業前確認錨位、測深與海底障礙調查，作業中監測錨纜張力與船位，偏移超過允許值即停止吊裝。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The mooring analysis lists line tensions under design current, wind and lifting conditions, compared with anchor holding capacity and line breaking strength with safety factors; before work confirm anchor positions, soundings and seabed obstruction surveys, and during work monitor line tensions and vessel position, stopping the lift if offset exceeds the limit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 流力 F = ½ρC_dAV²。ρ = 1,025 kg/m³、C_d = 1.0、流速 1.5 m/s：船首迎流投影面積 30 m × 7 m = 210 m² 時 F ≈ 0.5×1,025×1.0×210×1.5² ≈ 242 kN；側向迎流 117 m × 7 m = 819 m² 時 F ≈ 944 kN，約為船首迎流的 3.9 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Current force F = ½ρC_dAV². With ρ = 1,025 kg/m³, C_d = 1.0 and 1.5 m/s current, a bow-on projected area of 30 m × 7 m = 210 m² gives F ≈ 0.5×1,025×1.0×210×1.5² ≈ 242 kN; beam-on, 117 m × 7 m = 819 m² gives F ≈ 944 kN, about 3.9 times as much. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「浮吊錨泊、流力與定位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mooring, current forces and positioning", which statement holds?
options: 流力 F = ½ρC_dAV²。
只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。
吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。
optionsEn: Current force F = ½ρC_dAV².
If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe.
A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure.
quiz.explanation: 流力 F = ½ρC_dAV²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Current force F = ½ρC_dAV². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 浮吊錨泊、流力與定位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mooring, current forces and positioning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「浮吊錨泊與定位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crane-barge mooring and positioning” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 錨泊分析須列出各錨纜在設計流速、風速與吊重狀態下的張力，與錨的抓力和纜繩破斷力比較並保留安全係數；作業前確認錨位、測深與海底障礙調查，作業中監測錨纜張力與船位，偏移超過允許值即停止吊裝。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The mooring analysis lists line tensions under design current, wind and lifting conditions, compared with anchor holding capacity and line breaking strength with safety factors; before work confirm anchor positions, soundings and seabed obstruction surveys, and during work monitor line tensions and vessel position, stopping the lift if offset exceeds the limit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：錨泊計畫須經港務或航政主管機關核准並發布航行公告，作業時間依潮汐表安排在平潮前後；船長、吊裝總指揮與錨泊監控人員的通訊與指揮權限事先明定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The mooring plan must be approved by the port or maritime authority with a notice to mariners, and work is timed around slack water from tide tables; communications and command authority among the master, lift director and mooring watch are defined in advance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在潮流最強時段作業，錨纜張力超過錨的抓力，浮吊拖錨漂移，吊物撞上橋墩；錨纜跨越航道或鉤到海底電纜，造成第三方損害與作業中斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Working at peak current lets line tensions exceed anchor holding so the crane drags anchors and drifts, swinging the load into the pier; lines crossing a fairway or snagging a seabed cable cause third-party damage and stop the work. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 錨泊分析須列出各錨纜在設計流速、風速與吊重狀態下的張力，與錨的抓力和纜繩破斷力比較並保留安全係數；作業前確認錨位、測深與海底障礙調查，作業中監測錨纜張力與船位，偏移超過允許值即停止吊裝。
knowledge.textEn: The mooring analysis lists line tensions under design current, wind and lifting conditions, compared with anchor holding capacity and line breaking strength with safety factors; before work confirm anchor positions, soundings and seabed obstruction surveys, and during work monitor line tensions and vessel position, stopping the lift if offset exceeds the limit.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 錨泊計畫須經港務或航政主管機關核准並發布航行公告，作業時間依潮汐表安排在平潮前後；船長、吊裝總指揮與錨泊監控人員的通訊與指揮權限事先明定。
knowledge.textEn: The mooring plan must be approved by the port or maritime authority with a notice to mariners, and work is timed around slack water from tide tables; communications and command authority among the master, lift director and mooring watch are defined in advance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「浮吊錨泊、流力與定位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mooring, current forces and positioning"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
錨泊分析須列出各錨纜在設計流速、風速與吊重狀態下的張力，與錨的抓力和纜繩破斷力比較並保留安全係數。
浮吊吊裝只要風小就可以進行，波浪對吊物影響不大。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
The mooring analysis lists line tensions under design current, wind and lifting conditions, compared with anchor holding capacity and line breaking strength with safety factors.
A floating-crane lift can proceed whenever wind is light; waves hardly affect the load.
quiz.explanation: 錨泊分析須列出各錨纜在設計流速、風速與吊重狀態下的張力，與錨的抓力和纜繩破斷力比較並保留安全係數；作業前確認錨位、測深與海底障礙調查，作業中監測錨纜張力與船位，偏移超過允許值即停止吊裝。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The mooring analysis lists line tensions under design current, wind and lifting conditions, compared with anchor holding capacity and line breaking strength with safety factors; before work confirm anchor positions, soundings and seabed obstruction surveys, and during work monitor line tensions and vessel position, stopping the lift if offset exceeds the limit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 浮吊錨泊、流力與定位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mooring, current forces and positioning: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「浮吊錨泊與定位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crane-barge mooring and positioning” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在潮流最強時段作業，錨纜張力超過錨的抓力，浮吊拖錨漂移，吊物撞上橋墩；錨纜跨越航道或鉤到海底電纜，造成第三方損害與作業中斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Working at peak current lets line tensions exceed anchor holding so the crane drags anchors and drifts, swinging the load into the pier; lines crossing a fairway or snagging a seabed cable cause third-party damage and stop the work. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：吊重時船體吃水與傾斜改變，錨纜張力隨之變化；靠近橋墩還要考慮淺水與海底管線，錨的位置與拋錨路徑須事先申請與標示。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lifting changes draft and heel, and mooring tensions change with them; near piers, shallow water and seabed pipelines must be considered, and anchor positions and anchoring paths must be permitted and marked in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮吊很重，水流不可能推動它，所以不必特別錨泊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A floating crane is so heavy that current cannot move it, so special mooring is unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在潮流最強時段作業，錨纜張力超過錨的抓力，浮吊拖錨漂移，吊物撞上橋墩；錨纜跨越航道或鉤到海底電纜，造成第三方損害與作業中斷。
knowledge.textEn: Working at peak current lets line tensions exceed anchor holding so the crane drags anchors and drifts, swinging the load into the pier; lines crossing a fairway or snagging a seabed cable cause third-party damage and stop the work.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮吊錨泊、流力與定位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mooring, current forces and positioning" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
浮吊落位與陸上起重機一樣，只要把吊鉤慢慢放下即可。
在潮流最強時段作業，錨纜張力超過錨的抓力，浮吊拖錨漂移，吊物撞上橋墩；錨纜跨越航道或鉤到海底電纜，造成第三方損害與作業中斷。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Setting down with a floating crane is just like a land crane: lower the hook slowly.
Working at peak current lets line tensions exceed anchor holding so the crane drags anchors and drifts, swinging the load into the pier.
quiz.explanation: 在潮流最強時段作業，錨纜張力超過錨的抓力，浮吊拖錨漂移，吊物撞上橋墩；錨纜跨越航道或鉤到海底電纜，造成第三方損害與作業中斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Working at peak current lets line tensions exceed anchor holding so the crane drags anchors and drifts, swinging the load into the pier; lines crossing a fairway or snagging a seabed cable cause third-party damage and stop the work. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Set-down alignment, tide and draft change: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「落位導向與荷重轉換」如何影響浮吊大型橋段吊裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Set-down guides and load transfer” governs force, deformation or durability in “Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 吊物到達橋墩上方後，先以導向架或擋塊做粗對位，再慢慢下放，使構件坐上臨時支撐、支承或已完成構件的接合面。浮吊在這個階段有兩個特殊問題：潮汐使船體持續升降，吊鉤高度隨之改變；荷重由吊鉤轉移到墩上時，船體吃水變淺而上浮，吊鉤也跟著上升，如果不同步放鉤，構件會被重新提起或受衝擊。因此落位要分級進行，每一級都確認構件已穩定坐上支撐、臨時固定完成，才逐步釋放吊鉤荷重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「落位導向與荷重轉換」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once over the pier, the load is roughly aligned by guide frames or stops and lowered slowly onto temporary supports, bearings or the joint face of completed members. A floating crane brings two particular problems at this stage: the tide keeps raising or lowering the hull and therefore the hook, and as load transfers from the hook to the pier the vessel's draft decreases so it rises and lifts the hook with it; unless the hook pays out in step, the member is lifted again or shocked. Set-down therefore proceeds in stages, each confirming that the member sits stably on its supports and is temporarily secured before more hook load is released. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Set-down guides and load transfer” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：吊重 15,000 kN 完全轉移到墩上時，船體上浮 Δ = W/(ρgA_wp)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: When 15,000 kN transfers fully to the pier, the vessel rises Δ = W/(ρgA_wp).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮吊落位與陸上起重機一樣，只要把吊鉤慢慢放下即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Setting down with a floating crane is just like a land crane: lower the hook slowly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「落位導向與荷重轉換」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Set-down guides and load transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化
knowledge.titleEn: Set-down alignment, tide and draft change
knowledge.text: 吊物到達橋墩上方後，先以導向架或擋塊做粗對位，再慢慢下放，使構件坐上臨時支撐、支承或已完成構件的接合面。浮吊在這個階段有兩個特殊問題：潮汐使船體持續升降，吊鉤高度隨之改變；荷重由吊鉤轉移到墩上時，船體吃水變淺而上浮，吊鉤也跟著上升，如果不同步放鉤，構件會被重新提起或受衝擊。
knowledge.textEn: Once over the pier, the load is roughly aligned by guide frames or stops and lowered slowly onto temporary supports, bearings or the joint face of completed members. A floating crane brings two particular problems at this stage: the tide keeps raising or lowering the hull and therefore the hook, and as load transfers from the hook to the pier the vessel's draft decreases so it rises and lifts the hook with it; unless the hook pays out in step, the member is lifted again or shocked.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：浮吊落位與陸上起重機一樣，只要把吊鉤慢慢放下即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Setting down with a floating crane is just like a land crane: lower the hook slowly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Set-down alignment, tide and draft change" is correct?
options: 吊物到達橋墩上方後，先以導向架或擋塊做粗對位，再慢慢下放，使構件坐上臨時支撐、支承或已完成構件的接合面。
浮吊落位與陸上起重機一樣，只要把吊鉤慢慢放下即可。
構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。
optionsEn: Once over the pier, the load is roughly aligned by guide frames or stops and lowered slowly onto temporary supports, bearings or the joint face of completed members.
Setting down with a floating crane is just like a land crane: lower the hook slowly.
Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift.
quiz.explanation: 吊物到達橋墩上方後，先以導向架或擋塊做粗對位，再慢慢下放，使構件坐上臨時支撐、支承或已完成構件的接合面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once over the pier, the load is roughly aligned by guide frames or stops and lowered slowly onto temporary supports, bearings or the joint face of completed members. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Set-down alignment, tide and draft change: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「落位導向與荷重轉換」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Set-down guides and load transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：吊重 15,000 kN 完全轉移到墩上時，船體上浮 Δ = W/(ρgA_wp)。水線面積 117 m × 30 m = 3,510 m²：Δ = 15,000/(1.025×9.81×3,510) ≈ 0.43 m。另若潮位每小時變化 0.5 m，20 分鐘的落位期間又變化約 0.17 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: When 15,000 kN transfers fully to the pier, the vessel rises Δ = W/(ρgA_wp). With a waterplane of 117 m × 30 m = 3,510 m², Δ = 15,000/(1.025×9.81×3,510) ≈ 0.43 m. If the tide changes 0.5 m per hour, a 20-minute set-down adds about 0.17 m more. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：落位前在墩頂設置量測標記與導向，吊鉤荷重以 25% 為一級釋放，每級量測構件高程、支撐壓縮與吊鉤荷重；臨時固定（栓接、楔塊或臨時預力）完成並經檢查後才完全卸鉤，所有讀值與時間記錄存檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before set-down, fit survey marks and guides on the pier top; release hook load in steps of 25%, measuring member levels, support compression and hook load at each step; release the hook completely only after temporary fixings (bolts, wedges or temporary prestress) are completed and inspected, logging all readings with time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 吊重 15,000 kN 完全轉移到墩上時，船體上浮 Δ = W/(ρgA_wp)。水線面積 117 m × 30 m = 3,510 m²：Δ = 15,000/(1.025×9.81×3,510) ≈ 0.43 m。另若潮位每小時變化 0.5 m，20 分鐘的落位期間又變化約 0.17 m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: When 15,000 kN transfers fully to the pier, the vessel rises Δ = W/(ρgA_wp). With a waterplane of 117 m × 30 m = 3,510 m², Δ = 15,000/(1.025×9.81×3,510) ≈ 0.43 m. If the tide changes 0.5 m per hour, a 20-minute set-down adds about 0.17 m more. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Set-down alignment, tide and draft change", which statement holds?
options: 吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。
吊重 15,000 kN 完全轉移到墩上時，船體上浮 Δ = W/(ρgA_wp)。
只要吊索總容量大於構件重量，吊索角度與長度就無關緊要。
optionsEn: Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them.
When 15,000 kN transfers fully to the pier, the vessel rises Δ = W/(ρgA_wp).
As long as total sling capacity exceeds member weight, sling angles and lengths do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 吊重 15,000 kN 完全轉移到墩上時，船體上浮 Δ = W/(ρgA_wp)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: When 15,000 kN transfers fully to the pier, the vessel rises Δ = W/(ρgA_wp). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Set-down alignment, tide and draft change: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「落位導向與荷重轉換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Set-down guides and load transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 落位前在墩頂設置量測標記與導向，吊鉤荷重以 25% 為一級釋放，每級量測構件高程、支撐壓縮與吊鉤荷重；臨時固定（栓接、楔塊或臨時預力）完成並經檢查後才完全卸鉤，所有讀值與時間記錄存檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before set-down, fit survey marks and guides on the pier top; release hook load in steps of 25%, measuring member levels, support compression and hook load at each step; release the hook completely only after temporary fixings (bolts, wedges or temporary prestress) are completed and inspected, logging all readings with time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：落位程序書須列出分級卸載比例、每級檢查項目、臨時固定方式、潮汐與吃水補償方法；完全卸鉤是停留點，由吊裝總指揮、構件設計代表與監造共同確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The set-down procedure must list unloading steps, checks at each step, temporary fixing methods and tide and draft compensation; full hook release is a hold point confirmed jointly by the lift director, the member designer's representative and the supervising engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一次放鉤到零，船體上浮又把吊鉤提起，構件在支撐上跳動，臨時支撐或支承受衝擊損壞；漲潮時未及時放鉤，吊索被拉緊，構件被拖離已對位的位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Releasing the hook to zero in one go lets the rising vessel lift it again so the member bounces on its supports, damaging temporary supports or bearings; failing to pay out on a rising tide tightens the slings and drags the member off its aligned position. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 落位前在墩頂設置量測標記與導向，吊鉤荷重以 25% 為一級釋放，每級量測構件高程、支撐壓縮與吊鉤荷重；臨時固定（栓接、楔塊或臨時預力）完成並經檢查後才完全卸鉤，所有讀值與時間記錄存檔。
knowledge.textEn: Before set-down, fit survey marks and guides on the pier top; release hook load in steps of 25%, measuring member levels, support compression and hook load at each step; release the hook completely only after temporary fixings (bolts, wedges or temporary prestress) are completed and inspected, logging all readings with time.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 落位程序書須列出分級卸載比例、每級檢查項目、臨時固定方式、潮汐與吃水補償方法；完全卸鉤是停留點，由吊裝總指揮、構件設計代表與監造共同確認。
knowledge.textEn: The set-down procedure must list unloading steps, checks at each step, temporary fixing methods and tide and draft compensation; full hook release is a hold point confirmed jointly by the lift director, the member designer's representative and the supervising engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Set-down alignment, tide and draft change"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
吊耳只在吊裝時用幾小時，設計可以比永久構件寬鬆。
落位前在墩頂設置量測標記與導向，吊鉤荷重以 25% 為一級釋放，每級量測構件高程、支撐壓縮與吊鉤荷重。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Lugs are used for only a few hours, so they can be designed less strictly than permanent members.
Before set-down, fit survey marks and guides on the pier top.
quiz.explanation: 落位前在墩頂設置量測標記與導向，吊鉤荷重以 25% 為一級釋放，每級量測構件高程、支撐壓縮與吊鉤荷重；臨時固定（栓接、楔塊或臨時預力）完成並經檢查後才完全卸鉤，所有讀值與時間記錄存檔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before set-down, fit survey marks and guides on the pier top; release hook load in steps of 25%, measuring member levels, support compression and hook load at each step; release the hook completely only after temporary fixings (bolts, wedges or temporary prestress) are completed and inspected, logging all readings with time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Set-down alignment, tide and draft change: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「落位導向與荷重轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Set-down guides and load transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一次放鉤到零，船體上浮又把吊鉤提起，構件在支撐上跳動，臨時支撐或支承受衝擊損壞；漲潮時未及時放鉤，吊索被拉緊，構件被拖離已對位的位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Releasing the hook to zero in one go lets the rising vessel lift it again so the member bounces on its supports, damaging temporary supports or bearings; failing to pay out on a rising tide tightens the slings and drags the member off its aligned position. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此落位要分級進行，每一級都確認構件已穩定坐上支撐、臨時固定完成，才逐步釋放吊鉤荷重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Set-down therefore proceeds in stages, each confirming that the member sits stably on its supports and is temporarily secured before more hook load is released.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮吊落位與陸上起重機一樣，只要把吊鉤慢慢放下即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Setting down with a floating crane is just like a land crane: lower the hook slowly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一次放鉤到零，船體上浮又把吊鉤提起，構件在支撐上跳動，臨時支撐或支承受衝擊損壞；漲潮時未及時放鉤，吊索被拉緊，構件被拖離已對位的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Releasing the hook to zero in one go lets the rising vessel lift it again so the member bounces on its supports, damaging temporary supports or bearings; failing to pay out on a rising tide tightens the slings and drags the member off its aligned position.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Set-down alignment, tide and draft change" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 一次放鉤到零，船體上浮又把吊鉤提起，構件在支撐上跳動，臨時支撐或支承受衝擊損壞；漲潮時未及時放鉤，吊索被拉緊，構件被拖離已對位的位置。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。
optionsEn: Releasing the hook to zero in one go lets the rising vessel lift it again so the member bounces on its supports, damaging temporary supports or bearings.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift.
quiz.explanation: 一次放鉤到零，船體上浮又把吊鉤提起，構件在支撐上跳動，臨時支撐或支承受衝擊損壞；漲潮時未及時放鉤，吊索被拉緊，構件被拖離已對位的位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Releasing the hook to zero in one go lets the rising vessel lift it again so the member bounces on its supports, damaging temporary supports or bearings; failing to pay out on a rising tide tightens the slings and drags the member off its aligned position. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吊重與重心的量測驗證」與「天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity" and "Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊鉤荷重計」如何影響浮吊大型橋段吊裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hook load cells” governs force, deformation or durability in “Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 吊裝計算的起點是構件重量與重心，但混凝土單位重、鋼筋量、預埋件、殘留模板與積水都會使實際重量偏離計算值。因此大型吊裝會在吊鉤或各吊索上安裝荷重計，頂離支架後先暫停，量測總重與各點分配，反算重心位置；若與計算差異超出預留的重量裕度，必須停止並重新評估吊具與起重機利用率。量得的數據也回饋給後續相同構件的吊裝計畫。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊鉤荷重計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lift calculations start from member weight and centre of gravity, but concrete unit weight, reinforcement, embedments, leftover formwork and trapped water all move the real weight away from calculation. Major lifts therefore fit load cells on the hook or each sling, pause just after lift-off, measure total weight and its distribution and back-calculate the centre of gravity; if the difference exceeds the weight contingency, the lift stops and rigging and crane utilisation are re-evaluated. The data also feed back into the plans for later identical members. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hook load cells” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩組吊點相距 20 m，量得 R₁ = 7,800 kN、R₂ = 7,200 kN，總重 15,000 kN，重心距第一組 x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m；設計值 10.0 m，偏差 0.4 m，構件吊起後會向第一組一側傾斜，須調整吊索長度或吊點。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group; against a design value of 10.0 m, the 0.4 m offset will tilt the hanging member towards the first group, so sling lengths or lift points must be adjusted.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊鉤荷重計」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hook load cells”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity
knowledge.text: 吊裝計算的起點是構件重量與重心，但混凝土單位重、鋼筋量、預埋件、殘留模板與積水都會使實際重量偏離計算值。因此大型吊裝會在吊鉤或各吊索上安裝荷重計，頂離支架後先暫停，量測總重與各點分配，反算重心位置；若與計算差異超出預留的重量裕度，必須停止並重新評估吊具與起重機利用率。
knowledge.textEn: Lift calculations start from member weight and centre of gravity, but concrete unit weight, reinforcement, embedments, leftover formwork and trapped water all move the real weight away from calculation. Major lifts therefore fit load cells on the hook or each sling, pause just after lift-off, measure total weight and its distribution and back-calculate the centre of gravity; if the difference exceeds the weight contingency, the lift stops and rigging and crane utilisation are re-evaluated.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊重與重心的量測驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity" is correct?
options: 構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。
吊裝計算的起點是構件重量與重心，但混凝土單位重、鋼筋量、預埋件、殘留模板與積水都會使實際重量偏離計算值。
只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。
optionsEn: Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift.

Lift calculations start from member weight and centre of gravity, but concrete unit weight, reinforcement, embedments, leftover formwork and trapped water all move the real weight away from calculation.
If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝計算的起點是構件重量與重心，但混凝土單位重、鋼筋量、預埋件、殘留模板與積水都會使實際重量偏離計算值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lift calculations start from member weight and centre of gravity, but concrete unit weight, reinforcement, embedments, leftover formwork and trapped water all move the real weight away from calculation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊鉤荷重計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hook load cells” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩組吊點相距 20 m，量得 R₁ = 7,800 kN、R₂ = 7,200 kN，總重 15,000 kN，重心距第一組 x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m；設計值 10.0 m，偏差 0.4 m，構件吊起後會向第一組一側傾斜，須調整吊索長度或吊點。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group; against a design value of 10.0 m, the 0.4 m offset will tilt the hanging member towards the first group, so sling lengths or lift points must be adjusted. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift; after raising the member about 100 to 200 mm off its supports, hold for a few minutes, record steady readings and compare with calculated weight and centre of gravity, continuing only if differences are within the preset range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩組吊點相距 20 m，量得 R₁ = 7,800 kN、R₂ = 7,200 kN，總重 15,000 kN，重心距第一組 x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m；設計值 10.0 m，偏差 0.4 m，構件吊起後會向第一組一側傾斜，須調整吊索長度或吊點。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group; against a design value of 10.0 m, the 0.4 m offset will tilt the hanging member towards the first group, so sling lengths or lift points must be adjusted. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊重與重心的量測驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity", which statement holds?
options: 吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。
浮吊吊裝只要風小就可以進行，波浪對吊物影響不大。
optionsEn: A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure.
A floating-crane lift can proceed whenever wind is light; waves hardly affect the load.
With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group.
quiz.explanation: 兩組吊點相距 20 m，量得 R₁ = 7,800 kN、R₂ = 7,200 kN，總重 15,000 kN，重心距第一組 x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m；設計值 10.0 m，偏差 0.4 m，構件吊起後會向第一組一側傾斜，須調整吊索長度或吊點。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group; against a design value of 10.0 m, the 0.4 m offset will tilt the hanging member towards the first group, so sling lengths or lift points must be adjusted. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊鉤荷重計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hook load cells” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。量測結果附於吊裝紀錄，並更新同型構件的重量資料庫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift; after raising the member about 100 to 200 mm off its supports, hold for a few minutes, record steady readings and compare with calculated weight and centre of gravity, continuing only if differences are within the preset range. Results are attached to the lift record and update the weight database for similar members. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝計畫應訂定重量裕度（例如 5%）與重心容許偏差，並規定頂離暫停量測為必要步驟；吊裝前清除構件上的雜物與積水並由專人檢查簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lift plan should set a weight contingency, for example 5%, and a centre-of-gravity tolerance, and make the lift-off pause and measurement mandatory; before lifting, debris and water are removed from the member and checked and signed off by a designated person.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回；重心偏移未發現，構件在空中傾斜並撞擊吊臂或駁船結構。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back; an undetected centre-of-gravity offset tilts the member in the air into the boom or barge structure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。量測結果附於吊裝紀錄，並更新同型構件的重量資料庫。
knowledge.textEn: Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift; after raising the member about 100 to 200 mm off its supports, hold for a few minutes, record steady readings and compare with calculated weight and centre of gravity, continuing only if differences are within the preset range. Results are attached to the lift record and update the weight database for similar members.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 吊裝計畫應訂定重量裕度（例如 5%）與重心容許偏差，並規定頂離暫停量測為必要步驟；吊裝前清除構件上的雜物與積水並由專人檢查簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The lift plan should set a weight contingency, for example 5%, and a centre-of-gravity tolerance, and make the lift-off pause and measurement mandatory; before lifting, debris and water are removed from the member and checked and signed off by a designated person.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊重與重心的量測驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity"?
options: 荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
構件能承受營運荷載，就一定能承受自己的吊裝狀態。
optionsEn: Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A member that can carry service loads can always carry its own lifting state.
quiz.explanation: 荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift; after raising the member about 100 to 200 mm off its supports, hold for a few minutes, record steady readings and compare with calculated weight and centre of gravity, continuing only if differences are within the preset range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊鉤荷重計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hook load cells” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回；重心偏移未發現，構件在空中傾斜並撞擊吊臂或駁船結構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back; an undetected centre-of-gravity offset tilts the member in the air into the boom or barge structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量得的數據也回饋給後續相同構件的吊裝計畫。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The data also feed back into the plans for later identical members.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回；重心偏移未發現，構件在空中傾斜並撞擊吊臂或駁船結構。
knowledge.textEn: Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back; an undetected centre-of-gravity offset tilts the member in the air into the boom or barge structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊重與重心的量測驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回。
只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back.
If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe.
quiz.explanation: 構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回；重心偏移未發現，構件在空中傾斜並撞擊吊臂或駁船結構。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back; an undetected centre-of-gravity offset tilts the member in the air into the boom or barge structure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「天候窗口與預報係數」如何影響浮吊大型橋段吊裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weather window and forecast factor” governs force, deformation or durability in “Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 浮吊吊裝是一次不能中途隨意中斷的作業：吊物一旦離開駁船，就必須完成落位與臨時固定。因此決定是否開始，要看整個作業期間（含應變時間）的天候預報，而不是開始時的天氣。海事作業標準以作業限值乘上小於 1 的預報係數，作為預報值的上限，來涵蓋預報誤差；同時要把地面或海面 10 m 的風速換算到吊臂高度，因為高處風速較大，吊物與吊臂承受的風力也較大。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「天候窗口與預報係數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A floating-crane lift cannot be stopped casually halfway: once the load leaves the barge, set-down and temporary fixing must be completed. Whether to start therefore depends on the forecast for the whole operation including contingency time, not the weather at the start. Marine-operation standards multiply the operational limit by a forecast factor below 1 to set the maximum acceptable forecast value, covering forecast error; the 10 m wind speed must also be converted to boom height, where it is stronger and loads the boom and suspended member more. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Weather window and forecast factor” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「天候窗口與預報係數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Weather window and forecast factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值
knowledge.titleEn: Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits
knowledge.text: 浮吊吊裝是一次不能中途隨意中斷的作業：吊物一旦離開駁船，就必須完成落位與臨時固定。因此決定是否開始，要看整個作業期間（含應變時間）的天候預報，而不是開始時的天氣。
knowledge.textEn: A floating-crane lift cannot be stopped casually halfway: once the load leaves the barge, set-down and temporary fixing must be completed. Whether to start therefore depends on the forecast for the whole operation including contingency time, not the weather at the start.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits" is correct?
options: 只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。
吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。
浮吊吊裝是一次不能中途隨意中斷的作業：吊物一旦離開駁船，就必須完成落位與臨時固定。
optionsEn: If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe.
Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them.
A floating-crane lift cannot be stopped casually halfway: once the load leaves the barge, set-down and temporary fixing must be completed.
quiz.explanation: 浮吊吊裝是一次不能中途隨意中斷的作業：吊物一旦離開駁船，就必須完成落位與臨時固定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A floating-crane lift cannot be stopped casually halfway: once the load leaves the barge, set-down and temporary fixing must be completed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天候窗口與預報係數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weather window and forecast factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。V₁₀ = 10 m/s 時，90 m 吊臂高度 V₉₀ ≈ 10×9^0.11 ≈ 12.7 m/s。若起重機在吊臂高度的作業限值 15 m/s、預報係數 0.8，預報值須 ≤ 12 m/s，換算回 10 m 高度約 12/1.27 ≈ 9.4 m/s。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11. For V₁₀ = 10 m/s, the speed at a 90 m boom height is V₉₀ ≈ 10×9^0.11 ≈ 12.7 m/s. With a crane limit of 15 m/s at boom height and a forecast factor of 0.8, the forecast must not exceed 12 m/s, about 12/1.27 ≈ 9.4 m/s at 10 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：作業前訂定計畫作業時間與應變時間，取得涵蓋整段時間的專業海象氣象預報；作業前會議確認預報值在折減後的限值內，作業中以吊臂頂與船上的風速計、波浪資料持續監測，接近限值即啟動預先規劃的中止或安全放置方案。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the lift, define the planned operation time and contingency, obtain a specialist marine forecast covering the whole period, and confirm at the pre-lift meeting that forecasts are within the reduced limits; during the lift monitor boom-tip and deck anemometers and wave data continuously, triggering the pre-planned abort or safe-set-down option near the limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。V₁₀ = 10 m/s 時，90 m 吊臂高度 V₉₀ ≈ 10×9^0.11 ≈ 12.7 m/s。若起重機在吊臂高度的作業限值 15 m/s、預報係數 0.8，預報值須 ≤ 12 m/s，換算回 10 m 高度約 12/1.27 ≈ 9.4 m/s。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11. For V₁₀ = 10 m/s, the speed at a 90 m boom height is V₉₀ ≈ 10×9^0.11 ≈ 12.7 m/s. With a crane limit of 15 m/s at boom height and a forecast factor of 0.8, the forecast must not exceed 12 m/s, about 12/1.27 ≈ 9.4 m/s at 10 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits", which statement holds?
options: 風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。
只要吊索總容量大於構件重量，吊索角度與長度就無關緊要。
吊耳只在吊裝時用幾小時，設計可以比永久構件寬鬆。
optionsEn: Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11.
As long as total sling capacity exceeds member weight, sling angles and lengths do not matter.
Lugs are used for only a few hours, so they can be designed less strictly than permanent members.
quiz.explanation: 風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「天候窗口與預報係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weather window and forecast factor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 作業前訂定計畫作業時間與應變時間，取得涵蓋整段時間的專業海象氣象預報；作業前會議確認預報值在折減後的限值內，作業中以吊臂頂與船上的風速計、波浪資料持續監測，接近限值即啟動預先規劃的中止或安全放置方案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the lift, define the planned operation time and contingency, obtain a specialist marine forecast covering the whole period, and confirm at the pre-lift meeting that forecasts are within the reduced limits; during the lift monitor boom-tip and deck anemometers and wave data continuously, triggering the pre-planned abort or safe-set-down option near the limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝的開始決定是停留點：由吊裝總指揮、船長、海事保證檢驗員與業主代表依預報與限值共同簽認；中止條件與吊物安全放置位置事先規劃，不在現場臨時決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The decision to start is a hold point signed jointly by the lift director, master, marine warranty surveyor and owner's representative against forecasts and limits; abort criteria and safe set-down locations are planned beforehand, not improvised on site.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait; judging by ground-level wind and ignoring wind at boom height lets the load spin out of control. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 吊裝的開始決定是停留點：由吊裝總指揮、船長、海事保證檢驗員與業主代表依預報與限值共同簽認；中止條件與吊物安全放置位置事先規劃，不在現場臨時決定。

quiz.question: 要驗證「天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits"?

作業前訂定計畫作業時間與應變時間，取得涵蓋整段時間的專業海象氣象預報。
浮吊很重，水流不可能推動它，所以不必特別錨泊。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Before the lift, define the planned operation time and contingency, obtain a specialist marine forecast covering the whole period, and confirm at the pre-lift meeting that forecasts are within the reduced limits.
A floating crane is so heavy that current cannot move it, so special mooring is unnecessary.
