Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「天候窗口與預報係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weather window and forecast factor” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait; judging by ground-level wind and ignoring wind at boom height lets the load spin out of control. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：海事作業標準以作業限值乘上小於 1 的預報係數，作為預報值的上限，來涵蓋預報誤差；同時要把地面或海面 10 m 的風速換算到吊臂高度，因為高處風速較大，吊物與吊臂承受的風力也較大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Marine-operation standards multiply the operational limit by a forecast factor below 1 to set the maximum acceptable forecast value, covering forecast error; the 10 m wind speed must also be converted to boom height, where it is stronger and loads the boom and suspended member more.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。
knowledge.textEn: Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait; judging by ground-level wind and ignoring wind at boom height lets the load spin out of control.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。
只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them.
Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait.
quiz.explanation: 只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait; judging by ground-level wind and ignoring wind at boom height lets the load spin out of control. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久」與「吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Marine durability of lifting holes and joints" and "Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Marine durability of lifting holes and joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊孔封填與保護層」如何影響浮吊大型橋段吊裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lifting-hole sealing and cover” governs force, deformation or durability in “Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土構件為了吊裝而留下的貫穿孔、預埋吊具凹槽與臨時預力錨座，在吊裝後都要封填。這些位置常位於海水噴濺區，若封填材料的緻密度低於母體混凝土，或與母體界面脫開，氯離子會更快到達鋼筋。聯邦大橋這類冰海環境中的橋梁，還要承受凍融與冰撞。耐久設計因此必須把吊裝細部當作永久構件的一部分，規定封填材料、表面處理與檢查方法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊孔封填與保護層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Through-holes, recesses for cast-in lifting devices and temporary prestressing anchors left in concrete members by the lift must all be sealed afterwards. They often lie in the splash zone, and if the filling is less dense than the parent concrete or debonds from it, chlorides reach the reinforcement sooner. Bridges in icy seas such as Confederation Bridge also face freeze–thaw and ice impact. Durability design must therefore treat lifting details as part of the permanent member, specifying filling materials, surface preparation and inspection methods. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lifting-hole sealing and cover” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊孔封填與保護層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lifting-hole sealing and cover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久
knowledge.titleEn: Marine durability of lifting holes and joints
knowledge.text: 混凝土構件為了吊裝而留下的貫穿孔、預埋吊具凹槽與臨時預力錨座，在吊裝後都要封填。這些位置常位於海水噴濺區，若封填材料的緻密度低於母體混凝土，或與母體界面脫開，氯離子會更快到達鋼筋。
knowledge.textEn: Through-holes, recesses for cast-in lifting devices and temporary prestressing anchors left in concrete members by the lift must all be sealed afterwards. They often lie in the splash zone, and if the filling is less dense than the parent concrete or debonds from it, chlorides reach the reinforcement sooner.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Marine durability of lifting holes and joints" is correct?
options: 混凝土構件為了吊裝而留下的貫穿孔、預埋吊具凹槽與臨時預力錨座，在吊裝後都要封填。
吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。
吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。
optionsEn: Through-holes, recesses for cast-in lifting devices and temporary prestressing anchors left in concrete members by the lift must all be sealed afterwards.
Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them.
A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土構件為了吊裝而留下的貫穿孔、預埋吊具凹槽與臨時預力錨座，在吊裝後都要封填。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Through-holes, recesses for cast-in lifting devices and temporary prestressing anchors left in concrete members by the lift must all be sealed afterwards. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Marine durability of lifting holes and joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊孔封填與保護層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lifting-hole sealing and cover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。以 C/C_s = 0.1 為鋼筋起鏽門檻時 x/(2√(Dt)) ≈ 1.163，t = [x/(2×1.163)]²/D。保護層 x = 75 mm：母體 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t ≈ 33 年；封填材料 D = 5×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t ≈ 6.6 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]. Taking C/C_s = 0.1 as the corrosion threshold gives x/(2√(Dt)) ≈ 1.163 and t = [x/(2×1.163)]²/D. For 75 mm cover, parent concrete with D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s reaches it in about 33 years, while a filling with D = 5×10⁻¹² m²/s does so in about 6.6 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete; afterwards confirm bond by sounding and pull-off tests, and tabulate every sealed location, material and date at handover.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。以 C/C_s = 0.1 為鋼筋起鏽門檻時 x/(2√(Dt)) ≈ 1.163，t = [x/(2×1.163)]²/D。保護層 x = 75 mm：母體 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t ≈ 33 年；封填材料 D = 5×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t ≈ 6.6 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]. Taking C/C_s = 0.1 as the corrosion threshold gives x/(2√(Dt)) ≈ 1.163 and t = [x/(2×1.163)]²/D. For 75 mm cover, parent concrete with D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s reaches it in about 33 years, while a filling with D = 5×10⁻¹² m²/s does so in about 6.6 years. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Marine durability of lifting holes and joints", which statement holds?
options: 浮吊吊裝只要風小就可以進行，波浪對吊物影響不大。
Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。
構件能承受營運荷載，就一定能承受自己的吊裝狀態。
optionsEn: A floating-crane lift can proceed whenever wind is light; waves hardly affect the load.
Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))].
A member that can carry service loads can always carry its own lifting state.
quiz.explanation: Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Marine durability of lifting holes and joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊孔封填與保護層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lifting-hole sealing and cover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete; afterwards confirm bond by sounding and pull-off tests, and tabulate every sealed location, material and date at handover. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構件圖說應把吊孔封填列為永久細部，規定材料性能、施工方法與檢查頻率；封填作業屬檢驗停留點，完成並驗收後才可進行塗裝或防護層施工。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Member drawings should treat lifting-hole sealing as a permanent detail with specified material performance, method and inspection frequency; sealing is an inspection hold point, accepted before any coating or protective layer is applied.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points; unsealed temporary prestress anchorages corrode at bar ends and spall the surrounding concrete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。
knowledge.textEn: Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete; afterwards confirm bond by sounding and pull-off tests, and tabulate every sealed location, material and date at handover.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 構件圖說應把吊孔封填列為永久細部，規定材料性能、施工方法與檢查頻率；封填作業屬檢驗停留點，完成並驗收後才可進行塗裝或防護層施工。
knowledge.textEn: Member drawings should treat lifting-hole sealing as a permanent detail with specified material performance, method and inspection frequency; sealing is an inspection hold point, accepted before any coating or protective layer is applied.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Marine durability of lifting holes and joints"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
浮吊落位與陸上起重機一樣，只要把吊鉤慢慢放下即可。
封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Setting down with a floating crane is just like a land crane: lower the hook slowly.
Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete.
quiz.explanation: 封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete; afterwards confirm bond by sounding and pull-off tests, and tabulate every sealed location, material and date at handover. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Marine durability of lifting holes and joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊孔封填與保護層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lifting-hole sealing and cover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points; unsealed temporary prestress anchorages corrode at bar ends and spall the surrounding concrete. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：耐久設計因此必須把吊裝細部當作永久構件的一部分，規定封填材料、表面處理與檢查方法。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Durability design must therefore treat lifting details as part of the permanent member, specifying filling materials, surface preparation and inspection methods.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。
knowledge.textEn: Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points; unsealed temporary prestress anchorages corrode at bar ends and spall the surrounding concrete.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Marine durability of lifting holes and joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。
optionsEn: Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points; unsealed temporary prestress anchorages corrode at bar ends and spall the surrounding concrete. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」如何影響浮吊大型橋段吊裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lug removal and fatigue details” governs force, deformation or durability in “Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼構件上的吊耳在吊裝後通常要切除，但切除位置若留下殘根、切割缺口或焊縫未磨平，就等於在主梁受拉翼板上留下一個附加物細部，疲勞類別大幅下降。正確的做法是在離母材一段距離處切除，再磨平並做磁粉檢測；若吊耳位於低應力區且設計允許保留，也要確認其焊縫細部的疲勞類別。交接時應把每一個吊耳的位置、處理方式與檢測結果，以及吊裝紀錄（重量、重心、天候、荷重讀值）一併移交。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lugs on steel members are usually cut off after the lift, but a stub, gouge or unground weld left at the cut equals an attachment detail on a tension flange, sharply lowering its fatigue category. The correct method is to cut a short distance from the parent metal, grind flush and test by magnetic particle; if a lug in a low-stress zone may stay by design, its weld detail's fatigue category must still be confirmed. Handover should include every lug's position, treatment and test result, together with the lift records of weight, centre of gravity, weather and load readings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lug removal and fatigue details” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lug removal and fatigue details”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接
knowledge.titleEn: Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records
knowledge.text: 鋼構件上的吊耳在吊裝後通常要切除，但切除位置若留下殘根、切割缺口或焊縫未磨平，就等於在主梁受拉翼板上留下一個附加物細部，疲勞類別大幅下降。正確的做法是在離母材一段距離處切除，再磨平並做磁粉檢測；若吊耳位於低應力區且設計允許保留，也要確認其焊縫細部的疲勞類別。
knowledge.textEn: Lugs on steel members are usually cut off after the lift, but a stub, gouge or unground weld left at the cut equals an attachment detail on a tension flange, sharply lowering its fatigue category. The correct method is to cut a short distance from the parent metal, grind flush and test by magnetic particle; if a lug in a low-stress zone may stay by design, its weld detail's fatigue category must still be confirmed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records" is correct?
options: 吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。
鋼構件上的吊耳在吊裝後通常要切除，但切除位置若留下殘根、切割缺口或焊縫未磨平，就等於在主梁受拉翼板上留下一個附加物細部，疲勞類別大幅下降。
只要吊索總容量大於構件重量，吊索角度與長度就無關緊要。
optionsEn: A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure.
Lugs on steel members are usually cut off after the lift, but a stub, gouge or unground weld left at the cut equals an attachment detail on a tension flange, sharply lowering its fatigue category.
As long as total sling capacity exceeds member weight, sling angles and lengths do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 鋼構件上的吊耳在吊裝後通常要切除，但切除位置若留下殘根、切割缺口或焊縫未磨平，就等於在主梁受拉翼板上留下一個附加物細部，疲勞類別大幅下降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lugs on steel members are usually cut off after the lift, but a stub, gouge or unground weld left at the cut equals an attachment detail on a tension flange, sharply lowering its fatigue category. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lug removal and fatigue details” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。母材平滑板類別 160 MPa，若殘留附加物使類別降為 80 MPa，同一應力幅下壽命為 (80/160)³ = 1/8。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³. A plain plate of category 160 MPa reduced to category 80 MPa by a remaining attachment has (80/160)³ = 1/8 of the life at the same stress range. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值；吊裝紀錄逐件整理，包括吊裝計畫版本、量測重量與重心、天候紀錄、落位量測與臨時固定檢查，由業主驗收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design; compile lift records member by member, including plan revision, measured weight and centre of gravity, weather logs, set-down surveys and temporary-fixing inspections, accepted by the owner.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。母材平滑板類別 160 MPa，若殘留附加物使類別降為 80 MPa，同一應力幅下壽命為 (80/160)³ = 1/8。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³. A plain plate of category 160 MPa reduced to category 80 MPa by a remaining attachment has (80/160)³ = 1/8 of the life at the same stress range. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records", which statement holds?
options: 吊耳只在吊裝時用幾小時，設計可以比永久構件寬鬆。
浮吊很重，水流不可能推動它，所以不必特別錨泊。
S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。
optionsEn: Lugs are used for only a few hours, so they can be designed less strictly than permanent members.
A floating crane is so heavy that current cannot move it, so special mooring is unnecessary.
With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³.
quiz.explanation: S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lug removal and fatigue details” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值；吊裝紀錄逐件整理，包括吊裝計畫版本、量測重量與重心、天候紀錄、落位量測與臨時固定檢查，由業主驗收。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design; compile lift records member by member, including plan revision, measured weight and centre of gravity, weather logs, set-down surveys and temporary-fixing inspections, accepted by the owner. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含吊裝計畫與修訂紀錄、吊具與吊耳檢測報告、吊耳處理清單、量測與天候紀錄、封填紀錄，並標示需在首次定期檢查特別檢視的位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should include lift plans with revisions, rigging and lug test reports, the lug treatment list, measurement and weather logs and sealing records, and mark the locations to be examined closely at the first routine inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic; with lift records lost, local distortion found at a later inspection cannot be attributed to lifting impact or service. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值；吊裝紀錄逐件整理，包括吊裝計畫版本、量測重量與重心、天候紀錄、落位量測與臨時固定檢查，由業主驗收。
knowledge.textEn: After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design; compile lift records member by member, including plan revision, measured weight and centre of gravity, weather logs, set-down surveys and temporary-fixing inspections, accepted by the owner.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含吊裝計畫與修訂紀錄、吊具與吊耳檢測報告、吊耳處理清單、量測與天候紀錄、封填紀錄，並標示需在首次定期檢查特別檢視的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents should include lift plans with revisions, rigging and lug test reports, the lug treatment list, measurement and weather logs and sealing records, and mark the locations to be examined closely at the first routine inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records"?
options: 切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。
optionsEn: After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift.
quiz.explanation: 切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值；吊裝紀錄逐件整理，包括吊裝計畫版本、量測重量與重心、天候紀錄、落位量測與臨時固定檢查，由業主驗收。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design; compile lift records member by member, including plan revision, measured weight and centre of gravity, weather logs, set-down surveys and temporary-fixing inspections, accepted by the owner. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊耳移除與疲勞細部」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lug removal and fatigue details” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic; with lift records lost, local distortion found at a later inspection cannot be attributed to lifting impact or service. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時應把每一個吊耳的位置、處理方式與檢測結果，以及吊裝紀錄（重量、重心、天候、荷重讀值）一併移交。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover should include every lug's position, treatment and test result, together with the lift records of weight, centre of gravity, weather and load readings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。
knowledge.textEn: A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic; with lift records lost, local distortion found at a later inspection cannot be attributed to lifting impact or service.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。
只要吊索總容量大於構件重量，吊索角度與長度就無關緊要。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic.
As long as total sling capacity exceeds member weight, sling angles and lengths do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic; with lift records lost, local distortion found at a later inspection cannot be attributed to lifting impact or service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換
summary: 從溫度、乾縮、潛變與活載造成的梁端位移出發，決定伸縮縫型式與間隙數，檢核中梁輪載衝擊與疲勞，再處理錨碇箱與後澆混凝土、安裝溫度預設、通車條件下的分幅更換、出廠疲勞與防水試驗、現場間隙—溫度量測，最後以止水排水維護與生命週期更換策略交接，並以新 Tappan Zee 橋的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫、Øresund 橋的旋轉橫梁伸縮縫更換與漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋伸縮縫翻修為案例。
summaryEn: Starting from girder-end movements due to temperature, shrinkage, creep and live load, choose the joint type and number of gaps and check centre-beam wheel impact and fatigue, then handle anchorage boxes and blockout concrete, temperature presetting at installation, staged replacement under traffic, factory fatigue and watertightness tests and field gap–temperature measurements, and finally hand over with seal and drainage maintenance and a life-cycle replacement strategy, using the LR18 modular joints of the new Tappan Zee crossing, the swivel-joist joint replacement on the Øresund Bridge and the joint rehabilitation of Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge as cases.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 支承、伸縮縫與橋梁耐震
subcategoryTitleEn: Bearings, joints and bridge seismic design

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 選型練習：一座鋼橋伸縮長度 480 m，α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C，結構溫度範圍 −5 至 +55°C（ΔT = 60°C）：溫度位移 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×60 ≈ 346 mm；加上活載轉角與煞車往復 ±20 mm 共 40 mm，合計約 386 mm。若模組式每間隙 80 mm，需 386/80 ≈ 4.8，取 5 個間隙（400 mm），中位開口 200 mm（每間隙 40 mm），參考溫度 25°C。安裝時結構溫度 35°C，梁較中位長 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×10 ≈ 58 mm，預設總開口 200 − 58 ≈ 142 mm，平均每間隙約 28.5 mm。若耐震要求另需容納 150 mm 地震位移，總需求約 536 mm，需 536/80 ≈ 6.7，取 7 個間隙；或改採在地震時允許犧牲、事後快速更換的設計，兩者須與業主的震後通行目標一起比較。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Selection exercise: a steel bridge has a 480 m expansion length, α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and a structure temperature range of −5 to +55°C (ΔT = 60°C), so thermal movement is 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×60 ≈ 346 mm; adding ±20 mm, 40 mm in all, for live-load rotation and braking gives about 386 mm. At 80 mm per modular gap, 386/80 ≈ 4.8, so 5 gaps (400 mm) with a mid opening of 200 mm (40 mm per gap) at a 25°C reference. Installed at a structure temperature of 35°C, the girder is 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×10 ≈ 58 mm longer than at mid, so the preset total opening is 200 − 58 ≈ 142 mm, about 28.5 mm per gap. If seismic design also requires 150 mm of earthquake displacement, the demand becomes about 536 mm, needing 536/80 ≈ 6.7, so 7 gaps; alternatively a design that may be sacrificed in an earthquake and quickly replaced afterwards can be compared, together with the owner's post-earthquake access objective. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」與「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range" and "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「設計伸縮量」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Design movement range” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫位於兩段結構之間，必須容納梁端的縱向伸縮、轉角與少量橫向及豎向位移，同時讓車輪平順通過、阻止雨水與鹽分落到支承與墩帽上。梁端位移的主要來源是溫度變化，混凝土橋另有乾縮與潛變造成的單向縮短，長跨橋還有活載、風與煞車造成的往復位移，耐震設計可能再加上地震位移。伸縮量由固定點到伸縮縫之間的伸縮長度決定，所以支承配置與固定點位置改變，伸縮縫需求也隨之改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「設計伸縮量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An expansion joint sits between two structural parts and must accommodate longitudinal movement, rotation and some transverse and vertical displacement of the girder ends, while letting wheels pass smoothly and keeping rain and salt off bearings and pier caps. The main source of movement is temperature; concrete bridges add one-way shortening from shrinkage and creep, long spans add cyclic movements from live load, wind and braking, and seismic design may add earthquake displacement. The movement is governed by the expansion length between the fixed point and the joint, so changing the bearing layout or fixed point changes the joint demand too. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Design movement range” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「設計伸縮量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Design movement range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求
knowledge.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫位於兩段結構之間，必須容納梁端的縱向伸縮、轉角與少量橫向及豎向位移，同時讓車輪平順通過、阻止雨水與鹽分落到支承與墩帽上。梁端位移的主要來源是溫度變化，混凝土橋另有乾縮與潛變造成的單向縮短，長跨橋還有活載、風與煞車造成的往復位移，耐震設計可能再加上地震位移。
knowledge.textEn: An expansion joint sits between two structural parts and must accommodate longitudinal movement, rotation and some transverse and vertical displacement of the girder ends, while letting wheels pass smoothly and keeping rain and salt off bearings and pier caps. The main source of movement is temperature; concrete bridges add one-way shortening from shrinkage and creep, long spans add cyclic movements from live load, wind and braking, and seismic design may add earthquake displacement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。
伸縮縫位於兩段結構之間，必須容納梁端的縱向伸縮、轉角與少量橫向及豎向位移，同時讓車輪平順通過、阻止雨水與鹽分落到支承與墩帽上。
伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。
optionsEn: Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change.

An expansion joint sits between two structural parts and must accommodate longitudinal movement, rotation and some transverse and vertical displacement of the girder ends, while letting wheels pass smoothly and keeping rain and salt off bearings and pier caps.
An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫位於兩段結構之間，必須容納梁端的縱向伸縮、轉角與少量橫向及豎向位移，同時讓車輪平順通過、阻止雨水與鹽分落到支承與墩帽上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An expansion joint sits between two structural parts and must accommodate longitudinal movement, rotation and some transverse and vertical displacement of the girder ends, while letting wheels pass smoothly and keeping rain and salt off bearings and pier caps. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設計伸縮量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Design movement range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預力混凝土橋伸縮長度 L = 300 m：溫度 ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm；殘餘乾縮 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm；潛變 (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm。合計 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm，若模組式每間隙 80 mm，需 274/80 ≈ 3.4，取 4 個間隙（320 mm）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm. The total, 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm, at 80 mm per modular gap needs 274/80 ≈ 3.4, so 4 gaps (320 mm). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm. The total, 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm, at 80 mm per modular gap needs 274/80 ≈ 3.4, so 4 gaps (320 mm). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range", which statement holds?
options: 後澆混凝土只要外觀硬化，就可以開放重車通行。
更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。
預力混凝土橋伸縮長度 L = 300 m：溫度 ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm。
optionsEn: Once blockout concrete looks hard, heavy trucks can be allowed back.
Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew.
For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm.
quiz.explanationEn: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設計伸縮量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Design movement range” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：伸縮縫規格須列出各方向設計位移、轉角、可逆與單向分量、地震設計策略（容納或可犧牲），以及安裝時的預設計算方法，並與支承規格一起審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The joint specification must list design movements in each direction, rotations, reversible and one-way components, the seismic strategy (accommodate or sacrificial) and the presetting method, and be reviewed together with the bearing specification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫規格須列出各方向設計位移、轉角、可逆與單向分量、地震設計策略（容納或可犧牲），以及安裝時的預設計算方法，並與支承規格一起審查。
knowledge.textEn: The joint specification must list design movements in each direction, rotations, reversible and one-way components, the seismic strategy (accommodate or sacrificial) and the presetting method, and be reviewed together with the bearing specification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range"?

量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless.

quiz.explanationEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「設計伸縮量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Design movement range” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：伸縮量由固定點到伸縮縫之間的伸縮長度決定，所以支承配置與固定點位置改變，伸縮縫需求也隨之改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The movement is governed by the expansion length between the fixed point and the joint, so changing the bearing layout or fixed point changes the joint demand too.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統。
伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system.
An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design.
quiz.explanation: 若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「中梁輪載衝擊」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Centre-beam wheel impact” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫直接承受車輪衝擊：輪胎從橋面滾到鋼梁再滾回橋面，路面的高低差與間隙造成衝擊，動態放大比一般橋面更大；車輛煞車與加速又在縫面上施加水平力。模組式伸縮縫的中梁像一根多跨連續梁，擱在間距約一公尺多的支撐梁上，每一次車輪通過都在中梁與支撐梁的焊接或連接處產生應力循環，所以疲勞是模組式伸縮縫最主要的結構問題，美國 NCHRP 的研究與 AASHTO 規範都要求以疲勞試驗驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「中梁輪載衝擊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Expansion joints take wheel impact directly: as a tyre rolls from the deck onto steel beams and back, steps and gaps cause impact with larger dynamic amplification than elsewhere on the deck, and braking and acceleration apply horizontal forces at the surface. In a modular joint the centre beam acts as a multi-span continuous beam on support bars spaced a little over a metre apart, and every wheel passage cycles stress at the centre-beam-to-support-bar weld or connection, so fatigue is the main structural issue for modular joints; NCHRP research and AASHTO provisions call for verification by fatigue testing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Centre-beam wheel impact” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「中梁輪載衝擊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Centre-beam wheel impact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞
