In a modular joint the centre beam acts as a multi-span continuous beam on support bars spaced a little over a metre apart, and every wheel passage cycles stress at the centre-beam-to-support-bar weld or connection, so fatigue is the main structural issue for modular joints; NCHRP research and AASHTO provisions call for verification by fatigue testing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。
模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。
伸縮縫直接承受車輪衝擊：輪胎從橋面滾到鋼梁再滾回橋面，路面的高低差與間隙造成衝擊，動態放大比一般橋面更大；車輛煞車與加速又在縫面上施加水平力。
optionsEn: An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design.
Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system.

Expansion joints take wheel impact directly: as a tyre rolls from the deck onto steel beams and back, steps and gaps cause impact with larger dynamic amplification than elsewhere on the deck, and braking and acceleration apply horizontal forces at the surface.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫直接承受車輪衝擊：輪胎從橋面滾到鋼梁再滾回橋面，路面的高低差與間隙造成衝擊，動態放大比一般橋面更大；車輛煞車與加速又在縫面上施加水平力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Expansion joints take wheel impact directly: as a tyre rolls from the deck onto steel beams and back, steps and gaps cause impact with larger dynamic amplification than elsewhere on the deck, and braking and acceleration apply horizontal forces at the surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中梁輪載衝擊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Centre-beam wheel impact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue", which statement holds?
options: 輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN。
伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。
只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。
optionsEn: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN.
A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with.
If a joint has enough movement capacity, its fatigue test data need not be reviewed.
quiz.explanation: 輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「中梁輪載衝擊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Centre-beam wheel impact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購規格要求依交通量分級的疲勞試驗與型式認證，並規定縫面與鋪面高差允差；重車比例高的路段應優先採用經試驗驗證的連接細部，並把伸縮縫列入每次例行檢查的必看項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Procurement should require fatigue testing and type approval graded by traffic, and a flushness tolerance between joint and pavement; routes with heavy truck traffic should favour connection details proven by testing, and joints are a mandatory item at every routine inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。
knowledge.textEn: The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採購規格要求依交通量分級的疲勞試驗與型式認證，並規定縫面與鋪面高差允差；重車比例高的路段應優先採用經試驗驗證的連接細部，並把伸縮縫列入每次例行檢查的必看項目。
knowledge.textEn: Procurement should require fatigue testing and type approval graded by traffic, and a flushness tolerance between joint and pavement; routes with heavy truck traffic should favour connection details proven by testing, and joints are a mandatory item at every routine inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核。
伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic.
A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement.
quiz.explanation: 製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中梁輪載衝擊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Centre-beam wheel impact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：模組式伸縮縫的中梁像一根多跨連續梁，擱在間距約一公尺多的支撐梁上，每一次車輪通過都在中梁與支撐梁的焊接或連接處產生應力循環，所以疲勞是模組式伸縮縫最主要的結構問題，美國 NCHRP 的研究與 AASHTO 規範都要求以疲勞試驗驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In a modular joint the centre beam acts as a multi-span continuous beam on support bars spaced a little over a metre apart, and every wheel passage cycles stress at the centre-beam-to-support-bar weld or connection, so fatigue is the main structural issue for modular joints; NCHRP research and AASHTO provisions call for verification by fatigue testing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。
knowledge.textEn: The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。
中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system.
The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard.
quiz.explanation: 中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「伸縮縫型式與模組式構造」與「錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint types and modular construction" and "Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 伸縮縫型式與模組式構造：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint types and modular construction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「模組式中梁與支撐梁」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Modular centre beams and support bars” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 小位移可用壓縮密封縫或條形止水縫，中等位移可用梳齒板，大位移則用模組式伸縮縫：多根中梁把總位移分成數個間隙，每個間隙以橡膠止水帶封閉，下方支撐梁擱在錨碇箱內並可滑動，彈性控制系統讓各間隙平均開合。另一種大位移形式是旋轉橫梁（swivel joist）伸縮縫，支撐橫梁可旋轉，能同時容納縱向、橫向與轉角位移。Øresund 橋的 DS15 旋轉橫梁伸縮縫以 15 個型材容納約 1,500 mm 位移，新 Tappan Zee 橋最大的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫有 18 個間隙、位移可達約 1.4 m。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「模組式中梁與支撐梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small movements use compression seals or strip seals, medium movements finger plates, and large movements modular joints: several centre beams divide the total movement into gaps sealed by elastomeric profiles, support bars below slide within anchorage boxes, and an elastic control system keeps the gaps opening evenly. Another large-movement form is the swivel-joist joint, whose support joists can rotate, accommodating longitudinal, transverse and rotational movement together. The Øresund Bridge's DS15 swivel-joist joint takes about 1,500 mm with 15 profiles, and the largest LR18 modular joints on the new Tappan Zee crossing have 18 gaps and movements up to about 1.4 m. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Modular centre beams and support bars” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每間隙平均位移 = 總位移/間隙數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Average movement per gap = total movement/number of gaps.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「模組式中梁與支撐梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Modular centre beams and support bars”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 伸縮縫型式與模組式構造
knowledge.text: 小位移可用壓縮密封縫或條形止水縫，中等位移可用梳齒板，大位移則用模組式伸縮縫：多根中梁把總位移分成數個間隙，每個間隙以橡膠止水帶封閉，下方支撐梁擱在錨碇箱內並可滑動，彈性控制系統讓各間隙平均開合。另一種大位移形式是旋轉橫梁（swivel joist）伸縮縫，支撐橫梁可旋轉，能同時容納縱向、橫向與轉角位移。
knowledge.textEn: Small movements use compression seals or strip seals, medium movements finger plates, and large movements modular joints: several centre beams divide the total movement into gaps sealed by elastomeric profiles, support bars below slide within anchorage boxes, and an elastic control system keeps the gaps opening evenly. Another large-movement form is the swivel-joist joint, whose support joists can rotate, accommodating longitudinal, transverse and rotational movement together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「伸縮縫型式與模組式構造」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint types and modular construction" is correct?
options: 小位移可用壓縮密封縫或條形止水縫，中等位移可用梳齒板，大位移則用模組式伸縮縫：多根中梁把總位移分成數個間隙，每個間隙以橡膠止水帶封閉，下方支撐梁擱在錨碇箱內並可滑動，彈性控制系統讓各間隙平均開合。
模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。
後澆混凝土只要外觀硬化，就可以開放重車通行。
optionsEn: Small movements use compression seals or strip seals, medium movements finger plates, and large movements modular joints: several centre beams divide the total movement into gaps sealed by elastomeric profiles, support bars below slide within anchorage boxes, and an elastic control system keeps the gaps opening evenly.
Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system.
Once blockout concrete looks hard, heavy trucks can be allowed back.
quiz.explanation: 小位移可用壓縮密封縫或條形止水縫，中等位移可用梳齒板，大位移則用模組式伸縮縫：多根中梁把總位移分成數個間隙，每個間隙以橡膠止水帶封閉，下方支撐梁擱在錨碇箱內並可滑動，彈性控制系統讓各間隙平均開合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small movements use compression seals or strip seals, medium movements finger plates, and large movements modular joints: several centre beams divide the total movement into gaps sealed by elastomeric profiles, support bars below slide within anchorage boxes, and an elastic control system keeps the gaps opening evenly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 伸縮縫型式與模組式構造：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint types and modular construction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模組式中梁與支撐梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Modular centre beams and support bars” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每間隙平均位移 = 總位移/間隙數。Tappan Zee LR18：1,400/18 ≈ 78 mm（54 in/18 = 3 in）；Øresund DS15：1,500/15 = 100 mm；Köhlbrand LR8 760 mm、LR12 1,140 mm，皆約 95 mm/間隙。控制系統失效使一間隙承擔兩倍位移時，該間隙需約 156 至 200 mm，超過止水帶容許而撕裂。數值依公開資料換算，失效情境為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average movement per gap = total movement/number of gaps. Tappan Zee LR18: 1,400/18 ≈ 78 mm (54 in/18 = 3 in); Øresund DS15: 1,500/15 = 100 mm; Köhlbrand LR8 760 mm and LR12 1,140 mm, both about 95 mm per gap. If a failed control system lets one gap take twice its share, it needs about 156 to 200 mm, beyond the seal's capacity, and tears. Ratios are derived from public data; the failure case is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依位移、交通量、噪音與維護需求比較型式，製造圖須標示間隙數、每間隙最大開口、控制系統型式與預設方法；出廠前在工廠以千斤頂開合全行程，量測各間隙是否均勻（例如差異不超過數公釐）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare types by movement, traffic, noise and maintenance needs; shop drawings must show the number of gaps, maximum opening per gap, control-system type and presetting method; before dispatch, cycle the joint through its full range with jacks in the shop and measure gap uniformity, for example within a few millimetres.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每間隙平均位移 = 總位移/間隙數。Tappan Zee LR18：1,400/18 ≈ 78 mm（54 in/18 = 3 in）；Øresund DS15：1,500/15 = 100 mm；Köhlbrand LR8 760 mm、LR12 1,140 mm，皆約 95 mm/間隙。控制系統失效使一間隙承擔兩倍位移時，該間隙需約 156 至 200 mm，超過止水帶容許而撕裂。數值依公開資料換算，失效情境為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Average movement per gap = total movement/number of gaps. Tappan Zee LR18: 1,400/18 ≈ 78 mm (54 in/18 = 3 in); Øresund DS15: 1,500/15 = 100 mm; Köhlbrand LR8 760 mm and LR12 1,140 mm, both about 95 mm per gap. If a failed control system lets one gap take twice its share, it needs about 156 to 200 mm, beyond the seal's capacity, and tears. Ratios are derived from public data; the failure case is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「伸縮縫型式與模組式構造」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint types and modular construction", which statement holds?
options: 更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。
每間隙平均位移 = 總位移/間隙數。
伸縮縫的間隙每天都在變，量測它沒有意義。
optionsEn: Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew.
Average movement per gap = total movement/number of gaps.
Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless.
quiz.explanation: 每間隙平均位移 = 總位移/間隙數。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Average movement per gap = total movement/number of gaps. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 伸縮縫型式與模組式構造：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint types and modular construction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模組式中梁與支撐梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Modular centre beams and support bars” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依位移、交通量、噪音與維護需求比較型式，製造圖須標示間隙數、每間隙最大開口、控制系統型式與預設方法；出廠前在工廠以千斤頂開合全行程，量測各間隙是否均勻（例如差異不超過數公釐）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare types by movement, traffic, noise and maintenance needs; shop drawings must show the number of gaps, maximum opening per gap, control-system type and presetting method; before dispatch, cycle the joint through its full range with jacks in the shop and measure gap uniformity, for example within a few millimetres. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：伸縮縫型式選擇應以全生命週期考量，包括更換便利性（如可快速拆換的單元設計）；製造圖與出廠試驗紀錄須經設計單位審查，控制系統的備品與更換方法列入維護手冊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Choose the joint type on whole-life grounds, including ease of replacement such as quickly removable units; shop drawings and factory test records are reviewed by the designer, and control-system spares and replacement methods go into the maintenance manual.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：控制系統彈簧老化或斷裂，各間隙開合不均，一個間隙長期全開、另一個全閉，止水帶被拉斷或擠出，碎石塞入閉合間隙使中梁無法移動，最終把位移強迫傳給錨碇。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Aged or broken control springs make gaps open unevenly, leaving one permanently wide and another closed; seals tear or extrude, debris packs into the closed gap so centre beams cannot move, and movement is finally forced onto the anchorages. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依位移、交通量、噪音與維護需求比較型式，製造圖須標示間隙數、每間隙最大開口、控制系統型式與預設方法；出廠前在工廠以千斤頂開合全行程，量測各間隙是否均勻（例如差異不超過數公釐）。
knowledge.textEn: Compare types by movement, traffic, noise and maintenance needs; shop drawings must show the number of gaps, maximum opening per gap, control-system type and presetting method; before dispatch, cycle the joint through its full range with jacks in the shop and measure gap uniformity, for example within a few millimetres.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫型式選擇應以全生命週期考量，包括更換便利性（如可快速拆換的單元設計）；製造圖與出廠試驗紀錄須經設計單位審查，控制系統的備品與更換方法列入維護手冊。
knowledge.textEn: Choose the joint type on whole-life grounds, including ease of replacement such as quickly removable units; shop drawings and factory test records are reviewed by the designer, and control-system spares and replacement methods go into the maintenance manual.

quiz.question: 要驗證「伸縮縫型式與模組式構造」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint types and modular construction"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。
依位移、交通量、噪音與維護需求比較型式，製造圖須標示間隙數、每間隙最大開口、控制系統型式與預設方法。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design.
Compare types by movement, traffic, noise and maintenance needs.
quiz.explanation: 依位移、交通量、噪音與維護需求比較型式，製造圖須標示間隙數、每間隙最大開口、控制系統型式與預設方法；出廠前在工廠以千斤頂開合全行程，量測各間隙是否均勻（例如差異不超過數公釐）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare types by movement, traffic, noise and maintenance needs; shop drawings must show the number of gaps, maximum opening per gap, control-system type and presetting method; before dispatch, cycle the joint through its full range with jacks in the shop and measure gap uniformity, for example within a few millimetres. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 伸縮縫型式與模組式構造：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint types and modular construction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模組式中梁與支撐梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Modular centre beams and support bars” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 控制系統彈簧老化或斷裂，各間隙開合不均，一個間隙長期全開、另一個全閉，止水帶被拉斷或擠出，碎石塞入閉合間隙使中梁無法移動，最終把位移強迫傳給錨碇。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Aged or broken control springs make gaps open unevenly, leaving one permanently wide and another closed; seals tear or extrude, debris packs into the closed gap so centre beams cannot move, and movement is finally forced onto the anchorages. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Øresund 橋的 DS15 旋轉橫梁伸縮縫以 15 個型材容納約 1,500 mm 位移，新 Tappan Zee 橋最大的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫有 18 個間隙、位移可達約 1.4 m。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Øresund Bridge's DS15 swivel-joist joint takes about 1,500 mm with 15 profiles, and the largest LR18 modular joints on the new Tappan Zee crossing have 18 gaps and movements up to about 1.4 m.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 控制系統彈簧老化或斷裂，各間隙開合不均，一個間隙長期全開、另一個全閉，止水帶被拉斷或擠出，碎石塞入閉合間隙使中梁無法移動，最終把位移強迫傳給錨碇。
knowledge.textEn: Aged or broken control springs make gaps open unevenly, leaving one permanently wide and another closed; seals tear or extrude, debris packs into the closed gap so centre beams cannot move, and movement is finally forced onto the anchorages.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「伸縮縫型式與模組式構造」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint types and modular construction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 控制系統彈簧老化或斷裂，各間隙開合不均，一個間隙長期全開、另一個全閉，止水帶被拉斷或擠出，碎石塞入閉合間隙使中梁無法移動，最終把位移強迫傳給錨碇。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
後澆混凝土只要外觀硬化，就可以開放重車通行。
optionsEn: Aged or broken control springs make gaps open unevenly, leaving one permanently wide and another closed.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once blockout concrete looks hard, heavy trucks can be allowed back.
quiz.explanation: 控制系統彈簧老化或斷裂，各間隙開合不均，一個間隙長期全開、另一個全閉，止水帶被拉斷或擠出，碎石塞入閉合間隙使中梁無法移動，最終把位移強迫傳給錨碇。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Aged or broken control springs make gaps open unevenly, leaving one permanently wide and another closed; seals tear or extrude, debris packs into the closed gap so centre beams cannot move, and movement is finally forced onto the anchorages. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「錨碇箱與後澆混凝土」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchorage boxes and blockout concrete” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫的力量經錨碇箱、錨筋或錨栓傳到橋面板與梁端：豎向衝擊、上拔與煞車水平力都要靠這些錨碇承受。新建時先在梁端預留凹槽（後澆槽），伸縮縫定位後再澆置高強度或快硬混凝土；更換工程則要鑿除舊後澆混凝土、處理鋼筋，再澆新混凝土。後澆混凝土強度發展決定何時可以開放交通，而強度發展又強烈依賴溫度，所以冬季更換工程的封閉時間往往比夏季長。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「錨碇箱與後澆混凝土」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint forces pass through anchorage boxes, anchor bars or bolts into the deck slab and girder ends: vertical impact, uplift and horizontal braking all depend on them. In new construction a recess (blockout) is left at the girder end and filled with high-strength or rapid-hardening concrete after the joint is positioned; in replacements the old blockout concrete is broken out, the reinforcement treated and new concrete cast. Blockout strength gain decides when traffic can return, and strength gain depends strongly on temperature, so winter replacements often need longer closures than summer ones. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Anchorage boxes and blockout concrete” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)·Δt with T₀ = −10°C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「後澆混凝土只要外觀硬化，就可以開放重車通行。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

quiz.question: 關於「錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Joint forces pass through anchorage boxes, anchor bars or bolts into the deck slab and girder ends: vertical impact, uplift and horizontal braking all depend on them.

quiz.explanationEn: Joint forces pass through anchorage boxes, anchor bars or bolts into the deck slab and girder ends: vertical impact, uplift and horizontal braking all depend on them. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨碇箱與後澆混凝土」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchorage boxes and blockout concrete” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Nurse–Saul 成熟度 M = Σ(T − T₀)·Δt，T₀ = −10°C。若後澆混凝土達到通車強度需 M = 900 °C·h：養護溫度 20°C 時每小時累積 30 °C·h，需 900/30 = 30 h；10°C 時每小時 20 °C·h，需 45 h，多 15 h。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)·Δt with T₀ = −10°C. If the blockout concrete reaches opening strength at M = 900 °C·h, curing at 20°C accumulates 30 °C·h per hour and needs 900/30 = 30 h; at 10°C it accumulates 20 °C·h per hour and needs 45 h, 15 h more. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一配比預先建立成熟度—強度曲線，現場在後澆槽埋設溫度感測器即時計算成熟度，並以同條件養護試體確認；錨筋與錨栓在澆置前逐一檢查位置、焊接與保護層，舊混凝土界面清潔、濕潤並檢查無鬆動骨材。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish a maturity–strength curve for the same mix in advance, embed temperature sensors in the blockout to compute maturity in real time and confirm with field-cured specimens; check every anchor bar and bolt for position, welding and cover before casting, and make sure the old concrete interface is clean, damp and free of loose aggregate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Nurse–Saul 成熟度 M = Σ(T − T₀)·Δt，T₀ = −10°C。若後澆混凝土達到通車強度需 M = 900 °C·h：養護溫度 20°C 時每小時累積 30 °C·h，需 900/30 = 30 h；10°C 時每小時 20 °C·h，需 45 h，多 15 h。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)·Δt with T₀ = −10°C. If the blockout concrete reaches opening strength at M = 900 °C·h, curing at 20°C accumulates 30 °C·h per hour and needs 900/30 = 30 h; at 10°C it accumulates 20 °C·h per hour and needs 45 h, 15 h more. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing", which statement holds?
options: 只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。

Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)·Δt with T₀ = −10°C.

quiz.explanationEn: Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)·Δt with T₀ = −10°C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨碇箱與後澆混凝土」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchorage boxes and blockout concrete” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一配比預先建立成熟度—強度曲線，現場在後澆槽埋設溫度感測器即時計算成熟度，並以同條件養護試體確認；錨筋與錨栓在澆置前逐一檢查位置、焊接與保護層，舊混凝土界面清潔、濕潤並檢查無鬆動骨材。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish a maturity–strength curve for the same mix in advance, embed temperature sensors in the blockout to compute maturity in real time and confirm with field-cured specimens; check every anchor bar and bolt for position, welding and cover before casting, and make sure the old concrete interface is clean, damp and free of loose aggregate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：開放交通的條件以成熟度或試體強度表示，而不是以時間表示，並由監造書面放行；施工計畫須依季節預估養護時間並預留應變時段，冬季考慮加溫養護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Express release to traffic as a maturity or specimen-strength criterion rather than elapsed time, with written release by the supervising engineer; the construction plan estimates curing time by season with contingency, and heated curing is considered in winter.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：趕在強度未達前開放交通，後澆混凝土在錨筋周圍碎裂，伸縮縫數週內就鬆動並發出撞擊聲；舊混凝土鑿除不徹底，新舊界面脫開，水沿界面滲入梁端，造成鋼筋腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Opening to traffic before strength is reached shatters blockout concrete around the anchors, so the joint loosens and bangs within weeks; incomplete breakout leaves a debonded new-to-old interface that lets water reach the girder end and corrode reinforcement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以同一配比預先建立成熟度—強度曲線，現場在後澆槽埋設溫度感測器即時計算成熟度，並以同條件養護試體確認；錨筋與錨栓在澆置前逐一檢查位置、焊接與保護層，舊混凝土界面清潔、濕潤並檢查無鬆動骨材。
knowledge.textEn: Establish a maturity–strength curve for the same mix in advance, embed temperature sensors in the blockout to compute maturity in real time and confirm with field-cured specimens; check every anchor bar and bolt for position, welding and cover before casting, and make sure the old concrete interface is clean, damp and free of loose aggregate.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 開放交通的條件以成熟度或試體強度表示，而不是以時間表示，並由監造書面放行；施工計畫須依季節預估養護時間並預留應變時段，冬季考慮加溫養護。

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing"?
options: 以同一配比預先建立成熟度—強度曲線，現場在後澆槽埋設溫度感測器即時計算成熟度，並以同條件養護試體確認。

quiz.explanationEn: Establish a maturity–strength curve for the same mix in advance, embed temperature sensors in the blockout to compute maturity in real time and confirm with field-cured specimens; check every anchor bar and bolt for position, welding and cover before casting, and make sure the old concrete interface is clean, damp and free of loose aggregate. steps.title: 錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨碇箱與後澆混凝土」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Anchorage boxes and blockout concrete” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 趕在強度未達前開放交通，後澆混凝土在錨筋周圍碎裂，伸縮縫數週內就鬆動並發出撞擊聲；舊混凝土鑿除不徹底，新舊界面脫開，水沿界面滲入梁端，造成鋼筋腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Opening to traffic before strength is reached shatters blockout concrete around the anchors, so the joint loosens and bangs within weeks; incomplete breakout leaves a debonded new-to-old interface that lets water reach the girder end and corrode reinforcement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：後澆混凝土強度發展決定何時可以開放交通，而強度發展又強烈依賴溫度，所以冬季更換工程的封閉時間往往比夏季長。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Blockout strength gain decides when traffic can return, and strength gain depends strongly on temperature, so winter replacements often need longer closures than summer ones.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「後澆混凝土只要外觀硬化，就可以開放重車通行。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once blockout concrete looks hard, heavy trucks can be allowed back." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Installation temperature and preset opening" and "Staged replacement under traffic": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安裝溫度與預設開口：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Installation temperature and preset opening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「安裝預設開口」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Installation preset opening” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫在工廠以某一開口製造並以臨時夾具固定，安裝時必須依當下的結構溫度與尚未發生的乾縮潛變，調整到正確的預設開口：天氣熱時梁比平均長，開口應較窄；未來還會發生的單向縮短會讓伸縮縫逐漸張開，因此新建混凝土橋在安裝時要再預先收窄一些。預設錯誤的伸縮縫一開始就偏向行程的一端，往後在極端溫度時就會頂死或拉脫。量測要用結構實際溫度，而不是氣溫。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「安裝預設開口」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A joint is manufactured at a set opening and held by temporary clamps; at installation it must be adjusted to the correct preset opening for the current structure temperature and the shrinkage and creep still to come: in hot weather the girder is longer than average so the opening should be narrower, and future one-way shortening will gradually open the joint, so new concrete bridges are set a little narrower still. A joint preset wrongly starts biased towards one end of its range and later jams or pulls apart at extreme temperatures. The measurement must use actual structure temperature, not air temperature. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Installation preset opening” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：4 間隙共 320 mm 的伸縮縫中位開口 160 mm、參考溫度 20°C、伸縮長度 300 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 4-gap, 320 mm joint has a mid opening of 160 mm at a 20°C reference, with a 300 m expansion length.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「安裝預設開口」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Installation preset opening”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝溫度與預設開口
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫在工廠以某一開口製造並以臨時夾具固定，安裝時必須依當下的結構溫度與尚未發生的乾縮潛變，調整到正確的預設開口：天氣熱時梁比平均長，開口應較窄；未來還會發生的單向縮短會讓伸縮縫逐漸張開，因此新建混凝土橋在安裝時要再預先收窄一些。預設錯誤的伸縮縫一開始就偏向行程的一端，往後在極端溫度時就會頂死或拉脫。
knowledge.textEn: A joint is manufactured at a set opening and held by temporary clamps; at installation it must be adjusted to the correct preset opening for the current structure temperature and the shrinkage and creep still to come: in hot weather the girder is longer than average so the opening should be narrower, and future one-way shortening will gradually open the joint, so new concrete bridges are set a little narrower still. A joint preset wrongly starts biased towards one end of its range and later jams or pulls apart at extreme temperatures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝溫度與預設開口」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Installation temperature and preset opening" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。
更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。
伸縮縫在工廠以某一開口製造並以臨時夾具固定，安裝時必須依當下的結構溫度與尚未發生的乾縮潛變，調整到正確的預設開口：天氣熱時梁比平均長，開口應較窄。
optionsEn: A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with.
Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew.
A joint is manufactured at a set opening and held by temporary clamps.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫在工廠以某一開口製造並以臨時夾具固定，安裝時必須依當下的結構溫度與尚未發生的乾縮潛變，調整到正確的預設開口：天氣熱時梁比平均長，開口應較窄；未來還會發生的單向縮短會讓伸縮縫逐漸張開，因此新建混凝土橋在安裝時要再預先收窄一些。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A joint is manufactured at a set opening and held by temporary clamps; at installation it must be adjusted to the correct preset opening for the current structure temperature and the shrinkage and creep still to come: in hot weather the girder is longer than average so the opening should be narrower, and future one-way shortening will gradually open the joint, so new concrete bridges are set a little narrower still. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝溫度與預設開口：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Installation temperature and preset opening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安裝預設開口」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Installation preset opening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：4 間隙共 320 mm 的伸縮縫中位開口 160 mm、參考溫度 20°C、伸縮長度 300 m。安裝時結構溫度 32°C，梁較中位長 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×12 = 36 mm；未來尚有一半乾縮潛變 0.5×(60 + 64) ≈ 62 mm 會使縫張開。預設開口 = 160 − 36 − 62 ≈ 62 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 4-gap, 320 mm joint has a mid opening of 160 mm at a 20°C reference, with a 300 m expansion length. At a structure temperature of 32°C the girder is 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×12 = 36 mm longer than at mid; half the shrinkage and creep, 0.5×(60 + 64) ≈ 62 mm, is still to come and will open the joint. Preset opening = 160 − 36 − 62 ≈ 62 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝當天以埋設或表面溫度計量測梁體平均溫度（避免日照直射時段），依預設表計算開口，現場以量規量測各間隙並記錄；夾具拆除前確認預設正確並經監造簽認，拆除後再量一次並記錄當時溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the day, measure the girder's average temperature with embedded or surface thermometers away from direct sun, calculate the opening from the preset table, gauge and record every gap; before releasing clamps confirm the preset and obtain the supervising engineer's signature, then measure again after release and record the temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 4 間隙共 320 mm 的伸縮縫中位開口 160 mm、參考溫度 20°C、伸縮長度 300 m。安裝時結構溫度 32°C，梁較中位長 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×12 = 36 mm；未來尚有一半乾縮潛變 0.5×(60 + 64) ≈ 62 mm 會使縫張開。預設開口 = 160 − 36 − 62 ≈ 62 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 4-gap, 320 mm joint has a mid opening of 160 mm at a 20°C reference, with a 300 m expansion length. At a structure temperature of 32°C the girder is 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×12 = 36 mm longer than at mid; half the shrinkage and creep, 0.5×(60 + 64) ≈ 62 mm, is still to come and will open the joint. Preset opening = 160 − 36 − 62 ≈ 62 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝溫度與預設開口」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Installation temperature and preset opening", which statement holds?
options: 4 間隙共 320 mm 的伸縮縫中位開口 160 mm、參考溫度 20°C、伸縮長度 300 m。
伸縮縫的間隙每天都在變，量測它沒有意義。
伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。
optionsEn: A 4-gap, 320 mm joint has a mid opening of 160 mm at a 20°C reference, with a 300 m expansion length.
Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless.
A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design.
quiz.explanation: 4 間隙共 320 mm 的伸縮縫中位開口 160 mm、參考溫度 20°C、伸縮長度 300 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 4-gap, 320 mm joint has a mid opening of 160 mm at a 20°C reference, with a 300 m expansion length. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝溫度與預設開口：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Installation temperature and preset opening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「安裝預設開口」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Installation preset opening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝當天以埋設或表面溫度計量測梁體平均溫度（避免日照直射時段），依預設表計算開口，現場以量規量測各間隙並記錄；夾具拆除前確認預設正確並經監造簽認，拆除後再量一次並記錄當時溫度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the day, measure the girder's average temperature with embedded or surface thermometers away from direct sun, calculate the opening from the preset table, gauge and record every gap; before releasing clamps confirm the preset and obtain the supervising engineer's signature, then measure again after release and record the temperature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計文件應提供以結構溫度為變數的預設開口表，並說明殘餘乾縮潛變的假設；安裝與夾具拆除列為停留點，量測溫度、開口與時間的紀錄須隨竣工資料保存。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design documents should give a preset table with structure temperature as the variable and state the assumed remaining shrinkage and creep; installation and clamp release are hold points, and the measured temperature, opening and time are kept with the as-built records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以中午氣溫推算預設值而非結構溫度，開口設得過寬，冬季縫隙超過行程、止水帶拉斷；忘記扣除未來乾縮潛變，伸縮縫幾年後就長期偏開，夏季行程又不足而頂死，把力量推到梁端與墩頂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Presetting from noon air temperature instead of structure temperature sets the opening too wide, so winter gaps exceed the range and seals tear; forgetting future shrinkage and creep leaves the joint permanently wide after a few years and short of range in summer, jamming and pushing force into girder ends and pier tops. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝當天以埋設或表面溫度計量測梁體平均溫度（避免日照直射時段），依預設表計算開口，現場以量規量測各間隙並記錄；夾具拆除前確認預設正確並經監造簽認，拆除後再量一次並記錄當時溫度。
knowledge.textEn: On the day, measure the girder's average temperature with embedded or surface thermometers away from direct sun, calculate the opening from the preset table, gauge and record every gap; before releasing clamps confirm the preset and obtain the supervising engineer's signature, then measure again after release and record the temperature.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計文件應提供以結構溫度為變數的預設開口表，並說明殘餘乾縮潛變的假設；安裝與夾具拆除列為停留點，量測溫度、開口與時間的紀錄須隨竣工資料保存。
knowledge.textEn: Design documents should give a preset table with structure temperature as the variable and state the assumed remaining shrinkage and creep; installation and clamp release are hold points, and the measured temperature, opening and time are kept with the as-built records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝溫度與預設開口」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Installation temperature and preset opening"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
安裝當天以埋設或表面溫度計量測梁體平均溫度（避免日照直射時段），依預設表計算開口，現場以量規量測各間隙並記錄。
伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
On the day, measure the girder's average temperature with embedded or surface thermometers away from direct sun, calculate the opening from the preset table, gauge and record every gap.
An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design.
quiz.explanation: 安裝當天以埋設或表面溫度計量測梁體平均溫度（避免日照直射時段），依預設表計算開口，現場以量規量測各間隙並記錄；夾具拆除前確認預設正確並經監造簽認，拆除後再量一次並記錄當時溫度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: On the day, measure the girder's average temperature with embedded or surface thermometers away from direct sun, calculate the opening from the preset table, gauge and record every gap; before releasing clamps confirm the preset and obtain the supervising engineer's signature, then measure again after release and record the temperature. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝溫度與預設開口：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Installation temperature and preset opening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「安裝預設開口」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Installation preset opening” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以中午氣溫推算預設值而非結構溫度，開口設得過寬，冬季縫隙超過行程、止水帶拉斷；忘記扣除未來乾縮潛變，伸縮縫幾年後就長期偏開，夏季行程又不足而頂死，把力量推到梁端與墩頂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Presetting from noon air temperature instead of structure temperature sets the opening too wide, so winter gaps exceed the range and seals tear; forgetting future shrinkage and creep leaves the joint permanently wide after a few years and short of range in summer, jamming and pushing force into girder ends and pier tops. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測要用結構實際溫度，而不是氣溫。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The measurement must use actual structure temperature, not air temperature.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以中午氣溫推算預設值而非結構溫度，開口設得過寬，冬季縫隙超過行程、止水帶拉斷；忘記扣除未來乾縮潛變，伸縮縫幾年後就長期偏開，夏季行程又不足而頂死，把力量推到梁端與墩頂。
knowledge.textEn: Presetting from noon air temperature instead of structure temperature sets the opening too wide, so winter gaps exceed the range and seals tear; forgetting future shrinkage and creep leaves the joint permanently wide after a few years and short of range in summer, jamming and pushing force into girder ends and pier tops.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝溫度與預設開口」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Installation temperature and preset opening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。
以中午氣溫推算預設值而非結構溫度，開口設得過寬，冬季縫隙超過行程、止水帶拉斷。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew.
Presetting from noon air temperature instead of structure temperature sets the opening too wide, so winter gaps exceed the range and seals tear.
quiz.explanation: 以中午氣溫推算預設值而非結構溫度，開口設得過寬，冬季縫隙超過行程、止水帶拉斷；忘記扣除未來乾縮潛變，伸縮縫幾年後就長期偏開，夏季行程又不足而頂死，把力量推到梁端與墩頂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Presetting from noon air temperature instead of structure temperature sets the opening too wide, so winter gaps exceed the range and seals tear; forgetting future shrinkage and creep leaves the joint permanently wide after a few years and short of range in summer, jamming and pushing force into girder ends and pier tops. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通車條件下的分階段更換：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Staged replacement under traffic: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「分幅更換與臨時鋪板」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Staged replacement and temporary plates” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫更換多半必須在不中斷交通的情況下進行：先封閉部分車道，拆除該幅舊伸縮縫與後澆混凝土，安裝新單元並與相鄰段焊接或栓接，澆置養護後開放，再轉換到另一幅。Øresund 橋 2025 年更換第一座旋轉橫梁伸縮縫時保留了既有錨碇在混凝土中的橫梁箱，只更換伸縮縫單元，並以兩階段三部分施工，先換中段、交通走外側，再換外側兩段；營運單位公告此類大型伸縮縫更換須限制為單向一車道約八週。分段接頭處的焊接與對位品質，決定了日後是否成為疲勞弱點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「分幅更換與臨時鋪板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint replacement usually has to proceed without stopping traffic: some lanes are closed, the old joint and blockout concrete in that width are removed, the new unit is installed and welded or bolted to the adjacent part, the blockout is cast and cured and the lanes reopened before moving to the next width. When the Øresund Bridge replaced its first swivel-joist joint in 2025, the traverse boxes anchored in the concrete were kept and only the joint unit was exchanged, in two stages and three parts: first the middle part with traffic outside, then the two outer parts; the operator announced that such large joint replacements limit traffic to one lane each way for about eight weeks. The quality of welding and alignment at the splices between parts decides whether they become fatigue weak points. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Staged replacement and temporary plates” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每一幅的工期 = 拆除 10 h + 安裝 8 h + 分段焊接 6 h + 後澆養護。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each width takes breakout 10 h + installation 8 h + splice welding 6 h + blockout curing.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「分幅更換與臨時鋪板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Staged replacement and temporary plates”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 伸縮縫更換多半必須在不中斷交通的情況下進行：先封閉部分車道，拆除該幅舊伸縮縫與後澆混凝土，安裝新單元並與相鄰段焊接或栓接，澆置養護後開放，再轉換到另一幅。Øresund 橋 2025 年更換第一座旋轉橫梁伸縮縫時保留了既有錨碇在混凝土中的橫梁箱，只更換伸縮縫單元，並以兩階段三部分施工，先換中段、交通走外側，再換外側兩段；營運單位公告此類大型伸縮縫更換須限制為單向一車道約八週。
knowledge.textEn: Joint replacement usually has to proceed without stopping traffic: some lanes are closed, the old joint and blockout concrete in that width are removed, the new unit is installed and welded or bolted to the adjacent part, the blockout is cast and cured and the lanes reopened before moving to the next width. When the Øresund Bridge replaced its first swivel-joist joint in 2025, the traverse boxes anchored in the concrete were kept and only the joint unit was exchanged, in two stages and three parts: first the middle part with traffic outside, then the two outer parts; the operator announced that such large joint replacements limit traffic to one lane each way for about eight weeks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通車條件下的分階段更換」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Staged replacement under traffic" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫更換多半必須在不中斷交通的情況下進行：先封閉部分車道，拆除該幅舊伸縮縫與後澆混凝土，安裝新單元並與相鄰段焊接或栓接，澆置養護後開放，再轉換到另一幅。
更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。
只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。
optionsEn: Joint replacement usually has to proceed without stopping traffic: some lanes are closed, the old joint and blockout concrete in that width are removed, the new unit is installed and welded or bolted to the adjacent part, the blockout is cast and cured and the lanes reopened before moving to the next width.
Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew.
If a joint has enough movement capacity, its fatigue test data need not be reviewed.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫更換多半必須在不中斷交通的情況下進行：先封閉部分車道，拆除該幅舊伸縮縫與後澆混凝土，安裝新單元並與相鄰段焊接或栓接，澆置養護後開放，再轉換到另一幅。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint replacement usually has to proceed without stopping traffic: some lanes are closed, the old joint and blockout concrete in that width are removed, the new unit is installed and welded or bolted to the adjacent part, the blockout is cast and cured and the lanes reopened before moving to the next width. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通車條件下的分階段更換：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged replacement under traffic: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分幅更換與臨時鋪板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Staged replacement and temporary plates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每一幅的工期 = 拆除 10 h + 安裝 8 h + 分段焊接 6 h + 後澆養護。20°C 時養護 30 h，每幅 54 h，兩幅 108 h；10°C 時養護 45 h，每幅 69 h，兩幅 138 h，多出約 28%。若保留錨碇箱只換單元，拆除時間可再縮短。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each width takes breakout 10 h + installation 8 h + splice welding 6 h + blockout curing. At 20°C curing is 30 h, so 54 h per width and 108 h for two; at 10°C curing is 45 h, so 69 h per width and 138 h for two, about 28% longer. Keeping the anchorage boxes and changing only the unit can shorten breakout further. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：更換前詳細調查舊伸縮縫的錨碇、梁端與支承狀況，決定保留或重建錨碇；交通維持計畫須經主管機關核准，臨時鋪板的承載與固定須經計算；分段接頭的焊接程序事先評定，現場焊後以超音波或磁粉檢測，接頭高差與平整度量測合格才開放。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before replacement, survey the old joint's anchorage, girder ends and bearings in detail to decide whether to keep or rebuild the anchorage; the traffic management plan needs authority approval and temporary plates need calculated capacity and fixing; splice welding procedures are qualified in advance, site welds tested by ultrasonics or magnetic particle, and the joint opens only after step and flatness checks pass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每一幅的工期 = 拆除 10 h + 安裝 8 h + 分段焊接 6 h + 後澆養護。20°C 時養護 30 h，每幅 54 h，兩幅 108 h；10°C 時養護 45 h，每幅 69 h，兩幅 138 h，多出約 28%。若保留錨碇箱只換單元，拆除時間可再縮短。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Each width takes breakout 10 h + installation 8 h + splice welding 6 h + blockout curing. At 20°C curing is 30 h, so 54 h per width and 108 h for two; at 10°C curing is 45 h, so 69 h per width and 138 h for two, about 28% longer. Keeping the anchorage boxes and changing only the unit can shorten breakout further. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通車條件下的分階段更換」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Staged replacement under traffic", which statement holds?
options: 伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。
每一幅的工期 = 拆除 10 h + 安裝 8 h + 分段焊接 6 h + 後澆養護。
伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。
optionsEn: A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement.
Each width takes breakout 10 h + installation 8 h + splice welding 6 h + blockout curing.
Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change.
quiz.explanation: 每一幅的工期 = 拆除 10 h + 安裝 8 h + 分段焊接 6 h + 後澆養護。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Each width takes breakout 10 h + installation 8 h + splice welding 6 h + blockout curing. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通車條件下的分階段更換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Staged replacement under traffic: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分幅更換與臨時鋪板」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Staged replacement and temporary plates” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 更換前詳細調查舊伸縮縫的錨碇、梁端與支承狀況，決定保留或重建錨碇；交通維持計畫須經主管機關核准，臨時鋪板的承載與固定須經計算；分段接頭的焊接程序事先評定，現場焊後以超音波或磁粉檢測，接頭高差與平整度量測合格才開放。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before replacement, survey the old joint's anchorage, girder ends and bearings in detail to decide whether to keep or rebuild the anchorage; the traffic management plan needs authority approval and temporary plates need calculated capacity and fixing; splice welding procedures are qualified in advance, site welds tested by ultrasonics or magnetic particle, and the joint opens only after step and flatness checks pass. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：更換工程須有結構工程師參與，鑿除時規定保護梁端鋼筋與預力錨頭的方法；每一幅完成後的開放條件（強度、焊接檢測、高差）列為停留點並由監造簽認，交通維持與臨時鋪板由交通工程師負責。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Replacement work needs a structural engineer, with specified methods to protect girder-end reinforcement and prestress anchorages during breakout; the release conditions for each width (strength, weld testing, flushness) are hold points signed by the supervising engineer, and traffic management and temporary plates are a traffic engineer's responsibility.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：分幅施工時新舊段在接頭處高程不一，形成跳車並加速接頭疲勞；臨時鋪板固定不良被車輛帶起，造成交通事故；拆除時損傷梁端鋼筋或預力錨頭而未發現，日後成為結構弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In staged work, mismatched levels at the new-to-old splice create a bump that accelerates fatigue at the splice; badly fixed temporary plates are lifted by traffic and cause accidents; damage to girder-end reinforcement or prestress anchorages during breakout goes unnoticed and becomes a structural weakness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 更換前詳細調查舊伸縮縫的錨碇、梁端與支承狀況，決定保留或重建錨碇；交通維持計畫須經主管機關核准，臨時鋪板的承載與固定須經計算；分段接頭的焊接程序事先評定，現場焊後以超音波或磁粉檢測，接頭高差與平整度量測合格才開放。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 更換工程須有結構工程師參與，鑿除時規定保護梁端鋼筋與預力錨頭的方法；每一幅完成後的開放條件（強度、焊接檢測、高差）列為停留點並由監造簽認，交通維持與臨時鋪板由交通工程師負責。
