quiz.question: 要驗證「通車條件下的分階段更換」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Staged replacement under traffic"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。
更換前詳細調查舊伸縮縫的錨碇、梁端與支承狀況，決定保留或重建錨碇。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system.
Before replacement, survey the old joint's anchorage, girder ends and bearings in detail to decide whether to keep or rebuild the anchorage.
quiz.explanation: 更換前詳細調查舊伸縮縫的錨碇、梁端與支承狀況，決定保留或重建錨碇；交通維持計畫須經主管機關核准，臨時鋪板的承載與固定須經計算；分段接頭的焊接程序事先評定，現場焊後以超音波或磁粉檢測，接頭高差與平整度量測合格才開放。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before replacement, survey the old joint's anchorage, girder ends and bearings in detail to decide whether to keep or rebuild the anchorage; the traffic management plan needs authority approval and temporary plates need calculated capacity and fixing; splice welding procedures are qualified in advance, site welds tested by ultrasonics or magnetic particle, and the joint opens only after step and flatness checks pass. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通車條件下的分階段更換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged replacement under traffic: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分幅更換與臨時鋪板」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Staged replacement and temporary plates” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 分幅施工時新舊段在接頭處高程不一，形成跳車並加速接頭疲勞；臨時鋪板固定不良被車輛帶起，造成交通事故；拆除時損傷梁端鋼筋或預力錨頭而未發現，日後成為結構弱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: In staged work, mismatched levels at the new-to-old splice create a bump that accelerates fatigue at the splice; badly fixed temporary plates are lifted by traffic and cause accidents; damage to girder-end reinforcement or prestress anchorages during breakout goes unnoticed and becomes a structural weakness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分段接頭處的焊接與對位品質，決定了日後是否成為疲勞弱點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The quality of welding and alignment at the splices between parts decides whether they become fatigue weak points.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 分幅施工時新舊段在接頭處高程不一，形成跳車並加速接頭疲勞；臨時鋪板固定不良被車輛帶起，造成交通事故；拆除時損傷梁端鋼筋或預力錨頭而未發現，日後成為結構弱點。
knowledge.textEn: In staged work, mismatched levels at the new-to-old splice create a bump that accelerates fatigue at the splice; badly fixed temporary plates are lifted by traffic and cause accidents; damage to girder-end reinforcement or prestress anchorages during breakout goes unnoticed and becomes a structural weakness.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通車條件下的分階段更換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Staged replacement under traffic" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 分幅施工時新舊段在接頭處高程不一，形成跳車並加速接頭疲勞；臨時鋪板固定不良被車輛帶起，造成交通事故；拆除時損傷梁端鋼筋或預力錨頭而未發現，日後成為結構弱點。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。
optionsEn: In staged work, mismatched levels at the new-to-old splice create a bump that accelerates fatigue at the splice.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If a joint has enough movement capacity, its fatigue test data need not be reviewed.
quiz.explanation: 分幅施工時新舊段在接頭處高程不一，形成跳車並加速接頭疲勞；臨時鋪板固定不良被車輛帶起，造成交通事故；拆除時損傷梁端鋼筋或預力錨頭而未發現，日後成為結構弱點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In staged work, mismatched levels at the new-to-old splice create a bump that accelerates fatigue at the splice; badly fixed temporary plates are lifted by traffic and cause accidents; damage to girder-end reinforcement or prestress anchorages during breakout goes unnoticed and becomes a structural weakness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證」與「現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval" and "Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「疲勞與水密試驗」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fatigue and watertightness tests” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫在現場很難做全尺寸試驗，因此性能主要靠型式試驗與出廠檢驗保證：模組式伸縮縫的中梁與支撐梁連接要做疲勞試驗，止水帶要做水密與耐候試驗，控制系統要做開合循環試驗；歐洲以技術認證指引規範這些項目，美國則在 AASHTO 規範中要求模組式伸縮縫的疲勞試驗。疲勞試驗常以加大的應力幅加速，換算回設計交通下的等效循環次數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「疲勞與水密試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joints are hard to test full scale on site, so performance is assured mainly by type tests and factory inspection: centre-beam-to-support-bar connections in modular joints undergo fatigue tests, seals undergo watertightness and weathering tests, and control systems undergo opening–closing cycle tests; in Europe a technical-approval guideline covers these items, and in the US AASHTO requires fatigue testing of modular joints. Fatigue tests are often accelerated at a higher stress range and converted back to equivalent cycles under design traffic. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fatigue and watertightness tests” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：S–N 曲線 m = 3 時，等效循環 N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With an m = 3 S–N curve, equivalent cycles N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a joint has enough movement capacity, its fatigue test data need not be reviewed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「疲勞與水密試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fatigue and watertightness tests”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證
knowledge.titleEn: Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫在現場很難做全尺寸試驗，因此性能主要靠型式試驗與出廠檢驗保證：模組式伸縮縫的中梁與支撐梁連接要做疲勞試驗，止水帶要做水密與耐候試驗，控制系統要做開合循環試驗；歐洲以技術認證指引規範這些項目，美國則在 AASHTO 規範中要求模組式伸縮縫的疲勞試驗。疲勞試驗常以加大的應力幅加速，換算回設計交通下的等效循環次數。
knowledge.textEn: Joints are hard to test full scale on site, so performance is assured mainly by type tests and factory inspection: centre-beam-to-support-bar connections in modular joints undergo fatigue tests, seals undergo watertightness and weathering tests, and control systems undergo opening–closing cycle tests; in Europe a technical-approval guideline covers these items, and in the US AASHTO requires fatigue testing of modular joints. Fatigue tests are often accelerated at a higher stress range and converted back to equivalent cycles under design traffic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a joint has enough movement capacity, its fatigue test data need not be reviewed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval" is correct?
options: 只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。
伸縮縫在現場很難做全尺寸試驗，因此性能主要靠型式試驗與出廠檢驗保證：模組式伸縮縫的中梁與支撐梁連接要做疲勞試驗，止水帶要做水密與耐候試驗，控制系統要做開合循環試驗。
伸縮縫的間隙每天都在變，量測它沒有意義。
optionsEn: If a joint has enough movement capacity, its fatigue test data need not be reviewed.

Joints are hard to test full scale on site, so performance is assured mainly by type tests and factory inspection: centre-beam-to-support-bar connections in modular joints undergo fatigue tests, seals undergo watertightness and weathering tests, and control systems undergo opening–closing cycle tests.
Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫在現場很難做全尺寸試驗，因此性能主要靠型式試驗與出廠檢驗保證：模組式伸縮縫的中梁與支撐梁連接要做疲勞試驗，止水帶要做水密與耐候試驗，控制系統要做開合循環試驗；歐洲以技術認證指引規範這些項目，美國則在 AASHTO 規範中要求模組式伸縮縫的疲勞試驗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joints are hard to test full scale on site, so performance is assured mainly by type tests and factory inspection: centre-beam-to-support-bar connections in modular joints undergo fatigue tests, seals undergo watertightness and weathering tests, and control systems undergo opening–closing cycle tests; in Europe a technical-approval guideline covers these items, and in the US AASHTO requires fatigue testing of modular joints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「疲勞與水密試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fatigue and watertightness tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N 曲線 m = 3 時，等效循環 N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³。設計交通在 30 MPa 下相當於 2×10⁸ 次，試驗以 60 MPa 進行，等效次數 2×10⁸×(30/60)³ = 2.5×10⁷ 次，仍需長時間試驗，故常再以更高應力幅或規範規定的試驗程序執行。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an m = 3 S–N curve, equivalent cycles N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³. Design traffic equivalent to 2×10⁸ cycles at 30 MPa, tested at 60 MPa, needs 2×10⁸×(30/60)³ = 2.5×10⁷ cycles, still a long test, so higher stress ranges or code-prescribed procedures are commonly used. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：審查製造商的型式認證、疲勞試驗報告與試驗試體是否與供貨細部一致；出廠時檢查中梁焊縫的非破壞檢測、防蝕塗裝厚度、止水帶安裝與全行程開合，並在工廠做局部注水試驗確認無滲漏。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review the manufacturer's type approval and fatigue test reports and check that test specimens match the supplied details; at dispatch inspect centre-beam weld NDT, corrosion-protection coating thickness, seal installation and full-range cycling, and run a local water test in the shop to confirm no leakage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: S–N 曲線 m = 3 時，等效循環 N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³。設計交通在 30 MPa 下相當於 2×10⁸ 次，試驗以 60 MPa 進行，等效次數 2×10⁸×(30/60)³ = 2.5×10⁷ 次，仍需長時間試驗，故常再以更高應力幅或規範規定的試驗程序執行。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With an m = 3 S–N curve, equivalent cycles N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³. Design traffic equivalent to 2×10⁸ cycles at 30 MPa, tested at 60 MPa, needs 2×10⁸×(30/60)³ = 2.5×10⁷ cycles, still a long test, so higher stress ranges or code-prescribed procedures are commonly used. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval", which statement holds?
options: 伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。
伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。
S–N 曲線 m = 3 時，等效循環 N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³。
optionsEn: A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design.
An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design.
With an m = 3 S–N curve, equivalent cycles N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³.
quiz.explanation: S–N 曲線 m = 3 時，等效循環 N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With an m = 3 S–N curve, equivalent cycles N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「疲勞與水密試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fatigue and watertightness tests” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 審查製造商的型式認證、疲勞試驗報告與試驗試體是否與供貨細部一致；出廠時檢查中梁焊縫的非破壞檢測、防蝕塗裝厚度、止水帶安裝與全行程開合，並在工廠做局部注水試驗確認無滲漏。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review the manufacturer's type approval and fatigue test reports and check that test specimens match the supplied details; at dispatch inspect centre-beam weld NDT, corrosion-protection coating thickness, seal installation and full-range cycling, and run a local water test in the shop to confirm no leakage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：招標文件應要求提送與供貨一致的型式試驗與疲勞試驗報告，並規定出廠檢驗的見證項目；任何細部變更都需重新證明性能並經設計單位同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tender documents should require type and fatigue test reports matching the supplied product and define witnessed factory inspections; any detail change requires renewed proof of performance and the designer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：供貨細部與試驗試體不同（例如改了焊接型式或支撐間距），疲勞試驗結果就不再適用，伸縮縫在通車數年內出現中梁焊縫裂縫；止水帶材料未經耐候驗證，在紫外線與臭氧下硬化龜裂而漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If supplied details differ from the test specimens, for example a changed weld type or support spacing, the fatigue results no longer apply and centre-beam welds crack within a few years of opening; seal material not proven for weathering hardens and cracks under UV and ozone and leaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 審查製造商的型式認證、疲勞試驗報告與試驗試體是否與供貨細部一致；出廠時檢查中梁焊縫的非破壞檢測、防蝕塗裝厚度、止水帶安裝與全行程開合，並在工廠做局部注水試驗確認無滲漏。
knowledge.textEn: Review the manufacturer's type approval and fatigue test reports and check that test specimens match the supplied details; at dispatch inspect centre-beam weld NDT, corrosion-protection coating thickness, seal installation and full-range cycling, and run a local water test in the shop to confirm no leakage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 招標文件應要求提送與供貨一致的型式試驗與疲勞試驗報告，並規定出廠檢驗的見證項目；任何細部變更都需重新證明性能並經設計單位同意。
knowledge.textEn: Tender documents should require type and fatigue test reports matching the supplied product and define witnessed factory inspections; any detail change requires renewed proof of performance and the designer's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval"?
options: 審查製造商的型式認證、疲勞試驗報告與試驗試體是否與供貨細部一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
後澆混凝土只要外觀硬化，就可以開放重車通行。
optionsEn: Review the manufacturer's type approval and fatigue test reports and check that test specimens match the supplied details.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once blockout concrete looks hard, heavy trucks can be allowed back.
quiz.explanation: 審查製造商的型式認證、疲勞試驗報告與試驗試體是否與供貨細部一致；出廠時檢查中梁焊縫的非破壞檢測、防蝕塗裝厚度、止水帶安裝與全行程開合，並在工廠做局部注水試驗確認無滲漏。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Review the manufacturer's type approval and fatigue test reports and check that test specimens match the supplied details; at dispatch inspect centre-beam weld NDT, corrosion-protection coating thickness, seal installation and full-range cycling, and run a local water test in the shop to confirm no leakage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「疲勞與水密試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fatigue and watertightness tests” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 供貨細部與試驗試體不同（例如改了焊接型式或支撐間距），疲勞試驗結果就不再適用，伸縮縫在通車數年內出現中梁焊縫裂縫；止水帶材料未經耐候驗證，在紫外線與臭氧下硬化龜裂而漏水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If supplied details differ from the test specimens, for example a changed weld type or support spacing, the fatigue results no longer apply and centre-beam welds crack within a few years of opening; seal material not proven for weathering hardens and cracks under UV and ozone and leaks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：疲勞試驗常以加大的應力幅加速，換算回設計交通下的等效循環次數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Fatigue tests are often accelerated at a higher stress range and converted back to equivalent cycles under design traffic.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a joint has enough movement capacity, its fatigue test data need not be reviewed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 供貨細部與試驗試體不同（例如改了焊接型式或支撐間距），疲勞試驗結果就不再適用，伸縮縫在通車數年內出現中梁焊縫裂縫；止水帶材料未經耐候驗證，在紫外線與臭氧下硬化龜裂而漏水。
knowledge.textEn: If supplied details differ from the test specimens, for example a changed weld type or support spacing, the fatigue results no longer apply and centre-beam welds crack within a few years of opening; seal material not proven for weathering hardens and cracks under UV and ozone and leaks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
供貨細部與試驗試體不同（例如改了焊接型式或支撐間距），疲勞試驗結果就不再適用，伸縮縫在通車數年內出現中梁焊縫裂縫。
伸縮縫的間隙每天都在變，量測它沒有意義。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If supplied details differ from the test specimens, for example a changed weld type or support spacing, the fatigue results no longer apply and centre-beam welds crack within a few years of opening.
Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless.
quiz.explanation: 供貨細部與試驗試體不同（例如改了焊接型式或支撐間距），疲勞試驗結果就不再適用，伸縮縫在通車數年內出現中梁焊縫裂縫；止水帶材料未經耐候驗證，在紫外線與臭氧下硬化龜裂而漏水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If supplied details differ from the test specimens, for example a changed weld type or support spacing, the fatigue results no longer apply and centre-beam welds crack within a few years of opening; seal material not proven for weathering hardens and cracks under UV and ozone and leaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「間隙—溫度量測」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gap–temperature measurement” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫安裝後的行為是檢驗整個伸縮系統的好指標：若結構能自由伸縮，伸縮縫間隙應隨結構溫度線性變化，斜率等於 α 乘伸縮長度。量測多個季節的間隙與溫度，若斜率明顯偏小，表示某處被約束，例如活動支承卡住、梁端頂到橋台背牆或固定點位置與設計不同；若間隙隨時間單向張開，則反映乾縮潛變的進展。這種量測簡單但資訊豐富，適合列入驗收與定期檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「間隙—溫度量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A joint's behaviour after installation is a good indicator of the whole movement system: if the structure moves freely, the gap varies linearly with structure temperature at a slope equal to α times the expansion length. Measuring gap and temperature across several seasons, a markedly lower slope points to restraint somewhere, such as a seized sliding bearing, a girder end bearing against the abutment backwall or a fixed point different from design; a gap opening steadily over time reflects ongoing shrinkage and creep. The measurement is simple but rich in information and suits acceptance and routine inspection. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Gap–temperature measurement” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：理論斜率 dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Theoretical slope dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫的間隙每天都在變，量測它沒有意義。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「間隙—溫度量測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Gap–temperature measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Measuring gap and temperature across several seasons, a markedly lower slope points to restraint somewhere, such as a seized sliding bearing, a girder end bearing against the abutment backwall or a fixed point different from design; a gap opening steadily over time reflects ongoing shrinkage and creep.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫的間隙每天都在變，量測它沒有意義。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫的間隙每天都在變，量測它沒有意義。
伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。
伸縮縫安裝後的行為是檢驗整個伸縮系統的好指標：若結構能自由伸縮，伸縮縫間隙應隨結構溫度線性變化，斜率等於 α 乘伸縮長度。
optionsEn: Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless.
A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement.

A joint's behaviour after installation is a good indicator of the whole movement system: if the structure moves freely, the gap varies linearly with structure temperature at a slope equal to α times the expansion length.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫安裝後的行為是檢驗整個伸縮系統的好指標：若結構能自由伸縮，伸縮縫間隙應隨結構溫度線性變化，斜率等於 α 乘伸縮長度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A joint's behaviour after installation is a good indicator of the whole movement system: if the structure moves freely, the gap varies linearly with structure temperature at a slope equal to α times the expansion length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「間隙—溫度量測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gap–temperature measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：理論斜率 dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C。若現場迴歸得 2.4 mm/°C，等效伸縮長度 2.4/(10×10⁻⁶) = 240,000 mm = 240 m，比設計少 60 m，提示有支承被卡住或固定點偏移。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Theoretical slope dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C. A field regression of 2.4 mm/°C gives an equivalent expansion length of 2.4/(10×10⁻⁶) = 240,000 mm = 240 m, 60 m less than design, suggesting a seized bearing or a shifted fixed point. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收時量測縫面與鋪面高差、各間隙寬度、排水槽暢通與注水防漏，並在伸縮縫兩側設固定量測點；之後每次檢查記錄間隙與結構溫度，累積資料做迴歸，斜率或截距偏離預測時，安排支承與梁端詳細檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At acceptance measure the step between joint and pavement, each gap width, trough drainage and a water leak test, and set fixed measuring points on both sides of the joint; at every later inspection record gap and structure temperature, regress the accumulated data and arrange detailed checks of bearings and girder ends if slope or intercept departs from prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 理論斜率 dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C。若現場迴歸得 2.4 mm/°C，等效伸縮長度 2.4/(10×10⁻⁶) = 240,000 mm = 240 m，比設計少 60 m，提示有支承被卡住或固定點偏移。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Theoretical slope dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C. A field regression of 2.4 mm/°C gives an equivalent expansion length of 2.4/(10×10⁻⁶) = 240,000 mm = 240 m, 60 m less than design, suggesting a seized bearing or a shifted fixed point. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement", which statement holds?
options: 伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。
模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。
optionsEn: Theoretical slope dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C.
Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change.
Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system.
quiz.explanation: 理論斜率 dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Theoretical slope dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「間隙—溫度量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gap–temperature measurement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 驗收時量測縫面與鋪面高差、各間隙寬度、排水槽暢通與注水防漏，並在伸縮縫兩側設固定量測點；之後每次檢查記錄間隙與結構溫度，累積資料做迴歸，斜率或截距偏離預測時，安排支承與梁端詳細檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At acceptance measure the step between joint and pavement, each gap width, trough drainage and a water leak test, and set fixed measuring points on both sides of the joint; at every later inspection record gap and structure temperature, regress the accumulated data and arrange detailed checks of bearings and girder ends if slope or intercept departs from prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：竣工資料應提供每一伸縮縫的設計間隙—溫度曲線與量測點位置，檢查表格以溫度與間隙成對記錄；偏離預測的趨勢須通報結構工程師評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: As-built records should provide each joint's design gap–temperature line and measuring points, with inspection forms recording temperature and gap in pairs; trends departing from prediction are reported to the structural engineer for assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看伸縮縫外觀而不量間隙，活動支承因腐蝕卡住多年未被發現，溫度力由墩柱承受而在墩底開裂；間隙長期單向張開未被追蹤，直到止水帶拉脫漏水才察覺。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Looking only at the joint's appearance without measuring gaps lets a sliding bearing seized by corrosion go unnoticed for years while the piers take the temperature forces and crack at the base; steady one-way opening goes untracked until seals pull out and leak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收時量測縫面與鋪面高差、各間隙寬度、排水槽暢通與注水防漏，並在伸縮縫兩側設固定量測點；之後每次檢查記錄間隙與結構溫度，累積資料做迴歸，斜率或截距偏離預測時，安排支承與梁端詳細檢查。
knowledge.textEn: At acceptance measure the step between joint and pavement, each gap width, trough drainage and a water leak test, and set fixed measuring points on both sides of the joint; at every later inspection record gap and structure temperature, regress the accumulated data and arrange detailed checks of bearings and girder ends if slope or intercept departs from prediction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 竣工資料應提供每一伸縮縫的設計間隙—溫度曲線與量測點位置，檢查表格以溫度與間隙成對記錄；偏離預測的趨勢須通報結構工程師評估。
knowledge.textEn: As-built records should provide each joint's design gap–temperature line and measuring points, with inspection forms recording temperature and gap in pairs; trends departing from prediction are reported to the structural engineer for assessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
驗收時量測縫面與鋪面高差、各間隙寬度、排水槽暢通與注水防漏，並在伸縮縫兩側設固定量測點。
伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
At acceptance measure the step between joint and pavement, each gap width, trough drainage and a water leak test, and set fixed measuring points on both sides of the joint.
A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with.
quiz.explanation: 驗收時量測縫面與鋪面高差、各間隙寬度、排水槽暢通與注水防漏，並在伸縮縫兩側設固定量測點；之後每次檢查記錄間隙與結構溫度，累積資料做迴歸，斜率或截距偏離預測時，安排支承與梁端詳細檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At acceptance measure the step between joint and pavement, each gap width, trough drainage and a water leak test, and set fixed measuring points on both sides of the joint; at every later inspection record gap and structure temperature, regress the accumulated data and arrange detailed checks of bearings and girder ends if slope or intercept departs from prediction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「間隙—溫度量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gap–temperature measurement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看伸縮縫外觀而不量間隙，活動支承因腐蝕卡住多年未被發現，溫度力由墩柱承受而在墩底開裂；間隙長期單向張開未被追蹤，直到止水帶拉脫漏水才察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Looking only at the joint's appearance without measuring gaps lets a sliding bearing seized by corrosion go unnoticed for years while the piers take the temperature forces and crack at the base; steady one-way opening goes untracked until seals pull out and leak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種量測簡單但資訊豐富，適合列入驗收與定期檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The measurement is simple but rich in information and suits acceptance and routine inspection.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看伸縮縫外觀而不量間隙，活動支承因腐蝕卡住多年未被發現，溫度力由墩柱承受而在墩底開裂；間隙長期單向張開未被追蹤，直到止水帶拉脫漏水才察覺。
knowledge.textEn: Looking only at the joint's appearance without measuring gaps lets a sliding bearing seized by corrosion go unnoticed for years while the piers take the temperature forces and crack at the base; steady one-way opening goes untracked until seals pull out and leak.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。
只看伸縮縫外觀而不量間隙，活動支承因腐蝕卡住多年未被發現，溫度力由墩柱承受而在墩底開裂；間隙長期單向張開未被追蹤，直到止水帶拉脫漏水才察覺。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement.
Looking only at the joint's appearance without measuring gaps lets a sliding bearing seized by corrosion go unnoticed for years while the piers take the temperature forces and crack at the base.
quiz.explanation: 只看伸縮縫外觀而不量間隙，活動支承因腐蝕卡住多年未被發現，溫度力由墩柱承受而在墩底開裂；間隙長期單向張開未被追蹤，直到止水帶拉脫漏水才察覺。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Looking only at the joint's appearance without measuring gaps lets a sliding bearing seized by corrosion go unnoticed for years while the piers take the temperature forces and crack at the base; steady one-way opening goes untracked until seals pull out and leak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漏水、劣化模式與維護」與「更換策略、可更換設計與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance" and "Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漏水、劣化模式與維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「止水帶與排水槽」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seals and drainage trough” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫最常見也最昂貴的問題不是伸縮縫本身，而是它漏水：含除冰鹽或海鹽的水穿過破損止水帶，落在支承、墩帽與梁端，造成鋼筋腐蝕、支承鏽蝕與混凝土剝落，修復下部結構的費用常遠高於更換伸縮縫。其他劣化模式包括碎石堆積使間隙無法閉合、止水帶老化撕裂、中梁焊縫疲勞、錨碇鬆動與噪音。維護重點是定期清除碎石、檢查並更換止水帶、確認排水槽通暢，並記錄異常噪音與跳車。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「止水帶與排水槽」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The commonest and costliest joint problem is not the joint itself but leakage: water carrying de-icing or sea salt passes through damaged seals onto bearings, pier caps and girder ends, corroding reinforcement and bearings and spalling concrete, and repairing the substructure often costs far more than replacing the joint. Other deterioration modes include debris packing that stops gaps closing, ageing and tearing seals, fatigue of centre-beam welds, loosened anchorages and noise. Maintenance focuses on regular debris removal, inspecting and renewing seals, keeping drainage troughs clear and logging unusual noise and bumps. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Seals and drainage trough” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：橋面集水面積 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² 流向伸縮縫，降雨強度 50 mm/h 時水量 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h；若止水帶破損使 10% 漏下，每小時約 2.4 m³ 的水直接落在支承與墩帽上，一年多次豪雨即足以使鹽分持續累積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a deck catchment of 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² draining towards the joint and 50 mm/h rainfall, the flow is 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h; if a damaged seal lets 10% leak, about 2.4 m³ an hour falls directly on bearings and pier caps, and a few heavy storms a year are enough for salt to keep accumulating.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「止水帶與排水槽」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Seals and drainage trough”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漏水、劣化模式與維護
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫最常見也最昂貴的問題不是伸縮縫本身，而是它漏水：含除冰鹽或海鹽的水穿過破損止水帶，落在支承、墩帽與梁端，造成鋼筋腐蝕、支承鏽蝕與混凝土剝落，修復下部結構的費用常遠高於更換伸縮縫。其他劣化模式包括碎石堆積使間隙無法閉合、止水帶老化撕裂、中梁焊縫疲勞、錨碇鬆動與噪音。

Other deterioration modes include debris packing that stops gaps closing, ageing and tearing seals, fatigue of centre-beam welds, loosened anchorages and noise.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漏水、劣化模式與維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫最常見也最昂貴的問題不是伸縮縫本身，而是它漏水：含除冰鹽或海鹽的水穿過破損止水帶，落在支承、墩帽與梁端，造成鋼筋腐蝕、支承鏽蝕與混凝土剝落，修復下部結構的費用常遠高於更換伸縮縫。
伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。
伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。
optionsEn: The commonest and costliest joint problem is not the joint itself but leakage: water carrying de-icing or sea salt passes through damaged seals onto bearings, pier caps and girder ends, corroding reinforcement and bearings and spalling concrete, and repairing the substructure often costs far more than replacing the joint.
A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement.
A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design.

quiz.explanationEn: The commonest and costliest joint problem is not the joint itself but leakage: water carrying de-icing or sea salt passes through damaged seals onto bearings, pier caps and girder ends, corroding reinforcement and bearings and spalling concrete, and repairing the substructure often costs far more than replacing the joint. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漏水、劣化模式與維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「止水帶與排水槽」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seals and drainage trough” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橋面集水面積 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² 流向伸縮縫，降雨強度 50 mm/h 時水量 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h；若止水帶破損使 10% 漏下，每小時約 2.4 m³ 的水直接落在支承與墩帽上，一年多次豪雨即足以使鹽分持續累積。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a deck catchment of 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² draining towards the joint and 50 mm/h rainfall, the flow is 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h; if a damaged seal lets 10% leak, about 2.4 m³ an hour falls directly on bearings and pier caps, and a few heavy storms a year are enough for salt to keep accumulating. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期檢查時由橋下目視墩帽與支承有無水漬、鏽水與白華，由橋面檢查止水帶完整性與碎石堆積；必要時做注水試驗確認漏點，並把結果與上次檢查比較，止水帶破損列為限期修復項目。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At routine inspections look from below for water stains, rust and efflorescence on pier caps and bearings, and from the deck for seal integrity and debris; where needed, run a water test to locate leaks and compare with the previous inspection, treating damaged seals as a time-limited repair item.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 橋面集水面積 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² 流向伸縮縫，降雨強度 50 mm/h 時水量 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h；若止水帶破損使 10% 漏下，每小時約 2.4 m³ 的水直接落在支承與墩帽上，一年多次豪雨即足以使鹽分持續累積。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a deck catchment of 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² draining towards the joint and 50 mm/h rainfall, the flow is 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h; if a damaged seal lets 10% leak, about 2.4 m³ an hour falls directly on bearings and pier caps, and a few heavy storms a year are enough for salt to keep accumulating. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漏水、劣化模式與維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance", which statement holds?
options: 伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。
橋面集水面積 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² 流向伸縮縫，降雨強度 50 mm/h 時水量 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h。
後澆混凝土只要外觀硬化，就可以開放重車通行。
optionsEn: An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design.
With a deck catchment of 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² draining towards the joint and 50 mm/h rainfall, the flow is 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h.
Once blockout concrete looks hard, heavy trucks can be allowed back.
quiz.explanation: 橋面集水面積 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² 流向伸縮縫，降雨強度 50 mm/h 時水量 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h；若止水帶破損使 10% 漏下，每小時約 2.4 m³ 的水直接落在支承與墩帽上，一年多次豪雨即足以使鹽分持續累積。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a deck catchment of 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² draining towards the joint and 50 mm/h rainfall, the flow is 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h; if a damaged seal lets 10% leak, about 2.4 m³ an hour falls directly on bearings and pier caps, and a few heavy storms a year are enough for salt to keep accumulating. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漏水、劣化模式與維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「止水帶與排水槽」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seals and drainage trough” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期檢查時由橋下目視墩帽與支承有無水漬、鏽水與白華，由橋面檢查止水帶完整性與碎石堆積；必要時做注水試驗確認漏點，並把結果與上次檢查比較，止水帶破損列為限期修復項目。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At routine inspections look from below for water stains, rust and efflorescence on pier caps and bearings, and from the deck for seal integrity and debris; where needed, run a water test to locate leaks and compare with the previous inspection, treating damaged seals as a time-limited repair item. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊應規定清掃與檢查週期、止水帶更換方法與備品、排水槽清理方式，並把伸縮縫下方的墩帽與支承列為同一檢查單元；止水帶設計宜可從橋面更換，不需拆除整座伸縮縫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should define cleaning and inspection intervals, seal replacement methods and spares and trough cleaning, treating the pier cap and bearings below the joint as part of the same inspection unit; seals should be replaceable from the deck without removing the whole joint.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：止水帶小破洞多年未修，墩帽頂面長期潮濕含鹽，支承底板鏽蝕失去滑動功能、墩帽保護層剝落露筋，最後必須頂升梁體更換支承並修補墩帽，費用與封閉時間都遠超過更換止水帶。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small hole in a seal left for years keeps the pier cap wet and salty, the bearing base plate rusts and stops sliding and the cap spalls to expose reinforcement, until the girder must be jacked to replace bearings and repair the cap, at far greater cost and closure time than renewing the seal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 定期檢查時由橋下目視墩帽與支承有無水漬、鏽水與白華，由橋面檢查止水帶完整性與碎石堆積；必要時做注水試驗確認漏點，並把結果與上次檢查比較，止水帶破損列為限期修復項目。
knowledge.textEn: At routine inspections look from below for water stains, rust and efflorescence on pier caps and bearings, and from the deck for seal integrity and debris; where needed, run a water test to locate leaks and compare with the previous inspection, treating damaged seals as a time-limited repair item.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊應規定清掃與檢查週期、止水帶更換方法與備品、排水槽清理方式，並把伸縮縫下方的墩帽與支承列為同一檢查單元；止水帶設計宜可從橋面更換，不需拆除整座伸縮縫。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance manual should define cleaning and inspection intervals, seal replacement methods and spares and trough cleaning, treating the pier cap and bearings below the joint as part of the same inspection unit; seals should be replaceable from the deck without removing the whole joint.

quiz.question: 要驗證「漏水、劣化模式與維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。
定期檢查時由橋下目視墩帽與支承有無水漬、鏽水與白華，由橋面檢查止水帶完整性與碎石堆積。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew.
At routine inspections look from below for water stains, rust and efflorescence on pier caps and bearings, and from the deck for seal integrity and debris.
quiz.explanation: 定期檢查時由橋下目視墩帽與支承有無水漬、鏽水與白華，由橋面檢查止水帶完整性與碎石堆積；必要時做注水試驗確認漏點，並把結果與上次檢查比較，止水帶破損列為限期修復項目。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At routine inspections look from below for water stains, rust and efflorescence on pier caps and bearings, and from the deck for seal integrity and debris; where needed, run a water test to locate leaks and compare with the previous inspection, treating damaged seals as a time-limited repair item. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 漏水、劣化模式與維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「止水帶與排水槽」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seals and drainage trough” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 止水帶小破洞多年未修，墩帽頂面長期潮濕含鹽，支承底板鏽蝕失去滑動功能、墩帽保護層剝落露筋，最後必須頂升梁體更換支承並修補墩帽，費用與封閉時間都遠超過更換止水帶。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small hole in a seal left for years keeps the pier cap wet and salty, the bearing base plate rusts and stops sliding and the cap spalls to expose reinforcement, until the girder must be jacked to replace bearings and repair the cap, at far greater cost and closure time than renewing the seal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：維護重點是定期清除碎石、檢查並更換止水帶、確認排水槽通暢，並記錄異常噪音與跳車。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance focuses on regular debris removal, inspecting and renewing seals, keeping drainage troughs clear and logging unusual noise and bumps.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 止水帶小破洞多年未修，墩帽頂面長期潮濕含鹽，支承底板鏽蝕失去滑動功能、墩帽保護層剝落露筋，最後必須頂升梁體更換支承並修補墩帽，費用與封閉時間都遠超過更換止水帶。
knowledge.textEn: A small hole in a seal left for years keeps the pier cap wet and salty, the bearing base plate rusts and stops sliding and the cap spalls to expose reinforcement, until the girder must be jacked to replace bearings and repair the cap, at far greater cost and closure time than renewing the seal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「漏水、劣化模式與維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 止水帶小破洞多年未修，墩帽頂面長期潮濕含鹽，支承底板鏽蝕失去滑動功能、墩帽保護層剝落露筋，最後必須頂升梁體更換支承並修補墩帽，費用與封閉時間都遠超過更換止水帶。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。
optionsEn: A small hole in a seal left for years keeps the pier cap wet and salty, the bearing base plate rusts and stops sliding and the cap spalls to expose reinforcement, until the girder must be jacked to replace bearings and repair the cap, at far greater cost and closure time than renewing the seal.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design.
quiz.explanation: 止水帶小破洞多年未修，墩帽頂面長期潮濕含鹽，支承底板鏽蝕失去滑動功能、墩帽保護層剝落露筋，最後必須頂升梁體更換支承並修補墩帽，費用與封閉時間都遠超過更換止水帶。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small hole in a seal left for years keeps the pier cap wet and salty, the bearing base plate rusts and stops sliding and the cap spalls to expose reinforcement, until the girder must be jacked to replace bearings and repair the cap, at far greater cost and closure time than renewing the seal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 更換策略、可更換設計與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint life-cycle records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫的使用年限通常遠短於橋梁本身，所以在橋梁一生中會被更換數次；設計時就把更換納入考量，可以大幅縮短未來的封閉時間。例子包括 Øresund 橋保留錨碇在混凝土中的橫梁箱、只更換伸縮縫單元，以及漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋 2014 至 2016 年翻修時採用可快速拆除、不需動到瀝青與混凝土的 QUICK-EX 系統。交接文件應記錄每一座伸縮縫的型式、預設、安裝溫度、試驗報告與檢查歷程，讓下一次更換可以事先規劃。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joints usually last far less than the bridge, so they are replaced several times in its life, and designing for replacement greatly shortens future closures. Examples include the Øresund Bridge keeping the traverse boxes anchored in concrete and replacing only the joint unit, and Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge using the QUICK-EX system in its 2014–2016 rehabilitation so joints can be removed quickly without disturbing asphalt or concrete. Handover documents should record each joint's type, preset, installation temperature, test reports and inspection history so the next replacement can be planned in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joint life-cycle records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：橋梁設計年限 100 年、伸縮縫壽命 25 年：一生中需更換 100/25 − 1 = 3 次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Joint life-cycle records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 更換策略、可更換設計與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫的使用年限通常遠短於橋梁本身，所以在橋梁一生中會被更換數次；設計時就把更換納入考量，可以大幅縮短未來的封閉時間。例子包括 Øresund 橋保留錨碇在混凝土中的橫梁箱、只更換伸縮縫單元，以及漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋 2014 至 2016 年翻修時採用可快速拆除、不需動到瀝青與混凝土的 QUICK-EX 系統。
knowledge.textEn: Joints usually last far less than the bridge, so they are replaced several times in its life, and designing for replacement greatly shortens future closures. Examples include the Øresund Bridge keeping the traverse boxes anchored in concrete and replacing only the joint unit, and Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge using the QUICK-EX system in its 2014–2016 rehabilitation so joints can be removed quickly without disturbing asphalt or concrete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「更換策略、可更換設計與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。
伸縮縫的使用年限通常遠短於橋梁本身，所以在橋梁一生中會被更換數次；設計時就把更換納入考量，可以大幅縮短未來的封閉時間。
伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。
optionsEn: A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design.
Joints usually last far less than the bridge, so they are replaced several times in its life, and designing for replacement greatly shortens future closures.
Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫的使用年限通常遠短於橋梁本身，所以在橋梁一生中會被更換數次；設計時就把更換納入考量，可以大幅縮短未來的封閉時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joints usually last far less than the bridge, so they are replaced several times in its life, and designing for replacement greatly shortens future closures. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 更換策略、可更換設計與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint life-cycle records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橋梁設計年限 100 年、伸縮縫壽命 25 年：一生中需更換 100/25 − 1 = 3 次。全橋 8 座伸縮縫，若每座需鑿除錨碇重建、封閉 6 天，總計 3×8×6 = 144 天；若保留錨碇只換單元、每座 3.5 天，總計 84 天，減少約 42%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed. For 8 joints, rebuilding the anchorage at 6 closure days each totals 3×8×6 = 144 days; keeping the anchorage and changing only the unit at 3.5 days each totals 84 days, about 42% less. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前清點每一座伸縮縫的資料：製造圖、型式與疲勞試驗報告、出廠檢驗、預設與安裝溫度紀錄、驗收量測、備品清單與更換程序，並確認營運單位已建立間隙—溫度與漏水檢查的基準資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, check each joint's records: shop drawings, type and fatigue test reports, factory inspection, preset and installation-temperature records, acceptance measurements, spare-parts list and replacement procedure, and confirm the owner has baselines for gap–temperature and leakage inspections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 橋梁設計年限 100 年、伸縮縫壽命 25 年：一生中需更換 100/25 − 1 = 3 次。全橋 8 座伸縮縫，若每座需鑿除錨碇重建、封閉 6 天，總計 3×8×6 = 144 天；若保留錨碇只換單元、每座 3.5 天，總計 84 天，減少約 42%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed. For 8 joints, rebuilding the anchorage at 6 closure days each totals 3×8×6 = 144 days; keeping the anchorage and changing only the unit at 3.5 days each totals 84 days, about 42% less. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「更換策略、可更換設計與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover", which statement holds?
options: 模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。
伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。
橋梁設計年限 100 年、伸縮縫壽命 25 年：一生中需更換 100/25 − 1 = 3 次。
optionsEn: Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system.
A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with.
With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed.
quiz.explanation: 橋梁設計年限 100 年、伸縮縫壽命 25 年：一生中需更換 100/25 − 1 = 3 次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 更換策略、可更換設計與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint life-cycle records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前清點每一座伸縮縫的資料：製造圖、型式與疲勞試驗報告、出廠檢驗、預設與安裝溫度紀錄、驗收量測、備品清單與更換程序，並確認營運單位已建立間隙—溫度與漏水檢查的基準資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, check each joint's records: shop drawings, type and fatigue test reports, factory inspection, preset and installation-temperature records, acceptance measurements, spare-parts list and replacement procedure, and confirm the owner has baselines for gap–temperature and leakage inspections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計規格應要求伸縮縫可在部分車道封閉下分幅更換、錨碇可保留、止水帶可從橋面更換；交接文件包含上述全部紀錄與更換程序，並由營運單位指定專人管理伸縮縫資產資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design specifications should require joints to be replaceable width by width under partial lane closures, with retainable anchorages and seals renewable from the deck; handover includes all the records above and the replacement procedure, and the owner assigns a person to manage joint asset data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交接資料缺漏，十多年後更換伸縮縫時不知道原設計位移、錨碇細部與預設方法，只能保守地全部鑿除重建，封閉時間與成本倍增；若新伸縮縫型式與舊錨碇不相容，還需修改梁端結構。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With incomplete handover records, a replacement a decade or two later cannot know the original design movements, anchorage details or presetting method, so everything is conservatively broken out and rebuilt, multiplying closure time and cost; a new joint incompatible with the old anchorage may even require changes to the girder ends. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前清點每一座伸縮縫的資料：製造圖、型式與疲勞試驗報告、出廠檢驗、預設與安裝溫度紀錄、驗收量測、備品清單與更換程序，並確認營運單位已建立間隙—溫度與漏水檢查的基準資料。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, check each joint's records: shop drawings, type and fatigue test reports, factory inspection, preset and installation-temperature records, acceptance measurements, spare-parts list and replacement procedure, and confirm the owner has baselines for gap–temperature and leakage inspections.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計規格應要求伸縮縫可在部分車道封閉下分幅更換、錨碇可保留、止水帶可從橋面更換；交接文件包含上述全部紀錄與更換程序，並由營運單位指定專人管理伸縮縫資產資料。
knowledge.textEn: Design specifications should require joints to be replaceable width by width under partial lane closures, with retainable anchorages and seals renewable from the deck; handover includes all the records above and the replacement procedure, and the owner assigns a person to manage joint asset data.

quiz.question: 要驗證「更換策略、可更換設計與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover"?
options: 交接前清點每一座伸縮縫的資料：製造圖、型式與疲勞試驗報告、出廠檢驗、預設與安裝溫度紀錄、驗收量測、備品清單與更換程序，並確認營運單位已建立間隙—溫度與漏水檢查的基準資料。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。
optionsEn: Before handover, check each joint's records: shop drawings, type and fatigue test reports, factory inspection, preset and installation-temperature records, acceptance measurements, spare-parts list and replacement procedure, and confirm the owner has baselines for gap–temperature and leakage inspections.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If a joint has enough movement capacity, its fatigue test data need not be reviewed.
quiz.explanation: 交接前清點每一座伸縮縫的資料：製造圖、型式與疲勞試驗報告、出廠檢驗、預設與安裝溫度紀錄、驗收量測、備品清單與更換程序，並確認營運單位已建立間隙—溫度與漏水檢查的基準資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, check each joint's records: shop drawings, type and fatigue test reports, factory inspection, preset and installation-temperature records, acceptance measurements, spare-parts list and replacement procedure, and confirm the owner has baselines for gap–temperature and leakage inspections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 更換策略、可更換設計與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint life-cycle records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交接資料缺漏，十多年後更換伸縮縫時不知道原設計位移、錨碇細部與預設方法，只能保守地全部鑿除重建，封閉時間與成本倍增；若新伸縮縫型式與舊錨碇不相容，還需修改梁端結構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With incomplete handover records, a replacement a decade or two later cannot know the original design movements, anchorage details or presetting method, so everything is conservatively broken out and rebuilt, multiplying closure time and cost; a new joint incompatible with the old anchorage may even require changes to the girder ends. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件應記錄每一座伸縮縫的型式、預設、安裝溫度、試驗報告與檢查歷程，讓下一次更換可以事先規劃。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents should record each joint's type, preset, installation temperature, test reports and inspection history so the next replacement can be planned in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交接資料缺漏，十多年後更換伸縮縫時不知道原設計位移、錨碇細部與預設方法，只能保守地全部鑿除重建，封閉時間與成本倍增；若新伸縮縫型式與舊錨碇不相容，還需修改梁端結構。
knowledge.textEn: With incomplete handover records, a replacement a decade or two later cannot know the original design movements, anchorage details or presetting method, so everything is conservatively broken out and rebuilt, multiplying closure time and cost; a new joint incompatible with the old anchorage may even require changes to the girder ends.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「更換策略、可更換設計與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
交接資料缺漏，十多年後更換伸縮縫時不知道原設計位移、錨碇細部與預設方法，只能保守地全部鑿除重建，封閉時間與成本倍增。
伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

With incomplete handover records, a replacement a decade or two later cannot know the original design movements, anchorage details or presetting method, so everything is conservatively broken out and rebuilt, multiplying closure time and cost.
Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change.
quiz.explanation: 交接資料缺漏，十多年後更換伸縮縫時不知道原設計位移、錨碇細部與預設方法，只能保守地全部鑿除重建，封閉時間與成本倍增；若新伸縮縫型式與舊錨碇不相容，還需修改梁端結構。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With incomplete handover records, a replacement a decade or two later cannot know the original design movements, anchorage details or presetting method, so everything is conservatively broken out and rebuilt, multiplying closure time and cost; a new joint incompatible with the old anchorage may even require changes to the girder ends. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 球面支承安裝
summary: 從支承配置與熱位移出發，量化球面支承的轉角需求、滑動材料承壓、曲面摩擦力矩與偏心，再處理工廠預設偏移、墊層灌漿、運輸固定件拆除、型式試驗、現場位移指標與累積滑移磨耗，最後以萊茵河上兩座斜張橋的 120 MN 級球面支承更換與新建案例，說明頂升更換與交接紀錄。
summaryEn: Starting from bearing layout and thermal movement, quantify a spherical bearing's rotation demand, sliding-material pressure, curved-surface friction moment and eccentricity, then handle factory presetting, bedding grout, removal of transport fittings, type testing, movement indicators and accumulated sliding wear, closing with jacking replacement and handover records through 120 MN class spherical bearings on two Rhine cable-stayed bridges.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
