quiz.question: 要驗證「振動台驗證與強震監測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shake-table verification and strong-motion monitoring"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較振動台量測的支承遲滯迴圈、位移時間歷程與墩底剪力，和同一輸入下的數值模型預測；差異超過預設範圍時調整模型參數並說明原因。
隔震支承有彈性，安裝時的偏移會自己回正，不必控制。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Compare the measured bearing loops, displacement histories and pier base shears from the shake table with numerical predictions for the same input, adjusting model parameters and explaining any difference beyond a preset range.
Isolators are elastic, so any installation offset will self-correct and need not be controlled.
quiz.explanation: 比較振動台量測的支承遲滯迴圈、位移時間歷程與墩底剪力，和同一輸入下的數值模型預測；差異超過預設範圍時調整模型參數並說明原因。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare the measured bearing loops, displacement histories and pier base shears from the shake table with numerical predictions for the same input, adjusting model parameters and explaining any difference beyond a preset range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 振動台驗證與強震監測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shake-table verification and strong-motion monitoring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「振動台縮尺模型」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shake-table scale model” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模型縮尺後若忽略鉛心與橡膠材料無法同比例縮小的效應，試驗結果可能偏離原型；橋上強震儀若只裝在地面而沒有量支承相對位移，就無法判斷隔震層是否如預期啟動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the fact that lead and rubber properties do not scale proportionally can make model results deviate from the prototype; strong-motion instruments placed only at ground level, without measuring relative bearing displacement, cannot show whether the isolation layer engaged as expected. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：完工後在橋上布設強震儀，則能在真實地震中回饋支承位移與墩頂加速度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: After completion, strong-motion instruments on the bridge feed back bearing displacements and pier-top accelerations from real earthquakes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「縮尺模型只要把尺寸縮小，原始地震紀錄可以直接輸入。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A scale model only needs smaller dimensions; the original record can be input unchanged." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 模型縮尺後若忽略鉛心與橡膠材料無法同比例縮小的效應，試驗結果可能偏離原型；橋上強震儀若只裝在地面而沒有量支承相對位移，就無法判斷隔震層是否如預期啟動。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring the fact that lead and rubber properties do not scale proportionally can make model results deviate from the prototype; strong-motion instruments placed only at ground level, without measuring relative bearing displacement, cannot show whether the isolation layer engaged as expected.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「振動台驗證與強震監測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shake-table verification and strong-motion monitoring" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
支承性質由出廠試驗決定，數十年使用期間都不會改變。
模型縮尺後若忽略鉛心與橡膠材料無法同比例縮小的效應，試驗結果可能偏離原型；橋上強震儀若只裝在地面而沒有量支承相對位移，就無法判斷隔震層是否如預期啟動。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Bearing properties are fixed by factory tests and do not change over decades of service.
Ignoring the fact that lead and rubber properties do not scale proportionally can make model results deviate from the prototype.
quiz.explanation: 模型縮尺後若忽略鉛心與橡膠材料無法同比例縮小的效應，試驗結果可能偏離原型；橋上強震儀若只裝在地面而沒有量支承相對位移，就無法判斷隔震層是否如預期啟動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring the fact that lead and rubber properties do not scale proportionally can make model results deviate from the prototype; strong-motion instruments placed only at ground level, without measuring relative bearing displacement, cannot show whether the isolation layer engaged as expected. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「老化、溫度與性質上下限」與「震後檢查、更換與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ageing, temperature and property bounds" and "Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and property bounds: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「性質修正係數 λ」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Property modification factors λ” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鉛心橡膠支承的性質不是定值：橡膠隨老化與低溫變硬，鉛心在低溫時強度升高、在連續大位移循環時因發熱而降低，製造批次也有差異。因此設計採用上下限分析：以性質修正係數把名目 Q_d 與 K_d 放大或縮小，上限性質產生較大的墩頂剪力與基礎力，下限性質產生較大的支承位移與隔震縫需求，兩組結果分別控制不同構件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「性質修正係數 λ」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A lead-rubber bearing's properties are not constant: rubber stiffens with ageing and cold, lead strength rises at low temperature and falls as it heats during continuous large cycles, and production batches vary. Design therefore uses bounding analysis: property modification factors scale nominal Q_d and K_d up and down; upper-bound properties produce larger pier shears and foundation forces, lower-bound properties produce larger bearing displacements and gap demands, and each set governs different components. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Property modification factors λ” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：名目 Q_d = 177 kN，取 λ_max = 1.3、λ_min = 0.85：上限 Q_d ≈ 230 kN、下限 Q_d ≈ 150 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Nominal Q_d = 177 kN with λ_max = 1.3 and λ_min = 0.85 gives an upper bound of about 230 kN and a lower bound of about 150 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支承性質由出廠試驗決定，數十年使用期間都不會改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bearing properties are fixed by factory tests and do not change over decades of service." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「性質修正係數 λ」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Property modification factors λ”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限
knowledge.text: 鉛心橡膠支承的性質不是定值：橡膠隨老化與低溫變硬，鉛心在低溫時強度升高、在連續大位移循環時因發熱而降低，製造批次也有差異。因此設計採用上下限分析：以性質修正係數把名目 Q_d 與 K_d 放大或縮小，上限性質產生較大的墩頂剪力與基礎力，下限性質產生較大的支承位移與隔震縫需求，兩組結果分別控制不同構件。
knowledge.textEn: A lead-rubber bearing's properties are not constant: rubber stiffens with ageing and cold, lead strength rises at low temperature and falls as it heats during continuous large cycles, and production batches vary. Design therefore uses bounding analysis: property modification factors scale nominal Q_d and K_d up and down; upper-bound properties produce larger pier shears and foundation forces, lower-bound properties produce larger bearing displacements and gap demands, and each set governs different components.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支承性質由出廠試驗決定，數十年使用期間都不會改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Bearing properties are fixed by factory tests and do not change over decades of service. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「老化、溫度與性質上下限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ageing, temperature and property bounds" is correct?
options: 鉛心橡膠支承的性質不是定值：橡膠隨老化與低溫變硬，鉛心在低溫時強度升高、在連續大位移循環時因發熱而降低，製造批次也有差異。
支承性質由出廠試驗決定，數十年使用期間都不會改變。
鉛心橡膠支承震後一定會自動回到原位，不需要檢查。
optionsEn: A lead-rubber bearing's properties are not constant: rubber stiffens with ageing and cold, lead strength rises at low temperature and falls as it heats during continuous large cycles, and production batches vary.
Bearing properties are fixed by factory tests and do not change over decades of service.
A lead-rubber bearing always re-centres by itself after an earthquake and needs no inspection.
quiz.explanation: 鉛心橡膠支承的性質不是定值：橡膠隨老化與低溫變硬，鉛心在低溫時強度升高、在連續大位移循環時因發熱而降低，製造批次也有差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A lead-rubber bearing's properties are not constant: rubber stiffens with ageing and cold, lead strength rises at low temperature and falls as it heats during continuous large cycles, and production batches vary. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and property bounds: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「性質修正係數 λ」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Property modification factors λ” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：名目 Q_d = 177 kN，取 λ_max = 1.3、λ_min = 0.85：上限 Q_d ≈ 230 kN、下限 Q_d ≈ 150 kN。上限值用於檢核墩柱與基礎強度，下限值用於檢核支承位移、組合應變與隔震縫寬。數值為教學假設，λ 依規範與試驗資料決定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Nominal Q_d = 177 kN with λ_max = 1.3 and λ_min = 0.85 gives an upper bound of about 230 kN and a lower bound of about 150 kN. Upper-bound values check pier and foundation strength; lower-bound values check bearing displacement, combined strain and gap width. Values are teaching assumptions; λ follows the code and test data. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：λ 的組成（溫度、老化、汙染、循環、製造變異）要有依據：引用規範預設值或製造商的試驗資料；分析報告須分別列出上限與下限兩組的墩底剪力、支承位移，並標明各構件由哪一組控制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The components of λ (temperature, ageing, contamination, cycling and manufacturing variation) must be justified by code defaults or manufacturer test data; the analysis report lists pier shear and bearing displacement for both upper and lower bounds and states which set governs each component.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 名目 Q_d = 177 kN，取 λ_max = 1.3、λ_min = 0.85：上限 Q_d ≈ 230 kN、下限 Q_d ≈ 150 kN。上限值用於檢核墩柱與基礎強度，下限值用於檢核支承位移、組合應變與隔震縫寬。數值為教學假設，λ 依規範與試驗資料決定。
knowledge.textEn: Nominal Q_d = 177 kN with λ_max = 1.3 and λ_min = 0.85 gives an upper bound of about 230 kN and a lower bound of about 150 kN. Upper-bound values check pier and foundation strength; lower-bound values check bearing displacement, combined strain and gap width. Values are teaching assumptions; λ follows the code and test data.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「老化、溫度與性質上下限」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ageing, temperature and property bounds", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼越大，隔震橋的所有反應一定都越小。
名目 Q_d = 177 kN，取 λ_max = 1.3、λ_min = 0.85：上限 Q_d ≈ 230 kN、下限 Q_d ≈ 150 kN。
橡膠越厚越軟就一定越好，因為水平勁度越低隔震效果越佳。
optionsEn: More damping always reduces every response of an isolated bridge.
Nominal Q_d = 177 kN with λ_max = 1.3 and λ_min = 0.85 gives an upper bound of about 230 kN and a lower bound of about 150 kN.
Thicker, softer rubber is always better because lower lateral stiffness means better isolation.
quiz.explanation: 名目 Q_d = 177 kN，取 λ_max = 1.3、λ_min = 0.85：上限 Q_d ≈ 230 kN、下限 Q_d ≈ 150 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Nominal Q_d = 177 kN with λ_max = 1.3 and λ_min = 0.85 gives an upper bound of about 230 kN and a lower bound of about 150 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and property bounds: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「性質修正係數 λ」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Property modification factors λ” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: λ 的組成（溫度、老化、汙染、循環、製造變異）要有依據：引用規範預設值或製造商的試驗資料；分析報告須分別列出上限與下限兩組的墩底剪力、支承位移，並標明各構件由哪一組控制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The components of λ (temperature, ageing, contamination, cycling and manufacturing variation) must be justified by code defaults or manufacturer test data; the analysis report lists pier shear and bearing displacement for both upper and lower bounds and states which set governs each component. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：計算書首頁列出名目值與上下限值的對照表，並要求製造商提供老化與低溫試驗依據；維護計畫在數十年使用期間安排抽樣取出支承做複驗，或保留同批次備品作為老化比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The calculation cover sheet tabulates nominal, upper and lower values and requires the manufacturer's ageing and low-temperature evidence; over decades of service the maintenance plan schedules sample removal and retesting, or keeps spare bearings from the same batch for ageing comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用名目性質設計時，寒冷地區冬季地震可能讓鉛心強度與橡膠勁度升高，墩柱承受的剪力超出設計；而大位移連續循環使鉛心軟化時，支承位移又超過名目分析，兩端都被低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing with nominal properties only can let a winter earthquake in a cold region raise lead strength and rubber stiffness so pier shear exceeds design, while lead softening in continuous large cycles drives bearing displacement past the nominal analysis, underestimating both ends. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: λ 的組成（溫度、老化、汙染、循環、製造變異）要有依據：引用規範預設值或製造商的試驗資料；分析報告須分別列出上限與下限兩組的墩底剪力、支承位移，並標明各構件由哪一組控制。
knowledge.textEn: The components of λ (temperature, ageing, contamination, cycling and manufacturing variation) must be justified by code defaults or manufacturer test data; the analysis report lists pier shear and bearing displacement for both upper and lower bounds and states which set governs each component.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 計算書首頁列出名目值與上下限值的對照表，並要求製造商提供老化與低溫試驗依據；維護計畫在數十年使用期間安排抽樣取出支承做複驗，或保留同批次備品作為老化比對。
knowledge.textEn: The calculation cover sheet tabulates nominal, upper and lower values and requires the manufacturer's ageing and low-temperature evidence; over decades of service the maintenance plan schedules sample removal and retesting, or keeps spare bearings from the same batch for ageing comparison.

quiz.question: 要驗證「老化、溫度與性質上下限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ageing, temperature and property bounds"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
隔震縫只是施工留下的空隙，之後可以拿來安裝管線或設施。
λ 的組成（溫度、老化、汙染、循環、製造變異）要有依據：引用規範預設值或製造商的試驗資料。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
An isolation gap is just a construction void that can later host utilities or fittings.
The components of λ (temperature, ageing, contamination, cycling and manufacturing variation) must be justified by code defaults or manufacturer test data.
quiz.explanation: λ 的組成（溫度、老化、汙染、循環、製造變異）要有依據：引用規範預設值或製造商的試驗資料；分析報告須分別列出上限與下限兩組的墩底剪力、支承位移，並標明各構件由哪一組控制。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The components of λ (temperature, ageing, contamination, cycling and manufacturing variation) must be justified by code defaults or manufacturer test data; the analysis report lists pier shear and bearing displacement for both upper and lower bounds and states which set governs each component. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 老化、溫度與性質上下限：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ageing, temperature and property bounds: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「性質修正係數 λ」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Property modification factors λ” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用名目性質設計時，寒冷地區冬季地震可能讓鉛心強度與橡膠勁度升高，墩柱承受的剪力超出設計；而大位移連續循環使鉛心軟化時，支承位移又超過名目分析，兩端都被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing with nominal properties only can let a winter earthquake in a cold region raise lead strength and rubber stiffness so pier shear exceeds design, while lead softening in continuous large cycles drives bearing displacement past the nominal analysis, underestimating both ends. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此設計採用上下限分析：以性質修正係數把名目 Q_d 與 K_d 放大或縮小，上限性質產生較大的墩頂剪力與基礎力，下限性質產生較大的支承位移與隔震縫需求，兩組結果分別控制不同構件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design therefore uses bounding analysis: property modification factors scale nominal Q_d and K_d up and down; upper-bound properties produce larger pier shears and foundation forces, lower-bound properties produce larger bearing displacements and gap demands, and each set governs different components.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支承性質由出廠試驗決定，數十年使用期間都不會改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bearing properties are fixed by factory tests and do not change over decades of service." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用名目性質設計時，寒冷地區冬季地震可能讓鉛心強度與橡膠勁度升高，墩柱承受的剪力超出設計；而大位移連續循環使鉛心軟化時，支承位移又超過名目分析，兩端都被低估。
knowledge.textEn: Designing with nominal properties only can let a winter earthquake in a cold region raise lead strength and rubber stiffness so pier shear exceeds design, while lead softening in continuous large cycles drives bearing displacement past the nominal analysis, underestimating both ends.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「老化、溫度與性質上下限」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ageing, temperature and property bounds" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鉛心橡膠支承震後一定會自動回到原位，不需要檢查。
optionsEn: Designing with nominal properties only can let a winter earthquake in a cold region raise lead strength and rubber stiffness so pier shear exceeds design, while lead softening in continuous large cycles drives bearing displacement past the nominal analysis, underestimating both ends.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A lead-rubber bearing always re-centres by itself after an earthquake and needs no inspection.

quiz.explanationEn: Designing with nominal properties only can let a winter earthquake in a cold region raise lead strength and rubber stiffness so pier shear exceeds design, while lead softening in continuous large cycles drives bearing displacement past the nominal analysis, underestimating both ends. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 震後檢查、更換與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「殘留位移與回復力」如何影響鉛心橡膠支承隔震的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual offset and restoring force” governs force, deformation or durability in “Lead-rubber bearing seismic isolation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 隔震橋震後的第一個問題是：支承是否回到原位、有沒有損傷、還能不能承受下一次地震。鉛心橡膠支承靠橡膠彈性提供回復力，但鉛心強度會抵抗回位，因此震後可能留下殘留位移；設計時要求足夠的回復力，避免位移逐次累積。交接文件必須包含每顆支承的試驗數據、安裝偏移基準、上下限分析結果與震後檢查程序，並預留頂升點以便更換。金門大橋馬林郡引道高架橋在 1997 至 2001 年的第一期耐震改造中，就於新鋼支撐塔頂裝設鉛心橡膠隔震支承。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「殘留位移與回復力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake the first questions for an isolated bridge are whether the bearings have returned to position, whether they are damaged and whether they can take the next event. A lead-rubber bearing's restoring force comes from rubber elasticity, but the lead resists re-centring, so a residual offset may remain; design requires enough restoring force to prevent displacement ratcheting. Handover documents must include each bearing's test data, installation baselines, bounding-analysis results and the post-earthquake inspection procedure, with jacking points for replacement. In Phase 1 of the Golden Gate Bridge seismic retrofit, from 1997 to 2001, lead-core rubber isolators were installed atop new steel support towers on the Marin approach viaduct. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Residual offset and restoring force” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Restoring-force check concept: F(D) − F(D/2) = K_d·D/2 = 970×0.125 ≈ 121 kN, greater than W/80 = 3,000/80 = 37.5 kN, so restoring force is adequate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鉛心橡膠支承震後一定會自動回到原位，不需要檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lead-rubber bearing always re-centres by itself after an earthquake and needs no inspection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「殘留位移與回復力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Residual offset and restoring force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

A lead-rubber bearing's restoring force comes from rubber elasticity, but the lead resists re-centring, so a residual offset may remain; design requires enough restoring force to prevent displacement ratcheting.

knowledge.text: 誤解：鉛心橡膠支承震後一定會自動回到原位，不需要檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「震後檢查、更換與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover" is correct?
options: 鉛心橡膠支承震後一定會自動回到原位，不需要檢查。
隔震橋震後的第一個問題是：支承是否回到原位、有沒有損傷、還能不能承受下一次地震。
隔震讓橋梁在地震時完全不動，所以位移問題可以忽略。

After an earthquake the first questions for an isolated bridge are whether the bearings have returned to position, whether they are damaged and whether they can take the next event.
Isolation keeps the bridge from moving in an earthquake, so displacement can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 隔震橋震後的第一個問題是：支承是否回到原位、有沒有損傷、還能不能承受下一次地震。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After an earthquake the first questions for an isolated bridge are whether the bearings have returned to position, whether they are damaged and whether they can take the next event. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 震後檢查、更換與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「殘留位移與回復力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Residual offset and restoring force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：回復力檢核概念：F(D) − F(D/2) = K_d·D/2 = 970×0.125 ≈ 121 kN，大於 W/80 = 3,000/80 = 37.5 kN，回復力足夠。理論最大靜態殘留位移約 Q_d/K_d = 177/970 ≈ 0.18 m，實際震後通常較小，需以量測確認。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Restoring-force check concept: F(D) − F(D/2) = K_d·D/2 = 970×0.125 ≈ 121 kN, greater than W/80 = 3,000/80 = 37.5 kN, so restoring force is adequate. The theoretical maximum static residual offset is about Q_d/K_d = 177/970 ≈ 0.18 m; actual residuals are usually smaller and must be measured. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：震後依程序量測每顆支承的殘留剪變位、外觀裂紋、鼓脹與脫層、連接螺栓與灌漿墊層，並檢查隔震縫撞擊痕跡；與交接基準比較後，由結構工程師判定繼續使用、監測或更換。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an earthquake measure each bearing's residual shear offset, surface cracks, bulging and delamination, connection bolts and grout bed, and check isolation gaps for pounding marks; after comparison with handover baselines a structural engineer decides on continued use, monitoring or replacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 回復力檢核概念：F(D) − F(D/2) = K_d·D/2 = 970×0.125 ≈ 121 kN，大於 W/80 = 3,000/80 = 37.5 kN，回復力足夠。理論最大靜態殘留位移約 Q_d/K_d = 177/970 ≈ 0.18 m，實際震後通常較小，需以量測確認。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Restoring-force check concept: F(D) − F(D/2) = K_d·D/2 = 970×0.125 ≈ 121 kN, greater than W/80 = 3,000/80 = 37.5 kN, so restoring force is adequate. The theoretical maximum static residual offset is about Q_d/K_d = 177/970 ≈ 0.18 m; actual residuals are usually smaller and must be measured. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「震後檢查、更換與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover", which statement holds?
options: 鉛心越大，隔震效果一定越好。
隔震支承有彈性，安裝時的偏移會自己回正，不必控制。
optionsEn: The bigger the lead core, the better the isolation.
Isolators are elastic, so any installation offset will self-correct and need not be controlled.
Restoring-force check concept: F(D) − F(D/2) = K_d·D/2 = 970×0.125 ≈ 121 kN, greater than W/80 = 3,000/80 = 37.5 kN, so restoring force is adequate.

steps.title: 震後檢查、更換與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「殘留位移與回復力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual offset and restoring force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 震後依程序量測每顆支承的殘留剪變位、外觀裂紋、鼓脹與脫層、連接螺栓與灌漿墊層，並檢查隔震縫撞擊痕跡；與交接基準比較後，由結構工程師判定繼續使用、監測或更換。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake measure each bearing's residual shear offset, surface cracks, bulging and delamination, connection bolts and grout bed, and check isolation gaps for pounding marks; after comparison with handover baselines a structural engineer decides on continued use, monitoring or replacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含支承一覽表與序號、原型與量產試驗報告、上下限分析摘要、安裝偏移基準、隔震縫寬度、頂升程序與震後檢查表；震後是否恢復通行由主管機關指定的結構工程師簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover includes the bearing schedule with serial numbers, prototype and production test reports, bounding-analysis summary, installation offset baselines, isolation-gap widths, jacking procedure and post-earthquake checklist; reopening after an earthquake is signed off by a structural engineer designated by the owner agency.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接時沒有記錄初始偏移，震後無法分辨殘留位移是地震造成還是原本就存在；未預留頂升點時，損傷支承無法在短時間更換，橋梁只能限制通行，失去隔震設計原本要保障的震後功能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without recorded initial offsets at handover, post-earthquake residual displacement cannot be distinguished from pre-existing offset; without jacking points, damaged bearings cannot be replaced quickly and the bridge must be restricted, losing the post-earthquake function isolation was meant to protect. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 震後依程序量測每顆支承的殘留剪變位、外觀裂紋、鼓脹與脫層、連接螺栓與灌漿墊層，並檢查隔震縫撞擊痕跡；與交接基準比較後，由結構工程師判定繼續使用、監測或更換。

quiz.question: 要驗證「震後檢查、更換與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover"?
options: 震後依程序量測每顆支承的殘留剪變位、外觀裂紋、鼓脹與脫層、連接螺栓與灌漿墊層，並檢查隔震縫撞擊痕跡；與交接基準比較後，由結構工程師判定繼續使用、監測或更換。

steps.title: 震後檢查、更換與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「殘留位移與回復力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Residual offset and restoring force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接時沒有記錄初始偏移，震後無法分辨殘留位移是地震造成還是原本就存在；未預留頂升點時，損傷支承無法在短時間更換，橋梁只能限制通行，失去隔震設計原本要保障的震後功能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without recorded initial offsets at handover, post-earthquake residual displacement cannot be distinguished from pre-existing offset; without jacking points, damaged bearings cannot be replaced quickly and the bridge must be restricted, losing the post-earthquake function isolation was meant to protect. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：金門大橋馬林郡引道高架橋在 1997 至 2001 年的第一期耐震改造中，就於新鋼支撐塔頂裝設鉛心橡膠隔震支承。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In Phase 1 of the Golden Gate Bridge seismic retrofit, from 1997 to 2001, lead-core rubber isolators were installed atop new steel support towers on the Marin approach viaduct.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鉛心橡膠支承震後一定會自動回到原位，不需要檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lead-rubber bearing always re-centres by itself after an earthquake and needs no inspection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「震後檢查、更換與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-earthquake inspection, replacement and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若交接時沒有記錄初始偏移，震後無法分辨殘留位移是地震造成還是原本就存在。
隔震讓橋梁在地震時完全不動，所以位移問題可以忽略。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without recorded initial offsets at handover, post-earthquake residual displacement cannot be distinguished from pre-existing offset.
Isolation keeps the bridge from moving in an earthquake, so displacement can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 若交接時沒有記錄初始偏移，震後無法分辨殘留位移是地震造成還是原本就存在；未預留頂升點時，損傷支承無法在短時間更換，橋梁只能限制通行，失去隔震設計原本要保障的震後功能。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without recorded initial offsets at handover, post-earthquake residual displacement cannot be distinguished from pre-existing offset; without jacking points, damaged bearings cannot be replaced quickly and the bridge must be restricted, losing the post-earthquake function isolation was meant to protect. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 橋墩塑鉸韌性設計
titleEn: Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers
summary: 從 1989 年賽普勒斯高架橋、1995 年阪神高速神戶線與 1999 年 921 地震的橋墩破壞出發，建立容量設計層級與位移韌性需求，量化圍束箍筋、塑鉸長度與轉角容量，再處理箍筋與續接器施工、反覆載重試驗、震後殘留漂移、塑鉸區腐蝕與既有橋墩的剪力退化評估，說明為何塑鉸只能出現在預先選定、詳細配筋且可檢查的位置。
summaryEn: Starting from pier failures in the 1989 Cypress Viaduct, the 1995 Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route and the 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake, build the capacity-design hierarchy and displacement-ductility demand, quantify confinement, plastic-hinge length and rotation capacity, then cover hoop and coupler construction, cyclic testing, residual drift, hinge-zone corrosion and shear degradation in existing piers, explaining why plastic hinges may form only at preselected, well-detailed and inspectable locations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a single cantilever circular pier with D = 2.0 m, height L = 10 m and axial load P = 8 MN has 46 bars of 36 mm (A_s ≈ 0.0468 m², ρ_l ≈ 1.5%) with f_ye = 475 MPa, and moment–curvature analysis gives M_p ≈ 12 MN·m (teaching assumption). Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25×0.002375/2.0 ≈ 0.00267 1/m and Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 ≈ 0.089 m. A 22 mm spiral at 100 mm gives ρ_s = 0.0080, ε_cu ≈ 0.0136 and φ_u ≈ 0.0136/0.5 ≈ 0.0272 1/m. L_p = 0.08×10 + 0.022×475×0.036 ≈ 1.18 m, θ_p ≈ (0.0272 − 0.0027)×1.18 ≈ 0.029 rad, Δ_p ≈ 0.029×9.41 ≈ 0.27 m, so capacity Δ_c ≈ 0.36 m and μ_c ≈ 0.36/0.089 ≈ 4.0 (at least 3). With demand Δ_D = 0.30 m, μ_D ≈ 3.4 (at most 4) and Δ_c/Δ_D ≈ 1.2. Capacity protection: M_o = 1.2×12 = 14.4 MN·m and V_o = 1.44 MN govern foundation and column shear design. Widening the spiral pitch to 130 mm lowers ε_cu to about 0.0114 and Δ_c to about 0.31 m, nearly erasing the margin. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「容量設計與破壞層級」與「位移需求與韌性限值」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Capacity design and failure hierarchy" and "Displacement demand and ductility limits": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 容量設計與破壞層級：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Capacity design and failure hierarchy: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「超強度彎矩 M_o」如何影響橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overstrength moment M_o” governs force, deformation or durability in “Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 以彈性設計抵抗設計地震對橋墩並不經濟，因此規範允許橋墩以塑性變形消散能量，但必須事先決定「哪裡可以壞、怎麼壞」。容量設計把柱端彎曲塑鉸設為唯一的延性保險絲，其他構件（剪力、帽梁、基礎、梁柱接頭、支承與錨定）都以塑鉸可能達到的超強度彎矩來設計，確保它們保持彈性。這樣即使地震遠超預期，破壞仍以可預測、可修復的彎曲變形出現，而不是脆性剪斷或基礎破壞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「超強度彎矩 M_o」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Designing piers to stay elastic in the design earthquake is uneconomical, so codes allow piers to dissipate energy by yielding, but the designer must decide in advance where damage may occur and how. Capacity design makes the column-end flexural plastic hinge the only ductile fuse, and designs every other element (shear, cap beam, foundation, beam–column joint, bearings and anchorages) for the overstrength moment the hinge can develop, so that they stay elastic. Even in an earthquake far beyond expectation, damage then appears as predictable, repairable flexural deformation rather than brittle shear or foundation failure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Overstrength moment M_o” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2·M_p。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Overstrength moment M_o = 1.2·M_p.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「超強度彎矩 M_o」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Overstrength moment M_o”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 容量設計與破壞層級
knowledge.text: 以彈性設計抵抗設計地震對橋墩並不經濟，因此規範允許橋墩以塑性變形消散能量，但必須事先決定「哪裡可以壞、怎麼壞」。容量設計把柱端彎曲塑鉸設為唯一的延性保險絲，其他構件（剪力、帽梁、基礎、梁柱接頭、支承與錨定）都以塑鉸可能達到的超強度彎矩來設計，確保它們保持彈性。
knowledge.textEn: Designing piers to stay elastic in the design earthquake is uneconomical, so codes allow piers to dissipate energy by yielding, but the designer must decide in advance where damage may occur and how. Capacity design makes the column-end flexural plastic hinge the only ductile fuse, and designs every other element (shear, cap beam, foundation, beam–column joint, bearings and anchorages) for the overstrength moment the hinge can develop, so that they stay elastic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「容量設計與破壞層級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Capacity design and failure hierarchy" is correct?
options: 橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。
以彈性設計抵抗設計地震對橋墩並不經濟，因此規範允許橋墩以塑性變形消散能量，但必須事先決定「哪裡可以壞、怎麼壞」。
只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。
optionsEn: The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety.
Designing piers to stay elastic in the design earthquake is uneconomical, so codes allow piers to dissipate energy by yielding, but the designer must decide in advance where damage may occur and how.
If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked.
quiz.explanation: 以彈性設計抵抗設計地震對橋墩並不經濟，因此規範允許橋墩以塑性變形消散能量，但必須事先決定「哪裡可以壞、怎麼壞」。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing piers to stay elastic in the design earthquake is uneconomical, so codes allow piers to dissipate energy by yielding, but the designer must decide in advance where damage may occur and how. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 容量設計與破壞層級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Capacity design and failure hierarchy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超強度彎矩 M_o」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Overstrength moment M_o” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2·M_p。M_p = 12 MN·m 時 M_o = 14.4 MN·m；懸臂高 L = 10 m 的單柱，對應剪力 V_o = M_o/L = 1.44 MN，基礎、帽梁與柱剪力都以此設計；若柱高只有 6 m，V_o 升為 2.4 MN。數值為教學假設，係數依所採規範。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Overstrength moment M_o = 1.2·M_p. For M_p = 12 MN·m, M_o = 14.4 MN·m; for a single cantilever column of height L = 10 m the corresponding shear is V_o = M_o/L = 1.44 MN, used to design foundation, cap beam and column shear; a 6 m column raises V_o to 2.4 MN. Values are teaching assumptions; the factor follows the governing code. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以彎矩—曲率分析求得柱的理想化塑性彎矩 M_p（採期望材料強度），乘以超強度係數後，逐一核對柱剪力、帽梁、基礎、樁與接頭的設計強度是否大於對應需求，並在計算書中列出完整的能力保護清單。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the column's idealised plastic moment M_p from moment–curvature analysis using expected material strengths, apply the overstrength factor, and check that the design strengths of column shear, cap beam, footing, piles and joints exceed the corresponding demands, listing the full capacity-protection table in the calculations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2·M_p。M_p = 12 MN·m 時 M_o = 14.4 MN·m；懸臂高 L = 10 m 的單柱，對應剪力 V_o = M_o/L = 1.44 MN，基礎、帽梁與柱剪力都以此設計；若柱高只有 6 m，V_o 升為 2.4 MN。數值為教學假設，係數依所採規範。
knowledge.textEn: Overstrength moment M_o = 1.2·M_p. For M_p = 12 MN·m, M_o = 14.4 MN·m; for a single cantilever column of height L = 10 m the corresponding shear is V_o = M_o/L = 1.44 MN, used to design foundation, cap beam and column shear; a 6 m column raises V_o to 2.4 MN. Values are teaching assumptions; the factor follows the governing code.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「容量設計與破壞層級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Capacity design and failure hierarchy", which statement holds?
options: 塑鉸長度就是柱底出現裂縫的長度，可以在現場直接量到。
只要續接器能承受鋼筋的降伏強度，就可以用在塑鉸區。
超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2·M_p。
optionsEn: The plastic-hinge length is simply the cracked length at the column base and can be measured on site.
Any coupler that develops the bar's yield strength can be used in a plastic hinge zone.
Overstrength moment M_o = 1.2·M_p.
quiz.explanation: 超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2·M_p。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Overstrength moment M_o = 1.2·M_p. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 容量設計與破壞層級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Capacity design and failure hierarchy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「超強度彎矩 M_o」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Overstrength moment M_o” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以彎矩—曲率分析求得柱的理想化塑性彎矩 M_p（採期望材料強度），乘以超強度係數後，逐一核對柱剪力、帽梁、基礎、樁與接頭的設計強度是否大於對應需求，並在計算書中列出完整的能力保護清單。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the column's idealised plastic moment M_p from moment–curvature analysis using expected material strengths, apply the overstrength factor, and check that the design strengths of column shear, cap beam, footing, piles and joints exceed the corresponding demands, listing the full capacity-protection table in the calculations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計審查時要求一張「延性構件與能力保護構件」對照表，列出塑鉸位置、M_p、M_o 與各能力保護構件的強度比；變更柱配筋時，必須同步重算所有能力保護構件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design review requires a table of ductile versus capacity-protected members listing hinge locations, M_p, M_o and each protected member's strength ratio; any change to column reinforcement triggers recalculation of all capacity-protected members.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降；1971 年聖費爾南多與 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中多座高架橋就因柱剪力與接頭不足而崩塌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle; in the 1971 San Fernando and 1989 Loma Prieta earthquakes several viaducts collapsed because of inadequate column shear and joint capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以彎矩—曲率分析求得柱的理想化塑性彎矩 M_p（採期望材料強度），乘以超強度係數後，逐一核對柱剪力、帽梁、基礎、樁與接頭的設計強度是否大於對應需求，並在計算書中列出完整的能力保護清單。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain the column's idealised plastic moment M_p from moment–curvature analysis using expected material strengths, apply the overstrength factor, and check that the design strengths of column shear, cap beam, footing, piles and joints exceed the corresponding demands, listing the full capacity-protection table in the calculations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計審查時要求一張「延性構件與能力保護構件」對照表，列出塑鉸位置、M_p、M_o 與各能力保護構件的強度比；變更柱配筋時，必須同步重算所有能力保護構件。
knowledge.textEn: Design review requires a table of ductile versus capacity-protected members listing hinge locations, M_p, M_o and each protected member's strength ratio; any change to column reinforcement triggers recalculation of all capacity-protected members.

quiz.question: 要驗證「容量設計與破壞層級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Capacity design and failure hierarchy"?
options: 以彎矩—曲率分析求得柱的理想化塑性彎矩 M_p（採期望材料強度），乘以超強度係數後，逐一核對柱剪力、帽梁、基礎、樁與接頭的設計強度是否大於對應需求，並在計算書中列出完整的能力保護清單。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
震後柱子沒有倒，就表示可以直接恢復通行。
optionsEn: Obtain the column's idealised plastic moment M_p from moment–curvature analysis using expected material strengths, apply the overstrength factor, and check that the design strengths of column shear, cap beam, footing, piles and joints exceed the corresponding demands, listing the full capacity-protection table in the calculations.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If a column did not collapse in the earthquake, the bridge can reopen immediately.
quiz.explanation: 以彎矩—曲率分析求得柱的理想化塑性彎矩 M_p（採期望材料強度），乘以超強度係數後，逐一核對柱剪力、帽梁、基礎、樁與接頭的設計強度是否大於對應需求，並在計算書中列出完整的能力保護清單。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain the column's idealised plastic moment M_p from moment–curvature analysis using expected material strengths, apply the overstrength factor, and check that the design strengths of column shear, cap beam, footing, piles and joints exceed the corresponding demands, listing the full capacity-protection table in the calculations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 容量設計與破壞層級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Capacity design and failure hierarchy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「超強度彎矩 M_o」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Overstrength moment M_o” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降；1971 年聖費爾南多與 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中多座高架橋就因柱剪力與接頭不足而崩塌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle; in the 1971 San Fernando and 1989 Loma Prieta earthquakes several viaducts collapsed because of inadequate column shear and joint capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這樣即使地震遠超預期，破壞仍以可預測、可修復的彎曲變形出現，而不是脆性剪斷或基礎破壞。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Even in an earthquake far beyond expectation, damage then appears as predictable, repairable flexural deformation rather than brittle shear or foundation failure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降；1971 年聖費爾南多與 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中多座高架橋就因柱剪力與接頭不足而崩塌。
knowledge.textEn: If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle; in the 1971 San Fernando and 1989 Loma Prieta earthquakes several viaducts collapsed because of inadequate column shear and joint capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「容量設計與破壞層級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Capacity design and failure hierarchy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降。
只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle.
If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked.
quiz.explanation: 若剪力或基礎只以設計地震力計算，塑鉸形成前或形成時柱先剪斷，強度在一個循環內驟降；1971 年聖費爾南多與 1989 年洛馬普列塔地震中多座高架橋就因柱剪力與接頭不足而崩塌。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If shear or foundations are designed only for the design earthquake force, the column can fail in shear before or as the hinge forms, losing strength within one cycle; in the 1971 San Fernando and 1989 Loma Prieta earthquakes several viaducts collapsed because of inadequate column shear and joint capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 位移需求與韌性限值：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Displacement demand and ductility limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「位移韌性需求 μ_D」如何影響橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Displacement ductility demand μ_D” governs force, deformation or durability in “Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 對週期較長的橋梁，等位移原則指出非線性結構的最大位移與同週期的彈性結構相近，因此設計可先求彈性位移需求，再除以柱的降伏位移得到位移韌性需求 μ_D。韌性需求越高，塑鉸轉角越大、損傷越重；加州運輸局耐震設計準則 1.7 版把固定基礎單柱橋墩的 μ_D 限制在 4、多柱排架限制在 5，並要求每個延性構件的局部位移韌性容量至少為 3。限值的目的是讓需求與容量之間保有餘裕，同時把震後損傷控制在可修復範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「位移韌性需求 μ_D」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For longer-period bridges the equal-displacement principle says the peak displacement of a nonlinear structure is close to that of an elastic structure with the same period, so design first finds the elastic displacement demand and divides it by the column's yield displacement to get the displacement ductility demand μ_D. Higher demand means larger hinge rotations and heavier damage; Caltrans Seismic Design Criteria version 1.7 limits μ_D to 4 for single-column bents on fixed foundations and 5 for multi-column bents, and requires each ductile member to have a local displacement ductility capacity of at least 3. The limits keep a margin between demand and capacity and hold post-earthquake damage within a repairable range. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Displacement ductility demand μ_D” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D with ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375 and D = 2.0 m gives φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m; yield displacement Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 = 0.00267×10²/3 ≈ 0.089 m, ignoring bar slip.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「位移韌性需求 μ_D」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Displacement ductility demand μ_D”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 位移需求與韌性限值
knowledge.text: 對週期較長的橋梁，等位移原則指出非線性結構的最大位移與同週期的彈性結構相近，因此設計可先求彈性位移需求，再除以柱的降伏位移得到位移韌性需求 μ_D。韌性需求越高，塑鉸轉角越大、損傷越重；加州運輸局耐震設計準則 1.7 版把固定基礎單柱橋墩的 μ_D 限制在 4、多柱排架限制在 5，並要求每個延性構件的局部位移韌性容量至少為 3。
knowledge.textEn: For longer-period bridges the equal-displacement principle says the peak displacement of a nonlinear structure is close to that of an elastic structure with the same period, so design first finds the elastic displacement demand and divides it by the column's yield displacement to get the displacement ductility demand μ_D. Higher demand means larger hinge rotations and heavier damage; Caltrans Seismic Design Criteria version 1.7 limits μ_D to 4 for single-column bents on fixed foundations and 5 for multi-column bents, and requires each ductile member to have a local displacement ductility capacity of at least 3.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「位移需求與韌性限值」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Displacement demand and ductility limits" is correct?
options: 只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。
箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。
對週期較長的橋梁，等位移原則指出非線性結構的最大位移與同週期的彈性結構相近，因此設計可先求彈性位移需求，再除以柱的降伏位移得到位移韌性需求 μ_D。
optionsEn: If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked.
Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance.

For longer-period bridges the equal-displacement principle says the peak displacement of a nonlinear structure is close to that of an elastic structure with the same period, so design first finds the elastic displacement demand and divides it by the column's yield displacement to get the displacement ductility demand μ_D.
quiz.explanation: 對週期較長的橋梁，等位移原則指出非線性結構的最大位移與同週期的彈性結構相近，因此設計可先求彈性位移需求，再除以柱的降伏位移得到位移韌性需求 μ_D。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For longer-period bridges the equal-displacement principle says the peak displacement of a nonlinear structure is close to that of an elastic structure with the same period, so design first finds the elastic displacement demand and divides it by the column's yield displacement to get the displacement ductility demand μ_D. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 位移需求與韌性限值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Displacement demand and ductility limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「位移韌性需求 μ_D」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Displacement ductility demand μ_D” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：降伏曲率 φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D，ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375，D = 2.0 m，φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m；降伏位移 Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 = 0.00267×10²/3 ≈ 0.089 m（未計鋼筋滑移）。彈性位移需求 Δ_D = 0.30 m，μ_D = 0.30/0.089 ≈ 3.4，小於 4。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D with ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375 and D = 2.0 m gives φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m; yield displacement Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 = 0.00267×10²/3 ≈ 0.089 m, ignoring bar slip. For an elastic displacement demand Δ_D = 0.30 m, μ_D = 0.30/0.089 ≈ 3.4, below 4. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以反應譜或非線性時間歷程分析求得每座排架的位移需求，與推覆分析（pushover）得到的降伏位移與容量位移比較，確認 μ_D 不超過規範限值且 Δ_D 小於容量位移；短週期橋梁要另加位移放大係數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain each bent's displacement demand by response-spectrum or nonlinear time-history analysis and compare it with yield and capacity displacements from pushover analysis, confirming μ_D stays within the code limit and Δ_D below capacity; short-period bridges need an additional displacement magnification factor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D with ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375 and D = 2.0 m gives φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m; yield displacement Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 = 0.00267×10²/3 ≈ 0.089 m, ignoring bar slip. For an elastic displacement demand Δ_D = 0.30 m, μ_D = 0.30/0.089 ≈ 3.4, below 4. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「位移需求與韌性限值」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Displacement demand and ductility limits", which statement holds?
options: 箍筋間距差幾公分不影響結構安全，可以依現場方便調整。
單調推到破壞的試驗就足以代表地震下的柱韌性。
optionsEn: Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D with ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375 and D = 2.0 m gives φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m.
A few centimetres of extra hoop spacing do not affect safety and can be adjusted for site convenience.
A monotonic push to failure is enough to represent column ductility under earthquakes.
quiz.explanationEn: Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25·ε_y/D with ε_y = 475/200,000 = 0.002375 and D = 2.0 m gives φ_y ≈ 0.00267 1/m; yield displacement Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 = 0.00267×10²/3 ≈ 0.089 m, ignoring bar slip. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 位移需求與韌性限值：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Displacement demand and ductility limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「位移韌性需求 μ_D」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Displacement ductility demand μ_D” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以反應譜或非線性時間歷程分析求得每座排架的位移需求，與推覆分析（pushover）得到的降伏位移與容量位移比較，確認 μ_D 不超過規範限值且 Δ_D 小於容量位移；短週期橋梁要另加位移放大係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain each bent's displacement demand by response-spectrum or nonlinear time-history analysis and compare it with yield and capacity displacements from pushover analysis, confirming μ_D stays within the code limit and Δ_D below capacity; short-period bridges need an additional displacement magnification factor. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：相鄰排架的有效勁度比應盡量接近（例如以墩高、斷面或基礎埋深調整），設計報告須列出每座排架的 Δ_D、Δ_y、Δ_c 與 μ_D，作為審查與後續評估的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep effective stiffness ratios of adjacent bents close, adjusting pier height, section or foundation embedment, and list Δ_D, Δ_y, Δ_c and μ_D for every bent in the design report as the baseline for review and later assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一座橋中長短不一的橋墩若未調整勁度，短墩吸收大部分地震力且韌性需求集中，可能先達到剪力或韌性極限；忽略短週期放大則低估位移，使塑鉸轉角超過容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If piers of very different heights in one bridge are not balanced in stiffness, the short piers attract most of the seismic force and concentrate ductility demand, reaching shear or ductility limits first; ignoring short-period magnification underestimates displacement and drives hinge rotation beyond capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以反應譜或非線性時間歷程分析求得每座排架的位移需求，與推覆分析（pushover）得到的降伏位移與容量位移比較，確認 μ_D 不超過規範限值且 Δ_D 小於容量位移；短週期橋梁要另加位移放大係數。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain each bent's displacement demand by response-spectrum or nonlinear time-history analysis and compare it with yield and capacity displacements from pushover analysis, confirming μ_D stays within the code limit and Δ_D below capacity; short-period bridges need an additional displacement magnification factor.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 相鄰排架的有效勁度比應盡量接近（例如以墩高、斷面或基礎埋深調整），設計報告須列出每座排架的 Δ_D、Δ_y、Δ_c 與 μ_D，作為審查與後續評估的基準。
knowledge.textEn: Keep effective stiffness ratios of adjacent bents close, adjusting pier height, section or foundation embedment, and list Δ_D, Δ_y, Δ_c and μ_D for every bent in the design report as the baseline for review and later assessment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「位移需求與韌性限值」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Displacement demand and ductility limits"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以反應譜或非線性時間歷程分析求得每座排架的位移需求，與推覆分析（pushover）得到的降伏位移與容量位移比較，確認 μ_D 不超過規範限值且 Δ_D 小於容量位移。
耐震與耐久是兩個獨立問題，腐蝕不會影響橋墩的耐震能力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Obtain each bent's displacement demand by response-spectrum or nonlinear time-history analysis and compare it with yield and capacity displacements from pushover analysis, confirming μ_D stays within the code limit and Δ_D below capacity.
Seismic and durability performance are separate issues; corrosion does not affect a pier's seismic capacity.
quiz.explanation: 以反應譜或非線性時間歷程分析求得每座排架的位移需求，與推覆分析（pushover）得到的降伏位移與容量位移比較，確認 μ_D 不超過規範限值且 Δ_D 小於容量位移；短週期橋梁要另加位移放大係數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain each bent's displacement demand by response-spectrum or nonlinear time-history analysis and compare it with yield and capacity displacements from pushover analysis, confirming μ_D stays within the code limit and Δ_D below capacity; short-period bridges need an additional displacement magnification factor. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 位移需求與韌性限值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Displacement demand and ductility limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「位移韌性需求 μ_D」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Displacement ductility demand μ_D” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一座橋中長短不一的橋墩若未調整勁度，短墩吸收大部分地震力且韌性需求集中，可能先達到剪力或韌性極限；忽略短週期放大則低估位移，使塑鉸轉角超過容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If piers of very different heights in one bridge are not balanced in stiffness, the short piers attract most of the seismic force and concentrate ductility demand, reaching shear or ductility limits first; ignoring short-period magnification underestimates displacement and drives hinge rotation beyond capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：限值的目的是讓需求與容量之間保有餘裕，同時把震後損傷控制在可修復範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The limits keep a margin between demand and capacity and hold post-earthquake damage within a repairable range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一座橋中長短不一的橋墩若未調整勁度，短墩吸收大部分地震力且韌性需求集中，可能先達到剪力或韌性極限；忽略短週期放大則低估位移，使塑鉸轉角超過容量。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Displacement demand and ductility limits" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「圍束箍筋與核心混凝土」與「塑鉸長度、轉角容量與搭接禁區」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Confining hoops and core concrete" and "Hinge length, rotation capacity and no-splice zones": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 圍束箍筋與核心混凝土：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Confining hoops and core concrete: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺旋箍筋體積比 ρ_s」如何影響橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spiral volumetric ratio ρ_s” governs force, deformation or durability in “Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 塑鉸轉角容量主要取決於受壓區混凝土能承受多大壓應變：保護層混凝土在應變約 0.004 時剝落，但被螺旋箍筋或封閉箍筋圍束的核心混凝土，受到箍筋的側向反力，強度與極限應變都大幅提高。圍束同時防止縱向主筋在反覆載重下挫屈，以及提供剪力強度。圓形斷面用螺旋筋圍束效率最高，矩形斷面則需要繫筋把箍筋的長邊拉住，否則箍筋向外彎曲，圍束作用只在角落有效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺旋箍筋體積比 ρ_s」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The rotation capacity of a plastic hinge depends mainly on how much compressive strain the concrete can sustain: cover concrete spalls at a strain of about 0.004, but core concrete confined by spirals or closed hoops gains strength and ultimate strain from the hoops' lateral reaction. Confinement also stops longitudinal bars buckling under reversed loading and supplies shear strength. Circular sections confined by spirals are the most efficient; rectangular sections need cross-ties to restrain the long sides of the hoops, or the hoops bow outward and confine effectively only at the corners. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spiral volumetric ratio ρ_s” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ρ_s = 4·A_sp/(D′·s); a 22 mm spiral with A_sp = 380 mm², core diameter D′ = 1,900 mm and pitch s = 100 mm gives ρ_s = 1,520/190,000 = 0.0080.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺旋箍筋體積比 ρ_s」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Spiral volumetric ratio ρ_s”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 圍束箍筋與核心混凝土
knowledge.text: 塑鉸轉角容量主要取決於受壓區混凝土能承受多大壓應變：保護層混凝土在應變約 0.004 時剝落，但被螺旋箍筋或封閉箍筋圍束的核心混凝土，受到箍筋的側向反力，強度與極限應變都大幅提高。圍束同時防止縱向主筋在反覆載重下挫屈，以及提供剪力強度。
knowledge.textEn: The rotation capacity of a plastic hinge depends mainly on how much compressive strain the concrete can sustain: cover concrete spalls at a strain of about 0.004, but core concrete confined by spirals or closed hoops gains strength and ultimate strain from the hoops' lateral reaction. Confinement also stops longitudinal bars buckling under reversed loading and supplies shear strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「圍束箍筋與核心混凝土」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Confining hoops and core concrete" is correct?
options: 塑鉸轉角容量主要取決於受壓區混凝土能承受多大壓應變：保護層混凝土在應變約 0.004 時剝落，但被螺旋箍筋或封閉箍筋圍束的核心混凝土，受到箍筋的側向反力，強度與極限應變都大幅提高。
箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。
塑鉸長度就是柱底出現裂縫的長度，可以在現場直接量到。
optionsEn: The rotation capacity of a plastic hinge depends mainly on how much compressive strain the concrete can sustain: cover concrete spalls at a strain of about 0.004, but core concrete confined by spirals or closed hoops gains strength and ultimate strain from the hoops' lateral reaction.
Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance.
The plastic-hinge length is simply the cracked length at the column base and can be measured on site.
quiz.explanation: 塑鉸轉角容量主要取決於受壓區混凝土能承受多大壓應變：保護層混凝土在應變約 0.004 時剝落，但被螺旋箍筋或封閉箍筋圍束的核心混凝土，受到箍筋的側向反力，強度與極限應變都大幅提高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The rotation capacity of a plastic hinge depends mainly on how much compressive strain the concrete can sustain: cover concrete spalls at a strain of about 0.004, but core concrete confined by spirals or closed hoops gains strength and ultimate strain from the hoops' lateral reaction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 圍束箍筋與核心混凝土：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Confining hoops and core concrete: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺旋箍筋體積比 ρ_s」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spiral volumetric ratio ρ_s” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ρ_s = 4·A_sp/(D′·s)，22 mm 螺旋筋 A_sp = 380 mm²、核心直徑 D′ = 1,900 mm、間距 s = 100 mm，ρ_s = 1,520/190,000 = 0.0080。極限應變 ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4·ρ_s·f_yh·ε_su/f′_cc = 0.004 + 1.4×0.008×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0136，約為未圍束值的 3.4 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ρ_s = 4·A_sp/(D′·s); a 22 mm spiral with A_sp = 380 mm², core diameter D′ = 1,900 mm and pitch s = 100 mm gives ρ_s = 1,520/190,000 = 0.0080. Ultimate strain ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4·ρ_s·f_yh·ε_su/f′_cc = 0.004 + 1.4×0.008×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0136, about 3.4 times the unconfined value. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 Mander 等圍束混凝土模型建立彎矩—曲率分析，確認極限曲率由核心混凝土壓應變或主筋拉應變控制；並檢查箍筋間距不超過規範對防止主筋挫屈的上限（常以主筋直徑的倍數表示）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the moment–curvature analysis with a confined-concrete model such as Mander's, confirming whether ultimate curvature is governed by core compressive strain or bar tensile strain; check that hoop spacing does not exceed the code limit for preventing bar buckling, usually expressed as a multiple of bar diameter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: ρ_s = 4·A_sp/(D′·s); a 22 mm spiral with A_sp = 380 mm², core diameter D′ = 1,900 mm and pitch s = 100 mm gives ρ_s = 1,520/190,000 = 0.0080. Ultimate strain ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4·ρ_s·f_yh·ε_su/f′_cc = 0.004 + 1.4×0.008×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0136, about 3.4 times the unconfined value. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Confining hoops and core concrete", which statement holds?
options: 只要續接器能承受鋼筋的降伏強度，就可以用在塑鉸區。
震後柱子沒有倒，就表示可以直接恢復通行。
