Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：震後以全站儀或傾斜儀量測柱頂相對柱底的水平偏移，記錄裂縫寬度、剝落高度與主筋狀態，並與設計時預估的損傷等級比較；超過門檻（例如殘留漂移 1%，教學假設）或主筋挫屈時，限制通行並由結構工程師評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an earthquake measure the horizontal offset of column top relative to base with a total station or inclinometer, record crack widths, spalling height and bar condition, and compare with the damage state predicted at design; beyond a threshold, for example 1% residual drift as a teaching assumption, or with buckled bars, restrict traffic pending a structural engineer's assessment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 殘留漂移比 = Δ_r/H = 0.08/10 = 0.8%。P-Δ 二次彎矩 = P·Δ_r = 8 MN×0.08 m = 0.64 MN·m，約為 M_p = 12 MN·m 的 5.3%，低於設計時常用的 20% 檢核比例；若 Δ_r = 0.30 m，P-Δ 為 2.4 MN·m，即達 20%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Residual drift = Δ_r/H = 0.08/10 = 0.8%. The P-Δ moment = P·Δ_r = 8 MN×0.08 m = 0.64 MN·m, about 5.3% of M_p = 12 MN·m, below the 20% ratio commonly checked in design; a residual of 0.30 m gives 2.4 MN·m, reaching 20%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「震後損傷量測與殘留變形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-earthquake damage measurement and residual deformation", which statement holds?
options: 橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。
箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。
optionsEn: Residual drift = Δ_r/H = 0.08/10 = 0.8%.
The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety.
Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance.
quiz.explanation: 殘留漂移比 = Δ_r/H = 0.08/10 = 0.8%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Residual drift = Δ_r/H = 0.08/10 = 0.8%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 震後損傷量測與殘留變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage measurement and residual deformation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「殘留漂移比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual drift ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 震後以全站儀或傾斜儀量測柱頂相對柱底的水平偏移，記錄裂縫寬度、剝落高度與主筋狀態，並與設計時預估的損傷等級比較；超過門檻（例如殘留漂移 1%，教學假設）或主筋挫屈時，限制通行並由結構工程師評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an earthquake measure the horizontal offset of column top relative to base with a total station or inclinometer, record crack widths, spalling height and bar condition, and compare with the damage state predicted at design; beyond a threshold, for example 1% residual drift as a teaching assumption, or with buckled bars, restrict traffic pending a structural engineer's assessment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：震後檢查程序要事先分級（立即通行、限制通行、封閉），每級對應裂縫、剝落、殘留漂移與主筋狀態的量化門檻；量測基準點與柱的竣工垂直度在交接時就要建立。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Grade the post-earthquake procedure in advance into open, restricted and closed, each tied to quantitative thresholds for cracking, spalling, residual drift and bar condition; set up survey reference points and as-built column plumbness at handover.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未量測殘留傾斜就恢復通行，若主筋已挫屈或柱核心已壓碎，餘震中柱可能失去軸向承載；1995 年阪神地震中阪神高速神戶線有多處高架段整段側倒，正顯示缺乏韌性與殘留變形控制的後果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reopening without measuring residual tilt risks loss of axial capacity in aftershocks if bars have buckled or the core has crushed; in the 1995 Kobe earthquake several elevated sections of the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route toppled sideways, showing the consequence of lacking ductility and residual-deformation control. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 震後以全站儀或傾斜儀量測柱頂相對柱底的水平偏移，記錄裂縫寬度、剝落高度與主筋狀態，並與設計時預估的損傷等級比較；超過門檻（例如殘留漂移 1%，教學假設）或主筋挫屈時，限制通行並由結構工程師評估。
knowledge.textEn: After an earthquake measure the horizontal offset of column top relative to base with a total station or inclinometer, record crack widths, spalling height and bar condition, and compare with the damage state predicted at design; beyond a threshold, for example 1% residual drift as a teaching assumption, or with buckled bars, restrict traffic pending a structural engineer's assessment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 震後檢查程序要事先分級（立即通行、限制通行、封閉），每級對應裂縫、剝落、殘留漂移與主筋狀態的量化門檻；量測基準點與柱的竣工垂直度在交接時就要建立。
knowledge.textEn: Grade the post-earthquake procedure in advance into open, restricted and closed, each tied to quantitative thresholds for cracking, spalling, residual drift and bar condition; set up survey reference points and as-built column plumbness at handover.

quiz.question: 要驗證「震後損傷量測與殘留變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-earthquake damage measurement and residual deformation"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
震後以全站儀或傾斜儀量測柱頂相對柱底的水平偏移，記錄裂縫寬度、剝落高度與主筋狀態，並與設計時預估的損傷等級比較。
箍筋間距差幾公分不影響結構安全，可以依現場方便調整。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

After an earthquake measure the horizontal offset of column top relative to base with a total station or inclinometer, record crack widths, spalling height and bar condition, and compare with the damage state predicted at design.
A few centimetres of extra hoop spacing do not affect safety and can be adjusted for site convenience.
quiz.explanation: 震後以全站儀或傾斜儀量測柱頂相對柱底的水平偏移，記錄裂縫寬度、剝落高度與主筋狀態，並與設計時預估的損傷等級比較；超過門檻（例如殘留漂移 1%，教學假設）或主筋挫屈時，限制通行並由結構工程師評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After an earthquake measure the horizontal offset of column top relative to base with a total station or inclinometer, record crack widths, spalling height and bar condition, and compare with the damage state predicted at design; beyond a threshold, for example 1% residual drift as a teaching assumption, or with buckled bars, restrict traffic pending a structural engineer's assessment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 震後損傷量測與殘留變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake damage measurement and residual deformation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「殘留漂移比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Residual drift ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未量測殘留傾斜就恢復通行，若主筋已挫屈或柱核心已壓碎，餘震中柱可能失去軸向承載；1995 年阪神地震中阪神高速神戶線有多處高架段整段側倒，正顯示缺乏韌性與殘留變形控制的後果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reopening without measuring residual tilt risks loss of axial capacity in aftershocks if bars have buckled or the core has crushed; in the 1995 Kobe earthquake several elevated sections of the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route toppled sideways, showing the consequence of lacking ductility and residual-deformation control. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：殘留漂移比是決定能否修復的關鍵，因為傾斜的柱在重力下產生 P-Δ 二次彎矩，降低後續地震的安全餘裕；1995 年阪神地震後日本在設計中引入殘留位移檢核，即是為了避免大量傾斜橋墩只能拆除重建。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Residual drift is the key repairability criterion because a tilted column carries second-order P-Δ moment under gravity, eroding safety for later earthquakes; after the 1995 Kobe earthquake Japan introduced residual-displacement checks into design to avoid large numbers of tilted piers that could only be demolished and rebuilt.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「震後柱子沒有倒，就表示可以直接恢復通行。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a column did not collapse in the earthquake, the bridge can reopen immediately." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未量測殘留傾斜就恢復通行，若主筋已挫屈或柱核心已壓碎，餘震中柱可能失去軸向承載；1995 年阪神地震中阪神高速神戶線有多處高架段整段側倒，正顯示缺乏韌性與殘留變形控制的後果。
knowledge.textEn: Reopening without measuring residual tilt risks loss of axial capacity in aftershocks if bars have buckled or the core has crushed; in the 1995 Kobe earthquake several elevated sections of the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route toppled sideways, showing the consequence of lacking ductility and residual-deformation control.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「震後損傷量測與殘留變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-earthquake damage measurement and residual deformation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
耐震與耐久是兩個獨立問題，腐蝕不會影響橋墩的耐震能力。
未量測殘留傾斜就恢復通行，若主筋已挫屈或柱核心已壓碎，餘震中柱可能失去軸向承載。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Seismic and durability performance are separate issues; corrosion does not affect a pier's seismic capacity.
Reopening without measuring residual tilt risks loss of axial capacity in aftershocks if bars have buckled or the core has crushed.
quiz.explanation: 未量測殘留傾斜就恢復通行，若主筋已挫屈或柱核心已壓碎，餘震中柱可能失去軸向承載；1995 年阪神地震中阪神高速神戶線有多處高架段整段側倒，正顯示缺乏韌性與殘留變形控制的後果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reopening without measuring residual tilt risks loss of axial capacity in aftershocks if bars have buckled or the core has crushed; in the 1995 Kobe earthquake several elevated sections of the Hanshin Expressway Kobe Route toppled sideways, showing the consequence of lacking ductility and residual-deformation control. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「塑鉸區的耐久性與箍筋腐蝕」與「既有橋墩評估與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Durability of the hinge zone and hoop corrosion" and "Assessing existing piers and engineering handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 塑鉸區的耐久性與箍筋腐蝕：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Durability of the hinge zone and hoop corrosion: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「塑鉸區保護層」如何影響橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hinge-zone cover” governs force, deformation or durability in “Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 柱底塑鉸區通常在地面或水面附近，最容易受到乾濕循環、鹽分、除冰鹽或河水沖刷磨耗；箍筋位於最外層，比主筋更早腐蝕。箍筋斷面一旦因腐蝕減少，圍束能力與剪力強度同步下降，而這兩者正是韌性設計賴以成立的條件。因此耐久設計（保護層厚度、混凝土品質、裂縫控制、表面保護）在塑鉸區不只是延壽問題，而是維持耐震性能的必要條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「塑鉸區保護層」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The base hinge zone usually sits near ground or water level, where it is most exposed to wetting and drying, salts, de-icing salts and abrasion by river flow; hoops lie outermost and corrode before longitudinal bars. Once corrosion reduces hoop area, confinement and shear strength fall together, and those are exactly the conditions ductile design relies on. Durability design (cover, concrete quality, crack control and surface protection) in the hinge zone is therefore not just about service life but a prerequisite for keeping seismic performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Hinge-zone cover” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Corrosion that removes 20% of hoop area lowers ρ_s from 0.0080 to 0.0064, so ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4×0.0064×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0117, about 14% below the original 0.0136, with a corresponding loss of hinge rotation capacity.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「耐震與耐久是兩個獨立問題，腐蝕不會影響橋墩的耐震能力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Seismic and durability performance are separate issues; corrosion does not affect a pier's seismic capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「塑鉸區保護層」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Hinge-zone cover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 塑鉸區的耐久性與箍筋腐蝕
knowledge.titleEn: Durability of the hinge zone and hoop corrosion
knowledge.text: 柱底塑鉸區通常在地面或水面附近，最容易受到乾濕循環、鹽分、除冰鹽或河水沖刷磨耗；箍筋位於最外層，比主筋更早腐蝕。箍筋斷面一旦因腐蝕減少，圍束能力與剪力強度同步下降，而這兩者正是韌性設計賴以成立的條件。
knowledge.textEn: The base hinge zone usually sits near ground or water level, where it is most exposed to wetting and drying, salts, de-icing salts and abrasion by river flow; hoops lie outermost and corrode before longitudinal bars. Once corrosion reduces hoop area, confinement and shear strength fall together, and those are exactly the conditions ductile design relies on.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：耐震與耐久是兩個獨立問題，腐蝕不會影響橋墩的耐震能力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Seismic and durability performance are separate issues; corrosion does not affect a pier's seismic capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「塑鉸區的耐久性與箍筋腐蝕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Durability of the hinge zone and hoop corrosion" is correct?
options: 柱底塑鉸區通常在地面或水面附近，最容易受到乾濕循環、鹽分、除冰鹽或河水沖刷磨耗；箍筋位於最外層，比主筋更早腐蝕。
耐震與耐久是兩個獨立問題，腐蝕不會影響橋墩的耐震能力。
混凝土剪力強度是固定值，不會因柱子的彎曲變形而改變。
optionsEn: The base hinge zone usually sits near ground or water level, where it is most exposed to wetting and drying, salts, de-icing salts and abrasion by river flow.
Seismic and durability performance are separate issues; corrosion does not affect a pier's seismic capacity.
The concrete shear strength is a fixed value that does not change with column flexural deformation.
quiz.explanation: 柱底塑鉸區通常在地面或水面附近，最容易受到乾濕循環、鹽分、除冰鹽或河水沖刷磨耗；箍筋位於最外層，比主筋更早腐蝕。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The base hinge zone usually sits near ground or water level, where it is most exposed to wetting and drying, salts, de-icing salts and abrasion by river flow; hoops lie outermost and corrode before longitudinal bars. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 塑鉸區的耐久性與箍筋腐蝕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Durability of the hinge zone and hoop corrosion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塑鉸區保護層」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hinge-zone cover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：箍筋腐蝕使有效面積減少 20%，ρ_s 由 0.0080 降為 0.0064，ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4×0.0064×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0117，比原設計 0.0136 低約 14%，塑鉸轉角容量也相應降低。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Corrosion that removes 20% of hoop area lowers ρ_s from 0.0080 to 0.0064, so ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4×0.0064×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0117, about 14% below the original 0.0136, with a corresponding loss of hinge rotation capacity. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期檢查柱底的鏽水、裂縫與剝落，必要時以保護層厚度計、半電池電位與氯離子含量取樣評估腐蝕風險；發現箍筋外露時量測殘餘直徑，回算圍束與剪力強度並與原設計比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect column bases periodically for rust staining, cracking and spalling, and where needed assess corrosion risk with cover meters, half-cell potential and chloride sampling; where hoops are exposed, measure remaining diameter and back-calculate confinement and shear strength against the original design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Corrosion that removes 20% of hoop area lowers ρ_s from 0.0080 to 0.0064, so ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4×0.0064×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0117, about 14% below the original 0.0136, with a corresponding loss of hinge rotation capacity. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塑鉸區的耐久性與箍筋腐蝕」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Durability of the hinge zone and hoop corrosion", which statement holds?
options: 只要強度需求以韌性折減後滿足，就不必檢查位移。
塑鉸長度就是柱底出現裂縫的長度，可以在現場直接量到。
optionsEn: If strength demand reduced by ductility is satisfied, displacement need not be checked.

Corrosion that removes 20% of hoop area lowers ρ_s from 0.0080 to 0.0064, so ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4×0.0064×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0117, about 14% below the original 0.0136, with a corresponding loss of hinge rotation capacity.
The plastic-hinge length is simply the cracked length at the column base and can be measured on site.
quiz.explanationEn: Corrosion that removes 20% of hoop area lowers ρ_s from 0.0080 to 0.0064, so ε_cu = 0.004 + 1.4×0.0064×475×0.09/50 ≈ 0.0117, about 14% below the original 0.0136, with a corresponding loss of hinge rotation capacity. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塑鉸區的耐久性與箍筋腐蝕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Durability of the hinge zone and hoop corrosion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塑鉸區保護層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hinge-zone cover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期檢查柱底的鏽水、裂縫與剝落，必要時以保護層厚度計、半電池電位與氯離子含量取樣評估腐蝕風險；發現箍筋外露時量測殘餘直徑，回算圍束與剪力強度並與原設計比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect column bases periodically for rust staining, cracking and spalling, and where needed assess corrosion risk with cover meters, half-cell potential and chloride sampling; where hoops are exposed, measure remaining diameter and back-calculate confinement and shear strength against the original design. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：塑鉸區保護層厚度、混凝土等級與表面保護要依暴露環境提高，河中橋墩加設防撞與防磨耗保護；檢查手冊把柱底箍筋狀態列為耐震關鍵項目，並設定修復門檻。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase hinge-zone cover, concrete grade and surface protection to suit exposure, and add impact and abrasion protection for in-river piers; the inspection manual lists base hoop condition as a seismic-critical item with defined repair thresholds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：河川或沿海橋墩柱底保護層被沖刷磨耗、箍筋鏽斷，平時外觀只是局部剝落，地震時塑鉸區卻提早剪力破壞或主筋挫屈，原本設計的韌性容量已不存在。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: At river or coastal piers, abraded cover and corroded-through hoops at the column base look like minor spalling in service, yet in an earthquake the hinge zone fails early in shear or by bar buckling, because the designed ductility capacity no longer exists. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Inspect column bases periodically for rust staining, cracking and spalling, and where needed assess corrosion risk with cover meters, half-cell potential and chloride sampling; where hoops are exposed, measure remaining diameter and back-calculate confinement and shear strength against the original design.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 塑鉸區保護層厚度、混凝土等級與表面保護要依暴露環境提高，河中橋墩加設防撞與防磨耗保護；檢查手冊把柱底箍筋狀態列為耐震關鍵項目，並設定修復門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Increase hinge-zone cover, concrete grade and surface protection to suit exposure, and add impact and abrasion protection for in-river piers; the inspection manual lists base hoop condition as a seismic-critical item with defined repair thresholds.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塑鉸區的耐久性與箍筋腐蝕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Durability of the hinge zone and hoop corrosion"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要續接器能承受鋼筋的降伏強度，就可以用在塑鉸區。

Any coupler that develops the bar's yield strength can be used in a plastic hinge zone.
Inspect column bases periodically for rust staining, cracking and spalling, and where needed assess corrosion risk with cover meters, half-cell potential and chloride sampling.

quiz.explanationEn: Inspect column bases periodically for rust staining, cracking and spalling, and where needed assess corrosion risk with cover meters, half-cell potential and chloride sampling; where hoops are exposed, measure remaining diameter and back-calculate confinement and shear strength against the original design. steps.title: 塑鉸區的耐久性與箍筋腐蝕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Durability of the hinge zone and hoop corrosion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塑鉸區保護層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hinge-zone cover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 河川或沿海橋墩柱底保護層被沖刷磨耗、箍筋鏽斷，平時外觀只是局部剝落，地震時塑鉸區卻提早剪力破壞或主筋挫屈，原本設計的韌性容量已不存在。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: At river or coastal piers, abraded cover and corroded-through hoops at the column base look like minor spalling in service, yet in an earthquake the hinge zone fails early in shear or by bar buckling, because the designed ductility capacity no longer exists. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此耐久設計（保護層厚度、混凝土品質、裂縫控制、表面保護）在塑鉸區不只是延壽問題，而是維持耐震性能的必要條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Durability design (cover, concrete quality, crack control and surface protection) in the hinge zone is therefore not just about service life but a prerequisite for keeping seismic performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「耐震與耐久是兩個獨立問題，腐蝕不會影響橋墩的耐震能力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Seismic and durability performance are separate issues; corrosion does not affect a pier's seismic capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「塑鉸區的耐久性與箍筋腐蝕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Durability of the hinge zone and hoop corrosion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 河川或沿海橋墩柱底保護層被沖刷磨耗、箍筋鏽斷，平時外觀只是局部剝落，地震時塑鉸區卻提早剪力破壞或主筋挫屈，原本設計的韌性容量已不存在。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
混凝土剪力強度是固定值，不會因柱子的彎曲變形而改變。
optionsEn: At river or coastal piers, abraded cover and corroded-through hoops at the column base look like minor spalling in service, yet in an earthquake the hinge zone fails early in shear or by bar buckling, because the designed ductility capacity no longer exists.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The concrete shear strength is a fixed value that does not change with column flexural deformation.

quiz.explanationEn: At river or coastal piers, abraded cover and corroded-through hoops at the column base look like minor spalling in service, yet in an earthquake the hinge zone fails early in shear or by bar buckling, because the designed ductility capacity no longer exists. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 既有橋墩評估與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Assessing existing piers and engineering handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「剪力隨韌性退化」如何影響橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shear degradation with ductility” governs force, deformation or durability in “Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 依舊規範設計的橋墩常見三種韌性缺陷：圍束箍筋太少、柱底主筋搭接、以及剪力強度不足。混凝土提供的剪力強度會隨塑鉸轉動而退化，因為斜裂縫張開、骨材互鎖減弱，所以即使柱在小變形時剪力足夠，進入韌性範圍後也可能剪斷，短柱尤其危險。評估流程是先求彎曲容量對應的剪力需求，再與隨韌性退化的剪力容量比較，判斷破壞模式；結果決定是否需要鋼板包覆或纖維複材補強，並寫入交接與維護文件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「剪力隨韌性退化」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Piers designed to older codes commonly show three ductility deficiencies: too little confinement, lap splices at the column base and inadequate shear strength. The concrete contribution to shear degrades as the hinge rotates, because diagonal cracks open and aggregate interlock weakens, so a column with adequate shear at small deformation can fail in shear once it enters the ductile range, short columns especially. Assessment first finds the shear demand corresponding to flexural capacity, then compares it with shear capacity degrading with ductility to identify the failure mode; the result decides whether steel or fibre-reinforced-polymer jacketing is needed and is written into handover and maintenance records. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shear degradation with ductility” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: V_c = k·√f′_c·A_e with f′_c = 30 MPa and A_e = 0.8×π×1.0² ≈ 2.51 m²: k = 0.29 for μ ≤ 2 gives V_c ≈ 3.99 MN; k = 0.10 at μ = 4 gives V_c ≈ 1.38 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土剪力強度是固定值，不會因柱子的彎曲變形而改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The concrete shear strength is a fixed value that does not change with column flexural deformation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「剪力隨韌性退化」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shear degradation with ductility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 既有橋墩評估與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Assessing existing piers and engineering handover
knowledge.text: 依舊規範設計的橋墩常見三種韌性缺陷：圍束箍筋太少、柱底主筋搭接、以及剪力強度不足。混凝土提供的剪力強度會隨塑鉸轉動而退化，因為斜裂縫張開、骨材互鎖減弱，所以即使柱在小變形時剪力足夠，進入韌性範圍後也可能剪斷，短柱尤其危險。
knowledge.textEn: Piers designed to older codes commonly show three ductility deficiencies: too little confinement, lap splices at the column base and inadequate shear strength. The concrete contribution to shear degrades as the hinge rotates, because diagonal cracks open and aggregate interlock weakens, so a column with adequate shear at small deformation can fail in shear once it enters the ductile range, short columns especially.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土剪力強度是固定值，不會因柱子的彎曲變形而改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The concrete shear strength is a fixed value that does not change with column flexural deformation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「既有橋墩評估與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Assessing existing piers and engineering handover" is correct?
options: 混凝土剪力強度是固定值，不會因柱子的彎曲變形而改變。
依舊規範設計的橋墩常見三種韌性缺陷：圍束箍筋太少、柱底主筋搭接、以及剪力強度不足。
橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。
optionsEn: The concrete shear strength is a fixed value that does not change with column flexural deformation.
Piers designed to older codes commonly show three ductility deficiencies: too little confinement, lap splices at the column base and inadequate shear strength.
The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety.
quiz.explanation: 依舊規範設計的橋墩常見三種韌性缺陷：圍束箍筋太少、柱底主筋搭接、以及剪力強度不足。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Piers designed to older codes commonly show three ductility deficiencies: too little confinement, lap splices at the column base and inadequate shear strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 既有橋墩評估與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Assessing existing piers and engineering handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剪力隨韌性退化」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shear degradation with ductility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：V_c = k·√f′_c·A_e，f′_c = 30 MPa、A_e = 0.8×π×1.0² ≈ 2.51 m²：μ ≤ 2 時 k = 0.29，V_c ≈ 3.99 MN；μ = 4 時 k = 0.10，V_c ≈ 1.38 MN。舊箍筋 13 mm@300 mm 提供 V_s ≈ 0.64 MN，合計 2.02 MN；6 m 短柱 V_o = 2.4 MN，判定韌性未達 4 即剪力破壞。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: V_c = k·√f′_c·A_e with f′_c = 30 MPa and A_e = 0.8×π×1.0² ≈ 2.51 m²: k = 0.29 for μ ≤ 2 gives V_c ≈ 3.99 MN; k = 0.10 at μ = 4 gives V_c ≈ 1.38 MN. Old 13 mm hoops at 300 mm add V_s ≈ 0.64 MN, 2.02 MN in total; a 6 m short column with V_o = 2.4 MN fails in shear before reaching μ = 4. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以竣工圖與現地取樣（鑽心強度、鋼筋掃描、局部打除確認箍筋與搭接）建立既有橋墩模型，進行推覆分析並同時繪出剪力需求與剪力容量隨位移的曲線，交點即破壞模式判斷依據；評估結果須經第二位工程師複核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the existing-pier model from as-built drawings and site sampling (core strengths, rebar scanning, local breakouts to confirm hoops and splices), run a pushover and plot shear demand and degrading shear capacity against displacement, using their intersection to identify the failure mode; a second engineer checks the assessment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: V_c = k·√f′_c·A_e，f′_c = 30 MPa、A_e = 0.8×π×1.0² ≈ 2.51 m²：μ ≤ 2 時 k = 0.29，V_c ≈ 3.99 MN；μ = 4 時 k = 0.10，V_c ≈ 1.38 MN。舊箍筋 13 mm@300 mm 提供 V_s ≈ 0.64 MN，合計 2.02 MN；6 m 短柱 V_o = 2.4 MN，判定韌性未達 4 即剪力破壞。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: V_c = k·√f′_c·A_e with f′_c = 30 MPa and A_e = 0.8×π×1.0² ≈ 2.51 m²: k = 0.29 for μ ≤ 2 gives V_c ≈ 3.99 MN; k = 0.10 at μ = 4 gives V_c ≈ 1.38 MN. Old 13 mm hoops at 300 mm add V_s ≈ 0.64 MN, 2.02 MN in total; a 6 m short column with V_o = 2.4 MN fails in shear before reaching μ = 4. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「既有橋墩評估與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Assessing existing piers and engineering handover", which statement holds?
options: 箍筋主要是用來固定主筋位置，對耐震性能影響不大。
箍筋間距差幾公分不影響結構安全，可以依現場方便調整。
optionsEn: Hoops mainly hold the longitudinal bars in place and matter little for seismic performance.
A few centimetres of extra hoop spacing do not affect safety and can be adjusted for site convenience.
V_c = k·√f′_c·A_e with f′_c = 30 MPa and A_e = 0.8×π×1.0² ≈ 2.51 m²: k = 0.29 for μ ≤ 2 gives V_c ≈ 3.99 MN; k = 0.10 at μ = 4 gives V_c ≈ 1.38 MN.
quiz.explanationEn: V_c = k·√f′_c·A_e with f′_c = 30 MPa and A_e = 0.8×π×1.0² ≈ 2.51 m²: k = 0.29 for μ ≤ 2 gives V_c ≈ 3.99 MN; k = 0.10 at μ = 4 gives V_c ≈ 1.38 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 既有橋墩評估與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Assessing existing piers and engineering handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剪力隨韌性退化」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shear degradation with ductility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以竣工圖與現地取樣（鑽心強度、鋼筋掃描、局部打除確認箍筋與搭接）建立既有橋墩模型，進行推覆分析並同時繪出剪力需求與剪力容量隨位移的曲線，交點即破壞模式判斷依據；評估結果須經第二位工程師複核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the existing-pier model from as-built drawings and site sampling (core strengths, rebar scanning, local breakouts to confirm hoops and splices), run a pushover and plot shear demand and degrading shear capacity against displacement, using their intersection to identify the failure mode; a second engineer checks the assessment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含每座排架的推覆曲線、破壞模式判斷、塑鉸區配筋竣工照片、續接器試驗報告與震後檢查門檻；既有橋墩評估若顯示剪力先於彎曲破壞，須排入補強計畫並經主管機關核定優先順序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover contains each bent's pushover curve, failure-mode determination, as-built photos of hinge-zone reinforcement, coupler test reports and post-earthquake thresholds; where assessment shows shear failure before flexure, the pier enters the retrofit programme with priority approved by the owner agency.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：評估若只用設計時的未退化剪力強度，會誤判舊橋墩為彎曲破壞而不需補強；1999 年 921 地震中台灣有約 102 座主要橋梁嚴重受損，提醒既有橋墩的韌性缺陷在強震前往往不被察覺。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using the undegraded shear strength misclassifies old piers as flexure-governed and not needing retrofit; in the 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake about 102 major bridges in Taiwan were badly damaged, a reminder that ductility deficiencies in existing piers often go unnoticed until a strong earthquake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「既有橋墩評估與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Assessing existing piers and engineering handover"?

steps.title: 既有橋墩評估與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Assessing existing piers and engineering handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剪力隨韌性退化」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shear degradation with ductility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 評估若只用設計時的未退化剪力強度，會誤判舊橋墩為彎曲破壞而不需補強；1999 年 921 地震中台灣有約 102 座主要橋梁嚴重受損，提醒既有橋墩的韌性缺陷在強震前往往不被察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using the undegraded shear strength misclassifies old piers as flexure-governed and not needing retrofit; in the 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake about 102 major bridges in Taiwan were badly damaged, a reminder that ductility deficiencies in existing piers often go unnoticed until a strong earthquake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：評估流程是先求彎曲容量對應的剪力需求，再與隨韌性退化的剪力容量比較，判斷破壞模式；結果決定是否需要鋼板包覆或纖維複材補強，並寫入交接與維護文件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assessment first finds the shear demand corresponding to flexural capacity, then compares it with shear capacity degrading with ductility to identify the failure mode; the result decides whether steel or fibre-reinforced-polymer jacketing is needed and is written into handover and maintenance records.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土剪力強度是固定值，不會因柱子的彎曲變形而改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The concrete shear strength is a fixed value that does not change with column flexural deformation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「既有橋墩評估與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Assessing existing piers and engineering handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
評估若只用設計時的未退化剪力強度，會誤判舊橋墩為彎曲破壞而不需補強。
橋墩越強越好，所有構件都加強就能確保耐震安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using the undegraded shear strength misclassifies old piers as flexure-governed and not needing retrofit.
The stronger the pier the better; strengthening every member guarantees seismic safety.
quiz.explanation: 評估若只用設計時的未退化剪力強度，會誤判舊橋墩為彎曲破壞而不需補強；1999 年 921 地震中台灣有約 102 座主要橋梁嚴重受損，提醒既有橋墩的韌性缺陷在強震前往往不被察覺。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the undegraded shear strength misclassifies old piers as flexure-governed and not needing retrofit; in the 1999 Chi-Chi earthquake about 102 major bridges in Taiwan were badly damaged, a reminder that ductility deficiencies in existing piers often go unnoticed until a strong earthquake. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 橋墩纖維複材耐震補強
titleEn: FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers
summary: 從舊橋墩的剪力、圍束與柱底搭接三種缺陷出發，說明纖維複材套管為何只沿環向布纖維、如何以側向圍束壓力與有效應變計算層數與剪力貢獻，再處理表面處理、露點與圓角、濕式積層、拉拔與脫層檢驗、補強前後反覆載重驗證、紫外線與撞擊耐久以及震後量測，並以賓州 I-84 跨越橋 1995 年的塑鉸區包覆與舊金山碼頭 250 支沉箱套管為例。
summaryEn: Starting from the three deficiencies of old piers — shear, confinement and base lap splices — explain why FRP jackets place fibres only in the hoop direction and how confining pressure and effective strain set ply count and shear contribution, then cover surface preparation, dew point and corner rounding, wet lay-up, pull-off and delamination checks, cyclic validation before and after retrofit, UV and impact durability and post-earthquake measurement, using the 1995 plastic-hinge wrapping of a Pennsylvania I-84 overpass and jackets on about 250 caissons of a San Francisco pier.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: an old circular column with D = 1.5 m and f′_c = 27.5 MPa has inadequate hoops, and pushover shows μ_c ≈ 1.5 against a demand μ_D ≈ 3.5. A carbon wet lay-up with E_f = 230 GPa, t_f = 0.165 mm per ply, ε*_fu = 0.017, exterior C_E = 0.85 and κ_ε = 0.55 gives ε_fe ≈ 0.0079. With 6 plies f_l = 2×230,000×6×0.165×0.0079/1,500 ≈ 2.41 MPa and f_l/f′_c ≈ 0.088, at least 0.08. Confined strength f′_cc = f′_c + 0.95×3.3×f_l ≈ 27.5 + 7.6 ≈ 35.1 MPa; ultimate strain ε_ccu = 0.002×[1.5 + 12×0.088×(0.0079/0.002)^0.45] ≈ 0.0069, about 2.3 times the unconfined 0.003. The shear contribution with a 0.004 strain limit and θ = 45° is V_j = (π/2)×6×0.165×230,000×0.004×1,500 ≈ 2.15 MN, about 1.82 MN after a 0.85 reduction. With only 4 plies f_l/f′_c ≈ 0.058, so no confinement gain may be counted, and the shear contribution falls to about 1.43 MN. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge or product.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略」與「補強目標與能力保護」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy" and "Retrofit targets and capacity protection": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「舊橋墩三種缺陷」如何影響橋墩纖維複材耐震補強的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three deficiencies of old piers” governs force, deformation or durability in “FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 1970 年代以前設計的橋墩，箍筋常為小直徑、大間距的開口箍，柱底主筋以短搭接接到基礎預留筋，剪力強度也只依彈性地震力計算。地震時這三種缺陷分別導致脆性剪力破壞、保護層剝落後核心壓碎與主筋挫屈，以及柱底搭接滑脫。纖維複材套管的策略是在柱外包覆以環向為主的纖維，像額外的箍筋一樣抑制斜裂縫張開、圍束核心混凝土並夾緊搭接段，而不增加縱向彎矩強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「舊橋墩三種缺陷」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Piers designed before the 1970s often have small, widely spaced open hoops, column bars lapped onto short footing starter bars at the base, and shear strength sized only for elastic seismic forces. In an earthquake these three deficiencies lead respectively to brittle shear failure, core crushing and bar buckling after cover spalling, and slip of the base lap splice. The FRP jacket strategy wraps the column with mainly hoop-direction fibres that act like extra hoops, restraining diagonal crack opening, confining the core and clamping the splice zone, without adding longitudinal flexural strength. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Three deficiencies of old piers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：既有柱推覆分析：降伏位移 Δ_y = 0.08 m，因剪力破壞在 Δ = 0.12 m 時強度驟降，位移韌性容量 μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5；設計位移需求 Δ_D = 0.28 m，μ_D = 3.5，需求為容量的 2.3 倍，判定需補強。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pushover of an existing column: yield displacement Δ_y = 0.08 m, with shear failure dropping strength at Δ = 0.12 m, so displacement ductility capacity μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5; a design demand Δ_D = 0.28 m means μ_D = 3.5, 2.3 times capacity, so retrofit is required.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把橋墩包上碳纖維，就能解決所有耐震問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Wrapping a pier in carbon fibre solves all of its seismic problems." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「舊橋墩三種缺陷」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Three deficiencies of old piers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy
knowledge.text: 1970 年代以前設計的橋墩，箍筋常為小直徑、大間距的開口箍，柱底主筋以短搭接接到基礎預留筋，剪力強度也只依彈性地震力計算。地震時這三種缺陷分別導致脆性剪力破壞、保護層剝落後核心壓碎與主筋挫屈，以及柱底搭接滑脫。
knowledge.textEn: Piers designed before the 1970s often have small, widely spaced open hoops, column bars lapped onto short footing starter bars at the base, and shear strength sized only for elastic seismic forces. In an earthquake these three deficiencies lead respectively to brittle shear failure, core crushing and bar buckling after cover spalling, and slip of the base lap splice.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把橋墩包上碳纖維，就能解決所有耐震問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Wrapping a pier in carbon fibre solves all of its seismic problems. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy" is correct?
options: 只要把橋墩包上碳纖維，就能解決所有耐震問題。
1970 年代以前設計的橋墩，箍筋常為小直徑、大間距的開口箍，柱底主筋以短搭接接到基礎預留筋，剪力強度也只依彈性地震力計算。
補強後橋墩越強越好，連基礎與帽梁的受力都不用重新檢查。
optionsEn: Wrapping a pier in carbon fibre solves all of its seismic problems.
Piers designed before the 1970s often have small, widely spaced open hoops, column bars lapped onto short footing starter bars at the base, and shear strength sized only for elastic seismic forces.
After retrofit the stronger the pier the better, with no need to recheck footing and cap-beam forces.
quiz.explanation: 1970 年代以前設計的橋墩，箍筋常為小直徑、大間距的開口箍，柱底主筋以短搭接接到基礎預留筋，剪力強度也只依彈性地震力計算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Piers designed before the 1970s often have small, widely spaced open hoops, column bars lapped onto short footing starter bars at the base, and shear strength sized only for elastic seismic forces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「舊橋墩三種缺陷」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three deficiencies of old piers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：既有柱推覆分析：降伏位移 Δ_y = 0.08 m，因剪力破壞在 Δ = 0.12 m 時強度驟降，位移韌性容量 μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5；設計位移需求 Δ_D = 0.28 m，μ_D = 3.5，需求為容量的 2.3 倍，判定需補強。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pushover of an existing column: yield displacement Δ_y = 0.08 m, with shear failure dropping strength at Δ = 0.12 m, so displacement ductility capacity μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5; a design demand Δ_D = 0.28 m means μ_D = 3.5, 2.3 times capacity, so retrofit is required. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以竣工圖、現地鋼筋掃描與局部打除確認箍筋直徑、間距、彎鉤型式與柱底搭接長度，再以推覆分析同時繪出彎曲與剪力容量曲線，判斷控制的破壞模式；補強需求須針對各缺陷分開計算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm hoop size, spacing, hook type and base splice length from as-built drawings, site rebar scanning and local breakouts, then run a pushover with both flexural and shear capacity curves to identify the governing failure mode; compute retrofit needs separately for each deficiency.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 既有柱推覆分析：降伏位移 Δ_y = 0.08 m，因剪力破壞在 Δ = 0.12 m 時強度驟降，位移韌性容量 μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5；設計位移需求 Δ_D = 0.28 m，μ_D = 3.5，需求為容量的 2.3 倍，判定需補強。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Pushover of an existing column: yield displacement Δ_y = 0.08 m, with shear failure dropping strength at Δ = 0.12 m, so displacement ductility capacity μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5; a design demand Δ_D = 0.28 m means μ_D = 3.5, 2.3 times capacity, so retrofit is required. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy", which statement holds?
options: 纖維層數加倍，圍束與剪力效果一定也加倍，且不受柱徑影響。
只要總層數正確，搭接位置與纖維方向並不重要。
既有柱推覆分析：降伏位移 Δ_y = 0.08 m，因剪力破壞在 Δ = 0.12 m 時強度驟降，位移韌性容量 μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5。
optionsEn: Doubling the plies always doubles confinement and shear benefit, regardless of column diameter.
As long as the total ply count is right, overlap location and fibre direction do not matter.
Pushover of an existing column: yield displacement Δ_y = 0.08 m, with shear failure dropping strength at Δ = 0.12 m, so displacement ductility capacity μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5.
quiz.explanation: 既有柱推覆分析：降伏位移 Δ_y = 0.08 m，因剪力破壞在 Δ = 0.12 m 時強度驟降，位移韌性容量 μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5；設計位移需求 Δ_D = 0.28 m，μ_D = 3.5，需求為容量的 2.3 倍，判定需補強。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Pushover of an existing column: yield displacement Δ_y = 0.08 m, with shear failure dropping strength at Δ = 0.12 m, so displacement ductility capacity μ_c = 0.12/0.08 = 1.5; a design demand Δ_D = 0.28 m means μ_D = 3.5, 2.3 times capacity, so retrofit is required. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「舊橋墩三種缺陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Three deficiencies of old piers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以竣工圖、現地鋼筋掃描與局部打除確認箍筋直徑、間距、彎鉤型式與柱底搭接長度，再以推覆分析同時繪出彎曲與剪力容量曲線，判斷控制的破壞模式；補強需求須針對各缺陷分開計算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm hoop size, spacing, hook type and base splice length from as-built drawings, site rebar scanning and local breakouts, then run a pushover with both flexural and shear capacity curves to identify the governing failure mode; compute retrofit needs separately for each deficiency. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：補強設計報告須列出每一座橋墩的缺陷類型、控制破壞模式、補強目標（剪力、圍束、搭接夾持）與未處理的其他弱點，並由審查工程師確認補強範圍與優先順序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The retrofit design report lists, for each pier, the deficiency type, governing failure mode, retrofit target (shear, confinement or splice clamping) and any other weaknesses left untreated, with the checking engineer confirming scope and priority.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只看到柱身裂縫就全面包覆而未判斷缺陷類型，可能把纖維用在不需要的位置，而真正的弱點（例如帽梁接頭或基礎）仍未處理；包覆後外觀完整，反而讓管理單位誤以為橋墩已符合耐震要求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wrapping every cracked column without identifying the deficiency type can put fibres where they are not needed while the real weakness, such as the cap-beam joint or footing, remains untreated; the intact appearance after wrapping can then mislead the owner into believing the pier now meets seismic requirements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以竣工圖、現地鋼筋掃描與局部打除確認箍筋直徑、間距、彎鉤型式與柱底搭接長度，再以推覆分析同時繪出彎曲與剪力容量曲線，判斷控制的破壞模式；補強需求須針對各缺陷分開計算。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm hoop size, spacing, hook type and base splice length from as-built drawings, site rebar scanning and local breakouts, then run a pushover with both flexural and shear capacity curves to identify the governing failure mode; compute retrofit needs separately for each deficiency.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 補強設計報告須列出每一座橋墩的缺陷類型、控制破壞模式、補強目標（剪力、圍束、搭接夾持）與未處理的其他弱點，並由審查工程師確認補強範圍與優先順序。
knowledge.textEn: The retrofit design report lists, for each pier, the deficiency type, governing failure mode, retrofit target (shear, confinement or splice clamping) and any other weaknesses left untreated, with the checking engineer confirming scope and priority.

quiz.question: 要驗證「舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy"?
options: 以竣工圖、現地鋼筋掃描與局部打除確認箍筋直徑、間距、彎鉤型式與柱底搭接長度，再以推覆分析同時繪出彎曲與剪力容量曲線，判斷控制的破壞模式。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要有一篇試驗證明碳纖維有效，任何橋柱都能直接套用同一設計。
optionsEn: Confirm hoop size, spacing, hook type and base splice length from as-built drawings, site rebar scanning and local breakouts, then run a pushover with both flexural and shear capacity curves to identify the governing failure mode.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One test showing carbon fibre works means any column can use the same design.
quiz.explanation: 以竣工圖、現地鋼筋掃描與局部打除確認箍筋直徑、間距、彎鉤型式與柱底搭接長度，再以推覆分析同時繪出彎曲與剪力容量曲線，判斷控制的破壞模式；補強需求須針對各缺陷分開計算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm hoop size, spacing, hook type and base splice length from as-built drawings, site rebar scanning and local breakouts, then run a pushover with both flexural and shear capacity curves to identify the governing failure mode; compute retrofit needs separately for each deficiency. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「舊橋墩三種缺陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Three deficiencies of old piers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只看到柱身裂縫就全面包覆而未判斷缺陷類型，可能把纖維用在不需要的位置，而真正的弱點（例如帽梁接頭或基礎）仍未處理；包覆後外觀完整，反而讓管理單位誤以為橋墩已符合耐震要求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wrapping every cracked column without identifying the deficiency type can put fibres where they are not needed while the real weakness, such as the cap-beam joint or footing, remains untreated; the intact appearance after wrapping can then mislead the owner into believing the pier now meets seismic requirements. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：纖維複材套管的策略是在柱外包覆以環向為主的纖維，像額外的箍筋一樣抑制斜裂縫張開、圍束核心混凝土並夾緊搭接段，而不增加縱向彎矩強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The FRP jacket strategy wraps the column with mainly hoop-direction fibres that act like extra hoops, restraining diagonal crack opening, confining the core and clamping the splice zone, without adding longitudinal flexural strength.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把橋墩包上碳纖維，就能解決所有耐震問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Wrapping a pier in carbon fibre solves all of its seismic problems." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只看到柱身裂縫就全面包覆而未判斷缺陷類型，可能把纖維用在不需要的位置，而真正的弱點（例如帽梁接頭或基礎）仍未處理；包覆後外觀完整，反而讓管理單位誤以為橋墩已符合耐震要求。
knowledge.textEn: Wrapping every cracked column without identifying the deficiency type can put fibres where they are not needed while the real weakness, such as the cap-beam joint or footing, remains untreated; the intact appearance after wrapping can then mislead the owner into believing the pier now meets seismic requirements.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「舊橋墩的耐震缺陷與補強策略」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seismic deficiencies of old piers and retrofit strategy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只看到柱身裂縫就全面包覆而未判斷缺陷類型，可能把纖維用在不需要的位置，而真正的弱點（例如帽梁接頭或基礎）仍未處理。
補強後橋墩越強越好，連基礎與帽梁的受力都不用重新檢查。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Wrapping every cracked column without identifying the deficiency type can put fibres where they are not needed while the real weakness, such as the cap-beam joint or footing, remains untreated.
After retrofit the stronger the pier the better, with no need to recheck footing and cap-beam forces.
quiz.explanation: 若只看到柱身裂縫就全面包覆而未判斷缺陷類型，可能把纖維用在不需要的位置，而真正的弱點（例如帽梁接頭或基礎）仍未處理；包覆後外觀完整，反而讓管理單位誤以為橋墩已符合耐震要求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Wrapping every cracked column without identifying the deficiency type can put fibres where they are not needed while the real weakness, such as the cap-beam joint or footing, remains untreated; the intact appearance after wrapping can then mislead the owner into believing the pier now meets seismic requirements. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 補強目標與能力保護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Retrofit targets and capacity protection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「套管端部間隙」如何影響橋墩纖維複材耐震補強的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jacket end gap” governs force, deformation or durability in “FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 補強的目的是讓塑鉸能在柱端形成並延展，而不是把柱變得更強：若套管增加了柱的彎矩強度，地震時傳到基礎、帽梁與樁的力隨之增加，原本沒有問題的構件可能變成新的弱點。因此纖維主要沿環向布置，套管兩端通常與基礎頂面及帽梁底面留一小段間隙，避免套管直接承壓而增加斷面抗彎。圍束後的核心混凝土強度提高會讓塑性彎矩小幅上升，設計者必須以補強後的超強度彎矩重新檢核能力保護構件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「套管端部間隙」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The goal of retrofit is to let the plastic hinge form and deform at the column end, not to make the column stronger: if the jacket increases flexural strength, the forces delivered to footing, cap beam and piles rise in an earthquake and members that were adequate can become new weak links. Fibres are therefore placed mainly in the hoop direction, and the jacket usually stops a small gap short of the footing top and cap-beam soffit so it does not bear directly and add flexural capacity. Confined core concrete still raises the plastic moment slightly, so the designer must recheck capacity-protected members with the retrofitted overstrength moment. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Jacket end gap” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：既有柱 M_p = 10 MN·m，圍束後核心強度提高使 M_p 增為約 11 MN·m（+10%）；超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The existing column has M_p = 10 MN·m; core confinement raises it to about 11 MN·m (+10%), so M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「補強後橋墩越強越好，連基礎與帽梁的受力都不用重新檢查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After retrofit the stronger the pier the better, with no need to recheck footing and cap-beam forces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「套管端部間隙」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Jacket end gap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 補強目標與能力保護
knowledge.text: 補強的目的是讓塑鉸能在柱端形成並延展，而不是把柱變得更強：若套管增加了柱的彎矩強度，地震時傳到基礎、帽梁與樁的力隨之增加，原本沒有問題的構件可能變成新的弱點。因此纖維主要沿環向布置，套管兩端通常與基礎頂面及帽梁底面留一小段間隙，避免套管直接承壓而增加斷面抗彎。
knowledge.textEn: The goal of retrofit is to let the plastic hinge form and deform at the column end, not to make the column stronger: if the jacket increases flexural strength, the forces delivered to footing, cap beam and piles rise in an earthquake and members that were adequate can become new weak links. Fibres are therefore placed mainly in the hoop direction, and the jacket usually stops a small gap short of the footing top and cap-beam soffit so it does not bear directly and add flexural capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：補強後橋墩越強越好，連基礎與帽梁的受力都不用重新檢查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: After retrofit the stronger the pier the better, with no need to recheck footing and cap-beam forces. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「補強目標與能力保護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Retrofit targets and capacity protection" is correct?
options: 補強後橋墩越強越好，連基礎與帽梁的受力都不用重新檢查。
碳纖維強度是鋼材的數倍，所以用一層就能取代大量箍筋。
補強的目的是讓塑鉸能在柱端形成並延展，而不是把柱變得更強：若套管增加了柱的彎矩強度，地震時傳到基礎、帽梁與樁的力隨之增加，原本沒有問題的構件可能變成新的弱點。
optionsEn: After retrofit the stronger the pier the better, with no need to recheck footing and cap-beam forces.
Carbon fibre is several times stronger than steel, so one ply can replace a large amount of hoop steel.

The goal of retrofit is to let the plastic hinge form and deform at the column end, not to make the column stronger: if the jacket increases flexural strength, the forces delivered to footing, cap beam and piles rise in an earthquake and members that were adequate can become new weak links.
quiz.explanation: 補強的目的是讓塑鉸能在柱端形成並延展，而不是把柱變得更強：若套管增加了柱的彎矩強度，地震時傳到基礎、帽梁與樁的力隨之增加，原本沒有問題的構件可能變成新的弱點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The goal of retrofit is to let the plastic hinge form and deform at the column end, not to make the column stronger: if the jacket increases flexural strength, the forces delivered to footing, cap beam and piles rise in an earthquake and members that were adequate can become new weak links. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 補強目標與能力保護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Retrofit targets and capacity protection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「套管端部間隙」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Jacket end gap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：既有柱 M_p = 10 MN·m，圍束後核心強度提高使 M_p 增為約 11 MN·m（+10%）；超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m。基礎抗彎容量 14 MN·m，比值 14/13.2 ≈ 1.06，仍可保護；若誤把縱向纖維錨入基礎使 M_p 增為 13 MN·m，M_o = 15.6 MN·m，基礎不足。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The existing column has M_p = 10 MN·m; core confinement raises it to about 11 MN·m (+10%), so M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m. A footing flexural capacity of 14 MN·m gives 14/13.2 ≈ 1.06, still protected; wrongly anchoring longitudinal fibres into the footing to give M_p = 13 MN·m makes M_o = 15.6 MN·m and the footing inadequate. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以圍束混凝土模型重算補強後的彎矩—曲率關係，取得新的 M_p 與 M_o，逐一核對基礎、樁、帽梁與接頭；圖面須標示纖維方向、層數、包覆範圍與端部間隙，現場量測間隙是否保留。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recompute the moment–curvature relation with a confined-concrete model to obtain the new M_p and M_o and check footing, piles, cap beam and joints one by one; drawings show fibre direction, ply count, wrap extent and end gaps, and the gaps are measured on site.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 既有柱 M_p = 10 MN·m，圍束後核心強度提高使 M_p 增為約 11 MN·m（+10%）；超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m。基礎抗彎容量 14 MN·m，比值 14/13.2 ≈ 1.06，仍可保護；若誤把縱向纖維錨入基礎使 M_p 增為 13 MN·m，M_o = 15.6 MN·m，基礎不足。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The existing column has M_p = 10 MN·m; core confinement raises it to about 11 MN·m (+10%), so M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m. A footing flexural capacity of 14 MN·m gives 14/13.2 ≈ 1.06, still protected; wrongly anchoring longitudinal fibres into the footing to give M_p = 13 MN·m makes M_o = 15.6 MN·m and the footing inadequate. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「補強目標與能力保護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Retrofit targets and capacity protection", which statement holds?
options: 既有柱 M_p = 10 MN·m，圍束後核心強度提高使 M_p 增為約 11 MN·m（+10%）。
樹脂可以在任何天氣下施作，只要多塗一層就能彌補潮濕。
纖維套管外觀平整沒有氣泡，就表示黏結良好。
optionsEn: The existing column has M_p = 10 MN·m; core confinement raises it to about 11 MN·m (+10%), so M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m.
Resin can be applied in any weather; an extra coat makes up for dampness.
If the jacket looks smooth with no bubbles, the bond must be good.
quiz.explanation: 既有柱 M_p = 10 MN·m，圍束後核心強度提高使 M_p 增為約 11 MN·m（+10%）；超強度彎矩 M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The existing column has M_p = 10 MN·m; core confinement raises it to about 11 MN·m (+10%), so M_o = 1.2×11 = 13.2 MN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 補強目標與能力保護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Retrofit targets and capacity protection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「套管端部間隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Jacket end gap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以圍束混凝土模型重算補強後的彎矩—曲率關係，取得新的 M_p 與 M_o，逐一核對基礎、樁、帽梁與接頭；圖面須標示纖維方向、層數、包覆範圍與端部間隙，現場量測間隙是否保留。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute the moment–curvature relation with a confined-concrete model to obtain the new M_p and M_o and check footing, piles, cap beam and joints one by one; drawings show fibre direction, ply count, wrap extent and end gaps, and the gaps are measured on site. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：補強計算書要包含補強前後 M_p、M_o 的對照與能力保護檢核；施工規範明定端部間隙尺寸，施工期間不得以砂漿或樹脂填滿，並在竣工檢查中逐柱確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retrofit calculations compare M_p and M_o before and after and include capacity-protection checks; the specification fixes the end-gap size, which must not be filled with mortar or resin during construction and is confirmed column by column at final inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：套管一路包到基礎頂面並以樹脂灌滿間隙，柱底在地震中形同加大斷面，塑鉸被迫轉移到套管以上未補強的區段，或把超額彎矩推進基礎，造成基礎剪力或樁頭破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wrapping down onto the footing and filling the gap with resin makes the column base act as an enlarged section in an earthquake, forcing the hinge up into the unwrapped region above the jacket or pushing excess moment into the foundation, causing footing shear or pile-head failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以圍束混凝土模型重算補強後的彎矩—曲率關係，取得新的 M_p 與 M_o，逐一核對基礎、樁、帽梁與接頭；圖面須標示纖維方向、層數、包覆範圍與端部間隙，現場量測間隙是否保留。
knowledge.textEn: Recompute the moment–curvature relation with a confined-concrete model to obtain the new M_p and M_o and check footing, piles, cap beam and joints one by one; drawings show fibre direction, ply count, wrap extent and end gaps, and the gaps are measured on site.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 補強計算書要包含補強前後 M_p、M_o 的對照與能力保護檢核；施工規範明定端部間隙尺寸，施工期間不得以砂漿或樹脂填滿，並在竣工檢查中逐柱確認。
knowledge.textEn: Retrofit calculations compare M_p and M_o before and after and include capacity-protection checks; the specification fixes the end-gap size, which must not be filled with mortar or resin during construction and is confirmed column by column at final inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「補強目標與能力保護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Retrofit targets and capacity protection"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以圍束混凝土模型重算補強後的彎矩—曲率關係，取得新的 M_p 與 M_o，逐一核對基礎、樁、帽梁與接頭。
纖維複材不會生鏽，因此包覆後的橋墩不需要任何維護。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Recompute the moment–curvature relation with a confined-concrete model to obtain the new M_p and M_o and check footing, piles, cap beam and joints one by one.
FRP does not rust, so a wrapped pier needs no maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 以圍束混凝土模型重算補強後的彎矩—曲率關係，取得新的 M_p 與 M_o，逐一核對基礎、樁、帽梁與接頭；圖面須標示纖維方向、層數、包覆範圍與端部間隙，現場量測間隙是否保留。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recompute the moment–curvature relation with a confined-concrete model to obtain the new M_p and M_o and check footing, piles, cap beam and joints one by one; drawings show fibre direction, ply count, wrap extent and end gaps, and the gaps are measured on site. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 補強目標與能力保護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Retrofit targets and capacity protection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「套管端部間隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Jacket end gap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 套管一路包到基礎頂面並以樹脂灌滿間隙，柱底在地震中形同加大斷面，塑鉸被迫轉移到套管以上未補強的區段，或把超額彎矩推進基礎，造成基礎剪力或樁頭破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wrapping down onto the footing and filling the gap with resin makes the column base act as an enlarged section in an earthquake, forcing the hinge up into the unwrapped region above the jacket or pushing excess moment into the foundation, causing footing shear or pile-head failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圍束後的核心混凝土強度提高會讓塑性彎矩小幅上升，設計者必須以補強後的超強度彎矩重新檢核能力保護構件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Confined core concrete still raises the plastic moment slightly, so the designer must recheck capacity-protected members with the retrofitted overstrength moment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「補強後橋墩越強越好，連基礎與帽梁的受力都不用重新檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After retrofit the stronger the pier the better, with no need to recheck footing and cap-beam forces." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 套管一路包到基礎頂面並以樹脂灌滿間隙，柱底在地震中形同加大斷面，塑鉸被迫轉移到套管以上未補強的區段，或把超額彎矩推進基礎，造成基礎剪力或樁頭破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Wrapping down onto the footing and filling the gap with resin makes the column base act as an enlarged section in an earthquake, forcing the hinge up into the unwrapped region above the jacket or pushing excess moment into the foundation, causing footing shear or pile-head failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「補強目標與能力保護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Retrofit targets and capacity protection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
碳纖維強度是鋼材的數倍，所以用一層就能取代大量箍筋。
套管一路包到基礎頂面並以樹脂灌滿間隙，柱底在地震中形同加大斷面，塑鉸被迫轉移到套管以上未補強的區段，或把超額彎矩推進基礎，造成基礎剪力或樁頭破壞。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Carbon fibre is several times stronger than steel, so one ply can replace a large amount of hoop steel.

Wrapping down onto the footing and filling the gap with resin makes the column base act as an enlarged section in an earthquake, forcing the hinge up into the unwrapped region above the jacket or pushing excess moment into the foundation, causing footing shear or pile-head failure.
quiz.explanation: 套管一路包到基礎頂面並以樹脂灌滿間隙，柱底在地震中形同加大斷面，塑鉸被迫轉移到套管以上未補強的區段，或把超額彎矩推進基礎，造成基礎剪力或樁頭破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Wrapping down onto the footing and filling the gap with resin makes the column base act as an enlarged section in an earthquake, forcing the hinge up into the unwrapped region above the jacket or pushing excess moment into the foundation, causing footing shear or pile-head failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「纖維複材材料與有效應變」與「圍束壓力、層數與剪力貢獻」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "FRP materials and effective strain" and "Confining pressure, ply count and shear contribution": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 纖維複材材料與有效應變：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: FRP materials and effective strain: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「纖維有效應變 ε_fe」如何影響橋墩纖維複材耐震補強的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective fibre strain ε_fe” governs force, deformation or durability in “FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋墩補強常用碳纖維或玻璃纖維織物，以環氧樹脂含浸後積層，或採工廠預製殼片。纖維在破斷前近乎線彈性、沒有降伏平台，因此設計不以強度而以「有效應變」控制：實際套管在圓角、搭接與混凝土不均勻膨脹處會提早破斷，所以只取材料破斷應變的一部分。長期環境（濕熱、鹼性、紫外線）又會降低性能，玻璃纖維對鹼與濕氣較敏感，故設計值要再乘以環境折減係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「纖維有效應變 ε_fe」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pier retrofits commonly use carbon or glass fabrics saturated with epoxy and laminated, or factory-made prefabricated shells. The fibres are nearly linear-elastic to rupture with no yield plateau, so design is controlled by effective strain rather than strength: real jackets rupture early at corners, overlaps and where the concrete dilates unevenly, so only part of the material's rupture strain is used. Long-term environment (moisture, heat, alkalinity and UV) also reduces performance, and glass fibre is more sensitive to alkali and moisture, so design values are multiplied by an environmental reduction factor.
