Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基礎型式與沖刷後的結構後果：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Foundation type and structural consequences of scour: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基礎暴露與樁側支撐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Foundation exposure and pile support” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 擴展基礎淘空時，橋墩可能在洪峰中毫無徵兆地沉陷，Schoharie 溪橋的上部結構隨墩下落，後續又因殘骸阻塞河道使相鄰墩流速升高；樁基裸露過長則在水流與漂流木撞擊下彎曲破壞或整體傾斜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An undermined spread footing can drop without warning at the flood peak; at Schoharie Creek the superstructure fell with the pier, and wreckage partly blocking the river may have raised velocities at the adjacent pier. Overexposed piles bend to failure or tilt as a group under flow and debris impact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：1987 年紐約州高速公路 Schoharie 溪橋就是三號墩擴展基礎被淘空掉入沖刷坑而崩塌，造成 10 人死亡；調查也指出拋石過輕且保護、檢查與維護不足。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The 1987 Schoharie Creek Bridge collapse on the New York State Thruway began when pier 3, on an undermined spread footing, dropped into a scour hole, killing 10 people; investigators also found the riprap too light and protection, inspection and maintenance inadequate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要是樁基礎，沖刷再深也不會有問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a pier stands on piles, scour depth does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 擴展基礎淘空時，橋墩可能在洪峰中毫無徵兆地沉陷，Schoharie 溪橋的上部結構隨墩下落，後續又因殘骸阻塞河道使相鄰墩流速升高；樁基裸露過長則在水流與漂流木撞擊下彎曲破壞或整體傾斜。
knowledge.textEn: An undermined spread footing can drop without warning at the flood peak; at Schoharie Creek the superstructure fell with the pier, and wreckage partly blocking the river may have raised velocities at the adjacent pier. Overexposed piles bend to failure or tilt as a group under flow and debris impact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基礎型式與沖刷後的結構後果」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Foundation type and structural consequences of scour" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 擴展基礎淘空時，橋墩可能在洪峰中毫無徵兆地沉陷，Schoharie 溪橋的上部結構隨墩下落，後續又因殘骸阻塞河道使相鄰墩流速升高。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
在橋墩旁傾倒大量石塊，就能永久防止沖刷。
optionsEn: An undermined spread footing can drop without warning at the flood peak.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Dumping plenty of rock beside a pier prevents scour permanently.
quiz.explanation: 擴展基礎淘空時，橋墩可能在洪峰中毫無徵兆地沉陷，Schoharie 溪橋的上部結構隨墩下落，後續又因殘骸阻塞河道使相鄰墩流速升高；樁基裸露過長則在水流與漂流木撞擊下彎曲破壞或整體傾斜。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An undermined spread footing can drop without warning at the flood peak; at Schoharie Creek the superstructure fell with the pier, and wreckage partly blocking the river may have raised velocities at the adjacent pier. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 沖刷保護工與河床穩定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Scour countermeasures and bed stabilisation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「拋石 D50 與護坦範圍」如何影響橋梁基礎沖刷監測的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Riprap D50 and apron extent” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge-foundation scour monitoring”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 沖刷保護分為水理與結構兩類：拋石、混凝土塊、蛇籠或袋裝混凝土在墩周形成抗沖護坦，下方需要濾層或土工織物防止細料被吸出；河床保護工（固床工、潛壩）則穩定整段河床、防止長期降低。拋石大小取決於局部流速的平方，墩前流速受加速影響必須放大；保護範圍要涵蓋墩寬的數倍，否則沖刷坑會從護坦邊緣向內侵蝕。固床工若在下游形成落差，又可能在其下方引發新的沖刷，后豐大橋的水躍即是例證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「拋石 D50 與護坦範圍」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Countermeasures are hydraulic or structural: riprap, concrete blocks, gabions or grout bags form an erosion-resistant apron around the pier, with a filter layer or geotextile beneath to stop fines being drawn out; bed-protection works such as check dams stabilise a reach and stop long-term degradation. Riprap size depends on the square of local velocity, which must be amplified for acceleration around the pier; the apron must extend several pier widths, or the scour hole eats inward from its edge. A bed-protection structure that creates a drop can trigger new scour below it, as the hydraulic jump at the Houfeng Bridge showed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Riprap D50 and apron extent” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：HEC-23 墩周拋石 D50 = 0.692·(K·V)²/((S_s − 1)·2g)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: HEC-23 pier riprap D50 = 0.692·(K·V)²/((S_s − 1)·2g).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「在橋墩旁傾倒大量石塊，就能永久防止沖刷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dumping plenty of rock beside a pier prevents scour permanently." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「拋石 D50 與護坦範圍」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Riprap D50 and apron extent”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沖刷保護工與河床穩定
knowledge.text: 沖刷保護分為水理與結構兩類：拋石、混凝土塊、蛇籠或袋裝混凝土在墩周形成抗沖護坦，下方需要濾層或土工織物防止細料被吸出；河床保護工（固床工、潛壩）則穩定整段河床、防止長期降低。拋石大小取決於局部流速的平方，墩前流速受加速影響必須放大；保護範圍要涵蓋墩寬的數倍，否則沖刷坑會從護坦邊緣向內侵蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Countermeasures are hydraulic or structural: riprap, concrete blocks, gabions or grout bags form an erosion-resistant apron around the pier, with a filter layer or geotextile beneath to stop fines being drawn out; bed-protection works such as check dams stabilise a reach and stop long-term degradation. Riprap size depends on the square of local velocity, which must be amplified for acceleration around the pier; the apron must extend several pier widths, or the scour hole eats inward from its edge.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：在橋墩旁傾倒大量石塊，就能永久防止沖刷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dumping plenty of rock beside a pier prevents scour permanently. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沖刷保護工與河床穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scour countermeasures and bed stabilisation" is correct?
options: 在橋墩旁傾倒大量石塊，就能永久防止沖刷。
沖刷保護分為水理與結構兩類：拋石、混凝土塊、蛇籠或袋裝混凝土在墩周形成抗沖護坦，下方需要濾層或土工織物防止細料被吸出。
裝了監測儀器的橋梁，就等於已經解決了沖刷問題。
optionsEn: Dumping plenty of rock beside a pier prevents scour permanently.

Countermeasures are hydraulic or structural: riprap, concrete blocks, gabions or grout bags form an erosion-resistant apron around the pier, with a filter layer or geotextile beneath to stop fines being drawn out.
Once a bridge has scour monitors, its scour problem is solved.
quiz.explanation: 沖刷保護分為水理與結構兩類：拋石、混凝土塊、蛇籠或袋裝混凝土在墩周形成抗沖護坦，下方需要濾層或土工織物防止細料被吸出；河床保護工（固床工、潛壩）則穩定整段河床、防止長期降低。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Countermeasures are hydraulic or structural: riprap, concrete blocks, gabions or grout bags form an erosion-resistant apron around the pier, with a filter layer or geotextile beneath to stop fines being drawn out; bed-protection works such as check dams stabilise a reach and stop long-term degradation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沖刷保護工與河床穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scour countermeasures and bed stabilisation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拋石 D50 與護坦範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Riprap D50 and apron extent” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：HEC-23 墩周拋石 D50 = 0.692·(K·V)²/((S_s − 1)·2g)。圓頭墩 K = 1.5、V = 4.0 m/s、S_s = 2.65：D50 = 0.692×36/(1.65×19.62) ≈ 0.77 m，單顆約 π/6×0.77³×2,650 ≈ 630 kg；若流速升為 5.0 m/s，D50 增為約 1.20 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: HEC-23 pier riprap D50 = 0.692·(K·V)²/((S_s − 1)·2g). For a round-nosed pier K = 1.5, V = 4.0 m/s and S_s = 2.65: D50 = 0.692×36/(1.65×19.62) ≈ 0.77 m, about π/6×0.77³×2,650 ≈ 630 kg per stone; at 5.0 m/s D50 rises to about 1.20 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工時抽查石塊尺寸與比重、級配、層厚與護坦平面範圍，確認濾層或土工織物鋪設連續且搭接足夠；完工後測量護坦頂高程作為基準，洪後重測比較，量測護坦沉陷或流失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During construction sample stone size, specific gravity, gradation, layer thickness and apron plan extent, confirming continuous filter or geotextile with adequate overlaps; after completion survey the apron top as a baseline and resurvey after floods to measure settlement or loss.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: HEC-23 pier riprap D50 = 0.692·(K·V)²/((S_s − 1)·2g). For a round-nosed pier K = 1.5, V = 4.0 m/s and S_s = 2.65: D50 = 0.692×36/(1.65×19.62) ≈ 0.77 m, about π/6×0.77³×2,650 ≈ 630 kg per stone; at 5.0 m/s D50 rises to about 1.20 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沖刷保護工與河床穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scour countermeasures and bed stabilisation", which statement holds?
options: 監測讀值沒有變化，就表示河床很穩定。
只要橋還站著，洪水期間就可以繼續開放通行。
optionsEn: If the monitored reading does not change, the bed is stable.
As long as the bridge is still standing, it can stay open during a flood.
HEC-23 pier riprap D50 = 0.692·(K·V)²/((S_s − 1)·2g).
quiz.explanation: HEC-23 墩周拋石 D50 = 0.692·(K·V)²/((S_s − 1)·2g)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: HEC-23 pier riprap D50 = 0.692·(K·V)²/((S_s − 1)·2g). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沖刷保護工與河床穩定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scour countermeasures and bed stabilisation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拋石 D50 與護坦範圍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Riprap D50 and apron extent” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工時抽查石塊尺寸與比重、級配、層厚與護坦平面範圍，確認濾層或土工織物鋪設連續且搭接足夠；完工後測量護坦頂高程作為基準，洪後重測比較，量測護坦沉陷或流失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During construction sample stone size, specific gravity, gradation, layer thickness and apron plan extent, confirming continuous filter or geotextile with adequate overlaps; after completion survey the apron top as a baseline and resurvey after floods to measure settlement or loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保護工設計要附上石塊尺寸、級配、厚度、濾層、平面範圍與預期壽命，並把洪後補充列入維護計畫；採用固床工時，同步評估下游落差可能引起的沖刷，並與水利主管機關協調。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Countermeasure design states stone size, gradation, thickness, filter, plan extent and expected life, with post-flood replenishment in the maintenance plan; when using bed-protection structures, assess scour from any downstream drop and coordinate with the water-resources authority.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：拋石過輕或缺少濾層，洪水中石塊被翻動帶走或下方細砂被吸出，護坦逐步下陷並在邊緣形成沖刷坑；Schoharie 溪橋的調查即指出拋石過輕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Riprap that is too light or lacks a filter is rolled away or loses the sand beneath it, so the apron sinks and a scour hole forms at its edge; the Schoharie Creek investigation found the riprap too light. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 施工時抽查石塊尺寸與比重、級配、層厚與護坦平面範圍，確認濾層或土工織物鋪設連續且搭接足夠；完工後測量護坦頂高程作為基準，洪後重測比較，量測護坦沉陷或流失。
knowledge.textEn: During construction sample stone size, specific gravity, gradation, layer thickness and apron plan extent, confirming continuous filter or geotextile with adequate overlaps; after completion survey the apron top as a baseline and resurvey after floods to measure settlement or loss.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保護工設計要附上石塊尺寸、級配、厚度、濾層、平面範圍與預期壽命，並把洪後補充列入維護計畫；採用固床工時，同步評估下游落差可能引起的沖刷，並與水利主管機關協調。
knowledge.textEn: Countermeasure design states stone size, gradation, thickness, filter, plan extent and expected life, with post-flood replenishment in the maintenance plan; when using bed-protection structures, assess scour from any downstream drop and coordinate with the water-resources authority.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沖刷保護工與河床穩定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scour countermeasures and bed stabilisation"?
options: 施工時抽查石塊尺寸與比重、級配、層厚與護坦平面範圍，確認濾層或土工織物鋪設連續且搭接足夠；完工後測量護坦頂高程作為基準，洪後重測比較，量測護坦沉陷或流失。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
洪水沖垮橋梁主要是因為水流的推力太大。
optionsEn: During construction sample stone size, specific gravity, gradation, layer thickness and apron plan extent, confirming continuous filter or geotextile with adequate overlaps.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Floods destroy bridges mainly because the water's thrust is too large.
quiz.explanation: 施工時抽查石塊尺寸與比重、級配、層厚與護坦平面範圍，確認濾層或土工織物鋪設連續且搭接足夠；完工後測量護坦頂高程作為基準，洪後重測比較，量測護坦沉陷或流失。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During construction sample stone size, specific gravity, gradation, layer thickness and apron plan extent, confirming continuous filter or geotextile with adequate overlaps; after completion survey the apron top as a baseline and resurvey after floods to measure settlement or loss. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沖刷保護工與河床穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scour countermeasures and bed stabilisation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拋石 D50 與護坦範圍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Riprap D50 and apron extent” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 拋石過輕或缺少濾層，洪水中石塊被翻動帶走或下方細砂被吸出，護坦逐步下陷並在邊緣形成沖刷坑；Schoharie 溪橋的調查即指出拋石過輕。保護工在洪後未補充，下一場洪水時基礎已無保護。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Riprap that is too light or lacks a filter is rolled away or loses the sand beneath it, so the apron sinks and a scour hole forms at its edge; the Schoharie Creek investigation found the riprap too light. Protection not replenished after a flood leaves the foundation unprotected in the next one. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：固床工若在下游形成落差，又可能在其下方引發新的沖刷，后豐大橋的水躍即是例證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A bed-protection structure that creates a drop can trigger new scour below it, as the hydraulic jump at the Houfeng Bridge showed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「在橋墩旁傾倒大量石塊，就能永久防止沖刷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dumping plenty of rock beside a pier prevents scour permanently." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 拋石過輕或缺少濾層，洪水中石塊被翻動帶走或下方細砂被吸出，護坦逐步下陷並在邊緣形成沖刷坑；Schoharie 溪橋的調查即指出拋石過輕。保護工在洪後未補充，下一場洪水時基礎已無保護。
knowledge.textEn: Riprap that is too light or lacks a filter is rolled away or loses the sand beneath it, so the apron sinks and a scour hole forms at its edge; the Schoharie Creek investigation found the riprap too light. Protection not replenished after a flood leaves the foundation unprotected in the next one.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沖刷保護工與河床穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scour countermeasures and bed stabilisation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
拋石過輕或缺少濾層，洪水中石塊被翻動帶走或下方細砂被吸出，護坦逐步下陷並在邊緣形成沖刷坑；Schoharie 溪橋的調查即指出拋石過輕。
裝了監測儀器的橋梁，就等於已經解決了沖刷問題。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Riprap that is too light or lacks a filter is rolled away or loses the sand beneath it, so the apron sinks and a scour hole forms at its edge.
Once a bridge has scour monitors, its scour problem is solved.
quiz.explanation: 拋石過輕或缺少濾層，洪水中石塊被翻動帶走或下方細砂被吸出，護坦逐步下陷並在邊緣形成沖刷坑；Schoharie 溪橋的調查即指出拋石過輕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Riprap that is too light or lacks a filter is rolled away or loses the sand beneath it, so the apron sinks and a scour hole forms at its edge; the Schoharie Creek investigation found the riprap too light. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝」與「施工期河道束縮與臨時工程」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors" and "Construction-stage contraction and temporary works": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「固定式監測儀與警戒高程」如何影響橋梁基礎沖刷監測的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fixed monitors and alarm elevations” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge-foundation scour monitoring”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 固定式監測儀在洪水期間持續量測墩旁河床高程：聲納裝在墩身水面下向下發射聲波量測水深；磁性滑環套在打入河床的導管上，河床下降時滑環隨之下滑並觸發磁性開關；浮出式感測器預先埋在不同深度，被沖出時發出訊號；傾斜計與加速度計則量測墩體的反應。美國 NCHRP 第 396 號報告（1997 年）在多州實地測試這些儀器，磁性滑環以 0.3 m 磁鐵間距可達約 ±0.15 m 精度。選擇儀器要考慮河床材料、漂流物、流速、維護可及性與資料傳輸。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「固定式監測儀與警戒高程」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fixed instruments measure the bed elevation beside a pier continuously during a flood: a sonar mounted on the pier below water sends acoustic pulses down to measure depth; a magnetic sliding collar rides on a pipe driven into the bed and slides down as the bed drops, tripping magnetic switches; float-out sensors buried at several depths signal when they are washed out; tilt meters and accelerometers measure pier response. NCHRP Report 396 (1997) field-tested such instruments in several states, with the magnetic sliding collar reaching about ±0.15 m accuracy at 0.3 m magnet spacing. Selection must consider bed material, debris, velocity, maintenance access and data transmission. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fixed monitors and alarm elevations” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原河床 EL +10.0 m，基礎底 EL +5.0 m，結構分析得臨界沖刷高程 EL +5.5 m，可用沖刷深度 4.5 m；警戒值取 50% 為 EL +7.75 m、封橋值取 75% 為 EL +6.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original bed EL +10.0 m, footing base EL +5.0 m and a critical scour elevation from analysis of EL +5.5 m give 4.5 m of available scour; the alert level at 50% is EL +7.75 m and the closure level at 75% is EL +6.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裝了監測儀器的橋梁，就等於已經解決了沖刷問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a bridge has scour monitors, its scour problem is solved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「固定式監測儀與警戒高程」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fixed monitors and alarm elevations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝
knowledge.titleEn: Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors
knowledge.text: 固定式監測儀在洪水期間持續量測墩旁河床高程：聲納裝在墩身水面下向下發射聲波量測水深；磁性滑環套在打入河床的導管上，河床下降時滑環隨之下滑並觸發磁性開關；浮出式感測器預先埋在不同深度，被沖出時發出訊號；傾斜計與加速度計則量測墩體的反應。美國 NCHRP 第 396 號報告（1997 年）在多州實地測試這些儀器，磁性滑環以 0.3 m 磁鐵間距可達約 ±0.15 m 精度。
knowledge.textEn: Fixed instruments measure the bed elevation beside a pier continuously during a flood: a sonar mounted on the pier below water sends acoustic pulses down to measure depth; a magnetic sliding collar rides on a pipe driven into the bed and slides down as the bed drops, tripping magnetic switches; float-out sensors buried at several depths signal when they are washed out; tilt meters and accelerometers measure pier response. NCHRP Report 396 (1997) field-tested such instruments in several states, with the magnetic sliding collar reaching about ±0.15 m accuracy at 0.3 m magnet spacing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裝了監測儀器的橋梁，就等於已經解決了沖刷問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a bridge has scour monitors, its scour problem is solved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors" is correct?
options: 裝了監測儀器的橋梁，就等於已經解決了沖刷問題。
臨時工程只存在幾個月，不需要考慮洪水沖刷。
固定式監測儀在洪水期間持續量測墩旁河床高程：聲納裝在墩身水面下向下發射聲波量測水深。
optionsEn: Once a bridge has scour monitors, its scour problem is solved.
Temporary works last only a few months, so flood scour need not be considered.
Fixed instruments measure the bed elevation beside a pier continuously during a flood: a sonar mounted on the pier below water sends acoustic pulses down to measure depth.
quiz.explanation: 固定式監測儀在洪水期間持續量測墩旁河床高程：聲納裝在墩身水面下向下發射聲波量測水深；磁性滑環套在打入河床的導管上，河床下降時滑環隨之下滑並觸發磁性開關；浮出式感測器預先埋在不同深度，被沖出時發出訊號；傾斜計與加速度計則量測墩體的反應。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fixed instruments measure the bed elevation beside a pier continuously during a flood: a sonar mounted on the pier below water sends acoustic pulses down to measure depth; a magnetic sliding collar rides on a pipe driven into the bed and slides down as the bed drops, tripping magnetic switches; float-out sensors buried at several depths signal when they are washed out; tilt meters and accelerometers measure pier response. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「固定式監測儀與警戒高程」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fixed monitors and alarm elevations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原河床 EL +10.0 m，基礎底 EL +5.0 m，結構分析得臨界沖刷高程 EL +5.5 m，可用沖刷深度 4.5 m；警戒值取 50% 為 EL +7.75 m、封橋值取 75% 為 EL +6.6 m。滑環精度 ±0.15 m，封橋值再保守提高 0.15 m 至 EL +6.75 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original bed EL +10.0 m, footing base EL +5.0 m and a critical scour elevation from analysis of EL +5.5 m give 4.5 m of available scour; the alert level at 50% is EL +7.75 m and the closure level at 75% is EL +6.6 m. With ±0.15 m collar accuracy, the closure level is raised conservatively by 0.15 m to EL +6.75 m. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝後以測深或潛水調查確認儀器讀值與實際河床一致，記錄感測器高程、方位與零點；資料傳輸要做端對端測試（感測器、記錄器、通訊、伺服器、告警簡訊），並在枯水期安排定期功能檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After installation confirm instrument readings against soundings or diver surveys and record sensor elevations, orientation and zero; test data transmission end to end (sensor, logger, communications, server and alarm messages) and schedule periodic function checks in the dry season.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原河床 EL +10.0 m，基礎底 EL +5.0 m，結構分析得臨界沖刷高程 EL +5.5 m，可用沖刷深度 4.5 m；警戒值取 50% 為 EL +7.75 m、封橋值取 75% 為 EL +6.6 m。滑環精度 ±0.15 m，封橋值再保守提高 0.15 m 至 EL +6.75 m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Original bed EL +10.0 m, footing base EL +5.0 m and a critical scour elevation from analysis of EL +5.5 m give 4.5 m of available scour; the alert level at 50% is EL +7.75 m and the closure level at 75% is EL +6.6 m. With ±0.15 m collar accuracy, the closure level is raised conservatively by 0.15 m to EL +6.75 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors", which statement holds?
options: 原河床 EL +10.0 m，基礎底 EL +5.0 m，結構分析得臨界沖刷高程 EL +5.5 m，可用沖刷深度 4.5 m。
橋墩自然頻率下降一定代表基礎被沖刷。
洪水過後量到的河床高程，就是洪水期間最深的沖刷位置。
optionsEn: Original bed EL +10.0 m, footing base EL +5.0 m and a critical scour elevation from analysis of EL +5.5 m give 4.5 m of available scour.
A drop in pier natural frequency always means the foundation has been scoured.
The bed elevation measured after a flood is the deepest scour reached during it.
quiz.explanation: 原河床 EL +10.0 m，基礎底 EL +5.0 m，結構分析得臨界沖刷高程 EL +5.5 m，可用沖刷深度 4.5 m；警戒值取 50% 為 EL +7.75 m、封橋值取 75% 為 EL +6.6 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original bed EL +10.0 m, footing base EL +5.0 m and a critical scour elevation from analysis of EL +5.5 m give 4.5 m of available scour; the alert level at 50% is EL +7.75 m and the closure level at 75% is EL +6.6 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「固定式監測儀與警戒高程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fixed monitors and alarm elevations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝後以測深或潛水調查確認儀器讀值與實際河床一致，記錄感測器高程、方位與零點；資料傳輸要做端對端測試（感測器、記錄器、通訊、伺服器、告警簡訊），並在枯水期安排定期功能檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After installation confirm instrument readings against soundings or diver surveys and record sensor elevations, orientation and zero; test data transmission end to end (sensor, logger, communications, server and alarm messages) and schedule periodic function checks in the dry season. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測位置以沖刷計算最深、基礎最淺的墩與墩頭為優先，至少兩種原理不同的儀器互相備援；纜線走在墩身凹槽或保護管內，設計時就預留維修通道與枯水期更換程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prioritise piers and pier noses with the deepest computed scour and shallowest foundations, using at least two instruments of different principle as backup; route cables in pier recesses or protective conduits, and provide maintenance access and a dry-season replacement procedure from design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器只裝在一座墩或裝在墩的下游側，最深的沖刷坑發生在未監測的上游墩頭，警報沒有觸發；纜線沿墩身外露，第一場颱風就被漂流木扯斷，系統在最需要時沒有資料。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sensors on only one pier, or on the downstream face, miss the deepest scour at an unmonitored upstream nose, so no alarm is raised; cables run exposed down the pier are torn off by debris in the first typhoon, leaving no data when it matters most. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝後以測深或潛水調查確認儀器讀值與實際河床一致，記錄感測器高程、方位與零點；資料傳輸要做端對端測試（感測器、記錄器、通訊、伺服器、告警簡訊），並在枯水期安排定期功能檢查。
knowledge.textEn: After installation confirm instrument readings against soundings or diver surveys and record sensor elevations, orientation and zero; test data transmission end to end (sensor, logger, communications, server and alarm messages) and schedule periodic function checks in the dry season.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測位置以沖刷計算最深、基礎最淺的墩與墩頭為優先，至少兩種原理不同的儀器互相備援；纜線走在墩身凹槽或保護管內，設計時就預留維修通道與枯水期更換程序。
knowledge.textEn: Prioritise piers and pier noses with the deepest computed scour and shallowest foundations, using at least two instruments of different principle as backup; route cables in pier recesses or protective conduits, and provide maintenance access and a dry-season replacement procedure from design.

quiz.question: 要驗證「固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
安裝後以測深或潛水調查確認儀器讀值與實際河床一致，記錄感測器高程、方位與零點。
橋墩越細長，沖刷就一定越小。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
After installation confirm instrument readings against soundings or diver surveys and record sensor elevations, orientation and zero.
The slimmer and longer the pier, the smaller the scour always is.
quiz.explanation: 安裝後以測深或潛水調查確認儀器讀值與實際河床一致，記錄感測器高程、方位與零點；資料傳輸要做端對端測試（感測器、記錄器、通訊、伺服器、告警簡訊），並在枯水期安排定期功能檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After installation confirm instrument readings against soundings or diver surveys and record sensor elevations, orientation and zero; test data transmission end to end (sensor, logger, communications, server and alarm messages) and schedule periodic function checks in the dry season. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「固定式監測儀與警戒高程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fixed monitors and alarm elevations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器只裝在一座墩或裝在墩的下游側，最深的沖刷坑發生在未監測的上游墩頭，警報沒有觸發；纜線沿墩身外露，第一場颱風就被漂流木扯斷，系統在最需要時沒有資料。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sensors on only one pier, or on the downstream face, miss the deepest scour at an unmonitored upstream nose, so no alarm is raised; cables run exposed down the pier are torn off by debris in the first typhoon, leaving no data when it matters most. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：選擇儀器要考慮河床材料、漂流物、流速、維護可及性與資料傳輸。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Selection must consider bed material, debris, velocity, maintenance access and data transmission.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裝了監測儀器的橋梁，就等於已經解決了沖刷問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a bridge has scour monitors, its scour problem is solved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 感測器只裝在一座墩或裝在墩的下游側，最深的沖刷坑發生在未監測的上游墩頭，警報沒有觸發；纜線沿墩身外露，第一場颱風就被漂流木扯斷，系統在最需要時沒有資料。
knowledge.textEn: Sensors on only one pier, or on the downstream face, miss the deepest scour at an unmonitored upstream nose, so no alarm is raised; cables run exposed down the pier are torn off by debris in the first typhoon, leaving no data when it matters most.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「固定式沖刷監測儀的選擇與安裝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Selecting and installing fixed scour monitors" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
臨時工程只存在幾個月，不需要考慮洪水沖刷。
感測器只裝在一座墩或裝在墩的下游側，最深的沖刷坑發生在未監測的上游墩頭，警報沒有觸發；纜線沿墩身外露，第一場颱風就被漂流木扯斷，系統在最需要時沒有資料。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Temporary works last only a few months, so flood scour need not be considered.
Sensors on only one pier, or on the downstream face, miss the deepest scour at an unmonitored upstream nose, so no alarm is raised.
quiz.explanation: 感測器只裝在一座墩或裝在墩的下游側，最深的沖刷坑發生在未監測的上游墩頭，警報沒有觸發；纜線沿墩身外露，第一場颱風就被漂流木扯斷，系統在最需要時沒有資料。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sensors on only one pier, or on the downstream face, miss the deepest scour at an unmonitored upstream nose, so no alarm is raised; cables run exposed down the pier are torn off by debris in the first typhoon, leaving no data when it matters most. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工期河道束縮與臨時工程：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage contraction and temporary works: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「施工圍堰束縮沖刷」如何影響橋梁基礎沖刷監測的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cofferdam contraction scour” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge-foundation scour monitoring”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 新建或改建橋梁時，圍堰、施工便橋、工作平台與堆置的土方都會佔用河道，使通水寬度縮窄、流速升高，在汛期造成比完工後更嚴重的束縮沖刷，危及既有橋墩與尚未完成的新基礎。施工計畫因此要以汛期洪水檢核臨時工程，必要時在汛期前撤除或降低圍堰。河道上的採砂也會使床面長期下降；高屏大橋所在河段在 1995 年就已撤除採砂船，顯示採砂對橋基的長期影響早受關注。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「施工圍堰束縮沖刷」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During construction or replacement, cofferdams, temporary trestles, work platforms and stockpiles occupy the channel, narrowing the waterway and raising velocity, so in the flood season contraction scour can be worse than after completion, endangering existing piers and unfinished new foundations. The construction plan must therefore check temporary works against flood-season discharges, removing or lowering cofferdams before the season where needed. Mining in the channel also lowers the bed over time; on the reach of the Kaoping Bridge, sand-dredging boats had already been removed in 1995, showing how long mining's effect on foundations has been a concern. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cofferdam contraction scour” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Laursen 活床束縮沖刷 y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Laursen live-bed contraction scour y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臨時工程只存在幾個月，不需要考慮洪水沖刷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Temporary works last only a few months, so flood scour need not be considered." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「施工圍堰束縮沖刷」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cofferdam contraction scour”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工期河道束縮與臨時工程
knowledge.text: 新建或改建橋梁時，圍堰、施工便橋、工作平台與堆置的土方都會佔用河道，使通水寬度縮窄、流速升高，在汛期造成比完工後更嚴重的束縮沖刷，危及既有橋墩與尚未完成的新基礎。施工計畫因此要以汛期洪水檢核臨時工程，必要時在汛期前撤除或降低圍堰。
knowledge.textEn: During construction or replacement, cofferdams, temporary trestles, work platforms and stockpiles occupy the channel, narrowing the waterway and raising velocity, so in the flood season contraction scour can be worse than after completion, endangering existing piers and unfinished new foundations. The construction plan must therefore check temporary works against flood-season discharges, removing or lowering cofferdams before the season where needed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：臨時工程只存在幾個月，不需要考慮洪水沖刷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Temporary works last only a few months, so flood scour need not be considered. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工期河道束縮與臨時工程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction-stage contraction and temporary works" is correct?
options: 新建或改建橋梁時，圍堰、施工便橋、工作平台與堆置的土方都會佔用河道，使通水寬度縮窄、流速升高，在汛期造成比完工後更嚴重的束縮沖刷，危及既有橋墩與尚未完成的新基礎。
臨時工程只存在幾個月，不需要考慮洪水沖刷。
監測讀值沒有變化，就表示河床很穩定。
optionsEn: During construction or replacement, cofferdams, temporary trestles, work platforms and stockpiles occupy the channel, narrowing the waterway and raising velocity, so in the flood season contraction scour can be worse than after completion, endangering existing piers and unfinished new foundations.
Temporary works last only a few months, so flood scour need not be considered.
If the monitored reading does not change, the bed is stable.
quiz.explanation: 新建或改建橋梁時，圍堰、施工便橋、工作平台與堆置的土方都會佔用河道，使通水寬度縮窄、流速升高，在汛期造成比完工後更嚴重的束縮沖刷，危及既有橋墩與尚未完成的新基礎。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: During construction or replacement, cofferdams, temporary trestles, work platforms and stockpiles occupy the channel, narrowing the waterway and raising velocity, so in the flood season contraction scour can be worse than after completion, endangering existing piers and unfinished new foundations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工期河道束縮與臨時工程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage contraction and temporary works: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工圍堰束縮沖刷」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cofferdam contraction scour” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Laursen 活床束縮沖刷 y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁。施工圍堰使通水寬度由 300 m 縮為 240 m，k₁ = 0.69：y₂/y₁ = 1.25^0.69 ≈ 1.166，y₁ = 5.0 m 時 y₂ ≈ 5.83 m，束縮沖刷約 0.83 m；若圍堰汛期前撤除，此量回到接近 0。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Laursen live-bed contraction scour y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁. A cofferdam narrowing the waterway from 300 m to 240 m with k₁ = 0.69 gives y₂/y₁ = 1.25^0.69 ≈ 1.166, so with y₁ = 5.0 m, y₂ ≈ 5.83 m and contraction scour is about 0.83 m; removing the cofferdam before the flood season returns it to near zero. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：施工前由水理模型模擬汛期洪水在臨時工程存在時的水位與流速，檢查既有墩與新基礎的沖刷；施工期間定期測量河床斷面，並把汛期前臨時工程的撤除或降挖列為查驗點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before construction simulate flood-season water levels and velocities with the temporary works in place and check scour at existing piers and new foundations; survey cross-sections regularly during construction and make removal or lowering of temporary works before the flood season an inspection point.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Laursen 活床束縮沖刷 y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁。施工圍堰使通水寬度由 300 m 縮為 240 m，k₁ = 0.69：y₂/y₁ = 1.25^0.69 ≈ 1.166，y₁ = 5.0 m 時 y₂ ≈ 5.83 m，束縮沖刷約 0.83 m；若圍堰汛期前撤除，此量回到接近 0。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Laursen live-bed contraction scour y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁. A cofferdam narrowing the waterway from 300 m to 240 m with k₁ = 0.69 gives y₂/y₁ = 1.25^0.69 ≈ 1.166, so with y₁ = 5.0 m, y₂ ≈ 5.83 m and contraction scour is about 0.83 m; removing the cofferdam before the flood season returns it to near zero. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工期河道束縮與臨時工程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction-stage contraction and temporary works", which statement holds?
options: 只要橋還站著，洪水期間就可以繼續開放通行。
Laursen 活床束縮沖刷 y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁。
洪水沖垮橋梁主要是因為水流的推力太大。
optionsEn: As long as the bridge is still standing, it can stay open during a flood.
Laursen live-bed contraction scour y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁.
Floods destroy bridges mainly because the water's thrust is too large.
quiz.explanation: Laursen 活床束縮沖刷 y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Laursen live-bed contraction scour y₂/y₁ = (W₁/W₂)^k₁. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工期河道束縮與臨時工程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage contraction and temporary works: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工圍堰束縮沖刷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cofferdam contraction scour” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 施工前由水理模型模擬汛期洪水在臨時工程存在時的水位與流速，檢查既有墩與新基礎的沖刷；施工期間定期測量河床斷面，並把汛期前臨時工程的撤除或降挖列為查驗點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before construction simulate flood-season water levels and velocities with the temporary works in place and check scour at existing piers and new foundations; survey cross-sections regularly during construction and make removal or lowering of temporary works before the flood season an inspection point. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫要有汛期應變章節：明訂停止水中作業與撤除臨時工程的水位或預報條件、撤除所需時間與責任人，並由工程主辦機關與水利主管機關核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan includes a flood-season chapter defining the water-level or forecast triggers for stopping in-river work and removing temporary works, the time required and the responsible person, approved by the project owner and the water-resources authority.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工便橋與圍堰在颱風來臨前未撤除，洪水被迫擠過剩餘河道，既有橋墩旁出現深沖刷坑；臨時工程本身被沖毀後的殘骸堆積在下游橋墩前，進一步加寬有效墩寬並加深沖刷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Trestles and cofferdams not removed before a typhoon force the flood through the remaining channel, excavating deep scour holes beside existing piers; debris from washed-out temporary works piles against downstream piers, widening their effective width and deepening scour. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 施工前由水理模型模擬汛期洪水在臨時工程存在時的水位與流速，檢查既有墩與新基礎的沖刷；施工期間定期測量河床斷面，並把汛期前臨時工程的撤除或降挖列為查驗點。
knowledge.textEn: Before construction simulate flood-season water levels and velocities with the temporary works in place and check scour at existing piers and new foundations; survey cross-sections regularly during construction and make removal or lowering of temporary works before the flood season an inspection point.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫要有汛期應變章節：明訂停止水中作業與撤除臨時工程的水位或預報條件、撤除所需時間與責任人，並由工程主辦機關與水利主管機關核准。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan includes a flood-season chapter defining the water-level or forecast triggers for stopping in-river work and removing temporary works, the time required and the responsible person, approved by the project owner and the water-resources authority.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工期河道束縮與臨時工程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction-stage contraction and temporary works"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要是樁基礎，沖刷再深也不會有問題。
施工前由水理模型模擬汛期洪水在臨時工程存在時的水位與流速，檢查既有墩與新基礎的沖刷；施工期間定期測量河床斷面，並把汛期前臨時工程的撤除或降挖列為查驗點。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
If a pier stands on piles, scour depth does not matter.
Before construction simulate flood-season water levels and velocities with the temporary works in place and check scour at existing piers and new foundations.
quiz.explanation: 施工前由水理模型模擬汛期洪水在臨時工程存在時的水位與流速，檢查既有墩與新基礎的沖刷；施工期間定期測量河床斷面，並把汛期前臨時工程的撤除或降挖列為查驗點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before construction simulate flood-season water levels and velocities with the temporary works in place and check scour at existing piers and new foundations; survey cross-sections regularly during construction and make removal or lowering of temporary works before the flood season an inspection point. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工期河道束縮與臨時工程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction-stage contraction and temporary works: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工圍堰束縮沖刷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cofferdam contraction scour” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工便橋與圍堰在颱風來臨前未撤除，洪水被迫擠過剩餘河道，既有橋墩旁出現深沖刷坑；臨時工程本身被沖毀後的殘骸堆積在下游橋墩前，進一步加寬有效墩寬並加深沖刷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Trestles and cofferdams not removed before a typhoon force the flood through the remaining channel, excavating deep scour holes beside existing piers; debris from washed-out temporary works piles against downstream piers, widening their effective width and deepening scour. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：河道上的採砂也會使床面長期下降；高屏大橋所在河段在 1995 年就已撤除採砂船，顯示採砂對橋基的長期影響早受關注。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mining in the channel also lowers the bed over time; on the reach of the Kaoping Bridge, sand-dredging boats had already been removed in 1995, showing how long mining's effect on foundations has been a concern.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「臨時工程只存在幾個月，不需要考慮洪水沖刷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Temporary works last only a few months, so flood scour need not be considered." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工便橋與圍堰在颱風來臨前未撤除，洪水被迫擠過剩餘河道，既有橋墩旁出現深沖刷坑；臨時工程本身被沖毀後的殘骸堆積在下游橋墩前，進一步加寬有效墩寬並加深沖刷。
knowledge.textEn: Trestles and cofferdams not removed before a typhoon force the flood through the remaining channel, excavating deep scour holes beside existing piers; debris from washed-out temporary works piles against downstream piers, widening their effective width and deepening scour.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工期河道束縮與臨時工程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction-stage contraction and temporary works" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 施工便橋與圍堰在颱風來臨前未撤除，洪水被迫擠過剩餘河道，既有橋墩旁出現深沖刷坑；臨時工程本身被沖毀後的殘骸堆積在下游橋墩前，進一步加寬有效墩寬並加深沖刷。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
監測讀值沒有變化，就表示河床很穩定。
optionsEn: Trestles and cofferdams not removed before a typhoon force the flood through the remaining channel, excavating deep scour holes beside existing piers.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If the monitored reading does not change, the bed is stable.
quiz.explanation: 施工便橋與圍堰在颱風來臨前未撤除，洪水被迫擠過剩餘河道，既有橋墩旁出現深沖刷坑；臨時工程本身被沖毀後的殘骸堆積在下游橋墩前，進一步加寬有效墩寬並加深沖刷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Trestles and cofferdams not removed before a typhoon force the flood through the remaining channel, excavating deep scour holes beside existing piers; debris from washed-out temporary works piles against downstream piers, widening their effective width and deepening scour. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「即時監測資料與警戒判斷」與「以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions" and "Detecting scour from vibration and tilt": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 即時監測資料與警戒判斷：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「聲納測深與聲速」如何影響橋梁基礎沖刷監測的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sonar depth and sound speed” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge-foundation scour monitoring”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 聲納以聲波往返時間換算到河床的距離，原理簡單，但洪水時的實際困難很多：水中夾帶大量氣泡或高濃度泥沙會吸收與散射聲波，造成訊號遺失；漂流物經過會產生假的淺值；長期浸水的換能器會被生物附著。NCHRP 第 396 號報告的實地測試就記錄到高含氣水流時訊號遺失、佛羅里達潮汐橋墩第二年出現藤壺附著影響讀值。因此即時資料必須經過濾波與合理性檢查，並以多儀器、多指標共同判斷，而不是單一讀值觸發封橋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「聲納測深與聲速」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sonar converts the round-trip time of an acoustic pulse into distance to the bed. The principle is simple, but floods bring many practical problems: heavy air entrainment or high sediment concentration absorbs and scatters sound and causes signal loss, passing debris produces false shallow readings, and transducers submerged for long periods foul with marine growth. Field tests in NCHRP Report 396 recorded signal loss in highly air-entrained flow and barnacle growth affecting a Florida tidal pier unit in its second year. Real-time data must therefore be filtered and sanity-checked, and decisions made from several instruments and indicators rather than a single reading triggering closure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sonar depth and sound speed” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：距離 d = c·t/2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Distance d = c·t/2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「監測讀值沒有變化，就表示河床很穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the monitored reading does not change, the bed is stable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「聲納測深與聲速」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Sonar depth and sound speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 即時監測資料與警戒判斷
knowledge.titleEn: Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions
knowledge.text: 聲納以聲波往返時間換算到河床的距離，原理簡單，但洪水時的實際困難很多：水中夾帶大量氣泡或高濃度泥沙會吸收與散射聲波，造成訊號遺失；漂流物經過會產生假的淺值；長期浸水的換能器會被生物附著。NCHRP 第 396 號報告的實地測試就記錄到高含氣水流時訊號遺失、佛羅里達潮汐橋墩第二年出現藤壺附著影響讀值。
knowledge.textEn: Sonar converts the round-trip time of an acoustic pulse into distance to the bed. The principle is simple, but floods bring many practical problems: heavy air entrainment or high sediment concentration absorbs and scatters sound and causes signal loss, passing debris produces false shallow readings, and transducers submerged for long periods foul with marine growth.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：監測讀值沒有變化，就表示河床很穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the monitored reading does not change, the bed is stable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「即時監測資料與警戒判斷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions" is correct?
options: 監測讀值沒有變化，就表示河床很穩定。
聲納以聲波往返時間換算到河床的距離，原理簡單，但洪水時的實際困難很多：水中夾帶大量氣泡或高濃度泥沙會吸收與散射聲波，造成訊號遺失。
橋墩自然頻率下降一定代表基礎被沖刷。
optionsEn: If the monitored reading does not change, the bed is stable.
Sonar converts the round-trip time of an acoustic pulse into distance to the bed.
A drop in pier natural frequency always means the foundation has been scoured.
quiz.explanation: 聲納以聲波往返時間換算到河床的距離，原理簡單，但洪水時的實際困難很多：水中夾帶大量氣泡或高濃度泥沙會吸收與散射聲波，造成訊號遺失；漂流物經過會產生假的淺值；長期浸水的換能器會被生物附著。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sonar converts the round-trip time of an acoustic pulse into distance to the bed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 即時監測資料與警戒判斷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「聲納測深與聲速」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sonar depth and sound speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：距離 d = c·t/2。水中聲速 c = 1,480 m/s、往返時間 t = 10.8 ms，d = 1,480×0.0108/2 ≈ 7.99 m；水溫與含砂使聲速偏差 2% 時，誤差約 ±0.16 m。換能器高程 EL +14.5 m，河床 EL ≈ 14.5 − 7.99 ≈ +6.5 m，已低於封橋值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Distance d = c·t/2. With sound speed c = 1,480 m/s and round-trip time t = 10.8 ms, d = 1,480×0.0108/2 ≈ 7.99 m; a 2% speed error from temperature and sediment gives about ±0.16 m. With the transducer at EL +14.5 m, the bed is at about EL 14.5 − 7.99 ≈ +6.5 m, below the closure level. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以滑動中位數或時間窗平均濾除突跳，設定讀值合理範圍與變化率上限，訊號遺失超過設定時間即發出設備告警；警戒判斷結合水位、流量、上游雨量與第二種感測器，演練時檢查告警是否在規定時間內送達值班人員。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Filter spikes with a moving median or time-window average, set plausible ranges and maximum rates of change, and raise an equipment alarm if signal is lost beyond a set time; combine water level, discharge, upstream rainfall and a second sensor in alarm decisions, and check in drills that alarms reach duty staff within the required time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 距離 d = c·t/2。水中聲速 c = 1,480 m/s、往返時間 t = 10.8 ms，d = 1,480×0.0108/2 ≈ 7.99 m；水溫與含砂使聲速偏差 2% 時，誤差約 ±0.16 m。換能器高程 EL +14.5 m，河床 EL ≈ 14.5 − 7.99 ≈ +6.5 m，已低於封橋值。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Distance d = c·t/2. With sound speed c = 1,480 m/s and round-trip time t = 10.8 ms, d = 1,480×0.0108/2 ≈ 7.99 m; a 2% speed error from temperature and sediment gives about ±0.16 m. With the transducer at EL +14.5 m, the bed is at about EL 14.5 − 7.99 ≈ +6.5 m, below the closure level. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「即時監測資料與警戒判斷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions", which statement holds?
options: 洪水過後量到的河床高程，就是洪水期間最深的沖刷位置。
橋墩越細長，沖刷就一定越小。
距離 d = c·t/2。
optionsEn: The bed elevation measured after a flood is the deepest scour reached during it.
The slimmer and longer the pier, the smaller the scour always is.
Distance d = c·t/2.
quiz.explanation: 距離 d = c·t/2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Distance d = c·t/2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 即時監測資料與警戒判斷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「聲納測深與聲速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sonar depth and sound speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以滑動中位數或時間窗平均濾除突跳，設定讀值合理範圍與變化率上限，訊號遺失超過設定時間即發出設備告警；警戒判斷結合水位、流量、上游雨量與第二種感測器，演練時檢查告警是否在規定時間內送達值班人員。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Filter spikes with a moving median or time-window average, set plausible ranges and maximum rates of change, and raise an equipment alarm if signal is lost beyond a set time; combine water level, discharge, upstream rainfall and a second sensor in alarm decisions, and check in drills that alarms reach duty staff within the required time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：行動計畫中把「設備失效」本身列為警戒條件：洪水期間若監測中斷，改以水位或流量門檻與人員目視執行預防性封橋；所有告警與處置須留下時間戳記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The plan of action treats instrument failure itself as an alert condition: if monitoring drops out during a flood, fall back to water-level or discharge thresholds and visual watch for precautionary closure; every alarm and response is time-stamped in the log.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未過濾的聲納資料在洪峰時因氣泡頻繁跳到極淺或極深，值班人員對誤報麻木而忽略真警報；或系統在訊號遺失時沿用最後一筆正常值，洪峰期間顯示「穩定」，實際河床正在快速下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unfiltered sonar data jumping to very shallow or very deep values in aerated flow make duty staff numb to false alarms so they ignore a real one; or a system that holds the last good value during signal loss shows stable readings through the peak while the bed is actually dropping fast. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以滑動中位數或時間窗平均濾除突跳，設定讀值合理範圍與變化率上限，訊號遺失超過設定時間即發出設備告警；警戒判斷結合水位、流量、上游雨量與第二種感測器，演練時檢查告警是否在規定時間內送達值班人員。
knowledge.textEn: Filter spikes with a moving median or time-window average, set plausible ranges and maximum rates of change, and raise an equipment alarm if signal is lost beyond a set time; combine water level, discharge, upstream rainfall and a second sensor in alarm decisions, and check in drills that alarms reach duty staff within the required time.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 行動計畫中把「設備失效」本身列為警戒條件：洪水期間若監測中斷，改以水位或流量門檻與人員目視執行預防性封橋；所有告警與處置須留下時間戳記錄。
