quiz.question: 要驗證「即時監測資料與警戒判斷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions"?
options: 以滑動中位數或時間窗平均濾除突跳，設定讀值合理範圍與變化率上限，訊號遺失超過設定時間即發出設備告警。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
在橋墩旁傾倒大量石塊，就能永久防止沖刷。
optionsEn: Filter spikes with a moving median or time-window average, set plausible ranges and maximum rates of change, and raise an equipment alarm if signal is lost beyond a set time.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Dumping plenty of rock beside a pier prevents scour permanently.
quiz.explanation: 以滑動中位數或時間窗平均濾除突跳，設定讀值合理範圍與變化率上限，訊號遺失超過設定時間即發出設備告警；警戒判斷結合水位、流量、上游雨量與第二種感測器，演練時檢查告警是否在規定時間內送達值班人員。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Filter spikes with a moving median or time-window average, set plausible ranges and maximum rates of change, and raise an equipment alarm if signal is lost beyond a set time; combine water level, discharge, upstream rainfall and a second sensor in alarm decisions, and check in drills that alarms reach duty staff within the required time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 即時監測資料與警戒判斷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「聲納測深與聲速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sonar depth and sound speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未過濾的聲納資料在洪峰時因氣泡頻繁跳到極淺或極深，值班人員對誤報麻木而忽略真警報；或系統在訊號遺失時沿用最後一筆正常值，洪峰期間顯示「穩定」，實際河床正在快速下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unfiltered sonar data jumping to very shallow or very deep values in aerated flow make duty staff numb to false alarms so they ignore a real one; or a system that holds the last good value during signal loss shows stable readings through the peak while the bed is actually dropping fast. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此即時資料必須經過濾波與合理性檢查，並以多儀器、多指標共同判斷，而不是單一讀值觸發封橋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Real-time data must therefore be filtered and sanity-checked, and decisions made from several instruments and indicators rather than a single reading triggering closure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「監測讀值沒有變化，就表示河床很穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the monitored reading does not change, the bed is stable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未過濾的聲納資料在洪峰時因氣泡頻繁跳到極淺或極深，值班人員對誤報麻木而忽略真警報；或系統在訊號遺失時沿用最後一筆正常值，洪峰期間顯示「穩定」，實際河床正在快速下降。
knowledge.textEn: Unfiltered sonar data jumping to very shallow or very deep values in aerated flow make duty staff numb to false alarms so they ignore a real one; or a system that holds the last good value during signal loss shows stable readings through the peak while the bed is actually dropping fast.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「即時監測資料與警戒判斷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
未過濾的聲納資料在洪峰時因氣泡頻繁跳到極淺或極深，值班人員對誤報麻木而忽略真警報。
橋墩自然頻率下降一定代表基礎被沖刷。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Unfiltered sonar data jumping to very shallow or very deep values in aerated flow make duty staff numb to false alarms so they ignore a real one.
A drop in pier natural frequency always means the foundation has been scoured.
quiz.explanation: 未過濾的聲納資料在洪峰時因氣泡頻繁跳到極淺或極深，值班人員對誤報麻木而忽略真警報；或系統在訊號遺失時沿用最後一筆正常值，洪峰期間顯示「穩定」，實際河床正在快速下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unfiltered sonar data jumping to very shallow or very deep values in aerated flow make duty staff numb to false alarms so they ignore a real one; or a system that holds the last good value during signal loss shows stable readings through the peak while the bed is actually dropping fast. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Detecting scour from vibration and tilt: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「墩體自然頻率」如何影響橋梁基礎沖刷監測的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pier natural frequency” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge-foundation scour monitoring”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 直接量測河床的儀器容易在洪水中失效，因此也可以量測橋墩本身的反應：基礎周圍土壤被沖走後，墩—基礎系統的側向勁度降低，自然頻率隨之下降；擴展基礎或淺基礎局部被淘空時，墩體會出現傾斜或沉陷。加速度計與傾斜計裝在水面以上，不受洪水直接破壞，維護也較容易。但頻率同時受溫度、水位附加質量與上部結構影響，必須先建立正常狀態的基準與變化範圍，才能從中辨識沖刷造成的偏移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墩體自然頻率」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Instruments that measure the bed directly tend to fail in floods, so engineers can measure the pier's own response instead: once soil around the foundation is removed, the lateral stiffness of the pier–foundation system falls and its natural frequency drops; when a spread or shallow footing is partly undermined, the pier tilts or settles. Accelerometers and tilt meters sit above water, out of direct reach of the flood, and are easier to maintain. Frequency, however, also varies with temperature, added water mass and the superstructure, so a baseline and normal range must be established before a scour-induced shift can be recognised. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pier natural frequency” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：f ∝ √k，故 k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: f ∝ √k, so k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋墩自然頻率下降一定代表基礎被沖刷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A drop in pier natural frequency always means the foundation has been scoured." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「墩體自然頻率」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Pier natural frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷
knowledge.titleEn: Detecting scour from vibration and tilt
knowledge.text: 直接量測河床的儀器容易在洪水中失效，因此也可以量測橋墩本身的反應：基礎周圍土壤被沖走後，墩—基礎系統的側向勁度降低，自然頻率隨之下降；擴展基礎或淺基礎局部被淘空時，墩體會出現傾斜或沉陷。加速度計與傾斜計裝在水面以上，不受洪水直接破壞，維護也較容易。
knowledge.textEn: Instruments that measure the bed directly tend to fail in floods, so engineers can measure the pier's own response instead: once soil around the foundation is removed, the lateral stiffness of the pier–foundation system falls and its natural frequency drops; when a spread or shallow footing is partly undermined, the pier tilts or settles. Accelerometers and tilt meters sit above water, out of direct reach of the flood, and are easier to maintain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋墩自然頻率下降一定代表基礎被沖刷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A drop in pier natural frequency always means the foundation has been scoured. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Detecting scour from vibration and tilt" is correct?
options: 橋墩自然頻率下降一定代表基礎被沖刷。
只要橋還站著，洪水期間就可以繼續開放通行。
直接量測河床的儀器容易在洪水中失效，因此也可以量測橋墩本身的反應：基礎周圍土壤被沖走後，墩—基礎系統的側向勁度降低，自然頻率隨之下降。
optionsEn: A drop in pier natural frequency always means the foundation has been scoured.
As long as the bridge is still standing, it can stay open during a flood.

Instruments that measure the bed directly tend to fail in floods, so engineers can measure the pier's own response instead: once soil around the foundation is removed, the lateral stiffness of the pier–foundation system falls and its natural frequency drops.
quiz.explanation: 直接量測河床的儀器容易在洪水中失效，因此也可以量測橋墩本身的反應：基礎周圍土壤被沖走後，墩—基礎系統的側向勁度降低，自然頻率隨之下降；擴展基礎或淺基礎局部被淘空時，墩體會出現傾斜或沉陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Instruments that measure the bed directly tend to fail in floods, so engineers can measure the pier's own response instead: once soil around the foundation is removed, the lateral stiffness of the pier–foundation system falls and its natural frequency drops; when a spread or shallow footing is partly undermined, the pier tilts or settles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Detecting scour from vibration and tilt: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墩體自然頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pier natural frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f ∝ √k，故 k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)²。洪前墩體側向頻率 2.4 Hz、洪峰期間降為 1.9 Hz，k₂/k₁ = (1.9/2.4)² ≈ 0.63，勁度損失約 37%；對照有限元素模型中頻率對沖刷深度的曲線，可反推等效沖刷深度。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: f ∝ √k, so k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)². A pre-flood lateral pier frequency of 2.4 Hz falling to 1.9 Hz at the flood peak gives k₂/k₁ = (1.9/2.4)² ≈ 0.63, about a 37% stiffness loss; comparing with the finite-element curve of frequency versus scour depth back-calculates an equivalent scour depth. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以至少一年的環境振動資料建立頻率與溫度、水位的回歸基準，設定偏離門檻；有限元素模型以多個沖刷深度計算頻率曲線並以洪後實測沖刷校正；傾斜計設定絕對與變化率雙重門檻，並與測量結果比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a baseline regression of frequency against temperature and water level from at least a year of ambient data and set deviation thresholds; compute a frequency-versus-scour curve with the finite-element model at several depths and calibrate it with measured post-flood scour; give tilt meters both absolute and rate thresholds and cross-check them against surveys.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: f ∝ √k，故 k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)²。洪前墩體側向頻率 2.4 Hz、洪峰期間降為 1.9 Hz，k₂/k₁ = (1.9/2.4)² ≈ 0.63，勁度損失約 37%；對照有限元素模型中頻率對沖刷深度的曲線，可反推等效沖刷深度。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: f ∝ √k, so k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)². A pre-flood lateral pier frequency of 2.4 Hz falling to 1.9 Hz at the flood peak gives k₂/k₁ = (1.9/2.4)² ≈ 0.63, about a 37% stiffness loss; comparing with the finite-element curve of frequency versus scour depth back-calculates an equivalent scour depth. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Detecting scour from vibration and tilt", which statement holds?
options: f ∝ √k，故 k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)²。
洪水沖垮橋梁主要是因為水流的推力太大。
只要是樁基礎，沖刷再深也不會有問題。
optionsEn: f ∝ √k, so k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)².
Floods destroy bridges mainly because the water's thrust is too large.
If a pier stands on piles, scour depth does not matter.
quiz.explanation: f ∝ √k，故 k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: f ∝ √k, so k₂/k₁ = (f₂/f₁)². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Detecting scour from vibration and tilt: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墩體自然頻率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pier natural frequency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以至少一年的環境振動資料建立頻率與溫度、水位的回歸基準，設定偏離門檻；有限元素模型以多個沖刷深度計算頻率曲線並以洪後實測沖刷校正；傾斜計設定絕對與變化率雙重門檻，並與測量結果比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a baseline regression of frequency against temperature and water level from at least a year of ambient data and set deviation thresholds; compute a frequency-versus-scour curve with the finite-element model at several depths and calibrate it with measured post-flood scour; give tilt meters both absolute and rate thresholds and cross-check them against surveys. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：振動與傾斜監測當作直接測深的備援與交叉驗證，而非唯一依據；監測報告要列出基準期、回歸模型、門檻與每次警報的事後檢討，持續修正判斷規則。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use vibration and tilt monitoring as a backup and cross-check to direct depth measurement, not the sole basis; monitoring reports list the baseline period, regression model, thresholds and a review of every alarm, refining the decision rules continuously.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未扣除水位上升造成的附加質量效應，就把洪峰時的頻率下降全部歸因於沖刷，造成誤報；反之若門檻設得太寬，擴展基礎在淘空瞬間傾斜時頻率變化不大，振動法可能錯過突發破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attributing the whole frequency drop at the flood peak to scour without removing the added-mass effect of rising water causes false alarms; conversely, thresholds set too wide can miss sudden failure, because a spread footing that tips at the moment of undermining may show little frequency change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以至少一年的環境振動資料建立頻率與溫度、水位的回歸基準，設定偏離門檻；有限元素模型以多個沖刷深度計算頻率曲線並以洪後實測沖刷校正；傾斜計設定絕對與變化率雙重門檻，並與測量結果比對。
knowledge.textEn: Build a baseline regression of frequency against temperature and water level from at least a year of ambient data and set deviation thresholds; compute a frequency-versus-scour curve with the finite-element model at several depths and calibrate it with measured post-flood scour; give tilt meters both absolute and rate thresholds and cross-check them against surveys.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 振動與傾斜監測當作直接測深的備援與交叉驗證，而非唯一依據；監測報告要列出基準期、回歸模型、門檻與每次警報的事後檢討，持續修正判斷規則。
knowledge.textEn: Use vibration and tilt monitoring as a backup and cross-check to direct depth measurement, not the sole basis; monitoring reports list the baseline period, regression model, thresholds and a review of every alarm, refining the decision rules continuously.

quiz.question: 要驗證「以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Detecting scour from vibration and tilt"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以至少一年的環境振動資料建立頻率與溫度、水位的回歸基準，設定偏離門檻。
裝了監測儀器的橋梁，就等於已經解決了沖刷問題。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Build a baseline regression of frequency against temperature and water level from at least a year of ambient data and set deviation thresholds.
Once a bridge has scour monitors, its scour problem is solved.
quiz.explanation: 以至少一年的環境振動資料建立頻率與溫度、水位的回歸基準，設定偏離門檻；有限元素模型以多個沖刷深度計算頻率曲線並以洪後實測沖刷校正；傾斜計設定絕對與變化率雙重門檻，並與測量結果比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a baseline regression of frequency against temperature and water level from at least a year of ambient data and set deviation thresholds; compute a frequency-versus-scour curve with the finite-element model at several depths and calibrate it with measured post-flood scour; give tilt meters both absolute and rate thresholds and cross-check them against surveys. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Detecting scour from vibration and tilt: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墩體自然頻率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pier natural frequency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未扣除水位上升造成的附加質量效應，就把洪峰時的頻率下降全部歸因於沖刷，造成誤報；反之若門檻設得太寬，擴展基礎在淘空瞬間傾斜時頻率變化不大，振動法可能錯過突發破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing the whole frequency drop at the flood peak to scour without removing the added-mass effect of rising water causes false alarms; conversely, thresholds set too wide can miss sudden failure, because a spread footing that tips at the moment of undermining may show little frequency change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：但頻率同時受溫度、水位附加質量與上部結構影響，必須先建立正常狀態的基準與變化範圍，才能從中辨識沖刷造成的偏移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Frequency, however, also varies with temperature, added water mass and the superstructure, so a baseline and normal range must be established before a scour-induced shift can be recognised.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋墩自然頻率下降一定代表基礎被沖刷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A drop in pier natural frequency always means the foundation has been scoured." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未扣除水位上升造成的附加質量效應，就把洪峰時的頻率下降全部歸因於沖刷，造成誤報；反之若門檻設得太寬，擴展基礎在淘空瞬間傾斜時頻率變化不大，振動法可能錯過突發破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Attributing the whole frequency drop at the flood peak to scour without removing the added-mass effect of rising water causes false alarms; conversely, thresholds set too wide can miss sudden failure, because a spread footing that tips at the moment of undermining may show little frequency change.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「以振動與傾斜識別基礎沖刷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Detecting scour from vibration and tilt" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要橋還站著，洪水期間就可以繼續開放通行。
未扣除水位上升造成的附加質量效應，就把洪峰時的頻率下降全部歸因於沖刷，造成誤報。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
As long as the bridge is still standing, it can stay open during a flood.
Attributing the whole frequency drop at the flood peak to scour without removing the added-mass effect of rising water causes false alarms.
quiz.explanation: 未扣除水位上升造成的附加質量效應，就把洪峰時的頻率下降全部歸因於沖刷，造成誤報；反之若門檻設得太寬，擴展基礎在淘空瞬間傾斜時頻率變化不大，振動法可能錯過突發破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attributing the whole frequency drop at the flood peak to scour without removing the added-mass effect of rising water causes false alarms; conversely, thresholds set too wide can miss sudden failure, because a spread footing that tips at the moment of undermining may show little frequency change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沖刷危急橋梁行動計畫」與「洪後檢查、沖刷紀錄與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Plans of action for scour-critical bridges" and "Post-flood inspection, scour records and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沖刷危急橋梁行動計畫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Plans of action for scour-critical bridges: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「行動計畫與封橋門檻」如何影響橋梁基礎沖刷監測的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plan of action and closure triggers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge-foundation scour monitoring”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 監測只是工具，真正保護用路人的是事先寫好的行動計畫：美國聯邦法規要求每座被列為沖刷危急的橋梁都必須有行動計畫，內容包括檢查與監測的方式和頻率、封橋與重新開放的條件、繞道路線、責任人與聯絡方式，以及設計和施作永久保護工的時程。HEC-23 第 3 版（2009 年）也強調，監測本身不能讓橋梁脫離沖刷危急的分類，只能爭取時間或在特定情況下作為對策。台灣的公路主管機關也採用分級預警封橋，例如 2026 年 6 月公告台 9 線萬里溪橋將隨上游堰塞湖警戒層級提升辦理預警性封閉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「行動計畫與封橋門檻」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring is only a tool; what protects road users is a plan of action written in advance. U.S. federal regulations require every bridge coded scour-critical to have one, covering inspection and monitoring type and frequency, closure and reopening criteria, detour routes, responsible staff and contacts, and the schedule for designing and building permanent countermeasures. HEC-23 (3rd edition, 2009) stresses that monitoring alone does not remove a bridge from the scour-critical category; it buys time or serves as a countermeasure in specific cases. Taiwan's highway authority also uses tiered pre-emptive closure, for example announcing in June 2026 that the Route 9 Wanli Creek Bridge would be closed as the alert level of an upstream barrier lake rises. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Plan of action and closure triggers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：水位—流量率定曲線 Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Stage–discharge rating Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要橋還站著，洪水期間就可以繼續開放通行。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the bridge is still standing, it can stay open during a flood." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「行動計畫與封橋門檻」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Plan of action and closure triggers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沖刷危急橋梁行動計畫
knowledge.titleEn: Plans of action for scour-critical bridges
knowledge.text: 監測只是工具，真正保護用路人的是事先寫好的行動計畫：美國聯邦法規要求每座被列為沖刷危急的橋梁都必須有行動計畫，內容包括檢查與監測的方式和頻率、封橋與重新開放的條件、繞道路線、責任人與聯絡方式，以及設計和施作永久保護工的時程。HEC-23 第 3 版（2009 年）也強調，監測本身不能讓橋梁脫離沖刷危急的分類，只能爭取時間或在特定情況下作為對策。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring is only a tool; what protects road users is a plan of action written in advance. U.S. federal regulations require every bridge coded scour-critical to have one, covering inspection and monitoring type and frequency, closure and reopening criteria, detour routes, responsible staff and contacts, and the schedule for designing and building permanent countermeasures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要橋還站著，洪水期間就可以繼續開放通行。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the bridge is still standing, it can stay open during a flood. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沖刷危急橋梁行動計畫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Plans of action for scour-critical bridges" is correct?
options: 監測只是工具，真正保護用路人的是事先寫好的行動計畫：美國聯邦法規要求每座被列為沖刷危急的橋梁都必須有行動計畫，內容包括檢查與監測的方式和頻率、封橋與重新開放的條件、繞道路線、責任人與聯絡方式，以及設計和施作永久保護工的時程。
只要橋還站著，洪水期間就可以繼續開放通行。
洪水過後量到的河床高程，就是洪水期間最深的沖刷位置。
optionsEn: Monitoring is only a tool; what protects road users is a plan of action written in advance.
As long as the bridge is still standing, it can stay open during a flood.
The bed elevation measured after a flood is the deepest scour reached during it.
quiz.explanation: 監測只是工具，真正保護用路人的是事先寫好的行動計畫：美國聯邦法規要求每座被列為沖刷危急的橋梁都必須有行動計畫，內容包括檢查與監測的方式和頻率、封橋與重新開放的條件、繞道路線、責任人與聯絡方式，以及設計和施作永久保護工的時程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring is only a tool; what protects road users is a plan of action written in advance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沖刷危急橋梁行動計畫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Plans of action for scour-critical bridges: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「行動計畫與封橋門檻」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plan of action and closure triggers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：水位—流量率定曲線 Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5。若封橋流量取沖刷達可用深度 75% 時的 Q = 8,000 m³/s，(h − 1.0)^1.5 = 26.7，h − 1.0 = 26.7^(2/3) ≈ 8.93，封橋水位 h ≈ 9.9 m；水位上升速率每小時 0.5 m 時，自 8.0 m 起約 3.8 h 後達到門檻。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Stage–discharge rating Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5. If the closure discharge, at which scour reaches 75% of the available depth, is Q = 8,000 m³/s, then (h − 1.0)^1.5 = 26.7, h − 1.0 = 26.7^(2/3) ≈ 8.93 and the closure stage is h ≈ 9.9 m; rising at 0.5 m per hour from 8.0 m, the trigger is reached in about 3.8 h. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每年汛期前檢討行動計畫：更新聯絡人、確認繞道路線可用、測試告警系統，並以桌上演練或實地演練檢查從觸發到完成封橋所需時間是否短於水位達門檻的預估時間；每次封橋事件後檢討門檻是否合理。

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 水位—流量率定曲線 Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5。若封橋流量取沖刷達可用深度 75% 時的 Q = 8,000 m³/s，(h − 1.0)^1.5 = 26.7，h − 1.0 = 26.7^(2/3) ≈ 8.93，封橋水位 h ≈ 9.9 m；水位上升速率每小時 0.5 m 時，自 8.0 m 起約 3.8 h 後達到門檻。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Stage–discharge rating Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5. If the closure discharge, at which scour reaches 75% of the available depth, is Q = 8,000 m³/s, then (h − 1.0)^1.5 = 26.7, h − 1.0 = 26.7^(2/3) ≈ 8.93 and the closure stage is h ≈ 9.9 m; rising at 0.5 m per hour from 8.0 m, the trigger is reached in about 3.8 h. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 洪後檢查、沖刷紀錄與交接：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「洪後測深與回淤」如何影響橋梁基礎沖刷監測的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-flood sounding and refill” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge-foundation scour monitoring”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 洪峰時沖刷坑最深，退水期間上游來砂又會回填沖刷坑，因此洪後測深看到的河床可能比洪峰時高出許多，回填的鬆散砂土也沒有原土的承載與側向支撐能力。只依洪後測量判斷，會低估基礎曾經暴露的程度。洪後檢查要結合監測紀錄的最低河床、潛水或水下聲納掃描、基礎外觀與墩體傾斜量測，並把結果寫入每座橋的沖刷歷史，作為下一次行動計畫與保護工設計的依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「洪後測深與回淤」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Scour holes are deepest at the flood peak, and on the falling limb incoming sediment refills them, so a post-flood sounding can show the bed much higher than at the peak, and the loose refill lacks the bearing and lateral support of the original soil. Judging only from post-flood surveys underestimates how far the foundation was exposed. Post-flood inspection must combine the minimum bed elevation from monitoring records, diver or underwater sonar scans, foundation condition and pier tilt measurements, and enter the results into each bridge's scour history as the basis for the next plan of action and countermeasure design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-flood sounding and refill” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：洪峰期間聲納記錄最低河床 EL +6.8 m，洪後測深為 EL +8.9 m，回淤 2.1 m；若只看洪後資料，會把最大沖刷低估 2.1 m，相當於第 5 步可用沖刷深度 4.5 m 的約 47%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: During the peak, sonar recorded a minimum bed of EL +6.8 m, while the post-flood sounding shows EL +8.9 m, 2.1 m of refill; relying on post-flood data alone underestimates maximum scour by 2.1 m, about 47% of the 4.5 m available scour depth set at the monitor-installation step.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「洪水過後量到的河床高程，就是洪水期間最深的沖刷位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-flood sounding and refill” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：洪峰期間聲納記錄最低河床 EL +6.8 m，洪後測深為 EL +8.9 m，回淤 2.1 m；若只看洪後資料，會把最大沖刷低估 2.1 m，相當於第 5 步可用沖刷深度 4.5 m 的約 47%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: During the peak, sonar recorded a minimum bed of EL +6.8 m, while the post-flood sounding shows EL +8.9 m, 2.1 m of refill; relying on post-flood data alone underestimates maximum scour by 2.1 m, about 47% of the 4.5 m available scour depth set at the monitor-installation step. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：洪後依程序在安全條件允許時盡快以水下聲納或潛水檢查墩周河床、護坦與基礎外露情形，量測墩體傾斜與沉陷，並與監測系統記錄的最低值及前次基準比較；異常時限制通行，由結構與水利工程師共同評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After a flood, as soon as conditions are safe, inspect the bed around each pier, the apron and any exposed foundation by underwater sonar or divers, measure pier tilt and settlement, and compare with the monitored minimum and previous baselines; if abnormal, restrict traffic pending joint assessment by structural and hydraulic engineers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 洪峰期間聲納記錄最低河床 EL +6.8 m，洪後測深為 EL +8.9 m，回淤 2.1 m；若只看洪後資料，會把最大沖刷低估 2.1 m，相當於第 5 步可用沖刷深度 4.5 m 的約 47%。數值為教學假設。

Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「洪後檢查、沖刷紀錄與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-flood inspection, scour records and handover", which statement holds?
options: 只要是樁基礎，沖刷再深也不會有問題。
裝了監測儀器的橋梁，就等於已經解決了沖刷問題。
洪峰期間聲納記錄最低河床 EL +6.8 m，洪後測深為 EL +8.9 m，回淤 2.1 m。
optionsEn: If a pier stands on piles, scour depth does not matter.
Once a bridge has scour monitors, its scour problem is solved.
During the peak, sonar recorded a minimum bed of EL +6.8 m, while the post-flood sounding shows EL +8.9 m, 2.1 m of refill.
quiz.explanation: 洪峰期間聲納記錄最低河床 EL +6.8 m，洪後測深為 EL +8.9 m，回淤 2.1 m；若只看洪後資料，會把最大沖刷低估 2.1 m，相當於第 5 步可用沖刷深度 4.5 m 的約 47%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: During the peak, sonar recorded a minimum bed of EL +6.8 m, while the post-flood sounding shows EL +8.9 m, 2.1 m of refill; relying on post-flood data alone underestimates maximum scour by 2.1 m, about 47% of the 4.5 m available scour depth set at the monitor-installation step. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 洪後檢查、沖刷紀錄與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-flood inspection, scour records and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洪後測深與回淤」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-flood sounding and refill” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 洪後依程序在安全條件允許時盡快以水下聲納或潛水檢查墩周河床、護坦與基礎外露情形，量測墩體傾斜與沉陷，並與監測系統記錄的最低值及前次基準比較；異常時限制通行，由結構與水利工程師共同評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After a flood, as soon as conditions are safe, inspect the bed around each pier, the apron and any exposed foundation by underwater sonar or divers, measure pier tilt and settlement, and compare with the monitored minimum and previous baselines; if abnormal, restrict traffic pending joint assessment by structural and hydraulic engineers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每座沖刷危急橋梁建立沖刷歷史檔案：基礎竣工資料、臨界沖刷高程、歷次洪水的監測最低值、洪後檢查、保護工施作與補充紀錄、行動計畫版本；資料交接時一併移交儀器設定與資料格式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep a scour history file for each scour-critical bridge: foundation as-built data, critical scour elevation, monitored minimum for each flood, post-flood inspections, countermeasure construction and replenishment records and plan-of-action versions; handover also transfers instrument settings and data formats.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：管理單位只依洪後河床「看起來正常」就解除列管，不知道洪峰時基礎已暴露、回填的是鬆砂；下一場較小的洪水就足以把鬆砂沖走，基礎在毫無準備下再次暴露甚至失穩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An owner who delists a bridge because the post-flood bed looks normal does not know the foundation was exposed at the peak and refilled with loose sand; a smaller next flood washes the loose sand out and exposes or destabilises the foundation with no preparation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 洪後依程序在安全條件允許時盡快以水下聲納或潛水檢查墩周河床、護坦與基礎外露情形，量測墩體傾斜與沉陷，並與監測系統記錄的最低值及前次基準比較；異常時限制通行，由結構與水利工程師共同評估。
knowledge.textEn: After a flood, as soon as conditions are safe, inspect the bed around each pier, the apron and any exposed foundation by underwater sonar or divers, measure pier tilt and settlement, and compare with the monitored minimum and previous baselines; if abnormal, restrict traffic pending joint assessment by structural and hydraulic engineers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每座沖刷危急橋梁建立沖刷歷史檔案：基礎竣工資料、臨界沖刷高程、歷次洪水的監測最低值、洪後檢查、保護工施作與補充紀錄、行動計畫版本；資料交接時一併移交儀器設定與資料格式。
knowledge.textEn: Keep a scour history file for each scour-critical bridge: foundation as-built data, critical scour elevation, monitored minimum for each flood, post-flood inspections, countermeasure construction and replenishment records and plan-of-action versions; handover also transfers instrument settings and data formats.

quiz.question: 要驗證「洪後檢查、沖刷紀錄與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-flood inspection, scour records and handover"?
options: 洪後依程序在安全條件允許時盡快以水下聲納或潛水檢查墩周河床、護坦與基礎外露情形，量測墩體傾斜與沉陷，並與監測系統記錄的最低值及前次基準比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
監測讀值沒有變化，就表示河床很穩定。
optionsEn: After a flood, as soon as conditions are safe, inspect the bed around each pier, the apron and any exposed foundation by underwater sonar or divers, measure pier tilt and settlement, and compare with the monitored minimum and previous baselines.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the monitored reading does not change, the bed is stable.
quiz.explanation: 洪後依程序在安全條件允許時盡快以水下聲納或潛水檢查墩周河床、護坦與基礎外露情形，量測墩體傾斜與沉陷，並與監測系統記錄的最低值及前次基準比較；異常時限制通行，由結構與水利工程師共同評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After a flood, as soon as conditions are safe, inspect the bed around each pier, the apron and any exposed foundation by underwater sonar or divers, measure pier tilt and settlement, and compare with the monitored minimum and previous baselines; if abnormal, restrict traffic pending joint assessment by structural and hydraulic engineers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 洪後檢查、沖刷紀錄與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-flood inspection, scour records and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洪後測深與回淤」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-flood sounding and refill” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 管理單位只依洪後河床「看起來正常」就解除列管，不知道洪峰時基礎已暴露、回填的是鬆砂；下一場較小的洪水就足以把鬆砂沖走，基礎在毫無準備下再次暴露甚至失穩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An owner who delists a bridge because the post-flood bed looks normal does not know the foundation was exposed at the peak and refilled with loose sand; a smaller next flood washes the loose sand out and exposes or destabilises the foundation with no preparation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：洪後檢查要結合監測紀錄的最低河床、潛水或水下聲納掃描、基礎外觀與墩體傾斜量測，並把結果寫入每座橋的沖刷歷史，作為下一次行動計畫與保護工設計的依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Post-flood inspection must combine the minimum bed elevation from monitoring records, diver or underwater sonar scans, foundation condition and pier tilt measurements, and enter the results into each bridge's scour history as the basis for the next plan of action and countermeasure design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「洪水過後量到的河床高程，就是洪水期間最深的沖刷位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The bed elevation measured after a flood is the deepest scour reached during it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 管理單位只依洪後河床「看起來正常」就解除列管，不知道洪峰時基礎已暴露、回填的是鬆砂；下一場較小的洪水就足以把鬆砂沖走，基礎在毫無準備下再次暴露甚至失穩。
knowledge.textEn: An owner who delists a bridge because the post-flood bed looks normal does not know the foundation was exposed at the peak and refilled with loose sand; a smaller next flood washes the loose sand out and exposes or destabilises the foundation with no preparation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「洪後檢查、沖刷紀錄與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-flood inspection, scour records and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
管理單位只依洪後河床「看起來正常」就解除列管，不知道洪峰時基礎已暴露、回填的是鬆砂；下一場較小的洪水就足以把鬆砂沖走，基礎在毫無準備下再次暴露甚至失穩。
洪水沖垮橋梁主要是因為水流的推力太大。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An owner who delists a bridge because the post-flood bed looks normal does not know the foundation was exposed at the peak and refilled with loose sand.
Floods destroy bridges mainly because the water's thrust is too large.
quiz.explanation: 管理單位只依洪後河床「看起來正常」就解除列管，不知道洪峰時基礎已暴露、回填的是鬆砂；下一場較小的洪水就足以把鬆砂沖走，基礎在毫無準備下再次暴露甚至失穩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An owner who delists a bridge because the post-flood bed looks normal does not know the foundation was exposed at the peak and refilled with loose sand; a smaller next flood washes the loose sand out and exposes or destabilises the foundation with no preparation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗
summary: 從 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋的扭轉顫振崩塌出發，建立橋面設計風速、氣動現象分類、斷面外形與扭轉勁度、Scruton 數等結構參數，再處理施工懸臂階段的抗風、節段模型的彈簧懸吊試驗與縮尺換算、全橋氣動彈性模型、營運期渦振與阻尼器改善以及改裝前的風洞複核，並以明石海峽大橋的全橋模型風洞試驗與伏爾加格勒大橋 2010 年振動事件為例。
summaryEn: Starting from the torsional flutter collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940, establish deck design wind speed, the classes of aeroelastic phenomena, section shape and torsional stiffness and structural parameters such as the Scruton number, then cover wind resistance during cantilever erection, spring-mounted section-model tests and scaling, full aeroelastic models, in-service vortex vibration and damper retrofits and aerodynamic rechecks before modifications, using the full-model wind-tunnel tests of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge and the 2010 vibration event on the Volgograd Bridge.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某斜張橋主梁寬 B = 32 m、深 D = 3.5 m，扭轉頻率 f_t = 0.35 Hz、豎向頻率 f_b = 0.12 Hz、每延公尺質量 18,000 kg/m、對數衰減率 0.03。基本風速 40 m/s、橋面高 70 m，取 α = 0.125：U_d = 40×7^0.125 ≈ 51.0 m/s，顫振需求取 1.2 倍約 61.2 m/s。1/50 節段模型、頻率比 f_m/f_p = 5，速度縮尺 (1/50)×5 = 0.1。原斷面在模型 5.6 m/s 發生顫振，對應原型 56 m/s，折減風速 56/(0.35×32) = 5.0，小於 61.2 m/s，不合格；加裝整流罩後折減風速提升到 6.5，原型顫振風速 6.5×0.35×32 ≈ 72.8 m/s，滿足需求。渦振方面，St = 0.11 時豎向渦振臨界風速 U_cr = 0.12×3.5/0.11 ≈ 3.8 m/s，Sc = 2×18,000×0.03/(1.25×3.5²) ≈ 70.5；若完工實測阻尼只有一半，Sc 約 35，渦振振幅約加倍，需預留阻尼器空間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的試驗結果。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a cable-stayed girder is B = 32 m wide and D = 3.5 m deep, with torsional frequency f_t = 0.35 Hz, vertical frequency f_b = 0.12 Hz, 18,000 kg/m mass and a logarithmic decrement of 0.03. With a 40 m/s basic speed, a 70 m deck height and α = 0.125, U_d = 40×7^0.125 ≈ 51.0 m/s, and the flutter requirement at 1.2 times is about 61.2 m/s. A 1/50 section model with frequency ratio f_m/f_p = 5 has velocity scale (1/50)×5 = 0.1. The original section flutters at 5.6 m/s in the model, 56 m/s at full scale, a reduced velocity of 56/(0.35×32) = 5.0, below 61.2 m/s, so it fails; adding fairings raises the reduced velocity to 6.5, giving a full-scale flutter speed of 6.5×0.35×32 ≈ 72.8 m/s, which meets the requirement. For vortex shedding with St = 0.11 the vertical onset speed is U_cr = 0.12×3.5/0.11 ≈ 3.8 m/s and Sc = 2×18,000×0.03/(1.25×3.5²) ≈ 70.5; if as-built damping is only half, Sc is about 35 and vortex amplitude roughly doubles, so space for dampers should be reserved. Values are teaching assumptions, not test results for any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設計風速與風場特性」與「渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics" and "Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋面高度設計風速」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck-level design wind speed” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。海峽與河口地形開闊、粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加較慢但基本值高；山谷地形則可能產生局部加速與強烈紊流。除平均風速外，還要給出紊流強度與積分尺度，因為它們決定了陣風抖振的大小，也影響模型試驗中紊流場的重現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面高度設計風速」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness. Open straits and estuaries have low roughness, so speed grows slowly with height but the base value is high; valleys can produce local speed-up and strong turbulence. Besides mean speed, turbulence intensity and integral length scales must be specified, because they control buffeting response and must be reproduced in model tests. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck-level design wind speed” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋面高度設計風速」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck-level design wind speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設計風速與風場特性
knowledge.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics
knowledge.text: 風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。海峽與河口地形開闊、粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加較慢但基本值高；山谷地形則可能產生局部加速與強烈紊流。
knowledge.textEn: The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness. Open straits and estuaries have low roughness, so speed grows slowly with height but the base value is high; valleys can produce local speed-up and strong turbulence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設計風速與風場特性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics" is correct?
options: 橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。
風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。
只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。
optionsEn: A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record.

The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness.
If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it.
quiz.explanation: 風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面高度設計風速」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck-level design wind speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。若基本風速 46 m/s、橋面高約 97 m、取 α = 1/8（教學假設），U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s，與明石海峽大橋公開的加勁梁設計風速 60 m/s 相近；若 α 改為 1/6，同高度風速約 67 m/s。數值除註明者外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. With a basic wind speed of 46 m/s, a deck about 97 m above the sea and α = 1/8 as a teaching assumption, U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s, close to the published 60 m/s girder design wind speed of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge; with α = 1/6 the speed at the same height is about 67 m/s. Values other than those cited are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。若基本風速 46 m/s、橋面高約 97 m、取 α = 1/8（教學假設），U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s，與明石海峽大橋公開的加勁梁設計風速 60 m/s 相近；若 α 改為 1/6，同高度風速約 67 m/s。數值除註明者外為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. With a basic wind speed of 46 m/s, a deck about 97 m above the sea and α = 1/8 as a teaching assumption, U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s, close to the published 60 m/s girder design wind speed of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge; with α = 1/6 the speed at the same height is about 67 m/s. Values other than those cited are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設計風速與風場特性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics", which statement holds?
options: 結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。
懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。
冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。
optionsEn: Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests.
As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety.
Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α.
quiz.explanation: 冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面高度設計風速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck-level design wind speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風工程報告的第一章要列出基本風速、回歸期、地況分類、橋面與塔頂設計風速、紊流強度與積分尺度，並說明資料來源；後續所有試驗與分析都引用同一組參數，變更時須全面更新。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The first chapter of the wind-engineering report lists basic speed, return period, terrain category, deck and tower-top design speeds, turbulence intensity and integral scales with their sources; every later test and analysis cites the same set, and any change triggers a full update.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target; wrong turbulence parameters distort buffeting response and fatigue assessment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。
knowledge.textEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風工程報告的第一章要列出基本風速、回歸期、地況分類、橋面與塔頂設計風速、紊流強度與積分尺度，並說明資料來源；後續所有試驗與分析都引用同一組參數，變更時須全面更新。
knowledge.textEn: The first chapter of the wind-engineering report lists basic speed, return period, terrain category, deck and tower-top design speeds, turbulence intensity and integral scales with their sources; every later test and analysis cites the same set, and any change triggers a full update.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設計風速與風場特性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics"?
options: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。
optionsEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction.
quiz.explanation: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋面高度設計風速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck-level design wind speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target; wrong turbulence parameters distort buffeting response and fatigue assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：除平均風速外，還要給出紊流強度與積分尺度，因為它們決定了陣風抖振的大小，也影響模型試驗中紊流場的重現。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Besides mean speed, turbulence intensity and integral length scales must be specified, because they control buffeting response and must be reproduced in model tests.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。
knowledge.textEn: Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target; wrong turbulence parameters distort buffeting response and fatigue assessment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設計風速與風場特性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。
只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target.
If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it.
quiz.explanation: 以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target; wrong turbulence parameters distort buffeting response and fatigue assessment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 風對長跨橋面造成四類動力問題：渦流脫落在特定風速鎖定結構頻率，引起有限振幅的渦振，常在低風速出現而影響舒適與疲勞；馳振是鈍形斷面在單一方向的自激振動，振幅隨風速無限增長；顫振是彎曲與扭轉耦合（或純扭轉）的自激振動，一旦超過臨界風速，氣動力持續輸入能量而發散；抖振則是紊流造成的隨機強迫振動，不會發散但控制強度與疲勞。風洞試驗要分別找出前三者的發生風速，並量測抖振的反應大小。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wind causes four classes of dynamic problems on long-span decks: vortex shedding locks onto a structural frequency at particular speeds and causes limited-amplitude vortex-induced vibration, often at low speed and affecting comfort and fatigue; galloping is a single-direction self-excited motion of bluff sections whose amplitude grows without limit with speed; flutter is self-excited coupled bending–torsion or pure torsion that diverges beyond a critical speed as the airflow keeps feeding energy; buffeting is random forced vibration from turbulence that does not diverge but governs strength and fatigue. Wind-tunnel tests must find the onset speeds of the first three and measure buffeting response. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：渦振臨界風速 U_cr = f·D/St。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vortex-shedding onset U_cr = f·D/St. With deck depth D = 4 m, vertical frequency f = 0.15 Hz and St = 0.10: U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s, a common wind speed, so vibration will occur frequently; a more streamlined section with St = 0.20 gives U_cr = 3.0 m/s but usually less energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：渦振臨界風速 U_cr = f·D/St。梁深 D = 4 m、豎向頻率 f = 0.15 Hz、St = 0.10：U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s，屬常見風速，振動會頻繁發生；若改為 St = 0.20 的較流線斷面，U_cr 降為 3.0 m/s，但能量通常較小。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vortex-shedding onset U_cr = f·D/St. With deck depth D = 4 m, vertical frequency f = 0.15 Hz and St = 0.10: U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s, a common wind speed, so vibration will occur frequently; a more streamlined section with St = 0.20 gives U_cr = 3.0 m/s but usually less energy. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在節段模型試驗中由低至高逐級提高風速，記錄每一風速的豎向與扭轉振幅，畫出振幅—風速曲線，辨識渦振鎖定區、馳振或顫振的起始風速，並以不同攻角（例如 −3°、0°、+3°）重複，找出最不利情況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In section-model tests raise wind speed step by step, record vertical and torsional amplitude at each step and plot amplitude against speed to identify lock-in ranges and the onset of galloping or flutter, repeating at several angles of attack such as −3°, 0° and +3° to find the worst case.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在節段模型試驗中由低至高逐級提高風速，記錄每一風速的豎向與扭轉振幅，畫出振幅—風速曲線，辨識渦振鎖定區、馳振或顫振的起始風速，並以不同攻角（例如 −3°、0°、+3°）重複，找出最不利情況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In section-model tests raise wind speed step by step, record vertical and torsional amplitude at each step and plot amplitude against speed to identify lock-in ranges and the onset of galloping or flutter, repeating at several angles of attack such as −3°, 0° and +3° to find the worst case. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計審查要求風工程報告分別列出渦振、馳振、顫振的檢核結果與抖振反應，並說明每一項採用的允收準則；任何一項無法以計算確認時，必須以風洞試驗驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design review requires the wind report to list results for vortex shedding, galloping and flutter and the buffeting response separately, with the acceptance criterion for each; any item that cannot be confirmed by calculation must be verified by wind-tunnel test.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：1940 年 11 月 7 日，主跨約 853 m、以 8 呎深板梁為加勁梁的塔科馬海峽橋，在約 40 mph（64 km/h）的風中發生扭轉振動，振幅不斷增大直到吊索斷裂、橋面墜落；這不是靜力風壓過大，而是氣動自激振動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: On 7 November 1940 the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, with a main span of about 853 m stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders, twisted in a wind of about 40 mph (64 km/h) with growing amplitude until suspenders broke and the deck fell; the cause was aeroelastic self-excitation, not excessive static wind pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 1940 年 11 月 7 日，主跨約 853 m、以 8 呎深板梁為加勁梁的塔科馬海峽橋，在約 40 mph（64 km/h）的風中發生扭轉振動，振幅不斷增大直到吊索斷裂、橋面墜落；這不是靜力風壓過大，而是氣動自激振動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: On 7 November 1940 the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, with a main span of about 853 m stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders, twisted in a wind of about 40 mph (64 km/h) with growing amplitude until suspenders broke and the deck fell; the cause was aeroelastic self-excitation, not excessive static wind pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：風洞試驗要分別找出前三者的發生風速，並量測抖振的反應大小。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wind-tunnel tests must find the onset speeds of the first three and measure buffeting response.

knowledge.textEn: On 7 November 1940 the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, with a main span of about 853 m stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders, twisted in a wind of about 40 mph (64 km/h) with growing amplitude until suspenders broke and the deck fell; the cause was aeroelastic self-excitation, not excessive static wind pressure.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「橋面斷面外形與扭轉勁度」與「質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Deck section shape and torsional stiffness" and "Mass, damping and the Scruton number": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 橋面斷面外形與扭轉勁度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Deck section shape and torsional stiffness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斷面外形與扭轉常數 J」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section shape and torsion constant J” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋面斷面決定了氣流如何分離與再附著：寬而淺、兩端尖削的流線箱梁能讓氣流平順通過，顫振臨界風速高；開口板梁或鈍形斷面則在前緣強烈分離，容易產生渦流與扭轉自激。塔科馬海峽橋寬約 39 呎、梁深 8 呎，寬深比低又是開口斷面，扭轉勁度極小。改善方法包括閉合箱梁、加導流板（整流罩）、中央開槽或格柵，以及加深的桁架加勁梁；閉合斷面的扭轉勁度遠高於開口斷面，使扭轉頻率與彎曲頻率分開，提升顫振風速。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斷面外形與扭轉常數 J」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The deck section governs how flow separates and reattaches: a wide, shallow streamlined box with tapered edges lets air pass smoothly and has a high flutter speed, while an open plate-girder or bluff section separates strongly at the leading edge and readily sheds vortices and self-excites in torsion. The Tacoma Narrows deck was about 39 ft wide and 8 ft deep, a low width-to-depth ratio on an open section with tiny torsional stiffness. Remedies include closed boxes, fairings, central slots or gratings and deeper truss stiffening girders; a closed section is far stiffer in torsion than an open one, separating torsional from bending frequency and raising flutter speed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Section shape and torsion constant J” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Closed box J = 4A²/∮(ds/t): for 30 m×3 m with 14 mm equivalent plate, A = 90 m² and ∮ds/t = 66/0.014 ≈ 4,714, so J ≈ 4×8,100/4,714 ≈ 6.87 m⁴; an open twin-girder section of the same size has J = Σbt³/3 = (2×3×0.02³ + 30×0.014³)/3 ≈ 4.3×10⁻⁵ m⁴, about 158,000 times smaller.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋面斷面只影響外觀與交通，風洞試驗只需要看主梁本體。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The deck section affects only appearance and traffic, so tests need only the bare girder." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斷面外形與扭轉常數 J」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Section shape and torsion constant J”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 橋面斷面外形與扭轉勁度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deck section shape and torsional stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斷面外形與扭轉常數 J」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Section shape and torsion constant J” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：閉合箱梁 J = 4A²/∮(ds/t)：30 m×3 m、等效板厚 14 mm，A = 90 m²，∮ds/t = 66/0.014 ≈ 4,714，J ≈ 4×8,100/4,714 ≈ 6.87 m⁴；同尺寸開口雙板梁 J = Σbt³/3 = (2×3×0.02³ + 30×0.014³)/3 ≈ 4.3×10⁻⁵ m⁴，約小 158,000 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Closed box J = 4A²/∮(ds/t): for 30 m×3 m with 14 mm equivalent plate, A = 90 m² and ∮ds/t = 66/0.014 ≈ 4,714, so J ≈ 4×8,100/4,714 ≈ 6.87 m⁴; an open twin-girder section of the same size has J = Σbt³/3 = (2×3×0.02³ + 30×0.014³)/3 ≈ 4.3×10⁻⁵ m⁴, about 158,000 times smaller. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型計算扭轉與彎曲頻率比，並在概念階段以多個候選斷面做快速節段模型試驗或計算流體力學比較，選出氣動性能最佳者；確定斷面後，連同欄杆、防風牆、檢修車軌道等附屬物的實際外形一起試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the torsion-to-bending frequency ratio with a finite-element model, compare several candidate sections at concept stage by quick section-model tests or computational fluid dynamics to choose the best aerodynamic form, and once the section is fixed, test it with the real geometry of railings, wind screens and inspection-gantry rails.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Closed box J = 4A²/∮(ds/t): for 30 m×3 m with 14 mm equivalent plate, A = 90 m² and ∮ds/t = 66/0.014 ≈ 4,714, so J ≈ 4×8,100/4,714 ≈ 6.87 m⁴; an open twin-girder section of the same size has J = Σbt³/3 = (2×3×0.02³ + 30×0.014³)/3 ≈ 4.3×10⁻⁵ m⁴, about 158,000 times smaller. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「橋面斷面外形與扭轉勁度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
