optionsEn: As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety.
Closed box J = 4A²/∮(ds/t): for 30 m×3 m with 14 mm equivalent plate, A = 90 m² and ∮ds/t = 66/0.014 ≈ 4,714, so J ≈ 4×8,100/4,714 ≈ 6.87 m⁴.
If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction.
quiz.explanationEn: Closed box J = 4A²/∮(ds/t): for 30 m×3 m with 14 mm equivalent plate, A = 90 m² and ∮ds/t = 66/0.014 ≈ 4,714, so J ≈ 4×8,100/4,714 ≈ 6.87 m⁴; an open twin-girder section of the same size has J = Σbt³/3 = (2×3×0.02³ + 30×0.014³)/3 ≈ 4.3×10⁻⁵ m⁴, about 158,000 times smaller. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 橋面斷面外形與扭轉勁度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deck section shape and torsional stiffness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷面外形與扭轉常數 J」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section shape and torsion constant J” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型計算扭轉與彎曲頻率比，並在概念階段以多個候選斷面做快速節段模型試驗或計算流體力學比較，選出氣動性能最佳者；確定斷面後，連同欄杆、防風牆、檢修車軌道等附屬物的實際外形一起試驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the torsion-to-bending frequency ratio with a finite-element model, compare several candidate sections at concept stage by quick section-model tests or computational fluid dynamics to choose the best aerodynamic form, and once the section is fixed, test it with the real geometry of railings, wind screens and inspection-gantry rails. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風洞模型必須包含欄杆、防風牆、排水溝、檢修車軌道等外露附屬物的正確幾何；設計凍結後，任何改變外形的變更都要經風工程師書面評估，必要時重新試驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Wind-tunnel models must include the correct geometry of railings, wind screens, gutters and gantry rails; after design freeze, any change to the external shape requires the wind engineer's written assessment and, if needed, retesting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：設計後期為了景觀或施工方便把箱梁兩端改鈍、或在邊緣加裝實心欄杆，未重新試驗，結果渦振振幅與顫振風速都與原試驗不同；細小的附屬物也可能決定氣流分離位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Late changes that blunt the box edges for appearance or buildability, or add solid parapets at the edges, without retesting change both vortex amplitudes and flutter speed from the original test; small attachments can decide where flow separates. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 橋面斷面外形與扭轉勁度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deck section shape and torsional stiffness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷面外形與扭轉常數 J」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Section shape and torsion constant J” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 設計後期為了景觀或施工方便把箱梁兩端改鈍、或在邊緣加裝實心欄杆，未重新試驗，結果渦振振幅與顫振風速都與原試驗不同；細小的附屬物也可能決定氣流分離位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Late changes that blunt the box edges for appearance or buildability, or add solid parapets at the edges, without retesting change both vortex amplitudes and flutter speed from the original test; small attachments can decide where flow separates. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：改善方法包括閉合箱梁、加導流板（整流罩）、中央開槽或格柵，以及加深的桁架加勁梁；閉合斷面的扭轉勁度遠高於開口斷面，使扭轉頻率與彎曲頻率分開，提升顫振風速。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Remedies include closed boxes, fairings, central slots or gratings and deeper truss stiffening girders; a closed section is far stiffer in torsion than an open one, separating torsional from bending frequency and raising flutter speed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋面斷面只影響外觀與交通，風洞試驗只需要看主梁本體。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The deck section affects only appearance and traffic, so tests need only the bare girder." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 設計後期為了景觀或施工方便把箱梁兩端改鈍、或在邊緣加裝實心欄杆，未重新試驗，結果渦振振幅與顫振風速都與原試驗不同；細小的附屬物也可能決定氣流分離位置。
knowledge.textEn: Late changes that blunt the box edges for appearance or buildability, or add solid parapets at the edges, without retesting change both vortex amplitudes and flutter speed from the original test; small attachments can decide where flow separates.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「橋面斷面外形與扭轉勁度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deck section shape and torsional stiffness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 設計後期為了景觀或施工方便把箱梁兩端改鈍、或在邊緣加裝實心欄杆，未重新試驗，結果渦振振幅與顫振風速都與原試驗不同；細小的附屬物也可能決定氣流分離位置。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。
optionsEn: Late changes that blunt the box edges for appearance or buildability, or add solid parapets at the edges, without retesting change both vortex amplitudes and flutter speed from the original test.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests.
quiz.explanation: 設計後期為了景觀或施工方便把箱梁兩端改鈍、或在邊緣加裝實心欄杆，未重新試驗，結果渦振振幅與顫振風速都與原試驗不同；細小的附屬物也可能決定氣流分離位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Late changes that blunt the box edges for appearance or buildability, or add solid parapets at the edges, without retesting change both vortex amplitudes and flutter speed from the original test; small attachments can decide where flow separates. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Mass, damping and the Scruton number: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「質量阻尼參數 Sc」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scruton number Sc” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 同一個斷面外形，振動大小還取決於結構本身的質量與阻尼：每延公尺質量越大、阻尼越高，風輸入的能量越難把結構推動。Scruton 數把質量、對數衰減率與空氣密度、斷面深度合成一個無因次參數，渦振振幅大致隨 Scruton 數增加而減小。鋼橋的結構阻尼通常很低，混凝土橋較高；施工中或完工後的實際阻尼常與設計假設不同，因此試驗時要以合理偏低的阻尼檢核，並在完工後實測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「質量阻尼參數 Sc」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a given section shape, response size also depends on the structure's mass and damping: the greater the mass per metre and the higher the damping, the harder it is for wind energy to drive the structure. The Scruton number combines mass, logarithmic decrement, air density and section depth into one dimensionless parameter, and vortex amplitude falls roughly as it rises. Steel bridges usually have very low structural damping and concrete bridges more; actual damping during and after construction often differs from design assumptions, so tests use a reasonably low damping value and damping is measured after completion. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Scruton number Sc” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「質量阻尼參數 Sc」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Scruton number Sc”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Mass, damping and the Scruton number

The Scruton number combines mass, logarithmic decrement, air density and section depth into one dimensionless parameter, and vortex amplitude falls roughly as it rises.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mass, damping and the Scruton number" is correct?
options: 結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。
同一個斷面外形，振動大小還取決於結構本身的質量與阻尼：每延公尺質量越大、阻尼越高，風輸入的能量越難把結構推動。
施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。

For a given section shape, response size also depends on the structure's mass and damping: the greater the mass per metre and the higher the damping, the harder it is for wind energy to drive the structure.
Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test.

quiz.explanationEn: For a given section shape, response size also depends on the structure's mass and damping: the greater the mass per metre and the higher the damping, the harder it is for wind energy to drive the structure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mass, damping and the Scruton number: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「質量阻尼參數 Sc」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scruton number Sc” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²)。m = 20,000 kg/m、δ = 0.03、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³、D = 4 m：Sc = 2×20,000×0.03/(1.25×16) = 60；若實際對數衰減率只有 0.015，Sc 降為 30，渦振振幅約加倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²). With m = 20,000 kg/m, δ = 0.03, ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ and D = 4 m: Sc = 2×20,000×0.03/(1.25×16) = 60; if the actual logarithmic decrement is only 0.015, Sc falls to 30 and vortex amplitude roughly doubles. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：節段模型的質量、質量慣性矩與阻尼要依縮尺換算並量測確認（以自由衰減求模型阻尼）；完工後以環境振動或強迫振動實測橋梁的頻率與阻尼，與試驗假設比較，若阻尼明顯偏低則重新評估渦振振幅。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The section model's mass, mass moment of inertia and damping are scaled and measured (model damping from free decay); after completion, measure the bridge's frequencies and damping by ambient or forced vibration and compare with test assumptions, re-evaluating vortex amplitudes if damping is clearly lower.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²)。m = 20,000 kg/m、δ = 0.03、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³、D = 4 m：Sc = 2×20,000×0.03/(1.25×16) = 60；若實際對數衰減率只有 0.015，Sc 降為 30，渦振振幅約加倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²). With m = 20,000 kg/m, δ = 0.03, ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ and D = 4 m: Sc = 2×20,000×0.03/(1.25×16) = 60; if the actual logarithmic decrement is only 0.015, Sc falls to 30 and vortex amplitude roughly doubles. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mass, damping and the Scruton number", which statement holds?
options: 縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。
完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。
Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²)。
optionsEn: If a scale model has the right shape, tunnel wind speed equals real wind speed.
A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service.
Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²).
quiz.explanation: Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Sc = 2·m·δ/(ρ·D²). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mass, damping and the Scruton number: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「質量阻尼參數 Sc」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scruton number Sc” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 節段模型的質量、質量慣性矩與阻尼要依縮尺換算並量測確認（以自由衰減求模型阻尼）；完工後以環境振動或強迫振動實測橋梁的頻率與阻尼，與試驗假設比較，若阻尼明顯偏低則重新評估渦振振幅。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The section model's mass, mass moment of inertia and damping are scaled and measured (model damping from free decay); after completion, measure the bridge's frequencies and damping by ambient or forced vibration and compare with test assumptions, re-evaluating vortex amplitudes if damping is clearly lower. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風洞報告要明示試驗採用的阻尼值及其依據，並提供不同阻尼下的振幅敏感度；合約中預留完工後實測阻尼與必要時加裝阻尼器的條款與空間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The wind report states the damping used and its basis and gives amplitude sensitivity to damping; the contract reserves post-completion damping measurement and the space and provisions to add dampers if needed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試驗時採用偏高的阻尼，報告結論為渦振振幅可接受；完工後鋼橋實際阻尼只有一半，在每天常見的風速下出現明顯上下振動，行車舒適度與構件疲勞都成為問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using optimistic damping in tests leads to a report that vortex amplitudes are acceptable; after completion the steel bridge has only half that damping and shows obvious vertical motion in everyday winds, creating ride-comfort and fatigue problems. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 節段模型的質量、質量慣性矩與阻尼要依縮尺換算並量測確認（以自由衰減求模型阻尼）；完工後以環境振動或強迫振動實測橋梁的頻率與阻尼，與試驗假設比較，若阻尼明顯偏低則重新評估渦振振幅。
knowledge.textEn: The section model's mass, mass moment of inertia and damping are scaled and measured (model damping from free decay); after completion, measure the bridge's frequencies and damping by ambient or forced vibration and compare with test assumptions, re-evaluating vortex amplitudes if damping is clearly lower.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風洞報告要明示試驗採用的阻尼值及其依據，並提供不同阻尼下的振幅敏感度；合約中預留完工後實測阻尼與必要時加裝阻尼器的條款與空間。
knowledge.textEn: The wind report states the damping used and its basis and gives amplitude sensitivity to damping; the contract reserves post-completion damping measurement and the space and provisions to add dampers if needed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mass, damping and the Scruton number"?
options: 節段模型的質量、質量慣性矩與阻尼要依縮尺換算並量測確認（以自由衰減求模型阻尼）。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。
optionsEn: The section model's mass, mass moment of inertia and damping are scaled and measured (model damping from free decay).
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record.
quiz.explanation: 節段模型的質量、質量慣性矩與阻尼要依縮尺換算並量測確認（以自由衰減求模型阻尼）；完工後以環境振動或強迫振動實測橋梁的頻率與阻尼，與試驗假設比較，若阻尼明顯偏低則重新評估渦振振幅。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The section model's mass, mass moment of inertia and damping are scaled and measured (model damping from free decay); after completion, measure the bridge's frequencies and damping by ambient or forced vibration and compare with test assumptions, re-evaluating vortex amplitudes if damping is clearly lower. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.instructionEn: Using optimistic damping in tests leads to a report that vortex amplitudes are acceptable; after completion the steel bridge has only half that damping and shows obvious vertical motion in everyday winds, creating ride-comfort and fatigue problems. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼橋的結構阻尼通常很低，混凝土橋較高；施工中或完工後的實際阻尼常與設計假設不同，因此試驗時要以合理偏低的阻尼檢核，並在完工後實測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Steel bridges usually have very low structural damping and concrete bridges more; actual damping during and after construction often differs from design assumptions, so tests use a reasonably low damping value and damping is measured after completion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試驗時採用偏高的阻尼，報告結論為渦振振幅可接受；完工後鋼橋實際阻尼只有一半，在每天常見的風速下出現明顯上下振動，行車舒適度與構件疲勞都成為問題。
knowledge.textEn: Using optimistic damping in tests leads to a report that vortex amplitudes are acceptable; after completion the steel bridge has only half that damping and shows obvious vertical motion in everyday winds, creating ride-comfort and fatigue problems.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「質量、阻尼與 Scruton 數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mass, damping and the Scruton number" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
試驗時採用偏高的阻尼，報告結論為渦振振幅可接受；完工後鋼橋實際阻尼只有一半，在每天常見的風速下出現明顯上下振動，行車舒適度與構件疲勞都成為問題。
施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using optimistic damping in tests leads to a report that vortex amplitudes are acceptable.
Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test.
quiz.explanation: 試驗時採用偏高的阻尼，報告結論為渦振振幅可接受；完工後鋼橋實際阻尼只有一半，在每天常見的風速下出現明顯上下振動，行車舒適度與構件疲勞都成為問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using optimistic damping in tests leads to a report that vortex amplitudes are acceptable; after completion the steel bridge has only half that damping and shows obvious vertical motion in everyday winds, creating ride-comfort and fatigue problems. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工階段的氣動穩定」與「施工期抗風措施與作業風速」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Aerodynamic stability during erection" and "Erection-stage wind measures and working limits": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工階段的氣動穩定：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic stability during erection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「最大懸臂階段」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Longest cantilever stage” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋梁在施工中往往比完工後更怕風：斜張橋單側或雙側懸臂伸出時，沒有另一端的支撐，彎曲與扭轉頻率都比完工狀態低；懸索橋在加勁梁分段吊裝、接頭尚未全部鎖固時，扭轉勁度特別小。施工階段的風速檢核可以採用較短的回歸期，但因為頻率降低、阻尼不確定，渦振與顫振的臨界風速可能落入常見範圍。因此風洞試驗必須涵蓋關鍵施工階段，而不只是完工狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「最大懸臂階段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bridges are often more vulnerable to wind during construction than when complete: a cable-stayed cantilever reaching out on one or both sides has no support at its far end, so bending and torsional frequencies are lower than in the finished state; a suspension bridge whose deck segments are being lifted with joints not yet locked has particularly low torsional stiffness. Construction-stage wind checks may use a shorter return period, but with reduced frequencies and uncertain damping the vortex and flutter onset speeds can fall into the common range. Wind-tunnel tests must therefore cover the critical construction stages, not only the completed state. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Longest cantilever stage” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸臂頻率約與長度平方成反比 f ∝ 1/L²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Cantilever frequency varies roughly as 1/L².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「最大懸臂階段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Longest cantilever stage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工階段的氣動穩定
knowledge.text: 橋梁在施工中往往比完工後更怕風：斜張橋單側或雙側懸臂伸出時，沒有另一端的支撐，彎曲與扭轉頻率都比完工狀態低；懸索橋在加勁梁分段吊裝、接頭尚未全部鎖固時，扭轉勁度特別小。施工階段的風速檢核可以採用較短的回歸期，但因為頻率降低、阻尼不確定，渦振與顫振的臨界風速可能落入常見範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Bridges are often more vulnerable to wind during construction than when complete: a cable-stayed cantilever reaching out on one or both sides has no support at its far end, so bending and torsional frequencies are lower than in the finished state; a suspension bridge whose deck segments are being lifted with joints not yet locked has particularly low torsional stiffness. Construction-stage wind checks may use a shorter return period, but with reduced frequencies and uncertain damping the vortex and flutter onset speeds can fall into the common range.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工階段的氣動穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Aerodynamic stability during erection" is correct?
options: 施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。
懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。
橋梁在施工中往往比完工後更怕風：斜張橋單側或雙側懸臂伸出時，沒有另一端的支撐，彎曲與扭轉頻率都比完工狀態低。
optionsEn: Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test.
As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety.

Bridges are often more vulnerable to wind during construction than when complete: a cable-stayed cantilever reaching out on one or both sides has no support at its far end, so bending and torsional frequencies are lower than in the finished state.
quiz.explanation: 橋梁在施工中往往比完工後更怕風：斜張橋單側或雙側懸臂伸出時，沒有另一端的支撐，彎曲與扭轉頻率都比完工狀態低；懸索橋在加勁梁分段吊裝、接頭尚未全部鎖固時，扭轉勁度特別小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bridges are often more vulnerable to wind during construction than when complete: a cable-stayed cantilever reaching out on one or both sides has no support at its far end, so bending and torsional frequencies are lower than in the finished state; a suspension bridge whose deck segments are being lifted with joints not yet locked has particularly low torsional stiffness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工階段的氣動穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic stability during erection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「最大懸臂階段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Longest cantilever stage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸臂頻率約與長度平方成反比 f ∝ 1/L²。最大懸臂由 150 m 增為 200 m，頻率降為 (150/200)² ≈ 0.56 倍：扭轉頻率 0.60 Hz 降為約 0.34 Hz，渦振臨界風速由 6.0 m/s 降為約 3.4 m/s，顫振風速亦隨扭轉頻率約按比例下降。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Cantilever frequency varies roughly as 1/L². Growing the longest cantilever from 150 m to 200 m multiplies frequency by (150/200)² ≈ 0.56: a 0.60 Hz torsional frequency falls to about 0.34 Hz, the vortex onset speed from 6.0 to about 3.4 m/s, and flutter speed drops roughly in proportion to torsional frequency. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析找出頻率最低、最不利的幾個階段，製作對應的節段或全橋施工模型試驗；檢核採用的回歸期與風速要經業主核定，並與施工期程中的颱風季節對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use staged analysis to find the lowest-frequency, most critical stages and test the corresponding section or full-bridge erection models; the return period and wind speed used must be approved by the owner and compared with typhoon seasons in the construction schedule.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸臂頻率約與長度平方成反比 f ∝ 1/L²。最大懸臂由 150 m 增為 200 m，頻率降為 (150/200)² ≈ 0.56 倍：扭轉頻率 0.60 Hz 降為約 0.34 Hz，渦振臨界風速由 6.0 m/s 降為約 3.4 m/s，顫振風速亦隨扭轉頻率約按比例下降。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Cantilever frequency varies roughly as 1/L². Growing the longest cantilever from 150 m to 200 m multiplies frequency by (150/200)² ≈ 0.56: a 0.60 Hz torsional frequency falls to about 0.34 Hz, the vortex onset speed from 6.0 to about 3.4 m/s, and flutter speed drops roughly in proportion to torsional frequency. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工階段的氣動穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Aerodynamic stability during erection", which statement holds?
options: 懸臂頻率約與長度平方成反比 f ∝ 1/L²。
節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。
加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。
optionsEn: Cantilever frequency varies roughly as 1/L².
If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction.
Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability.
quiz.explanation: 懸臂頻率約與長度平方成反比 f ∝ 1/L²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Cantilever frequency varies roughly as 1/L². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工階段的氣動穩定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic stability during erection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「最大懸臂階段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Longest cantilever stage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析找出頻率最低、最不利的幾個階段，製作對應的節段或全橋施工模型試驗；檢核採用的回歸期與風速要經業主核定，並與施工期程中的颱風季節對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use staged analysis to find the lowest-frequency, most critical stages and test the corresponding section or full-bridge erection models; the return period and wind speed used must be approved by the owner and compared with typhoon seasons in the construction schedule. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工計畫要列出每個關鍵階段的容許風速、臨時穩定措施與颱風來臨前的固定程序，並經風工程師與設計者確認；最大懸臂階段盡量避開颱風季。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The construction plan lists allowable wind speeds, temporary stabilising measures and pre-typhoon securing procedures for each critical stage, confirmed by the wind engineer and designer; schedule the longest cantilever outside the typhoon season where possible.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只做完工狀態的風洞試驗，施工時最長懸臂在中等強風下出現大幅扭轉振動，迫使停工並緊急加設臨時穩定索；若振動造成吊裝設備或臨時接頭損壞，後果可能比完工後更嚴重。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the completed state lets the longest cantilever twist heavily in a moderate gale during construction, forcing a stop and emergency temporary stays; if the motion damages lifting equipment or temporary joints, the consequences can exceed anything in service. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段分析找出頻率最低、最不利的幾個階段，製作對應的節段或全橋施工模型試驗；檢核採用的回歸期與風速要經業主核定，並與施工期程中的颱風季節對照。
knowledge.textEn: Use staged analysis to find the lowest-frequency, most critical stages and test the corresponding section or full-bridge erection models; the return period and wind speed used must be approved by the owner and compared with typhoon seasons in the construction schedule.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工計畫要列出每個關鍵階段的容許風速、臨時穩定措施與颱風來臨前的固定程序，並經風工程師與設計者確認；最大懸臂階段盡量避開颱風季。
knowledge.textEn: The construction plan lists allowable wind speeds, temporary stabilising measures and pre-typhoon securing procedures for each critical stage, confirmed by the wind engineer and designer; schedule the longest cantilever outside the typhoon season where possible.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工階段的氣動穩定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Aerodynamic stability during erection"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以施工階段分析找出頻率最低、最不利的幾個階段，製作對應的節段或全橋施工模型試驗；檢核採用的回歸期與風速要經業主核定，並與施工期程中的颱風季節對照。
只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Use staged analysis to find the lowest-frequency, most critical stages and test the corresponding section or full-bridge erection models.
If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it.
quiz.explanation: 以施工階段分析找出頻率最低、最不利的幾個階段，製作對應的節段或全橋施工模型試驗；檢核採用的回歸期與風速要經業主核定，並與施工期程中的颱風季節對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use staged analysis to find the lowest-frequency, most critical stages and test the corresponding section or full-bridge erection models; the return period and wind speed used must be approved by the owner and compared with typhoon seasons in the construction schedule. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工階段的氣動穩定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aerodynamic stability during erection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「最大懸臂階段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Longest cantilever stage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只做完工狀態的風洞試驗，施工時最長懸臂在中等強風下出現大幅扭轉振動，迫使停工並緊急加設臨時穩定索；若振動造成吊裝設備或臨時接頭損壞，後果可能比完工後更嚴重。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only the completed state lets the longest cantilever twist heavily in a moderate gale during construction, forcing a stop and emergency temporary stays; if the motion damages lifting equipment or temporary joints, the consequences can exceed anything in service. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此風洞試驗必須涵蓋關鍵施工階段，而不只是完工狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wind-tunnel tests must therefore cover the critical construction stages, not only the completed state.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只做完工狀態的風洞試驗，施工時最長懸臂在中等強風下出現大幅扭轉振動，迫使停工並緊急加設臨時穩定索；若振動造成吊裝設備或臨時接頭損壞，後果可能比完工後更嚴重。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only the completed state lets the longest cantilever twist heavily in a moderate gale during construction, forcing a stop and emergency temporary stays; if the motion damages lifting equipment or temporary joints, the consequences can exceed anything in service.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工階段的氣動穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Aerodynamic stability during erection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。
只做完工狀態的風洞試驗，施工時最長懸臂在中等強風下出現大幅扭轉振動，迫使停工並緊急加設臨時穩定索；若振動造成吊裝設備或臨時接頭損壞，後果可能比完工後更嚴重。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety.
Testing only the completed state lets the longest cantilever twist heavily in a moderate gale during construction, forcing a stop and emergency temporary stays.
quiz.explanation: 只做完工狀態的風洞試驗，施工時最長懸臂在中等強風下出現大幅扭轉振動，迫使停工並緊急加設臨時穩定索；若振動造成吊裝設備或臨時接頭損壞，後果可能比完工後更嚴重。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only the completed state lets the longest cantilever twist heavily in a moderate gale during construction, forcing a stop and emergency temporary stays; if the motion damages lifting equipment or temporary joints, the consequences can exceed anything in service. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工期抗風措施與作業風速：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Erection-stage wind measures and working limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「臨時穩定索與吊裝風速」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temporary stays and lifting wind limits” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 施工期的抗風措施分為結構與作業兩類：結構措施包括臨時穩定索把懸臂端拉到地面或墩上、臨時支墩縮短懸臂長度、在懸臂端加裝臨時調諧質量阻尼器，以及調整吊裝順序讓扭轉勁度較早形成；作業措施則是以現地風速計即時監控，超過門檻時停止吊裝、鎖固吊具與梁段。懸臂越長，橫向風力在塔或墩底產生的彎矩越大，臨時措施也要能承受颱風等級的風力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「臨時穩定索與吊裝風速」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Erection-stage wind measures are structural and operational. Structural measures include temporary stays tying the cantilever tip down to the ground or a pier, temporary supports that shorten the cantilever, temporary tuned mass dampers at the tip and erection sequences that build torsional stiffness earlier; operational measures use site anemometers for real-time monitoring, stopping lifts and securing lifting gear and segments above set thresholds. The longer the cantilever, the larger the moment that lateral wind creates at the pylon or pier base, and temporary measures must also resist typhoon-level wind. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Temporary stays and lifting wind limits” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：橫向風力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Lateral wind force F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「臨時穩定索與吊裝風速」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Temporary stays and lifting wind limits”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工期抗風措施與作業風速
knowledge.titleEn: Erection-stage wind measures and working limits
knowledge.text: 施工期的抗風措施分為結構與作業兩類：結構措施包括臨時穩定索把懸臂端拉到地面或墩上、臨時支墩縮短懸臂長度、在懸臂端加裝臨時調諧質量阻尼器，以及調整吊裝順序讓扭轉勁度較早形成；作業措施則是以現地風速計即時監控，超過門檻時停止吊裝、鎖固吊具與梁段。懸臂越長，橫向風力在塔或墩底產生的彎矩越大，臨時措施也要能承受颱風等級的風力。
knowledge.textEn: Erection-stage wind measures are structural and operational. Structural measures include temporary stays tying the cantilever tip down to the ground or a pier, temporary supports that shorten the cantilever, temporary tuned mass dampers at the tip and erection sequences that build torsional stiffness earlier; operational measures use site anemometers for real-time monitoring, stopping lifts and securing lifting gear and segments above set thresholds.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工期抗風措施與作業風速」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Erection-stage wind measures and working limits" is correct?
options: 施工期的抗風措施分為結構與作業兩類：結構措施包括臨時穩定索把懸臂端拉到地面或墩上、臨時支墩縮短懸臂長度、在懸臂端加裝臨時調諧質量阻尼器，以及調整吊裝順序讓扭轉勁度較早形成。
懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。
縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。
optionsEn: Erection-stage wind measures are structural and operational.
As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety.
If a scale model has the right shape, tunnel wind speed equals real wind speed.
quiz.explanation: 施工期的抗風措施分為結構與作業兩類：結構措施包括臨時穩定索把懸臂端拉到地面或墩上、臨時支墩縮短懸臂長度、在懸臂端加裝臨時調諧質量阻尼器，以及調整吊裝順序讓扭轉勁度較早形成；作業措施則是以現地風速計即時監控，超過門檻時停止吊裝、鎖固吊具與梁段。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Erection-stage wind measures are structural and operational. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工期抗風措施與作業風速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Erection-stage wind measures and working limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臨時穩定索與吊裝風速」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temporary stays and lifting wind limits” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橫向風力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L。U = 25 m/s、C_D = 1.2、D = 4 m、L = 200 m：F = 0.5×1.25×625×1.2×4×200 = 375,000 N = 375 kN；作用於懸臂中點，塔底附加彎矩 375 kN×100 m = 37.5 MN·m；風速加倍為 50 m/s 時增為 4 倍。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Lateral wind force F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L. With U = 25 m/s, C_D = 1.2, D = 4 m and L = 200 m: F = 0.5×1.25×625×1.2×4×200 = 375,000 N = 375 kN; acting at mid-cantilever it adds 375 kN×100 m = 37.5 MN·m at the pylon base, and doubling speed to 50 m/s quadruples it. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在塔頂與懸臂端設置風速計並與吊裝控制室連線，記錄 10 分鐘平均與陣風；臨時穩定索的張力以荷重計監測，颱風前後比對；臨時阻尼器安裝後以自由衰減試驗確認懸臂阻尼提升。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install anemometers at the pylon top and cantilever tip linked to the lifting control room, recording 10-minute means and gusts; monitor temporary-stay tension with load cells before and after typhoons; after fitting a temporary damper, confirm the cantilever's added damping by a free-decay test.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 橫向風力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L。U = 25 m/s、C_D = 1.2、D = 4 m、L = 200 m：F = 0.5×1.25×625×1.2×4×200 = 375,000 N = 375 kN；作用於懸臂中點，塔底附加彎矩 375 kN×100 m = 37.5 MN·m；風速加倍為 50 m/s 時增為 4 倍。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Lateral wind force F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L. With U = 25 m/s, C_D = 1.2, D = 4 m and L = 200 m: F = 0.5×1.25×625×1.2×4×200 = 375,000 N = 375 kN; acting at mid-cantilever it adds 375 kN×100 m = 37.5 MN·m at the pylon base, and doubling speed to 50 m/s quadruples it. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工期抗風措施與作業風速」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Erection-stage wind measures and working limits", which statement holds?
options: 完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。
橫向風力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L。
橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。
optionsEn: A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service.
Lateral wind force F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L.
A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record.
quiz.explanation: 橫向風力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Lateral wind force F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D·L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工期抗風措施與作業風速：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Erection-stage wind measures and working limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「臨時穩定索與吊裝風速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temporary stays and lifting wind limits” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在塔頂與懸臂端設置風速計並與吊裝控制室連線，記錄 10 分鐘平均與陣風；臨時穩定索的張力以荷重計監測，颱風前後比對；臨時阻尼器安裝後以自由衰減試驗確認懸臂阻尼提升。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install anemometers at the pylon top and cantilever tip linked to the lifting control room, recording 10-minute means and gusts; monitor temporary-stay tension with load cells before and after typhoons; after fitting a temporary damper, confirm the cantilever's added damping by a free-decay test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把作業風速門檻、颱風警報下的固定程序與臨時穩定索張拉列為停留點，由施工主管與監造簽認；此處只建立判斷與查驗原則，實際吊裝與張拉作業須由合格人員依核准的施工計畫執行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make working wind thresholds, the securing procedure under typhoon warnings and temporary-stay tensioning hold points signed by the site manager and inspector; this step sets out reasoning and checks only, and actual lifting and tensioning must be done by qualified personnel under the approved method statement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：吊裝作業只依天氣預報而未以現地風速計判斷，梁段在吊起後遇到陣風擺動撞擊已完成段；颱風前未完成臨時穩定索張拉，懸臂端在強風中大幅振動，損壞接頭與吊具。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lifting decided only by forecasts, without site anemometers, lets a segment swing in a gust after pick-up and strike completed work; failing to tension temporary stays before a typhoon leaves the cantilever tip vibrating heavily in strong wind, damaging joints and lifting gear. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在塔頂與懸臂端設置風速計並與吊裝控制室連線，記錄 10 分鐘平均與陣風；臨時穩定索的張力以荷重計監測，颱風前後比對；臨時阻尼器安裝後以自由衰減試驗確認懸臂阻尼提升。
knowledge.textEn: Install anemometers at the pylon top and cantilever tip linked to the lifting control room, recording 10-minute means and gusts; monitor temporary-stay tension with load cells before and after typhoons; after fitting a temporary damper, confirm the cantilever's added damping by a free-decay test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把作業風速門檻、颱風警報下的固定程序與臨時穩定索張拉列為停留點，由施工主管與監造簽認；此處只建立判斷與查驗原則，實際吊裝與張拉作業須由合格人員依核准的施工計畫執行。
knowledge.textEn: Make working wind thresholds, the securing procedure under typhoon warnings and temporary-stay tensioning hold points signed by the site manager and inspector; this step sets out reasoning and checks only, and actual lifting and tensioning must be done by qualified personnel under the approved method statement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工期抗風措施與作業風速」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Erection-stage wind measures and working limits"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
橋面斷面只影響外觀與交通，風洞試驗只需要看主梁本體。
在塔頂與懸臂端設置風速計並與吊裝控制室連線，記錄 10 分鐘平均與陣風。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The deck section affects only appearance and traffic, so tests need only the bare girder.
Install anemometers at the pylon top and cantilever tip linked to the lifting control room, recording 10-minute means and gusts.
quiz.explanation: 在塔頂與懸臂端設置風速計並與吊裝控制室連線，記錄 10 分鐘平均與陣風；臨時穩定索的張力以荷重計監測，颱風前後比對；臨時阻尼器安裝後以自由衰減試驗確認懸臂阻尼提升。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Install anemometers at the pylon top and cantilever tip linked to the lifting control room, recording 10-minute means and gusts; monitor temporary-stay tension with load cells before and after typhoons; after fitting a temporary damper, confirm the cantilever's added damping by a free-decay test. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工期抗風措施與作業風速：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Erection-stage wind measures and working limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臨時穩定索與吊裝風速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temporary stays and lifting wind limits” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吊裝作業只依天氣預報而未以現地風速計判斷，梁段在吊起後遇到陣風擺動撞擊已完成段；颱風前未完成臨時穩定索張拉，懸臂端在強風中大幅振動，損壞接頭與吊具。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lifting decided only by forecasts, without site anemometers, lets a segment swing in a gust after pick-up and strike completed work; failing to tension temporary stays before a typhoon leaves the cantilever tip vibrating heavily in strong wind, damaging joints and lifting gear. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：懸臂越長，橫向風力在塔或墩底產生的彎矩越大，臨時措施也要能承受颱風等級的風力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The longer the cantilever, the larger the moment that lateral wind creates at the pylon or pier base, and temporary measures must also resist typhoon-level wind.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 吊裝作業只依天氣預報而未以現地風速計判斷，梁段在吊起後遇到陣風擺動撞擊已完成段；颱風前未完成臨時穩定索張拉，懸臂端在強風中大幅振動，損壞接頭與吊具。
knowledge.textEn: Lifting decided only by forecasts, without site anemometers, lets a segment swing in a gust after pick-up and strike completed work; failing to tension temporary stays before a typhoon leaves the cantilever tip vibrating heavily in strong wind, damaging joints and lifting gear.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工期抗風措施與作業風速」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Erection-stage wind measures and working limits" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 吊裝作業只依天氣預報而未以現地風速計判斷，梁段在吊起後遇到陣風擺動撞擊已完成段；颱風前未完成臨時穩定索張拉，懸臂端在強風中大幅振動，損壞接頭與吊具。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。
optionsEn: Lifting decided only by forecasts, without site anemometers, lets a segment swing in a gust after pick-up and strike completed work.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If a scale model has the right shape, tunnel wind speed equals real wind speed.
quiz.explanation: 吊裝作業只依天氣預報而未以現地風速計判斷，梁段在吊起後遇到陣風擺動撞擊已完成段；颱風前未完成臨時穩定索張拉，懸臂端在強風中大幅振動，損壞接頭與吊具。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lifting decided only by forecasts, without site anemometers, lets a segment swing in a gust after pick-up and strike completed work; failing to tension temporary stays before a typhoon leaves the cantilever tip vibrating heavily in strong wind, damaging joints and lifting gear. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」與「全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spring-mounted section-model testing" and "Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Spring-mounted section-model testing: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「節段模型速度縮尺」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section-model velocity scale” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 節段模型是把橋面一段做成剛性縮尺模型（常見 1/40 至 1/80），以彈簧懸吊在風洞中，使其具有與原型對應的豎向與扭轉頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼。相似的關鍵是折減風速 U/(f·B) 相同，因此可以自由選擇模型頻率，再由頻率比與長度縮尺換算風速縮尺。試驗可直接觀察渦振與顫振，也可量測靜力係數與顫振導數，供全橋顫振與抖振分析使用；塔科馬海峽橋崩塌前，Farquharson 已在華盛頓大學以 1/20 節段模型與 1/200 全橋模型進行研究。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「節段模型速度縮尺」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A section model reproduces a length of deck as a rigid scaled model, commonly 1/40 to 1/80, mounted on springs in the tunnel so its vertical and torsional frequencies, mass, inertia and damping correspond to the prototype. The key similarity is equal reduced velocity U/(f·B), so the model frequency can be chosen freely and the velocity scale follows from the frequency ratio and length scale. Tests observe vortex shedding and flutter directly and measure static coefficients and flutter derivatives for full-bridge flutter and buffeting analysis; before the Tacoma Narrows collapse, Farquharson at the University of Washington was already studying a 1:20 section model and a 1:200 full model. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Section-model velocity scale” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：速度縮尺 λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Velocity scale λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a scale model has the right shape, tunnel wind speed equals real wind speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「節段模型速度縮尺」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Section-model velocity scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗
knowledge.text: 節段模型是把橋面一段做成剛性縮尺模型（常見 1/40 至 1/80），以彈簧懸吊在風洞中，使其具有與原型對應的豎向與扭轉頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼。相似的關鍵是折減風速 U/(f·B) 相同，因此可以自由選擇模型頻率，再由頻率比與長度縮尺換算風速縮尺。
knowledge.textEn: A section model reproduces a length of deck as a rigid scaled model, commonly 1/40 to 1/80, mounted on springs in the tunnel so its vertical and torsional frequencies, mass, inertia and damping correspond to the prototype. The key similarity is equal reduced velocity U/(f·B), so the model frequency can be chosen freely and the velocity scale follows from the frequency ratio and length scale.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a scale model has the right shape, tunnel wind speed equals real wind speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spring-mounted section-model testing" is correct?
options: 縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。
節段模型是把橋面一段做成剛性縮尺模型（常見 1/40 至 1/80），以彈簧懸吊在風洞中，使其具有與原型對應的豎向與扭轉頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼。
節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。
optionsEn: If a scale model has the right shape, tunnel wind speed equals real wind speed.

A section model reproduces a length of deck as a rigid scaled model, commonly 1/40 to 1/80, mounted on springs in the tunnel so its vertical and torsional frequencies, mass, inertia and damping correspond to the prototype.
If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction.
quiz.explanation: 節段模型是把橋面一段做成剛性縮尺模型（常見 1/40 至 1/80），以彈簧懸吊在風洞中，使其具有與原型對應的豎向與扭轉頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A section model reproduces a length of deck as a rigid scaled model, commonly 1/40 to 1/80, mounted on springs in the tunnel so its vertical and torsional frequencies, mass, inertia and damping correspond to the prototype. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spring-mounted section-model testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節段模型速度縮尺」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Section-model velocity scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：速度縮尺 λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p)。長度縮尺 1/60，原型寬 35 m 對應模型 0.583 m；原型扭轉頻率 0.30 Hz、模型 2.0 Hz，λ_U = (1/60)×(2.0/0.30) ≈ 0.111。模型在 7.0 m/s 發生顫振，對應原型 7.0/0.111 ≈ 63 m/s，即折減風速 63/(0.30×35) = 6.0。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Velocity scale λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p). At a 1/60 length scale a 35 m prototype width becomes 0.583 m; with prototype torsional frequency 0.30 Hz and model frequency 2.0 Hz, λ_U = (1/60)×(2.0/0.30) ≈ 0.111. Flutter at 7.0 m/s in the model corresponds to 7.0/0.111 ≈ 63 m/s at full scale, a reduced velocity of 63/(0.30×35) = 6.0. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗前量測模型的頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼並與目標比較；試驗中以均勻流與紊流各做一組、多個攻角，記錄振幅—風速曲線；將換算的顫振風速與規範要求（設計風速乘以安全係數）比較，並重複試驗確認再現性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before testing measure model frequency, mass, inertia and damping against targets; test in smooth and turbulent flow at several angles of attack, recording amplitude against speed; compare the converted flutter speed with the code requirement (design speed times a safety factor) and repeat to confirm reproducibility.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 速度縮尺 λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p)。長度縮尺 1/60，原型寬 35 m 對應模型 0.583 m；原型扭轉頻率 0.30 Hz、模型 2.0 Hz，λ_U = (1/60)×(2.0/0.30) ≈ 0.111。模型在 7.0 m/s 發生顫振，對應原型 7.0/0.111 ≈ 63 m/s，即折減風速 63/(0.30×35) = 6.0。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Velocity scale λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p). At a 1/60 length scale a 35 m prototype width becomes 0.583 m; with prototype torsional frequency 0.30 Hz and model frequency 2.0 Hz, λ_U = (1/60)×(2.0/0.30) ≈ 0.111. Flutter at 7.0 m/s in the model corresponds to 7.0/0.111 ≈ 63 m/s at full scale, a reduced velocity of 63/(0.30×35) = 6.0. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spring-mounted section-model testing", which statement holds?
options: 加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。
只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。
速度縮尺 λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p)。
optionsEn: Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability.
If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it.
Velocity scale λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p).
quiz.explanation: 速度縮尺 λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Velocity scale λ_U = λ_L·(f_m/f_p). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spring-mounted section-model testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節段模型速度縮尺」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section-model velocity scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗前量測模型的頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼並與目標比較；試驗中以均勻流與紊流各做一組、多個攻角，記錄振幅—風速曲線；將換算的顫振風速與規範要求（設計風速乘以安全係數）比較，並重複試驗確認再現性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before testing measure model frequency, mass, inertia and damping against targets; test in smooth and turbulent flow at several angles of attack, recording amplitude against speed; compare the converted flutter speed with the code requirement (design speed times a safety factor) and repeat to confirm reproducibility. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗計畫要列出長度、頻率、速度、質量與阻尼的縮尺關係與允差，試驗報告附原始資料、攻角與流場條件；顫振檢核以最不利攻角的結果為準，並由獨立風工程師審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The test plan lists scale relations and tolerances for length, frequency, velocity, mass and damping, and the report attaches raw data, attack angles and flow conditions; flutter checks use the worst angle, reviewed by an independent wind engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模型的質量慣性矩或扭轉頻率比未正確縮尺，試驗得到的顫振風速與原型不符；只做 0° 攻角而忽略地形造成的上升或下沉氣流，可能錯過最不利的顫振風速。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mis-scaled mass moment of inertia or torsion-to-bending frequency ratio makes the measured flutter speed unrepresentative; testing only at 0° attack while ignoring terrain-induced updraft or downdraft can miss the worst flutter speed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗前量測模型的頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼並與目標比較；試驗中以均勻流與紊流各做一組、多個攻角，記錄振幅—風速曲線；將換算的顫振風速與規範要求（設計風速乘以安全係數）比較，並重複試驗確認再現性。
knowledge.textEn: Before testing measure model frequency, mass, inertia and damping against targets; test in smooth and turbulent flow at several angles of attack, recording amplitude against speed; compare the converted flutter speed with the code requirement (design speed times a safety factor) and repeat to confirm reproducibility.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫要列出長度、頻率、速度、質量與阻尼的縮尺關係與允差，試驗報告附原始資料、攻角與流場條件；顫振檢核以最不利攻角的結果為準，並由獨立風工程師審查。
knowledge.textEn: The test plan lists scale relations and tolerances for length, frequency, velocity, mass and damping, and the report attaches raw data, attack angles and flow conditions; flutter checks use the worst angle, reviewed by an independent wind engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spring-mounted section-model testing"?
options: 試驗前量測模型的頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼並與目標比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。
optionsEn: Before testing measure model frequency, mass, inertia and damping against targets.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests.
quiz.explanation: 試驗前量測模型的頻率、質量、慣性矩與阻尼並與目標比較；試驗中以均勻流與紊流各做一組、多個攻角，記錄振幅—風速曲線；將換算的顫振風速與規範要求（設計風速乘以安全係數）比較，並重複試驗確認再現性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before testing measure model frequency, mass, inertia and damping against targets; test in smooth and turbulent flow at several angles of attack, recording amplitude against speed; compare the converted flutter speed with the code requirement (design speed times a safety factor) and repeat to confirm reproducibility. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spring-mounted section-model testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節段模型速度縮尺」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Section-model velocity scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模型的質量慣性矩或扭轉頻率比未正確縮尺，試驗得到的顫振風速與原型不符；只做 0° 攻角而忽略地形造成的上升或下沉氣流，可能錯過最不利的顫振風速。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mis-scaled mass moment of inertia or torsion-to-bending frequency ratio makes the measured flutter speed unrepresentative; testing only at 0° attack while ignoring terrain-induced updraft or downdraft can miss the worst flutter speed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗可直接觀察渦振與顫振，也可量測靜力係數與顫振導數，供全橋顫振與抖振分析使用；塔科馬海峽橋崩塌前，Farquharson 已在華盛頓大學以 1/20 節段模型與 1/200 全橋模型進行研究。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tests observe vortex shedding and flutter directly and measure static coefficients and flutter derivatives for full-bridge flutter and buffeting analysis; before the Tacoma Narrows collapse, Farquharson at the University of Washington was already studying a 1:20 section model and a 1:200 full model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a scale model has the right shape, tunnel wind speed equals real wind speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 模型的質量慣性矩或扭轉頻率比未正確縮尺，試驗得到的顫振風速與原型不符；只做 0° 攻角而忽略地形造成的上升或下沉氣流，可能錯過最不利的顫振風速。
knowledge.textEn: Mis-scaled mass moment of inertia or torsion-to-bending frequency ratio makes the measured flutter speed unrepresentative; testing only at 0° attack while ignoring terrain-induced updraft or downdraft can miss the worst flutter speed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「節段模型彈簧懸吊試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spring-mounted section-model testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
模型的質量慣性矩或扭轉頻率比未正確縮尺，試驗得到的顫振風速與原型不符；只做 0° 攻角而忽略地形造成的上升或下沉氣流，可能錯過最不利的顫振風速。
節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mis-scaled mass moment of inertia or torsion-to-bending frequency ratio makes the measured flutter speed unrepresentative.
If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction.
quiz.explanation: 模型的質量慣性矩或扭轉頻率比未正確縮尺，試驗得到的顫振風速與原型不符；只做 0° 攻角而忽略地形造成的上升或下沉氣流，可能錯過最不利的顫振風速。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mis-scaled mass moment of inertia or torsion-to-bending frequency ratio makes the measured flutter speed unrepresentative; testing only at 0° attack while ignoring terrain-induced updraft or downdraft can miss the worst flutter speed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「全橋氣動彈性模型」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full aeroelastic model” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 節段模型假設氣流沿橋軸二維、振型均勻，無法反映懸索與斜張橋的三維振型、主纜與吊索的重力勁度、斜風與塔的互制以及紊流的空間相關性。全橋氣動彈性模型以 Froude 相似律縮放（使重力勁度正確），在大型邊界層風洞中重現紊流風場，直接觀察整座橋在不同風向下的反應。明石海峽大橋（主跨 1,991 m，1988 至 1998 年建造）即以全橋模型風洞試驗驗證其抗風性能，加勁梁設計風速為 60 m/s、橋塔為 67 m/s。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「全橋氣動彈性模型」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Section models assume two-dimensional flow along the deck and a uniform mode shape, so they cannot capture the three-dimensional modes of suspension and cable-stayed bridges, the gravity stiffness of cables and hangers, skewed wind and tower interaction or the spatial correlation of turbulence. A full aeroelastic model is scaled by Froude similitude so that gravity stiffness is correct and tested in a large boundary-layer tunnel that reproduces turbulent wind, directly observing the whole bridge's response at different wind directions. The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge (main span 1,991 m, built 1988 to 1998) was verified by full-model wind-tunnel testing, with design wind speeds of 60 m/s for the stiffening girder and 67 m/s for the towers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Full aeroelastic model” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Froude 相似：速度縮尺 λ_U = √λ_L、時間縮尺 √λ_L、頻率縮尺 1/√λ_L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Froude similitude: velocity scale λ_U = √λ_L, time scale √λ_L and frequency scale 1/√λ_L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「全橋氣動彈性模型」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Full aeroelastic model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場
knowledge.titleEn: Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow
knowledge.text: 節段模型假設氣流沿橋軸二維、振型均勻，無法反映懸索與斜張橋的三維振型、主纜與吊索的重力勁度、斜風與塔的互制以及紊流的空間相關性。全橋氣動彈性模型以 Froude 相似律縮放（使重力勁度正確），在大型邊界層風洞中重現紊流風場，直接觀察整座橋在不同風向下的反應。
knowledge.textEn: Section models assume two-dimensional flow along the deck and a uniform mode shape, so they cannot capture the three-dimensional modes of suspension and cable-stayed bridges, the gravity stiffness of cables and hangers, skewed wind and tower interaction or the spatial correlation of turbulence. A full aeroelastic model is scaled by Froude similitude so that gravity stiffness is correct and tested in a large boundary-layer tunnel that reproduces turbulent wind, directly observing the whole bridge's response at different wind directions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow" is correct?
options: 節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。
完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。
節段模型假設氣流沿橋軸二維、振型均勻，無法反映懸索與斜張橋的三維振型、主纜與吊索的重力勁度、斜風與塔的互制以及紊流的空間相關性。
optionsEn: If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction.
A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service.

Section models assume two-dimensional flow along the deck and a uniform mode shape, so they cannot capture the three-dimensional modes of suspension and cable-stayed bridges, the gravity stiffness of cables and hangers, skewed wind and tower interaction or the spatial correlation of turbulence.
quiz.explanation: 節段模型假設氣流沿橋軸二維、振型均勻，無法反映懸索與斜張橋的三維振型、主纜與吊索的重力勁度、斜風與塔的互制以及紊流的空間相關性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Section models assume two-dimensional flow along the deck and a uniform mode shape, so they cannot capture the three-dimensional modes of suspension and cable-stayed bridges, the gravity stiffness of cables and hangers, skewed wind and tower interaction or the spatial correlation of turbulence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「全橋氣動彈性模型」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full aeroelastic model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Froude 相似：速度縮尺 λ_U = √λ_L、時間縮尺 √λ_L、頻率縮尺 1/√λ_L。λ_L = 1/100 時 λ_U = 0.1：原型 60 m/s 對應模型 6 m/s；原型頻率 0.15 Hz 對應模型 1.5 Hz；模型 1 分鐘記錄相當原型 10 分鐘。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Froude similitude: velocity scale λ_U = √λ_L, time scale √λ_L and frequency scale 1/√λ_L. At λ_L = 1/100, λ_U = 0.1: 60 m/s at full scale is 6 m/s in the model, a 0.15 Hz prototype frequency is 1.5 Hz in the model and 1 minute of model record equals 10 minutes at full scale. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對全橋模型的模態頻率與振型和有限元素分析；以熱線或多孔探針量測風洞紊流強度與頻譜，與目標風場比較；把全橋模型的反應與以節段模型顫振導數計算的全橋分析結果相互驗證，差異需能解釋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the full model's modal frequencies and shapes with finite-element results; measure tunnel turbulence intensity and spectra with hot-wire or multi-hole probes against the target wind field; cross-check full-model response against full-bridge analysis using section-model flutter derivatives, with differences explained.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Froude 相似：速度縮尺 λ_U = √λ_L、時間縮尺 √λ_L、頻率縮尺 1/√λ_L。λ_L = 1/100 時 λ_U = 0.1：原型 60 m/s 對應模型 6 m/s；原型頻率 0.15 Hz 對應模型 1.5 Hz；模型 1 分鐘記錄相當原型 10 分鐘。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Froude similitude: velocity scale λ_U = √λ_L, time scale √λ_L and frequency scale 1/√λ_L. At λ_L = 1/100, λ_U = 0.1: 60 m/s at full scale is 6 m/s in the model, a 0.15 Hz prototype frequency is 1.5 Hz in the model and 1 minute of model record equals 10 minutes at full scale. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow", which statement holds?
options: Froude 相似：速度縮尺 λ_U = √λ_L、時間縮尺 √λ_L、頻率縮尺 1/√λ_L。
橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。
橋面斷面只影響外觀與交通，風洞試驗只需要看主梁本體。
optionsEn: Froude similitude: velocity scale λ_U = √λ_L, time scale √λ_L and frequency scale 1/√λ_L.
A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record.
The deck section affects only appearance and traffic, so tests need only the bare girder.
quiz.explanation: Froude 相似：速度縮尺 λ_U = √λ_L、時間縮尺 √λ_L、頻率縮尺 1/√λ_L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Froude similitude: velocity scale λ_U = √λ_L, time scale √λ_L and frequency scale 1/√λ_L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「全橋氣動彈性模型」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full aeroelastic model” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對全橋模型的模態頻率與振型和有限元素分析；以熱線或多孔探針量測風洞紊流強度與頻譜，與目標風場比較；把全橋模型的反應與以節段模型顫振導數計算的全橋分析結果相互驗證，差異需能解釋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the full model's modal frequencies and shapes with finite-element results; measure tunnel turbulence intensity and spectra with hot-wire or multi-hole probes against the target wind field; cross-check full-model response against full-bridge analysis using section-model flutter derivatives, with differences explained.
