Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：主跨超過一定規模或形式特殊的橋梁，業主應在設計階段就安排全橋模型試驗的時程與經費；全橋試驗報告要列出模型縮尺、風場量測、各風向的反應與和分析的比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For bridges beyond a certain span or of unusual form, the owner schedules and funds full-model testing from the design stage; the report lists model scales, wind-field measurements, responses by wind direction and comparison with analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：全橋模型的主纜或吊索勁度未依 Froude 律縮放，重力勁度失真，量到的扭轉頻率與振型錯誤；風洞紊流太弱則低估抖振反應，使塔與加勁梁的設計彎矩偏小。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If cable or hanger stiffness in a full model is not scaled by Froude's law, gravity stiffness is distorted and measured torsional frequencies and mode shapes are wrong; tunnel turbulence that is too weak underestimates buffeting and leaves tower and girder design moments too low. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對全橋模型的模態頻率與振型和有限元素分析；以熱線或多孔探針量測風洞紊流強度與頻譜，與目標風場比較；把全橋模型的反應與以節段模型顫振導數計算的全橋分析結果相互驗證，差異需能解釋。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the full model's modal frequencies and shapes with finite-element results; measure tunnel turbulence intensity and spectra with hot-wire or multi-hole probes against the target wind field; cross-check full-model response against full-bridge analysis using section-model flutter derivatives, with differences explained.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 主跨超過一定規模或形式特殊的橋梁，業主應在設計階段就安排全橋模型試驗的時程與經費；全橋試驗報告要列出模型縮尺、風場量測、各風向的反應與和分析的比較。
knowledge.textEn: For bridges beyond a certain span or of unusual form, the owner schedules and funds full-model testing from the design stage; the report lists model scales, wind-field measurements, responses by wind direction and comparison with analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比對全橋模型的模態頻率與振型和有限元素分析。
施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compare the full model's modal frequencies and shapes with finite-element results.
Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test.
quiz.explanation: 比對全橋模型的模態頻率與振型和有限元素分析；以熱線或多孔探針量測風洞紊流強度與頻譜，與目標風場比較；把全橋模型的反應與以節段模型顫振導數計算的全橋分析結果相互驗證，差異需能解釋。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare the full model's modal frequencies and shapes with finite-element results; measure tunnel turbulence intensity and spectra with hot-wire or multi-hole probes against the target wind field; cross-check full-model response against full-bridge analysis using section-model flutter derivatives, with differences explained. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「全橋氣動彈性模型」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full aeroelastic model” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 全橋模型的主纜或吊索勁度未依 Froude 律縮放，重力勁度失真，量到的扭轉頻率與振型錯誤；風洞紊流太弱則低估抖振反應，使塔與加勁梁的設計彎矩偏小。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If cable or hanger stiffness in a full model is not scaled by Froude's law, gravity stiffness is distorted and measured torsional frequencies and mode shapes are wrong; tunnel turbulence that is too weak underestimates buffeting and leaves tower and girder design moments too low. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：明石海峽大橋（主跨 1,991 m，1988 至 1998 年建造）即以全橋模型風洞試驗驗證其抗風性能，加勁梁設計風速為 60 m/s、橋塔為 67 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Akashi Kaikyō Bridge (main span 1,991 m, built 1988 to 1998) was verified by full-model wind-tunnel testing, with design wind speeds of 60 m/s for the stiffening girder and 67 m/s for the towers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 全橋模型的主纜或吊索勁度未依 Froude 律縮放，重力勁度失真，量到的扭轉頻率與振型錯誤；風洞紊流太弱則低估抖振反應，使塔與加勁梁的設計彎矩偏小。
knowledge.textEn: If cable or hanger stiffness in a full model is not scaled by Froude's law, gravity stiffness is distorted and measured torsional frequencies and mode shapes are wrong; tunnel turbulence that is too weak underestimates buffeting and leaves tower and girder design moments too low.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「全橋氣動彈性模型與紊流場」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Full aeroelastic models and turbulent flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。
全橋模型的主纜或吊索勁度未依 Froude 律縮放，重力勁度失真，量到的扭轉頻率與振型錯誤；風洞紊流太弱則低估抖振反應，使塔與加勁梁的設計彎矩偏小。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service.
If cable or hanger stiffness in a full model is not scaled by Froude's law, gravity stiffness is distorted and measured torsional frequencies and mode shapes are wrong.
quiz.explanation: 全橋模型的主纜或吊索勁度未依 Froude 律縮放，重力勁度失真，量到的扭轉頻率與振型錯誤；風洞紊流太弱則低估抖振反應，使塔與加勁梁的設計彎矩偏小。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If cable or hanger stiffness in a full model is not scaled by Froude's law, gravity stiffness is distorted and measured torsional frequencies and mode shapes are wrong; tunnel turbulence that is too weak underestimates buffeting and leaves tower and girder design moments too low. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「營運期風振觀測與改善」與「改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies" and "Change control, closure wind speeds and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 營運期風振觀測與改善：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「營運期渦振與阻尼器」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “In-service vortex vibration and dampers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 風洞試驗不能保證完工後絕不振動：實際阻尼、附屬物、臨時設施或風場都可能與試驗不同。2010 年 5 月俄羅斯伏爾加格勒大橋在強風中出現明顯振動，當局在 5 月 20 日封閉全部車流、5 月 25 日重新開放，之後由 MAURER 與瑞士 Empa 等合作開發半主動調諧質量阻尼器，於 2011 年秋季安裝 12 組、每組質量 5,200 kg。營運期的改善手段包括加裝阻尼器、導流板或整流罩，以及移除改變氣流的附屬物，但每一項都要先以監測資料確認振動型態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「營運期渦振與阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wind-tunnel testing cannot guarantee a finished bridge will never vibrate: actual damping, attachments, temporary fittings or the wind field may differ from the test. In May 2010 the Volgograd Bridge in Russia vibrated noticeably in strong wind; authorities closed it to all motor traffic on 20 May and reopened it on 25 May, and semi-active tuned mass dampers were then developed by MAURER with partners including the Swiss laboratory Empa, with 12 units of 5,200 kg each installed in autumn 2011. In-service remedies include added dampers, guide vanes or fairings and removal of attachments that alter the flow, but each must start from monitoring data that confirm the vibration pattern. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “In-service vortex vibration and dampers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：渦振振幅約與 Scruton 數成反比 y ∝ 1/Sc。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vortex amplitude varies roughly as 1/Sc.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「營運期渦振與阻尼器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “In-service vortex vibration and dampers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 營運期風振觀測與改善
knowledge.text: 風洞試驗不能保證完工後絕不振動：實際阻尼、附屬物、臨時設施或風場都可能與試驗不同。2010 年 5 月俄羅斯伏爾加格勒大橋在強風中出現明顯振動，當局在 5 月 20 日封閉全部車流、5 月 25 日重新開放，之後由 MAURER 與瑞士 Empa 等合作開發半主動調諧質量阻尼器，於 2011 年秋季安裝 12 組、每組質量 5,200 kg。
knowledge.textEn: Wind-tunnel testing cannot guarantee a finished bridge will never vibrate: actual damping, attachments, temporary fittings or the wind field may differ from the test. In May 2010 the Volgograd Bridge in Russia vibrated noticeably in strong wind; authorities closed it to all motor traffic on 20 May and reopened it on 25 May, and semi-active tuned mass dampers were then developed by MAURER with partners including the Swiss laboratory Empa, with 12 units of 5,200 kg each installed in autumn 2011.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「營運期風振觀測與改善」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies" is correct?
options: 風洞試驗不能保證完工後絕不振動：實際阻尼、附屬物、臨時設施或風場都可能與試驗不同。
完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。
加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。
optionsEn: Wind-tunnel testing cannot guarantee a finished bridge will never vibrate: actual damping, attachments, temporary fittings or the wind field may differ from the test.
A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service.
Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability.
quiz.explanation: 風洞試驗不能保證完工後絕不振動：實際阻尼、附屬物、臨時設施或風場都可能與試驗不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wind-tunnel testing cannot guarantee a finished bridge will never vibrate: actual damping, attachments, temporary fittings or the wind field may differ from the test. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 營運期風振觀測與改善：定量估算
steps.titleEn: In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「營運期渦振與阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “In-service vortex vibration and dampers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：渦振振幅約與 Scruton 數成反比 y ∝ 1/Sc。若加裝阻尼器使對數衰減率由 0.02 提升到 0.08，Sc 增為 4 倍，振幅約降為 1/4，例如由 0.40 m 降為約 0.10 m；12 組 5,200 kg 阻尼器合計質量 62,400 kg。數值除阻尼器規格外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vortex amplitude varies roughly as 1/Sc. Raising the logarithmic decrement from 0.02 to 0.08 with dampers quadruples Sc and cuts amplitude to about a quarter, for example from 0.40 m to about 0.10 m; twelve 5,200 kg dampers total 62,400 kg. Values other than the damper data are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在跨中與四分點布設加速度計與現地風速計，記錄振動發生時的風速、風向、頻率與振型，確認是否落在渦振鎖定區；改善後以相同條件比較振幅，並以自由衰減或環境振動資料計算阻尼提升量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place accelerometers at midspan and quarter points with a site anemometer, recording wind speed, direction, frequency and mode shape during events to confirm whether they fall in a lock-in range; after the remedy compare amplitudes under the same conditions and compute the added damping from free decay or ambient data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 渦振振幅約與 Scruton 數成反比 y ∝ 1/Sc。若加裝阻尼器使對數衰減率由 0.02 提升到 0.08，Sc 增為 4 倍，振幅約降為 1/4，例如由 0.40 m 降為約 0.10 m；12 組 5,200 kg 阻尼器合計質量 62,400 kg。數值除阻尼器規格外為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Vortex amplitude varies roughly as 1/Sc. Raising the logarithmic decrement from 0.02 to 0.08 with dampers quadruples Sc and cuts amplitude to about a quarter, for example from 0.40 m to about 0.10 m; twelve 5,200 kg dampers total 62,400 kg. Values other than the damper data are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「營運期風振觀測與改善」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies", which statement holds?
options: 只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。
渦振振幅約與 Scruton 數成反比 y ∝ 1/Sc。
結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。
optionsEn: If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it.
Vortex amplitude varies roughly as 1/Sc.
Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests.
quiz.explanation: 渦振振幅約與 Scruton 數成反比 y ∝ 1/Sc。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Vortex amplitude varies roughly as 1/Sc. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 營運期風振觀測與改善：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「營運期渦振與阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “In-service vortex vibration and dampers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在跨中與四分點布設加速度計與現地風速計，記錄振動發生時的風速、風向、頻率與振型，確認是否落在渦振鎖定區；改善後以相同條件比較振幅，並以自由衰減或環境振動資料計算阻尼提升量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place accelerometers at midspan and quarter points with a site anemometer, recording wind speed, direction, frequency and mode shape during events to confirm whether they fall in a lock-in range; after the remedy compare amplitudes under the same conditions and compute the added damping from free decay or ambient data. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：長跨橋梁的監測系統要能在風振事件時自動觸發高頻記錄並通知管理單位；任何改善方案須以監測資料與風洞或數值驗證為依據，並由原設計或獨立風工程師核定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Monitoring on long-span bridges should automatically trigger high-rate recording and notify the owner during wind-vibration events; any remedy must rest on monitoring data and wind-tunnel or numerical verification, approved by the original designer or an independent wind engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未先辨識振動模態就安裝阻尼器，阻尼器調到錯誤頻率而幾乎無效；或為了趕快恢復通車只加裝導流板而未經試驗，結果改變了扭轉氣動特性，反而降低顫振餘裕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Installing dampers before identifying the mode tunes them to the wrong frequency and makes them nearly useless; adding untested guide vanes to reopen quickly can change torsional aerodynamics and reduce the flutter margin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在跨中與四分點布設加速度計與現地風速計，記錄振動發生時的風速、風向、頻率與振型，確認是否落在渦振鎖定區；改善後以相同條件比較振幅，並以自由衰減或環境振動資料計算阻尼提升量。
knowledge.textEn: Place accelerometers at midspan and quarter points with a site anemometer, recording wind speed, direction, frequency and mode shape during events to confirm whether they fall in a lock-in range; after the remedy compare amplitudes under the same conditions and compute the added damping from free decay or ambient data.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 長跨橋梁的監測系統要能在風振事件時自動觸發高頻記錄並通知管理單位；任何改善方案須以監測資料與風洞或數值驗證為依據，並由原設計或獨立風工程師核定。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring on long-span bridges should automatically trigger high-rate recording and notify the owner during wind-vibration events; any remedy must rest on monitoring data and wind-tunnel or numerical verification, approved by the original designer or an independent wind engineer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「營運期風振觀測與改善」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。
在跨中與四分點布設加速度計與現地風速計，記錄振動發生時的風速、風向、頻率與振型，確認是否落在渦振鎖定區。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety.
Place accelerometers at midspan and quarter points with a site anemometer, recording wind speed, direction, frequency and mode shape during events to confirm whether they fall in a lock-in range.
quiz.explanation: 在跨中與四分點布設加速度計與現地風速計，記錄振動發生時的風速、風向、頻率與振型，確認是否落在渦振鎖定區；改善後以相同條件比較振幅，並以自由衰減或環境振動資料計算阻尼提升量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place accelerometers at midspan and quarter points with a site anemometer, recording wind speed, direction, frequency and mode shape during events to confirm whether they fall in a lock-in range; after the remedy compare amplitudes under the same conditions and compute the added damping from free decay or ambient data. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 營運期風振觀測與改善：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「營運期渦振與阻尼器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “In-service vortex vibration and dampers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未先辨識振動模態就安裝阻尼器，阻尼器調到錯誤頻率而幾乎無效；或為了趕快恢復通車只加裝導流板而未經試驗，結果改變了扭轉氣動特性，反而降低顫振餘裕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Installing dampers before identifying the mode tunes them to the wrong frequency and makes them nearly useless; adding untested guide vanes to reopen quickly can change torsional aerodynamics and reduce the flutter margin. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：營運期的改善手段包括加裝阻尼器、導流板或整流罩，以及移除改變氣流的附屬物，但每一項都要先以監測資料確認振動型態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In-service remedies include added dampers, guide vanes or fairings and removal of attachments that alter the flow, but each must start from monitoring data that confirm the vibration pattern.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完工前做過風洞試驗的橋，營運期間就不會出現風振問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未先辨識振動模態就安裝阻尼器，阻尼器調到錯誤頻率而幾乎無效；或為了趕快恢復通車只加裝導流板而未經試驗，結果改變了扭轉氣動特性，反而降低顫振餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Installing dampers before identifying the mode tunes them to the wrong frequency and makes them nearly useless; adding untested guide vanes to reopen quickly can change torsional aerodynamics and reduce the flutter margin.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「營運期風振觀測與改善」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "In-service wind-vibration observation and remedies" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未先辨識振動模態就安裝阻尼器，阻尼器調到錯誤頻率而幾乎無效；或為了趕快恢復通車只加裝導流板而未經試驗，結果改變了扭轉氣動特性，反而降低顫振餘裕。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。
optionsEn: Installing dampers before identifying the mode tunes them to the wrong frequency and makes them nearly useless.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability.
quiz.explanation: 未先辨識振動模態就安裝阻尼器，阻尼器調到錯誤頻率而幾乎無效；或為了趕快恢復通車只加裝導流板而未經試驗，結果改變了扭轉氣動特性，反而降低顫振餘裕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Installing dampers before identifying the mode tunes them to the wrong frequency and makes them nearly useless; adding untested guide vanes to reopen quickly can change torsional aerodynamics and reduce the flutter margin. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Change control, closure wind speeds and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「附屬物變更的氣動複核」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋梁在數十年營運中會加裝防風牆、隔音牆、管線、照明、檢修車軌道或更換欄杆，這些都改變斷面外形與阻力，可能讓渦振重新出現或降低顫振風速。交接文件因此要保存風洞試驗的斷面幾何、試驗條件、靜力係數、顫振導數與允收結果，並規定任何外形變更都需氣動複核。營運面則要訂定依風速分級的交通管制，例如強風時限制高車身車輛或封橋，並把風速監測與管制程序連結。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「附屬物變更的氣動複核」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Over decades of service a bridge acquires wind screens, noise barriers, utilities, lighting, gantry rails or new railings, all of which change section shape and drag and can revive vortex shedding or lower flutter speed. Handover documents must therefore keep the tested section geometry, test conditions, static coefficients, flutter derivatives and acceptance results, and require aerodynamic review of any change in shape. Operationally, wind-speed-graded traffic control, such as restricting high-sided vehicles or closing the bridge in strong wind, must be defined and linked to wind monitoring. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每延公尺阻力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Drag per metre F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「附屬物變更的氣動複核」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Change control, closure wind speeds and handover
knowledge.text: 橋梁在數十年營運中會加裝防風牆、隔音牆、管線、照明、檢修車軌道或更換欄杆，這些都改變斷面外形與阻力，可能讓渦振重新出現或降低顫振風速。交接文件因此要保存風洞試驗的斷面幾何、試驗條件、靜力係數、顫振導數與允收結果，並規定任何外形變更都需氣動複核。
knowledge.textEn: Over decades of service a bridge acquires wind screens, noise barriers, utilities, lighting, gantry rails or new railings, all of which change section shape and drag and can revive vortex shedding or lower flutter speed. Handover documents must therefore keep the tested section geometry, test conditions, static coefficients, flutter derivatives and acceptance results, and require aerodynamic review of any change in shape.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Change control, closure wind speeds and handover" is correct?
options: 加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。
橋梁在數十年營運中會加裝防風牆、隔音牆、管線、照明、檢修車軌道或更換欄杆，這些都改變斷面外形與阻力，可能讓渦振重新出現或降低顫振風速。
橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。
optionsEn: Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability.

Over decades of service a bridge acquires wind screens, noise barriers, utilities, lighting, gantry rails or new railings, all of which change section shape and drag and can revive vortex shedding or lower flutter speed.
A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record.
quiz.explanation: 橋梁在數十年營運中會加裝防風牆、隔音牆、管線、照明、檢修車軌道或更換欄杆，這些都改變斷面外形與阻力，可能讓渦振重新出現或降低顫振風速。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Over decades of service a bridge acquires wind screens, noise barriers, utilities, lighting, gantry rails or new railings, all of which change section shape and drag and can revive vortex shedding or lower flutter speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Change control, closure wind speeds and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「附屬物變更的氣動複核」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每延公尺阻力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D。U = 60 m/s、D = 4 m：無防風牆 C_D = 1.0 時 F = 0.5×1.25×3,600×4×1.0 = 9.0 kN/m；加裝防風牆後 C_D = 1.6，F = 14.4 kN/m，1 km 橋長的總橫向風力由 9,000 kN 增為 14,400 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Drag per metre F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D. With U = 60 m/s and D = 4 m: without wind screens, C_D = 1.0 gives F = 0.5×1.25×3,600×4×1.0 = 9.0 kN/m; with screens C_D = 1.6 gives 14.4 kN/m, raising the total lateral load on 1 km of deck from 9,000 kN to 14,400 kN. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：任何改裝申請都要附上新外形圖，由風工程師判斷是否需要補充節段模型試驗或數值模擬，比較靜力係數、渦振與顫振結果與原試驗；交通管制門檻以現地風速計資料與車輛側風穩定分析訂定，並定期檢討事件紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Every modification request includes the new section drawing, and a wind engineer decides whether supplementary section tests or numerical simulation are needed to compare static coefficients, vortex and flutter results with the original tests; traffic-control thresholds come from site anemometer data and vehicle crosswind-stability analysis, with event records reviewed periodically.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 每延公尺阻力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D。U = 60 m/s、D = 4 m：無防風牆 C_D = 1.0 時 F = 0.5×1.25×3,600×4×1.0 = 9.0 kN/m；加裝防風牆後 C_D = 1.6，F = 14.4 kN/m，1 km 橋長的總橫向風力由 9,000 kN 增為 14,400 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Drag per metre F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D. With U = 60 m/s and D = 4 m: without wind screens, C_D = 1.0 gives F = 0.5×1.25×3,600×4×1.0 = 9.0 kN/m; with screens C_D = 1.6 gives 14.4 kN/m, raising the total lateral load on 1 km of deck from 9,000 kN to 14,400 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Change control, closure wind speeds and handover", which statement holds?
options: 橋面斷面只影響外觀與交通，風洞試驗只需要看主梁本體。
施工期間只有幾個月，風險比完工後的百年使用期低，不必做風洞試驗。
每延公尺阻力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D。
optionsEn: The deck section affects only appearance and traffic, so tests need only the bare girder.
Construction lasts only months, so its risk is lower than a century of service and needs no wind-tunnel test.
Drag per metre F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D.
quiz.explanation: 每延公尺阻力 F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Drag per metre F = ½·ρ·U²·C_D·D. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Change control, closure wind speeds and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「附屬物變更的氣動複核」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 任何改裝申請都要附上新外形圖，由風工程師判斷是否需要補充節段模型試驗或數值模擬，比較靜力係數、渦振與顫振結果與原試驗；交通管制門檻以現地風速計資料與車輛側風穩定分析訂定，並定期檢討事件紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Every modification request includes the new section drawing, and a wind engineer decides whether supplementary section tests or numerical simulation are needed to compare static coefficients, vortex and flutter results with the original tests; traffic-control thresholds come from site anemometer data and vehicle crosswind-stability analysis, with event records reviewed periodically. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含風場參數、節段與全橋試驗報告、靜力係數與顫振導數、完工實測頻率與阻尼、監測系統設定與依風速分級的交通管制程序；外形變更一律經風工程師核定後才可施作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover includes wind-field parameters, section and full-model test reports, static coefficients and flutter derivatives, measured as-built frequencies and damping, monitoring settings and wind-graded traffic-control procedures; any change of shape proceeds only after a wind engineer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：管理單位為了行車安全加裝實心防風牆，卻未做氣動複核，結果橋面阻力大增、渦振重新出現，甚至降低顫振餘裕；交接時沒有保存試驗斷面與數據，日後無法判斷改裝的影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An owner fits solid wind screens for road safety without aerodynamic review, sharply increasing drag, reviving vortex vibration and even reducing the flutter margin; without the tested section and data kept at handover, the effect of modifications cannot later be judged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 任何改裝申請都要附上新外形圖，由風工程師判斷是否需要補充節段模型試驗或數值模擬，比較靜力係數、渦振與顫振結果與原試驗；交通管制門檻以現地風速計資料與車輛側風穩定分析訂定，並定期檢討事件紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Every modification request includes the new section drawing, and a wind engineer decides whether supplementary section tests or numerical simulation are needed to compare static coefficients, vortex and flutter results with the original tests; traffic-control thresholds come from site anemometer data and vehicle crosswind-stability analysis, with event records reviewed periodically.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含風場參數、節段與全橋試驗報告、靜力係數與顫振導數、完工實測頻率與阻尼、監測系統設定與依風速分級的交通管制程序；外形變更一律經風工程師核定後才可施作。
knowledge.textEn: Handover includes wind-field parameters, section and full-model test reports, static coefficients and flutter derivatives, measured as-built frequencies and damping, monitoring settings and wind-graded traffic-control procedures; any change of shape proceeds only after a wind engineer's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Change control, closure wind speeds and handover"?
options: 任何改裝申請都要附上新外形圖，由風工程師判斷是否需要補充節段模型試驗或數值模擬，比較靜力係數、渦振與顫振結果與原試驗。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
縮尺模型只要外形比例正確，風洞風速就等於實際風速。
optionsEn: Every modification request includes the new section drawing, and a wind engineer decides whether supplementary section tests or numerical simulation are needed to compare static coefficients, vortex and flutter results with the original tests.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If a scale model has the right shape, tunnel wind speed equals real wind speed.
quiz.explanation: 任何改裝申請都要附上新外形圖，由風工程師判斷是否需要補充節段模型試驗或數值模擬，比較靜力係數、渦振與顫振結果與原試驗；交通管制門檻以現地風速計資料與車輛側風穩定分析訂定，並定期檢討事件紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Every modification request includes the new section drawing, and a wind engineer decides whether supplementary section tests or numerical simulation are needed to compare static coefficients, vortex and flutter results with the original tests; traffic-control thresholds come from site anemometer data and vehicle crosswind-stability analysis, with event records reviewed periodically. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Change control, closure wind speeds and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「附屬物變更的氣動複核」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aerodynamic recheck of attachments” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 管理單位為了行車安全加裝實心防風牆，卻未做氣動複核，結果橋面阻力大增、渦振重新出現，甚至降低顫振餘裕；交接時沒有保存試驗斷面與數據，日後無法判斷改裝的影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An owner fits solid wind screens for road safety without aerodynamic review, sharply increasing drag, reviving vortex vibration and even reducing the flutter margin; without the tested section and data kept at handover, the effect of modifications cannot later be judged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：營運面則要訂定依風速分級的交通管制，例如強風時限制高車身車輛或封橋，並把風速監測與管制程序連結。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Operationally, wind-speed-graded traffic control, such as restricting high-sided vehicles or closing the bridge in strong wind, must be defined and linked to wind monitoring.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加裝防風牆只會讓橋面更安全，不會影響橋梁本身的抗風穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding wind screens only makes the deck safer and cannot affect the bridge's own aerodynamic stability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 管理單位為了行車安全加裝實心防風牆，卻未做氣動複核，結果橋面阻力大增、渦振重新出現，甚至降低顫振餘裕；交接時沒有保存試驗斷面與數據，日後無法判斷改裝的影響。
knowledge.textEn: An owner fits solid wind screens for road safety without aerodynamic review, sharply increasing drag, reviving vortex vibration and even reducing the flutter margin; without the tested section and data kept at handover, the effect of modifications cannot later be judged.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「改裝管理、封橋風速與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Change control, closure wind speeds and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
管理單位為了行車安全加裝實心防風牆，卻未做氣動複核，結果橋面阻力大增、渦振重新出現，甚至降低顫振餘裕；交接時沒有保存試驗斷面與數據，日後無法判斷改裝的影響。
橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An owner fits solid wind screens for road safety without aerodynamic review, sharply increasing drag, reviving vortex vibration and even reducing the flutter margin.
A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record.
quiz.explanation: 管理單位為了行車安全加裝實心防風牆，卻未做氣動複核，結果橋面阻力大增、渦振重新出現，甚至降低顫振餘裕；交接時沒有保存試驗斷面與數據，日後無法判斷改裝的影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An owner fits solid wind screens for road safety without aerodynamic review, sharply increasing drag, reviving vortex vibration and even reducing the flutter margin; without the tested section and data kept at handover, the effect of modifications cannot later be judged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 橋面超高性能混凝土接縫
summary: 從快速橋梁施工中預鑄橋面板接縫的荷載路徑出發，說明超高性能混凝土為何能以約 150 mm 寬的接縫完成鋼筋非接觸搭接，量化介面應力、收縮約束、搭接長度與鋼纖維用量，再處理介面粗糙化、模板密封與溢流、流度與強度驗收、接縫性能監測、氯離子耐久與交接維修，並以紐約州 2009 年首批現澆 UHPC 接縫與 2013 年 I-81 雪城四座橋的 10 天封路更換為例。
summaryEn: Starting from the load path through joints between precast deck elements in accelerated bridge construction, explain why ultra-high-performance concrete completes non-contact lap splices in joints about 150 mm wide, quantify interface stress, restrained shrinkage, lap length and steel-fibre content, then cover interface roughening, form sealing and overfill, flow and strength acceptance, joint performance monitoring, chloride durability and handover and repair, using New York's first field-cast UHPC connections in 2009 and the 2013 replacement of four I-81 bridges in Syracuse under 10-day closures.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：兩塊全深度預鑄橋面板厚 200 mm，以 UHPC 橫向接縫連接，伸出 16 mm 鋼筋@150 mm（f_y = 420 MPa，低於 75 ksi），保護層 50 mm（≥ 3d_b = 48 mm）。依 FHWA 規則 ℓ_d = 8d_b = 128 mm、ℓ_s ≥ 0.75×128 = 96 mm，採 120 mm 搭接、152 mm 接縫，兩側各留 16 mm 允差。若改用 100 ksi 級鋼筋且保護層 40 mm（2.5d_b），ℓ_d = 12d_b = 192 mm、ℓ_s ≥ 144 mm，接縫應加寬到約 203 mm。一道 12 m 長接縫 UHPC 體積 0.152×0.2×12 ≈ 0.365 m³，含 10% 損耗約 0.40 m³，鋼纖維約 0.40×157 ≈ 63 kg。介面剪力以剪力摩擦估算：粗糙化 6 mm 約 895 kN/m，未粗糙化約 442 kN/m，差約 2 倍。驗收：流度 178 至 254 mm，抗壓達 97 MPa（14 ksi）才拆模與承受施工荷重，28 天大於 145 MPa（21 ksi）；76.2 mm 圓柱試體破壞荷重 680 kN 即約 149 MPa。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: two full-depth precast deck panels 200 mm thick are joined by a transverse UHPC joint with projecting 16 mm bars at 150 mm (f_y = 420 MPa, below 75 ksi) and 50 mm cover (at least 3d_b = 48 mm). By the FHWA rule ℓ_d = 8d_b = 128 mm and ℓ_s ≥ 0.75×128 = 96 mm, so a 120 mm lap in a 152 mm joint leaves 16 mm tolerance each side. With 100 ksi bars and 40 mm cover (2.5d_b), ℓ_d = 12d_b = 192 mm and ℓ_s ≥ 144 mm, so the joint should widen to about 203 mm. A 12 m joint holds 0.152×0.2×12 ≈ 0.365 m³ of UHPC, about 0.40 m³ with 10% waste and about 0.40×157 ≈ 63 kg of steel fibre. Shear friction gives interface capacity of about 895 kN/m when roughened to 6 mm and about 442 kN/m unroughened, roughly a factor of 2. Acceptance: flow of 178 to 254 mm, stripping and construction loading only at 97 MPa (14 ksi), and above 145 MPa (21 ksi) at 28 days; a 76.2 mm cylinder failing at 680 kN is about 149 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」與「收縮、溫差與介面約束」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load path through precast deck joints" and "Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path through precast deck joints: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「接縫介面彎曲應力」如何影響橋面超高性能混凝土接縫的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint-interface flexural stress” governs force, deformation or durability in “UHPC bridge-deck closure joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 快速橋梁施工把橋面拆成預鑄全深度橋面板或帶翼板的預鑄梁，在工廠製作、現場吊裝，再以現澆接縫把它們連成連續的橋面。接縫必須把車輪荷重造成的彎矩與剪力從一塊板傳到下一塊，並長期不透水；傳統做法需要寬接縫讓鋼筋長距離搭接，或以後拉預力壓緊接縫。超高性能混凝土的強度與握裹力極高，使接縫可窄到約 150 mm，鋼筋只需短距離非接觸搭接。但接縫最弱的地方往往不是 UHPC 本身，而是它與預鑄混凝土之間的介面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「接縫介面彎曲應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Accelerated bridge construction splits the deck into full-depth precast panels or precast girders with integral flanges, made in a plant and lifted into place, then joined into a continuous deck with field-cast joints. The joints must pass wheel-load moments and shears from one element to the next and stay watertight for decades; conventional practice needs wide joints for long bar laps or post-tensioning to clamp the joint. UHPC's very high strength and bond allow joints only about 150 mm wide with short non-contact lap splices. Yet the weakest part of the joint is often not the UHPC itself but its interface with the precast concrete. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joint-interface flexural stress” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa；此應力低於 UHPC 約 8.5 MPa 的直接拉伸開裂強度，但已接近一般混凝土與介面的開裂應力，裂縫會先出現在介面。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa; this is below UHPC's direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but near the cracking stress of ordinary concrete and the interface, so cracks appear at the interface first.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「UHPC 強度極高，所以接縫處絕對不會開裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "UHPC is so strong that the joint can never crack." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「接縫介面彎曲應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Joint-interface flexural stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑
knowledge.titleEn: Load path through precast deck joints
knowledge.text: 快速橋梁施工把橋面拆成預鑄全深度橋面板或帶翼板的預鑄梁，在工廠製作、現場吊裝，再以現澆接縫把它們連成連續的橋面。接縫必須把車輪荷重造成的彎矩與剪力從一塊板傳到下一塊，並長期不透水；傳統做法需要寬接縫讓鋼筋長距離搭接，或以後拉預力壓緊接縫。
knowledge.textEn: Accelerated bridge construction splits the deck into full-depth precast panels or precast girders with integral flanges, made in a plant and lifted into place, then joined into a continuous deck with field-cast joints. The joints must pass wheel-load moments and shears from one element to the next and stay watertight for decades; conventional practice needs wide joints for long bar laps or post-tensioning to clamp the joint.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：UHPC 強度極高，所以接縫處絕對不會開裂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: UHPC is so strong that the joint can never crack. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path through precast deck joints" is correct?
options: UHPC 強度極高，所以接縫處絕對不會開裂。
快速橋梁施工把橋面拆成預鑄全深度橋面板或帶翼板的預鑄梁，在工廠製作、現場吊裝，再以現澆接縫把它們連成連續的橋面。
UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。
optionsEn: UHPC is so strong that the joint can never crack.

Accelerated bridge construction splits the deck into full-depth precast panels or precast girders with integral flanges, made in a plant and lifted into place, then joined into a continuous deck with field-cast joints.
UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 快速橋梁施工把橋面拆成預鑄全深度橋面板或帶翼板的預鑄梁，在工廠製作、現場吊裝，再以現澆接縫把它們連成連續的橋面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Accelerated bridge construction splits the deck into full-depth precast panels or precast girders with integral flanges, made in a plant and lifted into place, then joined into a continuous deck with field-cast joints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path through precast deck joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫介面彎曲應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint-interface flexural stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa；此應力低於 UHPC 約 8.5 MPa 的直接拉伸開裂強度，但已接近一般混凝土與介面的開裂應力，裂縫會先出現在介面。數值除 UHPC 強度外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa; this is below UHPC's direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but near the cracking stress of ordinary concrete and the interface, so cracks appear at the interface first. Values other than the UHPC strength are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力；接縫位置盡量避開負彎矩最大處，並確認鋼筋穿越接縫的數量足以承受介面開裂後的拉力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately; avoid placing joints at peak negative moment where possible and confirm that reinforcement crossing the joint can carry the tension once the interface cracks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa；此應力低於 UHPC 約 8.5 MPa 的直接拉伸開裂強度，但已接近一般混凝土與介面的開裂應力，裂縫會先出現在介面。數值除 UHPC 強度外為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa; this is below UHPC's direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but near the cracking stress of ordinary concrete and the interface, so cracks appear at the interface first. Values other than the UHPC strength are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path through precast deck joints", which statement holds?
options: UHPC 只是強度比較高的混凝土，配比與纖維可以由現場自行調整。
UHPC 可以像一般混凝土一樣用普通模板，漏一點漿不影響品質。
接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa。
optionsEn: UHPC is just stronger concrete, so mix and fibre content can be adjusted on site.
UHPC can use ordinary formwork, and a little paste leakage does not matter.
With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 接縫處每米寬負彎矩 M = 25 kN·m/m，板厚 h = 0.2 m，斷面模數 S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³，σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa；此應力低於 UHPC 約 8.5 MPa 的直接拉伸開裂強度，但已接近一般混凝土與介面的開裂應力，裂縫會先出現在介面。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a negative moment at the joint of M = 25 kN·m/m and deck thickness h = 0.2 m, the section modulus S = b·h²/6 = 1.0×0.2²/6 ≈ 0.00667 m³ and σ = M/S ≈ 3.75 MPa; this is below UHPC's direct tensile cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but near the cracking stress of ordinary concrete and the interface, so cracks appear at the interface first. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path through precast deck joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接縫介面彎曲應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint-interface flexural stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力；接縫位置盡量避開負彎矩最大處，並確認鋼筋穿越接縫的數量足以承受介面開裂後的拉力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately; avoid placing joints at peak negative moment where possible and confirm that reinforcement crossing the joint can carry the tension once the interface cracks. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：接縫設計要分別列出 UHPC 本體、介面與相鄰預鑄板的應力檢核，並說明介面開裂後的傳力假設；接縫位置與方向在預鑄板分割時就與設計者協調，不得由施工方任意調整。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Joint design lists stress checks for the UHPC, the interface and the adjacent precast panel separately and states the load-transfer assumption after interface cracking; joint location and direction are coordinated with the designer when panels are divided and may not be changed by the contractor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力；接縫位置盡量避開負彎矩最大處，並確認鋼筋穿越接縫的數量足以承受介面開裂後的拉力。
knowledge.textEn: Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately; avoid placing joints at peak negative moment where possible and confirm that reinforcement crossing the joint can carry the tension once the interface cracks.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 接縫設計要分別列出 UHPC 本體、介面與相鄰預鑄板的應力檢核，並說明介面開裂後的傳力假設；接縫位置與方向在預鑄板分割時就與設計者協調，不得由施工方任意調整。
knowledge.textEn: Joint design lists stress checks for the UHPC, the interface and the adjacent precast panel separately and states the load-transfer assumption after interface cracking; joint location and direction are coordinated with the designer when panels are divided and may not be changed by the contractor.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load path through precast deck joints"?
options: 以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
接縫只要表面看不到裂縫，就代表不會滲水。
optionsEn: Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If no crack is visible on the joint surface, it cannot leak.
quiz.explanation: 以有限元素或格梁分析求得接縫位置在車輪荷重、溫度梯度與收縮下的彎矩與剪力，分別檢查 UHPC 本體、介面與預鑄板的應力；接縫位置盡量避開負彎矩最大處，並確認鋼筋穿越接縫的數量足以承受介面開裂後的拉力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use finite-element or grillage analysis to find moments and shears at the joints under wheel loads, thermal gradient and shrinkage, checking stresses in the UHPC, the interface and the precast panel separately; avoid placing joints at peak negative moment where possible and confirm that reinforcement crossing the joint can carry the tension once the interface cracks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path through precast deck joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接縫介面彎曲應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint-interface flexural stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：但接縫最弱的地方往往不是 UHPC 本身，而是它與預鑄混凝土之間的介面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Yet the weakest part of the joint is often not the UHPC itself but its interface with the precast concrete.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「UHPC 強度極高，所以接縫處絕對不會開裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "UHPC is so strong that the joint can never crack." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。
knowledge.textEn: Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預鑄橋面接縫的荷載路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path through precast deck joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。
UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate.
UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 傳統窄接縫若以一般無收縮砂漿或混凝土澆置，鋼筋搭接不足、握裹力有限，車輛反覆通過後接縫開裂、滲水，鹽水沿裂縫流到梁頂與支承，接縫成為整座橋最先劣化的部位。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Narrow joints filled with ordinary non-shrink grout or concrete have inadequate lap length and limited bond, so repeated traffic cracks them, water leaks through and de-icing brine runs onto girder tops and bearings, making the joints the first part of the bridge to deteriorate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「收縮約束應力」如何影響橋面超高性能混凝土接縫的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained shrinkage stress” governs force, deformation or durability in “UHPC bridge-deck closure joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: UHPC 水膠比低於 0.25、膠結材含量高，自體收縮比一般混凝土大，長期收縮可達數百微應變；而相鄰的預鑄板早已完成大部分收縮，於是新澆的 UHPC 被兩側舊混凝土約束，在介面產生拉應力。水化熱也使窄接縫在初期溫度較高，冷卻時再增加收縮。若介面黏結不足，這些約束應力會讓介面在通車前就脫開，形成貫穿板厚的細縫，成為日後滲水路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「收縮約束應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: UHPC has a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25 and a high binder content, so its autogenous shrinkage exceeds that of ordinary concrete and long-term shrinkage reaches several hundred microstrain; the adjacent precast panels have already completed most of their shrinkage, so the new UHPC is restrained by older concrete on both sides and tension develops at the interface. Heat of hydration also warms the narrow joint early, adding shrinkage as it cools. If bond is inadequate, these restraint stresses open the interface before traffic is even applied, forming a fine through-thickness crack that becomes a future leakage path. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Restrained shrinkage stress” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：約束收縮應力 σ = R·E·ε·k。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Restrained shrinkage stress σ = R·E·ε·k.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「收縮約束應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Restrained shrinkage stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束
knowledge.titleEn: Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint
knowledge.text: UHPC 水膠比低於 0.25、膠結材含量高，自體收縮比一般混凝土大，長期收縮可達數百微應變；而相鄰的預鑄板早已完成大部分收縮，於是新澆的 UHPC 被兩側舊混凝土約束，在介面產生拉應力。水化熱也使窄接縫在初期溫度較高，冷卻時再增加收縮。
knowledge.textEn: UHPC has a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25 and a high binder content, so its autogenous shrinkage exceeds that of ordinary concrete and long-term shrinkage reaches several hundred microstrain; the adjacent precast panels have already completed most of their shrinkage, so the new UHPC is restrained by older concrete on both sides and tension develops at the interface. Heat of hydration also warms the narrow joint early, adding shrinkage as it cools.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收縮、溫差與介面約束」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint" is correct?
options: UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。
UHPC 握裹力很強，鋼筋搭接長度可以隨意縮短。
UHPC 水膠比低於 0.25、膠結材含量高，自體收縮比一般混凝土大，長期收縮可達數百微應變。
optionsEn: UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered.
UHPC bonds so well that lap length can be shortened at will.
UHPC has a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25 and a high binder content, so its autogenous shrinkage exceeds that of ordinary concrete and long-term shrinkage reaches several hundred microstrain.
quiz.explanation: UHPC 水膠比低於 0.25、膠結材含量高，自體收縮比一般混凝土大，長期收縮可達數百微應變；而相鄰的預鑄板早已完成大部分收縮，於是新澆的 UHPC 被兩側舊混凝土約束，在介面產生拉應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: UHPC has a water-to-cementitious ratio below 0.25 and a high binder content, so its autogenous shrinkage exceeds that of ordinary concrete and long-term shrinkage reaches several hundred microstrain; the adjacent precast panels have already completed most of their shrinkage, so the new UHPC is restrained by older concrete on both sides and tension develops at the interface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收縮約束應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained shrinkage stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：約束收縮應力 σ = R·E·ε·k。E = 48 GPa、長期收縮 ε = 555×10⁻⁶、約束度 R = 0.3、潛變鬆弛係數 k = 0.5：σ = 0.3×48,000×555×10⁻⁶×0.5 ≈ 4.0 MPa，低於 UHPC 開裂強度約 8.5 MPa，但可能超過未粗糙化介面的黏結強度。數值除材料性質外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Restrained shrinkage stress σ = R·E·ε·k. With E = 48 GPa, long-term shrinkage ε = 555×10⁻⁶, restraint R = 0.3 and creep relaxation factor k = 0.5: σ = 0.3×48,000×555×10⁻⁶×0.5 ≈ 4.0 MPa, below UHPC's cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but possibly above the bond strength of an unroughened interface. Values other than material properties are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以材料試驗取得 UHPC 的收縮曲線（例如規定 28 天收縮上限），在接縫中埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計記錄初期溫度與應變；通車前以目視與噴水檢查介面是否有細縫，並在第一個冬季後再檢查一次。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the UHPC shrinkage curve from material tests (for example against a specified 28-day limit), embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the joint to record early temperature and strain, and check the interface for fine cracks visually and by water spray before opening and again after the first winter.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

With E = 48 GPa, long-term shrinkage ε = 555×10⁻⁶, restraint R = 0.3 and creep relaxation factor k = 0.5: σ = 0.3×48,000×555×10⁻⁶×0.5 ≈ 4.0 MPa, below UHPC's cracking strength of about 8.5 MPa but possibly above the bond strength of an unroughened interface. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「收縮、溫差與介面約束」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint", which statement holds?
options: 約束收縮應力 σ = R·E·ε·k。
UHPC 黏結力很強，預鑄介面平滑也沒關係。
UHPC 一定很強，只要按配比拌合就不必做驗收試驗。
optionsEn: Restrained shrinkage stress σ = R·E·ε·k.
UHPC bonds so strongly that a smooth precast interface does not matter.
UHPC is always strong, so batching by the recipe makes acceptance testing unnecessary.

steps.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收縮約束應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrained shrinkage stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以材料試驗取得 UHPC 的收縮曲線（例如規定 28 天收縮上限），在接縫中埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計記錄初期溫度與應變；通車前以目視與噴水檢查介面是否有細縫，並在第一個冬季後再檢查一次。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the UHPC shrinkage curve from material tests (for example against a specified 28-day limit), embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the joint to record early temperature and strain, and check the interface for fine cracks visually and by water spray before opening and again after the first winter. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要列出 UHPC 收縮上限、澆置時的氣溫與預鑄板表面溫度範圍、初期養護方式（封閉保濕至初凝），並禁止以熱風直吹新澆表面；接縫監測計畫在設計時就納入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification lists the UHPC shrinkage limit, air and panel-surface temperature ranges for casting and early curing (sealed and moist until initial set), and forbids forced hot air on fresh surfaces; joint monitoring is planned at design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開；外觀上接縫完整，但雨水與鹽水沿介面細縫滲入，數年後下方梁頂出現鏽水與白華。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Casting a narrow joint on a hot afternoon and blowing forced air across it dries the surface and drives severe shrinkage, opening the interface within days; the joint looks intact, but rain and brine seep along the fine interface crack and rust staining and efflorescence appear on the girder tops below within a few years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「收縮、溫差與介面約束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

UHPC is impermeable, so neither the joint nor its surroundings can corrode.
quiz.explanation: 以材料試驗取得 UHPC 的收縮曲線（例如規定 28 天收縮上限），在接縫中埋設振弦式應變計與溫度計記錄初期溫度與應變；通車前以目視與噴水檢查介面是否有細縫，並在第一個冬季後再檢查一次。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain the UHPC shrinkage curve from material tests (for example against a specified 28-day limit), embed vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers in the joint to record early temperature and strain, and check the interface for fine cracks visually and by water spray before opening and again after the first winter. steps.title: 收縮、溫差與介面約束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收縮約束應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained shrinkage stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開；外觀上接縫完整，但雨水與鹽水沿介面細縫滲入，數年後下方梁頂出現鏽水與白華。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Casting a narrow joint on a hot afternoon and blowing forced air across it dries the surface and drives severe shrinkage, opening the interface within days; the joint looks intact, but rain and brine seep along the fine interface crack and rust staining and efflorescence appear on the girder tops below within a few years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若介面黏結不足，這些約束應力會讓介面在通車前就脫開，形成貫穿板厚的細縫，成為日後滲水路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If bond is inadequate, these restraint stresses open the interface before traffic is even applied, forming a fine through-thickness crack that becomes a future leakage path.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「UHPC 是無收縮材料，不需要考慮收縮與溫差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "UHPC is a non-shrink material, so shrinkage and temperature need not be considered." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開；外觀上接縫完整，但雨水與鹽水沿介面細縫滲入，數年後下方梁頂出現鏽水與白華。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收縮、溫差與介面約束」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shrinkage, thermal difference and interface restraint" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
UHPC 握裹力很強，鋼筋搭接長度可以隨意縮短。
在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
UHPC bonds so well that lap length can be shortened at will.
Casting a narrow joint on a hot afternoon and blowing forced air across it dries the surface and drives severe shrinkage, opening the interface within days.
quiz.explanation: 在高溫午後澆置窄接縫、又以強風機直吹表面加速乾燥，UHPC 表面失水並劇烈收縮，介面在數天內脫開；外觀上接縫完整，但雨水與鹽水沿介面細縫滲入，數年後下方梁頂出現鏽水與白華。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼筋搭接長度與接縫寬度」與「UHPC 組成與材料性質」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lap-splice length and joint width" and "UHPC constituents and material properties": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼筋搭接長度與接縫寬度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lap-splice length and joint width: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「非接觸搭接長度 ℓ_s」如何影響橋面超高性能混凝土接縫的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Non-contact lap length ℓ_s” governs force, deformation or durability in “UHPC bridge-deck closure joints”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 接縫中的鋼筋不需要互相接觸，而是由兩側伸出的鋼筋交錯排列，拉力經由周圍 UHPC 的握裹與纖維橋接傳到另一側鋼筋。FHWA 2014 年的技術說明建議：在 2% 鋼纖維、抗壓強度至少 14 ksi、保護層至少 3 倍筋徑、鋼筋不大於 8 號且降伏強度不超過 75 ksi 時，伸展長度 ℓ_d 取 8 倍筋徑，搭接長度 ℓ_s 至少 0.75ℓ_d；鋼筋強度在 75 至 100 ksi 時取 10 倍，保護層只有 2 至 3 倍筋徑時再加 2 倍筋徑，且相鄰搭接筋的淨距不得超過 ℓ_s。接縫寬度則要在搭接長度外保留製造與安裝允差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「非接觸搭接長度 ℓ_s」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bars in the joint need not touch; bars projecting from each side interleave, and tension passes through bond in the surrounding UHPC and fibre bridging to the bars opposite. FHWA's 2014 TechNote recommends that, with 2% steel fibre, compressive strength of at least 14 ksi, cover of at least three bar diameters, bars no larger than No. 8 and yield strength up to 75 ksi, the development length ℓ_d be 8 bar diameters and the lap ℓ_s at least 0.75ℓ_d; bars of 75 to 100 ksi take 10 diameters, cover of only 2 to 3 diameters adds 2 diameters, and clear spacing to the nearest spliced bar may not exceed ℓ_s. Joint width must then add fabrication and erection tolerance to the lap length. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Non-contact lap length ℓ_s” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：16 mm 鋼筋、f_y ≤ 75 ksi、保護層 ≥ 3d_b：ℓ_d = 8×16 = 128 mm，ℓ_s ≥ 0.75×128 = 96 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For 16 mm bars with f_y ≤ 75 ksi and cover ≥ 3d_b: ℓ_d = 8×16 = 128 mm and ℓ_s ≥ 0.75×128 = 96 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「UHPC 握裹力很強，鋼筋搭接長度可以隨意縮短。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "UHPC bonds so well that lap length can be shortened at will." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「非接觸搭接長度 ℓ_s」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Non-contact lap length ℓ_s”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
