The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 灌漿材料、配比與氯離子控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grout materials, mix design and chloride control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灌漿等級與氯離子上限」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grout class and chloride limit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：拌合水帶入的氯離子 = 水灰比 × 水中氯離子濃度。w/c = 0.40、拌合水含 500 mg/L：每 kg 水泥帶入 0.40×500 = 200 mg，即 0.02%，加上材料本身 0.05% 共 0.07%，低於 0.08%；若誤用海水（約 19,000 mg/L），單由水帶入 0.76%，遠超上限。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Chloride from mixing water = water–cement ratio × chloride concentration. With w/c = 0.40 and 500 mg/L in the water, each kg of cement receives 0.40×500 = 200 mg, i.e. 0.02%, which with 0.05% from the material totals 0.07%, below 0.08%; seawater at about 19,000 mg/L would contribute 0.76% from the water alone, far above the limit. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：審查灌漿產品的型式試驗報告（流度、泌水、凝結時間、強度、氯離子與硫酸鹽含量）與批號；現場確認包裝未受潮、未過期、儲存條件合格，拌合水來源經水質檢驗，並保留每批材料的出廠證明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review the grout product's qualification reports (fluidity, bleed, setting time, strength, chloride and sulfate content) and batch numbers; on site confirm bags are dry, in date and properly stored, that mixing water is tested and that mill certificates are kept for every lot.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 拌合水帶入的氯離子 = 水灰比 × 水中氯離子濃度。w/c = 0.40、拌合水含 500 mg/L：每 kg 水泥帶入 0.40×500 = 200 mg，即 0.02%，加上材料本身 0.05% 共 0.07%，低於 0.08%；若誤用海水（約 19,000 mg/L），單由水帶入 0.76%，遠超上限。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Chloride from mixing water = water–cement ratio × chloride concentration. With w/c = 0.40 and 500 mg/L in the water, each kg of cement receives 0.40×500 = 200 mg, i.e. 0.02%, which with 0.05% from the material totals 0.07%, below 0.08%; seawater at about 19,000 mg/L would contribute 0.76% from the water alone, far above the limit. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「灌漿材料、配比與氯離子控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grout materials, mix design and chloride control", which statement holds?
options: 灌漿當天出漿正常，之後就不可能在高點或錨頭出現空洞。
拌合水帶入的氯離子 = 水灰比 × 水中氯離子濃度。
非破壞檢測可以百分之百找出孔道內的所有空洞。
optionsEn: If grout flowed properly on grouting day, voids cannot later appear at crests or anchorages.
Chloride from mixing water = water–cement ratio × chloride concentration.
Non-destructive testing can find every void in a duct with certainty.
quiz.explanation: 拌合水帶入的氯離子 = 水灰比 × 水中氯離子濃度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Chloride from mixing water = water–cement ratio × chloride concentration. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 灌漿材料、配比與氯離子控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grout materials, mix design and chloride control: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌漿等級與氯離子上限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grout class and chloride limit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 審查灌漿產品的型式試驗報告（流度、泌水、凝結時間、強度、氯離子與硫酸鹽含量）與批號；現場確認包裝未受潮、未過期、儲存條件合格，拌合水來源經水質檢驗，並保留每批材料的出廠證明。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review the grout product's qualification reports (fluidity, bleed, setting time, strength, chloride and sulfate content) and batch numbers; on site confirm bags are dry, in date and properly stored, that mixing water is tested and that mill certificates are kept for every lot. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書明定灌漿等級、核可產品與禁止事項（禁止現場添加任何未經核准的外加劑、禁止使用含氯材料），任何材料替換都須重新提交試驗並經設計者書面核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification fixes grout class, approved products and prohibitions (no unapproved admixtures added on site, no chloride-bearing materials), and any substitution requires a new test submittal and the designer's written approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：2000 年美國北卡羅來納州夏洛特賽車場的人行橋（1995 年建成）因灌漿中添加了未經核准的化學品，造成鋼絞線腐蝕，一跨突然斷落，多名觀眾受傷；材料的一個未授權變更就足以摧毀整套防蝕系統。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In 2000 a span of the pedestrian bridge at Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina, built in 1995, collapsed suddenly, injuring many spectators, because an unauthorised chemical added to the tendon grout had corroded the strands; a single unapproved change to the material can defeat the whole corrosion-protection system. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Review the grout product's qualification reports (fluidity, bleed, setting time, strength, chloride and sulfate content) and batch numbers; on site confirm bags are dry, in date and properly stored, that mixing water is tested and that mill certificates are kept for every lot.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書明定灌漿等級、核可產品與禁止事項（禁止現場添加任何未經核准的外加劑、禁止使用含氯材料），任何材料替換都須重新提交試驗並經設計者書面核准。
knowledge.textEn: The specification fixes grout class, approved products and prohibitions (no unapproved admixtures added on site, no chloride-bearing materials), and any substitution requires a new test submittal and the designer's written approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「灌漿材料、配比與氯離子控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Grout materials, mix design and chloride control"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
灌漿完成後紀錄就沒有用處，不需要長期保存。
審查灌漿產品的型式試驗報告（流度、泌水、凝結時間、強度、氯離子與硫酸鹽含量）與批號。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once grouting is done the records are useless and need not be kept.
Review the grout product's qualification reports (fluidity, bleed, setting time, strength, chloride and sulfate content) and batch numbers.

quiz.explanationEn: Review the grout product's qualification reports (fluidity, bleed, setting time, strength, chloride and sulfate content) and batch numbers; on site confirm bags are dry, in date and properly stored, that mixing water is tested and that mill certificates are kept for every lot. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 灌漿材料、配比與氯離子控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grout materials, mix design and chloride control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灌漿等級與氯離子上限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grout class and chloride limit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 2000 年美國北卡羅來納州夏洛特賽車場的人行橋（1995 年建成）因灌漿中添加了未經核准的化學品，造成鋼絞線腐蝕，一跨突然斷落，多名觀眾受傷；材料的一個未授權變更就足以摧毀整套防蝕系統。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: In 2000 a span of the pedestrian bridge at Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina, built in 1995, collapsed suddenly, injuring many spectators, because an unauthorised chemical added to the tendon grout had corroded the strands; a single unapproved change to the material can defeat the whole corrosion-protection system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：2001 年後預拌觸變性灌漿普及，但 FHWA 調查顯示部分新橋仍因材料離析、軟化與高氯、高硫酸鹽而腐蝕，說明材料管理與現場拌合同樣重要。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pre-bagged thixotropic grouts spread after 2001, yet FHWA investigations found some newer bridges still corroding because of segregated, soft grout with high chloride and sulfate, showing that material control matters as much as field mixing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加一點早強劑或其他添加劑讓灌漿更快硬化，對鋼腱沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding a little accelerator or another admixture to speed grout hardening does not affect the tendons." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 2000 年美國北卡羅來納州夏洛特賽車場的人行橋（1995 年建成）因灌漿中添加了未經核准的化學品，造成鋼絞線腐蝕，一跨突然斷落，多名觀眾受傷；材料的一個未授權變更就足以摧毀整套防蝕系統。
knowledge.textEn: In 2000 a span of the pedestrian bridge at Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina, built in 1995, collapsed suddenly, injuring many spectators, because an unauthorised chemical added to the tendon grout had corroded the strands; a single unapproved change to the material can defeat the whole corrosion-protection system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「灌漿材料、配比與氯離子控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grout materials, mix design and chloride control" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 2000 年美國北卡羅來納州夏洛特賽車場的人行橋（1995 年建成）因灌漿中添加了未經核准的化學品，造成鋼絞線腐蝕，一跨突然斷落，多名觀眾受傷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
孔道只是預留的通道，用什麼材料、接頭是否密封都不重要。
optionsEn: In 2000 a span of the pedestrian bridge at Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina, built in 1995, collapsed suddenly, injuring many spectators, because an unauthorised chemical added to the tendon grout had corroded the strands.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A duct is just a preformed hole, so its material and joint sealing do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 2000 年美國北卡羅來納州夏洛特賽車場的人行橋（1995 年建成）因灌漿中添加了未經核准的化學品，造成鋼絞線腐蝕，一跨突然斷落，多名觀眾受傷；材料的一個未授權變更就足以摧毀整套防蝕系統。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In 2000 a span of the pedestrian bridge at Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina, built in 1995, collapsed suddenly, injuring many spectators, because an unauthorised chemical added to the tendon grout had corroded the strands; a single unapproved change to the material can defeat the whole corrosion-protection system. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔道、灌漿口與錨頭細部：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Ducts, ports and anchorage details: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「孔道面積比與灌漿量」如何影響預力混凝土孔道灌漿的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct area ratio and grout volume” governs force, deformation or durability in “Prestressing-duct grouting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 孔道必須夠大，讓鋼絞線穿索後仍留有足夠空間讓灌漿流過並包覆每一股；密封的塑膠波紋管比鍍鋅鋼管更能阻絕外部水分與氯離子，但接頭、耦合器與節塊接縫處必須確實密封。灌漿口與排氣管的內徑也有下限，FHWA 手冊建議鋼絞線鋼腱的進出口內徑至少 20 mm，以免灌漿阻塞。錨頭是最容易進水的位置，需以永久封蓋灌滿，再以混凝土封頭與防水層保護。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「孔道面積比與灌漿量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ducts must be large enough to leave space for grout to flow around every strand after threading; sealed corrugated plastic ducts block external water and chlorides better than galvanised steel, but joints, couplers and segment interfaces must be properly sealed. Inlets and vents also have minimum sizes; the FHWA manual recommends at least 20 mm internal diameter for strand-tendon ports so grout does not block them. Anchorages are the easiest entry point for water and need permanent caps filled with grout, then concrete pour-backs and waterproofing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Duct area ratio and grout volume” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：孔道內徑 100 mm，面積 π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm²，鋼絞線 2,660 mm²，面積比 7,854/2,660 ≈ 2.95；每公尺灌漿淨面積 7,854 − 2,660 ≈ 5,194 mm²，100 m 鋼腱理論灌漿量約 0.52 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 100 mm duct has π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm² against 2,660 mm² of strand, an area ratio of about 2.95; the net grout area is about 5,194 mm² per metre, so a 100 m tendon needs about 0.52 m³ of grout in theory.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔道只是預留的通道，用什麼材料、接頭是否密封都不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A duct is just a preformed hole, so its material and joint sealing do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「孔道面積比與灌漿量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Duct area ratio and grout volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔道、灌漿口與錨頭細部
knowledge.text: 孔道必須夠大，讓鋼絞線穿索後仍留有足夠空間讓灌漿流過並包覆每一股；密封的塑膠波紋管比鍍鋅鋼管更能阻絕外部水分與氯離子，但接頭、耦合器與節塊接縫處必須確實密封。灌漿口與排氣管的內徑也有下限，FHWA 手冊建議鋼絞線鋼腱的進出口內徑至少 20 mm，以免灌漿阻塞。
knowledge.textEn: Ducts must be large enough to leave space for grout to flow around every strand after threading; sealed corrugated plastic ducts block external water and chlorides better than galvanised steel, but joints, couplers and segment interfaces must be properly sealed. Inlets and vents also have minimum sizes; the FHWA manual recommends at least 20 mm internal diameter for strand-tendon ports so grout does not block them.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔道只是預留的通道，用什麼材料、接頭是否密封都不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A duct is just a preformed hole, so its material and joint sealing do not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔道、灌漿口與錨頭細部」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ducts, ports and anchorage details" is correct?
options: 孔道只是預留的通道，用什麼材料、接頭是否密封都不重要。
孔道必須夠大，讓鋼絞線穿索後仍留有足夠空間讓灌漿流過並包覆每一股；密封的塑膠波紋管比鍍鋅鋼管更能阻絕外部水分與氯離子，但接頭、耦合器與節塊接縫處必須確實密封。
灌漿壓力越高越好，可以把孔道擠得更密實。
optionsEn: A duct is just a preformed hole, so its material and joint sealing do not matter.
Ducts must be large enough to leave space for grout to flow around every strand after threading.
The higher the grouting pressure the better, because it packs the duct more densely.
quiz.explanation: 孔道必須夠大，讓鋼絞線穿索後仍留有足夠空間讓灌漿流過並包覆每一股；密封的塑膠波紋管比鍍鋅鋼管更能阻絕外部水分與氯離子，但接頭、耦合器與節塊接縫處必須確實密封。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ducts must be large enough to leave space for grout to flow around every strand after threading; sealed corrugated plastic ducts block external water and chlorides better than galvanised steel, but joints, couplers and segment interfaces must be properly sealed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔道、灌漿口與錨頭細部：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ducts, ports and anchorage details: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔道面積比與灌漿量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct area ratio and grout volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：孔道內徑 100 mm，面積 π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm²，鋼絞線 2,660 mm²，面積比 7,854/2,660 ≈ 2.95；每公尺灌漿淨面積 7,854 − 2,660 ≈ 5,194 mm²，100 m 鋼腱理論灌漿量約 0.52 m³。若改用 90 mm 孔道，面積比降為約 2.39。數值為教學假設，面積比下限依規範。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 100 mm duct has π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm² against 2,660 mm² of strand, an area ratio of about 2.95; the net grout area is about 5,194 mm² per metre, so a 100 m tendon needs about 0.52 m³ of grout in theory. A 90 mm duct lowers the ratio to about 2.39. Values are teaching assumptions; the minimum ratio follows the code. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查孔道材料證明、壁厚、接頭與耦合器的密封方式，澆置混凝土前以壓力或真空試驗確認孔道系統氣密；量測灌漿口與排氣管內徑與位置，並在混凝土澆置後以通球或吹氣確認孔道未被壓扁或堵塞。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check duct material certificates, wall thickness and sealing of joints and couplers, and pressure- or vacuum-test the duct system for airtightness before concreting; measure port diameters and locations, and after concreting confirm by pulling a ball or blowing air that ducts are neither crushed nor blocked.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 孔道內徑 100 mm，面積 π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm²，鋼絞線 2,660 mm²，面積比 7,854/2,660 ≈ 2.95；每公尺灌漿淨面積 7,854 − 2,660 ≈ 5,194 mm²，100 m 鋼腱理論灌漿量約 0.52 m³。若改用 90 mm 孔道，面積比降為約 2.39。數值為教學假設，面積比下限依規範。
knowledge.textEn: A 100 mm duct has π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm² against 2,660 mm² of strand, an area ratio of about 2.95; the net grout area is about 5,194 mm² per metre, so a 100 m tendon needs about 0.52 m³ of grout in theory. A 90 mm duct lowers the ratio to about 2.39. Values are teaching assumptions; the minimum ratio follows the code.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔道、灌漿口與錨頭細部」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ducts, ports and anchorage details", which statement holds?
options: 灌漿越稀越容易流進孔道，品質就越好。
使用預拌包裝灌漿的新橋，就不會有灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕。
optionsEn: The thinner the grout, the more easily it fills the duct and the better the quality.
New bridges using pre-bagged grout cannot suffer corrosion from grout defects.
A 100 mm duct has π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm² against 2,660 mm² of strand, an area ratio of about 2.95.
quiz.explanation: 孔道內徑 100 mm，面積 π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm²，鋼絞線 2,660 mm²，面積比 7,854/2,660 ≈ 2.95；每公尺灌漿淨面積 7,854 − 2,660 ≈ 5,194 mm²，100 m 鋼腱理論灌漿量約 0.52 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 100 mm duct has π/4×100² ≈ 7,854 mm² against 2,660 mm² of strand, an area ratio of about 2.95; the net grout area is about 5,194 mm² per metre, so a 100 m tendon needs about 0.52 m³ of grout in theory. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔道、灌漿口與錨頭細部：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ducts, ports and anchorage details: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔道面積比與灌漿量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct area ratio and grout volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查孔道材料證明、壁厚、接頭與耦合器的密封方式，澆置混凝土前以壓力或真空試驗確認孔道系統氣密；量測灌漿口與排氣管內徑與位置，並在混凝土澆置後以通球或吹氣確認孔道未被壓扁或堵塞。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check duct material certificates, wall thickness and sealing of joints and couplers, and pressure- or vacuum-test the duct system for airtightness before concreting; measure port diameters and locations, and after concreting confirm by pulling a ball or blowing air that ducts are neither crushed nor blocked. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把孔道氣密試驗與通孔確認列為澆置混凝土與灌漿前的兩個停留點；錨頭封蓋、封頭混凝土與防水細部在施工圖中逐一繪出，不得留待現場決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make duct airtightness testing and clear-passage confirmation hold points before concreting and before grouting; draw anchorage caps, pour-backs and waterproofing details individually on the shop drawings rather than leaving them to site decisions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：節塊接縫處孔道未以密封環對接，混凝土漿與後來的雨水從接縫進入孔道；混凝土澆置時振動棒壓扁孔道，灌漿無法通過而在一側留下長段空洞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ducts not joined with sealing couplers at segment joints let cement paste and later rainwater enter the duct; a vibrator crushing the duct during concreting stops grout passing and leaves a long void on one side. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查孔道材料證明、壁厚、接頭與耦合器的密封方式，澆置混凝土前以壓力或真空試驗確認孔道系統氣密；量測灌漿口與排氣管內徑與位置，並在混凝土澆置後以通球或吹氣確認孔道未被壓扁或堵塞。
knowledge.textEn: Check duct material certificates, wall thickness and sealing of joints and couplers, and pressure- or vacuum-test the duct system for airtightness before concreting; measure port diameters and locations, and after concreting confirm by pulling a ball or blowing air that ducts are neither crushed nor blocked.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把孔道氣密試驗與通孔確認列為澆置混凝土與灌漿前的兩個停留點；錨頭封蓋、封頭混凝土與防水細部在施工圖中逐一繪出，不得留待現場決定。
knowledge.textEn: Make duct airtightness testing and clear-passage confirmation hold points before concreting and before grouting; draw anchorage caps, pour-backs and waterproofing details individually on the shop drawings rather than leaving them to site decisions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔道、灌漿口與錨頭細部」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ducts, ports and anchorage details"?
options: 檢查孔道材料證明、壁厚、接頭與耦合器的密封方式，澆置混凝土前以壓力或真空試驗確認孔道系統氣密。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
鋼腱被包在混凝土裡面，自然就不會生鏽。
optionsEn: Check duct material certificates, wall thickness and sealing of joints and couplers, and pressure- or vacuum-test the duct system for airtightness before concreting.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Tendons buried inside concrete cannot rust.
quiz.explanation: 檢查孔道材料證明、壁厚、接頭與耦合器的密封方式，澆置混凝土前以壓力或真空試驗確認孔道系統氣密；量測灌漿口與排氣管內徑與位置，並在混凝土澆置後以通球或吹氣確認孔道未被壓扁或堵塞。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check duct material certificates, wall thickness and sealing of joints and couplers, and pressure- or vacuum-test the duct system for airtightness before concreting; measure port diameters and locations, and after concreting confirm by pulling a ball or blowing air that ducts are neither crushed nor blocked. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔道、灌漿口與錨頭細部：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ducts, ports and anchorage details: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔道面積比與灌漿量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct area ratio and grout volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 節塊接縫處孔道未以密封環對接，混凝土漿與後來的雨水從接縫進入孔道；混凝土澆置時振動棒壓扁孔道，灌漿無法通過而在一側留下長段空洞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ducts not joined with sealing couplers at segment joints let cement paste and later rainwater enter the duct; a vibrator crushing the duct during concreting stops grout passing and leaves a long void on one side. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：錨頭是最容易進水的位置，需以永久封蓋灌滿，再以混凝土封頭與防水層保護。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Anchorages are the easiest entry point for water and need permanent caps filled with grout, then concrete pour-backs and waterproofing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔道只是預留的通道，用什麼材料、接頭是否密封都不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A duct is just a preformed hole, so its material and joint sealing do not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 節塊接縫處孔道未以密封環對接，混凝土漿與後來的雨水從接縫進入孔道；混凝土澆置時振動棒壓扁孔道，灌漿無法通過而在一側留下長段空洞。
knowledge.textEn: Ducts not joined with sealing couplers at segment joints let cement paste and later rainwater enter the duct; a vibrator crushing the duct during concreting stops grout passing and leaves a long void on one side.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔道、灌漿口與錨頭細部」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ducts, ports and anchorage details" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
節塊接縫處孔道未以密封環對接，混凝土漿與後來的雨水從接縫進入孔道；混凝土澆置時振動棒壓扁孔道，灌漿無法通過而在一側留下長段空洞。
灌漿壓力越高越好，可以把孔道擠得更密實。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ducts not joined with sealing couplers at segment joints let cement paste and later rainwater enter the duct.
The higher the grouting pressure the better, because it packs the duct more densely.
quiz.explanation: 節塊接縫處孔道未以密封環對接，混凝土漿與後來的雨水從接縫進入孔道；混凝土澆置時振動棒壓扁孔道，灌漿無法通過而在一側留下長段空洞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ducts not joined with sealing couplers at segment joints let cement paste and later rainwater enter the duct; a vibrator crushing the duct during concreting stops grout passing and leaves a long void on one side. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序」與「錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence" and "Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「灌漿推進速度與壓力」如何影響預力混凝土孔道灌漿的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grout advance rate and pressure” governs force, deformation or durability in “Prestressing-duct grouting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 灌漿要從最低點的灌漿口以連續、穩定的流量推進，讓灌漿前緣把空氣與水推向排氣口；每個排氣口在流出與進料一致、無氣泡的灌漿後才依序關閉，直到最後出漿口確認後再加壓保持一段時間。推進太快會讓灌漿越過鋼絞線間的空氣而形成空洞，太慢或中斷則讓灌漿在孔道內開始凝結。壓力要控制在孔道與錨頭可承受範圍內，垂直或高差大的鋼腱還要考慮靜水壓與雙閥門。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「灌漿推進速度與壓力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grout is pumped from the lowest inlet at a continuous, steady rate so the grout front pushes air and water toward the vents; each vent is closed in sequence only once grout of the same consistency as the feed, free of bubbles, flows from it, and after the final outlet is confirmed the system is held under pressure for a period. Advancing too fast lets grout bypass air between strands and leave voids; too slow, or interrupted, lets grout begin to set inside the duct. Pressure must stay within what ducts and anchorages can take, and vertical or steep tendons must also consider static head and double valves. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Grout advance rate and pressure” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：幫浦流量 30 L/min，孔道淨面積 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m，推進速度 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min；100 m 鋼腱 0.52 m³ 約需 17 分鐘連續灌注。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At a pump rate of 30 L/min and a net duct area of 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m, the grout advances at 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min, so a 100 m tendon of 0.52 m³ needs about 17 minutes of continuous pumping.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌漿壓力越高越好，可以把孔道擠得更密實。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the grouting pressure the better, because it packs the duct more densely." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「灌漿推進速度與壓力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Grout advance rate and pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序
knowledge.titleEn: Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence
knowledge.text: 灌漿要從最低點的灌漿口以連續、穩定的流量推進，讓灌漿前緣把空氣與水推向排氣口；每個排氣口在流出與進料一致、無氣泡的灌漿後才依序關閉，直到最後出漿口確認後再加壓保持一段時間。推進太快會讓灌漿越過鋼絞線間的空氣而形成空洞，太慢或中斷則讓灌漿在孔道內開始凝結。
knowledge.textEn: Grout is pumped from the lowest inlet at a continuous, steady rate so the grout front pushes air and water toward the vents; each vent is closed in sequence only once grout of the same consistency as the feed, free of bubbles, flows from it, and after the final outlet is confirmed the system is held under pressure for a period. Advancing too fast lets grout bypass air between strands and leave voids; too slow, or interrupted, lets grout begin to set inside the duct.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：灌漿壓力越高越好，可以把孔道擠得更密實。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The higher the grouting pressure the better, because it packs the duct more densely. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence" is correct?
options: 灌漿壓力越高越好，可以把孔道擠得更密實。
灌漿當天出漿正常，之後就不可能在高點或錨頭出現空洞。
灌漿要從最低點的灌漿口以連續、穩定的流量推進，讓灌漿前緣把空氣與水推向排氣口。
optionsEn: The higher the grouting pressure the better, because it packs the duct more densely.
If grout flowed properly on grouting day, voids cannot later appear at crests or anchorages.
Grout is pumped from the lowest inlet at a continuous, steady rate so the grout front pushes air and water toward the vents.
quiz.explanation: 灌漿要從最低點的灌漿口以連續、穩定的流量推進，讓灌漿前緣把空氣與水推向排氣口；每個排氣口在流出與進料一致、無氣泡的灌漿後才依序關閉，直到最後出漿口確認後再加壓保持一段時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Grout is pumped from the lowest inlet at a continuous, steady rate so the grout front pushes air and water toward the vents; each vent is closed in sequence only once grout of the same consistency as the feed, free of bubbles, flows from it, and after the final outlet is confirmed the system is held under pressure for a period. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灌漿推進速度與壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grout advance rate and pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：幫浦流量 30 L/min，孔道淨面積 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m，推進速度 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min；100 m 鋼腱 0.52 m³ 約需 17 分鐘連續灌注。若高點比灌漿口高 3 m、灌漿密度 1,900 kg/m³，靜水壓 1,900×9.81×3 ≈ 56 kPa，須加在摩擦損失之上。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At a pump rate of 30 L/min and a net duct area of 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m, the grout advances at 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min, so a 100 m tendon of 0.52 m³ needs about 17 minutes of continuous pumping. With a crest 3 m above the inlet and grout density 1,900 kg/m³, static head is 1,900×9.81×3 ≈ 56 kPa, added to friction losses. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：灌漿前確認幫浦、備用幫浦與足夠材料就位，逐條鋼腱記錄開始與結束時間、壓力歷程、各排氣口關閉時間與出漿狀態；在出漿口取樣量測流度與密度，與進料比較，確認出口灌漿未被稀釋或混入空氣。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before grouting confirm the pump, a standby pump and sufficient material are ready; for each tendon record start and finish times, pressure history, vent closing times and outflow condition; sample at the outlet for fluidity and density and compare with the feed to confirm the outflow is neither diluted nor aerated.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 幫浦流量 30 L/min，孔道淨面積 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m，推進速度 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min；100 m 鋼腱 0.52 m³ 約需 17 分鐘連續灌注。若高點比灌漿口高 3 m、灌漿密度 1,900 kg/m³，靜水壓 1,900×9.81×3 ≈ 56 kPa，須加在摩擦損失之上。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: At a pump rate of 30 L/min and a net duct area of 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m, the grout advances at 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min, so a 100 m tendon of 0.52 m³ needs about 17 minutes of continuous pumping. With a crest 3 m above the inlet and grout density 1,900 kg/m³, static head is 1,900×9.81×3 ≈ 56 kPa, added to friction losses. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence", which statement holds?
options: 幫浦流量 30 L/min，孔道淨面積 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m，推進速度 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min。
非破壞檢測可以百分之百找出孔道內的所有空洞。
灌漿完成後紀錄就沒有用處，不需要長期保存。
optionsEn: At a pump rate of 30 L/min and a net duct area of 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m, the grout advances at 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min, so a 100 m tendon of 0.52 m³ needs about 17 minutes of continuous pumping.
Non-destructive testing can find every void in a duct with certainty.
Once grouting is done the records are useless and need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 幫浦流量 30 L/min，孔道淨面積 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m，推進速度 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min；100 m 鋼腱 0.52 m³ 約需 17 分鐘連續灌注。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: At a pump rate of 30 L/min and a net duct area of 5,194 mm² = 5.19 L/m, the grout advances at 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m/min, so a 100 m tendon of 0.52 m³ needs about 17 minutes of continuous pumping. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌漿推進速度與壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grout advance rate and pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 灌漿前確認幫浦、備用幫浦與足夠材料就位，逐條鋼腱記錄開始與結束時間、壓力歷程、各排氣口關閉時間與出漿狀態；在出漿口取樣量測流度與密度，與進料比較，確認出口灌漿未被稀釋或混入空氣。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before grouting confirm the pump, a standby pump and sufficient material are ready; for each tendon record start and finish times, pressure history, vent closing times and outflow condition; sample at the outlet for fluidity and density and compare with the feed to confirm the outflow is neither diluted nor aerated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：灌漿作業由取得專業認證的人員執行並由監造全程見證，每條鋼腱的灌漿紀錄當場簽認；中斷時依事先核准的應變程序（例如立即以水沖洗或改由另一灌漿口完成）處理，不得臨場自行判斷。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Grouting is carried out by certified specialists and witnessed throughout by the inspector, with each tendon's record signed on the spot; interruptions follow a pre-approved contingency (for example immediate flushing or completion from another inlet), never improvisation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：灌漿中途幫浦故障而沒有備用設備，孔道內灌漿停留過久開始凝結，再次啟動時壓力暴增而無法完成，留下半段空孔道；或排氣口一見到灌漿就關閉，前緣夾帶的水與空氣被封在孔道內。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A pump failure mid-tendon with no standby leaves grout standing until it begins to set, so restarting spikes the pressure and the tendon cannot be completed, leaving half the duct empty; closing vents as soon as any grout appears traps the water and air carried at the front inside the duct. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 灌漿前確認幫浦、備用幫浦與足夠材料就位，逐條鋼腱記錄開始與結束時間、壓力歷程、各排氣口關閉時間與出漿狀態；在出漿口取樣量測流度與密度，與進料比較，確認出口灌漿未被稀釋或混入空氣。
knowledge.textEn: Before grouting confirm the pump, a standby pump and sufficient material are ready; for each tendon record start and finish times, pressure history, vent closing times and outflow condition; sample at the outlet for fluidity and density and compare with the feed to confirm the outflow is neither diluted nor aerated.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 灌漿作業由取得專業認證的人員執行並由監造全程見證，每條鋼腱的灌漿紀錄當場簽認；中斷時依事先核准的應變程序（例如立即以水沖洗或改由另一灌漿口完成）處理，不得臨場自行判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Grouting is carried out by certified specialists and witnessed throughout by the inspector, with each tendon's record signed on the spot; interruptions follow a pre-approved contingency (for example immediate flushing or completion from another inlet), never improvisation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
灌漿前確認幫浦、備用幫浦與足夠材料就位，逐條鋼腱記錄開始與結束時間、壓力歷程、各排氣口關閉時間與出漿狀態。
灌漿從一端打入、另一端出漿，就代表孔道已經完全填滿。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before grouting confirm the pump, a standby pump and sufficient material are ready.
If grout pumped in at one end comes out at the other, the duct is completely filled.
quiz.explanation: 灌漿前確認幫浦、備用幫浦與足夠材料就位，逐條鋼腱記錄開始與結束時間、壓力歷程、各排氣口關閉時間與出漿狀態；在出漿口取樣量測流度與密度，與進料比較，確認出口灌漿未被稀釋或混入空氣。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before grouting confirm the pump, a standby pump and sufficient material are ready; for each tendon record start and finish times, pressure history, vent closing times and outflow condition; sample at the outlet for fluidity and density and compare with the feed to confirm the outflow is neither diluted nor aerated. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灌漿推進速度與壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grout advance rate and pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 灌漿中途幫浦故障而沒有備用設備，孔道內灌漿停留過久開始凝結，再次啟動時壓力暴增而無法完成，留下半段空孔道；或排氣口一見到灌漿就關閉，前緣夾帶的水與空氣被封在孔道內。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A pump failure mid-tendon with no standby leaves grout standing until it begins to set, so restarting spikes the pressure and the tendon cannot be completed, leaving half the duct empty; closing vents as soon as any grout appears traps the water and air carried at the front inside the duct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：壓力要控制在孔道與錨頭可承受範圍內，垂直或高差大的鋼腱還要考慮靜水壓與雙閥門。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pressure must stay within what ducts and anchorages can take, and vertical or steep tendons must also consider static head and double valves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌漿壓力越高越好，可以把孔道擠得更密實。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the grouting pressure the better, because it packs the duct more densely." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 灌漿中途幫浦故障而沒有備用設備，孔道內灌漿停留過久開始凝結，再次啟動時壓力暴增而無法完成，留下半段空孔道；或排氣口一見到灌漿就關閉，前緣夾帶的水與空氣被封在孔道內。
knowledge.textEn: A pump failure mid-tendon with no standby leaves grout standing until it begins to set, so restarting spikes the pressure and the tendon cannot be completed, leaving half the duct empty; closing vents as soon as any grout appears traps the water and air carried at the front inside the duct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「灌漿程序、壓力與排氣順序」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grouting procedure, pressure and venting sequence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
灌漿當天出漿正常，之後就不可能在高點或錨頭出現空洞。
灌漿中途幫浦故障而沒有備用設備，孔道內灌漿停留過久開始凝結，再次啟動時壓力暴增而無法完成，留下半段空孔道。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If grout flowed properly on grouting day, voids cannot later appear at crests or anchorages.
A pump failure mid-tendon with no standby leaves grout standing until it begins to set, so restarting spikes the pressure and the tendon cannot be completed, leaving half the duct empty.
quiz.explanation: 灌漿中途幫浦故障而沒有備用設備，孔道內灌漿停留過久開始凝結，再次啟動時壓力暴增而無法完成，留下半段空孔道；或排氣口一見到灌漿就關閉，前緣夾帶的水與空氣被封在孔道內。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A pump failure mid-tendon with no standby leaves grout standing until it begins to set, so restarting spikes the pressure and the tendon cannot be completed, leaving half the duct empty; closing vents as soon as any grout appears traps the water and air carried at the front inside the duct. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「真空補灌與空洞體積」如何影響預力混凝土孔道灌漿的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vacuum regrouting and void volume” governs force, deformation or durability in “Prestressing-duct grouting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 灌漿完成並初凝後，要檢查高點與錨頭是否因沉降或泌水被吸收而出現空洞：常見做法是在高點排氣管與錨頭封蓋處開孔，以探針或內視鏡觀察，必要時以真空輔助補灌。真空補灌先把空洞抽成低壓，再讓灌漿被吸入，能填入細小且彎曲的空間；以已知容積的儲氣槽連接空洞並觀察壓力平衡，即可依波以耳定律估算空洞體積，進而確認補灌量。錨頭最後以永久封蓋、封頭混凝土與防水塗層多層保護。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「真空補灌與空洞體積」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After grouting and initial set, high points and anchorages are checked for voids caused by settlement or bleed reabsorption: vents at crests and anchorage caps are opened and probed or viewed with a borescope, and vacuum-assisted regrouting is used where needed. Vacuum regrouting first evacuates the void, then lets grout be drawn in, filling small and tortuous spaces; connecting a reservoir of known volume to the void and observing the pressure equalisation estimates the void volume by Boyle's law, confirming the regrout quantity. The anchorage is finally protected in layers by a permanent cap, a concrete pour-back and a waterproof coating. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Vacuum regrouting and void volume” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：波以耳定律 p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Boyle's law p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌漿當天出漿正常，之後就不可能在高點或錨頭出現空洞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If grout flowed properly on grouting day, voids cannot later appear at crests or anchorages." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「真空補灌與空洞體積」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Vacuum regrouting and void volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查
knowledge.titleEn: Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks
knowledge.text: 灌漿完成並初凝後，要檢查高點與錨頭是否因沉降或泌水被吸收而出現空洞：常見做法是在高點排氣管與錨頭封蓋處開孔，以探針或內視鏡觀察，必要時以真空輔助補灌。真空補灌先把空洞抽成低壓，再讓灌漿被吸入，能填入細小且彎曲的空間；以已知容積的儲氣槽連接空洞並觀察壓力平衡，即可依波以耳定律估算空洞體積，進而確認補灌量。
knowledge.textEn: After grouting and initial set, high points and anchorages are checked for voids caused by settlement or bleed reabsorption: vents at crests and anchorage caps are opened and probed or viewed with a borescope, and vacuum-assisted regrouting is used where needed. Vacuum regrouting first evacuates the void, then lets grout be drawn in, filling small and tortuous spaces; connecting a reservoir of known volume to the void and observing the pressure equalisation estimates the void volume by Boyle's law, confirming the regrout quantity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：灌漿當天出漿正常，之後就不可能在高點或錨頭出現空洞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If grout flowed properly on grouting day, voids cannot later appear at crests or anchorages. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks" is correct?
options: 灌漿完成並初凝後，要檢查高點與錨頭是否因沉降或泌水被吸收而出現空洞：常見做法是在高點排氣管與錨頭封蓋處開孔，以探針或內視鏡觀察，必要時以真空輔助補灌。
灌漿當天出漿正常，之後就不可能在高點或錨頭出現空洞。
灌漿越稀越容易流進孔道，品質就越好。
optionsEn: After grouting and initial set, high points and anchorages are checked for voids caused by settlement or bleed reabsorption: vents at crests and anchorage caps are opened and probed or viewed with a borescope, and vacuum-assisted regrouting is used where needed.
If grout flowed properly on grouting day, voids cannot later appear at crests or anchorages.
The thinner the grout, the more easily it fills the duct and the better the quality.
quiz.explanation: 灌漿完成並初凝後，要檢查高點與錨頭是否因沉降或泌水被吸收而出現空洞：常見做法是在高點排氣管與錨頭封蓋處開孔，以探針或內視鏡觀察，必要時以真空輔助補灌。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After grouting and initial set, high points and anchorages are checked for voids caused by settlement or bleed reabsorption: vents at crests and anchorage caps are opened and probed or viewed with a borescope, and vacuum-assisted regrouting is used where needed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「真空補灌與空洞體積」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vacuum regrouting and void volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：波以耳定律 p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v)。儲氣槽 V_r = 20 L、1.0 bar，空洞抽到 0.1 bar，連通後平衡為 0.8 bar：20×1.0 + 0.1V_v = 0.8×(20 + V_v)，得 V_v = 4/0.7 ≈ 5.7 L，即約 1.1 m 長孔道的淨灌漿體積。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Boyle's law p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v). With a 20 L reservoir at 1.0 bar, a void evacuated to 0.1 bar and equalisation at 0.8 bar: 20×1.0 + 0.1V_v = 0.8×(20 + V_v), so V_v = 4/0.7 ≈ 5.7 L, the net grout volume of about 1.1 m of duct. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依計畫在每條鋼腱的高點與錨頭抽查空洞，以探針或量規量測空洞深度並記錄位置；補灌後重新檢查，確認補灌量與估算空洞體積一致；錨頭封蓋灌滿後以敲擊或開孔抽查，封頭混凝土與防水層依圖施作並拍照存證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check for voids at each tendon's crests and anchorages as planned, measuring depth with a probe or gauge and recording location; after regrouting recheck and confirm that the regrout quantity matches the estimated void volume; after caps are filled check by sounding or test holes, and build pour-backs and waterproofing as drawn with photographic records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 波以耳定律 p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v)。儲氣槽 V_r = 20 L、1.0 bar，空洞抽到 0.1 bar，連通後平衡為 0.8 bar：20×1.0 + 0.1V_v = 0.8×(20 + V_v)，得 V_v = 4/0.7 ≈ 5.7 L，即約 1.1 m 長孔道的淨灌漿體積。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Boyle's law p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v). With a 20 L reservoir at 1.0 bar, a void evacuated to 0.1 bar and equalisation at 0.8 bar: 20×1.0 + 0.1V_v = 0.8×(20 + V_v), so V_v = 4/0.7 ≈ 5.7 L, the net grout volume of about 1.1 m of duct. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks", which statement holds?
options: 使用預拌包裝灌漿的新橋，就不會有灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕。
波以耳定律 p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v)。
鋼腱被包在混凝土裡面，自然就不會生鏽。
optionsEn: New bridges using pre-bagged grout cannot suffer corrosion from grout defects.
Boyle's law p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v).
Tendons buried inside concrete cannot rust.
quiz.explanation: 波以耳定律 p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Boyle's law p_r·V_r + p_v·V_v = p_f·(V_r + V_v). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「真空補灌與空洞體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vacuum regrouting and void volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依計畫在每條鋼腱的高點與錨頭抽查空洞，以探針或量規量測空洞深度並記錄位置；補灌後重新檢查，確認補灌量與估算空洞體積一致；錨頭封蓋灌滿後以敲擊或開孔抽查，封頭混凝土與防水層依圖施作並拍照存證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check for voids at each tendon's crests and anchorages as planned, measuring depth with a probe or gauge and recording location; after regrouting recheck and confirm that the regrout quantity matches the estimated void volume; after caps are filled check by sounding or test holes, and build pour-backs and waterproofing as drawn with photographic records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把「初凝後高點與錨頭空洞檢查」與「錨頭封護完成」列為獨立的停留點，檢查孔洞事後以相容材料封閉；補灌由合格人員依核准程序進行，結果寫入該鋼腱的灌漿紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make the post-set void check at crests and anchorages and completion of anchorage protection separate hold points, sealing inspection holes afterwards with compatible material; regrouting is done by qualified personnel to an approved procedure and recorded in that tendon's grouting record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：完工後沒有檢查高點與錨頭，泌水被吸收後留下的空洞與封蓋內未填滿的空間長期存在；錨頭封頭混凝土開裂後，雨水與除冰鹽直接進入錨頭與鋼絞線端部，是許多鋼腱腐蝕案例的起點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without checks at crests and anchorages after completion, voids left by reabsorbed bleed water and unfilled cap space persist for years; once the anchorage pour-back cracks, rain and de-icing salt enter the anchorage and strand ends directly, the starting point of many tendon corrosion cases. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依計畫在每條鋼腱的高點與錨頭抽查空洞，以探針或量規量測空洞深度並記錄位置；補灌後重新檢查，確認補灌量與估算空洞體積一致；錨頭封蓋灌滿後以敲擊或開孔抽查，封頭混凝土與防水層依圖施作並拍照存證。
knowledge.textEn: Check for voids at each tendon's crests and anchorages as planned, measuring depth with a probe or gauge and recording location; after regrouting recheck and confirm that the regrout quantity matches the estimated void volume; after caps are filled check by sounding or test holes, and build pour-backs and waterproofing as drawn with photographic records.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把「初凝後高點與錨頭空洞檢查」與「錨頭封護完成」列為獨立的停留點，檢查孔洞事後以相容材料封閉；補灌由合格人員依核准程序進行，結果寫入該鋼腱的灌漿紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Make the post-set void check at crests and anchorages and completion of anchorage protection separate hold points, sealing inspection holes afterwards with compatible material; regrouting is done by qualified personnel to an approved procedure and recorded in that tendon's grouting record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
加一點早強劑或其他添加劑讓灌漿更快硬化，對鋼腱沒有影響。
依計畫在每條鋼腱的高點與錨頭抽查空洞，以探針或量規量測空洞深度並記錄位置。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Adding a little accelerator or another admixture to speed grout hardening does not affect the tendons.
Check for voids at each tendon's crests and anchorages as planned, measuring depth with a probe or gauge and recording location.
quiz.explanation: 依計畫在每條鋼腱的高點與錨頭抽查空洞，以探針或量規量測空洞深度並記錄位置；補灌後重新檢查，確認補灌量與估算空洞體積一致；錨頭封蓋灌滿後以敲擊或開孔抽查，封頭混凝土與防水層依圖施作並拍照存證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check for voids at each tendon's crests and anchorages as planned, measuring depth with a probe or gauge and recording location; after regrouting recheck and confirm that the regrout quantity matches the estimated void volume; after caps are filled check by sounding or test holes, and build pour-backs and waterproofing as drawn with photographic records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「真空補灌與空洞體積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vacuum regrouting and void volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 完工後沒有檢查高點與錨頭，泌水被吸收後留下的空洞與封蓋內未填滿的空間長期存在；錨頭封頭混凝土開裂後，雨水與除冰鹽直接進入錨頭與鋼絞線端部，是許多鋼腱腐蝕案例的起點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without checks at crests and anchorages after completion, voids left by reabsorbed bleed water and unfilled cap space persist for years; once the anchorage pour-back cracks, rain and de-icing salt enter the anchorage and strand ends directly, the starting point of many tendon corrosion cases. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：錨頭最後以永久封蓋、封頭混凝土與防水塗層多層保護。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The anchorage is finally protected in layers by a permanent cap, a concrete pour-back and a waterproof coating.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌漿當天出漿正常，之後就不可能在高點或錨頭出現空洞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If grout flowed properly on grouting day, voids cannot later appear at crests or anchorages." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 完工後沒有檢查高點與錨頭，泌水被吸收後留下的空洞與封蓋內未填滿的空間長期存在；錨頭封頭混凝土開裂後，雨水與除冰鹽直接進入錨頭與鋼絞線端部，是許多鋼腱腐蝕案例的起點。
knowledge.textEn: Without checks at crests and anchorages after completion, voids left by reabsorbed bleed water and unfilled cap space persist for years; once the anchorage pour-back cracks, rain and de-icing salt enter the anchorage and strand ends directly, the starting point of many tendon corrosion cases.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨頭封護、空洞補灌與完工檢查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Anchorage protection, void regrouting and completion checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 完工後沒有檢查高點與錨頭，泌水被吸收後留下的空洞與封蓋內未填滿的空間長期存在。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
灌漿越稀越容易流進孔道，品質就越好。
optionsEn: Without checks at crests and anchorages after completion, voids left by reabsorbed bleed water and unfilled cap space persist for years.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The thinner the grout, the more easily it fills the duct and the better the quality.
quiz.explanation: 完工後沒有檢查高點與錨頭，泌水被吸收後留下的空洞與封蓋內未填滿的空間長期存在；錨頭封頭混凝土開裂後，雨水與除冰鹽直接進入錨頭與鋼絞線端部，是許多鋼腱腐蝕案例的起點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without checks at crests and anchorages after completion, voids left by reabsorbed bleed water and unfilled cap space persist for years; once the anchorage pour-back cracks, rain and de-icing salt enter the anchorage and strand ends directly, the starting point of many tendon corrosion cases. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」與「空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Grout testing and field mock-ups" and "Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Grout testing and field mock-ups: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「流錐、泌水與密度試驗」如何影響預力混凝土孔道灌漿的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flow-cone, bleed and density tests” governs force, deformation or durability in “Prestressing-duct grouting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 灌漿品質要以試驗證明：流錐試驗（ASTM C939 標準或改良式）量測一定體積灌漿流出的時間，反映流動性；燈芯泌水試驗把鋼絞線插入灌漿柱，模擬鋼絞線吸水造成的泌水；加壓泌水試驗以過濾漏斗在壓力下量測水分分離，反映高差大的鋼腱中灌漿是否會被擠出水分；傾斜管試驗則以實尺寸傾斜孔道檢查高點空洞。現場還可用泥漿密度計快速檢查是否多加了水。重要工程先做實尺寸試灌，剖開確認填充品質。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「流錐、泌水與密度試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grout quality must be proven by testing: the flow-cone test (ASTM C939 standard or modified) times the efflux of a fixed volume to reflect fluidity; the wick-induced bleed test inserts strand into a grout column to mimic water drawn along strands; the bleed-under-pressure test uses a filtration funnel to measure water separation under pressure, reflecting whether grout in tall tendons will be squeezed dry; and the inclined-tube test checks high-point voids in a full-size inclined duct. On site a mud balance quickly checks whether extra water was added. Important projects first grout a full-size mock-up and cut it open to confirm filling. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Flow-cone, bleed and density tests” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：理論密度 ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Theoretical density ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌漿越稀越容易流進孔道，品質就越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The thinner the grout, the more easily it fills the duct and the better the quality." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「流錐、泌水與密度試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Flow-cone, bleed and density tests”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌
knowledge.text: 灌漿品質要以試驗證明：流錐試驗（ASTM C939 標準或改良式）量測一定體積灌漿流出的時間，反映流動性；燈芯泌水試驗把鋼絞線插入灌漿柱，模擬鋼絞線吸水造成的泌水；加壓泌水試驗以過濾漏斗在壓力下量測水分分離，反映高差大的鋼腱中灌漿是否會被擠出水分；傾斜管試驗則以實尺寸傾斜孔道檢查高點空洞。現場還可用泥漿密度計快速檢查是否多加了水。
knowledge.textEn: Grout quality must be proven by testing: the flow-cone test (ASTM C939 standard or modified) times the efflux of a fixed volume to reflect fluidity; the wick-induced bleed test inserts strand into a grout column to mimic water drawn along strands; the bleed-under-pressure test uses a filtration funnel to measure water separation under pressure, reflecting whether grout in tall tendons will be squeezed dry; and the inclined-tube test checks high-point voids in a full-size inclined duct. On site a mud balance quickly checks whether extra water was added.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：灌漿越稀越容易流進孔道，品質就越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The thinner the grout, the more easily it fills the duct and the better the quality. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Grout testing and field mock-ups" is correct?
options: 灌漿越稀越容易流進孔道，品質就越好。
灌漿品質要以試驗證明：流錐試驗（ASTM C939 標準或改良式）量測一定體積灌漿流出的時間，反映流動性。
非破壞檢測可以百分之百找出孔道內的所有空洞。
optionsEn: The thinner the grout, the more easily it fills the duct and the better the quality.
Grout quality must be proven by testing: the flow-cone test (ASTM C939 standard or modified) times the efflux of a fixed volume to reflect fluidity.
Non-destructive testing can find every void in a duct with certainty.
quiz.explanation: 灌漿品質要以試驗證明：流錐試驗（ASTM C939 標準或改良式）量測一定體積灌漿流出的時間，反映流動性；燈芯泌水試驗把鋼絞線插入灌漿柱，模擬鋼絞線吸水造成的泌水；加壓泌水試驗以過濾漏斗在壓力下量測水分分離，反映高差大的鋼腱中灌漿是否會被擠出水分；傾斜管試驗則以實尺寸傾斜孔道檢查高點空洞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Grout quality must be proven by testing: the flow-cone test (ASTM C939 standard or modified) times the efflux of a fixed volume to reflect fluidity; the wick-induced bleed test inserts strand into a grout column to mimic water drawn along strands; the bleed-under-pressure test uses a filtration funnel to measure water separation under pressure, reflecting whether grout in tall tendons will be squeezed dry; and the inclined-tube test checks high-point voids in a full-size inclined duct. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grout testing and field mock-ups: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「流錐、泌水與密度試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flow-cone, bleed and density tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：理論密度 ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c)。水泥比重 3.15、w/c = 0.40：ρ = 1.40/(0.3175 + 0.40) ≈ 1.95 kg/L；若現場多加水使 w/c = 0.45，ρ = 1.45/0.7675 ≈ 1.89 kg/L，低約 62 kg/m³。燈芯泌水試驗 800 mL 試樣分離 2 mL 水，泌水率 0.25%，對要求 0% 的觸變性灌漿判定不合格。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Theoretical density ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c). With cement specific gravity 3.15 and w/c = 0.40, ρ = 1.40/(0.3175 + 0.40) ≈ 1.95 kg/L; extra water raising w/c to 0.45 gives ρ = 1.45/0.7675 ≈ 1.89 kg/L, about 62 kg/m³ lower. A wick-bleed sample of 800 mL separating 2 mL of water shows 0.25% bleed and fails a thixotropic grout required to show 0%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：送審階段以實驗室試驗確認材料符合規格；開工前做實尺寸試灌並剖開檢查；施工中每批拌合量測流錐時間與密度，並依規定頻率做泌水與抗壓試驗，結果與允收值比較，不合格批次立即廢棄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At submittal confirm by laboratory tests that the material meets the specification; before production grout a full-size mock-up and cut it open; during production measure flow-cone time and density for every batch and run bleed and compressive tests at the specified frequency, comparing with acceptance values and discarding failing batches immediately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
