knowledge.text: 理論密度 ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c)。水泥比重 3.15、w/c = 0.40：ρ = 1.40/(0.3175 + 0.40) ≈ 1.95 kg/L；若現場多加水使 w/c = 0.45，ρ = 1.45/0.7675 ≈ 1.89 kg/L，低約 62 kg/m³。燈芯泌水試驗 800 mL 試樣分離 2 mL 水，泌水率 0.25%，對要求 0% 的觸變性灌漿判定不合格。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Theoretical density ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c). With cement specific gravity 3.15 and w/c = 0.40, ρ = 1.40/(0.3175 + 0.40) ≈ 1.95 kg/L; extra water raising w/c to 0.45 gives ρ = 1.45/0.7675 ≈ 1.89 kg/L, about 62 kg/m³ lower. A wick-bleed sample of 800 mL separating 2 mL of water shows 0.25% bleed and fails a thixotropic grout required to show 0%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grout testing and field mock-ups", which statement holds?
options: 灌漿完成後紀錄就沒有用處，不需要長期保存。
灌漿從一端打入、另一端出漿，就代表孔道已經完全填滿。
理論密度 ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c)。
optionsEn: Once grouting is done the records are useless and need not be kept.
If grout pumped in at one end comes out at the other, the duct is completely filled.
Theoretical density ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c).
quiz.explanation: 理論密度 ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Theoretical density ρ = (1 + w/c)/(1/G_c + w/c). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grout testing and field mock-ups: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「流錐、泌水與密度試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flow-cone, bleed and density tests” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 送審階段以實驗室試驗確認材料符合規格；開工前做實尺寸試灌並剖開檢查；施工中每批拌合量測流錐時間與密度，並依規定頻率做泌水與抗壓試驗，結果與允收值比較，不合格批次立即廢棄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At submittal confirm by laboratory tests that the material meets the specification; before production grout a full-size mock-up and cut it open; during production measure flow-cone time and density for every batch and run bleed and compressive tests at the specified frequency, comparing with acceptance values and discarding failing batches immediately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：品質計畫列出每項試驗的標準、頻率、允收值與退料規則，拌合加水量以計量設備控制並記錄；實尺寸試灌與剖開檢查列為正式灌漿前的停留點，由設計者或其代表見證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The quality plan lists standard, frequency, acceptance value and rejection rule for each test, with mixing water metered and recorded; the full-size mock-up and its sectioning are a hold point before production grouting, witnessed by the designer or a representative.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：現場為了讓灌漿好打而多加水，流錐時間變短看似「更順」，但泌水大增，高點留下水層與空洞；若只在開工第一天做試驗，之後的材料批號變化或拌合時間不足都不會被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding water on site to ease pumping shortens the flow-cone time and seems smoother, but bleed rises sharply and crests are left with water lenses and voids; testing only on the first day lets later batch changes or short mixing times go unnoticed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 送審階段以實驗室試驗確認材料符合規格；開工前做實尺寸試灌並剖開檢查；施工中每批拌合量測流錐時間與密度，並依規定頻率做泌水與抗壓試驗，結果與允收值比較，不合格批次立即廢棄。
knowledge.textEn: At submittal confirm by laboratory tests that the material meets the specification; before production grout a full-size mock-up and cut it open; during production measure flow-cone time and density for every batch and run bleed and compressive tests at the specified frequency, comparing with acceptance values and discarding failing batches immediately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 品質計畫列出每項試驗的標準、頻率、允收值與退料規則，拌合加水量以計量設備控制並記錄；實尺寸試灌與剖開檢查列為正式灌漿前的停留點，由設計者或其代表見證。
knowledge.textEn: The quality plan lists standard, frequency, acceptance value and rejection rule for each test, with mixing water metered and recorded; the full-size mock-up and its sectioning are a hold point before production grouting, witnessed by the designer or a representative.

quiz.question: 要驗證「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Grout testing and field mock-ups"?
options: 送審階段以實驗室試驗確認材料符合規格。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
孔道只是預留的通道，用什麼材料、接頭是否密封都不重要。
optionsEn: At submittal confirm by laboratory tests that the material meets the specification.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A duct is just a preformed hole, so its material and joint sealing do not matter.
quiz.explanation: 送審階段以實驗室試驗確認材料符合規格；開工前做實尺寸試灌並剖開檢查；施工中每批拌合量測流錐時間與密度，並依規定頻率做泌水與抗壓試驗，結果與允收值比較，不合格批次立即廢棄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At submittal confirm by laboratory tests that the material meets the specification; before production grout a full-size mock-up and cut it open; during production measure flow-cone time and density for every batch and run bleed and compressive tests at the specified frequency, comparing with acceptance values and discarding failing batches immediately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grout testing and field mock-ups: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「流錐、泌水與密度試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Flow-cone, bleed and density tests” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 現場為了讓灌漿好打而多加水，流錐時間變短看似「更順」，但泌水大增，高點留下水層與空洞；若只在開工第一天做試驗，之後的材料批號變化或拌合時間不足都不會被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding water on site to ease pumping shortens the flow-cone time and seems smoother, but bleed rises sharply and crests are left with water lenses and voids; testing only on the first day lets later batch changes or short mixing times go unnoticed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重要工程先做實尺寸試灌，剖開確認填充品質。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Important projects first grout a full-size mock-up and cut it open to confirm filling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌漿越稀越容易流進孔道，品質就越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The thinner the grout, the more easily it fills the duct and the better the quality." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 現場為了讓灌漿好打而多加水，流錐時間變短看似「更順」，但泌水大增，高點留下水層與空洞；若只在開工第一天做試驗，之後的材料批號變化或拌合時間不足都不會被發現。
knowledge.textEn: Adding water on site to ease pumping shortens the flow-cone time and seems smoother, but bleed rises sharply and crests are left with water lenses and voids; testing only on the first day lets later batch changes or short mixing times go unnoticed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「灌漿材料試驗與現場試灌」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grout testing and field mock-ups" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
現場為了讓灌漿好打而多加水，流錐時間變短看似「更順」，但泌水大增，高點留下水層與空洞；若只在開工第一天做試驗，之後的材料批號變化或拌合時間不足都不會被發現。
非破壞檢測可以百分之百找出孔道內的所有空洞。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding water on site to ease pumping shortens the flow-cone time and seems smoother, but bleed rises sharply and crests are left with water lenses and voids.
Non-destructive testing can find every void in a duct with certainty.
quiz.explanation: 現場為了讓灌漿好打而多加水，流錐時間變短看似「更順」，但泌水大增，高點留下水層與空洞；若只在開工第一天做試驗，之後的材料批號變化或拌合時間不足都不會被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding water on site to ease pumping shortens the flow-cone time and seems smoother, but bleed rises sharply and crests are left with water lenses and voids; testing only on the first day lets later batch changes or short mixing times go unnoticed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「敲擊回音頻率」如何影響預力混凝土孔道灌漿的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Impact-echo frequency” governs force, deformation or durability in “Prestressing-duct grouting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 完工後或既有橋梁的灌漿狀態只能間接判斷：透地雷達先定位內部鋼腱，敲擊回音法以應力波在混凝土中反射的頻率判斷孔道處是否有空洞，超音波斷層掃描可建立斷面影像，放射線攝影則能直接看見孔道內部但受安全與厚度限制。非破壞結果有疑問時，再以小孔鑽入孔道、用內視鏡觀察並取樣檢驗灌漿的氯離子與硫酸鹽。FHWA 2013 年的指引提醒，侵入式檢測本身會製造腐蝕通道，取樣數量應盡量少並確實修復。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「敲擊回音頻率」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The grout condition of completed or existing bridges can only be judged indirectly: ground-penetrating radar first locates internal tendons, impact-echo uses the frequency of stress waves reflected in the concrete to judge whether a duct contains voids, ultrasonic tomography builds section images, and radiography sees inside ducts directly but is limited by safety and thickness. Where non-destructive results are doubtful, a small hole is drilled into the duct, inspected with a borescope and the grout sampled for chloride and sulfate. FHWA's 2013 guidance warns that invasive testing itself creates corrosion paths, so the number of samples should be minimised and every hole properly repaired. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Impact-echo frequency” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：敲擊回音厚度頻率 f = β·C_p/(2T)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Impact-echo thickness frequency f = β·C_p/(2T).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「非破壞檢測可以百分之百找出孔道內的所有空洞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Non-destructive testing can find every void in a duct with certainty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「敲擊回音頻率」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Impact-echo frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測
knowledge.titleEn: Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection
knowledge.text: 完工後或既有橋梁的灌漿狀態只能間接判斷：透地雷達先定位內部鋼腱，敲擊回音法以應力波在混凝土中反射的頻率判斷孔道處是否有空洞，超音波斷層掃描可建立斷面影像，放射線攝影則能直接看見孔道內部但受安全與厚度限制。非破壞結果有疑問時，再以小孔鑽入孔道、用內視鏡觀察並取樣檢驗灌漿的氯離子與硫酸鹽。
knowledge.textEn: The grout condition of completed or existing bridges can only be judged indirectly: ground-penetrating radar first locates internal tendons, impact-echo uses the frequency of stress waves reflected in the concrete to judge whether a duct contains voids, ultrasonic tomography builds section images, and radiography sees inside ducts directly but is limited by safety and thickness. Where non-destructive results are doubtful, a small hole is drilled into the duct, inspected with a borescope and the grout sampled for chloride and sulfate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：非破壞檢測可以百分之百找出孔道內的所有空洞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Non-destructive testing can find every void in a duct with certainty. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection" is correct?
options: 非破壞檢測可以百分之百找出孔道內的所有空洞。
使用預拌包裝灌漿的新橋，就不會有灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕。
完工後或既有橋梁的灌漿狀態只能間接判斷：透地雷達先定位內部鋼腱，敲擊回音法以應力波在混凝土中反射的頻率判斷孔道處是否有空洞，超音波斷層掃描可建立斷面影像，放射線攝影則能直接看見孔道內部但受安全與厚度限制。
optionsEn: Non-destructive testing can find every void in a duct with certainty.
New bridges using pre-bagged grout cannot suffer corrosion from grout defects.

The grout condition of completed or existing bridges can only be judged indirectly: ground-penetrating radar first locates internal tendons, impact-echo uses the frequency of stress waves reflected in the concrete to judge whether a duct contains voids, ultrasonic tomography builds section images, and radiography sees inside ducts directly but is limited by safety and thickness.
quiz.explanation: 完工後或既有橋梁的灌漿狀態只能間接判斷：透地雷達先定位內部鋼腱，敲擊回音法以應力波在混凝土中反射的頻率判斷孔道處是否有空洞，超音波斷層掃描可建立斷面影像，放射線攝影則能直接看見孔道內部但受安全與厚度限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The grout condition of completed or existing bridges can only be judged indirectly: ground-penetrating radar first locates internal tendons, impact-echo uses the frequency of stress waves reflected in the concrete to judge whether a duct contains voids, ultrasonic tomography builds section images, and radiography sees inside ducts directly but is limited by safety and thickness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「敲擊回音頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Impact-echo frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：敲擊回音厚度頻率 f = β·C_p/(2T)。腹板厚 T = 0.30 m、C_p = 4,000 m/s、β = 0.96：f = 0.96×4,000/0.60 = 6,400 Hz；若孔道深 0.15 m 處有空洞，反射面變為 0.15 m，頻率峰值移到 0.96×4,000/0.30 = 12,800 Hz。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Impact-echo thickness frequency f = β·C_p/(2T). For a 0.30 m web with C_p = 4,000 m/s and β = 0.96, f = 0.96×4,000/0.60 = 6,400 Hz; a void at a duct 0.15 m deep moves the reflecting surface to 0.15 m and the peak to 0.96×4,000/0.30 = 12,800 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先以透地雷達標出鋼腱位置，再沿鋼腱以固定間距做敲擊回音或超音波掃描，把疑似空洞標在圖上；選取代表性位置鑽孔以內視鏡確認，並以已知良好與已知空洞的位置校正判讀門檻，所有鑽孔事後以相容材料密封。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Locate tendons first with ground-penetrating radar, then scan along them at fixed spacing by impact-echo or ultrasonics and map suspected voids; drill representative locations for borescope confirmation, calibrate interpretation thresholds against known-good and known-void spots, and seal every hole afterwards with compatible material.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Impact-echo thickness frequency f = β·C_p/(2T). For a 0.30 m web with C_p = 4,000 m/s and β = 0.96, f = 0.96×4,000/0.60 = 6,400 Hz; a void at a duct 0.15 m deep moves the reflecting surface to 0.15 m and the peak to 0.96×4,000/0.30 = 12,800 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection", which statement holds?
options: 敲擊回音厚度頻率 f = β·C_p/(2T)。
鋼腱被包在混凝土裡面，自然就不會生鏽。
加一點早強劑或其他添加劑讓灌漿更快硬化，對鋼腱沒有影響。
optionsEn: Impact-echo thickness frequency f = β·C_p/(2T).
Tendons buried inside concrete cannot rust.
Adding a little accelerator or another admixture to speed grout hardening does not affect the tendons.
quiz.explanation: 敲擊回音厚度頻率 f = β·C_p/(2T)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Impact-echo thickness frequency f = β·C_p/(2T). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「敲擊回音頻率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Impact-echo frequency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先以透地雷達標出鋼腱位置，再沿鋼腱以固定間距做敲擊回音或超音波掃描，把疑似空洞標在圖上；選取代表性位置鑽孔以內視鏡確認，並以已知良好與已知空洞的位置校正判讀門檻，所有鑽孔事後以相容材料密封。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Locate tendons first with ground-penetrating radar, then scan along them at fixed spacing by impact-echo or ultrasonics and map suspected voids; drill representative locations for borescope confirmation, calibrate interpretation thresholds against known-good and known-void spots, and seal every hole afterwards with compatible material. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢測計畫要說明採用的方法組合、掃描間距、判讀門檻與校正方式，並以風險高低決定鑽孔位置與數量；鑽孔、取樣與封孔程序由設計者核准，結果與鋼腱編號一同存檔。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection plan states the combination of methods, scan spacing, interpretation thresholds and calibration, choosing drilling locations and numbers by risk; drilling, sampling and sealing procedures are approved by the designer, and results are archived against tendon numbers.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只依單一非破壞方法的結果就判定「無空洞」，忽略鋼絞線束與鋼筋造成的訊號干擾；或大量鑽孔取樣後未確實封孔，反而為水與氯離子打開新通道，加速原本完好鋼腱的腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Declaring no voids from a single non-destructive method ignores interference from strand bundles and reinforcement; drilling many sample holes without proper sealing opens new paths for water and chloride, accelerating corrosion of tendons that were sound. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先以透地雷達標出鋼腱位置，再沿鋼腱以固定間距做敲擊回音或超音波掃描，把疑似空洞標在圖上；選取代表性位置鑽孔以內視鏡確認，並以已知良好與已知空洞的位置校正判讀門檻，所有鑽孔事後以相容材料密封。
knowledge.textEn: Locate tendons first with ground-penetrating radar, then scan along them at fixed spacing by impact-echo or ultrasonics and map suspected voids; drill representative locations for borescope confirmation, calibrate interpretation thresholds against known-good and known-void spots, and seal every hole afterwards with compatible material.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 檢測計畫要說明採用的方法組合、掃描間距、判讀門檻與校正方式，並以風險高低決定鑽孔位置與數量；鑽孔、取樣與封孔程序由設計者核准，結果與鋼腱編號一同存檔。
knowledge.textEn: The inspection plan states the combination of methods, scan spacing, interpretation thresholds and calibration, choosing drilling locations and numbers by risk; drilling, sampling and sealing procedures are approved by the designer, and results are archived against tendon numbers.

quiz.question: 要驗證「空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
先以透地雷達標出鋼腱位置，再沿鋼腱以固定間距做敲擊回音或超音波掃描，把疑似空洞標在圖上。
灌漿壓力越高越好，可以把孔道擠得更密實。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Locate tendons first with ground-penetrating radar, then scan along them at fixed spacing by impact-echo or ultrasonics and map suspected voids.
The higher the grouting pressure the better, because it packs the duct more densely.
quiz.explanation: 先以透地雷達標出鋼腱位置，再沿鋼腱以固定間距做敲擊回音或超音波掃描，把疑似空洞標在圖上；選取代表性位置鑽孔以內視鏡確認，並以已知良好與已知空洞的位置校正判讀門檻，所有鑽孔事後以相容材料密封。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Locate tendons first with ground-penetrating radar, then scan along them at fixed spacing by impact-echo or ultrasonics and map suspected voids; drill representative locations for borescope confirmation, calibrate interpretation thresholds against known-good and known-void spots, and seal every hole afterwards with compatible material. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「敲擊回音頻率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Impact-echo frequency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只依單一非破壞方法的結果就判定「無空洞」，忽略鋼絞線束與鋼筋造成的訊號干擾；或大量鑽孔取樣後未確實封孔，反而為水與氯離子打開新通道，加速原本完好鋼腱的腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Declaring no voids from a single non-destructive method ignores interference from strand bundles and reinforcement; drilling many sample holes without proper sealing opens new paths for water and chloride, accelerating corrosion of tendons that were sound. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：FHWA 2013 年的指引提醒，侵入式檢測本身會製造腐蝕通道，取樣數量應盡量少並確實修復。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: FHWA's 2013 guidance warns that invasive testing itself creates corrosion paths, so the number of samples should be minimised and every hole properly repaired.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「非破壞檢測可以百分之百找出孔道內的所有空洞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Non-destructive testing can find every void in a duct with certainty." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只依單一非破壞方法的結果就判定「無空洞」，忽略鋼絞線束與鋼筋造成的訊號干擾；或大量鑽孔取樣後未確實封孔，反而為水與氯離子打開新通道，加速原本完好鋼腱的腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Declaring no voids from a single non-destructive method ignores interference from strand bundles and reinforcement; drilling many sample holes without proper sealing opens new paths for water and chloride, accelerating corrosion of tendons that were sound.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「空洞的非破壞與局部破壞檢測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Non-destructive and minimally invasive void detection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
使用預拌包裝灌漿的新橋，就不會有灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕。
只依單一非破壞方法的結果就判定「無空洞」，忽略鋼絞線束與鋼筋造成的訊號干擾；或大量鑽孔取樣後未確實封孔，反而為水與氯離子打開新通道，加速原本完好鋼腱的腐蝕。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
New bridges using pre-bagged grout cannot suffer corrosion from grout defects.
Declaring no voids from a single non-destructive method ignores interference from strand bundles and reinforcement.
quiz.explanation: 只依單一非破壞方法的結果就判定「無空洞」，忽略鋼絞線束與鋼筋造成的訊號干擾；或大量鑽孔取樣後未確實封孔，反而為水與氯離子打開新通道，加速原本完好鋼腱的腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Declaring no voids from a single non-destructive method ignores interference from strand bundles and reinforcement; drilling many sample holes without proper sealing opens new paths for water and chloride, accelerating corrosion of tendons that were sound. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「缺陷灌漿中的長期劣化」與「灌漿紀錄、風險分級與工程交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-term deterioration in defective grout" and "Grouting records, risk ranking and engineering handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 缺陷灌漿中的長期劣化：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term deterioration in defective grout: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「蝕坑深度與鋼絲斷面」如何影響預力混凝土孔道灌漿的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pit depth and wire section” governs force, deformation or durability in “Prestressing-duct grouting”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕通常是慢性的：空洞中的潮濕空氣、泌水留下的水分、離析後柔軟且鹼性不足的灌漿，以及氯離子或硫酸鹽，都會讓鋼絞線局部去鈍化並形成蝕坑。蝕坑比均勻腐蝕危險，因為鋼絲在蝕坑處應力集中、斷面驟減，在仍有高預力的情況下可能突然斷裂。外部來源同樣重要：倫敦漢默史密斯高架橋在 2011 年因除冰鹽造成鋼腱腐蝕而緊急處理，後來以外置預力補強，2015 年完成修復。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「蝕坑深度與鋼絲斷面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Corrosion from grout defects is usually chronic: damp air in voids, water left by bleed, segregated grout that is soft and less alkaline, and chlorides or sulfates depassivate strands locally and form pits. Pitting is more dangerous than uniform corrosion, because stress concentrates and the section drops sharply at the pit while the wire still carries high prestress, so it can snap suddenly. External sources matter too: London's Hammersmith Flyover required emergency action in 2011 when de-icing salts corroded its tendons, and was later strengthened with external post-tensioning, with repairs completed in 2015. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Pit depth and wire section” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：腐蝕電流 1 μA/cm² 約相當於 11.6 μm/年。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A corrosion current of 1 μA/cm² corresponds to about 11.6 μm per year.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「使用預拌包裝灌漿的新橋，就不會有灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "New bridges using pre-bagged grout cannot suffer corrosion from grout defects." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 缺陷灌漿中的長期劣化
knowledge.text: 灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕通常是慢性的：空洞中的潮濕空氣、泌水留下的水分、離析後柔軟且鹼性不足的灌漿，以及氯離子或硫酸鹽，都會讓鋼絞線局部去鈍化並形成蝕坑。蝕坑比均勻腐蝕危險，因為鋼絲在蝕坑處應力集中、斷面驟減，在仍有高預力的情況下可能突然斷裂。
knowledge.textEn: Corrosion from grout defects is usually chronic: damp air in voids, water left by bleed, segregated grout that is soft and less alkaline, and chlorides or sulfates depassivate strands locally and form pits. Pitting is more dangerous than uniform corrosion, because stress concentrates and the section drops sharply at the pit while the wire still carries high prestress, so it can snap suddenly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：使用預拌包裝灌漿的新橋，就不會有灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: New bridges using pre-bagged grout cannot suffer corrosion from grout defects. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

使用預拌包裝灌漿的新橋，就不會有灌漿缺陷造成的腐蝕。
灌漿完成後紀錄就沒有用處，不需要長期保存。
optionsEn: Corrosion from grout defects is usually chronic: damp air in voids, water left by bleed, segregated grout that is soft and less alkaline, and chlorides or sulfates depassivate strands locally and form pits.
New bridges using pre-bagged grout cannot suffer corrosion from grout defects.

steps.title: 缺陷灌漿中的長期劣化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term deterioration in defective grout: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蝕坑深度與鋼絲斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pit depth and wire section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：腐蝕電流 1 μA/cm² 約相當於 11.6 μm/年。直徑 5 mm 鋼絲（半徑 2.5 mm）均勻腐蝕 20 年，半徑損失 0.23 mm，剩餘面積 (2.268/2.5)² ≈ 82%；若蝕坑係數 5，局部蝕坑深度約 1.16 mm，接近半徑的一半。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A corrosion current of 1 μA/cm² corresponds to about 11.6 μm per year. A 5 mm wire (2.5 mm radius) corroding uniformly for 20 years loses 0.23 mm of radius, leaving (2.268/2.5)² ≈ 82% of its area; with a pitting factor of 5, the local pit is about 1.16 mm deep, nearly half the radius. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取出的灌漿樣本檢驗酸溶性氯離子（以水泥重量 0.08% 為門檻）、硫酸鹽與含水狀態，觀察灌漿是否柔軟、分層或變色；暴露的鋼絞線記錄蝕坑深度與斷絲數；必要時以磁漏或其他方法評估鋼腱內部斷絲，並以結構分析檢查剩餘預力的安全性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test extracted grout for acid-soluble chloride against the 0.08% by cement weight threshold, for sulfate and for moisture, and look for soft, layered or discoloured grout; record pit depths and broken wires on exposed strands; where needed assess internal wire breaks by magnetic flux leakage or other methods, and check the safety of the remaining prestress by analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 灌漿缺陷無法在完工後直接看到，因此施工紀錄是日後判斷風險的主要依據：每條鋼腱的材料批號、試驗結果、灌注量、壓力歷程與排氣順序都要保存。FHWA 2013 年的指引把風險定義為缺陷機率指標乘以破壞後果指標，各以 1 到 5 分評估，沒有紀錄的工程被直接給予最高的機率分數。英國在 1985 年 Ynys-y-Gwas 崩塌後，1992 年暫停新建內部灌漿後拉橋並進行五年檢查，1996 年才解除，說明紀錄、檢查與可更換設計對業主決策的重要性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「灌漿量對帳與風險分數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grout defects cannot be seen after completion, so construction records are the main basis for later risk judgements: each tendon's material lots, test results, injected volume, pressure history and venting sequence must be kept. FHWA's 2013 guidance defines risk as a probability-of-defect indicator times a consequence-of-failure indicator, each scored 1 to 5, and projects with no records are given the highest probability score outright. After the Ynys-y-Gwas collapse of 1985, Britain halted new internally grouted post-tensioned bridges in 1992 for a five-year inspection programme and lifted the moratorium only in 1996, showing how records, inspection and replaceable design shape owners' decisions. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Grout reconciliation and risk score” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：灌漿量對帳：理論淨灌漿 0.52 m³，扣除出口廢棄量後實際灌入 0.49 m³，短少 0.03 m³ = 30 L，相當於 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m 孔道的淨體積，應列為疑似空洞追查。

steps.title: 灌漿紀錄、風險分級與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grouting records, risk ranking and engineering handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灌漿量對帳與風險分數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grout reconciliation and risk score” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：灌漿量對帳：理論淨灌漿 0.52 m³，扣除出口廢棄量後實際灌入 0.49 m³，短少 0.03 m³ = 30 L，相當於 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m 孔道的淨體積，應列為疑似空洞追查。風險分數 = 機率 × 後果：無紀錄 5 × 主要幹線 4 = 20（滿分 25），優先檢查。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Grout reconciliation: the theoretical net volume is 0.52 m³ and 0.49 m³ went in after outlet waste, a shortfall of 0.03 m³ = 30 L, the net volume of about 30/5.19 ≈ 5.8 m of duct, to be followed up as a suspected void. Risk score = probability × consequence: no records 5 × major route 4 = 20 out of 25, a priority for inspection. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前逐條核對灌漿紀錄的完整性（材料批號、試驗、壓力、排氣、灌注量與理論量對帳、空洞檢查與補灌），缺漏者補做檢測；把風險評分方法與結果寫入維護計畫，並訂定錨頭與高點的定期檢查週期。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover check every tendon's grouting record for completeness (lots, tests, pressures, venting, injected versus theoretical volume, void checks and regrouting), testing where records are missing; write the risk-scoring method and results into the maintenance plan with set inspection intervals for anchorages and crests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Risk score = probability × consequence: no records 5 × major route 4 = 20 out of 25, a priority for inspection. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 灌漿紀錄、風險分級與工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grouting records, risk ranking and engineering handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌漿量對帳與風險分數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grout reconciliation and risk score” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前逐條核對灌漿紀錄的完整性（材料批號、試驗、壓力、排氣、灌注量與理論量對帳、空洞檢查與補灌），缺漏者補做檢測；把風險評分方法與結果寫入維護計畫，並訂定錨頭與高點的定期檢查週期。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover check every tendon's grouting record for completeness (lots, tests, pressures, venting, injected versus theoretical volume, void checks and regrouting), testing where records are missing; write the risk-scoring method and results into the maintenance plan with set inspection intervals for anchorages and crests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含鋼腱與排氣口配置竣工圖、每條鋼腱的灌漿紀錄與對帳、材料與試驗報告、空洞檢查與補灌紀錄、錨頭防護細部、風險評分與檢查週期；新設計優先考慮可檢查、可更換的鋼腱配置，並由業主指定的工程師核定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover includes as-built tendon and vent layouts, each tendon's grouting record and reconciliation, material and test reports, void-check and regrout records, anchorage-protection details, risk scores and inspection intervals; new designs favour inspectable, replaceable tendon layouts, approved by the owner's designated engineer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：灌漿紀錄只寫「完成」而沒有灌注量與壓力資料，多年後發現某條鋼腱斷絲時，無法判斷是個案還是系統性問題，只能大範圍鑽孔檢查，既昂貴又增加新的腐蝕通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Records that say only completed, with no volumes or pressures, mean that when a tendon is later found with broken wires no one can tell whether it is isolated or systemic, forcing widespread drilling that is costly and opens new corrosion paths. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灌漿量對帳與風險分數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grout reconciliation and risk score” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 灌漿紀錄只寫「完成」而沒有灌注量與壓力資料，多年後發現某條鋼腱斷絲時，無法判斷是個案還是系統性問題，只能大範圍鑽孔檢查，既昂貴又增加新的腐蝕通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌漿完成後紀錄就沒有用處，不需要長期保存。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once grouting is done the records are useless and need not be kept." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「灌漿紀錄、風險分級與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grouting records, risk ranking and engineering handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
灌漿紀錄只寫「完成」而沒有灌注量與壓力資料，多年後發現某條鋼腱斷絲時，無法判斷是個案還是系統性問題，只能大範圍鑽孔檢查，既昂貴又增加新的腐蝕通道。
鋼腱被包在混凝土裡面，自然就不會生鏽。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

Records that say only completed, with no volumes or pressures, mean that when a tendon is later found with broken wires no one can tell whether it is isolated or systemic, forcing widespread drilling that is costly and opens new corrosion paths.
Tendons buried inside concrete cannot rust.
quiz.explanation: 灌漿紀錄只寫「完成」而沒有灌注量與壓力資料，多年後發現某條鋼腱斷絲時，無法判斷是個案還是系統性問題，只能大範圍鑽孔檢查，既昂貴又增加新的腐蝕通道。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Records that say only completed, with no volumes or pressures, mean that when a tendon is later found with broken wires no one can tell whether it is isolated or systemic, forcing widespread drilling that is costly and opens new corrosion paths. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 橋梁預力鋼腱更換
summary: 從預鑄節塊箱梁外置鋼腱的荷載路徑與冗餘度出發，說明灌漿離析與泌水如何讓鋼絞線在低氯離子下仍然腐蝕斷裂，再處理可更換細部、舊鋼腱去張的能量控制、新鋼腱張拉與伸長量核對、全橋普查、振動與聲射監測，並以美國 Mid-Bay、Ringling 堤道與 Wando River 等橋的鋼腱更換為實例。
summaryEn: Starting from the load path and redundancy of external tendons in precast segmental box girders, explain how segregated, bleeding grout lets strands corrode and rupture even at low chloride, then cover replaceable detailing, energy control when detensioning the old tendon, force and elongation checks on the new one, network-wide surveys, and vibration and acoustic-emission monitoring, using the tendon replacements at the Mid-Bay, Ringling Causeway and Wando River bridges in the United States.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某預鑄節塊箱梁每跨 6 條 19 股 15.2 mm 外置鋼腱，每條有效預力 2.97 MN；斷面 A = 6.0 m²、S_b = 3.5 m³、e = 1.2 m，服務彎矩 M = 30 MN·m，其中恆載 22 MN·m、活載 8 MN·m。(1) 六條鋼腱時底緣 σ_b = −17.82/6.0 − 17.82×1.2/3.5 + 30/3.5 ≈ −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 = −0.51 MPa。(2) 去張一條後 P = 14.85 MN，底緣零應力可承受的彎矩 M_0 = S_b·(P/A + P·e/S_b) = 3.5×(2.475 + 5.091) ≈ 26.5 MN·m，扣除恆載 22 MN·m 後活載只能用 4.5 MN·m，約為設計活載的 56%，需要封閉車道或禁行重車。(3) 新鋼腱以 P_j ≈ 3,857 kN 張拉，μ = 0.25、α = 0.20 rad、L = 120 m，平均力約 3,763 kN，伸長量 ΔL ≈ 0.87 m，250 mm 行程需 4 次。(4) 若改變一個輸入：更換期間加裝兩支臨時預力棒共 2.0 MN、偏心相同，底緣再增加壓應力 2.0/6.0 + 2.0×1.2/3.5 ≈ 1.02 MPa，M_0 升至約 30.0 MN·m，可恢復全部活載。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a precast segmental box girder has six external tendons of 19 × 15.2 mm strands per span, each with 2.97 MN effective prestress; the section has A = 6.0 m², S_b = 3.5 m³ and e = 1.2 m, and the service moment is M = 30 MN·m, of which 22 MN·m is dead load and 8 MN·m live load. (1) With six tendons the bottom fibre is σ_b = −17.82/6.0 − 17.82×1.2/3.5 + 30/3.5 ≈ −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 = −0.51 MPa. (2) With one tendon detensioned, P = 14.85 MN and the moment at zero bottom stress is M_0 = S_b·(P/A + P·e/S_b) = 3.5×(2.475 + 5.091) ≈ 26.5 MN·m; after 22 MN·m of dead load only 4.5 MN·m of live load remains, about 56% of the design live load, so lanes must be closed or heavy vehicles banned. (3) The new tendon is stressed to P_j ≈ 3,857 kN with μ = 0.25, α = 0.20 rad and L = 120 m; the average force is about 3,763 kN and the elongation ΔL ≈ 0.87 m, needing 4 strokes of 250 mm. (4) Changing one input: adding two temporary prestressing bars totalling 2.0 MN at the same eccentricity adds 2.0/6.0 + 2.0×1.2/3.5 ≈ 1.02 MPa of bottom compression, raising M_0 to about 30.0 MN·m so full live load can return. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」與「移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load path of external tendons" and "Joint stress with one tendon removed": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path of external tendons: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」如何影響橋梁預力鋼腱更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預鑄節塊箱梁的外置鋼腱位於箱室內、混凝土之外，只在錨定隔梁與轉向塊處與結構接觸：錨定處把預力以集中承壓傳入隔梁，轉向塊處鋼腱改變方向，產生向上的徑向力抵銷部分自重彎矩。因為鋼腱沿全長不與混凝土黏結，任何一處斷裂都會讓整條鋼腱在整個跨度內失去作用，而不像內置黏結鋼腱只在斷點附近局部失效；這正是外置鋼腱能夠更換、也必須事先規劃更換的原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a precast segmental box girder, external tendons run inside the box cell outside the concrete and touch the structure only at anchorage diaphragms and deviators: the anchorages push prestress into the diaphragm as concentrated bearing, and at each deviator the tendon changes direction, producing an upward radial force that offsets part of the self-weight moment. Because the tendon is not bonded to the concrete along its length, a break anywhere deactivates it over the whole span, unlike a bonded internal tendon that loses effect only near the break; that is exactly why external tendons can be replaced and why their replacement must be planned in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：轉向力 F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Deviator force F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑
knowledge.text: 預鑄節塊箱梁的外置鋼腱位於箱室內、混凝土之外，只在錨定隔梁與轉向塊處與結構接觸：錨定處把預力以集中承壓傳入隔梁，轉向塊處鋼腱改變方向，產生向上的徑向力抵銷部分自重彎矩。因為鋼腱沿全長不與混凝土黏結，任何一處斷裂都會讓整條鋼腱在整個跨度內失去作用，而不像內置黏結鋼腱只在斷點附近局部失效；這正是外置鋼腱能夠更換、也必須事先規劃更換的原因。
knowledge.textEn: In a precast segmental box girder, external tendons run inside the box cell outside the concrete and touch the structure only at anchorage diaphragms and deviators: the anchorages push prestress into the diaphragm as concentrated bearing, and at each deviator the tendon changes direction, producing an upward radial force that offsets part of the self-weight moment. Because the tendon is not bonded to the concrete along its length, a break anywhere deactivates it over the whole span, unlike a bonded internal tendon that loses effect only near the break; that is exactly why external tendons can be replaced and why their replacement must be planned in advance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path of external tendons" is correct?
options: 外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。
預鑄節塊箱梁的外置鋼腱位於箱室內、混凝土之外，只在錨定隔梁與轉向塊處與結構接觸：錨定處把預力以集中承壓傳入隔梁，轉向塊處鋼腱改變方向，產生向上的徑向力抵銷部分自重彎矩。
只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。
optionsEn: When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress.

In a precast segmental box girder, external tendons run inside the box cell outside the concrete and touch the structure only at anchorage diaphragms and deviators: the anchorages push prestress into the diaphragm as concentrated bearing, and at each deviator the tendon changes direction, producing an upward radial force that offsets part of the self-weight moment.
As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement.
quiz.explanation: 預鑄節塊箱梁的外置鋼腱位於箱室內、混凝土之外，只在錨定隔梁與轉向塊處與結構接觸：錨定處把預力以集中承壓傳入隔梁，轉向塊處鋼腱改變方向，產生向上的徑向力抵銷部分自重彎矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a precast segmental box girder, external tendons run inside the box cell outside the concrete and touch the structure only at anchorage diaphragms and deviators: the anchorages push prestress into the diaphragm as concentrated bearing, and at each deviator the tendon changes direction, producing an upward radial force that offsets part of the self-weight moment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path of external tendons: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：轉向力 F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2)。取有效預力 P = 2,970 kN（19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、0.60 f_pu）、轉向角 Δθ = 6°，F = 2×2,970×sin3° ≈ 311 kN；一跨兩處轉向塊、六條鋼腱，總向上力約 2×6×311 ≈ 3,730 kN。失去一條鋼腱，這部分向上力就少約 622 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Deviator force F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2). With effective prestress P = 2,970 kN (19 strands of 15.2 mm at 0.60 f_pu) and a deviation of Δθ = 6°, F = 2×2,970×sin3° ≈ 311 kN; two deviators and six tendons per span give about 2×6×311 ≈ 3,730 kN of upward force. Losing one tendon removes about 622 kN of it. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以竣工圖與預力施工紀錄核對每條鋼腱的路線、轉向角與張拉力，並在結構模型中逐跨計算轉向力與錨定區承壓應力；現場檢查轉向塊與隔梁是否有放射狀裂縫、埋設鋼管滑出或混凝土剝落，拍照編號作為更換前的基準狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check each tendon's profile, deviation angles and stressing force against as-built drawings and stressing records, compute deviator forces and anchorage-zone bearing stresses span by span in the structural model, and inspect deviators and diaphragms for radial cracks, embedded pipes sliding out or spalling, photographing and numbering them as the baseline condition before any replacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 轉向力 F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2)。取有效預力 P = 2,970 kN（19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、0.60 f_pu）、轉向角 Δθ = 6°，F = 2×2,970×sin3° ≈ 311 kN；一跨兩處轉向塊、六條鋼腱，總向上力約 2×6×311 ≈ 3,730 kN。失去一條鋼腱，這部分向上力就少約 622 kN。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Deviator force F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2). With effective prestress P = 2,970 kN (19 strands of 15.2 mm at 0.60 f_pu) and a deviation of Δθ = 6°, F = 2×2,970×sin3° ≈ 311 kN; two deviators and six tendons per span give about 2×6×311 ≈ 3,730 kN of upward force. Losing one tendon removes about 622 kN of it. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path of external tendons", which statement holds?
options: 外置鋼腱因為看得到，天生就可以更換，不需要特別的細部。
千斤頂油壓達到目標值，就證明整條鋼腱的力量都正確。
轉向力 F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2)。
optionsEn: Because external tendons are visible, they are inherently replaceable without special detailing.
Reaching the target jack pressure proves the force is correct along the whole tendon.
Deviator force F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2).
quiz.explanation: 轉向力 F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Deviator force F = 2P·sin(Δθ/2). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path of external tendons: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以竣工圖與預力施工紀錄核對每條鋼腱的路線、轉向角與張拉力，並在結構模型中逐跨計算轉向力與錨定區承壓應力；現場檢查轉向塊與隔梁是否有放射狀裂縫、埋設鋼管滑出或混凝土剝落，拍照編號作為更換前的基準狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check each tendon's profile, deviation angles and stressing force against as-built drawings and stressing records, compute deviator forces and anchorage-zone bearing stresses span by span in the structural model, and inspect deviators and diaphragms for radial cracks, embedded pipes sliding out or spalling, photographing and numbering them as the baseline condition before any replacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計時就要在說明中寫明每一條外置鋼腱都可在交通管制下單獨更換，並在計算書逐跨列出移除任一條鋼腱時的應力檢核與所需交通限制，讓日後的管理單位不必重新推導。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State in the design that every external tendon can be replaced individually under traffic management, and list in the calculations, span by span, the stress check with any one tendon removed and the traffic restriction it requires, so the future owner does not have to re-derive it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：2000 年佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋例行檢查發現一條鋼腱因錨定區嚴重腐蝕而由伸縮縫隔梁拉脫、整條鬆弛，灌漿鋼管也在斷裂時被拉出隔梁；外置鋼腱斷裂時釋放的能量還可能撞擊並損壞轉向塊與箱室內設備。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 外置鋼腱的荷載路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path of external tendons: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉向塊與錨定隔梁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deviators and anchorage diaphragms” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 2000 年佛州 Mid-Bay 大橋例行檢查發現一條鋼腱因錨定區嚴重腐蝕而由伸縮縫隔梁拉脫、整條鬆弛，灌漿鋼管也在斷裂時被拉出隔梁；外置鋼腱斷裂時釋放的能量還可能撞擊並損壞轉向塊與箱室內設備。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: In 2000 a routine inspection of Florida's Mid-Bay Bridge found a tendon that had separated from an expansion-joint diaphragm after severe anchorage-zone corrosion and gone completely slack, with its grouted steel pipe pulled out of the diaphragm during the rupture; the energy released by a breaking external tendon can also strike and damage deviators and equipment inside the box. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因為鋼腱沿全長不與混凝土黏結，任何一處斷裂都會讓整條鋼腱在整個跨度內失去作用，而不像內置黏結鋼腱只在斷點附近局部失效；這正是外置鋼腱能夠更換、也必須事先規劃更換的原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Because the tendon is not bonded to the concrete along its length, a break anywhere deactivates it over the whole span, unlike a bonded internal tendon that loses effect only near the break; that is exactly why external tendons can be replaced and why their replacement must be planned in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「外置鋼腱的荷載路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint stress with one tendon removed: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「節塊接縫底緣應力」如何影響橋梁預力鋼腱更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 預鑄節塊之間的接縫通常沒有鋼筋穿越，接縫能否保持閉合完全依賴預力在底緣留下的壓應力。正常使用時，預力的軸壓與偏心彎矩抵銷恆載與活載彎矩，使底緣仍保有少量壓應力儲備；更換鋼腱時必須先把舊鋼腱去張，等於在施工期間主動讓該跨少一條鋼腱數週。因此更換工程的第一個問題不是怎麼切，而是少一條鋼腱時接縫會不會出現拉應力而張開，以及需要多少交通管制或臨時預力才能避免。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「節塊接縫底緣應力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joints between precast segments usually have no reinforcement crossing them, so whether a joint stays closed depends entirely on the compression that prestress leaves in the bottom fibre. In service, the axial prestress and its eccentric moment offset dead- and live-load moments, leaving a small compressive reserve; replacing a tendon means deliberately detensioning the old one, so the span works one tendon short for weeks. The first question of a replacement is therefore not how to cut, but whether the joints decompress and open with one tendon missing, and how much traffic restriction or temporary prestress prevents it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「節塊接縫底緣應力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Joint stress with one tendon removed
knowledge.text: 預鑄節塊之間的接縫通常沒有鋼筋穿越，接縫能否保持閉合完全依賴預力在底緣留下的壓應力。正常使用時，預力的軸壓與偏心彎矩抵銷恆載與活載彎矩，使底緣仍保有少量壓應力儲備；更換鋼腱時必須先把舊鋼腱去張，等於在施工期間主動讓該跨少一條鋼腱數週。

In service, the axial prestress and its eccentric moment offset dead- and live-load moments, leaving a small compressive reserve; replacing a tendon means deliberately detensioning the old one, so the span works one tendon short for weeks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint stress with one tendon removed" is correct?
options: 只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。
只要灌漿的氯離子含量很低，鋼腱就不會腐蝕。
預鑄節塊之間的接縫通常沒有鋼筋穿越，接縫能否保持閉合完全依賴預力在底緣留下的壓應力。
optionsEn: As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement.
If grout chloride content is very low, the tendon cannot corrode.

quiz.explanationEn: Joints between precast segments usually have no reinforcement crossing them, so whether a joint stays closed depends entirely on the compression that prestress leaves in the bottom fibre. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint stress with one tendon removed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節塊接縫底緣應力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b。設 A = 6.0 m²、S_b = 3.5 m³、e = 1.2 m、M = 30 MN·m。六條鋼腱 P = 17.82 MN：σ_b = −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 ≈ −0.51 MPa（受壓）；去掉一條後 P = 14.85 MN：σ_b = −2.48 − 5.09 + 8.57 ≈ +1.00 MPa（受拉，接縫可能張開）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b. Take A = 6.0 m², S_b = 3.5 m³, e = 1.2 m and M = 30 MN·m. With six tendons, P = 17.82 MN gives σ_b = −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 ≈ −0.51 MPa (compression); with one removed, P = 14.85 MN gives σ_b = −2.48 − 5.09 + 8.57 ≈ +1.00 MPa (tension, the joint may open). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段模型逐步模擬「舊鋼腱去張、空缺期、新鋼腱張拉」三個狀態，檢查每個接縫在設計活載與溫度梯度下的應力；現場在接縫兩側安裝裂縫計或位移計，去張期間連續記錄接縫開口，超過預定警戒值（例如 0.1 mm）即停工檢討。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Model the three construction states, old tendon detensioned, gap period and new tendon stressed, and check every joint under design live load and thermal gradient; on site, fit crack gauges or displacement transducers across joints and log opening continuously during detensioning, stopping work for review if a preset alert value such as 0.1 mm is exceeded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b. Take A = 6.0 m², S_b = 3.5 m³, e = 1.2 m and M = 30 MN·m. With six tendons, P = 17.82 MN gives σ_b = −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 ≈ −0.51 MPa (compression); with one removed, P = 14.85 MN gives σ_b = −2.48 − 5.09 + 8.57 ≈ +1.00 MPa (tension, the joint may open). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint stress with one tendon removed", which statement holds?
options: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b。
鋼腱已經斷了一部分，剩下的鋼絞線可以直接在錨頭燒斷。
只要套管外觀沒有裂縫，裡面的鋼腱就一定完好。
optionsEn: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b.
Once part of a tendon has broken, the remaining strands can simply be torched off at the anchorage.
If the duct shows no cracks outside, the tendon inside must be sound.
quiz.explanation: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: σ_b = −P/A − P·e/S_b + M/S_b. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 移除一條鋼腱時的接縫應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint stress with one tendon removed: testing and verification

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bottom-fibre stress at segment joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼絞線腐蝕與殘餘強度」與「可更換鋼腱的細部設計」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strand corrosion and residual strength" and "Detailing for replaceable tendons": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼絞線腐蝕與殘餘強度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Strand corrosion and residual strength: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「灌漿空隙與泌水」如何影響橋梁預力鋼腱更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grout voids and bleed water” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 灌漿鋼腱的防蝕依靠水泥漿的高鹼性與完整包覆，但灌漿若離析、泌水，會在鋼腱高點、錨頭與轉向處留下空隙與軟弱漿體。FHWA 對 Mid-Bay 的彙整指出，即使灌漿氯離子含量很低，碳化、離析灌漿與多餘泌水仍會在氧氣與水氣存在下造成快速腐蝕；Wando River 橋與 Ringling 堤道橋也都找到離析、粉狀或濕軟的灌漿帶。腐蝕常集中在少數鋼絞線，鋼絲先在局部斷裂，灌漿又把附近未斷的鋼絲綁在一起，使殘存鋼絲在斷點附近承擔更高應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「灌漿空隙與泌水」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grouted tendons rely on the high alkalinity and full encapsulation of cement grout, but segregated or bleeding grout leaves voids and soft paste at high points, anchorages and deviators. FHWA's review of Mid-Bay concluded that carbonation, segregated grout and excess bleed water caused rapid corrosion in the presence of oxygen and moisture even though grout chloride was very low; investigations at the Wando River and Ringling Causeway bridges also found segregated, chalky or soft wet grout bands. Corrosion usually concentrates in a few strands, wires break locally, and the grout ties nearby intact wires together so that the survivors carry higher stress near the break. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Grout voids and bleed water” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：19 股鋼腱 A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa，極限力 F_pu ≈ 4,950 kN，有效預力 0.60F_pu ≈ 2,970 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 19-strand tendon has A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm² and f_pu = 1,860 MPa, so F_pu ≈ 4,950 kN and the effective prestress 0.60F_pu ≈ 2,970 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要灌漿的氯離子含量很低，鋼腱就不會腐蝕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If grout chloride content is very low, the tendon cannot corrode." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「灌漿空隙與泌水」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Grout voids and bleed water”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要灌漿的氯離子含量很低，鋼腱就不會腐蝕。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 鋼絞線腐蝕與殘餘強度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strand corrosion and residual strength: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灌漿空隙與泌水」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grout voids and bleed water” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：19 股鋼腱 A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa，極限力 F_pu ≈ 4,950 kN，有效預力 0.60F_pu ≈ 2,970 kN。若灌漿在斷點附近把力量局部鎖住，殘存面積比降到 0.60/0.90 ≈ 0.67 時殘存鋼絲達降伏（約斷 6.3 股），降到 0.60 時達極限（約斷 7.6 股）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 19-strand tendon has A_ps = 19×140 = 2,660 mm² and f_pu = 1,860 MPa, so F_pu ≈ 4,950 kN and the effective prestress 0.60F_pu ≈ 2,970 kN. If the grout locks the force locally near a break, the survivors yield when the remaining area ratio falls to 0.60/0.90 ≈ 0.67 (about 6.3 strands lost) and reach ultimate at 0.60 (about 7.6 strands lost). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在鋼腱高點、錨頭後方與轉向塊兩側鑽小孔，以內視鏡觀察空隙與鋼絲表面，取灌漿樣本做氯離子、硫酸根、含水率與碳化試驗；鋼絲樣本則量測截面損失與腐蝕型態，每一筆結果都標註到鋼腱編號與位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Drill small holes at tendon high points, behind anchorages and on both sides of deviators, inspect voids and wire surfaces with a borescope, and test grout samples for chloride, sulfate, moisture content and carbonation; measure section loss and corrosion morphology on wire samples, and tag every result to the tendon number and location.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鋼絞線腐蝕與殘餘強度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strand corrosion and residual strength: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌漿空隙與泌水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grout voids and bleed water” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在鋼腱高點、錨頭後方與轉向塊兩側鑽小孔，以內視鏡觀察空隙與鋼絲表面，取灌漿樣本做氯離子、硫酸根、含水率與碳化試驗；鋼絲樣本則量測截面損失與腐蝕型態，每一筆結果都標註到鋼腱編號與位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Drill small holes at tendon high points, behind anchorages and on both sides of deviators, inspect voids and wire surfaces with a borescope, and test grout samples for chloride, sulfate, moisture content and carbonation; measure section loss and corrosion morphology on wire samples, and tag every result to the tendon number and location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢測取樣要涵蓋高點、低點、錨頭與轉向處，並把排氣管與灌漿孔是否封閉列入每次巡檢；任何開放的排氣管或積水的錨頭帽都視為缺陷，限期封堵並追查同一灌漿批次的鋼腱。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Sampling must cover high points, low points, anchorages and deviators, and every inspection should check that vents and grout ports are sealed; treat any open vent or water-filled anchor cap as a defect, seal it within a set deadline and investigate the tendons grouted in the same batch.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：Wando River 橋第二次失效的鋼腱共 133 根鋼絲中，約 80.5% 因腐蝕斷裂，其餘在截面減少後因過載拉斷，顯示局部腐蝕累積到臨界點後，最後的斷裂是突發的；一支未封閉、通到橋面的灌漿排氣管把水引入隔梁，是調查確認的進水路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the second Wando River Bridge failure, about 80.5% of the tendon's 133 wires had ruptured by corrosion and the rest by overstress on the reduced area, showing that once local corrosion reaches a threshold the final rupture is sudden; an open grout vent tube running up to the deck and carrying water into a diaphragm was a confirmed water path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 可更換鋼腱的細部設計：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Detailing for replaceable tendons: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙層包覆與擴口轉向」如何影響橋梁預力鋼腱更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Double envelope and diabolo” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 傳統做法在轉向塊與隔梁內埋設剛性鋼管，再以套管接上外露的 HDPE 套管並一起灌漿；更換時灌漿把鋼腱與鋼管黏成一體，抽出時常損壞混凝土。FHWA 2019 年的可更換灌漿外置鋼腱指引提出「雙層包覆」概念：在轉向塊與隔梁內以喇叭狀的擴口模形成空腔，讓鋼腱連同套管只靠承壓傳力、不與混凝土黏結，錨頭也用導管或雙喇叭管隔開，舊鋼腱可以整條抽出。AASHTO LRFD 節塊橋條文另要求預留臨時與未來追加鋼腱的錨座與孔道，作為更換期間或日後補強的備援。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙層包覆與擴口轉向」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Traditional details embed rigid steel pipes in deviators and diaphragms, couple them to exposed HDPE duct and grout everything together; on replacement the grout binds tendon and pipe into one piece, so extraction often damages the concrete. FHWA's 2019 guide on replaceable grouted external tendons proposes a double-envelope concept: trumpet-shaped diabolo voids in deviators and diaphragms let the tendon and its duct transfer force by bearing only, with no bond to the concrete, and guide pipes or double trumpets isolate the anchorages, so the old tendon can be pulled out whole. AASHTO LRFD segmental provisions also require provisional and future tendon anchorages and ducts, which serve as a reserve during replacement or later strengthening. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Double envelope and diabolo” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：FHWA 指引建議擴口出口角 = 轉向角 + 3°。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The FHWA guide recommends a diabolo exit angle equal to the deviation angle plus 3°.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外置鋼腱因為看得到，天生就可以更換，不需要特別的細部。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
