quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate the MFL equipment on a specimen with known defects to confirm the smallest detectable section loss, then cross-check field signals against borescope or opened-window findings; set sample numbers and locations with the statistical approach in FHWA's grout-defect guidelines, weighted toward high points, anchorages and segments with a history of leakage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 全橋鋼腱普查與抽樣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Network-wide tendon survey and sampling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「磁通洩漏掃描與鑽孔內視鏡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “MFL scans and borescope holes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: MFL 在錨頭、轉向鋼管與鋼筋密集處訊號會受干擾，若把「沒有訊號」當成「沒有缺陷」，最可能腐蝕的錨定區反而沒有被檢查；只做目視而不鑽孔，也看不到套管內的空隙與粉狀灌漿。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: MFL signals are disturbed at anchorages, deviator pipes and congested reinforcement, so treating no signal as no defect leaves the anchorage zones, where corrosion is most likely, unchecked; visual inspection without drilling cannot see voids and chalky grout inside the duct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：決定更換清單與優先順序的應是普查結果，而不只是已經斷的那一條。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The survey, not just the broken tendon, should set the replacement list and priorities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要套管外觀沒有裂縫，裡面的鋼腱就一定完好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the duct shows no cracks outside, the tendon inside must be sound." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: MFL 在錨頭、轉向鋼管與鋼筋密集處訊號會受干擾，若把「沒有訊號」當成「沒有缺陷」，最可能腐蝕的錨定區反而沒有被檢查；只做目視而不鑽孔，也看不到套管內的空隙與粉狀灌漿。
knowledge.textEn: MFL signals are disturbed at anchorages, deviator pipes and congested reinforcement, so treating no signal as no defect leaves the anchorage zones, where corrosion is most likely, unchecked; visual inspection without drilling cannot see voids and chalky grout inside the duct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「全橋鋼腱普查與抽樣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Network-wide tendon survey and sampling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
MFL 在錨頭、轉向鋼管與鋼筋密集處訊號會受干擾，若把「沒有訊號」當成「沒有缺陷」，最可能腐蝕的錨定區反而沒有被檢查。
鋼腱振動頻率只要有變化，就一定是斷了鋼絲。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
MFL signals are disturbed at anchorages, deviator pipes and congested reinforcement, so treating no signal as no defect leaves the anchorage zones, where corrosion is most likely, unchecked.
Any change in a tendon's vibration frequency must mean broken wires.
quiz.explanation: MFL 在錨頭、轉向鋼管與鋼筋密集處訊號會受干擾，若把「沒有訊號」當成「沒有缺陷」，最可能腐蝕的錨定區反而沒有被檢查；只做目視而不鑽孔，也看不到套管內的空隙與粉狀灌漿。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: MFL signals are disturbed at anchorages, deviator pipes and congested reinforcement, so treating no signal as no defect leaves the anchorage zones, where corrosion is most likely, unchecked; visual inspection without drilling cannot see voids and chalky grout inside the duct. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 以振動估計鋼腱殘餘張力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Estimating residual tendon force by vibration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「鋼腱自振頻率」如何影響橋梁預力鋼腱更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tendon natural frequency” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 外置鋼腱在兩個轉向塊之間像一根拉緊的弦，張力越大，橫向自振頻率越高。以小錘輕敲或環境振動激發，用加速度計量到基頻即可反推張力，不必切開套管就能比較各條鋼腱的力量；FDOT 在 Mid-Bay 的狀況評估中也使用了南佛羅里達大學發展的振動測試技術。灌漿後的鋼腱具有彎曲勁度，轉向處也不是理想鉸接，因此絕對值需要校正，最可靠的用法是比較同一跨各條鋼腱或同一條鋼腱的歷年變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「鋼腱自振頻率」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Between two deviators an external tendon behaves like a taut string: the higher the tension, the higher its transverse natural frequency. Excited by a light hammer tap or ambient vibration, the fundamental frequency measured with an accelerometer can be inverted to tension, letting engineers compare tendon forces without opening the duct; FDOT's Mid-Bay condition assessment also used a vibration testing technique developed at the University of South Florida. A grouted tendon has bending stiffness and deviators are not ideal pins, so absolute values need calibration; the most reliable use is comparing tendons within one span, or one tendon year by year. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Tendon natural frequency” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：弦振動 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: String vibration gives f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼腱振動頻率只要有變化，就一定是斷了鋼絲。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any change in a tendon's vibration frequency must mean broken wires." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「鋼腱自振頻率」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Tendon natural frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 以振動估計鋼腱殘餘張力
knowledge.titleEn: Estimating residual tendon force by vibration
knowledge.text: 外置鋼腱在兩個轉向塊之間像一根拉緊的弦，張力越大，橫向自振頻率越高。以小錘輕敲或環境振動激發，用加速度計量到基頻即可反推張力，不必切開套管就能比較各條鋼腱的力量；FDOT 在 Mid-Bay 的狀況評估中也使用了南佛羅里達大學發展的振動測試技術。
knowledge.textEn: Between two deviators an external tendon behaves like a taut string: the higher the tension, the higher its transverse natural frequency. Excited by a light hammer tap or ambient vibration, the fundamental frequency measured with an accelerometer can be inverted to tension, letting engineers compare tendon forces without opening the duct; FDOT's Mid-Bay condition assessment also used a vibration testing technique developed at the University of South Florida.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼腱振動頻率只要有變化，就一定是斷了鋼絲。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any change in a tendon's vibration frequency must mean broken wires. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「以振動估計鋼腱殘餘張力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Estimating residual tendon force by vibration" is correct?
options: 鋼腱振動頻率只要有變化，就一定是斷了鋼絲。
真空灌注可以讓已腐蝕的鋼腱恢復原來的強度。
外置鋼腱在兩個轉向塊之間像一根拉緊的弦，張力越大，橫向自振頻率越高。
optionsEn: Any change in a tendon's vibration frequency must mean broken wires.
Vacuum injection restores a corroded tendon to its original strength.
Between two deviators an external tendon behaves like a taut string: the higher the tension, the higher its transverse natural frequency.
quiz.explanation: 外置鋼腱在兩個轉向塊之間像一根拉緊的弦，張力越大，橫向自振頻率越高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Between two deviators an external tendon behaves like a taut string: the higher the tension, the higher its transverse natural frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 以振動估計鋼腱殘餘張力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Estimating residual tendon force by vibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼腱自振頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tendon natural frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：弦振動 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。自由長度 L = 20 m，單位長質量 m ≈ 鋼絞線 19×1.10 + 灌漿 9.9 + 套管 1.5 ≈ 32.3 kg/m；T = 2,970 kN 時 f₁ = (1/40)×√(2,970,000/32.3) ≈ 7.6 Hz。因 f ∝ √T，張力降 30% 時頻率降為約 6.3 Hz。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: String vibration gives f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With a free length L = 20 m and a mass per metre m ≈ strand 19×1.10 + grout 9.9 + duct 1.5 ≈ 32.3 kg/m, T = 2,970 kN gives f₁ = (1/40)×√(2,970,000/32.3) ≈ 7.6 Hz. Because f ∝ √T, a 30% loss of tension lowers it to about 6.3 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以加速度計量取至少前三個模態，檢查 f_n 是否隨 n 線性增加以確認弦模型適用，偏離時改用含彎曲勁度的模型；以剛完成張拉、力量已知的新鋼腱做現場標定，再換算同跨其他鋼腱的張力，差異超過約 10% 者列為優先開窗檢查對象。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record at least the first three modes and check that f_n grows linearly with n, confirming the string model, and switch to a model with bending stiffness if it does not; calibrate on site with a freshly stressed tendon of known force, convert the frequencies of the other tendons in the span, and prioritise any that differ by more than about 10% for opening and inspection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 弦振動 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。自由長度 L = 20 m，單位長質量 m ≈ 鋼絞線 19×1.10 + 灌漿 9.9 + 套管 1.5 ≈ 32.3 kg/m；T = 2,970 kN 時 f₁ = (1/40)×√(2,970,000/32.3) ≈ 7.6 Hz。因 f ∝ √T，張力降 30% 時頻率降為約 6.3 Hz。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: String vibration gives f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With a free length L = 20 m and a mass per metre m ≈ strand 19×1.10 + grout 9.9 + duct 1.5 ≈ 32.3 kg/m, T = 2,970 kN gives f₁ = (1/40)×√(2,970,000/32.3) ≈ 7.6 Hz. Because f ∝ √T, a 30% loss of tension lowers it to about 6.3 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「以振動估計鋼腱殘餘張力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Estimating residual tendon force by vibration", which statement holds?
options: 弦振動 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。
外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。
只要灌漿的氯離子含量很低，鋼腱就不會腐蝕。
optionsEn: String vibration gives f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m).
When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress.
If grout chloride content is very low, the tendon cannot corrode.
quiz.explanation: 弦振動 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: String vibration gives f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 以振動估計鋼腱殘餘張力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Estimating residual tendon force by vibration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼腱自振頻率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tendon natural frequency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以加速度計量取至少前三個模態，檢查 f_n 是否隨 n 線性增加以確認弦模型適用，偏離時改用含彎曲勁度的模型；以剛完成張拉、力量已知的新鋼腱做現場標定，再換算同跨其他鋼腱的張力，差異超過約 10% 者列為優先開窗檢查對象。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record at least the first three modes and check that f_n grows linearly with n, confirming the string model, and switch to a model with bending stiffness if it does not; calibrate on site with a freshly stressed tendon of known force, convert the frequencies of the other tendons in the span, and prioritise any that differ by more than about 10% for opening and inspection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為每一條鋼腱建立頻率指紋：施工或更換完成時量一次作為基準，之後在相近溫度下定期複量；量測點位、激振方式與感測器型號寫入檢測程序，以免換了檢測人員就換了方法。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Give every tendon a frequency fingerprint: measure once at completion or after replacement as the baseline, then re-measure periodically at similar temperatures; write the measurement points, excitation method and sensor model into the inspection procedure so the method does not change with the inspector.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把轉向處當成理想支點而忽略灌漿鋼腱的彎曲勁度，算出的張力會偏高，讓已失去部分鋼絲的鋼腱看起來正常；溫度變化也會改變張力與頻率，直接比較不同季節的資料可能誤判。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating deviators as ideal supports and ignoring the bending stiffness of a grouted tendon overestimates tension, making a tendon that has lost wires look normal; temperature also changes tension and frequency, so directly comparing data from different seasons can mislead. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以加速度計量取至少前三個模態，檢查 f_n 是否隨 n 線性增加以確認弦模型適用，偏離時改用含彎曲勁度的模型；以剛完成張拉、力量已知的新鋼腱做現場標定，再換算同跨其他鋼腱的張力，差異超過約 10% 者列為優先開窗檢查對象。
knowledge.textEn: Record at least the first three modes and check that f_n grows linearly with n, confirming the string model, and switch to a model with bending stiffness if it does not; calibrate on site with a freshly stressed tendon of known force, convert the frequencies of the other tendons in the span, and prioritise any that differ by more than about 10% for opening and inspection.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為每一條鋼腱建立頻率指紋：施工或更換完成時量一次作為基準，之後在相近溫度下定期複量；量測點位、激振方式與感測器型號寫入檢測程序，以免換了檢測人員就換了方法。
knowledge.textEn: Give every tendon a frequency fingerprint: measure once at completion or after replacement as the baseline, then re-measure periodically at similar temperatures; write the measurement points, excitation method and sensor model into the inspection procedure so the method does not change with the inspector.

quiz.question: 要驗證「以振動估計鋼腱殘餘張力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Estimating residual tendon force by vibration"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以加速度計量取至少前三個模態，檢查 f_n 是否隨 n 線性增加以確認弦模型適用，偏離時改用含彎曲勁度的模型。
鋼腱已經斷了一部分，剩下的鋼絞線可以直接在錨頭燒斷。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Record at least the first three modes and check that f_n grows linearly with n, confirming the string model, and switch to a model with bending stiffness if it does not.
Once part of a tendon has broken, the remaining strands can simply be torched off at the anchorage.
quiz.explanation: 以加速度計量取至少前三個模態，檢查 f_n 是否隨 n 線性增加以確認弦模型適用，偏離時改用含彎曲勁度的模型；以剛完成張拉、力量已知的新鋼腱做現場標定，再換算同跨其他鋼腱的張力，差異超過約 10% 者列為優先開窗檢查對象。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record at least the first three modes and check that f_n grows linearly with n, confirming the string model, and switch to a model with bending stiffness if it does not; calibrate on site with a freshly stressed tendon of known force, convert the frequencies of the other tendons in the span, and prioritise any that differ by more than about 10% for opening and inspection. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 以振動估計鋼腱殘餘張力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Estimating residual tendon force by vibration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼腱自振頻率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tendon natural frequency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把轉向處當成理想支點而忽略灌漿鋼腱的彎曲勁度，算出的張力會偏高，讓已失去部分鋼絲的鋼腱看起來正常；溫度變化也會改變張力與頻率，直接比較不同季節的資料可能誤判。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating deviators as ideal supports and ignoring the bending stiffness of a grouted tendon overestimates tension, making a tendon that has lost wires look normal; temperature also changes tension and frequency, so directly comparing data from different seasons can mislead. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：灌漿後的鋼腱具有彎曲勁度，轉向處也不是理想鉸接，因此絕對值需要校正，最可靠的用法是比較同一跨各條鋼腱或同一條鋼腱的歷年變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A grouted tendon has bending stiffness and deviators are not ideal pins, so absolute values need calibration; the most reliable use is comparing tendons within one span, or one tendon year by year.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼腱振動頻率只要有變化，就一定是斷了鋼絲。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any change in a tendon's vibration frequency must mean broken wires." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把轉向處當成理想支點而忽略灌漿鋼腱的彎曲勁度，算出的張力會偏高，讓已失去部分鋼絲的鋼腱看起來正常；溫度變化也會改變張力與頻率，直接比較不同季節的資料可能誤判。
knowledge.textEn: Treating deviators as ideal supports and ignoring the bending stiffness of a grouted tendon overestimates tension, making a tendon that has lost wires look normal; temperature also changes tension and frequency, so directly comparing data from different seasons can mislead.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「以振動估計鋼腱殘餘張力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Estimating residual tendon force by vibration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
真空灌注可以讓已腐蝕的鋼腱恢復原來的強度。
若把轉向處當成理想支點而忽略灌漿鋼腱的彎曲勁度，算出的張力會偏高，讓已失去部分鋼絲的鋼腱看起來正常；溫度變化也會改變張力與頻率，直接比較不同季節的資料可能誤判。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Vacuum injection restores a corroded tendon to its original strength.
Treating deviators as ideal supports and ignoring the bending stiffness of a grouted tendon overestimates tension, making a tendon that has lost wires look normal.
quiz.explanation: 若把轉向處當成理想支點而忽略灌漿鋼腱的彎曲勁度，算出的張力會偏高，讓已失去部分鋼絲的鋼腱看起來正常；溫度變化也會改變張力與頻率，直接比較不同季節的資料可能誤判。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating deviators as ideal supports and ignoring the bending stiffness of a grouted tendon overestimates tension, making a tendon that has lost wires look normal; temperature also changes tension and frequency, so directly comparing data from different seasons can mislead. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護」與「長期監測、紀錄與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Grout-void repair and anchorage protection" and "Long-term monitoring, records and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Grout-void repair and anchorage protection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「真空灌注與錨頭保護帽」如何影響橋梁預力鋼腱更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vacuum injection and anchor caps” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 不是每一條有空隙的鋼腱都需要更換：鋼絲完好但灌漿不滿時，可用真空輔助灌注先把空隙抽成負壓，再注入低泌水灌漿或樹脂填滿，阻斷水氣與氧氣。Mid-Bay 在 2000 年事件後即對錨頭空隙進行真空再灌漿，後續整治也包含鋼腱包覆與錨頭保護。錨頭是最容易進水的位置，修補後要以防蝕帽、密封材與防水塗層形成多道屏障，並保留可檢查的觀察孔。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「真空灌注與錨頭保護帽」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Not every tendon with a void needs replacement: where wires are sound but the grout is incomplete, vacuum-assisted injection first evacuates the void and then fills it with low-bleed grout or resin, cutting off water and oxygen. After the 2000 event, Mid-Bay's anchorage voids were vacuum-regrouted, and later rehabilitation also included tendon wrapping and anchorage protection. Anchorages are the likeliest entry points for water, so repairs should build several barriers with protective caps, sealants and waterproof coatings and keep an inspectable port. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Vacuum injection and anchor caps” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：真空體積法以波以耳定律量空隙：真空槽 V_t = 20 L 抽至 0.1 bar（絕對壓力），接上空隙（初始 1.0 bar），平衡後 0.4 bar。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vacuum volumetry measures a void with Boyle's law: a 20 L tank evacuated to 0.1 bar absolute is connected to a void initially at 1.0 bar, and the pressures equalise at 0.4 bar.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「真空灌注可以讓已腐蝕的鋼腱恢復原來的強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Vacuum injection restores a corroded tendon to its original strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「真空灌注與錨頭保護帽」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Vacuum injection and anchor caps”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護
knowledge.text: 不是每一條有空隙的鋼腱都需要更換：鋼絲完好但灌漿不滿時，可用真空輔助灌注先把空隙抽成負壓，再注入低泌水灌漿或樹脂填滿，阻斷水氣與氧氣。Mid-Bay 在 2000 年事件後即對錨頭空隙進行真空再灌漿，後續整治也包含鋼腱包覆與錨頭保護。
knowledge.textEn: Not every tendon with a void needs replacement: where wires are sound but the grout is incomplete, vacuum-assisted injection first evacuates the void and then fills it with low-bleed grout or resin, cutting off water and oxygen. After the 2000 event, Mid-Bay's anchorage voids were vacuum-regrouted, and later rehabilitation also included tendon wrapping and anchorage protection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：真空灌注可以讓已腐蝕的鋼腱恢復原來的強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Vacuum injection restores a corroded tendon to its original strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Grout-void repair and anchorage protection" is correct?
options: 不是每一條有空隙的鋼腱都需要更換：鋼絲完好但灌漿不滿時，可用真空輔助灌注先把空隙抽成負壓，再注入低泌水灌漿或樹脂填滿，阻斷水氣與氧氣。
真空灌注可以讓已腐蝕的鋼腱恢復原來的強度。
鋼腱更換完成後，這座橋的預力問題就徹底解決了。
optionsEn: Not every tendon with a void needs replacement: where wires are sound but the grout is incomplete, vacuum-assisted injection first evacuates the void and then fills it with low-bleed grout or resin, cutting off water and oxygen.
Vacuum injection restores a corroded tendon to its original strength.
Once tendons are replaced, the bridge's prestressing problems are solved for good.
quiz.explanation: 不是每一條有空隙的鋼腱都需要更換：鋼絲完好但灌漿不滿時，可用真空輔助灌注先把空隙抽成負壓，再注入低泌水灌漿或樹脂填滿，阻斷水氣與氧氣。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Not every tendon with a void needs replacement: where wires are sound but the grout is incomplete, vacuum-assisted injection first evacuates the void and then fills it with low-bleed grout or resin, cutting off water and oxygen. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grout-void repair and anchorage protection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「真空灌注與錨頭保護帽」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vacuum injection and anchor caps” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：真空體積法以波以耳定律量空隙：真空槽 V_t = 20 L 抽至 0.1 bar（絕對壓力），接上空隙（初始 1.0 bar），平衡後 0.4 bar。0.1×20 + 1.0×V = 0.4×(20 + V)，得 V = 10 L；若 100 mm 套管頂部空隙截面約 2,000 mm²，空隙長度約 5 m。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vacuum volumetry measures a void with Boyle's law: a 20 L tank evacuated to 0.1 bar absolute is connected to a void initially at 1.0 bar, and the pressures equalise at 0.4 bar. 0.1×20 + 1.0×V = 0.4×(20 + V) gives V = 10 L; if the void at the top of a 100 mm duct has a cross-section of about 2,000 mm², it is about 5 m long. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：灌注前以真空體積法量測空隙體積，灌注後與實際注入量比對，兩者差異過大代表有洩漏路徑或沒有填滿；完成後從原檢查孔再以內視鏡確認，並對錨頭保護帽做壓力或氣密試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the void volume by vacuum volumetry before injection and compare it with the volume actually injected; a large difference signals a leak path or incomplete filling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 真空體積法以波以耳定律量空隙：真空槽 V_t = 20 L 抽至 0.1 bar（絕對壓力），接上空隙（初始 1.0 bar），平衡後 0.4 bar。0.1×20 + 1.0×V = 0.4×(20 + V)，得 V = 10 L；若 100 mm 套管頂部空隙截面約 2,000 mm²，空隙長度約 5 m。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Vacuum volumetry measures a void with Boyle's law: a 20 L tank evacuated to 0.1 bar absolute is connected to a void initially at 1.0 bar, and the pressures equalise at 0.4 bar. 0.1×20 + 1.0×V = 0.4×(20 + V) gives V = 10 L; if the void at the top of a 100 mm duct has a cross-section of about 2,000 mm², it is about 5 m long. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grout-void repair and anchorage protection", which statement holds?
options: 只要其餘鋼腱沒斷，更換期間的橋就和平常一樣安全。
真空體積法以波以耳定律量空隙：真空槽 V_t = 20 L 抽至 0.1 bar（絕對壓力），接上空隙（初始 1.0 bar），平衡後 0.4 bar。
外置鋼腱因為看得到，天生就可以更換，不需要特別的細部。
optionsEn: As long as the other tendons are intact, the bridge is as safe as usual during a replacement.
Vacuum volumetry measures a void with Boyle's law: a 20 L tank evacuated to 0.1 bar absolute is connected to a void initially at 1.0 bar, and the pressures equalise at 0.4 bar.
Because external tendons are visible, they are inherently replaceable without special detailing.
quiz.explanation: 真空體積法以波以耳定律量空隙：真空槽 V_t = 20 L 抽至 0.1 bar（絕對壓力），接上空隙（初始 1.0 bar），平衡後 0.4 bar。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Vacuum volumetry measures a void with Boyle's law: a 20 L tank evacuated to 0.1 bar absolute is connected to a void initially at 1.0 bar, and the pressures equalise at 0.4 bar. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grout-void repair and anchorage protection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「真空灌注與錨頭保護帽」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vacuum injection and anchor caps” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 灌注前以真空體積法量測空隙體積，灌注後與實際注入量比對，兩者差異過大代表有洩漏路徑或沒有填滿；完成後從原檢查孔再以內視鏡確認，並對錨頭保護帽做壓力或氣密試驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the void volume by vacuum volumetry before injection and compare it with the volume actually injected; a large difference signals a leak path or incomplete filling. Afterwards re-check through the original holes with a borescope and pressure- or air-test the anchor caps. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：修補與更換的分界要事先定義，例如 MFL 或開窗顯示截面損失超過設定比例、或已有斷絲的鋼腱一律更換，只有鋼絲完好的空隙才做灌注；判定準則由業主的結構工程師核定並寫入維護手冊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Define the line between repair and replacement in advance, for example replacing any tendon whose MFL or opening shows section loss above a set fraction or any broken wires, and injecting only voids with sound wires; the owner's structural engineer approves the criteria and writes them into the maintenance manual.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在已有大量斷絲的鋼腱上只做真空灌注，等於把損傷封起來看不見，鋼腱仍可能在數年後斷裂；灌注材料與舊灌漿不相容，或殘留水分沒有排出，也可能在界面持續腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Vacuum-injecting a tendon that already has many broken wires only seals the damage out of sight, and the tendon may still rupture years later; a filler incompatible with the old grout, or moisture left trapped, can keep corroding at the interface. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 灌注前以真空體積法量測空隙體積，灌注後與實際注入量比對，兩者差異過大代表有洩漏路徑或沒有填滿；完成後從原檢查孔再以內視鏡確認，並對錨頭保護帽做壓力或氣密試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the void volume by vacuum volumetry before injection and compare it with the volume actually injected; a large difference signals a leak path or incomplete filling. Afterwards re-check through the original holes with a borescope and pressure- or air-test the anchor caps.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 修補與更換的分界要事先定義，例如 MFL 或開窗顯示截面損失超過設定比例、或已有斷絲的鋼腱一律更換，只有鋼絲完好的空隙才做灌注；判定準則由業主的結構工程師核定並寫入維護手冊。
knowledge.textEn: Define the line between repair and replacement in advance, for example replacing any tendon whose MFL or opening shows section loss above a set fraction or any broken wires, and injecting only voids with sound wires; the owner's structural engineer approves the criteria and writes them into the maintenance manual.

quiz.question: 要驗證「灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Grout-void repair and anchorage protection"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
千斤頂油壓達到目標值，就證明整條鋼腱的力量都正確。
灌注前以真空體積法量測空隙體積，灌注後與實際注入量比對，兩者差異過大代表有洩漏路徑或沒有填滿；完成後從原檢查孔再以內視鏡確認，並對錨頭保護帽做壓力或氣密試驗。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Reaching the target jack pressure proves the force is correct along the whole tendon.
Measure the void volume by vacuum volumetry before injection and compare it with the volume actually injected.
quiz.explanation: 灌注前以真空體積法量測空隙體積，灌注後與實際注入量比對，兩者差異過大代表有洩漏路徑或沒有填滿；完成後從原檢查孔再以內視鏡確認，並對錨頭保護帽做壓力或氣密試驗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the void volume by vacuum volumetry before injection and compare it with the volume actually injected; a large difference signals a leak path or incomplete filling. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grout-void repair and anchorage protection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「真空灌注與錨頭保護帽」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vacuum injection and anchor caps” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在已有大量斷絲的鋼腱上只做真空灌注，等於把損傷封起來看不見，鋼腱仍可能在數年後斷裂；灌注材料與舊灌漿不相容，或殘留水分沒有排出，也可能在界面持續腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Vacuum-injecting a tendon that already has many broken wires only seals the damage out of sight, and the tendon may still rupture years later; a filler incompatible with the old grout, or moisture left trapped, can keep corroding at the interface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：錨頭是最容易進水的位置，修補後要以防蝕帽、密封材與防水塗層形成多道屏障，並保留可檢查的觀察孔。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Anchorages are the likeliest entry points for water, so repairs should build several barriers with protective caps, sealants and waterproof coatings and keep an inspectable port.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「真空灌注可以讓已腐蝕的鋼腱恢復原來的強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Vacuum injection restores a corroded tendon to its original strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在已有大量斷絲的鋼腱上只做真空灌注，等於把損傷封起來看不見，鋼腱仍可能在數年後斷裂；灌注材料與舊灌漿不相容，或殘留水分沒有排出，也可能在界面持續腐蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Vacuum-injecting a tendon that already has many broken wires only seals the damage out of sight, and the tendon may still rupture years later; a filler incompatible with the old grout, or moisture left trapped, can keep corroding at the interface.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「灌漿空隙修補與錨頭防護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grout-void repair and anchorage protection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若在已有大量斷絲的鋼腱上只做真空灌注，等於把損傷封起來看不見，鋼腱仍可能在數年後斷裂；灌注材料與舊灌漿不相容，或殘留水分沒有排出，也可能在界面持續腐蝕。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鋼腱更換完成後，這座橋的預力問題就徹底解決了。
optionsEn: Vacuum-injecting a tendon that already has many broken wires only seals the damage out of sight, and the tendon may still rupture years later.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once tendons are replaced, the bridge's prestressing problems are solved for good.
quiz.explanation: 若在已有大量斷絲的鋼腱上只做真空灌注，等於把損傷封起來看不見，鋼腱仍可能在數年後斷裂；灌注材料與舊灌漿不相容，或殘留水分沒有排出，也可能在界面持續腐蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Vacuum-injecting a tendon that already has many broken wires only seals the damage out of sight, and the tendon may still rupture years later; a filler incompatible with the old grout, or moisture left trapped, can keep corroding at the interface. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長期監測、紀錄與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term monitoring, records and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「聲射監測與鋼腱履歷」如何影響橋梁預力鋼腱更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acoustic emission and tendon records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge prestressing-tendon replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼絲斷裂會釋放瞬間應力波，可被聲射（AE）感測器捕捉，因此在高風險跨段佈設感測器，就能即時記錄斷絲事件的時間與位置。FHWA 報告指出 Varina-Enon 橋在 2020 年 10 月裝設聲射監測，並稱其為偵測即時斷絲最經濟的技術；Wando River 橋則在更換鋼腱後加設兩條外置鋼腱以提高冗餘。交接時要留下每條鋼腱的履歷：材料批號、張拉與伸長量紀錄、灌漿或填充材、頻率基準、檢測孔位置與修補紀錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「聲射監測與鋼腱履歷」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A wire break releases a transient stress wave that acoustic emission (AE) sensors can capture, so instrumenting high-risk spans records the time and location of wire-break events in real time. FHWA reports that Varina-Enon Bridge received AE monitoring in October 2020 and calls it the most economical technology for detecting real-time wire breaks; at Wando River two extra external tendons were added after the replacement to raise redundancy. Handover must leave a history for every tendon: material heat numbers, stressing and elongation records, grout or filler, frequency baseline, inspection-hole locations and repair records. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Acoustic emission and tendon records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：19 股七線鋼絞線共 19×7 = 133 根鋼絲，每斷一根約損失 1/133 ≈ 0.75% 的鋼材面積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A tendon of 19 seven-wire strands has 19×7 = 133 wires, so each break removes about 1/133 ≈ 0.75% of the steel area.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼腱更換完成後，這座橋的預力問題就徹底解決了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once tendons are replaced, the bridge's prestressing problems are solved for good." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「聲射監測與鋼腱履歷」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Acoustic emission and tendon records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期監測、紀錄與交接
knowledge.text: 鋼絲斷裂會釋放瞬間應力波，可被聲射（AE）感測器捕捉，因此在高風險跨段佈設感測器，就能即時記錄斷絲事件的時間與位置。FHWA 報告指出 Varina-Enon 橋在 2020 年 10 月裝設聲射監測，並稱其為偵測即時斷絲最經濟的技術；Wando River 橋則在更換鋼腱後加設兩條外置鋼腱以提高冗餘。
knowledge.textEn: A wire break releases a transient stress wave that acoustic emission (AE) sensors can capture, so instrumenting high-risk spans records the time and location of wire-break events in real time. FHWA reports that Varina-Enon Bridge received AE monitoring in October 2020 and calls it the most economical technology for detecting real-time wire breaks; at Wando River two extra external tendons were added after the replacement to raise redundancy.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼腱更換完成後，這座橋的預力問題就徹底解決了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once tendons are replaced, the bridge's prestressing problems are solved for good. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期監測、紀錄與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term monitoring, records and handover" is correct?
options: 鋼腱更換完成後，這座橋的預力問題就徹底解決了。
鋼絲斷裂會釋放瞬間應力波，可被聲射（AE）感測器捕捉，因此在高風險跨段佈設感測器，就能即時記錄斷絲事件的時間與位置。
外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。
optionsEn: Once tendons are replaced, the bridge's prestressing problems are solved for good.
A wire break releases a transient stress wave that acoustic emission (AE) sensors can capture, so instrumenting high-risk spans records the time and location of wire-break events in real time.
When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress.
quiz.explanation: 鋼絲斷裂會釋放瞬間應力波，可被聲射（AE）感測器捕捉，因此在高風險跨段佈設感測器，就能即時記錄斷絲事件的時間與位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A wire break releases a transient stress wave that acoustic emission (AE) sensors can capture, so instrumenting high-risk spans records the time and location of wire-break events in real time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期監測、紀錄與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term monitoring, records and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「聲射監測與鋼腱履歷」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acoustic emission and tendon records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：19 股七線鋼絞線共 19×7 = 133 根鋼絲，每斷一根約損失 1/133 ≈ 0.75% 的鋼材面積。若警戒值設在單一鋼腱 5% 面積損失，即 0.05×133 ≈ 6.65，約在第 7 次斷絲事件時發出警報。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A tendon of 19 seven-wire strands has 19×7 = 133 wires, so each break removes about 1/133 ≈ 0.75% of the steel area. An alert threshold of 5% area loss in one tendon corresponds to 0.05×133 ≈ 6.65, so the alarm is raised at about the seventh wire-break event. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：聲射系統安裝後以斷鉛試驗或校正敲擊確認每個感測器的靈敏度與定位精度，並定期檢查通訊與電源；每次警報都要經人工複核，比對事件波形、定位與交通紀錄，排除重車與伸縮縫撞擊造成的誤報。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After installing the AE system, confirm each sensor's sensitivity and location accuracy with pencil-lead breaks or calibration taps, and check communications and power regularly; every alert needs a manual review comparing waveform, location and traffic records to rule out false alarms from heavy trucks or expansion-joint impacts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 19 股七線鋼絞線共 19×7 = 133 根鋼絲，每斷一根約損失 1/133 ≈ 0.75% 的鋼材面積。若警戒值設在單一鋼腱 5% 面積損失，即 0.05×133 ≈ 6.65，約在第 7 次斷絲事件時發出警報。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A tendon of 19 seven-wire strands has 19×7 = 133 wires, so each break removes about 1/133 ≈ 0.75% of the steel area. An alert threshold of 5% area loss in one tendon corresponds to 0.05×133 ≈ 6.65, so the alarm is raised at about the seventh wire-break event. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期監測、紀錄與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term monitoring, records and handover", which statement holds?
options: 只要灌漿的氯離子含量很低，鋼腱就不會腐蝕。
鋼腱已經斷了一部分，剩下的鋼絞線可以直接在錨頭燒斷。
19 股七線鋼絞線共 19×7 = 133 根鋼絲，每斷一根約損失 1/133 ≈ 0.75% 的鋼材面積。
optionsEn: If grout chloride content is very low, the tendon cannot corrode.
Once part of a tendon has broken, the remaining strands can simply be torched off at the anchorage.
A tendon of 19 seven-wire strands has 19×7 = 133 wires, so each break removes about 1/133 ≈ 0.75% of the steel area.
quiz.explanation: 19 股七線鋼絞線共 19×7 = 133 根鋼絲，每斷一根約損失 1/133 ≈ 0.75% 的鋼材面積。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A tendon of 19 seven-wire strands has 19×7 = 133 wires, so each break removes about 1/133 ≈ 0.75% of the steel area. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期監測、紀錄與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term monitoring, records and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「聲射監測與鋼腱履歷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Acoustic emission and tendon records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 聲射系統安裝後以斷鉛試驗或校正敲擊確認每個感測器的靈敏度與定位精度，並定期檢查通訊與電源；每次警報都要經人工複核，比對事件波形、定位與交通紀錄，排除重車與伸縮縫撞擊造成的誤報。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After installing the AE system, confirm each sensor's sensitivity and location accuracy with pencil-lead breaks or calibration taps, and check communications and power regularly; every alert needs a manual review comparing waveform, location and traffic records to rule out false alarms from heavy trucks or expansion-joint impacts. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊應包含每跨的單一鋼腱移除交通限制表、檢測週期（例如高風險跨段縮短為半年一次）、警報處置流程與聯絡窗口；任何加載變更或橋面改建前，須由結構工程師重新檢核預力冗餘。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should include each span's single-tendon-removal traffic table, inspection intervals (for example six-monthly for high-risk spans), the alarm response procedure and contacts; before any load change or deck rebuild, a structural engineer must recheck prestress redundancy.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交接文件只有竣工圖而沒有鋼腱層級的紀錄，多年後發生斷絲時，工程師無法判斷是同一灌漿批次、同一施工季節或同一細部的系統性問題，只能全面重新普查，成本與交通衝擊都被放大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If handover leaves only as-built drawings without tendon-level records, engineers facing a wire break years later cannot tell whether it reflects a systemic problem of one grout batch, one construction season or one detail, and must resurvey everything at far greater cost and traffic impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 聲射系統安裝後以斷鉛試驗或校正敲擊確認每個感測器的靈敏度與定位精度，並定期檢查通訊與電源；每次警報都要經人工複核，比對事件波形、定位與交通紀錄，排除重車與伸縮縫撞擊造成的誤報。
knowledge.textEn: After installing the AE system, confirm each sensor's sensitivity and location accuracy with pencil-lead breaks or calibration taps, and check communications and power regularly; every alert needs a manual review comparing waveform, location and traffic records to rule out false alarms from heavy trucks or expansion-joint impacts.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維護手冊應包含每跨的單一鋼腱移除交通限制表、檢測週期（例如高風險跨段縮短為半年一次）、警報處置流程與聯絡窗口；任何加載變更或橋面改建前，須由結構工程師重新檢核預力冗餘。
knowledge.textEn: The maintenance manual should include each span's single-tendon-removal traffic table, inspection intervals (for example six-monthly for high-risk spans), the alarm response procedure and contacts; before any load change or deck rebuild, a structural engineer must recheck prestress redundancy.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期監測、紀錄與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term monitoring, records and handover"?
options: 聲射系統安裝後以斷鉛試驗或校正敲擊確認每個感測器的靈敏度與定位精度，並定期檢查通訊與電源。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要套管外觀沒有裂縫，裡面的鋼腱就一定完好。
optionsEn: After installing the AE system, confirm each sensor's sensitivity and location accuracy with pencil-lead breaks or calibration taps, and check communications and power regularly.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
If the duct shows no cracks outside, the tendon inside must be sound.
quiz.explanation: 聲射系統安裝後以斷鉛試驗或校正敲擊確認每個感測器的靈敏度與定位精度，並定期檢查通訊與電源；每次警報都要經人工複核，比對事件波形、定位與交通紀錄，排除重車與伸縮縫撞擊造成的誤報。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After installing the AE system, confirm each sensor's sensitivity and location accuracy with pencil-lead breaks or calibration taps, and check communications and power regularly; every alert needs a manual review comparing waveform, location and traffic records to rule out false alarms from heavy trucks or expansion-joint impacts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期監測、紀錄與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term monitoring, records and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「聲射監測與鋼腱履歷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Acoustic emission and tendon records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交接文件只有竣工圖而沒有鋼腱層級的紀錄，多年後發生斷絲時，工程師無法判斷是同一灌漿批次、同一施工季節或同一細部的系統性問題，只能全面重新普查，成本與交通衝擊都被放大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If handover leaves only as-built drawings without tendon-level records, engineers facing a wire break years later cannot tell whether it reflects a systemic problem of one grout batch, one construction season or one detail, and must resurvey everything at far greater cost and traffic impact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時要留下每條鋼腱的履歷：材料批號、張拉與伸長量紀錄、灌漿或填充材、頻率基準、檢測孔位置與修補紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover must leave a history for every tendon: material heat numbers, stressing and elongation records, grout or filler, frequency baseline, inspection-hole locations and repair records.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼腱更換完成後，這座橋的預力問題就徹底解決了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once tendons are replaced, the bridge's prestressing problems are solved for good." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交接文件只有竣工圖而沒有鋼腱層級的紀錄，多年後發生斷絲時，工程師無法判斷是同一灌漿批次、同一施工季節或同一細部的系統性問題，只能全面重新普查，成本與交通衝擊都被放大。
knowledge.textEn: If handover leaves only as-built drawings without tendon-level records, engineers facing a wire break years later cannot tell whether it reflects a systemic problem of one grout batch, one construction season or one detail, and must resurvey everything at far greater cost and traffic impact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期監測、紀錄與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term monitoring, records and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若交接文件只有竣工圖而沒有鋼腱層級的紀錄，多年後發生斷絲時，工程師無法判斷是同一灌漿批次、同一施工季節或同一細部的系統性問題，只能全面重新普查，成本與交通衝擊都被放大。
外置鋼腱斷一條只影響斷點附近，其餘跨段照常有預力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

If handover leaves only as-built drawings without tendon-level records, engineers facing a wire break years later cannot tell whether it reflects a systemic problem of one grout batch, one construction season or one detail, and must resurvey everything at far greater cost and traffic impact.
When one external tendon breaks, only the region near the break loses prestress.
quiz.explanation: 若交接文件只有竣工圖而沒有鋼腱層級的紀錄，多年後發生斷絲時，工程師無法判斷是同一灌漿批次、同一施工季節或同一細部的系統性問題，只能全面重新普查，成本與交通衝擊都被放大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If handover leaves only as-built drawings without tendon-level records, engineers facing a wire break years later cannot tell whether it reflects a systemic problem of one grout batch, one construction season or one detail, and must resurvey everything at far greater cost and traffic impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復
summary: 從焊接細節的應力範圍與 AASHTO 疲勞類別出發，區分載重誘發與變形誘發的疲勞裂縫，以斷裂韌性與 Paris 定律估算臨界尺寸與剩餘壽命，再處理止裂孔、錘擊、螺栓拼接、非破壞檢測、現場應變量測與斷裂關鍵構件的檢查交接，並以 Yellow Mill Pond、Lafayette Street、Hoan 與 I-40 Hernando de Soto 等橋為實例。
summaryEn: Starting from stress ranges at welded details and the AASHTO fatigue categories, distinguish load-induced from distortion-induced cracking, estimate critical size and remaining life with fracture toughness and the Paris law, then cover arrest holes, peening, bolted splices, nondestructive testing, field strain measurement and the inspection and handover of fracture-critical members, using the Yellow Mill Pond, Lafayette Street, Hoan and I-40 Hernando de Soto bridges as examples.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 1970 年代鋼板梁橋受拉翼板的蓋板端部屬 AASHTO E′ 類（A = 3.9×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 1.28×10¹¹ MPa³，常幅門檻約 18 MPa）。現場應變量測得有效應力範圍 S_re = 25 MPa、每天約 1,500 次循環（約 547,500 次/年）。(1) 疲勞壽命 N = 1.28×10¹¹/25³ ≈ 8.2×10⁶ 次，約 15 年，說明通車數十年的此類細節出現裂縫並不意外。(2) 檢查發現半長 a = 30 mm 的邊緣裂縫，取孔邊尖峰應力範圍限值 110 MPa、設計應力範圍 Δσ = 50 MPa：ρ ≥ 4×30×(50/110)² ≈ 24.8 mm，孔徑約 49.6 mm，邊緣裂縫加大 25% 約 62 mm，選用 64 mm（2.5 in）環形鑽，落在 FHWA 手冊 2 至 4 in 的經驗範圍。(3) 再以螺栓拼接板跨越蓋板端部，讓力量繞過受損斷面，並於一年內追蹤檢查孔緣。(4) 若改變一個輸入：S_re 改為 30 MPa，壽命變為 8.2×10⁶×(25/30)³ ≈ 4.7×10⁶ 次，約 8.6 年，應力範圍增加 20% 使壽命少了約 42%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a cover-plate end on the tension flange of a 1970s steel plate-girder bridge is AASHTO Category E′ (A = 3.9×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 1.28×10¹¹ MPa³, constant-amplitude threshold about 18 MPa). Field strain measurement gives an effective stress range S_re = 25 MPa and about 1,500 cycles a day (about 547,500 a year). (1) Fatigue life N = 1.28×10¹¹/25³ ≈ 8.2×10⁶ cycles, about 15 years, so cracking at such a detail after decades of service is no surprise. (2) Inspection finds an edge crack of half-length a = 30 mm; with a peak hole-edge stress-range limit of 110 MPa and design stress range Δσ = 50 MPa, ρ ≥ 4×30×(50/110)² ≈ 24.8 mm, a diameter of about 49.6 mm, raised by 25% for an edge crack to about 62 mm, so a 64 mm (2.5 in) annular cutter is chosen, within the 2 to 4 in range supported in the FHWA manual. (3) Bolted splice plates then bridge the cover-plate end so force bypasses the damaged section, and the hole edges are re-inspected within a year. (4) Changing one input: with S_re = 30 MPa the life becomes 8.2×10⁶×(25/30)³ ≈ 4.7×10⁶ cycles, about 8.6 years, so a 20% higher stress range cuts life by about 42%. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」與「變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stress range and fatigue detail categories" and "Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 應力範圍與疲勞細節類別：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Stress range and fatigue detail categories: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「蓋板端部焊趾」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cover-plate end weld toe” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 鋼橋的疲勞裂縫幾乎都從焊接細節開始：焊趾的幾何不連續、殘餘拉應力與微小熔渣缺陷使局部應力集中，車輛每次通過造成的應力範圍（而不是最大應力）驅動裂縫逐步成長。AASHTO 把細節依疲勞強度分成 A 到 E′ 等類別，蓋板端部的橫向填角焊屬最差的 E 或 E′ 類，康乃狄克州 I-95 Yellow Mill Pond 橋的蓋板端部裂縫就是 FHWA 修復手冊中的典型照片。由於 S–N 曲線斜率為 3，應力範圍增加約 26% 壽命就減半，因此疲勞評估的核心是準確的應力範圍與循環次數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「蓋板端部焊趾」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue cracks in steel bridges almost always start at welded details: the geometric discontinuity at the weld toe, tensile residual stress and tiny slag defects concentrate stress locally, and the stress range from each passing vehicle, not the peak stress, drives the crack forward. AASHTO groups details by fatigue strength into categories A to E′; transverse fillet welds at cover-plate ends are among the worst, Category E or E′, and the cracked cover-plate end on the I-95 Yellow Mill Pond Bridge in Connecticut is a classic illustration in the FHWA repair manual. Because the S–N curve has a slope of 3, a stress range about 26% higher halves the life, so fatigue assessment hinges on accurate stress ranges and cycle counts. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cover-plate end weld toe” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：N = A/(ΔF)³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: N = A/(ΔF)³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要最大應力低於降伏強度，鋼橋就不會發生疲勞裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as peak stress stays below yield, a steel bridge cannot develop fatigue cracks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「蓋板端部焊趾」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cover-plate end weld toe”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 應力範圍與疲勞細節類別
knowledge.titleEn: Stress range and fatigue detail categories
knowledge.text: 鋼橋的疲勞裂縫幾乎都從焊接細節開始：焊趾的幾何不連續、殘餘拉應力與微小熔渣缺陷使局部應力集中，車輛每次通過造成的應力範圍（而不是最大應力）驅動裂縫逐步成長。AASHTO 把細節依疲勞強度分成 A 到 E′ 等類別，蓋板端部的橫向填角焊屬最差的 E 或 E′ 類，康乃狄克州 I-95 Yellow Mill Pond 橋的蓋板端部裂縫就是 FHWA 修復手冊中的典型照片。
knowledge.textEn: Fatigue cracks in steel bridges almost always start at welded details: the geometric discontinuity at the weld toe, tensile residual stress and tiny slag defects concentrate stress locally, and the stress range from each passing vehicle, not the peak stress, drives the crack forward. AASHTO groups details by fatigue strength into categories A to E′; transverse fillet welds at cover-plate ends are among the worst, Category E or E′, and the cracked cover-plate end on the I-95 Yellow Mill Pond Bridge in Connecticut is a classic illustration in the FHWA repair manual.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要最大應力低於降伏強度，鋼橋就不會發生疲勞裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as peak stress stays below yield, a steel bridge cannot develop fatigue cracks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stress range and fatigue detail categories" is correct?
options: 只要最大應力低於降伏強度，鋼橋就不會發生疲勞裂縫。
鋼橋的疲勞裂縫幾乎都從焊接細節開始：焊趾的幾何不連續、殘餘拉應力與微小熔渣缺陷使局部應力集中，車輛每次通過造成的應力範圍（而不是最大應力）驅動裂縫逐步成長。
腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。
optionsEn: As long as peak stress stays below yield, a steel bridge cannot develop fatigue cracks.

Fatigue cracks in steel bridges almost always start at welded details: the geometric discontinuity at the weld toe, tensile residual stress and tiny slag defects concentrate stress locally, and the stress range from each passing vehicle, not the peak stress, drives the crack forward.
Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks.
quiz.explanation: 鋼橋的疲勞裂縫幾乎都從焊接細節開始：焊趾的幾何不連續、殘餘拉應力與微小熔渣缺陷使局部應力集中，車輛每次通過造成的應力範圍（而不是最大應力）驅動裂縫逐步成長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fatigue cracks in steel bridges almost always start at welded details: the geometric discontinuity at the weld toe, tensile residual stress and tiny slag defects concentrate stress locally, and the stress range from each passing vehicle, not the peak stress, drives the crack forward. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應力範圍與疲勞細節類別：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stress range and fatigue detail categories: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蓋板端部焊趾」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cover-plate end weld toe” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N = A/(ΔF)³。E 類 A = 11.0×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 3.61×10¹¹ MPa³；有效應力範圍 ΔF = 40 MPa 時 N = 3.61×10¹¹/40³ ≈ 5.6×10⁶ 次，若每天 2,000 輛卡車各造成一次循環，約 7.7 年；同樣應力下 C 類（A ≈ 1.44×10¹² MPa³）約 2.25×10⁷ 次、約 31 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: N = A/(ΔF)³. For Category E, A = 11.0×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 3.61×10¹¹ MPa³; at an effective stress range ΔF = 40 MPa, N = 3.61×10¹¹/40³ ≈ 5.6×10⁶ cycles, or about 7.7 years if 2,000 trucks a day each cause one cycle. At the same stress a Category C detail (A ≈ 1.44×10¹² MPa³) lasts about 2.25×10⁷ cycles, about 31 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以竣工圖與現場檢查列出每一個疲勞敏感細節並標註 AASHTO 類別，用影響線與實測交通量計算有效應力範圍與累積循環次數；再與細節的常幅疲勞門檻（例如 E 類 4.5 ksi，約 31 MPa）比較，判斷屬有限壽命或無限壽命區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List every fatigue-sensitive detail from as-built drawings and field inspection and tag its AASHTO category, compute effective stress range and accumulated cycles from influence lines and measured traffic, then compare with the detail's constant-amplitude threshold (for example 4.5 ksi, about 31 MPa, for Category E) to decide whether it lies in the finite-life or infinite-life region.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: N = A/(ΔF)³。E 類 A = 11.0×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 3.61×10¹¹ MPa³；有效應力範圍 ΔF = 40 MPa 時 N = 3.61×10¹¹/40³ ≈ 5.6×10⁶ 次，若每天 2,000 輛卡車各造成一次循環，約 7.7 年；同樣應力下 C 類（A ≈ 1.44×10¹² MPa³）約 2.25×10⁷ 次、約 31 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: N = A/(ΔF)³. For Category E, A = 11.0×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 3.61×10¹¹ MPa³; at an effective stress range ΔF = 40 MPa, N = 3.61×10¹¹/40³ ≈ 5.6×10⁶ cycles, or about 7.7 years if 2,000 trucks a day each cause one cycle. At the same stress a Category C detail (A ≈ 1.44×10¹² MPa³) lasts about 2.25×10⁷ cycles, about 31 years. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stress range and fatigue detail categories", which statement holds?
options: 裂縫每年增加的長度是固定的，可以直接線性外推。
只要把裂縫焊補起來，構件就恢復原來的疲勞強度。
N = A/(ΔF)³。
optionsEn: A crack grows by the same length every year, so it can be extrapolated linearly.
Simply weld-repairing a crack restores the member's original fatigue strength.
N = A/(ΔF)³.
quiz.explanation: N = A/(ΔF)³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: N = A/(ΔF)³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 應力範圍與疲勞細節類別：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stress range and fatigue detail categories: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「蓋板端部焊趾」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cover-plate end weld toe” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以竣工圖與現場檢查列出每一個疲勞敏感細節並標註 AASHTO 類別，用影響線與實測交通量計算有效應力範圍與累積循環次數；再與細節的常幅疲勞門檻（例如 E 類 4.5 ksi，約 31 MPa）比較，判斷屬有限壽命或無限壽命區。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List every fatigue-sensitive detail from as-built drawings and field inspection and tag its AASHTO category, compute effective stress range and accumulated cycles from influence lines and measured traffic, then compare with the detail's constant-amplitude threshold (for example 4.5 ksi, about 31 MPa, for Category E) to decide whether it lies in the finite-life or infinite-life region. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：新建設計避免使用 E 與 E′ 類細節；既有橋的疲勞清冊要依細節類別與應力範圍排序檢查優先順序，並把每一個 E′ 類細節的位置標在檢查圖上，作為每次例行檢查必看的點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Avoid Category E and E′ details in new design; for existing bridges, rank the fatigue inventory by detail category and stress range to set inspection priority, and mark every Category E′ detail on the inspection drawings as a must-see point at each routine inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：蓋板端部的焊趾裂縫先在翼板內穿透厚度，再沿翼板寬度擴展；若未及時發現，裂縫可貫穿整個受拉翼板並進入腹板，FHWA 手冊收錄的明尼蘇達州聖保羅 Lafayette Street 橋就出現貫穿整個梁深的疲勞裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A weld-toe crack at a cover-plate end first grows through the flange thickness and then across its width; if missed, it can sever the whole tension flange and run into the web, as in the full-girder-depth fatigue crack of the Lafayette Street Bridge in St. Paul, Minnesota, shown in the FHWA manual. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以竣工圖與現場檢查列出每一個疲勞敏感細節並標註 AASHTO 類別，用影響線與實測交通量計算有效應力範圍與累積循環次數；再與細節的常幅疲勞門檻（例如 E 類 4.5 ksi，約 31 MPa）比較，判斷屬有限壽命或無限壽命區。
knowledge.textEn: List every fatigue-sensitive detail from as-built drawings and field inspection and tag its AASHTO category, compute effective stress range and accumulated cycles from influence lines and measured traffic, then compare with the detail's constant-amplitude threshold (for example 4.5 ksi, about 31 MPa, for Category E) to decide whether it lies in the finite-life or infinite-life region.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 新建設計避免使用 E 與 E′ 類細節；既有橋的疲勞清冊要依細節類別與應力範圍排序檢查優先順序，並把每一個 E′ 類細節的位置標在檢查圖上，作為每次例行檢查必看的點。
knowledge.textEn: Avoid Category E and E′ details in new design; for existing bridges, rank the fatigue inventory by detail category and stress range to set inspection priority, and mark every Category E′ detail on the inspection drawings as a must-see point at each routine inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stress range and fatigue detail categories"?
options: 以竣工圖與現場檢查列出每一個疲勞敏感細節並標註 AASHTO 類別，用影響線與實測交通量計算有效應力範圍與累積循環次數。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
疲勞評估只要用規範的疲勞卡車計算，不需要現場量測。
optionsEn: List every fatigue-sensitive detail from as-built drawings and field inspection and tag its AASHTO category, compute effective stress range and accumulated cycles from influence lines and measured traffic, then compare with the detail's constant-amplitude threshold (for example 4.5 ksi, about 31 MPa, for Category E) to decide whether it lies in the finite-life or infinite-life region.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement.
quiz.explanation: 以竣工圖與現場檢查列出每一個疲勞敏感細節並標註 AASHTO 類別，用影響線與實測交通量計算有效應力範圍與累積循環次數；再與細節的常幅疲勞門檻（例如 E 類 4.5 ksi，約 31 MPa）比較，判斷屬有限壽命或無限壽命區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List every fatigue-sensitive detail from as-built drawings and field inspection and tag its AASHTO category, compute effective stress range and accumulated cycles from influence lines and measured traffic, then compare with the detail's constant-amplitude threshold (for example 4.5 ksi, about 31 MPa, for Category E) to decide whether it lies in the finite-life or infinite-life region. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 應力範圍與疲勞細節類別：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stress range and fatigue detail categories: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蓋板端部焊趾」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cover-plate end weld toe” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 蓋板端部的焊趾裂縫先在翼板內穿透厚度，再沿翼板寬度擴展；若未及時發現，裂縫可貫穿整個受拉翼板並進入腹板，FHWA 手冊收錄的明尼蘇達州聖保羅 Lafayette Street 橋就出現貫穿整個梁深的疲勞裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

quiz.question: 在「應力範圍與疲勞細節類別」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stress range and fatigue detail categories" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
蓋板端部的焊趾裂縫先在翼板內穿透厚度，再沿翼板寬度擴展。

A weld-toe crack at a cover-plate end first grows through the flange thickness and then across its width.
