Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「連接板腹板間隙」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Connection-plate web gap” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 主梁間的橫隔或橫構架在活載下使相鄰主梁產生不同撓度，若橫構架連接板沒有與受拉翼板相連，連接板端部與翼板之間的一小段腹板（腹板間隙）就被迫承受面外變形。這段腹板很短，極小的相對位移就產生很大的二次彎曲應力，形成平行於焊道的裂縫。FHWA 手冊估計變形誘發的開裂佔全部疲勞裂縫的 90% 以上，1985 年以前的設計普遍有此細節，例如明尼蘇達州約 85% 的鋼橋建於 1986 年以前。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「連接板腹板間隙」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under live load, diaphragms or cross-frames between girders force adjacent girders to deflect differently; if the cross-frame connection plate is not attached to the tension flange, the short strip of web between the plate end and the flange, the web gap, must absorb out-of-plane distortion. Because the strip is so short, a tiny relative displacement produces large secondary bending stress and cracks parallel to the weld. The FHWA manual estimates that distortion-induced cracking causes over 90% of all fatigue cracking, and the detail was common in designs before 1985; in Minnesota, for example, about 85% of steel bridges were built before 1986. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Connection-plate web gap” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩端固定的腹板間隙在面外相對位移 Δ 下，彎曲應力 σ = 3E·t·Δ/g²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a web gap fixed at both ends under relative out-of-plane displacement Δ, the bending stress is σ = 3E·t·Δ/g².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「連接板腹板間隙」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Connection-plate web gap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙
knowledge.text: 主梁間的橫隔或橫構架在活載下使相鄰主梁產生不同撓度，若橫構架連接板沒有與受拉翼板相連，連接板端部與翼板之間的一小段腹板（腹板間隙）就被迫承受面外變形。這段腹板很短，極小的相對位移就產生很大的二次彎曲應力，形成平行於焊道的裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Under live load, diaphragms or cross-frames between girders force adjacent girders to deflect differently; if the cross-frame connection plate is not attached to the tension flange, the short strip of web between the plate end and the flange, the web gap, must absorb out-of-plane distortion. Because the strip is so short, a tiny relative displacement produces large secondary bending stress and cracks parallel to the weld.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps" is correct?
options: 腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。
鋼材是延性材料，所以鋼橋只會先變形再破壞，不會突然斷裂。
主梁間的橫隔或橫構架在活載下使相鄰主梁產生不同撓度，若橫構架連接板沒有與受拉翼板相連，連接板端部與翼板之間的一小段腹板（腹板間隙）就被迫承受面外變形。
optionsEn: Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks.
Steel is ductile, so a steel bridge always deforms visibly before it fails and never fractures suddenly.
Under live load, diaphragms or cross-frames between girders force adjacent girders to deflect differently.
quiz.explanation: 主梁間的橫隔或橫構架在活載下使相鄰主梁產生不同撓度，若橫構架連接板沒有與受拉翼板相連，連接板端部與翼板之間的一小段腹板（腹板間隙）就被迫承受面外變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Under live load, diaphragms or cross-frames between girders force adjacent girders to deflect differently; if the cross-frame connection plate is not attached to the tension flange, the short strip of web between the plate end and the flange, the web gap, must absorb out-of-plane distortion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「連接板腹板間隙」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Connection-plate web gap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩端固定的腹板間隙在面外相對位移 Δ 下，彎曲應力 σ = 3E·t·Δ/g²。取 E = 200 GPa、腹板厚 t = 12 mm、Δ = 0.05 mm、間隙 g = 50 mm：σ = 3×200,000×12×0.05/50² = 144 MPa；若切除材料把間隙放大到 100 mm，σ 降為 36 MPa，只剩四分之一。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a web gap fixed at both ends under relative out-of-plane displacement Δ, the bending stress is σ = 3E·t·Δ/g². With E = 200 GPa, web thickness t = 12 mm, Δ = 0.05 mm and gap g = 50 mm, σ = 3×200,000×12×0.05/50² = 144 MPa; enlarging the gap to 100 mm by removing material drops σ to 36 MPa, one quarter. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在連接板端部上下方的腹板兩面貼應變計，量測卡車通過時的面外彎曲應變，與有限元素模型的熱點應力比較；FHWA 手冊以距焊趾約 1/4 in（6 mm）處的熱點應力對照 C 類曲線評估腹板間隙。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit strain gauges on both faces of the web above and below the connection-plate end, measure out-of-plane bending strain as trucks pass and compare with hot-spot stresses from a finite-element model; the FHWA manual assesses web gaps using the hot-spot stress about 1/4 in (6 mm) from the weld toe against the Category C curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩端固定的腹板間隙在面外相對位移 Δ 下，彎曲應力 σ = 3E·t·Δ/g²。取 E = 200 GPa、腹板厚 t = 12 mm、Δ = 0.05 mm、間隙 g = 50 mm：σ = 3×200,000×12×0.05/50² = 144 MPa；若切除材料把間隙放大到 100 mm，σ 降為 36 MPa，只剩四分之一。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a web gap fixed at both ends under relative out-of-plane displacement Δ, the bending stress is σ = 3E·t·Δ/g². With E = 200 GPa, web thickness t = 12 mm, Δ = 0.05 mm and gap g = 50 mm, σ = 3×200,000×12×0.05/50² = 144 MPa; enlarging the gap to 100 mm by removing material drops σ to 36 MPa, one quarter. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps", which statement holds?
options: 兩端固定的腹板間隙在面外相對位移 Δ 下，彎曲應力 σ = 3E·t·Δ/g²。
止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。
目視檢查沒有看到裂縫，就表示焊接細節沒有裂縫。
optionsEn: For a web gap fixed at both ends under relative out-of-plane displacement Δ, the bending stress is σ = 3E·t·Δ/g².
Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section.
If visual inspection shows no crack, the welded detail has no crack.
quiz.explanation: 兩端固定的腹板間隙在面外相對位移 Δ 下，彎曲應力 σ = 3E·t·Δ/g²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a web gap fixed at both ends under relative out-of-plane displacement Δ, the bending stress is σ = 3E·t·Δ/g². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連接板腹板間隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Connection-plate web gap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在連接板端部上下方的腹板兩面貼應變計，量測卡車通過時的面外彎曲應變，與有限元素模型的熱點應力比較；FHWA 手冊以距焊趾約 1/4 in（6 mm）處的熱點應力對照 C 類曲線評估腹板間隙。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit strain gauges on both faces of the web above and below the connection-plate end, measure out-of-plane bending strain as trucks pass and compare with hot-spot stresses from a finite-element model; the FHWA manual assesses web gaps using the hot-spot stress about 1/4 in (6 mm) from the weld toe against the Category C curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：修復腹板間隙要先決定策略：加勁（以螺栓角鋼或 T 型鋼把連接板接到翼板）或軟化（放大間隙、移除或移位橫構架），不可兩者混用；任何修復都要先量測再設計，修復後再量一次確認應力確實下降。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Choose the web-gap strategy first: stiffening (bolting the connection plate to the flange with angles or a tee) or softening (enlarging the gap, removing or repositioning the cross-frame), never a mix; measure before designing any repair and measure again afterwards to confirm the stress has actually dropped.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用主梁彎矩檢核疲勞時，腹板間隙的二次應力完全不會出現在計算中，裂縫卻在通車數年後沿連接板焊道成長；若裂縫轉向並沿腹板延伸，就由局部問題變成主梁斷面的問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fatigue check based only on girder moments never shows the secondary stress in the web gap, yet cracks grow along the connection-plate weld within a few years of opening; if a crack turns and runs into the web, a local problem becomes a problem for the whole girder section. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在連接板端部上下方的腹板兩面貼應變計，量測卡車通過時的面外彎曲應變，與有限元素模型的熱點應力比較；FHWA 手冊以距焊趾約 1/4 in（6 mm）處的熱點應力對照 C 類曲線評估腹板間隙。
knowledge.textEn: Fit strain gauges on both faces of the web above and below the connection-plate end, measure out-of-plane bending strain as trucks pass and compare with hot-spot stresses from a finite-element model; the FHWA manual assesses web gaps using the hot-spot stress about 1/4 in (6 mm) from the weld toe against the Category C curve.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 修復腹板間隙要先決定策略：加勁（以螺栓角鋼或 T 型鋼把連接板接到翼板）或軟化（放大間隙、移除或移位橫構架），不可兩者混用；任何修復都要先量測再設計，修復後再量一次確認應力確實下降。
knowledge.textEn: Choose the web-gap strategy first: stiffening (bolting the connection plate to the flange with angles or a tee) or softening (enlarging the gap, removing or repositioning the cross-frame), never a mix; measure before designing any repair and measure again afterwards to confirm the stress has actually dropped.

quiz.question: 要驗證「變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在連接板端部上下方的腹板兩面貼應變計，量測卡車通過時的面外彎曲應變，與有限元素模型的熱點應力比較。
裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Fit strain gauges on both faces of the web above and below the connection-plate end, measure out-of-plane bending strain as trucks pass and compare with hot-spot stresses from a finite-element model.
Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up.
quiz.explanation: 在連接板端部上下方的腹板兩面貼應變計，量測卡車通過時的面外彎曲應變，與有限元素模型的熱點應力比較；FHWA 手冊以距焊趾約 1/4 in（6 mm）處的熱點應力對照 C 類曲線評估腹板間隙。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fit strain gauges on both faces of the web above and below the connection-plate end, measure out-of-plane bending strain as trucks pass and compare with hot-spot stresses from a finite-element model; the FHWA manual assesses web gaps using the hot-spot stress about 1/4 in (6 mm) from the weld toe against the Category C curve. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「連接板腹板間隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Connection-plate web gap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用主梁彎矩檢核疲勞時，腹板間隙的二次應力完全不會出現在計算中，裂縫卻在通車數年後沿連接板焊道成長；若裂縫轉向並沿腹板延伸，就由局部問題變成主梁斷面的問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fatigue check based only on girder moments never shows the secondary stress in the web gap, yet cracks grow along the connection-plate weld within a few years of opening; if a crack turns and runs into the web, a local problem becomes a problem for the whole girder section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：FHWA 手冊估計變形誘發的開裂佔全部疲勞裂縫的 90% 以上，1985 年以前的設計普遍有此細節，例如明尼蘇達州約 85% 的鋼橋建於 1986 年以前。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The FHWA manual estimates that distortion-induced cracking causes over 90% of all fatigue cracking, and the detail was common in designs before 1985; in Minnesota, for example, about 85% of steel bridges were built before 1986.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用主梁彎矩檢核疲勞時，腹板間隙的二次應力完全不會出現在計算中，裂縫卻在通車數年後沿連接板焊道成長；若裂縫轉向並沿腹板延伸，就由局部問題變成主梁斷面的問題。
knowledge.textEn: A fatigue check based only on girder moments never shows the secondary stress in the web gap, yet cracks grow along the connection-plate weld within a few years of opening; if a crack turns and runs into the web, a local problem becomes a problem for the whole girder section.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「變形誘發疲勞與腹板間隙」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Distortion-induced fatigue in web gaps" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼材是延性材料，所以鋼橋只會先變形再破壞，不會突然斷裂。
只用主梁彎矩檢核疲勞時，腹板間隙的二次應力完全不會出現在計算中，裂縫卻在通車數年後沿連接板焊道成長；若裂縫轉向並沿腹板延伸，就由局部問題變成主梁斷面的問題。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Steel is ductile, so a steel bridge always deforms visibly before it fails and never fractures suddenly.
A fatigue check based only on girder moments never shows the secondary stress in the web gap, yet cracks grow along the connection-plate weld within a few years of opening.
quiz.explanation: 只用主梁彎矩檢核疲勞時，腹板間隙的二次應力完全不會出現在計算中，裂縫卻在通車數年後沿連接板焊道成長；若裂縫轉向並沿腹板延伸，就由局部問題變成主梁斷面的問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A fatigue check based only on girder moments never shows the secondary stress in the web gap, yet cracks grow along the connection-plate weld within a few years of opening; if a crack turns and runs into the web, a local problem becomes a problem for the whole girder section. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂」與「裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fracture toughness and brittle fracture" and "Crack-growth rate and remaining life": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fracture toughness and brittle fracture: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「臨界裂縫與 Charpy 韌性」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Critical crack and Charpy toughness” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 疲勞裂縫本身不會讓橋倒塌，真正的危險是裂縫長到臨界尺寸後在低溫下脆性斷裂。臨界尺寸由材料韌性、應力大小與幾何拘束決定；1967 年 Silver Bridge 因無冗餘眼桿脆斷而倒塌，促成 1970 年代的斷裂控制計畫與 Charpy V 型缺口韌性要求。2000 年 12 月密爾瓦基 Hoan 橋三根主梁中有兩根斷裂，FHWA 手冊指出這是在沒有先前疲勞裂縫下發生的脆性斷裂；焊接板件交會形成的高拘束使鋼材無法藉降伏釋放應力，冬季低溫又降低了韌性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「臨界裂縫與 Charpy 韌性」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fatigue crack alone does not drop a bridge; the real danger is that once it reaches critical size it can fracture in a brittle way at low temperature. Critical size depends on toughness, stress level and geometric constraint. The 1967 collapse of the Silver Bridge through brittle fracture of a non-redundant eyebar led to the fracture control plan and Charpy V-notch toughness requirements of the 1970s. In December 2000 two of the three girders of Milwaukee's Hoan Bridge fractured; the FHWA manual describes it as brittle fracture without prior fatigue cracking, where highly constrained intersecting welded plates prevented the steel from relieving stress by yielding and winter cold reduced its toughness. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Critical crack and Charpy toughness” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：臨界裂縫 a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Critical crack size a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼材是延性材料，所以鋼橋只會先變形再破壞，不會突然斷裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel is ductile, so a steel bridge always deforms visibly before it fails and never fractures suddenly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「臨界裂縫與 Charpy 韌性」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Critical crack and Charpy toughness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂
knowledge.text: 疲勞裂縫本身不會讓橋倒塌，真正的危險是裂縫長到臨界尺寸後在低溫下脆性斷裂。臨界尺寸由材料韌性、應力大小與幾何拘束決定；1967 年 Silver Bridge 因無冗餘眼桿脆斷而倒塌，促成 1970 年代的斷裂控制計畫與 Charpy V 型缺口韌性要求。
knowledge.textEn: A fatigue crack alone does not drop a bridge; the real danger is that once it reaches critical size it can fracture in a brittle way at low temperature. Critical size depends on toughness, stress level and geometric constraint.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼材是延性材料，所以鋼橋只會先變形再破壞，不會突然斷裂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel is ductile, so a steel bridge always deforms visibly before it fails and never fractures suddenly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fracture toughness and brittle fracture" is correct?
options: 疲勞裂縫本身不會讓橋倒塌，真正的危險是裂縫長到臨界尺寸後在低溫下脆性斷裂。
鋼材是延性材料，所以鋼橋只會先變形再破壞，不會突然斷裂。
裂縫每年增加的長度是固定的，可以直接線性外推。
optionsEn: A fatigue crack alone does not drop a bridge; the real danger is that once it reaches critical size it can fracture in a brittle way at low temperature.
Steel is ductile, so a steel bridge always deforms visibly before it fails and never fractures suddenly.
A crack grows by the same length every year, so it can be extrapolated linearly.
quiz.explanation: 疲勞裂縫本身不會讓橋倒塌，真正的危險是裂縫長到臨界尺寸後在低溫下脆性斷裂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A fatigue crack alone does not drop a bridge; the real danger is that once it reaches critical size it can fracture in a brittle way at low temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fracture toughness and brittle fracture: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臨界裂縫與 Charpy 韌性」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Critical crack and Charpy toughness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臨界裂縫 a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]²。取 K_Ic = 100 MPa√m、邊緣裂縫 Y = 1.12、σ_max = 150 MPa：a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm；低溫使 K_Ic 降為 50 MPa√m 時 a_c 只剩約 28 mm，為原來的四分之一。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Critical crack size a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]². With K_Ic = 100 MPa√m, an edge-crack factor Y = 1.12 and σ_max = 150 MPa, a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm; if low temperature drops K_Ic to 50 MPa√m, a_c shrinks to about 28 mm, one quarter of the original. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從構件取樣或查閱鋼材證明書，在對應設計最低溫度的試驗溫度做 Charpy V 型缺口衝擊試驗，與 AASHTO 依溫度區及斷裂關鍵構件分級的要求比較；同時檢查焊接板件交會、零間隙相交等高拘束細節。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take samples from the member or review the mill certificates, run Charpy V-notch impact tests at the test temperature corresponding to the lowest design temperature and compare with AASHTO requirements by temperature zone and fracture-critical classification; also check for highly constrained details such as intersecting welded plates with zero gap.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 臨界裂縫 a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]²。取 K_Ic = 100 MPa√m、邊緣裂縫 Y = 1.12、σ_max = 150 MPa：a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm；低溫使 K_Ic 降為 50 MPa√m 時 a_c 只剩約 28 mm，為原來的四分之一。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Critical crack size a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]². With K_Ic = 100 MPa√m, an edge-crack factor Y = 1.12 and σ_max = 150 MPa, a_c = (1/π)×(100/168)² ≈ 0.113 m = 113 mm; if low temperature drops K_Ic to 50 MPa√m, a_c shrinks to about 28 mm, one quarter of the original. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fracture toughness and brittle fracture", which statement holds?
options: 只要把裂縫焊補起來，構件就恢復原來的疲勞強度。
臨界裂縫 a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]²。
疲勞評估只要用規範的疲勞卡車計算，不需要現場量測。
optionsEn: Simply weld-repairing a crack restores the member's original fatigue strength.
Critical crack size a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]².
Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement.
quiz.explanation: 臨界裂縫 a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Critical crack size a_c = (1/π)·[K_Ic/(Y·σ_max)]². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fracture toughness and brittle fracture: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「臨界裂縫與 Charpy 韌性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Critical crack and Charpy toughness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從構件取樣或查閱鋼材證明書，在對應設計最低溫度的試驗溫度做 Charpy V 型缺口衝擊試驗，與 AASHTO 依溫度區及斷裂關鍵構件分級的要求比較；同時檢查焊接板件交會、零間隙相交等高拘束細節。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take samples from the member or review the mill certificates, run Charpy V-notch impact tests at the test temperature corresponding to the lowest design temperature and compare with AASHTO requirements by temperature zone and fracture-critical classification; also check for highly constrained details such as intersecting welded plates with zero gap. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：斷裂關鍵構件的修復焊接必須依 AASHTO/AWS D1.5 的斷裂控制計畫執行，包括銲材、預熱、韌性試驗與更嚴格的非破壞檢測；設計審查要特別找出零間隙相交的板件，改為留設間隙或螺栓連接。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Repair welding on fracture-critical members must follow the fracture control plan of AASHTO/AWS D1.5, covering consumables, preheat, toughness testing and stricter nondestructive testing; design review should hunt for plates intersecting with zero gap and change them to gapped or bolted connections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：Hoan 橋斷裂後北行車道下陷約 4 ft（約 1.2 m），雖無人受傷，但大橋封閉，受損段以控制爆破移除，修復與補強歷時近一年；高拘束細節即使沒有疲勞裂縫，也可能在寒冬中瞬間斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: After the Hoan fracture the northbound lanes sagged about 4 ft (about 1.2 m); nobody was hurt, but the bridge closed, the damaged section was removed by controlled demolition and repair and retrofit took nearly a year. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從構件取樣或查閱鋼材證明書，在對應設計最低溫度的試驗溫度做 Charpy V 型缺口衝擊試驗，與 AASHTO 依溫度區及斷裂關鍵構件分級的要求比較；同時檢查焊接板件交會、零間隙相交等高拘束細節。
knowledge.textEn: Take samples from the member or review the mill certificates, run Charpy V-notch impact tests at the test temperature corresponding to the lowest design temperature and compare with AASHTO requirements by temperature zone and fracture-critical classification; also check for highly constrained details such as intersecting welded plates with zero gap.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 斷裂關鍵構件的修復焊接必須依 AASHTO/AWS D1.5 的斷裂控制計畫執行，包括銲材、預熱、韌性試驗與更嚴格的非破壞檢測；設計審查要特別找出零間隙相交的板件，改為留設間隙或螺栓連接。
knowledge.textEn: Repair welding on fracture-critical members must follow the fracture control plan of AASHTO/AWS D1.5, covering consumables, preheat, toughness testing and stricter nondestructive testing; design review should hunt for plates intersecting with zero gap and change them to gapped or bolted connections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fracture toughness and brittle fracture"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
空拍影像已經可以取代斷裂關鍵構件的近距離檢查。
從構件取樣或查閱鋼材證明書，在對應設計最低溫度的試驗溫度做 Charpy V 型缺口衝擊試驗，與 AASHTO 依溫度區及斷裂關鍵構件分級的要求比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Drone imagery can now replace hands-on inspection of fracture-critical members.

Take samples from the member or review the mill certificates, run Charpy V-notch impact tests at the test temperature corresponding to the lowest design temperature and compare with AASHTO requirements by temperature zone and fracture-critical classification.
quiz.explanation: 從構件取樣或查閱鋼材證明書，在對應設計最低溫度的試驗溫度做 Charpy V 型缺口衝擊試驗，與 AASHTO 依溫度區及斷裂關鍵構件分級的要求比較；同時檢查焊接板件交會、零間隙相交等高拘束細節。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take samples from the member or review the mill certificates, run Charpy V-notch impact tests at the test temperature corresponding to the lowest design temperature and compare with AASHTO requirements by temperature zone and fracture-critical classification; also check for highly constrained details such as intersecting welded plates with zero gap. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fracture toughness and brittle fracture: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臨界裂縫與 Charpy 韌性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Critical crack and Charpy toughness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: Hoan 橋斷裂後北行車道下陷約 4 ft（約 1.2 m），雖無人受傷，但大橋封閉，受損段以控制爆破移除，修復與補強歷時近一年；高拘束細節即使沒有疲勞裂縫，也可能在寒冬中瞬間斷裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: After the Hoan fracture the northbound lanes sagged about 4 ft (about 1.2 m); nobody was hurt, but the bridge closed, the damaged section was removed by controlled demolition and repair and retrofit took nearly a year. Highly constrained details can fracture suddenly in deep winter even without fatigue cracks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：2000 年 12 月密爾瓦基 Hoan 橋三根主梁中有兩根斷裂，FHWA 手冊指出這是在沒有先前疲勞裂縫下發生的脆性斷裂；焊接板件交會形成的高拘束使鋼材無法藉降伏釋放應力，冬季低溫又降低了韌性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In December 2000 two of the three girders of Milwaukee's Hoan Bridge fractured; the FHWA manual describes it as brittle fracture without prior fatigue cracking, where highly constrained intersecting welded plates prevented the steel from relieving stress by yielding and winter cold reduced its toughness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼材是延性材料，所以鋼橋只會先變形再破壞，不會突然斷裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel is ductile, so a steel bridge always deforms visibly before it fails and never fractures suddenly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: After the Hoan fracture the northbound lanes sagged about 4 ft (about 1.2 m); nobody was hurt, but the bridge closed, the damaged section was removed by controlled demolition and repair and retrofit took nearly a year. Highly constrained details can fracture suddenly in deep winter even without fatigue cracks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斷裂韌性與脆性斷裂」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fracture toughness and brittle fracture" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: Hoan 橋斷裂後北行車道下陷約 4 ft（約 1.2 m），雖無人受傷，但大橋封閉，受損段以控制爆破移除，修復與補強歷時近一年。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
裂縫每年增加的長度是固定的，可以直接線性外推。
optionsEn: After the Hoan fracture the northbound lanes sagged about 4 ft (about 1.2 m).
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A crack grows by the same length every year, so it can be extrapolated linearly.
quiz.explanation: Hoan 橋斷裂後北行車道下陷約 4 ft（約 1.2 m），雖無人受傷，但大橋封閉，受損段以控制爆破移除，修復與補強歷時近一年；高拘束細節即使沒有疲勞裂縫，也可能在寒冬中瞬間斷裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: After the Hoan fracture the northbound lanes sagged about 4 ft (about 1.2 m); nobody was hurt, but the bridge closed, the damaged section was removed by controlled demolition and repair and retrofit took nearly a year. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Crack-growth rate and remaining life: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「裂縫成長曲線」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crack-growth curve” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 裂縫一旦存在，S–N 曲線就不再適用，需改用線彈性斷裂力學：每次循環的成長量 da/dN 與應力強度因子範圍 ΔK 的冪次成正比（Paris 定律），而 ΔK 又隨裂縫長度增加，所以裂縫越長長得越快，壽命大部分消耗在裂縫很短的階段。剩餘壽命取決於目前尺寸、臨界尺寸與應力範圍，這也說明及早找到短裂縫的價值遠大於事後補強。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「裂縫成長曲線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once a crack exists the S–N curve no longer applies and linear-elastic fracture mechanics takes over: growth per cycle, da/dN, is proportional to a power of the stress-intensity range ΔK (the Paris law), and ΔK itself rises with crack length, so longer cracks grow faster and most of the life is spent while the crack is still short. Remaining life depends on current size, critical size and stress range, which is why finding short cracks early is worth far more than strengthening afterwards. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Crack-growth curve” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Paris 定律 da/dN = C·ΔK^m，取鐵素體—波來鐵鋼常用 C = 6.9×10⁻¹²（m/cycle，MPa√m）、m = 3，邊緣裂縫 ΔK = 1.12Δσ√(πa)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Paris law da/dN = C·ΔK^m, with C = 6.9×10⁻¹² (m/cycle, MPa√m) and m = 3, commonly used for ferrite–pearlite steels, and ΔK = 1.12Δσ√(πa) for an edge crack.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裂縫每年增加的長度是固定的，可以直接線性外推。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A crack grows by the same length every year, so it can be extrapolated linearly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「裂縫成長曲線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Crack-growth curve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命
knowledge.text: 裂縫一旦存在，S–N 曲線就不再適用，需改用線彈性斷裂力學：每次循環的成長量 da/dN 與應力強度因子範圍 ΔK 的冪次成正比（Paris 定律），而 ΔK 又隨裂縫長度增加，所以裂縫越長長得越快，壽命大部分消耗在裂縫很短的階段。剩餘壽命取決於目前尺寸、臨界尺寸與應力範圍，這也說明及早找到短裂縫的價值遠大於事後補強。
knowledge.textEn: Once a crack exists the S–N curve no longer applies and linear-elastic fracture mechanics takes over: growth per cycle, da/dN, is proportional to a power of the stress-intensity range ΔK (the Paris law), and ΔK itself rises with crack length, so longer cracks grow faster and most of the life is spent while the crack is still short. Remaining life depends on current size, critical size and stress range, which is why finding short cracks early is worth far more than strengthening afterwards.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裂縫每年增加的長度是固定的，可以直接線性外推。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A crack grows by the same length every year, so it can be extrapolated linearly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crack-growth rate and remaining life" is correct?
options: 裂縫每年增加的長度是固定的，可以直接線性外推。
裂縫一旦存在，S–N 曲線就不再適用，需改用線彈性斷裂力學：每次循環的成長量 da/dN 與應力強度因子範圍 ΔK 的冪次成正比（Paris 定律），而 ΔK 又隨裂縫長度增加，所以裂縫越長長得越快，壽命大部分消耗在裂縫很短的階段。
止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。
optionsEn: A crack grows by the same length every year, so it can be extrapolated linearly.

Once a crack exists the S–N curve no longer applies and linear-elastic fracture mechanics takes over: growth per cycle, da/dN, is proportional to a power of the stress-intensity range ΔK (the Paris law), and ΔK itself rises with crack length, so longer cracks grow faster and most of the life is spent while the crack is still short.
Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section.
quiz.explanation: 裂縫一旦存在，S–N 曲線就不再適用，需改用線彈性斷裂力學：每次循環的成長量 da/dN 與應力強度因子範圍 ΔK 的冪次成正比（Paris 定律），而 ΔK 又隨裂縫長度增加，所以裂縫越長長得越快，壽命大部分消耗在裂縫很短的階段。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Once a crack exists the S–N curve no longer applies and linear-elastic fracture mechanics takes over: growth per cycle, da/dN, is proportional to a power of the stress-intensity range ΔK (the Paris law), and ΔK itself rises with crack length, so longer cracks grow faster and most of the life is spent while the crack is still short. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crack-growth rate and remaining life: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂縫成長曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crack-growth curve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Paris 定律 da/dN = C·ΔK^m，取鐵素體—波來鐵鋼常用 C = 6.9×10⁻¹²（m/cycle，MPa√m）、m = 3，邊緣裂縫 ΔK = 1.12Δσ√(πa)。Δσ = 40 MPa、a 由 5 mm 成長到 113 mm：N = 2(1/√a_i − 1/√a_c)/[C(1.12Δσ√π)³] ≈ 6.5×10⁶ 次，每天 2,000 次約 8.9 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Paris law da/dN = C·ΔK^m, with C = 6.9×10⁻¹² (m/cycle, MPa√m) and m = 3, commonly used for ferrite–pearlite steels, and ΔK = 1.12Δσ√(πa) for an edge crack. For Δσ = 40 MPa and growth from 5 mm to 113 mm, N = 2(1/√a_i − 1/√a_c)/[C(1.12Δσ√π)³] ≈ 6.5×10⁶ cycles, about 8.9 years at 2,000 cycles a day. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩次以上檢查量到的裂縫長度與時間間隔，比較實際成長率與模型預測；若實測成長較快，代表應力範圍或循環次數被低估，必須補量應變並縮短檢查間隔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use crack lengths measured at two or more inspections and the time between them to compare the actual growth rate with the model; faster measured growth means the stress range or cycle count was underestimated, so strains must be measured and the inspection interval shortened.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Paris 定律 da/dN = C·ΔK^m，取鐵素體—波來鐵鋼常用 C = 6.9×10⁻¹²（m/cycle，MPa√m）、m = 3，邊緣裂縫 ΔK = 1.12Δσ√(πa)。Δσ = 40 MPa、a 由 5 mm 成長到 113 mm：N = 2(1/√a_i − 1/√a_c)/[C(1.12Δσ√π)³] ≈ 6.5×10⁶ 次，每天 2,000 次約 8.9 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Paris law da/dN = C·ΔK^m, with C = 6.9×10⁻¹² (m/cycle, MPa√m) and m = 3, commonly used for ferrite–pearlite steels, and ΔK = 1.12Δσ√(πa) for an edge crack. For Δσ = 40 MPa and growth from 5 mm to 113 mm, N = 2(1/√a_i − 1/√a_c)/[C(1.12Δσ√π)³] ≈ 6.5×10⁶ cycles, about 8.9 years at 2,000 cycles a day. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Crack-growth rate and remaining life", which statement holds?
options: 目視檢查沒有看到裂縫，就表示焊接細節沒有裂縫。
裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。
Paris 定律 da/dN = C·ΔK^m，取鐵素體—波來鐵鋼常用 C = 6.9×10⁻¹²（m/cycle，MPa√m）、m = 3，邊緣裂縫 ΔK = 1.12Δσ√(πa)。
optionsEn: If visual inspection shows no crack, the welded detail has no crack.
Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up.
Paris law da/dN = C·ΔK^m, with C = 6.9×10⁻¹² (m/cycle, MPa√m) and m = 3, commonly used for ferrite–pearlite steels, and ΔK = 1.12Δσ√(πa) for an edge crack.
quiz.explanation: Paris 定律 da/dN = C·ΔK^m，取鐵素體—波來鐵鋼常用 C = 6.9×10⁻¹²（m/cycle，MPa√m）、m = 3，邊緣裂縫 ΔK = 1.12Δσ√(πa)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Paris law da/dN = C·ΔK^m, with C = 6.9×10⁻¹² (m/cycle, MPa√m) and m = 3, commonly used for ferrite–pearlite steels, and ΔK = 1.12Δσ√(πa) for an edge crack. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crack-growth rate and remaining life: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂縫成長曲線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crack-growth curve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以兩次以上檢查量到的裂縫長度與時間間隔，比較實際成長率與模型預測；若實測成長較快，代表應力範圍或循環次數被低估，必須補量應變並縮短檢查間隔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use crack lengths measured at two or more inspections and the time between them to compare the actual growth rate with the model; faster measured growth means the stress range or cycle count was underestimated, so strains must be measured and the inspection interval shortened. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每一條已知裂縫都要有編號、量測方法、量測日期與照片，報告中附上依斷裂力學估算的剩餘壽命與下次檢查日期；初始尺寸、應力範圍與韌性等假設必須寫明，讓下一位工程師可以更新計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Give every known crack a number, measurement method, date and photograph, and attach to the report a fracture-mechanics estimate of remaining life and the next inspection date; state the assumptions on initial size, stress range and toughness so the next engineer can update the calculation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若認為裂縫只有幾公釐、可以等下次定期檢查再處理，卻忽略交通量增加已使應力範圍上升，裂縫可能在兩次檢查之間由穩定成長轉為快速成長，等到發現時已接近臨界尺寸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

knowledge.textEn: Use crack lengths measured at two or more inspections and the time between them to compare the actual growth rate with the model; faster measured growth means the stress range or cycle count was underestimated, so strains must be measured and the inspection interval shortened.

steps.title: 裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crack-growth rate and remaining life: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crack-growth curve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若認為裂縫只有幾公釐、可以等下次定期檢查再處理，卻忽略交通量增加已使應力範圍上升，裂縫可能在兩次檢查之間由穩定成長轉為快速成長，等到發現時已接近臨界尺寸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deciding that a crack of a few millimetres can wait for the next routine inspection, while ignoring that heavier traffic has raised the stress range, lets the crack accelerate between inspections and approach critical size by the time it is found again. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：剩餘壽命取決於目前尺寸、臨界尺寸與應力範圍，這也說明及早找到短裂縫的價值遠大於事後補強。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Remaining life depends on current size, critical size and stress range, which is why finding short cracks early is worth far more than strengthening afterwards.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裂縫每年增加的長度是固定的，可以直接線性外推。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「裂縫成長速率與剩餘壽命」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crack-growth rate and remaining life" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「止裂孔的尺寸與施作」與「錘擊處理與螺栓拼接補強」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes" and "Peening and bolted splice repairs": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 止裂孔的尺寸與施作：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「裂尖止裂孔」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crack-tip arrest hole” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 止裂孔是在裂尖鑽一個圓孔，把尖銳裂尖換成有限半徑的缺口，使局部應力集中降到不足以重新起裂。FHWA 手冊稱鑽孔可能是最常用的疲勞裂縫修復法，要求最小孔徑 1.0 in（25.4 mm），邊緣裂縫的計算孔徑要加大 25%，現場經驗支持 2 至 4 in 的孔徑；孔要以環形鑽施作，嚴禁火焰切割，孔緣須磨平去毛邊。孔必須真正包含裂尖，否則裂縫會從孔外繼續成長。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「裂尖止裂孔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An arrest hole drilled at the crack tip replaces the sharp tip with a notch of finite radius, lowering the local stress concentration below what is needed to re-initiate cracking. The FHWA manual calls hole drilling perhaps the most widely used fatigue-crack repair, requires a minimum diameter of 1.0 in (25.4 mm), increases the calculated diameter by 25% for edge cracks, and notes that field experience supports holes of 2 to 4 in; holes are cut with annular cutters, never flame-cut, and their edges ground smooth. The hole must truly contain the crack tip, or the crack simply continues outside it. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Crack-tip arrest hole” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以 Creager–Paris 鈍化缺口關係，孔邊尖峰應力範圍 Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: By the Creager–Paris blunt-notch relation, the peak stress range at the hole edge is Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「裂尖止裂孔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Crack-tip arrest hole”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 止裂孔的尺寸與施作
knowledge.text: 止裂孔是在裂尖鑽一個圓孔，把尖銳裂尖換成有限半徑的缺口，使局部應力集中降到不足以重新起裂。FHWA 手冊稱鑽孔可能是最常用的疲勞裂縫修復法，要求最小孔徑 1.0 in（25.4 mm），邊緣裂縫的計算孔徑要加大 25%，現場經驗支持 2 至 4 in 的孔徑；孔要以環形鑽施作，嚴禁火焰切割，孔緣須磨平去毛邊。
knowledge.textEn: An arrest hole drilled at the crack tip replaces the sharp tip with a notch of finite radius, lowering the local stress concentration below what is needed to re-initiate cracking. The FHWA manual calls hole drilling perhaps the most widely used fatigue-crack repair, requires a minimum diameter of 1.0 in (25.4 mm), increases the calculated diameter by 25% for edge cracks, and notes that field experience supports holes of 2 to 4 in; holes are cut with annular cutters, never flame-cut, and their edges ground smooth.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「止裂孔的尺寸與施作」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes" is correct?
options: 止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。
只要把裂縫焊補起來，構件就恢復原來的疲勞強度。
止裂孔是在裂尖鑽一個圓孔，把尖銳裂尖換成有限半徑的缺口，使局部應力集中降到不足以重新起裂。
optionsEn: Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section.
Simply weld-repairing a crack restores the member's original fatigue strength.
An arrest hole drilled at the crack tip replaces the sharp tip with a notch of finite radius, lowering the local stress concentration below what is needed to re-initiate cracking.
quiz.explanation: 止裂孔是在裂尖鑽一個圓孔，把尖銳裂尖換成有限半徑的缺口，使局部應力集中降到不足以重新起裂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An arrest hole drilled at the crack tip replaces the sharp tip with a notch of finite radius, lowering the local stress concentration below what is needed to re-initiate cracking. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 止裂孔的尺寸與施作：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂尖止裂孔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crack-tip arrest hole” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以 Creager–Paris 鈍化缺口關係，孔邊尖峰應力範圍 Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ)。要求 Δσ_max ≤ 110 MPa（教學門檻），裂縫半長 a = 40 mm、Δσ = 30 MPa：ρ ≥ 4a(Δσ/110)² = 4×40×(30/110)² ≈ 11.9 mm，孔徑約 24 mm，依最小值取 25.4 mm；若為邊緣裂縫加大 25% 約 30 mm，取 32 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: By the Creager–Paris blunt-notch relation, the peak stress range at the hole edge is Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ). Requiring Δσ_max ≤ 110 MPa (a teaching limit) for a crack half-length a = 40 mm and Δσ = 30 MPa gives ρ ≥ 4a(Δσ/110)² = 4×40×(30/110)² ≈ 11.9 mm, a diameter of about 24 mm, raised to the 25.4 mm minimum; for an edge crack, adding 25% gives about 30 mm, so use 32 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鑽孔前以磁粉或染色滲透確認裂尖位置，FHWA 手冊建議先鑽約 1/8 in 的參考小孔檢查背面裂尖；鑽孔後再以染色滲透檢查孔壁與孔緣，確認沒有殘留裂尖，並記錄孔位座標與孔徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before drilling, locate the crack tip with magnetic particle or dye penetrant; the FHWA manual suggests a reference hole of about 1/8 in to check the tip on the far side.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以 Creager–Paris 鈍化缺口關係，孔邊尖峰應力範圍 Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ)。要求 Δσ_max ≤ 110 MPa（教學門檻），裂縫半長 a = 40 mm、Δσ = 30 MPa：ρ ≥ 4a(Δσ/110)² = 4×40×(30/110)² ≈ 11.9 mm，孔徑約 24 mm，依最小值取 25.4 mm；若為邊緣裂縫加大 25% 約 30 mm，取 32 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: By the Creager–Paris blunt-notch relation, the peak stress range at the hole edge is Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ). Requiring Δσ_max ≤ 110 MPa (a teaching limit) for a crack half-length a = 40 mm and Δσ = 30 MPa gives ρ ≥ 4a(Δσ/110)² = 4×40×(30/110)² ≈ 11.9 mm, a diameter of about 24 mm, raised to the 25.4 mm minimum; for an edge crack, adding 25% gives about 30 mm, so use 32 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「止裂孔的尺寸與施作」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes", which statement holds?
options: 以 Creager–Paris 鈍化缺口關係，孔邊尖峰應力範圍 Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ)。

optionsEn: By the Creager–Paris blunt-notch relation, the peak stress range at the hole edge is Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ).
Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement.
Drone imagery can now replace hands-on inspection of fracture-critical members.
quiz.explanation: 以 Creager–Paris 鈍化缺口關係，孔邊尖峰應力範圍 Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: By the Creager–Paris blunt-notch relation, the peak stress range at the hole edge is Δσ_max ≈ 2ΔK/√(πρ) = 2Δσ√(a/ρ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 止裂孔的尺寸與施作：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂尖止裂孔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crack-tip arrest hole” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 鑽孔前以磁粉或染色滲透確認裂尖位置，FHWA 手冊建議先鑽約 1/8 in 的參考小孔檢查背面裂尖；鑽孔後再以染色滲透檢查孔壁與孔緣，確認沒有殘留裂尖，並記錄孔位座標與孔徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before drilling, locate the crack tip with magnetic particle or dye penetrant; the FHWA manual suggests a reference hole of about 1/8 in to check the tip on the far side. After drilling, inspect the bore and edges with dye penetrant to confirm no crack tip remains, and record hole coordinates and diameter. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：止裂孔是局部或暫時措施，報告須說明裂縫成因是否已處理；變形誘發裂縫在鑽孔後通常還要搭配腹板間隙加勁或軟化。孔內可依 FHWA 建議裝上全預拉的高強度螺栓與硬化墊圈，使孔周保持有利的壓應力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: An arrest hole is a local or temporary measure, and the report must say whether the cause has been addressed; distortion-induced cracks usually also need web-gap stiffening or softening after drilling. As the FHWA manual suggests, a fully pretensioned high-strength bolt with hardened washers can be installed in the hole to keep favourable compression around it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若孔位偏離裂尖，或裂縫在背面比正面更長，止裂孔只是在裂縫旁邊多開了一個洞；以火焰切割開孔會在孔壁留下硬化層與缺口，反而成為新的疲勞起點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the hole misses the tip, or the crack is longer on the far face than the near face, the arrest hole is just an extra hole beside the crack; a flame-cut hole leaves a hardened, notched surface that becomes a new fatigue origin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 止裂孔的尺寸與施作：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂尖止裂孔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crack-tip arrest hole” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若孔位偏離裂尖，或裂縫在背面比正面更長，止裂孔只是在裂縫旁邊多開了一個洞；以火焰切割開孔會在孔壁留下硬化層與缺口，反而成為新的疲勞起點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the hole misses the tip, or the crack is longer on the far face than the near face, the arrest hole is just an extra hole beside the crack; a flame-cut hole leaves a hardened, notched surface that becomes a new fatigue origin. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：孔必須真正包含裂尖，否則裂縫會從孔外繼續成長。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The hole must truly contain the crack tip, or the crack simply continues outside it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「止裂孔的尺寸與施作」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sizing and drilling crack-arrest holes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要把裂縫焊補起來，構件就恢復原來的疲勞強度。

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Simply weld-repairing a crack restores the member's original fatigue strength.
If the hole misses the tip, or the crack is longer on the far face than the near face, the arrest hole is just an extra hole beside the crack.

steps.title: 錘擊處理與螺栓拼接補強：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Peening and bolted splice repairs: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺栓拼接板與錘擊焊趾」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolted splices and peened toes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 錘擊處理以氣動鎚沿焊趾敲擊，使表層塑性變形並引入壓縮殘餘應力，同時修圓焊趾幾何；FHWA 手冊指出它通常可把疲勞抗力提高至少一個細節類別，並可處理深約 3 mm 以內的表面裂縫。裂縫已貫穿翼板或腹板時，就要以螺栓拼接板跨越裂縫，讓力量繞過斷裂斷面；高強度鋼更偏好螺栓補強，以免焊接造成氫致開裂。2021 年 I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋繫梁斷裂後，也是先在兩側加鋼板穩住構件，再加板繞過斷裂部位並切除較小的受損段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺栓拼接板與錘擊焊趾」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Peening hammers the weld toe with a pneumatic tool, plastically deforming the surface, introducing compressive residual stress and rounding the toe; the FHWA manual says it generally raises fatigue resistance by at least one detail category and can treat surface cracks up to about 3 mm deep. Once a crack has passed through a flange or web, bolted splice plates must bridge it so force bypasses the broken section, and bolting is preferred on high-strength steel to avoid hydrogen cracking from welding. After the 2021 tie-girder fracture on the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge, plates were first added on both sides to stabilise the member, then more plating bypassed the fracture and a smaller damaged piece was removed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bolted splices and peened toes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：受拉翼板 400×25 mm 裂斷，需傳遞力 F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A cracked 400×25 mm tension flange must transfer F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把裂縫焊補起來，構件就恢復原來的疲勞強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Simply weld-repairing a crack restores the member's original fatigue strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺栓拼接板與錘擊焊趾」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Bolted splices and peened toes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Simply weld-repairing a crack restores the member's original fatigue strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錘擊處理與螺栓拼接補強」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Peening and bolted splice repairs" is correct?
options: 錘擊處理以氣動鎚沿焊趾敲擊，使表層塑性變形並引入壓縮殘餘應力，同時修圓焊趾幾何。
只要把裂縫焊補起來，構件就恢復原來的疲勞強度。
目視檢查沒有看到裂縫，就表示焊接細節沒有裂縫。
optionsEn: Peening hammers the weld toe with a pneumatic tool, plastically deforming the surface, introducing compressive residual stress and rounding the toe.
Simply weld-repairing a crack restores the member's original fatigue strength.
If visual inspection shows no crack, the welded detail has no crack.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錘擊處理與螺栓拼接補強：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Peening and bolted splice repairs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺栓拼接板與錘擊焊趾」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolted splices and peened toes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：受拉翼板 400×25 mm 裂斷，需傳遞力 F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN。以兩片拼接板夾住翼板形成雙摩擦面，每支 7/8 in（M22 級）高強度螺栓預拉 173 kN、滑動係數 0.50：每支抗滑 0.50×173×2 = 173 kN，裂縫每側需 1,200/173 ≈ 6.9 支，取 8 支。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A cracked 400×25 mm tension flange must transfer F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN. Two splice plates sandwiching the flange give two slip planes; with 7/8 in (M22-class) high-strength bolts pretensioned to 173 kN and a slip coefficient of 0.50, each bolt resists 0.50×173×2 = 173 kN, so each side of the crack needs 1,200/173 ≈ 6.9 bolts, rounded to 8. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：錘擊後以目視與量規確認焊趾形成連續平滑的凹槽、塑性深度在約 0.8 至 1.6 mm，並以染色滲透確認沒有搭疊缺陷；拼接板則檢查接觸面處理、螺栓預拉力與邊距，補強後量測裂縫兩側應變，確認力量確實轉移到拼接板。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After peening, confirm visually and with a gauge that the toe has a continuous smooth groove with plastic depth of about 0.8 to 1.6 mm, and check with dye penetrant for lap defects; for splices, check faying-surface preparation, bolt pretension and edge distances, then measure strains on both sides of the crack to confirm that force has actually moved into the plates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 受拉翼板 400×25 mm 裂斷，需傳遞力 F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN。以兩片拼接板夾住翼板形成雙摩擦面，每支 7/8 in（M22 級）高強度螺栓預拉 173 kN、滑動係數 0.50：每支抗滑 0.50×173×2 = 173 kN，裂縫每側需 1,200/173 ≈ 6.9 支，取 8 支。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A cracked 400×25 mm tension flange must transfer F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN. Two splice plates sandwiching the flange give two slip planes; with 7/8 in (M22-class) high-strength bolts pretensioned to 173 kN and a slip coefficient of 0.50, each bolt resists 0.50×173×2 = 173 kN, so each side of the crack needs 1,200/173 ≈ 6.9 bolts, rounded to 8. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錘擊處理與螺栓拼接補強」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Peening and bolted splice repairs", which statement holds?
options: 裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。
受拉翼板 400×25 mm 裂斷，需傳遞力 F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN。
只要最大應力低於降伏強度，鋼橋就不會發生疲勞裂縫。
optionsEn: Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up.
A cracked 400×25 mm tension flange must transfer F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN.
As long as peak stress stays below yield, a steel bridge cannot develop fatigue cracks.
quiz.explanation: 受拉翼板 400×25 mm 裂斷，需傳遞力 F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A cracked 400×25 mm tension flange must transfer F = 120 MPa×10,000 mm² = 1,200 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錘擊處理與螺栓拼接補強：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Peening and bolted splice repairs: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺栓拼接板與錘擊焊趾」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolted splices and peened toes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 錘擊後以目視與量規確認焊趾形成連續平滑的凹槽、塑性深度在約 0.8 至 1.6 mm，並以染色滲透確認沒有搭疊缺陷；拼接板則檢查接觸面處理、螺栓預拉力與邊距，補強後量測裂縫兩側應變，確認力量確實轉移到拼接板。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After peening, confirm visually and with a gauge that the toe has a continuous smooth groove with plastic depth of about 0.8 to 1.6 mm, and check with dye penetrant for lap defects; for splices, check faying-surface preparation, bolt pretension and edge distances, then measure strains on both sides of the crack to confirm that force has actually moved into the plates. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：焊補只在裂縫可完全移除、焊後能做全面非破壞檢測時才考慮，FHWA 手冊提醒修補焊道的疲勞表現可能只相當於 D 類；修復方案由結構工程師依剩餘應力範圍選定，施工圖須標出每一片拼接板、螺栓等級與接觸面處理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Consider weld repair only when the crack can be removed completely and the weld fully tested afterwards; the FHWA manual warns that repair welds may perform no better than Category D. The structural engineer selects the repair from the remaining stress range, and the shop drawings must show every splice plate, bolt grade and faying-surface treatment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在已有較深裂縫上錘擊，只會把裂口表面壓合而看不見，裂縫在內部持續成長；拼接板若只用一般螺栓或接觸面留有油漆，滑動後變成螺栓承壓，孔邊又成為新的疲勞起點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Peening over a deeper crack only closes its mouth out of sight while it keeps growing inside; splice plates with ordinary bolts or painted faying surfaces slip into bearing, and the hole edges become new fatigue origins. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 錘擊處理與螺栓拼接補強：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Peening and bolted splice repairs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螺栓拼接板與錘擊焊趾」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolted splices and peened toes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在已有較深裂縫上錘擊，只會把裂口表面壓合而看不見，裂縫在內部持續成長；拼接板若只用一般螺栓或接觸面留有油漆，滑動後變成螺栓承壓，孔邊又成為新的疲勞起點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把裂縫焊補起來，構件就恢復原來的疲勞強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Simply weld-repairing a crack restores the member's original fatigue strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」與「現場應變量測與有效應力範圍」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT" and "Field strain measurement and effective stress range": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Locating and sizing cracks by NDT: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「染色滲透、磁粉與超音波」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dye penetrant, MT and ultrasonics” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 目視只能找到已經使油漆開裂的裂縫，確認長度與裂尖位置要靠非破壞檢測。FHWA 手冊說明染色滲透與磁粉是最簡便常用的方法：染色滲透以三種藥劑讓顯像劑把滲入裂縫的染料吸出；磁粉可找到表面及部分近表面裂縫，但隔著油漆並不可靠。量測裂縫深度需要超音波或繞射時差法（TOFD），設備與人員資格要求都較高。檢測前必須去除油漆與鏽皮，檢測後再補塗防蝕。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「染色滲透、磁粉與超音波」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Visual inspection finds only cracks that have already split the paint; confirming length and tip location needs nondestructive testing. The FHWA manual describes dye penetrant and magnetic particle testing as the easiest and most widely used: penetrant is a three-part system whose developer draws dye back out of the crack, while magnetic particle testing finds surface and some near-surface cracks but is unreliable through paint. Sizing crack depth needs ultrasonic testing or time-of-flight diffraction (TOFD), with costlier equipment and more highly trained operators. Paint and mill scale must be removed before testing and the coating restored afterwards. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dye penetrant, MT and ultrasonics” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：TOFD 以兩探頭間距 2S 量測裂尖繞射波到達時間 t，深度 d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: TOFD measures the arrival time t of the wave diffracted from the crack tip with probes 2S apart, so depth d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目視檢查沒有看到裂縫，就表示焊接細節沒有裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If visual inspection shows no crack, the welded detail has no crack." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「染色滲透、磁粉與超音波」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dye penetrant, MT and ultrasonics”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫
knowledge.titleEn: Locating and sizing cracks by NDT
knowledge.text: 目視只能找到已經使油漆開裂的裂縫，確認長度與裂尖位置要靠非破壞檢測。FHWA 手冊說明染色滲透與磁粉是最簡便常用的方法：染色滲透以三種藥劑讓顯像劑把滲入裂縫的染料吸出；磁粉可找到表面及部分近表面裂縫，但隔著油漆並不可靠。

The FHWA manual describes dye penetrant and magnetic particle testing as the easiest and most widely used: penetrant is a three-part system whose developer draws dye back out of the crack, while magnetic particle testing finds surface and some near-surface cracks but is unreliable through paint.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目視檢查沒有看到裂縫，就表示焊接細節沒有裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If visual inspection shows no crack, the welded detail has no crack. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT" is correct?
options: 目視檢查沒有看到裂縫，就表示焊接細節沒有裂縫。
目視只能找到已經使油漆開裂的裂縫，確認長度與裂尖位置要靠非破壞檢測。
疲勞評估只要用規範的疲勞卡車計算，不需要現場量測。
optionsEn: If visual inspection shows no crack, the welded detail has no crack.
Visual inspection finds only cracks that have already split the paint; confirming length and tip location needs nondestructive testing.
Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement.
quiz.explanation: 目視只能找到已經使油漆開裂的裂縫，確認長度與裂尖位置要靠非破壞檢測。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Visual inspection finds only cracks that have already split the paint; confirming length and tip location needs nondestructive testing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Locating and sizing cracks by NDT: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「染色滲透、磁粉與超音波」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dye penetrant, MT and ultrasonics” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：TOFD 以兩探頭間距 2S 量測裂尖繞射波到達時間 t，深度 d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²]。縱波速 c = 5.92 mm/μs、S = 30 mm、t = 12.0 μs：c·t/2 = 35.52 mm，d = √(35.52² − 30²) ≈ 19.0 mm；t 增為 12.5 μs 時 d ≈ 21.7 mm，0.5 μs 的時間差約代表 2.7 mm 深度。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: TOFD measures the arrival time t of the wave diffracted from the crack tip with probes 2S apart, so depth d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²]. With longitudinal velocity c = 5.92 mm/μs, S = 30 mm and t = 12.0 μs, c·t/2 = 35.52 mm and d = √(35.52² − 30²) ≈ 19.0 mm; at t = 12.5 μs, d ≈ 21.7 mm, so 0.5 μs corresponds to about 2.7 mm of depth. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢測人員應具 ASNT 或 ISO 9712 等級資格，以含已知人工缺陷的標準試片校正儀器；同一條裂縫至少用兩種方法交叉確認，長度以裂尖兩端的標記與量尺照片記錄，並註明檢測溫度與表面處理狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspectors should be qualified to ASNT or ISO 9712 levels and calibrate their instruments on reference blocks with known artificial flaws; confirm each crack with at least two methods, record its length with marks at both tips and a scaled photograph, and note test temperature and surface condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
