knowledge.text: TOFD 以兩探頭間距 2S 量測裂尖繞射波到達時間 t，深度 d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²]。縱波速 c = 5.92 mm/μs、S = 30 mm、t = 12.0 μs：c·t/2 = 35.52 mm，d = √(35.52² − 30²) ≈ 19.0 mm；t 增為 12.5 μs 時 d ≈ 21.7 mm，0.5 μs 的時間差約代表 2.7 mm 深度。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: TOFD measures the arrival time t of the wave diffracted from the crack tip with probes 2S apart, so depth d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²]. With longitudinal velocity c = 5.92 mm/μs, S = 30 mm and t = 12.0 μs, c·t/2 = 35.52 mm and d = √(35.52² − 30²) ≈ 19.0 mm; at t = 12.5 μs, d ≈ 21.7 mm, so 0.5 μs corresponds to about 2.7 mm of depth. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT", which statement holds?
options: 空拍影像已經可以取代斷裂關鍵構件的近距離檢查。
腹板間隙的變形只有百分之幾毫米，不可能造成裂縫。
TOFD 以兩探頭間距 2S 量測裂尖繞射波到達時間 t，深度 d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²]。
optionsEn: Drone imagery can now replace hands-on inspection of fracture-critical members.
Web-gap distortions are only hundredths of a millimetre, so they cannot cause cracks.
TOFD measures the arrival time t of the wave diffracted from the crack tip with probes 2S apart, so depth d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²].
quiz.explanation: TOFD 以兩探頭間距 2S 量測裂尖繞射波到達時間 t，深度 d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: TOFD measures the arrival time t of the wave diffracted from the crack tip with probes 2S apart, so depth d = √[(c·t/2)² − S²]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Locating and sizing cracks by NDT: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「染色滲透、磁粉與超音波」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dye penetrant, MT and ultrasonics” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢測人員應具 ASNT 或 ISO 9712 等級資格，以含已知人工缺陷的標準試片校正儀器；同一條裂縫至少用兩種方法交叉確認，長度以裂尖兩端的標記與量尺照片記錄，並註明檢測溫度與表面處理狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspectors should be qualified to ASNT or ISO 9712 levels and calibrate their instruments on reference blocks with known artificial flaws; confirm each crack with at least two methods, record its length with marks at both tips and a scaled photograph, and note test temperature and surface condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：檢測程序書要寫明去漆範圍、檢測方法、驗收與記錄格式，並規定當天完成局部補漆；所有裂縫都在構件上以油漆筆標示裂尖與日期，便於下次檢查判斷是否成長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The inspection procedure must define paint-removal extent, test method, acceptance and record format, and require local recoating the same day; mark every crack tip and the date on the steel with a paint pen so the next inspection can tell whether it has grown.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：隔著油漆做磁粉檢測，或去漆後未清除鏽皮，容易漏判短裂縫；把焊道表面的咬邊或研磨痕誤判為裂縫，則會導致不必要的鑽孔與補強，反而增加新的應力集中。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Magnetic particle testing through paint, or after paint removal without cleaning off scale, easily misses short cracks; mistaking undercut or grinding marks for cracks leads to unnecessary drilling and strengthening that adds new stress concentrations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢測人員應具 ASNT 或 ISO 9712 等級資格，以含已知人工缺陷的標準試片校正儀器；同一條裂縫至少用兩種方法交叉確認，長度以裂尖兩端的標記與量尺照片記錄，並註明檢測溫度與表面處理狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Inspectors should be qualified to ASNT or ISO 9712 levels and calibrate their instruments on reference blocks with known artificial flaws; confirm each crack with at least two methods, record its length with marks at both tips and a scaled photograph, and note test temperature and surface condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 檢測程序書要寫明去漆範圍、檢測方法、驗收與記錄格式，並規定當天完成局部補漆；所有裂縫都在構件上以油漆筆標示裂尖與日期，便於下次檢查判斷是否成長。
knowledge.textEn: The inspection procedure must define paint-removal extent, test method, acceptance and record format, and require local recoating the same day; mark every crack tip and the date on the steel with a paint pen so the next inspection can tell whether it has grown.

quiz.question: 要驗證「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT"?
options: 檢測人員應具 ASNT 或 ISO 9712 等級資格，以含已知人工缺陷的標準試片校正儀器。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
裂縫每年增加的長度是固定的，可以直接線性外推。
optionsEn: Inspectors should be qualified to ASNT or ISO 9712 levels and calibrate their instruments on reference blocks with known artificial flaws.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A crack grows by the same length every year, so it can be extrapolated linearly.
quiz.explanation: 檢測人員應具 ASNT 或 ISO 9712 等級資格，以含已知人工缺陷的標準試片校正儀器；同一條裂縫至少用兩種方法交叉確認，長度以裂尖兩端的標記與量尺照片記錄，並註明檢測溫度與表面處理狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspectors should be qualified to ASNT or ISO 9712 levels and calibrate their instruments on reference blocks with known artificial flaws; confirm each crack with at least two methods, record its length with marks at both tips and a scaled photograph, and note test temperature and surface condition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Locating and sizing cracks by NDT: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「染色滲透、磁粉與超音波」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dye penetrant, MT and ultrasonics” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 隔著油漆做磁粉檢測，或去漆後未清除鏽皮，容易漏判短裂縫；把焊道表面的咬邊或研磨痕誤判為裂縫，則會導致不必要的鑽孔與補強，反而增加新的應力集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Magnetic particle testing through paint, or after paint removal without cleaning off scale, easily misses short cracks; mistaking undercut or grinding marks for cracks leads to unnecessary drilling and strengthening that adds new stress concentrations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：檢測前必須去除油漆與鏽皮，檢測後再補塗防蝕。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Paint and mill scale must be removed before testing and the coating restored afterwards.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目視檢查沒有看到裂縫，就表示焊接細節沒有裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If visual inspection shows no crack, the welded detail has no crack." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 隔著油漆做磁粉檢測，或去漆後未清除鏽皮，容易漏判短裂縫；把焊道表面的咬邊或研磨痕誤判為裂縫，則會導致不必要的鑽孔與補強，反而增加新的應力集中。
knowledge.textEn: Magnetic particle testing through paint, or after paint removal without cleaning off scale, easily misses short cracks; mistaking undercut or grinding marks for cracks leads to unnecessary drilling and strengthening that adds new stress concentrations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「非破壞檢測定位與量測裂縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Locating and sizing cracks by NDT" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
隔著油漆做磁粉檢測，或去漆後未清除鏽皮，容易漏判短裂縫；把焊道表面的咬邊或研磨痕誤判為裂縫，則會導致不必要的鑽孔與補強，反而增加新的應力集中。
疲勞評估只要用規範的疲勞卡車計算，不需要現場量測。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Magnetic particle testing through paint, or after paint removal without cleaning off scale, easily misses short cracks.
Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement.
quiz.explanation: 隔著油漆做磁粉檢測，或去漆後未清除鏽皮，容易漏判短裂縫；把焊道表面的咬邊或研磨痕誤判為裂縫，則會導致不必要的鑽孔與補強，反而增加新的應力集中。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Magnetic particle testing through paint, or after paint removal without cleaning off scale, easily misses short cracks; mistaking undercut or grinding marks for cracks leads to unnecessary drilling and strengthening that adds new stress concentrations. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 現場應變量測與有效應力範圍：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Field strain measurement and effective stress range: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 設計用的疲勞卡車與實際交通差異很大，評估既有橋最可靠的做法是在疲勞敏感細節附近貼應變計，連續記錄一到數週的實際交通反應。以雨流計數法把不規則的應變歷時拆成一個個循環，再依 Miner 線性累積損傷把不同大小的循環換算成一個等效常幅應力範圍。量測也能找出模型沒有考慮的效應，例如變形誘發的二次彎曲或支承卡死造成的額外應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The design fatigue truck differs greatly from real traffic, so the most reliable assessment of an existing bridge puts strain gauges near fatigue-sensitive details and records actual traffic for one to several weeks. Rainflow counting splits the irregular strain history into individual cycles, and Miner's linear damage rule converts cycles of different sizes into one equivalent constant-amplitude stress range. Measurements also reveal effects the model omits, such as distortion-induced secondary bending or extra stress from seized bearings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：有效應力範圍 S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Effective stress range S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「疲勞評估只要用規範的疲勞卡車計算，不需要現場量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 現場應變量測與有效應力範圍
knowledge.titleEn: Field strain measurement and effective stress range
knowledge.text: 設計用的疲勞卡車與實際交通差異很大，評估既有橋最可靠的做法是在疲勞敏感細節附近貼應變計，連續記錄一到數週的實際交通反應。以雨流計數法把不規則的應變歷時拆成一個個循環，再依 Miner 線性累積損傷把不同大小的循環換算成一個等效常幅應力範圍。
knowledge.textEn: The design fatigue truck differs greatly from real traffic, so the most reliable assessment of an existing bridge puts strain gauges near fatigue-sensitive details and records actual traffic for one to several weeks. Rainflow counting splits the irregular strain history into individual cycles, and Miner's linear damage rule converts cycles of different sizes into one equivalent constant-amplitude stress range.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：疲勞評估只要用規範的疲勞卡車計算，不需要現場量測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「現場應變量測與有效應力範圍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field strain measurement and effective stress range" is correct?
options: 疲勞評估只要用規範的疲勞卡車計算，不需要現場量測。
裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。
設計用的疲勞卡車與實際交通差異很大，評估既有橋最可靠的做法是在疲勞敏感細節附近貼應變計，連續記錄一到數週的實際交通反應。
optionsEn: Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement.
Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up.

The design fatigue truck differs greatly from real traffic, so the most reliable assessment of an existing bridge puts strain gauges near fatigue-sensitive details and records actual traffic for one to several weeks.
quiz.explanation: 設計用的疲勞卡車與實際交通差異很大，評估既有橋最可靠的做法是在疲勞敏感細節附近貼應變計，連續記錄一到數週的實際交通反應。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The design fatigue truck differs greatly from real traffic, so the most reliable assessment of an existing bridge puts strain gauges near fatigue-sensitive details and records actual traffic for one to several weeks. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場應變量測與有效應力範圍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field strain measurement and effective stress range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：有效應力範圍 S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3)。雨流計數得 60% 循環為 10 MPa、30% 為 20 MPa、10% 為 40 MPa：S_re = (0.6×1,000 + 0.3×8,000 + 0.1×64,000)^(1/3) = 9,400^(1/3) ≈ 21.1 MPa。E 類 N = 3.61×10¹¹/21.1³ ≈ 3.8×10⁷ 次，每天 3,000 次約 35 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Effective stress range S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3). If rainflow counting gives 60% of cycles at 10 MPa, 30% at 20 MPa and 10% at 40 MPa, S_re = (0.6×1,000 + 0.3×8,000 + 0.1×64,000)^(1/3) = 9,400^(1/3) ≈ 21.1 MPa. For Category E, N = 3.61×10¹¹/21.1³ ≈ 3.8×10⁷ cycles, about 35 years at 3,000 cycles a day. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：應變計距焊趾保持固定距離並避開應力梯度最陡處，以已知重量的試驗卡車做標定行車，確認量到的應力與影響線計算相符；長期記錄要涵蓋平日與週末，並剔除溫度漂移造成的假循環。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place gauges at a fixed distance from the weld toe, away from the steepest stress gradient, and run a calibration truck of known weight to confirm that measured stresses match influence-line calculations; long-term records must cover weekdays and weekends, with spurious cycles from thermal drift removed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Effective stress range S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3). If rainflow counting gives 60% of cycles at 10 MPa, 30% at 20 MPa and 10% at 40 MPa, S_re = (0.6×1,000 + 0.3×8,000 + 0.1×64,000)^(1/3) = 9,400^(1/3) ≈ 21.1 MPa. For Category E, N = 3.61×10¹¹/21.1³ ≈ 3.8×10⁷ cycles, about 35 years at 3,000 cycles a day. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場應變量測與有效應力範圍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Field strain measurement and effective stress range", which statement holds?
options: 有效應力範圍 S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3)。
只要最大應力低於降伏強度，鋼橋就不會發生疲勞裂縫。
鋼材是延性材料，所以鋼橋只會先變形再破壞，不會突然斷裂。
optionsEn: Effective stress range S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3).
As long as peak stress stays below yield, a steel bridge cannot develop fatigue cracks.
Steel is ductile, so a steel bridge always deforms visibly before it fails and never fractures suddenly.
quiz.explanation: 有效應力範圍 S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective stress range S_re = (Σγ_i·S_i³)^(1/3). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 現場應變量測與有效應力範圍：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field strain measurement and effective stress range: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 應變計距焊趾保持固定距離並避開應力梯度最陡處，以已知重量的試驗卡車做標定行車，確認量到的應力與影響線計算相符；長期記錄要涵蓋平日與週末，並剔除溫度漂移造成的假循環。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place gauges at a fixed distance from the weld toe, away from the steepest stress gradient, and run a calibration truck of known weight to confirm that measured stresses match influence-line calculations; long-term records must cover weekdays and weekends, with spurious cycles from thermal drift removed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：量測報告要附上應變計位置照片、標定車重、取樣頻率、濾波設定與雨流計數門檻，並把 S_re、每日循環數與剩餘壽命一起列入疲勞清冊，作為交通量改變時重新評估的基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The measurement report should attach gauge-location photographs, calibration truck weight, sampling rate, filter settings and rainflow thresholds, and enter S_re, daily cycles and remaining life into the fatigue inventory as the baseline for reassessment when traffic changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只量幾個小時或只在離峰時段量測，會低估重車循環與最大應力範圍；忽略低於門檻的小循環在有大循環存在時仍會造成損傷，也會讓剩餘壽命估得過於樂觀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Recording for only a few hours, or only off-peak, underestimates heavy-truck cycles and the maximum stress range; ignoring that small cycles below the threshold still cause damage when larger cycles are present makes the remaining-life estimate too optimistic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 應變計距焊趾保持固定距離並避開應力梯度最陡處，以已知重量的試驗卡車做標定行車，確認量到的應力與影響線計算相符；長期記錄要涵蓋平日與週末，並剔除溫度漂移造成的假循環。
knowledge.textEn: Place gauges at a fixed distance from the weld toe, away from the steepest stress gradient, and run a calibration truck of known weight to confirm that measured stresses match influence-line calculations; long-term records must cover weekdays and weekends, with spurious cycles from thermal drift removed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 量測報告要附上應變計位置照片、標定車重、取樣頻率、濾波設定與雨流計數門檻，並把 S_re、每日循環數與剩餘壽命一起列入疲勞清冊，作為交通量改變時重新評估的基準。
knowledge.textEn: The measurement report should attach gauge-location photographs, calibration truck weight, sampling rate, filter settings and rainflow thresholds, and enter S_re, daily cycles and remaining life into the fatigue inventory as the baseline for reassessment when traffic changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場應變量測與有效應力範圍」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field strain measurement and effective stress range"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
應變計距焊趾保持固定距離並避開應力梯度最陡處，以已知重量的試驗卡車做標定行車，確認量到的應力與影響線計算相符。
止裂孔越小越好，因為開孔會削弱斷面。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Place gauges at a fixed distance from the weld toe, away from the steepest stress gradient, and run a calibration truck of known weight to confirm that measured stresses match influence-line calculations.
Arrest holes should be as small as possible because holes weaken the section.
quiz.explanation: 應變計距焊趾保持固定距離並避開應力梯度最陡處，以已知重量的試驗卡車做標定行車，確認量到的應力與影響線計算相符；長期記錄要涵蓋平日與週末，並剔除溫度漂移造成的假循環。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place gauges at a fixed distance from the weld toe, away from the steepest stress gradient, and run a calibration truck of known weight to confirm that measured stresses match influence-line calculations; long-term records must cover weekdays and weekends, with spurious cycles from thermal drift removed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場應變量測與有效應力範圍：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field strain measurement and effective stress range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊趾應變計與雨流計數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weld-toe gauges and rainflow counting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只量幾個小時或只在離峰時段量測，會低估重車循環與最大應力範圍；忽略低於門檻的小循環在有大循環存在時仍會造成損傷，也會讓剩餘壽命估得過於樂觀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Recording for only a few hours, or only off-peak, underestimates heavy-truck cycles and the maximum stress range; ignoring that small cycles below the threshold still cause damage when larger cycles are present makes the remaining-life estimate too optimistic. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測也能找出模型沒有考慮的效應，例如變形誘發的二次彎曲或支承卡死造成的額外應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Measurements also reveal effects the model omits, such as distortion-induced secondary bending or extra stress from seized bearings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「疲勞評估只要用規範的疲勞卡車計算，不需要現場量測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fatigue assessment needs only the code fatigue truck, never field measurement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只量幾個小時或只在離峰時段量測，會低估重車循環與最大應力範圍；忽略低於門檻的小循環在有大循環存在時仍會造成損傷，也會讓剩餘壽命估得過於樂觀。
knowledge.textEn: Recording for only a few hours, or only off-peak, underestimates heavy-truck cycles and the maximum stress range; ignoring that small cycles below the threshold still cause damage when larger cycles are present makes the remaining-life estimate too optimistic.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場應變量測與有效應力範圍」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field strain measurement and effective stress range" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。
只量幾個小時或只在離峰時段量測，會低估重車循環與最大應力範圍；忽略低於門檻的小循環在有大循環存在時仍會造成損傷，也會讓剩餘壽命估得過於樂觀。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up.
Recording for only a few hours, or only off-peak, underestimates heavy-truck cycles and the maximum stress range.
quiz.explanation: 只量幾個小時或只在離峰時段量測，會低估重車循環與最大應力範圍；忽略低於門檻的小循環在有大循環存在時仍會造成損傷，也會讓剩餘壽命估得過於樂觀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Recording for only a few hours, or only off-peak, underestimates heavy-truck cycles and the maximum stress range; ignoring that small cycles below the threshold still cause damage when larger cycles are present makes the remaining-life estimate too optimistic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢查間隔與修復後追蹤」與「斷裂關鍵構件管理與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Inspection intervals and post-repair follow-up" and "Fracture-critical member management and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 檢查間隔與修復後追蹤：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Inspection intervals and post-repair follow-up: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「修復後追蹤檢查週期」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-repair inspection interval” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 修復不是終點：止裂孔可能重新起裂、拼接板邊緣成為新的起點，未修的同類細節也可能陸續出現裂縫。FHWA 手冊指出，對常見的冗餘橋梁，最好的選擇常常不是修復而是監測裂縫，面外變形造成的裂縫尤其如此。檢查間隔應由可偵測的最小裂縫、臨界裂縫與成長速率決定，而不只是套用固定的兩年週期；偵測能力越差，所需的檢查頻率就越高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「修復後追蹤檢查週期」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Repair is not the end: arrest holes can re-initiate, splice-plate edges can become new origins, and unrepaired details of the same type may crack in turn. The FHWA manual notes that for common redundant bridges the best choice is often to monitor rather than repair a crack, especially one caused by out-of-plane distortion. Inspection intervals should follow from the smallest detectable crack, the critical crack and the growth rate, not just a fixed two-year cycle; the poorer the detection capability, the more often one must inspect. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-repair inspection interval” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：沿用第 4 單元（Δσ = 40 MPa、a_c = 113 mm）：非破壞檢測能可靠偵測 5 mm 裂縫時，剩餘約 6.5×10⁶ 次 ≈ 8.9 年；若只靠目視、25 mm 才看得到，只剩約 1.9×10⁶ 次 ≈ 2.7 年。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Using unit 4 (Δσ = 40 MPa, a_c = 113 mm): if NDT reliably detects a 5 mm crack, about 6.5×10⁶ cycles ≈ 8.9 years remain; if only visual inspection finds it at 25 mm, only about 1.9×10⁶ cycles ≈ 2.7 years remain.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「修復後追蹤檢查週期」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-repair inspection interval”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 檢查間隔與修復後追蹤
knowledge.text: 修復不是終點：止裂孔可能重新起裂、拼接板邊緣成為新的起點，未修的同類細節也可能陸續出現裂縫。FHWA 手冊指出，對常見的冗餘橋梁，最好的選擇常常不是修復而是監測裂縫，面外變形造成的裂縫尤其如此。
knowledge.textEn: Repair is not the end: arrest holes can re-initiate, splice-plate edges can become new origins, and unrepaired details of the same type may crack in turn. The FHWA manual notes that for common redundant bridges the best choice is often to monitor rather than repair a crack, especially one caused by out-of-plane distortion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「檢查間隔與修復後追蹤」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inspection intervals and post-repair follow-up" is correct?
options: 修復不是終點：止裂孔可能重新起裂、拼接板邊緣成為新的起點，未修的同類細節也可能陸續出現裂縫。
裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。
空拍影像已經可以取代斷裂關鍵構件的近距離檢查。
optionsEn: Repair is not the end: arrest holes can re-initiate, splice-plate edges can become new origins, and unrepaired details of the same type may crack in turn.
Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up.
Drone imagery can now replace hands-on inspection of fracture-critical members.
quiz.explanation: 修復不是終點：止裂孔可能重新起裂、拼接板邊緣成為新的起點，未修的同類細節也可能陸續出現裂縫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Repair is not the end: arrest holes can re-initiate, splice-plate edges can become new origins, and unrepaired details of the same type may crack in turn. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 檢查間隔與修復後追蹤：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inspection intervals and post-repair follow-up: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「修復後追蹤檢查週期」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-repair inspection interval” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：沿用第 4 單元（Δσ = 40 MPa、a_c = 113 mm）：非破壞檢測能可靠偵測 5 mm 裂縫時，剩餘約 6.5×10⁶ 次 ≈ 8.9 年；若只靠目視、25 mm 才看得到，只剩約 1.9×10⁶ 次 ≈ 2.7 年。要求斷裂前至少有兩次檢查機會，間隔分別不超過約 4.4 年與 1.3 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Using unit 4 (Δσ = 40 MPa, a_c = 113 mm): if NDT reliably detects a 5 mm crack, about 6.5×10⁶ cycles ≈ 8.9 years remain; if only visual inspection finds it at 25 mm, only about 1.9×10⁶ cycles ≈ 2.7 years remain. Requiring at least two inspection opportunities before fracture gives intervals of no more than about 4.4 and 1.3 years respectively. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次追蹤檢查以相同方法量測裂縫長度與止裂孔孔緣，並與上次紀錄比對；對冗餘度低或應力範圍高的細節加裝裂縫計或聲射感測器並設定成長警戒值，超過即提前安排詳細檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At each follow-up inspection, measure crack length and arrest-hole edges with the same method and compare with the previous record; fit crack gauges or acoustic-emission sensors with growth alarms on details of low redundancy or high stress range, bringing forward a detailed inspection whenever an alarm is exceeded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 沿用第 4 單元（Δσ = 40 MPa、a_c = 113 mm）：非破壞檢測能可靠偵測 5 mm 裂縫時，剩餘約 6.5×10⁶ 次 ≈ 8.9 年；若只靠目視、25 mm 才看得到，只剩約 1.9×10⁶ 次 ≈ 2.7 年。要求斷裂前至少有兩次檢查機會，間隔分別不超過約 4.4 年與 1.3 年。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Using unit 4 (Δσ = 40 MPa, a_c = 113 mm): if NDT reliably detects a 5 mm crack, about 6.5×10⁶ cycles ≈ 8.9 years remain; if only visual inspection finds it at 25 mm, only about 1.9×10⁶ cycles ≈ 2.7 years remain. Requiring at least two inspection opportunities before fracture gives intervals of no more than about 4.4 and 1.3 years respectively. Values are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 檢查間隔與修復後追蹤：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inspection intervals and post-repair follow-up: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「修復後追蹤檢查週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-repair inspection interval” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次追蹤檢查以相同方法量測裂縫長度與止裂孔孔緣，並與上次紀錄比對；對冗餘度低或應力範圍高的細節加裝裂縫計或聲射感測器並設定成長警戒值，超過即提前安排詳細檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At each follow-up inspection, measure crack length and arrest-hole edges with the same method and compare with the previous record; fit crack gauges or acoustic-emission sensors with growth alarms on details of low redundancy or high stress range, bringing forward a detailed inspection whenever an alarm is exceeded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：修復後的第一次追蹤檢查應在較短期間內（例如數個月到一年）進行，確認止裂孔沒有重新起裂；追蹤結果與原始裂縫圖一起存檔，並由負責工程師簽署是否可恢復常規間隔。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Schedule the first follow-up inspection soon after repair, for example within a few months to a year, to confirm the arrest holes have not re-initiated; file the results with the original crack map and have the responsible engineer sign whether the normal interval may resume.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：2021 年 I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋繫梁斷裂被發現後，業餘照片顯示同一位置早在 2016 年就有損傷，2019 年的空拍檢查影像也拍到裂縫；調查認為斷裂源於製造時焊接修補引發的氫致裂紋而非疲勞成長，但它說明若未真正近距離檢視，任何追蹤計畫都會落空。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: After the 2021 tie-girder fracture on the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge was found, amateur photographs showed damage at the same spot as early as 2016, and drone footage from a 2019 inspection also captured it; the investigation traced the fracture to hydrogen cracks from fabrication weld repairs rather than fatigue growth, but it shows that any follow-up plan fails without genuine close-up examination. steps.title: 檢查間隔與修復後追蹤：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-repair inspection interval” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 2021 年 I-40 Hernando de Soto 橋繫梁斷裂被發現後，業餘照片顯示同一位置早在 2016 年就有損傷，2019 年的空拍檢查影像也拍到裂縫；調查認為斷裂源於製造時焊接修補引發的氫致裂紋而非疲勞成長，但它說明若未真正近距離檢視，任何追蹤計畫都會落空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: After the 2021 tie-girder fracture on the I-40 Hernando de Soto Bridge was found, amateur photographs showed damage at the same spot as early as 2016, and drone footage from a 2019 inspection also captured it; the investigation traced the fracture to hydrogen cracks from fabrication weld repairs rather than fatigue growth, but it shows that any follow-up plan fails without genuine close-up examination. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inspection intervals should follow from the smallest detectable crack, the critical crack and the growth rate, not just a fixed two-year cycle; the poorer the detection capability, the more often one must inspect.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裂縫修復完成後就可以恢復一般的兩年檢查週期，不必再追蹤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a crack is repaired, the normal two-year cycle can resume without follow-up." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.title: 斷裂關鍵構件管理與交接：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「斷裂關鍵構件檔案」如何影響鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fracture-critical member file” governs force, deformation or durability in “Steel-bridge fatigue-crack assessment and repair”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 斷裂關鍵構件是受拉、一旦斷裂可能造成部分或整座橋倒塌的鋼構件，美國國家橋梁檢查標準要求至少每 24 個月做一次可以用手觸及的近距離檢查，且不適用 48 個月的延長週期。交接檔案要讓下一個檢查團隊知道每一個構件在哪裡、屬哪一類細節、曾有哪些裂縫、怎麼修、修後量到什麼。把這些資料連成時間序列，就能從裂縫成長反推實際應力範圍，判斷修復是否有效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斷裂關鍵構件檔案」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fracture-critical members are steel members in tension whose failure would probably collapse part or all of the bridge; the US National Bridge Inspection Standards require hands-on inspection at least every 24 months and exclude them from the 48-month extended cycle. The handover file must tell the next inspection team where each member is, what detail category it belongs to, which cracks it has had, how they were repaired and what was measured afterwards. Linked as a time series, these data let engineers back-calculate the real stress range from crack growth and judge whether a repair worked. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fracture-critical member file” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某裂縫兩年內由 20 mm 成長到 26 mm，期間約 1.46×10⁶ 次循環：da/dN ≈ 0.006/1.46×10⁶ ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁹ m/cycle。ΔK = (da/dN/C)^(1/3) = (4.1×10⁻⁹/6.9×10⁻¹²)^(1/3) ≈ 8.4 MPa√m；取平均 a = 23 mm，Δσ = ΔK/[1.12√(πa)] ≈ 28 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A crack grew from 20 mm to 26 mm over two years and about 1.46×10⁶ cycles, so da/dN ≈ 0.006/1.46×10⁶ ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁹ m/cycle. Then ΔK = (da/dN/C)^(1/3) = (4.1×10⁻⁹/6.9×10⁻¹²)^(1/3) ≈ 8.4 MPa√m, and with a mean a = 23 mm, Δσ = ΔK/[1.12√(πa)] ≈ 28 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前核對檔案是否涵蓋所有斷裂關鍵構件的位置圖、檢查程序、近接方式（橋檢車、繩索或吊籃）、歷次裂縫圖與修復圖說；抽查幾處現場標記與檔案是否一致，並確認檢查團隊負責人的資格與近接設備已排定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, check that the file covers location drawings, inspection procedures, access methods (snooper truck, rope access or lift), every crack map and the repair drawings for all fracture-critical members; spot-check site marks against the file and confirm the team leader's qualification and the access equipment schedule.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 斷裂關鍵構件管理與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fracture-critical member management and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷裂關鍵構件檔案」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fracture-critical member file” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前核對檔案是否涵蓋所有斷裂關鍵構件的位置圖、檢查程序、近接方式（橋檢車、繩索或吊籃）、歷次裂縫圖與修復圖說；抽查幾處現場標記與檔案是否一致，並確認檢查團隊負責人的資格與近接設備已排定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, check that the file covers location drawings, inspection procedures, access methods (snooper truck, rope access or lift), every crack map and the repair drawings for all fracture-critical members; spot-check site marks against the file and confirm the team leader's qualification and the access equipment schedule. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊列出每一個斷裂關鍵構件的檢查程序、近接方法、必要的非破壞檢測與通報門檻；發現疑似斷裂時，第一線檢查員必須有權立即封橋並通報業主，這項權責要在交接時寫清楚。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual lists, for each fracture-critical member, the inspection procedure, access method, required NDT and reporting thresholds; when a fracture is suspected, the front-line inspector must have authority to close the bridge immediately and notify the owner, and that authority must be written down at handover.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若檔案只保留結論而缺少裂縫量測資料，新的檢查團隊無法計算成長率，也無法判斷修復是否有效；近接設備若未事先安排，容易以遠距目視或空拍取代近距離檢查，正是讓斷裂長期未被發現的條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the file keeps only conclusions without crack measurements, a new team cannot compute growth rates or judge whether repairs worked; if access equipment is not arranged in advance, distant visual checks or drone footage tend to replace hands-on inspection, exactly the condition that lets a fracture go unnoticed for years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 斷裂關鍵構件管理與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fracture-critical member management and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷裂關鍵構件檔案」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fracture-critical member file” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若檔案只保留結論而缺少裂縫量測資料，新的檢查團隊無法計算成長率，也無法判斷修復是否有效；近接設備若未事先安排，容易以遠距目視或空拍取代近距離檢查，正是讓斷裂長期未被發現的條件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the file keeps only conclusions without crack measurements, a new team cannot compute growth rates or judge whether repairs worked; if access equipment is not arranged in advance, distant visual checks or drone footage tend to replace hands-on inspection, exactly the condition that lets a fracture go unnoticed for years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把這些資料連成時間序列，就能從裂縫成長反推實際應力範圍，判斷修復是否有效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Linked as a time series, these data let engineers back-calculate the real stress range from crack growth and judge whether a repair worked.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空拍影像已經可以取代斷裂關鍵構件的近距離檢查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drone imagery can now replace hands-on inspection of fracture-critical members." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「斷裂關鍵構件管理與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fracture-critical member management and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
