title: 橋梁健康監測感測網
summary: 以香港青馬大橋等橋的風與結構健康監測系統、明尼阿波利斯 I-35W St. Anthony Falls 新橋內建感測器與加州收費橋梁的強震儀為例，說明如何由監測目的決定量測項目與感測器配置，處理感測原理、安裝與供電、資料擷取與時間同步、施工期基準值、模態識別與溫度效應、警戒值與誤報率，以及系統維護與資料交接。
summaryEn: Using the wind and structural health monitoring system on Hong Kong's Tsing Ma and neighbouring bridges, the built-in sensors of Minneapolis's new I-35W St. Anthony Falls Bridge and the strong-motion instruments on California toll bridges, explain how monitoring objectives set what is measured and where sensors go, then cover sensing principles, installation and power, data acquisition and time synchronisation, construction-stage baselines, modal identification and temperature effects, alert thresholds and false-alarm rates, and system maintenance and data handover.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：為一座教學用斜張橋規劃監測網，共 40 個加速度通道（100 Hz）、60 個應變通道（20 Hz）與 20 個溫度通道（1 Hz），每筆 4 bytes。(1) 資料率 = (40×100 + 60×20 + 20×1)×4 = 20,880 B/s，每天約 1.80 GB，每年約 659 GB。(2) 關心的最高模態約 3 Hz，若要求相位誤差 ≤ 1°，Δt ≤ 1/(360×3) ≈ 0.93 ms，一般網路校時不夠，需 GNSS 授時或 IEEE 1588 同步。(3) 以每小時判斷一次的殘差警戒，3σ 每年約 23.7 次誤報、4σ 約 0.55 次，選擇以 3σ 作為注意級、4σ 作為警告級。(4) 遠端節點耗電 5 W，需 720 Wh 電池與 50 W 太陽板。(5) 若改變一個輸入：加速度改以 200 Hz 取樣，資料率增為 36,880 B/s，每天約 3.19 GB，儲存與傳輸成本約增加 77%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的監測設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: plan a monitoring network for a teaching cable-stayed bridge with 40 acceleration channels at 100 Hz, 60 strain channels at 20 Hz and 20 temperature channels at 1 Hz, 4 bytes per sample. (1) Data rate = (40×100 + 60×20 + 20×1)×4 = 20,880 B/s, about 1.80 GB a day and about 659 GB a year. (2) The highest mode of interest is about 3 Hz; a phase error of no more than 1° needs Δt ≤ 1/(360×3) ≈ 0.93 ms, which ordinary network time cannot deliver, so GNSS timing or IEEE 1588 synchronisation is required. (3) With hourly residual checks, 3σ gives about 23.7 false alarms a year and 4σ about 0.55, so 3σ is used for the notice level and 4σ for the warning level. (4) A remote node drawing 5 W needs a 720 Wh battery and a 50 W panel. (5) Changing one input: sampling acceleration at 200 Hz raises the rate to 36,880 B/s, about 3.19 GB a day, increasing storage and transmission by about 77%. Values are teaching assumptions, not the monitoring design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「監測目的決定量測項目」與「結構反應與感測器配置」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Objectives define what to measure" and "Structural response and sensor placement": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 監測目的決定量測項目：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Objectives define what to measure: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「監測目標清單」如何影響橋梁健康監測感測網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Monitoring objectives list” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 健康監測系統不是把感測器貼滿橋，而是回答幾個具體問題：風與交通是否超過設計假設、構件應力與位移是否在預期範圍、支承與伸縮縫是否正常活動、地震或颱風後能否快速判斷可否通行。香港公路署的風與結構健康監測系統在青馬、汀九、汲水門與昂船洲橋上量測風速、溫度、構件應變、主纜與橋面位移、動態地磅與 GPS 位置，每一類量測都對應一項設計假設或維護決策。先寫出問題清單，再決定通道數，才能避免資料多卻無人使用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「監測目標清單」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A health-monitoring system is not about covering a bridge with sensors but about answering a few specific questions: do wind and traffic exceed design assumptions, are member stresses and displacements within expected ranges, are bearings and joints moving freely, and can the bridge be judged safe to reopen quickly after an earthquake or typhoon. Hong Kong Highways Department's wind and structural health monitoring system on the Tsing Ma, Ting Kau, Kap Shui Mun and Stonecutters bridges measures wind speed, temperature, member strain, cable and deck movement, weigh-in-motion loads and GPS positions, each tied to a design assumption or a maintenance decision. Writing the question list before counting channels avoids a system rich in data that nobody uses. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Monitoring objectives list” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原始資料量 = 通道數 × 取樣率 × 每筆位元組。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Raw data volume = channels × sampling rate × bytes per sample.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more sensors installed, the safer the bridge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「監測目標清單」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Monitoring objectives list”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 監測目的決定量測項目
knowledge.text: 健康監測系統不是把感測器貼滿橋，而是回答幾個具體問題：風與交通是否超過設計假設、構件應力與位移是否在預期範圍、支承與伸縮縫是否正常活動、地震或颱風後能否快速判斷可否通行。香港公路署的風與結構健康監測系統在青馬、汀九、汲水門與昂船洲橋上量測風速、溫度、構件應變、主纜與橋面位移、動態地磅與 GPS 位置，每一類量測都對應一項設計假設或維護決策。
knowledge.textEn: A health-monitoring system is not about covering a bridge with sensors but about answering a few specific questions: do wind and traffic exceed design assumptions, are member stresses and displacements within expected ranges, are bearings and joints moving freely, and can the bridge be judged safe to reopen quickly after an earthquake or typhoon. Hong Kong Highways Department's wind and structural health monitoring system on the Tsing Ma, Ting Kau, Kap Shui Mun and Stonecutters bridges measures wind speed, temperature, member strain, cable and deck movement, weigh-in-motion loads and GPS positions, each tied to a design assumption or a maintenance decision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more sensors installed, the safer the bridge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「監測目的決定量測項目」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Objectives define what to measure" is correct?
options: 感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全。
健康監測系統不是把感測器貼滿橋，而是回答幾個具體問題：風與交通是否超過設計假設、構件應力與位移是否在預期範圍、支承與伸縮縫是否正常活動、地震或颱風後能否快速判斷可否通行。
感測器裝在任何位置都能量到結構的真實狀態。
optionsEn: The more sensors installed, the safer the bridge.

A health-monitoring system is not about covering a bridge with sensors but about answering a few specific questions: do wind and traffic exceed design assumptions, are member stresses and displacements within expected ranges, are bearings and joints moving freely, and can the bridge be judged safe to reopen quickly after an earthquake or typhoon.
A sensor anywhere on the bridge measures the true structural state.
quiz.explanation: 健康監測系統不是把感測器貼滿橋，而是回答幾個具體問題：風與交通是否超過設計假設、構件應力與位移是否在預期範圍、支承與伸縮縫是否正常活動、地震或颱風後能否快速判斷可否通行。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A health-monitoring system is not about covering a bridge with sensors but about answering a few specific questions: do wind and traffic exceed design assumptions, are member stresses and displacements within expected ranges, are bearings and joints moving freely, and can the bridge be judged safe to reopen quickly after an earthquake or typhoon. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 監測目的決定量測項目：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Objectives define what to measure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「監測目標清單」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Monitoring objectives list” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原始資料量 = 通道數 × 取樣率 × 每筆位元組。350 個通道、100 Hz、4 bytes：350×100×4 = 140,000 B/s，每天 140,000×86,400 ≈ 12.1 GB，每年約 4.4 TB。若溫度與位移通道改為 1 Hz，資料量可大幅下降。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Raw data volume = channels × sampling rate × bytes per sample. With 350 channels at 100 Hz and 4 bytes, 350×100×4 = 140,000 B/s, or 140,000×86,400 ≈ 12.1 GB a day and about 4.4 TB a year. Logging temperature and displacement channels at 1 Hz instead cuts the volume sharply. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計階段把每一個監測問題對應到量測量、感測器、取樣率、警戒值與使用者，製成需求追溯表；完工驗收時逐項確認每個問題都有可用資料與負責判讀的人，沒有對應問題的通道要說明保留理由。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage, map every monitoring question to a measurand, sensor, sampling rate, threshold and user in a requirements traceability table; at acceptance, confirm item by item that each question has usable data and a named interpreter, and justify any channel that serves no question.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原始資料量 = 通道數 × 取樣率 × 每筆位元組。350 個通道、100 Hz、4 bytes：350×100×4 = 140,000 B/s，每天 140,000×86,400 ≈ 12.1 GB，每年約 4.4 TB。若溫度與位移通道改為 1 Hz，資料量可大幅下降。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Raw data volume = channels × sampling rate × bytes per sample. With 350 channels at 100 Hz and 4 bytes, 350×100×4 = 140,000 B/s, or 140,000×86,400 ≈ 12.1 GB a day and about 4.4 TB a year. Logging temperature and displacement channels at 1 Hz instead cuts the volume sharply. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「監測目的決定量測項目」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Objectives define what to measure", which statement holds?
options: 感測器是附屬設備，安裝方式不會影響結構本身。
監測系統等橋梁完工後再安裝即可，不會損失任何資訊。
原始資料量 = 通道數 × 取樣率 × 每筆位元組。
optionsEn: Sensors are accessories, so how they are mounted cannot affect the structure.
A monitoring system can be installed after completion without losing any information.
Raw data volume = channels × sampling rate × bytes per sample.
quiz.explanation: 原始資料量 = 通道數 × 取樣率 × 每筆位元組。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Raw data volume = channels × sampling rate × bytes per sample. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 監測目的決定量測項目：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Objectives define what to measure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「監測目標清單」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Monitoring objectives list” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計階段把每一個監測問題對應到量測量、感測器、取樣率、警戒值與使用者，製成需求追溯表；完工驗收時逐項確認每個問題都有可用資料與負責判讀的人，沒有對應問題的通道要說明保留理由。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage, map every monitoring question to a measurand, sensor, sampling rate, threshold and user in a requirements traceability table; at acceptance, confirm item by item that each question has usable data and a named interpreter, and justify any channel that serves no question. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測系統規格書第一章應是監測目的與決策流程，而不是設備清單；每一項量測都要寫明由誰、在多久內、根據什麼數值做出什麼決定，並由業主的橋梁管理單位簽認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The first chapter of a monitoring specification should be objectives and decision flow, not an equipment list; every measurand should state who decides what, within how long and on which value, signed off by the owner's bridge management unit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以「越多越好」佈設感測器，數年後資料庫累積數十 TB，卻沒有人定義正常範圍或警戒值；真正發生異常時，工程師在雜訊中找不到訊號，監測系統反而成為維護負擔。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Deploying sensors on the principle that more is better leaves a database of tens of terabytes after a few years with no defined normal range or threshold; when a real anomaly occurs engineers cannot find the signal in the noise, and the system becomes a maintenance burden instead of a tool. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計階段把每一個監測問題對應到量測量、感測器、取樣率、警戒值與使用者，製成需求追溯表；完工驗收時逐項確認每個問題都有可用資料與負責判讀的人，沒有對應問題的通道要說明保留理由。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage, map every monitoring question to a measurand, sensor, sampling rate, threshold and user in a requirements traceability table; at acceptance, confirm item by item that each question has usable data and a named interpreter, and justify any channel that serves no question.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測系統規格書第一章應是監測目的與決策流程，而不是設備清單；每一項量測都要寫明由誰、在多久內、根據什麼數值做出什麼決定，並由業主的橋梁管理單位簽認。
knowledge.textEn: The first chapter of a monitoring specification should be objectives and decision flow, not an equipment list; every measurand should state who decides what, within how long and on which value, signed off by the owner's bridge management unit.

quiz.question: 要驗證「監測目的決定量測項目」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Objectives define what to measure"?
options: 設計階段把每一個監測問題對應到量測量、感測器、取樣率、警戒值與使用者，製成需求追溯表。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
警戒門檻越嚴格，監測系統就越安全。
optionsEn: At design stage, map every monitoring question to a measurand, sensor, sampling rate, threshold and user in a requirements traceability table.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The stricter the alarm threshold, the safer the monitoring system.
quiz.explanation: 設計階段把每一個監測問題對應到量測量、感測器、取樣率、警戒值與使用者，製成需求追溯表；完工驗收時逐項確認每個問題都有可用資料與負責判讀的人，沒有對應問題的通道要說明保留理由。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage, map every monitoring question to a measurand, sensor, sampling rate, threshold and user in a requirements traceability table; at acceptance, confirm item by item that each question has usable data and a named interpreter, and justify any channel that serves no question. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 監測目的決定量測項目：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Objectives define what to measure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監測目標清單」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Monitoring objectives list” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以「越多越好」佈設感測器，數年後資料庫累積數十 TB，卻沒有人定義正常範圍或警戒值；真正發生異常時，工程師在雜訊中找不到訊號，監測系統反而成為維護負擔。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deploying sensors on the principle that more is better leaves a database of tens of terabytes after a few years with no defined normal range or threshold; when a real anomaly occurs engineers cannot find the signal in the noise, and the system becomes a maintenance burden instead of a tool. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：先寫出問題清單，再決定通道數，才能避免資料多卻無人使用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Writing the question list before counting channels avoids a system rich in data that nobody uses.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more sensors installed, the safer the bridge." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以「越多越好」佈設感測器，數年後資料庫累積數十 TB，卻沒有人定義正常範圍或警戒值；真正發生異常時，工程師在雜訊中找不到訊號，監測系統反而成為維護負擔。
knowledge.textEn: Deploying sensors on the principle that more is better leaves a database of tens of terabytes after a few years with no defined normal range or threshold; when a real anomaly occurs engineers cannot find the signal in the noise, and the system becomes a maintenance burden instead of a tool.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「監測目的決定量測項目」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Objectives define what to measure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只以「越多越好」佈設感測器，數年後資料庫累積數十 TB，卻沒有人定義正常範圍或警戒值；真正發生異常時，工程師在雜訊中找不到訊號，監測系統反而成為維護負擔。
感測器裝在任何位置都能量到結構的真實狀態。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Deploying sensors on the principle that more is better leaves a database of tens of terabytes after a few years with no defined normal range or threshold.
A sensor anywhere on the bridge measures the true structural state.
quiz.explanation: 只以「越多越好」佈設感測器，數年後資料庫累積數十 TB，卻沒有人定義正常範圍或警戒值；真正發生異常時，工程師在雜訊中找不到訊號，監測系統反而成為維護負擔。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Deploying sensors on the principle that more is better leaves a database of tens of terabytes after a few years with no defined normal range or threshold; when a real anomaly occurs engineers cannot find the signal in the noise, and the system becomes a maintenance burden instead of a tool. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 結構反應與感測器配置：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Structural response and sensor placement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「伸縮縫位移計量程」如何影響橋梁健康監測感測網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Expansion-joint displacement range” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 感測器位置要由預期的結構反應決定：加速度計放在主要振態振幅大的位置，以便辨識模態；應變計放在應力高或疲勞敏感的細節旁，並避開局部應力集中造成的誤判；位移計放在支承與伸縮縫，記錄溫度引起的伸縮與可能的卡死。大跨橋梁每天最大的反應往往來自溫度而非車輛，若位移計量程不足，夏季或冬季的極端值就會飽和。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「伸縮縫位移計量程」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sensor locations follow from the expected structural response: accelerometers go where the main mode shapes have large amplitude so that modes can be identified; strain gauges sit beside highly stressed or fatigue-sensitive details while avoiding misleading local stress concentrations; displacement sensors go at bearings and expansion joints to record thermal movement and possible seizure. On long-span bridges the largest daily response often comes from temperature rather than traffic, so an undersized displacement range saturates at summer or winter extremes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Expansion-joint displacement range” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器裝在任何位置都能量到結構的真實狀態。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sensor anywhere on the bridge measures the true structural state." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「伸縮縫位移計量程」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Expansion-joint displacement range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 結構反應與感測器配置
knowledge.text: 感測器位置要由預期的結構反應決定：加速度計放在主要振態振幅大的位置，以便辨識模態；應變計放在應力高或疲勞敏感的細節旁，並避開局部應力集中造成的誤判；位移計放在支承與伸縮縫，記錄溫度引起的伸縮與可能的卡死。大跨橋梁每天最大的反應往往來自溫度而非車輛，若位移計量程不足，夏季或冬季的極端值就會飽和。
knowledge.textEn: Sensor locations follow from the expected structural response: accelerometers go where the main mode shapes have large amplitude so that modes can be identified; strain gauges sit beside highly stressed or fatigue-sensitive details while avoiding misleading local stress concentrations; displacement sensors go at bearings and expansion joints to record thermal movement and possible seizure. On long-span bridges the largest daily response often comes from temperature rather than traffic, so an undersized displacement range saturates at summer or winter extremes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器裝在任何位置都能量到結構的真實狀態。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sensor anywhere on the bridge measures the true structural state. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「結構反應與感測器配置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Structural response and sensor placement" is correct?
options: 感測器裝在任何位置都能量到結構的真實狀態。
所有應變計都一樣，只要精度高就能用於任何監測目的。
感測器位置要由預期的結構反應決定：加速度計放在主要振態振幅大的位置，以便辨識模態。
optionsEn: A sensor anywhere on the bridge measures the true structural state.
All strain gauges are equivalent; any high-precision gauge suits any purpose.
Sensor locations follow from the expected structural response: accelerometers go where the main mode shapes have large amplitude so that modes can be identified.
quiz.explanation: 感測器位置要由預期的結構反應決定：加速度計放在主要振態振幅大的位置，以便辨識模態；應變計放在應力高或疲勞敏感的細節旁，並避開局部應力集中造成的誤判；位移計放在支承與伸縮縫，記錄溫度引起的伸縮與可能的卡死。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sensor locations follow from the expected structural response: accelerometers go where the main mode shapes have large amplitude so that modes can be identified; strain gauges sit beside highly stressed or fatigue-sensitive details while avoiding misleading local stress concentrations; displacement sensors go at bearings and expansion joints to record thermal movement and possible seizure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 結構反應與感測器配置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Structural response and sensor placement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伸縮縫位移計量程」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Expansion-joint displacement range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。鋼梁 α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、伸縮長度 L = 700 m、有效溫差 ΔT = 40°C：ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×700×40 ≈ 0.34 m；位移計量程至少取 ±0.4 m 並保留安裝偏差，若只選 ±0.25 m，極端季節必然飽和。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For steel with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, an expansion length L = 700 m and an effective range ΔT = 40°C, ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×700×40 ≈ 0.34 m; the displacement sensor needs at least ±0.4 m with allowance for installation offset, and a ±0.25 m unit would certainly saturate in extreme seasons. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型計算各模態振型與溫度、交通、風下的反應包絡，檢查每個感測器的量程、解析度與位置是否涵蓋預期範圍；完工後以第一年資料確認沒有通道長期飽和或反應過小而被雜訊淹沒。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute mode shapes and response envelopes under temperature, traffic and wind with the finite-element model, and check that each sensor's range, resolution and position cover the expected values; after completion, use the first year of data to confirm that no channel saturates for long periods or responds so little that noise swamps it.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。鋼梁 α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、伸縮長度 L = 700 m、有效溫差 ΔT = 40°C：ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×700×40 ≈ 0.34 m；位移計量程至少取 ±0.4 m 並保留安裝偏差，若只選 ±0.25 m，極端季節必然飽和。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For steel with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C, an expansion length L = 700 m and an effective range ΔT = 40°C, ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×700×40 ≈ 0.34 m; the displacement sensor needs at least ±0.4 m with allowance for installation offset, and a ±0.25 m unit would certainly saturate in extreme seasons. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「結構反應與感測器配置」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Structural response and sensor placement", which statement holds?
options: 伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
只要取樣率夠高，不同擷取站的資料就可以直接一起分析。
橋梁頻率下降就一定代表結構受損。
optionsEn: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
If sampling rates are high enough, data from different stations can be analysed together directly.
A drop in a bridge's frequency always means structural damage.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮量 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 結構反應與感測器配置：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Structural response and sensor placement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「伸縮縫位移計量程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Expansion-joint displacement range” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型計算各模態振型與溫度、交通、風下的反應包絡，檢查每個感測器的量程、解析度與位置是否涵蓋預期範圍；完工後以第一年資料確認沒有通道長期飽和或反應過小而被雜訊淹沒。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute mode shapes and response envelopes under temperature, traffic and wind with the finite-element model, and check that each sensor's range, resolution and position cover the expected values; after completion, use the first year of data to confirm that no channel saturates for long periods or responds so little that noise swamps it. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：感測器配置圖要同時標示模態振型、預期反應量與量程，並為每個關鍵量測安排至少一個冗餘通道；配置變更必須經設計者確認，不可因施工方便而自行移位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The sensor layout drawing should show mode shapes, expected responses and ranges together, with at least one redundant channel for every key measurand; any relocation needs the designer's approval and must not be made just for construction convenience.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：應變計若貼在焊趾或開孔邊緣的局部應力集中處，讀數遠高於構件平均應力，容易觸發誤報；加速度計若剛好放在某一模態的節點附近，該模態在資料中幾乎看不見，識別結果會漏掉重要振態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A strain gauge placed at a weld toe or hole edge reads far above the member's average stress and triggers false alarms; an accelerometer placed near a node of a mode makes that mode almost invisible in the data, so identification misses an important mode. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以有限元素模型計算各模態振型與溫度、交通、風下的反應包絡，檢查每個感測器的量程、解析度與位置是否涵蓋預期範圍；完工後以第一年資料確認沒有通道長期飽和或反應過小而被雜訊淹沒。
knowledge.textEn: Compute mode shapes and response envelopes under temperature, traffic and wind with the finite-element model, and check that each sensor's range, resolution and position cover the expected values; after completion, use the first year of data to confirm that no channel saturates for long periods or responds so little that noise swamps it.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 感測器配置圖要同時標示模態振型、預期反應量與量程，並為每個關鍵量測安排至少一個冗餘通道；配置變更必須經設計者確認，不可因施工方便而自行移位。
knowledge.textEn: The sensor layout drawing should show mode shapes, expected responses and ranges together, with at least one redundant channel for every key measurand; any relocation needs the designer's approval and must not be made just for construction convenience.

quiz.question: 要驗證「結構反應與感測器配置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Structural response and sensor placement"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以有限元素模型計算各模態振型與溫度、交通、風下的反應包絡，檢查每個感測器的量程、解析度與位置是否涵蓋預期範圍。
監測系統一旦建置完成，就能自動運作數十年。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Compute mode shapes and response envelopes under temperature, traffic and wind with the finite-element model, and check that each sensor's range, resolution and position cover the expected values.
Once built, a monitoring system runs itself for decades.
quiz.explanation: 以有限元素模型計算各模態振型與溫度、交通、風下的反應包絡，檢查每個感測器的量程、解析度與位置是否涵蓋預期範圍；完工後以第一年資料確認沒有通道長期飽和或反應過小而被雜訊淹沒。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute mode shapes and response envelopes under temperature, traffic and wind with the finite-element model, and check that each sensor's range, resolution and position cover the expected values; after completion, use the first year of data to confirm that no channel saturates for long periods or responds so little that noise swamps it. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 結構反應與感測器配置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Structural response and sensor placement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伸縮縫位移計量程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Expansion-joint displacement range” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 應變計若貼在焊趾或開孔邊緣的局部應力集中處，讀數遠高於構件平均應力，容易觸發誤報；加速度計若剛好放在某一模態的節點附近，該模態在資料中幾乎看不見，識別結果會漏掉重要振態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A strain gauge placed at a weld toe or hole edge reads far above the member's average stress and triggers false alarms; an accelerometer placed near a node of a mode makes that mode almost invisible in the data, so identification misses an important mode. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大跨橋梁每天最大的反應往往來自溫度而非車輛，若位移計量程不足，夏季或冬季的極端值就會飽和。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: On long-span bridges the largest daily response often comes from temperature rather than traffic, so an undersized displacement range saturates at summer or winter extremes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器裝在任何位置都能量到結構的真實狀態。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sensor anywhere on the bridge measures the true structural state." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 應變計若貼在焊趾或開孔邊緣的局部應力集中處，讀數遠高於構件平均應力，容易觸發誤報；加速度計若剛好放在某一模態的節點附近，該模態在資料中幾乎看不見，識別結果會漏掉重要振態。
knowledge.textEn: A strain gauge placed at a weld toe or hole edge reads far above the member's average stress and triggers false alarms; an accelerometer placed near a node of a mode makes that mode almost invisible in the data, so identification misses an important mode.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「結構反應與感測器配置」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Structural response and sensor placement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
所有應變計都一樣，只要精度高就能用於任何監測目的。
應變計若貼在焊趾或開孔邊緣的局部應力集中處，讀數遠高於構件平均應力，容易觸發誤報。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
All strain gauges are equivalent; any high-precision gauge suits any purpose.
A strain gauge placed at a weld toe or hole edge reads far above the member's average stress and triggers false alarms.
quiz.explanation: 應變計若貼在焊趾或開孔邊緣的局部應力集中處，讀數遠高於構件平均應力，容易觸發誤報；加速度計若剛好放在某一模態的節點附近，該模態在資料中幾乎看不見，識別結果會漏掉重要振態。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A strain gauge placed at a weld toe or hole edge reads far above the member's average stress and triggers false alarms; an accelerometer placed near a node of a mode makes that mode almost invisible in the data, so identification misses an important mode. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「感測器類型與量測原理」與「安裝、供電與環境防護」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sensor types and measuring principles" and "Installation, power and environmental protection": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 感測器類型與量測原理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sensor types and measuring principles: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「振弦式應變計與光纖光柵」如何影響橋梁健康監測感測網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vibrating-wire and FBG gauges” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.

steps.title: 感測器類型與量測原理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sensor types and measuring principles: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「振弦式應變計與光纖光柵」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vibrating-wire and FBG gauges” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光纖光柵 Δλ/λ ≈ (1 − p_e)·ε + (溫度項)。λ = 1,550 nm、p_e = 0.22：應變靈敏度 ≈ 0.78×1,550 nm = 1.21 pm/με，100 με 約移動 121 pm。若溫度靈敏度約 10 pm/°C，1°C 就相當於約 8.3 με 的假應變，必須以無應變參考光柵扣除。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a fibre Bragg grating, Δλ/λ ≈ (1 − p_e)·ε + (temperature term). With λ = 1,550 nm and p_e = 0.22, strain sensitivity ≈ 0.78×1,550 nm = 1.21 pm/με, so 100 με shifts it by about 121 pm. If temperature sensitivity is about 10 pm/°C, 1°C mimics about 8.3 με of false strain, which must be removed with a strain-free reference grating. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每支感測器出廠附校正證書，安裝前抽樣在實驗室複驗靈敏度與溫度係數；現場以已知溫度變化或標定載重檢查讀數方向與量級是否合理，並把校正係數、序號與安裝位置一同寫入資料庫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Every sensor ships with a calibration certificate, and samples are re-checked in the laboratory for sensitivity and temperature coefficient before installation; on site, check sign and magnitude against a known temperature change or calibration load, and store calibration factors, serial numbers and locations together in the database.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: For a fibre Bragg grating, Δλ/λ ≈ (1 − p_e)·ε + (temperature term). With λ = 1,550 nm and p_e = 0.22, strain sensitivity ≈ 0.78×1,550 nm = 1.21 pm/με, so 100 με shifts it by about 121 pm. If temperature sensitivity is about 10 pm/°C, 1°C mimics about 8.3 με of false strain, which must be removed with a strain-free reference grating. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 感測器類型與量測原理：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sensor types and measuring principles: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「振弦式應變計與光纖光柵」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vibrating-wire and FBG gauges” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每支感測器出廠附校正證書，安裝前抽樣在實驗室複驗靈敏度與溫度係數；現場以已知溫度變化或標定載重檢查讀數方向與量級是否合理，並把校正係數、序號與安裝位置一同寫入資料庫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Every sensor ships with a calibration certificate, and samples are re-checked in the laboratory for sensitivity and temperature coefficient before installation; on site, check sign and magnitude against a known temperature change or calibration load, and store calibration factors, serial numbers and locations together in the database. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書應依量測目的指定感測原理、長期穩定性、溫度補償方式與取樣率，而不只寫精度；同一量測量混用不同原理時，要在資料庫中標示並建立換算與比對程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should define sensing principle, long-term stability, temperature compensation and sampling rate by purpose, not just accuracy; where different principles measure the same quantity, flag them in the database and set up a conversion and comparison procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未做溫度補償的光纖光柵在日夜溫差下顯示數十微應變的變化，被誤判為結構應力變化；用箔式應變計量測多年的混凝土潛變，則會把感測器漂移當成結構行為。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An uncompensated fibre Bragg grating shows tens of microstrain of day–night change that is mistaken for structural stress; using foil gauges to follow concrete creep for years mistakes sensor drift for structural behaviour. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instructionEn: An uncompensated fibre Bragg grating shows tens of microstrain of day–night change that is mistaken for structural stress; using foil gauges to follow concrete creep for years mistakes sensor drift for structural behaviour. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：加速度計、風速計、GNSS 接收器與傾斜儀則分別處理振動、風場、絕對位移與轉角。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Accelerometers, anemometers, GNSS receivers and tiltmeters cover vibration, wind, absolute displacement and rotation respectively.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有應變計都一樣，只要精度高就能用於任何監測目的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.title: 安裝、供電與環境防護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Installation, power and environmental protection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「感測器底座、纜線與防雷」如何影響橋梁健康監測感測網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mounts, cabling and surge protection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋梁感測器要在鹽霧、紫外線、振動與雷擊環境下工作數十年，安裝細部常比感測器本身更決定壽命：底座要與結構可靠接合又不損傷防蝕塗層，纜線要沿可檢修的線槽佈設並有應力釋放，戶外箱體要有足夠防護等級，並以等電位接地與突波保護避免雷擊沿纜線進入擷取設備。遠離電源的位置常用太陽能與電池供電，必須以最不利季節計算能量平衡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「感測器底座、纜線與防雷」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bridge sensors must work for decades amid salt spray, ultraviolet light, vibration and lightning, and installation details often govern life more than the sensor itself: mounts must bond reliably without damaging the corrosion protection, cables must run in maintainable trays with strain relief, outdoor enclosures need an adequate protection rating, and equipotential bonding with surge protection keeps lightning from travelling along cables into the acquisition hardware. Remote locations are often solar and battery powered, so the energy balance must be checked for the least favourable season. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Mounts, cabling and surge protection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：某遠端節點耗電 5 W，每天 5×24 = 120 Wh；要求 3 天無日照自主、電池放電深度 50%，電池容量 120×3/0.5 = 720 Wh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A remote node draws 5 W, so it uses 5×24 = 120 Wh a day; with 3 days of autonomy without sun and 50% depth of discharge the battery needs 120×3/0.5 = 720 Wh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器是附屬設備，安裝方式不會影響結構本身。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sensors are accessories, so how they are mounted cannot affect the structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「感測器底座、纜線與防雷」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Mounts, cabling and surge protection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝、供電與環境防護
knowledge.text: 橋梁感測器要在鹽霧、紫外線、振動與雷擊環境下工作數十年，安裝細部常比感測器本身更決定壽命：底座要與結構可靠接合又不損傷防蝕塗層，纜線要沿可檢修的線槽佈設並有應力釋放，戶外箱體要有足夠防護等級，並以等電位接地與突波保護避免雷擊沿纜線進入擷取設備。遠離電源的位置常用太陽能與電池供電，必須以最不利季節計算能量平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Bridge sensors must work for decades amid salt spray, ultraviolet light, vibration and lightning, and installation details often govern life more than the sensor itself: mounts must bond reliably without damaging the corrosion protection, cables must run in maintainable trays with strain relief, outdoor enclosures need an adequate protection rating, and equipotential bonding with surge protection keeps lightning from travelling along cables into the acquisition hardware. Remote locations are often solar and battery powered, so the energy balance must be checked for the least favourable season.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器是附屬設備，安裝方式不會影響結構本身。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sensors are accessories, so how they are mounted cannot affect the structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝、供電與環境防護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Installation, power and environmental protection" is correct?
options: 感測器是附屬設備，安裝方式不會影響結構本身。
橋梁感測器要在鹽霧、紫外線、振動與雷擊環境下工作數十年，安裝細部常比感測器本身更決定壽命：底座要與結構可靠接合又不損傷防蝕塗層，纜線要沿可檢修的線槽佈設並有應力釋放，戶外箱體要有足夠防護等級，並以等電位接地與突波保護避免雷擊沿纜線進入擷取設備。
只要取樣率夠高，不同擷取站的資料就可以直接一起分析。
optionsEn: Sensors are accessories, so how they are mounted cannot affect the structure.

Bridge sensors must work for decades amid salt spray, ultraviolet light, vibration and lightning, and installation details often govern life more than the sensor itself: mounts must bond reliably without damaging the corrosion protection, cables must run in maintainable trays with strain relief, outdoor enclosures need an adequate protection rating, and equipotential bonding with surge protection keeps lightning from travelling along cables into the acquisition hardware.
If sampling rates are high enough, data from different stations can be analysed together directly.
quiz.explanation: 橋梁感測器要在鹽霧、紫外線、振動與雷擊環境下工作數十年，安裝細部常比感測器本身更決定壽命：底座要與結構可靠接合又不損傷防蝕塗層，纜線要沿可檢修的線槽佈設並有應力釋放，戶外箱體要有足夠防護等級，並以等電位接地與突波保護避免雷擊沿纜線進入擷取設備。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bridge sensors must work for decades amid salt spray, ultraviolet light, vibration and lightning, and installation details often govern life more than the sensor itself: mounts must bond reliably without damaging the corrosion protection, cables must run in maintainable trays with strain relief, outdoor enclosures need an adequate protection rating, and equipotential bonding with surge protection keeps lightning from travelling along cables into the acquisition hardware. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝、供電與環境防護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Installation, power and environmental protection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測器底座、纜線與防雷」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mounts, cabling and surge protection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：某遠端節點耗電 5 W，每天 5×24 = 120 Wh；要求 3 天無日照自主、電池放電深度 50%，電池容量 120×3/0.5 = 720 Wh。冬季日照 4 峰值小時、系統效率 0.7，太陽板功率 120/(4×0.7) ≈ 43 W，取 50 W。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A remote node draws 5 W, so it uses 5×24 = 120 Wh a day; with 3 days of autonomy without sun and 50% depth of discharge the battery needs 120×3/0.5 = 720 Wh. With 4 peak sun hours in winter and 0.7 system efficiency, the panel needs 120/(4×0.7) ≈ 43 W, so 50 W is chosen. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝後逐一量測接地電阻、纜線絕緣與每個通道的雜訊底線，並拍照記錄底座、方向與纜線路徑；供電系統則在第一個冬季檢查電池最低電壓與資料缺漏時段，確認能量平衡假設成立。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After installation, measure grounding resistance, cable insulation and the noise floor of every channel, and photograph mounts, orientations and cable routes; for power, check minimum battery voltage and data gaps during the first winter to confirm the energy-balance assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 某遠端節點耗電 5 W，每天 5×24 = 120 Wh；要求 3 天無日照自主、電池放電深度 50%，電池容量 120×3/0.5 = 720 Wh。冬季日照 4 峰值小時、系統效率 0.7，太陽板功率 120/(4×0.7) ≈ 43 W，取 50 W。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A remote node draws 5 W, so it uses 5×24 = 120 Wh a day; with 3 days of autonomy without sun and 50% depth of discharge the battery needs 120×3/0.5 = 720 Wh. With 4 peak sun hours in winter and 0.7 system efficiency, the panel needs 120/(4×0.7) ≈ 43 W, so 50 W is chosen. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝、供電與環境防護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Installation, power and environmental protection", which statement holds?
options: 橋梁頻率下降就一定代表結構受損。
監測系統一旦建置完成，就能自動運作數十年。
某遠端節點耗電 5 W，每天 5×24 = 120 Wh；要求 3 天無日照自主、電池放電深度 50%，電池容量 120×3/0.5 = 720 Wh。
optionsEn: A drop in a bridge's frequency always means structural damage.
Once built, a monitoring system runs itself for decades.
A remote node draws 5 W, so it uses 5×24 = 120 Wh a day; with 3 days of autonomy without sun and 50% depth of discharge the battery needs 120×3/0.5 = 720 Wh.
quiz.explanation: 某遠端節點耗電 5 W，每天 5×24 = 120 Wh；要求 3 天無日照自主、電池放電深度 50%，電池容量 120×3/0.5 = 720 Wh。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A remote node draws 5 W, so it uses 5×24 = 120 Wh a day; with 3 days of autonomy without sun and 50% depth of discharge the battery needs 120×3/0.5 = 720 Wh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝、供電與環境防護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Installation, power and environmental protection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「感測器底座、纜線與防雷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mounts, cabling and surge protection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝後逐一量測接地電阻、纜線絕緣與每個通道的雜訊底線，並拍照記錄底座、方向與纜線路徑；供電系統則在第一個冬季檢查電池最低電壓與資料缺漏時段，確認能量平衡假設成立。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After installation, measure grounding resistance, cable insulation and the noise floor of every channel, and photograph mounts, orientations and cable routes; for power, check minimum battery voltage and data gaps during the first winter to confirm the energy-balance assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：感測器在鋼構件上的固定方式須經結構工程師核准，受拉區優先採用夾具或黏著而非焊接；所有箱體與纜線路徑都要留檢修通道，並納入橋梁檢查路線，讓監測設備與結構一起被檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mounting methods on steel members need the structural engineer's approval, preferring clamps or adhesives to welding in tension zones; every enclosure and cable route needs maintenance access and should be on the bridge inspection route so the monitoring hardware is inspected along with the structure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器底座直接以焊接固定在鋼構件上，會在受拉翼板留下不良焊接細節而成為疲勞起點；纜線未做應力釋放，在橋面振動下數年就疲勞斷線；雷擊沒有突波保護，一次就可能燒毀整個擷取站。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Welding sensor mounts directly onto steel members leaves poor welded details on tension flanges that become fatigue origins; cables without strain relief break by fatigue under deck vibration within a few years; without surge protection, one lightning strike can destroy a whole acquisition station. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝後逐一量測接地電阻、纜線絕緣與每個通道的雜訊底線，並拍照記錄底座、方向與纜線路徑；供電系統則在第一個冬季檢查電池最低電壓與資料缺漏時段，確認能量平衡假設成立。
knowledge.textEn: After installation, measure grounding resistance, cable insulation and the noise floor of every channel, and photograph mounts, orientations and cable routes; for power, check minimum battery voltage and data gaps during the first winter to confirm the energy-balance assumptions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 感測器在鋼構件上的固定方式須經結構工程師核准，受拉區優先採用夾具或黏著而非焊接；所有箱體與纜線路徑都要留檢修通道，並納入橋梁檢查路線，讓監測設備與結構一起被檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Mounting methods on steel members need the structural engineer's approval, preferring clamps or adhesives to welding in tension zones; every enclosure and cable route needs maintenance access and should be on the bridge inspection route so the monitoring hardware is inspected along with the structure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝、供電與環境防護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Installation, power and environmental protection"?
options: 安裝後逐一量測接地電阻、纜線絕緣與每個通道的雜訊底線，並拍照記錄底座、方向與纜線路徑。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全。
optionsEn: After installation, measure grounding resistance, cable insulation and the noise floor of every channel, and photograph mounts, orientations and cable routes.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The more sensors installed, the safer the bridge.
quiz.explanation: 安裝後逐一量測接地電阻、纜線絕緣與每個通道的雜訊底線，並拍照記錄底座、方向與纜線路徑；供電系統則在第一個冬季檢查電池最低電壓與資料缺漏時段，確認能量平衡假設成立。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After installation, measure grounding resistance, cable insulation and the noise floor of every channel, and photograph mounts, orientations and cable routes; for power, check minimum battery voltage and data gaps during the first winter to confirm the energy-balance assumptions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝、供電與環境防護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Installation, power and environmental protection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「感測器底座、纜線與防雷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mounts, cabling and surge protection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器底座直接以焊接固定在鋼構件上，會在受拉翼板留下不良焊接細節而成為疲勞起點；纜線未做應力釋放，在橋面振動下數年就疲勞斷線；雷擊沒有突波保護，一次就可能燒毀整個擷取站。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Welding sensor mounts directly onto steel members leaves poor welded details on tension flanges that become fatigue origins; cables without strain relief break by fatigue under deck vibration within a few years; without surge protection, one lightning strike can destroy a whole acquisition station. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：遠離電源的位置常用太陽能與電池供電，必須以最不利季節計算能量平衡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Remote locations are often solar and battery powered, so the energy balance must be checked for the least favourable season.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器是附屬設備，安裝方式不會影響結構本身。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sensors are accessories, so how they are mounted cannot affect the structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 感測器底座直接以焊接固定在鋼構件上，會在受拉翼板留下不良焊接細節而成為疲勞起點；纜線未做應力釋放，在橋面振動下數年就疲勞斷線；雷擊沒有突波保護，一次就可能燒毀整個擷取站。
knowledge.textEn: Welding sensor mounts directly onto steel members leaves poor welded details on tension flanges that become fatigue origins; cables without strain relief break by fatigue under deck vibration within a few years; without surge protection, one lightning strike can destroy a whole acquisition station.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝、供電與環境防護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Installation, power and environmental protection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
感測器底座直接以焊接固定在鋼構件上，會在受拉翼板留下不良焊接細節而成為疲勞起點。
只要取樣率夠高，不同擷取站的資料就可以直接一起分析。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Welding sensor mounts directly onto steel members leaves poor welded details on tension flanges that become fatigue origins.
If sampling rates are high enough, data from different stations can be analysed together directly.
quiz.explanation: 感測器底座直接以焊接固定在鋼構件上，會在受拉翼板留下不良焊接細節而成為疲勞起點；纜線未做應力釋放，在橋面振動下數年就疲勞斷線；雷擊沒有突波保護，一次就可能燒毀整個擷取站。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Welding sensor mounts directly onto steel members leaves poor welded details on tension flanges that become fatigue origins; cables without strain relief break by fatigue under deck vibration within a few years; without surge protection, one lightning strike can destroy a whole acquisition station. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「資料擷取、取樣與時間同步」與「施工期安裝與基準值建立」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Data acquisition, sampling and time synchronisation" and "Installation during construction and baselines": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 資料擷取、取樣與時間同步：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Data acquisition, sampling and time synchronisation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「資料擷取站與時間同步」如何影響橋梁健康監測感測網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acquisition stations and time sync” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 分散在全橋的擷取站把類比訊號經抗混疊濾波與類比數位轉換變成數位資料，再傳回控制中心。取樣率要高於關心頻率的兩倍以上並配合濾波器，否則高頻振動會混疊成假的低頻成分。更容易被忽略的是時間同步：模態振型由不同位置加速度的相位關係決定，各站時鐘若相差數十毫秒，振型就會扭曲；因此長橋常以 GNSS 授時或 IEEE 1588 精確時間協定同步各站。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「資料擷取站與時間同步」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acquisition stations distributed along the bridge pass analogue signals through anti-aliasing filters and analogue-to-digital converters and send the data to a control centre. Sampling must exceed twice the highest frequency of interest, with matching filters, or high-frequency vibration aliases into false low-frequency content. Time synchronisation is more easily overlooked: mode shapes come from phase relations between accelerations at different locations, so station clocks that differ by tens of milliseconds distort them; long bridges therefore synchronise stations by GNSS timing or the IEEE 1588 precision time protocol. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Acquisition stations and time sync” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：時間誤差造成的相位誤差 Δφ = 360°×f×Δt。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Phase error from a timing offset is Δφ = 360°×f×Δt.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要取樣率夠高，不同擷取站的資料就可以直接一起分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If sampling rates are high enough, data from different stations can be analysed together directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「資料擷取站與時間同步」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Acquisition stations and time sync”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資料擷取、取樣與時間同步
knowledge.titleEn: Data acquisition, sampling and time synchronisation
knowledge.text: 分散在全橋的擷取站把類比訊號經抗混疊濾波與類比數位轉換變成數位資料，再傳回控制中心。取樣率要高於關心頻率的兩倍以上並配合濾波器，否則高頻振動會混疊成假的低頻成分。
knowledge.textEn: Acquisition stations distributed along the bridge pass analogue signals through anti-aliasing filters and analogue-to-digital converters and send the data to a control centre. Sampling must exceed twice the highest frequency of interest, with matching filters, or high-frequency vibration aliases into false low-frequency content.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要取樣率夠高，不同擷取站的資料就可以直接一起分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If sampling rates are high enough, data from different stations can be analysed together directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資料擷取、取樣與時間同步」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Data acquisition, sampling and time synchronisation" is correct?
options: 只要取樣率夠高，不同擷取站的資料就可以直接一起分析。
監測系統等橋梁完工後再安裝即可，不會損失任何資訊。
分散在全橋的擷取站把類比訊號經抗混疊濾波與類比數位轉換變成數位資料，再傳回控制中心。
optionsEn: If sampling rates are high enough, data from different stations can be analysed together directly.
A monitoring system can be installed after completion without losing any information.
Acquisition stations distributed along the bridge pass analogue signals through anti-aliasing filters and analogue-to-digital converters and send the data to a control centre.
quiz.explanation: 分散在全橋的擷取站把類比訊號經抗混疊濾波與類比數位轉換變成數位資料，再傳回控制中心。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acquisition stations distributed along the bridge pass analogue signals through anti-aliasing filters and analogue-to-digital converters and send the data to a control centre. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資料擷取、取樣與時間同步：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Data acquisition, sampling and time synchronisation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資料擷取站與時間同步」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acquisition stations and time sync” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：時間誤差造成的相位誤差 Δφ = 360°×f×Δt。f = 2 Hz 的模態、Δt = 5 ms：Δφ = 360×2×0.005 = 3.6°；若只靠一般網路校時、Δt = 50 ms，Δφ = 36°，相鄰測點同相或反相都可能判錯。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Phase error from a timing offset is Δφ = 360°×f×Δt. For a 2 Hz mode and Δt = 5 ms, Δφ = 360×2×0.005 = 3.6°; relying on ordinary network time with Δt = 50 ms gives Δφ = 36°, enough to misjudge whether neighbouring points move in or out of phase. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收時把兩站的感測器並排放在同一振動源上，比較兩通道的相位差，確認時間同步誤差在規格內；同時以已知頻率的訊號檢查抗混疊濾波與取樣率設定，並檢查資料封包缺漏率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At acceptance, place sensors from two stations side by side on one vibration source and compare their phase to confirm that the synchronisation error is within specification; also check anti-aliasing filters and sampling settings with a known-frequency signal, and measure the packet-loss rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 時間誤差造成的相位誤差 Δφ = 360°×f×Δt。f = 2 Hz 的模態、Δt = 5 ms：Δφ = 360×2×0.005 = 3.6°；若只靠一般網路校時、Δt = 50 ms，Δφ = 36°，相鄰測點同相或反相都可能判錯。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Phase error from a timing offset is Δφ = 360°×f×Δt. For a 2 Hz mode and Δt = 5 ms, Δφ = 360×2×0.005 = 3.6°; relying on ordinary network time with Δt = 50 ms gives Δφ = 36°, enough to misjudge whether neighbouring points move in or out of phase. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資料擷取、取樣與時間同步」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Data acquisition, sampling and time synchronisation", which statement holds?
options: 時間誤差造成的相位誤差 Δφ = 360°×f×Δt。
警戒門檻越嚴格，監測系統就越安全。
只要每年有一份監測報告，資料本身就不需要保存。
optionsEn: Phase error from a timing offset is Δφ = 360°×f×Δt.
The stricter the alarm threshold, the safer the monitoring system.
As long as there is an annual monitoring report, the data themselves need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 時間誤差造成的相位誤差 Δφ = 360°×f×Δt。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Phase error from a timing offset is Δφ = 360°×f×Δt. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資料擷取、取樣與時間同步：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Data acquisition, sampling and time synchronisation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資料擷取站與時間同步」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Acquisition stations and time sync” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 驗收時把兩站的感測器並排放在同一振動源上，比較兩通道的相位差，確認時間同步誤差在規格內；同時以已知頻率的訊號檢查抗混疊濾波與取樣率設定，並檢查資料封包缺漏率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At acceptance, place sensors from two stations side by side on one vibration source and compare their phase to confirm that the synchronisation error is within specification; also check anti-aliasing filters and sampling settings with a known-frequency signal, and measure the packet-loss rate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要寫明各通道取樣率、濾波器、類比數位轉換解析度與時間同步精度，並要求系統記錄每筆資料的時間來源與同步狀態；同步失效時資料仍要保存，但必須加上旗標供分析者排除。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should state each channel's sampling rate, filter, converter resolution and time-synchronisation accuracy, and require the system to log the time source and sync status of every record; data recorded during a sync failure must still be kept but flagged so analysts can exclude it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若擷取站之間沒有可靠的時間同步，模態識別得到的振型在主跨中央出現不合理的扭轉或反相；地震事件時各站觸發時間不一致，也會讓事後的波傳與反應分析失去意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without reliable synchronisation between stations, identified mode shapes show implausible twisting or phase reversals at midspan; in an earthquake, inconsistent trigger times across stations make later wave-propagation and response analyses meaningless. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 驗收時把兩站的感測器並排放在同一振動源上，比較兩通道的相位差，確認時間同步誤差在規格內；同時以已知頻率的訊號檢查抗混疊濾波與取樣率設定，並檢查資料封包缺漏率。
knowledge.textEn: At acceptance, place sensors from two stations side by side on one vibration source and compare their phase to confirm that the synchronisation error is within specification; also check anti-aliasing filters and sampling settings with a known-frequency signal, and measure the packet-loss rate.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書要寫明各通道取樣率、濾波器、類比數位轉換解析度與時間同步精度，並要求系統記錄每筆資料的時間來源與同步狀態；同步失效時資料仍要保存，但必須加上旗標供分析者排除。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should state each channel's sampling rate, filter, converter resolution and time-synchronisation accuracy, and require the system to log the time source and sync status of every record; data recorded during a sync failure must still be kept but flagged so analysts can exclude it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資料擷取、取樣與時間同步」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Data acquisition, sampling and time synchronisation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
驗收時把兩站的感測器並排放在同一振動源上，比較兩通道的相位差，確認時間同步誤差在規格內；同時以已知頻率的訊號檢查抗混疊濾波與取樣率設定，並檢查資料封包缺漏率。
感測器裝在任何位置都能量到結構的真實狀態。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
At acceptance, place sensors from two stations side by side on one vibration source and compare their phase to confirm that the synchronisation error is within specification.
A sensor anywhere on the bridge measures the true structural state.
quiz.explanation: 驗收時把兩站的感測器並排放在同一振動源上，比較兩通道的相位差，確認時間同步誤差在規格內；同時以已知頻率的訊號檢查抗混疊濾波與取樣率設定，並檢查資料封包缺漏率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At acceptance, place sensors from two stations side by side on one vibration source and compare their phase to confirm that the synchronisation error is within specification; also check anti-aliasing filters and sampling settings with a known-frequency signal, and measure the packet-loss rate. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資料擷取、取樣與時間同步：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Data acquisition, sampling and time synchronisation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資料擷取站與時間同步」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Acquisition stations and time sync” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若擷取站之間沒有可靠的時間同步，模態識別得到的振型在主跨中央出現不合理的扭轉或反相；地震事件時各站觸發時間不一致，也會讓事後的波傳與反應分析失去意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without reliable synchronisation between stations, identified mode shapes show implausible twisting or phase reversals at midspan; in an earthquake, inconsistent trigger times across stations make later wave-propagation and response analyses meaningless. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：更容易被忽略的是時間同步：模態振型由不同位置加速度的相位關係決定，各站時鐘若相差數十毫秒，振型就會扭曲；因此長橋常以 GNSS 授時或 IEEE 1588 精確時間協定同步各站。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Time synchronisation is more easily overlooked: mode shapes come from phase relations between accelerations at different locations, so station clocks that differ by tens of milliseconds distort them; long bridges therefore synchronise stations by GNSS timing or the IEEE 1588 precision time protocol.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要取樣率夠高，不同擷取站的資料就可以直接一起分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If sampling rates are high enough, data from different stations can be analysed together directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若擷取站之間沒有可靠的時間同步，模態識別得到的振型在主跨中央出現不合理的扭轉或反相；地震事件時各站觸發時間不一致，也會讓事後的波傳與反應分析失去意義。
knowledge.textEn: Without reliable synchronisation between stations, identified mode shapes show implausible twisting or phase reversals at midspan; in an earthquake, inconsistent trigger times across stations make later wave-propagation and response analyses meaningless.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資料擷取、取樣與時間同步」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Data acquisition, sampling and time synchronisation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
監測系統等橋梁完工後再安裝即可，不會損失任何資訊。
若擷取站之間沒有可靠的時間同步，模態識別得到的振型在主跨中央出現不合理的扭轉或反相；地震事件時各站觸發時間不一致，也會讓事後的波傳與反應分析失去意義。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A monitoring system can be installed after completion without losing any information.
Without reliable synchronisation between stations, identified mode shapes show implausible twisting or phase reversals at midspan.
quiz.explanation: 若擷取站之間沒有可靠的時間同步，模態識別得到的振型在主跨中央出現不合理的扭轉或反相；地震事件時各站觸發時間不一致，也會讓事後的波傳與反應分析失去意義。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without reliable synchronisation between stations, identified mode shapes show implausible twisting or phase reversals at midspan; in an earthquake, inconsistent trigger times across stations make later wave-propagation and response analyses meaningless. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工期安裝與基準值建立：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Installation during construction and baselines: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「零點讀數與施工期基準」如何影響橋梁健康監測感測網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Zero readings and construction baseline” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 很多重要的應變與變形發生在施工期間：預力張拉、合龍、鋪面加載與混凝土早期收縮。感測器若在施工中就埋設並記錄零點，監測系統能看到構件從無應力到使用狀態的完整歷程；若等到完工才安裝，只能量到之後的變化。2007 年 I-35W 舊橋倒塌後，明尼蘇達州交通部以設計施工統包在 339 天內完成新橋，並把感測與監測系統直接建在橋內，作為百年設計壽命期間的監測基礎。完工時再以環境振動或載重試驗建立第一組基準值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「零點讀數與施工期基準」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Many important strains and deformations occur during construction: post-tensioning, closure, surfacing loads and early concrete shrinkage. If sensors are embedded during construction with recorded zero readings, the system sees the whole history from unstressed to service state; installed only after completion, they can measure only later changes. After the 2007 collapse of the old I-35W bridge, MnDOT delivered the new bridge by design–build in 339 days with a sensor and monitoring system built into the structure as the basis for monitoring over its 100-year design life. At completion, ambient vibration or a load test sets the first baseline. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Zero readings and construction baseline” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預力造成的平均壓應變 ε = P/(A·E_c)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mean compressive strain from prestress is ε = P/(A·E_c).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「監測系統等橋梁完工後再安裝即可，不會損失任何資訊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A monitoring system can be installed after completion without losing any information." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「零點讀數與施工期基準」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Zero readings and construction baseline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工期安裝與基準值建立
knowledge.text: 很多重要的應變與變形發生在施工期間：預力張拉、合龍、鋪面加載與混凝土早期收縮。感測器若在施工中就埋設並記錄零點，監測系統能看到構件從無應力到使用狀態的完整歷程；若等到完工才安裝，只能量到之後的變化。
knowledge.textEn: Many important strains and deformations occur during construction: post-tensioning, closure, surfacing loads and early concrete shrinkage. If sensors are embedded during construction with recorded zero readings, the system sees the whole history from unstressed to service state; installed only after completion, they can measure only later changes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：監測系統等橋梁完工後再安裝即可，不會損失任何資訊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
