knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A monitoring system can be installed after completion without losing any information. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工期安裝與基準值建立」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Installation during construction and baselines" is correct?
options: 很多重要的應變與變形發生在施工期間：預力張拉、合龍、鋪面加載與混凝土早期收縮。
監測系統等橋梁完工後再安裝即可，不會損失任何資訊。
橋梁頻率下降就一定代表結構受損。
optionsEn: Many important strains and deformations occur during construction: post-tensioning, closure, surfacing loads and early concrete shrinkage.
A monitoring system can be installed after completion without losing any information.
A drop in a bridge's frequency always means structural damage.
quiz.explanation: 很多重要的應變與變形發生在施工期間：預力張拉、合龍、鋪面加載與混凝土早期收縮。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Many important strains and deformations occur during construction: post-tensioning, closure, surfacing loads and early concrete shrinkage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工期安裝與基準值建立：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Installation during construction and baselines: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「零點讀數與施工期基準」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Zero readings and construction baseline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預力造成的平均壓應變 ε = P/(A·E_c)。P = 50 MN、A = 10 m²、E_c = 35 GPa：ε = 50×10⁶/(10×35×10⁹) ≈ 143 με。若應變計在張拉後才歸零，資料中就永遠少了這 143 με，之後的潛變與預力損失也無法與設計值比較。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mean compressive strain from prestress is ε = P/(A·E_c). With P = 50 MN, A = 10 m² and E_c = 35 GPa, ε = 50×10⁶/(10×35×10⁹) ≈ 143 με. If gauges are zeroed after stressing, those 143 με are missing from the data forever and later creep and prestress loss cannot be compared with design values. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每支埋設感測器記錄安裝時間、零點讀數、當時溫度與施工狀態（例如張拉前、合龍後），並在每個施工里程碑讀取一次，與施工階段分析的預測值比較；差異超出預定範圍時查明是感測器問題還是結構行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record for every embedded sensor its installation time, zero reading, temperature and construction state (for example before stressing or after closure), read it at each construction milestone and compare with the predictions of the construction-stage analysis; when the difference exceeds a preset range, establish whether the sensor or the structure is responsible.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 預力造成的平均壓應變 ε = P/(A·E_c)。P = 50 MN、A = 10 m²、E_c = 35 GPa：ε = 50×10⁶/(10×35×10⁹) ≈ 143 με。若應變計在張拉後才歸零，資料中就永遠少了這 143 με，之後的潛變與預力損失也無法與設計值比較。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Mean compressive strain from prestress is ε = P/(A·E_c). With P = 50 MN, A = 10 m² and E_c = 35 GPa, ε = 50×10⁶/(10×35×10⁹) ≈ 143 με. If gauges are zeroed after stressing, those 143 με are missing from the data forever and later creep and prestress loss cannot be compared with design values. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工期安裝與基準值建立」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Installation during construction and baselines", which statement holds?
options: 監測系統一旦建置完成，就能自動運作數十年。
預力造成的平均壓應變 ε = P/(A·E_c)。
感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全。
optionsEn: Once built, a monitoring system runs itself for decades.
Mean compressive strain from prestress is ε = P/(A·E_c).
The more sensors installed, the safer the bridge.
quiz.explanation: 預力造成的平均壓應變 ε = P/(A·E_c)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean compressive strain from prestress is ε = P/(A·E_c). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工期安裝與基準值建立：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Installation during construction and baselines: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「零點讀數與施工期基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Zero readings and construction baseline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每支埋設感測器記錄安裝時間、零點讀數、當時溫度與施工狀態（例如張拉前、合龍後），並在每個施工里程碑讀取一次，與施工階段分析的預測值比較；差異超出預定範圍時查明是感測器問題還是結構行為。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record for every embedded sensor its installation time, zero reading, temperature and construction state (for example before stressing or after closure), read it at each construction milestone and compare with the predictions of the construction-stage analysis; when the difference exceeds a preset range, establish whether the sensor or the structure is responsible. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測承包商應與主體承包商共同排定埋設時程，並設置停留點：感測器埋設、讀值確認與保護完成後才可澆置；每個施工里程碑的讀值由監造簽認，作為交接基準的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The monitoring contractor and main contractor should schedule embedment together with a hold point: casting proceeds only after sensors are placed, read and protected; readings at each construction milestone are signed by the resident engineer and become part of the handover baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工中埋設的感測器若沒有保護，常在澆置、振動棒或焊接時損壞，完工後才發現三成通道失效；零點紀錄遺失則讓資料只剩相對變化，無法回答構件實際應力是多少。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Embedded sensors left unprotected are often damaged by casting, vibrators or welding, so a third of channels may be found dead at completion; a lost zero record leaves only relative changes and cannot answer what the actual member stress is. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每支埋設感測器記錄安裝時間、零點讀數、當時溫度與施工狀態（例如張拉前、合龍後），並在每個施工里程碑讀取一次，與施工階段分析的預測值比較；差異超出預定範圍時查明是感測器問題還是結構行為。
knowledge.textEn: Record for every embedded sensor its installation time, zero reading, temperature and construction state (for example before stressing or after closure), read it at each construction milestone and compare with the predictions of the construction-stage analysis; when the difference exceeds a preset range, establish whether the sensor or the structure is responsible.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測承包商應與主體承包商共同排定埋設時程，並設置停留點：感測器埋設、讀值確認與保護完成後才可澆置；每個施工里程碑的讀值由監造簽認，作為交接基準的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: The monitoring contractor and main contractor should schedule embedment together with a hold point: casting proceeds only after sensors are placed, read and protected; readings at each construction milestone are signed by the resident engineer and become part of the handover baseline.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工期安裝與基準值建立」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Installation during construction and baselines"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
所有應變計都一樣，只要精度高就能用於任何監測目的。
每支埋設感測器記錄安裝時間、零點讀數、當時溫度與施工狀態（例如張拉前、合龍後），並在每個施工里程碑讀取一次，與施工階段分析的預測值比較。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
All strain gauges are equivalent; any high-precision gauge suits any purpose.

Record for every embedded sensor its installation time, zero reading, temperature and construction state (for example before stressing or after closure), read it at each construction milestone and compare with the predictions of the construction-stage analysis.
quiz.explanation: 每支埋設感測器記錄安裝時間、零點讀數、當時溫度與施工狀態（例如張拉前、合龍後），並在每個施工里程碑讀取一次，與施工階段分析的預測值比較；差異超出預定範圍時查明是感測器問題還是結構行為。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record for every embedded sensor its installation time, zero reading, temperature and construction state (for example before stressing or after closure), read it at each construction milestone and compare with the predictions of the construction-stage analysis; when the difference exceeds a preset range, establish whether the sensor or the structure is responsible. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工期安裝與基準值建立：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Installation during construction and baselines: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「零點讀數與施工期基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Zero readings and construction baseline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工中埋設的感測器若沒有保護，常在澆置、振動棒或焊接時損壞，完工後才發現三成通道失效；零點紀錄遺失則讓資料只剩相對變化，無法回答構件實際應力是多少。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Embedded sensors left unprotected are often damaged by casting, vibrators or welding, so a third of channels may be found dead at completion; a lost zero record leaves only relative changes and cannot answer what the actual member stress is. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：完工時再以環境振動或載重試驗建立第一組基準值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At completion, ambient vibration or a load test sets the first baseline.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「監測系統等橋梁完工後再安裝即可，不會損失任何資訊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A monitoring system can be installed after completion without losing any information." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工中埋設的感測器若沒有保護，常在澆置、振動棒或焊接時損壞，完工後才發現三成通道失效；零點紀錄遺失則讓資料只剩相對變化，無法回答構件實際應力是多少。
knowledge.textEn: Embedded sensors left unprotected are often damaged by casting, vibrators or welding, so a third of channels may be found dead at completion; a lost zero record leaves only relative changes and cannot answer what the actual member stress is.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工期安裝與基準值建立」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Installation during construction and baselines" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 施工中埋設的感測器若沒有保護，常在澆置、振動棒或焊接時損壞，完工後才發現三成通道失效；零點紀錄遺失則讓資料只剩相對變化，無法回答構件實際應力是多少。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
橋梁頻率下降就一定代表結構受損。
optionsEn: Embedded sensors left unprotected are often damaged by casting, vibrators or welding, so a third of channels may be found dead at completion.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A drop in a bridge's frequency always means structural damage.
quiz.explanation: 施工中埋設的感測器若沒有保護，常在澆置、振動棒或焊接時損壞，完工後才發現三成通道失效；零點紀錄遺失則讓資料只剩相對變化，無法回答構件實際應力是多少。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Embedded sensors left unprotected are often damaged by casting, vibrators or welding, so a third of channels may be found dead at completion; a lost zero record leaves only relative changes and cannot answer what the actual member stress is. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「模態識別與環境效應分離」與「警戒值、誤報率與事件觸發」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Modal identification and environmental effects" and "Alert thresholds, false alarms and event triggers": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模態識別與環境效應分離：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Modal identification and environmental effects: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「頻率—溫度回歸」如何影響橋梁健康監測感測網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frequency–temperature regression” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 以環境振動做運轉模態分析，可以長期追蹤橋梁的頻率、振型與阻尼。但頻率不只受損傷影響：溫度改變材料模數、鋪面勁度、支承摩擦與纜索張力，季節變化常造成數個百分比的頻率漂移，往往大於中等損傷造成的變化。因此要先用一段健康期資料建立頻率與溫度等環境變數的回歸模型，之後只看扣除環境效應後的殘差，殘差持續偏離時才代表結構可能改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「頻率—溫度回歸」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Operational modal analysis of ambient vibration tracks a bridge's frequencies, mode shapes and damping over the long term. But frequency responds to more than damage: temperature changes material modulus, surfacing stiffness, bearing friction and cable tension, and seasonal changes often shift frequencies by several percent, often more than moderate damage would. A regression of frequency on temperature and other environmental variables must therefore be built from a healthy reference period; afterwards only the residual after removing environmental effects is tracked, and a persistent drift of that residual is what signals possible structural change. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Frequency–temperature regression” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：回歸 f = f₀ + k·(T − 20°C)，f₀ = 0.500 Hz、k = −0.0005 Hz/°C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Regression f = f₀ + k·(T − 20°C) with f₀ = 0.500 Hz and k = −0.0005 Hz/°C predicts f = 0.500 − 0.0005×15 = 0.4925 Hz at 35°C; a measured 0.4880 Hz leaves a residual of −0.0045 Hz (about −0.9%).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁頻率下降就一定代表結構受損。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A drop in a bridge's frequency always means structural damage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「頻率—溫度回歸」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Frequency–temperature regression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模態識別與環境效應分離
knowledge.text: 以環境振動做運轉模態分析，可以長期追蹤橋梁的頻率、振型與阻尼。但頻率不只受損傷影響：溫度改變材料模數、鋪面勁度、支承摩擦與纜索張力，季節變化常造成數個百分比的頻率漂移，往往大於中等損傷造成的變化。
knowledge.textEn: Operational modal analysis of ambient vibration tracks a bridge's frequencies, mode shapes and damping over the long term. But frequency responds to more than damage: temperature changes material modulus, surfacing stiffness, bearing friction and cable tension, and seasonal changes often shift frequencies by several percent, often more than moderate damage would.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋梁頻率下降就一定代表結構受損。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A drop in a bridge's frequency always means structural damage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模態識別與環境效應分離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Modal identification and environmental effects" is correct?
options: 橋梁頻率下降就一定代表結構受損。
以環境振動做運轉模態分析，可以長期追蹤橋梁的頻率、振型與阻尼。
警戒門檻越嚴格，監測系統就越安全。
optionsEn: A drop in a bridge's frequency always means structural damage.
Operational modal analysis of ambient vibration tracks a bridge's frequencies, mode shapes and damping over the long term.
The stricter the alarm threshold, the safer the monitoring system.
quiz.explanation: 以環境振動做運轉模態分析，可以長期追蹤橋梁的頻率、振型與阻尼。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Operational modal analysis of ambient vibration tracks a bridge's frequencies, mode shapes and damping over the long term. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模態識別與環境效應分離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Modal identification and environmental effects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻率—溫度回歸」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frequency–temperature regression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：回歸 f = f₀ + k·(T − 20°C)，f₀ = 0.500 Hz、k = −0.0005 Hz/°C。35°C 時預測 f = 0.500 − 0.0005×15 = 0.4925 Hz；實測 0.4880 Hz，殘差 −0.0045 Hz（約 −0.9%）。若健康期殘差標準差 σ = 0.0015 Hz，此值恰為 3σ。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Regression f = f₀ + k·(T − 20°C) with f₀ = 0.500 Hz and k = −0.0005 Hz/°C predicts f = 0.500 − 0.0005×15 = 0.4925 Hz at 35°C; a measured 0.4880 Hz leaves a residual of −0.0045 Hz (about −0.9%). If the residual standard deviation in the healthy period is σ = 0.0015 Hz, this equals 3σ. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以至少一整年的健康期資料涵蓋四季溫度，建立回歸並以交叉驗證檢查預測誤差；用兩種識別方法（例如頻域分解與隨機子空間）比對頻率，並把結果與完工時的載重試驗或有限元素模型比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use at least a full year of healthy-period data spanning all seasons to fit the regression and check prediction error by cross-validation; compare frequencies from two identification methods, such as frequency-domain decomposition and stochastic subspace identification, and check them against the completion load test or finite-element model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Regression f = f₀ + k·(T − 20°C) with f₀ = 0.500 Hz and k = −0.0005 Hz/°C predicts f = 0.500 − 0.0005×15 = 0.4925 Hz at 35°C; a measured 0.4880 Hz leaves a residual of −0.0045 Hz (about −0.9%). If the residual standard deviation in the healthy period is σ = 0.0015 Hz, this equals 3σ. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模態識別與環境效應分離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Modal identification and environmental effects", which statement holds?
options: 只要每年有一份監測報告，資料本身就不需要保存。
感測器裝在任何位置都能量到結構的真實狀態。
optionsEn: As long as there is an annual monitoring report, the data themselves need not be kept.
A sensor anywhere on the bridge measures the true structural state.
Regression f = f₀ + k·(T − 20°C) with f₀ = 0.500 Hz and k = −0.0005 Hz/°C predicts f = 0.500 − 0.0005×15 = 0.4925 Hz at 35°C.
quiz.explanation: 回歸 f = f₀ + k·(T − 20°C)，f₀ = 0.500 Hz、k = −0.0005 Hz/°C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Regression f = f₀ + k·(T − 20°C) with f₀ = 0.500 Hz and k = −0.0005 Hz/°C predicts f = 0.500 − 0.0005×15 = 0.4925 Hz at 35°C; a measured 0.4880 Hz leaves a residual of −0.0045 Hz (about −0.9%). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模態識別與環境效應分離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Modal identification and environmental effects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頻率—溫度回歸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Frequency–temperature regression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以至少一整年的健康期資料涵蓋四季溫度，建立回歸並以交叉驗證檢查預測誤差；用兩種識別方法（例如頻域分解與隨機子空間）比對頻率，並把結果與完工時的載重試驗或有限元素模型比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use at least a full year of healthy-period data spanning all seasons to fit the regression and check prediction error by cross-validation; compare frequencies from two identification methods, such as frequency-domain decomposition and stochastic subspace identification, and check them against the completion load test or finite-element model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：環境效應模型要隨資料累積定期更新並保留版本，警戒判斷一律使用殘差而非原始頻率；任何維修、鋪面更換或支承更換都要在資料庫中標記，作為新的基準段起點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Update the environmental model periodically as data accumulate and keep its versions, base alerts on residuals rather than raw frequencies, and flag every repair, resurfacing or bearing replacement in the database as the start of a new baseline segment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用夏季數週資料建立基準，冬季頻率自然上升就被誤判為異常，或反過來把真正的勁度下降掩蓋在溫度變化中；支承在低溫卡死造成的頻率突跳，也可能被誤認為損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A baseline built from a few summer weeks flags the natural winter rise in frequency as an anomaly, or conversely hides a real stiffness loss inside temperature variation; a frequency jump caused by bearings seizing in cold weather can also be mistaken for damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以至少一整年的健康期資料涵蓋四季溫度，建立回歸並以交叉驗證檢查預測誤差；用兩種識別方法（例如頻域分解與隨機子空間）比對頻率，並把結果與完工時的載重試驗或有限元素模型比較。
knowledge.textEn: Use at least a full year of healthy-period data spanning all seasons to fit the regression and check prediction error by cross-validation; compare frequencies from two identification methods, such as frequency-domain decomposition and stochastic subspace identification, and check them against the completion load test or finite-element model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 環境效應模型要隨資料累積定期更新並保留版本，警戒判斷一律使用殘差而非原始頻率；任何維修、鋪面更換或支承更換都要在資料庫中標記，作為新的基準段起點。
knowledge.textEn: Update the environmental model periodically as data accumulate and keep its versions, base alerts on residuals rather than raw frequencies, and flag every repair, resurfacing or bearing replacement in the database as the start of a new baseline segment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模態識別與環境效應分離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Modal identification and environmental effects"?
options: 以至少一整年的健康期資料涵蓋四季溫度，建立回歸並以交叉驗證檢查預測誤差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
感測器是附屬設備，安裝方式不會影響結構本身。
optionsEn: Use at least a full year of healthy-period data spanning all seasons to fit the regression and check prediction error by cross-validation.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Sensors are accessories, so how they are mounted cannot affect the structure.
quiz.explanation: 以至少一整年的健康期資料涵蓋四季溫度，建立回歸並以交叉驗證檢查預測誤差；用兩種識別方法（例如頻域分解與隨機子空間）比對頻率，並把結果與完工時的載重試驗或有限元素模型比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use at least a full year of healthy-period data spanning all seasons to fit the regression and check prediction error by cross-validation; compare frequencies from two identification methods, such as frequency-domain decomposition and stochastic subspace identification, and check them against the completion load test or finite-element model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模態識別與環境效應分離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Modal identification and environmental effects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻率—溫度回歸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Frequency–temperature regression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用夏季數週資料建立基準，冬季頻率自然上升就被誤判為異常，或反過來把真正的勁度下降掩蓋在溫度變化中；支承在低溫卡死造成的頻率突跳，也可能被誤認為損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A baseline built from a few summer weeks flags the natural winter rise in frequency as an anomaly, or conversely hides a real stiffness loss inside temperature variation; a frequency jump caused by bearings seizing in cold weather can also be mistaken for damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此要先用一段健康期資料建立頻率與溫度等環境變數的回歸模型，之後只看扣除環境效應後的殘差，殘差持續偏離時才代表結構可能改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A regression of frequency on temperature and other environmental variables must therefore be built from a healthy reference period; afterwards only the residual after removing environmental effects is tracked, and a persistent drift of that residual is what signals possible structural change.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋梁頻率下降就一定代表結構受損。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A drop in a bridge's frequency always means structural damage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用夏季數週資料建立基準，冬季頻率自然上升就被誤判為異常，或反過來把真正的勁度下降掩蓋在溫度變化中；支承在低溫卡死造成的頻率突跳，也可能被誤認為損傷。
knowledge.textEn: A baseline built from a few summer weeks flags the natural winter rise in frequency as an anomaly, or conversely hides a real stiffness loss inside temperature variation; a frequency jump caused by bearings seizing in cold weather can also be mistaken for damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模態識別與環境效應分離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Modal identification and environmental effects" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只用夏季數週資料建立基準，冬季頻率自然上升就被誤判為異常，或反過來把真正的勁度下降掩蓋在溫度變化中；支承在低溫卡死造成的頻率突跳，也可能被誤認為損傷。
警戒門檻越嚴格，監測系統就越安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A baseline built from a few summer weeks flags the natural winter rise in frequency as an anomaly, or conversely hides a real stiffness loss inside temperature variation.
The stricter the alarm threshold, the safer the monitoring system.
quiz.explanation: 只用夏季數週資料建立基準，冬季頻率自然上升就被誤判為異常，或反過來把真正的勁度下降掩蓋在溫度變化中；支承在低溫卡死造成的頻率突跳，也可能被誤認為損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A baseline built from a few summer weeks flags the natural winter rise in frequency as an anomaly, or conversely hides a real stiffness loss inside temperature variation; a frequency jump caused by bearings seizing in cold weather can also be mistaken for damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 警戒值、誤報率與事件觸發：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Alert thresholds, false alarms and event triggers: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「三級警戒值」如何影響橋梁健康監測感測網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-level alert thresholds” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 監測的價值在於觸發正確的行動。警戒值通常分三級：注意（需要工程師查看）、警告（需要現場檢查）、行動（需要交通管制），並分別對應設計值、使用性限值或統計殘差。地震或颱風時，系統應切換到事件模式，以較高取樣率記錄並自動產生初步評估。加州運輸局的快速評估計畫（BRACE2）即以 Hayward 580/238 立體交叉為試辦橋，把現場感測資料直接傳到分析平台，以模型與易損性演算法即時估計震後損傷，取代過去等待資料處理的延遲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「三級警戒值」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The value of monitoring lies in triggering the right action. Thresholds usually have three levels, notice (an engineer looks), warning (a site inspection) and action (traffic control), tied respectively to design values, serviceability limits or statistical residuals. During an earthquake or typhoon the system should switch to event mode, record at higher rates and generate a preliminary assessment automatically. Caltrans' rapid-assessment project BRACE2 uses the Hayward 580/238 Separation as its trial bridge, sending site sensor data directly to an analysis platform where models and fragility algorithms estimate post-earthquake damage in near real time, removing the delay of waiting for processed data. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Three-level alert thresholds” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若殘差呈常態，雙尾 3σ 門檻每次判斷的誤報機率約 0.27%；每小時判斷一次，一年 8,760 次約 0.0027×8,760 ≈ 23.7 次誤報。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If residuals are normal, a two-sided 3σ threshold has a false-alarm probability of about 0.27% per evaluation; evaluating hourly, 8,760 times a year, gives about 0.0027×8,760 ≈ 23.7 false alarms.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「警戒門檻越嚴格，監測系統就越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The stricter the alarm threshold, the safer the monitoring system." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「三級警戒值」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Three-level alert thresholds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 警戒值、誤報率與事件觸發
knowledge.titleEn: Alert thresholds, false alarms and event triggers
knowledge.text: 監測的價值在於觸發正確的行動。警戒值通常分三級：注意（需要工程師查看）、警告（需要現場檢查）、行動（需要交通管制），並分別對應設計值、使用性限值或統計殘差。
knowledge.textEn: The value of monitoring lies in triggering the right action. Thresholds usually have three levels, notice (an engineer looks), warning (a site inspection) and action (traffic control), tied respectively to design values, serviceability limits or statistical residuals.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：警戒門檻越嚴格，監測系統就越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The stricter the alarm threshold, the safer the monitoring system. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「警戒值、誤報率與事件觸發」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Alert thresholds, false alarms and event triggers" is correct?
options: 警戒門檻越嚴格，監測系統就越安全。
監測系統一旦建置完成，就能自動運作數十年。
監測的價值在於觸發正確的行動。
optionsEn: The stricter the alarm threshold, the safer the monitoring system.
Once built, a monitoring system runs itself for decades.
The value of monitoring lies in triggering the right action.
quiz.explanation: 監測的價值在於觸發正確的行動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The value of monitoring lies in triggering the right action. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 警戒值、誤報率與事件觸發：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Alert thresholds, false alarms and event triggers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三級警戒值」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-level alert thresholds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：若殘差呈常態，雙尾 3σ 門檻每次判斷的誤報機率約 0.27%；每小時判斷一次，一年 8,760 次約 0.0027×8,760 ≈ 23.7 次誤報。門檻提高到 4σ（約 6.3×10⁻⁵）時，每年約 0.55 次，但真實異常也要更大才會被偵測。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: If residuals are normal, a two-sided 3σ threshold has a false-alarm probability of about 0.27% per evaluation; evaluating hourly, 8,760 times a year, gives about 0.0027×8,760 ≈ 23.7 false alarms. Raising the threshold to 4σ (about 6.3×10⁻⁵) gives about 0.55 a year, but a real anomaly must then be larger to be detected. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以過去資料回放測試警戒邏輯，統計誤報與漏報次數並調整門檻；每年至少做一次演練，從模擬警報、通知、現場確認到解除，檢查責任人與時效是否符合規定，並記錄改善事項。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay historical data through the alert logic to count false and missed alarms and tune thresholds; run at least one drill a year, from simulated alert through notification and site confirmation to stand-down, checking responsibilities and response times against the procedure and recording improvements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 若殘差呈常態，雙尾 3σ 門檻每次判斷的誤報機率約 0.27%；每小時判斷一次，一年 8,760 次約 0.0027×8,760 ≈ 23.7 次誤報。門檻提高到 4σ（約 6.3×10⁻⁵）時，每年約 0.55 次，但真實異常也要更大才會被偵測。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: If residuals are normal, a two-sided 3σ threshold has a false-alarm probability of about 0.27% per evaluation; evaluating hourly, 8,760 times a year, gives about 0.0027×8,760 ≈ 23.7 false alarms. Raising the threshold to 4σ (about 6.3×10⁻⁵) gives about 0.55 a year, but a real anomaly must then be larger to be detected. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「警戒值、誤報率與事件觸發」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Alert thresholds, false alarms and event triggers", which statement holds?
options: 若殘差呈常態，雙尾 3σ 門檻每次判斷的誤報機率約 0.27%；每小時判斷一次，一年 8,760 次約 0.0027×8,760 ≈ 23.7 次誤報。
感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全。
所有應變計都一樣，只要精度高就能用於任何監測目的。
optionsEn: If residuals are normal, a two-sided 3σ threshold has a false-alarm probability of about 0.27% per evaluation.
The more sensors installed, the safer the bridge.
All strain gauges are equivalent; any high-precision gauge suits any purpose.
quiz.explanation: 若殘差呈常態，雙尾 3σ 門檻每次判斷的誤報機率約 0.27%；每小時判斷一次，一年 8,760 次約 0.0027×8,760 ≈ 23.7 次誤報。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: If residuals are normal, a two-sided 3σ threshold has a false-alarm probability of about 0.27% per evaluation; evaluating hourly, 8,760 times a year, gives about 0.0027×8,760 ≈ 23.7 false alarms. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 警戒值、誤報率與事件觸發：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alert thresholds, false alarms and event triggers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三級警戒值」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Three-level alert thresholds” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以過去資料回放測試警戒邏輯，統計誤報與漏報次數並調整門檻；每年至少做一次演練，從模擬警報、通知、現場確認到解除，檢查責任人與時效是否符合規定，並記錄改善事項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay historical data through the alert logic to count false and missed alarms and tune thresholds; run at least one drill a year, from simulated alert through notification and site confirmation to stand-down, checking responsibilities and response times against the procedure and recording improvements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每一級警戒都要對應書面的行動程序：通知對象、到場時限、可採取的交通措施與解除條件；交通管制的決定權必須事先授權給明確的職位，不能等到事件發生才協調。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Every alert level needs a written action procedure: whom to notify, response time, permitted traffic measures and stand-down conditions; authority for traffic control must be delegated in advance to a named post, not negotiated during the event.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：門檻設得太低，每週數次誤報讓值班人員習慣性忽略，真正的警報也被當成雜訊；門檻設得太高或只看單一通道，則支承卡死或構件斷裂的早期跡象在跨越門檻前就被錯過。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Thresholds set too low produce several false alarms a week, training staff to ignore them until a real alarm is dismissed as noise; thresholds set too high, or on single channels only, miss early signs of seized bearings or member fracture before they cross the line. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以過去資料回放測試警戒邏輯，統計誤報與漏報次數並調整門檻；每年至少做一次演練，從模擬警報、通知、現場確認到解除，檢查責任人與時效是否符合規定，並記錄改善事項。
knowledge.textEn: Replay historical data through the alert logic to count false and missed alarms and tune thresholds; run at least one drill a year, from simulated alert through notification and site confirmation to stand-down, checking responsibilities and response times against the procedure and recording improvements.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每一級警戒都要對應書面的行動程序：通知對象、到場時限、可採取的交通措施與解除條件；交通管制的決定權必須事先授權給明確的職位，不能等到事件發生才協調。
knowledge.textEn: Every alert level needs a written action procedure: whom to notify, response time, permitted traffic measures and stand-down conditions; authority for traffic control must be delegated in advance to a named post, not negotiated during the event.

quiz.question: 要驗證「警戒值、誤報率與事件觸發」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Alert thresholds, false alarms and event triggers"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以過去資料回放測試警戒邏輯，統計誤報與漏報次數並調整門檻；每年至少做一次演練，從模擬警報、通知、現場確認到解除，檢查責任人與時效是否符合規定，並記錄改善事項。
只要取樣率夠高，不同擷取站的資料就可以直接一起分析。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Replay historical data through the alert logic to count false and missed alarms and tune thresholds.
If sampling rates are high enough, data from different stations can be analysed together directly.
quiz.explanation: 以過去資料回放測試警戒邏輯，統計誤報與漏報次數並調整門檻；每年至少做一次演練，從模擬警報、通知、現場確認到解除，檢查責任人與時效是否符合規定，並記錄改善事項。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Replay historical data through the alert logic to count false and missed alarms and tune thresholds; run at least one drill a year, from simulated alert through notification and site confirmation to stand-down, checking responsibilities and response times against the procedure and recording improvements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 警戒值、誤報率與事件觸發：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alert thresholds, false alarms and event triggers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三級警戒值」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Three-level alert thresholds” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 門檻設得太低，每週數次誤報讓值班人員習慣性忽略，真正的警報也被當成雜訊；門檻設得太高或只看單一通道，則支承卡死或構件斷裂的早期跡象在跨越門檻前就被錯過。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Thresholds set too low produce several false alarms a week, training staff to ignore them until a real alarm is dismissed as noise; thresholds set too high, or on single channels only, miss early signs of seized bearings or member fracture before they cross the line. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：加州運輸局的快速評估計畫（BRACE2）即以 Hayward 580/238 立體交叉為試辦橋，把現場感測資料直接傳到分析平台，以模型與易損性演算法即時估計震後損傷，取代過去等待資料處理的延遲。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Caltrans' rapid-assessment project BRACE2 uses the Hayward 580/238 Separation as its trial bridge, sending site sensor data directly to an analysis platform where models and fragility algorithms estimate post-earthquake damage in near real time, removing the delay of waiting for processed data.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「警戒門檻越嚴格，監測系統就越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The stricter the alarm threshold, the safer the monitoring system." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 門檻設得太低，每週數次誤報讓值班人員習慣性忽略，真正的警報也被當成雜訊；門檻設得太高或只看單一通道，則支承卡死或構件斷裂的早期跡象在跨越門檻前就被錯過。
knowledge.textEn: Thresholds set too low produce several false alarms a week, training staff to ignore them until a real alarm is dismissed as noise; thresholds set too high, or on single channels only, miss early signs of seized bearings or member fracture before they cross the line.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「警戒值、誤報率與事件觸發」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Alert thresholds, false alarms and event triggers" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
監測系統一旦建置完成，就能自動運作數十年。
門檻設得太低，每週數次誤報讓值班人員習慣性忽略，真正的警報也被當成雜訊；門檻設得太高或只看單一通道，則支承卡死或構件斷裂的早期跡象在跨越門檻前就被錯過。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once built, a monitoring system runs itself for decades.
Thresholds set too low produce several false alarms a week, training staff to ignore them until a real alarm is dismissed as noise.
quiz.explanation: 門檻設得太低，每週數次誤報讓值班人員習慣性忽略，真正的警報也被當成雜訊；門檻設得太高或只看單一通道，則支承卡死或構件斷裂的早期跡象在跨越門檻前就被錯過。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Thresholds set too low produce several false alarms a week, training staff to ignore them until a real alarm is dismissed as noise; thresholds set too high, or on single channels only, miss early signs of seized bearings or member fracture before they cross the line. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「系統可用率、漂移與維護」與「資料管理、決策應用與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "System availability, drift and maintenance" and "Data management, decision use and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 系統可用率、漂移與維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: System availability, drift and maintenance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「資料完整率與感測器存活率」如何影響橋梁健康監測感測網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Data completeness and sensor survival” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 橋梁設計壽命可達百年，感測器與電子設備的壽命卻常只有十到二十年，而且會漂移、故障、被施工或撞擊損壞。監測系統因此需要自己的維護計畫：定期檢查通道健康狀態、比對冗餘通道找出漂移、更換故障感測器並重新建立零點，以及因應電子零件停產而規劃世代更新。資料完整率是衡量系統是否仍在工作的基本指標，應與結構指標一起報告。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「資料完整率與感測器存活率」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A bridge may be designed for a hundred years, but sensors and electronics often last only ten to twenty, and they drift, fail or get damaged by works or impacts. A monitoring system therefore needs its own maintenance plan: regular channel health checks, comparison of redundant channels to catch drift, replacement of failed sensors with new zero readings, and generational upgrades as electronic parts go obsolete. Data completeness is the basic indicator of whether the system still works and should be reported alongside the structural indicators. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Data completeness and sensor survival” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：350 個感測器、每年故障率 3%：每年預期故障 350×0.03 ≈ 10.5 支；若 5 年不更換，存活比例 0.97⁵ ≈ 0.859，只剩約 301 支。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 350 sensors and a 3% annual failure rate, about 350×0.03 ≈ 10.5 fail each year; without replacement for 5 years the surviving fraction is 0.97⁵ ≈ 0.859, about 301 sensors.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「監測系統一旦建置完成，就能自動運作數十年。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once built, a monitoring system runs itself for decades." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「資料完整率與感測器存活率」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Data completeness and sensor survival”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 系統可用率、漂移與維護
knowledge.text: 橋梁設計壽命可達百年，感測器與電子設備的壽命卻常只有十到二十年，而且會漂移、故障、被施工或撞擊損壞。監測系統因此需要自己的維護計畫：定期檢查通道健康狀態、比對冗餘通道找出漂移、更換故障感測器並重新建立零點，以及因應電子零件停產而規劃世代更新。
knowledge.textEn: A bridge may be designed for a hundred years, but sensors and electronics often last only ten to twenty, and they drift, fail or get damaged by works or impacts. A monitoring system therefore needs its own maintenance plan: regular channel health checks, comparison of redundant channels to catch drift, replacement of failed sensors with new zero readings, and generational upgrades as electronic parts go obsolete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：監測系統一旦建置完成，就能自動運作數十年。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once built, a monitoring system runs itself for decades. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「系統可用率、漂移與維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System availability, drift and maintenance" is correct?
options: 橋梁設計壽命可達百年，感測器與電子設備的壽命卻常只有十到二十年，而且會漂移、故障、被施工或撞擊損壞。
監測系統一旦建置完成，就能自動運作數十年。
只要每年有一份監測報告，資料本身就不需要保存。
optionsEn: A bridge may be designed for a hundred years, but sensors and electronics often last only ten to twenty, and they drift, fail or get damaged by works or impacts.
Once built, a monitoring system runs itself for decades.
As long as there is an annual monitoring report, the data themselves need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 橋梁設計壽命可達百年，感測器與電子設備的壽命卻常只有十到二十年，而且會漂移、故障、被施工或撞擊損壞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A bridge may be designed for a hundred years, but sensors and electronics often last only ten to twenty, and they drift, fail or get damaged by works or impacts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 系統可用率、漂移與維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System availability, drift and maintenance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資料完整率與感測器存活率」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Data completeness and sensor survival” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：350 個感測器、每年故障率 3%：每年預期故障 350×0.03 ≈ 10.5 支；若 5 年不更換，存活比例 0.97⁵ ≈ 0.859，只剩約 301 支。若關鍵量測只有單一通道，5 年內失去該量測的機率約 1 − 0.859 ≈ 14%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 350 sensors and a 3% annual failure rate, about 350×0.03 ≈ 10.5 fail each year; without replacement for 5 years the surviving fraction is 0.97⁵ ≈ 0.859, about 301 sensors. A key measurand on a single channel then has about a 1 − 0.859 ≈ 14% chance of being lost within 5 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每月自動產生通道健康報告：資料完整率、雜訊底線、零點漂移與冗餘通道差異，低於門檻的通道列入維修清單；每年抽樣以攜帶式參考儀器現場比對，確認感測器讀值仍在允差內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Generate a monthly channel-health report automatically, covering data completeness, noise floor, zero drift and differences between redundant channels, and put channels below threshold on the repair list; each year, spot-check sensors on site against a portable reference instrument to confirm readings remain within tolerance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 350 個感測器、每年故障率 3%：每年預期故障 350×0.03 ≈ 10.5 支；若 5 年不更換，存活比例 0.97⁵ ≈ 0.859，只剩約 301 支。若關鍵量測只有單一通道，5 年內失去該量測的機率約 1 − 0.859 ≈ 14%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With 350 sensors and a 3% annual failure rate, about 350×0.03 ≈ 10.5 fail each year; without replacement for 5 years the surviving fraction is 0.97⁵ ≈ 0.859, about 301 sensors. A key measurand on a single channel then has about a 1 − 0.859 ≈ 14% chance of being lost within 5 years. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「系統可用率、漂移與維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System availability, drift and maintenance", which statement holds?
options: 感測器裝在任何位置都能量到結構的真實狀態。
350 個感測器、每年故障率 3%：每年預期故障 350×0.03 ≈ 10.5 支。
感測器是附屬設備，安裝方式不會影響結構本身。
optionsEn: A sensor anywhere on the bridge measures the true structural state.
With 350 sensors and a 3% annual failure rate, about 350×0.03 ≈ 10.5 fail each year.
Sensors are accessories, so how they are mounted cannot affect the structure.
quiz.explanation: 350 個感測器、每年故障率 3%：每年預期故障 350×0.03 ≈ 10.5 支；若 5 年不更換，存活比例 0.97⁵ ≈ 0.859，只剩約 301 支。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With 350 sensors and a 3% annual failure rate, about 350×0.03 ≈ 10.5 fail each year; without replacement for 5 years the surviving fraction is 0.97⁵ ≈ 0.859, about 301 sensors. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 系統可用率、漂移與維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: System availability, drift and maintenance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資料完整率與感測器存活率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Data completeness and sensor survival” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每月自動產生通道健康報告：資料完整率、雜訊底線、零點漂移與冗餘通道差異，低於門檻的通道列入維修清單；每年抽樣以攜帶式參考儀器現場比對，確認感測器讀值仍在允差內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Generate a monthly channel-health report automatically, covering data completeness, noise floor, zero drift and differences between redundant channels, and put channels below threshold on the repair list; each year, spot-check sensors on site against a portable reference instrument to confirm readings remain within tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測合約應包含至少數年的維運期，並把資料完整率（例如關鍵通道 95% 以上）列為付款條件；更換感測器時要做新舊並行量測一段時間，以銜接資料序列。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The monitoring contract should include several years of operation and maintenance and make data completeness, for example above 95% on key channels, a payment condition; when replacing a sensor, run old and new in parallel for a period to splice the data series.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：系統建置時預算充足，維護卻沒有編列經費，數年後大半通道失效、軟體無人更新，監測中心只剩螢幕上的空白曲線；更換感測器時未記錄新零點，新舊資料拼接出不存在的應變跳動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Generous capital funding with no maintenance budget leaves most channels dead and software unpatched after a few years, so the control room shows only blank traces; replacing a sensor without recording a new zero splices old and new data into a strain jump that never happened. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每月自動產生通道健康報告：資料完整率、雜訊底線、零點漂移與冗餘通道差異，低於門檻的通道列入維修清單；每年抽樣以攜帶式參考儀器現場比對，確認感測器讀值仍在允差內。
knowledge.textEn: Generate a monthly channel-health report automatically, covering data completeness, noise floor, zero drift and differences between redundant channels, and put channels below threshold on the repair list; each year, spot-check sensors on site against a portable reference instrument to confirm readings remain within tolerance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 監測合約應包含至少數年的維運期，並把資料完整率（例如關鍵通道 95% 以上）列為付款條件；更換感測器時要做新舊並行量測一段時間，以銜接資料序列。
knowledge.textEn: The monitoring contract should include several years of operation and maintenance and make data completeness, for example above 95% on key channels, a payment condition; when replacing a sensor, run old and new in parallel for a period to splice the data series.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統可用率、漂移與維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System availability, drift and maintenance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
監測系統等橋梁完工後再安裝即可，不會損失任何資訊。
每月自動產生通道健康報告：資料完整率、雜訊底線、零點漂移與冗餘通道差異，低於門檻的通道列入維修清單；每年抽樣以攜帶式參考儀器現場比對，確認感測器讀值仍在允差內。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A monitoring system can be installed after completion without losing any information.

Generate a monthly channel-health report automatically, covering data completeness, noise floor, zero drift and differences between redundant channels, and put channels below threshold on the repair list.
quiz.explanation: 每月自動產生通道健康報告：資料完整率、雜訊底線、零點漂移與冗餘通道差異，低於門檻的通道列入維修清單；每年抽樣以攜帶式參考儀器現場比對，確認感測器讀值仍在允差內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Generate a monthly channel-health report automatically, covering data completeness, noise floor, zero drift and differences between redundant channels, and put channels below threshold on the repair list; each year, spot-check sensors on site against a portable reference instrument to confirm readings remain within tolerance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 系統可用率、漂移與維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System availability, drift and maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資料完整率與感測器存活率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Data completeness and sensor survival” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 系統建置時預算充足，維護卻沒有編列經費，數年後大半通道失效、軟體無人更新，監測中心只剩螢幕上的空白曲線；更換感測器時未記錄新零點，新舊資料拼接出不存在的應變跳動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Generous capital funding with no maintenance budget leaves most channels dead and software unpatched after a few years, so the control room shows only blank traces; replacing a sensor without recording a new zero splices old and new data into a strain jump that never happened. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：資料完整率是衡量系統是否仍在工作的基本指標，應與結構指標一起報告。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Data completeness is the basic indicator of whether the system still works and should be reported alongside the structural indicators.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「監測系統一旦建置完成，就能自動運作數十年。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once built, a monitoring system runs itself for decades." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 系統建置時預算充足，維護卻沒有編列經費，數年後大半通道失效、軟體無人更新，監測中心只剩螢幕上的空白曲線；更換感測器時未記錄新零點，新舊資料拼接出不存在的應變跳動。
knowledge.textEn: Generous capital funding with no maintenance budget leaves most channels dead and software unpatched after a few years, so the control room shows only blank traces; replacing a sensor without recording a new zero splices old and new data into a strain jump that never happened.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「系統可用率、漂移與維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System availability, drift and maintenance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 系統建置時預算充足，維護卻沒有編列經費，數年後大半通道失效、軟體無人更新，監測中心只剩螢幕上的空白曲線。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要每年有一份監測報告，資料本身就不需要保存。
optionsEn: Generous capital funding with no maintenance budget leaves most channels dead and software unpatched after a few years, so the control room shows only blank traces.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
As long as there is an annual monitoring report, the data themselves need not be kept.
quiz.explanation: 系統建置時預算充足，維護卻沒有編列經費，數年後大半通道失效、軟體無人更新，監測中心只剩螢幕上的空白曲線；更換感測器時未記錄新零點，新舊資料拼接出不存在的應變跳動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Generous capital funding with no maintenance budget leaves most channels dead and software unpatched after a few years, so the control room shows only blank traces; replacing a sensor without recording a new zero splices old and new data into a strain jump that never happened. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資料管理、決策應用與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Data management, decision use and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「後設資料與資料庫」如何影響橋梁健康監測感測網的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Metadata and database” governs force, deformation or durability in “Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 監測資料只有在後設資料完整時才有長期價值：每個通道的位置、方向、感測原理、校正係數、零點、更換紀錄與資料處理參數都要可查。資料庫也要與橋梁檢查紀錄、維修履歷及結構模型連結，讓工程師能把異常讀值與現場狀況對照。交接時，業主應取得原始資料格式說明、處理程式與存取權限，而不只是一份年報；網路安全與資料保存期限也要在交接文件中寫明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「後設資料與資料庫」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring data keep long-term value only with complete metadata: every channel's location, orientation, sensing principle, calibration factors, zero reading, replacement history and processing parameters must be retrievable. The database should also link to inspection records, maintenance history and the structural model so engineers can compare an anomalous reading with site conditions. At handover the owner should receive the raw data format description, processing software and access rights, not just an annual report, and cybersecurity and data retention periods must be written into the handover documents. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Metadata and database” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原始資料每天 12.1 GB、每年約 4.4 TB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Raw data at 12.1 GB a day amount to about 4.4 TB a year.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每年有一份監測報告，資料本身就不需要保存。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as there is an annual monitoring report, the data themselves need not be kept." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「後設資料與資料庫」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Metadata and database”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資料管理、決策應用與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Data management, decision use and handover
knowledge.text: 監測資料只有在後設資料完整時才有長期價值：每個通道的位置、方向、感測原理、校正係數、零點、更換紀錄與資料處理參數都要可查。資料庫也要與橋梁檢查紀錄、維修履歷及結構模型連結，讓工程師能把異常讀值與現場狀況對照。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring data keep long-term value only with complete metadata: every channel's location, orientation, sensing principle, calibration factors, zero reading, replacement history and processing parameters must be retrievable. The database should also link to inspection records, maintenance history and the structural model so engineers can compare an anomalous reading with site conditions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要每年有一份監測報告，資料本身就不需要保存。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as there is an annual monitoring report, the data themselves need not be kept. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資料管理、決策應用與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Data management, decision use and handover" is correct?
options: 只要每年有一份監測報告，資料本身就不需要保存。
監測資料只有在後設資料完整時才有長期價值：每個通道的位置、方向、感測原理、校正係數、零點、更換紀錄與資料處理參數都要可查。
感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全。
optionsEn: As long as there is an annual monitoring report, the data themselves need not be kept.

Monitoring data keep long-term value only with complete metadata: every channel's location, orientation, sensing principle, calibration factors, zero reading, replacement history and processing parameters must be retrievable.
The more sensors installed, the safer the bridge.
quiz.explanation: 監測資料只有在後設資料完整時才有長期價值：每個通道的位置、方向、感測原理、校正係數、零點、更換紀錄與資料處理參數都要可查。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring data keep long-term value only with complete metadata: every channel's location, orientation, sensing principle, calibration factors, zero reading, replacement history and processing parameters must be retrievable. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資料管理、決策應用與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Data management, decision use and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「後設資料與資料庫」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Metadata and database” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原始資料每天 12.1 GB、每年約 4.4 TB。若只長期保存事件期間原始資料，其餘改存每 10 分鐘 6 項統計值（平均、最大、最小、標準差等）：350×6×144×8 bytes ≈ 2.4 MB/天，每年約 0.88 GB，約為原始量的五千分之一。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Raw data at 12.1 GB a day amount to about 4.4 TB a year. Keeping raw records only for events and storing six statistics every 10 minutes otherwise (mean, maximum, minimum, standard deviation and so on) gives 350×6×144×8 bytes ≈ 2.4 MB a day, about 0.88 GB a year, roughly one five-thousandth of the raw volume. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前由業主或第三方以交付的文件與程式，從原始資料獨立重算一段期間的統計值與模態結果，與承包商報告比對；同時抽查後設資料是否與現場標籤、照片一致，並測試備份還原。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, have the owner or a third party independently recompute statistics and modal results for a sample period from raw data using the delivered documents and software, and compare with the contractor's reports; also spot-check metadata against site labels and photographs and test a backup restore.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原始資料每天 12.1 GB、每年約 4.4 TB。若只長期保存事件期間原始資料，其餘改存每 10 分鐘 6 項統計值（平均、最大、最小、標準差等）：350×6×144×8 bytes ≈ 2.4 MB/天，每年約 0.88 GB，約為原始量的五千分之一。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Raw data at 12.1 GB a day amount to about 4.4 TB a year. Keeping raw records only for events and storing six statistics every 10 minutes otherwise (mean, maximum, minimum, standard deviation and so on) gives 350×6×144×8 bytes ≈ 2.4 MB a day, about 0.88 GB a year, roughly one five-thousandth of the raw volume. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資料管理、決策應用與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Data management, decision use and handover", which statement holds?
options: 所有應變計都一樣，只要精度高就能用於任何監測目的。
只要取樣率夠高，不同擷取站的資料就可以直接一起分析。
原始資料每天 12.1 GB、每年約 4.4 TB。
optionsEn: All strain gauges are equivalent; any high-precision gauge suits any purpose.
If sampling rates are high enough, data from different stations can be analysed together directly.
Raw data at 12.1 GB a day amount to about 4.4 TB a year.
quiz.explanation: 原始資料每天 12.1 GB、每年約 4.4 TB。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Raw data at 12.1 GB a day amount to about 4.4 TB a year. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資料管理、決策應用與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Data management, decision use and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「後設資料與資料庫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Metadata and database” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前由業主或第三方以交付的文件與程式，從原始資料獨立重算一段期間的統計值與模態結果，與承包商報告比對；同時抽查後設資料是否與現場標籤、照片一致，並測試備份還原。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, have the owner or a third party independently recompute statistics and modal results for a sample period from raw data using the delivered documents and software, and compare with the contractor's reports; also spot-check metadata against site labels and photographs and test a backup restore. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含通道清單與後設資料、資料字典、處理程式原始碼或可執行版本、警戒程序、維護紀錄與聯絡窗口；業主必須擁有資料所有權，並把監測結果正式納入橋梁檢查與維修決策流程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover should include the channel list with metadata, a data dictionary, processing source code or executables, alert procedures, maintenance records and contacts; the owner must own the data and formally feed monitoring results into bridge inspection and maintenance decisions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若資料格式與處理程式掌握在原承包商手中，合約結束後業主只能看到停止更新的圖表；多年後需要追查某次異常時，才發現原始資料已被刪除或無法解讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If data formats and processing software stay with the original contractor, the owner is left with frozen charts when the contract ends; years later, when an anomaly must be traced, the raw data turn out to be deleted or unreadable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前由業主或第三方以交付的文件與程式，從原始資料獨立重算一段期間的統計值與模態結果，與承包商報告比對；同時抽查後設資料是否與現場標籤、照片一致，並測試備份還原。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, have the owner or a third party independently recompute statistics and modal results for a sample period from raw data using the delivered documents and software, and compare with the contractor's reports; also spot-check metadata against site labels and photographs and test a backup restore.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含通道清單與後設資料、資料字典、處理程式原始碼或可執行版本、警戒程序、維護紀錄與聯絡窗口；業主必須擁有資料所有權，並把監測結果正式納入橋梁檢查與維修決策流程。
knowledge.textEn: Handover should include the channel list with metadata, a data dictionary, processing source code or executables, alert procedures, maintenance records and contacts; the owner must own the data and formally feed monitoring results into bridge inspection and maintenance decisions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資料管理、決策應用與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Data management, decision use and handover"?
options: 交接前由業主或第三方以交付的文件與程式，從原始資料獨立重算一段期間的統計值與模態結果，與承包商報告比對。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
橋梁頻率下降就一定代表結構受損。
optionsEn: Before handover, have the owner or a third party independently recompute statistics and modal results for a sample period from raw data using the delivered documents and software, and compare with the contractor's reports.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A drop in a bridge's frequency always means structural damage.
quiz.explanation: 交接前由業主或第三方以交付的文件與程式，從原始資料獨立重算一段期間的統計值與模態結果，與承包商報告比對；同時抽查後設資料是否與現場標籤、照片一致，並測試備份還原。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, have the owner or a third party independently recompute statistics and modal results for a sample period from raw data using the delivered documents and software, and compare with the contractor's reports; also spot-check metadata against site labels and photographs and test a backup restore. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資料管理、決策應用與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Data management, decision use and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「後設資料與資料庫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Metadata and database” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若資料格式與處理程式掌握在原承包商手中，合約結束後業主只能看到停止更新的圖表；多年後需要追查某次異常時，才發現原始資料已被刪除或無法解讀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If data formats and processing software stay with the original contractor, the owner is left with frozen charts when the contract ends; years later, when an anomaly must be traced, the raw data turn out to be deleted or unreadable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接時，業主應取得原始資料格式說明、處理程式與存取權限，而不只是一份年報；網路安全與資料保存期限也要在交接文件中寫明。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At handover the owner should receive the raw data format description, processing software and access rights, not just an annual report, and cybersecurity and data retention periods must be written into the handover documents.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每年有一份監測報告，資料本身就不需要保存。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as there is an annual monitoring report, the data themselves need not be kept." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若資料格式與處理程式掌握在原承包商手中，合約結束後業主只能看到停止更新的圖表；多年後需要追查某次異常時，才發現原始資料已被刪除或無法解讀。
knowledge.textEn: If data formats and processing software stay with the original contractor, the owner is left with frozen charts when the contract ends; years later, when an anomaly must be traced, the raw data turn out to be deleted or unreadable.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資料管理、決策應用與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Data management, decision use and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若資料格式與處理程式掌握在原承包商手中，合約結束後業主只能看到停止更新的圖表；多年後需要追查某次異常時，才發現原始資料已被刪除或無法解讀。
感測器裝得越多，橋梁就越安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If data formats and processing software stay with the original contractor, the owner is left with frozen charts when the contract ends.
The more sensors installed, the safer the bridge.
quiz.explanation: 若資料格式與處理程式掌握在原承包商手中，合約結束後業主只能看到停止更新的圖表；多年後需要追查某次異常時，才發現原始資料已被刪除或無法解讀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If data formats and processing software stay with the original contractor, the owner is left with frozen charts when the contract ends; years later, when an anomaly must be traced, the raw data turn out to be deleted or unreadable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 橋梁動態荷重試驗
summary: 從車輛動力效應與人群同步振動出發，說明試驗載重與預期反應的計算、儀器與取樣率、趟次矩陣與封橋安全、強迫振動與人群試驗、動力放大與頻率判讀、以試驗修正係數更新評等，以及舒適度改善與基準交接，並以倫敦千禧橋的人群試驗與阻尼改造、雪梨港灣大橋 1932 年的機車載重試驗與 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋為對照。
summaryEn: Starting from vehicle dynamic effects and crowd lock-in, explain how to compute test loads and expected responses, choose instruments and sampling rates, plan run matrices and safe closures, run forced-vibration and crowd tests, interpret amplification and frequency, update load ratings with test adjustment factors, and handle comfort retrofits and baseline handover, drawing on the crowd tests and damper retrofit of London's Millennium Bridge, the 1932 locomotive load test of Sydney Harbour Bridge and the 1940 Tacoma Narrows Bridge.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
