stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「試驗載重與預期反應」與「量測儀器與取樣率」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Test loads and predicted response" and "Instrumentation and sampling rate": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 試驗載重與預期反應：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Test loads and predicted response: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「試驗車輛軸重」如何影響橋梁動態荷重試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Test-vehicle axle weights” governs force, deformation or durability in “Dynamic bridge load testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 試驗載重必須是已知的：每部試驗車都要以地磅逐軸秤重並量測軸距，裝載物固定不可移動，量測反應才能與計算比較。1932 年雪梨港灣大橋開放前，以最多 96 部蒸汽機車頭尾相接排滿四條鐵軌，進行約三週的載重試驗後才宣布安全，那是以極大靜載驗證整體行為的做法。動態試驗的載重較輕，卻更重視可重複性：同一部車、同一車道、不同車速，並以事先計算的預期反應決定感測器量程與停止準則。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「試驗車輛軸重」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The test load must be known: each test vehicle is weighed axle by axle on a weighbridge and its axle spacing measured, with the payload secured so that measured responses can be compared with calculations. Before Sydney Harbour Bridge opened in 1932, up to 96 steam locomotives were placed end to end across its four rail tracks for about three weeks of testing before it was declared safe, a verification of overall behaviour with a very large static load. Dynamic tests use lighter loads but care more about repeatability: the same truck, the same lane, different speeds, with predicted responses computed beforehand to set sensor ranges and stop criteria. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Test-vehicle axle weights” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：30 m 簡支梁跨中，300 kN 試驗車近似集中載重：M = PL/4 = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m；分配到最受力主梁 0.6 倍為 1,350 kN·m，斷面模數 S = 0.045 m³：σ = 1.35×10⁶ N·m/0.045 m³ = 30 MPa，鋼材 ε = 30/200,000 = 150 με。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a 30 m simple span with a 300 kN test truck approximated as a midspan point load, M = PL/4 = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m; distributing 0.6 of it to the most loaded girder gives 1,350 kN·m, and with section modulus S = 0.045 m³, σ = 1.35×10⁶ N·m/0.045 m³ = 30 MPa, a steel strain of ε = 30/200,000 = 150 με.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「載重試驗用的車越重，得到的結論就越可靠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The heavier the test vehicle, the more reliable the conclusions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「試驗車輛軸重」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Test-vehicle axle weights”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試驗載重與預期反應
knowledge.text: 試驗載重必須是已知的：每部試驗車都要以地磅逐軸秤重並量測軸距，裝載物固定不可移動，量測反應才能與計算比較。1932 年雪梨港灣大橋開放前，以最多 96 部蒸汽機車頭尾相接排滿四條鐵軌，進行約三週的載重試驗後才宣布安全，那是以極大靜載驗證整體行為的做法。
knowledge.textEn: The test load must be known: each test vehicle is weighed axle by axle on a weighbridge and its axle spacing measured, with the payload secured so that measured responses can be compared with calculations. Before Sydney Harbour Bridge opened in 1932, up to 96 steam locomotives were placed end to end across its four rail tracks for about three weeks of testing before it was declared safe, a verification of overall behaviour with a very large static load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：載重試驗用的車越重，得到的結論就越可靠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The heavier the test vehicle, the more reliable the conclusions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試驗載重與預期反應」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Test loads and predicted response" is correct?
options: 試驗載重必須是已知的：每部試驗車都要以地磅逐軸秤重並量測軸距，裝載物固定不可移動，量測反應才能與計算比較。
載重試驗用的車越重，得到的結論就越可靠。
只要量到最大應變，取樣率高低並不重要。
optionsEn: The test load must be known: each test vehicle is weighed axle by axle on a weighbridge and its axle spacing measured, with the payload secured so that measured responses can be compared with calculations.
The heavier the test vehicle, the more reliable the conclusions.
As long as the maximum strain is captured, sampling rate does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 試驗載重必須是已知的：每部試驗車都要以地磅逐軸秤重並量測軸距，裝載物固定不可移動，量測反應才能與計算比較。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The test load must be known: each test vehicle is weighed axle by axle on a weighbridge and its axle spacing measured, with the payload secured so that measured responses can be compared with calculations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試驗載重與預期反應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Test loads and predicted response: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試驗車輛軸重」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Test-vehicle axle weights” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：30 m 簡支梁跨中，300 kN 試驗車近似集中載重：M = PL/4 = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m；分配到最受力主梁 0.6 倍為 1,350 kN·m，斷面模數 S = 0.045 m³：σ = 1.35×10⁶ N·m/0.045 m³ = 30 MPa，鋼材 ε = 30/200,000 = 150 με。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a 30 m simple span with a 300 kN test truck approximated as a midspan point load, M = PL/4 = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m; distributing 0.6 of it to the most loaded girder gives 1,350 kN·m, and with section modulus S = 0.045 m³, σ = 1.35×10⁶ N·m/0.045 m³ = 30 MPa, a steel strain of ε = 30/200,000 = 150 με. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗前由第三方地磅出具逐軸重量與總重證明，量測軸距與輪距並拍照；以實際數值重算影響線反應，訂出每個量測點的預期值與停止門檻，例如預期值的 1.2 倍或規範容許應力的一定比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before testing, obtain third-party weighbridge tickets for each axle and the gross weight, measure and photograph axle and wheel spacing, recompute influence-line responses with the actual values, and set an expected value and stop threshold for each gauge, for example 1.2 times the prediction or a set fraction of the allowable stress.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 30 m 簡支梁跨中，300 kN 試驗車近似集中載重：M = PL/4 = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m；分配到最受力主梁 0.6 倍為 1,350 kN·m，斷面模數 S = 0.045 m³：σ = 1.35×10⁶ N·m/0.045 m³ = 30 MPa，鋼材 ε = 30/200,000 = 150 με。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: For a 30 m simple span with a 300 kN test truck approximated as a midspan point load, M = PL/4 = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m; distributing 0.6 of it to the most loaded girder gives 1,350 kN·m, and with section modulus S = 0.045 m³, σ = 1.35×10⁶ N·m/0.045 m³ = 30 MPa, a steel strain of ε = 30/200,000 = 150 με. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試驗載重與預期反應」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Test loads and predicted response", which statement holds?
options: 人行橋只要強度設計通過，就不必做人群振動試驗。
30 m 簡支梁跨中，300 kN 試驗車近似集中載重：M = PL/4 = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m。
實測應變比計算低，就可以按比例直接提高橋梁的容許載重。
optionsEn: If a footbridge passes its strength design, it needs no crowd vibration test.
For a 30 m simple span with a 300 kN test truck approximated as a midspan point load, M = PL/4 = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m.
If measured strain is lower than calculated, the permitted load can be raised in direct proportion.
quiz.explanation: 30 m 簡支梁跨中，300 kN 試驗車近似集中載重：M = PL/4 = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m；分配到最受力主梁 0.6 倍為 1,350 kN·m，斷面模數 S = 0.045 m³：σ = 1.35×10⁶ N·m/0.045 m³ = 30 MPa，鋼材 ε = 30/200,000 = 150 με。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a 30 m simple span with a 300 kN test truck approximated as a midspan point load, M = PL/4 = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m; distributing 0.6 of it to the most loaded girder gives 1,350 kN·m, and with section modulus S = 0.045 m³, σ = 1.35×10⁶ N·m/0.045 m³ = 30 MPa, a steel strain of ε = 30/200,000 = 150 με. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試驗載重與預期反應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Test loads and predicted response: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試驗車輛軸重」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Test-vehicle axle weights” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗前由第三方地磅出具逐軸重量與總重證明，量測軸距與輪距並拍照；以實際數值重算影響線反應，訂出每個量測點的預期值與停止門檻，例如預期值的 1.2 倍或規範容許應力的一定比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before testing, obtain third-party weighbridge tickets for each axle and the gross weight, measure and photograph axle and wheel spacing, recompute influence-line responses with the actual values, and set an expected value and stop threshold for each gauge, for example 1.2 times the prediction or a set fraction of the allowable stress. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗計畫須由評等或設計工程師核算試驗載重不超過構件容許值，列出逐級加載與停止準則；試驗當天現場要有有權中止試驗的工程師在場，所有決定記錄在試驗日誌。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The test plan must have the rating or design engineer confirm that test loads stay within member capacities and list load stages and stop criteria; on test day an engineer with authority to stop the test must be on site, and every decision goes into the test log.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若試驗車載運砂石卻未秤重、只依車型估計，或試驗中途更換車輛，量測反應就無法與計算比較；試驗車過重則可能讓已劣化的構件在試驗中受損，試驗本身變成事故。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a gravel-loaded truck is not weighed but estimated from its type, or vehicles are swapped mid-test, measured responses cannot be compared with calculations; an overweight truck can damage deteriorated members during the test, turning the test into an incident. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗前由第三方地磅出具逐軸重量與總重證明，量測軸距與輪距並拍照；以實際數值重算影響線反應，訂出每個量測點的預期值與停止門檻，例如預期值的 1.2 倍或規範容許應力的一定比例。
knowledge.textEn: Before testing, obtain third-party weighbridge tickets for each axle and the gross weight, measure and photograph axle and wheel spacing, recompute influence-line responses with the actual values, and set an expected value and stop threshold for each gauge, for example 1.2 times the prediction or a set fraction of the allowable stress.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗計畫須由評等或設計工程師核算試驗載重不超過構件容許值，列出逐級加載與停止準則；試驗當天現場要有有權中止試驗的工程師在場，所有決定記錄在試驗日誌。
knowledge.textEn: The test plan must have the rating or design engineer confirm that test loads stay within member capacities and list load stages and stop criteria; on test day an engineer with authority to stop the test must be on site, and every decision goes into the test log.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試驗載重與預期反應」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Test loads and predicted response"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
載重試驗通過一次，就證明橋梁永遠安全。
試驗前由第三方地磅出具逐軸重量與總重證明，量測軸距與輪距並拍照。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Passing one load test proves the bridge safe forever.

Before testing, obtain third-party weighbridge tickets for each axle and the gross weight, measure and photograph axle and wheel spacing, recompute influence-line responses with the actual values, and set an expected value and stop threshold for each gauge, for example 1.2 times the prediction or a set fraction of the allowable stress.
quiz.explanation: 試驗前由第三方地磅出具逐軸重量與總重證明，量測軸距與輪距並拍照；以實際數值重算影響線反應，訂出每個量測點的預期值與停止門檻，例如預期值的 1.2 倍或規範容許應力的一定比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before testing, obtain third-party weighbridge tickets for each axle and the gross weight, measure and photograph axle and wheel spacing, recompute influence-line responses with the actual values, and set an expected value and stop threshold for each gauge, for example 1.2 times the prediction or a set fraction of the allowable stress. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 試驗載重與預期反應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Test loads and predicted response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試驗車輛軸重」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Test-vehicle axle weights” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若試驗車載運砂石卻未秤重、只依車型估計，或試驗中途更換車輛，量測反應就無法與計算比較；試驗車過重則可能讓已劣化的構件在試驗中受損，試驗本身變成事故。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a gravel-loaded truck is not weighed but estimated from its type, or vehicles are swapped mid-test, measured responses cannot be compared with calculations; an overweight truck can damage deteriorated members during the test, turning the test into an incident. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：動態試驗的載重較輕，卻更重視可重複性：同一部車、同一車道、不同車速，並以事先計算的預期反應決定感測器量程與停止準則。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dynamic tests use lighter loads but care more about repeatability: the same truck, the same lane, different speeds, with predicted responses computed beforehand to set sensor ranges and stop criteria.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「載重試驗用的車越重，得到的結論就越可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The heavier the test vehicle, the more reliable the conclusions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若試驗車載運砂石卻未秤重、只依車型估計，或試驗中途更換車輛，量測反應就無法與計算比較；試驗車過重則可能讓已劣化的構件在試驗中受損，試驗本身變成事故。
knowledge.textEn: If a gravel-loaded truck is not weighed but estimated from its type, or vehicles are swapped mid-test, measured responses cannot be compared with calculations; an overweight truck can damage deteriorated members during the test, turning the test into an incident.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試驗載重與預期反應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Test loads and predicted response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若試驗車載運砂石卻未秤重、只依車型估計，或試驗中途更換車輛，量測反應就無法與計算比較；試驗車過重則可能讓已劣化的構件在試驗中受損，試驗本身變成事故。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要量到最大應變，取樣率高低並不重要。
optionsEn: If a gravel-loaded truck is not weighed but estimated from its type, or vehicles are swapped mid-test, measured responses cannot be compared with calculations.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
As long as the maximum strain is captured, sampling rate does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 若試驗車載運砂石卻未秤重、只依車型估計，或試驗中途更換車輛，量測反應就無法與計算比較；試驗車過重則可能讓已劣化的構件在試驗中受損，試驗本身變成事故。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a gravel-loaded truck is not weighed but estimated from its type, or vehicles are swapped mid-test, measured responses cannot be compared with calculations; an overweight truck can damage deteriorated members during the test, turning the test into an incident. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 量測儀器與取樣率：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Instrumentation and sampling rate: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「動態應變計與加速度計」如何影響橋梁動態荷重試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dynamic strain gauges and accelerometers” governs force, deformation or durability in “Dynamic bridge load testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 動態試驗同時需要三類資料：主梁與關鍵構件的應變、跨中撓度或加速度，以及車輛位置與速度。應變計要能反應快速變化，加速度計的頻寬與解析度要涵蓋主要振態與試驗產生的微小加速度，撓度可用線性位移計、雷射或雷達干涉儀量測。車輛位置可用路面觸發開關或影像同步，讓每一筆反應都能對應到荷重位置，這是區分靜態與動態成分的前提。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「動態應變計與加速度計」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dynamic test needs three kinds of data at once: strains in girders and critical members, midspan deflection or acceleration, and vehicle position and speed. Strain gauges must follow fast changes, accelerometers need bandwidth and resolution covering the main modes and the small accelerations a test produces, and deflection can be measured by displacement transducers, laser or radar interferometry. Vehicle position from road-surface trigger switches or synchronised video lets every response be tied to load position, the precondition for separating static from dynamic components. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dynamic strain gauges and accelerometers” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：試驗車以 80 km/h（22.2 m/s）通過 30 m 跨需 30/22.2 ≈ 1.35 s；若每次通過要有至少 50 個取樣點描述影響線，取樣率 ≥ 50/1.35 ≈ 37 Hz；要辨識 20 Hz 以下的振態，依 2.56 倍規則需 ≥ 51.2 Hz，因此取 100 Hz 以上。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A truck at 80 km/h (22.2 m/s) crosses a 30 m span in 30/22.2 ≈ 1.35 s; at least 50 samples per crossing to describe the influence line needs ≥ 50/1.35 ≈ 37 Hz, and identifying modes up to 20 Hz by the 2.56 rule needs ≥ 51.2 Hz, so 100 Hz or more is chosen.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要量到最大應變，取樣率高低並不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "As long as the maximum strain is captured, sampling rate does not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「動態應變計與加速度計」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dynamic strain gauges and accelerometers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 量測儀器與取樣率
knowledge.text: 動態試驗同時需要三類資料：主梁與關鍵構件的應變、跨中撓度或加速度，以及車輛位置與速度。應變計要能反應快速變化，加速度計的頻寬與解析度要涵蓋主要振態與試驗產生的微小加速度，撓度可用線性位移計、雷射或雷達干涉儀量測。
knowledge.textEn: A dynamic test needs three kinds of data at once: strains in girders and critical members, midspan deflection or acceleration, and vehicle position and speed. Strain gauges must follow fast changes, accelerometers need bandwidth and resolution covering the main modes and the small accelerations a test produces, and deflection can be measured by displacement transducers, laser or radar interferometry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要量到最大應變，取樣率高低並不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: As long as the maximum strain is captured, sampling rate does not matter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「量測儀器與取樣率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Instrumentation and sampling rate" is correct?
options: 只要量到最大應變，取樣率高低並不重要。
動態試驗同時需要三類資料：主梁與關鍵構件的應變、跨中撓度或加速度，以及車輛位置與速度。
動態試驗只要讓卡車以最高速通過一次就夠了。
optionsEn: As long as the maximum strain is captured, sampling rate does not matter.
A dynamic test needs three kinds of data at once: strains in girders and critical members, midspan deflection or acceleration, and vehicle position and speed.
A dynamic test only needs one pass of the truck at top speed.
quiz.explanation: 動態試驗同時需要三類資料：主梁與關鍵構件的應變、跨中撓度或加速度，以及車輛位置與速度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A dynamic test needs three kinds of data at once: strains in girders and critical members, midspan deflection or acceleration, and vehicle position and speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 量測儀器與取樣率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Instrumentation and sampling rate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動態應變計與加速度計」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dynamic strain gauges and accelerometers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：試驗車以 80 km/h（22.2 m/s）通過 30 m 跨需 30/22.2 ≈ 1.35 s；若每次通過要有至少 50 個取樣點描述影響線，取樣率 ≥ 50/1.35 ≈ 37 Hz；要辨識 20 Hz 以下的振態，依 2.56 倍規則需 ≥ 51.2 Hz，因此取 100 Hz 以上。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A truck at 80 km/h (22.2 m/s) crosses a 30 m span in 30/22.2 ≈ 1.35 s; at least 50 samples per crossing to describe the influence line needs ≥ 50/1.35 ≈ 37 Hz, and identifying modes up to 20 Hz by the 2.56 rule needs ≥ 51.2 Hz, so 100 Hz or more is chosen. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗前檢查每個通道的方向、增益與雜訊底線，並以已知敲擊或靜置歸零確認；每一趟試驗後立即檢視資料是否飽和、缺漏或觸發錯位，有問題的趟次當場重做，而不是回辦公室才發現。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before testing, check every channel's orientation, gain and noise floor and confirm with a known tap or a static zero; after each run, inspect the data immediately for saturation, gaps or trigger misalignment and repeat faulty runs on the spot rather than discovering them back at the office.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 試驗車以 80 km/h（22.2 m/s）通過 30 m 跨需 30/22.2 ≈ 1.35 s；若每次通過要有至少 50 個取樣點描述影響線，取樣率 ≥ 50/1.35 ≈ 37 Hz；要辨識 20 Hz 以下的振態，依 2.56 倍規則需 ≥ 51.2 Hz，因此取 100 Hz 以上。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A truck at 80 km/h (22.2 m/s) crosses a 30 m span in 30/22.2 ≈ 1.35 s; at least 50 samples per crossing to describe the influence line needs ≥ 50/1.35 ≈ 37 Hz, and identifying modes up to 20 Hz by the 2.56 rule needs ≥ 51.2 Hz, so 100 Hz or more is chosen. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「量測儀器與取樣率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Instrumentation and sampling rate", which statement holds?
options: 實測頻率比模型高，就代表橋梁沒有任何問題。
加大構件斷面一定是解決人行橋振動最有效的方法。
optionsEn: A measured frequency higher than the model means the bridge has no problems.
Enlarging member sections is always the most effective cure for footbridge vibration.
A truck at 80 km/h (22.2 m/s) crosses a 30 m span in 30/22.2 ≈ 1.35 s.
quiz.explanation: 試驗車以 80 km/h（22.2 m/s）通過 30 m 跨需 30/22.2 ≈ 1.35 s；若每次通過要有至少 50 個取樣點描述影響線，取樣率 ≥ 50/1.35 ≈ 37 Hz；要辨識 20 Hz 以下的振態，依 2.56 倍規則需 ≥ 51.2 Hz，因此取 100 Hz 以上。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A truck at 80 km/h (22.2 m/s) crosses a 30 m span in 30/22.2 ≈ 1.35 s; at least 50 samples per crossing to describe the influence line needs ≥ 50/1.35 ≈ 37 Hz, and identifying modes up to 20 Hz by the 2.56 rule needs ≥ 51.2 Hz, so 100 Hz or more is chosen. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 量測儀器與取樣率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Instrumentation and sampling rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「動態應變計與加速度計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dynamic strain gauges and accelerometers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗前檢查每個通道的方向、增益與雜訊底線，並以已知敲擊或靜置歸零確認；每一趟試驗後立即檢視資料是否飽和、缺漏或觸發錯位，有問題的趟次當場重做，而不是回辦公室才發現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before testing, check every channel's orientation, gain and noise floor and confirm with a known tap or a static zero; after each run, inspect the data immediately for saturation, gaps or trigger misalignment and repeat faulty runs on the spot rather than discovering them back at the office. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：量測計畫以表格列出每個通道的感測器型號、位置、方向、量程、取樣率與預期值，現場安裝後逐一拍照核對；所有通道共用同一時間基準，原始檔案保留車輛觸發訊號。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The instrumentation plan tabulates sensor model, location, orientation, range, sampling rate and expected value for every channel, with each installation photographed and checked; all channels share one time base, and raw files keep the vehicle trigger signals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：取樣率太低時峰值被削掉，算出的動力放大偏小；位移計架在會隨橋振動的臨時支架上，量到的其實是支架的運動；車輛位置沒有同步，事後就無法判斷峰值發生時車在哪裡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Too low a sampling rate clips peaks and underestimates amplification; a displacement transducer on a temporary frame that vibrates with the bridge measures the frame; without synchronised vehicle position nobody can later tell where the truck was at the peak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗前檢查每個通道的方向、增益與雜訊底線，並以已知敲擊或靜置歸零確認；每一趟試驗後立即檢視資料是否飽和、缺漏或觸發錯位，有問題的趟次當場重做，而不是回辦公室才發現。
knowledge.textEn: Before testing, check every channel's orientation, gain and noise floor and confirm with a known tap or a static zero; after each run, inspect the data immediately for saturation, gaps or trigger misalignment and repeat faulty runs on the spot rather than discovering them back at the office.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 量測計畫以表格列出每個通道的感測器型號、位置、方向、量程、取樣率與預期值，現場安裝後逐一拍照核對；所有通道共用同一時間基準，原始檔案保留車輛觸發訊號。
knowledge.textEn: The instrumentation plan tabulates sensor model, location, orientation, range, sampling rate and expected value for every channel, with each installation photographed and checked; all channels share one time base, and raw files keep the vehicle trigger signals.

quiz.question: 要驗證「量測儀器與取樣率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Instrumentation and sampling rate"?
options: 試驗前檢查每個通道的方向、增益與雜訊底線，並以已知敲擊或靜置歸零確認。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
車速越快，橋梁的動力放大一定越大。
optionsEn: Before testing, check every channel's orientation, gain and noise floor and confirm with a known tap or a static zero.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The faster the vehicle, the larger the dynamic amplification must be.
quiz.explanation: 試驗前檢查每個通道的方向、增益與雜訊底線，並以已知敲擊或靜置歸零確認；每一趟試驗後立即檢視資料是否飽和、缺漏或觸發錯位，有問題的趟次當場重做，而不是回辦公室才發現。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before testing, check every channel's orientation, gain and noise floor and confirm with a known tap or a static zero; after each run, inspect the data immediately for saturation, gaps or trigger misalignment and repeat faulty runs on the spot rather than discovering them back at the office. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 量測儀器與取樣率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Instrumentation and sampling rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動態應變計與加速度計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dynamic strain gauges and accelerometers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 取樣率太低時峰值被削掉，算出的動力放大偏小；位移計架在會隨橋振動的臨時支架上，量到的其實是支架的運動；車輛位置沒有同步，事後就無法判斷峰值發生時車在哪裡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Too low a sampling rate clips peaks and underestimates amplification; a displacement transducer on a temporary frame that vibrates with the bridge measures the frame; without synchronised vehicle position nobody can later tell where the truck was at the peak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：車輛位置可用路面觸發開關或影像同步，讓每一筆反應都能對應到荷重位置，這是區分靜態與動態成分的前提。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Vehicle position from road-surface trigger switches or synchronised video lets every response be tied to load position, the precondition for separating static from dynamic components.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要量到最大應變，取樣率高低並不重要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "As long as the maximum strain is captured, sampling rate does not matter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 取樣率太低時峰值被削掉，算出的動力放大偏小；位移計架在會隨橋振動的臨時支架上，量到的其實是支架的運動；車輛位置沒有同步，事後就無法判斷峰值發生時車在哪裡。
knowledge.textEn: Too low a sampling rate clips peaks and underestimates amplification; a displacement transducer on a temporary frame that vibrates with the bridge measures the frame; without synchronised vehicle position nobody can later tell where the truck was at the peak.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「量測儀器與取樣率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Instrumentation and sampling rate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
取樣率太低時峰值被削掉，算出的動力放大偏小；位移計架在會隨橋振動的臨時支架上，量到的其實是支架的運動；車輛位置沒有同步，事後就無法判斷峰值發生時車在哪裡。
動態試驗只要讓卡車以最高速通過一次就夠了。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Too low a sampling rate clips peaks and underestimates amplification.
A dynamic test only needs one pass of the truck at top speed.
quiz.explanation: 取樣率太低時峰值被削掉，算出的動力放大偏小；位移計架在會隨橋振動的臨時支架上，量到的其實是支架的運動；車輛位置沒有同步，事後就無法判斷峰值發生時車在哪裡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Too low a sampling rate clips peaks and underestimates amplification; a displacement transducer on a temporary frame that vibrates with the bridge measures the frame; without synchronised vehicle position nobody can later tell where the truck was at the peak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「試驗程序、封橋與安全管理」與「強迫振動與人群試驗」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Test procedure, closure and safety" and "Forced-vibration and crowd tests": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 試驗程序、封橋與安全管理：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Test procedure, closure and safety: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「試驗趟次矩陣」如何影響橋梁動態荷重試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Test-run matrix” governs force, deformation or durability in “Dynamic bridge load testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 動態試驗通常依序進行：先量環境振動，再做慢速（TRB 入門所稱低於約 5 mph，即 8 km/h）的準靜態趟次，接著是不同車速的動態趟次，必要時在橋面放置木板做跳車試驗，最後再量一次環境振動確認橋梁狀態未改變。每一組條件重複三趟以上以評估離散度。試驗需要封閉交通，因此要預先排定趟次矩陣、時程與緊急開放程序，並在每一階段確認資料合理後才進入下一階段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「試驗趟次矩陣」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dynamic test usually runs in order: ambient vibration first, then quasi-static runs at crawl speed (below about 5 mph, or 8 km/h, as the TRB primer describes), then dynamic runs at several speeds, a plank or bump test where needed, and a final ambient record to confirm the bridge has not changed. Each condition is repeated three or more times to judge scatter. Testing requires a traffic closure, so the run matrix, schedule and emergency reopening procedure must be fixed in advance, with each stage's data checked for plausibility before moving on. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Test-run matrix” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩個車道 × 四種車速（20、40、60、80 km/h）× 三趟 = 24 趟，加上兩車道慢速各三趟共 30 趟；每趟含迴轉與歸零約 6 分鐘，需約 30×6 = 180 min = 3 小時封橋，另加前後環境振動量測。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Two lanes × four speeds (20, 40, 60 and 80 km/h) × three runs = 24 runs, plus three crawl runs in each lane, 30 runs in all; at about 6 minutes per run including turning and re-zeroing, the closure needs about 30×6 = 180 min = 3 hours, plus ambient records before and after.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「動態試驗只要讓卡車以最高速通過一次就夠了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dynamic test only needs one pass of the truck at top speed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「試驗趟次矩陣」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Test-run matrix”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試驗程序、封橋與安全管理
knowledge.text: 動態試驗通常依序進行：先量環境振動，再做慢速（TRB 入門所稱低於約 5 mph，即 8 km/h）的準靜態趟次，接著是不同車速的動態趟次，必要時在橋面放置木板做跳車試驗，最後再量一次環境振動確認橋梁狀態未改變。每一組條件重複三趟以上以評估離散度。
knowledge.textEn: A dynamic test usually runs in order: ambient vibration first, then quasi-static runs at crawl speed (below about 5 mph, or 8 km/h, as the TRB primer describes), then dynamic runs at several speeds, a plank or bump test where needed, and a final ambient record to confirm the bridge has not changed. Each condition is repeated three or more times to judge scatter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：動態試驗只要讓卡車以最高速通過一次就夠了。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dynamic test only needs one pass of the truck at top speed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試驗程序、封橋與安全管理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Test procedure, closure and safety" is correct?
options: 動態試驗只要讓卡車以最高速通過一次就夠了。
人行橋只要強度設計通過，就不必做人群振動試驗。
動態試驗通常依序進行：先量環境振動，再做慢速（TRB 入門所稱低於約 5 mph，即 8 km/h）的準靜態趟次，接著是不同車速的動態趟次，必要時在橋面放置木板做跳車試驗，最後再量一次環境振動確認橋梁狀態未改變。
optionsEn: A dynamic test only needs one pass of the truck at top speed.
If a footbridge passes its strength design, it needs no crowd vibration test.

A dynamic test usually runs in order: ambient vibration first, then quasi-static runs at crawl speed (below about 5 mph, or 8 km/h, as the TRB primer describes), then dynamic runs at several speeds, a plank or bump test where needed, and a final ambient record to confirm the bridge has not changed.
quiz.explanation: 動態試驗通常依序進行：先量環境振動，再做慢速（TRB 入門所稱低於約 5 mph，即 8 km/h）的準靜態趟次，接著是不同車速的動態趟次，必要時在橋面放置木板做跳車試驗，最後再量一次環境振動確認橋梁狀態未改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A dynamic test usually runs in order: ambient vibration first, then quasi-static runs at crawl speed (below about 5 mph, or 8 km/h, as the TRB primer describes), then dynamic runs at several speeds, a plank or bump test where needed, and a final ambient record to confirm the bridge has not changed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試驗程序、封橋與安全管理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Test procedure, closure and safety: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試驗趟次矩陣」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Test-run matrix” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩個車道 × 四種車速（20、40、60、80 km/h）× 三趟 = 24 趟，加上兩車道慢速各三趟共 30 趟；每趟含迴轉與歸零約 6 分鐘，需約 30×6 = 180 min = 3 小時封橋，另加前後環境振動量測。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Two lanes × four speeds (20, 40, 60 and 80 km/h) × three runs = 24 runs, plus three crawl runs in each lane, 30 runs in all; at about 6 minutes per run including turning and re-zeroing, the closure needs about 30×6 = 180 min = 3 hours, plus ambient records before and after. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗主持人在每一趟後檢查關鍵通道峰值與預期值的比值，若超過停止準則（例如 1.2 倍）或出現未歸零的殘餘應變，即暫停並檢查橋梁與儀器；所有趟次以編號、時間、車速與車道記錄於試驗日誌。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After every run, the test director checks the ratio of peak to predicted value on key channels; if it exceeds the stop criterion, for example 1.2, or residual strain fails to return to zero, testing pauses for a bridge and instrument check.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 兩個車道 × 四種車速（20、40、60、80 km/h）× 三趟 = 24 趟，加上兩車道慢速各三趟共 30 趟；每趟含迴轉與歸零約 6 分鐘，需約 30×6 = 180 min = 3 小時封橋，另加前後環境振動量測。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Two lanes × four speeds (20, 40, 60 and 80 km/h) × three runs = 24 runs, plus three crawl runs in each lane, 30 runs in all; at about 6 minutes per run including turning and re-zeroing, the closure needs about 30×6 = 180 min = 3 hours, plus ambient records before and after. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試驗程序、封橋與安全管理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Test procedure, closure and safety", which statement holds?
options: 兩個車道 × 四種車速（20、40、60、80 km/h）× 三趟 = 24 趟，加上兩車道慢速各三趟共 30 趟。
實測應變比計算低，就可以按比例直接提高橋梁的容許載重。
載重試驗通過一次，就證明橋梁永遠安全。
optionsEn: Two lanes × four speeds (20, 40, 60 and 80 km/h) × three runs = 24 runs, plus three crawl runs in each lane, 30 runs in all.
If measured strain is lower than calculated, the permitted load can be raised in direct proportion.
Passing one load test proves the bridge safe forever.
quiz.explanation: 兩個車道 × 四種車速（20、40、60、80 km/h）× 三趟 = 24 趟，加上兩車道慢速各三趟共 30 趟；每趟含迴轉與歸零約 6 分鐘，需約 30×6 = 180 min = 3 小時封橋，另加前後環境振動量測。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Two lanes × four speeds (20, 40, 60 and 80 km/h) × three runs = 24 runs, plus three crawl runs in each lane, 30 runs in all; at about 6 minutes per run including turning and re-zeroing, the closure needs about 30×6 = 180 min = 3 hours, plus ambient records before and after. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試驗程序、封橋與安全管理：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Test procedure, closure and safety: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試驗趟次矩陣」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Test-run matrix” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗主持人在每一趟後檢查關鍵通道峰值與預期值的比值，若超過停止準則（例如 1.2 倍）或出現未歸零的殘餘應變，即暫停並檢查橋梁與儀器；所有趟次以編號、時間、車速與車道記錄於試驗日誌。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After every run, the test director checks the ratio of peak to predicted value on key channels; if it exceeds the stop criterion, for example 1.2, or residual strain fails to return to zero, testing pauses for a bridge and instrument check. Every run is logged with number, time, speed and lane. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：高速趟次屬有風險的作業，須由交通主管機關核准封閉、設置緩衝區與救援車輛，試驗駕駛事先演練；本課只說明試驗設計邏輯，實際執行須依業主核准的試驗計畫與安全計畫辦理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: High-speed runs are hazardous: the traffic authority must approve the closure, buffer zones and recovery vehicles must be in place and drivers must rehearse; this course explains test-design logic only, and real tests must follow the owner-approved test and safety plans.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為了縮短封橋時間而省略重複趟次，單一趟次受到風或駕駛偏移影響，得到的動力放大不具代表性；試驗車沒有按標線行駛或速度不穩，也會使不同趟次無法比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Skipping repeats to shorten the closure leaves single runs affected by wind or driver offset, so the measured amplification is unrepresentative; a truck that strays from its marked line or holds an unsteady speed makes runs incomparable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗主持人在每一趟後檢查關鍵通道峰值與預期值的比值，若超過停止準則（例如 1.2 倍）或出現未歸零的殘餘應變，即暫停並檢查橋梁與儀器；所有趟次以編號、時間、車速與車道記錄於試驗日誌。
knowledge.textEn: After every run, the test director checks the ratio of peak to predicted value on key channels; if it exceeds the stop criterion, for example 1.2, or residual strain fails to return to zero, testing pauses for a bridge and instrument check. Every run is logged with number, time, speed and lane.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 高速趟次屬有風險的作業，須由交通主管機關核准封閉、設置緩衝區與救援車輛，試驗駕駛事先演練；本課只說明試驗設計邏輯，實際執行須依業主核准的試驗計畫與安全計畫辦理。
knowledge.textEn: High-speed runs are hazardous: the traffic authority must approve the closure, buffer zones and recovery vehicles must be in place and drivers must rehearse; this course explains test-design logic only, and real tests must follow the owner-approved test and safety plans.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試驗程序、封橋與安全管理」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Test procedure, closure and safety"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
試驗主持人在每一趟後檢查關鍵通道峰值與預期值的比值，若超過停止準則（例如 1.2 倍）或出現未歸零的殘餘應變，即暫停並檢查橋梁與儀器。
只要垂直頻率避開 2 Hz，人行橋就不會有振動問題。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
After every run, the test director checks the ratio of peak to predicted value on key channels.
As long as the vertical frequency avoids 2 Hz, a footbridge will have no vibration problems.
quiz.explanation: 試驗主持人在每一趟後檢查關鍵通道峰值與預期值的比值，若超過停止準則（例如 1.2 倍）或出現未歸零的殘餘應變，即暫停並檢查橋梁與儀器；所有趟次以編號、時間、車速與車道記錄於試驗日誌。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After every run, the test director checks the ratio of peak to predicted value on key channels; if it exceeds the stop criterion, for example 1.2, or residual strain fails to return to zero, testing pauses for a bridge and instrument check. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 試驗程序、封橋與安全管理：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Test procedure, closure and safety: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試驗趟次矩陣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Test-run matrix” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為了縮短封橋時間而省略重複趟次，單一趟次受到風或駕駛偏移影響，得到的動力放大不具代表性；試驗車沒有按標線行駛或速度不穩，也會使不同趟次無法比較。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skipping repeats to shorten the closure leaves single runs affected by wind or driver offset, so the measured amplification is unrepresentative; a truck that strays from its marked line or holds an unsteady speed makes runs incomparable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試驗需要封閉交通，因此要預先排定趟次矩陣、時程與緊急開放程序，並在每一階段確認資料合理後才進入下一階段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Testing requires a traffic closure, so the run matrix, schedule and emergency reopening procedure must be fixed in advance, with each stage's data checked for plausibility before moving on.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「動態試驗只要讓卡車以最高速通過一次就夠了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dynamic test only needs one pass of the truck at top speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 為了縮短封橋時間而省略重複趟次，單一趟次受到風或駕駛偏移影響，得到的動力放大不具代表性；試驗車沒有按標線行駛或速度不穩，也會使不同趟次無法比較。
knowledge.textEn: Skipping repeats to shorten the closure leaves single runs affected by wind or driver offset, so the measured amplification is unrepresentative; a truck that strays from its marked line or holds an unsteady speed makes runs incomparable.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試驗程序、封橋與安全管理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Test procedure, closure and safety" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
人行橋只要強度設計通過，就不必做人群振動試驗。
為了縮短封橋時間而省略重複趟次，單一趟次受到風或駕駛偏移影響，得到的動力放大不具代表性；試驗車沒有按標線行駛或速度不穩，也會使不同趟次無法比較。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
If a footbridge passes its strength design, it needs no crowd vibration test.
Skipping repeats to shorten the closure leaves single runs affected by wind or driver offset, so the measured amplification is unrepresentative.
quiz.explanation: 為了縮短封橋時間而省略重複趟次，單一趟次受到風或駕駛偏移影響，得到的動力放大不具代表性；試驗車沒有按標線行駛或速度不穩，也會使不同趟次無法比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Skipping repeats to shorten the closure leaves single runs affected by wind or driver offset, so the measured amplification is unrepresentative; a truck that strays from its marked line or holds an unsteady speed makes runs incomparable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 強迫振動與人群試驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Forced-vibration and crowd tests: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「激振器與人群步行試驗」如何影響橋梁動態荷重試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shaker and crowd walking tests” governs force, deformation or durability in “Dynamic bridge load testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 卡車通過只能短暫激起振動，要精確量測特定振態的頻率、振型與阻尼，常用偏心質量激振器在固定頻率持續激振，或以掃頻找出共振峰；人行橋則用可控制人數與步頻的人群試驗。千禧橋在 2000 年以最多 275 人在單一跨上進行人群試驗，找出側向振動隨人數突然增加的行為；改造完成後，Arup 再安排 2,000 人過橋驗證阻尼裝置的效果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「激振器與人群步行試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A passing truck excites vibration only briefly, so measuring the frequency, shape and damping of a particular mode precisely calls for an eccentric-mass shaker driven steadily at one frequency or swept to find the resonant peak; footbridges use crowd tests with controlled numbers and pacing. In 2000 the Millennium Bridge was tested with crowds of up to 275 people on one span, revealing lateral vibration that jumped once numbers passed a threshold; after the retrofit, Arup had 2,000 people walk across to verify the damping devices. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shaker and crowd walking tests” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：偏心質量激振力 F = m_e·e·ω²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Eccentric-mass shaker force F = m_e·e·ω².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「人行橋只要強度設計通過，就不必做人群振動試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a footbridge passes its strength design, it needs no crowd vibration test." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「激振器與人群步行試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shaker and crowd walking tests”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
