knowledge.textEn: A passing truck excites vibration only briefly, so measuring the frequency, shape and damping of a particular mode precisely calls for an eccentric-mass shaker driven steadily at one frequency or swept to find the resonant peak; footbridges use crowd tests with controlled numbers and pacing. In 2000 the Millennium Bridge was tested with crowds of up to 275 people on one span, revealing lateral vibration that jumped once numbers passed a threshold; after the retrofit, Arup had 2,000 people walk across to verify the damping devices.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：人行橋只要強度設計通過，就不必做人群振動試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a footbridge passes its strength design, it needs no crowd vibration test. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「強迫振動與人群試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Forced-vibration and crowd tests" is correct?
options: 卡車通過只能短暫激起振動，要精確量測特定振態的頻率、振型與阻尼，常用偏心質量激振器在固定頻率持續激振，或以掃頻找出共振峰；人行橋則用可控制人數與步頻的人群試驗。
人行橋只要強度設計通過，就不必做人群振動試驗。
實測頻率比模型高，就代表橋梁沒有任何問題。
optionsEn: A passing truck excites vibration only briefly, so measuring the frequency, shape and damping of a particular mode precisely calls for an eccentric-mass shaker driven steadily at one frequency or swept to find the resonant peak.
If a footbridge passes its strength design, it needs no crowd vibration test.
A measured frequency higher than the model means the bridge has no problems.
quiz.explanation: 卡車通過只能短暫激起振動，要精確量測特定振態的頻率、振型與阻尼，常用偏心質量激振器在固定頻率持續激振，或以掃頻找出共振峰；人行橋則用可控制人數與步頻的人群試驗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A passing truck excites vibration only briefly, so measuring the frequency, shape and damping of a particular mode precisely calls for an eccentric-mass shaker driven steadily at one frequency or swept to find the resonant peak; footbridges use crowd tests with controlled numbers and pacing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 強迫振動與人群試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Forced-vibration and crowd tests: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「激振器與人群步行試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shaker and crowd walking tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：偏心質量激振力 F = m_e·e·ω²。m_e·e = 2 kg·m、f = 2 Hz（ω = 12.57 rad/s）：F = 2×157.9 ≈ 316 N。模態質量 M = 50,000 kg、模態勁度 k = M·ω² ≈ 7.9×10⁶ N/m、ζ = 1%：共振振幅 x = F/(2ζk) ≈ 2.0 mm，加速度 ω²x ≈ 0.32 m/s²。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Eccentric-mass shaker force F = m_e·e·ω². With m_e·e = 2 kg·m and f = 2 Hz (ω = 12.57 rad/s), F = 2×157.9 ≈ 316 N. For modal mass M = 50,000 kg, modal stiffness k = M·ω² ≈ 7.9×10⁶ N/m and ζ = 1%, the resonant amplitude is x = F/(2ζk) ≈ 2.0 mm and the acceleration ω²x ≈ 0.32 m/s². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：掃頻時以小步距逐步改變頻率，每一頻率等待穩態後記錄力與加速度，繪出頻率響應函數求共振頻率與阻尼；人群試驗以影像或計數器記錄人數與分布，並設定即時顯示的加速度中止門檻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In a sweep, step the frequency in small increments, wait for steady state at each and record force and acceleration, then build the frequency response function to obtain resonance and damping; in crowd tests, record numbers and distribution with video or counters and set a live-displayed acceleration stop threshold.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 偏心質量激振力 F = m_e·e·ω²。m_e·e = 2 kg·m、f = 2 Hz（ω = 12.57 rad/s）：F = 2×157.9 ≈ 316 N。模態質量 M = 50,000 kg、模態勁度 k = M·ω² ≈ 7.9×10⁶ N/m、ζ = 1%：共振振幅 x = F/(2ζk) ≈ 2.0 mm，加速度 ω²x ≈ 0.32 m/s²。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Eccentric-mass shaker force F = m_e·e·ω². With m_e·e = 2 kg·m and f = 2 Hz (ω = 12.57 rad/s), F = 2×157.9 ≈ 316 N. For modal mass M = 50,000 kg, modal stiffness k = M·ω² ≈ 7.9×10⁶ N/m and ζ = 1%, the resonant amplitude is x = F/(2ζk) ≈ 2.0 mm and the acceleration ω²x ≈ 0.32 m/s². Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「強迫振動與人群試驗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Forced-vibration and crowd tests", which statement holds?
options: 加大構件斷面一定是解決人行橋振動最有效的方法。
偏心質量激振力 F = m_e·e·ω²。
車速越快，橋梁的動力放大一定越大。
optionsEn: Enlarging member sections is always the most effective cure for footbridge vibration.
Eccentric-mass shaker force F = m_e·e·ω².
The faster the vehicle, the larger the dynamic amplification must be.
quiz.explanation: 偏心質量激振力 F = m_e·e·ω²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Eccentric-mass shaker force F = m_e·e·ω². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 強迫振動與人群試驗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Forced-vibration and crowd tests: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「激振器與人群步行試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shaker and crowd walking tests” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 掃頻時以小步距逐步改變頻率，每一頻率等待穩態後記錄力與加速度，繪出頻率響應函數求共振頻率與阻尼；人群試驗以影像或計數器記錄人數與分布，並設定即時顯示的加速度中止門檻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In a sweep, step the frequency in small increments, wait for steady state at each and record force and acceleration, then build the frequency response function to obtain resonance and damping; in crowd tests, record numbers and distribution with video or counters and set a live-displayed acceleration stop threshold. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：人群試驗須先完成風險評估：人數分級逐步增加、出入口管制、醫護與廣播、加速度即時顯示與中止權責；參與者事前須了解試驗內容，所有分級與中止決定由試驗主持工程師記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A crowd test needs a prior risk assessment: stepwise crowd stages, controlled entry and exit, first aid and public address, live acceleration display and a clear stop authority; participants are briefed in advance, and the test director records every stage and stop decision.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：激振器若固定在不夠剛的位置，量到的是局部板件振動而非整體振態；人群試驗若沒有中止門檻，側向同步一旦觸發，人群可能在擺動中失去平衡或擠向欄杆。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shaker fixed at a flexible spot measures local plate vibration rather than the global mode; a crowd test without a stop threshold can see people lose balance or crowd the railings once lateral lock-in starts. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 掃頻時以小步距逐步改變頻率，每一頻率等待穩態後記錄力與加速度，繪出頻率響應函數求共振頻率與阻尼；人群試驗以影像或計數器記錄人數與分布，並設定即時顯示的加速度中止門檻。
knowledge.textEn: In a sweep, step the frequency in small increments, wait for steady state at each and record force and acceleration, then build the frequency response function to obtain resonance and damping; in crowd tests, record numbers and distribution with video or counters and set a live-displayed acceleration stop threshold.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 人群試驗須先完成風險評估：人數分級逐步增加、出入口管制、醫護與廣播、加速度即時顯示與中止權責；參與者事前須了解試驗內容，所有分級與中止決定由試驗主持工程師記錄。
knowledge.textEn: A crowd test needs a prior risk assessment: stepwise crowd stages, controlled entry and exit, first aid and public address, live acceleration display and a clear stop authority; participants are briefed in advance, and the test director records every stage and stop decision.

quiz.question: 要驗證「強迫振動與人群試驗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Forced-vibration and crowd tests"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
載重試驗用的車越重，得到的結論就越可靠。
掃頻時以小步距逐步改變頻率，每一頻率等待穩態後記錄力與加速度，繪出頻率響應函數求共振頻率與阻尼。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The heavier the test vehicle, the more reliable the conclusions.
In a sweep, step the frequency in small increments, wait for steady state at each and record force and acceleration, then build the frequency response function to obtain resonance and damping.
quiz.explanation: 掃頻時以小步距逐步改變頻率，每一頻率等待穩態後記錄力與加速度，繪出頻率響應函數求共振頻率與阻尼；人群試驗以影像或計數器記錄人數與分布，並設定即時顯示的加速度中止門檻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In a sweep, step the frequency in small increments, wait for steady state at each and record force and acceleration, then build the frequency response function to obtain resonance and damping; in crowd tests, record numbers and distribution with video or counters and set a live-displayed acceleration stop threshold. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 強迫振動與人群試驗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Forced-vibration and crowd tests: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「激振器與人群步行試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shaker and crowd walking tests” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 激振器若固定在不夠剛的位置，量到的是局部板件振動而非整體振態；人群試驗若沒有中止門檻，側向同步一旦觸發，人群可能在擺動中失去平衡或擠向欄杆。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shaker fixed at a flexible spot measures local plate vibration rather than the global mode; a crowd test without a stop threshold can see people lose balance or crowd the railings once lateral lock-in starts. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：千禧橋在 2000 年以最多 275 人在單一跨上進行人群試驗，找出側向振動隨人數突然增加的行為；改造完成後，Arup 再安排 2,000 人過橋驗證阻尼裝置的效果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In 2000 the Millennium Bridge was tested with crowds of up to 275 people on one span, revealing lateral vibration that jumped once numbers passed a threshold; after the retrofit, Arup had 2,000 people walk across to verify the damping devices.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「人行橋只要強度設計通過，就不必做人群振動試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a footbridge passes its strength design, it needs no crowd vibration test." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 激振器若固定在不夠剛的位置，量到的是局部板件振動而非整體振態；人群試驗若沒有中止門檻，側向同步一旦觸發，人群可能在擺動中失去平衡或擠向欄杆。
knowledge.textEn: A shaker fixed at a flexible spot measures local plate vibration rather than the global mode; a crowd test without a stop threshold can see people lose balance or crowd the railings once lateral lock-in starts.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「強迫振動與人群試驗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Forced-vibration and crowd tests" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 激振器若固定在不夠剛的位置，量到的是局部板件振動而非整體振態；人群試驗若沒有中止門檻，側向同步一旦觸發，人群可能在擺動中失去平衡或擠向欄杆。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
實測頻率比模型高，就代表橋梁沒有任何問題。
optionsEn: A shaker fixed at a flexible spot measures local plate vibration rather than the global mode.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A measured frequency higher than the model means the bridge has no problems.
quiz.explanation: 激振器若固定在不夠剛的位置，量到的是局部板件振動而非整體振態；人群試驗若沒有中止門檻，側向同步一旦觸發，人群可能在擺動中失去平衡或擠向欄杆。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A shaker fixed at a flexible spot measures local plate vibration rather than the global mode; a crowd test without a stop threshold can see people lose balance or crowd the railings once lateral lock-in starts. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀」與「模型修正與載重評等」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness" and "Model updating and load rating": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「動態與準靜態歷時」如何影響橋梁動態荷重試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dynamic and quasi-static histories” governs force, deformation or durability in “Dynamic bridge load testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一趟高速通過的應變歷時包含兩部分：隨車輛位置緩慢變化的準靜態成分，以及橋梁自身振動造成的動態成分。可用低通濾波從高速趟次中分離準靜態成分，或直接與慢速趟次比較，求得動力放大。車輛離橋後的自由振動可用頻譜分析得到自振頻率，與模型比較即可判斷實際勁度：頻率與勁度的平方根成正比，所以頻率高約 6% 代表勁度高約 13%。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「動態與準靜態歷時」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A strain history from a fast run contains two parts: a quasi-static component that follows vehicle position slowly, and a dynamic component from the bridge's own vibration. Low-pass filtering separates the quasi-static part from a fast run, or the fast run can be compared directly with a crawl run, to obtain amplification. The free vibration after the truck leaves gives natural frequencies by spectral analysis, and comparing them with the model reveals actual stiffness: frequency varies with the square root of stiffness, so a frequency about 6% higher means a stiffness about 13% higher. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dynamic and quasi-static histories” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：慢速峰值 120 με、80 km/h 峰值 142 με：DAF = 142/120 ≈ 1.18。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Crawl peak 120 με and 80 km/h peak 142 με give DAF = 142/120 ≈ 1.18.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「實測頻率比模型高，就代表橋梁沒有任何問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A measured frequency higher than the model means the bridge has no problems." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「動態與準靜態歷時」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dynamic and quasi-static histories”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀
knowledge.text: 一趟高速通過的應變歷時包含兩部分：隨車輛位置緩慢變化的準靜態成分，以及橋梁自身振動造成的動態成分。可用低通濾波從高速趟次中分離準靜態成分，或直接與慢速趟次比較，求得動力放大。
knowledge.textEn: A strain history from a fast run contains two parts: a quasi-static component that follows vehicle position slowly, and a dynamic component from the bridge's own vibration. Low-pass filtering separates the quasi-static part from a fast run, or the fast run can be compared directly with a crawl run, to obtain amplification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：實測頻率比模型高，就代表橋梁沒有任何問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A measured frequency higher than the model means the bridge has no problems. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness" is correct?
options: 實測頻率比模型高，就代表橋梁沒有任何問題。
一趟高速通過的應變歷時包含兩部分：隨車輛位置緩慢變化的準靜態成分，以及橋梁自身振動造成的動態成分。
實測應變比計算低，就可以按比例直接提高橋梁的容許載重。
optionsEn: A measured frequency higher than the model means the bridge has no problems.
A strain history from a fast run contains two parts: a quasi-static component that follows vehicle position slowly, and a dynamic component from the bridge's own vibration.
If measured strain is lower than calculated, the permitted load can be raised in direct proportion.
quiz.explanation: 一趟高速通過的應變歷時包含兩部分：隨車輛位置緩慢變化的準靜態成分，以及橋梁自身振動造成的動態成分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A strain history from a fast run contains two parts: a quasi-static component that follows vehicle position slowly, and a dynamic component from the bridge's own vibration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動態與準靜態歷時」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dynamic and quasi-static histories” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：慢速峰值 120 με、80 km/h 峰值 142 με：DAF = 142/120 ≈ 1.18。第一彎曲頻率 f = (π/2L²)·√(EI/m)，L = 30 m、EI = 8.0×10¹⁰ N·m²、m = 12,000 kg/m：f_m ≈ 4.51 Hz；實測 4.80 Hz，勁度比 (4.80/4.51)² ≈ 1.13，實際勁度約高 13%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Crawl peak 120 με and 80 km/h peak 142 με give DAF = 142/120 ≈ 1.18. The first bending frequency is f = (π/2L²)·√(EI/m); with L = 30 m, EI = 8.0×10¹⁰ N·m² and m = 12,000 kg/m, f_m ≈ 4.51 Hz. A measured 4.80 Hz gives a stiffness ratio (4.80/4.51)² ≈ 1.13, about 13% stiffer than modelled. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以至少兩種方式（慢速比較與濾波分離）計算動力放大，結果應一致；頻率以多趟自由振動與環境振動資料交叉確認，並記錄試驗時溫度，以判斷差異是否來自護欄、鋪面參與或支承束制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute amplification by at least two routes, crawl comparison and filtering, and require agreement; confirm frequencies with several free-vibration records and ambient data, and record test temperature to judge whether differences come from barriers, surfacing or bearing restraint.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 慢速峰值 120 με、80 km/h 峰值 142 με：DAF = 142/120 ≈ 1.18。第一彎曲頻率 f = (π/2L²)·√(EI/m)，L = 30 m、EI = 8.0×10¹⁰ N·m²、m = 12,000 kg/m：f_m ≈ 4.51 Hz；實測 4.80 Hz，勁度比 (4.80/4.51)² ≈ 1.13，實際勁度約高 13%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Crawl peak 120 με and 80 km/h peak 142 με give DAF = 142/120 ≈ 1.18. The first bending frequency is f = (π/2L²)·√(EI/m); with L = 30 m, EI = 8.0×10¹⁰ N·m² and m = 12,000 kg/m, f_m ≈ 4.51 Hz. A measured 4.80 Hz gives a stiffness ratio (4.80/4.51)² ≈ 1.13, about 13% stiffer than modelled. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness", which statement holds?
options: 載重試驗通過一次，就證明橋梁永遠安全。
只要垂直頻率避開 2 Hz，人行橋就不會有振動問題。
optionsEn: Passing one load test proves the bridge safe forever.
As long as the vertical frequency avoids 2 Hz, a footbridge will have no vibration problems.
Crawl peak 120 με and 80 km/h peak 142 με give DAF = 142/120 ≈ 1.18.
quiz.explanation: 慢速峰值 120 με、80 km/h 峰值 142 με：DAF = 142/120 ≈ 1.18。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Crawl peak 120 με and 80 km/h peak 142 με give DAF = 142/120 ≈ 1.18. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「動態與準靜態歷時」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dynamic and quasi-static histories” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以至少兩種方式（慢速比較與濾波分離）計算動力放大，結果應一致；頻率以多趟自由振動與環境振動資料交叉確認，並記錄試驗時溫度，以判斷差異是否來自護欄、鋪面參與或支承束制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute amplification by at least two routes, crawl comparison and filtering, and require agreement; confirm frequencies with several free-vibration records and ambient data, and record test temperature to judge whether differences come from barriers, surfacing or bearing restraint. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：判讀報告要附上每一趟的原始歷時圖、濾波參數與頻譜圖，並說明實測與模型差異的可能來源（非結構構件、支承、溫度）；差異超過預定範圍時必須有工程解釋，不能直接調整模型參數使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The interpretation report should attach each run's raw history, filter settings and spectrum, and explain likely sources of difference between test and model (non-structural elements, bearings, temperature); any difference beyond a preset range needs an engineering explanation, not a quiet parameter tweak to force agreement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低通濾波截止頻率選得太低，會把部分準靜態峰值也濾掉，使動力放大被高估；把較高的實測頻率直接解讀為橋梁很健康，卻沒發現那是支承卡死造成的額外束制，反而掩蓋了另一種問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low-pass cut-off set too low also removes part of the quasi-static peak and overstates amplification; reading a higher measured frequency simply as a healthy bridge can miss that it comes from seized bearings, masking a different problem. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以至少兩種方式（慢速比較與濾波分離）計算動力放大，結果應一致；頻率以多趟自由振動與環境振動資料交叉確認，並記錄試驗時溫度，以判斷差異是否來自護欄、鋪面參與或支承束制。
knowledge.textEn: Compute amplification by at least two routes, crawl comparison and filtering, and require agreement; confirm frequencies with several free-vibration records and ambient data, and record test temperature to judge whether differences come from barriers, surfacing or bearing restraint.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 判讀報告要附上每一趟的原始歷時圖、濾波參數與頻譜圖，並說明實測與模型差異的可能來源（非結構構件、支承、溫度）；差異超過預定範圍時必須有工程解釋，不能直接調整模型參數使其吻合。
knowledge.textEn: The interpretation report should attach each run's raw history, filter settings and spectrum, and explain likely sources of difference between test and model (non-structural elements, bearings, temperature); any difference beyond a preset range needs an engineering explanation, not a quiet parameter tweak to force agreement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness"?
options: 以至少兩種方式（慢速比較與濾波分離）計算動力放大，結果應一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要量到最大應變，取樣率高低並不重要。
optionsEn: Compute amplification by at least two routes, crawl comparison and filtering, and require agreement.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
As long as the maximum strain is captured, sampling rate does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 以至少兩種方式（慢速比較與濾波分離）計算動力放大，結果應一致；頻率以多趟自由振動與環境振動資料交叉確認，並記錄試驗時溫度，以判斷差異是否來自護欄、鋪面參與或支承束制。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute amplification by at least two routes, crawl comparison and filtering, and require agreement; confirm frequencies with several free-vibration records and ambient data, and record test temperature to judge whether differences come from barriers, surfacing or bearing restraint. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動態與準靜態歷時」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dynamic and quasi-static histories” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低通濾波截止頻率選得太低，會把部分準靜態峰值也濾掉，使動力放大被高估；把較高的實測頻率直接解讀為橋梁很健康，卻沒發現那是支承卡死造成的額外束制，反而掩蓋了另一種問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low-pass cut-off set too low also removes part of the quasi-static peak and overstates amplification; reading a higher measured frequency simply as a healthy bridge can miss that it comes from seized bearings, masking a different problem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：車輛離橋後的自由振動可用頻譜分析得到自振頻率，與模型比較即可判斷實際勁度：頻率與勁度的平方根成正比，所以頻率高約 6% 代表勁度高約 13%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The free vibration after the truck leaves gives natural frequencies by spectral analysis, and comparing them with the model reveals actual stiffness: frequency varies with the square root of stiffness, so a frequency about 6% higher means a stiffness about 13% higher.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「實測頻率比模型高，就代表橋梁沒有任何問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A measured frequency higher than the model means the bridge has no problems." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低通濾波截止頻率選得太低，會把部分準靜態峰值也濾掉，使動力放大被高估；把較高的實測頻率直接解讀為橋梁很健康，卻沒發現那是支承卡死造成的額外束制，反而掩蓋了另一種問題。
knowledge.textEn: A low-pass cut-off set too low also removes part of the quasi-static peak and overstates amplification; reading a higher measured frequency simply as a healthy bridge can miss that it comes from seized bearings, masking a different problem.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「動力放大、頻率與勁度判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interpreting amplification, frequency and stiffness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
低通濾波截止頻率選得太低，會把部分準靜態峰值也濾掉，使動力放大被高估。
實測應變比計算低，就可以按比例直接提高橋梁的容許載重。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A low-pass cut-off set too low also removes part of the quasi-static peak and overstates amplification.
If measured strain is lower than calculated, the permitted load can be raised in direct proportion.
quiz.explanation: 低通濾波截止頻率選得太低，會把部分準靜態峰值也濾掉，使動力放大被高估；把較高的實測頻率直接解讀為橋梁很健康，卻沒發現那是支承卡死造成的額外束制，反而掩蓋了另一種問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low-pass cut-off set too low also removes part of the quasi-static peak and overstates amplification; reading a higher measured frequency simply as a healthy bridge can miss that it comes from seized bearings, masking a different problem. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 模型修正與載重評等：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Model updating and load rating: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「試驗修正係數」如何影響橋梁動態荷重試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Test adjustment factor” governs force, deformation or durability in “Dynamic bridge load testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 試驗的最終用途常是載重評等：若實測應變低於計算值，表示橋梁有計算未考慮的有利機制，例如未設計為組合作用的混凝土橋面、護欄參與、支承束制或較佳的橫向分配。AASHTO 橋梁評估手冊允許以試驗修正係數調整計算評等，但必須判斷這些有利機制在更重載重下是否仍然可靠；支承束制或未設計的組合作用可能在重載下失效，因此修正量要打折。動態試驗得到的實測動力放大也可取代規範值，前提是路面條件被納入管理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「試驗修正係數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The usual end use of a test is load rating: measured strains below calculation show favourable mechanisms the calculation ignored, such as unintended composite action with the deck, barrier participation, bearing restraint or better lateral distribution. The AASHTO Manual for Bridge Evaluation lets a test adjustment factor modify the calculated rating, but engineers must judge whether those mechanisms remain reliable under heavier loads; bearing restraint or unintended composite action can break down under heavy load, so the benefit is discounted. A measured dynamic amplification can also replace the code value, provided the surface condition is managed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Test adjustment factor” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：評等修正 RF_T = RF_c·K，K = 1 + K_a·K_b。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Rating adjustment RF_T = RF_c·K with K = 1 + K_a·K_b.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「實測應變比計算低，就可以按比例直接提高橋梁的容許載重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If measured strain is lower than calculated, the permitted load can be raised in direct proportion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「試驗修正係數」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Test adjustment factor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模型修正與載重評等
knowledge.text: 試驗的最終用途常是載重評等：若實測應變低於計算值，表示橋梁有計算未考慮的有利機制，例如未設計為組合作用的混凝土橋面、護欄參與、支承束制或較佳的橫向分配。AASHTO 橋梁評估手冊允許以試驗修正係數調整計算評等，但必須判斷這些有利機制在更重載重下是否仍然可靠；支承束制或未設計的組合作用可能在重載下失效，因此修正量要打折。
knowledge.textEn: The usual end use of a test is load rating: measured strains below calculation show favourable mechanisms the calculation ignored, such as unintended composite action with the deck, barrier participation, bearing restraint or better lateral distribution. The AASHTO Manual for Bridge Evaluation lets a test adjustment factor modify the calculated rating, but engineers must judge whether those mechanisms remain reliable under heavier loads; bearing restraint or unintended composite action can break down under heavy load, so the benefit is discounted.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：實測應變比計算低，就可以按比例直接提高橋梁的容許載重。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If measured strain is lower than calculated, the permitted load can be raised in direct proportion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模型修正與載重評等」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Model updating and load rating" is correct?
options: 實測應變比計算低，就可以按比例直接提高橋梁的容許載重。
加大構件斷面一定是解決人行橋振動最有效的方法。
試驗的最終用途常是載重評等：若實測應變低於計算值，表示橋梁有計算未考慮的有利機制，例如未設計為組合作用的混凝土橋面、護欄參與、支承束制或較佳的橫向分配。
optionsEn: If measured strain is lower than calculated, the permitted load can be raised in direct proportion.
Enlarging member sections is always the most effective cure for footbridge vibration.

The usual end use of a test is load rating: measured strains below calculation show favourable mechanisms the calculation ignored, such as unintended composite action with the deck, barrier participation, bearing restraint or better lateral distribution.
quiz.explanation: 試驗的最終用途常是載重評等：若實測應變低於計算值，表示橋梁有計算未考慮的有利機制，例如未設計為組合作用的混凝土橋面、護欄參與、支承束制或較佳的橫向分配。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The usual end use of a test is load rating: measured strains below calculation show favourable mechanisms the calculation ignored, such as unintended composite action with the deck, barrier participation, bearing restraint or better lateral distribution. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模型修正與載重評等：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Model updating and load rating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試驗修正係數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Test adjustment factor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：評等修正 RF_T = RF_c·K，K = 1 + K_a·K_b。計算應變 ε_c = 150 με、實測 ε_T = 120 με：K_a = ε_c/ε_T − 1 = 0.25；取 K_b = 0.5（試驗載重相對評等載重較低、有利機制不完全可靠），K = 1.125。原評等 RF_c = 0.92 提升為 0.92×1.125 ≈ 1.04。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Rating adjustment RF_T = RF_c·K with K = 1 + K_a·K_b. With calculated strain ε_c = 150 με and measured ε_T = 120 με, K_a = ε_c/ε_T − 1 = 0.25; taking K_b = 0.5 (test load low relative to the rating load, favourable mechanisms not fully reliable) gives K = 1.125, raising RF_c = 0.92 to 0.92×1.125 ≈ 1.04. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實測資料更新有限元素模型的邊界勁度與組合作用程度，檢查模型能否同時重現多個量測點與多個車道的反應，而不只是單一點；修正係數的取值依據要逐項說明，並由評等工程師簽認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Update boundary stiffness and degree of composite action in the finite-element model from the test data, and check that it reproduces responses at many gauges and in several lanes, not just one point; justify each term of the adjustment factor and have the rating engineer sign it.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 評等修正 RF_T = RF_c·K，K = 1 + K_a·K_b。計算應變 ε_c = 150 με、實測 ε_T = 120 με：K_a = ε_c/ε_T − 1 = 0.25；取 K_b = 0.5（試驗載重相對評等載重較低、有利機制不完全可靠），K = 1.125。原評等 RF_c = 0.92 提升為 0.92×1.125 ≈ 1.04。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Rating adjustment RF_T = RF_c·K with K = 1 + K_a·K_b. With calculated strain ε_c = 150 με and measured ε_T = 120 με, K_a = ε_c/ε_T − 1 = 0.25; taking K_b = 0.5 (test load low relative to the rating load, favourable mechanisms not fully reliable) gives K = 1.125, raising RF_c = 0.92 to 0.92×1.125 ≈ 1.04. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模型修正與載重評等」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Model updating and load rating", which statement holds?
options: 評等修正 RF_T = RF_c·K，K = 1 + K_a·K_b。
車速越快，橋梁的動力放大一定越大。
載重試驗用的車越重，得到的結論就越可靠。
optionsEn: Rating adjustment RF_T = RF_c·K with K = 1 + K_a·K_b.
The faster the vehicle, the larger the dynamic amplification must be.
The heavier the test vehicle, the more reliable the conclusions.
quiz.explanation: 評等修正 RF_T = RF_c·K，K = 1 + K_a·K_b。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Rating adjustment RF_T = RF_c·K with K = 1 + K_a·K_b. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模型修正與載重評等：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Model updating and load rating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試驗修正係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Test adjustment factor” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實測資料更新有限元素模型的邊界勁度與組合作用程度，檢查模型能否同時重現多個量測點與多個車道的反應，而不只是單一點；修正係數的取值依據要逐項說明，並由評等工程師簽認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Update boundary stiffness and degree of composite action in the finite-element model from the test data, and check that it reproduces responses at many gauges and in several lanes, not just one point; justify each term of the adjustment factor and have the rating engineer sign it. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以試驗提高評等時，報告必須列出所依賴的有利機制、可能失效的條件與重新試驗的觸發事件（例如支承更換、橋面重鋪、超重車輛增加），並明訂評等結果的適用期限。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When a test raises a rating, the report must list the favourable mechanisms relied on, the conditions under which they could fail and the events that trigger retesting (bearing replacement, resurfacing, more overweight traffic), and state how long the rating remains valid.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把支承卡死造成的有利束制當成永久性能而大幅提高評等，若支承日後鬆動或更換，實際應力會回到計算值以上；只用單一量測點修正模型，可能把局部效應誤當成整體行為。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating restraint from seized bearings as permanent and raising the rating sharply leaves stresses above calculation once the bearings free up or are replaced; updating the model on a single gauge can mistake a local effect for global behaviour. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以實測資料更新有限元素模型的邊界勁度與組合作用程度，檢查模型能否同時重現多個量測點與多個車道的反應，而不只是單一點；修正係數的取值依據要逐項說明，並由評等工程師簽認。
knowledge.textEn: Update boundary stiffness and degree of composite action in the finite-element model from the test data, and check that it reproduces responses at many gauges and in several lanes, not just one point; justify each term of the adjustment factor and have the rating engineer sign it.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以試驗提高評等時，報告必須列出所依賴的有利機制、可能失效的條件與重新試驗的觸發事件（例如支承更換、橋面重鋪、超重車輛增加），並明訂評等結果的適用期限。
knowledge.textEn: When a test raises a rating, the report must list the favourable mechanisms relied on, the conditions under which they could fail and the events that trigger retesting (bearing replacement, resurfacing, more overweight traffic), and state how long the rating remains valid.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模型修正與載重評等」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Model updating and load rating"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以實測資料更新有限元素模型的邊界勁度與組合作用程度，檢查模型能否同時重現多個量測點與多個車道的反應，而不只是單一點。
動態試驗只要讓卡車以最高速通過一次就夠了。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Update boundary stiffness and degree of composite action in the finite-element model from the test data, and check that it reproduces responses at many gauges and in several lanes, not just one point.
A dynamic test only needs one pass of the truck at top speed.
quiz.explanation: 以實測資料更新有限元素模型的邊界勁度與組合作用程度，檢查模型能否同時重現多個量測點與多個車道的反應，而不只是單一點；修正係數的取值依據要逐項說明，並由評等工程師簽認。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Update boundary stiffness and degree of composite action in the finite-element model from the test data, and check that it reproduces responses at many gauges and in several lanes, not just one point; justify each term of the adjustment factor and have the rating engineer sign it. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模型修正與載重評等：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Model updating and load rating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試驗修正係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Test adjustment factor” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把支承卡死造成的有利束制當成永久性能而大幅提高評等，若支承日後鬆動或更換，實際應力會回到計算值以上；只用單一量測點修正模型，可能把局部效應誤當成整體行為。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating restraint from seized bearings as permanent and raising the rating sharply leaves stresses above calculation once the bearings free up or are replaced; updating the model on a single gauge can mistake a local effect for global behaviour. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：動態試驗得到的實測動力放大也可取代規範值，前提是路面條件被納入管理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A measured dynamic amplification can also replace the code value, provided the surface condition is managed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「實測應變比計算低，就可以按比例直接提高橋梁的容許載重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If measured strain is lower than calculated, the permitted load can be raised in direct proportion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把支承卡死造成的有利束制當成永久性能而大幅提高評等，若支承日後鬆動或更換，實際應力會回到計算值以上；只用單一量測點修正模型，可能把局部效應誤當成整體行為。
knowledge.textEn: Treating restraint from seized bearings as permanent and raising the rating sharply leaves stresses above calculation once the bearings free up or are replaced; updating the model on a single gauge can mistake a local effect for global behaviour.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模型修正與載重評等」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Model updating and load rating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
加大構件斷面一定是解決人行橋振動最有效的方法。
把支承卡死造成的有利束制當成永久性能而大幅提高評等，若支承日後鬆動或更換，實際應力會回到計算值以上；只用單一量測點修正模型，可能把局部效應誤當成整體行為。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Enlarging member sections is always the most effective cure for footbridge vibration.
Treating restraint from seized bearings as permanent and raising the rating sharply leaves stresses above calculation once the bearings free up or are replaced.
quiz.explanation: 把支承卡死造成的有利束制當成永久性能而大幅提高評等，若支承日後鬆動或更換，實際應力會回到計算值以上；只用單一量測點修正模型，可能把局部效應誤當成整體行為。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating restraint from seized bearings as permanent and raising the rating sharply leaves stresses above calculation once the bearings free up or are replaced; updating the model on a single gauge can mistake a local effect for global behaviour. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「舒適度準則與振動改善」與「試驗報告、重現性與基準交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Comfort criteria and vibration retrofit" and "Test report, repeatability and baseline handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 舒適度準則與振動改善：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Comfort criteria and vibration retrofit: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「黏滯阻尼器與調諧質量阻尼器」如何影響橋梁動態荷重試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Viscous dampers and TMDs” governs force, deformation or durability in “Dynamic bridge load testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 人行橋與輕量橋梁的振動多半是使用性問題而非強度問題，判斷標準是加速度：歐洲規範 EN 1990 附錄 A2 建議人行橋垂直加速度不超過 0.7 m/s²，側向在一般使用不超過 0.2 m/s²、特殊人群情況 0.4 m/s²。千禧橋的改造加裝了 37 組黏滯阻尼器與 52 組調諧質量阻尼器，2002 年 2 月 22 日重新開放後沒有再出現明顯振動。改造前後都需要動態試驗：前者確定要對付哪些振態，後者證明阻尼確實達到目標。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「黏滯阻尼器與調諧質量阻尼器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vibration of footbridges and light bridges is mostly a serviceability issue rather than a strength issue, judged by acceleration: EN 1990 Annex A2 recommends a maximum footbridge acceleration of 0.7 m/s² vertically and 0.2 m/s² laterally in normal use, 0.4 m/s² for exceptional crowds. The Millennium Bridge retrofit added 37 viscous dampers and 52 tuned mass dampers, and since reopening on 22 February 2002 it has shown no significant vibration. Dynamic tests are needed both before a retrofit, to identify the modes to treat, and after it, to prove the damping target was reached. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Viscous dampers and TMDs” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：共振加速度 a ≈ F/(2ζM)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Resonant acceleration a ≈ F/(2ζM).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加大構件斷面一定是解決人行橋振動最有效的方法。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Enlarging member sections is always the most effective cure for footbridge vibration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Viscous dampers and TMDs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Comfort criteria and vibration retrofit" is correct?
options: 人行橋與輕量橋梁的振動多半是使用性問題而非強度問題，判斷標準是加速度：歐洲規範 EN 1990 附錄 A2 建議人行橋垂直加速度不超過 0.7 m/s²，側向在一般使用不超過 0.2 m/s²、特殊人群情況 0.4 m/s²。

Enlarging member sections is always the most effective cure for footbridge vibration.
Passing one load test proves the bridge safe forever.
quiz.explanation: 人行橋與輕量橋梁的振動多半是使用性問題而非強度問題，判斷標準是加速度：歐洲規範 EN 1990 附錄 A2 建議人行橋垂直加速度不超過 0.7 m/s²，側向在一般使用不超過 0.2 m/s²、特殊人群情況 0.4 m/s²。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 舒適度準則與振動改善：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Comfort criteria and vibration retrofit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏滯阻尼器與調諧質量阻尼器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Viscous dampers and TMDs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：共振加速度 a ≈ F/(2ζM)。側向等效人群力 F = 250 N、模態質量 M = 100,000 kg、ζ = 0.5%：a = 250/(2×0.005×100,000) = 0.25 m/s²，超過 0.2 m/s²；要降到 0.2 m/s² 需 ζ ≥ 250/(2×100,000×0.2) ≈ 0.63%，實務上會取更高的阻尼以涵蓋人群同步。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Resonant acceleration a ≈ F/(2ζM). With an equivalent lateral crowd force F = 250 N, modal mass M = 100,000 kg and ζ = 0.5%, a = 250/(2×0.005×100,000) = 0.25 m/s², above 0.2 m/s²; reaching 0.2 m/s² needs ζ ≥ 250/(2×100,000×0.2) ≈ 0.63%, and practice adopts much higher damping to cover crowd lock-in. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：改造後以與改造前相同的條件重做試驗（同樣的人數分級或激振頻率），比較加速度與阻尼比；阻尼器出廠前另做力—速度試驗，交接時記錄每組阻尼器的編號與位置，作為日後維護比對的基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After a retrofit, repeat the tests under the same conditions as before (same crowd stages or excitation frequencies) and compare accelerations and damping ratios; test each damper for force and velocity before delivery, and record serial numbers and locations at handover as the baseline for later maintenance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 共振加速度 a ≈ F/(2ζM)。側向等效人群力 F = 250 N、模態質量 M = 100,000 kg、ζ = 0.5%：a = 250/(2×0.005×100,000) = 0.25 m/s²，超過 0.2 m/s²；要降到 0.2 m/s² 需 ζ ≥ 250/(2×100,000×0.2) ≈ 0.63%，實務上會取更高的阻尼以涵蓋人群同步。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Resonant acceleration a ≈ F/(2ζM). With an equivalent lateral crowd force F = 250 N, modal mass M = 100,000 kg and ζ = 0.5%, a = 250/(2×0.005×100,000) = 0.25 m/s², above 0.2 m/s²; reaching 0.2 m/s² needs ζ ≥ 250/(2×100,000×0.2) ≈ 0.63%, and practice adopts much higher damping to cover crowd lock-in. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「舒適度準則與振動改善」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Comfort criteria and vibration retrofit", which statement holds?
options: 只要垂直頻率避開 2 Hz，人行橋就不會有振動問題。
共振加速度 a ≈ F/(2ζM)。
只要量到最大應變，取樣率高低並不重要。
optionsEn: As long as the vertical frequency avoids 2 Hz, a footbridge will have no vibration problems.
Resonant acceleration a ≈ F/(2ζM).
As long as the maximum strain is captured, sampling rate does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 共振加速度 a ≈ F/(2ζM)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Resonant acceleration a ≈ F/(2ζM). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 舒適度準則與振動改善：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Comfort criteria and vibration retrofit: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「黏滯阻尼器與調諧質量阻尼器」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Viscous dampers and TMDs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 改造後以與改造前相同的條件重做試驗（同樣的人數分級或激振頻率），比較加速度與阻尼比；阻尼器出廠前另做力—速度試驗，交接時記錄每組阻尼器的編號與位置，作為日後維護比對的基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After a retrofit, repeat the tests under the same conditions as before (same crowd stages or excitation frequencies) and compare accelerations and damping ratios; test each damper for force and velocity before delivery, and record serial numbers and locations at handover as the baseline for later maintenance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：振動改善設計應由設計者、阻尼器供應商與試驗單位共同確認目標振態與目標阻尼，並把改造後的驗證試驗列為重新開放的停留點，由業主核准後才開放通行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The designer, damper supplier and test team should jointly confirm target modes and target damping, and the post-retrofit verification test should be a hold point for reopening, released only on the owner's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只針對開幕時出問題的振態加裝阻尼，未檢查其他接近步頻的振態，人群密度增加後可能換另一個振態被激發；阻尼器連接件鬆動或漏油，也會使阻尼逐年下降而無人察覺。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Damping only the mode that misbehaved at opening, without checking other modes near walking frequencies, lets another mode take over when crowds grow denser; loose damper connections or leaking units let damping fall year by year unnoticed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 改造後以與改造前相同的條件重做試驗（同樣的人數分級或激振頻率），比較加速度與阻尼比；阻尼器出廠前另做力—速度試驗，交接時記錄每組阻尼器的編號與位置，作為日後維護比對的基準。
knowledge.textEn: After a retrofit, repeat the tests under the same conditions as before (same crowd stages or excitation frequencies) and compare accelerations and damping ratios; test each damper for force and velocity before delivery, and record serial numbers and locations at handover as the baseline for later maintenance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 振動改善設計應由設計者、阻尼器供應商與試驗單位共同確認目標振態與目標阻尼，並把改造後的驗證試驗列為重新開放的停留點，由業主核准後才開放通行。
knowledge.textEn: The designer, damper supplier and test team should jointly confirm target modes and target damping, and the post-retrofit verification test should be a hold point for reopening, released only on the owner's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「舒適度準則與振動改善」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Comfort criteria and vibration retrofit"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
人行橋只要強度設計通過，就不必做人群振動試驗。
改造後以與改造前相同的條件重做試驗（同樣的人數分級或激振頻率），比較加速度與阻尼比。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If a footbridge passes its strength design, it needs no crowd vibration test.
After a retrofit, repeat the tests under the same conditions as before (same crowd stages or excitation frequencies) and compare accelerations and damping ratios.
quiz.explanation: 改造後以與改造前相同的條件重做試驗（同樣的人數分級或激振頻率），比較加速度與阻尼比；阻尼器出廠前另做力—速度試驗，交接時記錄每組阻尼器的編號與位置，作為日後維護比對的基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After a retrofit, repeat the tests under the same conditions as before (same crowd stages or excitation frequencies) and compare accelerations and damping ratios; test each damper for force and velocity before delivery, and record serial numbers and locations at handover as the baseline for later maintenance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 舒適度準則與振動改善：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Comfort criteria and vibration retrofit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「黏滯阻尼器與調諧質量阻尼器」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Viscous dampers and TMDs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只針對開幕時出問題的振態加裝阻尼，未檢查其他接近步頻的振態，人群密度增加後可能換另一個振態被激發；阻尼器連接件鬆動或漏油，也會使阻尼逐年下降而無人察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Damping only the mode that misbehaved at opening, without checking other modes near walking frequencies, lets another mode take over when crowds grow denser; loose damper connections or leaking units let damping fall year by year unnoticed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：改造前後都需要動態試驗：前者確定要對付哪些振態，後者證明阻尼確實達到目標。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dynamic tests are needed both before a retrofit, to identify the modes to treat, and after it, to prove the damping target was reached.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加大構件斷面一定是解決人行橋振動最有效的方法。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Enlarging member sections is always the most effective cure for footbridge vibration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只針對開幕時出問題的振態加裝阻尼，未檢查其他接近步頻的振態，人群密度增加後可能換另一個振態被激發；阻尼器連接件鬆動或漏油，也會使阻尼逐年下降而無人察覺。
knowledge.textEn: Damping only the mode that misbehaved at opening, without checking other modes near walking frequencies, lets another mode take over when crowds grow denser; loose damper connections or leaking units let damping fall year by year unnoticed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「舒適度準則與振動改善」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Comfort criteria and vibration retrofit" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只針對開幕時出問題的振態加裝阻尼，未檢查其他接近步頻的振態，人群密度增加後可能換另一個振態被激發；阻尼器連接件鬆動或漏油，也會使阻尼逐年下降而無人察覺。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
載重試驗通過一次，就證明橋梁永遠安全。
optionsEn: Damping only the mode that misbehaved at opening, without checking other modes near walking frequencies, lets another mode take over when crowds grow denser.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Passing one load test proves the bridge safe forever.
quiz.explanation: 若只針對開幕時出問題的振態加裝阻尼，未檢查其他接近步頻的振態，人群密度增加後可能換另一個振態被激發；阻尼器連接件鬆動或漏油，也會使阻尼逐年下降而無人察覺。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Damping only the mode that misbehaved at opening, without checking other modes near walking frequencies, lets another mode take over when crowds grow denser; loose damper connections or leaking units let damping fall year by year unnoticed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 試驗報告、重現性與基準交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Test report, repeatability and baseline handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「動態試驗基準檔」如何影響橋梁動態荷重試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dynamic-test baseline file” governs force, deformation or durability in “Dynamic bridge load testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一次動態試驗的價值會延續數十年：它提供橋梁在已知載重、溫度與路面下的頻率、阻尼、動力放大與影響線，是之後健康監測、補強與重新評等的比較基準。要讓基準能被他人使用，報告必須保存原始資料、試驗車重與軸距、車速與車道、感測器位置與方向、溫度與路面狀況，並說明結果的離散度。千禧橋改造前後以同一套試驗邏輯對照，正是用試驗驗證工程成效的例子；1940 年塔科馬海峽橋通車約四個月即在風中倒塌，也提醒動力行為必須被量測而不只是假設。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「動態試驗基準檔」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A single dynamic test keeps its value for decades: it gives frequencies, damping, amplification and influence lines under known load, temperature and surface condition, the baseline for later monitoring, strengthening and re-rating. For others to use it, the report must preserve raw data, truck weights and axle spacings, speeds and lanes, sensor positions and orientations, temperature and surface condition, and state the scatter of results. Comparing the Millennium Bridge before and after its retrofit with the same test logic is an example of verifying engineering work by testing, and the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, which fell in the wind about four months after opening in 1940, is a reminder that dynamic behaviour must be measured, not merely assumed. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Dynamic-test baseline file” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Three repeat runs give DAF = 1.18, 1.22 and 1.15: mean 1.183, standard deviation 0.035; the 95% confidence half-width is t(0.975, 2)×s/√3 = 4.303×0.035/1.732 ≈ 0.087, an upper bound of about 1.27.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「載重試驗通過一次，就證明橋梁永遠安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing one load test proves the bridge safe forever." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「動態試驗基準檔」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Dynamic-test baseline file”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「試驗報告、重現性與基準交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 試驗報告、重現性與基準交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Test report, repeatability and baseline handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動態試驗基準檔」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dynamic-test baseline file” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三趟重複得 DAF = 1.18、1.22、1.15：平均 1.183、標準差 0.035；95% 信賴區間半寬 = t(0.975, 2)×s/√3 = 4.303×0.035/1.732 ≈ 0.087，上限約 1.27。評等若採 1.27 仍低於規範的 1.33；若只做一趟，就無法評估這個離散度。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Three repeat runs give DAF = 1.18, 1.22 and 1.15: mean 1.183, standard deviation 0.035; the 95% confidence half-width is t(0.975, 2)×s/√3 = 4.303×0.035/1.732 ≈ 0.087, an upper bound of about 1.27. Rating with 1.27 still stays below the code's 1.33; a single run could not reveal this scatter at all. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前由第三方抽取數趟原始資料，依報告記載的處理參數重算峰值、動力放大與頻率，確認可以重現；檢查報告是否附有試驗車秤重單、儀器校正證書與試驗日誌，並確認資料格式可被業主的監測系統讀取。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, have a third party take several raw runs and recompute peaks, amplification and frequencies with the processing parameters in the report to confirm reproducibility; check that weighbridge tickets, calibration certificates and the test log are attached and that the data format can be read by the owner's monitoring system.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Three repeat runs give DAF = 1.18, 1.22 and 1.15: mean 1.183, standard deviation 0.035; the 95% confidence half-width is t(0.975, 2)×s/√3 = 4.303×0.035/1.732 ≈ 0.087, an upper bound of about 1.27. Rating with 1.27 still stays below the code's 1.33; a single run could not reveal this scatter at all. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試驗報告、重現性與基準交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Test report, repeatability and baseline handover", which statement holds?
options: 載重試驗用的車越重，得到的結論就越可靠。
動態試驗只要讓卡車以最高速通過一次就夠了。
optionsEn: The heavier the test vehicle, the more reliable the conclusions.
A dynamic test only needs one pass of the truck at top speed.
Three repeat runs give DAF = 1.18, 1.22 and 1.15: mean 1.183, standard deviation 0.035.
quiz.explanationEn: Three repeat runs give DAF = 1.18, 1.22 and 1.15: mean 1.183, standard deviation 0.035; the 95% confidence half-width is t(0.975, 2)×s/√3 = 4.303×0.035/1.732 ≈ 0.087, an upper bound of about 1.27. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試驗報告、重現性與基準交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Test report, repeatability and baseline handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「動態試驗基準檔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dynamic-test baseline file” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前由第三方抽取數趟原始資料，依報告記載的處理參數重算峰值、動力放大與頻率，確認可以重現；檢查報告是否附有試驗車秤重單、儀器校正證書與試驗日誌，並確認資料格式可被業主的監測系統讀取。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, have a third party take several raw runs and recompute peaks, amplification and frequencies with the processing parameters in the report to confirm reproducibility; check that weighbridge tickets, calibration certificates and the test log are attached and that the data format can be read by the owner's monitoring system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：業主應把動態試驗資料納入橋梁管理系統，訂定重新試驗的觸發條件（重大補強、事故、評等變更、伸縮縫更換），並要求後續試驗盡量沿用相同的量測點與試驗車配置，以便直接比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The owner should load dynamic-test data into the bridge management system, define triggers for retesting (major strengthening, accidents, rating changes, joint replacement), and require later tests to reuse the same gauge locations and truck configuration wherever possible so results compare directly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若報告只留下結論數字，十年後橋梁補強或改建時，工程師無法判斷頻率變化是結構改變還是試驗方法不同；試驗車重與溫度紀錄缺漏，則讓前後兩次試驗無法比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the report keeps only conclusions, engineers strengthening or rebuilding the bridge ten years later cannot tell whether a frequency change reflects the structure or a different test method; missing truck weights or temperatures make the two tests incomparable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前由第三方抽取數趟原始資料，依報告記載的處理參數重算峰值、動力放大與頻率，確認可以重現；檢查報告是否附有試驗車秤重單、儀器校正證書與試驗日誌，並確認資料格式可被業主的監測系統讀取。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, have a third party take several raw runs and recompute peaks, amplification and frequencies with the processing parameters in the report to confirm reproducibility; check that weighbridge tickets, calibration certificates and the test log are attached and that the data format can be read by the owner's monitoring system.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試驗報告、重現性與基準交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Test report, repeatability and baseline handover"?
options: 交接前由第三方抽取數趟原始資料，依報告記載的處理參數重算峰值、動力放大與頻率，確認可以重現。

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 試驗報告、重現性與基準交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Test report, repeatability and baseline handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動態試驗基準檔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dynamic-test baseline file” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若報告只留下結論數字，十年後橋梁補強或改建時，工程師無法判斷頻率變化是結構改變還是試驗方法不同；試驗車重與溫度紀錄缺漏，則讓前後兩次試驗無法比較。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the report keeps only conclusions, engineers strengthening or rebuilding the bridge ten years later cannot tell whether a frequency change reflects the structure or a different test method; missing truck weights or temperatures make the two tests incomparable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：千禧橋改造前後以同一套試驗邏輯對照，正是用試驗驗證工程成效的例子；1940 年塔科馬海峽橋通車約四個月即在風中倒塌，也提醒動力行為必須被量測而不只是假設。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Comparing the Millennium Bridge before and after its retrofit with the same test logic is an example of verifying engineering work by testing, and the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, which fell in the wind about four months after opening in 1940, is a reminder that dynamic behaviour must be measured, not merely assumed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「載重試驗通過一次，就證明橋梁永遠安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing one load test proves the bridge safe forever." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若報告只留下結論數字，十年後橋梁補強或改建時，工程師無法判斷頻率變化是結構改變還是試驗方法不同；試驗車重與溫度紀錄缺漏，則讓前後兩次試驗無法比較。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試驗報告、重現性與基準交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Test report, repeatability and baseline handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若報告只留下結論數字，十年後橋梁補強或改建時，工程師無法判斷頻率變化是結構改變還是試驗方法不同；試驗車重與溫度紀錄缺漏，則讓前後兩次試驗無法比較。
車速越快，橋梁的動力放大一定越大。

If the report keeps only conclusions, engineers strengthening or rebuilding the bridge ten years later cannot tell whether a frequency change reflects the structure or a different test method.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 哈里發塔
summary: 從 Y 形扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度、螺旋退縮與風洞定向出發，計算 C80 牆體在徐變下的鋼筋分擔、3.7 m 筏基與摩擦樁的承載，再處理自爬模核心先行、約 600 m 的混凝土泵送、GPS 垂直度控制、應變監測分解，最後是鹽水地層的基礎耐久與外牆維護系統的交接。
summaryEn: Starting from the load path and direction-independent stiffness of the Y-shaped buttressed core and from spiralling setbacks and wind-tunnel orientation, compute creep-driven load sharing in C80 walls and the capacity of the 3.7 m raft and friction piles, then handle core-first self-climbing formwork, pumping concrete to about 600 m, GPS verticality control and strain decomposition, ending with foundation durability in saline ground and the handover of the façade access system.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 垂直縮短補償練習：某核心牆長期軸壓 15 MPa，C80 混凝土 E_c = 43.8 GPa。彈性應變 15/43,800 ≈ 342 με；徐變係數取 1.2，徐變應變約 411 με；乾縮取 200 με，總應變約 953 με。牆高 400 m 時總縮短約 953×10⁻⁶×400,000 ≈ 381 mm，平均每 3.5 m 樓層約 3.3 mm，因此每層模板標高可預加約 3 mm，並在施工中依量測修正。若改用 E_c = 36 GPa 的較低強度混凝土，彈性應變約 417 με、總應變約 1,117 με，總縮短增為約 447 mm，每層約 3.9 mm。周邊柱若應力較高、縮短較多，牆柱之間的差異縮短會使樓板傾斜，必須分別補償。數值為教學假設，不代表哈里發塔的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Vertical shortening compensation: a core wall carries 15 MPa sustained stress in C80 concrete with E_c = 43.8 GPa. The elastic strain is 15/43,800 ≈ 342 με; with a creep coefficient of 1.2 the creep strain is about 411 με, and shrinkage of 200 με brings the total to about 953 με. Over 400 m of wall this is about 953×10⁻⁶×400,000 ≈ 381 mm of shortening, or about 3.3 mm per 3.5 m storey, so each floor's formwork level can be raised by about 3 mm and corrected from measurements during construction. With a lower-strength concrete of E_c = 36 GPa the elastic strain is about 417 με, the total about 1,117 με and the shortening rises to about 447 mm, about 3.9 mm per storey. If perimeter columns are more highly stressed and shorten more, the differential shortening between walls and columns tilts the slabs and must be compensated separately. Values are teaching assumptions, not Burj Khalifa's design values.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度」與「退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness" and "Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「Y 形扶壁核心」如何影響哈里發塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Y-shaped buttressed core” governs force, deformation or durability in “Burj Khalifa”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 哈里發塔的平面是三翼的 Y 形，中央六角形核心由三翼的走廊牆像扶壁一樣互相撐住，每一翼都有自己的高性能混凝土核心牆與周邊柱，機械層另設五組外伸臂把核心與周邊柱連成整體。這種配置使扭轉勁度很高，三翼對稱也讓側向勁度幾乎不隨風向改變；上層柱對齊下層牆，形成連續傳力路徑，避免轉換構件及其造成的工期延誤。塔頂以鋼結構塔尖延續中央核心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「Y 形扶壁核心」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Burj Khalifa's plan is a three-winged Y. A central hexagonal core is buttressed by the corridor walls of the three wings, each wing has its own high-performance concrete core walls and perimeter columns, and five sets of outriggers at mechanical floors tie the core to the perimeter columns. This arrangement gives very high torsional stiffness, and the three-fold symmetry makes lateral stiffness almost independent of wind direction; columns above align with walls below to form a continuous load path, avoiding transfer structures and the delays they bring. At the top the central core continues as a structural steel spire. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Y-shaped buttressed core” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：三翼牆群對形心的慣性矩 I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Moment of inertia of the wing-wall groups about the centroid, I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「Y 形平面只是為了造型與景觀，對結構沒有好處。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The Y-shaped plan is only for appearance and views and gives no structural benefit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「Y 形扶壁核心」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Y-shaped buttressed core”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度
knowledge.titleEn: Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness
