knowledge.textEn: Burj Khalifa's plan is a three-winged Y. A central hexagonal core is buttressed by the corridor walls of the three wings, each wing has its own high-performance concrete core walls and perimeter columns, and five sets of outriggers at mechanical floors tie the core to the perimeter columns.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：Y 形平面只是為了造型與景觀，對結構沒有好處。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The Y-shaped plan is only for appearance and views and gives no structural benefit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness" is correct?
options: Y 形平面只是為了造型與景觀，對結構沒有好處。
哈里發塔的平面是三翼的 Y 形，中央六角形核心由三翼的走廊牆像扶壁一樣互相撐住，每一翼都有自己的高性能混凝土核心牆與周邊柱，機械層另設五組外伸臂把核心與周邊柱連成整體。
只要結構夠強，建築外形對風力的影響可以忽略。
optionsEn: The Y-shaped plan is only for appearance and views and gives no structural benefit.
Burj Khalifa's plan is a three-winged Y.
If the structure is strong enough, building shape has negligible effect on wind loads.
quiz.explanation: 哈里發塔的平面是三翼的 Y 形，中央六角形核心由三翼的走廊牆像扶壁一樣互相撐住，每一翼都有自己的高性能混凝土核心牆與周邊柱，機械層另設五組外伸臂把核心與周邊柱連成整體。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Burj Khalifa's plan is a three-winged Y. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Y 形扶壁核心」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Y-shaped buttressed core” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三翼牆群對形心的慣性矩 I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)²。三翼各 A = 60 m²、形心距 d = 25 m、夾角 120° 時，任何方向的 Σcos² 都等於 1.5，I = 1.5×60×25² = 56,250 m⁴，與風向無關。若改為兩翼一字形，順翼方向 I = 2×60×25² = 75,000 m⁴，垂直方向只剩牆體自身很小的慣性矩。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Moment of inertia of the wing-wall groups about the centroid, I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)². With three wings of A = 60 m² at d = 25 m and 120° apart, Σcos² equals 1.5 in every direction, so I = 1.5×60×25² = 56,250 m⁴ regardless of wind direction. A two-winged straight plan gives I = 2×60×25² = 75,000 m⁴ along the wings but only the walls' small self-inertia across them. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維殼元素模型（公開論文中的模型超過 73,500 個殼元素與 75,000 個節點）在 0° 至 360° 每隔 15° 施加單位側力，確認頂層變位與基底反力幾乎不隨方向改變；再逐一檢查各翼退縮處的柱牆對位與樓板傳力，確認沒有隱藏的轉換構件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Apply unit lateral loads every 15° from 0° to 360° to a three-dimensional shell model (the published model had more than 73,500 shell elements and 75,000 nodes) and confirm that top displacement and base reactions barely change with direction; then check column-to-wall alignment and slab load transfer at each wing setback to confirm there are no hidden transfer members.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 三翼牆群對形心的慣性矩 I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)²。三翼各 A = 60 m²、形心距 d = 25 m、夾角 120° 時，任何方向的 Σcos² 都等於 1.5，I = 1.5×60×25² = 56,250 m⁴，與風向無關。若改為兩翼一字形，順翼方向 I = 2×60×25² = 75,000 m⁴，垂直方向只剩牆體自身很小的慣性矩。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Moment of inertia of the wing-wall groups about the centroid, I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)². With three wings of A = 60 m² at d = 25 m and 120° apart, Σcos² equals 1.5 in every direction, so I = 1.5×60×25² = 56,250 m⁴ regardless of wind direction. A two-winged straight plan gives I = 2×60×25² = 75,000 m⁴ along the wings but only the walls' small self-inertia across them. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness", which statement holds?
options: 沒有打到堅硬岩盤的摩擦樁，不能支承超高層建築。
泵送高度只取決於泵機馬力，與混凝土配比無關。
三翼牆群對形心的慣性矩 I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)²。
optionsEn: Friction piles that do not reach hard rock cannot support a supertall tower.
Pumping height depends only on pump power, not on the concrete mix.
Moment of inertia of the wing-wall groups about the centroid, I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)².
quiz.explanation: 三翼牆群對形心的慣性矩 I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Moment of inertia of the wing-wall groups about the centroid, I = Σ A·(d·cosθ)². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「Y 形扶壁核心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Y-shaped buttressed core” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以三維殼元素模型（公開論文中的模型超過 73,500 個殼元素與 75,000 個節點）在 0° 至 360° 每隔 15° 施加單位側力，確認頂層變位與基底反力幾乎不隨方向改變；再逐一檢查各翼退縮處的柱牆對位與樓板傳力，確認沒有隱藏的轉換構件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Apply unit lateral loads every 15° from 0° to 360° to a three-dimensional shell model (the published model had more than 73,500 shell elements and 75,000 nodes) and confirm that top displacement and base reactions barely change with direction; then check column-to-wall alignment and slab load transfer at each wing setback to confirm there are no hidden transfer members. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：退縮樓層的平面圖要套疊上下兩層的牆柱位置，標明每支柱的承載牆編號；任何建築平面調整若造成柱牆錯位，須由結構工程師評估後才能定案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Overlay wall and column positions of the floors above and below on every setback plan, labelling the supporting wall of each column; any architectural change that misaligns a column and wall must be assessed by the structural engineer before it is fixed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若某一翼退縮處的柱子沒有落在下方牆上，就必須以轉換梁承接，造成局部應力集中與施工停頓；若三翼核心牆在退縮處厚度突變，剛度不連續會使內力集中在該樓層的樓板與連梁上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a column at a wing setback does not land on the wall below, a transfer beam must pick it up, causing local stress concentration and a construction pause; if the wing core walls change thickness abruptly at a setback, the stiffness discontinuity concentrates forces in that floor's slabs and link beams. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以三維殼元素模型（公開論文中的模型超過 73,500 個殼元素與 75,000 個節點）在 0° 至 360° 每隔 15° 施加單位側力，確認頂層變位與基底反力幾乎不隨方向改變；再逐一檢查各翼退縮處的柱牆對位與樓板傳力，確認沒有隱藏的轉換構件。
knowledge.textEn: Apply unit lateral loads every 15° from 0° to 360° to a three-dimensional shell model (the published model had more than 73,500 shell elements and 75,000 nodes) and confirm that top displacement and base reactions barely change with direction; then check column-to-wall alignment and slab load transfer at each wing setback to confirm there are no hidden transfer members.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 退縮樓層的平面圖要套疊上下兩層的牆柱位置，標明每支柱的承載牆編號；任何建築平面調整若造成柱牆錯位，須由結構工程師評估後才能定案。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay wall and column positions of the floors above and below on every setback plan, labelling the supporting wall of each column; any architectural change that misaligns a column and wall must be assessed by the structural engineer before it is fixed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness"?
options: 以三維殼元素模型（公開論文中的模型超過 73,500 個殼元素與 75,000 個節點）在 0° 至 360° 每隔 15° 施加單位側力，確認頂層變位與基底反力幾乎不隨方向改變。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
應變計讀數乘上彈性模數，就是構件的實際應力。
optionsEn: Apply unit lateral loads every 15° from 0° to 360° to a three-dimensional shell model (the published model had more than 73,500 shell elements and 75,000 nodes) and confirm that top displacement and base reactions barely change with direction.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Multiplying a strain-gauge reading by the elastic modulus gives the member's actual stress.
quiz.explanation: 以三維殼元素模型（公開論文中的模型超過 73,500 個殼元素與 75,000 個節點）在 0° 至 360° 每隔 15° 施加單位側力，確認頂層變位與基底反力幾乎不隨方向改變；再逐一檢查各翼退縮處的柱牆對位與樓板傳力，確認沒有隱藏的轉換構件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Apply unit lateral loads every 15° from 0° to 360° to a three-dimensional shell model (the published model had more than 73,500 shell elements and 75,000 nodes) and confirm that top displacement and base reactions barely change with direction; then check column-to-wall alignment and slab load transfer at each wing setback to confirm there are no hidden transfer members. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Y 形扶壁核心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Y-shaped buttressed core” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若某一翼退縮處的柱子沒有落在下方牆上，就必須以轉換梁承接，造成局部應力集中與施工停頓；若三翼核心牆在退縮處厚度突變，剛度不連續會使內力集中在該樓層的樓板與連梁上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a column at a wing setback does not land on the wall below, a transfer beam must pick it up, causing local stress concentration and a construction pause; if the wing core walls change thickness abruptly at a setback, the stiffness discontinuity concentrates forces in that floor's slabs and link beams. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：塔頂以鋼結構塔尖延續中央核心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At the top the central core continues as a structural steel spire.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「Y 形平面只是為了造型與景觀，對結構沒有好處。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The Y-shaped plan is only for appearance and views and gives no structural benefit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若某一翼退縮處的柱子沒有落在下方牆上，就必須以轉換梁承接，造成局部應力集中與施工停頓；若三翼核心牆在退縮處厚度突變，剛度不連續會使內力集中在該樓層的樓板與連梁上。
knowledge.textEn: If a column at a wing setback does not land on the wall below, a transfer beam must pick it up, causing local stress concentration and a construction pause; if the wing core walls change thickness abruptly at a setback, the stiffness discontinuity concentrates forces in that floor's slabs and link beams.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Buttressed-core load path and direction-independent stiffness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若某一翼退縮處的柱子沒有落在下方牆上，就必須以轉換梁承接，造成局部應力集中與施工停頓。
只要結構夠強，建築外形對風力的影響可以忽略。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If a column at a wing setback does not land on the wall below, a transfer beam must pick it up, causing local stress concentration and a construction pause.
If the structure is strong enough, building shape has negligible effect on wind loads.
quiz.explanation: 若某一翼退縮處的柱子沒有落在下方牆上，就必須以轉換梁承接，造成局部應力集中與施工停頓；若三翼核心牆在退縮處厚度突變，剛度不連續會使內力集中在該樓層的樓板與連梁上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a column at a wing setback does not land on the wall below, a transfer beam must pick it up, causing local stress concentration and a construction pause; if the wing core walls change thickness abruptly at a setback, the stiffness discontinuity concentrates forces in that floor's slabs and link beams. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「螺旋退縮與風向」如何影響哈里發塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spiralling setbacks and wind directions” governs force, deformation or durability in “Burj Khalifa”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 哈里發塔的三翼依順時針方向逐段退縮，每次退縮都改變建築寬度，使不同高度的渦流脫落頻率彼此錯開，無法沿全高同步形成強烈的橫風向力。RWDI 的風洞試驗以約 1:500 的氣動彈性與力平衡模型為主，依當地氣候定出六個主要風向（三個翼尖方向與三個翼尾方向），並據以調整建築方位。結構分析得到的前兩個側向模態週期約 11.3 s 與 10.2 s，扭轉模態約 4.3 s。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「螺旋退縮與風向」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Burj Khalifa's three wings step back clockwise in a spiral, and every setback changes the building width, so vortex-shedding frequencies at different heights are staggered and cannot lock together into a strong across-wind force over the full height. RWDI's wind-tunnel programme relied mostly on aeroelastic and force-balance models at about 1:500, identified six principal wind directions from the local climate (three wing-nose and three wing-tail directions), and the building orientation was set accordingly. The structural analysis gave first and second lateral periods of about 11.3 s and 10.2 s and a torsional period of about 4.3 s. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Spiralling setbacks and wind directions” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：臨界風速 U_cr = f₁·B/St。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Critical wind speed U_cr = f₁·B/St. With f₁ = 1/11.3 ≈ 0.0885 Hz and St = 0.15, a 60 m wide tier gives U_cr ≈ 0.0885×60/0.15 ≈ 35.4 m/s and a 40 m wide tier about 23.6 m/s, so at any one wind speed only a few heights are near resonance and across-wind forces cannot add up coherently.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要結構夠強，建築外形對風力的影響可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the structure is strong enough, building shape has negligible effect on wind loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「螺旋退縮與風向」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Spiralling setbacks and wind directions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向
knowledge.titleEn: Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation
knowledge.text: 哈里發塔的三翼依順時針方向逐段退縮，每次退縮都改變建築寬度，使不同高度的渦流脫落頻率彼此錯開，無法沿全高同步形成強烈的橫風向力。RWDI 的風洞試驗以約 1:500 的氣動彈性與力平衡模型為主，依當地氣候定出六個主要風向（三個翼尖方向與三個翼尾方向），並據以調整建築方位。
knowledge.textEn: Burj Khalifa's three wings step back clockwise in a spiral, and every setback changes the building width, so vortex-shedding frequencies at different heights are staggered and cannot lock together into a strong across-wind force over the full height. RWDI's wind-tunnel programme relied mostly on aeroelastic and force-balance models at about 1:500, identified six principal wind directions from the local climate (three wing-nose and three wing-tail directions), and the building orientation was set accordingly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要結構夠強，建築外形對風力的影響可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If the structure is strong enough, building shape has negligible effect on wind loads. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation" is correct?
options: 只要結構夠強，建築外形對風力的影響可以忽略。
混凝土強度夠高，徐變與縮短就可以忽略。
哈里發塔的三翼依順時針方向逐段退縮，每次退縮都改變建築寬度，使不同高度的渦流脫落頻率彼此錯開，無法沿全高同步形成強烈的橫風向力。
optionsEn: If the structure is strong enough, building shape has negligible effect on wind loads.
With high enough concrete strength, creep and shortening can be ignored.

Burj Khalifa's three wings step back clockwise in a spiral, and every setback changes the building width, so vortex-shedding frequencies at different heights are staggered and cannot lock together into a strong across-wind force over the full height.
quiz.explanation: 哈里發塔的三翼依順時針方向逐段退縮，每次退縮都改變建築寬度，使不同高度的渦流脫落頻率彼此錯開，無法沿全高同步形成強烈的橫風向力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Burj Khalifa's three wings step back clockwise in a spiral, and every setback changes the building width, so vortex-shedding frequencies at different heights are staggered and cannot lock together into a strong across-wind force over the full height. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「螺旋退縮與風向」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spiralling setbacks and wind directions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臨界風速 U_cr = f₁·B/St。f₁ = 1/11.3 ≈ 0.0885 Hz、St 取 0.15：寬度 60 m 的樓段 U_cr ≈ 0.0885×60/0.15 ≈ 35.4 m/s，寬度 40 m 的樓段約 23.6 m/s；同一風速下只有少數高度接近共振，橫風向力沿高度無法同步累加。St 與寬度為教學假設，週期取自公開論文。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Critical wind speed U_cr = f₁·B/St. With f₁ = 1/11.3 ≈ 0.0885 Hz and St = 0.15, a 60 m wide tier gives U_cr ≈ 0.0885×60/0.15 ≈ 35.4 m/s and a 40 m wide tier about 23.6 m/s, so at any one wind speed only a few heights are near resonance and across-wind forces cannot add up coherently. St and widths are teaching assumptions; the period is from the published paper. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對力平衡試驗的橫風向力頻譜在不同風向下是否出現尖銳峰值，並以氣動彈性模型確認退縮後的響應；風洞結果換算成設計載重後，與規範估算及同儕審查者的獨立判讀比較（本案由 Nick Isyumov 博士做同儕審查）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether the across-wind force spectra from force-balance tests show sharp peaks for different wind directions, and confirm the response after setbacks with aeroelastic models; convert the results into design loads and compare them with code estimates and an independent peer reviewer's reading (Dr Nick Isyumov peer-reviewed this programme).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 臨界風速 U_cr = f₁·B/St。f₁ = 1/11.3 ≈ 0.0885 Hz、St 取 0.15：寬度 60 m 的樓段 U_cr ≈ 0.0885×60/0.15 ≈ 35.4 m/s，寬度 40 m 的樓段約 23.6 m/s；同一風速下只有少數高度接近共振，橫風向力沿高度無法同步累加。St 與寬度為教學假設，週期取自公開論文。
knowledge.textEn: Critical wind speed U_cr = f₁·B/St. With f₁ = 1/11.3 ≈ 0.0885 Hz and St = 0.15, a 60 m wide tier gives U_cr ≈ 0.0885×60/0.15 ≈ 35.4 m/s and a 40 m wide tier about 23.6 m/s, so at any one wind speed only a few heights are near resonance and across-wind forces cannot add up coherently. St and widths are teaching assumptions; the period is from the published paper.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation", which statement holds?
options: 臨界風速 U_cr = f₁·B/St。
爬模只是一套模板，爬升時機由工班依進度自行決定即可。
只要每層都以雷射對準設計座標，建築就一定是直的。
optionsEn: Critical wind speed U_cr = f₁·B/St. With f₁ = 1/11.3 ≈ 0.0885 Hz and St = 0.15, a 60 m wide tier gives U_cr ≈ 0.0885×60/0.15 ≈ 35.4 m/s and a 40 m wide tier about 23.6 m/s, so at any one wind speed only a few heights are near resonance and across-wind forces cannot add up coherently.
A climbing form is just formwork, so the crew can decide when to climb based on progress.
If every floor is laser-aligned to the design coordinates, the building will be straight.
quiz.explanation: 臨界風速 U_cr = f₁·B/St。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Critical wind speed U_cr = f₁·B/St. With f₁ = 1/11.3 ≈ 0.0885 Hz and St = 0.15, a 60 m wide tier gives U_cr ≈ 0.0885×60/0.15 ≈ 35.4 m/s and a 40 m wide tier about 23.6 m/s, so at any one wind speed only a few heights are near resonance and across-wind forces cannot add up coherently. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺旋退縮與風向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spiralling setbacks and wind directions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對力平衡試驗的橫風向力頻譜在不同風向下是否出現尖銳峰值，並以氣動彈性模型確認退縮後的響應；風洞結果換算成設計載重後，與規範估算及同儕審查者的獨立判讀比較（本案由 Nick Isyumov 博士做同儕審查）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether the across-wind force spectra from force-balance tests show sharp peaks for different wind directions, and confirm the response after setbacks with aeroelastic models; convert the results into design loads and compare them with code estimates and an independent peer reviewer's reading (Dr Nick Isyumov peer-reviewed this programme). Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在概念設計階段就讓風工程顧問參與外形比選，每一輪外形修改都保留風洞或數值比較紀錄；設計基準書要寫明採用的主要風向、模型比例與同儕審查結論。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Involve the wind consultant in massing studies from the concept stage, keep wind-tunnel or numerical comparisons for every round of shape changes, and state the principal wind directions, model scale and peer-review conclusions in the design basis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若退縮的間距與尺寸過於規律，多個高度的渦流頻率可能仍落在相近範圍，在某一風速下出現明顯的橫風向共振；建築方位若未依主要風向調整，最不利的風向可能正對結構較弱的方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If setbacks are too regular in spacing and size, shedding frequencies at many heights may still cluster and produce marked across-wind resonance at one wind speed; if the orientation is not set against the principal wind directions, the worst wind may strike the structure's weaker direction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對力平衡試驗的橫風向力頻譜在不同風向下是否出現尖銳峰值，並以氣動彈性模型確認退縮後的響應；風洞結果換算成設計載重後，與規範估算及同儕審查者的獨立判讀比較（本案由 Nick Isyumov 博士做同儕審查）。
knowledge.textEn: Check whether the across-wind force spectra from force-balance tests show sharp peaks for different wind directions, and confirm the response after setbacks with aeroelastic models; convert the results into design loads and compare them with code estimates and an independent peer reviewer's reading (Dr Nick Isyumov peer-reviewed this programme).

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在概念設計階段就讓風工程顧問參與外形比選，每一輪外形修改都保留風洞或數值比較紀錄；設計基準書要寫明採用的主要風向、模型比例與同儕審查結論。
knowledge.textEn: Involve the wind consultant in massing studies from the concept stage, keep wind-tunnel or numerical comparisons for every round of shape changes, and state the principal wind directions, model scale and peer-review conclusions in the design basis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比對力平衡試驗的橫風向力頻譜在不同風向下是否出現尖銳峰值，並以氣動彈性模型確認退縮後的響應。
基礎埋在地下、不接觸空氣，所以不會腐蝕。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Check whether the across-wind force spectra from force-balance tests show sharp peaks for different wind directions, and confirm the response after setbacks with aeroelastic models.
Foundations are buried away from air, so they cannot corrode.
quiz.explanation: 比對力平衡試驗的橫風向力頻譜在不同風向下是否出現尖銳峰值，並以氣動彈性模型確認退縮後的響應；風洞結果換算成設計載重後，與規範估算及同儕審查者的獨立判讀比較（本案由 Nick Isyumov 博士做同儕審查）。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check whether the across-wind force spectra from force-balance tests show sharp peaks for different wind directions, and confirm the response after setbacks with aeroelastic models; convert the results into design loads and compare them with code estimates and an independent peer reviewer's reading (Dr Nick Isyumov peer-reviewed this programme). Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「螺旋退縮與風向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spiralling setbacks and wind directions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若退縮的間距與尺寸過於規律，多個高度的渦流頻率可能仍落在相近範圍，在某一風速下出現明顯的橫風向共振；建築方位若未依主要風向調整，最不利的風向可能正對結構較弱的方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If setbacks are too regular in spacing and size, shedding frequencies at many heights may still cluster and produce marked across-wind resonance at one wind speed; if the orientation is not set against the principal wind directions, the worst wind may strike the structure's weaker direction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：結構分析得到的前兩個側向模態週期約 11.3 s 與 10.2 s，扭轉模態約 4.3 s。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The structural analysis gave first and second lateral periods of about 11.3 s and 10.2 s and a torsional period of about 4.3 s.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要結構夠強，建築外形對風力的影響可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If the structure is strong enough, building shape has negligible effect on wind loads." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若退縮的間距與尺寸過於規律，多個高度的渦流頻率可能仍落在相近範圍，在某一風速下出現明顯的橫風向共振；建築方位若未依主要風向調整，最不利的風向可能正對結構較弱的方向。
knowledge.textEn: If setbacks are too regular in spacing and size, shedding frequencies at many heights may still cluster and produce marked across-wind resonance at one wind speed; if the orientation is not set against the principal wind directions, the worst wind may strike the structure's weaker direction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「退縮擾亂渦流與風洞定向」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Setbacks that confuse vortices and wind-tunnel orientation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混凝土強度夠高，徐變與縮短就可以忽略。
若退縮的間距與尺寸過於規律，多個高度的渦流頻率可能仍落在相近範圍，在某一風速下出現明顯的橫風向共振。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
With high enough concrete strength, creep and shortening can be ignored.
If setbacks are too regular in spacing and size, shedding frequencies at many heights may still cluster and produce marked across-wind resonance at one wind speed.
quiz.explanation: 若退縮的間距與尺寸過於規律，多個高度的渦流頻率可能仍落在相近範圍，在某一風速下出現明顯的橫風向共振；建築方位若未依主要風向調整，最不利的風向可能正對結構較弱的方向。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If setbacks are too regular in spacing and size, shedding frequencies at many heights may still cluster and produce marked across-wind resonance at one wind speed; if the orientation is not set against the principal wind directions, the worst wind may strike the structure's weaker direction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔」與「筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement" and "Raft, friction piles and capacity proof": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「C80 高性能混凝土牆」如何影響哈里發塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “C80 high-performance concrete walls” governs force, deformation or durability in “Burj Khalifa”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 哈里發塔的牆體混凝土由 C80 逐段降到 C60（立方試體強度），以普通水泥加飛灰與矽灰配製，C80 在 90 天的彈性模數約 43,800 MPa；周邊柱與典型走廊牆厚約 600 mm，鋼筋約佔混凝土面積 1%。混凝土在長期載重下徐變與乾縮，會把一部分軸力轉給鋼筋：公開論文指出第 135 層附近鋼筋分擔的比例完工時約 15%，30 年後約 30%。這個轉移影響鋼筋應力、牆柱縮短量與樓板傾斜。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「C80 高性能混凝土牆」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Burj Khalifa's wall concrete steps down from C80 to C60 cube strength, made with Portland cement, fly ash and silica fume; the C80 had an elastic modulus of about 43,800 MPa at 90 days. Perimeter columns and typical corridor walls are about 600 mm thick with reinforcement around 1% of the concrete area. Creep and shrinkage under sustained load transfer part of the axial force to the bars: the published paper notes that near level 135 the reinforcement carries about 15% at completion and about 30% after 30 years. This transfer affects bar stresses, wall and column shortening and slab tilt. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “C80 high-performance concrete walls” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：換算斷面的鋼筋分擔 = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Transformed-section steel share = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度夠高，徐變與縮短就可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With high enough concrete strength, creep and shortening can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「C80 高性能混凝土牆」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “C80 high-performance concrete walls”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔
knowledge.titleEn: High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement
knowledge.text: 哈里發塔的牆體混凝土由 C80 逐段降到 C60（立方試體強度），以普通水泥加飛灰與矽灰配製，C80 在 90 天的彈性模數約 43,800 MPa；周邊柱與典型走廊牆厚約 600 mm，鋼筋約佔混凝土面積 1%。混凝土在長期載重下徐變與乾縮，會把一部分軸力轉給鋼筋：公開論文指出第 135 層附近鋼筋分擔的比例完工時約 15%，30 年後約 30%。
knowledge.textEn: Burj Khalifa's wall concrete steps down from C80 to C60 cube strength, made with Portland cement, fly ash and silica fume; the C80 had an elastic modulus of about 43,800 MPa at 90 days. Perimeter columns and typical corridor walls are about 600 mm thick with reinforcement around 1% of the concrete area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度夠高，徐變與縮短就可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With high enough concrete strength, creep and shortening can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement" is correct?
options: 哈里發塔的牆體混凝土由 C80 逐段降到 C60（立方試體強度），以普通水泥加飛灰與矽灰配製，C80 在 90 天的彈性模數約 43,800 MPa。
混凝土強度夠高，徐變與縮短就可以忽略。
沒有打到堅硬岩盤的摩擦樁，不能支承超高層建築。
optionsEn: Burj Khalifa's wall concrete steps down from C80 to C60 cube strength, made with Portland cement, fly ash and silica fume.
With high enough concrete strength, creep and shortening can be ignored.
Friction piles that do not reach hard rock cannot support a supertall tower.
quiz.explanation: 哈里發塔的牆體混凝土由 C80 逐段降到 C60（立方試體強度），以普通水泥加飛灰與矽灰配製，C80 在 90 天的彈性模數約 43,800 MPa；周邊柱與典型走廊牆厚約 600 mm，鋼筋約佔混凝土面積 1%。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Burj Khalifa's wall concrete steps down from C80 to C60 cube strength, made with Portland cement, fly ash and silica fume; the C80 had an elastic modulus of about 43,800 MPa at 90 days. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「C80 高性能混凝土牆」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “C80 high-performance concrete walls” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：換算斷面的鋼筋分擔 = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ]。E_s = 200 GPa、E_c = 43.8 GPa，n = 4.57、ρ = 1%：彈性時分擔 0.0457/1.0357 ≈ 4.4%；徐變係數 φ = 2.0 時有效模數比 n_e = 4.57×3 = 13.7，分擔 0.137/1.127 ≈ 12.2%，再計入乾縮比例還會上升。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Transformed-section steel share = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ]. With E_s = 200 GPa and E_c = 43.8 GPa, n = 4.57 and ρ = 1%: the elastic share is 0.0457/1.0357 ≈ 4.4%; with a creep coefficient φ = 2.0 the effective modular ratio is n_e = 4.57×3 = 13.7 and the share is 0.137/1.127 ≈ 12.2%, rising further once shrinkage is included. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實際配比做 90 天強度與彈性模數試驗，並進行長期徐變與乾縮試驗，把量得的係數代回施工階段分析；在代表性牆柱內埋設振弦式應變計，比較量測應變與預測的彈性、徐變、乾縮分量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test the actual mixes for 90-day strength and elastic modulus and run long-term creep and shrinkage tests, feeding the measured coefficients back into the construction-sequence analysis; embed vibrating-wire strain gauges in representative walls and columns and compare measured strain with the predicted elastic, creep and shrinkage components.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 換算斷面的鋼筋分擔 = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ]。E_s = 200 GPa、E_c = 43.8 GPa，n = 4.57、ρ = 1%：彈性時分擔 0.0457/1.0357 ≈ 4.4%；徐變係數 φ = 2.0 時有效模數比 n_e = 4.57×3 = 13.7，分擔 0.137/1.127 ≈ 12.2%，再計入乾縮比例還會上升。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Transformed-section steel share = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ]. With E_s = 200 GPa and E_c = 43.8 GPa, n = 4.57 and ρ = 1%: the elastic share is 0.0457/1.0357 ≈ 4.4%; with a creep coefficient φ = 2.0 the effective modular ratio is n_e = 4.57×3 = 13.7 and the share is 0.137/1.127 ≈ 12.2%, rising further once shrinkage is included. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement", which statement holds?
options: 泵送高度只取決於泵機馬力，與混凝土配比無關。
換算斷面的鋼筋分擔 = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ]。
應變計讀數乘上彈性模數，就是構件的實際應力。
optionsEn: Pumping height depends only on pump power, not on the concrete mix.
Transformed-section steel share = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ].
Multiplying a strain-gauge reading by the elastic modulus gives the member's actual stress.
quiz.explanation: 換算斷面的鋼筋分擔 = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Transformed-section steel share = nρ/[1 + (n−1)ρ]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「C80 高性能混凝土牆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “C80 high-performance concrete walls” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實際配比做 90 天強度與彈性模數試驗，並進行長期徐變與乾縮試驗，把量得的係數代回施工階段分析；在代表性牆柱內埋設振弦式應變計，比較量測應變與預測的彈性、徐變、乾縮分量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test the actual mixes for 90-day strength and elastic modulus and run long-term creep and shrinkage tests, feeding the measured coefficients back into the construction-sequence analysis; embed vibrating-wire strain gauges in representative walls and columns and compare measured strain with the predicted elastic, creep and shrinkage components. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：配比設計報告要包含 90 天強度、彈性模數、徐變與乾縮的試驗計畫；施工中每批試體結果都回饋給結構分析，必要時修正後續樓層的標高補償，並由設計者確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The mix-design report should include the test programme for 90-day strength, elastic modulus, creep and shrinkage; feed each batch of results back into the structural analysis during construction and, where needed, revise level compensation for later floors with the designer's confirmation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以彈性分析設計，長期鋼筋應力可能被低估兩到三倍，高軸力區的鋼筋提早降伏；牆柱縮短量估計錯誤，則讓樓板傾斜，帷幕牆與電梯導軌承受非預期的變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Designing from elastic analysis alone can underestimate long-term bar stress two- to threefold, letting bars in heavily loaded zones yield early; wrong shortening estimates tilt slabs and impose unintended deformation on the curtain wall and elevator rails. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以實際配比做 90 天強度與彈性模數試驗，並進行長期徐變與乾縮試驗，把量得的係數代回施工階段分析；在代表性牆柱內埋設振弦式應變計，比較量測應變與預測的彈性、徐變、乾縮分量。
knowledge.textEn: Test the actual mixes for 90-day strength and elastic modulus and run long-term creep and shrinkage tests, feeding the measured coefficients back into the construction-sequence analysis; embed vibrating-wire strain gauges in representative walls and columns and compare measured strain with the predicted elastic, creep and shrinkage components.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 配比設計報告要包含 90 天強度、彈性模數、徐變與乾縮的試驗計畫；施工中每批試體結果都回饋給結構分析，必要時修正後續樓層的標高補償，並由設計者確認。
knowledge.textEn: The mix-design report should include the test programme for 90-day strength, elastic modulus, creep and shrinkage; feed each batch of results back into the structural analysis during construction and, where needed, revise level compensation for later floors with the designer's confirmation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
外牆維護設備只是清潔工具，不屬於結構工程的責任。
以實際配比做 90 天強度與彈性模數試驗，並進行長期徐變與乾縮試驗，把量得的係數代回施工階段分析。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Façade access equipment is just cleaning gear and not a structural engineering responsibility.
Test the actual mixes for 90-day strength and elastic modulus and run long-term creep and shrinkage tests, feeding the measured coefficients back into the construction-sequence analysis.
quiz.explanation: 以實際配比做 90 天強度與彈性模數試驗，並進行長期徐變與乾縮試驗，把量得的係數代回施工階段分析；在代表性牆柱內埋設振弦式應變計，比較量測應變與預測的彈性、徐變、乾縮分量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test the actual mixes for 90-day strength and elastic modulus and run long-term creep and shrinkage tests, feeding the measured coefficients back into the construction-sequence analysis; embed vibrating-wire strain gauges in representative walls and columns and compare measured strain with the predicted elastic, creep and shrinkage components. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「C80 高性能混凝土牆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “C80 high-performance concrete walls” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以彈性分析設計，長期鋼筋應力可能被低估兩到三倍，高軸力區的鋼筋提早降伏；牆柱縮短量估計錯誤，則讓樓板傾斜，帷幕牆與電梯導軌承受非預期的變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Designing from elastic analysis alone can underestimate long-term bar stress two- to threefold, letting bars in heavily loaded zones yield early; wrong shortening estimates tilt slabs and impose unintended deformation on the curtain wall and elevator rails. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個轉移影響鋼筋應力、牆柱縮短量與樓板傾斜。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This transfer affects bar stresses, wall and column shortening and slab tilt.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度夠高，徐變與縮短就可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With high enough concrete strength, creep and shortening can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以彈性分析設計，長期鋼筋應力可能被低估兩到三倍，高軸力區的鋼筋提早降伏；牆柱縮短量估計錯誤，則讓樓板傾斜，帷幕牆與電梯導軌承受非預期的變形。
knowledge.textEn: Designing from elastic analysis alone can underestimate long-term bar stress two- to threefold, letting bars in heavily loaded zones yield early; wrong shortening estimates tilt slabs and impose unintended deformation on the curtain wall and elevator rails.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高性能混凝土與鋼筋的長期分擔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High-performance concrete and long-term load sharing with reinforcement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若只以彈性分析設計，長期鋼筋應力可能被低估兩到三倍，高軸力區的鋼筋提早降伏；牆柱縮短量估計錯誤，則讓樓板傾斜，帷幕牆與電梯導軌承受非預期的變形。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
沒有打到堅硬岩盤的摩擦樁，不能支承超高層建築。
optionsEn: Designing from elastic analysis alone can underestimate long-term bar stress two- to threefold, letting bars in heavily loaded zones yield early.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Friction piles that do not reach hard rock cannot support a supertall tower.
quiz.explanation: 若只以彈性分析設計，長期鋼筋應力可能被低估兩到三倍，高軸力區的鋼筋提早降伏；牆柱縮短量估計錯誤，則讓樓板傾斜，帷幕牆與電梯導軌承受非預期的變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Designing from elastic analysis alone can underestimate long-term bar stress two- to threefold, letting bars in heavily loaded zones yield early; wrong shortening estimates tilt slabs and impose unintended deformation on the curtain wall and elevator rails. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Raft, friction piles and capacity proof: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「3.7 m 筏基與鑽掘樁」如何影響哈里發塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “The 3.7 m raft and bored piles” governs force, deformation or durability in “Burj Khalifa”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 哈里發塔塔樓坐落在厚 3.7 m 的 C50 自充填混凝土筏基上，筏基分四次澆置，配比含 40% 飛灰、水膠比 0.34；其下為 194 支直徑 1.5 m、長約 43 m 的鑽掘場鑄樁（另有資料記為 192 支），單樁設計容量約 3,000 公噸。地層以弱岩為主，樁主要靠側摩擦承載，公開論文採用的極限單位側摩擦約 250 至 350 kPa，預估長期最大沉陷約 80 mm。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「3.7 m 筏基與鑽掘樁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Burj Khalifa's tower sits on a 3.7 m thick raft of C50 self-consolidating concrete placed in four pours, with 40% fly ash and a water–cement ratio of 0.34; beneath it are 194 bored cast-in-place piles of 1.5 m diameter and about 43 m length (other sources say 192), each with a design capacity of about 3,000 t. The ground is mainly weak rock, so the piles work mostly in side friction; the published paper used an ultimate unit skin friction of about 250 to 350 kPa and predicted a maximum long-term settlement of about 80 mm. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “The 3.7 m raft and bored piles” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：側摩擦極限容量 Q = π·D·L·f_s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Ultimate side-friction capacity Q = π·D·L·f_s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沒有打到堅硬岩盤的摩擦樁，不能支承超高層建築。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Friction piles that do not reach hard rock cannot support a supertall tower." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「3.7 m 筏基與鑽掘樁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “The 3.7 m raft and bored piles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Raft, friction piles and capacity proof
knowledge.text: 哈里發塔塔樓坐落在厚 3.7 m 的 C50 自充填混凝土筏基上，筏基分四次澆置，配比含 40% 飛灰、水膠比 0.34；其下為 194 支直徑 1.5 m、長約 43 m 的鑽掘場鑄樁（另有資料記為 192 支），單樁設計容量約 3,000 公噸。地層以弱岩為主，樁主要靠側摩擦承載，公開論文採用的極限單位側摩擦約 250 至 350 kPa，預估長期最大沉陷約 80 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Burj Khalifa's tower sits on a 3.7 m thick raft of C50 self-consolidating concrete placed in four pours, with 40% fly ash and a water–cement ratio of 0.34; beneath it are 194 bored cast-in-place piles of 1.5 m diameter and about 43 m length (other sources say 192), each with a design capacity of about 3,000 t. The ground is mainly weak rock, so the piles work mostly in side friction; the published paper used an ultimate unit skin friction of about 250 to 350 kPa and predicted a maximum long-term settlement of about 80 mm.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沒有打到堅硬岩盤的摩擦樁，不能支承超高層建築。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Friction piles that do not reach hard rock cannot support a supertall tower. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Raft, friction piles and capacity proof" is correct?
options: 沒有打到堅硬岩盤的摩擦樁，不能支承超高層建築。
哈里發塔塔樓坐落在厚 3.7 m 的 C50 自充填混凝土筏基上，筏基分四次澆置，配比含 40% 飛灰、水膠比 0.34。
爬模只是一套模板，爬升時機由工班依進度自行決定即可。
optionsEn: Friction piles that do not reach hard rock cannot support a supertall tower.
Burj Khalifa's tower sits on a 3.7 m thick raft of C50 self-consolidating concrete placed in four pours, with 40% fly ash and a water–cement ratio of 0.34.
A climbing form is just formwork, so the crew can decide when to climb based on progress.
quiz.explanation: 哈里發塔塔樓坐落在厚 3.7 m 的 C50 自充填混凝土筏基上，筏基分四次澆置，配比含 40% 飛灰、水膠比 0.34；其下為 194 支直徑 1.5 m、長約 43 m 的鑽掘場鑄樁（另有資料記為 192 支），單樁設計容量約 3,000 公噸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Burj Khalifa's tower sits on a 3.7 m thick raft of C50 self-consolidating concrete placed in four pours, with 40% fly ash and a water–cement ratio of 0.34; beneath it are 194 bored cast-in-place piles of 1.5 m diameter and about 43 m length (other sources say 192), each with a design capacity of about 3,000 t. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Raft, friction piles and capacity proof: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「3.7 m 筏基與鑽掘樁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “The 3.7 m raft and bored piles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：側摩擦極限容量 Q = π·D·L·f_s。D = 1.5 m、L = 43 m、f_s = 300 kPa：Q = π×1.5×43×0.30 ≈ 60.8 MN（約 6,200 t），對設計 3,000 t（29.4 MN）的安全係數約 2.07；若 f_s 只有 250 kPa，Q ≈ 50.7 MN，安全係數降為約 1.72。f_s 取公開範圍內的教學值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Ultimate side-friction capacity Q = π·D·L·f_s. With D = 1.5 m, L = 43 m and f_s = 300 kPa, Q = π×1.5×43×0.30 ≈ 60.8 MN (about 6,200 t), a factor of safety of about 2.07 on the 3,000 t (29.4 MN) design load; with f_s of only 250 kPa, Q ≈ 50.7 MN and the factor falls to about 1.72. f_s is a teaching value within the published range. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以試驗樁加載超過 6,000 t 驗證容量，並以應變計分段量測側摩擦分布；施工時記錄每支樁的鑽掘深度、孔壁穩定與混凝土澆置量，施工中與完工後以水準測量追蹤筏基沉陷，並與預測曲線比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Prove capacity with trial piles loaded above 6,000 t, measuring side friction along the shaft with strain gauges; during construction record drilled depth, bore stability and concrete volume for every pile, and track raft settlement by levelling during and after construction against the predicted curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 側摩擦極限容量 Q = π·D·L·f_s。D = 1.5 m、L = 43 m、f_s = 300 kPa：Q = π×1.5×43×0.30 ≈ 60.8 MN（約 6,200 t），對設計 3,000 t（29.4 MN）的安全係數約 2.07；若 f_s 只有 250 kPa，Q ≈ 50.7 MN，安全係數降為約 1.72。f_s 取公開範圍內的教學值。
knowledge.textEn: Ultimate side-friction capacity Q = π·D·L·f_s. With D = 1.5 m, L = 43 m and f_s = 300 kPa, Q = π×1.5×43×0.30 ≈ 60.8 MN (about 6,200 t), a factor of safety of about 2.07 on the 3,000 t (29.4 MN) design load; with f_s of only 250 kPa, Q ≈ 50.7 MN and the factor falls to about 1.72. f_s is a teaching value within the published range.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Raft, friction piles and capacity proof", which statement holds?
options: 只要每層都以雷射對準設計座標，建築就一定是直的。
基礎埋在地下、不接觸空氣，所以不會腐蝕。
側摩擦極限容量 Q = π·D·L·f_s。
optionsEn: If every floor is laser-aligned to the design coordinates, the building will be straight.
Foundations are buried away from air, so they cannot corrode.
Ultimate side-friction capacity Q = π·D·L·f_s.
quiz.explanation: 側摩擦極限容量 Q = π·D·L·f_s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Ultimate side-friction capacity Q = π·D·L·f_s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Raft, friction piles and capacity proof: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「3.7 m 筏基與鑽掘樁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “The 3.7 m raft and bored piles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以試驗樁加載超過 6,000 t 驗證容量，並以應變計分段量測側摩擦分布；施工時記錄每支樁的鑽掘深度、孔壁穩定與混凝土澆置量，施工中與完工後以水準測量追蹤筏基沉陷，並與預測曲線比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Prove capacity with trial piles loaded above 6,000 t, measuring side friction along the shaft with strain gauges; during construction record drilled depth, bore stability and concrete volume for every pile, and track raft settlement by levelling during and after construction against the predicted curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：試驗樁應在正式施工前完成並回饋到樁長設計；筏基分次澆置的施工縫位置、溫度控制與鋼筋續接須經設計者核可，澆置期間設置溫度監測與停止條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Complete trial-pile tests before production piling and feed the results back into pile-length design; joint locations between raft pours, temperature control and bar splices need the designer's approval, with temperature monitoring and stop criteria during placement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：鑽掘時若孔壁泥膜過厚或孔底沉渣未清除，側摩擦與端承都會下降，個別樁偏軟會造成筏基不均勻沉陷；高鹽分地下水若侵入品質不佳的樁身混凝土，鋼筋腐蝕會在數十年後削弱樁的承載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A thick filter cake on the bore wall or uncleaned base debris reduces both skin friction and end bearing, and individual soft piles cause uneven raft settlement; if saline groundwater penetrates poor-quality pile concrete, reinforcement corrosion weakens the piles decades later. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以試驗樁加載超過 6,000 t 驗證容量，並以應變計分段量測側摩擦分布；施工時記錄每支樁的鑽掘深度、孔壁穩定與混凝土澆置量，施工中與完工後以水準測量追蹤筏基沉陷，並與預測曲線比較。
knowledge.textEn: Prove capacity with trial piles loaded above 6,000 t, measuring side friction along the shaft with strain gauges; during construction record drilled depth, bore stability and concrete volume for every pile, and track raft settlement by levelling during and after construction against the predicted curve.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 試驗樁應在正式施工前完成並回饋到樁長設計；筏基分次澆置的施工縫位置、溫度控制與鋼筋續接須經設計者核可，澆置期間設置溫度監測與停止條件。
knowledge.textEn: Complete trial-pile tests before production piling and feed the results back into pile-length design; joint locations between raft pours, temperature control and bar splices need the designer's approval, with temperature monitoring and stop criteria during placement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Raft, friction piles and capacity proof"?
options: 以試驗樁加載超過 6,000 t 驗證容量，並以應變計分段量測側摩擦分布。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
Y 形平面只是為了造型與景觀，對結構沒有好處。
optionsEn: Prove capacity with trial piles loaded above 6,000 t, measuring side friction along the shaft with strain gauges.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The Y-shaped plan is only for appearance and views and gives no structural benefit.
quiz.explanation: 以試驗樁加載超過 6,000 t 驗證容量，並以應變計分段量測側摩擦分布；施工時記錄每支樁的鑽掘深度、孔壁穩定與混凝土澆置量，施工中與完工後以水準測量追蹤筏基沉陷，並與預測曲線比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Prove capacity with trial piles loaded above 6,000 t, measuring side friction along the shaft with strain gauges; during construction record drilled depth, bore stability and concrete volume for every pile, and track raft settlement by levelling during and after construction against the predicted curve. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Raft, friction piles and capacity proof: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「3.7 m 筏基與鑽掘樁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “The 3.7 m raft and bored piles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鑽掘時若孔壁泥膜過厚或孔底沉渣未清除，側摩擦與端承都會下降，個別樁偏軟會造成筏基不均勻沉陷；高鹽分地下水若侵入品質不佳的樁身混凝土，鋼筋腐蝕會在數十年後削弱樁的承載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A thick filter cake on the bore wall or uncleaned base debris reduces both skin friction and end bearing, and individual soft piles cause uneven raft settlement; if saline groundwater penetrates poor-quality pile concrete, reinforcement corrosion weakens the piles decades later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地層以弱岩為主，樁主要靠側摩擦承載，公開論文採用的極限單位側摩擦約 250 至 350 kPa，預估長期最大沉陷約 80 mm。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The ground is mainly weak rock, so the piles work mostly in side friction; the published paper used an ultimate unit skin friction of about 250 to 350 kPa and predicted a maximum long-term settlement of about 80 mm.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沒有打到堅硬岩盤的摩擦樁，不能支承超高層建築。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Friction piles that do not reach hard rock cannot support a supertall tower." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鑽掘時若孔壁泥膜過厚或孔底沉渣未清除，側摩擦與端承都會下降，個別樁偏軟會造成筏基不均勻沉陷；高鹽分地下水若侵入品質不佳的樁身混凝土，鋼筋腐蝕會在數十年後削弱樁的承載。
knowledge.textEn: A thick filter cake on the bore wall or uncleaned base debris reduces both skin friction and end bearing, and individual soft piles cause uneven raft settlement; if saline groundwater penetrates poor-quality pile concrete, reinforcement corrosion weakens the piles decades later.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「筏基、摩擦樁與承載驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Raft, friction piles and capacity proof" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
鑽掘時若孔壁泥膜過厚或孔底沉渣未清除，側摩擦與端承都會下降，個別樁偏軟會造成筏基不均勻沉陷。
爬模只是一套模板，爬升時機由工班依進度自行決定即可。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A thick filter cake on the bore wall or uncleaned base debris reduces both skin friction and end bearing, and individual soft piles cause uneven raft settlement.
A climbing form is just formwork, so the crew can decide when to climb based on progress.
quiz.explanation: 鑽掘時若孔壁泥膜過厚或孔底沉渣未清除，側摩擦與端承都會下降，個別樁偏軟會造成筏基不均勻沉陷；高鹽分地下水若侵入品質不佳的樁身混凝土，鋼筋腐蝕會在數十年後削弱樁的承載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A thick filter cake on the bore wall or uncleaned base debris reduces both skin friction and end bearing, and individual soft piles cause uneven raft settlement; if saline groundwater penetrates poor-quality pile concrete, reinforcement corrosion weakens the piles decades later. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「核心先行的自爬模施工」與「約 600 m 的混凝土泵送與塔尖鋼構」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Core-first construction with self-climbing formwork" and "Pumping concrete to about 600 m and the steel spire": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 核心先行的自爬模施工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Core-first construction with self-climbing formwork: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「自爬模與核心先行」如何影響哈里發塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Self-climbing forms and core-first sequence” governs force, deformation or durability in “Burj Khalifa”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 哈里發塔採用 Doka SKE 100 自爬式模板，施工順序是先澆中央核心（分三段），再做各翼的牆與樓板，最後是翼尖的柱。核心先行讓塔吊與泵送管沿核心爬升，翼牆與樓板跟在後面，形成垂直方向的流水線；牆筋預先綁成約 8 m 長的鋼筋籠，以縮短高空作業時間。混凝土要求 10 小時達到約 10 MPa，模板才能及早脫模爬升。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「自爬模與核心先行」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Burj Khalifa used Doka SKE 100 self-climbing formwork with a sequence of central core first, in three sections, then the wing walls and slabs, and finally the nose columns. Leading with the core lets cranes and pump lines climb with it while wing walls and slabs follow, forming a vertical production line; wall reinforcement was prefabricated in cages about 8 m long to cut work at height. The concrete was required to reach about 10 MPa in 10 hours so forms could be stripped and climbed early. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Self-climbing forms and core-first sequence” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：樓層週期與工期：每層 3 天、150 層時純結構工期約 150×3 = 450 天，週期縮短為 2.5 天時約 375 天。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Floor cycle and duration: at 3 days per floor for 150 floors the structure alone takes about 150×3 = 450 days, or about 375 days at 2.5 days per floor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「爬模只是一套模板，爬升時機由工班依進度自行決定即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A climbing form is just formwork, so the crew can decide when to climb based on progress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「自爬模與核心先行」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Self-climbing forms and core-first sequence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 核心先行的自爬模施工
knowledge.text: 哈里發塔採用 Doka SKE 100 自爬式模板，施工順序是先澆中央核心（分三段），再做各翼的牆與樓板，最後是翼尖的柱。核心先行讓塔吊與泵送管沿核心爬升，翼牆與樓板跟在後面，形成垂直方向的流水線；牆筋預先綁成約 8 m 長的鋼筋籠，以縮短高空作業時間。
knowledge.textEn: Burj Khalifa used Doka SKE 100 self-climbing formwork with a sequence of central core first, in three sections, then the wing walls and slabs, and finally the nose columns. Leading with the core lets cranes and pump lines climb with it while wing walls and slabs follow, forming a vertical production line; wall reinforcement was prefabricated in cages about 8 m long to cut work at height.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：爬模只是一套模板，爬升時機由工班依進度自行決定即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A climbing form is just formwork, so the crew can decide when to climb based on progress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「核心先行的自爬模施工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Core-first construction with self-climbing formwork" is correct?
options: 爬模只是一套模板，爬升時機由工班依進度自行決定即可。
泵送高度只取決於泵機馬力，與混凝土配比無關。
哈里發塔採用 Doka SKE 100 自爬式模板，施工順序是先澆中央核心（分三段），再做各翼的牆與樓板，最後是翼尖的柱。
optionsEn: A climbing form is just formwork, so the crew can decide when to climb based on progress.
Pumping height depends only on pump power, not on the concrete mix.
Burj Khalifa used Doka SKE 100 self-climbing formwork with a sequence of central core first, in three sections, then the wing walls and slabs, and finally the nose columns.
quiz.explanation: 哈里發塔採用 Doka SKE 100 自爬式模板，施工順序是先澆中央核心（分三段），再做各翼的牆與樓板，最後是翼尖的柱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Burj Khalifa used Doka SKE 100 self-climbing formwork with a sequence of central core first, in three sections, then the wing walls and slabs, and finally the nose columns. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 核心先行的自爬模施工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Core-first construction with self-climbing formwork: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自爬模與核心先行」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Self-climbing forms and core-first sequence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：樓層週期與工期：每層 3 天、150 層時純結構工期約 150×3 = 450 天，週期縮短為 2.5 天時約 375 天。脫模時機看早期強度：若混凝土 10 小時達 10 MPa、爬模錨固需 8 MPa，以線性增長估計約 8 小時即可爬升，實際仍以試體確認。數值為教學假設，不代表實際工期。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Floor cycle and duration: at 3 days per floor for 150 floors the structure alone takes about 150×3 = 450 days, or about 375 days at 2.5 days per floor. Stripping is governed by early strength: if concrete reaches 10 MPa in 10 hours and the climbing anchors need 8 MPa, a linear-gain estimate allows climbing after about 8 hours, still confirmed by specimens. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual schedule. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每一節爬模在脫模前以同條件養護試體或成熟度感測器確認強度，記錄錨固點混凝土強度與爬升時間；核心、翼牆與樓板之間的施工時差要納入施工階段分析，檢查樓板未完成時核心牆的穩定與變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before stripping each lift, confirm strength with field-cured specimens or maturity sensors and record anchor-zone strength and climbing time; include the lag between core, wing walls and slabs in the construction-stage analysis, checking core-wall stability and deformation while slabs are incomplete.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 樓層週期與工期：每層 3 天、150 層時純結構工期約 150×3 = 450 天，週期縮短為 2.5 天時約 375 天。脫模時機看早期強度：若混凝土 10 小時達 10 MPa、爬模錨固需 8 MPa，以線性增長估計約 8 小時即可爬升，實際仍以試體確認。數值為教學假設，不代表實際工期。
knowledge.textEn: Floor cycle and duration: at 3 days per floor for 150 floors the structure alone takes about 150×3 = 450 days, or about 375 days at 2.5 days per floor. Stripping is governed by early strength: if concrete reaches 10 MPa in 10 hours and the climbing anchors need 8 MPa, a linear-gain estimate allows climbing after about 8 hours, still confirmed by specimens. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual schedule.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「核心先行的自爬模施工」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Core-first construction with self-climbing formwork", which statement holds?
options: 樓層週期與工期：每層 3 天、150 層時純結構工期約 150×3 = 450 天，週期縮短為 2.5 天時約 375 天。
應變計讀數乘上彈性模數，就是構件的實際應力。
外牆維護設備只是清潔工具，不屬於結構工程的責任。
optionsEn: Floor cycle and duration: at 3 days per floor for 150 floors the structure alone takes about 150×3 = 450 days, or about 375 days at 2.5 days per floor.
Multiplying a strain-gauge reading by the elastic modulus gives the member's actual stress.
Façade access equipment is just cleaning gear and not a structural engineering responsibility.
quiz.explanation: 樓層週期與工期：每層 3 天、150 層時純結構工期約 150×3 = 450 天，週期縮短為 2.5 天時約 375 天。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Floor cycle and duration: at 3 days per floor for 150 floors the structure alone takes about 150×3 = 450 days, or about 375 days at 2.5 days per floor. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 核心先行的自爬模施工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Core-first construction with self-climbing formwork: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自爬模與核心先行」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Self-climbing forms and core-first sequence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每一節爬模在脫模前以同條件養護試體或成熟度感測器確認強度，記錄錨固點混凝土強度與爬升時間；核心、翼牆與樓板之間的施工時差要納入施工階段分析，檢查樓板未完成時核心牆的穩定與變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before stripping each lift, confirm strength with field-cured specimens or maturity sensors and record anchor-zone strength and climbing time; include the lag between core, wing walls and slabs in the construction-stage analysis, checking core-wall stability and deformation while slabs are incomplete. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：爬模設計計算、錨固強度門檻與風速停工條件要寫入施工計畫；每次爬升前由現場工程師簽核強度與錨固檢查表，核心與翼牆允許的最大施工時差也要明列並持續監控。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Put the climbing-form design calculations, anchor-strength threshold and wind-speed stop limits into the construction plan; a site engineer signs the strength and anchor checklist before every climb, and the maximum allowed lag between core and wings is stated and monitored.

steps.instruction: 若在強度不足時爬升，錨固錐周圍混凝土可能被拉裂，整組爬模失去支承；核心與翼牆的施工時差過大時，核心單獨承受風力與吊裝荷重，變形與應力都會超過完工狀態的預期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 約 600 m 的混凝土泵送與塔尖鋼構：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Pumping concrete to about 600 m and the steel spire: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「超高壓泵送管線」如何影響哈里發塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Super-high-pressure pump line” governs force, deformation or durability in “Burj Khalifa”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 哈里發塔的混凝土全部由地面泵送：公開論文指出主要配比的泵送壓力上限約 200 bar，泵機可達 350 bar，經 150 mm 管線輸送，並以水平繞管試驗模擬約 600 m 的泵送高度；泵機廠商指出 2008 年以 BSA 14000 SHP-D 泵送到 606 m 創下紀錄。127 層以上把粗骨材最大粒徑由 20 mm 降為 10 mm，以降低堵管風險。再往上改為鋼結構，塔尖使用超過 4,000 公噸以斜撐組成的鋼材。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「超高壓泵送管線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: All of Burj Khalifa's concrete was pumped from ground level: the published paper sets a pumping-pressure limit of about 200 bar for the main mix, with pumps capable of 350 bar through a 150 mm line, and a horizontal loop trial simulating a pumping height of about 600 m; the pump manufacturer reports a record 606 m pumping height in 2008 with a BSA 14000 SHP-D. Above level 127 the maximum aggregate size dropped from 20 mm to 10 mm to reduce blockage risk. Higher still the structure turns to steel, and the spire uses more than 4,000 t of braced structural steel. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Super-high-pressure pump line” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：泵送壓力 p ≈ ρ·g·h + 摩擦損失。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pumping pressure p ≈ ρ·g·h + friction loss.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵送高度只取決於泵機馬力，與混凝土配比無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pumping height depends only on pump power, not on the concrete mix." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「超高壓泵送管線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Super-high-pressure pump line”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 約 600 m 的混凝土泵送與塔尖鋼構：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pumping concrete to about 600 m and the steel spire: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超高壓泵送管線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Super-high-pressure pump line” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：泵送壓力 p ≈ ρ·g·h + 摩擦損失。靜水壓 2,500×9.81×600 ≈ 14.7 MPa = 147 bar；若管線摩擦損失 0.08 bar/m、管長 650 m，再加約 52 bar，總計約 199 bar，正好貼近 200 bar 上限；配比變黏使摩擦升到 0.12 bar/m 時，總壓約 225 bar 即超標。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pumping pressure p ≈ ρ·g·h + friction loss. The static head is 2,500×9.81×600 ≈ 14.7 MPa = 147 bar; with a pipe friction loss of 0.08 bar/m over 650 m of line, another 52 bar brings the total to about 199 bar, right at the 200 bar limit; if a stickier mix raises friction to 0.12 bar/m, the total of about 225 bar exceeds it. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：正式泵送前以水平繞管試驗量測每公尺壓力損失與出口坍流度；施工中監測泵壓、管線溫度與出口材料性質，定期取樣試驗強度，並在管線各段訂出洗管與排堵程序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before production pumping, measure pressure loss per metre and discharge slump flow in a horizontal loop trial; during construction monitor pump pressure, line temperature and discharge properties, sample strength regularly, and set wash-out and blockage-clearing procedures for each line section.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 泵送壓力 p ≈ ρ·g·h + 摩擦損失。靜水壓 2,500×9.81×600 ≈ 14.7 MPa = 147 bar；若管線摩擦損失 0.08 bar/m、管長 650 m，再加約 52 bar，總計約 199 bar，正好貼近 200 bar 上限；配比變黏使摩擦升到 0.12 bar/m 時，總壓約 225 bar 即超標。數值為教學假設。
