The static head is 2,500×9.81×600 ≈ 14.7 MPa = 147 bar; with a pipe friction loss of 0.08 bar/m over 650 m of line, another 52 bar brings the total to about 199 bar, right at the 200 bar limit; if a stickier mix raises friction to 0.12 bar/m, the total of about 225 bar exceeds it. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 約 600 m 的混凝土泵送與塔尖鋼構：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「超高壓泵送管線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Super-high-pressure pump line” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 正式泵送前以水平繞管試驗量測每公尺壓力損失與出口坍流度；施工中監測泵壓、管線溫度與出口材料性質，定期取樣試驗強度，並在管線各段訂出洗管與排堵程序。塔尖鋼構分段吊裝或頂升時，須有分階段的穩定與臨時支撐計算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before production pumping, measure pressure loss per metre and discharge slump flow in a horizontal loop trial; during construction monitor pump pressure, line temperature and discharge properties, sample strength regularly, and set wash-out and blockage-clearing procedures for each line section. Erecting spire steel in segments or by jacking needs stage-by-stage stability and temporary-support calculations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: The pumping plan should list the mix, aggregate size, predicted pressure and standby pump for each height band; pipe anchors, bends and safety guards must be inspected, pumping stops whenever pressure exceeds the set value until the technical manager decides, and adding water on site is prohibited.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高空堵管時，管內混凝土在數百 bar 壓力下硬化，必須拆管清除，工期延誤並有爆管傷人風險；為了好泵而在現場加水會降低強度與彈性模數，直接增加牆柱縮短量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.textEn: Before production pumping, measure pressure loss per metre and discharge slump flow in a horizontal loop trial; during construction monitor pump pressure, line temperature and discharge properties, sample strength regularly, and set wash-out and blockage-clearing procedures for each line section. Erecting spire steel in segments or by jacking needs stage-by-stage stability and temporary-support calculations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 泵送計畫要列出每段高度的配比、骨材粒徑、預估壓力與備用泵；管線固定點、彎管與安全護罩須經檢查，壓力超過設定值即停止泵送，由技術主管判斷後才可續作，並禁止現場加水。

quiz.question: 要驗證「約 600 m 的混凝土泵送與塔尖鋼構」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

混凝土強度夠高，徐變與縮短就可以忽略。
正式泵送前以水平繞管試驗量測每公尺壓力損失與出口坍流度；施工中監測泵壓、管線溫度與出口材料性質，定期取樣試驗強度，並在管線各段訂出洗管與排堵程序。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
With high enough concrete strength, creep and shortening can be ignored.
Before production pumping, measure pressure loss per metre and discharge slump flow in a horizontal loop trial.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 約 600 m 的混凝土泵送與塔尖鋼構：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pumping concrete to about 600 m and the steel spire: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「超高壓泵送管線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Super-high-pressure pump line” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高空堵管時，管內混凝土在數百 bar 壓力下硬化，必須拆管清除，工期延誤並有爆管傷人風險；為了好泵而在現場加水會降低強度與彈性模數，直接增加牆柱縮短量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A blockage at height lets concrete harden in the line under hundreds of bar, forcing pipes to be dismantled, delaying work and risking burst-pipe injuries; adding water on site to ease pumping lowers strength and elastic modulus and directly increases wall and column shortening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：再往上改為鋼結構，塔尖使用超過 4,000 公噸以斜撐組成的鋼材。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Higher still the structure turns to steel, and the spire uses more than 4,000 t of braced structural steel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵送高度只取決於泵機馬力，與混凝土配比無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pumping height depends only on pump power, not on the concrete mix." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高空堵管時，管內混凝土在數百 bar 壓力下硬化，必須拆管清除，工期延誤並有爆管傷人風險；為了好泵而在現場加水會降低強度與彈性模數，直接增加牆柱縮短量。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「約 600 m 的混凝土泵送與塔尖鋼構」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pumping concrete to about 600 m and the steel spire" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 高空堵管時，管內混凝土在數百 bar 壓力下硬化，必須拆管清除，工期延誤並有爆管傷人風險；為了好泵而在現場加水會降低強度與彈性模數，直接增加牆柱縮短量。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要每層都以雷射對準設計座標，建築就一定是直的。
optionsEn: A blockage at height lets concrete harden in the line under hundreds of bar, forcing pipes to be dismantled, delaying work and risking burst-pipe injuries.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
If every floor is laser-aligned to the design coordinates, the building will be straight.
quiz.explanation: 高空堵管時，管內混凝土在數百 bar 壓力下硬化，必須拆管清除，工期延誤並有爆管傷人風險；為了好泵而在現場加水會降低強度與彈性模數，直接增加牆柱縮短量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A blockage at height lets concrete harden in the line under hundreds of bar, forcing pipes to be dismantled, delaying work and risking burst-pipe injuries; adding water on site to ease pumping lowers strength and elastic modulus and directly increases wall and column shortening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中」與「徐變收縮監測與設計假設比對」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring" and "Creep and shrinkage monitoring against design assumptions": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「GPS 垂直度監測」如何影響哈里發塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “GPS verticality monitoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Burj Khalifa”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 超過 500 m 高的混凝土核心在施工中不斷受風、日照溫差、不均勻縮短與基礎沉陷影響而微幅偏移，傳統由地面往上投點的方式誤差會累積。哈里發塔採用專門的 GPS 監測系統檢核垂直度，並在每次六角核心爬升時重新置中，作為水平方向的補償；垂直方向則以略為加高樓層高度補償縮短。量測時必須把瞬間的擺動與溫度彎曲，從真正的施工誤差中分離出來。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「GPS 垂直度監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A concrete core more than 500 m tall shifts slightly all the time during construction under wind, solar temperature differences, uneven shortening and foundation settlement, and traditional upward plumbing from the ground accumulates error. Burj Khalifa used a dedicated GPS monitoring system to check verticality and re-centred the hex core at each jump as horizontal compensation, while vertical shortening was compensated by modestly increasing floor-to-floor heights. Surveys must separate momentary sway and thermal bowing from genuine construction error. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “GPS verticality monitoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：基礎差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Tilt from differential foundation settlement θ = Δs/B.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要每層都以雷射對準設計座標，建築就一定是直的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If every floor is laser-aligned to the design coordinates, the building will be straight." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「GPS 垂直度監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “GPS verticality monitoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中
knowledge.titleEn: Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring
knowledge.text: 超過 500 m 高的混凝土核心在施工中不斷受風、日照溫差、不均勻縮短與基礎沉陷影響而微幅偏移，傳統由地面往上投點的方式誤差會累積。哈里發塔採用專門的 GPS 監測系統檢核垂直度，並在每次六角核心爬升時重新置中，作為水平方向的補償；垂直方向則以略為加高樓層高度補償縮短。
knowledge.textEn: A concrete core more than 500 m tall shifts slightly all the time during construction under wind, solar temperature differences, uneven shortening and foundation settlement, and traditional upward plumbing from the ground accumulates error. Burj Khalifa used a dedicated GPS monitoring system to check verticality and re-centred the hex core at each jump as horizontal compensation, while vertical shortening was compensated by modestly increasing floor-to-floor heights.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要每層都以雷射對準設計座標，建築就一定是直的。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If every floor is laser-aligned to the design coordinates, the building will be straight. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring" is correct?
options: 只要每層都以雷射對準設計座標，建築就一定是直的。
超過 500 m 高的混凝土核心在施工中不斷受風、日照溫差、不均勻縮短與基礎沉陷影響而微幅偏移，傳統由地面往上投點的方式誤差會累積。
應變計讀數乘上彈性模數，就是構件的實際應力。
optionsEn: If every floor is laser-aligned to the design coordinates, the building will be straight.

A concrete core more than 500 m tall shifts slightly all the time during construction under wind, solar temperature differences, uneven shortening and foundation settlement, and traditional upward plumbing from the ground accumulates error.
Multiplying a strain-gauge reading by the elastic modulus gives the member's actual stress.
quiz.explanation: 超過 500 m 高的混凝土核心在施工中不斷受風、日照溫差、不均勻縮短與基礎沉陷影響而微幅偏移，傳統由地面往上投點的方式誤差會累積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A concrete core more than 500 m tall shifts slightly all the time during construction under wind, solar temperature differences, uneven shortening and foundation settlement, and traditional upward plumbing from the ground accumulates error. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「GPS 垂直度監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “GPS verticality monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：基礎差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。若筏基兩端沉陷差 10 mm、寬度 60 m，θ = 10/60,000 ≈ 1/6,000；在 600 m 高處的水平偏移約 600,000/6,000 = 100 mm。若量測時忽略這個剛體傾斜，就會把 100 mm 誤判為施工誤差而錯誤修正。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Tilt from differential foundation settlement θ = Δs/B. A 10 mm settlement difference across a 60 m raft gives θ = 10/60,000 ≈ 1/6,000, or about 600,000/6,000 = 100 mm of horizontal offset at 600 m. If the survey ignores this rigid-body tilt, the 100 mm is misread as construction error and wrongly corrected. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在核心頂部設置 GPS 天線與傾斜儀連續記錄，以統計方法扣除風與溫度造成的週期性擺動；將結果與施工階段分析預測的變形及筏基沉陷量測比較，確認每次重新置中的修正量只針對真正的施工偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit GPS antennas and inclinometers at the top of the core, record continuously and statistically remove the periodic sway from wind and temperature; compare the results with deformations predicted by the construction-stage analysis and with measured raft settlement, so that each re-centring corrects only genuine construction deviation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 基礎差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。若筏基兩端沉陷差 10 mm、寬度 60 m，θ = 10/60,000 ≈ 1/6,000；在 600 m 高處的水平偏移約 600,000/6,000 = 100 mm。若量測時忽略這個剛體傾斜，就會把 100 mm 誤判為施工誤差而錯誤修正。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Tilt from differential foundation settlement θ = Δs/B. A 10 mm settlement difference across a 60 m raft gives θ = 10/60,000 ≈ 1/6,000, or about 600,000/6,000 = 100 mm of horizontal offset at 600 m. If the survey ignores this rigid-body tilt, the 100 mm is misread as construction error and wrongly corrected. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring", which statement holds?
options: 外牆維護設備只是清潔工具，不屬於結構工程的責任。
只要結構夠強，建築外形對風力的影響可以忽略。
基礎差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。
optionsEn: Façade access equipment is just cleaning gear and not a structural engineering responsibility.
If the structure is strong enough, building shape has negligible effect on wind loads.
Tilt from differential foundation settlement θ = Δs/B.
quiz.explanation: 基礎差異沉陷造成的傾斜 θ = Δs/B。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Tilt from differential foundation settlement θ = Δs/B. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「GPS 垂直度監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “GPS verticality monitoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在核心頂部設置 GPS 天線與傾斜儀連續記錄，以統計方法扣除風與溫度造成的週期性擺動；將結果與施工階段分析預測的變形及筏基沉陷量測比較，確認每次重新置中的修正量只針對真正的施工偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit GPS antennas and inclinometers at the top of the core, record continuously and statistically remove the periodic sway from wind and temperature; compare the results with deformations predicted by the construction-stage analysis and with measured raft settlement, so that each re-centring corrects only genuine construction deviation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在午後日照最強時投點並據以修正，核心冷卻後會偏向另一側，等於把建築做歪；若垂直縮短補償不足，完工多年後樓板標高低於設計值，影響電梯停靠精度與帷幕牆接縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「GPS 垂直度監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “GPS verticality monitoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在午後日照最強時投點並據以修正，核心冷卻後會偏向另一側，等於把建築做歪；若垂直縮短補償不足，完工多年後樓板標高低於設計值，影響電梯停靠精度與帷幕牆接縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Setting out in the hottest afternoon sun and correcting from it leaves the core leaning the other way once it cools, building the tower crooked; insufficient vertical compensation leaves floors below design level years later, affecting elevator levelling and curtain-wall joints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量測時必須把瞬間的擺動與溫度彎曲，從真正的施工誤差中分離出來。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surveys must separate momentary sway and thermal bowing from genuine construction error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要每層都以雷射對準設計座標，建築就一定是直的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every floor is laser-aligned to the design coordinates, the building will be straight." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在午後日照最強時投點並據以修正，核心冷卻後會偏向另一側，等於把建築做歪；若垂直縮短補償不足，完工多年後樓板標高低於設計值，影響電梯停靠精度與帷幕牆接縫。
knowledge.textEn: Setting out in the hottest afternoon sun and correcting from it leaves the core leaning the other way once it cools, building the tower crooked; insufficient vertical compensation leaves floors below design level years later, affecting elevator levelling and curtain-wall joints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測量基準、垂直度與核心重新置中」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Survey datums, verticality and core re-centring" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若在午後日照最強時投點並據以修正，核心冷卻後會偏向另一側，等於把建築做歪；若垂直縮短補償不足，完工多年後樓板標高低於設計值，影響電梯停靠精度與帷幕牆接縫。
應變計讀數乘上彈性模數，就是構件的實際應力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Setting out in the hottest afternoon sun and correcting from it leaves the core leaning the other way once it cools, building the tower crooked.
Multiplying a strain-gauge reading by the elastic modulus gives the member's actual stress.
quiz.explanation: 若在午後日照最強時投點並據以修正，核心冷卻後會偏向另一側，等於把建築做歪；若垂直縮短補償不足，完工多年後樓板標高低於設計值，影響電梯停靠精度與帷幕牆接縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Setting out in the hottest afternoon sun and correcting from it leaves the core leaning the other way once it cools, building the tower crooked; insufficient vertical compensation leaves floors below design level years later, affecting elevator levelling and curtain-wall joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 徐變收縮監測與設計假設比對：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Creep and shrinkage monitoring against design assumptions: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「應變計與長期監測」如何影響哈里發塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strain gauges and long-term monitoring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Burj Khalifa”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 哈里發塔的監測計畫由專業監測廠商供應安裝，涵蓋施工前的試驗樁、施工期間以應變計量測的應力分布，以及混凝土的徐變、乾縮與彈性性質，並把量測與模型預測比較，超過設計限值時即時警報。監測的價值在於分解應變：同一支應變計讀到的總應變包含彈性、徐變、乾縮與溫度分量，只有分離之後才能回推真正的應力與構件縮短。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「應變計與長期監測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Burj Khalifa's monitoring programme, supplied and installed by a specialist monitoring firm, covered trial piles before construction and, during construction, stress distribution from strain gauges and the creep, shrinkage and elastic properties of the concrete, compared with model predictions and with real-time alarms if design limits were exceeded. The value of monitoring lies in decomposing strain: one gauge's total reading combines elastic, creep, shrinkage and thermal components, and only after separating them can the true stress and member shortening be back-calculated. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Strain gauges and long-term monitoring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：彈性應變 = 總應變 − 徐變 − 乾縮 − 溫度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Elastic strain = total − creep − shrinkage − thermal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「應變計讀數乘上彈性模數，就是構件的實際應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Multiplying a strain-gauge reading by the elastic modulus gives the member's actual stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「應變計與長期監測」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Strain gauges and long-term monitoring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Creep and shrinkage monitoring against design assumptions

knowledge.textEn: Burj Khalifa's monitoring programme, supplied and installed by a specialist monitoring firm, covered trial piles before construction and, during construction, stress distribution from strain gauges and the creep, shrinkage and elastic properties of the concrete, compared with model predictions and with real-time alarms if design limits were exceeded. The value of monitoring lies in decomposing strain: one gauge's total reading combines elastic, creep, shrinkage and thermal components, and only after separating them can the true stress and member shortening be back-calculated.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

quiz.question: 關於「徐變收縮監測與設計假設比對」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Creep and shrinkage monitoring against design assumptions" is correct?
options: 應變計讀數乘上彈性模數，就是構件的實際應力。
基礎埋在地下、不接觸空氣，所以不會腐蝕。
哈里發塔的監測計畫由專業監測廠商供應安裝，涵蓋施工前的試驗樁、施工期間以應變計量測的應力分布，以及混凝土的徐變、乾縮與彈性性質，並把量測與模型預測比較，超過設計限值時即時警報。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 徐變收縮監測與設計假設比對：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Creep and shrinkage monitoring against design assumptions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「應變計與長期監測」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strain gauges and long-term monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：彈性應變 = 總應變 − 徐變 − 乾縮 − 溫度。若某牆量得 600 με，預估乾縮 200 με、徐變 250 με、溫度 0，彈性應變為 150 με，應力 σ = E·ε = 43,800×150×10⁻⁶ ≈ 6.6 MPa；若乾縮實際只有 120 με，回推應力變成約 10.1 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Elastic strain = total − creep − shrinkage − thermal. If a wall reads 600 με with predicted shrinkage of 200 με, creep of 250 με and no thermal strain, the elastic strain is 150 με and σ = E·ε = 43,800×150×10⁻⁶ ≈ 6.6 MPa; if shrinkage is really only 120 με, the back-calculated stress becomes about 10.1 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在受力應變計旁設置不受力的補償試體（無應力計），直接量測乾縮與溫度應變；應變計安裝前後拍照記錄方位，資料定期與施工階段分析比較，偏差超過設定範圍時由設計者檢討材料參數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install unloaded companion specimens, known as no-stress meters, next to loaded gauges to measure shrinkage and thermal strain directly; photograph gauge orientation before and after installation, compare data periodically with the construction-stage analysis, and have the designer review material parameters when deviations exceed set bounds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 彈性應變 = 總應變 − 徐變 − 乾縮 − 溫度。若某牆量得 600 με，預估乾縮 200 με、徐變 250 με、溫度 0，彈性應變為 150 με，應力 σ = E·ε = 43,800×150×10⁻⁶ ≈ 6.6 MPa；若乾縮實際只有 120 με，回推應力變成約 10.1 MPa。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Elastic strain = total − creep − shrinkage − thermal. If a wall reads 600 με with predicted shrinkage of 200 με, creep of 250 με and no thermal strain, the elastic strain is 150 με and σ = E·ε = 43,800×150×10⁻⁶ ≈ 6.6 MPa; if shrinkage is really only 120 με, the back-calculated stress becomes about 10.1 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「徐變收縮監測與設計假設比對」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Creep and shrinkage monitoring against design assumptions", which statement holds?
options: 彈性應變 = 總應變 − 徐變 − 乾縮 − 溫度。
Y 形平面只是為了造型與景觀，對結構沒有好處。
混凝土強度夠高，徐變與縮短就可以忽略。
optionsEn: Elastic strain = total − creep − shrinkage − thermal.
The Y-shaped plan is only for appearance and views and gives no structural benefit.
With high enough concrete strength, creep and shortening can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 彈性應變 = 總應變 − 徐變 − 乾縮 − 溫度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Elastic strain = total − creep − shrinkage − thermal. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 徐變收縮監測與設計假設比對：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Creep and shrinkage monitoring against design assumptions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「應變計與長期監測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strain gauges and long-term monitoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在受力應變計旁設置不受力的補償試體（無應力計），直接量測乾縮與溫度應變；應變計安裝前後拍照記錄方位，資料定期與施工階段分析比較，偏差超過設定範圍時由設計者檢討材料參數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install unloaded companion specimens, known as no-stress meters, next to loaded gauges to measure shrinkage and thermal strain directly; photograph gauge orientation before and after installation, compare data periodically with the construction-stage analysis, and have the designer review material parameters when deviations exceed set bounds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：監測規範要列出感測器數量與位置、無應力計配置、初讀值時機、資料格式、警戒值與通報流程；電纜路徑與保護要標示在施工圖上，交接時連同原始資料一起移交業主。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The monitoring specification should list sensor numbers and locations, no-stress meter layout, initial-reading timing, data format, alert levels and reporting procedure; mark cable routes and protection on the construction drawings and hand all raw data to the owner at handover.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有無應力計時，乾縮被誤當成受力應變，回推的應力可能偏差五成以上；感測器電纜在後續施工中被切斷，或資料沒有備份，關鍵的早期數據就永久遺失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without no-stress meters, shrinkage is mistaken for load strain and back-calculated stress can be off by 50% or more; cables cut by later trades or unbacked-up data permanently lose the crucial early readings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 徐變收縮監測與設計假設比對：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Creep and shrinkage monitoring against design assumptions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「應變計與長期監測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strain gauges and long-term monitoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沒有無應力計時，乾縮被誤當成受力應變，回推的應力可能偏差五成以上；感測器電纜在後續施工中被切斷，或資料沒有備份，關鍵的早期數據就永久遺失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without no-stress meters, shrinkage is mistaken for load strain and back-calculated stress can be off by 50% or more; cables cut by later trades or unbacked-up data permanently lose the crucial early readings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測的價值在於分解應變：同一支應變計讀到的總應變包含彈性、徐變、乾縮與溫度分量，只有分離之後才能回推真正的應力與構件縮短。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The value of monitoring lies in decomposing strain: one gauge's total reading combines elastic, creep, shrinkage and thermal components, and only after separating them can the true stress and member shortening be back-calculated.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「應變計讀數乘上彈性模數，就是構件的實際應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Multiplying a strain-gauge reading by the elastic modulus gives the member's actual stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「徐變收縮監測與設計假設比對」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Creep and shrinkage monitoring against design assumptions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

基礎埋在地下、不接觸空氣，所以不會腐蝕。
沒有無應力計時，乾縮被誤當成受力應變，回推的應力可能偏差五成以上；感測器電纜在後續施工中被切斷，或資料沒有備份，關鍵的早期數據就永久遺失。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Foundations are buried away from air, so they cannot corrode.
Without no-stress meters, shrinkage is mistaken for load strain and back-calculated stress can be off by 50% or more.
quiz.explanation: 沒有無應力計時，乾縮被誤當成受力應變，回推的應力可能偏差五成以上；感測器電纜在後續施工中被切斷，或資料沒有備份，關鍵的早期數據就永久遺失。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鹽水地層中的基礎耐久」與「26,000 片帷幕與外牆維護系統的交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Foundation durability in saline ground" and "Handing over 26,000 cladding panels and the façade access system": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鹽水地層中的基礎耐久：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Foundation durability in saline ground: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「高鹽分地下水」如何影響哈里發塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Saline groundwater” governs force, deformation or durability in “Burj Khalifa”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 杜拜的地下水含有高濃度鹽分，公開論文記載氯離子可達 4.5%、硫酸鹽可達 0.6%，對筏基與樁身的混凝土及鋼筋都是長期威脅。對策從材料開始：筏基採 40% 飛灰、水膠比 0.34，樁身採 25% 飛灰與 7% 矽灰、水膠比 0.32 的自充填混凝土，以降低滲透性並提高抗硫酸鹽能力，再配合足夠的保護層與防水、防蝕措施。基礎埋在地下無法目視檢查，耐久設計必須一次做對。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「高鹽分地下水」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dubai's groundwater is highly saline; the published paper records chlorides up to 4.5% and sulfates up to 0.6%, a long-term threat to raft and pile concrete and reinforcement. The response starts with materials: the raft uses 40% fly ash at a water–cement ratio of 0.34 and the piles a self-consolidating mix with 25% fly ash and 7% silica fume at 0.32, lowering permeability and improving sulfate resistance, backed by adequate cover and waterproofing and corrosion-protection measures. Buried foundations cannot be inspected visually, so durability design must be right the first time. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Saline groundwater” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：氯離子滲透深度約 x ≈ 2·√(D·t)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Chloride penetration depth is roughly x ≈ 2·√(D·t).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基礎埋在地下、不接觸空氣，所以不會腐蝕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Foundations are buried away from air, so they cannot corrode." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「高鹽分地下水」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Saline groundwater”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鹽水地層中的基礎耐久
knowledge.text: 杜拜的地下水含有高濃度鹽分，公開論文記載氯離子可達 4.5%、硫酸鹽可達 0.6%，對筏基與樁身的混凝土及鋼筋都是長期威脅。對策從材料開始：筏基採 40% 飛灰、水膠比 0.34，樁身採 25% 飛灰與 7% 矽灰、水膠比 0.32 的自充填混凝土，以降低滲透性並提高抗硫酸鹽能力，再配合足夠的保護層與防水、防蝕措施。
knowledge.textEn: Dubai's groundwater is highly saline; the published paper records chlorides up to 4.5% and sulfates up to 0.6%, a long-term threat to raft and pile concrete and reinforcement. The response starts with materials: the raft uses 40% fly ash at a water–cement ratio of 0.34 and the piles a self-consolidating mix with 25% fly ash and 7% silica fume at 0.32, lowering permeability and improving sulfate resistance, backed by adequate cover and waterproofing and corrosion-protection measures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基礎埋在地下、不接觸空氣，所以不會腐蝕。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Foundations are buried away from air, so they cannot corrode. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鹽水地層中的基礎耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Foundation durability in saline ground" is correct?
options: 杜拜的地下水含有高濃度鹽分，公開論文記載氯離子可達 4.5%、硫酸鹽可達 0.6%，對筏基與樁身的混凝土及鋼筋都是長期威脅。
基礎埋在地下、不接觸空氣，所以不會腐蝕。
外牆維護設備只是清潔工具，不屬於結構工程的責任。
optionsEn: Dubai's groundwater is highly saline.
Foundations are buried away from air, so they cannot corrode.
Façade access equipment is just cleaning gear and not a structural engineering responsibility.
quiz.explanation: 杜拜的地下水含有高濃度鹽分，公開論文記載氯離子可達 4.5%、硫酸鹽可達 0.6%，對筏基與樁身的混凝土及鋼筋都是長期威脅。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dubai's groundwater is highly saline; the published paper records chlorides up to 4.5% and sulfates up to 0.6%, a long-term threat to raft and pile concrete and reinforcement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鹽水地層中的基礎耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Foundation durability in saline ground: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高鹽分地下水」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Saline groundwater” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：氯離子滲透深度約 x ≈ 2·√(D·t)。擴散係數 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s、t = 100 年（3.16×10⁹ s）時 x ≈ 2×√(3.16×10⁻³) ≈ 0.112 m = 112 mm；若以飛灰與矽灰把 D 降到 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s，x 約 79 mm。保護層須大於臨界濃度到達的深度並保留餘裕。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Chloride penetration depth is roughly x ≈ 2·√(D·t). With a diffusion coefficient D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s over t = 100 years (3.16×10⁹ s), x ≈ 2×√(3.16×10⁻³) ≈ 0.112 m = 112 mm; cutting D to 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s with fly ash and silica fume gives about 79 mm. Cover must exceed the depth reached by the critical concentration, with margin. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對配比做快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗並設定允收上限，施工時抽驗保護層厚度與混凝土品質；長期則可埋設腐蝕感測器或參考電極，配合地下水水質定期檢測，追蹤基礎環境是否惡化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test the mixes for rapid chloride permeability or diffusion against set acceptance limits and spot-check cover and concrete quality during construction; in the long term, embedded corrosion sensors or reference electrodes plus periodic groundwater sampling track whether the foundation environment is deteriorating.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 氯離子滲透深度約 x ≈ 2·√(D·t)。擴散係數 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s、t = 100 年（3.16×10⁹ s）時 x ≈ 2×√(3.16×10⁻³) ≈ 0.112 m = 112 mm；若以飛灰與矽灰把 D 降到 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s，x 約 79 mm。保護層須大於臨界濃度到達的深度並保留餘裕。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Chloride penetration depth is roughly x ≈ 2·√(D·t). With a diffusion coefficient D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s over t = 100 years (3.16×10⁹ s), x ≈ 2×√(3.16×10⁻³) ≈ 0.112 m = 112 mm; cutting D to 5×10⁻¹³ m²/s with fly ash and silica fume gives about 79 mm. Cover must exceed the depth reached by the critical concentration, with margin. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鹽水地層中的基礎耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Foundation durability in saline ground", which statement holds?
options: 只要結構夠強，建築外形對風力的影響可以忽略。
氯離子滲透深度約 x ≈ 2·√(D·t)。
沒有打到堅硬岩盤的摩擦樁，不能支承超高層建築。
optionsEn: If the structure is strong enough, building shape has negligible effect on wind loads.
Chloride penetration depth is roughly x ≈ 2·√(D·t).
Friction piles that do not reach hard rock cannot support a supertall tower.
quiz.explanation: 氯離子滲透深度約 x ≈ 2·√(D·t)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Chloride penetration depth is roughly x ≈ 2·√(D·t). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鹽水地層中的基礎耐久：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Foundation durability in saline ground: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高鹽分地下水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Saline groundwater” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對配比做快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗並設定允收上限，施工時抽驗保護層厚度與混凝土品質；長期則可埋設腐蝕感測器或參考電極，配合地下水水質定期檢測，追蹤基礎環境是否惡化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test the mixes for rapid chloride permeability or diffusion against set acceptance limits and spot-check cover and concrete quality during construction; in the long term, embedded corrosion sensors or reference electrodes plus periodic groundwater sampling track whether the foundation environment is deteriorating. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計基準書要寫明地下水化學分析、暴露等級、配比限制與保護層；樁身完整性試驗（如跨孔超音波或低應變試驗）列為逐樁驗收項目，結果與防蝕措施資料一起交給營運單位存檔。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis should state the groundwater chemistry, exposure class, mix limits and cover; make pile-integrity testing such as cross-hole sonic or low-strain tests a pile-by-pile acceptance item, and hand the results and corrosion-protection records to the operator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樁身混凝土若在鑽掘泥漿中澆置不良而形成蜂窩或夾泥，鹽水會沿缺陷快速到達鋼筋，腐蝕膨脹使混凝土開裂並降低承載；這種損傷埋在地下，往往要到沉陷異常才被察覺。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Pile concrete placed poorly under drilling slurry can trap honeycombing or soil inclusions, letting brine reach the bars quickly; corrosion expansion cracks the concrete and reduces capacity, and because the damage is buried it often goes unnoticed until settlement becomes abnormal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Test the mixes for rapid chloride permeability or diffusion against set acceptance limits and spot-check cover and concrete quality during construction; in the long term, embedded corrosion sensors or reference electrodes plus periodic groundwater sampling track whether the foundation environment is deteriorating.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計基準書要寫明地下水化學分析、暴露等級、配比限制與保護層；樁身完整性試驗（如跨孔超音波或低應變試驗）列為逐樁驗收項目，結果與防蝕措施資料一起交給營運單位存檔。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis should state the groundwater chemistry, exposure class, mix limits and cover; make pile-integrity testing such as cross-hole sonic or low-strain tests a pile-by-pile acceptance item, and hand the results and corrosion-protection records to the operator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鹽水地層中的基礎耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Foundation durability in saline ground"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
泵送高度只取決於泵機馬力，與混凝土配比無關。
對配比做快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗並設定允收上限，施工時抽驗保護層厚度與混凝土品質。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Pumping height depends only on pump power, not on the concrete mix.
Test the mixes for rapid chloride permeability or diffusion against set acceptance limits and spot-check cover and concrete quality during construction.
quiz.explanation: 對配比做快速氯離子滲透或擴散試驗並設定允收上限，施工時抽驗保護層厚度與混凝土品質；長期則可埋設腐蝕感測器或參考電極，配合地下水水質定期檢測，追蹤基礎環境是否惡化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test the mixes for rapid chloride permeability or diffusion against set acceptance limits and spot-check cover and concrete quality during construction; in the long term, embedded corrosion sensors or reference electrodes plus periodic groundwater sampling track whether the foundation environment is deteriorating. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鹽水地層中的基礎耐久：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Foundation durability in saline ground: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高鹽分地下水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Saline groundwater” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樁身混凝土若在鑽掘泥漿中澆置不良而形成蜂窩或夾泥，鹽水會沿缺陷快速到達鋼筋，腐蝕膨脹使混凝土開裂並降低承載；這種損傷埋在地下，往往要到沉陷異常才被察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Pile concrete placed poorly under drilling slurry can trap honeycombing or soil inclusions, letting brine reach the bars quickly; corrosion expansion cracks the concrete and reduces capacity, and because the damage is buried it often goes unnoticed until settlement becomes abnormal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：基礎埋在地下無法目視檢查，耐久設計必須一次做對。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Buried foundations cannot be inspected visually, so durability design must be right the first time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基礎埋在地下、不接觸空氣，所以不會腐蝕。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Foundations are buried away from air, so they cannot corrode." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 樁身混凝土若在鑽掘泥漿中澆置不良而形成蜂窩或夾泥，鹽水會沿缺陷快速到達鋼筋，腐蝕膨脹使混凝土開裂並降低承載；這種損傷埋在地下，往往要到沉陷異常才被察覺。
knowledge.textEn: Pile concrete placed poorly under drilling slurry can trap honeycombing or soil inclusions, letting brine reach the bars quickly; corrosion expansion cracks the concrete and reduces capacity, and because the damage is buried it often goes unnoticed until settlement becomes abnormal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鹽水地層中的基礎耐久」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Foundation durability in saline ground" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 樁身混凝土若在鑽掘泥漿中澆置不良而形成蜂窩或夾泥，鹽水會沿缺陷快速到達鋼筋，腐蝕膨脹使混凝土開裂並降低承載；這種損傷埋在地下，往往要到沉陷異常才被察覺。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
外牆維護設備只是清潔工具，不屬於結構工程的責任。
optionsEn: Pile concrete placed poorly under drilling slurry can trap honeycombing or soil inclusions, letting brine reach the bars quickly.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Façade access equipment is just cleaning gear and not a structural engineering responsibility.
quiz.explanation: 樁身混凝土若在鑽掘泥漿中澆置不良而形成蜂窩或夾泥，鹽水會沿缺陷快速到達鋼筋，腐蝕膨脹使混凝土開裂並降低承載；這種損傷埋在地下，往往要到沉陷異常才被察覺。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Pile concrete placed poorly under drilling slurry can trap honeycombing or soil inclusions, letting brine reach the bars quickly; corrosion expansion cracks the concrete and reduces capacity, and because the damage is buried it often goes unnoticed until settlement becomes abnormal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 26,000 片帷幕與外牆維護系統的交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Handing over 26,000 cladding panels and the façade access system: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「帷幕單元與外牆維護設備」如何影響哈里發塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cladding units and façade access” governs force, deformation or durability in “Burj Khalifa”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 哈里發塔外牆有超過 26,000 片反射玻璃單元，典型單元約寬 1.4 m、高 3.3 m、重約 360 kg，必須在沙漠高溫、強烈日照與高空風壓下保持氣密水密。外牆清潔與維護分段處理：下段與中段以三條水平軌道上的吊籃機（每台約 1,500 kg），中上段以傳統吊臂吊籃，最頂部以繩索作業；公開資料指出一般條件下 36 名工人需三到四個月才能清潔整個外牆。外牆維護設備本身是固定在結構上的機械，交接時必須當作結構介面管理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「帷幕單元與外牆維護設備」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Burj Khalifa's façade has more than 26,000 reflective glass units; a typical unit is about 1.4 m wide, 3.3 m high and about 360 kg, and must stay airtight and watertight under desert heat, intense sun and high-altitude wind pressure. Cleaning and maintenance are zoned: the lower and middle sections use bucket machines of about 1,500 kg each on three horizontal tracks, the upper middle uses conventional davit cradles and the very top is done by rope access; public sources say 36 workers need three to four months to clean the whole exterior in normal conditions. The access equipment is machinery fixed to the structure, so at handover it must be managed as a structural interface. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cladding units and façade access” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單元面積 1.4×3.3 = 4.62 m²，自重 360/4.62 ≈ 78 kg/m²；若設計負風壓 3.0 kPa，單元總吸力 3.0×4.62 ≈ 13.9 kN，四個固定點各約 3.5 kN；自重約 360×9.81 ≈ 3.5 kN 由兩個承重點各分擔約 1.8 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A unit of 1.4×3.3 = 4.62 m² weighing 360 kg is about 360/4.62 ≈ 78 kg/m²; under a design suction of 3.0 kPa the unit carries 3.0×4.62 ≈ 13.9 kN, about 3.5 kN at each of four anchors, while its self-weight of about 360×9.81 ≈ 3.5 kN is shared by two dead-load points at about 1.8 kN each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外牆維護設備只是清潔工具，不屬於結構工程的責任。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Façade access equipment is just cleaning gear and not a structural engineering responsibility." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「帷幕單元與外牆維護設備」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cladding units and façade access”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 26,000 片帷幕與外牆維護系統的交接
knowledge.titleEn: Handing over 26,000 cladding panels and the façade access system
knowledge.text: 哈里發塔外牆有超過 26,000 片反射玻璃單元，典型單元約寬 1.4 m、高 3.3 m、重約 360 kg，必須在沙漠高溫、強烈日照與高空風壓下保持氣密水密。外牆清潔與維護分段處理：下段與中段以三條水平軌道上的吊籃機（每台約 1,500 kg），中上段以傳統吊臂吊籃，最頂部以繩索作業；公開資料指出一般條件下 36 名工人需三到四個月才能清潔整個外牆。

Cleaning and maintenance are zoned: the lower and middle sections use bucket machines of about 1,500 kg each on three horizontal tracks, the upper middle uses conventional davit cradles and the very top is done by rope access; public sources say 36 workers need three to four months to clean the whole exterior in normal conditions.

knowledge.text: 誤解：外牆維護設備只是清潔工具，不屬於結構工程的責任。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「26,000 片帷幕與外牆維護系統的交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Handing over 26,000 cladding panels and the façade access system" is correct?
options: 外牆維護設備只是清潔工具，不屬於結構工程的責任。
哈里發塔外牆有超過 26,000 片反射玻璃單元，典型單元約寬 1.4 m、高 3.3 m、重約 360 kg，必須在沙漠高溫、強烈日照與高空風壓下保持氣密水密。

Burj Khalifa's façade has more than 26,000 reflective glass units.

quiz.explanation: 哈里發塔外牆有超過 26,000 片反射玻璃單元，典型單元約寬 1.4 m、高 3.3 m、重約 360 kg，必須在沙漠高溫、強烈日照與高空風壓下保持氣密水密。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Burj Khalifa's façade has more than 26,000 reflective glass units; a typical unit is about 1.4 m wide, 3.3 m high and about 360 kg, and must stay airtight and watertight under desert heat, intense sun and high-altitude wind pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 26,000 片帷幕與外牆維護系統的交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Handing over 26,000 cladding panels and the façade access system: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「帷幕單元與外牆維護設備」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cladding units and façade access” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單元面積 1.4×3.3 = 4.62 m²，自重 360/4.62 ≈ 78 kg/m²；若設計負風壓 3.0 kPa，單元總吸力 3.0×4.62 ≈ 13.9 kN，四個固定點各約 3.5 kN；自重約 360×9.81 ≈ 3.5 kN 由兩個承重點各分擔約 1.8 kN。風壓為教學假設，單元尺寸與重量取自公開資料。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A unit of 1.4×3.3 = 4.62 m² weighing 360 kg is about 360/4.62 ≈ 78 kg/m²; under a design suction of 3.0 kPa the unit carries 3.0×4.62 ≈ 13.9 kN, about 3.5 kN at each of four anchors, while its self-weight of about 360×9.81 ≈ 3.5 kN is shared by two dead-load points at about 1.8 kN each. The pressure is a teaching assumption; unit size and weight are from public sources. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前完成外牆抽樣的現場水密試驗與錨定點拉拔試驗，外牆維護設備的軌道、吊臂與錨固由第三方檢驗並取得操作許可；建立單元編號資料庫，記錄每次破損更換的位置與原因。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover complete sample field water tests on the façade and pull-out tests on anchors; have the access-equipment tracks, davits and anchorages inspected by a third party and certified for operation; build a unit-numbered database recording the location and cause of every replacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單元面積 1.4×3.3 = 4.62 m²，自重 360/4.62 ≈ 78 kg/m²；若設計負風壓 3.0 kPa，單元總吸力 3.0×4.62 ≈ 13.9 kN，四個固定點各約 3.5 kN；自重約 360×9.81 ≈ 3.5 kN 由兩個承重點各分擔約 1.8 kN。風壓為教學假設，單元尺寸與重量取自公開資料。
knowledge.textEn: A unit of 1.4×3.3 = 4.62 m² weighing 360 kg is about 360/4.62 ≈ 78 kg/m²; under a design suction of 3.0 kPa the unit carries 3.0×4.62 ≈ 13.9 kN, about 3.5 kN at each of four anchors, while its self-weight of about 360×9.81 ≈ 3.5 kN is shared by two dead-load points at about 1.8 kN each. The pressure is a teaching assumption; unit size and weight are from public sources.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「26,000 片帷幕與外牆維護系統的交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Handing over 26,000 cladding panels and the façade access system", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土強度夠高，徐變與縮短就可以忽略。
爬模只是一套模板，爬升時機由工班依進度自行決定即可。
optionsEn: With high enough concrete strength, creep and shortening can be ignored.

quiz.explanationEn: A unit of 1.4×3.3 = 4.62 m² weighing 360 kg is about 360/4.62 ≈ 78 kg/m²; under a design suction of 3.0 kPa the unit carries 3.0×4.62 ≈ 13.9 kN, about 3.5 kN at each of four anchors, while its self-weight of about 360×9.81 ≈ 3.5 kN is shared by two dead-load points at about 1.8 kN each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 26,000 片帷幕與外牆維護系統的交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Handing over 26,000 cladding panels and the façade access system: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「帷幕單元與外牆維護設備」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cladding units and façade access” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前完成外牆抽樣的現場水密試驗與錨定點拉拔試驗，外牆維護設備的軌道、吊臂與錨固由第三方檢驗並取得操作許可；建立單元編號資料庫，記錄每次破損更換的位置與原因。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover complete sample field water tests on the façade and pull-out tests on anchors; have the access-equipment tracks, davits and anchorages inspected by a third party and certified for operation; build a unit-numbered database recording the location and cause of every replacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件包含外牆單元圖、錨固與軌道荷重資料、設備檢驗證書、更換單元的吊運路線與備品清單；營運單位要定期檢驗軌道錨固，並在任何外牆改裝前諮詢結構與外牆顧問。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents include unit drawings, anchorage and track load data, equipment inspection certificates, lifting routes for replacement units and a spares list; the operator inspects track anchorages periodically and consults the structural and façade consultants before any façade alteration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若外牆維護設備軌道的錨栓疲勞或腐蝕未被發現，上千公斤的設備可能在高空失控；單元密封失效使雨水滲入，會腐蝕固定件並在高溫下加速劣化，最後形成玻璃脫落風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Undetected fatigue or corrosion of the track anchor bolts can let equipment weighing more than a tonne run out of control at height; failed unit seals let rainwater in, corroding fixings and accelerating deterioration in the heat until glass detachment becomes a risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 26,000 片帷幕與外牆維護系統的交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Handing over 26,000 cladding panels and the façade access system: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「帷幕單元與外牆維護設備」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cladding units and façade access” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若外牆維護設備軌道的錨栓疲勞或腐蝕未被發現，上千公斤的設備可能在高空失控；單元密封失效使雨水滲入，會腐蝕固定件並在高溫下加速劣化，最後形成玻璃脫落風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Undetected fatigue or corrosion of the track anchor bolts can let equipment weighing more than a tonne run out of control at height; failed unit seals let rainwater in, corroding fixings and accelerating deterioration in the heat until glass detachment becomes a risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：外牆維護設備本身是固定在結構上的機械，交接時必須當作結構介面管理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The access equipment is machinery fixed to the structure, so at handover it must be managed as a structural interface.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外牆維護設備只是清潔工具，不屬於結構工程的責任。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Façade access equipment is just cleaning gear and not a structural engineering responsibility." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

title: 上海中心大廈
summary: 從 120° 扭轉外形帶來的 24% 風載折減與上海軟土的長週期地震需求出發，計算 C70 巨柱的軸壓比與雙層外伸桁架的斜桿力，再處理圓形地下連續壁與 6 m 筏基的一次澆置、鋼平台爬模與超高泵送、後注漿長樁驗證、性能設計的層間變位檢核，最後是懸掛式外層帷幕與超高速電梯鋼索在營運期的維護。
summaryEn: Starting from the 24% wind-load reduction of the 120° twisting form and the long-period seismic demand of Shanghai's soft ground, compute the axial-load ratio of C70 mega-columns and diagonal forces in two-storey outriggers, then handle the circular diaphragm wall and single 6 m mat pour, steel-platform climbing forms and extreme pumping, proof of post-grouted long piles and performance-based drift checks, ending with in-service upkeep of the hung outer façade and ropes of ultra-fast elevators.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 外形與巨柱連動練習：某超高層矩形對照方案的基底彎矩 M₀ = 30 GN·m，扭轉外形使風載折減 24%，M = 22.8 GN·m。外伸臂把 60% 傾覆彎矩交給巨柱，受拉與受壓側巨柱群力臂 50 m、每側 3 支巨柱：未扭轉時 ΔN = 0.6×30,000/(50×3) = 120 MN，扭轉後 ΔN = 0.6×22,800/(50×3) ≈ 91.2 MN。巨柱斷面 18.0 m²、含鋼率 4.5%，軸壓比分母 31.8×17.19 + 295×0.81 ≈ 786 MN；重力軸力 400 MN 時，未扭轉 μ = 520/786 ≈ 0.66，超過 0.65 限值，扭轉後 μ = 491.2/786 ≈ 0.63，符合要求。也就是說，外形帶來的風載折減可能決定巨柱是否需要加大；若不改外形而改為增加鋼骨，分母須達 520/0.65 = 800 MN，約需多出 (800 − 786)/(295 − 31.8) ≈ 0.055 m² 鋼骨，含鋼率由 4.5% 升到約 4.8%。數值為教學假設，不代表上海中心的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Form and mega-column exercise: a rectangular comparison scheme has base moment M₀ = 30 GN·m, and a twisting form cuts wind load by 24% to M = 22.8 GN·m. Outriggers pass 60% of overturning to the mega-columns, with 50 m between tension and compression groups and 3 columns per side: without the twist ΔN = 0.6×30,000/(50×3) = 120 MN, with it ΔN = 0.6×22,800/(50×3) ≈ 91.2 MN. For an 18.0 m² mega-column with 4.5% steel, the axial-ratio denominator is 31.8×17.19 + 295×0.81 ≈ 786 MN; with 400 MN of gravity load the untwisted case gives μ = 520/786 ≈ 0.66, above the 0.65 limit, while the twisted case gives μ = 491.2/786 ≈ 0.63, which complies. The form-driven wind reduction can therefore decide whether the mega-columns must grow; keeping the form and adding steel instead requires a denominator of 520/0.65 = 800 MN, or about (800 − 786)/(295 − 31.8) ≈ 0.055 m² of extra steel, raising the steel ratio from 4.5% to about 4.8%. Values are teaching assumptions, not Shanghai Tower's design values.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「扭轉漸縮外形與 24% 風載折減」與「軟土場址與長週期地震需求」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Twisting tapered form and a 24% wind-load cut" and "Soft-ground site and long-period seismic demand": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 扭轉漸縮外形與 24% 風載折減：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Twisting tapered form and a 24% wind-load cut: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「120° 扭轉外形」如何影響上海中心大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “120-degree twist” governs force, deformation or durability in “Shanghai Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 上海中心大廈的外層帷幕以圓角三角形平面隨高度旋轉約 120°，並逐漸縮小，外緣還有一道垂直凹槽。旋轉與漸縮讓不同高度的迎風寬度與分離點不斷改變，渦流無法沿高度同步脫落；設計者公開說明，經風洞試驗優化外形後，結構風載比同高度的矩形建築約少 24%，結構材料因此減輕。風載減少會沿著外伸臂、巨柱與基礎一路傳遞成材料節省。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「120° 扭轉外形」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shanghai Tower's outer façade is a rounded triangle in plan that rotates about 120° up the height while tapering, with a vertical notch along one edge. Rotation and taper keep changing the windward width and separation points with height, so vortices cannot shed coherently along the tower; the designers report that wind-tunnel refinement of the form cut structural wind loads by about 24% compared with a rectangular building of the same height, lightening the structure. The reduction carries through the outriggers, mega-columns and foundations as material savings. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “120-degree twist” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：若矩形對照方案基底彎矩 M₀ = 30 GN·m，24% 折減後 M = 30×0.76 = 22.8 GN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: If a rectangular comparison scheme has a base moment M₀ = 30 GN·m, a 24% reduction gives M = 30×0.76 = 22.8 GN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「扭轉外形純粹是造型，結構只是被動配合。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The twisting form is purely aesthetic and the structure merely follows." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「120° 扭轉外形」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “120-degree twist”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Shanghai Tower's outer façade is a rounded triangle in plan that rotates about 120° up the height while tapering, with a vertical notch along one edge. Rotation and taper keep changing the windward width and separation points with height, so vortices cannot shed coherently along the tower; the designers report that wind-tunnel refinement of the form cut structural wind loads by about 24% compared with a rectangular building of the same height, lightening the structure.

knowledge.text: 誤解：扭轉外形純粹是造型，結構只是被動配合。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
