knowledge.text: 平台總重 2,000 t 加施工荷重 300 t，W = 2,300×9.81 ≈ 22.6 MN，由 12 個支承點分擔約 1.88 MN；若支承處混凝土爬升時強度 15 MPa、容許承壓取 0.6 倍，所需承壓面積 A = 1.88/(0.6×15) ≈ 0.21 m²。強度不足時只能延後爬升或加大承壓板。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A platform of 2,000 t plus 300 t of construction load gives W = 2,300×9.81 ≈ 22.6 MN, about 1.88 MN at each of 12 supports; if the wall concrete at the supports is 15 MPa when climbing and allowable bearing is 0.6 times that, the required bearing area is A = 1.88/(0.6×15) ≈ 0.21 m². With less strength, climbing must wait or bearing plates must grow. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼平台爬模與超高泵送」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steel-platform climbing formwork and extreme pumping", which statement holds?
options: 帷幕牆掛在結構上，只需要考慮自重，不需要處理變形。
平台總重 2,000 t 加施工荷重 300 t，W = 2,300×9.81 ≈ 22.6 MN，由 12 個支承點分擔約 1.88 MN。
扭轉外形純粹是造型，結構只是被動配合。
optionsEn: A hung curtain wall only needs to carry its own weight and need not deal with movement.
A platform of 2,000 t plus 300 t of construction load gives W = 2,300×9.81 ≈ 22.6 MN, about 1.88 MN at each of 12 supports.
The twisting form is purely aesthetic and the structure merely follows.
quiz.explanation: 平台總重 2,000 t 加施工荷重 300 t，W = 2,300×9.81 ≈ 22.6 MN，由 12 個支承點分擔約 1.88 MN；若支承處混凝土爬升時強度 15 MPa、容許承壓取 0.6 倍，所需承壓面積 A = 1.88/(0.6×15) ≈ 0.21 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A platform of 2,000 t plus 300 t of construction load gives W = 2,300×9.81 ≈ 22.6 MN, about 1.88 MN at each of 12 supports; if the wall concrete at the supports is 15 MPa when climbing and allowable bearing is 0.6 times that, the required bearing area is A = 1.88/(0.6×15) ≈ 0.21 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼平台爬模與超高泵送：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel-platform climbing formwork and extreme pumping: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「整體鋼平台爬模」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Integral steel-platform climbing formwork” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次爬升前以同條件養護試體或成熟度計確認支承處混凝土強度，檢查支承構件、液壓系統與防墜裝置；平台在強風時須鎖定，並以施工階段分析檢查平台荷重與風力下核心牆的應力。泵送則記錄每段高度的壓力與出口性質，並抽驗強度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before each climb confirm concrete strength at the supports with field-cured specimens or maturity meters, and check support members, hydraulics and fall arresters; lock the platform in high wind and check core-wall stresses under platform load and wind with a construction-stage analysis. For pumping, log pressure and discharge properties at each height band and sample strength. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：平台設計須由專業工程師簽證，施工計畫列出爬升的強度門檻、風速停工條件與緊急鎖定程序；每次爬升設停止點，由現場結構工程師簽核後才可啟動液壓系統。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The platform design must be certified by a professional engineer, and the construction plan lists climbing strength thresholds, wind stop limits and emergency locking procedures; set a hold point for every climb so the hydraulics start only after the site structural engineer signs off.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在支承處混凝土強度不足時爬升，局部承壓破壞可能使平台傾斜甚至墜落；泵送高強度混凝土時配比黏度或溫度控制不當，會造成堵管，使樓層澆置中斷並形成冷縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Climbing with insufficient concrete strength at the supports can cause local bearing failure, tilting or even dropping the platform; poor control of viscosity or temperature when pumping high-strength concrete leads to blockages that interrupt a floor pour and leave cold joints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每次爬升前以同條件養護試體或成熟度計確認支承處混凝土強度，檢查支承構件、液壓系統與防墜裝置；平台在強風時須鎖定，並以施工階段分析檢查平台荷重與風力下核心牆的應力。泵送則記錄每段高度的壓力與出口性質，並抽驗強度。
knowledge.textEn: Before each climb confirm concrete strength at the supports with field-cured specimens or maturity meters, and check support members, hydraulics and fall arresters; lock the platform in high wind and check core-wall stresses under platform load and wind with a construction-stage analysis. For pumping, log pressure and discharge properties at each height band and sample strength.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 平台設計須由專業工程師簽證，施工計畫列出爬升的強度門檻、風速停工條件與緊急鎖定程序；每次爬升設停止點，由現場結構工程師簽核後才可啟動液壓系統。
knowledge.textEn: The platform design must be certified by a professional engineer, and the construction plan lists climbing strength thresholds, wind stop limits and emergency locking procedures; set a hold point for every climb so the hydraulics start only after the site structural engineer signs off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼平台爬模與超高泵送」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Steel-platform climbing formwork and extreme pumping"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要巨柱強度足夠，軸壓比高一點也沒關係。
每次爬升前以同條件養護試體或成熟度計確認支承處混凝土強度，檢查支承構件、液壓系統與防墜裝置。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
As long as a mega-column is strong enough, a somewhat high axial-load ratio does not matter.
Before each climb confirm concrete strength at the supports with field-cured specimens or maturity meters, and check support members, hydraulics and fall arresters.
quiz.explanation: 每次爬升前以同條件養護試體或成熟度計確認支承處混凝土強度，檢查支承構件、液壓系統與防墜裝置；平台在強風時須鎖定，並以施工階段分析檢查平台荷重與風力下核心牆的應力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before each climb confirm concrete strength at the supports with field-cured specimens or maturity meters, and check support members, hydraulics and fall arresters; lock the platform in high wind and check core-wall stresses under platform load and wind with a construction-stage analysis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鋼平台爬模與超高泵送：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steel-platform climbing formwork and extreme pumping: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「整體鋼平台爬模」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Integral steel-platform climbing formwork” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在支承處混凝土強度不足時爬升，局部承壓破壞可能使平台傾斜甚至墜落；泵送高強度混凝土時配比黏度或溫度控制不當，會造成堵管，使樓層澆置中斷並形成冷縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Climbing with insufficient concrete strength at the supports can cause local bearing failure, tilting or even dropping the platform; poor control of viscosity or temperature when pumping high-strength concrete leads to blockages that interrupt a floor pour and leave cold joints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平台荷重要靠早齡期的核心牆承擔，爬升時機與支承點強度成為施工控制重點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The platform's load rests on young core walls, so climbing time and support-point strength become key construction controls.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼平台是剛硬的鋼構，所以和下方混凝土的強度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steel platform is rigid steelwork, so it does not depend on the strength of the concrete below." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在支承處混凝土強度不足時爬升，局部承壓破壞可能使平台傾斜甚至墜落；泵送高強度混凝土時配比黏度或溫度控制不當，會造成堵管，使樓層澆置中斷並形成冷縫。
knowledge.textEn: Climbing with insufficient concrete strength at the supports can cause local bearing failure, tilting or even dropping the platform; poor control of viscosity or temperature when pumping high-strength concrete leads to blockages that interrupt a floor pour and leave cold joints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼平台爬模與超高泵送」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel-platform climbing formwork and extreme pumping" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若在支承處混凝土強度不足時爬升，局部承壓破壞可能使平台傾斜甚至墜落；泵送高強度混凝土時配比黏度或溫度控制不當，會造成堵管，使樓層澆置中斷並形成冷縫。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
樁端注漿只是補救施工缺陷，正常的樁不需要。
optionsEn: Climbing with insufficient concrete strength at the supports can cause local bearing failure, tilting or even dropping the platform.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Base grouting is only a fix for construction defects and sound piles do not need it.
quiz.explanation: 若在支承處混凝土強度不足時爬升，局部承壓破壞可能使平台傾斜甚至墜落；泵送高強度混凝土時配比黏度或溫度控制不當，會造成堵管，使樓層澆置中斷並形成冷縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Climbing with insufficient concrete strength at the supports can cause local bearing failure, tilting or even dropping the platform; poor control of viscosity or temperature when pumping high-strength concrete leads to blockages that interrupt a floor pour and leave cold joints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證」與「性能化耐震設計的變位與連梁檢核」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting" and "Drift and link-beam checks in performance-based seismic design": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「後注漿長鑽掘樁」如何影響上海中心大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-grouted long bored piles” governs force, deformation or durability in “Shanghai Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 上海軟土缺乏淺層堅硬持力層，塔樓以大量長鑽掘樁支承，設計者文章記載為 947 支直徑 1 m、長 52 至 56 m 的鑽掘樁（各資料的支數略有出入），承攬單位指出採用超長鑽掘樁並在樁端後注漿，單樁設計承載可達約 1,000 公噸。樁端後注漿是在混凝土硬化後，經預埋管把水泥漿壓入樁底，填實沉渣並預壓樁底土層，提高端承與底部側摩擦，同時減少沉陷的離散。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「後注漿長鑽掘樁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shanghai's soft ground has no shallow hard bearing stratum, so the tower stands on many long bored piles; the designers' article records 947 piles of 1 m diameter and 52 to 56 m length (counts vary slightly between sources), and the contractor reports super-long bored piles with base post-grouting and design capacities up to about 1,000 t each. Base post-grouting injects cement grout through pre-installed pipes after the concrete hardens, filling base debris and pre-loading the soil beneath the toe, which raises end bearing and lower-shaft friction and narrows the scatter of settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-grouted long bored piles” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樁端注漿只是補救施工缺陷，正常的樁不需要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Base grouting is only a fix for construction defects and sound piles do not need it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「後注漿長鑽掘樁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-grouted long bored piles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：樁端注漿只是補救施工缺陷，正常的樁不需要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「後注漿長鑽掘樁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-grouted long bored piles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b。D = 1.0 m、L = 54 m、f_s = 85 kPa：側摩擦 ≈ 14.4 MN；A_b = 0.785 m²，未注漿 q_b = 3 MPa 時端承 2.4 MN、合計 16.8 MN；注漿後 q_b = 6 MPa 時端承 4.7 MN、合計 19.1 MN，安全係數 2 時設計約 9.6 MN（約 975 t）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b. With D = 1.0 m, L = 54 m and f_s = 85 kPa, shaft friction ≈ 14.4 MN; with A_b = 0.785 m², an ungrouted q_b = 3 MPa adds 2.4 MN for 16.8 MN total, while grouting to q_b = 6 MPa adds 4.7 MN for 19.1 MN, about 9.6 MN (about 975 t) design load at a factor of safety of 2. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每支樁記錄注漿壓力、注漿量與樁頂上抬量，三者須同時達標才算完成；以靜載試驗比較注漿與未注漿試驗樁的荷重—沉陷曲線，並以低應變或聲波透測檢查樁身完整性，結果回饋給群樁沉陷分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record grout pressure, grout volume and pile-head uplift for every pile, accepting only when all three meet the criteria; compare load–settlement curves of grouted and ungrouted trial piles in static load tests, check pile integrity by low-strain or sonic logging, and feed the results back into group-settlement analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b。D = 1.0 m、L = 54 m、f_s = 85 kPa：側摩擦 ≈ 14.4 MN；A_b = 0.785 m²，未注漿 q_b = 3 MPa 時端承 2.4 MN、合計 16.8 MN；注漿後 q_b = 6 MPa 時端承 4.7 MN、合計 19.1 MN，安全係數 2 時設計約 9.6 MN（約 975 t）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b. With D = 1.0 m, L = 54 m and f_s = 85 kPa, shaft friction ≈ 14.4 MN; with A_b = 0.785 m², an ungrouted q_b = 3 MPa adds 2.4 MN for 16.8 MN total, while grouting to q_b = 6 MPa adds 4.7 MN for 19.1 MN, about 9.6 MN (about 975 t) design load at a factor of safety of 2. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting", which statement holds?
options: 電梯鋼索擺動是機電問題，和結構設計無關。
建築週期越長，地震力就越小，所以超高層不必擔心地震。
Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b。
optionsEn: Elevator rope sway is a mechanical issue unrelated to structural design.
The longer the building period the smaller the earthquake force, so supertall towers need not worry about earthquakes.
Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b.
quiz.explanation: Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = π·D·L·f_s + A_b·q_b. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「後注漿長鑽掘樁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-grouted long bored piles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每支樁記錄注漿壓力、注漿量與樁頂上抬量，三者須同時達標才算完成；以靜載試驗比較注漿與未注漿試驗樁的荷重—沉陷曲線，並以低應變或聲波透測檢查樁身完整性，結果回饋給群樁沉陷分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record grout pressure, grout volume and pile-head uplift for every pile, accepting only when all three meet the criteria; compare load–settlement curves of grouted and ungrouted trial piles in static load tests, check pile integrity by low-strain or sonic logging, and feed the results back into group-settlement analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：注漿規範要訂出最小注漿量、終止壓力與上抬量上限，任何一項異常即停止並由大地顧問判斷；注漿紀錄以樁號編入資料庫，與沉陷監測一起移交業主。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The grouting specification sets minimum grout volume, termination pressure and maximum uplift, stopping for the geotechnical consultant's judgement whenever one is abnormal; index grouting records by pile number in a database and hand them to the owner with the settlement monitoring.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：注漿管堵塞或注漿量不足的樁，端承仍受沉渣影響，在群樁中成為偏軟的樁，造成筏基不均勻沉陷；注漿壓力過大則可能使漿液沿樁側上竄或擾動鄰近已完成的樁。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Piles with blocked grout pipes or too little grout still sit on base debris and become soft piles in the group, causing uneven mat settlement; excessive grout pressure can drive grout up the shaft or disturb neighbouring finished piles. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每支樁記錄注漿壓力、注漿量與樁頂上抬量，三者須同時達標才算完成；以靜載試驗比較注漿與未注漿試驗樁的荷重—沉陷曲線，並以低應變或聲波透測檢查樁身完整性，結果回饋給群樁沉陷分析。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 注漿規範要訂出最小注漿量、終止壓力與上抬量上限，任何一項異常即停止並由大地顧問判斷；注漿紀錄以樁號編入資料庫，與沉陷監測一起移交業主。
knowledge.textEn: The grouting specification sets minimum grout volume, termination pressure and maximum uplift, stopping for the geotechnical consultant's judgement whenever one is abnormal; index grouting records by pile number in a database and hand them to the owner with the settlement monitoring.

quiz.question: 要驗證「軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting"?
options: 每支樁記錄注漿壓力、注漿量與樁頂上抬量，三者須同時達標才算完成。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
外伸桁架只要在鋼構範圍內設計，核心牆不用另外處理。
optionsEn: Record grout pressure, grout volume and pile-head uplift for every pile, accepting only when all three meet the criteria.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Outrigger trusses can be designed within the steelwork alone without special treatment of the core walls.
quiz.explanation: 每支樁記錄注漿壓力、注漿量與樁頂上抬量，三者須同時達標才算完成；以靜載試驗比較注漿與未注漿試驗樁的荷重—沉陷曲線，並以低應變或聲波透測檢查樁身完整性，結果回饋給群樁沉陷分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record grout pressure, grout volume and pile-head uplift for every pile, accepting only when all three meet the criteria; compare load–settlement curves of grouted and ungrouted trial piles in static load tests, check pile integrity by low-strain or sonic logging, and feed the results back into group-settlement analysis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 軟土中的長樁與樁端後注漿驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long piles in soft ground and verification of base post-grouting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「後注漿長鑽掘樁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-grouted long bored piles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 注漿管堵塞或注漿量不足的樁，端承仍受沉渣影響，在群樁中成為偏軟的樁，造成筏基不均勻沉陷；注漿壓力過大則可能使漿液沿樁側上竄或擾動鄰近已完成的樁。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Piles with blocked grout pipes or too little grout still sit on base debris and become soft piles in the group, causing uneven mat settlement; excessive grout pressure can drive grout up the shaft or disturb neighbouring finished piles. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：樁端後注漿是在混凝土硬化後，經預埋管把水泥漿壓入樁底，填實沉渣並預壓樁底土層，提高端承與底部側摩擦，同時減少沉陷的離散。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Base post-grouting injects cement grout through pre-installed pipes after the concrete hardens, filling base debris and pre-loading the soil beneath the toe, which raises end bearing and lower-shaft friction and narrows the scatter of settlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樁端注漿只是補救施工缺陷，正常的樁不需要。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Base grouting is only a fix for construction defects and sound piles do not need it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 性能化耐震設計的變位與連梁檢核：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Drift and link-beam checks in performance-based seismic design: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「七組時間歷程與層間變位」如何影響上海中心大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seven time histories and storey drift” governs force, deformation or durability in “Shanghai Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 上海中心的性能化耐震設計以七組地震時間歷程分析，設計者公開的結果是大震下平均最大層間變位角小於 1/130，低於 1/100 的限值；多數核心連梁降伏但仍在「生命安全」性能範圍內，外伸與帶狀桁架大多保持彈性。連梁是刻意設計的耗能元件，讓核心牆的牆肢在大震後仍可修復；外伸桁架則必須保持彈性，因為它一旦降伏，整個巨型框架的勁度分配就會改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「七組時間歷程與層間變位」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shanghai Tower's performance-based seismic design used seven sets of time-history analyses; the designers report an average maximum storey drift angle below 1/130 in the major earthquake, within the 1/100 limit, with most core link beams yielding while staying within the life-safety level and most outrigger and belt trusses remaining elastic. Link beams are intended energy-dissipating elements that keep core wall piers repairable after a major earthquake, whereas the outriggers must stay elastic because once they yield, stiffness distribution across the mega-frame changes. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Seven time histories and storey drift” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：層間變位 Δ = θ·h。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大震後結構完全不能有任何降伏才算設計成功。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 性能化耐震設計的變位與連梁檢核：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drift and link-beam checks in performance-based seismic design: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「七組時間歷程與層間變位」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seven time histories and storey drift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：層間變位 Δ = θ·h。樓高 4.5 m 時，θ = 1/130 對應 Δ ≈ 34.6 mm，限值 1/100 對應 45 mm。連梁轉角近似 γ = θ·L/l：牆肢形心距 L = 6 m、連梁淨跨 l = 2 m 時 γ ≈ (1/130)×6/2 ≈ 0.023 rad，須小於該連梁配筋形式在生命安全等級的轉角限值。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Storey drift Δ = θ·h. For a 4.5 m storey, θ = 1/130 gives Δ ≈ 34.6 mm against 45 mm at the 1/100 limit. Link-beam rotation is roughly γ = θ·L/l: with wall-pier centroids L = 6 m apart and a clear span l = 2 m, γ ≈ (1/130)×6/2 ≈ 0.023 rad, which must stay below the life-safety rotation limit for that reinforcement layout. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依規範取七組以上紀錄時以平均值判定，逐層輸出層間變位角、連梁轉角與外伸桁架應力比，並做敏感度分析（例如混凝土勁度折減、阻尼比變化）；設計結論須經超限高層建築專項審查與同儕審查確認。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: With seven or more records, judge on the mean as the code allows; output storey drift angles, link-beam rotations and outrigger stress ratios floor by floor, run sensitivity studies such as cracked-stiffness reductions and damping changes, and have the conclusions confirmed by the special review for code-exceeding tall buildings and by peer review.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 層間變位 Δ = θ·h。樓高 4.5 m 時，θ = 1/130 對應 Δ ≈ 34.6 mm，限值 1/100 對應 45 mm。連梁轉角近似 γ = θ·L/l：牆肢形心距 L = 6 m、連梁淨跨 l = 2 m 時 γ ≈ (1/130)×6/2 ≈ 0.023 rad，須小於該連梁配筋形式在生命安全等級的轉角限值。數值為教學假設。

Link-beam rotation is roughly γ = θ·L/l: with wall-pier centroids L = 6 m apart and a clear span l = 2 m, γ ≈ (1/130)×6/2 ≈ 0.023 rad, which must stay below the life-safety rotation limit for that reinforcement layout. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 性能化耐震設計的變位與連梁檢核：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drift and link-beam checks in performance-based seismic design: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「七組時間歷程與層間變位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seven time histories and storey drift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依規範取七組以上紀錄時以平均值判定，逐層輸出層間變位角、連梁轉角與外伸桁架應力比，並做敏感度分析（例如混凝土勁度折減、阻尼比變化）；設計結論須經超限高層建築專項審查與同儕審查確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: With seven or more records, judge on the mean as the code allows; output storey drift angles, link-beam rotations and outrigger stress ratios floor by floor, run sensitivity studies such as cracked-stiffness reductions and damping changes, and have the conclusions confirmed by the special review for code-exceeding tall buildings and by peer review. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在結構圖上標示「預期降伏構件」與「須保持彈性構件」，前者訂出可更換或修復的細部，後者訂出超強係數；大震後的檢查清單依此分類，優先檢查連梁與外伸桁架接合。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark on the structural drawings which members are expected to yield and which must stay elastic, giving the former repairable or replaceable details and the latter overstrength factors; organise the post-earthquake checklist the same way, inspecting link beams and outrigger connections first.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若連梁被設計得過強而不先降伏，地震能量會轉移到牆肢底部或外伸桁架，造成難以修復的損傷；若外伸桁架在大震中降伏，巨柱與核心的分擔改變，變位會突然增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If link beams are made too strong to yield first, seismic energy shifts to the base of wall piers or to the outriggers, causing damage that is hard to repair; if outriggers yield in a major earthquake, the core–column share changes and drift suddenly increases. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：連梁是刻意設計的耗能元件，讓核心牆的牆肢在大震後仍可修復；外伸桁架則必須保持彈性，因為它一旦降伏，整個巨型框架的勁度分配就會改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Link beams are intended energy-dissipating elements that keep core wall piers repairable after a major earthquake, whereas the outriggers must stay elastic because once they yield, stiffness distribution across the mega-frame changes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大震後結構完全不能有任何降伏才算設計成功。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A design succeeds only if nothing yields at all in a major earthquake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若連梁被設計得過強而不先降伏，地震能量會轉移到牆肢底部或外伸桁架，造成難以修復的損傷；若外伸桁架在大震中降伏，巨柱與核心的分擔改變，變位會突然增加。
knowledge.textEn: If link beams are made too strong to yield first, seismic energy shifts to the base of wall piers or to the outriggers, causing damage that is hard to repair; if outriggers yield in a major earthquake, the core–column share changes and drift suddenly increases.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「性能化耐震設計的變位與連梁檢核」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drift and link-beam checks in performance-based seismic design" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
帷幕牆掛在結構上，只需要考慮自重，不需要處理變形。
若連梁被設計得過強而不先降伏，地震能量會轉移到牆肢底部或外伸桁架，造成難以修復的損傷；若外伸桁架在大震中降伏，巨柱與核心的分擔改變，變位會突然增加。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A hung curtain wall only needs to carry its own weight and need not deal with movement.
If link beams are made too strong to yield first, seismic energy shifts to the base of wall piers or to the outriggers, causing damage that is hard to repair.
quiz.explanation: 若連梁被設計得過強而不先降伏，地震能量會轉移到牆肢底部或外伸桁架，造成難以修復的損傷；若外伸桁架在大震中降伏，巨柱與核心的分擔改變，變位會突然增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If link beams are made too strong to yield first, seismic energy shifts to the base of wall piers or to the outriggers, causing damage that is hard to repair; if outriggers yield in a major earthquake, the core–column share changes and drift suddenly increases. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護」與「電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade" and "Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「柔性懸掛帷幕支撐」如何影響上海中心大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flexible hung façade supports” governs force, deformation or durability in “Shanghai Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 上海中心的外層帷幕與內層樓板之間有中庭空間，外層玻璃不能直接固定在樓板邊緣，而是以柔性懸掛系統掛在每區的機電層帶狀桁架下，允許相對主結構在垂直方向自由變形；承攬單位指出曲面帷幕有超過 20,000 片尺寸各異的玻璃，以柔性懸掛結構與向下施工的智慧平台安裝。懸掛系統要同時吸收溫度伸縮、樓層下垂、風壓與層間變位，接縫與滑動件是長期維護的重點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「柔性懸掛帷幕支撐」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shanghai Tower's outer façade is separated from the floor plates by atrium space, so the outer glass cannot be fixed at slab edges; instead it hangs from the belt trusses at each zone's mechanical level on a flexible suspension system that lets it move vertically relative to the main structure. The contractor reports more than 20,000 glass pieces of different sizes on the curved wall, installed with the flexible suspension and a top-down intelligent platform. The suspension must absorb thermal movement, floor sag, wind pressure and storey drift together, so joints and sliding parts are the focus of long-term upkeep. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Flexible hung façade supports” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸掛段的溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement of a hung segment ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「帷幕牆掛在結構上，只需要考慮自重，不需要處理變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A hung curtain wall only needs to carry its own weight and need not deal with movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「柔性懸掛帷幕支撐」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Flexible hung façade supports”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護
knowledge.titleEn: Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade
knowledge.text: 上海中心的外層帷幕與內層樓板之間有中庭空間，外層玻璃不能直接固定在樓板邊緣，而是以柔性懸掛系統掛在每區的機電層帶狀桁架下，允許相對主結構在垂直方向自由變形；承攬單位指出曲面帷幕有超過 20,000 片尺寸各異的玻璃，以柔性懸掛結構與向下施工的智慧平台安裝。懸掛系統要同時吸收溫度伸縮、樓層下垂、風壓與層間變位，接縫與滑動件是長期維護的重點。
knowledge.textEn: Shanghai Tower's outer façade is separated from the floor plates by atrium space, so the outer glass cannot be fixed at slab edges; instead it hangs from the belt trusses at each zone's mechanical level on a flexible suspension system that lets it move vertically relative to the main structure. The contractor reports more than 20,000 glass pieces of different sizes on the curved wall, installed with the flexible suspension and a top-down intelligent platform.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：帷幕牆掛在結構上，只需要考慮自重，不需要處理變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A hung curtain wall only needs to carry its own weight and need not deal with movement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade" is correct?
options: 上海中心的外層帷幕與內層樓板之間有中庭空間，外層玻璃不能直接固定在樓板邊緣，而是以柔性懸掛系統掛在每區的機電層帶狀桁架下，允許相對主結構在垂直方向自由變形。
帷幕牆掛在結構上，只需要考慮自重，不需要處理變形。
電梯鋼索擺動是機電問題，和結構設計無關。
optionsEn: Shanghai Tower's outer façade is separated from the floor plates by atrium space, so the outer glass cannot be fixed at slab edges.
A hung curtain wall only needs to carry its own weight and need not deal with movement.
Elevator rope sway is a mechanical issue unrelated to structural design.
quiz.explanation: 上海中心的外層帷幕與內層樓板之間有中庭空間，外層玻璃不能直接固定在樓板邊緣，而是以柔性懸掛系統掛在每區的機電層帶狀桁架下，允許相對主結構在垂直方向自由變形；承攬單位指出曲面帷幕有超過 20,000 片尺寸各異的玻璃，以柔性懸掛結構與向下施工的智慧平台安裝。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柔性懸掛帷幕支撐」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flexible hung façade supports” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸掛段的溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。一區 14 層、每層 4.5 m，懸掛長度 L ≈ 63 m；α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、ΔT = 40 °C 時 ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×63,000×40 ≈ 30 mm。底部滑動接頭須容許約 ±30 mm 以上，並另加樓層下垂與施工誤差。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement of a hung segment ΔL = α·L·ΔT. A 14-floor zone at 4.5 m per floor hangs about L ≈ 63 m; with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×63,000×40 ≈ 30 mm. The bottom sliding joint must allow about ±30 mm or more, plus floor sag and construction tolerances. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實尺寸試體做垂直往復位移與層間變位試驗，確認滑動接頭不卡死、玻璃不受擠壓；完工後在代表性懸吊桿與滑動件旁設置位移計，比對季節溫差下的實際伸縮，並定期檢查吊桿腐蝕、螺栓鬆脫與密封膠劣化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test full-scale specimens under cyclic vertical movement and storey drift to confirm sliding joints do not bind and glass is not squeezed; after completion fit displacement gauges at representative hangers and sliding parts to compare actual seasonal movement, and inspect periodically for hanger corrosion, bolt loosening and sealant ageing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸掛段的溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。一區 14 層、每層 4.5 m，懸掛長度 L ≈ 63 m；α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C、ΔT = 40 °C 時 ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×63,000×40 ≈ 30 mm。底部滑動接頭須容許約 ±30 mm 以上，並另加樓層下垂與施工誤差。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal movement of a hung segment ΔL = α·L·ΔT. A 14-floor zone at 4.5 m per floor hangs about L ≈ 63 m; with α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and ΔT = 40 °C, ΔL = 12×10⁻⁶×63,000×40 ≈ 30 mm. The bottom sliding joint must allow about ±30 mm or more, plus floor sag and construction tolerances. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade", which statement holds?
options: 建築週期越長，地震力就越小，所以超高層不必擔心地震。
懸掛段的溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
外伸桁架只要在鋼構範圍內設計，核心牆不用另外處理。
optionsEn: The longer the building period the smaller the earthquake force, so supertall towers need not worry about earthquakes.
Thermal movement of a hung segment ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
Outrigger trusses can be designed within the steelwork alone without special treatment of the core walls.
quiz.explanation: 懸掛段的溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal movement of a hung segment ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「柔性懸掛帷幕支撐」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flexible hung façade supports” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實尺寸試體做垂直往復位移與層間變位試驗，確認滑動接頭不卡死、玻璃不受擠壓；完工後在代表性懸吊桿與滑動件旁設置位移計，比對季節溫差下的實際伸縮，並定期檢查吊桿腐蝕、螺栓鬆脫與密封膠劣化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test full-scale specimens under cyclic vertical movement and storey drift to confirm sliding joints do not bind and glass is not squeezed; after completion fit displacement gauges at representative hangers and sliding parts to compare actual seasonal movement, and inspect periodically for hanger corrosion, bolt loosening and sealant ageing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件要附懸掛系統的滑動方向圖、容許位移、吊桿與螺栓的檢查週期，以及禁止在滑動件上加裝任何附掛物的規定；破損玻璃更換須依原設計間隙重新調整並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should include sliding-direction diagrams, allowable movements, inspection intervals for hangers and bolts, and a rule forbidding any attachment to sliding parts; replacement panes must be re-gapped to the original design clearances and recorded.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：滑動接頭若被灰塵、腐蝕或施工時誤加的固定件卡死，溫度伸縮會轉成玻璃與框架的附加應力，導致玻璃破裂；懸吊桿螺栓鬆脫則可能使整片帷幕下沉，碰撞下方構件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If sliding joints are jammed by dirt, corrosion or fixings mistakenly added during construction, thermal movement becomes extra stress in glass and frames and cracks the glass; loosened hanger bolts can let a whole façade panel drop and strike members below. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以實尺寸試體做垂直往復位移與層間變位試驗，確認滑動接頭不卡死、玻璃不受擠壓；完工後在代表性懸吊桿與滑動件旁設置位移計，比對季節溫差下的實際伸縮，並定期檢查吊桿腐蝕、螺栓鬆脫與密封膠劣化。
knowledge.textEn: Test full-scale specimens under cyclic vertical movement and storey drift to confirm sliding joints do not bind and glass is not squeezed; after completion fit displacement gauges at representative hangers and sliding parts to compare actual seasonal movement, and inspect periodically for hanger corrosion, bolt loosening and sealant ageing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件要附懸掛系統的滑動方向圖、容許位移、吊桿與螺栓的檢查週期，以及禁止在滑動件上加裝任何附掛物的規定；破損玻璃更換須依原設計間隙重新調整並記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents should include sliding-direction diagrams, allowable movements, inspection intervals for hangers and bolts, and a rule forbidding any attachment to sliding parts; replacement panes must be re-gapped to the original design clearances and recorded.

quiz.question: 要驗證「懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
鋼平台是剛硬的鋼構，所以和下方混凝土的強度無關。
以實尺寸試體做垂直往復位移與層間變位試驗，確認滑動接頭不卡死、玻璃不受擠壓。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A steel platform is rigid steelwork, so it does not depend on the strength of the concrete below.
Test full-scale specimens under cyclic vertical movement and storey drift to confirm sliding joints do not bind and glass is not squeezed.
quiz.explanation: 以實尺寸試體做垂直往復位移與層間變位試驗，確認滑動接頭不卡死、玻璃不受擠壓；完工後在代表性懸吊桿與滑動件旁設置位移計，比對季節溫差下的實際伸縮，並定期檢查吊桿腐蝕、螺栓鬆脫與密封膠劣化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test full-scale specimens under cyclic vertical movement and storey drift to confirm sliding joints do not bind and glass is not squeezed; after completion fit displacement gauges at representative hangers and sliding parts to compare actual seasonal movement, and inspect periodically for hanger corrosion, bolt loosening and sealant ageing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「柔性懸掛帷幕支撐」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Flexible hung façade supports” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 滑動接頭若被灰塵、腐蝕或施工時誤加的固定件卡死，溫度伸縮會轉成玻璃與框架的附加應力，導致玻璃破裂；懸吊桿螺栓鬆脫則可能使整片帷幕下沉，碰撞下方構件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If sliding joints are jammed by dirt, corrosion or fixings mistakenly added during construction, thermal movement becomes extra stress in glass and frames and cracks the glass; loosened hanger bolts can let a whole façade panel drop and strike members below. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：懸掛系統要同時吸收溫度伸縮、樓層下垂、風壓與層間變位，接縫與滑動件是長期維護的重點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The suspension must absorb thermal movement, floor sag, wind pressure and storey drift together, so joints and sliding parts are the focus of long-term upkeep.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「帷幕牆掛在結構上，只需要考慮自重，不需要處理變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A hung curtain wall only needs to carry its own weight and need not deal with movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 滑動接頭若被灰塵、腐蝕或施工時誤加的固定件卡死，溫度伸縮會轉成玻璃與框架的附加應力，導致玻璃破裂；懸吊桿螺栓鬆脫則可能使整片帷幕下沉，碰撞下方構件。
knowledge.textEn: If sliding joints are jammed by dirt, corrosion or fixings mistakenly added during construction, thermal movement becomes extra stress in glass and frames and cracks the glass; loosened hanger bolts can let a whole façade panel drop and strike members below.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「懸掛式外層帷幕的變位吸收與維護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Movement absorption and upkeep of the hung outer façade" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 滑動接頭若被灰塵、腐蝕或施工時誤加的固定件卡死，溫度伸縮會轉成玻璃與框架的附加應力，導致玻璃破裂；懸吊桿螺栓鬆脫則可能使整片帷幕下沉，碰撞下方構件。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「超高速電梯曳引鋼索」如何影響上海中心大廈的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ultra-fast elevator hoist ropes” governs force, deformation or durability in “Shanghai Tower”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 上海中心有 106 部電梯，最高速度 20.5 m/s，超長行程的曳引鋼索與補償鋼索像一條很長的弦，自然頻率隨車廂位置改變。當建築在強風下以數秒以上的週期擺動，若鋼索某一長度的頻率接近建築頻率，鋼索就會在井道內共振擺動，碰撞井道設備或纏繞。這個問題屬於結構與機電的介面：結構提供建築頻率與擺幅，電梯系統依此設定強風時的停靠樓層、降速或暫停營運模式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「超高速電梯曳引鋼索」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shanghai Tower has 106 elevators with a top speed of 20.5 m/s. Very long hoist and compensation ropes behave like long strings whose natural frequency changes with car position. When the building sways with a period of several seconds in strong wind and some rope length has a frequency near the building's, the rope resonates in the shaft, striking equipment or tangling. This is a structure–services interface: the structure supplies building frequency and amplitude, and the elevator system uses them to set high-wind parking floors, reduced speed or suspended service. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Ultra-fast elevator hoist ropes” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：弦振動頻率 f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: String frequency f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電梯鋼索擺動是機電問題，和結構設計無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Elevator rope sway is a mechanical issue unrelated to structural design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「超高速電梯曳引鋼索」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Ultra-fast elevator hoist ropes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式
knowledge.titleEn: Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes
knowledge.text: 上海中心有 106 部電梯，最高速度 20.5 m/s，超長行程的曳引鋼索與補償鋼索像一條很長的弦，自然頻率隨車廂位置改變。當建築在強風下以數秒以上的週期擺動，若鋼索某一長度的頻率接近建築頻率，鋼索就會在井道內共振擺動，碰撞井道設備或纏繞。
knowledge.textEn: Shanghai Tower has 106 elevators with a top speed of 20.5 m/s. Very long hoist and compensation ropes behave like long strings whose natural frequency changes with car position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電梯鋼索擺動是機電問題，和結構設計無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Elevator rope sway is a mechanical issue unrelated to structural design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes" is correct?
options: 電梯鋼索擺動是機電問題，和結構設計無關。
上海中心有 106 部電梯，最高速度 20.5 m/s，超長行程的曳引鋼索與補償鋼索像一條很長的弦，自然頻率隨車廂位置改變。
扭轉外形純粹是造型，結構只是被動配合。
optionsEn: Elevator rope sway is a mechanical issue unrelated to structural design.
Shanghai Tower has 106 elevators with a top speed of 20.5 m/s.

quiz.explanationEn: Shanghai Tower has 106 elevators with a top speed of 20.5 m/s. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超高速電梯曳引鋼索」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ultra-fast elevator hoist ropes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：弦振動頻率 f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ)。張力 T = 100 kN、單位質量 μ = 8 kg/m 時波速 √(100,000/8) ≈ 112 m/s；自由長度 L = 500 m 時 f ≈ 112/1,000 ≈ 0.112 Hz，與週期 9 s 的建築頻率 0.111 Hz 幾乎相同；車廂移到中段使 L = 250 m 時 f ≈ 0.224 Hz，可避開共振。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: String frequency f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ). With tension T = 100 kN and mass μ = 8 kg/m the wave speed is √(100,000/8) ≈ 112 m/s; for a free length L = 500 m, f ≈ 112/1,000 ≈ 0.112 Hz, almost equal to the 0.111 Hz of a building with a 9 s period; moving the car to mid-height so that L = 250 m gives f ≈ 0.224 Hz, away from resonance. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以結構模型或實測取得建築前幾個模態頻率與預期擺幅，交給電梯廠商做鋼索擺動模擬；完工後在頂部設加速度計與風速計，連動電梯控制系統，於強風事件後檢查井道內鋼索磨損與設備碰撞痕跡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Provide the elevator supplier with the building's first few modal frequencies and expected amplitudes from the model or measurements for rope-sway simulation; after completion link rooftop accelerometers and anemometers to the elevator controls, and after high-wind events inspect shafts for rope wear and impact marks on equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 弦振動頻率 f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ)。張力 T = 100 kN、單位質量 μ = 8 kg/m 時波速 √(100,000/8) ≈ 112 m/s；自由長度 L = 500 m 時 f ≈ 112/1,000 ≈ 0.112 Hz，與週期 9 s 的建築頻率 0.111 Hz 幾乎相同；車廂移到中段使 L = 250 m 時 f ≈ 0.224 Hz，可避開共振。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: String frequency f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ). With tension T = 100 kN and mass μ = 8 kg/m the wave speed is √(100,000/8) ≈ 112 m/s; for a free length L = 500 m, f ≈ 112/1,000 ≈ 0.112 Hz, almost equal to the 0.111 Hz of a building with a 9 s period; moving the car to mid-height so that L = 250 m gives f ≈ 0.224 Hz, away from resonance. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes", which statement holds?
options: 只要巨柱強度足夠，軸壓比高一點也沒關係。
圓形連續壁只是為了配合圓形建築外形。
弦振動頻率 f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ)。
optionsEn: As long as a mega-column is strong enough, a somewhat high axial-load ratio does not matter.
A circular diaphragm wall is simply chosen to match the round building outline.
String frequency f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ).
quiz.explanation: 弦振動頻率 f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: String frequency f = (1/2L)·√(T/μ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「超高速電梯曳引鋼索」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ultra-fast elevator hoist ropes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以結構模型或實測取得建築前幾個模態頻率與預期擺幅，交給電梯廠商做鋼索擺動模擬；完工後在頂部設加速度計與風速計，連動電梯控制系統，於強風事件後檢查井道內鋼索磨損與設備碰撞痕跡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Provide the elevator supplier with the building's first few modal frequencies and expected amplitudes from the model or measurements for rope-sway simulation; after completion link rooftop accelerometers and anemometers to the elevator controls, and after high-wind events inspect shafts for rope wear and impact marks on equipment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構設計者應提供電梯顧問書面的模態頻率、預期擺幅與量測資料，雙方共同訂定強風營運模式的啟動門檻；建築重大改裝或阻尼器調整後，須重新確認這些門檻。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural designer should give the elevator consultant written modal frequencies, expected amplitudes and measured data, and both should set the trigger thresholds for high-wind operating modes; re-confirm these thresholds after major renovations or damper adjustments.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若電梯設計沒有考慮建築擺動，強風時鋼索可能在井道內大幅擺動，撞壞導軌支架或纏住樓層設備，造成長時間停駛；乘客受困於高空車廂也會成為緊急救援的難題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the elevator design ignores building sway, ropes can swing widely in strong wind, damaging rail brackets or snagging landing equipment and causing long outages; passengers trapped in cars at height also become a difficult rescue problem. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以結構模型或實測取得建築前幾個模態頻率與預期擺幅，交給電梯廠商做鋼索擺動模擬；完工後在頂部設加速度計與風速計，連動電梯控制系統，於強風事件後檢查井道內鋼索磨損與設備碰撞痕跡。
knowledge.textEn: Provide the elevator supplier with the building's first few modal frequencies and expected amplitudes from the model or measurements for rope-sway simulation; after completion link rooftop accelerometers and anemometers to the elevator controls, and after high-wind events inspect shafts for rope wear and impact marks on equipment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構設計者應提供電梯顧問書面的模態頻率、預期擺幅與量測資料，雙方共同訂定強風營運模式的啟動門檻；建築重大改裝或阻尼器調整後，須重新確認這些門檻。
knowledge.textEn: The structural designer should give the elevator consultant written modal frequencies, expected amplitudes and measured data, and both should set the trigger thresholds for high-wind operating modes; re-confirm these thresholds after major renovations or damper adjustments.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes"?
options: 以結構模型或實測取得建築前幾個模態頻率與預期擺幅，交給電梯廠商做鋼索擺動模擬。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
樁端注漿只是補救施工缺陷，正常的樁不需要。
optionsEn: Provide the elevator supplier with the building's first few modal frequencies and expected amplitudes from the model or measurements for rope-sway simulation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Base grouting is only a fix for construction defects and sound piles do not need it.
quiz.explanation: 以結構模型或實測取得建築前幾個模態頻率與預期擺幅，交給電梯廠商做鋼索擺動模擬；完工後在頂部設加速度計與風速計，連動電梯控制系統，於強風事件後檢查井道內鋼索磨損與設備碰撞痕跡。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Provide the elevator supplier with the building's first few modal frequencies and expected amplitudes from the model or measurements for rope-sway simulation; after completion link rooftop accelerometers and anemometers to the elevator controls, and after high-wind events inspect shafts for rope wear and impact marks on equipment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「超高速電梯曳引鋼索」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ultra-fast elevator hoist ropes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若電梯設計沒有考慮建築擺動，強風時鋼索可能在井道內大幅擺動，撞壞導軌支架或纏住樓層設備，造成長時間停駛；乘客受困於高空車廂也會成為緊急救援的難題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the elevator design ignores building sway, ropes can swing widely in strong wind, damaging rail brackets or snagging landing equipment and causing long outages; passengers trapped in cars at height also become a difficult rescue problem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個問題屬於結構與機電的介面：結構提供建築頻率與擺幅，電梯系統依此設定強風時的停靠樓層、降速或暫停營運模式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is a structure–services interface: the structure supplies building frequency and amplitude, and the elevator system uses them to set high-wind parking floors, reduced speed or suspended service.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電梯鋼索擺動是機電問題，和結構設計無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Elevator rope sway is a mechanical issue unrelated to structural design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若電梯設計沒有考慮建築擺動，強風時鋼索可能在井道內大幅擺動，撞壞導軌支架或纏住樓層設備，造成長時間停駛；乘客受困於高空車廂也會成為緊急救援的難題。
knowledge.textEn: If the elevator design ignores building sway, ropes can swing widely in strong wind, damaging rail brackets or snagging landing equipment and causing long outages; passengers trapped in cars at height also become a difficult rescue problem.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電梯鋼索共振與強風營運模式」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Elevator rope resonance and high-wind operating modes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若電梯設計沒有考慮建築擺動，強風時鋼索可能在井道內大幅擺動，撞壞導軌支架或纏住樓層設備，造成長時間停駛；乘客受困於高空車廂也會成為緊急救援的難題。
扭轉外形純粹是造型，結構只是被動配合。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If the elevator design ignores building sway, ropes can swing widely in strong wind, damaging rail brackets or snagging landing equipment and causing long outages.
The twisting form is purely aesthetic and the structure merely follows.
quiz.explanation: 若電梯設計沒有考慮建築擺動，強風時鋼索可能在井道內大幅擺動，撞壞導軌支架或纏住樓層設備，造成長時間停駛；乘客受困於高空車廂也會成為緊急救援的難題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the elevator design ignores building sway, ropes can swing widely in strong wind, damaging rail brackets or snagging landing equipment and causing long outages; passengers trapped in cars at height also become a difficult rescue problem. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
